0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.text: An Absolute Must-Do — Top 10 Life Experience for Our Family I don't say this lightly: visiting Elephant Jungle Sanctuary in Phuket was one of the top 10 experiences of my entire life, and my family felt the same way. If you're on the fence about booking this, stop hesitating and just do it. From the moment we arrived, the entire experience was thoughtfully organized and deeply meaningful. We got to feed and touch the elephants up close — something that instantly melted every heart in our group. Then came the mud bath, which was as hilarious as it was unforgettable, followed by splashing around with the elephants in a pool. Pure joy doesn't even begin to cover it. What really set this apart was how much we *learned*. The team took time to introduce each elephant individually — their personalities, their backstories, their quirks. You leave not just with incredible memories and photos, but with a genuine connection to these magnificent animals and a real appreciation for the sanctuary's mission. We also got to make traditional Thai food, which was a wonderful bonus and gave us even more cultural depth to an already packed and incredible day. Now — I have to talk about our guide Minty. She was, without question, the MVP of the entire experience. Smart, funny, warm, and incredibly engaging, she had our whole group laughing and participating from start to finish. She made sure no one was left out and brought so much energy and genuine passion to everything she did. Minty is the kind of guide who elevates a great experience into an unforgettable one. Hannah was also lovely and kind throughout the day as well. If you're visiting Phuket with family, this is a non-negotiable. Book it. You won't regret a single minute.
0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.author: John Daniels

0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.text: We traveled all the way from the Philippines and honestly, 1000% worth it. 🐘💚 Our tour guide Michael was AMAZING. You can instantly tell how passionate he is about elephants. Not the “memorized script” kind of passionate, but the “this man could talk about elephants for 10 business days straight” kind. 😂 He made the whole tour fun, informative, and super engaging. We learned so much from him and he explained everything so well during the orientation, from the dos and don’ts to why the sanctuary cares for the elephants the way they do. What we loved most is how much they genuinely care about the elephants. They’re free to roam around, well taken care of, and the whole experience felt very respectful and educational. You can really see that the elephants’ welfare comes first here, which made the experience even more special. The mahouts were also very friendly! They guided us while feeding the elephants and made us feel comfortable and not scared at all. You can tell they really care both about the elephants and the visitors, especially for first-timers like us. 🐘✨ Also, shoutout to the reception team for being so warm and friendly! They asked where we were from and then started playing Filipino songs at the reception. Instant happiness for us Filipinos abroad. 😂 Special thanks to Ana, Max, Mr. Shao, and Smiley for making our visit even more memorable! If you’re thinking of visiting, do it. Come for the elephants, stay for Michael’s elite elephant TED Talk. 🐘✨
0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.author: Mai Pagkalinawan

0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.text: Absolutely incredible experience from start to finish. The sanctuary is doing such important work rescuing and caring for elephants, and you can genuinely feel the love and dedication from everyone there. I learnt so much about elephants, their behaviour, their history, and the heartbreaking situations many of them were saved from. A massive thank you to our guide K, who was outstanding all day. So knowledgeable, passionate, and engaging you could tell how much they truly care about the elephants and their wellbeing. Hearing the rescue stories and learning about each elephant’s journey made the whole experience even more meaningful. Such a wholesome, eye-opening and unforgettable day. If you’re visiting Phuket, this is an absolute must-do experience. Thank you to everyone at Elephant Jungle Sanctuary for the amazing work you do! 🐘❤️
0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.author: Daniel Bent (DB)

0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.text: I booked the half-day tour. It was my first time experiencing elephants up close. The elephants are very well cared for here and seemed peaceful. At the beginning, the tour itinerary was explained. Sky, who explained everything at the start, was a really friendly and humorous person. Afterwards, we were allowed to feed the elephants watermelons, then prepare food and take mud baths with the elephants, followed by bathing with them in clean water. The elephants were very peaceful and let us stroke them without any problems. I had the impression that they really enjoyed it and the staff treated the animals with great sensitivity. Afterwards, there was a cooking class on how to prepare Pad Thai. I really recommend it and it was a wonderful morning.
0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.author: Sven

0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.text: A must do experience!!! What can I say, such a well designed informative tour and experience with these majestic animals. The organisation has a few other sanctuaries across Thailand. The elephants are rescued from the timber logging industry, entertainment (rides and circus tricks) are brought here to live from the mainland. Phuket has no wild elephants. We did the half day experience witj elephant feeding (watermelon amd sugarcane) making elephant rice balls (and feeding them), mud spa session amd elephant bathing ( you scrub them), shower off time and a lovely lunch. Bonus extra are the free high res photographs taken by their professional photographer you can download from a QR code link after the session.
0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.author: Hannah Cullup

0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.text: What a fantastic and rewarding experience! The Elephant Jungle Sanctuary provides a healthy environment for rescued elephants, in essence a retirement home for them. Our guide for the morning was Nancy, she was very knowledgeable, and obviously cares deeply for these gentle giants. We got to observe, feed, wash, make up meals and just be with the elephants. They are clearly well cared for by their assigned caretakers. There are excellent gift shops, and I would urge you to spend generously as you are supporting what is a hugely worthwhile sanctuary. Thank you Nancy for your guidance and information, we look forward to returning in the very near future.
0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.author: Tim Cowley

0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.text: One of the most beautiful and meaningful experiences I’ve ever had. This place truly cares about the elephants. There is no riding, no chains, and no harm—you can clearly see that the elephants are treated with love and respect. We had the chance to feed them, interact with them, and even help bathe them, which made the experience feel real and special, not touristy at all. The staff are very professional and kind, and they explain everything in a way that makes you appreciate how important ethical treatment is. If you are in Phuket, this is a must-do experience. Not only is it fun, but it also feels right. Highly recommended! 🐘💚
0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.author: Alaa Nas

0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.text: We found this place by accident while driving round in our rental car. WOW! We really loved getting up close with the elephants and learning about them. I almost walked off when I found out it was 2000baht/person for the elephant bath and feeding but after going for it I’m so glad I did. It was absolutely amazing. The elephant bath was great fun and it was amazing to be up close and personal with the elephants. The staff at the place are such helpful, friendly and nice people. We wondered off with the wrong group and instead of losing out - the guy noticed we were missing from the right group and came and got us. Thankyou! We got to make a food ball using a giant mortar and pestle with rice, banana and salt and feed this and bamboo to the elephants. All the staff were taking our phones of us to take pictures of us with the elephants. It was a really great experience and I’m so glad being tight didn’t make us miss out on it. We would love to come back here on our next holiday to Phuket 😍🐘
0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.author: Alexander Galley

0x30e29faf057b33f1_0x7ae09baf75e9f743.author: Axel Petit

0x30e29ef6f7a79945_0x15b0c644fc631423.text: I had an absolutely outstanding experience at Thantakit and can recommend them with full confidence. I travelled from Singapore to Bangkok for fairly extensive dental treatment over the course of three days and numerous appointments, and the clinic exceeded my expectations in every way. From the very beginning, their communication was clear, transparent, professional, and incredibly efficient. They explained the treatment plan, staging, timeline, and costs very clearly, which made it so much easier to plan from abroad. What stood out to me most was how organized and capable the team was. In one weekend, they managed a significant amount of treatment while still making me feel calm, informed, and very well cared for. Besides, It was possibly the least painful experience I ever had for such heavy procedures. I never before found myself in a situation where I had to ask the dentist whether I have already received the injection because I was feeling the numbness kick in!!! I especially want to mention Dr. Jenjira (General dentist), who really gave me the feeling that she cares deeply about saving teeth whenever possible and does not take decisions lightly. I truly appreciated her warm, non-judgemental, and clear approach. I also want to thank Dr. Chatruethai, who was an extremely skilled implantologist and made me feel deeply informed every step of the way. That made a huge difference to me, especially during a treatment process that could otherwise have felt quite overwhelming. Overall, the whole team was extraordinarily kind, professional, reassuring, and clearly very experienced with international patients. I came to Bangkok hoping to find a strong and more affordable alternative to treatment in Singapore, and I genuinely feel I found not only a better-value option, but also an excellent clinic with OUTSTANDING service. If you are considering dental treatment in Thailand, especially more complex work such as implants, crowns, restorative treatment, or cosmetic dentistry, I would highly recommend Thantakit. My experience was extremely positive, and I am very happy I chose them.

After escaping Dubai when the Iran war began, I found myself in Bangkok. I’ve always wanted to get veneers done due to tetracycline staining on my top teeth but the cost of it in the US is so high! It was the perfect opportunity for me to get it done at Thantakit. I had inquired about pricing a couple of years ago but didn’t have any concrete plans to go to Thailand to get it done. I called them on Friday and they were able to squeeze me in the next day. I had my consultation and got a cleaning done and came back Monday for my prep work. My temporary veneers cracked the next day which was unfortunate as I couldn’t enjoy a lot of food during my trip but the results were well worth it. My final placement was a week later and the final follow up for adjustments was the next day. It took 10 days in total. Dr. J (Dr. Adison Jirasuwannakul) did my veneers. I just recently went to my regular dentist and I felt ashamed, kind of like I cheated on him because he knew I wanted veneers done and I always talked about doing them with him. Anyway, my dentist was so thrilled for me and said they looked wonderful. The color was great and upon looking at my x-rays, he said the veneers were perfectly overlapped and that doesn’t always happen. He said my veneers were done extremely well. I was happy with my smile but as I’m not a dentist, I didn’t know if they were done properly so it was wonderful to hear from my dentist whom I trust explicitly to say that my veneers were done extremely well. I also had my 1 year old and 4 year old son with me and I asked if the clinic could watch him during my follow up appointments and they were so willing. My husband ended up being able to watch them so I didn’t bring them along but the staff asked where my little kids were!! That was so sweet. They also will pick you up from the hotel and drop you off so you don’t need to worry about transportation. I highly recommend this clinic. It’s always scary to get any procedures done especially in a foreign country where English is not there first language but this place was wonderful.

Late last year I travelled to Bangkok for dental treatment at Thantakit Dental Center.The Dental Center is exceptionally clean and the staff are friendly, kind and efficient. Por, the lady coordinating my treatment, was extremely competent and spoke very good English, as did most of the dentists and staff that I met. All dental sub specialities are catered for at Thantakit. I made two trips, the first being for deep cleaning, 5 root canals and 1 extraction, (all completely pain free). These procedures were in preparation for the fitting of multiple crowns, which was carried out during my second trip. I had received a written quotation for the work based on X rays and photographs prior to travelling to Bangkok. My front teeth were in a very cracked and worn condition and I was to have up to 26 crowns fitted. When I arrived I was introduced to Dr Piyaorn Taksaphan, who was to be my prosthodontist. After examining my teeth Dr Piyaorn suggested that I have crowns only on my front teeth since my back teeth were healthy and I ended up getting 8 upper and 6 lower crowns with the price reduced accordingly. I had told Dr Piyaorn of my wish to have natural looking teeth, particularly for them to not be too white and artificial looking and she took great care to find a suitable shade. My temporary crowns were in two slightly different shades of white, top and bottom, so that I could assess which I preferred and get the opinion of family members prior to installation of my permanent crowns. These were fitted a week later and are just marvelous ! I returned a few days after this and Dr Piyaorn spent quite some time making minor adjustments until my bite was completely comfortable. I am ecstatic with the results of my treatment and highly recommend Thantakit Dental Centre for any type of dental treatment. Thank you Dr Piyaorn and everyone at Thantakit for giving my smile back to me!

I had a fantastic experience at Thantakit International Dental Clinic. The entire team was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and professional from the moment I arrived. They made me feel comfortable and were very helpful throughout the entire process. I’m from Australia and travelled to Thailand for my dental work because the cost in Australia was significantly higher. Despite coming for the lower price, the quality of care I received was exceptional — the service was truly amazing. My dentist, Dr Ueawitthayasuporn, was excellent. She explained everything clearly and took the time to make sure I understood each step of the procedure. I really appreciated how straightforward and honest she was about the treatment and what to expect. The procedure itself went smoothly, and Dr Ueawitthayasuporn made sure I was comfortable the whole time. I felt very well looked after and confident in the care I received. Overall, it was a very positive experience. I would highly recommend Thantakit International Dental Clinic to anyone looking for professional, friendly, and well-priced dental care.

AMAZING * * * * * DENTISTRY Thantakit Dental Center is amazing! Firstly the incredible reception staff, Mattana, Bam, Aon, Por and Mimi take care of you from the moment you arrive. The customer service and care given is on par with a First Class flight on the best airlines in the world. Unfortunately, I am an extremely nervous dental patient, usually arriving at any dental surgery highly stressed and not wanting to be there! So when I arrived at Thanakit Dental Center in 2019 for my first two dental implants, I was not only stressed but had high blood pressure & needed time to calm down. Those two implants were done by implant specialist Dr Thara Sirikrai, he put me at ease, worked extremely fast and the whole procedure was almost painless, how could that be? Dr Thara Sirikrai is a remarkable dental specialist and now I am back for my third Implant and again with Dr Thara Sirikrai. Lastly replacing missing teeth with implants is something you should not delay, it was one of my best ever decisions. My advice, just do it.....

Six Dental Implants, Upper Jaw — Thantakit International Dental Center As a maritime consultant, I spend my working life assessing ships standards, precision, and reliability — qualities I don't take lightly, whether on a vessel or in a clinic. My experience at Thantakit over the past two to three weeks in Bangkok met that same bar in every respect. I underwent a full upper jaw restoration with six implants, and the professionalism throughout was outstanding. The technology, equipment, and materials used reflected genuinely international standards, and every step was clearly explained. What stood out most was the personal attention — the staff's warmth and care made a demanding treatment feel like a genuinely positive experience. That balance of clinical excellence and human touch is rare. I'll be back in Bangkok soon for a follow-up review of the implants, and I'm looking forward to seeing this excellent team again. Highly recommended.

I would like to highly recommend Thantakit Dental Center for anyone seeking advanced dental care, especially implant treatment. My dental implant procedure was personally handled by Dr. Thara, who is truly outstanding in this field. His expertise, precision, and confidence clearly reflect his position as a top-level implant specialist. Dr. Thara takes exceptional care of his patients. He is attentive, detail-oriented, and works efficiently while ensuring comfort and safety at every step. I was particularly impressed by the use of advanced innovations and state-of-the-art dental technology, which made the entire treatment process smooth and reassuring. The staff at Thantakit Dental Center are consistently kind, polite, and highly professional, creating a very welcoming and comfortable atmosphere. The clinic itself is modern, well organized, and conveniently located with easy access, making each visit stress-free.

Dr. Ekarin Booncheerdchaiyan was absolutely outstanding. I was on holiday in Bangkok when a tooth with a large filling suddenly broke, leaving me needing dental treatment. From the moment I met Dr. Ekarin, he made me feel completely at ease with his calm, reassuring manner and clear explanations of every step of the procedure. He removed the tooth with such skill that I experienced no pain during the extraction, and the whole experience was far less stressful than I had imagined. I am truly grateful for the exceptional care and kindness I received and would highly recommend Dr. Ekarin to anyone looking for a highly skilled, compassionate, and professional dentist in Bangkok. I will be back soon to get implants I’m totally 100% on that

0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.text: Sura Korean BBQ & Tofu House is a cozy, unpretentious spot that delivers authentic Korean flavors with a focus on hearty tofu soups, flavorful grilled meats, and a variety of vegan-friendly options. The portions are generous, the banchan is satisfying, and the service is welcoming, making it a great choice for both casual dinners and group outings. While the space is modest and it can get busy during peak hours, the food more than makes up for it, offering comforting, well-seasoned dishes that appeal to meat-eaters and vegetarians alike. Overall, it’s a reliable, delicious destination for anyone craving authentic Korean comfort food outside the hustle of Koreatown
0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.author: Kirsten Galido

0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.text: I had a wonderful experience at SURA Korean. The food was authentic, fresh, and full of flavor — every dish felt like it was made with great care. The side dishes were generous and delicious, and the BBQ was cooked to perfection. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, making it a great place for both casual dining and special occasions. The staff were very friendly, attentive, and always ready to explain the menu or recommend dishes. Service was quick and professional, which made the whole experience even better. If you’re looking for authentic Korean food with excellent service, I highly recommend SURA Korean. I’ll definitely be coming back!
0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.author: jackson son

0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.text: Food is good, but the queuing process is a bit unwelcoming and annoying. Fresh vegetables are for free refills, especially the oba leaves which normally you need to pay to get them. Side dishes were very tasty, and free refills similar to other korean restaurants. The grilled pork is average, but the stand out here is the pork intestines, very hard to find. The fluffy steamed eggs were just average, soup is good especially the tofu soup with clams. Recommend to make the reservation in advance because it’s usually full and need to wait due to size of the store. Free parking space in front.
0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.author: Nuch Suppanuch

0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.text: Mind-blowing! This was hands down my best Korean BBQ experience ever. Ordered the friends set + cold noodles and we were filled to the brim. The service was exceptional - the manager lady served us, and helped cook the meat to perfection. She even taught us the best way to make a ssam with the lettuce, perilla leaf, onion and chili. The quality of the food was also amazing, and it was seriously the best samgyapsal and intestines we've had. Highly recommend this restaurant. We will definitely be back again when we return to Bangkok one day.
0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.author: Amanda Teo

0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.text: Absolute hidden gem! Found this place accidentally but loving it! Generous portions, food tastes delicious especially Kimchi Jim, one of my favorites place in Bangkok (very rare to find this menu). Parking is a bit challenging but never have problems. The place has two portions of space so if you sit on the outside, you won’t get much attention from the staff. But overall I really like the food. Recommend.
0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.author: Natchonlathon Kodsup

0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.text: The food was delicious. The price was reasonable considering the quality. The premium ribs were tender and tasted amazing with just salt and wasabi. The grilled intestines were crispy and odorless. There were plenty of side dishes, and they were all delicious. The staff provided good service and refilled items frequently. Parking was convenient as there was a parking lot right in front of the restaurant.
0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.author: Aui Petitz

0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.text: SURA Korean BBQ impresses with its straightforward, delicious Korean food. The spicy stew is comforting with its mix of tofu and vegetables. The pork on the grill is the star, tender and flavorful, getting a nice smoky touch from the charcoal. Fresh lettuce adds crunch, perfect for wrapping the pork. It's a great spot for anyone wanting a taste of Korea with the fun of cooking right at your table.
0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.author: Phonlapat A

0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.text: Sura Korean BBQ Bangkok — Sura’s owner and chef learnt cooking from a Buddhist nun, Soenjae, the master of temple food, and value the harmony of nature’s diverse ingredients. We did not try Sura’s traditional chicken soup which has been awarded the Blue Ribbon Survey, Korea’s Michelin for 4 years in a row 2014-2017. Food wise, nothing to scream about but if you are looking for a quick affordable meal in the Sukhumvit area, this would be the place. It’s Korean no doubt but not the best quality Korean. Unexpectedly the notable dish was the cold buckwheat noodles (199B). We ordered the Friends Set (999B++) ideal for 3 persons -- Pork Belly (200g) Pork Blade Shoulder (200g), Kimchi Stew, Steam Egg Hotpot with Cheese. The vegetables were fresh and succulent. The popular boneless beef short ribs (730B 150g) was sold out when we came at about 2pm. We had the Premium Kkotgalbisal, highly marbled boneless beef short rib (870B 150g), but quality wise, it was on the low-end. The restaurant is cosy yet not cramped, having nice defined space for diners. March 7, 2024
0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.author: Onestonebooks

0x30e29e8734d33061_0x7a5bb80e48470737.text: I was visiting from abroad and needed some dental work done. I went to BIDC Main on Ratchadaphisek Road for a teeth cleaning and several cavity fillings, and I had a wonderful experience from start to finish. The clinic was exceptionally clean, and every staff member—from the receptionists and nurses who took my vital signs to the dentist—was professional, welcoming, and genuinely kind. They patiently answered all of my questions, and because the staff spoke excellent English, communication was easy and stress-free. I was able to get my treatment done in the same day. My dentist, Dr. Nonthapan, was incredibly thorough and detail-oriented. She took the time to explain each procedure, why it was necessary, and made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire visit. She was meticulous with my fillings and ensured my teeth looked and felt just right before I left. The aftercare instructions were clear, easy to understand, and very helpful. I felt completely safe and confident in her care. Her assistant, Rin, was also wonderful—kind, attentive, and supportive throughout the entire process. I highly recommend BIDC Main to anyone, especially international visitors looking for high-quality dental care in Bangkok. I will definitely return here for any future dental needs whenever I’m in Bangkok. -Amina

I found this clinic two days ago because, before leaving my country, I broke part of a tooth and didn’t have time to see a dentist. I was in a desperate situation, and during a layover in Bangkok (I had 5 hours, including travel to the clinic), I searched for this clinic and walked in without an appointment. The receptionist attended to me immediately, and when I explained that I was in a hurry to catch my connecting flight, one of the dentists took me in right away. He examined me thoroughly and explained all my options, considering the limited time. He also clearly told me the total cost for the examination and the repair, and once I agreed, he spent about an hour working on my tooth. In my non-professional opinion, he did a perfect job. Honestly, I believe it was done better—and cheaper—than it would have been in my home country. In the future, if I need to have something more expensive done, I’m seriously considering buying a ticket and combining it with a vacation. I can highly recommend this clinic. The doctors and the entire staff here should be paid in gold for their kindness and professional approach. Thank you so much!

I had an amazing experience at BIDC! I came for teeth whitening and composite bonding on my upper teeth, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. The entire staff was incredible — from the reception and secretaries to the assistants and my dentist, Dr. Kitinun Tissanavasoontra. Everyone was friendly, attentive, and very professional. They were also extremely responsive by email and made the whole process smooth and stress-free. I really appreciated how much time Dr. Kitinun took to make sure I was comfortable and happy with every detail. He even prepared a mock-up first so I could approve the shape and color before doing the final work, which gave me so much confidence. The clinic is modern, clean, and very well organized. I’m so happy with my new smile — natural, comfortable, and exactly what I wanted. Thank you to the whole BIDC team, and especially Dr. Kitinun, for their kindness and professionalism. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for top-quality dental care in Bangkok!
0x30e29e8734d33061_0x7a5bb80e48470737.author: Yann Le Bihan

0x30e29e8734d33061_0x7a5bb80e48470737.text: I had some composite bonding done in Singapore ( Royal Smile) after reading some 5 * reviews. It did give me the Hollywood white but the application was bordering on dangerously illegal in the dentistry world standards. My husband’s bonding gave him a very bad breath, it started smelling bad after about 2 weeks into the bonding being applied. We could not put a finger to it until we went on a holiday to Bangkok. We decided to google for a dentist and chanced upon BIDC. We were allocated Dr Jirach S. He is such a young chap, ever so patient he explained all the ‘overhangs’ that’s trapping food which explains the smells. It was so bad you could hang a floss on tooth where it attaches to gum line. I had all my composite removed. Dr Jirach was really careful not to remove my real enamel and I must say he’s done a great job. I strongly recommend this dental centre as they are all dentist, not beauticians who cares only about the smile and colour of tooth.

A first class clinic. Located between 2 stations of the MRT blue line, Huai Khwang and Thailand Cultural Centre. Clean environment, friendly staff. The implantologist and the dentist have done a good job. The prices are lower than in France. And you can obtain an appointment for the next days. Quite no pain for my Straumann implant. Surgery at 06.00 PM. In the evening I have eaten some ice creams. I have eaten 2 breakfasts the morning after at the hotel which is located inside the building of the clinic. The bleeding had completely stopped and the pain disappeared. The dentist has taken care of a cavity and filed the resin of the next tooth that the French dentist had put in excess. To-day, Dr. Chatchai, the implantologist has warned me about the weakness of the tooth next to my implant. I have a better healthcare here than In France. And Cheaper !

I rarely write reviews unless I’m truly satisfied with the service. I previously had new dentures made at BIDC and recently decided to go back for two dental implants. The service was excellent from both the dentists and the staff. For 10 years, I struggled with uncomfortable dentures. That changed when I got my new set from BIDC. When I say they were good, I mean they were durable, fit well, and significantly improved my speech and pronunciation. Eventually, I decided I wanted something more permanent and chose to get implants. The dentist was incredibly professional. He guided me through the entire process and explained every step clearly. I didn’t feel any pain, not even during the healing process. It was smooth and seamless. Although I still have a few missing teeth, I plan to have them implanted soon as well. BIDC has earned my trust!

I don’t even know where to begin with this location. The service and attentiveness they express is more than 5 star! As an American I’ve been to numerous dentist all over the U.S. and have been left traumatized when it comes to any dental needing to be done, so over the years I have neglected my teeth. Coming to BIDC, has rebuilt my trust and confidence when it comes to any dental service I may need. It makes you wonder what are they doing differently from America? From the ground floor and throughout the building , Very professional , clean facilities, all around great service 10/10 ! Will be coming here for any and everything and highly recommend . 👍
0x30e29e8734d33061_0x7a5bb80e48470737.author: Jonathan Rushin

0x30e29e8734d33061_0x7a5bb80e48470737.text: Coming from the UK, I could not recommend this place more. If you’re considering getting some treatment done, definitely do! I got quoted £1,800 in the UK at a badly rated private dentist, for the exact same treatment at this 5 star dentist in Bangkok I got quoted about £500. Huge money saving and the treatment was amazing! It feels 5 star from the second you enter, the doorman and receptionists are lovely, you then get checked by the nurse and get taken to your floor. My dentist Dr. Sawalak Suttaket was kind, professional & thorough. I felt comfortable in all 4 of my appointments & am very happy with the service! I have a whole new set of teeth!

0x30da3bf3fb7605af_0x64f05d0cadd9c34e.text: Update - we came back the following day for a 2hr hot oil aroma massage and they again did an excellent job! They were very professional and ensured that we had a relaxing massage. The facility is clean and inviting. Highly recommended! Also want to share that we also tried another popular massage spa nearby that garnered thousands of reviews (cozy) and it was a very disappointing experience. They talked the whole time. We will never go back there and disappointed in ourselves for trying it rather than coming back to Square. My husband and I got the 90 min Thai massage and left feeling so refreshed and relaxed. You leave your shoes at the door and they give you slides to wear. You get a pre-masssage drink, then they give you a shirt and pants to wear during the massage, afterwards you get a hot drink and crackers. The ladies had the best pressure and did an amazing job, we both fell asleep. The front desk staff were friendly and helpful. They accept credit cards with a 3% fee in case you don't have cash. We will definitely be back!!
0x30da3bf3fb7605af_0x64f05d0cadd9c34e.author: Mary LeCompte

0x30da3bf3fb7605af_0x64f05d0cadd9c34e.text: I visited The Square Massage in Chiang Mai, and honestly, it was one of the best massages I’ve ever had. The place feels calm and welcoming the moment you walk in. The staff are incredibly kind, professional, and really know what they’re doing. My therapist listened to what I needed, focused on the right areas, and the pressure was perfect the entire time. I walked out feeling lighter, relaxed, and totally refreshed. The studio is clean, peaceful, and beautifully maintained you can tell they really care about their guests. If you’re in Chiang Mai and looking for an amazing massage experience, The Square Massage is 100% worth it. I’d definitely come back!
0x30da3bf3fb7605af_0x64f05d0cadd9c34e.author: Amelie Döbler

0x30da3bf3fb7605af_0x64f05d0cadd9c34e.text: Second time here. They are warm welcoming at the first moment after you remove your shoes outside. They give you slippers once you entered the shop. Tea and wet towel are offered and your feet will get cleansed. This time I did a 2-hr Thai body massage with Thai herbal hot compress massage with 990 baht. The lady was very professional and kind. Her strength was at the point and she could feel and sense places where my body needs her energy to adjust. It was such a great and relaxing experience. With soft background music that helps to unwind and I got a private room. It felt really nice! I wish I can come every day. Haha
0x30da3bf3fb7605af_0x64f05d0cadd9c34e.author: Annie Yuen

0x30da3bf3fb7605af_0x64f05d0cadd9c34e.text: a comfortable and reliable place to relax, especially after a long day of walking or exploring. It’s a good option if you’re looking for a solid massage experience without anything overly fancy. Highlights • Professional therapists — pressure can be adjusted upon request • Clean and relaxing environment • Offers Thai massage, oil massage, and foot massage • Good value for the quality of service • Great for relieving shoulder and leg tension Overall The Square Massage is a dependable spot to unwind and recharge during your trip. If you need a break for your body, this place is worth considering.
0x30da3bf3fb7605af_0x64f05d0cadd9c34e.author: Sanj

0x30da3bf3fb7605af_0x64f05d0cadd9c34e.text: This was an amazing experience. Traditions foot wash but with nice herbs and yogurt, milk, and salt scrub. The massages were very skilled and relaxing. Then to finish it off they offered complimentary Khaotan and bael fruit tea. On top of all that they offer one free item of select choices for filling out a review. The staff was extremely kind, polite, generous, professional, and helpful. Most also spoke very good English. Recommend 10/10 although more luxury than local massage it is well worth it and has some GREAT promotions for couples.
0x30da3bf3fb7605af_0x64f05d0cadd9c34e.author: marquise humphrey

0x30da3bf3fb7605af_0x64f05d0cadd9c34e.text: I recently had a head, back and shoulders massage (1 hour) and it was a wonderful experience. The treatment was done in a private room with quiet, relaxing music playing in the background, which made it easy to unwind The therapist was very professional, and the whole environment felt clean, quiet, and welcoming. The staff were also very friendly, which added to the overall comfort The massage itself was excellent—firm, thorough, and exactly what I needed. I left feeling refreshed and relieved of tension. Highly recommended!
0x30da3bf3fb7605af_0x64f05d0cadd9c34e.author: דבורה מילוא רומי

0x30da3bf3fb7605af_0x64f05d0cadd9c34e.text: Excellent! The staff speaks both English and Chinese very well, communication was no problem, and they were very friendly. The environment was very clean; the service was attentive and friendly, and the air smelled wonderful. We had a foot massage and a Thai massage, and the masseuses were all very professional and enthusiastic. If we felt uncomfortable at all during the massage, we could just let them know, and they would immediately make adjustments. Highly recommended!
0x30da3bf3fb7605af_0x64f05d0cadd9c34e.author: ming

0x30da3bf3fb7605af_0x64f05d0cadd9c34e.text: Found this gem while walking around and let me tell you, best decision ever to step in. Reception was amazing and friendly. The massage lady was just as friendly (haha we laughed about using bathroom instead of toilet, I forgot that it’s toilet in other countries). Honestly One of the best massages I’ve gotten in a long time!!! 10/10 would recommend!!! We also go some treats after soo the aftercare is a nice touch!!
0x30da3bf3fb7605af_0x64f05d0cadd9c34e.author: Lungile Ravuku

0x30e2984634badc79_0xd5f0e330080118f4.text: I had a very good experience here. The admissions staff were friendly, kind and helpful. When I was trying to change specialty departments, a staff member (and translator), came to assist me and stayed with me throughout the process. My wait time in the women's health center was very fast. The doctor spoke excellent English and was very kind, understanding and thorough. He answered all of my questions and gave me a very good overview of my results and next steps. I am very satisfied. Prices seemed reasonable, too (especially for the speed and quality I was provided).
0x30e2984634badc79_0xd5f0e330080118f4.author: Vicki P

0x30e2984634badc79_0xd5f0e330080118f4.text: They even have a valet service! Went today for an annual medical checkup Service is great, the staffs speak decent english. Doctors are helpful. They have interpreters on standby if you ever need them. As of Mar 2026, a checkup for a work permit extension costs 1100B; which is extremely fair given the service and ammenities.
0x30e2984634badc79_0xd5f0e330080118f4.author: Nick H

0x30e2984634badc79_0xd5f0e330080118f4.text: I came here because of my menstrual cramps, which was badly hurting and I almost fainted. The staffs were very helpful and kind. You can ask for an English translator and they’ll help you assessing your symptoms. I went to a gynecologist, he spoke little English but was very thorough. 10/10 service, thank you so much!
0x30e2984634badc79_0xd5f0e330080118f4.author: Christy Olivianny

0x30e2984634badc79_0xd5f0e330080118f4.text: The service is very satisfying and staff are very helpful. I would love to come again in next year for medical check up. Thanks all.

0x30e2984634badc79_0xd5f0e330080118f4.text: This is a largehospital, but its management and service processes are relatively slow compared to other major hospitals in the same area. If you’re not in a hurry and can spare about two hours, it’s fine to use their services. However, if you need quicker service, it’s better to go to another hospital, as the quality of treatment, doctors, and pricing are essentially the same.
0x30e2984634badc79_0xd5f0e330080118f4.author: Supaporn Cherdchupanyachon

0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.text: I had a great experience from start to finish. The staff were very professional and friendly, and they took the time to explain the entire whitening process before we began. One thing I really appreciated was that they first did a shade comparison of my teeth, so I could clearly see my starting color and track the results afterward. It made the treatment feel much more personalized and transparent. They offer three different whitening packages depending on your goals and budget, which I thought was great because there wasn’t any pressure to choose the most expensive option. The staff patiently explained the differences between each service and helped me select the one that suited me best. The clinic itself was clean, comfortable, and welcoming. The treatment was straightforward, and the staff checked in regularly to make sure I was comfortable throughout the session. I noticed a visible improvement in the brightness of my teeth afterward, and seeing the before-and-after shade comparison was very satisfying. Overall, the experience exceeded my expectations. The combination of professional service, clear explanations, comfortable environment, and noticeable results made it well worth it. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone considering teeth whitening, whether it’s your first time or you’ve had whitening treatments before. I’ll definitely be coming back again in the future! 😊✨
0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.author: Valencia Hartono

0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.text: TLDR- awesome experience I recommend and will be a returning customer in the future. Now for the whole story. I’m on vacation in Thailand for the next several days but getting my teeth whitened at the smile bar in Bangkok was top on my to do list. I went there today and the service was top notch. Very welcoming and professional from the moment I walked in the door. They explained their whitening process and offered recommendations as well as set realistic expectations when discussing the results I would see. After examining my teeth the recommended a cleaning first, which of course I had completed. Every step and action was explained and I do not feel like the time I spent there was used efficiently. Highly recommend and I will definitely be back for future treatments.
0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.author: M G

0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.text: I recently visited your Siam location for a teeth whitening session, and I wanted to express my gratitude for the outstanding service I received. From the moment I walked in, I was impressed by the modern, clean environment, which immediately put me at ease.The consultation was thorough, and the staff made sure I was comfortable and informed throughout the entire process. The use of advanced technology, which delivered incredible results with zero pain, exceeded my expectations. After about 45 minutes, I left with a noticeably brighter smile that I'm thrilled with.Thank you for making my experience so positive. I will definitely recommend The Smile Bar to friends and family and look forward to returning for future treatments.
0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.author: Chong Chee Kiong

0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.text: I had a really great experience at Smile Bar. The whole process was smooth from start to finish, and the staff made me feel comfortable and well taken care of. They explained everything clearly before starting, which helped me relax. The treatment itself was quick and surprisingly comfortable. I could already see a noticeable difference right after the session — my teeth looked brighter and more even in color. The place is clean, modern, and very professional. I also appreciated how friendly and attentive everyone was throughout. Overall, I’m very happy with the results and would definitely recommend Smile Bar to anyone looking for an easy and effective teeth whitening experience.
0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.author: Olivier Leung

0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.text: Amazing experience at The Smile Bar! The service here is absolutely top-notch—the staff were incredibly professional, welcoming, and attentive throughout the whole process. Most importantly, the treatment actually works! My teeth went from shade 24 to shade 16 in just one session, and I couldn't be happier with the visible results. On top of the great service and results, the pricing is highly reasonable and offers great value. I will definitely be coming back next time. Highly recommended!
0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.author: KA MEI Chui

0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.text: My friend and i really wanted to leverage all Bangkok had to offer and whitening out teeth was at the top of the list. We found this place with Gemini and they were highly rated and rightfully so. Really professional and great service. The results are quite quick but my teeth were already quite white so the upgrade was abiut 2 shades. I did 1 session and the nano protect (which i really encourage). Def book this and do it in advance so you dont miss out. Theyre worth it!
0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.author: Isaac Elyahou

0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.text: Absolutely amazing! The Smile Bar exceeded all my expectations. The whole team was super friendly and professional, and the vibe was just wonderful. The interior is an absolute dream – modern, stylish and cozy all at once. And the best part: the prices are totally reasonable and fair! Everything was just perfect. Highly recommend – I will definitely be back! 😊
0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.author: Ferran Krüger

0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.text: Really good and professional dental place for cleaning, polishing and whitening! Prices are reasonable and affordable as well. Dr Thananya is v friendly and reassuring, kept checking in to make sure I am comfortable. Special thanks to receptionist assistants Sofia and Nuna for being friendly. They are all fluent in English as well. Highly recommend!
0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.author: Angel Tan

0x30e299e13ca0eda5_0x9a81af58f887abb3.text: This is a local market situated 7 km far from Bang Wa BTS Station (S12). Therefore, it needs to take another transportation to the market. As I mentioned above. Majority of the customers are localize instead of tourist. There are few fresh seafood stalls with free cooking service provide. The seafood price set is fair. Normally cheapest than some other stalls such as night market. Inside and surrounding with many stalls selling some other drink and Thai's food. There is tables and chairs for customers for having the food right here.
0x30e299e13ca0eda5_0x9a81af58f887abb3.author: Kenny Wong

0x30e299e13ca0eda5_0x9a81af58f887abb3.text: I love coming here! The food is always delicious, and there’s plenty of parking available. It’s never too crowded, which makes the dining experience even better. My favorite dish is the grilled salmon belly – it’s perfectly cooked and full of flavor. They offer a great variety, so there’s something for everyone. Lately, they’ve even had live music on some days, which adds to the nice atmosphere. Highly recommend Effotae for a tasty and relaxing meal.
0x30e299e13ca0eda5_0x9a81af58f887abb3.author: Fangkamonchanok Int

0x30e299e13ca0eda5_0x9a81af58f887abb3.text: Right before the circle is this awesome food market. Party of 4 all had food from different shops. I already need to go back and eat from more shops. Highly recommended to level up your Thai food eating game. Kanom buang not shown was delicious. Bearhouse smoothies and drinks is a great shop. My favorite compared to similar shops. We had pad kraprow and 3 various noodles dishes plus Khao mun kai. The soup. 10/10.
0x30e299e13ca0eda5_0x9a81af58f887abb3.author: Michael Metzger

0x30e299e13ca0eda5_0x9a81af58f887abb3.text: It is a big open-air market in Ratchapruek, western Bangkok. You can many things to do here. I like fruit and food stalls. There are all kinds of Thai fruits such as durian, rose apple, mango, guava and pomelo. My mother-in-law likes shopping and buying vegetables. You can eat a variety of foods. I recommend you to visit Bear Bowl and Sushi Haru. For desserts, you can try waffle with ice-cream from Maru Waffle.
0x30e299e13ca0eda5_0x9a81af58f887abb3.author: Emre Senbabaoglu

0x30e299e13ca0eda5_0x9a81af58f887abb3.text: Usually, I’m not a big fan of non air-conditioned places as the heat in Bangkok is unbearable. However, this might be my first 5-star rating of a flea market. On the surface, it doesn’t see to be too great, but all the shops are excellent. Not only does it have some of my favorite shops, but the others also make really high quality and good-tasting food.
0x30e299e13ca0eda5_0x9a81af58f887abb3.author: zxtremedemon

0x30e299e13ca0eda5_0x9a81af58f887abb3.text: Food Villa Ratchaphruek is a great local spot with plenty of street food options, especially during the evenings when the market comes alive with various vendors and even live music. It’s a smaller market compared to Thonburi Market Place but has its charm. Daytime visitors can enjoy fresh and affordable seafood, while evenings offer a wide variety of snacks, meals, and drinks. The market has convenience stores, a dental clinic, drugstores, Starbucks, and even pet shops, making it pretty versatile. It’s not air-conditioned, but it stays relatively cool inside. Parking is ample, which is a big plus. Overall, it’s a cozy, laid-back market for both quick bites and casual dinners.
0x30e299e13ca0eda5_0x9a81af58f887abb3.author: Moshi J.

0x30e299e13ca0eda5_0x9a81af58f887abb3.text: There are many shops in the food villa with food stalls, clothes stalls, and accessories for you to shop from. While the prices are a bit higher than many markets, you can still afford to buy and enjoy your food here. It is always difficult to find a parking spot, despite the fact that there are many parking areas. My family's favorite stall is Home Style Fried Rice, which is open only in the evening. In this stall, you can choose from a variety of Fried Rice options. In our family, we love Chinese sausage fried rice, salty fish friend rice, and crispy pork fried rice.
0x30e299e13ca0eda5_0x9a81af58f887abb3.author: Natalie Myer

0x30e299e13ca0eda5_0x9a81af58f887abb3.text: The market and food court were very congested at lunchtime on a weekend. I don't know if it's because Thais are supporting Thais, but finding parking was difficult. There were a lot of people inside, and it was hard to find a seat. There were many restaurants with a wide variety of choices, but there were few and few coffee shops. There was plenty of parking, but also a lot of cars.
0x30e299e13ca0eda5_0x9a81af58f887abb3.author: Robert RW

0x30e29d55e0d99aeb_0x82cdd08a282a0009.text: Highly recommend! 💯 I had my dental treatment with Dr. Pob, and he was so nice, super gentle, and patient. He always explained every step before doing anything and answered all my questions without making me feel rushed, which made me feel really comfortable. The reception staff were also really friendly and welcoming, and I appreciated that there was no hard selling at all. Also, The clinic is clean, the equipment looks modern, and there’s convenient parking right in front!
0x30e29d55e0d99aeb_0x82cdd08a282a0009.author: Lalita vw

0x30e29d55e0d99aeb_0x82cdd08a282a0009.text: ARC dentist is super professional, I came from New York, Dental cost a fortune in the U.S, So I figure give this place a try, the Dentist not only is very professional and also very gentle, dentists weren’t not rushing at all, taking time and done everything right, price is super friendly and affordable!! The clinic is extremely clean, and also their 3D X - Ray Machine is very up today. I normally doesn’t write too much reviews, this place is so good that I have to do it!!

From the moment I stepped in, I was greeted with the warmest welcome by the reception staff, setting the tone for an exceptional experience. The cleanliness of the clinic was striking, ensuring a comfortable and hygienic environment. As for the dental care, the doctor's gentle touch in handling tartar removal was truly remarkable, making the entire process smooth and painless. Highly recommend this place for a top-notch dental experience!

Dr Teddy was very friendly and professional. He helped me with my tooth and gum health and patiently explained everything clearly and concisely. I was impressed with his English skills. I felt listened to and more confident in managing my dental health going forward. Thank you! Not only the excellent dentist Dr Teddy is but the team at the receptionist was extremely helpful - easy to book an appointment and communication throughout.

I had a wonderful experience at Arc Dental Clinic. The clinic is clean, welcoming, and very professional. Dr. Bee, the endodontist is extremely kind, gentle, and very careful with her work. She explained everything clearly, made me feel comfortable throughout the treatment, and I could tell she truly cares about her patients. I’m very satisfied with the service and highly recommend Arc Dental Clinic and Dr. Bee to anyone 😁

First visit today with Dr New and he was the best! He explained things very clearly and laid out my options, providing advise and alternatives. He was also really engaging with all my questions, and very gentle and thorough. Making an appointment was also easy - made a call in the AM and got an appointment in the PM (thank you, reception!). Place is clean and comfortable too. Already made a follow-up appointment.
0x30e29d55e0d99aeb_0x82cdd08a282a0009.author: Shamini Darshni

0x30e29d55e0d99aeb_0x82cdd08a282a0009.text: Easy access to book and commute. Admin is very friendly and welcome. I did book quite urgent due to my busy schedule, the team could provide a full service with friendly gesture. The dentist was very gentle and kept checkin on the soreness during cleaning procedures, also provided insightful technique for daily dental care. Highly recommended and will definitely come back in future. ✨

The dentist is very talented and soft-handed. It’s quite surprising though. Moreover, the assistant nurse is also generous and smart, I comfortably in the short-time but effective care. I didn’t swallow any water due to the assistant nurse. So, strongly recommended. The price is also reasonable.

0x30e2999defe2a623_0xa3f223725a7b3bc6.text: Highly recommended. Everything was very transparent with no hidden fees, which I really appreciated. The dentist, Thida, was professional, honest, and took the time to explain everything clearly. I went in because of a small discomfort in one tooth, and the whole experience was smooth from start to finish. The reception was also very warm and welcoming. If you’re a tourist or expat in Bangkok and need urgent or routine dental care, this is definitely a place you can trust. On top of that, the clinic is very clean and well organized.
0x30e2999defe2a623_0xa3f223725a7b3bc6.author: A S

0x30e2999defe2a623_0xa3f223725a7b3bc6.text: What a wonderful service, it was super fast, and professional. The dentist Dr Sarasin speaks english well and is knowledgeable regarding dentistry options for me. The reception team were friendly and fast. Thank you so much!

Very professional service, and clear explanations. That’s very helpful for non Thai speakers. Came here for cleaning service and found out from reviews that their Invisalign services are also good. I did my Invisalign here.

Such a great service. I had an appointment for teeth whitening the day after I requested one. The session took around one hour. Everyone was kind, polite and explained everything very well. Great service. Worthy of 5 stars.

I was really impressed by the professionalism of Dr Chaipattanapruk. She did an amazing job for my cleaning and for the first time in years I did not bleed. Excellent service a well deserved 5* Massimo

0x30e298c2f24698d7_0xfde87652f8f225f6.text: As far as dental care goes, I had a truly excellent experience with Dr. Noon and this dental office. From the moment I arrived, everything felt clean, professional, and well-organized. Dr. Noon has incredibly gentle hands. She consistently checked in with me to make sure I was comfortable and feeling no pain. This was actually the first dental experience I’ve ever had without any pain injections or numbing agents, which was remarkable. Right now, just half an hour out of my appointment it doesn’t feel like I had a dentist visit. The appointment felt efficient, calm, and very respectful. After years of uncertainty about dental care and being told by previous dentists that work would be expensive- it was such a relief to hear her say that my teeth and gums are healthy. I did want her help addressing a small pocket that tends to trap food, and she fully supported that concern. She made sure I felt heard, understood, and involved in the decision-making. Even with a bit of a language barrier, Dr. Noon made a genuine effort to ensure that we understood each other clearly, which made a huge difference. Dental care is very personal, and she created an experience that felt safe and respectful rather than stressful. I don’t often leave reviews, but I chose this office because of the reviews- and they were accurate. Reviews matter, especially for something as personal as dental work. I will absolutely be returning and will be recommending this office to my family. Thank you, Dr. Noon, for such a positive experience.
0x30e298c2f24698d7_0xfde87652f8f225f6.author: Celana Pearson

0x30e298c2f24698d7_0xfde87652f8f225f6.text: I visited this dental clinic last week while travelling in Bangkok for a few days due to a cracked tooth. Prior to my trip, I had already seen a dentist in my home country and was referred to an endodontist, but I wasn’t able to get an appointment until much later in February. I contacted the clinic via Line and was impressed by how promptly they responded. I was able to book an appointment on the same day. The staff were very friendly, welcoming, and professional. The dentist who examined me (I regret that I’ve forgotten his name) was incredibly warm, thorough, and honest. Because I was in Bangkok for a short time and my situation would likely require either a root canal or an extraction, he advised that it would be better to have the treatment done back at home where follow-up care would be easier and more seamless. He explained that it wouldn’t be a simple process and prioritised my long-term safety and outcome rather than pushing for treatment while I was travelling. I really appreciated his integrity and professionalism. Even though I didn’t end up having treatment done there, I felt genuinely cared for and would highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for honest, patient-focused dental care in Bangkok.
0x30e298c2f24698d7_0xfde87652f8f225f6.author: Ara Kang

0x30e298c2f24698d7_0xfde87652f8f225f6.text: While on holiday, I decided to visit this clinic for a cleaning and polishing as it was my 6 month mark. I was not disappointed. I efficiently made the appointment using the Line messenger. The response time was fast and many appointment times were available. I was greeted and requested to complete paperwork upon arrival. Exactly at my appointment time I was taken to the exam room. All details of exam explained and observation of my teeth and gum health communicated. Protocols were established on what I should do if I felt or had pain during cleaning/exam. Overall total time was about 50 minutes for cleaning, polishing, flossing. I would recommend this clinic to any farrang or local looking for clean, quality, and professional service.

0x310295925648ac67_0x429d8cfbf7e0e5af.text: This dental clinic is a relatively new establishment, and its exterior design does not immediately resemble a conventional clinic. Instead, it embraces a minimalist, clean aesthetic that deliberately departs from the typical clinical environment. From the moment one steps inside, the atmosphere feels more akin to a music conservatory or an art gallery, calm, refined, and thoughtfully curated. The soothing ambiance, complemented by gentle background music, effectively alleviates the usual anxiety associated with dental visits, allowing patients to feel at ease almost instantly. At reception, I was initially surprised to be greeted by a very young staff member, likely in his early teens. However, from the moment he began explaining procedures and asking relevant questions, it became clear that he was well trained and capable. If this is part of a structured training initiative during school holidays, it is certainly a commendable approach to developing responsibility and confidence at a young age. The attending dentist, a young female practitioner with extensive experience, was both professional and approachable. Her demeanor was warm and reassuring, and her team of assistants maintained the same level of attentiveness and gentleness throughout the visit. Overall, the clinic offers a highly relaxed and patient friendly environment. Hygiene standards are excellent, with even the restroom maintained in pristine condition. Given that the clinic is newly established, the facilities are in near perfect condition. The only minor observation would be that some of the decorative plants in the corners appeared slightly wilted, which could be improved to better match the otherwise polished environment. The treatment experience itself was smooth and comfortable, and the appointment process was efficient and well-organized. In summary, this is a highly recommended dental clinic that successfully redefines the patient experience through thoughtful design, professionalism, and attention to detail.
0x310295925648ac67_0x429d8cfbf7e0e5af.author: Happitel Apartment

0x310295925648ac67_0x429d8cfbf7e0e5af.text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5-Star Dental Experience! I had a great experience at Siri Dental Clinic (ศิริทันตกรรม) in Pattaya today. 0x680dfbd1dc9df66b_0x23c5145489c61521.text: Had a really great experience at Aura Clinic Bangkok. The service was excellent from start to finish—staff were incredibly welcoming and made me feel comfortable right away. They took the time to clearly explain every procedure, which really helped me make an informed decision without feeling rushed. What I appreciated the most was that there was absolutely no pressure to go ahead with any treatment. They simply gave honest suggestions and guidance, allowing us to decide what was best for us. I had under-eye and cheek treatments done, including Rejuran HB Plus, Juvederm Volift, and Restylane Skinboosters Vital Light. The staff were very knowledgeable about each of these and explained the process, benefits, and aftercare really well. The clinic itself is very clean, well-maintained, and has a calming atmosphere. I also loved the little touches like being greeted with milk tea—it made the whole experience feel even more special. They currently have some great promotions, which makes it such good value for the range of services they offer. On top of that, we even received a voucher for a discount at their spa centre, which was a lovely bonus. After the procedure, they provided soothing gel and medication to help with recovery, and even followed up—covering the payment we made today—which I really appreciated. Overall, a very satisfying experience with great customer care. Highly recommend!

0x30e29e8d0c705d9f_0x5448833050277340.text: The Lotus group in Thailand was once a branch of Tesco UK so visitors from the UK will understand that Lotus is a one stop shop. This Lotus store is located at the end of Fortune Town, which is a few metres from Phram 9 MRT station. Take the Fortune Town exit. The store has a food hall where a multitude of freshly cooked Thai dishes is available at street market prices. The lower level has fresh meat, fruit and vegetables for sale, along with every conceivable grocery item. Also a fair selection of wines, spirits and beers. Note: Alcohol sales are not permitted between 2pm and 5pm. The upper level has a pharmacy, clothing , appliances and bedding. Also on the upper level is a branch of DIY, a hardware store that sells: hand and power tools, screws and fasteners, electrical accessories, plastic products, kitchen and bathroom accessories etc, etc. all at very reasonable prices.
0x30e29e8d0c705d9f_0x5448833050277340.author: Peter Williams

0x30e29e8d0c705d9f_0x5448833050277340.text: I recently had the pleasure of visiting Lotus’s shopping mall in Bangkok, and I couldn’t be more impressed! The mall is so spacious, clean, and well-organized that it felt a breeze to wander around. There’s an amazing variety of stores, offering everything from luxurious brands to adorable local finds. One of my favorite parts was the food court—it's a foodie paradise! You’ll find delicious Thai dishes alongside tasty international options, all at great prices. Plus, the staff are super friendly and ready to help, which made my visit even better. Getting there is easy, too, with convenient parking and good access to public transport. Whether you’re hunting for trendy fashion, cool electronics, or even just some groceries, Lotus’s has something for everyone. I definitely recommend checking this place out if you’re in Bangkok—it’s a must-visit!
0x30e29e8d0c705d9f_0x5448833050277340.author: Po

0x30e29e8d0c705d9f_0x5448833050277340.text: I recently visited the store to purchase some daily necessities and local products. The overall layout was clear, and the product categories were relatively easy to find, making the shopping process smooth. The fresh produce and ready-to-eat food sections had a good selection, and the prices were competitive compared to similar stores. The checkout process was efficient; even during busy periods, the wait wasn't too long. I noticed that the staff handled restocking and maintaining cleanliness well, keeping the overall environment comfortable. A small suggestion is that some area signage could be clearer, which would be more user-friendly for first-time customers. However, overall, it wouldn't have a significant impact. I will definitely come back if needed.
0x30e29e8d0c705d9f_0x5448833050277340.author: L Franz

0x30e29e8d0c705d9f_0x5448833050277340.text: Best non-gourmet supermarket to go in the immediate area. Huge area and great prices. Just be aware a lot of people come here to shop, so sometimes produce may run out. Tesco Lotus at Fortune Town was recently renovated to look brighter, more organized and definitely somewhat more modern. You can definitely find the difference in the fresh goods and produce sections where they have spot dynamic lighting. The prices here are usually the best you can find for retail groceries, and they have sales on many items that they need to clear inventory for. Also, they have a bakery, deli, and a "you hunt we cook" style eatery.
0x30e29e8d0c705d9f_0x5448833050277340.author: Bobin Lee

0x30e29e8d0c705d9f_0x5448833050277340.text: I just give this shop 4 stars because I like the shops like Tops, Villa Market or Foodland better. The prices are probably the cheapest but the product selection partly reflects this. So for me it's only a once in a while place to go. The location is good because it's directly opposite Central Rama 9 and easily accessible from MRT Rama 9. It's important for me because I like to move via public transportation through Bangkok due to the unbearable traffic. Don't expect to find English speaking staff. Having said this the staff is friendly and helpful.
0x30e29e8d0c705d9f_0x5448833050277340.author: ThailandLifestyle Odin

0x30e29e8d0c705d9f_0x5448833050277340.text: Aside from the tech hub here at Fortune Town, there's a supermarket located at the ground floor and a department store at the 2nd floor. I did check out the clothing department and bought a few t-shirts at really good prices. Staff is friendly and reminded us of a promo for certain purchases. Good customer service, clean and spacious retail area. Dropped by here after checking out the IT sector. Entrance to Lotus is the best place to grab a ride or taxi as it is very well known.
0x30e29e8d0c705d9f_0x5448833050277340.author: DanAGo

0x30e29e8d0c705d9f_0x5448833050277340.text: 3.8⭐️ Lotus is the grocery store inside the Fortune Town mall. This is right behind the MRT station, and around the corner from our place. So it is our go to place for groceries. I give 3.8⭐️ because they do run out of things quickly. If you go right when they open it’s not an issue, but if you go later in the day, or try and do an online order for delivery, then they will probably be out of a lot. If you order online, beverages are normally the only things they are not out of 🤣 but I have had them say they were out of water twice when I ordered online. I asked for substitutions but they just removed them from my order. So it is easier to get what you need in person and earlier in the day.
0x30e29e8d0c705d9f_0x5448833050277340.author: AL Franklin

0x30e29e8d0c705d9f_0x5448833050277340.text: FOREIGNERS BEWARE: if you plan to use the self checkout they will watch you like a hawk even if there’s 5 other Thai people in the self checkout they will only watch you. I usually use the self checkout to avoid the long lines and the woman working at the self checkout stood uncomfortably close to me so I would notice her and look up at her and then she tries to pretend you need help but she’s really just trying to make sure you’re not stealing anything. The reason I know is because I told her I already know how to use the self checkout and instead of leaving you alone they stand there and stare. And then the security guard also came to watch me although there’s many Thai in the self checkout area, but they don’t watch any of them. I asked the security guard why they don’t watch the other Thai people and she just laughed and kept watching me. There’s literally other Thai people buying hundreds of baht worth of items but they only want to watch me, the only foreign person. No offense but I literally have more money in my bank than all of these employees put together and you want to treat me like I’m some sort of thief? Westerners aren’t stupid enough to come to a foreign country and risk getting their visa revoked by stealing from such an inexpensive supermarket that would cost them 3 times as much in their home country. I find their racial profiling and discrimination very rude and unnecessary. This establishment owes me an apology and those staff members need some retraining. FOREIGNERS, EXPATS, and WESTERNERS BEWARE!
0x30e29e8d0c705d9f_0x5448833050277340.author: Bee 杨Yáng

0x30da3b1add1138c9_0xfb837bb29f41be10.text: I got a 90-minute Thai massage here and it was honestly one of the best massages I’ve had in a long time. It started with a short foot massage, which I wasn’t expecting, and ended with a little tea service that felt really warm and personal. The therapist asked me a couple of times about the pressure and adjusted it right away, so I never felt uncomfortable. The music in the room was really calming too — I actually caught myself dozing off a few times. By the time it ended, I almost wished I booked a longer session. I walked out feeling super relaxed. Definitely recommend it!
0x30da3b1add1138c9_0xfb837bb29f41be10.author: Karen Han

0x30da3b1add1138c9_0xfb837bb29f41be10.text: My husband and I did the Thai massage with the warm herbal compress for 90 mins. This was 1800 Baht. Interior is very clean and zen. Aromatherapy was all around, soft music, and dim lights. The staff was friendly, spoke great English, and most importantly, gave a great Thai massage. You can ask for soft medium or hard pressure and I feel much more loose and relaxed afterwards. They give complimentary water before the massage and warm fruit juice and a cookie after. I definitely recommend this place for a good Thai massage!

0x30e29e5511e0a255_0xa9f4f72fa8144b75.text: Mixed experience: Excellent doctors but administrative issues I've visited Samitivej Sukhumvit three times—once for ENT and twice for dermatology consultations. The medical care was excellent in all cases: the ENT specialist quickly identified and resolved my issue, and the dermatologist provided thorough treatment. However, my last visit revealed significant operational shortcomings. Upon arrival, I encountered several nurses at reception. One was visibly playing with her phone, so I approached an older nurse who spoke better English. She immediately redirected me to the younger nurse playing on her phone, despite being more fluent. This created an unnecessary communication chain where information had to be translated back and forth between myself, the younger nurse and the older nurse, making a simple check-in inefficient as I couldn't just tell the older nurse directly what I needed. During my dermatology appointment, the doctor interrupted my response to his question about medication effectiveness because my answer wasn't direct enough. While understandable, this felt dismissive. Most problematically, after my appointment with the dermatologist, I was given two appointments on the same Sunday (10:20 AM for a follow-up with the dermatologist and 4:00 PM for a routine skin cancer screening). I asked the older reception nurse if she could reschedule the first appointment, and she offered me a slot at 2:20 PM instead. She wrote the change on my paper slip. To make sure that this change would also be made in the hospital's system, I asked her *twice* within 10 minutes if she had updated the time in the system as I had a feeling that she might've forgotten to do so. Both times, she confirmed hastily. Six days later, I received an SMS reminder confirming the original 10:20 AM time, meaning the system had never been updated. The nurse had apparently forgotten despite my explicit follow-up. Because of that, I ended up cancelling both my appointments because I was fed up with how I was treated by the hospital staff. For a premium hospital targeting international patients and affluent clientele, such lapses are unacceptable. Nursing staff should maintain professionalism, and critical appointment changes must be reliably processed. The medical expertise is there, but operational execution needs improvement.

0x30e28299ff1149af_0x2929331072f42f58.text: Ying Charoen Market, or "Saphan Mai Market" as it's more commonly known, is one of the oldest and most important large-scale retail and wholesale fresh markets in the Bang Khen area. Overall reviews from actual customers indicate that it's a market with a complete range of ingredients, convenient transportation, and is open 24 hours a day. It's suitable for both vendors buying supplies for their businesses and the general public looking for fresh ingredients at reasonable prices. Atmosphere and Facilities Cleanliness and Management: The market has been renovated to be indoors and is well-organized into zones for selling goods, such as fresh produce (meat/seafood), fruits and vegetables, dried food, and prepared food, making it easy to browse. Even though it's a large market, it's well-maintained with good cleanliness and ventilation. Parking: There is ample parking space both around the market and in the parking garage. However, during peak hours, such as early mornings or evenings, finding parking may be difficult, and traffic around the market may be heavy. Accessibility: This is a major advantage as it's located next to Phahonyothin Road and is close to the BTS Sai Yud station, making it very convenient to travel to without worrying about traffic or parking. Products and Prices Variety: The market offers a wide range of products, from fresh ingredients such as pork, chicken, frozen and fresh seafood, local vegetables, temperate vegetables, and seasonal fruits, to groceries and various seasonings. Price: Known for its affordable prices, as it is a large wholesale market. Buying in bulk results in significantly lower prices. Many fresh produce items are of good quality at reasonable prices. Ready-to-Eat Food Zone (Yingcharoen Food Plaza): This food court brings together many delicious restaurants and ready-to-eat savory and sweet dishes, perfect for those who want to find something tasty to eat throughout the day.

0x30e28299ff1149af_0x2929331072f42f58.text: Be careful of the fruit shop located between the large building and the traditional market. I bought 3.8kg of durian for 600B, but they only gave me three pieces of flesh. They trick tourists, secretly steal the flesh, wrap it in plastic wrap, and resell it. I witnessed them trimming and packaging the durian pieces they had secretly stolen once the shop was quiet. I bought 30 to 40 durians in places like Chanthaburi and Bangkok, but this place is the worst. Unlike other durian shops, they stack other fruits in the front so the cutting board is not visible. They pretend to separate the peels and steal the flesh quite boldly. Also, the elderly woman at the shop across the street said she would cut and package two mangoes (1kg) for 60B. Other shops that only sell the raw fruit charge around 25B/kg. It was considerably more expensive than other shops, but I considered it the price for the trimming service. I paid 100B when I received the goods, but she insisted that it was originally 100B. The woman across the street who was helping with the durian sales... The lady joins in to take your side. You absolutely must not expect a good impression of Thailand here. Be nervous, haggle, and I highly recommend recording video when discussing prices and cutting the fruit. Especially at the durian shop, I recommend using a selfie stick to film from a high angle.
0x30e28299ff1149af_0x2929331072f42f58.author: 김여사

0x30e28fd99860fe0f_0x9505188fa96a6987.text: When buying things, the price tag says it's on sale, but we need to check what's on sale, the color, the scent, and the barcode. Sometimes it's the same type of product but with different scents. Check the barcode to make sure the discount matches the item you picked up. I once saw an item on sale but didn't check the color and barcode, and when I went to pay, the discount wasn't applied. They said I picked the wrong item. It has to be the specific item that's discounted. Instead of buying the discounted item, you might end up paying the regular price. Focus on checking the barcode of the item that's on sale.
