The staff was extremely friendly and attentive, and the entire place gives you exactly what you would hope for from a high-end beach club experience. Yes, it is definitely on the more expensive side, but you are clearly paying for the incredible ambiance and location, and in that sense it feels worth it. The music was perfect for the setting: relaxed, stylish, and never too much. It’s exactly the kind of place where you genuinely enjoy spending hours without wanting to leave. The only small downside — and honestly not really the club’s fault — was that it deserved a few more people. At times it felt a little empty, but that was probably because we visited during the week rather than on a weekend. Overall, a beautiful beach club with an amazing atmosphere, great service, and one of the best seaside vibes we’ve experienced in Phuket.
0x30503990fb35ab1f_0xcecf67b3c95ea51f.author: Moritz

0x30503990fb35ab1f_0xcecf67b3c95ea51f.text: Catch Beach Club was one of the most beautiful places we visited in Phuket. Its location right on the beach is stunning, with white sand and crystal-clear water adding to its charm. The atmosphere is both sophisticated and relaxing, the service is excellent and prompt, and the food and drinks are delicious and exceptional. It's the perfect place to spend the afternoon and enjoy the sunset. If you're looking for a sophisticated beachfront experience that combines relaxation with a beautiful ambiance, this place is definitely worth a visit. Catch Beach Club was one of the highlights of our trip to Phuket. The beachfront location is absolutely stunning, with soft white sand, crystal-clear water, and a relaxing yet vibrant atmosphere. The service was friendly and attentive, the food was delicious, and the cocktails were excellent. It’s the perfect place to spend the afternoon and stay for the beautiful sunset. Whether you’re looking to relax, enjoy great music, or have a memorable beachfront dining experience, Catch Beach Club is definitely worth a visit. Highly recommended.
0x30503990fb35ab1f_0xcecf67b3c95ea51f.author: Manal World

0x30503990fb35ab1f_0xcecf67b3c95ea51f.text: This place is just fantastic. I go there quite often and even have a member card now. Both Pool areas are great, the staff is attentive, areas are clean. The food is always good and the Sunday brunch is amazing as well as the Friday Dinner Buffet. The selection offered is always good and the food is fresh and of good quality. The DJ's are always excellent but this of course is a matter of taste. You'll be happy if you like electronic music mostly. Ibiza style atmosphere. I'm a bit sensible with noise but never had the feeling that the music is uncomfortably loud. Always appropriate for each time in the day. As a member you get many benefits and it's really worth it. So happy to be part of the family )) I simply love this place. Thank you for always and consistently giving me a good experience for over 2 years now. I appreciate that so much.
0x30503990fb35ab1f_0xcecf67b3c95ea51f.author: Kitty Cat

0x30503990fb35ab1f_0xcecf67b3c95ea51f.text: Catch beach club is fantastic. From the friendly staff, the fabulous music to the delicious food, this place was one of our favourite places in Phuket. Special mentions to their breakfast, which is included if you travel with Luxury Escapes. Also, We didn’t know anything about the Sunday brunch, but thank goodness we accidentally arrived that morning just in time for it (12noon - 3pm). More lunchtime than brunch, but anyway, who cares! The food was incredible. The only thing I didn’t love was the Thai beef salad. Loads of celery and not much else. One thing to note is that if you are traveling with Luxury Escapes, you will be choosing from a limited menu (both food and cocktails). It wasn’t a problem because the food was also delicious, but we just didn’t realise about the limited menu that before we booked.
0x30503990fb35ab1f_0xcecf67b3c95ea51f.author: Rachel B

0x30503990fb35ab1f_0xcecf67b3c95ea51f.text: We had a fantastic day at Catch! We had a lounge right on the edge next to the beach and from the get go, the service was wonderfully, the DJ vibes were just right all day and the facilities were great. Throughout the day there was a sax player and dancers who added to the fun atmosphere and all the meals we had and cocktails were fantastic. The fire dancers at the end of the night were wonderful, they weren’t on the beach but rather on the decking amongst everyone. Shout out to Mark who was lovely and gave us plenty of recommendations of places to see in Phuket. When we told him it was our honeymoon trip, he even organised a little cake and sparkler to celebrate. Ps; sunset was spectacular!!
0x30503990fb35ab1f_0xcecf67b3c95ea51f.author: Jorgia Brown

0x30503990fb35ab1f_0xcecf67b3c95ea51f.text: Exceptional Service & Amazing Food – A Dream Venue ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ We cannot recommend Catch highly enough. From the stunning setting to the incredible food, everything was perfect. What truly set this experience apart was the staff's dedication and attention to detail. Nothing was too hard for them. A special mention must go to Khun Moe and Khun Tip—their service was second to none. Every time we turned our head, they were there, anticipating our needs before we even asked. The food was amazing, the atmosphere was beautiful, and the entire team went above and beyond to make our wedding reception unforgettable. Thank you!
0x30503990fb35ab1f_0xcecf67b3c95ea51f.author: Michael Skowronski

0x30503990fb35ab1f_0xcecf67b3c95ea51f.text: This place is suitable for all groups, whether couples, groups of friends, or families. After staying for several days and getting tired of Italian food, I asked if they could make a spicy glass noodle salad. They said it wasn't on the menu, but they tried their best to get the chef to make it, which was very impressive and delicious – spicy exactly as I requested. Overall, the atmosphere is great, luxurious, and beautiful. I highly recommend it!
0x30503990fb35ab1f_0xcecf67b3c95ea51f.author: Kannisar S.

0x30503990fb35ab1f_0xcecf67b3c95ea51f.text: I visited on a Sunday around 4:00 p.m. as a solo diner while traveling. I regularly review restaurants and beach clubs on my social media, so I was looking forward to experiencing this one. Unfortunately, I did not feel welcome from the moment I arrived. I asked for a table for one and was told food service hadn’t started yet and that only bar seating was available. When I said I was happy to wait for a table, I was reminded multiple times about the minimum spend, even after I had already agreed to it. It felt like I was being talked out of dining rather than welcomed as a guest. What stood out most was that my reservation was simply written on a yellow sticky note. Whether that is standard practice or not, it came across as dismissive and very unprofessional. Combined with the overall interaction, it left me feeling like my business wasn’t valued. I decided to leave before ordering and spend my dollars elsewhere. This experience was especially disappointing because I took my business to another beach club that provided exceptional service! Even when someone in my group repeatedly asked for drinks to be remade, the staff remained patient, accommodating, and genuinely welcoming. That is what hospitality should look like. I included the pictures here. I review restaurants and beach clubs for my audience across social media, and I share both positive and negative experiences honestly. This is one of the few places where I walked away before even having the chance to order because It simply wasn’t welcoming.
0x30503990fb35ab1f_0xcecf67b3c95ea51f.author: sofia young

0x30e29f912d54ed85_0x1e86066451694962.text: 5⭐️ My cat (Baloo) ate something and we don't know what🥲 It is crazy how horrible I feel about this. I brought him here to Vet 4 Animal Hospital. They helped Baloo right away, and ended up having to keep him for a few nights, which is always scary. A lot of the staff spoke amazing English, so there wasn't much of a language barrier issue. So that made it easier. That was a big worry of mine because ... I guess all types of hospitals still scare me a little, and because I know Baloo HATES the vet. So it's always a horrible car ride there (he HATES riding in the car and yells the entire time), and then he yells when we're at the Vet also. So it's always a rough experience, no matter what. The one thing I didn't want to hear, was that he needed surgery. After 2 days at the hospital, blood tests, an X-Ray, and a ultrasound... they found the object inside of him. And what did that mean? SURGERY. Exactly what I didn't want to hear. So as I write this review, Baloo bear is in surgery. I am just happy it was figured out and handled quickly. All of the staff at the animal hospital have been so AMAZING, and update me twice a day (or more) on Baloo’s condition. I am very thankful for all of them!🙏🏾 I would highly recommend the Vet 4 Animal Hospital to any and everyone for their pets well being. A huge Thank You to everyone who works here!

0x30e29f258aba6d0f_0x41e5d338f0fbc4dc.text: 👀 Review of my ReLEx SMILE Pro vision correction experience at TRSC On June 4th, I decided to “invest in my eyes and quality of life” by having ReLEx SMILE Pro surgery at TRSC with Dr. Sukanda Sawasdibutr 🩺 Before the surgery, I must say that the examination here was very thorough. From measuring my eyesight and examining the corneal structure to consulting me on the most suitable method for my eye condition, everything was meticulously prepared. I was examined by Dr. Ornicha Sriwanich and had Earn as my personal consultant, answering questions, managing appointments, and providing close care throughout the process 💕 📌 Surgery Day Upon arrival at the center, the staff helped me, prepared me, and provided complete information. Honestly, I was very nervous 😅 At first, I chose to hug a ball to relieve my anxiety, but when the time came… I changed my mind and held the nurse's hand instead 🫶 The doctor talked to me, reassured me, and then started the countdown: 8…7…6… (It reminded me of tricking kids into getting their teeth done! 555) In a few seconds, everything was done ✨ At that moment, I could see! But it was like a thin fog was covering my vision. After the surgery, they covered my eyes to prevent me from rubbing them, and prescribed anxiety and pain medication. The first night was painless, just a feeling of tightness and irritation, similar to wearing contact lenses. 🌅 The next morning: My usual instinct was to reach for my glasses, but wait… I just had eye surgery! I tried opening my eyes through the small gap in the eye shield… Wow! I could see them! 😍 It was a strange and amazing feeling. I went back to the center. They removed the eye shield, checked my eyesight again, and taught me how to clean and apply the eye drops. Ern was there to take care of me closely, as always. ⏳ Recovery & Follow-up Appointment • 1 day after surgery: Vision is gradually getting clearer, no pain. • 3 days after surgery: Able to work normally, just wear glasses to protect against wind and droplets, avoid makeup around the eyes. • 1 week: Responsible for daily life. Still experiencing glare at night. • 1 month: Nighttime glare has improved significantly. • 3 months: Vision is stable, life is very comfortable, no bothersome problems. What I really liked was the follow-up appointments at 1 day / 1 week / 1 month / 3 months / 1 year, with no extra charge. 💡My feelings: Before the procedure, I was extremely worried about pain and glare, but in reality, it was much less painful than I expected. Just taking paracetamol was enough. The next day, I practically forgot I ever wore glasses 👓 Now, 3 months later, life is very comfortable. I don't have to worry about glasses or contact lenses anymore. ✨ Personally, I think ReLEx SMILE Pro at TRSC is the most worthwhile investment I've ever made. I'm so glad I decided to do it! 💙

0x30e2a00acea3865f_0xded68b894c75cfcd.text: This is an architectural experiment in real life! Very interesting spaces, internal green courtyards and floating connection bridges at upper floor. A surprise and fascination esp for design and architectural students.
0x30e2a00acea3865f_0xded68b894c75cfcd.author: curryman

0x30e2a00acea3865f_0xded68b894c75cfcd.text: Driving to this place requires one to go through automatic barrier gate of the main building and heading towards the car park at the back. Beautifully designed structure (metal frames) with plenty of greenery around and at the center courtyard. Car park is free for the first 15 minutes, and fees start adding up afterwards. I was out within 20 minutes (due to long queue time at the bakery shop), and I had to pay THB20 for the car park on exit. My visit was only for buying a specific item from the bakery and from that location (second floor) I couldn’t see anything interesting around and seemed like most visitors come to the same spot where I was too.
0x30e2a00acea3865f_0xded68b894c75cfcd.author: Husain AlHusaini (Husain_Tula)

0x30e2a00acea3865f_0xded68b894c75cfcd.text: The restaurant is a bit small, the atmosphere is nice and shady but it seems like it's not well-maintained. The second floor has empty, deserted spaces and lots of fallen leaves. However, I'm giving it 4 stars because the restaurant on the first floor is good. Getting the parking ticket stamped is a bit difficult; people keep forgetting. It would be nice to have a Tops or supermarket nearby after leaving the restaurant.
0x30e2a00acea3865f_0xded68b894c75cfcd.author: Punyawee Werasopon

0x30e2a00acea3865f_0xded68b894c75cfcd.text: I went there today. I used my parking ticket to wave it at the coffee shop. When I left, the security guard said the parking fee was 20 baht. I told him I had already waved the ticket. The male security guard responded, "Really?" Isn't that ridiculous? If you're going to use technology but use crappy equipment, just stop. The staff has no problem-solving skills. They told me to wave it again. My car was already right at the barrier; I was going to drive back just to wave it again. Speak more politely. It's okay if they can't suggest a solution; it's the machine's fault, not theirs. But that rude behavior is unacceptable. The entrance booth is also stuck; the card won't come out. Just remove the barrier and wave it instead. It's terrible. I will never set foot in this complex again until they have a new gate barrier + LPR system. I was so annoyed.
0x30e2a00acea3865f_0xded68b894c75cfcd.author: Lornorr S.

0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.text: I visited this dental clinic twice, once for dental cleaning and then to get 3 minor cavity fillings done. During my dental cleaning process, the dentist pointed out that I have some minor cavities need attention. The dentist was very thorough and took time to explain me the process and provided me with additional information regarding issues I need to take care of. After my first appointment, I requested the same dentist for the cavity filling procedure as I was very much satisfied with his service. I have been to another dental clinic in Chaing Mai last year but the professional service at this clinic was much better than the previous clinic I visited. This dental clinic is definitely the place to visit, especially if you an international traveller visiting Chaing Mai and you need to get any kind of dental services done.
0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.author: Neil R

0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.text: Amazing service! Originally came in for a scale and polish. Once there the dentist showed me 3 fillings that were needed in my mouth. I have had these black dots on my teeth without pain for a long time and the UK dentist never mentioned they needed anything doing. Once she pointed this out she scraped the gum line and it was sooo painful! So they done the worst filling on that day then I wanted a rest and rebooked two weeks later for the other two fillings. I also had my gap in my front teeth bonded which I am so happy with. I originally asked for the dentists advice about this and she said it wasn't necessary but I pushed for it and they did an amazing job. Very grateful for the dentists professionalism and honesty. Very trustworthy dental practice!
0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.author: chloe mccormack

0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.text: Since the beginning it was easy to contact them on WhatsApp and make an appointment even though I was outside the country. Staff was very friendly. And the clinic was very modern and clean. They took my wisdom tooth out. It was a very complicated one as it was growing 90 degrees and impacting the other teeth. DR Thongnard was my surgeon. He was very experienced. He took his time and was very gentle. I know because my recovery was very smooth and least painful unlike my other wisdom tooth I did where the doctors did it really fast and hurt the surrounding areas. After 1 week I went back to get my stitches out which was also not painful at all. Fairly priced. Thank you again 🙏🏽
0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.author: S.M. O

0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.text: I had an outstanding experience at GrandDent Clinic! From the moment I walked in, the staff made me feel welcome and speak English. The clinic is modern and clean. The dentist was incredibly knowledgeable, gentle, and took the time to explain every step of the treatment. They listened carefully to my concerns and made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire visit. I highly recommend GrandDent Clinic to anyone looking for high-quality dental care at an affordable price.
0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.author: Tania Guinsberg

0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.text: I’m absolutely thrilled with this dental clinic! The entire team is incredibly friendly, highly professional, and works at the highest level. The atmosphere is great – you can really feel the positive energy. The location is top-notch – modern, stylish, and fully equipped. The treatment was not only fast but also extremely reliable and perfectly done. I felt completely comfortable and in the best hands. A big thank you to the amazing team and Klinik
0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.author: Mojo Bofl

0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.text: I had a fantastic experience at GrandDent. From the moment I walked in, the staff was welcoming, professional, and made me feel completely at ease. The Dr took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all my questions, and was incredibly gentle and thorough during my treatment. The office is clean, modern, and runs efficiently—I was seen right on time. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and skilled dentist
0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.author: Lisa Brierley

0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.text: Had a crown come off. Had appointment on a Friday took mould of teeth had temporary made and returned following Tuesday to insert new crown with no alternations needed was fast, efficient, perfect fit wonderful dentist, staff exceptional the assistant was great at irrigation and evacuation, I usually drown at most dentists they leave so much water in my mouth this is the best I have ever had in going to dentists for 53 years.
0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.author: Scott Stewart

0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.text: I needed to have a new crown and major filling done, so found them online, had good reviews etc etc. Was only going to be in Thailand for 2 weeks so emailed a month ahead, carefully listing what needed to be done, set up the initial visit and all sounded fine. But when I arrived, they had no idea what was going on, the dentist was not available, had to do xrays, which was fine, then said I would have to come back in 2 weeks for the visit with the dentist. Not good to say the least especially when I specifically listed my time frame in the initial emails back and forth. So after a bit of arguing, they finally found an appt with the dentist 10 days or so later, calling it very close considering they had to make the crown and then if there was an issue, I was out of luck. So went back on a Thursday and that visit was fine, the Dentist was excellent and the facilities were nothing short of amazing. He did the filling and put on the temp crown and set me up for the next Monday for the final work. Showed up Monday and they seemed confused and mixed me up with another patient, saying I need an insert and a few other things. Huh? After a bit of discussion again, got that straightened out, met with the Dentist and all was good. Overall they did a very good job, one of if not the best major dental experiences I have ever had, but the office support staff is iffy at best and do not speak any English which may have contributed to the issues. So I do recommend them, but with a few caveats. Be sure to double and triple check appts, get confirmation on treatment plans and be firm about time frames. Oh, the cost was about 1/3 of what it was for the same work in the US and possibly better quality too.
0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.author: David

0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.text: We stumbled across this beautiful sanctuary by accident & wow what a place…. The staff were so welcoming & accommodating (we just turned up with no reservation) we were given 3 different packages to choose from, we chose package 3 . We were given a quick debrief on the do’s & dont’s whilst in the sanctuary then we was introduced to the baby elephants & was able to feed them… we were given a educational guide on the difference of the Asian & African elephants we then made protein balls & prepared food for the adult elephants… everything was so well organised & very relaxed we were allowed to interact with the elephants & true as many photos as we wished. We were then taken through a short jungle walk to meet another adult elephant who we fed then showered , after this we showered the babies which were very mischievous & playful. We were then given some fruit & were shown a video that was taken of our whole experience along with many photos taken by our guides. This whole experience was so much more than we had ever imagined & really made our holiday bring do close to these beautiful creatures who are so well looked after now since being rescued from lives of torture & trekking to now living a life if freedom in a lovely jungle enclosure to roam freely and safely whilst being shown respect & love from their handlers …. If you choose one place to see the elephants 100% choose this place as it runs entirely on donations & all money raised goes back into the upkeep , rescue & medical costs for not just these elephants but for all the elephants on Koh Samui …. Thank you to all the staff who welcomed us today & for making my dream of meeting & feeding these beautiful animals come true 🙏
0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.author: Caron Gould

0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.text: This sanctuary is truly an amazing place. The elephants are well cared for, and it's clear they are happy and comfortable in their environment. One of the standout aspects is that the elephants aren't caged or restrained, allowing them to roam freely, which creates a more natural and respectful setting. A highlight of the visit was getting the opportunity to make food for the elephants and feed them directly, which was an incredible hands-on experience that made us feel even more connected to these gentle giants. We visited as part of a large group of around 40 people, so there was a lot going on, and at times it felt a bit chaotic. If you're someone who prefers smaller groups or wants a more intimate experience, I would definitely recommend spending a little extra for a private or smaller group tour to ensure a more personalized encounter with the elephants. What’s really great about this place is that it’s a true sanctuary, meaning the elephants are not mistreated or exploited. They live in a stress-free environment, and unlike some other places, this sanctuary does not offer elephant rides, which can be harmful to the animals. Instead, the focus is on their well-being and allowing visitors to learn about them in a responsible and ethical way. I highly recommend doing thorough research to find a sanctuary like this one, where the elephants are treated with the respect and dignity they deserve. Make sure to support places that prioritize the health and happiness of the animals and avoid those that allow elephant rides or other forms of exploitation. Visiting a sanctuary like this can be a rewarding and unforgettable experience, both for you and the elephants!
0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.author: GEE

0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.text: We have visited this amazing place on 06/09/2020 and it totally exceed our expectations! First of all, 2 beautiful elephants Yo Yo and Champagne are happy, well treated, looking healthy and active. They are moving all around the territory all the time! Not standing at one place. No chains! They are free! Second, you can touch and feed elephants with bamboo and bananas. Third, you can wash elephants from hose and even take a bath with them in a Lake. Fourth, it’s a child friendly activity. In our visit there were guests with children and they absolutely loved communication with elephants! Fifth, you can have chilled drinks in the cafe while feeding elephants or just observing them. Sixth, all the staff are super friendly and helpful. Momay, Pookkie and guys told us interesting facts about elephants, took photos of us, so we didn’t have to interrupt our communication with elephants and send them on our phones. Seventh, the place location is very convenient - just behind the famous Mumified Monk temple. Eight, there is no entrance fee, and no other fees, just a donation. Ninth, elephants were rescued from the hard work and now finally start to live a happy life! Tenth, activity is cool and suitable for couples, individuals, families, kids, groups - for everyone. That’s true! Eleventh, guys are doing a great mission so please come and support them! I guarantee that you and your kids would have an unforgettable amazing activity and good memories! I’ve been in the big famous elephant sanctuary in Chiang Mai, the experience there was good, but believe me - here it feels even more unique and exotic! Super highly recommended!
0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.author: Viktoriya Kronos

0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.text: This is such a amazing sanctuary, the staff are incredible & the story of the sanctuary is amazing too, they explain everything how ethical they are and how they rescue and help other elephants, they have a vet who is the only vet on the island and she travels to help other elephants on the island, they are only donation based and they let their elephants roam freely - there is no gate or fence around. They have 2 new baby elephants rescued from the circus who are underweight and are being monitored, treated and fed at the moment as they are newly rescued. So beautiful to see a true ethical sanctuary, this one is a must see if you want to see a place that really is caring for the elephants! They have 1 hourly packages and you get to make a vitamin cake for the elephants and feed them, shower them with water and you get a video at the end and a lovely keyring. The elephants just roam around you and they are not told to do anything / pose for photos or do tricks, it is really beautiful & it seems they are very free! A very educational and wholesome day ! Staff are really amazing : great laugh with them and they are so good at explaining everything and educating on the sanctuary and also just elephants!
0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.author: Natalka

0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.text: A visit to see the elephants was a must for our Southern Thailand trip, and finding the most ethical elephant sanctuary was of utmost importance. After a bit of research, I'm so glad that we decided to go to I Love Elephant Samui, a wonderful home for previously abused elephants. The staff and management so clearly adore and take excellent care of these beloved gentle giants. The elephants are very happy, playful, and free to roam around the property as they please. We had the most special morning preparing a cake for the elephants that we then fed to them, along with lots of watermelon and bananas! The elephants were so comfortable with us! We spent time with a more elderly "Grandma" elephant as well as with a Mom and her sweet baby elephant 🥹We loved playing with them in the water and even gave them a bit of a scrub after they rolled around in the mud. It was truly an unforgettable experience. If you're planning a trip to Koh Samui, make sure you spend time at this amazing sanctuary to help them continue their incredible work. See you next time! ❤️ 🐘
0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.author: Anna Loumbrozo

0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.text: This elephant rescue site left us awe-inspired. The staff's warmth and passion for their work created trust and confidence that the animals are not forced to do anything. Of course you're a friend for the elephants when you bring them fruit and other food but I think that's generally the same with all animals. The staff ensured our comfort and safety during the visit, sharing impressive facts about the animals. The serene tropical location blended seamlessly with well-maintained facilities. But what really speaks for the team and their work is that they seem to limit the visits that can be done per day. When we returned from our tour the elephants clearly wanted to be alone and walked away from the facilities. When we returned we heard that the team just sent another group of tourists away and asked them to come another day because the animals got enough visits for today. So we can clearly recommend the visit for those seeking an enriching and respectful experience surrounded by a genuinely friendly team.
0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.author: Max Urbitsch

0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.text: We absolutely loved I love Elephant Samui. I was a bit worried because it is not one of the first to come up when searching, but I am glad we decided to go for it. The place is small but other than the time you spend preparing the elephants food, the rest of the time you are pretty much surrounded by elephants. We fed them multiple times, bathed them multiple times and had plenty of one on one time with them. My entire family absolutely loved it. The tour is supposed to be an hour but we were there for over 1.5 hours. Everyone there is extremely friendly and welcoming, we really could not have asked for a better tour. The place was opened by the only Elephant doctor on Samui to care for orphaned elephants, and they are truly roaming around, there was no forcing the elephants to do anything as they seemed extremely content following the food! I HIGHLY recommend this experience as it was a highlight of our trip!
0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.author: Susana Arispe

0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.text: AMAZING DAY! Staff so friendly and so educational getting to learn all about the elephants and the amazing work they are doing! Fully ethical sanctuary , you only get to be with the elephants on their terms , no riding no bathing with them, which is exactly how you should be with these animals. We got to feed, wash and massage the elephants aswell as walk with them. The staff take photos for you And then you get a free video of your time with the elephants . Could not recommend highly enough ! Please please visit and support this amazing cause. Thank you to the staff and our tour guide who made the afternoon amazing ! Mrs Pookie keep up the phenomenal work
0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.author: Graham Hughes

0x30e29f45c3a09f61_0x6f975cd224b3fa5f.text: เพิ่งมีโอกาสมาถอนฟันคุดที่คลินิกครั้งแรก คุณหมอและผู้ช่วยพูดจาดีและสุภาพมาก ๆ ค่ะ ไม่ยัดเยียดการนัดหรือการรักษา เพียงแค่อธิบายและให้คำแนะนำ พนักงานหน้าเคาน์เตอร์ก็บริการดีค่ะ เราสามารถนัดวันกับทางคลินิกเองได้เลยตามความสะดวก อย่างคุณหมอคอยถามตลอดว่าคนไข้ไหวไหม เจ็บรึเปล่า พร้อมอธิบายเกี่ยวกับฟันที่มีปัญหา ด้วยความที่ฟันคุดซี่นี้ถอนออกยากมาก แต่คุณหมอก็พยายามกันมาก ๆ (และใจเย็นมาก) เพื่อให้ฟันคุดหลุดออกมาให้ได้ พอถอนฟันเสร็จคุณหมอก็มาอธิบายถึงเรื่องฟันให้ฟังและช่วยให้คำแนะนำหลังการถอนฟันได้อย่างละเอียดและสุภาพมาก ๆ ค่ะ (ส่วนความเจ็บจากการถอนไม่มีเลยค่ะ จะรู้สึกเจ็บและแสบ ๆ นิดหน่อยก็ตรงมุมปาก เนื่องจากคุณหมอต้องใช้แรงพอสมควรในการถอนฟัน (เพราะฟันอยู่ลึกและหลุดออกมายาก) ทำให้เครื่องมือไปกดโดนมุมปากซ้ำ ๆ แต่หลังจากถอนเสร็จก็นับไม่ว่าไม่ค่อยมีอาการอะไรแล้วค่ะ) ถือว่าประทับใจค่ะสำหรับการใช้บริการเป็นครั้งแรก 👍🏻
0x30e29f45c3a09f61_0x6f975cd224b3fa5f.en: I recently had my wisdom tooth extracted at this clinic for the first time. The doctor and assistants were very kind and polite. They didn't pressure me into any appointments or treatments; they simply explained and offered advice. The front desk staff were also very helpful. We were able to schedule our own appointment at our convenience. The doctor constantly asked if I was feeling well and if I was in any pain, while explaining about the problematic tooth. This wisdom tooth was very difficult to remove, but the doctor tried very hard (and was very patient) to get it out. After the extraction, the doctor explained everything about the tooth and gave detailed and polite post-extraction advice. (There was no pain during the extraction itself; just a slight stinging and burning sensation at the corner of my mouth because the doctor had to use considerable force (since the tooth was deep and difficult to remove), causing the instrument to repeatedly press against the corner of my mouth. But after the extraction, there were hardly any symptoms.) Overall, I was very impressed with my first experience here. 👍🏻

0x30e29f45c3a09f61_0x6f975cd224b3fa5f.text: I recently had the opportunity to visit your clinic for a dental appointment, and I must say, I was thoroughly impressed. From the beautiful and clean clinic environment to the warm and friendly service provided by all the staff, who were always smiling and attentive, everything exceeded my expectations. I would like to commend the dentist, whose gentle touch and courteous, patient demeanor were truly remarkable. I am completely satisfied and cannot find fault with any part of my experience. I will definitely recommend your services and look forward to returning for future appointments. Thank you so much for such an excellent experience
0x30e29f45c3a09f61_0x6f975cd224b3fa5f.author: Phichaya S

0x30e29f45c3a09f61_0x6f975cd224b3fa5f.text: Thantakit Dental Hospital offers an amazing, five-star experience. The staff is incredibly friendly, helpful, and attentive, making you feel completely at ease. The clinic is modern and immaculate, equipped with the latest technology for precise and comfortable care. Their commitment to patient satisfaction is truly remarkable. The entire team goes above and beyond to provide outstanding service and genuine care. I highly recommend Thantakit for anyone looking for top-tier dental care in a professional and welcoming environment.
0x30e29f45c3a09f61_0x6f975cd224b3fa5f.author: mohammad Islam

0x30e29f45c3a09f61_0x6f975cd224b3fa5f.text: ขอชื่นชมคุณหมอและทีมงานคลินิกมากๆเลยค่ะ 🙏🏻 ไปผ่าฟันคุดมาแล้วประทับใจเกินคาด คุณหมอมือเบามากกกก ตอนทำแทบไม่รู้สึกเจ็บเลย มีเจ็บแค่ตอนฉีดยาชากับตอนยาชาหมดฤทธิ์นิดหน่อยเองค่ะ หลังทำบวมน้อยมาก ฟื้นตัวไว ดูแลดี พูดจาให้คำแนะนำละเอียดและใจเย็นสุดๆ ทำให้ไม่ค่อยกังวลเลยค่ะ 🥹✨
0x30e29f45c3a09f61_0x6f975cd224b3fa5f.en: I would like to express my sincere appreciation to the doctor and the clinic staff. 🙏🏻 I had my wisdom tooth extracted and was more impressed than I expected. The doctor was incredibly gentle; I barely felt any pain during the procedure. The only pain was during the anesthetic injection and a little after the anesthetic wore off. There was minimal swelling after the procedure, and recovery was quick. The care was excellent; the doctor was very detailed, patient, and understanding, which made me feel much less anxious. 🥹✨

0x30e29f45c3a09f61_0x6f975cd224b3fa5f.text: รักษาที่นี่ครั้งแรกกัยคุณหมอจ๋อมแจ๋ม จากใจคนที่กลัวหมอฟัน ที่นี่คือดีต่อใจทั้งบรรยากาศและการรักษา คุณหมอน่ารัก ใจดี มือก็เบา เพราะตอนฉีดยาชาเจ็บน้อยมากกก แล้วก็ให้คำแนะนำดีมากว่าเราจะรักษาอะไรยังไงต่อ ซึ่งดีต่อการตัดสินใจมากๆ ราคาก็ไม่ได้แรง ประทับใจมากค่ะ
0x30e29f45c3a09f61_0x6f975cd224b3fa5f.en: This was my first treatment here with Dr. Jomjaem. Coming from someone who's afraid of dentists, this place was wonderful – both the atmosphere and the treatment were excellent. The doctor is lovely, kind, and has a very gentle touch; the anesthetic injection was barely painful at all. She also gave great advice on what treatments were needed and how to proceed, which was very helpful in making decisions. The price wasn't too high either. I'm very impressed!

0x30fd019c90dca309_0xdb2239ae7bb49397.text: I had a wonderful experience at Apex in Market Village. From the moment I walked in, Khun Joy made me feel completely at ease. She was kind, curious about my concerns, and took the time to explain everything in a way that actually made sense. That kind of genuine care is hard to find anywhere. The whole team was professional and attentive, and the follow up after my treatment to check in on how I was doing was a really nice touch. It showed they actually care about their patients beyond the appointment itself. As for the price, let's just say I paid about a third of what I would have spent back in the States. That is not a typo. Same quality of care, significantly friendlier to my wallet. Once I rebuild my savings from this visit I will absolutely be back for other treatments. In the meantime I am keeping a close eye on any specials they run because this place has earned my trust and my return business.

0x304e033d1316c54f_0xe9ae2c9b43bbae37.text: My partner came in to the Cline after suffering from intense food poisoning — 12 hours of nonstop vomiting, completely drained and dehydrated. From the moment we arrived ,at the Cline was calm, compassionate, and incredibly professional. He quickly assessed the situation, made my partner feel at ease, and got them started on fluids and anti-nausea medication right away. The Cline didn’t just treat the symptoms — he took the time to explain what was happening, what to expect in the next 24–48 hours, and when to seek further help if things didn’t improve. We never felt rushed, and his bedside manner was exactly what we needed during a stressful time. Thanks to his care, my partner was able to stabilize quickly and start recovering. We’re incredibly grateful for this Cline’s expertise and genuine care. Highly recommend this place to anyone in need of a thoughtful and thorough physician

0x30e282dbf1150a41_0x3b5f15016a28673b.text: I had the opportunity to visit IT Square Laksi and found it to be a charming mall in its own way. While not a brand-new, luxury mall, it's very comprehensive and practical. Inside, there's a wide variety of restaurants, shops, banks, IT stores, mobile phone stores, and various services. It was easy to come for errands but ended up browsing leisurely afterwards. What I liked most was the relaxed atmosphere; it wasn't overly crowded, making it easy to navigate and not as chaotic as many larger malls. It's perfect for shopping, grabbing a bite to eat, or running errands on a weekday. Another convenient feature is the wide selection of computer, IT equipment, and mobile phone stores. Anyone looking for tech gadgets or general-purpose equipment can find plenty to choose from. Overall, it's a mall that has been a fixture in the Laksi area for a long time, offering a complete yet simple, comfortable, and convenient shopping experience. It's a place that locals frequent regularly. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

0x30e290a7be0dc75b_0x4848e9a161a5317f.text: Krung Non Market is a fairly large market. The outdoor area sells new and second-hand clothing, shoes, bed sheets, 10-baht household items, and second-hand goods displayed on sheets for customers to browse. The central area features outdoor food stalls where vendors set up their own tents, which is quite lively with many people buying food. This zone also has a ball pit for children to play in (coupons available). Inside the covered area, you'll find mobile phone shops, vegetable stalls, bakeries, and flower garland vendors. These are permanently located shops that operate daily. Most customers are residents of the Taling Chan area and migrant workers from neighboring countries, who come to shop in large numbers. Parking is available on the sides and behind the market, with designated parking areas, and it's free. There's a mobile sound system from Wat Phra Bat Nam Phu promoting the temple's products under the brand name "Jai Fah," including fabric softener, laundry detergent, dishwashing liquid, inhalers, balm, riceberry rice, and more. The money will go towards taking care of underprivileged or orphaned children who are currently under the care of the temple. So, my mother took the opportunity to buy Jai Fah products because it's a buy-one-get-two deal: she gets the product to use and also does good deeds at the same time. My mother said that if she lived around here, she would come to the market every day because she could buy everything she needed in one place.

0x30e29fa952bc97a9_0x141ae6860fbf6f9a.text: I was out and about on Christmas Day when I stumbled upon the Dental Joy clinic. Curious about dental hygiene, I decided to walk in and ask some questions. That’s when I met P Nut. I told her I had never tried flossing before, and her surprised expression quickly turned into a warm smile. She kindly offered to give me a tutorial, walking me through the process step by step. Thanks to P Nut, I not only learned how to floss properly but also had the most enjoyable teeth-brushing and mouth-washing experience of my life! Her patience, knowledge, and genuine care made all the difference. Dental Joy lives up to its name—it’s not just a clinic but a place where learning about dental health is a joy. P Nut’s dedication and enthusiasm made my visit unforgettable. If you’re looking for a dental clinic with amazing staff, Dental Joy is the place to go! Oh and Merry Christmas❤️💚

0x30e29fa952bc97a9_0x141ae6860fbf6f9a.text: I had been suffering from eroded enamel, many old fillings and some jagged teeth and knew things were likely to deteriorate to the point of losing the functionality of some before too long. I was reluctant at the outset to go through with the recommended ‘total mouth restoration’ but Dr. Suchada explained the thinking and rationale very well for me to finally accept I needed to do it. She made sure everything was done the right way (much as I hated the root canals 😆) and managed to save the tooth that looked destined to be replaced by an implant. The end result has been beyond my expectations as the cores of all my teeth were saved and built on by crowns. They feel so much better (smooth, not jaggy), look so normal & healthy and now I should have far less problems in the future. My wife is also delighted that I am smiling properly again.

0x30e29fa952bc97a9_0x141ae6860fbf6f9a.text: Very professional. I bet many customers would agree that this may be the best clinic in the city. One time, I had a bad experience with a man doctor. I wrote a formal letter about all the absurdities this man did and said, including the needless pain he had caused. Someone from upper management met me a few days later, apologizing, and supervising the “correction visit,” and they did not charge me a single satang. And this was only one time in 15 years, and my friend has been going since they opened years before that, and only had a similar problem with this same man doctor. (They told me they got rid of that doctor.) Last visit, I had a problem, and two separate doctors spent quite a bit of time with me, and the bill was under 2K baht. So, I’ll never go anywhere else, that’s for sure.

0x30e29f0291f3842b_0x736e3264da6a2f84.text: From the moment I walked into KCC Clinic in Siam Paragon, I felt immediately welcome- many of the lovely staff were in the reception area and greeted me with genuinely happy smiles and a large welcome. I was offered water by my delightful consultant Champagne, and asked to sit in a very comfortable lounge area for a complete assessment. Champagne never pushed me, suggested anything unnecessary, was most concerned with my comfort and the outcomes I desired. After my initial consultation and assessment, the amazing Dr. Karn came to me and explained all the treatments I was going to have, the effects, and what the end result would be. I was delighted to have Dr. Karn, as she is the co-founder of the clinic, and not only is she very practical about what can be achieved for each individual, but also has many years experience. During the entire process, the gorgeous Champagne was by my side at every step; helping me, explaining every process, ensuring my comfort and giving exceptional service- all very comforting, as she has a bubbly disposition and a great sense of humor! The entire staff are patient, kind, friendly and professional, and the clinic is very clean but also inviting rather than being simply clinical (which I tend not to enjoy, as it makes me feel quite uncomfortable- as if I am in a laboratory). The results of your treatment(s) are shown to you in real time, so you can see what effect they are having immediately. If you have any treatment which might involve some discomfort, you are provided the appropriate topical treatments without question, which only adds to the serene feeling of your experience. After my treatments were performed with an experienced eye, and gentle touch by the kind Dr. Karn, Champagne was waiting to happily greet me again. Both Dr. Karn and Champagne explained aftercare thoroughly and arranged for a follow-up visit, during which the progress of the treatment will be assessed and monitored. I am EXTREMELY impressed with the result, and I am told it will only improve! Champagne followed up immediately with reminders and asking how I was feeling, which was followed by messages the following day to ask if I was well, which I very much appreciated. I highly recommend KCC Clinic (Siam Paragon) for all your health and wellness advice and treatments! 🙏🏽
0x30e29f0291f3842b_0x736e3264da6a2f84.author: Cherry Blossom

0x30e29f0291f3842b_0x736e3264da6a2f84.text: This is my second time at KKC, and I’ve had another great experience. The whole team is very kind and attentive. I especially want to mention Kwang and Pui, who made the whole experience very easy and comfortable. They listen carefully to what you would like to improve, explain the different options, coordinate with the doctor, take the before-and-after photos, explain the pricing, and follow up with you after the treatment. They check how you are feeling, ask if you have had any discomfort, and send you the aftercare recommendations. I really appreciate this personalized follow-up. The doctor then evaluates your face and skin and recommends the most appropriate options, whether devices, injectables, or other treatments, based on what she actually sees. I particularly liked the doctor who treated me this time. She was very kind and seemed experienced, and I appreciated that she shared recommendations based on treatments she has personally tried and found effective. They are also very clear about expectations and explain what results you can expect immediately, after a week, after a month, and when the treatment should reach its full effect. They also explain when and how often they recommend coming back. Overall, I’m very happy with my experience and with the treatments I chose. I really like the personalized attention and follow-up, and I definitely recommend KKC.
0x30e29f0291f3842b_0x736e3264da6a2f84.author: Zkerly Vazquez Delgado

0x30e29f0291f3842b_0x736e3264da6a2f84.text: KKC is an exceptional clinic with the most wonderful staff. From start to finish I felt they were absolutely prepared and professional. Pancake was my original point of contact and she was organized, professional and informative. I spent a few months in contact with her and she answered every question I had about the procedures. I booked Upper Bleph (performed by Dr Palm) who was amazing and incredibly knowledgeable and skilled. I hardly have a scar which I’m thrilled about. Dr Karn performed the aesthetic components of Radiesse, Botox and laser, she is also incredible and achieved a result well above my expectation. APRIL, was so kind and supportive of me and was always there to hold my hand or give me a hug if I felt nervous. Checking in on me via WhatsApp on a daily basis. Such a beautiful person. Of course all the nurses were kind and compassionate and ready with hugs if needed. Thank you Au, Ann and Mimi. I’ll be back next year for touch up Botox and filler and to say hi to everyone again. I cannot recommend this clinic highly enough.
0x30e29f0291f3842b_0x736e3264da6a2f84.author: Jodie McCowan

0x30e29f0291f3842b_0x736e3264da6a2f84.text: Had a great experience at KKC Clinic! I did a few procedures: fat dissolving, Botox, fillers, HIFU, Sylfirm X microneedling and Juvelook. In total I spent about SGD 5,000 (around 129,000 THB). Special thanks to Palm, who assisted me throughout the whole experience. He made me feel very welcome and comfortable from start to finish, and explained every procedure clearly so I knew exactly what to expect. What I appreciated most was that there was no hard selling. They simply advised what I needed for my concerns and gave price comparisons, so I could decide for myself. I can already see slight results and will keep observing, since some of these treatments take time to show their full effect. Overall a very pleasant experience, and I'd recommend KKC Clinic!
0x30e29f0291f3842b_0x736e3264da6a2f84.author: Zenobia Loh

0x30e29f0291f3842b_0x736e3264da6a2f84.text: I've had face mole removal done at KKC twice now and both times the service was excellent. Everyone at the clinic is warm, friendly. Pepsi took really great care of me, checking in regularly to make sure I was comfortable which made me feel genuinely taken care of, not just like another appointment. The doctor who did my face mole removal was professional and skilled throughout the whole process. One thing that stood out to me is that aftercare. 0x30e29fa4ae2f574f_0xcc341752087446f2.en: I had my teeth cleaned at this branch about 6 months ago and was very impressed with the female dentist who treated me. Before the appointment, I clearly informed the staff that I wanted to schedule an appointment with the same dentist. Although I didn't remember her name, the staff were able to look her up in my records and tell me her name, so I understood that the appointment was confirmed. However, upon arrival, I was treated by a different male dentist without prior notice, which was disappointing because the main reason I returned was to consult and follow up with the same dentist. If it wasn't possible to schedule an appointment with him, I should have been informed during the booking process. In addition, there was some confusion regarding the appointment time and treatment cost, making this experience less positive than the first time, and I probably won't return. I would like the reception staff to be more careful in their work. It seems they might be trial staff, which I understand.

0x30da3018cc5a2ecd_0x673169aa7a77984d.text: A chic and up and coming shopping zone with plenty of parking. They have a weekly market that is very clean and plenty of food and veges to offer. There is also a very good animal hospital and staff who speaks good English. A great place for you to walk around to shop. There are many food outlets around that area.
0x30da3018cc5a2ecd_0x673169aa7a77984d.author: Weng Kin Lau

0x30da3018cc5a2ecd_0x673169aa7a77984d.text: Huge landmark, there are many shops and restaurants here (many kind - Thai, Western, Japanese, Chinese, Korean) including pastry shops. Also, a lot of food trucks here and if i remember well there is a street market once a week here (not sure if every Monday or Friday). There is a big Vet shop here too.
0x30da3018cc5a2ecd_0x673169aa7a77984d.author: Nitima Chaiboonruang

0x30da3018cc5a2ecd_0x673169aa7a77984d.text: This community mall offers a wide variety of food, snacks, desserts, and drinks. There's a daily evening market on Mondays and Wednesdays. There are also shops selling cosmetics and household goods, a car wash, mobile phone stores, massage parlors, a Chinese medicine clinic, and an animal hospital. Overall, it's a well-developed community mall.
0x30da3018cc5a2ecd_0x673169aa7a77984d.author: TANUN JAISUE

0x30da3018cc5a2ecd_0x673169aa7a77984d.text: It's changed a lot from 4-5 years ago. Now there are tons of restaurants and many famous dessert brands, but parking is getting progressively harder. In terms of transactions, the banks are closed. The mall still has Tops, Watson, and Lotus (across the street). Overall, it looks more modern and accessible to people than before.
0x30da3018cc5a2ecd_0x673169aa7a77984d.author: Pattra TNC

0x30da3018cc5a2ecd_0x673169aa7a77984d.text: The market set up on the premises had a wide variety of vegetables, fruits, and prepared foods on display.
0x30da3018cc5a2ecd_0x673169aa7a77984d.author: 松村郡守

0x305031e53d641c2b_0xd501c53a8feb874a.text: Very good clinic. I had a dental abscess, and it was extremely painful, so I decided to visit this clinic based on reviews, especially because of how they treat foreigners. During my first visit, I filled out forms where I could indicate my language level. Even though my English is quite poor and I only speak Russian, everything went smoothly. After completing the paperwork and entering the office, I was welcomed by the dentist and the assistant. Before the treatment, the doctor explained the entire process to me, including treatment options and costs. The procedure itself was very comfortable and stress-free — I’m actually very afraid of dentists, haha. They warned me before the anesthesia and even apologized for small things, which was very sweet. Thank you for your care and professionalism. Considering my condition and my preferences, the total cost came to 15,000 baht, which I think is very reasonable for a private clinic, especially given the high level of professionalism. The reception staff were also very kind and understanding. If I didn’t understand something, they always tried to explain it or translate it into Russian. Thank you so much!
0x305031e53d641c2b_0xd501c53a8feb874a.author: Карина Волкова

0x305031e53d641c2b_0xd501c53a8feb874a.text: I’m an Australian currently living in Switzerland and did a lot of research before choosing a dentist in Phuket. Rang Hill consistently came up as one of the best and safest clinics, so I decided to go with them. Really impressed overall. The clinic is modern, very clean, and runs professionally....... you can tell they have high standards and very skilled doctors! Dr. Apinya Jariyasoontorn was excellent. She was thorough, explained everything clearly, and took real care with the work. I had cleaning, X-rays and multiple fillings done, and the level of detail really stood out. ( Some complex fillings were very close to the root with zero pain throughout the treatment and after) You can also tell by the way the clinic is run that pricing is fair and consistent, it doesn’t feel like one of those places that inflates prices for tourists. Everything was transparent from the start. Would definitely recommend if you’re looking for quality dental care in Phuket (possibly better then Australian clinics that have grsds doing your work) Also shout out to all the team members at the clinic, whole process was extremely smooth and well run :)
0x305031e53d641c2b_0xd501c53a8feb874a.author: Jackson Rolfe

0x305031e53d641c2b_0xd501c53a8feb874a.text: I had a consultation at Rang Hill Dental Clinic and was genuinely impressed by the professionalism and honesty of the team. The clinic was very clean, modern, and well organized, and all the staff were polite, calm, and welcoming from the moment I arrived. I was seen by Dr Amonrat, and what I appreciated most was the Dr’s ethical and conservative approach. Instead of trying to sell me expensive cosmetic procedures, she carefully reviewed my X-rays, explained my bite and dental condition clearly, and recommended only the treatments that were genuinely appropriate for my situation. She was honest about the limitations and risks of cosmetic bonding in my case, which gave me a lot of confidence and trust. I really respected that the focus was on long-term dental health and the patient’s best interest, not unnecessary superficial treatment. Highly recommended for anyone looking for honest, professional dental care in Phuket.
0x305031e53d641c2b_0xd501c53a8feb874a.author: Dhafir Moussa

0x305031e53d641c2b_0xd501c53a8feb874a.text: My wife and I visited this dental clinic to request a treatment plan and then completed all the treatments over several appointments. We are extremely satisfied with our experience from start to finish. The entire team is wonderful: the assistants are kind, attentive, and professional, and the front desk staff is welcoming, well organized, and always helpful. We do not speak Thai and only speak very basic English, but everyone made a real effort to communicate with us and ensure everything went smoothly. This made a huge difference and made us feel completely comfortable and confident. A special thank you to Dr. Thanapon Chumnak, who is an exceptionally skilled and professional dentist, and also very gentle during treatments. His calm and reassuring approach truly puts patients at ease. We highly recommend this clinic without hesitation. Excellent care, both professionally and humanly.
0x305031e53d641c2b_0xd501c53a8feb874a.author: pêche extremadura

0x305031e53d641c2b_0xd501c53a8feb874a.text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ I am extremely satisfied with my visit to this clinic and with the consultation from Dr. Thanapon. The service was excellent, and everything was explained very clearly. Communication was very easy thanks to translation through a GPT chat, which made the entire experience smooth and stress-free. All necessary procedures and X-rays were done immediately, and any additional images were sent to me right away via WhatsApp. I was offered several treatment options without any pressure to decide on the spot. Everything felt easy, comfortable, and very professional. I am very happy with my experience and would highly recommend both Dr. Thanapon and this clinic.
0x305031e53d641c2b_0xd501c53a8feb874a.author: Natalia Gordiukova

0x305031e53d641c2b_0xd501c53a8feb874a.text: I had a filling done by Dr. Amonrat and she was absolutely wonderful. I would highly recommend her to anyone looking for a dentist who is both highly competent and genuinely compassionate. Thank you, Dr. Amonrat! 😊

0x305031e53d641c2b_0xd501c53a8feb874a.author: Igor Khromov

0x30e2a3826d544345_0x30cc398636f3ed23.text: เมื่อวันเสาร์ที่20​ ธค68 มาขูดหินปูน+เอกซเรย์ฟันคุดค่ะ​ มาขูดหินปูนครั้งแรกคุณหมอ​แดนซ์กับผู้ช่วยและพยาบาลทำเบามือดีมากเลยค่ะ​ พูดน่ารักให้เราไม่เกร็งและคอยถามอาการตลอดเลยค่ะ​ ปรึกษาได้​ และเราทำไม่เจ็บเลยค่ะถึงแม้จะมีคราบเยอะ​ เรื่องของการรันคิว​ทางคลินิกมีเลทบ้างนิดหน่อยค่ะ​ นัด14.00​ ทางพนักงานหน้าเคาเตอร์เช็คแล้วเช็คอีก​ และก็ได้บัตรคิวมาโชคดีที่มีคิวเราก่อนหน้า3คิวเลยรอไม่นาน เลยได้ทำประมาณ14.30 เลยไม่รู้จะให้จองเวลาทำไม​ ฟีลเหมือนมาวอคอินรับบัตรคิวมากกว่า​ เรื่องค่าใช้จ่ายถือว่าสมเหตุสมผลเทียบกับคุณภาพหมอค่ะ​ ของทางแอดมินและคลินิกบอก800-1200 แต่เราโดนคิดไป1300 (อาจจะเป็นเพราะคราบเยอะมาก)​ และที่น่าชื่นชมมาก​เป็นเรืรองของคลินิกสะอาดมากค่ะ​ มีเครื่องกรองทุกที่​ และมีของตกแต่งน่ารักๆๆให้ดูด้วยค่ะ​ ทำให้คลายกังวลสำหรับคนกลัวหมอฟัน​ โดยรวมถือว่าดีมากค่ะ​ อาจะจะต้องให้จัดการรันคิวระบบหลังบ้านดีกว่านี้ให้แน่ชัดกว่านี้นะคะ
0x30e2a3826d544345_0x30cc398636f3ed23.en: On Saturday, December 20th, 2025, I came for a teeth cleaning and wisdom tooth X-ray. It was my first time getting my teeth cleaned. Dr. Dance, along with her assistants and nurses, were very gentle. They were very kind, making me feel relaxed, and constantly checked on me. They were very helpful and the procedure was painless, even though I had a lot of plaque. Regarding the queuing system, there were some delays. My appointment was at 2 PM, but the counter staff double-checked my schedule. Luckily, there were only 3 people ahead of me, so I didn't have to wait long. I was treated around 2:30 PM. I don't understand why they even bother making appointments; it felt more like a walk-in appointment. The cost was reasonable considering the doctor's quality. The clinic and admin said 800-1200 baht, but I was charged 1300 baht (possibly because of the extensive plaque). What's most commendable is how clean the clinic is. There are air purifiers everywhere, and they have cute decorations, which helps alleviate anxiety for someone afraid of dentists. Overall, it was a very good experience. Perhaps they need to improve their back-end queuing system to make it more efficient.

0x30e2a3826d544345_0x30cc398636f3ed23.text: มาทำฟัน 2 ครั้ง ประทับใจมาก ครั้งแรกเจอหมอผู้หญิง ครั้งที่ 2 เจอหมอผู้ชาย ทั้ง2 ท่านน่ารักมาก พูดเพราะ มือเบามาก มีการแนะนำวิธีการรักษา แจ้งค่ารักษา โดยละเอียด น้องๆ บริการดี น่ารัก ยิ้มแย้ม พูดเพราะ บ่งบอกถึงความใส่ใจของ ผู้บริหารที่ให้ความสำคัญ ทั้งในด้านการรักษาโดยใช้ทีมแพทย์ผู้เชียวชาญระดับมืออาชีพ และ การให้บริการของพนักงานที่ผ่านการอบรมมาโดยเฉพาะ สำหรับเราถือว่าเป็นคลีนิคที่ดีมาก ถ้าเทียบกับที่เคยไปรักษาที่อื่นมา คุณหมอ ให้คำแนะนำดีมาก มีการจัดให้เรา รักษาฟัน กับคุณหมอ เฉพาะทางโดยตรง มีการติดตามอาการหลังทำฟัน เรียกได้ว่าใส่ใจมากๆ ประทับใจมากค่ะ ใครที่กำลังมองหา คลีนิคทำฟันดีๆ แนะนำเลยค่ะ 👍👍👍
0x30e2a3826d544345_0x30cc398636f3ed23.en: I had dental work done twice and was very impressed. The first time I saw a female dentist, and the second time a male dentist. Both were very kind, spoke gently, and were very gentle. They explained the treatment methods and explained the costs in detail. The staff were also very nice, friendly, and polite, showing the care and attention the management places on both the quality of treatment by a team of professional dentists and the service provided by specially trained staff. For me, this is a much better clinic compared to other places I've been to. The doctors gave excellent advice and arranged for me to receive treatment from a specialist. They also followed up after the treatment, showing great care. I was very impressed. If you're looking for a good dental clinic, I highly recommend this one! 👍👍👍

0x30e2a3826d544345_0x30cc398636f3ed23.text: ... เมื่อวานค่ำไปใช้บริการครั้งแรก แล้วประทับใจมาก ๆ เลยค่ะ มีปัญหาเรื่องฟันยื่น+กลัวการทำฟันมาก ๆ เลือกไปไกลบ้าน เพราะอ่านรีวิวที่หมอเข้าใจคนไข้ แต่ผลที่ได้เกินคาดมากค่ะ......... ความสบายใจแบบสุดเลยค่ะ พนักงานบริการ น่ารักทุกคนเลยค่ะ หมอเอให้วิเคราะห์ปัญหาคนไข้+ให้คำแนะนำการจัดฟันดีมากค่ะ และบอกให้ทราบถึงข้อดี-ข้อเสีย ของทุกแนวทางที่เราจะเลือก อีกทั้งให้เกียรติคนไข้ได้ตัดสินใจด้วย ตัวเองก่อน และไปอุดฟันต่อกับหมอพลอย มือเบามากกกกก ใจดีมาก ๆ ค่ะ 💕❤️💕❤️ ขอบคุณมาตรฐานที่ดีและสร้างความประทับใจให้คนไข้มาก ๆ ค่ะ 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏
0x30e2a3826d544345_0x30cc398636f3ed23.en: ...I went for my first visit last night and was very impressed! I have a problem with protruding teeth and am very afraid of dental work. 0x30e2a3826d544345_0x30cc398636f3ed23.text: วันนี้มาอุดฟันกับคุณหมอมิ้นค่ะ คุณหมอทำแบบละเอียดใจเย็น ไม่รีบ และให้กำลังใจตลอดเวลาที่ทำเลยค่ะ รวมถึงคุณผู้ช่วยคุณหมอก็บริการดีค่ะ และคุณหมอมิ้นให้คำแนะนำในการแปรงฟันด้วยค่ะ 🫶🏻 คลินิกมีการรันคิวเร็ว แนะนำให้จองไว้ก่อน ก่อนถึงวันทำฟันจะมีเจ้าหน้าที่โทรมาแจ้งเตือนค่ะ และเคยผ่าฟันคุดที่คลินิกด้วยเมื่อหลายปีก่อน แต่จำชื่อคุณหมอไม่ได้ค่ะ เป็นคุณหมอผู้ชาย พอทำเสร็จหน้าไม่บวมเลยค่ะ พนักงานหน้าเค้าเตอร์ก็บริการดีค่ะ จ่ายบัตรเครดิต โอนจ่าย เงินสดได้หมดเลยค่ะ แนะนำคลินิกนี้เลยค่ะ คุณหมอไม่รุนแรง น่ารักมากๆค่ะ 🥰💕
0x30e2a3826d544345_0x30cc398636f3ed23.en: Today I had a filling done with Dr. Mint. She was very meticulous, calm, and unhurried, and offered encouragement throughout the procedure. 0x30e2993bacb0f1bf_0x9fc32631cf4b0efd.text: I once sought treatment for food poisoning at Hua Chiao Hospital. Despite the severity of my symptoms, no tests or further investigations were conducted. They simply said I had diarrhea, gave me IV fluids, and sent me home. My condition worsened, I fainted, and after seeking treatment elsewhere, I discovered I had rotavirus and had to be admitted to another hospital for four days. The first day at Hua Chiao, before returning home, I almost died from shock. In another case, my mother's health insurance is terrible. The service here is awful; they are indifferent and neglectful of her illness. The doctors' responses were as if we were begging for treatment. They let her condition worsen for months without doing anything. It was difficult to get her transferred elsewhere. Her mental health was so severe she couldn't function, speak, or walk. Yet, the doctor suggested she try sewing, find something to cheer her up, and take her to the beach. Such nonsensical responses! The patient was seriously ill, unable to live, suffering from both mental and physical ailments. Hua Chiao Hospital didn't even inform the family that they didn't have a resident psychiatrist. They let a mentally ill patient with severe symptoms stay there for half a year with inadequate staff and facilities, until her condition deteriorated drastically. We only agreed to transfer her to another psychiatrist after we protested. The staff here are terrible, careless, and the nurses and doctors don't communicate or coordinate. Information is often missed, and the burden is shifted to the family. They never know the answers to questions; it's like they're just sitting around playing. Many times, when patients are discharged, they don't thoroughly check vital signs, just want them to go home. Ultimately, their oxygen levels drop, requiring ICU admission. Once, they discharged my mother even though she was unresponsive and her condition worsened. When I called the hospital, they said they'd reported it to management and told me to bring her in immediately. We called an ambulance because my mother's condition was very serious. When we arrived, the emergency room doctor said she was fine and could go home. When I asked about the phone call and the confirmation that they'd reported it, I got no answer. They told me to come back the next day, as if time and illness were a joke. In the end, the nephrologist who had previously treated my mother saw her and admitted her to the ICU. This experience was also frustrating and confusing. I'm wondering if there are any real standards of care here, or if they're just doing things haphazardly. How did the first doctor examine her and let her go home, while another doctor admitted her to the ICU? Or would we not have received treatment if we hadn't seen that doctor that day? And the claim that they told us to bring her in immediately because they'd reported it to management—I don't know if that was true or just a way to get it over with, because ultimately, there was no treatment or care provided. They just wanted to send her home that day. It's happened countless times. It's truly awful, and the situation here just keeps getting worse. I don't know if it's because people with social security insurance don't value their lives the same way as others, but they seem to neglect treatment.

0x30519541c1b0b233_0x70871ac2a5203418.text: My bf and I booked a "try scuba diving" experience, and it was a lot of fun. There were one other couple and another girl on the boat that day. The couple is doing a PADI course, the girl has done this for like 50 times already so she is super experienced. This was our first time diving, so it was also super cool to talk with them about their experiences. 3 coaches went with us that day: Ame, Big and Ohm. Ame is obviously the patient, wise teacher type. He is fluent in English, and is very expressive and responsible. He makes sure all details are clear. Big is the funny one. He is so energetic and happy all the time and can jump around on the boat even when it's super bumpy. It's almost like a super power. And this is a special shout out to Ohm, our life guard in the ocean. He is friendly, patient, and kind. He takes super good pictures under the water for us and carried us around the whole time. I just have 2 advice for people who want to try this for the first time: 1. Take motion sickness pills one day before or at least 1 hour before!! If you don't know if you will get seasick, think if you get carsick and if you do, you'll get seasick for sure. I didn't take pills so I threw up three times. It was embarrassing and painful... You should also google how to throw up while scuba diving btw, because it could be dangerous. 2. Take some clothes for changing because your clothes could get wet and it will be cold after the dives if you don't have dry clothes. Take an extra towel as well if you can. Otherwise have fun!!! And sorry Ohm that i threw up on you in the sea...🙈🙈🙈

0x30519541c1b0b233_0x70871ac2a5203418.text: We saw google reviews and went for enquiry about scuba dive for 1day which is near to our booked resort in Krabi with several companies. But they were very friendly and the lady answered all of our questions and showed so many videos and photos who went scuba dive without knowing swimming. 0x30e2999e0cd1cf99_0x8ffdd6b096ccdfc6.text: I can’t say enough positive things about this clinic. I had a hair transplant back in 2019 in Hong Kong and the results were underwhelming to say the least with a 30% survival rate. My rationale at the time was that medical quality was better in HK than Thailand. How wrong I was. I undertook a far bigger transplant with 3M and the results are astounding. My hair is back to the way it was 20 years ago. I was told the target survival ratio was 90% and I personally felt it was even higher than that for me. The after care was incredible and likely a key factor in the high survival rate as was the PRP injections they recommended. The core differentiation versus my experience in Hong Kong was 1) the sheer volume of staff; hair transplants are labour and time sensitive meaning more staff equals better results (and was why they were able to do 5000 grafts which most clinics will refuse to do), 2) the extreme level and quality of aftercare. I think this may be because 3M is listed on the Bangkok Exchange and hence very risk adverse to a single patient ending up with a head full of infected follicles and 3) the ancillary optional services such as medication issuance and stem cell injections. All in all I am incredibly grateful for the amazing job they did. They completely restored my hair. If I had one extremely minor criticism it would be that they use someone with actual training to cut your hair short when you first come in (or recommend patients to go to a proper barber beforehand). The haircut I was given (and had to live with for a month) looked pretty awful to say the least.

0x30e29f003ac34685_0x7c2797469d26839a.text: I had Ultraformer treatment at Talisa Clinic, Siam Square One branch, at the beginning of last month. I had 800 shots done, focusing on my cheeks and jawline because I felt my face was starting to sag and my jawline wasn't as defined. Before the treatment, the doctor thoroughly checked my face, examining both sides and advising on which areas needed attention. During the procedure, they carefully worked on each point, constantly asking if I was in pain or if I was comfortable. It was better than I expected. After the treatment, looking in the mirror, I could immediately see that my face was lifted, especially my cheeks and jawline. My jawline looked more defined, and my face looked firmer and more contoured, but still natural – not stiff or unnatural. Now, almost a month later, I like the results even more than the first day. My cheeks, which used to sag, are noticeably lifted, my jawline is much sharper, and my face looks smaller without having to find the perfect angle for photos! Especially in side photos, the lift in my cheeks and jawline is very noticeable. Comparing before and after photos, the difference is quite significant. This exceeded my expectations. The service was also good; the staff were attentive and didn't push me to buy additional treatments or packages, which I appreciated because I don't like being pressured into buying things at clinics. Overall, after about a month of waiting, I'm very happy with the results. The results were great immediately after the procedure, but after a month, the facial contours became even more defined, especially the cheeks and jawline. I feel like I made the right choice with 800 shots this time.

0x30e29919601934c9_0xf3255dacb5718e8a.text: This legendary restaurant serves incredibly delicious food. I heard they were the first to open in Thailand, so I came to try it. 0x30e29919601934c9_0xf3255dacb5718e8a.text: It is the most authentic Indian restaurant in Bangkok. It remains connected to its roots in a very humble location in Phahurat area. After having a great meal buy some of the traditional sweets outside the restaurant to take home.
0x30e29919601934c9_0xf3255dacb5718e8a.author: Paulo Gaspar

0x30e29919601934c9_0xf3255dacb5718e8a.text: During our trip to Bangkok's China Town, we decided to visit the Royal India Restaurant to satisfy our craving for Indian cuisine in Thailand. Despite initial apprehensions due to its unassuming exterior, the positive Google Maps reviews spurred us to give it a chance. Our hopes wavered as we approached, but once we tasted the food, they were immediately reignited. The dining experience at Royal India Restaurant turned out to be a delightful surprise. The moment we took our first bites, any doubts were dispelled. The flavors of the Indian dishes were simply exquisite, exceeding our expectations in every way. From aromatic curries to perfectly cooked rotis, every dish was a testament to their culinary prowess. Though the restaurant's appearance might not be as inviting, the true gem lies within its kitchen. For any Indian missing the familiar tastes of home while in Thailand, this establishment comes highly recommended. The journey from uncertainty to culinary satisfaction was a memorable one, reminding us not to judge a book by its cover.
0x30e29919601934c9_0xf3255dacb5718e8a.author: Rithu Maria Jose

0x30e29919601934c9_0xf3255dacb5718e8a.text: This place has a signage on the main road. The eatery itself is in the lane. The raita (seasoned yoghurt) with cucumber & potatoes was well seasoned, it was nice by itself as well as with roti. The Aloo Paratha was well made & seasoned. It was soft & nice on its own! The tandoori roti was also good. The Dal Makhani was perfect with the roti. The Vegetable Jalfrazi could have been seasoned better. The flavour was not right. Ended the meal with masala chai, perfect after an Indian meal. The mithai / sweetmeats were also good. The chum chum was mildly sweet & the center's thickened cream balanced the flavour. The rasmalai was white instead of the usual saffron infused yellow. The cream could have been a little thicker! The waitress serving us was good. She knew the menu & was friendly.

0x30e29f452907deff_0xb5669c0d8eba0b1c.text: I had liposuction on my stomach to create an S-shaped and sexy line about two weeks ago. My waist has decreased by almost 2 inches, and I've lost weight too. My stomach is flat, and I'm starting to see my abs. At first, I was worried about whether it would lose weight because I was a bit swollen, but it's exceeded my expectations. I'm very impressed. The doctor and staff were excellent. I went alone on the day of the procedure and was under general anesthesia, but it wasn't as scary as I thought. I rested for a short time and was able to go home. I didn't experience much pain afterward, probably because the medication made for a comfortable sleep the first night.
