0x30da300aaba356d7_0x6145ea5dbbec613a.text: I took my 9-year-old daughter to Dental World after she had a really upsetting and traumatic experience at another dentist, so I was quite anxious about how she would react to another appointment. Before we went in, I explained what had happened previously and that, more than anything, she needed to have a positive experience and rebuild her confidence around going to the dentist. The team were absolutely wonderful. They listened to what I told them and, importantly, they didn’t push her into having treatment or do anything intrusive just for the sake of doing it. They completely understood that the priority was making her feel safe, comfortable and in control. The way they interacted with her was gentle, patient and reassuring. There was no pressure and they gave her the time she needed, which made such a difference. By the end of the appointment, she was so much more relaxed, and I left feeling incredibly relieved that we'd finally had a positive dental experience. I also had an appointment myself while we were there and was very happy with the service I received, but honestly, it was the way they treated my daughter that impressed me most. As a parent, finding a dentist you can trust with a child who is already frightened of dental treatment is incredibly important. Dental World gave my daughter exactly the kind of experience she needed, and I’m very grateful to the whole team. I would absolutely recommend them to other parents, especially if their child is nervous or has had a difficult experience at the dentist before.

Firstly, as an extremely nervous and anxious patient with a strong phobia, I was very scared for my appointment and haven’t visited a dentist is a very long time (5+ years). I contacted via WhatsApp and the team were so helpful and friendly, they put me at ease and explained that they have solutions for nervous patients such as nitrous oxide. I was still very worried, but the second I stepped into Dental World my anxiety was eased, the staff and my very calm, considerate and empathetic dentist Dr. Keratiporn made me feel so comfortable and were very patient with me ensuring I was both mentally and physically okay during the procedure. The clinic and surrounding areas are also beautiful, this place is the highest standard of dentistry and everything runs so smoothly, I was in and out in 45+ minutes and the work they have done is amazing! I highly recommend for anyone needing dental treatment in Chiang Mai, the prices were exceptional for the level of care and service provided. Looks like I’ll just have to come to Chiang Mai again each year for my dental appointments! 😇🇹🇭 Thank you to the team at the clinic for helping me overcome my phobia of the dentist, hopefully each time I will get more comfortable with my visits!
0x30da300aaba356d7_0x6145ea5dbbec613a.author: Zac Smith

0x30da300aaba356d7_0x6145ea5dbbec613a.text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 I had an exceptional experience at this dental clinic today. From the moment I arrived, the entire team was incredibly professional, caring, and patient-centered. I came in with a painful infected tooth, feeling nervous and uncomfortable, but they took care of me with genuine compassion and expertise. The dentist explained every step clearly, made sure I felt safe, and performed my extraction gently and efficiently. What impressed me the most was their kindness and their attention to detail — they truly go above and beyond. After I left, they even followed up with me on WhatsApp to check how I was doing and to make sure my pain was under control. This level of care is rare, and it made me feel supported the entire time. The clinic is clean, organized, and very accommodating to foreigners. I highly recommend this place to anyone in Chiang Mai looking for high-quality dental care. Thank you to the entire team for taking such good care of me during a difficult moment — I am truly grateful.
0x30da300aaba356d7_0x6145ea5dbbec613a.author: Rosenildo Sacramento

0x30da300aaba356d7_0x6145ea5dbbec613a.text: I visited Dental World Chiang Mai because I was experiencing a very sensitive and painful tooth. From the moment I arrived, the staff was friendly, professional, and reassuring. The dentist performed a thorough examination, clearly explained the situation, and answered all of my questions. What impressed me most was their honesty. They did not recommend any unnecessary treatments or procedures simply to make money. After the examination, they advised that no treatment was needed at that time, which gave me a lot of confidence in their professionalism and ethics. The clinic is modern, clean, and well organized, and the prices are extremely reasonable compared to dental care in the Netherlands. It’s refreshing to find a clinic that genuinely puts the patient’s best interests first. I highly recommend Dental World Chiang Mai to anyone looking for trustworthy, high-quality dental care in Thailand. Thank you to the entire team for your excellent service and honest advice! And especially Dr.Pisutthinee 🙏🦷🇹🇭
0x30da300aaba356d7_0x6145ea5dbbec613a.author: Hendrik Blijden

0x30da300aaba356d7_0x6145ea5dbbec613a.text: Better service than in Europe, from my experience. I am super grateful for the gum treatment, that Dr. Teerat Sawangpanyangkura was able to treat. It was almost irreversible, yet in London, UK I was told that it's nothing to worry about and I can come back in a few months. Dr. Teerat Sawangpanyangkura was very focused and dedicated to help, went over my gums multiple times to check that there is no area left unnoticed. I also had 2 of my wisdom teeth removed here (1 impacted) by Dr. Surasak Yowcharoensuk, who was so gentle and professional, gave me music to listen to during my surgery, great aftercare service too. All of the staff was very kind and helpful, spoke well in English and made me feel extremely comfortable. Even checked on me multiple times over Whatsapp to ask how my healing is going and gave me tips. I am just super grateful for everyone, I was very scared as I had some unfortunate issues, but would trust this clinic with any of the issues I may have in the future.
0x30da300aaba356d7_0x6145ea5dbbec613a.author: Ella Pockevičiūtė

0x30da300aaba356d7_0x6145ea5dbbec613a.text: A local person introduced me to this clinic about eight years ago. And they maintain their high quality of service as usual from front desk staff to the dentists. Probably of this reason, I noticed there are many more foreign clients compared to the past. I usually feel very nervous and anxious about visiting the dentist, but not with this one. So, unless it's urgent i can't wait or I will keep all my dental appointments—including cleanings—at this clinic. The experience so far has been great. I just finished a filling. I didn’t even feel the anesthesia needle and kept asking when it would be done. In my home country, that injection is painful. After the filling on my molar, I experienced some sensitivity for a few days. I called the clinic and they scheduled an appointment for me in the same day. They care about their patients, just like in the past. The dentist gave me professional advice, and the next day the sensitivity had already reduced.
0x30da300aaba356d7_0x6145ea5dbbec613a.author: Adina

0x30da300aaba356d7_0x6145ea5dbbec613a.text: I was feeling some sensitivity in my teeth for a couple of days. I messaged dental world on WhatsApp and was able to schedule an appointment right away. The dentist was waiting for me when I arrived, ready to begin the assessment. The dentist told me exactly how much everything cost up front and made sure I understood why she was doing what she was doing. She was able to fill 3 cavities during the appointment. The dentist was very gentle and patient with me , understanding my pain tolerance and making sure that I was comfortable. They also took x-rays and spent time showing me the x-rays and explaining what is happening inside each tooth. I am so happy with my decision to go to this dentist. The price was fair and made sense for each part of the procedure. Dental world will be my regular dentist in Chiang Mai! I highly recommend for anyone looking for a good, reputable, and fairly priced dentist.

We were attracted to this dental clinic because of the great reviews and our experience lived up to that. My husband had a scale and polish with Dr Jirawit Inthayat, which was efficient, professional and painless. His cost was 1,100 baht. I had the same treatment (same cost) but I paid 400 baht for fluoride treatment. My dentist was Dr Pisuttinee Suwan and she found two small cavities. She was able to do them right after my clean (1,000 baht each for a filling). My teeth are a little sensitive so I really appreciated the care taken and great communication throughout the appointment. As a tourist from Australia, it was our first time experiencing an overseas dentist. The reception staff are professional and the clinic is like one I would expect in Australia. Everyone spoke good English. Thank you and we highly recommend! 😊🙏
0x30da300aaba356d7_0x6145ea5dbbec613a.author: Karen Scott

0x30e29f9c9a01c193_0x1fc177af344b11bf.text: My wife and I visited Multident Dental Clinic on Tuesday morning while we were in Bangkok, and we honestly couldn’t be happier with the experience. We had booked in advance, arrived at 11am, and by the time we left we had both had our composite teeth done. The work was absolutely outstanding — the results look fantastic and the price was very good. The service was 10 out of 10. The dentist who carried out our treatment was extremely professional and skilled, and all the staff were friendly, welcoming, and very helpful throughout the whole visit. We were so impressed that we have already recommended the clinic to our friends, and they are ready to go and get their teeth done as well. What more can I say — keep up the great work, you are the best! Thank you very much. Mr. West 😁

0x30da3a888e628539_0xcaf0f7a2d971d615.text: I lived in Phuket, Thailand for almost 15 years, now retired and traveling here there and everywhere. This is one of the best dental clinic in Thailand. Since my last teeth examination and cleaning in Bangkok about 1.5 years ago, I decided to check and clean my teeth while traveling in Chiang Mai. Based on google review, I went to another dental clinic to have my teeth cleaned and checked yesterday. Unfortunately, the experience was bad (may see my another review if interested). So I had to search again and finally decided to come to this one. I told the dentist that in my previous visit to another clinic, I was informed that there might be decays in my teeth that need filling. She examined my teeth thoroughly and concluded that there isn't any problem. To ease my concern, she suggested making an X-ray examination which subsequently reaffirmed her conclusion. Not only showing her professional and skillful dentistry, compared with the previous dentist trying to cheat me that there were 5 decays that need filling at a cost of 4,000 Bahts (800 Bahts each), the ethics of is dentist in DC Dental Clinic is definitely worth appraising.

I had an emergency dental situation while traveling, and the team at DC Dental Clinic was absolutely incredible. They were so kind and managed to fit me in for an appointment almost immediately to address my pain. Dr. Duitreed Choradol is a lovely person and a true professional. She was incredibly gentle and took the time to explain every detail and step of the treatment, which really helped put me at ease. She was focused on alleviating my pain and handled the broken tooth with expert care. Furthermore, the clinic was extremely helpful in providing all the necessary, detailed documentation I needed for my insurance reimbursement. The facility is spotless, and the staff speaks an excellent level of English. Thank you so much, Dr. Duitreed, for your wonderful care! I highly recommend this clinic to anyone in Chiang Mai.

I had a really good experience at DC Dental Clinic. From my first inquiry up to my recent visits, the staff have been very accommodating and kind. They explain the procedures clearly, which helped ease my worries, especially since I was very nervous about my extractions. The orthodontist is professional and patient, making sure I was comfortable during every step of my braces journey. Even though I had four teeth removed, they handled it well and guided me on what to expect and how to take care of myself after. The clinic is clean, organized, and the overall service is worth the cost. I truly appreciate how they take care of their patients. I would definitely recommend DC Dental Clinic to anyone planning to get braces or dental treatment.

Hi, everyone I came here just to fix my broken tooth . It was my first time I didn't use the anesthetic .! The dentist was so gentle ,calm and kind so that I decided to have my teeth checked, cleaned and also whitened. Everything was complete nicely within 2 hours. The clinic was awesome impressive clean as shown in the pictures. The atmosphere and staff were excellent and friendly. Moreover, the rate of service was reasonable happily. Thank you for your service 🙏.

The doctors & staff are very friendly and took great care of me during my visits. I came twice. First appointment: cleaning + whitening. Second appointment: Root canal + fillings. I get nervous when it comes to root canals but the doctor & the assistant made me feel at ease the entire time. They were thorough & gentle. Thank you DC Dental Chiang Mai ; ขอบคุณ 🙏🏾

Exceptional experience. I had my veneers done here, and the level of artistry is outstanding. The dentist is highly skilled and meticulous, while the staff ensures you feel comfortable throughout every visit. It’s hard to find this kind of premium cosmetic dental care at such an honest price point. Highly recommended if you’re looking to upgrade your smile.😁

A no frills, no fuss dental clinic that gets the job done. I made an appointment the day before and they were able to slot me and my friend in. Cleaning took about 25 minutes and was thorough. They will tell you the price beforehand after looking at your teeth at the initial consultation. A fraction of what I would have paid back home... Very worth it!

My 1st initial visit to DC Dental was based on recommendation from a guest at my condo who is visiting from UK. I asked for exam and cleaning since it had been 1-1/2 years since my last from my regular dentist in Pattaya. My appointment was for 1p.m. I arrived at 12:50 with expectation of some paperwork to be filled out took about 2 min. I waited until 1:30 until dentist arrived, I do not mind waiting 5-10 minutes for appointments but 30 min. A bit much, regardless got into chair cleaned and polished in 15 min. Again my dentist minimum 30 min. Maybe because of late arrival she became backed up with clients who arrived while I was in chair. Just felt a bit rushed. As far as cleaning goes I unfortunately had motorcycle accident after leaving office, oil on road,and in hospital now with broken clavicle, so just finally had opportunity to look teeth over more closely. I would say 9 out of 10 on cleaning,looks like maybe 1 or 2 places needed more attention maybe not? Since she did not explain if this is a good as it gets. 3.5 stars.

0x30e28f17a0a51dc3_0xb60ac45d37f89ab0.text: Jas Green Village is a beautiful community mall. Entering the mall, you'll feel the lushness of the trees. There's a small river inside the mall, with swans and ducks. There are many restaurants, both famous ones and those renting space to open their own shops. These include Fuji, KFC, MK, Yayoi, Bonchon, and the Suki Teenoi buffet. There's also Swenssense ice cream and many other shops. There's a food court (but it's very quiet; almost all the shops are gone, it seems like a break area for the mall employees). There's a Starbucks coffee shop. There's also a Tops Supermarket, a beauty clinic, a dental clinic, a massage parlor, a beauty salon, a pharmacy, a special education school, and many other things. Come visit!
0x30e28f17a0a51dc3_0xb60ac45d37f89ab0.author: Kitisak Prasatkaew

0x30e28f17a0a51dc3_0xb60ac45d37f89ab0.text: Jas Green Village has a huge variety of restaurants. This was my first time here. There's parking in both the front and back. If you park in the back, there's a shuttle service. The overall place is beautiful and nice to walk around. Today I ate at Shabu Shabu, and this branch was very impressive. The staff were all very attentive and quick; orders were fulfilled immediately. They constantly cleared plates from the tables. The food and the restaurant itself were clean. Unfortunately, I forgot to take pictures of the interior.

There is parking in the lot in front of the mall, but if you come on a holiday or in the evening, it might be a bit hard to find. Even during the day, it's still difficult on weekdays.
0x30e28f17a0a51dc3_0xb60ac45d37f89ab0.author: Omiiigod CJ.

0x3051928eb2d31a3b_0x42e129585f23ff4f.text: I attended to have a skin check on a persistent spot on my back, I have a history of skin cancer. The doctor quickly confirmed it was probably a cancer. It was surgically removed that day in their impressive surgical suite. 2000 baht for the surgery, 2000 baht for the use of the surgical suite. I’ve paid more just for a 15 minute private skin check in Sydney!! The only strangely expensive part was 4000 baht for the biopsy which was sent to Bangkok, this confirmed cancer and that it was all removed. I was very impressed with the posh reception and all treatment. I cannot speak Thai so my telephone inquiry was confusing for everyone but service was great in the clinic. I just turned up and left 3 hours later after treatment.

0x3051c00f44e1f345_0x32bedca5a1df150b.text: Patient care, treatment and diagnosis was prompt, and effective. Doctor and nurses were professional and courteous. 0x3051c00f44e1f345_0x32bedca5a1df150b.text: The clinic refused to share prescriptions for medicines and said we had to buy the medicines there. They said there’s no prescription system in Thailand. The medicines seemed a bit excessive for the symptoms we were facing. We had a talk with our doctor contacts back home and they gave a different course of action and we decided to stick to it. In India some pharmacies don’t give antibiotics without prescriptions but a pharmacy literally 50 meters from this clinic gave us the antibiotics without asking for a prescription or passport. I’m not sure if this really is the system in Thailand to not give prescriptions for medicines so I’m not going to sound too negative about this. However, when we decided to pay only the OPD fees and refused the medicine, the doctor got really mad at us and told us not to waste money and talk to doctors back home and buy at pharmacy instead of consulting in hospital. Valid advice in retrospec but I wasn’t aware I’d be robbed like this. I’m adding an extra star because I had left my wallet at the clinic and they had kept it safely for me. Overall highly dissatisfied with the service. Please don’t waste your time and money here. Edit: Response: I don’t know how accurate this is but perplexity clearly mentions that a complete medical report mentions the medicines required. The clinic refusing to do so is clearly a massive red flag. No clinic can force me to buy medicines which this clinic didn’t but also didn’t mention the medicines required in the medical report which it should have. If the clinic refuses to dispute this fact I can upload my medical report here to disprove this immediately. Also, nice gaslighting attempt to ignore the clearly inappropriate behaviour by the doctor who was clearly acting out of line and had no business talking to us like that. I’m taking my extra star back since this clinic refuses to take any accountability whatsoever which is a shame.

0x3102be134a595be9_0x17c776058e554ea.text: To all the people who do not speak Thai. The procedure is as follows You go to a self BP & oxygen testing machine. You test yourself and take the test results to triage, the nurse initially ask for your symptoms and give you a sheet with details of which department to go and a token no for registration. You go to registration counter and wait for your token to be called,make sure to bring passport and write your current address and phone no on a piece of paper. The registration counter gives you a registration card and a paper with QR CODE. You need to take this into the OPD department and give it to the nurse. The nurse takes the paper and call you name when your turn comes. Depending on your diagnoses you need to blood test and other stuff. I only paid for blood test and pills. I guess the doctor consultation is free. It was quick, the only place where it took time is the injection department and collecting the pills. The doctor and nurses speak English and can guide you well. Most of the signs are in Thai. The behavior of the staff is good. Saw couple of foreigners taking treatment.

0x3102be134a595be9_0x17c776058e554ea.text: My Mother died here, it was unacceptable. My experience with Bang Lamung Hospital was beyond devastating. My mother was admitted there in a critical condition, and despite our concerns, the doctors insisted on keeping her there, assuring us they had everything under control. They promised to transfer her to Chon Buri Hospital if her condition worsened. However, none of the staff spoke English, which created a constant barrier for us as her family, desperate for updates on her condition. From the moment she was admitted, we felt a profound lack of communication and care. It was over three hours before we were even called from the waiting room to receive any word about her condition. Then, without any warning or opportunity to say goodbye, she was abruptly taken to a quarantine room. We were standing right next to her but were not given even a moment to properly say goodbye before they whisked her away. After that, we were unable to see her or even contact her. Phone calls were restricted, and we were allowed to call only once a day to speak with a nurse. No doctor ever came to speak to us about her condition, and we were not given a single piece of paper or documentation detailing her health or treatment plan. My mother had complex health issues, including systemic sclerosis and lung fibrosis, which placed her at high risk. Despite this, her possible gastric paresis and critical condition were largely ignored. The hospital staff failed to recognize the severity of her situation or to communicate with us in a way that allowed us to make informed decisions. They did not take any action to transfer her to Chon Buri Hospital as they had promised, and tragically, she passed away there. We were told that she died of pneumonia, but given her conditions, we feel that her care was grossly inadequate. The worst part was finding her lifeless in bed, her body twisted unnaturally, eyes open, with no doctor present to explain or offer any comfort or clarity about her sudden passing. The lack of dignity, compassion, and professionalism we experienced at Bang Lamung Hospital was shocking and deeply traumatic. In my view, their neglect and incompetence cost my mother her life. I would not wish this experience on anyone and caution others about trusting this hospital with the care of their loved ones.
0x3102be134a595be9_0x17c776058e554ea.author: manee mo

0x30e29f01f4b67823_0x69f26ed6e28201eb.text: I visited this dental clinic in Bangkok almost a year ago for a root canal treatment. Before starting the procedure, they strongly recommended a dental cleaning, which I agreed to because I trusted them 100%. I was charged 9,000 THB for the cleaning, justified by the use of a “new high-pressure water system.” At the time, I didn’t compare prices with other clinics because I trusted their recommendation and professionalism. However, some time later, I went to another dental clinic in Bangkok and received a similar dental cleaning, also using a water-pressure system, for only 2,000 THB. This price difference makes me feel that I was significantly overcharged, possibly because I am a foreigner and was not fully aware of the real market prices in Thailand. The root canal treatment itself was already expensive, (around 60000 THB) so paying 9,000 THB for a basic cleaning now feels unjustified and disappointing. Overall, the treatment was completed, but this experience left me with a strong feeling of being overcharged and taken advantage of. I would strongly advise international patients to compare prices elsewhere before accepting any recommended treatments here.

0x30da3b478853c31b_0x224b043e90666b6e.text: Chiang Mai is a luxurious massage spot located near the Ping River near Pak Daeng Restaurant in Chiang Mai! This was my first time visiting a professional spa massage brand during my second trip to Chiang Mai. The building itself is impressively spacious, with the entire ground floor serving as a lobby, the first and second floors dedicated to massages, and the basement floor a space for relaxation, tea, and rejuvenation. The overall atmosphere feels like a five-star hotel, and the ample lobby space for resting and waiting was truly wonderful. Lying down on a cushion on the sofa was heavenly! Free Wi-Fi is also available. The holiday atmosphere, with Christmas just around the corner, is a bonus! While it's a bit pricier than other local Chiang Mai massage parlors, it's worth it. The massage rooms are all private, not just curtained off. Each room is based on a double occupancy, making it a truly comfortable experience for solo travelers, groups, couples, and families alike. Moreover, her skills were truly excellent, and the two-hour Thai massage was incredibly refreshing and completely free of fatigue. She focused on my lower body, and I felt like all the fatigue from the day had disappeared, leaving me feeling refreshed and refreshed! The massage room for two is equipped with a massage bed, personal clothing, a mirror, a TV, a clock, and hangers. Please note that this is for reference only. The massage was incredibly satisfying, and the cup of tea provided afterward was so delicious I almost wanted to ask for another. The bathroom was also incredibly clean and well-maintained! If I ever visit Chiang Mai again, Health Land was a place I'll definitely return to for another satisfying experience. By the way, we each gave a 100 baht tip.
0x30da3b478853c31b_0x224b043e90666b6e.author: 서군

0x30da3b478853c31b_0x224b043e90666b6e.text: The most comfortable massage I've ever had 🥰 and the price was very reasonable!!! The environment was so beautiful, and the experience was great for both body and mind. The room had soothing music at a comfortable volume, and every staff member was very attentive and kind… I wanted to give them all my blessings… We had a 2-hour traditional full-body Thai massage, and it was so comfortable that I fell asleep several times during the session. The pressure was perfect, and walking felt much easier. They even served hot tea afterward 🍵. The surrounding area was beautiful. I highly recommend this place to everyone.
0x30da3b478853c31b_0x224b043e90666b6e.author: zoey

0x30da3b478853c31b_0x224b043e90666b6e.text: Healthland Massage truly exceeded my expectations. The facilities were spacious and well-maintained, allowing for a comfortable and relaxing stay. It's also a great place for a group visit. The masseuses spoke a little Korean, and above all, they were incredibly cheerful and kind, making the massage experience incredibly enjoyable. I was blown away and truly refreshed. There's also a delicious restaurant nearby called "Paktaeng," so I recommend adding it to your itinerary. I would 100% return!
0x30da3b478853c31b_0x224b043e90666b6e.author: Yeji Community Geek

0x30da3b478853c31b_0x224b043e90666b6e.text: I give the environment, atmosphere, and cleanliness five stars! The masseur who massaged me was great, but the pressure was a little weak. After asking him to adjust the pressure, I realized it wasn't a matter of the pressure; it seemed like he wasn't hitting the right spots. However, I believe that massage preferences vary from person to person, so I still gave a tip and five stars. I look forward to number 53 being even more perfect next time I come ❤️
0x30da3b478853c31b_0x224b043e90666b6e.author: 啊駿カシュン

0x30da3b478853c31b_0x224b043e90666b6e.text: I used to frequent Healthland but as there are so many massages places and Spas in Thailand I have to admit I haven't been for a number of years. I was very impressed with the cleanliness of the place lovely service and a massage that left me relaxed and invigorated for the day ahead. Not only will I be back here but also other Healthland branches.
0x30da3b478853c31b_0x224b043e90666b6e.author: Vee Charununsiri

0x30da3b478853c31b_0x224b043e90666b6e.text: It's recommended to call and book in advance on weekends. It gets crowded, but there are also many masseuses. The place is clean and spacious. Good service, skilled masseuses. Thai massage 2 hours, 700 baht, private room. The bathroom is excellent, like a 5-star hotel. The only downside is that the admin is very slow to respond on Line.
0x30da3b478853c31b_0x224b043e90666b6e.author: Namwan Wanwan

0x30da3b478853c31b_0x224b043e90666b6e.text: Very large well run establishment. Correspondence very professional and helpful booking appointments. Lovely hard working staff. Prices are reasonable for the services you get. On the suggestion end, I would say I didn't like the big room where everyone was getting a foot massage. It would be nice if you had private rooms for that. I didn't like listening to people snore etc.
0x30da3b478853c31b_0x224b043e90666b6e.author: H L

0x30da3b478853c31b_0x224b043e90666b6e.text: One of the worst massages of my life. I get a massage once a week, and this one was painful. Not because the therapist was applying too much pressure, but because the massage was impersonal. Three days later, I still have neck pain. The massage room was very cold, with two mattresses on the floor, two bedside tables, and a television. I wondered if I was in a brothel. The atmosphere was questionable in a huge, nine-story building. How can a spa need nine floors? I saw a tour bus unload 35 people at once.
0x30da3b478853c31b_0x224b043e90666b6e.author: Vanmail Gmail

0x311d5fcba6365823_0x712aac85224f9e1c.text: Everyone at Dental Joy created a fantastic experience for me. Reception was warm, thorough and got me in the minute my appointment was scheduled. The professionalism and skill of the attending dentist and hygienist made my visit painless, comfortable, and refreshing. This was easily the best experience I’ve ever had at a dentist. I’m very lucky I was under their care during my visit. Also, the facilities are clean, very well maintained, and it was encouraging to see the equipment being sanitized after they finished with me. In virtually every aspect, Dental Joy Bangna’s team displayed high standards for customer service, attention to detail, and best practices. I’m very, very grateful I got the chance to have my teeth cleaned with Dental Joy Bangna. Thank you so much. I would recommend them to anyone looking for quality dental or orthodontic work. :D
0x311d5fcba6365823_0x712aac85224f9e1c.author: Dave Swanson

0x311d5fcba6365823_0x712aac85224f9e1c.text: A very nice and clean clinic indeed. Very convenient to make appointments 🥰 The doctor is kind and attentive. The staffs are well-trained and patient. Explains the patient in details. Have cookies and coffee while waiting for your turn! And you can brush your teeth and take a selfie too! There is no language barrier. They provide services in Thai, English, Chinese and Burmese too! Highly recommended for exceptional dental care 🦷
0x311d5fcba6365823_0x712aac85224f9e1c.author: Hnin Aye Lwin

0x311d5fcba6365823_0x712aac85224f9e1c.text: Amazing service. I was early for my appointment and still was seen straight away. The care is great! They spoke amazing English so that made it more comfortable for me as my Thai is not good yet! Would definitely recommend!
0x311d5fcba6365823_0x712aac85224f9e1c.author: Lauren Watts

0x311d5fcba6365823_0x712aac85224f9e1c.text: I had a great experience with the dental service. The dentist is highly skilled, experienced, and has a very gentle touch. The nurses are polite and friendly, and the reception staff are welcoming and provide excellent guidance. The clinic is clean and equipped with modern tools and facilities.
0x311d5fcba6365823_0x712aac85224f9e1c.author: Usana Chantarasap

0x311d5fcba6365823_0x712aac85224f9e1c.text: I found the dental clinic through Google Maps and made an appointment via their Facebook page. 0x311d5fcba6365823_0x712aac85224f9e1c.text: My husband and I have been coming to this dental clinic for at least two years already for dental cleaning. We are very happy with their service. The dentist is very competent; the staff is very helpful and courteous. Parking is easy. We highly recommend this clinic.
0x311d5fcba6365823_0x712aac85224f9e1c.author: D Chang

0x311d5fcba6365823_0x712aac85224f9e1c.text: Here offers you a very peaceful environment for your healthy teeth. Made an appointment then the lovely staff will direct you to the process. Plenty of parking lot and good restaurants in the place as well.
0x311d5fcba6365823_0x712aac85224f9e1c.author: Ekkaphon “Jay” Phonyiam

0x311d5fcba6365823_0x712aac85224f9e1c.text: It’s good to consult with the doctor before your treatment.Then It’s good for Myanmar people because they have Myanmar Translator who has warm kind heart and explain about the treatment in detail.
0x311d5fcba6365823_0x712aac85224f9e1c.author: Xie Jiouchin

0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.text: I spent two weeks volunteering at this shelter and I cannot recommend it enough! Doesn’t matter if it’s just for a day or up to a few months, this is the place for animal lovers. I was very close to canceling my travel plans and going home. The work here gave me purpose to work through it! It’s located in the more secluded/jungly side of Koh Samui, so the scenery is beautiful! The daily schedule was very similar from day to day: we started with cleaning the puppy area (and of course lots of cuddles) and went on to prepare and give extra food to the sicker/skinnier dogs in the morning. We always grabbed lunch with the volunteering staff, so there’s a nice sense of community. In the afternoon we helped cleaning the cat compartments as well as cleaning their ears/eyes if needed and went on a walk with different dogs every day (so everyone gets out) and went to the beach! On some days we took the truck with the older/disabled dogs, so they could enjoy moving in the ocean! Altogether, you could tell the dogs and cats were being taken good care of. There’s lots of different compartments with so many beautiful souls, that you’ll absolutely fall in love with. I was very sad to leave, especially without being able to adopt a furry friend, but I’ll for sure (!!!) come back to volunteer again and next time, I won’t be going home alone!
0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.author: Aitana Schmid

0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.text: Another great place. Go and walk the dogs there and donate a little. They look after 500 animals across 2 sites so they need all the help they can get. I believe they are looking for volunteers to help out, a Scottish couple were there whilst i was there and she said they had been working there for naearly 2 weeks. Also i think they are desperate for people to adopt some of the animals. They have cats and kittens there too, its not just for dogs. Its fantastic to see someone care for all these stray animals. Koh Samui is full of dogs, most i saw were well fed but obviously some wont be and dogs on the island wander around the dark streets at night, i even saw some lying in the main road when it was pitch black so plenty must get injured and i believe the owner of this place said they help with vets and care and recovery- all this must cost a small fortune to run on a daily level so i can only imagine how much it costs to see to all these animals. One of the dogs i walked had injured back legs so i assume it had been hit by a car at some point. Beware though that some of the dogs werent that approachable with me, its not their fault, they could have been mistreated. One did try to bite me so be careful if you go to stroke some of them
0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.author: Garry Webster

0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.text: I wasn’t sure what to expect when I decided to visit the Dog and Cat Sanctuary, but the experience completely exceeded anything I imagined. I had the chance to walk a beautiful dog named Jimmie on the beach with other dogs and travelers . Such a joyful, peaceful way to spend time. The dogs were incredibly sweet and friendly, and it was obvious how much love and care they receive. Even the other individuals visiting were a delight to meet . The volunteers are truly the heart of this place. Kind, dedicated, and clearly passionate about animal welfare, they make the sanctuary feel more like a community than a shelter. Everything is well-organized and thoughtfully run. I initially felt a bit apprehensive about visiting a shelter with so many animals, but I was quickly reassured. The dogs are happy, healthy, and clearly well looked after. The whole visit left me feeling uplifted and inspired. Special thanks Hasse, David and Marcus I was so moved by the experience that I now sponsor four dogs. It’s a small way to give back to a place that gives so much. Highly recommend for anyone who wants to make a difference or simply connect with some amazing animals and people.
0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.author: Khedjia Nottingham

0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.text: I was incredibly fortunate to learn about the work of Dog & Cat Rescue Samui – and I'm deeply impressed. Since its founding in 1999, they have been tirelessly helping street dogs and cats on Koh Samui. The team works with unbelievable passion, dedication, and professionalism. It's especially touching to see how lovingly the animals are cared for, given medical treatment, and prepared for a better life. Many of them have been through difficult times – here they get a real second chance. The organization is committed not only to rescue and care but also to sustainable solutions such as spay/neuter programs and education. This demonstrates their long-term thinking and approach. Anyone who loves animals should definitely support this organization – whether through donations, volunteering, or simply by recommending their important work. Dog & Cat Rescue Samui is a shining example of how much good people can achieve. Highly recommended! 🐾
0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.author: Simon Landthaler

0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.text: Whilst staying nearby, we decided to spend the afternoon playing with and walking some of the islands rescue dogs. The Dog and Cat Rescue foundation are doing an amazing job looking after all the animals. Although there are a lot of dogs and cats, they have large areas which are separated to ensure they dogs get along. They seem to be happy and looked after being fed large meals of rice and veg and donations from the public. If you decide to visit, please bring large bags of food and anything else you can spare as they can always do with more for the animals. 2pm ish you can also take the dogs to the beach for a walk and play. Unfortunately some dogs have some life long injuries , so may just want to sit and be stroked, but it’s great to give them the interaction Please also make sure you take the time to walk all the way to the back as the place is huge and it’s likely that the dogs in the rear do not get as much interaction
0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.author: D B

0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.text: I have volunteered at Dog and Cat Rescue Koh Samui for some time, and I continue to be amazed by the incredible work they do every day. Caring for more than 400 dogs and over 100 cats is a huge undertaking, yet the staff and volunteers provide outstanding care, dedication, and compassion to every animal. What impressed me most is how much they achieve with the donations they receive. Every contribution is clearly put to good use, helping improve the lives of hundreds of animals who otherwise would have very few options. The atmosphere is welcoming, the team is passionate, and the impact they make on Koh Samui is truly remarkable. I highly recommend visiting the shelter, volunteering, or simply taking one of the dogs for a walk. It’s a wonderful experience and a great way to support an organization that is making a real difference every single day.
0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.author: Phil Marek Haupt

0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.text: If I could, I'd give even more stars! I received a wonderfully warm welcome and was given a tour, including the chance to pet and greet the dogs. The cat café there is also fantastic. You feel very comfortable and well cared for right from the start. What I find particularly wonderful is that there are people who voluntarily invest so much time and passion to ensure the animals' well-being. Everyone I met there was extremely knowledgeable and able to tell me a lot about the animals and their work. My personal highlight was the walk with the dogs. You can immediately see how grateful they are for any attention and help. This experience deeply touched me. I highly recommend a visit to everyone and would do it again in a heartbeat. Thank you so much for your amazing dedication! 🤍
0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.author: Vanessa Hyka

0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.text: We stayed only for a moment, I think best to avoid feeding time, lots of dogs fighting can be quite stressful if you are there during this time (it is good that they are trying to help though)
0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.author: K Smith

0x30da3b6a87debb23_0x9fb7d60ae1d4f736.text: We had an excellent experience at Bangkok Chiang Mai Clinic Thaphae when my daughter became ill during our trip. From the moment we arrived, the staff were attentive, kind, and very professional, which gave us peace of mind in a stressful situation. Dr. Titiporn provided outstanding care - thorough in examination, clear in explanation, and very compassionate with my daughter. The nurses, Thanyarat and Patamavisa, were equally wonderful. They were gentle, patient, and reassuring throughout the visit, making sure my daughter was comfortable and well cared for. Blood tests and treatment were done quickly and efficiently, with everything clearly explained. The clinic itself is clean, well-organized, and very efficient, with medications provided right on-site. We are truly grateful for the excellent service and care we received. A big thank you to Dr. Titiporn, Nurse Thanyarat, and Nurse Patamavisa for going above and beyond. Highly recommended for anyone in need of medical care in Chiang Mai.
0x30da3b6a87debb23_0x9fb7d60ae1d4f736.author: Nir S

0x30da3b6a87debb23_0x9fb7d60ae1d4f736.text: I visited Bangkok Hospital Clinic Thapae last Thursday and was impressed from the moment I arrived. The doctor was very attentive and gave clear, helpful advice, explaining everything in a way that was easy to understand. The medication I received was high-quality, and my symptoms improved quickly. The nurses and staff were warm, caring, and professional, taking great care of me throughout the whole process. They even followed up on my condition afterward, which made me feel truly looked after. The service was fast and well-organized, with very little waiting time. Overall, I always feel confident getting treatment at Bangkok Hospital. Thank you to the entire team for the excellent care. 🩺💙
0x30da3b6a87debb23_0x9fb7d60ae1d4f736.author: Lay Laila

0x30da3b6a87debb23_0x9fb7d60ae1d4f736.text: I have been having body aches the last few days and feeling weak, tired and sore throat. I had to miss several activities because I was feeling so lousy so I finally decided to see a doctor. I came into their clinic and they saw me within 5 minutes and gave a diagnosis and medicine within 15. I thought I had the flu and am so thankful to have had a more accurate diagnosis and get the medicine I need so my trip isn’t ruined. Thank you for helping me! Can’t recommend them enough if your traveling through Chang Mai. It cost me about $50 U.S dollars to have the optional flu and covid test, get checked out and for the 3 prescriptions they gave me at the clinic! I’m very thankful!!!
0x30da3b6a87debb23_0x9fb7d60ae1d4f736.author: Kelsey Persyn

0x30da3b6a87debb23_0x9fb7d60ae1d4f736.text: I highly recommend this clinic. The doctors and front desk staff are extremely kind and attentive. I came to the clinic because I was very uncomfortable due to mild urethritis. They used Google Translate to communicate with me and carefully explained what procedures would be done. After that, they prescribed medication for me, and I felt better almost immediately. The clinic is also very clean and bright. This high rating is definitely well-deserved and not exaggerated. Thank you very much to all the medical staff.
0x30da3b6a87debb23_0x9fb7d60ae1d4f736.author: Fa Y

0x30da3b6a87debb23_0x9fb7d60ae1d4f736.text: Highly recommend for any travellers who require treatment while in Chiang Mai. I injured myself before arriving in Chiang Mai but went to this clinic for stitch removal and aftercare. I attended the clinic a few times over the course of the week and the staff were very friendly, attentive and helpful each time. They speak great English too, which is a plus for any travellers. My injuries have healed well under their care, thanks to this great team.

0x30da3b6a87debb23_0x9fb7d60ae1d4f736.text: I caught a cold while traveling in Chiang Mai and needed to see a doctor. All in all I spent a total of 30 mins there and received an examination from the doctor, covid/flu testing as well as my prescriptions ready to go. I’m happy to say I’m feeling much better and would highly recommend this clinic.

0x30e281dee7419343_0xf5fa61c0e870efa7.text: I am so happy with the two hour treatment I received from Dr. Nan this day last week. 0x30e281dee7419343_0xf5fa61c0e870efa7.en: Today I came for a filling. The dentist was very gentle and gave great advice. I came here because my mother had dental work done here before and said the dentist was amazing. So I followed her recommendation. It was a really fun dental experience!

0x30e281dee7419343_0xf5fa61c0e870efa7.text: As a foreigner they made me feel very comfortable and also spoke English to me the best they could to describe what I need to do to keep my teeth healthy.
Nice officers. The dentist here is so clam, polite and pay attention in detail. I am so grateful with 1st visit here. Highly recommended!!!!
Everything was impressive. Very professional. Good advices from the dentist. Reasonable price. Will come back again for sure
A professional dentist with wide experience and knowledge of the job.The staff is polite and friendly. Highly recommended.

0x3102bdfe6d6f19a5_0x5238b6dfee1aaa93.text: Took my children for Package B — cleaning, exams, X-rays, and one filling — I got Package B + Cool White Lightening, the results were amazing. Dentist was very gentle. Thank you!

0x3102bdfe6d6f19a5_0x5238b6dfee1aaa93.text: The doctor provided a thorough check-up and offered helpful advice, making decision-making easier. Overall, it was a good experience. I recommend using their services.

0x3102bdfe6d6f19a5_0x5238b6dfee1aaa93.text: I had dental work done at the clinic today. The dentist was good and lovely. The staff provided excellent service. My teeth look beautiful. I am very impressed.

0x3102bdfe6d6f19a5_0x5238b6dfee1aaa93.text: I came here for dental treatment. I like that the clinic looks clean and the air conditioning is nice and cool inside, I really like it.
0x3102bdfe6d6f19a5_0x5238b6dfee1aaa93.author: Chayanee mala

0x3102bdfe6d6f19a5_0x5238b6dfee1aaa93.text: Excellent service. I used social security insurance without needing to pay in advance, and they even gave me an extra 200 baht coupon.
0x3102bdfe6d6f19a5_0x5238b6dfee1aaa93.author: Nanthinee Endoo

0x3102bdfe6d6f19a5_0x5238b6dfee1aaa93.text: Fantastic teeth whitening results, all staff are fantastic and so friendly, highly recommend for dental treatment. 10/10
0x3102bdfe6d6f19a5_0x5238b6dfee1aaa93.author: Craig Birch

0x30e29ecdf9a9017d_0x6ae1c956b3af6f91.text: I had a lovely day here today - I’ve never had my teeth whitened before and it’s something I’ve always thought about doing when back home in the 🇬🇧. However upon researching I found BIDC in Bangkok and decided to go ahead with the treatment here. Upon arrival I was given the correct forms to read through and I also had Fern next to me to help me fill out the form if needed - all the staff were very lovely and friendly to me. My dentist properly cleaned my teeth ( I love the feel off this) and communicated anything he noticed with my teeth first! He spoke to me about what colour my teeth already were and assessed with a tooth colour chart. He mentioned how they would “lighten” rather than “whiten” as I think I already had pretty white teeth naturally - however I had gained a bit of tea stains over the years and it was something I wanted to remove. 🫖 ☕️ He also spoke great English and was welcoming - therefore we could communicate easily. This was a huge bonus for me coming from the 🇬🇧 ! The dental assistant was also great and always checked in to see how I felt and whether it was too sensitive and to put my hand up if I wanted to stop at any point which is really important. The actual mall where it is located is super modern and clean. Stylish toilets too! Im super happy with the results and Im currently trying to avoid any heavily staining foods for 2 days - so far I do have some tingling however this is normal at the beginning. I can’t wait to show them off properly in a few days time - over some tasty food with friends, thankyou !! 🦷
0x30e29ecdf9a9017d_0x6ae1c956b3af6f91.author: Billy-Jo Pierce

0x30e29ecdf9a9017d_0x6ae1c956b3af6f91.text: I'm extremely grateful for BIDC @ Siam Paragon. They were able to get me in the same day after I had called two other clinics that were fully booked. I drove for 30mins on the motorbike for treatment at this clinic and it was so worth it! Dr. Chananporn Sukchan treated me and she is excellent. The consultation didn't feel rushed at all (unlike in another clinic that I previously went to in Bangkok) and the four surface fillings she did took less than 60mins. She is also very conservative in her approach, asking me to come back in 6 months on a teeth that might have arrested decay. She advised against filling it now because that would damage healthy tissue. I definitely recommend! Plus she speaks very good English and even explained something to me with pictures from the computer. Thank you! Each surface filling was 700 Baht.

I’m a tourist visiting family from America and the staff there was really nice and seem to know what they’re all doing. I will definitely go back there on my next visit to Thailand. I really recommend this place if you speak English because the dentist that treated spoke English just fine. I even recommended my mom to go there when she comes. For locals all I like to say is this place is very clean nice staff and great service. Thank you guys for taking care of me.

Dr. Chanunporn has a very gentle touch. I had a tooth extracted there. I have been treated at here for a while, was so smooth and very gentle Also,Dentist is so helpful and giving such a good advice information like you are in a good hand!! ...... officers also very friendly and welcoming. If you're looking for a nice Dental place that's close to BTS. This is the one!! I'm highly recommended 💯😘

Very comfortable service. Everything was explained, everything was shown. Gave clear instructions after the procedure along with medications. During the procedure they constantly asked how I was feeling, if I was in pain. High-quality service and painless procedures took away the fear of visiting a dentist.

The doctors and assistants are so kind. Most important thing, price is affordable. Can be reserved by Line app. For foreigners, you can speak in English language, no need translators. Best dental clinic in Samut Prakan.

0x3050258d69214a41_0x6afc1f0c008d56c0.text: Apart from being very expensive, the nurses & doctor were amazing. Saw to me instantly & had me on an IV drip within 10 mins then advised I stayed in as a day patient so I could be monitored. Before anything is administered or done, a lady will come through to make sure you agree & their are no hidden payments, it was expensive but you can’t put a price on your health. I’m back in the UK and still recovering, but I’d recommend to come here if you have travel insurance & need a hygienic, well maintained doctors clinic whilst in Phuket. I think we paid just over £600 for 3 drips, day stay, monitoring & prescribed meds to take home.
0x3050258d69214a41_0x6afc1f0c008d56c0.author: Lexie

0x30e29c1dac0343ad_0xf0034225fd411b0d.text: ทำฟันกับพลัสเดนทัลตั้งแต่จัดฟันหลายปีแล้ว พอดีย้ายที่อยู่ก็ยังมาทำที่ใกล้ที่สุดก็สาขาอารีย์ บริการดี พนักงานคุยสนุกให้คำแนะนำดีมากๆ เป็นกันเอง แอดมินในไลน์ตอบไว มีของให้ด้วย ไว้จะมาทำอีกเรื่อยๆค่ะ ประทับใจบริการและคุณหมอก็มือเบามากๆค่ะ

0x30e29c1dac0343ad_0xf0034225fd411b0d.text: เดินทางสะดวก อยู่ไม่ไกลจากรถไฟฟ้า BTS ลูกค้าเยอะ คิวรอนานมาก นัด 14.30 กว่าจะได้ตรวจ 15.10 ที่นั่งรอแคบยืดขาไม่ได้ พนักงานเดินไปเดินมาตลอด และแอร์ค่อนข้างร้อน ห้องตรวจดูไม่ค่อยสะอาด อยากให้คลินิกดูปลอดเชื้อกว่านี้ ตอนเข้าห้องตรวจ มีแมลงหวี่ บินเข้าไปในห้องพร้อมกันด้วย ก้มมองพื้น เห็นถังขยะล้นด้วยถุงมือจำนวนมาก ซึ่งควรเก็บทิ้งบ่อย ๆ ไม่ก็ซ่อนไม่ให้ลูกค้าเห็นโดยง่าย ไปตรวจประเมินเพื่อดูแผนจัดฟัน รอ 45 นาที หมอตรวจตาเปล่า 5-10นาที จบ ไม่มี X-ray ไม่มีสแกน 3 มิติ เพื่อร่วมในการตรวจประเมินใด ๆ โดยหากสแกน 3 มิติ หรือทำแผนจะมีค่าใช้จ่าย 2,300 บาท ในการประเมิน ของผมเป็นเคสจัดฟันรอบสองแล้ว แต่ก็ไม่ได้ใส่นานมากจนฟันเก หลังตรวจเสร็จพนักงานแนะนำในส่วนของราคาโลหะ ซึ่งราคาไม่แพง แต่ส่วนตัวผมอยากมาทำจัดฟันใสมากกว่า นัดคลินิกเพราะโฆษณาเรื่องจัดฟันชุดเครื่องมือ เริ่มต้น 1400 (ชุดใส) พอถามเรื่องจัดฟันใสสิ่งที่เสนออันดับแรกคือ ประเมินว่าต้องใช้ invisalign ตัวท็อปสุด เครื่องมือแบบ Unlimited ผมค่อนข้างงงว่าเคสผมยากขนาดนั้นเลยหรือ ส่วนตัวผมไม่คิดว่าของผมเป็นเคสยากขนาดนั้น พนักงานถึงไปถามหมอให้อีกรอบและลด package ลงมาเป็นรองท็อปอยู่ดี (แตที่ผมไปประเมินที่อื่นจะเป็น moderate กลาง ๆ) ผมไม่เห็นพูดถึงสินค้าแบรนด์ตัวเองตามที่โปรโมตเลยลองถามดู แต่ราคายังไม่มีแผนที่แน่นอน ได้แค่ Range งบประมาณให้ตัดสินใจ คาดว่าคงต้องจ่ายค่าสแกนก่อน แต่ผมก็ไม่มีความเชื่อมั่นและกลัวงบจะบานปลาย ส่วนตัวยังไม่ประทับใจครับ ตั้งแต่สถานที่และที่ต้องรอนานมาก ถ้าหมอติดเคสด่วนในบางครั้งก็เข้าใจได้ แต่ควรแจ้งสักหน่อย หรือถ้าสถานที่พักผ่อนสบาย มีโซฟานั่งยืดขารอนาน แอร์ที่เย็น น้ำดื่มขวดคงดีกว่านี้ แต่ลูกค้าเยอะมากจริง ๆ พนักงานน่ารักยิ้มแย้มพูดดีทุกคน ราคาค่ารักษาอื่น ๆ ถ้าไม่ใช่การประเมินจัดฟันที่ package ระดับสูง ราคาปกติไม่แพงเลยครับ
0x30e29c1dac0343ad_0xf0034225fd411b0d.en: Convenient location, not far from the BTS Skytrain. Lots of customers, very long wait times. Appointment at 2:30 PM, didn't get examined until 3:10 PM. The waiting area is cramped, can't stretch your legs. Staff constantly walk around. And the air conditioning is quite warm. The examination room isn't very clean. I wish the clinic looked more sterile. When entering the examination room, a fly bent into the room with me. Looking down at the floor, I saw a trash can overflowing with a large number of gloves. It should be emptied more frequently, or hidden from customers' view. I went for an assessment to see the orthodontic treatment plan. Waited 45 minutes. The doctor did a visual examination for 5-10 minutes, then finished. No X-ray. No 3D scan. To be included in the assessment. A 3D scan or treatment plan would cost 2,300 baht. My assessment is for my second round of orthodontic treatment. But I didn't wear them for so long that my teeth became crooked. After the examination, the staff explained the price of metal braces, which wasn't expensive. But personally, I preferred clear aligners. I made an appointment at the clinic because of their advertisement for orthodontic treatment sets. Starting at 1400 (clear aligners). When I inquired about clear aligners, the first thing they offered was: An assessment suggested I needed the top-of-the-line Invisalign package, with unlimited aligners. I was quite confused, wondering if my case was really that difficult. Personally, I didn't think my case was that challenging. The staff then consulted with the doctor again and reduced the package to the second-highest option. (However, other clinics I've been to offered a moderate package.) I didn't see any mention of their own brand products as advertised, so I asked about them. They didn't provide a definite price plan, only a budget range. I assume I'll have to pay for the scans first, but I lack confidence and am worried about the cost spiraling out of control. Personally, I wasn't impressed. First, the location and the very long waiting times. I understand if the doctor is sometimes busy with urgent cases, but they should inform you beforehand. Or, a more comfortable waiting area with sofas, air conditioning, and bottled water would be better. However, there were a lot of patients. The staff were lovely, smiling, and spoke well. The prices for other treatments, apart from the high-end orthodontic package, were quite reasonable.

0x3102be55ed3ed2bb_0x641326246a1ecab6.text: I came to Dental Smile Pattaya for a significant amount of dental work and the experience has genuinely changed the way I feel about my smile and my confidence. My dentist was Dr. Jureeporn Piladist, and I cannot speak highly enough of her. She was warm, caring, patient and extremely thorough throughout the whole process. I had a full set of zirconia crowns across my upper teeth, including a bridge, as well as a professional cleaning and whitening of my lower teeth. The main treatment took around a week, but what impressed me just as much as the finished result was the aftercare. Dr. Jureeporn saw me repeatedly afterwards and continued making small adjustments to my bite until I was completely comfortable. There was never any feeling that the job was simply “finished” once the crowns were fitted. She wanted to make sure everything felt right. I am also a very nervous dental patient. I have a strong airway reflex and can sometimes panic and instinctively stop breathing when something unfamiliar is in my mouth. Dr. Jureeporn and her team handled this exceptionally well. They were calm, reassuring and never made me feel embarrassed or difficult. A sedative was used during the more demanding treatment, which worked extremely well and allowed me to remain unusually relaxed. I reached the point where I genuinely trusted them. The whole team at Dental Smile were incredibly friendly and caring. From the dentists and assistants to the reception staff, I felt looked after rather than simply treated as another patient. And the result is fantastic. For the first time in my life I actually love my teeth and my smile. The zirconia crowns look natural, clean and beautifully made. It has made a real difference to my self-confidence. For anyone travelling from the UK and considering dental treatment in Thailand, I would strongly recommend speaking to Dental Smile Pattaya. For the amount of work I had done, the cost was a fraction of what I would have expected to pay for comparable treatment in the UK, while the level of care, attention and aftercare I received was exceptional. A huge thank you to Dr. Jureeporn and the entire Dental Smile team. I will remember what you did for me for a very long time.

About three weeks before the end of my two-month trip, I developed a severe toothache that gradually spread to my jaw, cheek, ear, and sinus area. I was hoping to manage the pain until I could return home and see my trusted dentist, as I am always cautious about unnecessary extractions of important permanent teeth. When the pain became unbearable, I researched dental clinics in Pattaya and chose Dental Smile Pattaya. Looking back, it was absolutely the right decision. From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by the professionalism and friendliness of the entire team. After a thorough examination and multiple X-rays, the dentist carefully explained that the real source of my pain was not the tooth I suspected, but a severely damaged wisdom tooth with decay reaching the nerve. He even used a dental model to help me fully understand the diagnosis and treatment options. I have had dental anxiety since childhood and previously experienced a very traumatic wisdom tooth extraction. Because of that, I was extremely nervous. However, the dentist and his assistants were exceptional. Throughout the procedure, they continuously reassured me, helped manage my stress, and made me feel safe and comfortable. Their kindness, patience, and professionalism played a huge role in building my trust and helping me stay calm. The extraction itself was smooth, efficient, and far less traumatic than my previous experience. The dentist's skill and confidence were evident throughout the entire treatment. Today, I am very grateful that I chose Dental Smile Pattaya. They not only solved a serious problem during my travels, but also restored my confidence in dental treatment. To the dentist and the entire team: thank you for your professionalism, compassion, patience, and genuine care. I would confidently recommend Dental Smile Pattaya to anyone, especially travelers and patients who may feel nervous or uncertain about seeking dental care away from home. And finally, I apologize for the length of this review. I simply wanted to make sure I properly acknowledged the outstanding care I received and gave credit where it was truly deserved. Thank you again for everything.
0x3102be55ed3ed2bb_0x641326246a1ecab6.author: ali mahmoodi

0x3102be55ed3ed2bb_0x641326246a1ecab6.text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I cannot recommend Dr Aoy and her team highly enough. I actually travelled from Australia specifically to have my dental work done by Dr Aoy, and it was one of the best decisions I've made. I had a root canal treatment followed by a crown, and the entire experience exceeded my expectations. Dr Aoy is incredibly gentle, caring, and meticulous in her work. To my surprise, I felt virtually no pain throughout the treatment. The attention to detail was remarkable. The final crown turned out absolutely perfect. It looks and feels just like a natural tooth, and if I didn't know it was a crown, I wouldn't be able to tell the difference. From my very first visit, everyone at the clinic made me feel welcome. The dental assistants were professional and supportive, and the front desk staff were always friendly, helpful, and efficient. They explained everything clearly and kept me updated through WhatsApp with appointment confirmations and reminders, which made the whole process very easy. The prices are also very competitive. I did extensive research before choosing a dentist, and after reading reviews and comparing clinics, I decided on Dr Aoy. From the moment I walked through the door, I had a positive feeling about the clinic, and I wasn't wrong. The professionalism, attention to detail, quality of work, and genuine care from the entire team were outstanding. Travelling from Australia was absolutely worth it, and I would happily do it again. Thank you, Dr Aoy and the entire team for providing such exceptional dental care. I would highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for world-class treatment and a genuinely caring dental team.
0x3102be55ed3ed2bb_0x641326246a1ecab6.author: Daniel Soros

0x3102be55ed3ed2bb_0x641326246a1ecab6.text: My teeth have always been crooked, wonky and ugly to the point that I would only ever smile with my mouth closed. I eventually found the courage and strength of conviction to face up to the challenge of making a positive change for the better. My initial consultation with Dr Aoy was marked not only by her good advice and enthusiasm for what she could do for me, but by my own feelings of credibility, trust and belief in her. One particularly important point to me was a feeling that I had connected with Dr Aoy in such a way that I felt confident and reassured we could communicate clearly and effectively. In choosing to proceed with Dr Aoy, I didn’t make a good decision I made a GREAT decision. Dr Aoy and her team were truly first class in everything they did for me, not just in terms of professional ability to do the job but how the job was carried out with care, kindness and understanding every step of the way. To my amazement, there was no pain. The end result, which has transformed my appearance and willingness to smile, has truly blown my socks off! Thank you Dr Aoy and the entire team, because due to your help and encouragement (plus skill of course), something that I never dare dream about has been turned into reality. Without any hesitation, I strongly recommend Dr Aoy based on my personal experience.
0x3102be55ed3ed2bb_0x641326246a1ecab6.author: John Wellsted

0x3102be55ed3ed2bb_0x641326246a1ecab6.text: I recently had significant dental work done at Dental Smile Pattaya, and the experience was genuinely excellent from start to finish. The clinic is modern, spacious, and clearly well‑equipped — you can feel straight away that they take their technology and standards seriously, from imaging to treatment planning. Their team is warm, calm, and highly professional, and the English communication made everything smooth and stress‑free. What stood out most was the quality of care. Every step was explained clearly, options were laid out without pressure, and the actual dental work was done with a level of precision and gentleness that made me feel completely at ease. The pricing was also very fair, especially considering the standard of treatment and the clinic’s reputation. I am beyond thrilled with the results and I can honestly recommend Dental Smile Pattaya. They deliver exactly what they promise: professional care, modern facilities, and a team that wants you to walk out smiling. Thankyou Dr Aoy, Dr Cherry and all of the team for taking such great care of me. Richard.
0x3102be55ed3ed2bb_0x641326246a1ecab6.author: Richard

0x3102be55ed3ed2bb_0x641326246a1ecab6.text: If you’re looking for dental work, don’t hesitate to go to dental smile. From day one the staff at the front desk were very nice, Dr Aoy and her staff were truly amazing. They made my experience quick and painless. I had 20 crowns (10 top and 10 bottom). The prices were definitely way cheaper than the US by approximately 80 % cheaper here. Dr Aoy is very personable and speaks great English. I checked around for a couple of opinions from different clinics but I felt more comfortable with Dr Aoy to do my dental work. I so glad I made the right choice. I was a little embarrassed of showing my teeth because of years of grinding causing them to become smaller than normal. So after my dental work I’m able to smile while showing my teeth which gave me great confidence in my smiles. Thank you Dental Smile for the great work.

0x3102be55ed3ed2bb_0x641326246a1ecab6.text: I have visited the Dental Smile Clinic on 7 occasions in the past year. This included 2 root canals, a filling and also cleaning/scaling. I will be returning again in 6 months. Many thanks to all the staff for your hard work and professionalism.

0x3102be55ed3ed2bb_0x641326246a1ecab6.text: I visited the dentist yesterday to do some cleaning and to fill a tooth. This is the best dentist I’ve been to. I felt like a new person when I was finished. The price was good, the communication(English) was excellent and they had this gentle touch when operating in my mouth. Excellent service! I recommend this dentist to everybody! :) Paal

0x30e29eb18003e231_0x627d0a895da6d152.text: When my children were small, we went to the doctor frequently for colds, allergies, ENT treatments, a children's wellness clinic, a dentist, and even for unusual illnesses (fainting) that required hospitalization for neurological checkups, but nothing was found. We even went to the doctor late at night (emergencies). We saw many different specialists. It's all about observing and learning what symptoms your child has, why they're causing them, what medications can be used initially, and how to prevent serious illnesses. Later on, we went less often because each visit took so much time. Since the children came frequently, whenever we had the opportunity, we donated to the Children's Hospital Foundation, as much as we could afford.

I appreciated how they explained each step during treatment, checked regularly on my comfort, and offered practical advice for ongoing dental hygiene rather than just a quick fix. Appointments run on time, and the administration is efficient and easy to deal with, from booking to payment. Overall, HeysMile Dental Clinic combines high professional standards with genuine care for its patients. I feel that my dental health is in very good hands, and I would happily recommend HeysMile to anyone looking for reliable, friendly, and high-quality dental services.

They made me feel comfortable from start to finish. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for excellent dental care!

0x30e2994bdab79247_0x183f4a0091149b43.text: Relaxing Experience at Let’s Relax Spa Icon I recently had the pleasure of visiting Let’s Relax Spa at the Icon Siam branch, and it was an incredibly rejuvenating experience. 0x30e2994bdab79247_0x183f4a0091149b43.text: Title: My Favorite Spa Stop in Thailand! Let’s Relax Spa lived up to its reputation as one of the best massage chains in Thailand, and my experience here was absolutely wonderful. From the moment I walked in, the calm, minimalist decor and soft lighting immediately put me at ease. The reception staff were warm and efficient, checking me in quickly and explaining the process clearly. My therapist was incredibly professional—she asked about my tension areas and adjusted the pressure throughout the session, working out all the knots in my shoulders and back. The entire facility was spotless, and the private treatment room felt peaceful and private. After the massage, the signature mango sticky rice and warm herbal tea were the perfect way to end the experience. No pushy sales, no awkward moments—just pure relaxation. If you’re looking for a reliable, high-quality spa in Thailand, this is a must-visit. 10/10, would absolutely recommend to friends!

I believe the snack may vary from day to day, possibly depending on the spending amount as well. All in all, Let’s Relax truly stands out as a rising star in Thailand’s massage industry, and I would personally crown it as the No. 1 in the country.

For public transportation, there are buses, taxis, motorcycle taxis, and the Pink Line BTS Skytrain. 0x305031fa4c6fc08b_0x75b26a807ff2b0fd.text: Wow how should I begin. Honestly, I wasn't planning in advance to do any facial treatment. I had 2 extra free days to spend in Phuket and I didn't really know how to speed that time. I was thinking to go to massage but then I was thinking to check out maybe I can do a facial treatment. I was searching on Google and came across this place. It had a lot of positive reviews so I saved it and I saw that it's very close to my place. So after lunch I thought to pop in and ask them if they have free slots for that day by any chance or next day and ask to see what they can recommend for me. When I arrived I was greeted by the lovely receptionists and suddenly I got the manager talking to me asking me what I'd like to get and looked at my face and gave me her recomandation, even got the doctor coming out and also got her recomandation. They were super nice and patient with me got me some tea and amazingly delicious pumpkin desert 🤤. It took me forever to decide what I wanted because I wasn't planning on it and normally I also do deep research before doing or buying anything. In the end I chose a treatment and straight away they got me to the room and we did the treatment with the bubble gen 9 in 1 machine which is a non invasive treatment rejuvenates, cleanses and lifts the skin. It was a very pleasant experience, I've never done anything like this. They treated me like a princess from the moment I entered until the end, they are very polite and I could feel how genuine they were. They didn't try to push anything on me. I even got hand a foot massage. My skin felt hydrated straight after. It's been 3 weeks now and my skin looks better. I think I saw a difference after 1 week and more after 2 weeks. I also started using Korean sunscreen and pyto retinol after so I am not sure if those helped too. But I definitely think this was a good restart for my skin. After that I really started taking care of my skin and looking after it. So for me it was like a good restart for a better care. I highly recommend this place, they are very professional.
0x305031fa4c6fc08b_0x75b26a807ff2b0fd.author: Barbara Gergely

0x305031fa4c6fc08b_0x75b26a807ff2b0fd.text: I have had the most wonderful experience at healthy skin Phuket! I have never experienced such care and generosity in a setting as this. From the second I walked in I felt completely safe in their hands. It was the first time ever having the treatments and everything was explained carefully and was given the chance to ask all the questions I had. Because I had just come from another island I was properly fed (complementary) before the treatments began and I have received complementary taxi to my hotel and a goody bag with snacks for the road… amazing! It is very clear that the doctors are extremely experienced and knowledgeable in their art, actually every single person in this clinic is very good at what they do. I live in Australia where service is generally good for these sort of treatments and I was completely blown away by my overall experience at Healthy skin Phuket. In all honesty this is my new clinic for my skin treatments, I will work my future trips around availability at this clinic. I highly recommend them in every aspect.
0x305031fa4c6fc08b_0x75b26a807ff2b0fd.author: Maryanne Muigai

0x305031fa4c6fc08b_0x75b26a807ff2b0fd.text: I had a Bubblegen9 treatment today at the clinic, and the entire experience — from the initial communication and appointment booking to the treatment recommendation — was absolutely excellent. The staff was incredibly friendly, responded quickly, and supported me wonderfully in choosing the right treatment for my needs. The clinic itself is very clean, and the team who took care of me was especially kind, attentive, and made me feel completely at ease. They answered all my questions and ensured that my entire visit was perfect. During the treatment, every step was clearly explained, which made it a truly great experience. I’ve had several treatments in Korea before, but in terms of service, this clinic was by far the best! I was offered drinks, my shoes were disinfected, and I got to relax on a very comfortable bed with an additional hand and foot massage – it was like a dream. I can wholeheartedly recommend this clinic, and I will definitely come back next time I'm in Phuket. Thank you to the lovely team!
0x305031fa4c6fc08b_0x75b26a807ff2b0fd.author: Yasmin Stölting

0x305031fa4c6fc08b_0x75b26a807ff2b0fd.text: Absolutely amazing experience at Healthy Skin Clinic Phuket. From the moment I arrived, everything felt luxurious, calm, and genuinely caring. The team made me feel incredibly welcomed and special, and the attention to detail was honestly beyond what I expected. The doctor and staff were extremely professional, gentle, and attentive. They really took the time to understand my skin and recommend what was best for me personally instead of pushing unnecessary treatments. The atmosphere is beautiful, peaceful, and very private — exactly the kind of wellness experience you hope for in Phuket. I left feeling refreshed, confident, and glowing. My skin already looks healthier and brighter, but more importantly I truly felt taken care of. Thank you so much to the whole team for your kindness, professionalism, and warm energy. I will definitely come back and highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for high-quality treatments and a luxury experience 🤍✨
0x305031fa4c6fc08b_0x75b26a807ff2b0fd.author: Laura Lanez

0x305031fa4c6fc08b_0x75b26a807ff2b0fd.text: I was very impressed with the advice of the dermatologist there as I sought ablative laser treatment for age spots on my face. The Dr felt it was too harsh for my skin type and recommended other laser treatments available elsewhere. As an RN, I valued her integrity and honesty in a world of profit making. She did recommend diode laser for my tiny broken capillaries and I had 2 sessions, a week apart. I can see a difference already 2 weeks later. The professional support staff are kind, gentle, and caring ensuring my experience was painless and frankly, special. The pampering afterwards with a cooling facial mask to reduce redness plus the foot, leg, hand and arm massage and tea complemented the all ‘round experience. The cost was way less than in Australia and I was kept in contact Re appointments through What’s App all the way. The Thai know about service delivery and I highly recommend this clinic. ️
0x305031fa4c6fc08b_0x75b26a807ff2b0fd.author: V Con

I leave this clinic in a great mood every time. A brief overview of my visit, using today as an example: I'm always greeted warmly and asked how I'm doing. Today, they treated me to a fresh coconut, then did a treatment, and while I was lying with a mask on my face, they massaged my hands and feet, and then gave me liver tea. Dear team of this clinic, I'm absolutely delighted with you and your service. Thank you so much for working so hard for us. 😘😘😘
0x305031fa4c6fc08b_0x75b26a807ff2b0fd.author: Анастасия Селюк

0x305031fa4c6fc08b_0x75b26a807ff2b0fd.text: Absolutely, the most impressive clinic I’ve ever been to. I come from the United States and I wish we would have places that were top-notch like this place. I had my face and neck done with Morpheus and two months later my neck is 90% better and so is my face.
