0x305039d75e30be09_0xf1837d86152c5211.text: I recently visited My Physio by Kanitta Clinic in Phuket and was absolutely impressed from start to finish. From the very first moment, the entire team welcomed me with genuine warmth and kindness. The clinic atmosphere is calm, clean, and professional, creating immediate trust and comfort. Kanitta and her staff took the time to explain every step of the treatment process clearly and in detail. They carefully analyzed my condition, identified the root causes, and demonstrated each exercise and therapy technique in a way that was easy to understand and follow. I really appreciated how they combined modern physiotherapy knowledge with traditional Thai and Chinese medical understanding, making the treatment both effective and holistic. During my sessions, I never felt rushed. Every question was answered patiently, and every exercise was checked to make sure I was doing it correctly. The technology and equipment used are up‑to‑date, and the staff’s professionalism stands out in every aspect. Whether you’re a traveler in Phuket needing quick recovery from pain or an expat or local looking for long‑term care, I can wholeheartedly recommend this clinic. They truly care about each patient’s well‑being, not just the symptoms. Everything—from the friendly reception to the detailed explanations—was simply perfect. Without a doubt, this was one of the best physiotherapy experiences I’ve ever had. I confidently give them 5 out of 5 stars and will definitely return whenever I need professional physiotherapy in Phuket.

0x305039d75e30be09_0xf1837d86152c5211.text: I’m really happy with the treatment I received at this physiotherapy clinic in Phuket! After struggling with office syndrome for around 4 years, I finally found relief after 5 sessions here. I can barely move my neck before coming to the clinic. My therapist, Mo, was amazing. She’s very skilled, caring, and explained everything really well. My treatment plan included ultrasound therapy followed by therapeutic massage, plus shockwave therapy and dry needling based on Mo’s recommendations. Each technique was explained clearly and tailored to my condition, which made me feel confident in the process. Mo also recommended stretching exercises suitable to my condition and lifestyle changes to help maintain the results long term. The clinic is super clean and the whole environment feels professional yet welcoming. A lot of nice coffee shops around too. Nothing better than sipping drip coffee after therapy session. Highly recommend it to anyone needing physiotherapy in Phuket!

0x305039d75e30be09_0xf1837d86152c5211.text: I was traveling in Phuket when I suddenly injured my lower back, and it put a serious damper on my trip. From the moment I walked in, the team was welcoming, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable. I want to give huge credit to the doctor and to the amazing physiotherapist, Tuk, who worked absolute wonders. Tuk immediately understood the issue, explained everything clearly, and treated my back with such skill and care that I felt improvement after just the first session. By the third session, my back was completely healed — pain-free, mobile, and feeling better than I ever expected in such a short time. Thanks to them, I was able to enjoy the rest of my stay in Phuket without any discomfort. I can’t recommend My Physio By Kanitta Clinic highly enough. If you’re in Phuket and need physiotherapy, this is the place to go!

The therapist really took the time to understand what happened instead of just jumping into treatment. The session itself was very targeted and gentle (not painful at all), focusing on releasing the surrounding muscles rather than forcing the sore area. 0x30e29f0bfa33a897_0x95329a015ce39721.text: I came to the clinic with a problematic root canal issue that had been previously treated by another dentist, here. Dr. Ruangwarin clearly explained the situation, took additional X-rays, and walked me through the treatment options step by step. Two dentists I visited before refused to handle this complicated root canal, but she carefully located the problem and did real effort to save my tooth from the previous treatment. She spent a long time cleaning and repairing the canal with great precision. I also really appreciated that I never felt any pressure to do additional expensive procedures when there was no real need for them. As a foreigner in Thailand, it is extremely valuable to find a doctor you can trust. Dr. Ruangwarin was transparent, fair, and professional throughout the entire process. I’m very happy with the result and will definitely continue my treatment at this clinic.

My dental experience at Smile Center has been brilliant from the very first day I stepped into the clinic. 3 weeks back, I specifically flew down to Bangkok for my dental implant surgery because I trust all the doctors greatly and always feel comforted with their professionalism. Special thanks to Dr Kh Gun, Kh Mim and the rest of the lovely doctors for caring and taking care of me like family. I live in Singapore but choose to fly down to Bangkok to restore my dental health at Smile Center as they are the best in the business. I’m grateful to have found a gem of a place. My sincerest thank you once again 🙏

Done one front tooth at smile centre dental clinic, staffs were friendly all can speak English. Especially Mim very helpful, reassuring, explain everything, cost , post implant. Dr. Gun is speaking English fluently, caring , so lovely . No pain during the procedure, he showed the X-ray afterward, medications, temporary denture look natural . I love it

Very fast and efficient service from Dr Kalanyakorn. She is very gentle with her move and doesn't stress out the patient as usually we patients will be very nervous during dental treatment. And also the counter staff, Miss Fon and Miss Mim is very friendly and helpful. Definitely will come back for the next ddetal cleaning when I am back here in BKK.

The centre was great and the service was top notch. 0x3051c00687cb887d_0x1a2ac0bd9a88cf10.text: Yesterday, I visited Dr. Somboon Clinic, at the advice of a friend. I got there shortly after opening and was attended to almost immediately, by the staff. After giving them all my information, I sat down and waited for about 5 minutes. I was taken to see the doctor, and he asked me about my concerns and my medical history. He physically tested my leg, to see what the problem was. He prescribed a few meds for me, and I was on my way out. Very professional and knowledgeable. The problem I was having was some pretty serious pain in my leg. I thought it was my cancer spreading, but the medication he prescribed for me, seems to work. I feel better today, and I just started on the medication yesterday. I highly recommend Dr. Somboon Polyclinic. I am very satisfied how I was treated.

0x3051c00687cb887d_0x1a2ac0bd9a88cf10.text: We took my elementary school age kid to see Dr. Somboon based on reviews, but more importantly, after asking a couple hotel staff where they go for their clinic needs. 0x3051c00687cb887d_0x1a2ac0bd9a88cf10.text: I recently visited a local clinic in Ao Nang, Krabi, to get an earwax blockage removed, and I couldn't be more satisfied with the experience. 0x30da3b68e1e0578d_0x1cca820b29cd365a.text: During my visit to Chiang Mai, I had the opportunity to explore OT Dispensary, a standout establishment in the city’s burgeoning cannabis scene. Located conveniently in the heart of Chiang Mai, this dispensary offers a curated experience that blends professionalism with a relaxed, welcoming vibe. The first thing that struck me was the atmosphere. The interior design is sleek yet approachable, creating a space that feels both modern and cozy. The staff were knowledgeable, approachable, and passionate about their offerings, which made the experience educational and enjoyable for someone like me who appreciates understanding product quality and benefits. OT Dispensary boasts an impressive selection of cannabis strains and products, from high-quality flowers to oils and edibles. Their dedication to quality is evident in the carefully curated menu, which caters to both beginners and seasoned enthusiasts. I particularly appreciated the clear labeling and detailed descriptions, which helped me make an informed choice. Beyond the products, OT Dispensary goes the extra mile with its commitment to customer care. The staff took the time to listen to my preferences and provided thoughtful recommendations tailored to my needs. This personalized approach set OT Dispensary apart from other shops I’ve visited. Additionally, the dispensary prioritizes education and responsible use, which is a reassuring touch for both locals and travelers. Whether you’re looking for a relaxing strain to wind down after a day exploring Chiang Mai or something to spark creativity, OT Dispensary delivers with professionalism and care. In summary, OT Dispensary is a must-visit for anyone exploring the cannabis culture in Chiang Mai. With its excellent selection, knowledgeable staff, and welcoming atmosphere, it’s more than just a dispensary—it’s an experience.

From the second we walked in, Patrick and the rest of the team (Minnie, Ploy, Katie + Terry) welcomed us warmly, treated us with kindness, professionalism and respect, were patient with answering all of our questions, happily worked with us on our designs, made sure we were all on the same page regarding pricing before we walked out the door with quotes and provided the reassurance I was looking for when booking a new studio we had never been to before. The studio itself is absolutely immaculate. You know it’s clean the second you walk in because your nose feels as though it’s been transported to a hospital back in Australia. There’s not a speck of dust in the whole place and this goes for all floors and areas, not just the main reception. Every single floor is clean, comfortable, private and well equipped. Toilet on every floor for convenience. Snacks and drinks are well stocked and you’re constantly checked on throughout. My entire family all got tattoos and the calibre of work is beyond anything I could have imagined. I had tattoos from both Terry and Katie. Katie was the artist for my lion fish and coral, Terry for my bigger leg piece. The whole process was seamless and crazy to say, almost painless. Both artists as well as the shop owners (Pat + Minnie) constantly checking on me throughout from making sure I was happy with the stencil placement, comfortable in the chair, checking if I needed a break, drink, snack, air turned up or down, different music or a show on the tv. I couldn’t have been better looked after. The after care was also exceptional. Thorough details on how and when to remove second skin as well as aftercare cream actually being provided in a beautifully presented envelope. The team has also sent photos and checked in on us since leaving. 2 days later and we can’t feel our tattoo’s at all. If we couldn’t see them we would not know they were there. I cannot rate Artisan ink high enough, 5 stars is nowhere near a good enough rating! The service, the cleanliness, the calibre of work is extraordinary, the price is extremely reasonable, the friendliest team we have ever had the please of meeting. We walked in wary of going to a new studio, we walked out knowing we will never go anywhere else, sorry guys, you’re stuck with us now 🫶🏽 Do yourself a favour and go in for a chat, there’s zero pressure to actually book a tattoo but I guarantee you will!
0x30da3becf3885829_0x6dee724f34430d1d.author: Julz Perry

0x30da3becf3885829_0x6dee724f34430d1d.text: I could go on all day about how magnificient the service is here. Long story short - Immaculate shop - quite cheap, fair price and affordable. I left with a feeling of every penny being worth it! Fluency in English - so no need to worry being lost in translation for your ideas of interest. Heartwarming service - Patrick and Co. are extremely helpful and considerate making sure you literally feel at home in the shop. Everytime I return to Chiang Mai I will definitely come visit each time, even if it's just for a chatter with the team (that's how welcoming they are) Professionalism and perfection: The team will make sure everything sits right, by adjusting size and details before ink'ing and Patrick always make sure you feel comfortable before proceeding. If you are like me and you are very cautious/mildy perfectionistic then superb - Patrick had no issues with me changing somethings up on the go as he finalized the idea with his editing software. Besides, the team wants to make sure they have the correct size you want - something you are happy with before proceeding. The artists have sage-like hands-on experience with tattooing because my lord is their work flabbergasting! Hygiene - Absolutely perfect. They care for your tattoo's health before, during and after. Colors are super clean and looks astonishing once finished. Communication and guidance - Patrick's genius mind makes him able to know whether or not something "makes sense" for placement and details. He's always on the aim for perfection for the benefit of you. Consumables: Artisan ink offers an extra kick to your energy for time consuming tattoos - free beverages and snacks to make sure you remain steady during the sessions. (Patrick even ordered donuts for the team, and offered me to have some as well) All in all - This is the place to go in Chiang Mai. Hygiene is the best you'll find the shop is aesthetically pleasing to look at. So if you want astounding service and care with siginificant professionalism for a very reasonable and afforable price, then please, do yourself a favor and step into ARTISAN INK to get not just a tattoo for your life but also an experience for life. Thank you Patrick and Co. See you soon.
0x30da3becf3885829_0x6dee724f34430d1d.author: Mike Kure

0x30da3becf3885829_0x6dee724f34430d1d.text: This tattoo shop is unlike any other shop. It is a beautiful bright, clean establishment. I felt so comfortable with the staff, from my first walk in meeting to spending as much time as necessary perfecting my 3/4 arm sleeve. Patrick is the most welcoming guy and is extremely detailed and cares deeply about working with the artist and myself to come up with a perfect design that I absolutely loved. Jean was my artist and let me tell you he has a steady, light hand and applied the ink perfectly. We did a straight 11 hour session and he did such crisp, clean lines, shading and some added color. Im in love with the design we created together, Jean perfected it and even did some free hand to finish off a section on my shoulder. Hands down the best tattoo shop in Chaing Mai. I highly recommend you coming here to make your Mark at artisan ink. I wish I had more time to do my inner arm sleeve but time is limited for my trip. If I ever come back im coming here. They have so many experienced tattoo artist and offer a wide range of designs from tribal to traditional. I couldn't praise this shop more, customer service is unmatched. They were constantly checking on my needs throughout and even called a grab ride to take me back to my hotel. Im so blessed I found this shop. Such a different take then your average tattoo shop. Its absolutely gorgeous!! 100 starts still isn't enough to express how good this shop is.

0x30da3becf3885829_0x6dee724f34430d1d.text: If you go anywhere else for a tattoo you’ve chosen to live life at a lower quality. Don’t do that. At Artisan Ink, they’re beyond welcoming, they’re hospitable. Beyond nice, they’re kind. More than talented, they’re skilled. More than honest, they’re genuine. I got a tattoo here on Nov 14 for which we worked together on the design for over a day. They were patient, knowledgeable, and genuinely cared about getting it, not just right, perfect. They do a great job of explaining their philosophy of care and why they teach what they do. You can tell from first step in to step out afterward that they are committed to hygiene. Because I live in Bangkok, I will be factoring in flight costs to every tattoo moving forward because it. Is. Worth it. Don’t cheat yourself; treat yourself. Get your next favorite tattoo at Artisan Ink.

0x30da3becf3885829_0x6dee724f34430d1d.text: After researching tattoo studios in Chiang Mai for several weeks, I chose Artisan Ink Tattoo, and it was one of the best decisions I've made. I had a large custom colour neck tattoo completed, and the entire experience exceeded my expectations. The studio is exceptionally clean, professional, and well organised. The artists are highly skilled, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about their work. What impressed me most was the attention to detail. The artist carefully planned the placement and flow of the design, ensuring it complemented my existing tattoos perfectly. The colour work is vibrant, the line work is crisp, and the overall balance of the piece is exactly what I had hoped for. As someone who has multiple tattoos, I can honestly say this was one of the most professional tattoo experiences I've had. Communication was excellent throughout the process, and I always felt informed and comfortable. If you're searching for a tattoo studio in Chiang Mai, a custom tattoo artist in Thailand, or high-quality colour tattoo work, I would strongly recommend Artisan Ink Tattoo. The combination of artistic talent, customer care, cleanliness, and professionalism is difficult to find. Thank you to the entire team at Artisan Ink Tattoo for creating a piece that I will be proud to wear for life.

0x30da3becf3885829_0x6dee724f34430d1d.text: Great experience today at Artisan Ink Chiang Mai, booked in advance and popped in prior to appointment to discuss options and ideas on 2 different tattoos.. ran through some options and went away, before appointment sent me over some ideas to think on before showing for the tattoo.. 0x30503bb0d1604473_0x10fe98eea79a4626.text: We recently travelled to Phuket with a baby who is less than 1 years old. Baby was feeling feverish with a fever that did not subside. We ended up asking the hotel to call a doctor to our hotel room at 4am. Dr Mon and her assistant arrived at our hotel room within 30 mins and stayed for almost 1.5 hours conducting a thorough assessment, providing medication, and clearly explaining the next steps. It turned out our baby had contracted COVID Less than 12 hours after Dr Mon’s visit, our baby needed to be admitted to hospital. As soon as we let her know we were heading in, she promptly forwarded all the relevant paperwork to the hospital so our baby could be checked in quickly before we even arrived. Dr Mon was incredibly diligent, kind, and supportive, and helped us navigate the Thai hospital system during an already stressful time. Her regular check-ins via WhatsApp were so reassuring, and we especially appreciated her helping communicate in Thai with our Grab driver on the way to the hospital and the hospital staff. Now that we’re back home, our baby has made a full recovery. We sincerely thank Dr Mon and her team for their outstanding care and support. We are genuinely grateful and wish them all the very best.

0x30da313f784c4d83_0xe608c0b48832a14a.text: Narat and his assistant are amazing. I went there to see Narat two days in a row as I had pretty severe back and hip pain making it hard to walk. I messaged him through LINE to see if he would take me right when he opened. He took time to explain a few things and to understand my concerns. As I was in so much pain, I booked an appointment right when he opened at 9am. When I went to see him he took the time to understand my concerns and understand my body. He pointed out a lot of different issues and how he would try to fix it. Unfortunately he said it wasn’t a quick fix which is why I had to go twice. On the first day he was able to do a small adjustment which gave me a lot of relief, but it still was painful. His assistant gave me a massage down my back with care for my spine as he said that it was very tight and they don’t move well at all. He did a small back adjustment and a neck adjustment that I really needed to loosen up the tension and tightness. So on the first day it felt better but was still sore. On the second day I went back my hips and back were looser but still felt tight and painful. When I went to see him his assistant did a good massage of the back to loosen it up a bit, then he said he would try a new technique to loosen up the spine. He went to town on my spine and it felt great. After, he did a small adjustment to my neck, which hurt because of how tight it is. He was able to relieve the pain by doing some scraping and a certain pen technique which was really amazing. After, he said that my posture looks very hunched over, so he recommended cupping. I’ve had cupping before, but it has never been so incredibly effective. It really pulled out those sore muscles and gave it space. Once he finished the cupping, almost all my hip and back pain disappeared. He also cupped my neck and shoulders in a way I’ve never had before which made it feel a lot looser. I wish I could stay one more day to see what he’d do tomorrow, but I can say that he knows what he’s doing and really goes that extra mile to ensure he tries to get to the root of the problem. I’ve gone to many chiropractors in Canada over the years and none were this effective. He did not do a 5 minute crack and make you leave. His pricing is very reasonable too. 900 Baht first day 900 Baht for chiropractic treatment second day 500 Baht for cupping on the second day. Overall 2,300 Baht. This is not money wasted and was very well spent. When I left the store a group of 5 adults walked in after me. I think that sets the tone for how good he is as well. I highly recommend Narat. Thank you for your help.

0x30e29bb3e5ab0859_0x4c124803a9958f69.text: วันนี้ได้มีโอกาสไปขูดหินปูนที่อัลปาก้าคลินิกโดยใช้สิทธิ์ประกันสังคม ซึ่งดีมากเลยค่ะ เพราะจ่ายเพิ่มแค่ 200 บาท เท่านั้นเอง คุ้มสุดๆ และคุณหมอก็ตรวจฟันให้ละเอียดมาก พบว่ามีฟันผุ 1 ซี่ 2 ด้าน ก็เลยตัดสินใจอุดฟันไปเลยในวันนั้น ค่าใช้จ่าย 1,200 บาท ฟีลลิ่งคือคุณหมอมือเบา ใส่ใจมาก และอธิบายทุกขั้นตอนแบบเข้าใจง่าย ทำให้รู้สึกสบายใจและไว้วางใจได้เลยค่ะ นอกจากนี้ยังได้ทำ รีเทนเนอร์แบบลวด ราคา 4,000 บาท ด้วย คุณหมอวัดแบบอย่างตั้งใจ ใช้เวลาไม่นาน และให้คำแนะนำการดูแลรีเทนเนอร์ดีมากๆ ขอชมอีกคนคือน้องผู้ช่วยค่ะ ถึงจะยังมือใหม่ กำลังฝึกหัด แต่พยายามเต็มที่เลยนะคะ ซัคชั่นบางจังหวะอาจยังไม่เป๊ะ แต่เห็นถึงความตั้งใจจริงๆ เป็นกำลังใจให้น้องเก่งขึ้นทุกวันนะคะ สู้ๆ ค่า โดยรวมประทับใจมากค่ะ ใครมองหาคลินิกทำฟันในนนทบุรีที่คุณหมอน่ารัก ใจดี มือเบา แนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะ คลินิกทันตกรรมอัลปาก้า ใกล้รถไฟฟ้า สายสีชมพูสถานีแคราย เดิน 3 ก้าวถึง !!
0x30e29bb3e5ab0859_0x4c124803a9958f69.en: Today, I had the opportunity to get my teeth cleaned at Alpaca Clinic using my social security benefits, which was great because I only paid an extra 200 baht. It was incredibly worthwhile! The dentist examined my teeth thoroughly and found one tooth with cavities on two sides, so they decided to fill it that day. The cost was 1,200 baht. I felt the dentist was very gentle, attentive, and explained every step in an easy-to-understand way, making me feel comfortable and confident. I also got a wire retainer made for 4,000 baht. The dentist measured carefully, it didn't take long, and they gave excellent advice on how to care for the retainer. I'd also like to commend the assistant. Even though she's new and still learning, she tried her best. Some of the suction wasn't perfect, but I could see her dedication. I encourage her to improve every day! Overall, I was very impressed. If you're looking for a dental clinic in Nonthaburi with a kind, gentle, and lovely dentist, I highly recommend Alpaca Dental Clinic. It's near the Pink Line MRT Khaerai station – just three steps away!

0x3102973cdcb5a237_0xcbb1adfc97150064.text: I recently visited JMC Clinic for my allergy rash concerns, and the experience exceeded all my expectations. From the moment I walked in, I was struck by how immaculately clean the entire clinic was—every surface felt fresh and sanitized, creating a reassuring, safe environment that’s so important for medical care. The staff, from the front desk team to the nurses, were incredibly professional and attentive. They greeted me warmly, handled my appointment efficiently, and took the time to address all my questions with patience. Most impressively, the doctors demonstrated exceptional expertise: they listened carefully to my symptoms, thoroughly explained my condition and treatment options, and crafted a targeted plan that addressed my ongoing rash issues. Their professionalism never felt cold—instead, it was paired with genuine care that made me feel seen and supported throughout the visit. JMC Clinic checks all the boxes for quality healthcare: a spotless facility, a team of dedicated professionals, and personalized care that delivers results. I can’t recommend this clinic highly enough to anyone in need of reliable, compassionate medical support—they’ve earned my trust and will be my go-to for future healthcare needs.

0x3102973cdcb5a237_0xcbb1adfc97150064.text: I went to the clinic after not being able to stop coughing for 5 days. From the moment I walked into the clinic the amount of care and concern was evident. There was not much waiting at all. After examining me and getting an X-ray it was determined that I had a lung infection. They gave me an antibiotic drip and a hydration drip. they also gave me oxygen. The nursing staff was very kind and caring. I actually started to feel a bit better after the antibiotic drip. They gave me medicine to take home. They also gave me the paperwork because they wanted me to go to the hospital if I wasn’t feeling better the next day. The total cost for treatment 6,364.00 thb. Approximately $284.00 cdn. I was there for 2 1/2 hours.By the time I got home my coughing stopped 90%. The next day I was feeling a lot better and had an appetite again. I cannot express my gratitude for the very professional care. They really made me feel cared for. They all spoke English.

0x30e2a1e190777de3_0x3e84ed7b10185cb0.text: The new building has cleaning staff, and the elevators have a floor-locking system, allowing access only to the intended floor. There are about 10 restaurants, a 7-Eleven, an Amazon cafe, a gym, and a buffet restaurant. The building is decorated for holidays; for example, Christmas has a Christmas tree and Santa Claus handing out candy. However, the motorcycle parking needs improvement as it's insufficient and the back entrance is locked, forcing riders to walk around to the front, exposed to sun and rain. Those carrying documents must be careful not to get wet as there's no shelter. Running requires caution due to the slippery, smooth surface. Motorcycles are double-parked, and some security guards refuse to move them. The car parking lot has about 11 floors with two-way access. After 8:30 AM, parking is usually only available on the 5th or 6th floor. Tenants should be aware of air conditioning issues; the air conditioning ducts near the windows may not reach all areas, and turning the AC centrally can make it too cold.
0x30e2a1e190777de3_0x3e84ed7b10185cb0.author: Jaturong jarungjirakiet

0x30e2a1e190777de3_0x3e84ed7b10185cb0.text: This building houses the Revenue Department, located on the corner of Rama III Road, near the Supalai Head Office. On the 3rd, 4th, and 5th floors, you'll be greeted with a warm welcome and fast service. Hot and cold coffee and Ovaltine are served. High security measures are in place, and many companies are located. Separate elevators are available, with staff on hand to provide information. The ground floor hall features an indoor market selling clothing, food, and miscellaneous goods. The food court offers ample parking.

0x30e2a1e190777de3_0x3e84ed7b10185cb0.text: We drove around looking for parking, went up to the building, and finally found a spot. We walked to the information desk and asked for the company we were bringing the claim to. The guard told us the building was an office, so we should claim at Rat Burana. We thought, "Okay, that's a waste of time. I didn't call to check properly." So we asked where we could get our parking ticket stamped. The guard said it would be free within 15 minutes. Wow, it took 15 minutes to find a parking spot." So we hurried back to the car and drove out. It turned out we walked for 1 minute, parked for 16 minutes, and paid 40 baht for parking. We wanted to get our ticket stamped, but we thought we'd have to drive back up to find another spot. It would take longer, take more time, and make things even worse. 0x30e29ef49111928d_0x8110678d64a6c4b0.text: Very friendly staff who were responsive and professional while working on my friend Som (stray I took in who had a neck wound). Majority of staff spoke basic English but doctors and at least one other person on staff had a good level of English. They do charge you for every single item they use so it is quite expensive. Som was being treated for a neck wound and had to be taken in every couple of days for redressing. In total I brought him in about 8 times. 0x30e29ef49111928d_0x8110678d64a6c4b0.text: เราเคยพาน้องหมาที่บ้านไปทำหมันค่ะ แล้วน้องตัวเล็กมากผิวเค้าบอบบางเวลาลอกพลาสเตอร์ออกจากแผลที่ท้องของเค้า เค้าจะร้องน่าสงสารมาก เราใช้เวลาทำแผลให้เค้าเองที่บ้านนานมากเพราะกลัวเค้าเจ็บ อยู่มาวันนึงเราทนไม่ได้แล้วที่ต้องทำแผลให้เค้าเองเพราะเห็นเค้ารู้สึกเจ็บไม่ไหว เราเลยขับรถจากที่บ้านเราซึ่งอยู่สมุทรปราการไปที่โรงพยาบาลที่อยู่พระราม9 ระยะทางอยู่ไกลกันมากเราเข้าไปช่วงกลางดึกและได้พบกับนายแพทย์ตะวันซึ่งเป็นหมอเวรในคืนนั้น พฤติกรรมแรกที่เราเห็นเค้าคุยกับผู้ช่วยพนักงานคือดูใช้อารมณ์มาก น้องพนักงานทั้ง2คนดูกลัวหมอคนนี้มาก ทั้งๆที่พนักงาน2คนนั้นดูอ่อนโยนและน่ารักกับน้องหมาเรามาก ทันทีที่เราส่งน้องหมาตัวเล็กของเราให้นายแพทย์ตะวัน เค้ากลับบอกเราว่าวิธีการง่ายๆคือแค่เอาแอลกอฮอล์ทาที่บนพลาสเตอร์แล้วลอกออก ทันทีที่เค้าพูดอยู่นั้นก็เอามือกระชากพลาสเตอร์แผ่นนั้นออกอย่างแรง ย้ำว่ากระชากออกอย่างแรง น้องหมาเราร้องลั่น ท้องเค้าแดงและมีรอยถลอก เราโกรธมากแต่ไม่อยากมีเรื่อง เค้าทำตัวเหมือนน้ำเต็มแก้ว เหมือนไร้ซึ่งจรรยาบรรณของความเป็นสัตวแพทย์ที่ดีที่ไม่มีความเมตุตาหรืออ่อนโยนต่อสัตว์เลย เราผิดหวังมาก หลังจากนั้นน้องหมาเรากลายเป็นหมาที่กลัวคนทุกคนไปเลย ขนาดกับเราเค้ายังหวาดระแวง เราให้อภัยหมอคนนี้ไม่ได้จริงๆ ส่วนเรื่องคะแนนเต็มและ5ดาวที่ลูกค้าให้ในกูเกิ้ลแมพเราอยากให้รู้ไว้ว่าทางโรงพยาบาลแจ้งว่าถ้าให้ 5 ดาวเค้าจะให้ส่วนลดค่ารักษา นั่นก็น่าจะเป็นเหตุผลที่ทำไมคะแนนถึงดี I once took my small dog to be neutered. Because he is so tiny and has very delicate skin, he would cry out in pain whenever I had to peel the bandages off his abdominal wound. It was heartbreaking. I used to spend a long time cleaning his wound at home because I was so afraid of hurting him. One day, I couldn't bear to do it myself anymore because seeing him in pain was too much. I decided to drive all the way from my home in Samut Prakan to a hospital in Rama 9. Despite the long distance, I went in the middle of the night and met Dr. Tawan, who was the on-call veterinarian that shift. The first thing I noticed was how he spoke to his assistants; he seemed very temperamental and emotional. The two staff members looked terrified of him, even though they were being very gentle and sweet with my dog. As soon as I handed my little dog to Dr. Tawan, he told me that the 'simple' way to do it was to just apply alcohol over the plaster and peel it off. While he was saying this, he suddenly yanked the bandage off with great force—I emphasize, he ripped it off violently. My dog screamed in pain. His belly was bright red and Cooper had visible abrasions. I was furious, but I didn't want to start an altercation. He acted like a 'full cup' (arrogant and unwilling to listen), showing a complete lack of professional ethics and no mercy or gentleness toward animals. I was deeply disappointed. Since that incident, my dog has become terrified of everyone. He is even suspicious and paranoid around me. I truly cannot forgive this doctor. Regarding the 5-star reviews on Google Maps, I want people to know that the hospital offers discounts on treatment in exchange for 5-star ratings. That is likely why their score remains so high. 我曾经带家里的狗狗去过绝育手术。因为它体型很小，皮肤非常娇嫩，每次撕掉腹部伤口的胶布时，它都会疼得惨叫，听着让人非常心碎。为了怕它疼，我在家帮它处理伤口时总是小心翼翼，花很长时间。 直到有一天，我实在无法忍受亲手看它受苦，于是决定开车从北榄府（Samut Prakan）赶往拉玛九路（Rama 9）的一家医院。虽然路途遥远，且当时已是深夜，但为了它我还是去了。那天晚上的值班医生名叫 Tawan 医生。 我见他的第一眼，就发现他在和两名助理说话时态度非常暴躁，情绪化。那两名员工看起来非常害怕这位医生，尽管他们对我的狗狗表现得非常温柔可爱。 当我把小狗交给 Tawan 医生时，他竟然对我说：‘简单的方法就是直接把酒精涂在胶布上，然后撕掉。’ 话音刚落，他就伸手猛地一拽，把那块胶布狠狠地撕了下来。我强调一下，是非常用力地撕拽。我的狗狗顿时疼得大声惨叫，它的腹部变得通红，甚至出现了擦伤的痕迹。 我当时极其愤怒，但并不想在现场发生冲突。这位医生的表现就像‘满瓶子水’（固执己见，不听人言），完全没有一名优秀兽医应有的职业操守，对动物毫无慈悲心和温柔可言。我感到非常失望。 在那之后，我的狗狗变得非常胆小，害怕所有人，甚至连对我都会产生戒备和疑虑。我真的无法原谅这位医生。至于谷歌地图（Google Maps）上那些满分好评，我想让大家知道，那是因为医院告知：如果给五星好评就可以获得医疗费折扣。这大概就是为什么他们的评分会那么高。

0x30fdaba73d7a553f_0xc1832ef1ae173309.text: I'm 72 years old, and I thought that at my age, there were very few benefits to be gained from the science of chiropractic before being treated at Spine Clinic by Dr. David, chiropractor. For over 40 years, after a false move in judo, I regularly experienced numbness in my left thigh muscle, which made my daily life uncomfortable for walking activities. Recently, due to sciatica, I could no longer put one foot in front of the other to walk unaided. I had to hold myself to walk 10 meters. I was completely bent over with pain that started in my lower back and went down my left thigh and leg. I noticed immediate improvements after the first session, was amazed and surprised by the difference a single session could make. I felt reassured and full of hope. In just six treatment sessions with Dr. David, and with the help of his team of highly skilled masseuses, following the instructions to regularly perform the exercises and stretches at home recommended by Dr. David, I am amazed to have regained normal mobility in my left leg while improving my overall well-being in a safe and natural way. Dr. David took the time to listen to my concerns, understand my pain and its history, clearly explained what he was going to do, and devoted all his energy to achieving the best possible results. I am delighted with the Spine Clinic; the team is very professional and passionate, and they always make us feel welcome upon our arrival. The progress I have seen encourages me to continue using their services. Congratulations and a big thank you.

0x30e29ece000c3855_0xb9b976312e9a04d3.text: I would like to record my appreciation for Pacific Prime. They assisted me in iteratively comparing, applying for, and securing my (worldwide) health insurance. I want to make special mention of Kei, Daniel and Emalyn in the Bangkok Office, who made the entire process smooth and stress-free. I sent an initial meeting request to the Company over email and Kei responded in a timely manner, asking all the relevant questions to prepare for the scheduled meeting (with her and Daniel). The office itself was an oasis of calm, with everybody working, holding client meetings, and doing post-sales support in quietly and efficiently. I appreciated the work Kei put in for preparing the presentation, which made it easy for me to narrow down the insurance provider I wanted, and pinpoint the plan which suited my needs. Daniel, being more senior, provided several crucial insights which aided me in making my final choice. Finally, Emalyn did much of the post-application heavy lifting and liaisoning between the chosen provider and me, and handled both my requests for information and the insurer's requests comprehensively and with due speed. I hope I never need to use my insurance cover, but I take comfort in knowing that Pacific Prime will be around to assist me if there is ever such a situation. If you are serious about your insurance needs, and not simply checking off a list box requirement, I would recommend using the services of an insurance broker, and my vote is with Pacific Prime. Much thanks again to Kei, Daniel and Emalyn.

0x30e29ece000c3855_0xb9b976312e9a04d3.text: If getting the right international health insurance seems daunting, this is the place to go. My consultant Wouter was peaceful and trustworthy, very organized, knowledgeable, not pushy at all and took all the time to explain different options. When at first I was not accepted because of a very recent road accident he immediately came up with very decent temporary solutions which covered me until I was accepted by the Insurer with the policy I had initially chosen. I always had the feeling I had a guy in my corner. And God knows how rare that is where and when insurance is concerned. I am looking forward to a long and fruitful relationship with these brokers and I truly, truly can recommend them. I will not hesitate to get other kinds of insurance through them

0x30da3abd69eada57_0xfc6f6bbeb9b63237.text: I booked in advance via Facebook message, choosing Option B: a 90-minute facial massage + Thai massage for 1350 baht. I found it incredibly relaxing. After the massage, I chatted with the owner for a long time. She was super nice and my favorite person on this entire Chiang Mai trip! She said the facial massage technique was something she developed herself. She diligently researched various facial muscles and acupoints, and shared tips on which areas to massage for health benefits. She even created her own set of facial massage techniques – very impressive! The environment was quite simple and small, like a private studio. I felt revitalized after the massage – highly recommended! However, I suggest that women who wear makeup come before bed, as they apply some products to the face during the massage, so they will essentially remove your makeup first. You might want to consider going makeup-free for the rest of your trip! A minor drawback is that some movements during the massage involve lying face down, but their pillows are regular pillows, so you need to alternate between left and right sides. Lying face down for a while can cause neck pain.
0x30da3abd69eada57_0xfc6f6bbeb9b63237.author: Rui Lin

0x30da3abd69eada57_0xfc6f6bbeb9b63237.text: I found Orn while seeking out a Thai massage, and I am so happy I did. I expected a Thai massage, but received so much more. Not only is the shop full of good loving energy and true healing hands, but Orn really goes above and beyond in so many ways. She feels like a long lost family member, who has such love in her heart. She made me feel so beautiful inside and out. The Thai massage was amazing and tailored specifically to what I needed. She even gave me extra time in certain areas as my body really needed it. But the most incredible part was the face massage. She offers this as a stand alone service, as well as an add on to the thai massage. I never realized how much tension I held in my face, and how it is all connected to the neck and the shoulder. I had clicking in my jaw that was treated in just one session. I feel my jawline is more defined, my scalp is somehow looser and more relaxed, and I left feeling so happy in my heart as well. I highly recommend Orn, you will be so lucky to meet her and she is a real gift to the world. Thank you so much Orn 🙏❤️
0x30da3abd69eada57_0xfc6f6bbeb9b63237.author: Kelly Vaughn

0x30da3abd69eada57_0xfc6f6bbeb9b63237.text: This is not one of those typical walk-in massage places you find on every main street. It’s a small, cozy salon run by a lovely lady who truly cares about her clients. From the very beginning, you can feel it’s not a mass-service business – everything is done with attention, warmth, and real skill. The massage itself was excellent. I could literally feel the muscle tension melting away. It wasn’t just random pressure, but a thoughtful and professional treatment. Before starting, the therapist asked if it was my first Thai massage – such a nice and caring touch. After the session, we had a short, friendly chat, which made the whole experience even more personal. The place is not located on a main street, but it’s absolutely worth the short walk. I’ll definitely be going back and already recommend it to my friends. So far, it’s the best massage I’ve had in Thailand. Also, an important plus – the lady speaks very good English, so communication is easy and comfortable.

0x30da3abd69eada57_0xfc6f6bbeb9b63237.text: If you're looking for HARD Thai massages that leaves you feeling light and floaty afterwards, then Orn Healing Hands is for you! After trying a few massage places in Chiang Mai, we were frustrated by the lack of hard massages offered. Most of them were rubs leaving us feeling the same as we walked in. Do not be fooled by the simple decor and higher prices of Orn Healing Hands, because its worth every penny. They really know the pressure points of the body and work hard to relief the tightness in our bodies. There was pleasure and pain all at the same time! The atmosphere is very clean and simple with light music playing in the background. They start out washing our feet with lime and a scrub. Then we changed into the massage clothes. After the massage, they even gave us ginger tea and a biscuit. I would recommend making a reservation. I'm super happy to have found this place and I'm recommending to all my friends and family visiting Chiang Mai!

We'll definitely keep coming back!

0x30fdad84a3782ea9_0xb5512c5519cc234a.text: When I came to Chillax for a massage, I had somehow lost hope of finding a truly great massage in Thailand. I still carried memories from my first visit in the early 2000s, when you could walk into almost any place and receive an exceptional massage. Unfortunately, that has changed. Today, it often takes a lot of research and many disappointing experiences to finally find a place like Chillax. At Chillax, it’s immediately clear that the therapists are properly trained. They understand technique, anatomy, and the art of touch. The massage felt intentional, and deeply therapeutic. As a holistic health practitioner with nearly three decades of experience in this field, I know very well what quality touch feels like. Polly was my massage therapist for the three sessions I had there, and her work was consistently excellent. I’m confident that the other therapists are equally well trained and knowledgeable, as the overall standard at Chillax is very high. Nam, the owner, is a very lovely person and makes the experience even more special.
0x30fdad84a3782ea9_0xb5512c5519cc234a.author: Geeta

0x30fdad84a3782ea9_0xb5512c5519cc234a.text: This is hands down the best massage place I’ve experienced in Hua Hin over the past four years. All the masseuses are incredibly well-trained, and the quality of their service truly stands out. My personal favorite is Nan—her technique and attentiveness are exceptional. Booking an appointment is effortless through WhatsApp, and the staff are always welcoming, greeting you with warm smiles and kind words. What truly sets this place apart is their ability to quickly identify problem areas and tailor the massage to your specific needs. Whether you have knots, injuries, or tension, they adapt their approach to provide real relief and lasting results. This is not your typical touristy spot but a professional massage establishment where quality and care come first. I highly recommend making a booking in advance, as they are often in demand. If you’re in Hua Hin and looking for a massage that genuinely helps, this is the place to go!
0x30fdad84a3782ea9_0xb5512c5519cc234a.author: Hana Gamrot

0x30fdad84a3782ea9_0xb5512c5519cc234a.text: Dear Chillax Health Massage Team, I am incredibly grateful to have found your salon. The moment you arrive, you notice the difference compared to many other massage parlors – you're not approached on the street, but are allowed to settle in at your own pace. You truly address individual physical ailments, which I greatly appreciate. The salon is exceptionally clean, quiet, and exudes a special atmosphere of well-being. I have been suffering from mental health issues for some time, and the massages have been incredibly beneficial. Each visit has helped me to completely let go of worries and anxieties for a while. Your salon is a place where one feels safe, understood, and relaxed. I am very grateful for the many massages I received during my vacation in Hua Hin. I will especially never forget the lovely owner. If I am ever in the area again, I will definitely visit you again – I promise. Thank you so much for everything.
0x30fdad84a3782ea9_0xb5512c5519cc234a.author: KathinkaChristina

0x30fdad84a3782ea9_0xb5512c5519cc234a.text: I haven't had many massages in my life. That being said, this was THE BEST massage I've ever had. The staff was eager and happy to have us. They did things to my body that not only did I not know I wanted, they did things that I NEEDED! There were times that I felt like a human surf board and there were times that I felt like a pretzel. I thoroughly enjoyed all the times and plan on going back during my short stay. There are MANY places to get a massage in Hua Hin. This place was my needle in a haystack. I hugged the woman when she was done with me. They took our picture. I love them.
0x30fdad84a3782ea9_0xb5512c5519cc234a.author: Randy Moses

0x30fdad84a3782ea9_0xb5512c5519cc234a.text: Chillax Health Massage is a fantastic massage salon. I have been visiting Thailand for 27 years and find that you get the very best massages here. The masseuses are highly skilled and can read your body. If you have problems with your neck or shoulders, for example, they will resolve them here. They have nice massage tables with a head opening. They use fine towels and fine oil or balm. The owners speak good English. Are you looking for a massage salon that is clean, tidy, and where you get high-quality massages? Then go straight to Chillax Health Massage.
0x30fdad84a3782ea9_0xb5512c5519cc234a.author: Annet List

0x30fdad84a3782ea9_0xb5512c5519cc234a.text: I’ve been waiting to get a massage for a long time, so I decided to select this place when it reopened. Therapist and treatment room hygiene. Hands was sanitized before treatment which was my concern. Therapist wore a mask during a treatment. Bed sheet and pillow sheet was removed after treatment. Therapist was professional and talented. I would definitely recommend this place to my friends and travelers who want a spa-like experience at a low cost with excellent skill and service. Thank you so much for taking a good care of my husband and me.
0x30fdad84a3782ea9_0xb5512c5519cc234a.author: Yada Rojanastien

0x30fdad84a3782ea9_0xb5512c5519cc234a.text: The type of massage in this studio is distinctly different from the usual local massage parlors. One can always be lucky elsewhere and find a good masseuse who understands her craft, but that remains a lottery. Not so at Chillax Studio. The masseuses practice their profession with passion and competence. The Thai massage was truly outstanding and lives up to its name. I have never had a better massage elsewhere than here. I can recommend the studio without reservation, and the price is completely acceptable

0x30e29fcfe54058c1_0xe95515f1d6237c17.text: วันนี้ผ่าฟันคุดมาค่ะ ประทับใจทุกอย่างเลยพี่ๆหน้าเคาน์เตอร์น่ารักมากพูดจาน่ารักยิ้มแย้มบริการดีแนะนำดี เราจองคิวผ่านแอพHDmallได้ส่วนลดมา30บาท ราคาเต็มคือ3500บาทรวมทุกอย่าง สำหรับเราคือคุ้มมากนะดีกว่าไปโรงบาลเยอะเลยไม่ต้องไปนั่งรอคิวให้เสียเวลา คุณหมอก็น่ารักเป็นหมอผู้หญิง อยากจะบอกสำหรับใครที่กลัวเจ็บนะคือมันไม่เจ็บเลยอาจจะเจ็บนิดๆแค่ตอนฉีดยาชาเเค่ตึงๆชาๆ หลังจากนั้นก็ชิวมากคุณหมอถามตลอดว่าเจ็บมั้ยน่ารักมากพี่ผู้ช่วยก็คอยดูน้ำลายให้ตลอดคือตอนดึงฟันหลุดตอนไหนยังไม่รู้สึกเลยคุณหมอเก่งมาแปปเดียวเสร็จแล้วยังตกใจเลยเสร็จแล้วหรอเร็วมากกก10/10ไปเลยย
0x30e29fcfe54058c1_0xe95515f1d6237c17.en: I had my wisdom tooth extracted today. I was impressed with everything! The staff at the counter were so lovely, polite, and always smiling. They provided excellent service and advice. I booked my appointment through the HDmall app and got a 30 baht discount. The full price was 3500 baht, all-inclusive. For me, it was totally worth it – much better than going to the hospital and not having to wait in line. The doctor was also lovely; she was a woman. I want to tell anyone who's afraid of pain that it's not painful at all. Maybe a little stinging when they inject the local anesthetic, just a slight numbness. After that, it was very relaxing. The doctor kept asking if I was in pain, which was so sweet. The assistant also kept an eye on my saliva. I didn't even feel when the tooth came out! The doctor was so skilled; it was over in no time. I was surprised it was so quick! 10/10!

0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.text: I recently trained at Legacy Muscle Universe and bought a 10-session pass. Honestly, this is the best gym in Koh Samui and probably even one of the top 10 bodybuilding gyms in Thailand. In terms of equipment and overall bodybuilding setup, I honestly think it’s the best-equipped gym on the island. Like many other reviews mention, this is a very bodybuilding-oriented gym with a huge amount of machines, which is great if you train seriously. You can tell a lot of people here are passionate about fitness and bodybuilding. There are many experienced lifters and bodybuilders training here, and the atmosphere feels focused and motivating. There are also a lot of foreigners and tourists, but that’s normal for Koh Samui. Even during the mornings the gym can get quite busy, which shows how popular the place is. I came in low season and I never saw the gym empty. The staff are also excellent — very friendly, smiling, professional, and constantly re-racking weights and keeping the gym clean and organized. For me, that makes a huge difference in the overall experience. The price is a little expensive honestly, but considering this is Koh Samui, I still think the pricing remains fair for the quality of the gym and equipment. I’ve been living in Bangkok for years, and honestly, even in Bangkok it is extremely rare to find a gym with this level of equipment and overall quality for this kind of price. I can count them on one hand. That’s something they should absolutely keep because it’s one of the gym’s biggest strengths. Overall, a very serious gym with excellent bodybuilding machines, a good atmosphere, and probably one of the best training environments on the island.
0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.author: Mathieu Chaumont

0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.text: I have been a member of Legacy Gym since it opened 16 months ago and from Day 1 it’s been nothing but the best decision I could have made ! I love the place ! I’m made to feel like I’m the most special person in the gym every time I go ! The place itself is a world class five star facility with the best selection of equipment that is maintained hourly and daily. The entire facility is immaculately cleaned all day long every day by the best staff imaginable! In other words, you could eat off the floor ! But what separates Legacy Gym from all others is the staff! They are kind , hospitable, always helpful, always attentive to your needs and genuinely interested in you having the best environment to have a great workout! You will be greeted with by a smiling face at the entrance and thruout your time there ! I have even experienced a staff member greeting me at my car with an umbrella when it’s raining , and also have had my helmet taken off my bike when it begins to rain before leaving ! There is such a team effort I just have to say all this ! It’s family there for me and everyone else that goes there ! I’m joining for another year next week!
0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.author: Lynn

0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.text: I can confidently say that Legacy Gym is the best gym on the island. It’s huge — two full floors with a massive variety of equipment, and many machines are duplicated. Even during peak hours, you never have to wait because there’s plenty of space and enough equipment for everyone. The group classes are absolutely amazing. I personally train with Ben, and I love it. It’s honestly like a cult — you try it once and you can’t stop. A special thank you to the cleaning team — the gym is always spotless. All the equipment is clean, well-maintained, and feels new. The gym smells fresh, and with air conditioning and fans running, it’s always comfortable at any time of day. And a big thank you to the reception team — Terry and Wai-Wai. They are always so friendly. Every time I walk in, I’m greeted with a smile and asked how I’m doing. It really makes a difference. I always leave the gym smiling too, thanks to them. Huge appreciation to the owner for creating such an incredible place. Koh Samui truly needed a professional gym like this. Highly recommended!
0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.author: Kingdom Samui

0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.text: Hands down the best gym on Koh Samui. The space is huge, spotless, and fully air-conditioned — high ceilings, tons of room, and you never have to wait for a machine. The equipment is next-level: it’s kitted out with high-end Bench Fitness gear (the Australian brand), including plate-loaded machines and custom pieces you genuinely won’t find anywhere else in Thailand. Everything is new and maintained constantly. It’s so much more than a gym, too — there’s a proper podcast and photo studio, group classes (Power Pump, spin, BODYCOMBAT, yoga) led by great coaches, and a spa for recovery. Open 6 AM to 11 PM daily, which makes it easy to fit in around anything. But the thing that really sets Legacy apart is the staff. Genuinely warm, attentive, and welcoming — you’re treated like family every single time MAKE THE BEST PROTEIN SHAKE ON THE ISLAND 🏝️ The crowd is a healthy mix of beginners and serious lifters, so it’s motivating without ever feeling intimidating. If you’re on Samui and you actually want to train, this is the place. Highly recommend!
0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.author: Ben Urquhart

0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.text: I’ve trained in a few places in the past, and Legacy Muscle Universe is the best gym here on Koh Samui in my opinion. On day one, it was Payton who showed me around, and everything is new and very clean. The equipment is good quality. I have been coming for almost a year and visit 2 or 3 times every week. Everything is still good quality and the premier facilities are as good or better than ever, with the sauna and spa excellent additions. So I enjoy the good value. The classes are a fun way to work out. The reception staff are very friendly, and Payton is helpful as ever. As a local, or for tourists, I would definitely recommend Legacy Muscle Universe!
0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.author: Loupart jean-charles

0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.text: 5 star gym easily. 400 baht for a day pass which we agree to be reasonable. Lots of high end machines, lots of dumbbells plenty of weight in here. Upstairs is full of cardio machines & more machines. Multiple studios including a posing room upstairs as well. Very clean & maintained facility, did not check out the spa but looked quite nice from afar. Staff were friendly, this place did not have a snobby feel whatsoever but very welcoming. Spoke with a few of the members who were training at the time we went very friendly people. This gym is a must & well worth the price every time. Lots of vehicle & or scooter parking available.
0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.author: M

0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.text: The gym LEGACY is just incredible! Huge, beautifully designed with multiple training areas and top of the line equipment. But the real highlight is definitely the group classes. A super varied schedule with high quality coaches. Special mention to Linda, the best coach of all time, her Cardio Boxing class is number one and her Booty Circuit and Circuit Training sessions are amazing as well. The Yoga classes with Kru are also truly excellent and Elijah’s sessions with his relaxation practice are absolutely exceptional. Spin classes with Ben are also very good ! And all of this for a price that beats any other gym on Koh Samui !
0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.author: Camille De la Taille Gadret

0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.text: Fantastic gym. The selection of equipment is great — modern, well-maintained, and offers great variety for every type of workout. The overall vibe in the gym is motivating and positive, making every training session enjoyable. The classes are excellent as well, led by professional instructors who keep things fun and challenging. Without a doubt the best gym on the island. Highly recommended!
0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.author: Sabina

0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.text: I came to see Dr. Pui on October 22, 2025, after a friend who had been treated there and recovered, recommended her. I came to ask Dr. Pui for treatment of pain in my upper arm. It prevented me from lying face down and placing my hand on top of my arm, and reaching to the side or behind me caused sharp pain. I had to stop yoga for over a year. An MRI revealed a partial tendon tear. I had been receiving injections, medication, and shockwave therapy for over a year at several places, but the pain only subsided without a complete cure. After one acupuncture session with Dr. Pui, I felt my arm strength improve. Dr. Pui also prescribed physical exercises in the morning and before bed. After 3-5 acupuncture sessions, the pain disappeared completely and hasn't returned. I also discussed with Dr. Pui about a kidney cyst that I've had for almost 10 years. The cyst is 2-4 cm in size. In mid-2025, I had a severe infection with a high fever and had to be hospitalized for the first time in my life. Dr. Pui advised that if I continued to get infections due to the kidney cyst, it would be necessary to remove the kidney because the cyst is large, located in the center like the yolk of an egg, and there's no cure. I was very stressed and afraid of further infections and the need for removal. Dr. Pui suggested I try acupuncture and Chinese medicine, along with dietary control and stress reduction from work. The doctor confidently explained the treatment plan, giving the patient a great deal of hope and peace of mind. I received acupuncture treatments continuously from the end of October 2025 until now, April 2026, completing 20 sessions, including the initial sessions which caused shoulder and arm pain. I also took self-prepared Chinese herbal medicine for about 50 days, stopping in early March 2026 and remaining with acupuncture until mid-April 2026. The doctor then suggested a follow-up ultrasound to check the size of the cyst. The doctor who performed the previous ultrasound during my hospitalization was puzzled, asking where the cyst had gone, which side it was on, and why it was gone. They asked what I had done. I was so happy and accidentally mentioned that I had been receiving acupuncture (I didn't intend to tell them). Upon receiving the results, I immediately sent them to Dr. Pui, overjoyed and amazed by this Traditional Chinese Medicine treatment. I would like to express my deepest gratitude to Dr. Pui for providing a more comfortable alternative to waiting for infection and kidney removal. I wish Dr. Pui continued good health. I hope this shared information will be useful to others. May everyone find the best health options for themselves as well.
0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.author: hatairat Poonlarptawee

0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.text: Today I want to share my personal experience receiving treatment from this doctor. Two or three years ago, I was diagnosed with uterine cysts. I received treatment at private hospitals in Chiang Mai. The fibroids shrunk, but didn't disappear completely. When I had the opportunity to accompany my boyfriend to the clinic, I consulted with the doctor about the fibroids. The doctor gave excellent advice and is incredibly skilled. I used to experience monthly abdominal pain. After receiving treatment from the doctor using acupuncture and herbal medicine, the most impressive thing is that the abdominal pain disappeared completely – not even a little bit! And the uterine cysts shrunk entirely. After less than two months of treatment with the doctor, my latest checkup at the hospital informed me that the nearly 3cm cyst was completely gone. For anyone looking for a Chinese medicine doctor, I highly recommend this clinic. You won't be disappointed. From a patient's heart. (The doctor might be a little strict, haha, but it's worth it for the effective treatment!)
0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.author: ชนันท์ธิดา มาซิว

0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.text: I've had an allergic rash for a very long time, caused by COVID-19. I've tried many treatments, both modern and traditional Thai medicine, but the itchy rash wouldn't completely go away; it would reappear and become itchy again. So I searched for a Chinese medicine clinic on Google and found Songklod Traditional Chinese Medicine Clinic in Chiang Mai (luckily, the doctor had recently moved the clinic to Chiang Mai, making it very easy to visit). The doctor is very kind and attentive to patients. She examines the tongue, pulse, and analyzes the symptoms before starting the treatment. She also gives advice on exercise and overall health. The itchy rash significantly decreased within a month and a half, and no new rashes appeared. I'm very happy. If anyone has an allergic rash and is looking for a Chinese medicine treatment option, I highly recommend talking to Dr. Pui at Songklod Traditional Chinese Medicine Clinic in Chiang Mai.
0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.author: Theranath Luddapun

0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.text: My period was absent for 4 months, and before that it was irregular due to accumulated stress from moving and changing jobs. I was already interested in Traditional Chinese Medicine, so I searched for clinics on Google and found this one. It's not far from my house either. I came for the first time yesterday, January 20th, 2026. I was very lucky that the doctor was free for a short time, so I was able to have acupuncture. The doctor checked my pulse, examined my tongue, inserted acupuncture needles, and gave me herbal medicine to boil and take. I took the medicine for two doses. This afternoon (January 21st, 2026), my period came! I'm so happy! Thank you so much, Dr. Pui. Thank you truly. I will take care of my health, sleep well, eat well, and follow your advice. I'm so lucky to have found this clinic. It's a light and a great source of encouragement in my life. I hope you will stay in Chiang Mai for a long time. 💗
0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.author: Bow Suwannarat

0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.text: I had abdominal pain and was diagnosed with sand-like gallstones. I wanted to try Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) first, so I searched for a TCM practitioner in Chiang Mai and found Songklom Clinic through a Google search and reading reviews. I decided to consult them about my gallstones before considering surgery. The doctor prescribed acupuncture and herbal medicine. Initially, I experienced abdominal pain after eating, but after continuing to take the herbal medicine, I no longer have any pain and can live a normal life. I also no longer have jaundice (yellowing of the skin and eyes). It's been 5 months without any symptoms, so I've cancelled the gallstone surgery. Besides the doctor's treatment, we also need to manage our diet and lifestyle as advised. I haven't had surgery to remove the gallstones yet, and I have no symptoms; I'm living normally. I highly recommend this clinic; it's excellent!
0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.author: Kesorn KK

0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.text: I spotted this place from France and was able to visit during my time in Chiang Mai few weeks ago. I absolutely do NOT regret my choice. The doctor takes the time to explain everything, finds very accurate problems (i also am helped by others TCM practitioners here in France) that concurs with what we already knew and goes even deeper in my opinion. i had very painful legs for months prior to visit and in 2 sessions, the pain was gone. it was my main reason to visit this clinic but the doctor found my other problems and recommended me some tips to feel better. i also dragged my friend there for constipation problems and shoulder pain and her problems were also gone after the 2 sessions we did together. i HIGHLY recommend this place and, i almost want to come back to Chiang Mai JUST to be able to be treated here. Thanks a lot for everything!
0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.author: Faranah N.

0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.text: As a patient myself I have to admit that the medicine given was really effective. I used to be someone that did not believe in traditional medicine. However, my experience in Moonbow completely transformed my belief. Growing up I had really bad tic symptoms. I went to many hospitals and they gave me medicines. However as long as I don’t take the pills anymore my symptoms came back immediately if not worse than before. My family and I decided to try traditional medicines instead so we visited this clinic. I took herbal medicines and did acupuncture for around 2 months now my symptoms became around 50% better. During the treatments not just my tics got better but also my acne. If you are having illness right now I truly recommend you to come to Moonbow and give traditional medicine a try.
0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.author: Ethan Yi

0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.text: I've suffered from gastritis for many years and was so discouraged that I started looking into alternative medicine. I initially searched for many clinics until I found this one. It's as good as everyone says! The doctor is kind but strict. If I could give 10 stars, I would! They use a holistic approach to treatment, which takes time and patience. But when your symptoms improve, it's a holistic improvement, not just a localized problem. Recently, I was diagnosed with gallstones, but I didn't want surgery, so I consulted with a doctor and decided to seek treatment here first. If it didn't improve, I would consider surgery. But after just over two months, the gallstones are gone!!! I'm so happy that I was able to preserve my gallbladder.
0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.author: Arunee_Oom

0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.text: I had an incredible experience at DOPA, truly one of the best wellness spaces I’ve ever visited. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere feels calm, welcoming, and beautifully designed, with a very serene, almost retreat-like vibe that instantly helps you switch off. The food was outstanding, fresh, wholesome, and thoughtfully curated. We especially loved the immunity booster and the other wellness shots, which were both delicious and felt genuinely energising. It’s easy to see why so many people talk about their clean, nourishing menu and great coffee options too. The wellness facilities were just as impressive. The sauna and steam rooms were perfectly maintained and incredibly relaxing, and the entire space felt very clean and well organised something a lot of visitors appreciate. We also tried the massages and they were fantastic, easily among the most relaxing treatments we’ve had. The therapists were skilled and the experience felt very personalised and unhurried. What really stands out and something I’ve heard others mention as well is the overall energy of the place. It feels like a community space where you can slow down, recharge, and spend a few peaceful hours. The staff were warm and attentive, and everything from the facilities to the service felt premium yet comfortable. We genuinely had the best time here and I would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting Phuket who wants a mix of great food, wellness, and a truly relaxing experience.

0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.text: DOPA Sauna & Wellness Club Located conveniently on the outskirts of Bangtao, DOPA Sauna & Wellness Club is a hidden gem that offers an impressive array of wellness facilities, including a Banya, sauna, steam room, pool, jacuzzi, three different cold plunge options, massage rooms, a small workout area, and a menu of healthy, clean food. My overall experience was phenomenal. From the moment I arrived, the staff greeted me with warm smiles, creating an inviting atmosphere. The color scheme is visually pleasing, and the natural vibe truly makes you feel at ease. It’s a sanctuary where you can leave all your worries behind and immerse yourself in a vacation-like experience. What stood out to me was the friendly demeanor of both the staff and fellow visitors, contributing to a welcoming community feel. I also appreciated the owner, Boris, who is actively involved in maintaining the facility. His attention to detail is evident; he consistently ensures that the space is clean and presentable. As a leader, he sets a strong example for his staff with a “lead by example” approach. I highly recommend DOPA Sauna & Wellness Club for anyone seeking a relaxing retreat that prioritizes wellness and community.
0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.author: Mark G

0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.text: We got a recommendation to visit this place, and the moment we arrived we understood why, it’s truly one of the best wellness centers in the world. We’ve been to many wellness places before, but this one is on a whole different level. The attention to detail is insane: from the design, to the atmosphere, to the quality of the saunas and facilities. Everything feels natural, clean, and organic. Even the restaurant here, honestly, it’s the best food we’ve had in Phuket. Dopa has saunas, a steam room, hot and cold onsen pools, fire place, and beautiful spaces that feel like a sanctuary for your body and mind. The experience here is incredible, and even the people who come here are all so beautiful. This is the place I recommend the most in Phuket for anyone who loves wellness and health. Whether you’re coming for the amazing food or for a top-level sauna and spa experience, this is the spot. We even learned that the water they use inside the sauna is completely purified. Highly, highly recommended.

I was not rushed when explaining my concerns, and was given a thorough explanation of the recommended treatments. There was no push to buy services at all-more of information so i can make a decision. The clinic was very well kept, clean, and trustworthy. The Doctor who did the procedure explained everything-the procedure, what to expect during procedure and the expected results even way before I have committed to the procedure. I felt like I was the only patient as she spent time making sure I know and understand the process. Big thank you doc! Aftercare was TOP NOTCH. Had to travel the next day to another city, but the clinic was in constant follow-up using whatsapp. 5 day, 7 day, 10 day and even 1 month follow-up ensuring everything was healing perfectly and as intended. This were proactive messages asking how the healing is progressing and if I had any other concerns. I had nose and cheek thread lift done and botox injections done - excellent results! No adverse effects whatsoever ever just normal healing soreness, very minor not noticeable yellow bruising. Whats great is I had an open line communication anytime with the clinic about concerns i had and they’ve proactively contacted me to make sure healing is as expected and if I had any other concerns even if I was already in another city and eventually another country. I highly recommend Mi-A if you are ever in Chiang Mai and thinking about skin treatments. If undecided, book a consult and talk to the team. 0x30da3b2eb63ce545_0xf0420e6568c90fe2.text: I've been living in Chiang Mai on and off for a few months here and there and have always had skin issues which really escalated during the hotter period here in April along with my stress with work. The other clinic assistants were all very nice, gentle and patient. Never once was there any hardsell of their services or pressure to do anything I wasn't comfortable with. 0x30e29dea8f081e05_0x232fb52adf83c048.text: Today I tried teeth whitening at Wink Clinic. Actually, I've never had a dental checkup before because I've never had any pain, just slight sensitivity. Before the checkup, the clinic advised that I should get a tartar removal first. During the checkup, they found one cavity and three holes. I was worried, so I had the dentist take care of it right away (the dentist also gave me a general dental checkup). Then I proceeded with the teeth whitening program. The price wasn't expensive at all, only 3499 baht, and the results were great. My teeth are really whiter (several shades lighter, from very yellow to pure white). The dentist explained how long the results would last, no secrets withheld. The dentist said that if I wanted them to be even whiter, I could come back in two months, but that might not be convenient for me as I live in another province. But if I have the chance, I'll definitely come back again.
