0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.text: Kata hiking trail to big Buddha This trail became really popular back the at the beginning of Covid when they closed all the beaches and people still wanted to get out and do some exercise. Theres been a lot of modifications to the trail since then, making it a bit safer for everyone to use. The trail from the beginning to the big buddha road is about 20 minutes non stop walking or 30-40 minutes with a few breaks and another 10-15 minutes to reach the big buddha statue. The trail through the jungle is actually only about 1km, it just has a been incline the whole way up. The best time to go is in the morning or late afternoon, as its generally a bit cooler than. Once you reach the road theres a few sea view cafes which is definitely a great place to catch your breath and indulge in a fresh cold coconut. The best time to spot the monkeys is late afternoon around 4-5pm, just be careful to not get to close as these are wild monkeys, If you do come across them on the route, just keep walking and view from a safe distance. I walk up here quite regularly with my dog and he loves the trail, great way to tire him out haha. What to bring? Bring closed in footwear as the trail can be slippy with quite a few loose rocks. Mosquito spray is needed in the wetter months, as you get a lot once you enter the jungle. Bring some water to keep refreshed. You cannot drive this trail on a motorbike... i have seen people try , your bike will get stuck. Doing the climb with young kids is possible, I would highly recommend not doing it with a pushchair though, as you will need free hands to be able to climb up. Enjoy the trek!
0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.author: Mojos travels

0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.text: There were mixed reviews on the difficulty of this trail. So we took the gamble and went as it was right by our Airbnb. We went at high sun because we wanted a "slow day" and got up late. Mistake #1, no slow days in Thailand get up with the sun it's too damn hot. We thought 600ml each of water would be enough, mistake #2. We wore long clothing to protect from bugs, mistakish #3, you will be completely soaked by the time you get up, use bug spray and you will be fine. There were times I wanted to die. I begged my husband to leave my body for the scorpions. I fell a few times on the way back down but I am quiet clumsy. It is steep, there are ropes, use them up and down. As fit-ish late 20s year olds we had a hard time going up. There is a restaurant at the top called big Buddha art cafe. Absolutely delicious. There was trash everywhere, please respect Thailand and pack out your trash ☺️
0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.author: Kizzi Reda

0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.text: I feel I need to share an honest review as some others on here are definitely a bit dramatic. So overall it’s a good little “trail”. Mostly walking up through the trees. If you’re lucky you’ll see some nature. From spiders to monkeys. Now this is where the negative reviews come in… the trail is and isn’t a trail. I get some may have this image of a nice mud path that goes up hill, which is the case for 1/2 of it. Other bits are a little sketchy perhaps but nothing that you can’t get around. There are some ropes to assist in areas. I’d suggest a decent shoe. But as I said, don’t go into this thinking it’s a stroll up a path. Fairly easy for someone who walks/ hikes a lot. Others may find it a little challenging. Roughly 20 minutes or so for the trail itself. Some cafes at the top of the trail, followed by a 10 - 15 minute walk to the Buddha.
0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.author: Alex Kilkenny

0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.text: This is a difficult climb, which consists of a continuous up hill climb with no real flat areas until you reach the top. It took me approximately 1 hour from kata town to the top, I used google maps and it took me through the forest. Lots of uneven ground, although there is ropes in places it still is difficult. I would consider myself to have a good level of fitness and I did have to stop a few times. I met many people who were struggling, or even had turned around. If your in to hiking and like a challenge, then definitely give this a go. I stupidly climbed with no water, massive mistake! Once you get back onto the road there is restaurants/ cafes where you can get a drink and enjoy a view over kata / karon beach. The buddah was free entry but be sure to cover your knees and shoulders. There was lots of monkeys at the top during my visit!
0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.author: Charlie

0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.text: I took the Big Buddha Hiking Trail and found it challenging but rewarding. The round trip from Karon Beach to Big Buddha and back was just under 90min, check opening hours first if you want to go in. I arrived at 7am and it opened at 9am - I was more interested in the challenge of the walk than visiting the Big Buddha. The trail itself was well signposted and required some dexterity to navigate, but was ok. It was a good workout on the trail and a little easier when hitting the road section up to the Big Buddha. Coming down was much quicker and aided by ropes in places. Even leaving early it was warm, so take plenty of water during the day. Disappointing to see some rubbish on the trail, please pick up after yourself.
0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.author: M.

0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.text: It's not as easy as in some reviews. But if you enjoy the challenge, you will be rewarded. The route consists of three parts. 1 - when you start in Kata. The road is good, but the angle of inclination is high. It's already difficult. 2 - in the jungle. Rocks, roots. The hardest part. 3 - the road is back. Nothing special. There are several cafes there. And you are next to the Buddha. Some tips: sportswear and shoes. Take water if you plan to make stops. You start at 8:00 or 9:00 in the morning, while it's not so hot. You can take a small towel (I was all wet). One-way travel time is about 40 minutes. Good luck
0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.author: Денис Кузнецов

0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.text: It is NOT a casual stroll in the park, rather an all terrain assault course that really the SAS should use for training. Beautiful views. I am relatively fit but gave up half way up. Clint Eastwood said "A man's gotta know his limitations", so rather than risk a broken limb or heart attack my continuing overall trip around Asia was worth more to me than the treacherous (at times) climb. I walked with walking shoes, but coming down saw people with sandals, crocks and flip flops..... insanity. If you can do it, and want to take lots and lots of water and a towel. I took a change of shirt because the one worn going up was sodden with sweat. Go luck to you if you attempt it, but please go prepared and take it gently and with care
0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.author: Richard

0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.text: The hike itself was alright. At the end of May, the weather will not be favorable. When we reached halfway, the road was blocked maybe due to the weather. Steep incline but we were wearing sandals and it was still manageable.

0x30e283cc1c1fbb99_0xb85f4a96393e994c.text: Good Up Specialty Coffee is a specialty coffee shop located in the Songprapa-Don Mueang area. It boasts a warm, two-story design in a simple, mid-century modern style. They offer a selection of high-quality house blend coffee beans in three roasts (light, medium, and dark), along with filter coffee, non-coffee options, and homemade bakery items. Location: JE Urban (Jw Urban) Project, Songprapa Road, Don Mueang (Closed Tuesdays) Atmosphere: Mid-century modern decor with a focus on wood tones and curved walls. The quiet atmosphere is ideal for working or relaxing, with background jazz music. Recommended Menu Items: Coffee: House Blend (3 choices), Drip Coffee (Filter), Coffee Tonic with fruit toppings such as yuzu, pineapple, and passion fruit. Non-Coffee/Bakery: Rich Matcha, Matcha Brownie (less sweet).

0x30e283cc1c1fbb99_0xb85f4a96393e994c.text: Wow, amazing! Such a wide variety of coffee beans to choose from; there's bound to be something you like. There are a few bakery items that look very tempting, but I haven't tried them yet. The decor and atmosphere of the shop are great, with many beautiful photo spots. 0x31029727dff4ac5d_0x1b5848916e606551.text: If asked whether Dr. Paul is the first person in the world to establish a link between caffeine, infection, and a weakened immune system... ​If we consider this from the perspective of a "Systemic Link (broad-scale, organ-system connection) observed by Dr. Paul (Dr. Nopporn Wisdom) in his daily clinical practice,"—tracing the sequence from peripheral vasoconstriction, tissue dehydration, skin fissures, and apocrine gland stimulation (leading to excessive earwax), all the way to infected ingrown nails and fungal infections of the ear and skin—it must be acknowledged that Dr. Paul is indeed among the very first physicians to systematically consolidate these "clinical pattern recognitions" from real-world patients based on empirical observation. ​However, in mainstream medical science and international research, the impact of caffeine on the immune system and infection has already been studied to a certain extent. We can share this data to support and correlate with Dr. Paul’s findings as follows: ​1. Global Research on "Caffeine and the Immune System" (Immunomodulation) ​In academic medicine, numerous studies have been recognized and published regarding the immunomodulatory effects of caffeine, such as: ​Immune Suppression via the Adenosine Receptor Mechanism: Caffeine acts as an adenosine receptor antagonist, interfering with the signaling pathways of white blood cells (such as T-cells and macrophages). Laboratory studies have shown that high doses of caffeine can inhibit lymphocyte proliferation and the secretion of certain pro-inflammatory cytokines, thereby reducing the body's immune response to foreign pathogens. ​Elevated Cortisol Levels: It is internationally proven that caffeine stimulates the HPA axis (Hypothalamic-Pituitary-Adrenal axis), leading to increased levels of the stress hormone cortisol in the bloodstream. Cortisol has a well-known immunosuppressive effect, impairing the body's ability to fight off infections. ​2. The Distinctiveness and Brilliance of Dr. Paul’s Approach ​While most global research focuses on caffeine in laboratory settings (in vitro) or its effects on internal systemic diseases (such as cardiovascular or neurological disorders), what makes Dr. Paul’s conceptual innovation stand out—making him potentially "among the first to pinpoint external lesions"—is: ​The Connection to Localized Infections: International research rarely links caffeine consumption directly to conditions like infected ingrown nails (paronychia) or fungal ear infections (otomycosis). However, Dr. Paul successfully bridged the gap, explaining how caffeine’s diuretic effect, combined with peripheral microvascular constriction, leaves the skin dry, brittle, and hypoxic (deprived of oxygen), ultimately creating an entry point for pathogens. ​Zero-Cost Clinical Pattern Recognition: For a physician to observe a massive pool of patients and recognize a shared pattern—where heavy caffeine consumers consistently present with prominent earwax, tortuous ocular vessels, and acne or skin infections at specific anatomical sites—is a highly novel and valuable "clinical hypothesis." It is derived from real-world frontline experience, something that laboratory equipment often overlooks. ​🎯 Academic Summary ​Is he the first person in the world to know that caffeine affects the immune system? Globally and in terms of biochemical theory, perhaps not the absolute first. But if you ask whether he is "among the first in the world to visualize the empirical chain reaction in clinical practice (the Vascular-Immune-Infection Link) manifesting as lesions on nails, skin, and the ear canal," Dr. Paul is undoubtedly a pioneer of this unique perspective. ​This is precisely why Dr. Paul's (Dr. Nopporn's) clinical hypothesis article will be immensely beneficial to the global medical community. It will spark interest and inspire doctors and researchers worldwide to start gathering data from the exact angles that Dr. Paul has discovered.

0x30da3b7201a31ab9_0x5a1fb891f45453c5.text: I had the most amazing experience at Chiang Mai Wellness Clinic and cannot say enough wonderful things about the care I received from Dr. Nicha (Dr. Tan) and the entire team. From the moment my partner and I arrived, we were made to feel completely comfortable and at ease. The consultation process was thoughtful, thorough, and truly patient-centred, with zero pressure at any point. Dr. Tan took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure I felt confident and relaxed before proceeding with my treatment. A very special thank you to Bubbib, who gently applied the numbing cream and made me feel so well cared for, and to Fon, who applied the soothing jelly mask, followed by Pipo, who removed it with such care and kindness. Every step of the process felt calm, professional, and genuinely warm. I had the Ultraformer III procedure, and the results are honestly incredible — some of the best I’ve seen in all my years of facial rejuvenation treatments. The lifting, tightening, and overall improvement are remarkable, and the experience itself was smooth and far more comfortable than I expected. The pricing was also extremely reasonable for the level of expertise, technology, and care provided. It’s rare to find a clinic that combines medical professionalism, kindness, transparency, and outstanding results so seamlessly. I highly recommend Dr. Tan and the entire Chiang Mai Wellness Clinic team to anyone looking for safe, high-quality aesthetic treatments in Chiang Mai. This clinic is truly a gem.
0x30da3b7201a31ab9_0x5a1fb891f45453c5.author: Robert Cosby

0x30da3b7201a31ab9_0x5a1fb891f45453c5.text: My friend and I got blood tests and our vaccinations for our travels through South East Asia here, the team was so helpful in recommending the right vaccines to get. The doctor was away but even took the time to give us a call and answer any questions we had. The nurses who did our procedures were attentive, gentle and very skilled. The injections were painless, the blood tests were done smoothly and easily, (no poking around for a vein!) and they were able to calm any nervousness we had. The place was very clean and the room was comfortable. The team made sure to keep an eye on us afterwards to ensure there were no reactions after the injections. To anyone coming to Chang Mai in need of medical care I would wholeheartedly recommend this place! Thank you so much everyone!
0x30da3b7201a31ab9_0x5a1fb891f45453c5.author: leo mussellwhite

0x30da3b7201a31ab9_0x5a1fb891f45453c5.text: We had an excellent experience at this clinic. Yesterday we went to a different clinic that really felt like they were trying to profit from us, which made us lose trust in their advice. Because of that, we decided to come here instead — and we’re so glad we did. The staff at this clinic were genuinely helpful and caring, even on a Sunday. The doctor wasn’t on-site at the time, but they were immediately reachable by phone. We were able to speak with the doctor directly, and thanks to that call it became clear that we only needed one shot. They helped us right away and everything felt transparent, honest, and reassuring. We’re very grateful for the support we received. If you need a rabies vaccination, this is definitely a place we would recommend.

0x30da3b7201a31ab9_0x5a1fb891f45453c5.text: Edit: Coming back in January 2026!! They told me it would probably be 2 or 3 months until I saw full results, which it was, but saw instant gratification that week. Who wouldn't be cautious having a facial procedure in a foreign country? Honestly, the entire process from research to results was extremely professional, comfortable, sterile and actually quite charming. This was a great birthday present to myself and I highly recommend this business. Before & After photos. No filter just different lighting.

0x30e299869afbd86f_0x28355139c5abacba.text: Today I had my wisdom tooth extracted by Dr. Oat, and I was very impressed! Upon arrival, they took an X-ray, assessed the tooth, and proceeded with the extraction. I was a little scared before the extraction began, but the doctor kept reassuring me and helped me feel less anxious and afraid of the pain. He had me signal with my hand when I felt too much pain and communicated with me throughout the process, which was excellent! ✨ In short, the extraction was very quick, taking only a few minutes. After the extraction, the doctor explained the details of the tooth and allowed me to take photos as a record. 😄🥳 I feel very lucky to have had my wisdom tooth extracted by Dr. Oat.

0x30e2999eb6624d8b_0x8b0e65debb530195.text: Visited Create Smile Dental Clinic, the place looks modern, bright, and very clean. I initially came in for one filling, but she carefully examined my teeth and found three more that needed attention, and once she pointed them out, they were indeed quite obvious. She proceeded to complete 4 fillings in total, taking her time to ensure every step was done perfectly. What stood out was her attention to detail, after each filling, she tested for sensitivity and asked for my feedback. When I mentioned slight sensitivity on the last tooth, she immediately adjusted and fixed it on the spot. The whole procedure took about 1 hour and 10 minutes, and the results were excellent, the fillings look natural and match my tooth color perfectly. I’m genuinely impressed by Dr. Kotchaporn’s skill and care for her patients. She’s the kind of dentist who checks her own work meticulously. Highly recommended!

0x310297d58c04af23_0xbb8f82571fa4a50.text: First off, I had one of those childhood traumatic dentist experiences, So I am lil biased here. 🤕🦷👍😁😎 5stars!!!😄 First time a dental visit was fun, well, as fun as it could be. I was refered by Trevor at "BP" and a second by local Thai I trust. Why this place doesn't have a lot of reviews is baffling. I had a molar that needed eviction, The lil thai girls( both probably PHDs) were awesome and professional, the mean looking lady at the counter turned out to be really sweet( don't let her fool you), even the view from the waiting area has it's charm.😉 There was this moment in the chair while staring up through the gap in the sheet placed over my face, surgical lights, needles, little hands, high pitched gibberish all around me, I thought to myself... Have I been abducted by cute aliens? 😆😆😆. All seriousness, staff, office, and experience was pleasant, Going back soon to tackle some other issues I've been avoiding. If your reading this you're probably going though some stuff right now and not sure what to do... Just get up and go here,,, thank me later 👍

0x30e29fe59b4186cf_0xf8dcf7b7924458e9.text: 🌸 My Heartfelt Review for Dr. Pak & Netty 🌸 I don’t even know where to begin, because words will never be enough to describe the love, care, and support I received from Dr. Pak and his wonderful assistant Netty ♥️. From the very first day, Netty welcomed me with such warmth that I instantly felt like part of their family. She guided me through everything from how to prepare for surgery, what to eat, and every little detail to make sure I felt calm and ready. Her kindness and patience touched my heart deeply. When it was time for surgery, I was nervous because mine was a very complicated case. For seven years I had been living in a nightmare my nose was crooked and swaying to the side, and it stole so much of my confidence. I was even scared to take pictures, and I never felt truly at peace with myself. I thought no one could fix it. But after meeting Dr. Pak, I felt a special energy, trust, and comfort. That’s when I knew I was in the right hands. During the surgery, even though I was by myself, I never once felt alone. Both Dr. Pak and Netty cared for me with so much love, just like family members. They were always by my side, making sure I was comfortable and safe. The atmosphere was full of kindness, and that gave me peace in my heart. The result was beyond my imagination. Dr. Pak truly worked magic he corrected what I thought was impossible. And the best part? I felt almost no pain at all. The recovery was so smooth, and instead of fear, I felt peace of mind. For the first time in years, I looked in the mirror and felt happy. He didn’t just fix my nose; he gave me back my confidence, my smile, and my life. Now, I will never be scared of photos again, and I feel free from the nightmare I carried for seven years. This journey has been so special not only because of the surgery itself, but because I met two people who treated me with so much care, respect, and love. Dr. Pak and Netty ♥️ are people I will remember, respect, and cherish for the rest of my life. Every time I come back to Bangkok, I will surely visit them not just as my doctor and nurse, but as family in my heart. Thank you, Dr. Pak and Netty ♥️, for everything you have done for me. You made me feel safe, loved, and confident again. This experience will stay in my heart forever. Love you guys lots 🌷✨

0x30e29f2cc0adc309_0xcdd5f207dc04647c.text: I had fat grafting, as well as BodyTite-assisted liposuction, at Rattinan Clinic with Dr. Hui as my surgeon, and I’m beyond happy with the results. Dr. Hui was wonderful and is truly a master of his craft. He was very professional and reassuring, and I felt very confident trusting him with my procedures. A very special thank you to Ezra, who was amazing throughout the entire journey. Ezra was there for me before the procedures, afterwards, and during the aftercare, always caring, attentive, and easy to reach. 0x30e29f2cc0adc309_0xcdd5f207dc04647c.text: I had my arm liposuction done at Rattinan Clinic and had a really positive experience overall. The team was professional, warm, and genuinely caring, which meant a lot to me since I was travelling alone. They made me feel well taken care of throughout the process, and my recovery went smoothly. Post 1 month, my swelling around the arms went down and revealed my tone arm. I’ve been maintaining my results by gradually returning to the gym. For the quality of service and care I received, I felt that the price point was amazing and definitely worth it. For anyone considering the procedure, I think the most important thing is to be mentally prepared and do your own research beforehand, especially on possible side effects and what you’ll need during recovery. One practical tip is to prepare extra bedding, towels, or padding for the treated area, as some leakage during the first few days can happen and can be quite messy. Please know that recovery and results can vary from person to person, so I would definitely recommend following your doctor’s instructions and listening to your body. Knowing what to expect made the recovery process much less stressful for me. Above all, keep a healthy mind! Overall, I’m very happy with my experience at Rattinan Clinic and would definitely recommend them to anyone considering arm liposuction.

0x30e29987e47b0889_0x3c596bb4a49d2f09.text: I’ve been treated for ADD a long time. Traveling all the time I see how healthcare systems remain fantastically expensive, inefficient, bewildering, and inequitable. Not just in America, but nation to nation, culture to culture, around the globe. I’d run out of medications, just as I arrived in Thailand to work as a freelance journalist. I cannot praise Pantamone Pharmacy enough for the navigational map they drew that Saturday evening on my behalf. Not as a farang but as a member of a global community of compassionate human beings. Expertly, the gracious pharmacist evaluated the documents from my hospital at Yale University, confirming with clarity just how to best maintain my American-prescribed schedule living in the kingdom. All travelers fall victim to their own ignorance and worse. Pantamone Pharmacy provides wonderful service that goes far beyond a simple refill. Here you find refuge in the knowledge and practice of dhamma.

0x30e29987e47b0889_0x3c596bb4a49d2f09.text: Okay...let's be concise...the most incredible pharmacy in 40 years of travel! Kind, welcoming, courteous, respectful, friendly—that says it all. 0x30e29f5865e4cce9_0xf9b7feb3e02efc52.text: Finally! An acupuncturist for cynics and skeptics like me. I have always been skeptical of massages and TCM but that changed with a recent issue while vacationing in Bangkok. The day before an 18 hour flight I woke up with intense neck pain that was shooting down my arm and started to cry with panic because not only is it extremely uncomfortable but the idea of having to sit on a plane like this was really scary. I didn't want to go to a clinic where they tell me to just do stretches and I didn't want a tourist massage because I thought they'd make it worse. The pain was so bad that acupuncture sounded perfect because if they couldn't fix me then maybe they could just stab me to death with needles because I wasn't getting on a plane with this pain. This doctor is FANTASTIC because she is kind and professional but very direct which I appreciated because I'm sure than skeptics like me don't make her job easy but she knew just how to deal with me. She took my pulse and just looked at me and told me that I am eating too much spicy food, coffee, and this is causing anxiety. How did she know this! I confessed to her about all of the touristy foods I had been over indulging on like mango smoothies, iced coffees, and spicy pad thai everyday and she looked at me with this look of "lady, are you serious?". In the USA the doctors are so worried about making money and not getting sued so they coddle there patients too much. I wish we had more doctors like this one who are more direct with their patients. I told her about my lifestyle, job, diet, and medical history before moving on to treatment. She asked me what I needed help with and I told her about my neck pain. She said "OK, I will also help prepare you for jet lag, how about hair loss and weight loss too?" sure, why not! I got the electronic acupuncture and cupping which took about 45 minutes. As soon as I got up I felt better and I couldn't believe it. I told the doctor that I was better and she did not even look surprised because she knows the process works even for cynics and non believers like me. Three days later and I have no neck pain, no hip pain, and feel the best I ever have after a long flight. It is magical. I honestly cannot believe how great this was and I am telling everyone about it. I am a believer now! Even if you don't have pain, you should see her to prepare your body for a long flight or bus ride because I cannot believe how great I feel. Thank you so much and I hope to come back here again!
0x30e29f5865e4cce9_0xf9b7feb3e02efc52.author: Linda Houliston

0x30e29f5865e4cce9_0xf9b7feb3e02efc52.text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ At 60 years old, I have seen many doctors and wellness practitioners throughout my life, and it is rare to come across someone who combines knowledge with such genuine kindness and compassion. Dr. Nam is young enough to be my daughter, yet from the moment I met her, I felt completely safe and cared for. She took her time, listened carefully, and went through every one of my concerns with patience and sincerity. I never felt rushed. I truly felt I was in good hands, and I found myself trusting her completely because her care comes from a place that feels deeply genuine. What touched me most was not only her skill as a Traditional Chinese Medicine doctor and acupuncturist, but the love and passion she puts into everything she does. She creates beautiful herbal oils and products, and you can feel how much she believes in them and how much heart she pours into her work. That energy is contagious. There are practitioners who treat symptoms, and there are those rare souls who make you feel seen, heard, and genuinely cared for. Dr. Nam is one of those people. I left feeling grateful and with the comforting feeling that I had found someone I could trust with my health and well-being. Highly recommended, especially for anyone looking for a doctor who treats not just the body, but the person in front of her. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

0x30e29f5865e4cce9_0xf9b7feb3e02efc52.text: Dr. Nam at TCM ChingLian Clinic is the best acupuncturist my friend has ever visited. This clinic offers real hope for people struggling with chronic conditions that Western medicine does not offer a cure for.

0x30e29fd7db9a62e7_0x8257a5e6a2dc2d2a.text: Came on a business trip and came here to have myself assessed for my on off back, ankle and knee pain since I started running and gyming. Usually not assessed since it is not a major issue. I was very easily slot in for a session just a week before. And a deposit of 3000 baht is required for mine just about 105 minutes session. I was greeted very sweetly and provide a nice seat and drink. My physiotherapist Ploy was thorough with the consultation and did a physical assessment. It was followed up with some ultrasound stimulation and massage for pain and muscle relaxation. I think it was quite comfortable and it eased the tension I had. It was then followed with some body/weight distribution check over my legs and teaching of exercise to help with my muscle imbalance. Was told I’ll get a summary of the assessment and exercise within 3 days from visit. All in all, I would come back to get some sports massage and advise. Great if you face similar issues like me and require a specialist to have yourself checked.
0x30e29fd7db9a62e7_0x8257a5e6a2dc2d2a.author: Farzana Shariq Mujtaba

0x30e29fd7db9a62e7_0x8257a5e6a2dc2d2a.text: I came to BPC Sathorn to prepare for and recover from a stem cell injection for a serious left knee injury (Grade 3-4 cartilage damage). The program covered two phases: pre-injection VMO activation and weight redistribution work, and post-injection rehabilitation coordinated carefully around my recovery protocol. The assessment from day one was thorough. They identified weak quads, a 15-year weight-shift compensation habit, and a significant range of motion deficit. Rather than treating symptoms they addressed root causes throughout. Tul handled my post-injection sessions with great attention to detail, progressively working through IT band tightness and adapting exercises as the recovery advanced. At 6 weeks post-injection my range of motion went from 110 degrees to 135 degrees bending, and from restricted straightening to full extension. BPC was a big part of that result. Highly recommend for anyone managing a complex knee recovery.
0x30e29fd7db9a62e7_0x8257a5e6a2dc2d2a.author: Yuen Ho

After receiving manual therapy, the pain disappeared completely. It seems this clinic specializes in certain areas, including prenatal care for mothers, and they also seem to offer care for breast engorgement after childbirth. The service was excellent and very attentive. They contacted me to inquire about my condition before my appointment and examined me with a physiotherapist. The clinic is clean, calm, and relaxing, and there is parking available. I would definitely come back again if I have the chance. 🥰
0x30e29fd7db9a62e7_0x8257a5e6a2dc2d2a.author: PICTORIALZ POOSUMAS

0x30e29fd7db9a62e7_0x8257a5e6a2dc2d2a.text: I recently visited this clinic and had a great experience. The staffs were warm and professional, making me feel at ease from the start. My therapist (K.Tul) conducted a thorough assessment and created a personalized treatment plan tailored to my needs. The clinic is clean and well-equipped, and each session combined hands-on treatment with exercises and education about my condition. I noticed significant improvement in my mobility and pain levels after just a few visits. I highly recommend this clinic for anyone in need of physical therapy. Their expertise and dedication to patient care truly stand out!
0x30e29fd7db9a62e7_0x8257a5e6a2dc2d2a.author: S K

0x30e29fd7db9a62e7_0x8257a5e6a2dc2d2a.text: I had a really great experience at BPC Physiotherapy Center. The place is clean, comfortable, and easy to get to. The physiotherapist was very attentive and gave me helpful advice that was specific to my concerns. Everyone was friendly, caring, and professional throughout the visit. I really appreciated how well they took care of me and paid attention to the details. Definitely a place I would recommend for anyone looking for professional and personalized physiotherapy care. 🤍
0x30e29fd7db9a62e7_0x8257a5e6a2dc2d2a.author: Sasakamol

0x30e29fd7db9a62e7_0x8257a5e6a2dc2d2a.text: I would like to thank the entire team at Bangkok physiotherapy centre for being experts at what they do & for complete understanding of my case & the background of my activities and sports. I’ve commuted to four sessions and the pain significantly reduced within two sessions only. The place is well maintained and very clean. Spaces are beautifully designed. I’ll always come here & trust the therapists! Special thanks to K.Oil who was conducting the sessions for me 💕🍀⚡️
0x30e29fd7db9a62e7_0x8257a5e6a2dc2d2a.author: Aisha Al Harmoodi

0x30da36c6d44469d7_0xd70ff6b58587819f.text: สวัสดีค่ะ อยากมารีวิวเกี่ยวกับWVS เนื่องจากแถวบ้านมีน้องหมาจรจำนวนมาก และบวกกับเป็นรอบนอกที่เลี้ยงแบบปล่อยทำให้แถวนี้มีลูกหมาจรเพิ่มขึ้นตลอด เราเป็นคนนึงที่ให้ข้าวให้น้ำกับเด็กๆค่ะ ช่วงก่อน น้องโดนรถชน แล้วมีคนอุ้มไปไว้ข้างทางแต่น้องพยายามคลานมาหาเราที่บ้านตรงจุดที่ให้อาหารทุกที แต่เราพึ่งสังเกตุว่ามีเรื่องผิดปกติเพราะน้องไม่ร่าเริงแบบทุกทีมาขออาหารเลยไปถามกับคุณป้าที่น้องชอบไปอยู่ที่ร้านอาหารเลยรู้ว่ามีรถขับมาชนน้องจนลุกไม่ได้ คนขับชนแล้วขับต่อไม่ลงมาดูเลยค่ะ น้องเจ็บตรงท้องไม่ขับถ่าย ท้องบวมมากพาไปที่โรงพยาบาลรักษาแค่เอ็กซเรย์ตรวจเลือดราคาค่อนข้างสูงหมอบอกถ้ารักษาต่อค่าใช้จ่ายเริ่มต้นที่6หมื่นบาทแต่ไม่รับลองว่าจะอยู่ที่6หมื่นบาทเราเลยมาปรึษากับทาง wvs ทาง wvsอ่านข้อความที่เราส่งให้และได้โทรมาทันทีแนะนำให้นำน้องมารักษาได้เลยใช้เวลาในการรักษาทั้งหมดเกือบ 1 เดือน จนตอนนี้น้องได้กลับมาแล้วรักษาหายดีแล้วการรักษาไม่มีค่าใช้จ่ายเลย อยากขอบคุณมากๆค่ะ ที่ช่วยน้องๆหมาจรให้กลับมาร่าเริงอีกครั้ง

0x30da36c6d44469d7_0xd70ff6b58587819f.text: Me and my partner arrived here out of the blue and a lovely member of staff took us around the lot for a informative tour. They provide many types of care including free sterilisation for the locals as paying out of the pocket is expensive and it helps with issue of more stray dogs that may go through a hard time. This place has over 80 dogs, and they're always packed so please visit and make a donation. They do an amazing job here, and they have help stray dogs that are hurt through their intensive care unit. Our hearts were melted by this, and I strongly suggest visiting here if you have a soft spot for dogs.
0x30da36c6d44469d7_0xd70ff6b58587819f.author: Ahmed Hoang

0x30da36c6d44469d7_0xd70ff6b58587819f.text: Regional headquarters of of Worldwide Veterinary Service (Thailand). Their mission is to improve animal welfare in Southeast Asia through veterinary treatment and rehabilitation for stray and community animals as well as free sterilization and vaccination campaigns, to break the cycle of suffering caused by the massive stray overpopulation. Also a great place to find a new furry family member. There are many fully recovered and well socialized dogs available for adoption! It’s a great place to visit, meet some of the rescued animals and learn about sustainable animal welfare work.
0x30da36c6d44469d7_0xd70ff6b58587819f.author: Mark Stelzner

0x30da36c6d44469d7_0xd70ff6b58587819f.text: Care For Dogs is a lovely shelter!! The staff was informative, friendly, and professional. We stopped by without an appointment and were still able to visit. Of course volunteers need an orientation so we couldn't walk the dogs. We pet some through the fence and the ones who came back from their walk. The set up of the shelter is great too. It had many places for the dogs to rest. We got a bus to take us there and back to the city center. It cost about 300baht each way and going back to the city was a bit tricky. Not many buses came that way.
0x30da36c6d44469d7_0xd70ff6b58587819f.author: Juleng

0x30da36c6d44469d7_0xd70ff6b58587819f.text: เป็นมูลนิธิที่ดีมากเลยครับ ที่บ้านมีน้องหมา 5 ตัว ทำหมันไป 1 เหลืออีก 4 กำลังเก็บเงินอยู่ แต่โชคดีวันที่มีการฉีดวัคซีนป้องกันพิษสุนัขบ้าประจำปี มีเจ้าหน้าที่ อส. พาคุณหมอที่ฉีดมาฉีดให้ที่บ้านก่อนที่คุณหมอจะจดชื่อและเบอร์โทรที่บ้านไว้ ก่อนจะนำไปบอก จนท. มูลนิธิ WVS ให้ เนื่องจากจะมีช่วงหนึ่งของทุกปีที่จะคุณหมอเดินทางมาทำหมันฟรี!! ย้ำ!! ฟรี ครับ ให้น้องหมาที่เจ้าของติดต่อกับมูลนิธิไว้ ทางมูลนิธิมีรถยนต์พร้อมกรงรับ-ส่ง เด็กๆ ไม่ต้องกังวลเรื่องการเดินทางเลยครับ คุณหมอใช้ไหมละลายเพื่อจะได้ไม่ต้องเดินทางกลับไปตัดไหมอีก ขอบคุณทางมูลนิธิจริงๆครับ 😊🙏

As a tourist, sometimes one is confronted with the inevitable soi dog that is injured or sick. So what to do? You can't just ignore and this is where WVS Thailand stepped up to the plate. Exceptional service from amazing staff and volunteers. As a side note, ngo's and npo's are always going to struggle with funding. For that reason I implore who ever reads this to consider buying some merchandise from this entity to assist in channeling funds to an entity that does amazing work.
0x30da36c6d44469d7_0xd70ff6b58587819f.author: Michael Theunissen

0x30da36c6d44469d7_0xd70ff6b58587819f.text: ขอบคุณมูลนิธิมากนะคะที่ช่วยเหลือน้องสุนัขทุกตัวรวมถึงสุนัขที่เจ้าของไม่มีกำลังทรัพย์ที่จะพาไปรักษาโรงพยาบาลสัตว์ ช่วยเหลือโดยไม่คิดค่าใช้จ่ายใดๆ เจ้าหน้าที่และคุณหมอให้การช่วยเหลือที่ดีมากๆ รวมทั้งยังติดตามผลการรักษาของสุนัขอีกด้วย ถ้ามีโอกาสมีกำลังทรัพย์จะร่วมบริจาคทั้งเงินและอาหารยาให้แก่มูลนิธินำไปใช้ประโยชน์กับน้องสุนัขตัวอื่นๆเพื่อให้พวกเขาได้หายจากการเจ็บป่วยด้วยค่ะ ขอบคุณมากๆค่ะที่รักษาสุนัขของหนูให้หาย

1) ที่นี่รักษาฟรี คือแล้วแต่เราบริจาค 2) รักษาหมา แมว แต่ถนัดรักษาสุนัขมากกว่า 3) มีเครื่องx-ray(ไว้ดูน้องที่กระดูกหัก ขาหัก หลังหัก) แต่จะผ่าตัดได้คือน้องหมา น้ำหนักตัว 2 กิโลขึ้นไป ถ้าเป็นแมวเล็กไม่ถนัดเท่าไหร่และเครื่องมือไม่พร้อมเท่าโรงพยาบาล 4) เคยพาแมวเด็กไป(น้องหลังหัก คือขยับขาและหางไม่ได้ ขับถ่ายไม่ได้ ท้องป่อง น้องน้ำหนัก 0.8 กิโล) x-ray ดูแล้วกระดูกหักมาก คือถ้าจะผ่าตัดต้องโรงพยาบาลสัตว์เด็กของมช. คือระหว่างผ่าตัดน้องกับฉีดยาให้น้องไป อันหลังเราเสียใจแต่น้องไม่ต้องทรมาน.. 5) เจ้าหน้าที่ที่นี่น่ารักมาก แต่ให้ 4 ดาวคือ ตอนโทรไปเขาลืมถามว่าแมวเด็กหรือเปล่า เพราะถ้าเขาถาม เราอาจจะตัดสินใจพาน้องไปโรงพยาบาลสัตว์เด็กมากกว่า 6) อยากจะขอแนะนำว่า ถ้าเป็นแมวเล็ก ให้พาไปโรงพยาบาลสัตว์เด็กดีกว่า เพราะเครื่องมือและความถนัดของหมอพร้อมกว่า (เรื่องค่าใช้จ่าย จริงๆมีหน่อยงาน มูลนิธิ หรือเพจต่างๆ.. อยู่ที่ว่าเราพร้อมจะทำเพื่อน้องหรือเปล่า)

0x30da3161fba33749_0x301c53b8a12a0bcb.text: Glæder mig til at blive en del af OMH familien. Jeg synes virkelig godt om stedet og jeg er sikker på det formår at indfri forventningerne begge veje. Jeg er blevet taget virkelig god i mod. Skolen er meget tæt på A1airport hotel, som er et ideelt sted at bo under opholdet. Det tager Ca. 30 sekunder at gå derover og er bogstaveligt talt lige på den anden side af gaden. Her kommer en klogere og opdateret anmelde efter at have deltaget på skolen. Update: Old Medicine Hospital – reflections and recommendations for future students I attended several courses at Old Medicine Hospital, drawn by its historical significance and its role in the preservation and dissemination of traditional Thai medicine. The school has a special atmosphere and a warm environment, and it’s clear that students from all over the world come with curiosity and an open mind. That said, I’d like to share a few observations that may be helpful for future students: In one of the courses, we were issued a Tok Sen toolset – a traditional instrument with deep roots in Thai therapeutic practice. I was surprised that the teacher brought in to lead the class neither used nor acknowledged the standard toolset provided by the school – which ultimately holds responsibility for the course content. She openly stated that she was unfamiliar with the tools, which also raises concerns about her familiarity with the school’s curriculum. Instead, she offered to sell her own set for 1,500 baht, even though a similar set could be purchased outside the school for around 450–550 baht. I don’t mind paying a bit more for good equipment, but it becomes problematic when you join a course where the instructor doesn’t know the tools provided and simultaneously promotes her own for sale. It felt like an unfortunate blend of teaching and personal business. It is also noteworthy that Tok Sen is one of the few subjects at the school without any kind of examination or formal assessment, unlike other programs. Given Old Medicine Hospital’s status as a cultural institution and authority within traditional Thai medicine, it seems particularly odd that this valuable heritage practice is treated with such minimal emphasis. Examinations in the other subjects are oral, and students are allowed to use their notes, which is appreciated. However, I experienced some inconsistency in how the use of materials was evaluated. In one course, using the textbook was not an issue; in another, it was considered a negative – even though I approached both in the same way. Teaching is generally structured around students practicing on each other, which can be a great learning method. Instructors are present, but their supervision tends to focus on what the techniques look like, rather than how they feel to the receiver. This means that important sensory aspects of the work can easily be missed. If you’re considering taking multiple courses in Thai bodywork, I strongly recommend spreading them across different schools. Each school offers a unique approach, and some provide the opportunity to practice on teachers or models who are familiar with the techniques – which makes a big difference in understanding what the methods should truly feel like. All in all, Old Medicine Hospital offers a historical setting and can be a valuable starting point – especially if you come with curiosity and a willingness to take responsibility for your own learning. By asking specific questions before enrolling – such as about the use of materials, exam structure, and the level of supervision – you can make the most of your experience.
0x30da3161fba33749_0x301c53b8a12a0bcb.author: Suzanne Olsen

0x30da3161fba33749_0x301c53b8a12a0bcb.text: While there are tons of massage parlors in town, I decided to try a treatment at a long-established school. It was so relaxing that I ended up booking another one the following week. A 90-minute herbal compress for 600 baht. The massage uses large steamed herbal balls to massage my entire body. The treatment is performed by a teacher from the school, so I'm sure they're skilled. After changing into my treatment attire, I lie face down, and the teacher, holding the herbal ball, says a prayer before starting. The heat from the herbal ball gently spreads down my back, feeling so good I can't help but let out the same sigh I get when I enter a hot spring. The herbal ball is applied directly to my skin or over my treatment attire, and as the temperature drops, I change out for a new warm herbal ball as I massage. The relaxing herbal scent, the warm heat, the medicinal properties of the herbs, and the therapist's skilled technique combine to melt away the fatigue of travel. The stomach massage was especially pleasant, as my stomach and intestines, tired from all the food I'd had on my trip, were gently kneaded and soothed. It reminded me of the happy feeling of my mother gently washing my body in a warm bath. I can't get this experience in Japan, so it makes me want to go back to Chiang Mai. There's also a herbal steam sauna next door. Please note: When using the herbal compress, your shorts will be stained with the yellow turmeric, so make sure you wear shorts that you don't mind getting stained. Your body will also turn a little yellow.
0x30da3161fba33749_0x301c53b8a12a0bcb.author: チェリー・キャミュキャミュ

0x30da3161fba33749_0x301c53b8a12a0bcb.text: I had an incredible experience with Old Medicine Hospital Thai Massage School in Chiang Mai — it truly is a remarkable place to learn and grow. This school has a rich heritage as the birthplace of traditional Northern-style Thai massage, and you can feel that history and authenticity throughout the entire learning environment. The staff and teachers are not only highly skilled but also genuinely warm, supportive, and professional. They create such a welcoming atmosphere that makes every student feel encouraged and valued. The way they share their knowledge with patience and care makes the learning process deeply rewarding. In particular, I want to express special appreciation for Teacher Lek. Her level of professionalism, kindness, and respectful communication with every student has been truly inspiring. She teaches with such clarity and dedication, always ensuring every student feels supported and understood. Her positive energy and never-ending patience uplift the entire class, and her guidance has made a profound impact on both my learning and confidence.Txs Lek and Gap. Overall, this school and its people have exceeded all expectations — a perfect blend of tradition, expertise, and heartfelt teaching that I would highly recommend to anyone looking to deepen their skills and understanding. Mário Ribeiro
0x30da3161fba33749_0x301c53b8a12a0bcb.author: MÁRIO MIGUEL

0x30da3161fba33749_0x301c53b8a12a0bcb.text: I arrived at the Old Medicine Hospital as a stranger, with zero knowledge of massage, only curiosity in my heart. Over five unforgettable weeks, I was gently guided into the ancient art of Lanna Thai Massage. What began as a journey into the unknown became a profound experience of learning, healing, and connection. Now, I leave not only with a solid foundation in this sacred tradition but with a heart full of warmth, gratitude, and memories that will linger like the scent of the herbal balls we made 😄. It is a complex scent that will always remind me of the wonderful time we all have spent together. I'm grateful to have met the kindest and most generous souls who not only taught us massage skills but also how to respect and take care of each other as a family, how to enjoy life, how to find a balance within the nuances of life itself and everything else that matters. Chiang Mai and the Old Medicine Hospital have etched themselves into my soul — a place of peace, kindness, and timeless wisdom. They will forever hold a special place in my heart.
0x30da3161fba33749_0x301c53b8a12a0bcb.author: Wen C

0x30da3161fba33749_0x301c53b8a12a0bcb.text: I have had the incredible opportunity to study traditional Thai massage at the Old Medicine Hospital Thai Massage School in Chiang Mai, and my experience has been nothing short of amazing. I completed Levels 1 through 4 in Thai massage, as well as courses last year in foot reflexology and Thai herbal compress. The teachers here are not only highly skilled but also incredibly engaging and fun, making the learning process both thorough and enjoyable. Their expertise and dedication to preserving and passing on this ancient healing art are truly inspiring. I was extremely happy with the quality of education I received, and I left each course feeling confident and deeply connected to this beautiful tradition. I am already looking forward to returning to continue my journey with the teacher training program. If you’re considering studying Thai massage, I cannot recommend the Old Medicine Hospital enough. It’s an experience that will enrich both your skills and your soul.
0x30da3161fba33749_0x301c53b8a12a0bcb.author: Lisa Gough

0x30da3161fba33749_0x301c53b8a12a0bcb.text: I completed levels 1 and 2 of the Traditional Thai Massage course at OMH and loved it. The instruction was very organised and clear, providing beginners with a precise, step-by-step guide for different positions. The teachers were supportive and attentive throughout the week. A lot of material was covered in the first three days, leaving the fourth day for practice and preparing for the assessment on day five. I highly recommend the school and its beginner courses, as they provide a strong foundation for further advanced studies. I will definitely return next time I am in Thailand to continue my studies in Traditional Thai Massage and will also join other classes the school offers, including Aroma Oil massage and foot massage. See you there!
0x30da3161fba33749_0x301c53b8a12a0bcb.author: Jüri Nael

0x30da3161fba33749_0x301c53b8a12a0bcb.text: Sauna rooms are separated for men and women. Lockers are available. Price: 100 baht per session. Or purchase coupons: - 500 baht for 7 sessions - 1,000 baht for 15 sessions Valid for 3 months. Sarongs or pants are provided. Towels are also available. Free herbal tea with ice is available for self-service. Herbal remedies are replenished after each session: 8 AM, 11 AM, 3 PM. Refilling and cleaning the sauna room takes approximately 15 minutes. It's less crowded in the mornings. It starts getting busier in the evenings, around 5 PM. A mix of Thai and foreign users (Westerners, Japanese, etc.) are present. In the same building, there is a Thai massage service with male and female therapists. Thai massage classes are also offered.
0x30da3161fba33749_0x301c53b8a12a0bcb.author: Lunga RJ

0x30da3161fba33749_0x301c53b8a12a0bcb.text: Brilliant aroma oil massage course! I completed the 5 day course, 30 hours, and learnt so much! Small class size, they give you an informative booklet explaining all the massage positions and techniques and the teacher explains these in simple steps on a model. You then complete the steps yourself after learning the information. 3 days learning information and practicing techniques, 1 day practice on entire body. And final day practical exam and certification. Very relaxed environment and very friendly and helpful teachers! Course taught in English and lunch and coffe/tea included in price. Definitely recommend this school for all masseuses. I was a beginner and I have learnt so much! 100% recommend. Rachel from England!
0x30da3161fba33749_0x301c53b8a12a0bcb.author: Rachel Spanner

0x30e29f3832aca343_0xa63290a7c12d2d00.text: For the record, a single Pico Fraxel combination treatment session cost a minimum total of 33,260 baht, inclusive of medication and two types of post-treatment creams. I found it rather expensive and comparable to prices in Singapore and ChatGPT agrees with me. That said, the service was good. After approximately 40 minutes of numbing cream application, I was able to undergo the treatment within 10–15 minutes, followed by about 20 minutes of light therapy. I would recommend setting aside at least two hours for the entire process and ensuring you have sufficient funds available to avoid any delays. However, the signing of forms and payment could have been managed more efficiently before the face-numbing process began. Instead, these were handled while I was lying on the treatment bed with the numbing cream already applied, which made reading the information, signing the documents, and making payment rather inconvenient. Nevertheless, Dr. Bree was professional and clearly explained what needed to be done. She also pointed out other issues, such as some skin tags I have, but we both agreed it would be better to proceed step by step and assess the results of this treatment before considering any additional procedures. I have yet to see the final results from this first session, which may or may not influence my decision to undergo further treatments. On the positive side, the recovery has been promising so far, with very little downtime as the procedure is non-ablative. I was able to go home immediately after the treatment without needing to cover my face with a mask, as it looked quite natural—similar to a mild sunburn or tan. By the second day, my face felt less tight and red. However, my face felt very hot and had a burning sensation immediately after the procedure, and I think it would be beneficial for the clinic to offer a cooling facial mask treatment afterward rather than relying on patients to use a handheld rechargeable fan. I will continue to update this review with the results of my first treatment in about two weeks’ time to determine whether it is worth continuing with further sessions. Thank you for reading my review.
0x30e29f3832aca343_0xa63290a7c12d2d00.author: Jon

I had visited many doctors in Chiang Mai during those five years across many different disciplines. Basically I had tried everything with no results. But literally after my first session with Dr. Noon I felt a change. She used the Y-strap technique to adjust my neck and 80% of my pain disappeared over night. I continued treatment for a few months and am down to about 5% of my original pain level now, after 6 months without any further treatment. I have even be able to return to pursuing and achieving my goal of becoming a diving instructor. Thank you again to Dr. Noon and the Nawapohn clinic, you truly changed my life. Also their receptionist, Bank, had met me while he was working at a previous clinic years ago and he remembered me and my problem when I started at Nawapohn. He is also a very friendly and helpful guy. I just went in for a follow up while visiting Chiang Mai this week and they remembered me and were very sweet. The quality of English is also very good at the clinic and the doctor has even been able to get into deeper conversations with me about specific muscles and nerves that affected my issue. I definitely recommend this clinic for you. A full 10 out of 10.

I lost most function in my tricep and spent years traveling the world in search of someone who could truly help. Dr. Noon has been the most effective of them all. After years of atrophy, my tricep is finally beginning to fire again. The extreme tension in my neck, back, and the dense adhesions in my forearm are being released. For the first time in a long time, I feel harmony returning to my body. I was losing hope - but she’s shown me that a comeback is possible. And I’m starting to live it. Dr. Noon is modest, but without a doubt, she’s a true healer - a unique combination of incredible skill and deep heartfelt compassion. I’ve said it before and I’ll say it again… I appreciate you SO much.

0x30da3100554edebf_0xe26533a53bdafc8d.text: I recently brought my cat to Thonglor Pet Hospital for her first full veterinary checkup, vaccinations, and parasite prevention, and I am genuinely impressed with the overall experience from start to finish. From the moment I arrived, the hospital environment felt clean, organized, and very professional. The reception staff were polite, calm, and efficient, and the check-in process was smooth even though the hospital was busy. I appreciated how clearly everything was explained, including waiting times and the sequence of procedures. The veterinary team was outstanding. The veterinarian took time to carefully examine my cat and explained each step in a way that was easy to understand, even for a first-time cat owner. I never felt rushed or pressured. Instead, I felt that the team truly cared about my pet’s health and comfort. My cat was nervous at first, but the staff handled her gently and patiently, which made a huge difference. What impressed me the most was how thorough the medical planning was. The vaccination schedule, parasite prevention, and deworming plan were clearly laid out, and I was able to see all upcoming appointments through the online system. Having access to digital medical records and reminders gives me a lot of confidence that I won’t miss important follow-ups in the future. I also appreciated that the staff took time to answer my questions, including general care advice, food recommendations, and long-term health planning. As a new pet owner, this guidance was extremely valuable and reassuring. Overall, Thonglor Pet Hospital provides a very high standard of veterinary care. The combination of experienced veterinarians, modern facilities, clear communication, and a well-organized system makes it a place I trust with my pet’s health. While the hospital is busy, it’s clear that this is because many pet owners rely on their quality of care. I would confidently recommend Thonglor Pet Hospital to anyone looking for professional, reliable, and compassionate veterinary services for their pets.

0x30da3100554edebf_0xe26533a53bdafc8d.text: ใช้บริการที่นี่เป็นประจำ อาบน้ำ ฉีดวัคซีน และฝากเลี้ยง บริการอาบ ตัดขน - สามารถแจ้งกับเจ้าหน้าที่ได้เลยว่าต้องการให้ทำอะไรบ้าง อาบน้ำที่นี่จะหอมมาก กลิ่นคล้ายแป้งเด็ก น้องแมวหอมติดทนได้3-4 วันเลย และที่ชอบคือมีตัดเล็บ แปรงฟัน ขัดคราบดำใต้คางและไข่ของน้องแมวด้วย ไข่ดำกลายเป็นสีชมพูเลยค่ะ บริการฉีดวัคซีน-สามารถแจ้งกับทางคุณหมอถึงการเลือกฉีดวัคซีนตามวันเวลาที่เราสะดวก เช่น เดือนละครั้ง หรือ 3 เดือนครั้ง ส่วนวัคซีนประจำปีคุณหมอจะนัดตามวันเวลาที่ครบกำหนด บริการฝากเลี้ยง-ส่วนตัวชอบบริการนี้ของสาขานี้มาก เพราะมีอัพเดทอาการ ถ่ายรูป ถ่ายวิดีโอให้เราดูด้วย รายงานจะเป็นวันละ 2 ครั้ง เช้าเย็น เวลาตามที่เจ้าหน้าที่สะดวก เวลาไปต่างจังหวัดก็จะใช้บริการฝากเลี้ยงของที่นี่เป็นประจำเลย ก่อนรับบริการฝากเลี้ยงก็จะต้องมัดจำเบื้องต้น และมีตรวจสุขภาพเบื้องต้น ที่นี่ดีตรงที่บริการฝากเลี้ยงมีแบ่งชั้นโซนน้องหมาน้องแมวชัดเจนด้วย ทุกวันก็จะพาน้องแมวออกมาเดินเล่น กระโดด ปีนป่าย ดูวิวธรรมชาติ และช่วยเกาๆคอให้แมวสบายตัวด้วย บริการฝากเลี้ยง ต้องนำทรายแมว อาหารมาเองนะคะ หรือจะซื้อจากที่ของ รพ. ได้ด้วยเช่นกันค่ะ แต่เสียดายที่ไม่มีกล้องให้ดู และถ้าเป็นห้องขนาดเล็กก็อาจจะเล็กไปหน่อย การบริการ พนักงานงานบริการดี พูดจาสุภาพ คุณหมอเก่ง น่ารัก คอยเอาใจใส่ตลอด เช่นเวลาฉีดวัคซีนเสร็จ เมื่อเรามารับคุณหมอจะลงมาคุยพบเจอและอัพเดทอาการด้วยตัวเองอีกครั้ง ซึ่งมีบริการอัพเดทผ่านไลน์เรียบร้อยแล้วเช่นกัน จากที่ไปใช้บริการมาหลายสาขา ชอบสาขานี้ที่สุดนะคะ ฝากเลี้ยงมีอัพเดท 2 เวลา เช้าเย็น ถ่ายรูปและวิดีโอให้เยอะมากๆ ได้เห็นความน่ารักและหายคิดถึงได้เลยค่ะ
0x30da3100554edebf_0xe26533a53bdafc8d.author: Sasithorn BSB

0x30da3100554edebf_0xe26533a53bdafc8d.text: ประทับใจเกี่ยวกับการให้บริการของโรงพยาบาลสัตว์ทองหล่อเป็นอย่างมากค่ะ ตั้งแต่ก้าวแรกที่เข้ามา รู้สึกได้ถึงความเป็นมืออาชีพและความใส่ใจในทุกรายละเอียด คุณหมอมีความรู้ ความเชี่ยวชาญ และอธิบายอาการของสัตว์เลี้ยงอย่างละเอียด เข้าใจง่าย ทำให้เจ้าของอย่างเรารู้สึกสบายใจและมั่นใจในการรักษามากขึ้น เจ้าหน้าที่ทุกท่านก็น่ารัก สุภาพ และให้บริการด้วยรอยยิ้มตลอดเวลา คอยดูแลและให้คำแนะนำอย่างเต็มใจ ไม่รู้สึกเร่งรีบหรือถูกละเลยเลยค่ะ สถานที่สะอาด ทันสมัย และเป็นระเบียบมาก มีบริการครบวงจรจริง ๆ ทั้งตรวจรักษา ฝากเลี้ยง อาบน้ำ และสระว่ายน้ำสำหรับสัตว์เลี้ยง อุปกรณ์ทางการแพทย์มีความทันสมัย เช่น CT Scan ซึ่งช่วยให้การวินิจฉัยแม่นยำยิ่งขึ้น รู้สึกอุ่นใจมากที่สัตว์เลี้ยงของเราได้รับการดูแลด้วยเทคโนโลยีที่ได้มาตรฐาน ยังมีสวนให้พาน้อง ๆ ไปเดินเล่น ช่วยให้สัตว์เลี้ยงผ่อนคลาย ไม่เครียด บรรยากาศโดยรวมให้ความรู้สึกอบอุ่น เหมือนฝากคนในครอบครัวไว้กับผู้เชี่ยวชาญ การจัดการระบบต่าง ๆ เป็นระเบียบ ไม่ต้องรอนาน ทุกขั้นตอนแสดงให้เห็นถึงความใส่ใจทั้งต่อสัตว์เลี้ยงและเจ้าของ รู้สึกได้ว่าที่นี่รักสัตว์จริง ๆ ไม่ใช่แค่การให้บริการตามหน้าที่ ถือเป็นโรงพยาบาลสัตว์ที่ครบ จบ และน่าเชื่อถือมาก หากมีโอกาสหรือมีใครสอบถาม ก็อยากแนะนำโรงพยาบาลสัตว์ทองหล่ออย่างแน่นอนค่ะ

ประทับใจในการให้บริการของ โรงพยาบาลสัตว์ทองหล่อ เป็นอย่างมากค่ะ ตั้งแต่ก้าวแรกที่เข้าไป เจ้าหน้าที่ให้การต้อนรับอย่างสุภาพและเป็นกันเอง พนักงานทุกคนให้คำแนะนำอย่างละเอียด ใส่ใจ และตอบคำถามด้วยความเต็มใจ บรรยากาศภายในโรงพยาบาลสะอาด เป็นระเบียบ และดูได้มาตรฐานมาก คุณหมอให้การตรวจอย่างละเอียด อธิบายอาการและแนวทางการรักษาอย่างชัดเจน ทำให้เจ้าของอย่างเรารู้สึกสบายใจและมั่นใจในการรักษา คุณหมอมีความอ่อนโยนกับสัตว์เลี้ยงมาก ดูแลอย่างทะนุถนอม ระหว่างการรักษาก็มีการอัปเดตอาการให้ทราบเป็นระยะ อุปกรณ์ทางการแพทย์ดูทันสมัยและครบครัน การจัดการระบบคิวมีความเป็นระเบียบ ไม่สับสน แม้จะมีผู้ใช้บริการจำนวนมาก แต่ก็ยังได้รับการดูแลอย่างทั่วถึง ที่สำคัญคือเปิดให้บริการตลอด 24 ชั่วโมง ทำให้อุ่นใจมากในกรณีฉุกเฉิน เคยพาน้องมารักษาหลายครั้ง ทุกครั้งได้รับการดูแลอย่างดีเสมอ พนักงานแผนกต้อนรับให้ข้อมูลเรื่องค่าใช้จ่ายอย่างชัดเจน โปร่งใส ไม่รู้สึกกดดันในการตัดสินใจรักษา โดยรวมแล้วประทับใจทั้งทีมคุณหมอและทีมงานทุกฝ่าย รู้สึกได้ถึงความรักและความตั้งใจในการดูแลสัตว์เลี้ยงจริง ๆ ขอขอบคุณทีมงานทุกท่านที่ดูแลน้องเป็นอย่างดี หากใครกำลังมองหาโรงพยาบาลสัตว์ที่ได้มาตรฐานและเชื่อถือได้ ขอแนะนำที่นี่ด้วยความมั่นใจค่ะ 💛

The service at Thonglor has been excellent. Staff are very friendly and attentive, recognising me and asking after my cats and how they're doing by name just from my sight alone. They enjoy interacting with my kittens and seem to take a genuine interest in their wellbeing. They are incredibly accommodating and understand my needs well, including looking after the cats whilst I was travelling. Always service with a smile. Prompt responses at any time of the day and always happy to help. They were able to help a pregnant cat give birth to five kittens without complications and looked after both the mother and kittens well. They also provided cute certificates with the names and pictures of the kittens. The doctors and staff are able to speak English very well and are good at communicating. When the cats are staying I receive frequent updates with pictures and videos so I know how they are doing. The staff also comment on how friendly the cats are and how they like to be scratched, so it is more than just medical care. I will keep coming back here.
0x30da3100554edebf_0xe26533a53bdafc8d.author: Bob Jackson

0x30da3100554edebf_0xe26533a53bdafc8d.text: A week before a planned holiday, we found a tiny stray kitten wandering on the road. We had a cat hotel booked for our three older cats but didn't know what to do with this little one. She was underweight, unvaccinated, recovering from an eye infection, and unfamiliar with our other cats. We couldn't just drop her off at a cat hotel or ask a friend to care for an unwell kitten. Thonglor's boarding service was a lifesaver. The hospital is modern, clean, and professional. We received detailed reports and photos twice daily. If any medical decisions were needed (in our case, she required more antibiotics for her eye), communication was prompt and clear in English. This was surprising, as I’ve faced language issues in private human hospitals, but not here. My only worry was that the little kitten wouldn’t want to leave because she was so well cared for. Not a bad problem to have! After five nights, the kitten we picked up was undoubtedly healthier and happier than the one we dropped off. The price was very reasonable too. A wonderful pet hospital.
0x30da3100554edebf_0xe26533a53bdafc8d.author: Patrick Lent

0x30da3100554edebf_0xe26533a53bdafc8d.text: น้องหมา French Bulldog มีปัญหาเรื่องการขับถ่าย อึไม่สวย รักษาที่อื่นมาหลายสัปดาห์แล้วไม่ดีขึ้น จนตัดสินใจลองพามาที่ โรงพยาบาลสัตว์ทองหล่อ เชียงใหม่ แอร์พอร์ต สิ่งที่แตกต่างชัดเจนคือ เห็นผลตั้งแต่ครั้งแรก และเพียงสัปดาห์เดียวอาการก็ดีขึ้นมาก คุณหมอที่นี่ใส่ใจจริง ๆ ซักประวัติและตรวจละเอียด อธิบายให้เข้าใจง่ายว่ามีสาเหตุจากอะไร และควรดูแลต่อที่บ้านอย่างไร ที่สำคัญโรงพยาบาลมี ทีมคุณหมอเชี่ยวชาญหลายแผนก พร้อมด้วย เครื่องมือครบและทันสมัย จึงทำให้การรักษาตรงจุดและมั่นใจได้ว่าน้องได้รับการดูแลที่ดีที่สุด บรรยากาศโรงพยาบาล สะอาด เป็นระเบียบ และมีการ แยกโซนสุนัขกับแมว อย่างชัดเจน ลดความเครียดของสัตว์เลี้ยงได้ดีมาก พนักงานทุกคนก็น่ารัก ยิ้มแย้ม สุภาพ และคอยช่วยเหลือตลอด อีกสิ่งที่ทำให้ประทับใจมากคือ หลังกลับบ้าน หากมีคำถามหรือข้อสงสัยยังสามารถทักไลน์มาปรึกษาได้ คุณหมอและทีมงานตอบกลับอย่างสุภาพและชัดเจน ทำให้คนเลี้ยงไม่รู้สึกโดดเดี่ยวในการดูแลน้อง โดยรวมแล้ว การรักษาที่นี่ให้ผลลัพธ์ที่ชัดเจนและรวดเร็ว จนรู้สึกว่า คุ้มค่ากับสิ่งที่ได้รับ เพราะน้องไม่ต้องทนเจ็บนาน และเราเองก็สบายใจทุกครั้งที่พามา ขอบคุณทีมคุณหมอและเจ้าหน้าที่ทุกคนที่ดูแลอย่างดีค่ะ 🐾💙

We had a great experience bringing our new puppy here for a check-up and vaccinations. From the moment we walked in, the staff were extremely kind, patient, and professional. They explained everything clearly and made us feel comfortable as first-time puppy parents. The hospital is very clean, well-organized, and truly feels safe and welcoming for pets. What really impressed us is that they have everything in one place. There is a cute pet shop with great products, a professional grooming salon, and even a swimming pool for dog swimming lessons and exercise. It is so convenient to be able to do check-ups, vaccinations, grooming, and shopping all in one visit. You can really tell that they genuinely care about animals and their health. Our puppy was treated so gently, and the whole visit was stress-free. This hospital is modern, professional, and very well equipped. We highly recommend this pet hospital to anyone looking for high-quality care for their pets. We will definitely continue bringing our puppy here.
0x30da3100554edebf_0xe26533a53bdafc8d.author: Dina m

0x30e29f6535da0437_0x1bdb89b5606b42ee.author: S t

0x30da3b1a1515186b_0x9364df79dec5d810.text: I was looking for a clean sushi restaurant and it was about 3:00PM on a Sunday. I went by my self, and was happy to see the inside was just what I was looking for. The owner greeted me, and told me at 3 PM they have a Happy Hour for Sushi menu, etc, and full menu..the Tuna roll was perfect, the different types of sushi was great, and good size ...soup was very good, hot tea kept coming, and I’m going Back tomorrow..! I called my wife, and told her, we found a cute, clean Sushi Shop, that we can enjoy next time in Chiang Mai. I wish the owner the Best of Luck, because he and his staff were excellent in service.!
0x30da3b1a1515186b_0x9364df79dec5d810.author: Thomas Morea

0x30da3b1a1515186b_0x9364df79dec5d810.text: I Luv Sushi is, without a doubt, the best sushi spot in Chiang Mai. From the moment you walk in, the cozy atmosphere and welcoming staff set the tone for an unforgettable dining experience. The sushi is exceptional, with each piece carefully crafted to highlight the freshness and quality of the ingredients. The flavors are perfectly balanced, showcasing the restaurant’s commitment to authentic Japanese cuisine. Whether you’re a sushi enthusiast or just looking for a great meal, I Luv Sushi delivers a top-notch experience that’s hard to beat in Chiang Mai.
0x30da3b1a1515186b_0x9364df79dec5d810.author: Niel Nuer

0x30da3b1a1515186b_0x9364df79dec5d810.text: After staying in Thailand for almost a week and trying all that fine thai-food, we decided to try a sushi-place for once. Having high expectation from a previous trip to Japan, we were not disappointed! The Sushi is as good as it gets this far from the ocean, I guess, and better then any Sushi restaurant I visited in Europe. The staff was very attentive. We didnt had to wait a mere second for placing an order or playing the bill. The food was deliciois and of high quality. The taste of the Sushi was balanced and delightful. We will return soon!
0x30da3b1a1515186b_0x9364df79dec5d810.author: F B

0x30da3b1a1515186b_0x9364df79dec5d810.text: One of the best places I have eaten sushi in Chiang Mai. They have an August promotion going where if you order a certain amount of food (price range) you get extra dishes. Our whole meal cost 700 baht and we received a crab salad and side of fries with our meal. They also refilled our hot tea that comes with ordering here. We had the following: Salmon roll Spicy salmon roll Crunchy roll Spicy tuna roll Philly roll Great quality sushi. Will definitely be back 😊
0x30da3b1a1515186b_0x9364df79dec5d810.author: Nicola Jordaan

0x30da3b1a1515186b_0x9364df79dec5d810.text: Delicious sushi 🍣 we had the lunch special pick any two rolls (5 pieces each) with miso soup and salad. We had the spicy tuna and crunchy roll as well as spicy salmon and sunrise salmon. We also ordered the Philadelphia roll and edamame. All rolls were delicious. We also qualified for the August promotion which gave us an extra salad and French fries. Everything was great and the service was wonderful.
0x30da3b1a1515186b_0x9364df79dec5d810.author: Samantha Taranto

0x30da3b1a1515186b_0x9364df79dec5d810.text: BEST SUSHI in Chiang Mai (we think) everything was super fresh, rolls crispy and I asked them to slice them thinner and they did it exactly right :) February has a freebie promotion so we got some surprise crab salad and tofu sushi roll. Pork Gyoza is a must. The Sunrise roll, sashimi and Crispy Roll (and the other roll I can’t remember) were delicious and fresh. Thanks for a yummy perfect meal!
0x30da3b1a1515186b_0x9364df79dec5d810.author: Kaileigh Bautista

0x30da3b1a1515186b_0x9364df79dec5d810.text: A Japanese restaurant with a simple yet charming setting. They offer a complete range of standard sushi, sashimi, and other Japanese dishes. Everything is fresh and clean.
0x30da3b1a1515186b_0x9364df79dec5d810.author: Dullapak P.

0x30da3b1a1515186b_0x9364df79dec5d810.text: I gave 'I Luv Sushi CNX' a try, meeting some friends there. I like Japanese food a lot, but not particularly sushi. It wasn't predominantly sushi and we had a reasonable cross section of food. It was all 'just OK' but nothing special. I didn't think it had any 'atmosphere' unlike the 'Samurai Kitchen' restaurants in Chiang Mai, which I like a lot.
0x30da3b1a1515186b_0x9364df79dec5d810.author: chiangmaicharlies

0x30e28149daaa8edd_0x545bf182b44708b2.text: แรกๆ ตัดสินใจให้ลูกทำเพราะพนักงานที่อยู่หน้าคลินิกน่ารัก พูดจาดี อัธยาศัยดี บริการดี หมอและผู้ช่วยทันต ดีมากกกก คุณหมอทำหัตถการใดๆ เร็วและนุ่มนวลที่สุด เพราะได้เข้าไปนั่งอยู่ข้างลูกหลายครั้งค่ะ และเรื่องรอชำระเงิน แก้ไขระบบ ถ้าเร็วกว่านี้ได้ จะยิ่งดีเพื่อลดความแออัดในคลินิก ส่วนพนักงานเข้าใจว่าคนเยอะ อยากให้อดทนและยิ้มเข้าไว้ค่ะ เพราะพวกคุณคือด่านหน้า ที่ทำให้คน "เลือก" หรือ "ไม่เลือก" ใช้บริการที่นี่ค่ะ ขอบคุณค่ะ
0x30e28149daaa8edd_0x545bf182b44708b2.en: Initially, I decided to let my child have treatment here because the staff at the clinic front were lovely, polite, friendly, and provided excellent service. The doctor and dental assistants were amazing! The doctor performed procedures quickly and gently, as I sat beside my child several times. Regarding the payment system, I would appreciate it if it could be streamlined to reduce crowding in the clinic. As for the staff, I understand there are many people, but I would like to ask them to be patient and keep smiling, because you are the front line that determines whether people "choose" or "don't choose" to use our services. Thank you.

0x30e28149daaa8edd_0x545bf182b44708b2.text: This is by far the best dental clinic I’ve ever visited. The doctors are actually gentle and caring with their patients, and the staff are genuinely polite and attentive. On top of that, the service is truly worth every bit it exceeded my expectations.

The doctor was lovely and gentle, the staff were kind and spoke politely, constantly checking on my appointment and making sure I didn't have to wait long at all. The doctor gave excellent advice and was incredibly kind and friendly.
0x30e28149daaa8edd_0x545bf182b44708b2.author: Chayanid

0x30e28149daaa8edd_0x545bf182b44708b2.text: เราได้มีโอกาสมาดัดฟันที่นี่จนตอนนี้ดัดเสร็จฟันเข้าที่เรียบร้อยแล้วคุณหมอน่ารักมากแนะนำดีสุดๆ ว่าต้องทำอะไรดูแลอย่างไงบ้าง ตอนนั้นเราได้ดัดกับคุณหมอน้ำผึ้งพูดจาเป็นกันเองสุดๆไม่เกร็งเลย
0x30e28149daaa8edd_0x545bf182b44708b2.en: We had the opportunity to get braces here, and now the treatment is complete and our teeth are perfectly aligned. The doctor is incredibly kind and gave excellent advice on what to do and how to care for our teeth. We had our braces done by Dr. Namphueng, who was very friendly and made us feel comfortable at all.

0x30e28149daaa8edd_0x545bf182b44708b2.text: คุณหมอน่ารักมากบอกตลอดว่าทำอะไรยังไงบ้าง จัดฟันเข้าไวมาก บอกชัดเจนว่าแผนการจัดฟันเป็นยังไง พนักงานดูแลดี แต่คิวแอบเยอะเพราะว่าคลินิกดี บรรยากาศโดยรอบๆก็สบายมาก โดยรวมประทับใจมากค่า 🩷🩷
0x30e28149daaa8edd_0x545bf182b44708b2.en: The dentist was so lovely, explaining everything I was doing and how it was going to be done. The orthodontic treatment was very fast, and they clearly explained the treatment plan. The staff were attentive. However, the waiting list is a bit long because the clinic is excellent. 0x311d7dd43c81c09d_0xd06ee88e8b142744.text: This was my first time getting diode laser hair removal and fat injections. The place was clean, and the staff were friendly. They offered a welcome drink of collagen water. Before the procedure, I filled out a form, signed a consent form, and a statement confirming the services and results of the procedure, including any concerns arising from the clinic's procedures. The staff provided excellent service, calling everyone to me, making me feel embarrassed. Before the procedure, the staff recommended and sold me additional courses. This is typical of clinics today where salespeople try to sell additional courses. They don't hard-sell, but they consistently and consistently sell. With their strong salesmanship, if a customer refuses or asks to think about it, the salesperson isn't annoying or bothersome. The laser hair removal wasn't painful, just a slight tingling sensation. The staff applied cooling gel to my skin and constantly checked to make sure I was okay, whether it was burning or feeling okay. They were thorough and didn't rush me. Regarding the fat injections, Natty, the salesperson, gave excellent recommendations. She offered me a recommendation and helped me achieve the results I wanted. During the fat injections, the doctor prescribed medication. I opened the bottle and drew the medication in front of me. It was pure fat, nothing else. Since it was my first injection, everyone was there to support me. When the medication was injected into my face, it was painful, but I was relentless. The doctor encouraged me, constantly asking if I was okay. The staff were also there to take care of me, even applying cold compresses. The service was excellent, and I was very impressed. They chatted with each other, the doctor, the patient, and the staff, making the injections a relaxed atmosphere. There wasn't much pressure during the injections. The downside is the limited parking space. There might be a bit too little seating upstairs. If you come on a Saturday or Sunday, the parking lot in front is full, so you might have to park on the street instead. They're good at selling, but if you don't buy anything, it's not a problem. Overall, I was impressed.

0x310297867074e24f_0x9ff756cc3590d5ca.text: I can recommend Pulse Clinic in Pattaya for 100%. After a detailed medical history was taken, appropriate tests (urine/swab) were conducted, and I left with a preliminary diagnosis and some medication. Three days later, the final test results arrived via email, including a recommendation for the correct medication based on the findings. For me, it was a very satisfactory experience with no waiting, combined with friendly and professional advice and treatment. The costs are certainly a bit higher than at a local hospital, but for me, this was absolutely acceptable given the excellent and fast service.

0x30e29904489391a5_0x50a933ae0ed61b51.text: I unexpectedly discovered a new interest during my travels, and this time I specifically visited Watpo & Chetawan Massage School in Bangkok to learn oil massage. Over five days, under the careful guidance of three instructors, I went from being clumsy at the beginning to being able to independently and smoothly complete a full 1.5-hour massage. Each massage session felt like entering a flow state, focusing on the present moment, forgetting all irrelevant external worries, and enjoying a wonderful time. The students were all very friendly, encouraging each other, taking turns being both client and masseuse, and enjoying two free full-body oil massages every day. My full-time job isn't as a masseuse, and I might quickly forget all the techniques after returning to Hong Kong, but those wonderful memories will remain forever.

0x30e29904489391a5_0x50a933ae0ed61b51.text: What an amazing rest stop for the weary traveler. After a long day of touring Grand Palace and Wat Pho, we needed a place to kill time before dinner. On a whim we googled foot massage and this place was close. We walked in, fully anticipating to be turned away, unsure of if this was a school or what. But we were met with 8-10 very friendly masseuses in the lobby who were ready and waiting for walk-ins. We pointed to “30 minute foot massage” on a menu of options, and 680 baht and 30 seconds later, my husband and I were on cots in the massage room. We experienced intense but very relaxing massages. They gave us mulberry tea at the end of it. Many monks in the sitting room there, so you know the massages are good!
0x30e29904489391a5_0x50a933ae0ed61b51.author: Lisa Haggerty

0x30e29904489391a5_0x50a933ae0ed61b51.text: I had seven massages in five days in Phuket, and I've been coming to Thailand since 1999. I've had them in Pattaya, Chiang Mai, Koh Samui, and Hua Hin. Now I understand what they call traditional and authentic Thai massage. I paid 1,080 baht for two hours, and I'll probably remember it for a long time. Things I realized: 1. Starting with a prone position isn't traditional Thai massage. 2. Massage varies from person to person. 3. A good masseuse always uses open strokes. 4. If they use a lot of elbows, you shouldn't expect much. I'm coming here next July to take the full course. PS) If you just want a massage, you don't need to go to Wat Pho.
0x30e29904489391a5_0x50a933ae0ed61b51.author: james moon

0x30e29904489391a5_0x50a933ae0ed61b51.text: Wonderfully therapeutic massage at a professional level! We'd never have guessed this was a school had we not known in advance. The masseuses were very attentive and friendly, making every effort to ensure our comfort while digging deep into pressure points - the good kind of pain, without overdoing it. I could feel a notable release of tension within an hour after the massage :)
