0x3054f36d2d61595b_0xe3361175a37ab0f3.text: We were on a program of internal body cleansing (or we often refer it to detox) at Tanya Samui. Located on the Ko Samui, Thailand, Tanya Samui proclaims itself as a holistic health retreat center. Many foreigners who had come and gain health advantage from the program would happily share their experience by word-of-mouth and their own social media. Therefore, more and people were interested to also have the advantage, including my wife and me. For the accomodation, we chose the new building which rooms are spacious for 2 person occupancy and are equipped with smart TV, balcony and private bathroom. The rooms were cleaned every day. Initiated and directly managed by Mrs. Tunyarat Petchprom (or also known as “Teacher” Khun Kob), the program requires us to not consume any solid food troughout our retreat, while we are free to do any other positive activity e.g.: meditating, doing yoga, socializing with other guests at the common area, exercising in the inhouse gym, swimming, hiking, going to beach, or even exploring the island. The only restriction is not to consume any other food or beverages other than provided by the program schedule. For our consumption, there is a designated schedule to drink different types of liquids depending the time of day. The liquids includes herbal tea, herbal solutions, clear soup, enzyme, fruit juice, and the star is techers’s proprietary “Tanya Oil”. Should the fasting been done alone in our normal setting, I think it would be really hard to do as the body craving more and more for food. But in this retreat, we are encircled with the supportive environment, i.e: tranquil and beatiful gardens set with Buddhist theme helps us to relax and enjoy the present moment, socializing with other guests from different nations doing the same program made us feel strengthen, and the time that we had meeting with teacher Khun Kob made us inspired. In those meetings, she shares stories about her success journey developing the program in response for her health issue years ago, her gift of interpreting health issues in others, and her virtuous purpose in the world. For the two of us, it had been a memorable journey; the restrictions of food and the oil consumption was very challenging, but after all, we together learned a very important lesson about taking care of our own body by adopting a better mindset. We understand that graduating from 8 days program from Tanya Samui was not the end of the challenge, but rather, a new guerila to maintain the better attitude towards life. We sincerely pray that the Teacher and her staffs to be always resourceful in spreading the love, knowledge and spirit broader to the world. Kha pun khap.

0x3054f36d2d61595b_0xe3361175a37ab0f3.text: Wonderful place to do oil fasting detox. Although guest relations and program management could improve. There are 6, 8, 11 days detox program, if necessary you can stay even longer, for weeks as well. Once at registration you have been given an orientation about schedule, some pills and a 1.5 litre of water bottle, there is no more guidance afterwards. No one checks on you either. You just do your own thing and collect drinks at designated time. There is a clinic on site that is separate from the program, although being within the retreat centre the doctor knows of the program, one can see the doctor if you feel sick or have medical concern. Consultation is covered by the program but not medication or additional services. Ultimately they are separate business. This is common throughout the centre, the cafe is separate from centre reception, the retail shop is also separate as you have to pay for respective services individually and payment fees and methods are different too. Sometimes there are volunteers who will come to centre who speaks multiple Asian languages and English. They are knowledgeable and are great help. The Thai staff level of English comprehension varies, usually receptionist has the best English. Program activities start as early as 5am and finishes at 530pm. House keeping everyday, but it is pretty bare inside the room. Kettle, 2 glasses, hairdryer, a safety box, a fridge, a fan and a TV (only thai channels working, no streaming app). Of course there are beds and air con. No iron or iron board, no slippers, There are towels but no face towel, no other toiletries. You can book to come anyday of the year (as long as there are rooms). It is common for participants to feel sick or dizziness and often sodium tablets is prescribed at the clinic, Alternatively one can add salt (this is not supplied by centre so either go buy it yourself or bring some along). The teacher inspects your poo (which you will poo in a bucket and carried to inspection area towards the last few days of your program, it varies depending on how many days). It is best to bring mask with you as it can get smelly. The center offers airport transport for a fee, book in advance. One can share the ride with someone to reduce the cost. Usually the teacher will recommend maintenance program end of your retreat, therefore best to bring suitcase with space as well as luggage allowance. Average 5-10kg of additional goods purchase for thr maintenance program. Within walking distance from centre there are two convenient store that sells from food to toiletries. It is also possible to walk to nearby beach to see sunrise (as it faces East). There are various massage and treatment just like any resort centre, mostly for detox purposes. Tokens treatment is a Northern Thailand hammering treatment, the therapist on duty the day I received it was in a bad mood that rough handled me, argued with me about the room temperature when I politely requested to lower the aircon speed, and listened and watched YouTube video throughout the session, with his phone next to my head. He moved the phone when I turned to signal him about the noise disturbing me. One would expect this kind of behavior at many massage places outside, cheaper places unfortunately but I didnt expect it inside a resort. Overall it was good, I suggest check out different massage options in the area as well, and ask other long term frequent visiting guests for guidance, they might give better or faster advise than the Thai staff.
0x3054f36d2d61595b_0xe3361175a37ab0f3.author: T.T M

0x3054f36d2d61595b_0xe3361175a37ab0f3.text: This is a detox resort where you go through their detox program. Short summary of points to note before signing up: no solid food for entirety of program, schedule contains five am daily self-administered clysters (the thing where you stick the tube up into your large intenstine to clean your organs with 1.5 litres of water and then flush it out. not saying the e-word as I suspect it is why my review is not visible), drinking many laxatives to the point my mom and I kept producing excretion in our pants thinking it was passing gas and having sleep interrupted due to these bowel movement problems. Having to collect our solid waste in the bucket for the founder to review every morning. Drinking their "special oil" makes a lot of people puke. Was execreting so much that my piles bled so badly for days to the point I could not sleep and was frowned upon for stopping five out of eight days of the program. Even had someone follow me one km out to convince me to not eat my first solid food meal after deciding to stop. A lot of people have been to the program close to ten times as the founder recommended so. People have been recommended to extend their program. Expensive supplements prescribed to people (my mom was prescribed one thousand SGD of products). And many more...All I want is to spread information and awareness so people know what they are getting into and not end up like me.

0x3054f1ae2c744679_0x272c7db5e8dee48b.text: I waited for over an hour. I described the kitten's symptoms: lethargic, weak, and vomiting. The staff checked on it several times, and the last time, they held the kitten and checked its gums—they were pale. I thought they would do something or take it in for examination immediately because there was only one person ahead of me who was already being examined. But when they saw the pale gums, they said, "It's okay, it's still alright." I was confused; it was clearly very pale and the kitten was weak. Five minutes later, the kitten died in my hands. I walked over and said, "No need, I'm going home. It's gone." They immediately found an examination room, saying, "This room will do." I asked, "Is it really possible? It's already stopped breathing." When we went in, the female vet looked distressed. I admit, I was in a bad state when I arrived. I woke up to find the kitten lying weak on the floor, so I washed my face, brushed my teeth, and took it to the vet. If I had seen the vet from the moment I sat down, and the staff had checked on it, I think the kitten would have survived. After leaving the examination room, all the staff stood silently. This was the first and last time I'll ever go to this place.

0x311d7da2bda8ff61_0x78c2a68a597ecc01.text: It’s a nice place, good to visit for your teeth, great welcome. Kind and polite staff I will come back again soon
บริการดีค่ะ ตั้งแต่ส่วนต้อนรับจนถึงคุณหมอ เข้าใจเด็กๆ ช่วยพูดคุยจนทำให้หายกลัว คุณหมออธิบายละเอียดดีค่ะ
0x311d7da2bda8ff61_0x78c2a68a597ecc01.en: The service was excellent, from the receptionist to the doctor. They understood the children and helped talk to them, which eased their fears. The doctor explained everything in detail.

0x311d7da2bda8ff61_0x78c2a68a597ecc01.text: พนักงานบริการดี คุณหมอใจดีมือเบามาก อธิบายขณะทำให้เราฟังตลอดว่ากำลังทำอะไรอยู่ และแนะนำดีมากเลยค่ะ
0x311d7da2bda8ff61_0x78c2a68a597ecc01.en: The staff provided excellent service, and the doctor was kind and gentle. They explained everything they were doing throughout the procedure and gave very helpful advice.

0x30e282b62e4dd9e1_0xee4cee88c299123b.text: ...I went to consult about correcting my appointment slip, saying that I could come back next time to discuss the treatment plan with the doctor. However, on my second visit, I felt like my medical history hadn't been updated. I had to inform the doctor that I wanted metal braces, as the information from the admin might be inaccurate. The doctor was very kind and said it was okay, which was good that I informed them beforehand; otherwise, I would have had to send my information abroad to get dental impressions. In short, if you use their services, you might need to discuss many things directly with the doctor, or ask many questions. This also includes the payment process, as I mentioned using social security insurance, but they didn't process the payment. This might seem like a minor issue, but overall, I agreed to have them take care of my orthodontic treatment and receive care here anyway.
0x30e282b62e4dd9e1_0xee4cee88c299123b.author: Nunthisa Rodkaew

0x30e282b62e4dd9e1_0xee4cee88c299123b.text: I went there randomly, without doing any research or reading reviews beforehand, because I really needed a tooth extracted. Upon arrival, the staff greeted me very warmly. I then went in for the extraction, and the dentist gave good advice. Before coming here, I had been to another place that wouldn't extract the tooth, saying it was difficult. The dentist who performed the extraction was very small, but finished quickly. I was very impressed. The price was also reasonable. The dentist informed me of the price beforehand. I was very pleased.
0x30e282b62e4dd9e1_0xee4cee88c299123b.author: Da'a Porntip

0x30e282b62e4dd9e1_0xee4cee88c299123b.text: เราเป็นคนนึงที่กลัวการขูดหินปูนมาก ไม่ชอบทำฟัน เพราะมีอาการเสียวฟันตั้งเเต่เด็ก เเต่มาที่นี่คือเปิดโลกมาก การทำฟันไม่น่ากลัวอีกต่อไป เราขอใช้ยาชาเพราะทนไม่ได้ คุณหมอก็ทำให้ที่นี่ขอได้เเละใจดีมากๆๆ บริการดีมากกก ตั้งเเต่โทรนัด จนมาตามเวลานัด รอไม่นานก็ได้ทำ หมอใจดีมาก พูดดีมาก รับฟังทุกปัญหา ไม่เร่งรีบ ให้เวลาเราพักระหว่างทำเต็มที่ เจ้าหน้าที่ต้อนรับดีทุกคน คลีนิคสะอาดมากก ประทับใจสุดๆ สุขภาพฟันไม่ควรละเลย อยากให้มาลองเเล้วจะเลิกกลัวการทำฟันอีกต่อไป
0x30e282b62e4dd9e1_0xee4cee88c299123b.author: อัญธิญาน์ จรูญธนาพรรัตน์
0x30e282b62e4dd9e1_0xee4cee88c299123b.en: I'm someone who's terrified of teeth cleaning and hates going to the dentist because I've had tooth sensitivity since I was a child. But coming here was a whole new world! Dental procedures aren't scary anymore. I asked for local anesthesia because I can't tolerate the pain, and the dentist happily obliged. They were incredibly kind and provided excellent service, from making an appointment to arriving on time. I didn't have to wait long, and the dentist was so kind, spoke so well, listened to all my concerns, and didn't rush me. They gave me plenty of time to rest between treatments. The staff were all welcoming, and the clinic was spotlessly clean. I was extremely impressed. Dental health shouldn't be neglected. I highly recommend trying this clinic; you'll overcome your fear of dental work once and for all.

0x30e282b62e4dd9e1_0xee4cee88c299123b.text: It was a very happy dental visit. I had two dental implants done at the same time, and there was no pain or swelling at all. They're having a promotion right now too! Every Wednesday, if you spend 1500 baht or more, you get a free teddy bear keychain. They're giving them away while supplies last!
0x30e282b62e4dd9e1_0xee4cee88c299123b.author: Nujira Sitthiboriboon

0x30e282b62e4dd9e1_0xee4cee88c299123b.text: The clinic is clean, there are plenty of seats, and the wait is not long. The doctor has a gentle hand and speaks politely to everyone. It's easy to get to and very convenient. There are also free drinking water. The staff provides excellent service.
0x30e282b62e4dd9e1_0xee4cee88c299123b.author: Public Static vo

0x30e282b62e4dd9e1_0xee4cee88c299123b.text: I came here because a friend recommended it, and since then I haven't gone anywhere else. The doctor is kind, and all the staff are lovely. I'm very impressed. The clinic is clean, and overall it's excellent. It's made me love going to the dentist!
0x30e282b62e4dd9e1_0xee4cee88c299123b.author: Yuki Ch

0x30e282b62e4dd9e1_0xee4cee88c299123b.text: The doctor is highly skilled and experienced, providing excellent treatment with a 100% success rate. They are very attentive to patients. You can be confident that any oral health problem you may have will receive the best possible treatment here.
0x30e282b62e4dd9e1_0xee4cee88c299123b.author: Busaba Premyodhin

0x30e282b62e4dd9e1_0xee4cee88c299123b.text: Good service and reasonable price for basic care, like scaling. All staff and doctors are kind, with limited English skills. Mouthwash and toothpaste are available in the bathrooms, the clinic is clean with enough seats. Easy access with BTS. Dual price for locals and foreigners has been discarded, good news. Time for billing was a bit long (20 min) however.
0x30e282b62e4dd9e1_0xee4cee88c299123b.author: MG R

0x30e29f9bb0488815_0xfee0f1fd26bcda11.text: The technicians were skilled, not pushy, and the wait time was reasonable. I was a walk-in customer, arriving at the clinic around 7 PM on Saturday evening. I stated I wanted to have a profilo treatment. The staff briefly introduced the two treatment options. When I mentioned I was leaving Thailand the next day, they didn't insist and allowed me to have only one treatment. They arranged a doctor's consultation before the treatment. The doctor answered my questions and requests simply and clearly. The treatment was quick after the consultation. I spent less than 30 minutes at the clinic; the treatment was quick and efficient, and the location was convenient, on the 6th floor of Terminal 21.
0x30e29f9bb0488815_0xfee0f1fd26bcda11.author: Yu-chen Wu

0x30e29f9bb0488815_0xfee0f1fd26bcda11.text: I stopped by to see Dr. Rung. I only came for acne injections (again!). Luckily, I found this branch near my workplace at Terminal 21 Asoke. I previously went to the Siam Square branch, and the doctor there was also very helpful. It happened to be my turn for a Botox refill, so I came to this branch. The doctor was very helpful and gentle, even with the acne injections. Today was my follow-up Botox appointment; my face feels firmer and smaller! See you again in 6 months! Thank you!
0x30e29f9bb0488815_0xfee0f1fd26bcda11.author: supakit big

0x30e29f9bb0488815_0xfee0f1fd26bcda11.text: I got filler and Botox injections in my chin with Dr. Pim, and the results exceeded my expectations. My face looks soft and natural, not artificial. The doctor didn't try to push any packages, gave excellent advice, and was very meticulous with the injections. Everyone has commented on how much prettier I look. I love it so much! This will be my go-to branch. The staff are very friendly and polite, and the doctor provides excellent follow-up and case monitoring.
0x30e29f9bb0488815_0xfee0f1fd26bcda11.author: Sarocha Naktrakul

0x30e29f9bb0488815_0xfee0f1fd26bcda11.text: After getting filler injections with Dr. Pook at the Asoke Terminal 21 branch, the results are very noticeable after 1 month. I'm very satisfied and happy. Dr. Pook is meticulous in every detail and has a gentle touch. My face feels hydrated and firm, and I look prettier when I wear makeup. The staff at the front desk are very lovely, polite, and attentive throughout the process. 🙏🥰 Thank you.
0x30e29f9bb0488815_0xfee0f1fd26bcda11.author: Alinda Nondet

0x30e29f9bb0488815_0xfee0f1fd26bcda11.text: I'd like to visit Dr. Rung at the Terminal Asoke branch. I came for Botox; initially, a colleague dragged me along, but I was impressed by the service and the great promotions, so I decided to get Botox too. The doctor has a very gentle touch. If I have the chance, I'll come back in six months for more. It's close to my workplace, so I can stop by after work. Super convenient!
0x30e29f9bb0488815_0xfee0f1fd26bcda11.author: panitta ratta

0x30e29f9bb0488815_0xfee0f1fd26bcda11.text: This was my second visit to V Square Terminal 21 Asok. I have had both filler and Botox treatments here with Dr. Kate. She takes great care of her patients and always ensures that the recommended treatments are suitable for my needs. All of the staff are very friendly, professional, and welcoming. I am very happy with my experience and would highly recommend this clinic.
0x30e29f9bb0488815_0xfee0f1fd26bcda11.author: Bella S

0x30e29f9bb0488815_0xfee0f1fd26bcda11.text: This is the only clinic I'll ever go to. I always choose Dr. Pook; I've never met a doctor like her. Other clinics had doctors who rushed through the procedures in under 5 minutes, but here, Dr. Pook provides thorough consultation until I fully understand everything before proceeding. I've recommended this clinic to several friends, and they're all hooked now.
0x30e29f9bb0488815_0xfee0f1fd26bcda11.author: pinezz dp

0x30e29f9bb0488815_0xfee0f1fd26bcda11.text: Today I had Ultraformer III treatment with Dr. Kwang at the Terminal Asoke branch. Dr. Kwang did a great job; it was painless, the lifting and tightening were excellent, and I could see results immediately. It effectively reduced my double chin and tightened my skin. The staff provided excellent service.
0x30e29f9bb0488815_0xfee0f1fd26bcda11.author: coke muay

0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.text: We cannot thank the team at this clinic enough for the incredible care and support they provided to our 2-year-old son while we were staying at Club Med Phuket. When our son became seriously unwell with gastro, the medical team attended our room promptly, carried out a thorough assessment, provided clear medical guidance, administered an IV drip and supplied the necessary supporting medication — all with incredible professionalism, compassion and care. What stood out most was the genuine kindness of the team. They took the time to explain everything clearly, reassured us throughout a stressful situation, and have continued to follow up via WhatsApp to check on his recovery. They also provided all documentation and correspondence required for our travel insurance, making the entire process seamless. Beautiful people doing wonderful things. We are incredibly grateful for the care our son received and would highly recommend this clinic to anyone needing medical support in Phuket.
0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.author: Samwell Bateman

0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.text: After my 9 year old son was unwell for a few days, our lovely hotel staff called the Doctor from the Karon Medical Clinic Team to come to our hotel. The team were very prompt and friendly. The staff were amazing with my son, reassuring him he would feel better after the drip was in his arm to hydrate him (my boy is very fearful of needles). The staff were very gentle and caring. He was given some anti nausea medication, antibiotics, anti spasm and nausea intravenously. He was also given oral medication to start the next day. The cost was 11,060.00 Baht so about $476.28 Australian We also received an email the next day: We wanted to extend our heartfelt wishes for a fast recovery to your son. We genuinely hope that he will soon regain good health. Make sure to get adequate hydration. I would definitely recommend this amazing team. My boy regained his energy and was able to enjoy the rest of his holiday in Phuket. 🏖️☀️ Thank you 🙏🏼 😊
0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.author: Rebecca Warwick

0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.text: Excellent medical care and highly professional service. From the initial contact and appointment arrangement to the actual visit, everything was handled quickly and efficiently, creating an immediate sense of trust and reassurance. A doctor and a nurse came directly to our hotel, which was greatly appreciated and made the situation much easier to manage. The medical team was thorough, attentive, and clear in their communication. Test results were provided promptly, along with a well-explained assessment of the condition and findings, which helped reduce concern. The follow-up after the visit was very reassuring and demonstrated genuine care for patient well-being. The guidance provided contributed to a smooth recovery and a very positive overall experience. Highly recommended medical clinic with a dedicated, professional, and caring team. An excellent choice for anyone in need of reliable medical care in Thailand, Phuket.
0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.author: Samuel Tervanen

0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.text: My family and I stayed at a Kata Beach resort this week and we became ill during our stay. Our 3 year old daughter became very unwell in the middle of the night and the resort put us in contact with Karon medical clinic. Within 30 mins Dr Klow and Nurse May arrived. They were both very patient, informative and approachable. They answered all of our questions (even questions asked by our 3 year old). After giving her great treatment in the middle of the night they returned the night as she was still having a hard time. They were very understanding and listened to all our questions and concerned. The peace of mind helped us to care for our daughter and to still have an amazing stay in Phuket. I would highly recommend this clinic and this doctor and nurses particularly. Thank you so much Dr Klow, Nurse May and the Karon Medical Clinic for all your help and support, it is much appreciated.
0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.author: Cassandra Riddle

0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.text: Very professional and great service which goes beyond the European standard. My son (3) years old had flu and we found out by a test made by the clinic in our hotel room that he had Influenza B. They immediately called my travel insurance and registered him and also the billing was going directly to the insurance which was so nice. They gave ham IV directly with medicine in his veins, hydration water, salt etc. also we received a big bag with medicine and instructions and how to dosage the medicine. Within 24 hours he was already in much better condition. Thanks for saving our holiday. I highly recommend you and i highly recommended calling doctor home instead of waiting inside doctors waiting room. Much more confident!
0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.author: Martin Schack Nielsen

0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.text: I visited this clinic after being referred by my travel insurance due to several days of diarrhea and possible dehydration. From the moment I arrived, I was taken extremely well care of — there was no waiting time at all, and the staff were kind, professional, and efficient. I was examined thoroughly by a doctor, received IV fluids, and had all the necessary tests done to identify the cause of my symptoms. Before I left, they provided me with the right medication, and I was feeling significantly better within just a day. Overall, an excellent experience during a stressful situation. I’m very grateful for their help and highly recommend this clinic to anyone in need of medical care.
0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.author: Steven Christensen

0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.text: After suffering 4 days with stomach cramps, diarrhea and vomiting I went to the Dr Karon Clinic. I walked in to the clinic and was attended to straight away. My obs were taken within 3 minutes of sitting down and then mediately seen by a doctor.all staff spoke and understood English.i was diagnosed by the doctor and offered a list of treatments with costs. I choose to have an injection and medication to take with me. The nurse gave me the injection which was painless not like back home.the clinic is super clean and staff very caring, professional and understanding. My visit cost £72 and worth every penny. Medication started working within 2 hrs. Thank you everyone at the Clinic.
0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.author: Sandra D

0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.text: I had fever and wanted a check, once the doctor finished checking, the nurses wanted me to do a blood test (so they can charge me the fee for the nurse) and then they wanted to buy medicine from the office itself not the pharmacy …

0x30e29b10bd53765f_0xb09af80693d35acb.text: I came here for teeth cleaning using my social security benefits. The doctor and staff were very nice and friendly. The doctor gave great advice. I plan to get braces here in the future. The price isn't too high :)
0x30e29b10bd53765f_0xb09af80693d35acb.author: Orn Ornanong

0x30e29b10bd53765f_0xb09af80693d35acb.text: มาถอนฟันพร้อมกับขูดหินปูนที่นี้ใช้สิทธิ์ประกันสังคมได้ด้วยคุณหมอมือเบาทำไม่เจ็บเลยถ้าเราขับรถมาสามารถจอดรถข้างถนนฝั่งคลีนิคได้ตลอดทางเลยค่ะมาง่ายคลีนิคหาไม่ยากอยู่หน้าถนนเลยค่ะคลีนิคทำฟันแนะนำร้านนี้เลยค่ะ

0x30e29b10bd53765f_0xb09af80693d35acb.en: I had a tooth extracted and had my teeth cleaned here using my social security insurance. The dentist was very gentle and the procedure was painless. If you're driving, you can park on the street opposite the clinic anytime. It's easy to find, right on the main road. I highly recommend this dental clinic.

0x30e29b10bd53765f_0xb09af80693d35acb.text: The shop provides excellent patient service. The doctor is an expert and gives very good advice. It is convenient to travel to because there are always buses passing by.

0x30e29b10bd53765f_0xb09af80693d35acb.text: I've been here several times. The service is good, the dentist is gentle when extracting wisdom teeth, and they are always ready to provide advice.

0x30e29b10bd53765f_0xb09af80693d35acb.text: The clinic provided excellent service. The doctor and nurses were very attentive. I will definitely use their services again next time.
0x30e29b10bd53765f_0xb09af80693d35acb.author: thanyaporn kiatparadorn

0x310296129fd65393_0x848d1b22e9ec91a1.text: I recently had a root canal treatment at Doctor Smile Dental Clinic, and I couldn't be more satisfied with the experience. From the moment I walked in, the staff was incredibly welcoming and made me feel at ease immediately. The clinic is spotless and equipped with the latest dental technology, which reassured me that I was in good hands. The dentist who performed my root canal was exceptionally skilled and caring. They explained each step of the procedure clearly, ensuring I was comfortable and understood what to expect. The treatment was virtually painless, and I was impressed by the meticulous attention to detail. The aftercare provided by Doctor Smile Dental Clinic was outstanding. I received thorough instructions on how to care for my tooth post-treatment, and the follow-up calls to check on my recovery showed their genuine concern for my well-being. Overall, I highly recommend Doctor Smile Dental Clinic for anyone in need of dental care. Their commitment to patient comfort and quality treatment truly sets them apart. Thank you, Doctor Smile Dental Clinic, for making what could have been a stressful experience completely stress-free!
0x310296129fd65393_0x848d1b22e9ec91a1.author: Shah Fahad Bukhari

0x310296129fd65393_0x848d1b22e9ec91a1.text: I am lucky enough to have a friend who has traveled to Thailand a few times. When I mentioned to him that my dentist in Raleigh had given me an estimate of $15,000 for "necessary" dental procedures, he said "let's go to Thailand." He told me that a.) it was unlikely I needed everything done that was listed on the estimate, and b.) what I did need done could be done at a fraction of the cost in Thailand. So, we made the trip. Iwemt to Dr. Smile in Pattaya, and was absolutely impressed with the doctor and staff. I won't say how much it cost for what I had done, but I will tell you that I was able to get everything done that I wanted spend 2 weeks in Thailand and 1 week in Cambodia for less than a fifth of the original estimate.
0x310296129fd65393_0x848d1b22e9ec91a1.author: Dan Ratte'

0x310296129fd65393_0x848d1b22e9ec91a1.text: Excellent service. My husband and I went to this dentist. Wow extremely very happy and very affordable. I originally had a top plate that I wasn't happy with made in Australia. Doctor smile made a new plate top and partial bottom. I have never been so happy very comfortable and my smile is much better. Teeth are straight and correctly placed. So happy will definitely come back to this dentist next year and get another one made. Thank you Doctor Smile you are very professional 😀
0x310296129fd65393_0x848d1b22e9ec91a1.author: Cheree

0x310296129fd65393_0x848d1b22e9ec91a1.text: I had my wisdom teeth removed and teeth whitening done here in Pattaya, and the experience was excellent! The dentist was very professional, gentle, and explained every step clearly. The procedure was quick and almost painless, and the clinic was clean and modern. My smile looks so much better now — highly recommend for anyone looking for quality dental care in Pattaya!
0x310296129fd65393_0x848d1b22e9ec91a1.author: Kambiz Radman

0x310296129fd65393_0x848d1b22e9ec91a1.text: Excellent clinic! Very professional and attentive doctor, friendly receptionist. Wonderful doctor's assistants. The work was impeccable, prices reasonable. I scheduled an appointment online, they called back quickly and set an appointment. I highly recommend!
0x310296129fd65393_0x848d1b22e9ec91a1.author: Irina Gladchenko

0x310296129fd65393_0x848d1b22e9ec91a1.text: The office has always been professional and i could not be happier with the dental care. I have had two different dentists and they were both highly skilled and respectful of me at all times. I would very much recommend this dental care business.
0x310296129fd65393_0x848d1b22e9ec91a1.author: Kerry Colvin

0x310296129fd65393_0x848d1b22e9ec91a1.text: I am very happy with the service. Everyone was kind and polite, the doctor was looking out for you during the process, taking small breaks when you needed it and the price was within the advertised price frame. Will return again! Thank you
0x310296129fd65393_0x848d1b22e9ec91a1.author: Minos Papanikolaou

0x310296129fd65393_0x848d1b22e9ec91a1.text: I was not a patient of Dr. Smile - I was the friend of a patient helping him get his orthodontic treatment started. We went in together to find out the pricing and plan as we compared with other providers in Pattaya. We chose Dr. Smile based on price and recommendations from other patients we knew. I was disappointed after treatment started that the office staff I met with was unable to provide me a written plan, pricing, and payment schedule. After a few attempts and some emails back and forth months after the start of treatment I am now clear. Apparently because orthodontic treatment is almost exclusively provided to Thai patients they do not provide this information in writing as these patients prefer to receive information orally. I was assured that for western/foreign patients they provide all this information (pricing, plan) in writing and payment is almost always done at time of service and not on a plan as treatment is not months or years long. A strain is a genetic variant or subtype of a microorganism (e.g., a virus, bacterium or fungus). For example, a "flu strain" is a certain biological form of the influenza or "flu" virus. These flu strains are characterized by their differing isoforms of surface proteins. New viral strains can be created due to mutation or swapping of genetic components when two or more viruses infect the same cell in nature.[3] These phenomena are known respectively as antigenic drift and antigenic shift. 0x30e29900576661f9_0xa250b059650fde6b.text: 💖👀 I got Invisible Braces at this clinic. This was my first time getting braces. After working in a job that requires a strong smile, I was always worried about my crooked front teeth when I looked in the mirror while brushing my teeth. A friend who had gotten braces here for the second time recommended it. Since she's also a working professional, she suggested Invisible Braces. It solved her problem perfectly, giving her a beautiful, confident smile that even senior colleagues have commented on. The doctor gave excellent advice and allowed me to see the treatment plan before receiving the aligners. Initially, I was worried about eating because I tend to snack throughout the day, but I can eat normally now. I can even wear the aligners comfortably while traveling or going to concerts. I'm very impressed with the results after treatment. I'm already wearing my retainer! I highly recommend this clinic. The doctor is a specialist (you can check their credentials), and they've even received awards! Amazing! I'll be back for my retainer checkup and teeth cleaning soon. ⭐️🤭👍🏻

0x30e29900576661f9_0xa250b059650fde6b.text: Excellent experience at Puredent Dental Clinic in Sathon. One of my braces brackets came loose while I was eating, and several clinics refused to treat me because I hadn't started treatment there. The Puredent team agreed to help, neatly reattached the bracket, and even added the blue gum that my previous orthodontist should have applied from the start to prevent me from biting the lower braces. Professional, precise, reassuring, and efficient. They clearly understood the problem and provided a real solution without complicating things. I highly recommend them, especially if you have an "urgent" orthodontic issue during your treatment.

0x3054f1ab6d82cc2d_0x2b0297d7ccbc0b49.text: I've got stomach flu on my 4th day of my trip. Worrying I might be too weak to travel back home on the 5th day, I decided to engage Doctor Samui through whatsapp. They responded quickly and asked about my symptoms and the hotel I am staying. They were at my doorstep in less than an hour. 1 doctor and 2 other staff came. They spoke good English. They gave me IV drip, took my blood, administer antibiotics and other medications on the spot. The 2 staff stayed until my IV drip finished and gave me clear instructions on the oral medications for the next few days. I felt assured that someone came and took care of me and gave me proper medication (Before engaging them, I did buy some off the shelf medication but didn't work). They whatsapp me the doctor's memo and receipt (in English) and couple of hours later, they sent me the blood test results. This whole service is really expensive but luckily I bought travel insurance. All in all, I think their service is really good and gave me reassurance. Highly recommend anyone out there who need a doctor to see you urgently. To Doctor Samui team: Thank you for coming to Holiday Inn Bophut to "rescue" me on 23 Dec 2024. 0x3054f1ab6d82cc2d_0x2b0297d7ccbc0b49.text: My experience at clinic was mixed. On the one hand, I felt welcomed, and the clinic itself seemed professional. However, the doctor who treated me turned out to be completely incompetent. I was dealing with a severe bacterial infection and had already completed a five-day course of antibiotics. Unfortunately, as soon as I finished the treatment, my symptoms returned even worse than before. At this clinic, I was prescribed a ten-day course of what I thought was a different antibiotic. Only later did I realize that it was actually the same medication, just under a different name. Once again, the treatment only provided temporary relief but did not cure the infection. On the eighth day of taking the second antibiotic, my symptoms returned in full force. It was only when I was admitted to a hospital that I discovered I had been given the same ineffective antibiotic twice. There, I finally received the correct medication, and after just one day, I felt significantly better. Had I been properly diagnosed and treated from the start, I could have enjoyed my vacation much more. Unfortunately, based on my experience, I cannot recommend this clinic for serious medical issues.

0x30e29fc1d1e2410b_0x63ece8c11ce24120.text: I was incredibly impressed with my veneer experience at Dentista, so I wanted to share my experience in case it's helpful for others who are looking for information. Before deciding on veneers, I researched many places and had quite a few concerns about the naturalness of my teeth, color, shape, and safety. But after consulting with Dr. Lily at Dentista, I felt much more confident. Dr. Lily gave detailed advice, explaining the advantages, limitations, and treatment process straightforwardly. She designed a smile that suited my face and personality, without suggesting anything unnecessary. This made me feel comfortable and confident from the very first consultation. Throughout the veneer process, Dr. Lily was very attentive to detail, constantly asking about my feelings and explaining every step before starting, which made me feel completely at ease. The staff and assistants were also very caring, friendly, polite, and professional. The clinic itself was clean, beautiful, and modern. The results exceeded my expectations! My teeth look naturally beautiful, not artificially white. The shape of my teeth complements my face, and I feel much more confident when I smile. Many people around me have commented on how much prettier my teeth look, but they can't tell I had veneers, which is exactly what I wanted – a natural look. I would like to thank Dr. Lily and the entire Dentista team for their excellent care from the first day until the completion of my treatment. If you're looking for a reputable veneer clinic with expert doctors who provide sincere consultations and pay attention to detail at every step, I highly recommend Dentista. From my personal experience, it was a very worthwhile decision and has truly boosted my confidence in smiling! 😊✨
0x30e29fc1d1e2410b_0x63ece8c11ce24120.author: natchanan sumatpimonchai

0x30e29fc1d1e2410b_0x63ece8c11ce24120.text: I had the opportunity to be a case reviewer for ceramic veneers with Dr. Nutty. I have to say, I hesitated for a very long time before deciding to get veneers because I was afraid of tooth sensitivity, tooth thinning, and unnatural results. But after meeting Dr. Nutty, all my worries disappeared! Because I can honestly say that they use very little tooth preparation here. During the first consultation, Dr. Nutty was very patient. She sat down and talked with me in detail, asking what kind of smile I wanted, what my concerns were, what color tone I preferred, and how I wanted my teeth to be aligned. She then helped design a Smile Design for me to see what the results would look like before the actual procedure. Seeing the simulation before the actual procedure made me feel much more confident. During the process, the doctor explained every step, from tooth preparation and impression taking to trying on temporary veneers. This allowed me to see what it would look like before the final application. I have to say, I was impressed from the first time I saw the model because it matched almost everything I told the doctor. The result after the final veneers were fitted: my teeth look so beautiful and natural. They don't look unnaturally white, just as I discussed with the doctor. Every time I smile, I feel so much more confident. I feel like it was a worthwhile investment. If you're still hesitant, I recommend consulting with Dr. Nutty first. There's nothing a doctor can't answer! 🦷✨
0x30e29fc1d1e2410b_0x63ece8c11ce24120.author: VARANYA INPRASERT

0x30e29fc1d1e2410b_0x63ece8c11ce24120.text: 2023: the clinic really listen to client’s feedbacks & really try to improve the service, so decide to update my review. After finished my Invisalign, I continued to do teeth whitening here. The result was good & highly recommended! 2022: The service is good in general, especially the basic services like cleaning or whitening. However, for long treatment - eg. Brace or Invisalign, etc. please consider carefully. This is my experience doing Invisalign here: Pros: - Scan & X-ray can be done at the clinic, very convenient. Deposit 10k THB, after receiving the plan/ result, in case you decide to go with the program, the Scan & X-ray will be included into the package. - The doctor is very details oriented - Easy to communicate via LINE Cons: - Appointment schedule: the doctor is too busy and it’s hard to get the appointment. I normally need to scheduled at least 1 month in advance, just to do the check up. If you get busy on appointment date, good luck or wait for 1-2 more weeks then 😄 - They didn’t have quite good management system to keep tracking with Invisalign company. My Invisalign plan got 2 months gap as the Sample got damaged during transportation. The finally agreed to provide a retainer for me (after long discussion) while waiting for new trays to come. - Price: not cheap, Unlimited plan is ~20k more expensive than other clinics (comparing with 3 clinics in Sukhumvit area that my friends was doing)

I live near On Nut, and in the last two years, there have been more new dental clinics opening than 7-Eleven stores. I've tried several, at various price points from cheap to expensive. However, my last visit to a clinic in Lotus (which had many reviews) wasn't as good as I expected. I was disappointed. The dentist said I had a lot of tartar, but the scaling only took less than 10 minutes (there were so many patients!). Plus, they charged me excessively for just the scaling. I decided against it; they weren't honest with their customers. This year, I decided to find a new clinic for tartar removal. Initially, I considered another clinic across the street, which also had many reviews, but most were for orthodontics. I decided to try Dentistrya because the reviews showed a diverse range of clients, not just those getting braces, and they were genuinely helpful. I have to say, the service was excellent. The tartar removal cost 900-1400 baht. Again, I had a lot of tartar, but the dentist took almost half an hour. They were very meticulous and did a great job. The dentist kept asking me if I was okay, showing how worried they were about the pain.😹 Tartar removal is usually painful, but the dentist made it feel like they were being very gentle. In short, I highly recommend them. For me, the price was worth it. I will definitely use your service again next time.
0x30e29fc1d1e2410b_0x63ece8c11ce24120.author: Picha P.

0x30e29fc1d1e2410b_0x63ece8c11ce24120.text: It’s actually rare for me to leave a review so if I’m writing this, it really means the experience was super good. I’ve had trauma since I was a kid that made me really afraid of dentists. Even thinking about dental procedures makes me nervous. But recently I had no choice and needed to remove my wisdom tooth… and honestly, it was not as painful as I imagined at all. Dr. Champx was incredibly kind, patient, and understanding. I told him upfront that I was scared of dentists, and he really helped calm me down throughout the process. He explained clearly what was happening with my impacted wisdom tooth, and even though I was still a bit nervous, he kept reassuring me that everything was going to be okay and it really was. I also want to highlight the staff and admin team. They were always smiling, supportive, and very attentive. They noticed I was nervous and did their best to make me feel comfortable and at ease. Thank you, Dentista, for such a positive experience. I truly recommend this place, and it will definitely be my go-to clinic whenever I need dental care in the future.

0x30e29fc1d1e2410b_0x63ece8c11ce24120.text: This is my absolute favorite dental clinic. Seven years ago, I had root canal treatment here (it cost around 10,000 baht back then), and I didn't get a crown, but my tooth is still fine to this day. This time, I had a problem with another root canal, and this was the first place I thought of. I was so lucky to see the same doctor! She's incredibly kind, remembered me, and gave excellent advice. 0x30e29fbbbb58438f_0xa8caf871db3aed0e.text: จัดฟันที่นี่แบบดามอน หลายปีก่อนน่าจะ เกือบ 10 ปีที่แล้ว คุณหมอใจดีมาก ใช้เวลาจัดอยู่ 3 ปี ปัญหาของเราคือฟันซ้อนฟันไม่เรียงฟันเกิน ฟันล่างคล่อมบนนิดนึง จัด 1 ปี แบบไม่ถอน ฟันที่ไม่เรียง เรียงสวยดีมาก แต่คุณหมอถามว่า ฟันล่างคล่อมฟันบนอยู่หน่อย อยากจัดให้เข้ามั๊ย แต่ต้องถอนฟันประมาณ 3 ซี่ แล้วก็ถ้าดันเข้าหน้าจะเปลี่ยนเลย เราก็เลยจัดต่ออีก 2 ปี อยากจะบอกว่า แค่จัดฟันปากหุบลงนิดเดียว หน้าคือเปลี่ยน โหง่วเฮ่งเปลี่ยนเลย รู้สึกหน้าเด็กลง คนไม่เจอกันนานถามไปทำไรมา มันดูดีขึ้นแบบงงๆว่าไปทำไรมา อยากบอกว่าที่นี่ดีมากค่ะ พนักงาน คุณหมอ ใจดีมากๆ
0x30e29fbbbb58438f_0xa8caf871db3aed0e.en: I got Damon braces here many years ago, almost 10 years ago. The doctor was very kind. The treatment took 3 years. My problems were crowded teeth, misaligned teeth, and a slight overlap between my lower and upper teeth. After 1 year of treatment without extractions, the misaligned teeth became beautifully straight. However, the doctor asked if I wanted straightening my slightly overlapping lower teeth, which would require extracting about 3 teeth, and that it would drastically change my facial features. So, I continued the treatment for another 2 years. I want to say that just slightly closing my mouth with braces changed my face and my overall appearance. I feel younger. People who haven't seen me in a long time ask what I've done; I look so much better, they're surprised. I want to say that this place is excellent. The staff and the doctor are incredibly kind.

0x30e29fbbbb58438f_0xa8caf871db3aed0e.text: แนะนำจัดฟันที่นี่เลยค่ะ ของเราเป็นเคสยาก หลายที่ไม่รับทำ หรือถ้ารับก็ค่าใช้จ่ายแพงมาก แต่ทางหมอพิทักษ์รับทำ ในราคาสมเหตุสมผล ผลลัพธ์เกินความคาดหมายมาก ถ้าจัดฟันแนะนำที่คลินิกเลยค่ะ ติดนิดเดียวตรงคุณหมอผู้ชายอีกท่านที่ขุดหินปูน จริงๆคุณหมอแนะนำดีมากเลยค่ะ รู้สึกได้ว่าตั้งใจดูแลคนไข้จริงๆ แต่อาจจะมือหนักไปหน่อย เจ็บ & เลือดออกค่อนข้างเยอะ ขนาดว่าไปขูดหินปูนทุก 3-4 เดือน ก็ยังเจ็บทุกครั้ง น้ำตาไหลทุกครั้งที่ขูดหินปูน 🥲 หากปรับตรงนี้ได้จะดีมากๆเลยค่ะ นอกนั้นไม่ติดอะไรที่คลินิกนี้ค่ะ แนะนำเลย พนักงานทุกคนก็บริการดีเป็นกันเอง 👍🏼
0x30e29fbbbb58438f_0xa8caf871db3aed0e.en: I highly recommend getting braces here. My case was difficult; many places wouldn't accept it, or if they did, the cost was exorbitant. But Dr. Pitak accepted it at a reasonable price, and the results exceeded my expectations. If you're getting braces, I highly recommend this clinic. The only minor issue is with the other male doctor who does the tartar removal. He's actually very good at advising and you can feel his dedication to patient care, but he might be a bit heavy-handed. It was quite painful and caused a lot of bleeding, even though I get tartar removed every 3-4 months. It still hurts and I cry every time 🥲. If he could adjust this, it would be fantastic. Other than that, I have no complaints about the clinic. I highly recommend it. All the staff are friendly and provide excellent service 👍🏼.

0x30e29fbbbb58438f_0xa8caf871db3aed0e.text: เคยผ่าฟันคุดที่นี่ เมื่อ 10 ปีที่แล้ว คุณหมอผู้ชายใจดี มือเบามาก คุณหมอจะเข้าทุกวันศุกร์ จำชื่อคุณหมอไม่ได้แล้วเพราะนานมาก จำได้แค่ว่า ผ่าฟันคุดข้างขวาบนล่างเสร็จอาทิตย์ถัดมาผ่าข้างซ้ายบนล่างต่อเลย ด้วยความกลัวเลยเผลอกัดนิ้วคุณหมอไปทีหนึ่ง (ขอโทษค่ะ😅) ตอนนั้นรีบไปผ่าเพราะคุณหมอจะไปเรียนต่อ เพราะหาคลินิกที่ผ่าฟันดีๆ นานมาก ทนปวดฟันคุดอยู่เป็นปี ผ่านไปนานแล้วก็ยังนึกถึงที่นี่อยู่ ถ้าในอนาคตมีปัญหาเรื่องฟันก็จะกับไปรักษาที่นี่ค่ะ ถ้าแอดมินรู้ชื่อคุณหมอท่านนั้น กระซิบบอกหน่อยนะคะ
0x30e29fbbbb58438f_0xa8caf871db3aed0e.en: I had my wisdom teeth extracted here 10 years ago. The doctor was a kind, gentle man. He was only there on Fridays. I can't remember his name because it was so long ago. I only remember that after he had my upper and lower right wisdom teeth extracted, the following week he had my upper and lower left wisdom teeth extracted as well. Because I was scared, I accidentally bit his finger (sorry! 😅). I was in a hurry because the doctor was going back to school, and I had been searching for a good clinic for wisdom tooth extraction for a long time. I had endured the pain for a year. Even though it's been a while, I still think about this place. If I have any dental problems in the future, I would definitely go back here. If you know the doctor's name, please let me know!

0x30e299b960526a19_0xd2172f0614ca5ceb.text: Review for Dr. Pratchanun, Iconic Dental near ICONSIAM It is rare to find a dentist who combines technical mastery with artistic intuition, and rarer still to find one who does so with such grace. Dr. Pratchanun embodies that uncommon balance. From the moment I entered her care, I sensed a refinement that goes beyond routine dentistry. Her attention to detail is extraordinary. She approaches even a simple cleaning with intention and precision, as though sculpting rather than merely polishing. There is a quiet confidence in her work that allows you to relax completely. What distinguishes her most profoundly is her aesthetic eye. After my cleaning, she thoughtfully discussed how subtle composite enhancements could elevate my smile while preserving its natural character. Her philosophy is not transformation for its own sake, but harmony. She enhances without altering identity. My teeth have never appeared more luminous, nor more beautifully my own, than after a visit with Dr. Pratchanun. She is not simply a cosmetic dentist. She is a curator of confidence, an artist of proportion, and a rare presence in her field. I recommend her with complete trust.
0x30e299b960526a19_0xd2172f0614ca5ceb.author: Dominique Reiff

0x30e299b960526a19_0xd2172f0614ca5ceb.text: I don't live in Thailand but I am here for one month. I had pain in one tooth that I was concerned about a fracture with having Invisalign. 0x30e29dca2147bf37_0x26e80b7ac2386e70.text: I had a fantastic experience at Saphankhwai Skytrain Dental Clinic in Bangkok. I had a little tooth issue while visiting the Land of Smiles and did not know a local dentist. I walked into this location of Skytrain Dental and found the staff welcoming, professional, friendly, and attentive. The clinic is clean, modern, and well-equipped. The dentist explained my treatment options clearly. The quality of care was excellent, and the results met and even exceeded my expectations. I would have cost me more to park my car in the garage at a dentist’s office in the USA than the treatment cost here. Additionally, the convenient location near the Skytrain made it easy to access. I highly recommend Saphankhwai Skytrain Dental Clinic for anyone seeking reliable and top-notch dental care in Bangkok.

0x311d60734bf0002d_0xbfeb18716f86b4.text: What an amazing experience. I could not be happier. I am Australian and had All On 4 Dental Implants done in Thailand because it is so expensive in Australia and the dentists in Australia are not that experienced. Not only did I save money, I had a holiday in Bangkok, went to a JCI accredited Clinic and had the surgery done by an excellent surgeon trained in USA and the UK. I had all my remaining teeth removed and the All On 4 dental implants inserted, both upper and lower, in the clinics package deal that included transport and accomodation for 5 days. Everything was magnificent. The accommodation was excellent, the driver picked me up and dropped me off each day and treated me like I was special. The Surgeon is a very gifted and intelligent man who really did a magnificent job on me. I had a painless experience and after 4 days, walked out with a new magnificent set of teeth. Just as the clinic advertised and not as painful as I initially imagined. I am a very very happy customer and I have already booked my return in 6 months to upgrade my teeth. A special mention to Puifaii who coordinates all the overseas patients. She was amazing. So friendly and well organised. Thank you so much BFC Dental Clinic for such an amazing and wonderful experience. I should have done it years earlier.
0x311d60734bf0002d_0xbfeb18716f86b4.author: Steven Wade

0x311d60734bf0002d_0xbfeb18716f86b4.text: I had 14 veneers done by Dr A at BFC 2 years ago. Very reasonable price about US$70 each tooth. Painless, took 3 hours first day for top set, 2 hours next day for bottom set. I have enjoyed the pleasure of white teeth ever since. It was the best treat I have ever given myself. I had been resigned to have yellow, filled teeth for all my life. They are no trouble to look after and feel just like regular teeth. You can choose the shade of white you want. I just happened to be there for a check up and saw a client at the reception desk who had just finished having veneers. It is the fastest decision I have ever made to say yes and whip out my debit card. I really enjoy having beautiful teeth. Book your appointment now. A driver will come to your hotel to pick you up. Book it now Dr A only works Mon and Wed.
0x311d60734bf0002d_0xbfeb18716f86b4.author: Michelle Lockett

0x311d60734bf0002d_0xbfeb18716f86b4.text: Unbelievable! Unique! I would like to thank you for the nice, incredibly competent and professional work. I'm so glad I chose this clinic! So good organisation, so precise, accurate work. The implants are wonderfully healed. My provisional was already fantastic and sat like 1A, but where I got my right teeth, I was speechless. Excellent, fantastic! It felt like I had my teeth from birth 😂 I've never seen such a competent doctor and such a precise working doctor. The whole team was so well practised! Bravo! 0x311d60734bf0002d_0xbfeb18716f86b4.text: I recently had all-on-6 implant surgery performed by Dr. Jacky (Dr. Manapat Thaveeprungsiporn). He did an excellent job. The clinic also provided a driver who picked me up and dropped me off after each visit. I don't usually write reviews, but this was an exceptionally good dental experience. I highly reccommend BFC Dental Bangna.

0x311d60734bf0002d_0xbfeb18716f86b4.text: I am a New Zealander who has worked and lived in many countries and have been using BFC for more than 11 years. 0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.text: After suffering a severe comminuted fracture of my elbow, I can wholeheartedly recommend Thal International Hospital on Koh Samui. My elbow was so badly injured that it required complex surgery to reconstruct it with plates and screws. The entire medical team, and especially the surgeons, performed an extraordinary feat. The reconstruction of such a badly damaged elbow could hardly have been done better. Their expertise, precision, and professionalism were impressive. I would also like to highlight the excellent initial care I received at the Thal International Hospital on Koh Tao. From the initial treatment to the perfectly organized transfer to Koh Samui, everything was quick, professional, and seamless. Special thanks also go to all the nurses, caregivers, and staff. The entire team was always friendly, attentive, helpful, and highly dedicated. As a patient, you feel completely at ease from the very first moment and receive outstanding medical and personal care. The food was also excellent. It was varied, delicious, and of a quality you would expect from a fine restaurant. You really can't ask for more from a hospital. Many thanks to the entire team for the outstanding treatment and excellent care. Thanks to you, I have the best possible chance of regaining full use of my arm. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely top-notch service and highly recommended!
0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.author: Pitt Pitt

0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.text: I mean, it's a hospital. What is there to say? Went there with high fever and gastro intestinal issues at about 5.30 pm. Personal medical anamnesis was done within 10 minutes of arrival. Full diagnosis later that evening. Due to my symptoms a COVID test had to be done as well. The results for this took the longest time of all procedures done. Nurses and doctors were very friendly and proficient in English. Staff was also helpful in processing everything with and for the travel health insurance. Did not have to pay a single baht when leaving as the hospital dealt with the insurance for the most part. Got a room for myself with an extra bed for my girlfriend. TV, fridge, microwave and water kettle in the room. Small snacks and water are included. Had to stay 3 nights. Nurses available round the clock. Checking on you every few hours. Doctor's visit twice per day. Meals were ok but you can order outside food. All in all: a better experience than I ever had in Germany.
0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.author: Sören Dittrich

0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.text: I feel from a scoter at low speed. Don’t apply sun screen before driving one. Or at least clean it off your palms so they aren’t greasy. My hand was slipping from gas and trying to grab it back I added too much gas and couldn’t squeeze the breaks. My foot was pretty scratched up and broke a finger nail. EMT cleaned my foot and got me to hospital. Doctor examined me, every one was very professional and everything was clean. They told me the cost upfront, around 8000 B which is close to 250 €. I got my wounds cleaned and Tetanus shot. I got travel insurance and no worries, even if I didn’t get insurance, it wasn’t end of the world as I got savings. But it was still cheaper as I paid 20€ for insurance. Travel insurance is really cheap this days so don’t be cheap towards yourself and buy insurance when you travel. You spend more money in 7-eleven.
0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.author: Josip Ricov

0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.text: My partner has had emergency surgery here following two breaks in her leg. She was very looked after from start to finish. The surgeon was exceptional and she is very happy with the outcome . The scaring is very neat and they have cleaned the wound well every day. My hospital room was better than some hotels i have stayed in. The food was great quality and full of nutrients to help me recover fast. Last but not least the staff throughout the hospital were so friendly and kind. I was in very safe hands and felt comfortable in such a scary experience not being in my home country for my first surgery. Thank you from us both couldn’t have asked for anything more really from the bottom of our hearts.
0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.author: Abi Davies

0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.text: 5 stars is not enough. I'd give it a 10! After living on Samui for 18 years I have seen all hospitals from the inside. The one or other hospital might look a little more modern or fancy but that's only for the eye. When it comes to professional treatment, personal attention and an overall feeling of caring the Thai Inter is unbeatable. Doctors and staff are looking after you really well and the prices are well within range too. I wish good health to everyone and hopefully you will never have to go to any hospital but if you do, I can highly recommend the Thai Inter. Thank you so much for all you did for me over all these years.
0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.author: Sebastian Thorer

0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.text: After our bike accident, we were fortunate to receive care at this hospital. The staff was incredibly reliable. We were quickly transported from the accident site to their emergency room by ambulance. They took all info and proceeded with taking care of us. The hospital was very very clean, which gave us an added sense of comfort during such a stressful time. The doctor and staff were exceptionally reassuring. They adressed all our concerns with patience and professionalism. They took all the necessary steps to provide us with the best care possible, and we are truly grateful for their support during this experience.
0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.author: Rachad Koaik

0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.text: Spent two days in hospital for a stomach virus/bacterial infection. Staff are super professional and very good at their jobs. Explained all the steps at each level and always wanted to keep me informed. The nursing staff and doctors are kind, caring and explained everything along the way. Rooms are clean and spacious with TVs and a fridge as well as other amenities. Food here is great. They will even feed your companion. Check out was smooth and pharmacy explained all the medications I was being given. No one wants to get sick or injured but if you end up that way, this hospital would be my choice.
0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.author: Jason Schriml

0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.text: I do not recommend this hospital. I came in because something had bitten me and blood was running down my leg. I wanted a proper examination to understand what had happened, how serious it was, and whether anything was still left in the wound. Instead, the wound was simply cleaned with antiseptic and covered with a bandage. No real effort was made to identify what caused the injury, no proper examination was performed, and no meaningful explanation was provided. Then came the bill: more than 4,500 baht. The invoice included a doctor fee, emergency room nursing fee, OPD service fee, plus charges for gloves, bandages, antiseptic, saline solution, and other supplies. It felt as if every possible item and service had been added to maximize the bill. I understand that private hospitals charge more, but this felt less like healthcare and more like a money extraction scheme. Charging over 4,500 baht for what was essentially cleaning a wound and applying a bandage is outrageous.3300 from 4600 - just service charges The most disappointing part is that when you come in worried and needing medical help, you trust that you’re being treated as a patient. Instead, I left feeling like I was being treated as a tourist to be overcharged. If your insurance does not cover 100% of the cost, I strongly recommend avoiding this hospital. In my experience, the quality of care was nowhere near the price charged, and the entire process felt like an overpriced rip-off designed to squeeze as much money as possible out of patients.
0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.author: Liudmyla Topor

0x30e29f001d31f8bd_0xa9de7efa4abcd149.text: I came to Prism for an exam and new progressive lens prescription. I have a bad astigmatism. The staff were pleasant to work with and the exam was thorough. They had a good selection of frames to choose from as well as lens options at different price points. Given my bad eyes and difficult progressive prescription the price was around the same as I would pay in the USA but that was fully expected. I got my new glasses 5 days later and they were absolutely perfect. After wearing the same prescription for 10 years, I can’t believe how good these new glasses are and how clear my vision is. I give Prism my highest recommendation.

0x30e29f001d31f8bd_0xa9de7efa4abcd149.text: My mum and i got eye tests and then a pair of glasses each today! The staff were so attentive and patient while i took forever to decide on a frame. So after dinner we went back less than 10 minutes before closing and they completely replaced the frame for me!! Soooo kind and empathetic even tho it was entirely my fault. Thank you so so so so much team 🤩💖 I will be more careful this time!!!!!

0x30e29f001d31f8bd_0xa9de7efa4abcd149.text: The Experience: They use a very efficient, computerized eye exam system. 0x30502f2a3af02717_0x200f1a2f0812996d.text: Reached out to Nava a few wks before our trip was planned, they were quick to respond, answered questions about the procedure my bf needed done, and scheduled us a consult the day after we arrived. From the start to end of his dental work, 1 week total turn around w/ 4 appts total for 16 crowns (8 upper and 8 lower) and dealing with his old front 2 crowns that were a disaster, they were honest, professional, and didn’t leave any questions unanswered. Their front desk reception staff were friendly and awesome! All the dentist assistants and dentists were polite and genuinely care about the work they do and providing the best service they can to provide amazing end results! I also got a check up, cleaning, and take home whitening kit which has worked great so far and I am happy with it! I have very sensitive teeth and worn down enamel from GI issues w/ serious acid reflux and teeth grinding, they were honest that the Zoom whitening wouldn’t be the best option for me which I had a feeling it wouldn’t be and I really appreciated their honesty! Once we relocate there permanently, we will be coming back for all future dental work 100%, can’t recommend them enough thank you! Below are before/after pics of the work he had done!

I highly recommend this clinic to anyone in Phuket looking for honest advice, expert care, and outstanding service.

0x3050258f09521ed9_0x700892dd785e1bf1.text: While on vacation in Thailand, we had an unpleasant incident: my girlfriend became very ill on the way to an excursion and developed severe motion sickness. We used this medical center through our insurance, and it was a great decision. We were seen very quickly, and I'd especially like to thank the doctor who saw us—unfortunately, we didn't remember his name, but he really did his best. He was very attentive and calm, explained everything in detail, made decisions quickly, and oversaw the entire process. They gave my girlfriend an IV, took a blood sample, compiled a report, and gave her the necessary medications. Within an hour, she felt much better. It's clear that they are professionals, yet they have a human touch. The center, although small, is clean, tidy, and equipped with everything necessary. Thank you so much for the high-quality care and assistance. We highly recommend it!

0x3050258f09521ed9_0x700892dd785e1bf1.text: Amazing clinic, wonderful doctor and staff! I felt ill overnight, thinking I might have been poisoned. 0x310293f9b14ca899_0xcb0b55964decaff5.text: Animal Army Hospital โรงพยาบาลสัตว์ แอนิมัล อาร์มี่ in Pattaya is a truly remarkable organization that deserves all the recognition it can get. What makes this place so special is that it operates as a non-profit, dedicating its resources and efforts to helping animals in the community rather than focusing on profit margins. In a world where veterinary care can be expensive and inaccessible for many, having an organization like Animal Army stepping up and filling that gap is incredibly valuable and admirable. The team behind this operation is genuinely wonderful. Every person I interacted with was friendly, passionate, and clearly driven by a real love for animals. You could tell immediately that the people working here are not just doing a job but following a calling. That kind of dedication and heart is visible in everything they do and it creates an atmosphere of genuine care and compassion that both animals and their owners can feel. The work they do for the animal community in Pattaya cannot be overstated. Organizations like this are the backbone of animal welfare in areas where stray and neglected animals would otherwise have nowhere to turn. The fact that they provide professional veterinary care while operating on a non-profit basis shows an incredible commitment to their mission and the community they serve. Supporting places like Animal Army Hospital is supporting something that truly matters. Every visit, every donation, and every bit of awareness helps them continue the important work they do for animals that need it most. Five stars for an organization that combines professional veterinary care with genuine compassion and a non-profit mission that makes a real difference in Pattaya. If you are looking for a way to support animal welfare in the area, Animal Army Hospital is worthy of every bit of support it receives.

0x310293f9b14ca899_0xcb0b55964decaff5.text: I can highly recommend Animal Army in Pattaya. They are not only a dog rescue and animal welfare organization, but also operate a fully licensed veterinary clinic in Pattaya (Najomtien) that treats both rescue animals and privately owned pets. The veterinary team is incredibly friendly, professional, and experienced. The prices are very affordable compared to many other vets in Pattaya, while the quality of care is outstanding. Whether you need routine treatment, emergency care, surgery, or help with an injured animal, they genuinely care about every case. What makes Animal Army special is that they actively rescue injured and abandoned street dogs and provide life-saving medical treatment. If you find a sick or injured stray dog in Pattaya, they are one of the first places you should contact. They also help with adoptions, including international adoptions for people who want to give Thai rescue dogs a forever home abroad. I also find some of the negative reviews a little unfair. Animal Army is a charity organization that relies heavily on donations, volunteers, and a limited number of staff. Expecting a rescue organization to have unlimited resources, be available 24/7, or instantly respond to every situation is simply unrealistic. They are doing an incredible amount of work with the resources they have. So please be nice! TL;DR An amazing organization, a fantastic veterinary clinic, and a team that truly makes a difference for animals, pets, and street dogs in Thailand.

0x310293f9b14ca899_0xcb0b55964decaff5.text: This is the best foundation and shelter I have ever visited. The vet and volunteer staff are the kindest, most caring and loving people. These animals come in with horrendous accidents and in unspeakable conditions, and this foundation takes care of each one of them. They have saved so many lives. They have dog rescuers you can call if you find a stray on the street that needs help as well as emergency care. I found a street dog in bad condition while visiting thailand and called the foundation to pick him up, they went the next day and took him back to the foundation where he has been treated and cared for. Truly amazing people and an amazing company. Every penny goes to those animals - please donate! There are so many animals in need of adoption and the shelter works with local charities to help ship dogs or cats all over the world. If you fall in love with an animal while visiting thailand, it is 100% possible to bring them back home with you through this foundation. 0x30e29daddaf18e47_0xc6fd91e439be1efb.text: ตลอดระยะการจัดฟันมาหมอดูแลดีเอาใจใส่มากๆครับแนะนำก็ดี หมอเก่งไม่พอผู้ช่วยหมอก็เก่งมากเช่นกันครับดีใจ เราอยากรีวิวให้อ่าน เพื่อนแนะนำเรามาเพื่อนได้ทำกับพี่เอ็มเราเห็นฟันเพื่อนฟันเราเลยอยากทำบ้าง เราต้องบอกก่อนว่าฟันเราอ่ะไม่แข็งแรงตั้งแต่เด็กแล้ว ฟันเก ฟันพุ ฟันซ้อน ฟันคุตรวมๆ10กว่าซี่ จนเพื่อนพามาปรึกษาหมอและเราก็ทำเลยแบบไม่คิด เราได้จัดฟันกับพี่หมอเอกเราไม่มีความมั่นใจเลยและไม่กล้าตัดสินเลือกทำแบบไหนชอบแบบไหนเราไม่รู้เลยไม่ได้ศึกษามาก่อนเพื่อนบอกฟันแบบนี้สวยนะ (แต่ฟันเราอ่ะเหมือนเล็บตีนหมา555) เราก็รับฟังมาแต่ความโชคดีอ่ะเราเจอหมอที่เอาใจใส่อ่ะหมอว่าดีเราก็ว่าดีตามไปด้วยเราเชื่อหมอสุดๆ เพราะว่าฟันแต่ละคนไม่เหมือนกัน หมอไม่เคยบังคับให้เราทำมีแต่เราเท่านั้นที่ทำ เราคิดว่ามันต้องออกมาดี สรุปออกมาดีมากๆ ชื่นชมคุณหมอมากๆ ไม่แปลกใจเลยที่งานบริการจะดีขนาดนี้ อยากให้สัก100ดาว หวังว่าการรีวิวครั้งนี้จะมีผลต่อพี่ๆหลายคนที่กำลังตัดสินใจทำฟันครับ ขอบคุณครับ 🙏🏻

0x30e29daddaf18e47_0xc6fd91e439be1efb.en: Throughout my orthodontic treatment, the doctor was incredibly attentive and caring. His advice was excellent. 0x30da3b24686c98e9_0x3a87277961d543cf.text: TL;DR: very, very highly recommended. The service and the prices are so good I will come back here from Europe for any major procedures. Long version: I am a regular customer. Came here the first time because I live next door, keep coming back for everything tooth-related because they have amazing, professional doctors for very reasonable prices. Calm, professional, explain what they plan to do and why, never push you to some expensive procedure if there is a cheaper and less invasive way to solve the problem. There is a good reason this place has practically only five-star reviews, and it is mainly their doctors. Example: I just came back from getting 5 necessary fillings there. As a completely extra side-effect, every tooth the Doctor had to touch now looks like new. Literally better than any other tooth in my mouth that hasn't been treated here. Because the doc happens to be a restoration specialist, and it feels like he just can't help it but to make it look good. Painless procedure, despite us agreeing on no anasthetics for today. With complicated problems, the doctor thinks about them and tells you later (sometimes next visit two weeks later!) "oh, I thought about this tooth and, what I said earlier might not be necessary, I can do it this-and-that way". Or, sometimes, "I think we should leave it alone, because nothing I can do with this tooth will make it structurally better, and you have no problems right now." I think that is simply an amazing service, for many reasons. Unfortunately, I have to move back to Europe soon, but given the difference in price, service, and outcome, for anything complicated I will probably literally come back here, despite the travel costs and duration. I might not save much due to the flight, hotel, etc, but at least I know that I will get a better job done here than practically anywhere else I have ever been before (and my sample size is, unfortunately, quite staggering due to how bad my teeth are, and how often I change cities and countries).

Dr. Phum has a very gentle touch. After the procedure, I was able to go back to my normal life. The sensitivity and pain were completely gone. Now, several months have passed, and I haven't had any problems. I feel very happy. The clinic atmosphere is also great. It's clean, the staff are friendly and lovely, the music is nice, there are snacks, and they even provide blankets! 5555 I felt like I was at home. Thank you very much, Dr. Phum and the team, and I apologize for the late review. 😂😁😊🙏

0x3054f16d347b0e53_0x7082244f321eca49.text: I had an accident that caused a laceration on my right eyebrow with significant bleeding and pain, and I went to Samui Home Clinic, Chaweng, one of the most well-known clinics on the island. From the moment I arrived, the reception staff, nurse aides, and nursing team immediately rushed to assist me with genuine kindness, empathy, and professionalism, which made me feel safe and well cared for. Dr. Aratchaporn Kunasol (Dr. Pleng) attended to me promptly and compassionately 🙏🏻🥰. She administered local anesthesia very gently and painlessly before suturing. During the procedure, her technique was exceptionally delicate and highly professional, and she closed the wound beautifully. The entire team—including the nurses (Registered Nurse Bam), nurse aide Pin, and the reception staff (Khun Lady Ford)—was consistently kind, professional, attentive, and empathetic. Their warmth and sincerity truly stood out. They provide excellent care for patients from all over the world, with outstanding attention to detail throughout pre-treatment, treatment, and post-treatment. I am extremely appreciative of Dr. Pleng and her team. The clinic genuinely prioritizes patient care with remarkable kindness and empathy. The staff communicate in excellent English, the clinic is very clean, and they provide thorough and clear advice on wound care and follow-up until suture removal. Despite the high standard of specialist care, the pricing is very reasonable compared with other medical centers. I highly recommend this clinic not only for emergency care, but also for general medical care, family medicine, preventive care, and dermatologic conditions. 🙏🏻❤️
0x3054f16d347b0e53_0x7082244f321eca49.author: Chantaluk Muennarong

0x3054f16d347b0e53_0x7082244f321eca49.text: Professional doctors and nurses. Took one look at my problem and knew immediately waht it was and how to fix me up. Started off as a pimple on elbow which (don't ever try yourself) I tried to pop, big mistake absess in elbow followed with massive pain and swealing.. Doctor at clinic asked of I need local anaesthetic I didn't want but lanced infected area straight onto a antibiotic drip, all dressed super well.. had to return each fay to get wound cleaned and further antibiotic drip (it was pretty bad) anyway I cam back 4 days more for same, clean, drip, dress.. finally today it was good enough for no more drip amd dressing didn't need applied. Back to review of clinic 😀 it was great super clean super friendly staff.. I had insurance but really just for accident so I paid my own... very reasonable price 900 baht this for drip, for clean, for dressing for piece of mind from professional doctor amd nurses. Hope I do t need to come back again but of I did this is the place I wouod go.. recommend for any problem you might have . Keep safe Thank you samui home clinic chaweng
