0x3054f16d347b0e53_0x7082244f321eca49.text: Excellent efficient clinic in Chaweng. My daughter was very poorly with an infection & fever. We checked the clinic website which you can book online an appointment but we didn’t want to wait so we called and were able to come immediately. My daughter was seen in just a few minutes, had blood test, urine test, IV & antibiotics all very promptly. The doctor communicated what was wrong and we decided that our daughter would come daily for observation & tests & treatment.. We felt she was in very professional hands and we recommend the Clinic as it’s very clean & efficient. The price for initial consultation, tests and medicine & nearly 4 hours in a bed it was less than £100. The follow up consultation & IV/ antibiotic treatment was approx £12.50 per day in this day and age of poor medical facilities this clinic provided exceptional care for an exceptional price.
0x3054f16d347b0e53_0x7082244f321eca49.author: Fun Mum

0x3054f16d347b0e53_0x7082244f321eca49.text: The staff here are worth their weight in gold. I got ill when I landed in Samui (illness caught elsewhere) and with luck, I found this clinic on Google Maps just down the road. I have never been more grateful to the staff who sent a car to my hotel because I was unable to walk to the clinic, took care of me and arranged for me to get back to the hotel that night. They also worked 3 hours over their shift to make sure I was okay to leave. Their prices are incredibly reasonable and their ability to communicate in English was also really helpful and reassuring. I wouldn’t hesitate on recommending them for medical treatment, and would also recommend going sooner than you think you need, because I felt better almost instantly. They also arranged further tests and treatment on the days after to ensure I was fighting fit. Highly recommend.

0x30da255350938265_0x88f5a72bc204b1a7.text: As a judge, I sit for long periods, and as I get older, the body naturally declines, leading to recurring back, neck, and shoulder pain. He said it's treatable even with my age (which I really appreciate; it gives me the motivation to get back to work!). 😁 I especially liked that he did an ultrasound, which revealed the abnormal tendon bulge causing the pain in 3-4 spots. He gave me an injection; a quick sting is better than waking up in excruciating pain every night when I just turn over. He prescribed medication and said the pain should be gone by tomorrow. Thank you so much, Dr. Keng! 👍🙏🏻⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

0x3102960cdb1cd041_0xd9ab684afe8c21ac.text: Had a really interesting training with Mr. Na and first time experience training with his Pilates Reformer, and TRX... I'm 29 years-old, by the time I write this, I suffer from hips misalignment, knocked knees, and flat feet for as long as I know myself... I also broke two of my legs in diffrent occasion, and has a surgery during childhood... so I already knew all of it before, I wasnt seeking for diagnosis... Mr. Na's Pilates Reformer machines really guides you toward proper technique, fixing muscular imbalances etc, while the sholuder brace keeps your shoulders down, and pretty much square and even.. it's a good method to strengthen you glutes and core muscles without twisting your hips (if youre prone to compensate that way), and loading too much on your joints... I was surprised how hard my muscles worked in my last therapy session, yet my knee joint didnt get warm, tense, or burining as it usually does... Likewise Mr Na is honest, very friendly, and seems to have higher attention to details, (making sure a little more thoroughly you're using the right muscles) than most physiotherapist I've met, duing his supervisions... Other physiotherapists I've met didnt pay high regard, or were going out of their way to make sure I understand how important and how exactly should I use and work out my full body, and core muscles and all of that jazz... But i was noticed Mr. Na. Being remarkably diffrent, and has an hollistic approch.. (That being said, I must admit that I had most of my life an extremely low (real) posture understanding, and muscle awareness up untill I lost weight in early 20's, or more significantly was up untill I tried a diffrent non-conventional group therapy approch in the last 6 monthes prior coming to Pattaya, those time had really educated me about my how my body should move - I think it doesnt come intuitivly for everone...and we all should be curious and SELF INVOLVED about it, the process, and our diagnosis - to fully heal... even before of trying diffrent approches and practitioners... not just rely on other to notice that... and not just rely on western doctors which often time discourage and give you no hope to do something about it, with faking their certainty, and just tell you to use custom orthotics.... yet, despite everything I was still curious about using Pilates reformer, and to strengthen up my muscles foundation in a controlled manner, more tailored to my own pace and difficulty level, and I was pleasently surprised... I'm curious how fast my progress would go that way... Highly recommend you guys giving Mr. Na's clinic a try..

They briefly checked to make sure I was still alive, then said that without an MRI, they couldn't determine anything and that I would have to make an appointment for the next day. I was asked about my symptoms and the specific pain I was experiencing, with plenty of time and patience. Then I received very gentle treatment. I was wondering how this could possibly help. 😅 In total, I left the clinic pain-free after just one hour. I left the clinic pain-free after only one hour. 0x3102960cdb1cd041_0xd9ab684afe8c21ac.text: Amazing specialist! After 20 years of lower back pain, I feel relief! Over the years, I visited about 15 different specialists—masseurs, chiropractors, physiotherapists—with varying results. This physiotherapist in Pattaya was the first one who genuinely helped me. After just a few visits and simple, 15-minute home exercises, the pain was reduced by 60% in only two months! The pelvic massage and activation of muscles that had long stopped functioning proved revolutionary, immediately improving my posture and gait. The doctor has incredible knowledge and approaches the patient holistically—he even advised me on how to carry my bag so that it aligned with my new movement habits. I was also convinced by his open approach to taboo subjects (such as sexual activity), which demonstrates great professionalism and trustworthiness. I sincerely recommend dedicating 3–5 weeks (visiting twice a week) and following the recommendations. It is worth it! Every visit brings not only relief but a real improvement in the quality of life. Thank you kindly, and I will definitely be back!

0x30e2947666364c5f_0x8ce4643415fd922f.text: Today (March 2026), I had the opportunity to visit the Kanchanapisek Medical Center for dental care. This time, I noticed a new building under construction in front of the center 🏥. It seems the area is expanding. One thing that remains the same is that the place is quite spacious, well-organized, and clean. There's also plenty of parking space 🛻🛵🚙🚗🏍️. If you park far from the building, there's a shuttle service to take you back to the parking lot, making it convenient for those who need to use the services. After finishing my errands, I had a little time, so I walked around the ground floor. That's when I noticed there are many restaurants and cafes. I enjoyed browsing so much that I almost lost track of time. There was one shop that made me laugh at myself a little. At first glance, I mistook the sign for a gold shop, Hua Seng Heng, but upon closer inspection, I realized it was Hua Seng Hong, a Chinese restaurant selling dim sum and steamed buns, as the red sign is very similar. There are also snack shops like Auntie Anne's and several other restaurants, making the downstairs area quite lively. Browsing around was quite enjoyable and helped pass the waiting time. 🌽🍌🍋🍐🍊🥝🥑🍝🥙🌯🍛🥗🍡🍧🍨🍭🧁☕🧋🍯🍎🍒🍓🍉 Overall, I felt this medical center was spacious, well-organized, and offered many amenities, including parking, shuttle service, and restaurants, making the visit less stressful. But there are also areas where you can take a break or grab something to eat during the day.

0x30e29904148b43d7_0x8824142a95019562.text: It's like having Siriraj Hospital's clinic inside a shopping mall, at the ICS building opposite ICONSIAM. Summary of its highlights: 1. Short waiting times; not many patients yet. 2. Easier and free parking than at Siriraj Hospital. 3. New and modern equipment because it just opened. 4. Private-level service but at prices comparable to an after-hours clinic with minimal markups. 5. Diverse services, suitable for senior citizens. 6. Affordable prices. 7. Open from morning to evening; you can visit a doctor before or after work. My first visit was on the 5th floor. I had a sore throat, and the clinic had me get a COVID test first, but I had to do it myself in the restroom – a strip test. Then I waited for the doctor. I went in the evening; there were patients coming in steadily, but no waiting in line. The nurses were friendly, helpful, and cheerful. Free drinking water was provided. Payment can be made via QR code, cash, and credit card. Medication prices are the same as Siriraj Hospital; only the doctor's service fee is higher. Internal medicine doctors are available for general illnesses, but specialists require appointments. The doctors here are also from Siriraj Hospital. From what I've gathered, they're currently accepting cases until 7:30 or 8:00 PM, but the clinic itself is open until 10:00 PM. Since it's newly opened, everything looks clean, new, modern, and fully equipped, just like a private hospital. For elderly people or those in wheelchairs, it might be a bit difficult. From the parking lot to the elevator, you need to park in the correct zone and on the correct floor; otherwise, you'll have to go up and down the stairs. After your doctor's appointment, you can stop by for a meal and go shopping at ICS or Icon Siam, which are across the street. Getting there is relatively convenient with the BTS Skytrain nearby, and parking is not too difficult if you drive.
0x30e29904148b43d7_0x8824142a95019562.author: GiZMo

0x30e29904148b43d7_0x8824142a95019562.text: The location is okay, not crowded, and easy to get to. There's no parking fee (don't forget to get your parking ticket stamped!). You can claim benefits from the Government Savings Bank, just like at the main Siriraj Hospital branch. (However, Social Security benefits are not accepted; you have to pay yourself.) The service can be a bit bumpy at times, such as when many people arrive at the same time without an appointment, making it feel like they can't attend to everyone. Waiting times for patient files were very long, and people who arrived later were called first, which was a bit confusing. But I understand and can forgive that. Yesterday, I had a minor issue, but after sharing it with a staff member (I think her name was Coke), she listened, understood my concerns, and provided excellent assistance. She took me to consult with the medical records team (her name was Sai), who was also lovely, asked questions attentively, and helped me find the fastest available appointment. It was surprisingly fast – I got an appointment for the next day! This might have been a lucky coincidence that the doctor was on duty and there was an available slot. (This kind of luck doesn't happen every time!) Anyway, I want to thank all the staff and nurses involved. From the reception and screening process to the appointment scheduling team, everyone was attentive, understanding of the problem, and genuinely committed to helping us solve it. Today, I finally met with the doctor. He was very kind, thoroughly examined me, and gave excellent advice, which greatly relieved my and my family's worries. The doctor's assistant nurse was also incredibly lovely and attentive to detail. She promptly arranged for X-rays and other necessary tests, and the waiting times were minimal. Overall, it was a wonderful and very impressive experience! :)
0x30e29904148b43d7_0x8824142a95019562.author: Nitcha

0x30e29904148b43d7_0x8824142a95019562.text: Wow! I am so glad I went here for my respiratory issue. As an American I was a little skeptical because sometimes clinics can be all about selling services. Not here. I was met with a very friendly and professional staff. Very easy and clear process for in-take. Dr. Piapawn was outstanding. She took time to make sure that I understood the diagnosis and treatment. This was especially helpful seeing as I do not speak Thai. One of the best experiences I have had with a doctor anywhere. (I've been to over 60 countries. This ranks high.) Also, even though it is common in Thailand, I was still so impressed by the efficiency of having my prescriptions available for check-out, and all on the same bill. (This does not happen in the U.S.) It was very affordable for: nasal swab tests, chest x-ray, doctor consultation, and meds. On top of that, I did not have an appointment when I walked in. And still they managed to provide all of that in less than 2 hours. Plus, they handed me a CD with my x-ray results when I left. My God, I love Thai health care. On the mend now. Knowing this place is up the road from me gives me peace of mind. Thank you to all the very friendly and helpful staff at Siriraj H. Kawp Kun Kap.

0x30e29904148b43d7_0x8824142a95019562.text: School is about to start, so I came to get my 4-strain flu vaccine at Siriraj Solutions today. They're open until 10 PM, perfect for those who work late! I also consulted the doctor about the COVID-19 vaccine: The doctor said there is a vaccine, and they recommend getting it once a year. However, the symptoms are much milder than the flu, so I can decide if I want to get it again. The doctor recommended it for people with weakened immune systems. If you get enough sleep, eat well, exercise, and maintain a good immune system, that's great. In summary, both COVID-19 and the flu can affect the pneumonia, but the flu is much more severe. You can choose which to get vaccinated based on your needs. For the flu vaccine: You can get it right away. For the COVID-19 vaccine: You need to make an appointment beforehand because they need to order the vaccines from Siriraj Hospital. If you live nearby, please come! 0x30e299c4591a25b1_0x8f38db0968a38246.text: I recently completed a hair transplant with Dr. Top and his team, and they did an amazing job! I had suffered with a high forehead for decades, and The Skin Clinic restored my confidence. They understood my hair texture as an African American and truly listened to my needs. Several doctors had reached out to me, but I am so happy that I chose The Skin Clinic in Bangkok. It was absolutely the best decision. The care and attention started immediately. When I was inquiring and booking through WhatsApp, the agent was very responsive and helpful. She even responded late in the evening at times to answer my questions. When I arrived at the clinic, the entire staff was warm and welcoming, and the facility itself was beautiful, modern, and very clean. Prior to my surgery, Dr. Top met with me personally and answered all of my questions. He spoke English, which made communication very easy for me. After completing all of the required tests (blood work, HIV test, EKG, etc.), we were ready for surgery. The nurse carefully washed and dried my hair with such tenderness and care. During the surgery, everything went better than I expected. The extractions and implantations were uncomfortable at times, but they were not nearly as painful as I had heard online. There was a very kind nurse who held my hand throughout the procedure. At the time, I didn’t know who she was because my eyes were covered, but her kindness made me feel very safe and supported. I know this review is a little long, but I want people to understand how wonderful Dr. Top and his staff truly are. They care for you from the very beginning all the way through the recovery process. After the surgery, I returned to the clinic three times for hair washing and treatments. The lady who washed my hair was incredibly gentle and kind, always making sure that she did not hurt me. When I finished my final visit, I went to thank her. At that moment, she showed me a photo of herself holding my hand during the surgery. It was the same nurse who comforted me during the procedure—Ms. Yui. I immediately gave her the biggest hug. Thank you, Dr. Top and your amazing staff! There were so many wonderful people who helped me that I cannot remember everyone’s name. I do remember one lady wearing tan (light brown) scrubs who helped me throughout the entire process. I’m so sorry that I don’t know your name, but I want to thank you as well. I truly appreciated your kindness. If you are considering a hair transplant in Bangkok, I highly recommend Dr. Top and The Skin Clinic. The care, professionalism, and kindness of the entire team made this a wonderful experience for me.
0x30e299c4591a25b1_0x8f38db0968a38246.author: heart0422

0x30e299c4591a25b1_0x8f38db0968a38246.text: Dr. Top and his amazing team fixed my botched transplant from Turkey and restored both my looks and my confidence 🥰 After a failed transplant in Istanbul (with a too-low, pluggy, unnatural hairline, mainly multi-grafts even in my eyebrows, and poor density), I came to Dr. Top with a complex case. Despite his full schedule, Dr. Top video-called me several times and we discussed everything in detail. He took me seriously, consulted with his colleagues beforehand, and they created a personalized treatment plan tailored to my needs. I had a full redesign of my hairline and eyebrows — all done as a long-hair transplant without shaving a single hair. Only Dr. Top and his doctors worked directly on me. Their work was incredibly precise, clean, and gentle — every graft was carefully selected and placed. Thick grafts were moved further back, single ones placed at the front, and my brows were beautifully restored. There was absolutely no pain during or after the procedure. Even better: no scary bloody appearance, no thick crusts, and no cobblestoning like I had experienced in Turkey. Back then, the transplant was obvious even months later. This time, barely anything was visible right after the procedure — and all traces disappeared within days. I didn’t have to hide under basecaps as I did after my previous experience. I felt completely taken care of. The daily saline washes in the morning and evening gave me so much peace of mind. The transplant looked clean from day one, and my family — who had seen my last recovery, couldn’t believe the difference. I encourage anyone to come here. The clinic is trusted by locals and foreigners alike. Everyone I saw and spoke to seemed genuinely satisfied. Dr. Top really understood how sensitive I was after what I’d been through, yet he and his team took me in and corrected everything with kindness and professionalism. They didn’t let me down like the other clinic did. Everyone — from the doctors to the nurses and assistants — worked incredibly hard and with such care. I'm deeply grateful to the whole team. They exceeded every expectation, and I can confidently say they would never let a patient leave with anything less than excellent results. I genuinely recommend this clinic from the bottom of my heart. I only wish I had come here first. Thank you, all the way from Europe💛

0x30da3a63ba5115bf_0x1ede952ea899a909.text: I needed to have my glasses repaired: one of the arms had come off due to the loss of the hinge screw. The premises that house this sales center, preparation and repair of glasses and sunglasses, as well as the related activity of measuring eyesight, are large and luxurious. The assortment of frames is vast, and extends to almost all the most important brands in the world. I think anyone can find glasses to their taste. To be honest, the elegance of the environment intimidated me a little. But the kindness, simplicity and courtesy of the two young ladies who welcomed me immediately made me feel at ease. After a few minutes my glasses were returned to me repaired to perfection, and not without an accompanying smile from the gentleman who had done the work. When I asked how much I should pay for the repair, I was told nothing. I thanked him and left feeling grateful and satisfied. I don't think I need to add anything else.

0x30e298dd30968801_0xf7f2b420bf24b126.text: A dental clinic’s true quality is often reflected in the feeling you get the moment you step inside. Located diagonally opposite the renowned IconSiam shopping mall, this clinic has become my first choice in Bangkok. Having operated for many years, the clinic’s see renovation has created an atmosphere that feels spacious, calm, and exceptionally comfortable. From the instant you walk through the door, there is a noticeable absence of stress or pressure. The seating arrangement and the thoughtful use of space make the waiting experience surprisingly pleasant. The staff are consistently warm, polite, and approachable, communicating with a friendliness that immediately puts patients at ease. Their demeanor feels genuinely caring rather than clinical or rushed. The dentists deserve particular praise. The senior doctor brings a wealth of experience and professionalism, while the younger female dentist combines technical skill with a reassuringly gentle manner. Whether it is scaling, fillings, or extractions, every procedure is handled with precision and competence. While dental treatment may never be described as enjoyable, the overall experience here can certainly be considered comfortable and reassuring. Regular dental care should never be neglected, visiting only when problems arise is far from ideal. The clinic provides both a welcoming environment and services delivered to a high professional standard. The fees are reasonable, especially considering the level of comfort, care, and expertise provided. Overall, this clinic consistently delivers a positive and trustworthy experience, making it an easy recommendation for anyone seeking quality dental care in Bangkok.

0x30e29dc2510079ef_0xf3f3ad917538d04a.text: This is an honest review. I went in because of a toothache, but I didn't know what it was, so I asked for an examination first. It turned out I had a wisdom tooth that had penetrated my molar, reaching the nerve. So I needed to either have the tooth extracted or get a dental implant. But I didn't have that much money, so I chose to have two teeth extracted. It cost me 3500 baht. I think the price was very worthwhile. Because 1) I had an examination, 2) an X-ray, and 3) I had two teeth extracted, one of which was embedded in the gum, only slightly protruding. If I went to a government clinic (I checked the waiting list), I would have to wait another two months, which is a very long time. So I chose this clinic. After the extraction, I received medication and ice packs. Overall, I was very satisfied. The service was excellent, and the doctor explained everything well. For those wondering if tooth extraction hurts: The doctor injects local anesthetic. It's not painful, but there's a slight tingling sensation because it's like a nerve is being hit. But the doctor did a good job. I highly recommend this clinic for anyone considering treatment.

0x30da3b590ba0a30b_0xc6b6679da5704041.text: Previously, I struggled with severe acne, including clogged pores, inflamed pimples, and persistent acne scars, especially on my cheeks and chin. I tried many methods, including using skincare products based on reviews, changing face washes, taking vitamins, and reducing oily and sugary foods, but the acne kept recurring. Sometimes it improved, sometimes it worsened, causing me to lose confidence in public. Finally, I decided to seek serious acne treatment at Cleo. Initially, I was a little worried about the price, safety, and the possibility of damaging my skin. But after trying it, I can honestly say it was the right decision. From the moment I stepped into the clinic, the staff were incredibly helpful, polite, and provided clear information. The doctor took a very detailed history, covering my lifestyle, sleep, diet, skincare routine, and any previous allergies. They didn't push any treatments; instead, they assessed my skin problems first and explained the cause of my acne and the appropriate treatment. Overall, I was very impressed with the doctor, the staff, and the results. My acne genuinely improved, not just temporarily disappeared. If you've had acne for a long time and haven't found a solution with self-treatment, I highly recommend trying Cleo. At least you'll understand the root cause of your skin problem and receive proper care. My confidence has increased significantly. Highly recommended from a satisfied user.

0x30da3b590ba0a30b_0xc6b6679da5704041.text: After struggling with acne for years, trying many methods—creams, skincare products—but the acne kept recurring and wouldn't go away. At times, it was extremely severe, with both inflamed acne and clogged pores, along with acne scars, making me feel self-conscious in public. Then a friend recommended Cleo Clinic. Initially, I was a little apprehensive, but after actually visiting, I was very impressed. Cleo Clinic analyzes your skin condition first, revealing the true cause of your acne. The doctor and staff at Cleo give very detailed advice, explaining how to care for your skin, cleansing routine, skincare products, and how to prevent recurrence. The acne extraction is very clean and gentle; there's minimal swelling and redness afterward, unlike at other places I've been to. After consistent treatment and follow-up, I feel my skin has improved significantly. Inflamed acne has noticeably decreased, fewer new breakouts, smoother skin, and acne scars are fading. This has boosted my confidence considerably. I want to thank the doctor and staff at the clinic so much for their excellent care and guidance. They not only treated my acne but also taught me the correct way to care for my skin. If you're struggling with acne, I highly recommend consulting Cleo Clinic. It's totally worth it! My skin has improved significantly, and I feel much more confident. Highly recommend! From a satisfied Cleo Clinic client.

0x30da3b590ba0a30b_0xc6b6679da5704041.text: For anyone struggling with severe acne, I want to share my personal experience getting treatment at Cleo Clinic. Honestly, I was very hesitant at first because I had tried many methods without much results. But this clinic truly transformed my skin. Before treatment, I had a lot of inflamed acne, including small bumps and clogged pores, and it left red marks all over my face, making me extremely self-conscious. But after the consultation, the doctor gave very detailed advice and analyzed my skin condition accurately. They didn't push unnecessary treatments, so I decided to give it a try. The treatment process involved very clean acne extraction (leaving almost no scars) followed by an anti-inflammatory treatment. After the treatment, I noticed that the acne dried up faster. Within a few days, most of the inflamed acne had subsided. What I liked most was the detailed skincare advice they gave me after the treatment. This included face washing, medication application, and adjusting my daily routine to prevent new acne breakouts, so the acne wouldn't easily return. I've been receiving treatment for about 6 sessions now, and my skin has improved so much that people around me have noticed. Before, I used to have to wear thick makeup to cover it up, but now I have significantly less acne and my skin is much better.

0x30e297d163683efd_0xd13cddbeb419b81e.en: I'm usually terrified of dentists and only go to clinics for necessary procedures. Today, my front filling came out, and the dentist gave excellent advice. The dentist was very kind, providing guidance and explaining the filling process, including specific brushing techniques and areas that needed improvement. I was very impressed. The dentist even complimented me on my good oral hygiene practices. The assistant also did a great job. The reception upon entering the clinic was excellent. The service, care, and attention were great. The clinic is beautiful, the equipment is modern and clean, and they even accept social security benefits (900 baht/year), so I only pay the difference. Overall, I had a great experience here and was very impressed.

0x30e298ea61fba079_0x508db7419ac2acd9.text: I had a wonderful experience at Charoennakhon Dental clinic. I booked in for near the end of the my holiday. Today was that day. The dentist ( Dr Phanit) completed the fillings (white composite class 3) and a full scaling and polish. He has done an amazing job, very little pain at all. Spoke the Mr throughout the whole process, so I knew what was going to happen. After I needed a difficult extraction so was seen by Dr Manop he also spoke perfect English. He was also very friendly and explained everything in detail. The extraction took minuets and was painless, I didn't even realise the tooth had been removed until he told me. After they gave me some ice, ibuprofen and antibiotics. Overall the dentist was top notch, I will definitely be coming again for any work I need in the future. For all of this only ฿5191 very well priced and much cheaper than at home

I met the same person who was commenting on this. I don't know if they've read it. Please improve. A kind-hearted person with a positive attitude will improve your tone. Regarding the slow wait, I want to defend the doctor. He's attentive and thorough. He doesn't hold back or hesitate. He can complete the entire procedure in one day. If the patient is happy with it, there's no need to make multiple appointments like at other places. It's okay to be slow; I can wait. The lines at other places are much longer than here. Thank you to the doctor and all the staff.

0x30e2991c70aadca7_0x8b3d16f6e7ba1da9.text: It's been two months since I returned to Thailand. Around the beginning of the third month, I experienced severe molar pain for several days. At first, I was too scared to go to the dentist. I searched Google for a good dental clinic and saw the one opposite Pata Department Store on Facebook. The reviews were excellent, so I called to make an appointment. I was very nervous at first, but the staff and the dentist were incredibly helpful. They X-rayed my teeth, explained everything in detail, and the procedure was painless. I only felt a slight local anesthetic injection. I didn't even feel anything when the dentist extracted the tooth. The dentist also treated the tooth that I wanted to have removed because it was so painful, but they decided to keep it because it was more important than the innermost tooth. They scheduled follow-up appointments for continued treatment. Thank you so much to the dentist and all the nurses. 🙏 I highly recommend this clinic. It's excellent and painless. Anyone who is afraid of pain should definitely go here. I recommend this place. I didn't feel anything at all.

0x30e29f97e8b103af_0xba5d85b6a9754795.text: I got chin filler injections. I can see the results right away; my face looks so much softer. It wasn't painful at all, just a little tightness during the injection. The doctor had a very gentle touch. The seating area was lovely, and the clinic had a very warm and welcoming atmosphere. 🫶🏻✨ …
0x30e29f97e8b103af_0xba5d85b6a9754795.author: ศิริญากรณ์ สําราญวงค์

0x30e2978cffbf3bb1_0x33e72bb91104aae1.text: This was my first time getting a teeth cleaning here. The dentist was gentle, explained the details and price before the procedure, and clearly discussed and advised me on my oral health concerns. Overall, it was great. The counter staff (some of them) might need to communicate more effectively regarding scheduling appointments; it might be tiring, etc.
0x30e2978cffbf3bb1_0x33e72bb91104aae1.author: Kii Aii

0x30e2978cffbf3bb1_0x33e72bb91104aae1.text: ประทับใจมากตั้งแต่ก้าวแรกที่เข้าไปค่ะ คลินิกสะอาด บรรยากาศดี ไม่อึดอัด พนักงานและผู้ช่วยดูแลดี พูดจาสุภาพ ใส่ใจคนไข้จริง ๆ คุณหมออธิบายละเอียด ทำฟันเบามือ ไม่เจ็บอย่างที่คิดเลย แถมให้คำแนะนำตรงไปตรงมา ไม่ขายคอร์สเกินจำเป็น รู้สึกสบายใจและไว้ใจได้มากค่ะ ใครที่กลัวทำฟัน แนะนำที่นี่เลย ประสบการณ์ดีมาก จะกลับมาใช้บริการอีกแน่นอน 💙🦷
0x30e2978cffbf3bb1_0x33e72bb91104aae1.en: I was very impressed from the moment I stepped in. The clinic was clean, the atmosphere was nice and comfortable, and the staff and assistants were attentive, polite, and genuinely caring for the patients. The doctor explained everything in detail and gave thorough advice, allowing patients to analyze the situation comfortably without worrying about any costs.

0x30e2978cffbf3bb1_0x33e72bb91104aae1.text: วันนี้มาใช้บริการขูดหินปูนที่คลินิกครั้งแรกประทับใจมาก พี่พนักงาน ผู้ช่วย หมอ บริการดี สุภาพ ราคาไม่แพง เบามือ ให้คำแนะนำอย่างดี คลินิกสะอาด มีน้ำดื่มฟรี มาใช้บริการอีกแน่นอนค่ะ
0x30e2978cffbf3bb1_0x33e72bb91104aae1.en: Today was my first time getting my teeth cleaned at this clinic and I was very impressed. The staff, assistants, and doctor were all very helpful and polite. The price was reasonable, they were gentle, and gave good advice. The clinic was clean and offered free drinking water. I will definitely come back again.

0x30e2978cffbf3bb1_0x33e72bb91104aae1.text: ดีทำมาปีกว่าๆแล้วคุณหมอหน้ารักฟันเข้าไวราคาจับต้องได้ในการทำคลินิกสะอาดพยาบาลพูดดีบริการดีน่ารักรวมๆแล้วคือดีสุดๆใครตามหาที่ทำฟันจัดฟันขอให้เปิดใจมาทีเดนทัลฮับๆได้เลยงับ
0x30e2978cffbf3bb1_0x33e72bb91104aae1.en: I've been coming here for over a year now. The dentist is lovely, my teeth straightened quickly, the prices are affordable, the clinic is clean, the nurses are friendly and provide great service. Overall, it's the best! If you're looking for a place to get dental work or braces, please give T-Dental Hub a try!

0x30e2978cffbf3bb1_0x33e72bb91104aae1.text: It's a one-hour drive because the doctor is incredibly gentle and attentive. The staff are lovely and helpful, and the price is very reasonable, not expensive at all.
0x30e2978cffbf3bb1_0x33e72bb91104aae1.author: Nitchakan Phansuwan

0x30e2978cffbf3bb1_0x33e72bb91104aae1.text: I came for a consultation about orthodontics and the doctor gave great advice. All the staff were very helpful and provided excellent service. 💖 …
0x30e2978cffbf3bb1_0x33e72bb91104aae1.author: อีป

0x30e2978cffbf3bb1_0x33e72bb91104aae1.text: แนะนำเลยค่ะ บริการในคลินิกดีมากค่ะ คุณหมอให้คำปรึกษาและคำแนะนำดีมากค่ะ ตอนแรกกลัวหมอดุมากเพราะสภาพฟันแย่ค่ะแต่ไม่ใช่เลยค่ะ ประทับใจมากค่ะ
0x30e2978cffbf3bb1_0x33e72bb91104aae1.en: I highly recommend this clinic. The service is excellent. The doctor provides great advice and guidance. At first, I was afraid the doctor would be strict because my teeth were in bad condition, but that wasn't the case at all. I was very impressed.

0x30e2978cffbf3bb1_0x33e72bb91104aae1.text: The staff are lovely, the doctor is kind and speaks politely. The clinic is clean, tidy, and the air conditioning is comfortably cool.
0x30e2978cffbf3bb1_0x33e72bb91104aae1.author: ธนกร พันธุ์พาณิชย์

0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.text: โรงพยาบาลสัตว์โคซี่แอนด์แคร์ (Cozy & Care Animal Hospital) เป็นสถานพยาบาลสำหรับสัตว์เลี้ยงที่ตั้งอยู่ในทำเลที่สะดวกสบายและง่ายต่อการเข้าถึง ด้วยทีมสัตวแพทย์ที่มีความเชี่ยวชาญและประสบการณ์ รวมถึงการบริการที่เป็นกันเองและใส่ใจในทุกรายละเอียด ทำให้สถานพยาบาลนี้เป็นที่รักและไว้วางใจของเจ้าของสัตว์เลี้ยงหลายๆ คน เมื่อก้าวเข้าสู่โรงพยาบาลสัตว์โคซี่แอนด์แคร์ ความรู้สึกแรกที่สัมผัสได้คือบรรยากาศที่อบอุ่นและเป็นมิตร พนักงานทุกคนมีการต้อนรับที่ดีและยิ้มแย้มแจ่มใส ทำให้รู้สึกสบายใจที่จะฝากสัตว์เลี้ยงไว้ในมือของพวกเขา บริการของโรงพยาบาลสัตว์โคซี่แอนด์แคร์ครอบคลุมทุกความต้องการของสัตว์เลี้ยง ไม่ว่าจะเป็นการตรวจสุขภาพประจำปี การรักษาโรคทั่วไป การผ่าตัด การฉีดวัคซีน และการให้คำปรึกษาเกี่ยวกับการดูแลสัตว์เลี้ยง พวกเขายังมีบริการอาบน้ำและตัดขนที่มีมาตรฐานสูง พร้อมทั้งใช้ผลิตภัณฑ์ที่ปลอดภัยและเหมาะสมกับสัตว์เลี้ยงทุกประเภท ที่โดดเด่นที่สุดคือการให้บริการด้วยใจ พนักงานและสัตวแพทย์ทุกคนมีความรักและใส่ใจในสัตว์เลี้ยงทุกตัว รู้สึกได้ว่าพวกเขาไม่ใช่แค่ทำงานตามหน้าที่ แต่ทำด้วยความรักและความห่วงใยจริงๆ นอกจากนี้ยังมีการอัปเดตข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับสุขภาพของสัตว์เลี้ยงอย่างสม่ำเสมอ ทำให้เจ้าของสามารถติดตามความคืบหน้าและรู้สึกมั่นใจได้ว่าสัตว์เลี้ยงของพวกเขาได้รับการดูแลอย่างดีที่สุด หากคุณกำลังมองหาโรงพยาบาลสัตว์ที่ไว้ใจได้และมีบริการครบวงจร โรงพยาบาลสัตว์โคซี่แอนด์แคร์คือตัวเลือกที่ไม่ควรพลาด ด้วยความมุ่งมั่นในการให้บริการที่เป็นเลิศและการดูแลสัตว์เลี้ยงด้วยใจ โรงพยาบาลนี้จะทำให้คุณและสัตว์เลี้ยงของคุณรู้สึกอบอุ่นและปลอดภัยทุกครั้งที่มาเยือน
0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.author: Na Nanon

0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.text: ไปต่างจังหวัดหลายวัน ฝากน้องแมวโนอาห์ไว้กับทางโรงพยาบาลโคซี่แอนด์แคร์ แต่ละวันคุณพยาบาลจะพาน้องออกมาเดินเล่น ลูบหัวเกาคาง ปีนป่ายคลายเครียด มีรายงานทางไลน์ ถ่ายคลิปวีดีโอให้ชมการให้อาหาร น้องขับถ่ายดีหรือไม่ทุกวัน คุณหมอและคุณพยาบาลดูแลน้องดีมาก ถ้าคิดถึงก็เปิดกล้องดูน้องได้ คุยกับน้องได้(น้องก็จะเอามือมาแตะกล้องวงจรปิด กระดิกหางดีใจ คุยด้วยเมี้ยวๆ)ก่อนกลับบ้านก็ให้ทางรพ.อาบน้ำ แปรงฟัน ตัวหอมฟุ้งเลย ขอแนะนำให้ทุกท่านที่มีน้องหมา,น้องแมวมาที่นี่นะคะ คุณหมอใจดี เก่งเชี่ยวชาญ เป็นมิตรดูจากกล้องอุ้มน้อง กอดน้องทุกวัน น้องแมวโนอาห์อบอุ่น เดินตามต้อยๆเลยค่ะ แอบกระซิบราคาก็ไม่แพงขอขอบคุณทางรพ. คุณหมอ คุณพยาบาลและเจ้าหน้าที่ทุกท่านค่ะ ให้ห้าดาวเต็มเลยค่ะ😸👍🏻
0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.author: Punyisakorn Amponnavarat

0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.text: This pet hospital has been our go-to pet clinic from the start; We got our puppy vaccinated here; Some of our pet supplies, grooming (top-notched) and any immediate medical attention that our puppy would need. The ambiance is very cozy as the name suggests, people are warm and would really address your pets with their names; Well-equipped facilities; and budget friendly fees. The owner is nice and warm, always around to assist you and answer your questions. We have the nicest experience so far in this place, and i would definitely recommend it to bring your pets to! Regards, Blue's Furmom 🩵🐶
0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.author: Teacher Rose

0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.text: *การรักษามีราคาทั้งหมดแม้ช่วยชีวิตน้องแมวก็มีราคาปั๊มหัวใจ* สงสัย ว่าเปิด 24 ชั่วโมงไม่พร้อมสักอย่างเลย ผิดหวังกับการรักษาน้องแมวที่นี่มาก มาตี 2 แต่ไม่พร้อมอะไรเลยทั้งที่น้องแมวน่าบวม แต่กับฉีดแต่ยาให้แล้วก็กลับ แล้วรอดูอาการไป บริการแย่มาก พนักงานไม่สนใจอะไรเลยทำน่ายิ่งๆ จัดของไม่เกรงใจ เจ้าของที่พามารักษา คุณหมอที่รักษาน้องแมววันสุดท้ายที่น้องแมวจะเสียบริการดี น่ารักทุกอย่าง แต่ไม่ค่อยจะเก่งมากสักเท่าไหร่ ขอบคุณที่รักษาให้นะคะ ถ้ารู้รีวิวจะไม่พาไปรักษาที่นี่เลย ❤️‍🩹
0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.author: Charita Kunyosying

0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.text: I am so glad we found this pet hospital for our little Pomeranian baby! They are very dedicated and helpful when it comes to all things. Open 24/7 and you can come in spontaneously. We had our dog there for a few days when we left Chiang Mai. He was well taken care of and we got frequent updates without even asking. Very professional! Whatever concerns we have they reply very quickly on Line-App too. Very trustworthy people. I‘d bring/leave my dog there anytime again!
0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.author: Yannick Vollmer

0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.text: It's a 24-hour animal hospital. I'm not sure about Thai standards, but from my perspective (in Korea), the treatment costs are reasonable and the staff's service is excellent. (My Thai wife said it was a bit pricey.) Above all, I loved how much the veterinarians genuinely care about animals. The location is conveniently located right on the main road, and there's ample parking. It was a satisfying experience.
0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.author: Woo CH

0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.text: พาน้องแมวไปครั้งแรก แอดมิทกลางคืน 👩🏻‍⚕️👨‍⚕️ คุณหมอบริการดี พูดดีมากๆ ให้คำแนะนำละเอียดและอธิบายมากๆ ไม่ว่าจะเป็นอาการ การดูแล และการปฏิบัติ 🏪 สถานที่ให้บริการ24ชั่วโมง สะอาด กว้างขวาง ✅ นอกจากการรักษาแล้วคุณหมอยังยินดีที่ให้บริการผ่านทางไลน์หากในกรณีฉุกเฉินหรือสอบถามเพิ่มเติมอีกด้วย ❗️แนะนำหากช่วงดึกยามวิกาลติดต่อคุณหมอล่วงหน้าสักหน่อย ให้คุณหมอได้เตรียมความพร้อมในการรักษา 🟢 ค่าบริการรักษาไม่แพง สมราคา
0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.author: KKritsbabe

0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.text: I've never been a customer here before, but today my cat gave birth at home, and none of us have ever raised cats before, so we didn't know what to do. I found the phone number and called, and whether it was a veterinarian or a staff member, they gave excellent advice. I was very impressed. Thank you so much! If I have the opportunity, I will definitely use their services again.
0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.author: Lanna Grand

0x31029590f9050637_0x4639aeff87a1f50b.text: I had a spot on my back that was worrying me. Then it started to ooze. I started looking for a dermatologist. After checking out a few I landed on La Nitivadee. Her reviews were great. I arrived at the clinic for my appointment and had zero waiting time. Dr Nitivadee took me into a room and examined the spot. As suspected, it was a cyst. She asked if I wanted it removed now and I said absolutely. We went back to another room and she prepared me for the removal. The whole process took about an hour. The cyst ended being a double cyst and was pretty deep. She stitched me up using subcuticular sutures. This prevents me from having a hole in my back. I can’t say enough good things about Dr Nitivadee. She is very knowledgeable and personable. Couldn’t have been any kinder. On a side note, she also noticed a bump on my nose and diagnosed it as Basel Cell Carcinoma. I plan on having her remove it. So, for any skin care issues, please, give La Nitivadee a shot at fixing you up.
0x31029590f9050637_0x4639aeff87a1f50b.author: Steve Miller

0x31029590f9050637_0x4639aeff87a1f50b.text: I found this clinic on the internet following a small cancer growth under my skin...following a very high quote from a famous hospital IN Pattaya..i called this clinic in a morning and had the treatment the same afternoon amazing service and the Dr speaks perfect English with back up treatment and elimination all clear certificate A few friends have attended and are as happy as am I with Dr Nitivities treatment I have just attended again for a growth on my eye lid and the service as usual was amazing .. 100% accurate and painless with the correct cream and antibiotics and two weeks later the removal of the stitches completely healed anyone criticises this high level derma surgeon needs to look at themselves all of my friends now attend her clinic and are 100% satisfied
0x31029590f9050637_0x4639aeff87a1f50b.author: Peter Blyth

0x31029590f9050637_0x4639aeff87a1f50b.text: I had a cyst under my chest area that got infected. Luckily, I found Dr Nitivadee and she arranged for me to come in immediately. I tell you what…She was brilliant. She explained the options and we decided that the best option was to get it removed. It required six internal stitches and five external stitches. She knew what needed doing and got it done. I shudder to think what might have happened if I had found another skin clinic or another doctor. If you have any skin related problems, she knows her stuff and what needs to be done.
0x31029590f9050637_0x4639aeff87a1f50b.author: Shawn Sher

0x31029590f9050637_0x4639aeff87a1f50b.text: Dr. Nitivadee herself handled my treatments and was detailed, attentive, and professional throughout. Follow-ups were thorough, making sure the laser sessions were helping my rosacea without overdoing it, and she explained each step in a way that put me at ease. I had my rosacea laser treatments and the experience was great from start to finish. The clinic is well-equipped with modern laser technology. If you’re looking for dermatologist-led laser care with personal attention, this place is highly recommended.
0x31029590f9050637_0x4639aeff87a1f50b.author: Benji Harrison

0x31029590f9050637_0x4639aeff87a1f50b.text: I Recommend Dr. Nitivadee for anyone with skin problems or skin cancers involving minor surgery. I had several spots on my arm with basal cell carcinoma, one the size of a golf ball and she did a fantastic job of fully removing without all of the waiting, politics and overhead of a big hospital. Two 1-hour visits for in office minor surgery, with little to no pain, brief follow ups, almost no scaring and very reasonable rates. A++
0x31029590f9050637_0x4639aeff87a1f50b.author: JeffX X

0x31029590f9050637_0x4639aeff87a1f50b.text: After visiting dr Nitivadee with a lump on arm. I was given the choice of removal or lasser. Very good chance of skin cancer, which i experienced twice in the past. I went for removal by surgery. No pain out within 20 minutes. Results returned postive after 10 days..and free margin. Fantastic result. As good if not better.much quicker than the nhs I would fully recommend drNitivadee
0x31029590f9050637_0x4639aeff87a1f50b.author: Mark Bonner

0x31029590f9050637_0x4639aeff87a1f50b.text: Highly recommend La Nitivadee Dermatology & Aesthetic Laser Center! The staff and doctors are incredibly professional, knowledgeable, and welcoming. They took the time to explain the treatment options clearly and made sure I felt comfortable throughout the entire process. The clinic is spotless, and I am absolutely thrilled with the results. Will definitely be returning!
0x31029590f9050637_0x4639aeff87a1f50b.author: Maryke Coetzee

0x31029590f9050637_0x4639aeff87a1f50b.text: The doctor took care of a couple things for me one on my chest some growth like a cyst. I’m not sure what it was exactly she took that out and then remove some skin cancer off of my right ear. She did an awesome job I cannot complain about anything, she is very nice and does an awesome job.
0x31029590f9050637_0x4639aeff87a1f50b.author: Don H

0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.text: I attended this clinic whilst in Samui for ongoing shoulder pain I'd been experiencing whilst travelling. It was very easy to make an appointment with the clinic who responded to my email immediately. I had an appointment the next day. All staff spoke excellent English including the lovely friendly receptionist. The treatment lasted an hour. It was instantly effective with use of tens machine & combined ultrasound with electric stimulation, I think possibly her name is Rung. I booked a 2nd appointment for the same week. The 2nd Physio called Gift was very good at explaining the equipment which I haven't seen in the UK. She used a fantastic combination of heat, massage, Stretching & ultrasound electric stimulation to help relieve my pain. Again over an hour for treatment. She kindly sent me a follow up message with advice and pictures of the stretches she advise I perform. Excellent experience, wonderful talented staff. I'm sorry I'm not staying longer to avail of further treatment. Thank you Samui Physio Clinic
0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.author: Geraldine James

0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.text: I went in for treatment on my plantar fascia, and from the very first visit, I knew I was in the right hands. The clinic itself is clean, well-equipped, and has a welcoming atmosphere that immediately puts you at ease. A special thank you to Gift, my therapist, who was not only incredibly skilled and professional but also one of the kindest and most caring practitioners I've ever met. She took the time to understand my pain, explained the treatment process clearly, and worked with precision and expertise to relieve my discomfort. After just a few sessions, I felt a significant improvement, and now I can walk without the constant pain that had been bothering me for so long. If you're in Koh Samui and need top-notch physiotherapy, don't hesitate to visit Samui Physio Clinic. Their team is fantastic, and their dedication to their patients is truly outstanding. Thank you again, Gift and the whole team, for your amazing care! 🙌😊 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 Highly Recommended!
0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.author: Kovács Geri

0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.text: Very impressed. I've had serious low back issues for years (prolapsed discs needing fusion surgery), it can get very bad real quick, making me unable to walk or even stand for weeks. I tweaked my back while carrying my suitcase and I thought my holidays were ruined. I was able to get an appontment for the following day but I wasn't holding my breath, as it's usually too late when my back goes this bad. But... Gift was amazing and she sorted it! I felt much better some hours after my 1st session, and I did 2 more. It was truly unbelievable. She used machines that we don't have over here in Australia and the results are incredible! It literally saved my holidays. I genuinely wish I could find such a good physio in Queensland, who uses the same techniques. I higly recommend! Just trust their method and do the exercices they tell you to do. 👍👍👍 Thank you Gift!
0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.author: Steph

0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.text: I was looking for a chiropractor, so I didn’t have high hopes when I booked my first appointment. I was immediately impressed by their professionalism, expertise, and the results I got. After my first session, the issue I went in for was no longer an issue so, since I had signed up for a package of five sessions I just kept going and getting work done on my neck. I had no idea that Physio could work as well, if not better than chiropractic. My physiotherapist diagnosed my issue as a muscle issue, not a spine issue. In all of my years of using chiropractors, nobody has ever said that to me before. The results were amazing. The staff is very friendly and we’ll go out of their way to make you feel good. When I left Ko Samui, I was sad to leave this Clinic behind.
0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.author: Jane Latimer

0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.text: Excellent experience! I came in for some last-minute treatment before my next overseas trip and made tremendous progress in just a few days. My patellar tendonitis flared up pretty badly when I arrived on the Island. Could barely walk even with a cane and limited range of motion. After 3 sessions within 4 days I can now walk properly with only minor discomfort, restore range of motion and swim in a pool pain-free. Karim, my therapist, did a throughout examination before the 1st treatment. The procedure included ultrasound with electric stimulation, laser therapy, manual mobilization followed by application of K-tape and exercise routine for me. A detailed message was sent to me explaining all the details. I wished I’ve traveled here sooner. Thank you Karim!
0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.author: S L

0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.text: I had a lower back injury and pain for over 2 years from doing wrong deadlifts in the gym. I thought it'll go away by itself but it didn't. Then a friend recommended me to see a physio therapist in Bangkok but I couldn't find a good one quick. Then I looked in Samui and found this one here On Samui and I must say I love it! After the first session I felt a big pain relief already and after about 5 to 6 sessions the problem dissappeared almost fully. Also pricewise it's way more affordable than in Bangkok and I can highly recommend this Physio here in Samui. I've then continued the sessions while the pain has been stablelized and sometimes weeks or months go by where I forgot that I ever had it. That's an amazing improvement!
0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.author: Robert W

0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.text: I was 13 weeks post pattela detachment surgery when I arrived to Koh Samui. I paid for 5 sessions at a very affordable price, especially comparable to in Western Countries. The physio's (I seen three of the 4) where all very knowledgeable and gave me a combination of great treatment as well as exercises for home. I am very excited to say that my mobility has returned to almost 100% in 2 weeks and 5 treatments. Gift, one of the Physio's was very kind and helped me address my pain and mobility and I am so appreciative. The reception was also very helpful and worked with me to schedule around my Holiday. I highly recommend this business and will come back next time I'm in Samui even if I have no injuries. Thank You Krup
0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.author: Kyle Irwin

0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.text: Went to Samui Physio clinic with a rotator cuff shoulder injury I was struggling to shift. Really impressed with the expert treatment I received over two sessions with the wonderful physio Tan. A combination of laser, electrolysis, heat, massage and manipulation and the shoulder is moving much better with less pain after the two sessions. I’d have happily gone back for a third session but was leaving Samui so couldn’t, Tan gave me a full assessment report and a series of exercises to do to continue recovery. The clinic is about one year old, really clean and all the staff have excellent English too. Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Samui Physio Clinic.
0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.author: Philip Dalton

0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.text: Absolutely the best dental experience I’ve had in a very long time! I arranged everything via email before leaving Melbourne, and Nipa was amazing — so helpful and responsive in finalising my treatment plan. In just four days, I had two teeth extracted, a deep clean, a 3-unit bridge, and dentures fitted to cover the front gap until I return in November to complete the rest of my treatment. The clinic is spotless and modern — I was even given a blanket because the air-conditioning was so good! I felt genuinely comfortable and at ease throughout. Surprisingly, I had no downtime at all apart from waiting for the local anaesthetic to wear off. A few hours later, I was back sipping cocktails and enjoying my holiday! I honestly couldn’t believe how pain-free the whole process was — completely different to my previous experiences in Melbourne. The technology and service are just as good (if not better) than what I’ve had back home. I was quoted $23K–$24K in Melbourne — I paid $3,380 here for all this work, and my upcoming visit in November (for a 4-unit bridge and 4 veneers) will cost $5,794.46. You do the math! 😄 Highly recommend. My new local — not-so-local — dentist! See you soon Nipa, Dr Chumporn and team.
0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.author: Rebecca Attard

0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.text: I recently had an unexpected emergency dental visit while in Thailand, and I am thrilled to share my experience. I broke a tooth and needed immediate attention. From the moment I walked in, the dentist and staff were incredibly friendly and professional. They promptly examined my tooth and provided me with several treatment options. Initially, I chose the most expensive option to resolve the issue once and for all. However, after taking X-rays, the dentist noticed an underlying issue that required a course of antibiotics and a week's time to heal. Instead of proceeding with the costly treatment, the dentist advised me to take a more affordable and suitable alternative. I was genuinely impressed by their integrity and thoroughness. Most dentists might have proceeded with the expensive treatment to pocket the money, but here, they prioritised my health and well-being. The entire team made me feel comfortable and taken care of during a stressful situation. This level of honesty and care is rare, and I couldn't be more grateful. A perfect 10/10 experience—I never thought I'd say that about a dentist visit, especially one abroad! Highly recommended for anyone in need of dental care while traveling.
0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.author: Christopher Thomas

0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.text: I had an old filling in my right, lower molar crumble & eventually disintegrate a month or so before travelling to Phuket. There are a LOT of dentists available in Patong, but I hit the jackpot going to New Smile. I didn't need any cosmetic work done, just a repair &/or replace my filling. I got a walk-in appointment & checkup done by the owner. She was experienced & just lovely. There was also no charge for the review, & no obligation to continue. I liked that. In Australia, that would cost you $100 alone. It was recommended to get an xray done (only 200Baht) to confirm there was no rot below the damaged filling. Good advice & it was certainly not a money-spinner for them. I felt reassured & I was booked in a few days later. I had a full scale & clean, as well as having the old hole prepared for the new filling. It was a painless, covid-safe, & professional experience. I'd have no hesitation in recommending this dental clinic & also going back myself next time. 🙏🏼 🇹🇭
0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.author: Antony Pearson

0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.text: 6 days into my holiday and I cracked my back tooth. I was so worried about having to see a dentist abroad as I was unsure if they’d be skilled enough or how much the price would be. I walked into the New Smile Dentist and immediately felt welcomed. Luckily for me I was able to be seen straight away and the dentist was great. He spoke English, which was relieving as I unfortunately do not speak Thai, so there was no language barrier. He informed me immediately after inspection that I’d need a filling and informed me of the price- 2,500 baht. The process was pain free (I didn’t need anaesthetic) and the service was very good. The dentist really took his time to make sure it was perfect and paused throughout to check I was ok. I am very happy with the end result. I would recommend this dentist to anyone and would like to reassure people that they can trust this clinic if they to find themselves in a similar situation to me.
0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.author: Josie Cumiskey

0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.text: I wish I had taken a before and after photo. My teeth looked absolutely brand new after they were cleaned by Dr.Chumporn. I haven't had a dental checkup or cleaning in 1.5 years so decided to take a chance on one of the clinics here while in Thailand. Simple and easy booking over the phone, and all I booked for was a general teeth cleaning....but my word, it almost looked liked he gave me a whitening procedure instead (even though he didn't); that's how truly methodical, meticulous, precise, and thorough he was with cleaning my teeth. I've never had anyone do such a phenomenal and thorough job on a basic cleaning. Also the price was more than reasonable, only 2000 Baht ($82.55CAD/$58USD/£45)...I pay 4-5X times as much in Canada and never had my teeth cleaned so well. Highly, highly, recommend this for basic teeth cleaning and highly recommend Dr.Chumporn...he will do an excellent job on your teeth....I promise you!
0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.author: giggs112008

0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.text: I visited New Smile Dentist in May 2023 and now in July I am still very happy with the service I received at New Smile Dentists and the results. All of the staff are very friendly and accomodating. Dr Nis (Woranis Petchsuphamit) and her team were incredible answering all of my questions, they were very patient and gentle during the procedures. I had cleaning, whitening, a new night guard, 1 crown and 7 veneers over a few days. The time they spent answering my questions really reduced any anxiety that I had. During the procedures they communicated really well and were very gentle. I would say that it was the most gentle and relaxing dental experience I have ever had. I was travelling with a friend and they booked him in for cleaning and whitening on short notice with no issues. I will definitely be back when needed and would happily recommend Dr Nis and the team to friends and family.
0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.author: Shawn Stevenson

0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.text: I came to new smile dentist because it was one of the top rated in Patong. I had an infection in the gum near my wisdom tooth, and the doctor recommend that I come to a dentist. They fitted me in their first available slot, and the dentist was very professional and very efficient. She cleaned the area and saw that the gum was overlapping, the wisdom tooth and getting infected. She numbed the area burnt away the excess gum. Because I was already on the antibiotics. She said keep it clean, use saline and the pain should go away, but in the future, I will need to get this wisdom tooth removed. If I was staying here longer, I would have done it through them as it seems the quality of the care that you get from the dentist. Here is already more superior than the ones I have experienced in the UK. I saw Dr Parintorn. Great dentist
0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.author: Adam Prioletti

0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.text: I cannot recommend this dental clinic highly enough. I paid a high price in Australia through COVID to get my dentures and they totally botched the job. They made the teeth too short, my top lip was longer than my teeth and this made my face look out of place. I lost my smile and my top lip disappeared. I ended up with a very strong lisp as well. I decided to go to this clinic in Patong. They were double the price to most in Thailand but it was worth every cent. My dentist created a new top denture and used photos of me when my teeth were good to get an idea of what I wanted. He gave me back my smile, I have lips again and my face is back in proportion. The Australian dentist wanted to charge me to fix his bad workmanship but the Thai dentist wasn’t happy until the job was done right. Massive improvement.
0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.author: John and Annie McGrath

0x3054ffe32f164bb3_0xbb6f182359d660cf.text: A Pleasant Experience Despite an Unpleasant Situation While traveling in Samui, I had a dental emergency — a broken tooth. I spent several days trying to find a clinic that could see me quickly, but everywhere was fully booked for weeks. Since we were heading to Koh Phangan next, I started looking for clinics there. To my relief, this clinic was able to schedule me the very next day! The clinic is very clean and well-maintained, with polite staff who speak good English. The atmosphere was calm and professional. The doctor offered several options, and we agreed on a temporary solution that suited my travel plans. Now that I’m back home, my regular dentist confirmed that the temporary work was done properly, and he had no trouble finishing the treatment. Thank you to the team — you really helped me during a stressful moment!
0x3054ffe32f164bb3_0xbb6f182359d660cf.author: Alex Parepko

0x3054ffe32f164bb3_0xbb6f182359d660cf.text: A very needed dental clinic on our fast developing Koh Phagnan island ! Super clean, professional and high end equipment. They have a CT scan ! Went for a cleaning and a check up on a bad tooth… and it ended up that they were the first dental clinic in 10 years to discover what was wrong with this tooth…. When other dentists in Canada, France and Thailand weren’t even able to see what was wrong (yes - true story). Unfortunately for me, it ended up with a tooth extraction, bone work and in the next few month will go back for implant. The whole process has been explained to me and they were very reassuring. Prices are fair and in the normal range for Thailand. They offer different ranges of prices for implants. You can easily communicate in English with them through WhatsApp. Hands up to them. 🙌🏼
0x3054ffe32f164bb3_0xbb6f182359d660cf.author: Helbkk

0x3054ffe32f164bb3_0xbb6f182359d660cf.text: I came in to take care of a tooth ache. The earliest appointment available was in a couple of weeks however, a couple days later I received a message that someone canceled and if I would like to come in. The team and dentist were very polite and professional. The place was clean and the equipment was top notch. I received an assessment and recommended services. The dentist spoke very good english. Prices are fair and I highly recommend this establishment. The procedure was pretty much painless aside from mild discomfort from the injection
0x3054ffe32f164bb3_0xbb6f182359d660cf.author: OnTheRoadWith J5

0x3054ffe32f164bb3_0xbb6f182359d660cf.text: Absolute holiday saver! My front tooth fell out in week 1 of a 3 week holiday while diving. Dr Amy was amazing and not only got me in quickly, saved me by giving me a temp tooth to sort me for the remainder of the holiday. It looks so realistic, if I thought it would do the job long term I’d stick with it but her advice was that I would need a permanent fix of an implant when I get back to Aus. Thanks so much Amy, I’m back home now and proud and pleased to say the tooth survived the holiday. I highly recommend this clinic!
0x3054ffe32f164bb3_0xbb6f182359d660cf.author: Ashley Durrington

0x3054ffe32f164bb3_0xbb6f182359d660cf.text: Great place everyone very accommodating professional very clean had an emergency pain they got me in right away took x-rays gave me filling the dentist was amazing and everyone else was very nice. I have very bad anxiety and I ask alot of questions they were very patient with me. I have another issue but since I don't live here I have to take care of back home not enough time. They gave me antibiotics for the infection and pain killers. Thank you again highly recommend them .
0x3054ffe32f164bb3_0xbb6f182359d660cf.author: bern

0x3054ffe32f164bb3_0xbb6f182359d660cf.text: ich musste heute in Thailand zum Zahnarzt, denn von meinem Implantat war die Schraube locker und die Krone wackelte. ich hatte viel Glück und bekam den besten Zahnarzt auf Koh pangang. ich kann ihn nur empfehlen. vielen Dank Today I had to go to the dentist in Thailand because the screws holding my dental implant were loose and the crown was wobbly. I was very lucky to find the best dentist on Koh Phangan. I highly recommend this dentist. Thank you very much!
0x3054ffe32f164bb3_0xbb6f182359d660cf.author: Ralf Wesslegard

0x3054ffe32f164bb3_0xbb6f182359d660cf.text: Visiting on holiday from Australia, had a great experience with a single filling procedure, a clean modern clinic run as a family business. Cost for the filling was 1,500baht, a fraction of what it would be back home (private practice without health cover). Note: Giving five-stars because of the service and facilities there. Separately, I visited Koh Phangan as the husband and wife (both dentists) recently got married and I attended the ceremony.
0x3054ffe32f164bb3_0xbb6f182359d660cf.author: Joseph Tan

0x3054ffe32f164bb3_0xbb6f182359d660cf.text: I had an excellent experience with this dental clinic. I was taken in very quickly because I was in unbearable pain, and the entire team was extremely professional and caring. On Monday, I had a filling done on my last molar, and on Wednesday, they had to removed a wisdom tooth. Both procedures were handled with great skill, and I didn’t feel any pain at all. Truly outstanding care — I highly recommend this clinic. Very professional.
0x3054ffe32f164bb3_0xbb6f182359d660cf.author: David L.

0x30e29b664461e717_0x9135751c850207f.text: The shop is clean. The staff are friendly, polite, and provide good advice. The doctor has a lovely voice. Everyone smiles. The details of the service are good. Ask for information and provide good advice. Anyone thinking of using the service, I recommend it.
0x30e29b664461e717_0x9135751c850207f.author: Benjawan S. Chomphu

0x30e29b664461e717_0x9135751c850207f.text: I always use their services here. I really like the service; the doctor is attentive, and the staff follows up regularly after treatment. The atmosphere in the clinic is also quite nice. I think I'll be using their dental services permanently. ☺️
0x30e29b664461e717_0x9135751c850207f.author: Nick areeya

0x30e29b664461e717_0x9135751c850207f.text: The clinic is clean, and the admin service is excellent. The admin took care of every step of the process. The dentist was gentle and the teeth cleaning was very thorough. 10/10 (according to the National Health Security Office rating).
0x30e29b664461e717_0x9135751c850207f.author: Sirilak Chonkaewploy

0x30e29b664461e717_0x9135751c850207f.text: The staff and doctor were lovely. The clinic was clean, and the waiting time was comfortable. Luckily, they provided water to drink before the fluoride treatment; otherwise, I would have been without water for another 30 minutes. 🙏💖 …
0x30e29b664461e717_0x9135751c850207f.author: Boat Sarocha

0x30e29b664461e717_0x9135751c850207f.text: น้องที่อยู่หน้าเคาน์เตอร์บริการดีมากให้คำแนะนำดีสุดยอดเลยครับเพิ่งเคยมาใช้สิทธิ์ขูดหินปูนครั้งแรกประทับใจมากคุณหมอเช็คฟันก่อนทำ เจ็บนิดหน่อยแต่ก็พอทนได้แล้วก็นัดเราเองเลยว่าควรจะทำอะไรต่อไป ไม่เสียค่าใช้จ่ายสักบาท

0x30e29b664461e717_0x9135751c850207f.en: The staff at the counter were incredibly helpful and gave excellent advice. This was my first time using a teeth cleaning service and I was very impressed. The dentist checked my teeth before the procedure, it hurt a little but it was bearable, and they scheduled the next appointment for me. It was completely free of charge.

0x30e29b664461e717_0x9135751c850207f.text: I've been a regular customer of this clinic since 2020, and I've followed them to their Central WestVille branch. The doctor is kind, and the staff explains things very well. I highly recommend this clinic.
0x30e29b664461e717_0x9135751c850207f.author: วิไลพร คําพูชา

0x30e29b664461e717_0x9135751c850207f.text: Using my benefits here is amazing, Auntie! Both the doctor and the assistants are so kind and provide excellent service. I've used my benefits three times a year and haven't paid a single baht. Fantastic!
0x30e29b664461e717_0x9135751c850207f.author: Chalita Prompantakron

0x30e29b664461e717_0x9135751c850207f.text: I came for a teeth cleaning (tartar removal). The staff were very helpful, the dentist was very gentle, and all the staff were cheerful, smiling, and provided good information. Excellent service!
0x30e29b664461e717_0x9135751c850207f.author: Boontharika Maleekaew

0x30e29ee569962f7d_0x20755ab5b3a20cfb.text: Seems like deserted malls. From the design, it looks like designed to be food mall, but now it is not like it used to be. Only some big vendors are there such as KFC and Carls burger. Other than that not much choice we have. I went there for KFC since I craved for fried chicken that time.… my diet ruined.

0x30e29ee569962f7d_0x20755ab5b3a20cfb.text: Small market under a rooftop which is connected to to a mall and two foodcourts. Although everything is cheap, the quality of the food seems good. They have one of the best traditional Thai grilled banana there. Definitely check it out! It‘s right next to the main street.

0x30e29ee569962f7d_0x20755ab5b3a20cfb.text: Rather deserted mall, regretably. You can get coffee there, Office Mate, 7-Eleven and Tamiya are still there and several beauty doctors. …
0x30e29ee569962f7d_0x20755ab5b3a20cfb.author: BBQ

0x3102bfa346a55d1f_0xd0a3446fec837a74.text: This is a heartfelt review 💗 I decided to have surgery at this clinic because I saw so many reviews. And when I actually went there, I was impressed from the moment I stepped in. The staff were so kind and attentive. The doctor gave very direct and honest advice, didn't over-sell anything, and analyzed my facial structure in great detail. The procedure wasn't as scary as I thought; the doctor was incredibly gentle 🥹. There was some swelling after the procedure, as is normal, but the result is beautiful and subtle, naturally enhancing my face without looking artificial. Now I feel so much more confident; I can take pictures from any angle and look great. Thank you so much to the clinic for taking such good care of me 🤍✨
0x3102bfa346a55d1f_0xd0a3446fec837a74.author: Panpiree Khumsuwan

0x3102bfa346a55d1f_0xd0a3446fec837a74.text: Eyelid lift and eyebrow reduction with hidden scar. I was very impressed. I initially considered other clinics, but chose this one based on the reviews. And I can honestly say it was excellent. The doctor is incredibly skilled; the scar is hidden under the eyebrow, and they removed the drooping eyelids completely. It wasn't a long journey, and follow-up appointments were easy. There was no downtime; I could go back to work immediately after the procedure. It didn't affect my work at all. I highly recommend WMC Clinic in South Pattaya.
0x3102bfa346a55d1f_0xd0a3446fec837a74.author: lsland Channel

0x3102bfa346a55d1f_0xd0a3446fec837a74.text: I had a breast augmentation and lift done here and I'm very impressed! The doctor reshaped and lifted my sagging breasts, giving them a beautiful shape! It wasn't as painful as I expected; it was very comfortable and I can go about my normal life now. This Pattaya clinic has a specialist doctor, great prices, and the results are amazing! I never thought they could offer everything in one place. For a great clinic in Pattaya, I highly recommend WMCClinic.
0x3102bfa346a55d1f_0xd0a3446fec837a74.author: Nook Imram

0x3102bfa346a55d1f_0xd0a3446fec837a74.text: It's been 3 months since my rhinoplasty at WMC Clinic with Dr. Chon. I love it so much! The shape is beautiful, the doctor has a gentle touch, and used the Open technique to adjust the nasal structure to make it beautifully prominent. It's amazing! The clinic is close to my home in Pattaya, Rayong, so it's very convenient to travel to. The price is great, and I got the beautiful nose shape I wanted. I love Dr. Chon at WMC Clinic so much! 💖🤍
0x3102bfa346a55d1f_0xd0a3446fec837a74.author: To To

0x3102bfa346a55d1f_0xd0a3446fec837a74.text: I highly recommend this Pattaya clinic. It's conveniently located, and most importantly, the doctor is a specialist, delivering excellent results that I'm very happy with. I had double eyelid surgery here after researching several places. They offer a variety of procedures including eyelid lift, facelift, and liposuction, all performed by specialists. It's convenient, affordable, and offers complete beauty services all in one place! 😍👍👏🏻
0x3102bfa346a55d1f_0xd0a3446fec837a74.author: Tanaporn Goonna

0x3102bfa346a55d1f_0xd0a3446fec837a74.text: I had an open rhinoplasty with Dr. Chon and I was incredibly impressed! The shape is beautiful, high, pointed, and perfectly complements my face. Dr. Chon assessed my nose shape before the procedure, which was very detailed. I'm extremely happy with the result. The clinic and operating room are safe and meet high standards. For a Pattaya clinic with hospital-level standards, this is the place to go! 💓
0x3102bfa346a55d1f_0xd0a3446fec837a74.author: Nawaporn Laesun

0x30e29eb179f4f45b_0x1c3449acdde35515.text: I took my 81-year-old father to the doctor. I recommend that anyone over 75 years old should walk in before 10:00 AM (we arrived at 8:15 AM) to get a special queue number for senior citizens, avoiding long waits and eliminating the need for online bookings. (Initially, we booked online for my father, but when they found out he was over 75, they gave him a senior citizen queue number.) The process for our first visit was: Go to the 8th floor > Fill out the medical history form > Submit registration > Receive a referral slip and rest for 10-15 minutes (to stabilize blood pressure) > Proceed to the blood pressure measurement area > Weigh yourself and measure your height > Wait for your turn at the central seating area > Check the screen; they will call you for medical history according to your referral slip number > Wait to see the doctor in the room number indicated at the registration counter > See the doctor for diagnosis > Proceed to the payment counter > Proceed to the medication counter (we paid for everything ourselves; we didn't claim any insurance). The entire process took less than an hour, which was excellent. The security guards and staff were all very kind and helpful, providing great advice to first-time visitors like us. Highly commendable! Also, the facility is new and very clean, even cleaner than some private clinics. The parking garage is in the same building as the examination hall. That's very convenient! 😊

0x30e29fd9231c0ebf_0xeafd08231db388f1.text: I recently had crowns and veneers done by Dr Chutima, and I honestly could not be happier with the entire experience and the final result. From the very beginning, Dr Chutima was incredibly thorough and detail-focused. She took the time to carefully assess my teeth, explain the process clearly, and make sure every step was done properly rather than rushed. What really stood out to me was the level of precision and care that went into the work. You can tell she genuinely cares about achieving the best possible outcome for her patients. Throughout the treatment she was also extremely attentive to my comfort. Dental work can easily feel stressful, but she and the team made the whole process calm, gentle, and very professional. The final result exceeded my expectations. My crowns and veneers look natural, balanced, and beautifully done. I’ve never experienced this level of detail, care, and service from a dentist before. If you are considering dental work, I would absolutely recommend Dr Chutima. Her skill, professionalism, and attention to detail are truly remarkable. Highly recommend!!
0x30e29fd9231c0ebf_0xeafd08231db388f1.author: Samantha Johnson

0x30e29fd9231c0ebf_0xeafd08231db388f1.text: Visiting from Australia, I needed 4 crowns replaced. I contacted Smile Signature via the Web form. Cleaner than some dental clinic that I've visited in my country. I saw Dr Chutima she was absolutely lovely, very passionate about her job, language barrier was fine, she was amazing to deal with. Overall a positive experience. Thank you Smile Signature

0x30da30fb728315b9_0x8338c39bb7cdd424.text: We just adopted a 5 month old Pomeranian puppy and brought him here for a check-up, grooming and supplies. The staff was wonderful and the vet spoke excellent English. The place was clean and they had everything we needed for our new dog. When we got our puppy, he was dirty, matted, and full of fleas and ticks. The grooming team took him right in and gave him a bath, haircut, and flea treatment. The vet gave him a thorough check-up and advised us of future treatments - vaccinations, monthly flea medicine, and dietary needs. We were really impressed with the care our little puppy received.
0x30da30fb728315b9_0x8338c39bb7cdd424.author: Shawn Bitle

0x30da30fb728315b9_0x8338c39bb7cdd424.text: I have been bringing my three dogs here for many years. They're professional, polite, clean and honest. It's worth a 30 minute drive if you're not nearby. They're not over priced. It's a nice, boutique, upscale shop. If you're getting your animals bathed & groomed and don't want to spend a little extra money because you want them well cared for, bring them somewhere else. Everyone has their price points, and this place is well worth the extra baht.
0x30da30fb728315b9_0x8338c39bb7cdd424.author: Shane Cormier

0x30da30fb728315b9_0x8338c39bb7cdd424.text: It’s the only place I trust to take care of my dog. I bring him here every week for grooming, and I’ve also had his vaccinations and neutering done here. It’s clear they truly care about the pets and make them feel happy and comfortable. I highly recommend this place!
