0x30da3af09c63362f_0xf0c90caca686ff51.text: I highly recommend Family Pet Clinic. They have taken such good care of my cats during surgeries and also general checkups. The team is extremely professional and I always feel our cats are in good hands. The vets are very thorough with checkups and assessments and provide excellent bedside manner. The clinic is also very well equipped to conduct different kinds of services. For example, they have microchip services and help people prepare their pets for international travel, which is not often found in other clinics. We had both our cats successfully undergo dental scaling with Dr. New and they did a fantastic job. I’m excited about the clinic’s expansion and can’t wait to see the new services offered. Thank you again to the Family Pet Clinic team for taking amazing care of our cats! 🫶😻🙌
0x30da3af09c63362f_0xf0c90caca686ff51.author: Jillian

0x30da3af09c63362f_0xf0c90caca686ff51.text: I wanted to add to my previous 5 star review, and if I could give more stars I would. The doctors here are really fantastic, knowledgeable and really care about their patients. I take my two dogs here frequently and they're treated with the best care. My little pug had a rather complex facial and forelimb surgery, and being a bracycephalatic breed there were additional risks involved with anesthesia, but everything went very well including the post surgery care. Her follow up treatments and appointments have been informative and the doctor is suggestive of caution to care for her well-being instead of opting for expensive treatments or surgeries which could be detrimental for her. I highly recommend the doctors and nurses at this clinic, thankyou for being our go to in Chiang Mai 💚
0x30da3af09c63362f_0xf0c90caca686ff51.author: C M

0x30da3af09c63362f_0xf0c90caca686ff51.text: The BEST English-speaking vet in Chiang Mai! 10/10 experience with my stray jungle pup- diagnosing with bloodwork/ultrasound, treating her for acute parasite infection, then getting her ready to fly the the United States. So glad I found this clinic to microchip, vaccinate, draw a rabies titer, fill CDC paperwork, etc because it was less than half the price quoted on pet travel guide websites, no agent needed. My timeline was very tight- 60 days (would recommend starting much earlier than this!) but they were still able to accommodate me to travel to the US with the pup. Bonus tip- We flew on STARLUX airlines and had a great experience with them as well, enjoyed their $400 flat rate for dogs to fly. Cannot recommend this clinic highly enough!! You will not be disappointed
0x30da3af09c63362f_0xf0c90caca686ff51.author: Chelsea Hartwig

0x30da3af09c63362f_0xf0c90caca686ff51.text: First visit yesterday, after trying 3-4 other vets. Pleaseantly surprised. No 'yes yes' and nodding. If he don't know he says that, if there are various factors and/or treatments etc you can get an explanation and your questions answered (not easy to find coming from a westerns mindset..). We got a good treatment and the price is fair. Nothing special compared to others in the same area. I'm looking forward to seeing how my dog will react to the help from here. Based on the consultation and experience I'm optimistic about it. Thanks guys and see you again for the follow up. Btw. I'm better in English than in Thai, and the doctor was easily able to have a consultation in English, no worries there.
0x30da3af09c63362f_0xf0c90caca686ff51.author: geologisme

0x30da3af09c63362f_0xf0c90caca686ff51.text: We recently visited Family Pet Clinic for Honey's annual vaccination. This was our second time at the clinic since moving to Chiang Mai, and the experience was once again fantastic. Honey is a cat who is easily stressed and can get angry at the vet, but the team at Vat Clinic handled her perfectly. She was surprisingly calm and humble, showing no signs of the strong emotions she usually displays. This is completely thanks to the doctor and nurses, who are incredibly patient, gentle, and understanding. It truly seems like Honey can sense their kindness and good intentions. 0x30da3aa03025c223_0x8043421b3ef2b7fd.text: I have tried a lot of therapies, healing modalities, etc in my life and I can say that 3 sessions with Nick felt like the most impactful thing I have ever done. I recommend him so highly, if you are even remotely contemplating booking a session, just do it! In case you are wary of the term “hypnotherapy”, I will break down my experience. The first 30 minutes were more like traditional talk therapy, then Nick guided me through some breathwork and relaxation exercises to get me in a relaxed and receptive state. Then he guides you through a series of what I can best described as guided meditations and visualizations, he asks some questions, and I was welcome to speak at any time, but for the majority of the hypnosis portion of the session, Nick was doing the talking / guiding. I don’t know much about reiki, but I know that Nick is a reiki master and I now know that I would never want to do hypnotherapy with someone who is not a reiki master. His ability to follow the energy and manipulate the energy was one of the craziest things I have ever experienced in my life. My primary goal in these sessions was nervous system regulation. I am 2 weeks out from my time with Nick, and in those two weeks my HRV has increased by about 40% on average. (HRV is the key biometric indicator of if your nervous system is in fight/flight or rest/relax. The higher the number, the better). And I have felt a noticeable lightness and expansion in my body and mind. It may be too soon to tell, but my intuition says this feels permanent. My primary feedback to Nick was “I did not expect that to be so entertaining.” In the hypnotic state, I felt like I had my consciousness there watching the whole process unfold. And the theatrics that my subconscious and nervous system had to share were wildly entertaining to me. My sessions were immensely healing and helpful, but I can also describe them to others with lightness and laughter. In my experience, I was quite surprised that the things that came up in my session were not these moments of ultimate trauma and darkness, but rather misunderstandings of things that happened when I was a child, that are now very easy to understand and process as an adult. I don’t assume that will be everyone’s experience, but perhaps it is a reasonable expectation that the wounds that set you up for some darkness later in life are more easily addressed and healed than you might think, with the right guide and container. Thank you, Nick. I am so grateful that you exist and share all of your gifts and knowledge in this incredibly meaningful way.
0x30da3aa03025c223_0x8043421b3ef2b7fd.author: Optimistically Green

0x30da3aa03025c223_0x8043421b3ef2b7fd.text: I know what you were probably thinking when you first came across Nick's site/Google listing... Hypnotherapy? What nonsense. Trust me, I'm super logical, I don't believe things like that at first, and I was skeptical as all heck. What do you mean hypnotizing? How does that do anything?! But I wanted a therapist's support in person to help me with some challenges. Nick was the only male, foreign therapist I could find in Chiang Mai, so I signed up for some sessions thinking that worst case, I can always cancel them. LET ME TELL YOU SOMETHING: Signing up for sessions with Nick has been one of the best decisions I've made in the past years. Nick is extremely gifted, giving, and understanding. I was also worried he'd be too "woo-woo", seeing things about salt lamps, crystals, and reiki, on his website. But he's a very down-to-earth and real person as well that helps you work with your emotional/spiritual side, as well as your logical. His techniques have helped me work through challenges and things that I would never have been able to do on my own. Warning/heads up/suggestion: He's booked up for 2 months or so in advance. That should say something! Don't wait until you need urgent help, get signed up now and just start regularly seeing him. Otherwise, you're taking a huge risk and might never get in to see him. You won't know how it works until you go, and people tell me hypnotherapy works differently for every person so your mileage may vary... But I 110% recommend Nick and his techniques to anyone that is going through challenges, or just wants a bit of extra help. Well worth the price and time. Thanks for everything Nick!
0x30da3aa03025c223_0x8043421b3ef2b7fd.author: Noam Lightstone

0x30da3aa03025c223_0x8043421b3ef2b7fd.text: Nicholas is truly one in a million. I've worked with more than 10 therapists throughout my life, and no one has come close to Nicholas. He has a rare gift for helping people get to the root of what's really going on and actually work through it. What continually amazes me is that I can come into a session carrying something that feels heavy, painful, confusing, or stuck, and leave feeling like I've genuinely resolved it. Not just talked about it—resolved it. That has been my experience again and again. I've carried trauma and unprocessed emotions from childhood for most of my life. I also struggle with PTSD, and Nicholas has helped me tremendously in healing and processing wounds that I carried for years. Despite years of therapy, personal development work, and even powerful experiences with plant medicine, nothing was able to help me truly process and heal these emotions the way Nicholas has. The breakthroughs I've experienced working with him have been unlike anything I've experienced before. Beyond his incredible skill, Nicholas is one of the kindest, most compassionate, understanding, and caring people I've ever met. He creates a space where I feel completely safe, heard, and understood. I also genuinely enjoy talking with him. He has a warmth and humanity that makes every session feel natural rather than clinical. I consider myself incredibly fortunate to have found Nicholas and deeply grateful for the work we've done together. The impact he's had on my life has been profound. If you're thinking about working with him, my only regret is that I didn't find him sooner.

0x30da3aa03025c223_0x8043421b3ef2b7fd.text: I feel very grateful to have met Nick, a compassionate, patient and devoted person. 0x3054f18088ed9989_0x834230b59b0baa3a.text: Highly recommended. I had two teeth removed together with a crown, and honestly, I was very nervous before the procedure. However, everything went much faster and smoother than I expected. The doctor also performed bone smoothing and placed stitches. During the whole process, everything was explained very clearly: what I might feel, what I might hear, and what was happening at each stage. This made a huge difference and helped me feel much calmer. They took X-rays three times to make sure everything was perfectly done, and the X-ray was done right from the dental chair, which was very convenient. The doctor showed and explained everything in detail. I also received clear instructions for healing, aftercare, and the next steps for further treatment. The clinic is clean, cozy, and welcoming, and the staff are incredibly kind, attentive, and supportive. In the end, the price was also very reasonable. This was definitely the best dental experience we have had on Samui, and probably one of the best overall. We have now chosen this clinic as our family dental clinic and will definitely come back for any dental care in the future. Thank you so much to the whole team. I highly recommend this place to everyone 💚

0x3054f18088ed9989_0x834230b59b0baa3a.text: If you are looking for a dentist that actually cares for you then Floss Dental is the place to go. I searched all around Samui for a dental clinic for Invisalign & even checked ChatGBT it recommended this clinic. I messaged them on WhatsApp they responded very prompt & clear about the services. Booked me in basically the next day. I went and had a consult and everyone was very nice and welcoming. Hygiene was very very good & I couldn’t fault it. I was given a quote and decided to go ahead and do the program with them. Dr grace didn’t leave any information out and spent the time to explain everything to me I didn’t feel rushed at all. Awaiting the program the communication has been by far the best and easiest. I then had my appointment for installation and to collect the trays. I was given a few bonus gifts & I honestly could not fault this place. I also had a dental clean on my first appointment and everything was really well priced. I was amazed how good this clinic was & fairly priced. If you are looking for dental work this is the place to go. Thank you Dr grace & the team i will highly recommend you to many people.

0x3054f18088ed9989_0x834230b59b0baa3a.text: One word: wow. This dental practice could teach Belgian dentists a thing or two. Arrived on vacation in Koh Samui with a toothache, contacted them in the morning, and was able to go the same day. And if you think that is already great service... I was warmly guided to the treatment room, which was extremely hygienic, by the way. They placed a blanket over me, and a super kind dental assistant ensured everything went smoothly. The dentist was very professional, spoke good English, and walked me through all the options. Even during the treatment, they repeatedly checked to ensure I was doing okay, which was very reassuring. Afterward, I was given painkillers, a cold pack, and mouthwash. When I got back to the hotel, I was surprised to receive a WhatsApp message with additional tips, explanations about potential side effects, and reassurance that I could contact them anytime if I had concerns. W.O.W. And all of this for a third of the price in Belgium! So, if you're on vacation in Samui, you can visit this dental practice with peace of mind—you’ll be in great hands! Thank you to the entire team—you are amazing!
0x3054f18088ed9989_0x834230b59b0baa3a.author: Shari Woekier

0x3054f18088ed9989_0x834230b59b0baa3a.text: On the first day of vacation, a tooth broke off that held a bridge in the upper jaw, so that the bridge came loose. All dental practises, as well as the dental department at Bangkok Hospital, were already closed. Since the Floß Dental Office was open until 8 pm, we arrived 15 minutes before closing time. When they saw my problem, they wanted to help me. Since the broken tooth was no longer bearable, there was actually only one tooth left to hold the bridge. From a medical point of view, I asked the dentist to try to glue the bridge temporarily. He didn’t want to give me any guarantee that the bridge would last longer than a day. Nevertheless, he did his best and the bridge still holds after a week. Many thanks to the doctor and his team for this sensitive work. They saved my vacation on Samui

0x3054f18088ed9989_0x834230b59b0baa3a.text: First time at Floss today and I can honestly say excellent service. Deep clean took about an hour and Dr Nik and nurse Mint did a great painless job despite some stubborn areas. There was even an x-ray before to show where the heavy calculus buildup was and after to show the results. Teeth feel and look amazing now. My dentist phobia has disappeared and I will definitely be back every 6 months or so from now on to keep ontop of it. Thanks very much 🙏🏼

There are also different membership levels to receive discounts.

0x30e2a06b702e7527_0x7144c4ac5a91ab0d.text: This was the least scary dental experience of my life. The dentist was very kind and gave excellent advice. The place was clean; it was a dental clinic where even someone who is afraid of teeth could feel comfortable. Excellent!

0x30e2a3ed97859e83_0x2bfd926a70993051.text: I was so impressed! 🦷 At first, I went in feeling anxious, thinking I definitely had a cavity under the gums. But the doctor examined me very thoroughly and said it was probably just tartar that would be removed first. The doctor was very sincere, didn't drag out the case, and didn't try to get me to do anything that would cost extra money. ✨ Most importantly, the doctor had a very gentle touch. Anyone who is easily scared like me can rest assured. When I asked for extra anesthetic, the doctor only charged 100 baht for the anesthetic itself, without adding any extra service charges. It's a clinic that is very sincere and caring towards patients. I highly recommend it! 💖👍

0x30e2a3ed97859e83_0x2bfd926a70993051.text: I took my niece to the dentist for the second time. The first time was with a male dentist, but I really want to commend Dr. Mimi for her second visit. She was incredibly patient and calm, engaging the child in conversation to prevent fear. I also want to commend her assistant, Jeab (if I heard correctly), who explained everything step-by-step, making the child feel less afraid. She chatted with the child until they forgot their fear of the dental procedure and were able to respond, distracting them from the pain. Kudos to both of them! 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻

I will definitely go back for more dental work if I have any problems. 👍

I highly recommend it!

0x30e2a3ed97859e83_0x2bfd926a70993051.text: It's as everyone has reviewed. The doctor is very cute, has a gentle hand, and does thorough dental work. It doesn't hurt at all. The receptionist is also very cute and polite. She answers a lot of questions and is very nice.

0x30e29fd24e0bf1ef_0xad9c1fc63d8f9b17.text: After 2 years living in BKK, this was my first ever dentist visit. I decided to go to All About Teeth, because the service & the prices seem acceptable to me. The booking process was smooth and easy. They responded my chat fast with useful information too. Upon arrival, they sent me my appointment card, and I only had to wait for a bit until I received the treatment. I did dental fillings and scaling treatment. The dentist is super duper friendly, she speaks fluent English and I feel so comfortable because she made sure all procedures were done well. Another plus point is that they DON’T try to sell anything, instead, they only recommend and advise what’s best according to your teeth conditions. The choice is still yours. So no need to feel bad 😆 After the treatment is done, I had a little chat with the dentist and again, she gave me some advice and recommendations for other treatments I might consider to do in the future to make my teeth better. I would give the service a solid 10/10. For sure, I would visit this clinic again if (hopefully not though🤣) have another tooth problem 5555. But if you’re looking for a dental clinic, do pay All About Teeth Clinic a visit!
0x30e29fd24e0bf1ef_0xad9c1fc63d8f9b17.author: Sarah Geraldine

0x30e29fd24e0bf1ef_0xad9c1fc63d8f9b17.text: I booked a last minute appointment for a 5-step advanced teeth whitening treatment. I booked via line text message and got in within 30mins. The process included scaling, polishing, and an air blast, followed by a 40minute application of hydrogen peroxide gel in three steps, activated by a laser light. The treatment concluded with a fluoride mask to protect and strengthen my teeth. The doctor and staff were highly skilled, friendly, and communicated fluently in English. The wait time was minimal, and the Singh Tower location was fantastic, modern, clean, and conveniently situated. My teeth went from C2 to B1 🤩 STOKED!!! 😁

I went in spontaneously for a quick clean and the receptionist staff were super helpful and polite. They booked me in within the hour. The dentist was thorough and spoke excellent English. The result was much better than other dentists that I've visited previously, they took their time as opposed to the usual rushed efforts. Much appreciated and would definitely use this clinic again.

Highly recommend this clinic, especially for foreigners! I originally had my braces done in Myanmar and first visited this clinic to trim a long wire. After moving to Thailand, they were able to continue my braces treatment without any issues. The dentists and staff at the Asoke branch are all very friendly, professional, and helpful. I’m very happy with the service!
0x30e29fd24e0bf1ef_0xad9c1fc63d8f9b17.author: Bao Lin Chen

0x30e29fd24e0bf1ef_0xad9c1fc63d8f9b17.text: I originally came for just a teeth cleaning but I came back for a few fillings because the dentist and the staff were phenomenal. 0x311d5fd61ab57b13_0x9a0312019155d285.text: After spending a few years searching for a new dental clinic — since my old one stopped providing tartar removal services unless I underwent orthodontic treatment with them — I finally found an excellent option called “Tooth Journey Dental Clinic”! One of the main reasons I chose this clinic is that it’s a recently opened premium dental clinic owned by my high school friend, Dr. Nara Suriyajakyuthana. She has nearly 15 years of experience running two other successful dental clinics. When I arrived at the clinic, I was amazed by its luxurious, spacious, and impeccably clean design. They offer complimentary cold bottled water, milk, and even hot coffee made with a capsule coffee machine. Since the clinic also specializes in pediatric dentistry, there’s a dedicated playground in one corner featuring a ball pit, slide, and plenty of toys. I’m confident any child would have a joyful experience here. The modern, stylishly designed restroom also impressed me — it truly stole my heart. Dr. Nara carefully recommended the EMS airflow dental package, which she believed was the most suitable for me. She started by applying a dye to my teeth to highlight areas of plaque, clearly showing which parts I wasn’t cleaning properly. To my surprise, I discovered that while I was thoroughly cleaning the front surfaces of my teeth, the areas near the necks of my teeth were much dirtier, as revealed by the dark purple dye. Dr. Nara even used a tooth model to teach me how to properly clean these neglected areas. Next, to deeply clean the small channels between each pair of teeth, the package included an air-flow treatment, which uses a stream of air to clean these spaces without needing dental floss. Additionally, the clinic offered two types of tartar scrapers: a traditional one with consistent vibration speed and a new Artificial Intelligence (AI) tartar scraper from Switzerland, which automatically adjusts its vibration strength based on the thickness of the tartar. With only a minimal price difference, I eagerly opted to try the advanced AI technology. It turned out to be the right decision, as it was probably the smoothest tartar-scraping experience I’ve ever had, leaving my teeth perfectly clean! Since I wasn’t using dental floss, Dr. Nara suspected I might have tooth decay in the areas where teeth touch each other — spots not visible to the naked eye. The only way to check was through an X-ray, which I decided to take. Living in the US, where dental services are extremely expensive, and visiting Thailand only once a year for about a month, I wanted to ensure everything was thoroughly checked. Again, it was the right decision — the X-ray revealed accumulated tartar in the spaces between my teeth, with some pieces even buried deep in my gums. Fortunately, Dr. Nara cleaned everything in time, preventing gum inflammation. She also used a tooth model to teach me how to properly use dental floss for cleaning between my teeth. Since I only visit Thailand once a year, I prioritize finding a dental clinic that provides high-quality service to help maintain my teeth throughout the year while I’m in the US. Based on this fantastic first experience, I’ll definitely return next year! As Tooth Journey Dental Clinic is newly opened, they’re offering many attractive promotions and discounts — so be sure to check them out!

0x30e2b9aff5ac4587_0xb21a0c08094477b8.text: I visited this branch after researching composite bonding options from the UK, and I’m really glad I made the trip. Dr. Mings is about an hour outside central Bangkok by Grab bike, but it’s absolutely worth it for the level of service. I initially turned up unannounced to ask about composite bonding. They took a look at my teeth and did an X-ray, explaining that I needed a deep clean and seven fillings first. Everything was clearly communicated and booked in for the very next day at 10am—great service from the start. My third visit was to complete the remaining fillings, as there was too much to finish in the previous 3-hour session (which also included the cleaning). One thing to note: they only accept cash or bank transfer, so be prepared for that. On my fourth visit, I had the composite bonding done. They created a mock-up of different shades on my upper teeth, and I ended up getting eight teeth done in total. My only regret is choosing a shade that’s slightly too white. During the mock-up, the brighter shades were placed on my smaller teeth, while the two front teeth were matched or only slightly brighter. The final result looks amazing, but it was a bit of a shock at first because of how bright it is. Overall, the service has been fantastic from start to finish, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them

0x31029743f3406791_0x2210fe0a5a1d0f6a.text: Today is finally the day to review The Loft Clinic! 😊 I was impressed from the start by Khun Koy, a sales representative who provided excellent advice to someone completely unfamiliar with any procedures. She patiently listened to my needs, calmly explained each machine in detail, and recommended which machine would be best suited for me. Then came the consultation with Dr. Bas. Dr. Bas was incredibly patient and kind; listening to his recommendations was so relaxing. My first treatment was Ulthera 500 Lines, with a promotional offer including Red Touch Pro 200 Lines. Dr. Bas performed the procedure meticulously, constantly asking if I was okay and if it hurt. Just hearing his voice gave me the courage to persevere! 🤣😅 I'm very satisfied with the results. My second visit was for a follow-up 5 months after my first Ulthera treatment, as I needed my face to look great quickly. This time I met with Dr. Ink. Dr. Ink explained both the machine and injectable treatments in detail, clearly differentiating the differences, and recommended a procedure that perfectly matched my needs, limitations, and conditions. This time, we did the MPT 600 line and got a free Volnewmer 600 line. The results were even more noticeably lifted immediately after the treatment. Plus, the sales representative, Khun Koy, was so kind to let us try Pico Toning as well (we understand that the freebies are based on purchase amounts and monthly promotions). But Dr. Ink also included Pico Toning, which helps with freckles and melasma, as a freebie. Since our skin needs time to scab over after the treatment, and we'd never had any procedures before, we were incredibly paranoid and stressed for the first week (Dr. Ink said the process would improve in two weeks... You need to trust the process 😅). But Khun Koy, Dr. Ink, and the clinic took amazing care of us. They answered all our questions and concerns, provided assistance, followed up on our progress, and gave us medication to reduce irritation. Our skin looks amazing now! All that's left is the minor touch-up on the freckles and melasma from the Pico Toning, which Dr. Ink will schedule weekly checkups for. I want to clarify that I'm not a paid endorser; I paid for everything myself. But I'm writing this review because I'm truly touched and impressed by the care at The Loft Clinic. Thank you to sales representative Koya for being so patient with me, even though I was a bit moody and sulky at times before I finally trusted the process 🤣😘 Thank you for being so understanding towards a newcomer like me. Thank you for making visiting the clinic so comfortable and allowing me to choose my own beauty treatments without anyone pressuring me to buy courses. Thank you to Dr. Bas and Dr. Ing for choosing treatments that were perfect for my skin, needs, and age. And finally, thank you to all the staff at the clinic who were always so cheerful and smiling every time I visited. (The clinic has many price options and courses to choose from, so you can find something that suits your budget. Sales representative Koya is lovely; please be kind to her!) 😉☺️

He also inserted collagen and bone grafts. Now the implant is perfectly straight. I want to commend Dr. Wu. He was meticulous and attentive in every detail. He had 3 CT scans and 2 3D scans. The dentist spent 3 hours fixing my dental work, and even when I offered to pay extra, they refused, saying they just wanted to do it for me. I don't know how to thank them enough. I want to spread the word that there are still incredibly skilled and honest dentists out there! I've never met such a good person before. 0x30e2993f238aedff_0x388000f833b22e35.text: มาใช้บริการ 2 อย่าง คือ ขูดหินปูน และอุดฟันที่ผุค่ะ ข้อดี- คุณหมอดูเป็นคนใจเย็นมีสอบถามบอกบริเวณที่น่าจะเจ็บทุกครั้งว่าเราไหวมั้ยเลยรู้สึกอุ่นใจ และราคาไม่แพงอย่างที่คิดตามที่ดูรีวิวก่อนเข้าไปใช้บริการเลย รวมถึงคลินิกสะอาดฟีลคาเฟ่ ที่จอดรถสะดวกมากคือจอดที่อาคารจอดโลตัสปิ่นเกล้าข้างๆได้ ลงมาชั้น 1 เดินทะลุทางออกไปเดินเข้าอาคารได้เลย และน้องที่เคาน์เตอร์คือพูดจาดี ยิ้มแย้มดีมากค่ะ ข้อที่ติดใจนิดเดียว- คือ คุณหมอกับผู้ช่วยคุยกันตลอดเลยทำให้มีบางช่วงตามบริบทการสนทนามืออาจจะไม่นิ่งบางช่วงคืออยากให้โฟกัสคนไข้มากขึ้นอีกนิดนึงค่ะ และบางทีคุณหมอต้องถามหาอุปกรณ์ระหว่างทำไปด้วยไม่ได้มีการเตรียมรอ ทำให้อาจจะรอบางช่วงนิดหน่อย (แต่แบบแปลบเดียวไม่ได้รออะไรนาน) โดยรวมบริการดีถ้าปรับข้อที่ติดใจนิดเดียวที่นี่ก็ดีมากๆเลยค่ะ ถ้ารีวิวแล้วอาจไม่ถูกใจต้องขอโทษด้วยนะคะ
0x30e2993f238aedff_0x388000f833b22e35.en: I used their services for two things: teeth cleaning and filling a cavity. Pros - The dentist seemed very calm and always asked about potential pain points, making me feel reassured. The price wasn't as expensive as I thought, considering the reviews I read beforehand. The clinic was clean and had a cafe-like feel. Parking was very convenient; you can park in the Lotus Pinklao parking building next door, go down to the first floor, and walk through the exit to enter the building. The staff at the counter were very polite and friendly. Minor concerns - The dentist and assistant were talking constantly, which sometimes caused their hands to be shaky. I wish they would focus more on the patient. Also, sometimes the dentist needed to ask for equipment during the procedure without having it ready, resulting in a short wait (but it was only brief). Overall, the service was good. If they could fix these minor issues, this place would be excellent. I apologize if my review isn't to your liking.

0x311d7d66070583d7_0x43d78d2af8c248fb.text: Today I brought my child for a teeth cleaning. Dr. Trisukon was very patient and had great psychological skills in talking to my child, which made my child not afraid of dental work at all. The treatment was excellent, thorough, and very gentle. The clinic was clean, the price was reasonable, and they even had toys!

0x3054f184076cd82d_0x819ac4eda3d1277e.text: I just got my lashes done here and I’m so thankful. I got them done last week somewhere else and I hated them, most of them fell off in less than a week and she said they were mega volume (which they most definitely were not). I wanted to get them fixed by nubdaw immediately but she was fully booked until next week. However luckily she had a cancellation and could fit me in today and she’s done them exactly how I like them. The bed I was on was so comfortable and she was so delicate I could barely feel her there! I was trying my hardest not to fall asleep! (My eyes always sting afterwards/ during aswell which means I can never relax getting them done) but I had/have 0 pain. I’m very happy thank you so much , I love them 🥰🙏 the only person I will now go to in Samui!
0x3054f184076cd82d_0x819ac4eda3d1277e.author: Elisabeth Peters

0x3054f184076cd82d_0x819ac4eda3d1277e.text: I had eyelash extensions at this salon in Koh Samui, and it was the best choice I could have made. I was forced to do it because the treatment I had in Italy was terrible and painful. The technician was extremely gentle, removing the old work, full of excess glue, without hurting me or damaging my natural lashes. They let you choose the type based on pictures and advise you on whether it's right for your eye shape. In Italy, they told me this treatment wasn't right for me and my eye shape; you be the judge. The technicians are super professional, gentle, and attentive to the client and to cleanliness. As for the cost, it's in line with island prices, negligible compared to the European average, and significantly lower than the quality, which is EXCELLENT!
0x3054f184076cd82d_0x819ac4eda3d1277e.author: Sabrina Di Mella

0x3054f184076cd82d_0x819ac4eda3d1277e.text: I am so happy to have found this salon. After a really bad lash experience in another place on Samui I was quite worried trying to do lash extensions again. However lashes star beauty exceeded my expectations, they have the exact same quality and standards that I had with my previous lash tech in Bkk. They are professional and it’s really good value for what you might find on the market. I also had the pleasure of doing my gel nail extensions there, P’Nook is truly amazing at his job. He will make you comfortable as soon as you arrive and respect the design you want, or if you’re unsure, he’ll help you out pick the perfect design. This is now my go to salon for nails and lashes and I seriously recommend it to everyone on Samui.
0x3054f184076cd82d_0x819ac4eda3d1277e.author: Mohelie Coiron

0x3054f184076cd82d_0x819ac4eda3d1277e.text: I had such a wonderful experience at this salon! I came in for lash extensions, a manicure, and a pedicure, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. The quality of the work is absolutely top-tier, and you can really tell the staff take pride in what they do. Everyone was so attentive and made sure I was comfortable the entire time. The team is genuinely amazing, and the owner is just as lovely—so welcoming and professional. From start to finish, it was a great experience. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend this salon to anyone looking for accurate, relaxing and quality services!
0x3054f184076cd82d_0x819ac4eda3d1277e.author: Zan Mehta

0x3054f184076cd82d_0x819ac4eda3d1277e.text: Great beauty place , this is my second time coming, I’m very pleased. This is the first Thai salon where instruments are sterilized after each client. The girl who gave me a pedicure did a foot massage, body wrap, scrub and now my heels are like a baby's bottom. I also do eyelash extensions, everything is very neat and professional, and it’s also a big plus that almost everyone speaks English. Thank you for your work 🫰

0x30da250036ec1561_0x14b18ac6d4a7d01b.text: I highly recommend PhysioX, a physiotherapy and Pilates studio in Chiang Mai. From the very first inquiry, their team responded quickly and professionally, making me feel well taken care of. I came here with a shoulder injury caused by office syndrome, and the specialists at PhysioX gave me excellent advice and a clear rehabilitation plan. After six months of consistent physiotherapy and guided Pilates training, I’ve already seen remarkable improvements—even though my doctor originally estimated it might take two years to recover. The studio has a warm, welcoming atmosphere, and the combination of physiotherapy and Pilates here not only helps with recovery but also supports long-term health and reduces the risk of future injuries. With qualified instructors like Teacher Looknok and a highly professional team, PhysioX has truly become one of my favorite places in Chiang Mai.❤️
0x30da250036ec1561_0x14b18ac6d4a7d01b.author: Parada Chansree

0x30da250036ec1561_0x14b18ac6d4a7d01b.text: 10 out of 10, no deductions ✨ The location is convenient and clean. The classroom and studio vibe are a bit more like a serious clinic; it might not be as hip and trendy as girly activities. But the learning atmosphere is great. Even on my first visit and first class, I felt that the instructor didn't neglect me. They constantly monitored every student throughout the class and paid attention to detail 🥹💖 Time flew by because the classes were fun and physically challenging. If I thought I couldn't do something, the instructor would come around to support and push me until I succeeded. Overall, I was impressed, even though the classes were quite grueling 😂💪

0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.text: My husband and I recently needed a COVID test to get back into the US but had a full itinerary and were worried about squeezing it in and we were also worried about overpaying. I was able to get in touch with this clinic over facebook messenger and they were super quick to respond and extremely helpful with my questions and requests. We only had a 30min time slot in our schedule to get tested before our boat tour, and they were so willing to work with us. They were super quick, efficient, and made sure that we were out of there on time. The Rapid COVID test was also only 200 baht which was a great price. The front desk was so polite and helpful and the facility was clean and organized. They are a fairly new business which explains the lack of reviews, but I would highly highly recommend this place if you are looking for a clinic!
0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.author: Annie Welton

0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.text: An excellent experience. Following an injury that caused extensive abrasions to my arm, shoulder, knee, and foot, I had the opportunity to visit the Dr. OCEAN Clinic, where I received prompt and professional care. The treatment lasted a week, during which I was constantly monitored, supported, and cared for by the staff. I would like to express my gratitude in particular to Dr. Otto, who guided me with dedication and professionalism throughout the entire process. His thoroughness and attention to detail were remarkable. Special thanks also go to Dr. Su and Dr. Sim, whose contribution was crucial in managing documentation and communicating effectively. In short, if you need medical care, I highly recommend this clinic. I have personally witnessed the high level of satisfaction among patients, both Westerners and international.
0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.author: Roberto Drazza

0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.text: I have been treated the last few days at Dr Ocean's clinic for dehydration and sever UTI and the team here has been absolutely amazing. They sent a car to pick me up as soon as the hotel staff contacted them (around 10pm at night) and brought me back. They questioned me, took stats, urine sample and bloods (to rule out kidney/blood infection) and gave me IV antibiotics over 3 days. I saw improvement the next day and am now symptoms free. I was also given meds to relieve symptoms and follow up oral antibiotic for 5 days. They explained everything in detail, and cared for me with a smile, patience and so much kindness. They also cleaned and dressed my daughter's wound. Dr Ocean's - I am so impressed with your service and so grateful to you all, thank you so much for everything you did for me 🙏
0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.author: Odeya Barr

0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.text: Absolutely perfect!! I came in last night for emergency treatment after being stung by a jellyfish during an excursion. The medical team took care of me immediately and did everything necessary. A huge thank you especially to the doctors, who explained everything to me point by point: they were very attentive and patient with me. They also treated another injury I sustained during the excursion. I returned to the hotel feeling great and reassured! The paperwork was all handled quickly and easily. They even prepared my medication for me, so there was no need to go to the pharmacy. When you're not from the country, you're always a little worried about how you'll be received, but you can come here without hesitation! Thank you to the entire team at Dr. Ocean!
0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.author: Selim Bor

0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.text: The people at the clinic were very quick and professional. We went for an RT PCR test at 10.30 in the morning and got the report via email by 8.00 PM in the evening, just exactly as they had told us. The tests cost 1800/- and are most probably less expensive than any other nearby clinic. The clinic is located just by the side of the road and is easily accessible. We messaged them ahead of time through Facebook messenger and everything was set up. The lab was also extremely clean and tidy. The staff are very caring and they replied to all our messages even for the smallest thing. I highly recommend this lab for any of your tests which you may require to do while in Aonang, Krabi. Five stars from me.
0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.author: B

0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.text: I needed a thumb bandage after surgery elsewhere. I couldn't have the surgery here because they only had lidocaine, and I'm allergic to it. Here, it would have cost me three times less and without any scams. I highly recommend this place! They changed the bandage, answered all my questions, and provided competent and professional care. You can tell they genuinely want to help you. I only paid 500 baht for the bandage. For comparison, at the hospital where I had the surgery, they charged me 5,400 baht for the bandage—they're scammers. But here, the people are wonderful and honest. I highly recommend this clinic!
0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.author: Катрин Щ.

0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.text: Very friendly, fast, and professional service, and English is available. I contacted the clinic after an animal exposure – I was scratched by a monkey on a mountain trail. Fortunately, the medical staff at the Dr. OCEAN clinic took care of me immediately and explained the post-exposure procedure. Anyone traveling to the national park regions where monkeys can be encountered is strongly encouraged to get vaccinated against rabies and tetanus before arrival – this can help avoid the weeks-long post-exposure procedure! I highly recommend and send my best regards to the medical team at the Dr. OCEAN clinic!
0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.author: Shadow

0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.text: Im so thankful to Dr.OCEAN Clinic ! They took care of my covid test, and made all perfect ! I was so worried about this damn test, because I had to fly to Japan, where they are very meticulous about the documents. The clinic took care, and independently found a form to fill out from the official state website of Japan. So, at the airport in Japan, I did not have any problems! If you want to get excellent service, at an affordable price, in a clinic with a very convenient location (5 minutes from Ao Nang beach) - choose Dr.OCEAN Clinic ! They are the best 🔥♥️🌷

0x311d5d3f320ca1ff_0xd74b0097ecd030b3.text: มาขูดหินปูน -การจอง ง่าย สะดวก -ขูดหินปูดมาไม่เคยเลือดออกไรฟันเยอะแบบนี้ ขูดค่อนข้างแรงไป (คาดว่าคิวน่าจะเยอะ เลยรีบหน่อย) -เรื่องชำระเงิน รับเงินสดและส่วนต่างไม่แจ้งก่อนทำให้ไม่ได้สำรองเงินสดอาจจะเสียเวลาหน่อย แนะนำใครมาพกเงินส่วนสำรองส่วนต่างไว้ด้วย
0x311d5d3f320ca1ff_0xd74b0097ecd030b3.en: I came for a teeth cleaning (tartar removal). -Booking was easy and convenient. -I've never had this much bleeding between my teeth before. The scraping was quite forceful (I suspect there were a lot of people in line, so they were rushing). -Regarding payment, they only accept cash and didn't inform me beforehand, which meant I didn't have enough cash on hand and might have caused some delays. I recommend bringing extra cash for any additional expenses.

0x30e28fd78ef133b9_0xce218a903696de83.text: เลือกจัดฟันและดูแลสุขภาพช่องปากกับทางคลินิก เพราะ อ่านรีวิวทางเพจว่าคุณหมอมือเบามาก ๆ พอมาใช้บริการจริงรู้สึกประทับใจในการให้บริการจากคุณหมอ และพี่ ๆ เจ้าหน้าที่ที่คลินิกค่ะ เคยรับบริการผ่า-ถอนฟันคุด ถอนฟัน และขูดหินปูนกับที่นี่ ไม่เจ็บเลยค่ะ เหมือนในรีวิวเลย คุณหมอมือเบาทุกท่าน บริการดี สะอาด อาจจะมีบางช่วงที่ต้องรอคิวนานบ้าง ต้องเข้าใจว่าคนไข้ที่มารับบริการค่อนข้างเยอะ พี่พนักงานทุกคนก็ตั้งใจบริการอย่างสุดความสามารถแล้วค่ะ โดยรวมแล้วให้ 5 ดาวไปเลย⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

0x30e29edb32f94fb5_0xf5356585bf6e02b5.text: I chose Truth Dental based on Google reviews and convenience of location. I was very happy with my choice. I had been suffering a strong toothache for several months whilst traveling through Africa and Asia. On arrival in Bangkok I decided to put off treatment no longer. My entire experience with the clinic was positive. They were very responsive during initial online inquiries. I was able to get an appointment quickly. The office and equipment were alltop-notch. The staff were efficient and kind. I ended up needing two root canals on adjacent teeth. This was not a complete surprise but certainly an unpleasant fact. Dr Supason Thitthaweerat performed the procedures. Due to pre-existing complications with the root this required three visits. For one of which he was able to squeeze me in to his full schedule due to discomfort on my side. My interactions with Dr Thitthaweerat were entirely satisfactory at all levels. His professionalism, kindness, and clarity in what the situation with my teeth was and options in treatment was enormously helpful and reassuring. I travel in Asia frequently and intend to use Truth Dental for my future dental needs. I heartily recommend Truth Dental and Dr Thitthaweerat.

Wow wow wow...I cannot recommend Truth Dental Clinic enough, these guys are the best!!! The first day I arrived in Bangkok I needed to get my wisdom teeth removed, I contacted Truth Dental in the morning and they got back to me straight away, later that day I was in the clinic getting the removal done! Everyone I saw was amazing, from the dentists and nurses, to the receptionists! They make you feel very looked after and are very thorough in their approach to everything, from doing what ever scans need to be done, to explaining everything to me in a way that made me feel very cared for and considered, especially with something as intense as getting surgery done in a different country. After the surgery, anytime I needed something checked, I could go back in to see them either that day or the next, again the dentist was incredibly thorough with any after-care that needed to be done, I have never had such a lovely experience with a dentist at home! I will absolutely be coming back to Truth Dental for anything I need done in the future, thank you all so much 🙏 😊

I woke up with severe wisdom tooth pain and messaged the clinic first thing in the morning. To my relief, they fit me in for an extraction the very same day. I've always dreaded the dentist and was incredibly anxious about the procedure, but Dr. Chonlatee completely exceeded my expectations. He was incredibly patient and talked me through the entire process. The whole team was amazing— they really went above and beyond to calm my nerves by playing music, giving me a teddy bear to squeeze, and using the E-Flow Anesthesia Injection. If you are someone who is terrified of the dentist, I 100% recommend booking an appointment here. Ask for Dr. Chonlatee and his team —you will be in the absolute best hands!🙏🏽

0x311d6347dc6b8925_0xe5a13918b82945b9.text: KC Wellness in Bangkok is an excellent wellness clinic that delivers a top notch experience across the board. The consultation was handled with genuine care and professionalism, with the team taking the time to understand individual needs and provide tailored advice that felt truly personalized rather than generic. You could tell the staff was knowledgeable and passionate about what they do, which immediately builds trust and confidence in the services being offered. The speed of service was impressive without ever feeling rushed. Everything moved efficiently from arrival to consultation to treatment, respecting your time while still ensuring every step received the attention it deserved. In a world where wellness clinics often make you wait endlessly before anything happens, KC Wellness runs a tight and well organized operation that gets you in, takes care of you, and sends you on your way feeling great. The location itself deserves a mention for its cool and modern design. The clinic has a stylish and contemporary feel that sets it apart from the typical clinical environment you might expect. Walking in feels more like entering a premium lifestyle space than a medical facility, and that kind of atmosphere plays a big role in making the whole experience feel comfortable and enjoyable rather than sterile and intimidating. The friendly staff ties everything together perfectly. Every interaction was warm, professional, and genuinely welcoming. There was no hard selling, no pressure, just honest advice delivered by people who clearly care about their clients and take pride in what they do. Five stars for a wellness clinic that combines expert consultation, efficient service, a beautiful location, and a team that makes you feel valued. KC Wellness sets the standard for what a modern wellness experience should look like.

I can't believe the results from the HBOT, just from the first session I noticed results in my hands( I suffer from arthritis, which has left a few fingers very stiff, and unable to fully bend) after first session, I could bend those fingers more then had been possible in the last year. The blood test was very in-depth, the lovely clinic Dr was very informative and explained every part of the test results, and how to move forward to get optimum health. The whole staff where very sweet, friendly and highly professional. I definitely will go back to KC Wellness, whenever I'm back in Bangkok next.

0x305031eab1c35885_0xc96472cd76cfb0bf.text: I`d like to describe our experience in this condominium, and show all advantages and disadvantages from our side 🧐 Hope it will be helpful for somebody 🙂 📍LOCATION: central part of Phuket. Close to the biggest mall in Phuket (few km) and big supermarkets (even by foot). But far from the beaches. 👨‍💼 PROPERTY CONSULTANT: good communication skills and English. He guided us very professionally in the very beginning and through our further staying. 🏡APARTMENTS: small, but pretty nice and cosy. We rented 1-bedroom flat, it`s 34 square meters, but to be honest, it feels less. Good enough for a couple. But maybe too small for family with kids and if you have a lot of stuff, so it would be better to rent 2-bedroom apartment. 🍽 KITCHENETTE equipped with basic culinary utensils and appliances, microwave, fridge, small electric stove, toaster (useless for us). We were in great necessity of any elementery coffee maker here instead of toaster. 🛋 LIVING ROOM and hallway in one. Here is a sofa (could be used as full bed), air condition, TV. 🛏 BEDROOM: good hard mattress, wardrobe, linens (2 sets), 4 towels and 6 pillows, TV, air condition. 🚿 BATHROOM: a shower with electric water heater, good ventilation in it. ⛱ BALCONY: with washing machine (it`s a great advantage!), hanger and some place for smoking or drinking coffee. 🏔We had mountain VIEW called «Monkeys hill» 🐒 (by the way, nice place to visit 😉). So it was quite in the morning and noon, but sometimes it was loud live music on the night market nearby till night. 🚗 🛵Guarded bikes and cars PARKING only for condo residents (you need to put special sticker on your bike or car to avoid a fine). Sometimes it`s not enough places for cars. 👨‍✈️ CCTV, access to condo only for residents, no strangers. Security guards and other staff are friendly. 💎2 elegant LOBBIES has enough space for relax or work, but air conditioning could be switched off and it becomes hot. 🌴Nice GREEN ZONES with lawn, trees and palms. Сleanliness maintained everywhere. Comfortable shared spaces outdoor and smoking area. 🏊‍♀️ SWIMMING POOL is clean, around 20-ish meters long. There is also small pool for kids. Available from 7 a.m. till 10 p.m. Depends on the time of a day it could be crowdy or nobody there. But annoying insects are 24/7 here 😁 🏋️‍♀️ GYM is too small, but better than nothing. 7 trainers for cardio, 2 benches and dumbbells (pairs from 2,5 kg till 25 kg). No barbell 🙁, so if you are training with free weights, you will have to exercise your imagination with only dumbbells 😃 Available from 7 a.m. till 10 p.m. Enough place for stretching or yoga nearby gym🧘‍♀️ To sum up briefly, nice place and good value for money. Recommended if you are going to stay for 1 month and more. To avoid any conflicts just follow the rules of using sharing areas, be polite and enjoy! 😊

0x305031eab1c35885_0xc96472cd76cfb0bf.text: Staying here in an AirBnB. Nice pool, small gym that has treadmills, crosstrainers, bikes and free weights. The guards are helpful when the Grab taxi gets lost on the way. There is not much space in the kitchen (or anywhere in the apartment) but a one bedroom is okay for a couple with few possessions or only staying for a few weeks. The condo has strict rules about not hanging laundry over the balcony rail, which can be tricky if you don't have a proper clothes horse. There is not a lot of useful places very close by, other than the Tesco Lotus (which has a Starbucks, food court and other vendors) and Chain of Love Cafe. If you stay here, you will need either your own transport or the willingness to spend on Taxis. Phuket is not a pedestrian friendly place if you're going more than a block.
0x305031eab1c35885_0xc96472cd76cfb0bf.author: Midtown Owl

0x305031eab1c35885_0xc96472cd76cfb0bf.text: The apartments are small but adequate. It’s close to amenities but not close enough that it’s convenient. Tesco is kinda close but also far enough to be a pain (on the road you need to drive quite a distance to navigate the highway on the way back). The place is nice enough for a short stay but it’s in a dead part of town, with nothing in comfortable walking distance, so don’t really expect to be going anywhere without getting on your scooter on in a taxi. Having a mini-mart or bar/restaurant on-site would be a game changer.

As a passionate Muay Thai athlete who trains intensively, I often struggle with minor injuries and strains. Because of this, I've tried many different types of massage in Germany and Thailand, including some from well-known providers and therapists. Most recently, I suffered for months from a painful strain of my psoas muscle, which radiated into my hips, back, and shoulders. Even three sessions with a competent osteopath couldn't completely alleviate my discomfort. During my stay in Hua Hin, I went looking for a truly excellent massage and found Annie at Healthy House. On my first visit, I discovered she was fully booked, but I was easily able to reserve an appointment for the following week using an online tool. Most recently, I suffered for months with a debilitating strain of the psoas muscle, which radiated into my hips, back, and shoulders. Even three sessions with a competent osteopath couldn't completely resolve my symptoms. During my stay in Hua Hin, I went in search of a truly good massage and found Annie at Healthy House. I'm thrilled and grateful, and I can wholeheartedly recommend Healthy House Massage. Annie was also incredibly courteous, professional, and friendly. As soon as I return to Hua Hin, I'll definitely book more appointments!

0x30fdab03d1e71865_0xb35ccf6d73dbad48.text: I have had l lower back issues for many, many years. I had my second treatment yesterday with Annie and I have to say early days but I do like the approach she takes, the treatment therapy she gives, and most importantly the self-help stretching techniques she has shown me. So far I am very impressed and I understand with a long-term issue there is no instant fix but I do feel we are heading in the right direction. 0x3054f7f6b91b2653_0x1df6cc6c26c7cb11.text: My husband and I were involved in a very serious traffic accident with multiple injuries, and I spent the first two weeks in the intensive care unit.During one of the hardest times of my life, I experienced an incredible level of care, kindness, and humanity in this hospital that I will never forget. The nurses and staff in the ICU were unbelievably kind, caring, and helpful. Whenever I needed anything, someone came within seconds. They washed and cared for me from head to toe every day, and they even braided my hair for me. Despite my condition, I was always treated with dignity and compassion. The doctors checked on me daily and carefully monitored everything. Because my condition was very critical and my husband was extremely worried, Dr. Dear constantly updated him about my condition and always took the time to explain everything. When I was transferred to the regular ward, I had the exact same positive experience. The nurses were incredibly attentive, loving, and always there whenever I needed help. Especially during situations that felt uncomfortable or embarrassing to me, such as being washed or having my diaper changed, they never made me feel ashamed. Instead, they always reassured me that it was completely normal and part of their job. After several weeks in the hospital, I began struggling mentally and went through depressive phases. Whenever the nurses noticed me crying, some of them would sit with me for up to 30 minutes just to comfort me and cheer me up. That kind of compassion means more to me than words can describe. The wound care team was also amazing. The man who cleaned my wounds every day was incredibly kind and made me feel completely comfortable. The nurses from the wound care department were equally gentle, professional, and caring. One moment I will never forget was my birthday during my stay in the ICU. I was heartbroken that I had to spend it in a hospital bed, but Dr. Joy, the gynecologist, and the nurses still managed to make it a beautiful day for me. They brought me a cake and even a gift. I will always be grateful for that kindness. There was also another doctor — unfortunately I cannot remember his name — who showed exceptional kindness. I had asked him why I had a heavy coating on my tongue even though I do not smoke and had barely eaten. He explained everything to me very patiently. I told him it would be enough if he simply told my husband where to buy the proper products. But the next morning, during his rounds, he personally brought me a mouthwash and a tongue scraper. I will never forget such a thoughtful gesture. The rooms were also excellent: very large, modern, and always clean. A cleaning service came every day. We had our own bathroom, a kitchen, TV, WiFi, and even a couch so my husband could stay and sleep beside me. The view was beautiful as well. I would never wish a hospital stay on anyone. But if someone ever needs medical care, I truly hope they receive the same level of treatment and compassion that I received here. Thank you to the entire staff — doctors, nurses, cleaning staff, and everyone involved.You have my deepest respect. Despite all the pain and injuries, you made my stay as comfortable and positive as possible.Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
0x3054f7f6b91b2653_0x1df6cc6c26c7cb11.author: Selin Baba

0x3054f7f6b91b2653_0x1df6cc6c26c7cb11.text: A Top-Notch and Affordable Healthcare Experience with Great Food at Wattanapat Hospital on Samui Three months ago, Wattanapat Hospital on Samui opened its doors to the public, providing an incredible healthcare experience that surpasses even its high-priced competitors. I recently had the pleasure of being a patient here, and I am compelled to share my outstanding experience with others. The hospital's modern, state-of-the-art facilities and commitment to maintaining a high standard of cleanliness left a lasting impression on me. The staff at Wattanapat Hospital is truly exceptional - caring, professional, and always willing to go above and beyond to ensure patients are comfortable and well taken care of. An additional aspect of Wattanapat Hospital that I particularly enjoyed was the fantastic selection of Western food available. As someone who appreciates good food, I was thrilled to find American-style pancakes and delicious cheese and egg sandwiches on the menu. The quality and taste of these dishes were excellent, providing a sense of comfort and familiarity during my stay. What sets Wattanapat Hospital apart from other facilities, such as the overpriced Bangkok Hospital on Samui, is its affordability without compromising on quality. The hospital offers a range of room options, including standard and VIP rooms. I stayed in a standard room and was thoroughly impressed by its spaciousness (over 30 sqm), spotless en-suite bathroom, smart TV, and super-fast Wi-Fi. Not only does Wattanapat Hospital offer a superior healthcare experience, but it also does so at a much more reasonable price point compared to other establishments in the area. This makes it an excellent choice for both locals and visitors in need of medical attention. In conclusion, Wattanapat Hospital on Samui has quickly become a game-changer in the healthcare industry on the island. With its top-notch facilities, caring staff, competitive pricing, and delicious food options, I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone in need of medical care. Five stars well deserved!
0x3054f7f6b91b2653_0x1df6cc6c26c7cb11.author: Greg Borowczyk

0x3054f7f6b91b2653_0x1df6cc6c26c7cb11.text: I was on vacation with my family and unfortunately developed a high fever and diarrhea during the night. So I went to the hospital. I was seen immediately and filled out a questionnaire – the staff seemed a bit annoyed, perhaps because I was a tourist. After a short time, I was taken to the emergency room in a wheelchair. There, I received a check-up and was immediately put on an IV drip due to dehydration. Everything was very clean, and the staff were very friendly and even used translators if I didn't know the medical terminology in English. I was advised to stay overnight because, according to a blood test (the results were available just one hour after the sample was taken!), I had bacteria in my gastrointestinal tract. 🩺 After that, I was admitted to a ward. I was checked on every one to two hours, which made a very positive impression. The food was absolutely good compared to what I'd get in Germany. My medication was always brought to me, and I was given an explanation of its purpose. The staff always provided the medication and explained what it was for. . ... ❤️ A very special thank you goes to Dr. Sasipa (Tan) 🥰 and Kitiwan (Nam), 🥰 nurse – thanks to these two lovely ladies, I felt completely at ease and can only offer the highest praise. This is exactly the kind of treatment you want, no matter where you are, especially when you're in a foreign country with a different language. Absolutely fantastic!!! 👍🏼 This allowed me to catch my flight home the next day. I can definitely recommend this hospital from a medical perspective. At the end, I received a bag of medication to take with me, with individual instructions on what each medication was for and how to take it. 💊 Thanks to my international health insurance, everything regarding costs was sorted out on-site, and the process was smooth. 📑

0x3054f7f6b91b2653_0x1df6cc6c26c7cb11.text: This review is based purely on the organisation and administration of the hospital, not the medical staff. I gave birth here and had been a registered patient for quite some time. I attended regular appointments with my doctor, had a birth plan in place, my insurance was approved, and all paperwork had already been completed. Despite all of this, when I arrived in labour and was literally being wheeled through reception to give birth, the staff stopped us and insisted that we make payment immediately. At that moment I was about to push and deliver my daughter, yet they were demanding payment before the birth had even happened. They could not even know at that stage what type of birth it would be or what the final cost would be. We were also staying in the hospital for two nights afterwards, and of course we had passports, credit cards and everything needed to settle the bill. The timing and lack of judgement in that situation was incredibly stressful and unnecessary. Unfortunately, this is not an isolated incident. Every single time we visit this hospital there seems to be confusion at the entrance, even though we are already registered patients and all of our information has been on file for years. We are repeatedly asked for passport copies, there is constant confusion about insurance, and it often causes delays that make us late for our appointments. Even after the appointment, the same pattern continues. When waiting for medication there are often further delays because paperwork has not been sent to the pharmacy or insurance details are questioned again. The medical staff themselves have been good, but the level of disorganisation among the administrative staff is extremely frustrating. When you or your child are unwell, the last thing you want to deal with is repeated confusion and delays over paperwork that the hospital already has on file. It really takes away from what could otherwise be a very good hospital experience.
0x3054f7f6b91b2653_0x1df6cc6c26c7cb11.author: Sara Morgan

0x3054f7f6b91b2653_0x1df6cc6c26c7cb11.text: I received treatment at this hospital under my social security insurance for a breast lump. Most recently, today, I went for my appointment, but I was still being passed back and forth between the social security ward and the surgical ward. I'm very disappointed with the system that doesn't prioritize patients and social security insurance. My case was initially sent to this ward, but the counter staff told me to go back to the original ward. They kept passing me around. In the end, I had to go back to the surgical ward for treatment. I traveled from Koh Phangan, spending both money and time taking time off work. I didn't even get to eat breakfast while waiting. (Anyway, money is more important.) However, I would like to commend the nurse in the social security ward for her politeness, enthusiasm, and for being the only one who truly cared for the patient. I hope the hospital will take this matter into consideration and improve its service system, uphold medical ethics, and prioritize social security beneficiaries more than they currently do. รู้สึกไม่สบายใจที่จะฝากน้องให้ทางคลีนิคนี้ดูแลอีกต่อไป จากเหตุการณ์วันที่30 มค. 19:00น. พาน้องมารักษาเพราะโดนพิษจากคางคก สัตวแพทย์ไม่เชี่ยวชาญพอที่จะวินิจฉัยโรคได้ครบ ทำการรักษาเบื้องต้นแค่ฉีดยาแก้แพ้ และรอดูอาการเพียงแค่10นาทีและปล่อยให้กลับบ้าน ทางเราได้ถามแล้วว่ารอดูแค่นี้เพียงพอแล้วหรือ? ก็ได้คำตอบแค่ว่าถ้าแพ้หนักกว่านี้ ก็จะแสดงอาการใน10-15นาที เพราะสัตวแพทย์รีบปล่อยให้น้องกลับบ้าน และน้องก็อาการหนักขึ้น! แล้วขับรถไปๆกลับๆ ทั้งเสียเวลา และเสี่ยงต่อการรักษาชีวิตน้องไปมากแค่ไหน! ลองคิดดู เราได้โทรกลับไปหารพ. อีกครั้ง เวลา19:40น. ก็ได้คำตอบว่า ทางรพ. ไม่สามารถรักษาได้ ให้ไปรพ.สัตว์ที่มีความพร้อมมากกว่า! จากการวินิจฉัยไม่ครบถ้วนและไม่ละเอียดพอของรพ. แห่งนี้ จึงไม่เจอแผลในช่องปาก 2 จุด และมีเลือดออกจากพิษ มีอาการตาบวมแดงทั้ง2 ข้าง เหนื่อยหอบ ต้องให้น้ำเกลือโดยด่วนเพราะเสี่ยงช็อค ต้องดูแลอย่างใกล้ชิด และต้องระวังอาการไตวาย เนื่องจากน้องแพ้พิษหนักมาก ยิ่งเสียเวลาไปมากทำให้พิษกระจายมากขึ้น ถ้ารพ. ไม่มีความสามารถพอ ควรแจ้งกับเราโดยตรงและเร็วที่สุด เพื่อไปรพ. สัตว์ที่มีความพร้อมมากกว่าคุณ เพื่อไม่ให้ทางเราการเสียโอกาส และเสียเวลาที่จะรักษาน้องได้ทันท่วงที หวังเป็นอย่างยิ่งว่าทางรพ. จะไม่ทำเช่นนี้กับใครอีก

0x3102be6ebaf98977_0xc210511f5d614ae6.text: Since I heard it starts at 8:30 AM, I decided to go a bit early and wait. I arrived around 8:05 AM, but the doors were already open and the PCR testing area was accepting people. I received number 4. However, a woman came running almost as if she were trying to overtake me with only a 2-3 second gap. I was about to yield but decided against it. So, she couldn't overtake me. (This is where the twist begins.) But it turned out she was a travel agency employee who had brought Korean tourists. While I was getting my number, about 40 Koreans who had been on two minibuses rushed in. It turned out she was a local travel agency employee trying to get ahead of everyone else and register as a group first. Because of that 2-3 second difference, I almost ended up with number 44 instead of 4. It is really wise to go early and wait. If you are unlucky enough to be later than the travel agency shuttle, there is no hope. After that, several foreigners kept coming in as well. I recommend going as early as possible. They ask for a copy of your passport when you get your number; bringing it speeds things up a bit, but if you don't... they just make a copy for you there. I also heard that a plane ticket is required, so I printed out my airline e-ticket and brought it, but they weren't interested in it at all and it wasn't needed. They give you a paperwork form clipped to fill out. It's a questionnaire asking for your English name, nationality, occupation, address, whether you have COVID symptoms, whether you work in the medical field related to COVID-19, whether you came from a high-risk area for confirmed cases, etc., so most people end up checking "no." You just need to fill out your vaccination history, the name of the shot, and where you received it. I wrote it incorrectly and crossed it out with lines, but they said it didn't matter. I was too lazy to write the name of the hospital where I got vaccinated in English on the site, so I just wrote "hospital," but they later corrected it to "Korea Hospital." They overlook pretty much everything. ^^; I thought I would just clip my number, passport copy, and completed documents together and start right away, but I had to wait again. I sat in a chair like that until it started at 8:30. When it was my turn, they called out the number. After confirming my number at the table next to where I initially received it, they reviewed my completed documents and passport copy, made necessary corrections, and asked for 900 baht. After paying in cash, they gave me a stamped receipt. (You can pick up your results the next day using that receipt, so please keep it safe.) Then, I moved to a chair at the table right next to it. There, they re-checked my documents, stamped them, and said everything was done. I took that to the staff table near the waiting area. After reviewing my documents, they wrote my name on the test reagents and cotton swabs, and told me to take them and sit in the very front chair in that waiting area. Once there, I went to the testing chair in order to receive the test. One oral test, one nasal test. And that was it. It was around 8:50 when I finished everything. The process was on the slow side. When I asked on my way out, they told me to come back the next day at 10:30 to pick up the results. The email service was discontinued after the price changed to 900 baht. It costs 3,500 baht at the International Hospital in downtown Pattaya. A certain YouTube video claimed that if you book through a travel agency at a certain hotel, it costs 1,900 baht, so I asked that agency directly, and they said it was 2,400 baht. The price has gone up. And here, it's 900 baht. It's a profit even if you take a Bolt Taxi for a round trip for two days. When I received the results the next day, it showed that I was tested at 11:00 the previous day, and the printout indicated the results came out at 5:00 PM the previous day. Therefore, since the time starts counting from the day before the test, make sure to time your return within 48 hours. I hope you get tested cheaply and use the remaining money to treat yourself to something delicious one more time. I wish you a great trip! ^^
0x3102be6ebaf98977_0xc210511f5d614ae6.author: Vega

0x3102be6ebaf98977_0xc210511f5d614ae6.text: Visited on May 24, 2022. I arrived at 8:30 AM, the opening time, but there were only four people there. Even by 9 AM, when the PCR test was over, there were only about 10 people there. However, there's no guarantee that it will remain this crowded. All you need to bring is your passport. They'll make a copy of your passport there anyway. Of course, bringing a copy will speed up the process. They also give you a questionnaire, so just fill out the circled sections. It takes about 10 minutes. And even if you fill out the questionnaire quickly, you still have to wait for your turn. They always do the PCR test in order. The PCR test is very quick. They tell you to come pick up your results at 10:30 AM the next day. You'll be given your passport and receipt, which you should also bring. The price is 900 baht. Cash only. If you have time afterward, it would be nice to buy shrimp at the seafood market right next door and eat them on a mat. If you pay on the side, they'll cook it for you. Personally, I recommend the 300-400 baht per kilo.
0x3102be6ebaf98977_0xc210511f5d614ae6.author: 다가나

0x3102be6ebaf98977_0xc210511f5d614ae6.text: If you have a flight the next day, don't go in the morning. Go at 12:30 PM. You'll be the first one to get tested at 1:00 PM. Fill out the questionnaire upon arrival. You'll receive your test papers at 2:30 PM the next day. I took a songthaew from in front of Walking Street, and since I was the only one on board, they let me choose my route at Terminal 21. So I went to the fish market for 10 baht.

0x3102be6ebaf98977_0xc210511f5d614ae6.text: This is the cheapest place in Pattaya (900B) to take a PCR test for returning to Japan. It takes about 15 minutes in total from filling out the paperwork and paying to finishing the test. It's cheap and fast, so there's nothing to complain about. (However, this is only if the result is negative.) Additional Note As of October 1, 2022, PCR tests have been changed to weekday mornings only, not afternoons. PCR tests Weekdays 8:30-10:30 Pick-up is from 10:30-12:00 the next day

0x30da3bd9c6f5c86d_0x9c1f80008b2d156d.text: I was actually hesitant to bring my cat to a proper pet hospital because in my previous country, a vet hospital nearly cost us 2000 euro just for a misdiagnosis. My thoughts changed when I brought my cat Tifa to Arak Animal Hospital. First of all, they have different entry for cat and dog patients (so cute!). After that, they have a cute waiting area for humans with a separate play area for cats. Tifa was handled by Dr. Boat. He diagnosed Tifa with FIP and he had to undergo nearly 3-month medication. The attention that was given by the doctor and the staff of Arak was very touching. They were so calm when handling Tifa, sometimes one of the staff came to play with Tifa for a little bit. It was very clear that they work there not only because it's their job but also because they love animals. They texted me through LINE to ask about Tifa's well-being, and also responded when I send them updates about my cat. Tifa is now FIP-free and a very happy cat. Unfortunately I stop going to this hospital because we have moved quite far away, but Arak Animal Hospital will hold a special place in my (and Tifa's) heart.
0x30da3bd9c6f5c86d_0x9c1f80008b2d156d.author: Crystal

0x30da3bd9c6f5c86d_0x9c1f80008b2d156d.text: My wife and I brought our boys here to get their teeth cleaned. They severely needed it. The staff was very friendly and helpful not only to us, but to our boys making them feel comfortable at a new place. The vet talked us through the entire procedure to help us ease our worries. To get their teeth cleaned they must be under anesthesia, which always poses a risk. I was impressed as we were afforded to lots of time to ask questions to the vet and did not feel rushed. They kept us updated at key events of the procedure and recovery. Our boys were strong, recovered quickly, and came out with white teeth and fresh smelling breath. ***(Photo was after recovery when we picked them up) Thank you Arak staff as we appreciate all the kindness and gratitude given to us and our boys!

0x30e29b5aac751ff9_0x1e0e91c57d046c7.text: แย่ครับ ทำฟันแถมแผลในปากไป 3 จุด เราโดนทั้งเหล็กแหลมๆที่เขาใช้เช็คฟันทิ่มริมฝีปาก กับเครื่องขูดหินปูนโดนกระพุ้งแก้มและริมขอบปาก เพราะการเคลื่อนของเครื่องมือคุณหมอมันรวดเร็วมาก อาจจะเพราะชำนาญมั้ง แต่ส่วนตัวเรารู้สึกว่าไม่ค่อยพิถีพิถัน เพราะเครื่องมันเกี่ยวปากเรา และกระพุ้งแก้ม ทำฟันเจ็บแปปเดียวแต่แผลที่ปากมันกว่าจะหายมันนาน กินข้าวลำบาก และอยากให้คุณหมอพูดเวลาตรวจฟันมากกว่านี้ค่ะ เข้าใจว่าคุณหมอเข้าใจดูแล้วมีปัญหาตรงนี้ๆต้องทำอะไรบ้าง แต่อยากให้พูดละเอียดมากกว่านี้ เช่น การแนะนำระหว่างตรวจที่บอกว่า มีฟันผุ อุด 2 ซี่ ก็อยากให้หมอบอกด้วยว่าตำแหน่งไหน แล้วเยอะหรือน้อย น่าจะเกิดจากพฤติกรรมอะไร ส่วนราคาอุดฟันที่นี่ผุเยอะผุน้อย 800 หมด ไม่ค่อยชอบเท่าไหร่ครับ เคยเข้าที่อื่นแบบผุน้อยก็คิดแค่ 400-600บาท เยอะก็ 800 บาท
0x30e29b5aac751ff9_0x1e0e91c57d046c7.author: SiriPatt
0x30e29b5aac751ff9_0x1e0e91c57d046c7.en: It was a terrible experience. I ended up with three sores in my mouth from the sharp metal tool they used to check my teeth and from the scaler cutting my cheek and lip. The dentist's instruments moved very quickly, perhaps due to experience, but personally, I felt they weren't very thorough. The instruments kept cutting into my mouth and cheek. The dental work itself only hurt for a short time, but the sores in my mouth take a long time to heal, making eating difficult. I also wish the dentist had explained things more during the check-up. I understand the dentist recognized the problems and what needed to be done, but I'd like them to be more detailed. For example, during the check-up, when they mentioned I had two cavities that needed fillings, I'd like them to specify the location, the severity of the cavities, and what habits might have caused them. As for the price, fillings here cost 800 baht regardless of the severity of the cavity. I don't really like that price. I've been to other places where minor cavities only cost 400-600 baht, and major ones 800 baht.

0x3050312d2c866daf_0x39728d3d2c3b4383.text: I've been getting braces from Dr. Bee since I was a child, around 8th grade (middle school), and now I'm in 11th grade (high school). It took almost 4 years, which is considered fast because my teeth were crooked and difficult to straighten – my molars are smaller than my front teeth. Dr. Bee is very gentle. She did everything from setting anchors, extracting teeth (including wisdom teeth), fillings, and fitting braces – and it was painless. The doctor might say it might be a bit painful, but in reality, all the dentists involved were incredibly gentle. Scaling might cause some sensitivity, which is normal. The doctor gave great advice and explained how to use the dental appliances and how to care for my teeth. Regarding the price, I asked friends who had similar braces, and mine was more expensive, but the time and quality made it worth it. Their system is excellent. Waiting times are short; each time I went, I waited no more than 5 minutes before being called in. The doctor and dental assistants are polite, friendly, and chatty (even for someone like me who isn't very talkative), so it didn't feel pressured.
0x3050312d2c866daf_0x39728d3d2c3b4383.author: Kasakorn prayoth

0x3050312d2c866daf_0x39728d3d2c3b4383.text: I had an excellent experience at my recent dental visit. The consultation for Invisalign included a thorough X-ray and a detailed explanation of the procedure. Dentist Dr. Bee was highly professional, fluent in English, and provided a clear 3D visualization of how Invisalign would correct my teeth. I also received deep cleaning from dentist Dr. Fah who was exceptionally gentle, leaving my teeth spotless. Additionally, she repaired several chipped teeth that I had from combative sports, and the results were flawless. The quality of care and attention to detail was truly impressive. I highly recommend this dental office and will definitely return for future services.
