0x3050312d2c866daf_0x39728d3d2c3b4383.text: I had orthodontic treatment with Dr. Bee before COVID, and now it's been 3.5 years since I had my braces removed. I had 8 teeth extracted, but my teeth didn't lean forward and moved into place very quickly. Dr. Bee is incredibly skilled. I'm truly impressed. Now my 13-year-old son is also getting orthodontic treatment with Dr. Bee. My son praises Dr. Bee for being kind, the clinic being clean, and not crowded. I expect my daughter will be coming to see Dr. Bee soon as well.

If you're nervous or have been putting off your dental care, I can’t recommend this place enough. Truly a game-changer!
0x3050312d2c866daf_0x39728d3d2c3b4383.author: Lilly Carrion

0x3050312d2c866daf_0x39728d3d2c3b4383.text: I absolutely looooooove The Grand Dental Studio. I have had multiple dental procedures including wisdom tooth removal, dry socket, sinus lift and dental implants. They are cost effective and the staff are unbelievably amazing. So kind and supportive. The surgeon is absolutely precise and so gentle. Thank you so much for making me feel so comfortable and safe 🙏🙏🙏 I will recommend everyone to this dental studio. They are high tech and just lovely 🌹
0x3050312d2c866daf_0x39728d3d2c3b4383.author: Muneebah Dawson

0x3050312d2c866daf_0x39728d3d2c3b4383.text: This is an excellent dental clinic. The quality and standards easily match anything in western countries. it is spotless and the equipment is state of the art. The staff speaks English and is warm and friendly. I was very impressed by my dentist's skill and experience. Prices are reasonable. The work is exceptional. Parking is a problem. You might want to consider taking a taxi from wherever you are staying. Most highly recommended.
0x3050312d2c866daf_0x39728d3d2c3b4383.author: Robert McArthur

0x3050312d2c866daf_0x39728d3d2c3b4383.text: Been there once for filling repair, the dentist also did a check up and helped with other dental issues. Quick and pain free. Went there again for orthodontic help for my daughter, the doctor (Bee) helped professionally and friendly. Will go back for any other dental issues arising. It’s convenient to communicate before appointment via WhatsApp in English. Love this dental studio! 🙏🏼
0x3050312d2c866daf_0x39728d3d2c3b4383.author: Theresa Kotthoff

0x30e299cda8e98f1b_0x5435b4368c3beda5.text: This was my first time at a massage place in Bangkok, so I happened upon it near Icon Siam and saw some Korean reviews, so I went here! I got a 90-minute full body massage without oil, and I think it was around 460 baht. I highly recommend P'Ta (Ta) in massage parlors! They massaged me hard, so it was painful but refreshing. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ If I'd known about it earlier, I regret not going every day. ㅠ I'll definitely come back next time. Aunt Mina also recommends it!!! I found this place by chance and I highly recommend it! P'Ta provided a strong full body massage for 90 minutes, and it was great! The price itself wasn't expensive, but you can walk here from Icon Siam, so it's very convenient too! Konkhunaka~~
0x30e299cda8e98f1b_0x5435b4368c3beda5.author: Daye Cho

0x30e299cda8e98f1b_0x5435b4368c3beda5.text: I just came here for a massage about an hour ago, and the experience was absolutely perfect. The male staff who did the massage was really dedicated, the room was clean and fragrant, and even the restroom was spotless. They even provided disposable underwear for customers, which was really impressive 🥰👍🏻 However, when I mentioned that I’d like to come regularly every two weeks, they seemed either not to believe me (or maybe didn’t get what I meant) and only gave me a business card with a landline number and address, instead of some way to send a message and book in advance. So I felt a bit confused, especially since I can’t speak Thai 😅😅
0x30e299cda8e98f1b_0x5435b4368c3beda5.author: Quốc Thạch Kiến

0x30e299cda8e98f1b_0x5435b4368c3beda5.text: I was pleasantly surprised at Numcha Massage in Bangkok. I asked for a simple Thai massage and it was a great thing after a long day of sightseeing around the area. The skilled therapists provide fantastic massages that leave you feeling rejuvenated and refreshed. They prefer cash, which I should have known beforehand. Otherwise there’s a 4% service charge if you use credit card. Note to self: bring more cash on my trip.
0x30e299cda8e98f1b_0x5435b4368c3beda5.author: jennifer fong

0x30e299cda8e98f1b_0x5435b4368c3beda5.text: Since it was right in front of Icon Siam and I had some time before the dinner cruise, I went as a walk-in without making a reservation. The Thai massage was about 330 baht, and oh... it was refreshing because they pressed hard on the right spots. (It was a bit sore the next day, though haha.) Still, I like strong massages, so I was very satisfied. I would definitely come back.
0x30e299cda8e98f1b_0x5435b4368c3beda5.author: 호두나무

0x30e299cda8e98f1b_0x5435b4368c3beda5.text: I had a awesome oil Massage done today 2/4/24 by Eve and she was wonderful, Eve has a awesome technique, knows how to work on the tight areas and loosen them up. Eve was friendly, polite and happy at her job. Highly recommend Eve if you are in the area of Bangkok. I'm on Holidays from Melbourne Australia and I decided to give this shop a try . Happy Customer.
0x30e299cda8e98f1b_0x5435b4368c3beda5.author: GEOFFREY CHURCH

0x30e299cda8e98f1b_0x5435b4368c3beda5.text: Great place! We stayed at Hilton Millenium and this place is 5 min walk from there and across the road from IconSiam. You get 15% discount if you mention Google offer so an hour oil massage was only Baht 425. I would go every day if I lived here! I had Deb and she was fantastic, worked on all my knots and I got a lovely cup of herbal tea after. Recommend.
0x30e299cda8e98f1b_0x5435b4368c3beda5.author: Annie B

0x30e299cda8e98f1b_0x5435b4368c3beda5.text: I received a Thai massage from Mina. It was seriously sooooo good.. Mina seems to have professional massage skills. The massage program was really well-structured, and the pressure was exactly the level I wanted. If I come to Bangkok again, I definitely want to get a massage from Mina again!! Thank you for giving me such a wonderful experience🩵🥹

My husband told him politely on my behalf that I prefer a female and he started to show signs of anger like slamming the tap and leaving my feet wet (I believe he was supposed to at least dry them so I can move to my seat, he also did not instruct anyone to follow up. Another female masseuse saw me and helped me dry my feet). Afterwards, the lady in charge came up to inform me that there’s no female masseuse (which I’m fine, I just requested for a refund) but that guy was clearly unhappy with me as he pushed the chair and started to (very rudely) verbally chase me out of the massage palour when I asked if I could just sit and wait for my husband to be done. So overall, it was a pretty awful experience and there’re many other massage places around, don’t have to settle for this LOL Responding to your reply: his mistake is not only that, but inappropriately tickling the feet of your customers.

0x30e29f5d80d632af_0xf6da8aaf9ba6ee0c.author: Mileidy M

0x30e29f5d80d632af_0xf6da8aaf9ba6ee0c.text: Had a good experience here. The staff were friendly and the clinic was clean and comfortable. The doctor explained the treatment clearly and I didn’t feel pressured to buy extra packages. Looking forward to coming back again!

0x30e29f5d80d632af_0xf6da8aaf9ba6ee0c.text: Saw results a few weeks later! Super happy with everything at their clinic. Staff was great and super professional. All of the treatments I had were properly done. Highly recommend!
0x30e29f5d80d632af_0xf6da8aaf9ba6ee0c.author: alexa mcdonald

0x30e29f8770b1387f_0x1650970a7e7d737b.text: I am usually very scared of dental treatments, but Smile Center Dental Clinic completely changed my experience. I chose the Mahatun Plaza branch and was impressed even before my visit—the receptionist answered all my questions in detail and helped arrange appointments that fit my tight schedule. I received root canal treatment from Dr. Rungwarin Laohakanchanasiri and deep cleaning and root planing from Dr. Kantapon Rattanaprukskul. Both dentists were professional, caring, and constantly checked saying "Are you ok! Are you alright! Is you feel anything, please tell me, raise your hand...." to make sure I was comfortable. Their English communication was excellent, and I felt very safe throughout the treatment. I am truly satisfied with the results and very glad I chose Smile Center Dental Clinic. Thank you to all the staff and dentists for the great service. I will continue to come back for future treatments.

I had a severely infected molar and was literally suffering for a week before and 3 visits to the ER due to bad reaction to antibiotics which made me soo sick!! I called them to see if they can drain the infection, but they told me that the surgeon can take out the molar and flush out the infection... of course i was beyond terrified, but honestly, the surgeon was literally an angel! He was sooo patient with me and told me what he was doing every step of the way! Answered all my questions and explained to me everything! They even gave me a teddy bear to hold onto which was very sweet hahaha. I felt no pain at all during the procedure. I'm soo relieved that it's finally over! The price was very reasonable as well... so grateful for you guys, you truly deserve a glowing review🙏🙏
0x30e29f8770b1387f_0x1650970a7e7d737b.author: Jade Muasher

0x30e29f8770b1387f_0x1650970a7e7d737b.text: Amazing service at Smile Centre Dental Clinic! The customer service was excellent from start to finish. The staff were friendly, patient, and made me feel comfortable throughout my visit. The prices are very reasonable and transparent, with no hard selling. I had my Vivera retainers made here, along with teeth cleaning and a tooth filling, and I’m very satisfied with the results. The dentists are professional, gentle, and took the time to explain every procedure clearly. The clinic is also clean, modern, and well-maintained. Highly recommend Smile Centre Dental Clinic if you’re looking for quality dental care at a fair price. I’ll definitely come back for my future dental treatments!
0x30e29f8770b1387f_0x1650970a7e7d737b.author: Shirley Ee

0x30e29f8770b1387f_0x1650970a7e7d737b.text: I visited this clinic this morning since it’s conveniently located near our hotel, and I’m so glad I did. I availed of Package B, which included cleaning, polishing, fluoride treatment, and more, and the experience definitely did not disappoint. I was very well taken care of, and every step of the process was explained to me thoroughly, which made me feel comfortable and at ease. The clinic itself is very clean, and both the staff and my dentist were absolutely wonderful. I will definitely come back here the next time I’m in Thailand. The pricing is also very reasonable for the quality of service provided.
0x30e29f8770b1387f_0x1650970a7e7d737b.author: Carmela C

0x30e29f8770b1387f_0x1650970a7e7d737b.text: Saved my vacation. This place is amazing. My crown came off late at night. I woke up trying to find a dentist I went to 3 other clinics and they had appointments super late in the day or just didn’t have any appointments. I found Smile Center Dental and they saw me within 5 minutes of filling the application. It was super convenient and they did a great job. Thanks to the staff and the team for being super!

I came to Smile Center Dental Clinic for dental x-rays and a cleaning. The service was excellent and the equipment and facilities were extremely clean. I am quite picky about cleanliness of my dental clinics, and this location was to my liking. The front desk staff were very friendly and the doctor and assistant who did my cleaning were friendly and helpful. I highly recommend!

I’ve had my teeth cleaned multiple times, this was definitely by far the least uncomfortable experience for me. Dr. Rawinan did an excellent job with the cleaning and the repair of a few surface level abrasions… Thank you to Dr. Rawinan and to her assistant. I will definitely be returning. The entire process from booking the appointment was very simple.

The reception staff are so kind and helpful and respectful. The dentist was so gentle and considerate. She answered all my questions and reassured me. I feel very safe in her hands and that I can fully trust them with their extensive knowledge and experience. Very professional team. From the start to the finish.

0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.text: Arrived 10:30 am. No line. Depared 11:00 bus. Good leg room, aircon. Bus has narrow cubbies for storage inside. Modern Hwy to airport. Smooth ride. 130 baht as of November 2016 No aircon inside teninal so go across to the convience market. They have a fairly good stock of Western foods; cheese, pasteries, sandwiches etc. Don't forget your bag at the front security bag-check before you rush for your bus! Come early and grab a massage next door, or see a clinic doctor for your STD, or other ailments, a few doors down.
0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.author: Jeh Rhm

0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.text: If you buy your ticket two days in advance, you can board without waiting on the day. When I bought my ticket on the day, it was for a bus four hours later. I checked in a large suitcase, but I wasn't charged a baggage fee. However, it seems some people were charged a baggage fee, so check at the terminal. There are massage parlors and restaurants nearby, so you can kill time there. There's also a supermarket. If you're going to the airport, it's more convenient than the North Bus Terminal.
0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.author: shuzo asano

0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.text: I took a bus from Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport to Pattaya Jomtien Beach for 120 baht. The fare probably doesn't vary depending on the departure point, but I saw a comment below saying they paid 130 baht. Even if you haggle for a cheaper taxi, it's still 1,500 baht. This bus is a welcome relief for backpackers, with blazing air conditioning and comfortable seats. The ride takes about two hours. The fare, recently revised to 143 baht (May 1, 2023), has been raised.
0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.author: 하나의한국 (하나의한국)

0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.text: This has to be the best way to get to Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi airport. The prices change very slightly (up and down) with the movement in world oil prices but at about 120 baht, it's a steal. They leave absolutely punctually which is very unusual in Thailand and their drivers are very safe, not needing to get to the destination in a hurry. Once free piece of "stored" luggage plus whatever you carry into the cabin with you
0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.author: Mark Kalisch

0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.text: A very quick and easy way to get back to Bangkok Airport. Buses leave every hour our was on Tim to the minute for a one hour forty-five minute drive to the airport. The bus drops you directly outside the departure hall so is a quick and easy short walk to the check-in desks. Cost 143 Baht. Picture of coffee from cafe next to ticket office.
0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.author: Michael Pitts

0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.text: This bus terminal connects Pattaya to Suvarnabhumi Airport. It's also called Jomtien Bus Terminal. From Pattaya city, take a songthaew departing from the intersection of South Pattaya Road and Second Road for 10B. Note that buses to Ekkamai in Bangkok depart from North Pattaya Bus Terminal. Tickets to Suvarnabhumi Airport cost 143B, and reservations can be made two days in advance. Reservations are also available online (with a 25B handling fee). Any changes after purchase (such as changing the time) cost 50B. Buses depart approximately every hour from 7:00 AM, with the last bus at 9:00 PM. Carry-on luggage is free, but checked baggage costs 20B for up to 20kg, 50B for up to 30kg, and 100B for up to 50kg. The air conditioning on the bus is strong, so be sure to take precautions against the cold (though there is a toilet at the end of the bus). If the roads are not congested, you can arrive within two hours. Seats are unreserved. Please note that eating is prohibited on board the train.
0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.author: TAKASHI MIURA

0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.text: This is where the bus to Suvarnabhumi Airport departs. There are cafes, restaurants, and massage shops where you can rest, so arriving early is not a problem. Alcohol and smoking are permitted. It is easier to access than the North Pattaya bus stop and has a wider variety of shops, so it is recommended if you are going to the airport. It is about 20 minutes from Pattaya Beach. A Bolt taxi will cost 60-80 baht. You can also access it by songthaew, but you will need to transfer. If you have a fixed time, it is best to book your ticket online the day before. Online booking is not possible on the day of travel. However, even if you have booked online, please note that you will need to pick up a paper ticket at the ticket counter on the day of travel.
0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.author: chebutrip

0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.text: Relatively nice buses (if quite a bit worn) and an excellent alternative to taxis, but why do they insist on air-conditioning the bus down to a f.... freezing 18 degrees? Nobody, as in NOBODY, likes to sit immobile for two hours in cold like that. People try to cover themselves with whatever they have, but unsurprisingly few bring their overcoats to Thailand.
0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.author: Jesper Svarre

0x30da3b5b829bc033_0x95d01271bfa3185.text: Authentic stretching enthusiasts rejoice! This Thai massage parlor truly understands those who sit for long periods. The therapist's techniques were professional and measured throughout, from twisting the shoulders and neck, stretching the lower back, to pressing the legs. Every step precisely relaxed tense muscles without any forced pain, leaving only a refreshing soreness. After the massage, even bending over to pick things up felt easier, as if my body had been recalibrated. The authenticity is comparable to an experience in Chiang Mai, and I will definitely come back!
0x30da3b5b829bc033_0x95d01271bfa3185.author: LI LINGFEI

0x30da3b5b829bc033_0x95d01271bfa3185.text: Even after the time limit, the massage was thorough and excellent. The male masseuse was incredibly skilled and friendly. I'll definitely be back! Additional I had some time left before heading to the airport on my departure day, so I returned. Instead of a man, a young, pretty woman was there. She thoroughly and meticulously gave me a foot, hand, and head massage. Thanks to her, I'll have great memories of Chiang Mai, Thailand, until the end of my trip. I'll be back again next year! (I enjoyed the warm tea. ^^)
0x30da3b5b829bc033_0x95d01271bfa3185.author: 채정한

0x30da3b5b829bc033_0x95d01271bfa3185.text: Excellent massage and a very warm welcome! The staff is caring, professional, and truly attentive, with a great sense of service and friendliness. I booked a 1-hour oil massage and highly recommend it. At the end, I was even offered tea and treated with Tiger Balm, which was a lovely touch. A wonderful discovery. I’ll definitely be coming back without hesitation!
0x30da3b5b829bc033_0x95d01271bfa3185.author: taha snj

0x30da3b5b829bc033_0x95d01271bfa3185.text: One of the best Thai massages I’ve ever had! The therapists were skilled and knew exactly how to work on my sore shoulders and back. The place was clean, relaxing, and reasonably priced. Everyone was welcoming and made me feel comfortable from start to finish. I left feeling completely refreshed. Highly recommend this place if you’re visiting Thailand!
0x30da3b5b829bc033_0x95d01271bfa3185.author: Lizzy Liu

0x30da3b5b829bc033_0x95d01271bfa3185.text: ●It was my first time having a massage here and I was very impress with my therapist and his skills. ● My hip and upper back pain were completely gone after a 90 mins Thai Massage + hot herbal ball treatment. ● 300% Friendly staff would make you feel warm welcome. •Clean and tidy place. •Professional massage. •Reasonable price. •Highly recommend it!
0x30da3b5b829bc033_0x95d01271bfa3185.author: Nick P

0x30da3b5b829bc033_0x95d01271bfa3185.text: Excellent place to massage We lived in a hotel not too far from this location, stop by to decide to give it a try. It turns out it was a very good decision. Price is right and service is excellent. No complain at all. After finish they will give you a cup of hot tea. Will come back again if live around here.
0x30da3b5b829bc033_0x95d01271bfa3185.author: Stanley C

0x30da3b5b829bc033_0x95d01271bfa3185.text: We came 4 times within a week! So happy to have found this place for foot massages. Even once travelled from across town to come back here. Thank you for the great relaxing times! The place is so cleand and friendly! Will come back here first thing when back in Chiang Mai! 🙏🏽💫 …
0x30da3b5b829bc033_0x95d01271bfa3185.author: Nathalie Grolimund

0x30da3b5b829bc033_0x95d01271bfa3185.text: Wonderful full-body oil Thai massage! The essential oil smells soothing. The therapist adjusted the pressure properly and focused on my tight areas. Every minute was enjoyable. Great service, tidy rooms and nice ambiance. Definitely the best massage I’ve had in Thailand!
0x30da3b5b829bc033_0x95d01271bfa3185.author: yujie zhang

0x30fdac6cc3be3725_0xae704c06ebde98b8.text: We arrived at the hospital 45 minutes early with our elder mini schnauzer on January 2nd. He was having breathing issues the night before. It got so bad as we were trying to wait until they opened, our pup laid down in the seat to die. We carried him up near reception, and there was nobody around. At this point he was expelling liquid from his nose, and his heart stopped as we walked up near the critical care unit door. A cleaning employee went inside the CCU, and out came I believe his name was Leo. I told him that our pup wasn’t breathing, and his heart had just stopped. He grabbed him, and ran inside with him. A few moments later the Dr. came out, and said our pup was stabilized. A few moments later we were able to enter and see him. They had a breathing tube inserted, and his heart rate wasn’t ideal, but it was ok. We visited him each day as he was recovering, and we were able to bring him home yesterday January 6th. He has been doing great so far, and seems happy to be back home. The CCU staff are amazing, and we appreciate everything your staff did to save our pups life. 🙏🏼🙏🏼
0x30fdac6cc3be3725_0xae704c06ebde98b8.author: Kirk Dershem

0x30fdac6cc3be3725_0xae704c06ebde98b8.text: We took our dog, Maisie, there yesterday to have her go over the Rainbow Bridge. Her already declining health, including dementia, worsened over the weekend and as she couldn't stand and was unable to "do her business" outside and collapsed in it plus other upsetting things we made the heartbreaking decision to put our over 15year-old ex-soi dog to rest. The vet we saw was kindness itself making sure we understood the ramifications and asking if we wanted to find a solution. With 4 health problems already robbing her of dignity and quality of life we declined and were given quiet time to say goodbye. Thank you to all involved who treated us with kindness and Maisie with dignity.
0x30fdac6cc3be3725_0xae704c06ebde98b8.author: Julie Reeves

0x30fdac6cc3be3725_0xae704c06ebde98b8.text: I am so impressed! I came with my dog on a Friday which was a public holiday at around 10.45am. There was no queue at all and we were able to see the vet in less than 10 minutes! The vet was able to extract his tooth (baby tooth) without needing to put him under GA. She also cleaned his 2 canines that had tartar on them. All this also took about 10min. I'm so happy I came here because all the previous vets I've spoken to said they had to put him under GA for just teeth cleaning. The hospital was very clean, there was a water station for dogs in the airconditioned waiting room, and the pet shop has good prices. I will be back for future checkups 😊👌🙏
0x30fdac6cc3be3725_0xae704c06ebde98b8.author: MK

0x30fdac6cc3be3725_0xae704c06ebde98b8.text: We brought our French bulldog here with hope, as Phuket doesn't have an MRI machine. He had problems with his hind legs and couldn't walk. We were so excited, and the results were excellent. He's able to walk again. Thank you to the doctor who performed the MRI (he's both handsome and skilled), Dr. Yaya for his excellent explanations, and Dr. Aris, the physical therapist, who was very kind and lovely. Thank you to all the staff who provided friendly and smiling service. We didn't have a chance to talk to the surgeon, but thank you so much for helping our family.
0x30fdac6cc3be3725_0xae704c06ebde98b8.author: อรวรรณ ถิรพาณิชย์กุล

0x30fdac6cc3be3725_0xae704c06ebde98b8.text: This is definitely the best and most complete veterinary services in the area! We bring our dog here whenever he needs care. They are very caring and very professional. The vets are all advanced students who are overseen by professor/instructors. Our dog has had a couple of different surgeries here and he also gets all of his routine medical care from this hospital. They had inpatient services in the past, but it is not available now. I think it stopped due to Covid.
0x30fdac6cc3be3725_0xae704c06ebde98b8.author: Curtis Roberts

0x30fdac6cc3be3725_0xae704c06ebde98b8.text: Bamboo was 18 y/o. She is gone to the stars in her home. Thank you to the doctor Best, to the doctor Mong and to the surgeon from who, I am really sorry, i can't remember the name. Thank you to the administration staff at the entrance, thank to the ones who call us when it was our turn. Thank you very much to all of you. You help us a lot. Your professionalism was a big support. Alain Marc Auaichai
0x30fdac6cc3be3725_0xae704c06ebde98b8.author: alain francois

0x30fdac6cc3be3725_0xae704c06ebde98b8.text: The staff is extremely professional and kind from the vets to the nurses. You can tell that even the person who was only holding our cat genuinely likes animals. They have all the equipment and results are available in very short time. the price is the cheapest I experienced in Thailand so far. 0x30e29ed09ba26a03_0xdf2b2510162ac04e.text: I recently moved to Bangkok, and during the transition, my flight from Seattle was over 18 hours. The experience has been excellent all around—from the office manager at the front desk, Beam, to Dr. Mau and the different therapists I’ve worked with. Everyone has been professional, friendly, and attentive. I honestly couldn’t believe I got so lucky on my first try finding a chiropractic clinic in Bangkok that I feel comfortable using long-term. For me to rate anything above 4 mean I saw little to no negatives in there services and how they treat their customers.

0x30e29ed09ba26a03_0xdf2b2510162ac04e.text: Great first experience! I came using the BTS it was a short walk about 350 meters to the office. They were very friendly as was Dr. Minh. He is fluent in French, English and Thai so there is no language barrier! He's an experienced chiropractor who makes it simple to understand the process and what the diagnosis is. The physical therapists are well trained and very professional. The clinic is clean and quiet. I highly recommend coming to this clinic when in Bangkok!

0x30e29ed09ba26a03_0xdf2b2510162ac04e.text: The center offers treatment for back and spinal pain through the manipulation and realignment of slipped or painful vertebrae. The procedure begins with a medical examination, followed by muscle relaxation using a massage device. The therapist then works to realign the vertebrae of the spine and neck. The therapist then begins with manual massage of the treated muscles, followed by massage using sound waves and heat. Finally, pressure is applied to the painful areas to relieve pain, and stretching exercises are performed. A full session lasts approximately one hour, but complete treatment requires several sessions. However, you will feel the difference after the first session.

0x30e2987d76e9d67f_0x1a39eb2f420bd989.text: #บอกต่อสำหรับคนที่กลัวการทำฟัน เช่น มีอาการ Panic เมื่อต้องมาทำฟัน อ้าปากทำฟันแล้วจะอาเจียน แค่ได้ยินเสียงเครื่องมือทำฟันก็กลัวแล้ว แต่เราคงไม่สามารถหนีการทำฟันได้ ถ้าเรามีปัญหาเรื่องฟันอ่ะเนาะ เราพาแฟนมา เค้าต้องรักษารากฟัน จริง ๆ เค้าเคยทำฟันกับคุณหมออรสาที่ฉะเชิงเทรามาก่อนคุณหมอก็ใจดีมากเช่นกัน แต่แฟนต้องรักษารากฟัน คุณหมอเลยส่งต่อให้ผู้เชี่ยวชาญ แต่เราสะดวกทำที่ กทม เลยลองหาคลินิก โชคดีมาก เจอคลินิกนี้ หาจากใน google นี่ล่ะ ระหว่างทางได้ไปหาหมอที่อื่นมาบ้าง แต่เจอคุณหมอหลายท่านอาจจะไม่เข้าใจ กลายเป็นมองว่าคนไข้ไม่ให้ความร่วมมือ พอมาที่นี่ รักษารากฟัน ใครเคยทำจะรู้ว่า ใช้เวลาทำนานอยู่ ซึ่งคนไข้ก็จะมีพักบ่อยเพราะ จะสำลัก มีหายใจทางจมูกไม่ได้ตอนอ้าปาก เพราะเค้ากลัวนั่นแหละ ที่นี่ใช้จิตวิทยาดี ไม่ได้ทำให้คนไข้โฟกัสที่การทำฟันมาก แล้วพอคนไข้ขอพัก คุณหมอก็ใจเย็นมาก เรามารักษารากฟัน น่าจะ 2-3 ครั้ง ดีทุกครั้ง ทำครอบฟันเจอคุณหมออีกคนก็เข้าใจ ต่อด้วยทำรีเทนเนอร์ และอุดฟัน คุณหมอทุกคนน่ารักมาก ชื่นชมคนไข้ด้วยนะ สุดท้ายการทำฟันมันยากสำหรับแฟนเรามาก ไม่รู้ว่าใครมีปัญหาเหมือนกันไหม เลยอยากบอกต่อว่า ถ้าไปที่ไหนแล้วไม่สบายใจ ลองมาที่นี่นะค้า มาแล้วบอกพี่พนักงานหรือคุณหมอเค้าได้เลยว่าเรากลัวหรือมีปัญหายังไง คุณหมอจะได้ช่วยเราได้ค้า 🥰🥰🥰 พี่ ๆ พนักงานก็น่ารักมาก ให้กำลังใจ เตือนวันนัด สบายใจมากที่มาที่นี่
0x30e2987d76e9d67f_0x1a39eb2f420bd989.en: #Sharing for those who are afraid of dental procedures For example, panicking when going to the dentist, feeling nauseous when opening your mouth for treatment, or just being scared by the sound of dental instruments. But we can't avoid dental work if we have dental problems, right? I brought my boyfriend here; he needed root canal treatment. He had actually had treatment with Dr. Orasa in Chachoengsao before, and she was very kind. However, for root canal treatment, she referred him to a specialist. Since we preferred to work in Bangkok, we searched for a clinic and luckily found this one through Google. Along the way, we went to other dentists, but some didn't understand and perceived the patient as uncooperative. Here, for root canal treatment (anyone who's had it done knows it takes a long time), patients often need breaks because they worry about choking or difficulty breathing through their nose when their mouth is open due to fear. This clinic uses excellent psychology; they don't let the patient focus too much on the procedure. When patients need breaks, the dentists are very patient. We've had root canal treatment here 2-3 times, and it's been great each time. We had a crown done by a different dentist who was also understanding. We also had retainers and fillings done. All the dentists are wonderful and appreciate the patients. Ultimately, getting dental work done was really difficult for my boyfriend. I don't know if anyone else has had similar problems, but I wanted to share this: if you're feeling uncomfortable at other clinics, try coming here! Just tell the staff or the dentist what you're afraid of or what your concerns are, so they can help you. 🥰🥰🥰 The staff are also incredibly kind, encouraging, and remind you of your appointments. It was so reassuring to be here.

0x30e283d393956325_0x41ca3510fa105374.text: แนะนำคุหมอแป้งครับ อุดฟันละเอียดและใส่ใจมาก พิถีพิถันทุกขั้นตอน และระมัดระวังในการกรอฟัน ช่วยดูด้วยว่าจะอุดแบบไหนให้ดีที่สุดกับคนไข้ และลองใช้ไหมขัดระหว่างฟัน ช่วยเช็คฟัน xray จากจุดที่หมอสงสัยว่าจะผุ แล้วก็ผุจริงเกือบถึงคอฟัน ถ้าไม่ได้อุดตอนนี้แย่แน่ๆ สถานที่ติดถนนมาง่ายมากครับ แนะนำคลิกนิกสะอาดมีที่จอดรถเยอะ I’d recommend Dr. Paeng. She’s very detailed and caring with fillings, meticulous at every step, and very careful when drilling. She always considers which type of filling would be best for the patient. She even flossed between my teeth to check, and took an X-ray at the spot she suspected might have decay—turned out it really was, almost reaching the gumline. If I hadn’t filled it now, it would’ve been serious. The clinic is right by the main road, very easy to get to, clean, with plenty of parking.
0x30e283d393956325_0x41ca3510fa105374.en: I highly recommend Dr. Paeng. She's incredibly meticulous and attentive to fillings. She's careful with every step and drilling, always assessing the best filling method for her patient. She even flossed between my teeth and took an X-ray of a suspected decay – which turned out to be real, almost reaching the gum line. If I hadn't gotten it filled, it would have been much worse. The clinic is conveniently located right by the main road, clean, and has plenty of parking.

0x30e281d8c57c3d91_0x409bb92933c6afd9.text: มาผ่าและถอนฟันคุดค่ะ มาครั้งแรกประทับใจมากๆทุกอย่างดูดี สะอาด มีมาตรฐาน งานบริการดี พนักงานน่ารักตั้งแต่พี่ๆหน้าเคาท์เตอร์จนคุณหมอ ก่อนมาก็ทำการบ้านหนักมากว่าจะไปทำที่ไหนดี ตามล่าหารีวิวตามโซเซี่ยลจนมาเจอที่นี่ ว่าหมอทำเร็ว ไม่เจ็บ บวมน้อยมาก และพอเข้ามาทำจริงๆก็ตรงปก หมอชำนาญทำเร็วมากผ่า1ซี่ ถอน1ซี่ ใช้เวลา15นาทีเอง บวมน้อยมากๆ(ถ้าไม่มองแบบจ้องจับผิดก็ดูไม่ออก) ใครกลัวเจ็บอยากจะบอกว่าแทบไม่รู้สึกเจ็บเลยแม้แต่ขั้นตอนเดียว หมอใส่ใจ เป็นกันเอง และหล่อเกินปกไปมากๆ(เอาซะเขินไม่กล้ามองหน้าคุยกับหมอเลย) แถมเบิกประกันสังคมแบบไม่ต้องสำรองจ่ายได้ด้วยนะ ตอบโจทย์ทั้งงานบริการและค่าใช้จ่ายเลยค่ะ
0x30e281d8c57c3d91_0x409bb92933c6afd9.en: I came for wisdom tooth extraction and surgery. It was my first time here and I was very impressed. Everything was clean, professional, and the service was excellent. The staff, from the counter staff to the doctor, were lovely. Before coming, I did a lot of research on where to go, searching for reviews on social media until I found this place. They said the doctor was fast, painless, and had minimal swelling. And it was exactly as advertised. The doctor was highly skilled and worked very quickly; extracting one tooth took only 15 minutes. There was very little swelling (you wouldn't even notice unless you were looking closely). For anyone afraid of pain, I can assure you I felt almost no pain at all, not even during the procedure. The doctor was attentive, friendly, and even more handsome than advertised (I was so shy I couldn't even look him in the eye!). Plus, they accept social security insurance without requiring any upfront payment. It was perfect in both service and cost!

0x30e281d8c57c3d91_0x409bb92933c6afd9.text: ประทับใจมากค่ะะ ตั้งแต่เข้ามาปรึกษาและเข้ารับการผ่าฟันคุด คุณหมอให้คำแนะนำและอธิบายขั้นตอนต่าง ๆ อย่างละเอียด คุณหมอ ผู้ช่วย และพี่พนักงาน ดูแลดีมากค่ะ ใส่ใจในทุกขั้นตอน ระหว่างทำก็มีการสอบถามตลอดว่าโอเคมั้ย แล้วก็หลังผ่าฟันคุดทางคลินิกยังมีการทักมาติดตามอาการอย่างต่อเนื่องและให้คำแนะนำในการดูแลแผลเพิ่มเติม ทำให้รู้สึกว่าที่นี่ไม่ได้ดูแลแค่ตอนรักษาเสร็จ แต่ยังใส่ใจคนไข้หลังการรักษาด้วย โดยรวมประทับใจทั้งคุณหมอ ทีมงาน การบริการ และการติดตามอาการ ได้รับการดูแลเป็นอย่างดีมาก ๆ ค่ะ 🫰🏻🫰🏻
0x30e281d8c57c3d91_0x409bb92933c6afd9.en: I was very impressed! From the consultation to the wisdom tooth extraction, the doctor provided detailed advice and explanations of the procedure. The doctor, assistants, and staff took excellent care of me. They were attentive throughout the process, constantly checking in to see if I was okay. Even after the extraction, the clinic followed up regularly and provided additional wound care instructions. 0x30e29f2c6112a10d_0x6958ccb92e0dc5c4.text: I had a 2,700-graft DHI hair transplant with Dr Danai at BEQ Hair Center in September and had a really positive experience. I decided to get a transplant back in March and spent around two months speaking to different clinics in both Turkey and Thailand before choosing BEQ. One of the main reasons I went with them was that they really listened to what I wanted from my hairline. I didn’t want an overly conservative or already-mature/receded hairline, and BEQ were probably the most enthusiastic about finding a design that matched my goals while still being realistic for my donor area. I travelled from Japan for the procedure, and communication beforehand was always easy. The clinic itself is modern and clean, and on the day I never felt rushed. Dr Danai spent plenty of time discussing and designing the hairline with me and was very involved throughout the procedure. DHI was recommended for my case because I wanted to cover the areas where I’d already lost my hair while also bringing the hairline down, rather than simply filling in and maintaining my existing hairline. This was actually one of the main reasons I chose BEQ, as some of the other clinics I spoke to were much more conservative about lowering it. I’d originally been estimated around 1,800–2,200 grafts, but once Dr Danai assessed everything properly in person, it became clear that achieving the coverage and lower hairline I wanted would require more, so we ultimately went with 2,700 grafts. The surgery is definitely a long day, especially with 2,700 grafts, but I was really impressed by the patience of the whole team. The anaesthetic honestly wasn’t bad, and once it had kicked in, I couldn’t feel the extraction or implantation at all (although hearing the hairs being implanted into my head was pretty funny). The hardest part was probably just lying in the same position for a long time, but I recognise that mine was quite a big procedure. Despite working on my head for hours, nobody ever seemed rushed, annoyed or eager to finish. They remained friendly and attentive throughout and just kept going until everything was done properly. The whole medical team was very professional, and I felt completely safe throughout. I never really had any reason not to. The aftercare has also been very thorough. I was given medication and clear instructions for the recovery period and returned to the clinic for cleaning and follow-up after the procedure. It’s still far too early for me to judge the final result, but so far I’m very happy with the hairline, graft placement, and healing. I’ll update my review further down the line once the hair has actually had time to grow!
0x30e29f2c6112a10d_0x6958ccb92e0dc5c4.author: Taylor-Willliam Hill

I highly recommend this clinic and I would most definitely use them again! Thank you so much for your help.

0x30e2a50045b86719_0x3dd198b19a7ebdb4.text: บอกเลยว่าประทับใจมากๆ ตั้งแต่ก้าวเข้ามา พนักงานต้อนรับยิ้มแย้ม เป็นกันเอง ทำให้รู้สึกผ่อนคลายไม่เกร็งเลยค่ะ ภายในคลินิกสะอาดมาก บรรยากาศสว่างโล่ง ไม่อึดอัด เครื่องมือและอุปกรณ์ทันสมัย ดูแล้วมั่นใจได้ในเรื่องความปลอดภัย คุณหมออธิบายละเอียดมาก มีความใจเย็น ให้คำแนะนำเป็นขั้นตอน เข้าใจง่าย ไม่รีบร้อน ที่สำคัญคือมือเบามาก ทำให้รู้สึกสบายกว่าที่คิดเยอะเลยค่ะ 😍 ตอนทำก็มีการถามตลอดว่ารู้สึกเจ็บหรือไม่ ใส่ใจคนไข้สุดๆ เรื่องราคา ถือว่าเหมาะสม ไม่แพงเกินไปเมื่อเทียบกับคุณภาพและการบริการ หลังทำยังมีการแนะนำวิธีดูแลช่องปากต่อเนื่องให้ด้วย รู้สึกว่าได้ความรู้เพิ่มไปอีก สรุปคือใครที่กำลังมองหาคลินิกทำฟันที่ทั้งบริการดี คุณหมอเก่ง สะอาด และใส่ใจคนไข้ แนะนำเลยค่ะที่นี่ ไม่ผิดหวังแน่นอน 💯✨
0x30e2a50045b86719_0x3dd198b19a7ebdb4.en: I have to say, I was very impressed from the moment I stepped in. The reception staff were smiling and friendly, making me feel relaxed and not nervous at all. The clinic itself was very clean, bright, and spacious. The equipment and tools were modern, giving me confidence in its safety. The dentist explained everything in detail, was very patient, and gave step-by-step instructions that were easy to understand. They weren't rushed, and most importantly, had a very gentle touch, making the experience much more comfortable than I expected. 😍 During the procedure, they constantly asked if I felt any pain, showing incredible care for the patient. The price was reasonable, not too expensive considering the quality and service. They even provided post-treatment advice on how to continue caring for your oral hygiene, which was very educational. In summary, if you're looking for a dental clinic with excellent service, a skilled dentist, cleanliness, and attentive care, I highly recommend this place. You won't be disappointed! 💯✨

0x30519469cfe82835_0x31ae7a257b8a3ebd.text: If you're ever in need of a vet in Krabi, look no further than Bangkok Krabi Animal Hospital! I recently had to bring my furry friend in for a check-up and was blown away by the level of care and attention we received. First of all, the staff at Bangkok Krabi Animal Hospital are some of the friendliest and most welcoming people I've ever encountered at a vet's office. They clearly love animals and take great pride in their work, which is always reassuring when you're bringing your beloved pet in for treatment. The vets themselves are top-notch as well. They're incredibly knowledgeable and skilled, and took the time to explain everything they were doing and why. It was clear that they really cared about my pet's well-being and were doing everything in their power to ensure he was healthy and happy. One thing I really appreciated about Bangkok Krabi Animal Hospital was how clean and well-organized the facility was. Everything was clearly labeled and there were separate areas for different types of treatment, which helped to minimize any confusion or chaos. All in all, I couldn't have asked for a better experience at Bangkok Krabi Animal Hospital. They're truly the best of the best when it comes to pet care in Krabi, and I would highly recommend them to anyone in need of veterinary services.

0x30519469cfe82835_0x31ae7a257b8a3ebd.text: Caring staff helped me to get appropriate food for a starving kitten, I also brought my adult cat here when he was bitten in a fight, they were professional and kind, and for me the cost was very reasonable. 0x30e2995a5225f79f_0xb938a2def7ca68c5.text: I finally visited this salon yesterday, and honestly, now I understand why everyone raves about it! 💅 First of all, they don’t just make you look beautiful here they actually create an atmosphere of comfort and good vibes. Everything is spotless, tidy, and tastefully designed cozy, but without any pretentiousness. What really surprised me is that they have their own kitchen and not some trendy fusion nonsense, but real home style comfort food that warms your soul: hot borsch, rich kharcho soup, amazing khachapuri, and the classic Olivier salad, just like mom makes for New Year’s. Everything is fresh, beautifully served, and generously portioned you can tell it’s made with love, not just for show. 🍲🥗 Now, the best part the manicure. Ekaterina is an absolute magician! 💖 She creates gorgeous, perfectly shaped long nails, works carefully, with style and patience. Plus, she’s incredibly sweet, friendly, and open minded chatting with her is a pleasure, and time flies. After the treatment (and that delicious meal), I left the salon feeling like I’d just spent time in a cozy place where people genuinely care about you. 🌸 💯 Bottom line: a fantastic spot where you can both pamper yourself and enjoy amazing food a rare combo, but they’ve nailed it. Definitely coming back, and recommending it to all my friends!

0x30da3aa2fccccc1d_0x58226f9e7d906fbe.text: I had to get a crown whilst on holiday in Chiang Mai. I found Dr Pongsakorn's dental clinic and walked in off the street. I explained my problem and he took me in straight away as he had a spare appointment. He x-rayed my teeth and took me into his clinic and showed me the issue causing the problem on the x-ray screen. He discussed in perfect English 2 methods of treatment, outlining his preferred method and why. This was in fact the easier and less expensive route. I was booked in for treatment 2 days later. I had impressions taken, a temporary crown fitted and a repair made to another tooth which was sitting next to the proposed crown. The appointment was booked for 2 hours and the treatment was first class, no pain whatsoever. I was booked in for a further appointment 2 days later when the zirconium crown was to be fitted. After much attention Dr Pongsakorn was not happy with it's fit, although I thought it was fine. He apologised but said he wasn't happy and could I come back in 2 days. On the next appointment the crown was fitted, he showed me before it was fitted, it looked totally amazing. After fitting this time he was satisfied. I'm more than pleased. I asked to have my teeth cleaned also. Which I must say was second to none! In short, this man is a genius, his staff are so kind and friendly. I have never received such dedicated treatment anywhere. The treatment I had was probably one third of what I would have paid in the UK. I most certainly will be back to get more work done. His attention to detail is excellent!
0x30da3aa2fccccc1d_0x58226f9e7d906fbe.author: David Pointon

0x30da3aa2fccccc1d_0x58226f9e7d906fbe.text: This is truly a hidden gem of a dental clinic! 💖 I'm so lucky and grateful to have found Dr. Pongsakorn ✨ I had my teeth whitened, a two-hour procedure. The doctor and nurses were very professional, and the dentist cleaned my teeth very thoroughly. I'm extremely satisfied with the results! The stains are gone! My teeth are noticeably whiter! I'm so happy! Before this, I consulted with six clinics in the old city, and Pongsakorn offered the best price, including a cleaning! 👍 (Other clinics charged an extra 800-1200 baht for cleaning). The dentist can communicate in English, making the entire procedure very smooth. He's also very honest and straightforward, without any sales pitches. He explained to me that the difference between different whitening treatments lies only in the intensity of the light; the gel itself is the same. This dentist uses medium concentration light, which was perfect for my first whitening experience! 👍

0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.text: A friend and I spent two challenging and rewarding weeks at Palapon in April. It was the low-season and initially there was only one other person at the camp and she left soon after we arrived. Instead of being in a large group, the two of us were fortunate to get individualized attention I signed up for the Intensive Fitness Program, and he focused on Muay Thai Training, although many of the classes overlapped. All of the instructors are professionals who are dedicated to their craft. The three yoga instructors had their own style and way of connecting with students. I was very impressed with their patience and willingness to adjust the class to suit our (my) limitations. Thanks to them my hips are no longer so tight. Klaus led the Body Weight class, which was the most fear inducing and painful activity of the day. The intensity of the movements and the focus on slow, contracted form made it a challenge. Having him stand over us provided added motivation. The Muay Thai instructors were playful but also serious about students getting the most out of the experience. I’m not naturally a puncher or kicker but I learned how to leverage angles for a more powerful kick and how to control my breathing when punching. Initially, the movements felt awkward and I was gassed after every round. By the end I felt more comfortable weaving, bobbing and striking. Klaus’ son Nick headed up the kitchen, as well as handled miscellaneous duties. The food was uniformly delicious and nutritious. We looked forward to every meal, which was always enough to power us through the day. Nick also gave us many valuable insights into Thai culture and history. His presence reminded us that Palapon is family business that was built from the ground up. For me the biggest take-aways surrounded good nutrition, consistency and mental toughness. I was already aware that I needed to improve my nutrition and push myself a bit harder. However, there’s a big difference between knowing something and experiencing it first hand. After two weeks I lost 2% body fat and about three kilos. I’m noticeably leaner (I’m 172cm and went from 74KG to 71KG), even if the physical transformation wasn’t huge. Now that I’ve returned to civilian life, I’m more conscious of my workouts and diet. The camp gave me the right tools to continue to improve my overall health. Final note: The living facilities are a bit rustic. We chose to live in the hotel down the block which was the right decisions for us. Palapon is for people who want to sweat and are willing to grind through the multitude of activities. Like any anything in life, you’ll get out of it what you put in. I highly recommend Palpon to anyone serious about optimizing their health.
0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.author: Francis Huang

0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.text: Palapon!! Hua Hin's Hidden Muay Thai/ Fitness/Weightloss Sanctaury! Palapon is a fantastic Muay Thai and fitness camp. The training and the diet is second to none! Excellent regime and great instructors. What I'd say is... TRUST THE PROCESS. This was the second time visiting the camp for a 3 week weight loss stint. I was in Palapon before in Feb '24. I was also back there in Nov 24 for 10 x walk-in classes. I absolutely love this sanctuary. I'll be back again soon too. When walking on to camp you can't but notice the beautifully manicured garden with birds, squirrels and geckos moving around the place. The landscape staff are there most days doing their bit to maintain a fine relaxing environment for the participants! Klaus is an extremely knowledgeable fitness instructor. He helped me overcome a couple of injury niggles I had before arriving in camp. He architects the training to suit your needs and your abilities. While I was there I learned and developed a good habit mindset. This really helps from techniques, pushing yourself at the right time and diet and what foods are good and bad. He has a mind full of information. Tap into it while you're there!!! Klaus is also a very compassionate and empathetic person and helped calm down when receiving bad news from home. He listened and gave me advice and it really helped me. He's practically minded and to the point. I'm a firm believer of showing up on time for class and showing commitment to everything you do! Klaus thrives when he sees this! I would highly recommend Palapon whether you travelling solo or a couple or with friends. You'll meet so many different people from all walks of life. It's an absolute education learning about different cultures and environments. Amazing! From what I've encountered in Palapon, everyone is on the same wavelength bar the odd one or two. People are looking for the same or similar outcome or goal. But they are also seeking a new way of life to be able to take home with them. It's about creating good habits and being able to implement them when arriving home. The training I won't lie can be tough going especially in the 35C heat. But the satisfaction you get after achieving each class is brilliant. The accommodation is very good. You have a choice of an on-site camp room or the local Hotel with a decent 25m pool that's 5 mins walk away. The food is nourishing and is healthy and geared towards your program. Try the intermittent fasting with training! You'll achieve great results. Thank you so much Klaus! You're a legend and very good friend. Thanks for everything. I'll see you again soon! 🙏💪💯
0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.author: Mick P

0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.text: I recently completed a transformative two-week stay at Palapon Fitness Camp. At 47 years old, I'm in reasonable shape, though not nearly as fit as I used to be. Accompanied by a friend, we arrived pleasantly surprised by the well-maintained training complex, complete with beautiful gardens, a pool, and a cabanas. Klaus, the owner, is not only a gracious host but also an exceptionally knowledgeable trainer. He crafted a superb program that gradually increased in intensity, ensuring it was always challenging yet safe. The Muay Thai and yoga coaches—Dang, Bird, Anna, Ghan, and Chomphu—are top-notch, helping us to progressively enhance our skills and fitness gains. The meal plan, which included three meals a day for six days a week, was perfectly designed to boost energy, build muscle, and reduce fat. The breakfast consisted of yogurt, museli, protein powder and berries. The other meals, a combination of cuisines including Thai, prepared by Nick and Thi were consistently delicious, satisfying even the pickiest eaters without any cravings for external food. Inspired by the meals, I plan on recreating some of these healthy and tasty dishes back home. For accommodations, Palapon offers the choice between on-site bungalows and apartment-style residences a five-minute walk away. We opted for the apartments, and recommend this option to enjoy the added privacy, kitchenette, air conditioning, and your own showers—quite necessary after the rigorous workouts. The stats! Over the two weeks, I lost 3% body fat (2.4 kg), gained 200 g of muscle, and reduced my visceral fat from 3 to 1.9, thanks to the healthy diet. More importantly, I left feeling healthier, stronger, and leaner, with a renewed perspective on food and fitness and healthier habits that I now consider my new normal. For anyone considering a fitness retreat, I highly recommend Palapon. Make the decision after reading the reviews to change your life. Investing in your health is truly the best decision you can make—it always pays dividends!
0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.author: Pong Yen

0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.text: I was here on the weightloss program: Lets get one things straight if you are going here, you are not going on a lazy holiday. You will be suffering at times. If you want to be pampered, go to a luxury resort. But if you do it well, it can be a (life) changing experience in becoming more physically active and healthy person. What was exactly my goal. Not that I wasn't a happy person, but my habits and physique weren't like I wanted them and somehow i couldn't make that change on my own. Don't expect Klaus and his team to change that over night, but if your are in the right mindset the are a really huge help in the right direction! I made great progress during my stay and not only physically, that is something very positive and valuable i will take home. Next to some beautiful memories and precious friends i made there. A shared goal will unite 😊. In a bit under eight weeks my weight went down from 123,9 to 108 kilo. That is a loss of 15,9 kilo🥳 (35 pounds). I feel great and sometimes I almost don't recognise myself in the mirror 😆. Early 2024 I underwent surgery on my belly and was still experiencing pain of that when i came to Palapon in November'25. But since my stay then no more pain. If you think your stay is going to be an easy ride let me warn you: Unless you are used to working out and fastening, you will suffer, experience pain, feel sorry for yourself, ask yourself what the h*** have i started. At times I found my self whining like a little cry baby. Although that isn't my style. At those times I found Klaus and Tom a great help, listening and getting me back motivated. Thank you, @Klaus and @Tom for listening to my whining every "now and then". Klaus thanks for the very subtle (sometimes less subtle 😂)kicks under my butt to get me motivated and going again. "Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance, you must keep moving! Team Palapon, thanks for the push i needed!
0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.author: Harro Gerber

0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.text: Palapon – No Nonsense, Outcome Focused, Life-Changing Reboot I spent one month at Palapon weight loss and fitness camp in Hua Hin, Thailand and would highly recommend this experience to anyone truly interested in a reboot to jump-start a fitness transformation focused on lasting results. In January 2025 I was the heaviest I have ever been, having neglected my personal fitness for over 5 years. I knew I needed time to focus intently on restarting fitness habits and searched globally for a program that would best suit my needs. I was not looking for a luxurious “holiday” fitness destination, but rather a program truly focused on structured exercise, nutrition, and results. Klaus, owner or Palapon, and his Team delivered. Over 28 days I dropped 8.5 kg – my target was 9.0. The structure and support were perfect. I enjoyed the camp setting and appreciated the sense of community Klaus creates as fellow “campers” encourage each other. The group size of roughly 12 participants maximum is perfect for getting to know and rely upon one another which goes a long way toward accountability – not just to your own goals, but to the group as well. The Team was fantastic – from the daily meal preparation and service to the personal attention during Yoga and Muay Thai classes and even a chaperone for our morning walk/runs. And finally, the personal attention from Klaus was outstanding. He provided nutritional counseling and led daily “Klausfit” sessions as well as mobility focused classes. There is no hiding from Klaus – be it during classes or when out on the town – he is always watching! Thank you Palapon – and thank you Klaus for the reboot and for providing a structure I have been able to incorporate into my daily routine. The fitness journey continues.
0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.author: Don Bennett

0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.text: Spent 10 days at Palapon in Feb 2023, and I would highly recommend it for anyone with a willingness to lose weight, get fit, or just to change up an unhealthy lifestyle. Owner Klaus and wife Valerie are lovely and really want to help you improve: Klaus will ensure that you put in the work, whilst Valerie's nutritional cooking is actually delicious. His kids are also very nice and helpful. Stay in the villas if you want the convenience of being on-site and to have somewhere close to relax or 'thai shower' between classes, or stay in the apartments (also close by) if you want greater privacy. Pool is relaxing after class, and the Hua Hin area is nice to explore if you have the energy. Trust me though, you may not! Inclusion of massages, body scans and medical tests was a nice touch. The classes are all good, I enjoyed the 'Klaus Fit' (think cross fit) and Muay Thai especially. Yoga was new to me (and more difficult than expected) but the teachers were excellent - and patient! One day a week 'off' is a much needed break that also allows exploration of the wider area, and there are some beautiful sites to visit. Flexible programs are available, I did some surfing whilst a few others were doing kite-surfing lessons alongside a portion of the daily Palapon activities. If you are wanting a luxury Club-Med 5-Star resort-style fitness program this might not be for you, but if you are intent on working hard to improve your life or lose the weight then I suggest going to Palapon. It might not be easy, but you'll get amazing results. I did and the other lovely people around me staying longer even more so. I'll be going back - hopefully next time for a longer to really cement the gains.
0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.author: Cam Cowie

0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.text: Thumbs all the way up for a real holistic fitness experience. During my stay of ten days, I gained a lot of information about my body, how it works and how I could make it work even better. If you are ready to accept the challenge, go for it! You will work out with Klaus only in the mornings and you might think he is just an ordinary instructor, showing some known moves. In reality, he is a real "sensei", watching you, analysing you, discovering your weaknesses which you are not even aware of and gently approaching you with suggestions - nutrition, exercise, massage, mental fitness boosters, etc. - which leads you to a life changing path. You will work in a small group, and yet Klaus will take care of each and everyone individually, keeping an eye on during the whole day! This is not a place for those leaving on the surface and urging to share fancy pictures of "things". But, this is a place for the ones who would accept the challenge, commit to goals and respect their instructor and at the end enjoy sharing a fancy picture of their own! Keep in mind that the camp is a camp and if you need facilities, consider staying at the apartment or arrange your own fancy five star. Palapon team members are all experts on motivating, they will not leave you on your own and push you to make the most out of your retreat. This might be exhausting, considering that you are totally out of your comfort zone. So make sure you bring your inner motivation and full commitment with you. Overall I would definetly suggest Palapon to those who are ready to face their weaknesses, to learn how to eliminate them and who are committed to reach their goals.
0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.author: Umran Bilen

0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.text: 5 Stars! A Paradise for Fitness Enthusiasts Arrival in Paradise: When I opened the gate to the fitness camp, I could hardly believe my eyes. A beautiful garden with small cabins awaited me. While the training areas are a bit dated, they have everything you need for an effective workout. Personalized Support and Small Groups: The owner personally attends to his clients, and you feel well looked after from the very first moment. The groups are very small (I've experienced a maximum of 9 people, averaging 3-4), so each participant receives the trainers' full attention. Great Food and Varied Training: The food was varied and delicious. The training sessions were challenging yet motivating and diverse. Unjustified Criticisms: I cannot understand the criticisms expressed in other reviews. I never saw the dogs in any training area. They were always on the lawns. And the occasional bird dropping is simply unavoidable in nature and probably happens at every outdoor restaurant/cafe in Thailand. Problems were resolved immediately: Minor issues that arose during my stay were immediately resolved by the owner or the trainers. Conclusion: I can recommend this fitness camp to anyone looking for effective training in a stunning setting. I had a fantastic time here. No mass tourism, but rather an individualized program. I can't comment on the accommodations on the premises, as I stayed at the Hotel Nice. It's worth noting that electricity and water are charged separately after a certain length of stay, and toilet paper is only provided as a welcome gift; it is not replenished.

0x30502e35ee3b1403_0x9b411843375c8f23.text: Our cat was hit by a car and taken to this vet by a neighbour. By the time I arrived, he had already been sedated and “stabilised.” Within that very short time, they had already run blood tests, told us he had parasites in his blood, and started pushing treatment for it. Meanwhile, my neighbour had already been asked to pay 10,000 baht upfront, and the bill had reached around 6,000 baht before I had even arrived. When I got there and explained this was my cat, despite the fact we clearly knew where he was and why, the staff were completely inflexible and unhelpful. They insisted I couldn’t make decisions because someone else had brought him in. There was no proper guidance, no reassurance, and the vet wasn’t even present. The staff didn’t seem to know what they were doing. Instead, the focus was: He must stay overnight Pay additional fees (including 800 baht for the stay) Go and buy your own cat litter and food This is for a cat that had just been hit by a car. We were then told there was nothing seriously wrong and that he just needed cage rest. That turned out to be completely wrong. A week later, after following their advice, I took him to my regular vet. He had a broken pelvis that had shifted forward and needed immediate emergency surgery. So to summarise: Thousands spent immediately on unnecessary tests and treatments Parasite treatment prioritised over trauma from a road accident No vet present, and staff clearly unsure Poor communication and zero flexibility in a distressing situation A serious injury completely missed Because of that missed diagnosis, treatment was delayed and the situation became far more serious than it should have been. He has now had surgery and is recovering, but this could have ended very differently. I don’t write reviews lightly, but this was not just poor service — it was a complete failure in care and judgement.
0x30502e35ee3b1403_0x9b411843375c8f23.author: Paul Melvin
