0x30e29fd7befa7c5b_0x1549ed9b4b400f32.author: JIRAPAT TEPPROMWONG

0x30e29fd7befa7c5b_0x1549ed9b4b400f32.text: Today I had Ulthera Prime + Oligio at the clinic. Ulthera Prime 800 shots was manageable, very manageable, and not painful at all. The doctor was lovely, patient, and gave great advice. Oligio 400 shots was also great, not painful at all. After the treatment, I could eat normally and go about my life. Highly recommend it!!! The doctor and the staff were very lovely. Because I'm a breastfeeding mother, the doctor advised me on what I could do and what I might not be able to do yet. The staff kept checking on me, asking if I was feeling well and if I needed to pump milk. They were so lovely. P.S. I had it done at Cera Clinic, Rama 9 branch. Very impressed!
0x30e29fd7befa7c5b_0x1549ed9b4b400f32.author: Waranya Watcharanon

0x30e29fd7befa7c5b_0x1549ed9b4b400f32.text: Sera Clinic exceeded all my expectations. The staff were incredibly kind, professional, and made me feel completely at ease from start to finish. They took the time to explain everything in detail before and after the treatment, which really helped me trust the process. The clinic itself is spotless and well-maintained, and you can tell they genuinely care about each and every client. I had Ultherapy/Pico/Thermage treatments and the results were even better than I hoped for — absolutely amazing. If you're in Bangkok and looking for a skin clinic, this is the one. Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely be coming back!
0x30e29fd7befa7c5b_0x1549ed9b4b400f32.author: TAEGYU KANG

0x30e29fd7befa7c5b_0x1549ed9b4b400f32.text: I used the services at Sera Clinic Rama 9. It was an Ultraformer MPT treatment. Genuine machine, full treatment regimen. The service was excellent from the moment I walked in. The staff were lovely, they cleaned my face, applied numbing cream, and were gentle and meticulous. I had to change into a different gown before the treatment, which was very comfortable for my skin. The doctor gave good and detailed advice. The clinic is beautiful and very clean.
0x30e29fd7befa7c5b_0x1549ed9b4b400f32.author: Beary ST

0x30e29fd7befa7c5b_0x1549ed9b4b400f32.text: Professional and Comfortable Experience “I had an amazing experience at Sera clinic The doctor was so kind and professional, ensuring I felt comfortable throughout the entire laser treatment process. They took the time to explain everything, which really eased my nerves. The clinic is clean, well-maintained, and uses advanced equipment. I’m very happy with my results and will definitely return for future sessions!”
0x30e29fd7befa7c5b_0x1549ed9b4b400f32.author: Ann Viphada

0x30e29fd7befa7c5b_0x1549ed9b4b400f32.text: Here's an ASMR facial treatment video. I highly recommend this clinic; the price is the best. There's parking available in the G Tower building; the clinic is on the 2nd floor – just take the elevator. The staff are very helpful, and the doctor provides complete information. After the Ulthera Prime treatment, the doctor even lets the client check the number of shots. Transparent and clear. Highly recommend!
0x30e29fd7befa7c5b_0x1549ed9b4b400f32.author: ณัฏฐา รักซ้อน

0x3102bfe7795ee2fd_0xc0eb30e5d3bec042.text: เป็นโรงพยาบาลสัตว์ ที่ไม่ได้ช่วยเหลือเฉพาะสัตว์อย่างเดียว คุณหมอ และน้องๆยังช่วย เจ้าของสัตว์เลี้ยงได้ดีอีกด้วยในกรณีของเรา น้องหมาค่อนข้างดุ หมอ ช่วยแนะนำและช่วยแบ่งเบาได้เยอะ ขอบคุณคุณหมอมากๆทุกครั้งที่เราโทรไปขอคำปรึกษาคุณหมอใช้เวลาและอธิบายได้ คุณหมอไม่เลี้ยงไข้ ช่วยเซฟเวลาเจ้าของและบางครั้งก็ควบคุมค่าใช้จ่ายให้
0x3102bfe7795ee2fd_0xc0eb30e5d3bec042.author: Tippawan Phetpradup

0x3102bfe7795ee2fd_0xc0eb30e5d3bec042.text: มาครั้งแรกตามรีวิว คือหมอใจดีมาก คนให้บริการในโรงพยาบาลก็ดีมากทุกๆคน ทุกคนดูรักสัตว์เลี้ยงเราเหมือนกับเรา ที่ชอบมากๆคือมีคนคอยอุ้มสุนัขลงจากรถ อุ้มมาส่งรถให้เรา เพราะสุนัขเราตัวใหญ่มาก เราไม่สะดวกอุ้มสุนัขเราลงรถเลย ค่ารักษาไม่แพง ทุกคนยิ้มแย้มแจ่มใส ถึงจะมีโดนลูกค้าวีนบ้างก็ตาม 100/10 แนะนำ

จากที่เอาแมวไปฉีดวัคซีน และอาบน้ำ หยดยา น้องๆบริการดีมากคะแต่ตั้งแต่ มาะปิดร้าน ที่พัมยากลางกลับบ้านมืด ทุกวัน เลยต้องเอาตัวที่อาบน้ำ มา อาบแถวร้านซอยสยาม นะคะ ก็ เหลือ แค่รอ วัคซีนครบปี น้องๆเขาคงโทรมาตาม เพราะมี5ตัวนะคะ คงไปฉีดต่อเนื่องที่นี่หมดคะ
0x3102bfe7795ee2fd_0xc0eb30e5d3bec042.author: Clubneena Khomwan

0x3102bfe7795ee2fd_0xc0eb30e5d3bec042.text: คุณหมอ และพนักงานทุกคนดีมากๆค่ะ พูดจาดี เอาใจใส่ เอาแมวไปทำหมันอีกที่มาจนน้องไม่สบายเพิ่ม อาจเกิดจากที่อยู่รวมกับน้องๆที่เจ้าของมาฝาก กับน้องที่ป่วย จากทำหมันที่ควรอยู่ 1 อาทิตย์จนอยู่มา 1 เดือนเต็มเลยเอาน้องออกจากที่เก่า แล้วมาที่นี่ประทับใจมากค่ะ

คุณหมอผช. ไม่แน่ใจชื่อลูกหมีมั้ย แต่ดูแลน้องแมวดีมากๆค่ะ แจงอาการละเอียดยิบและบอกว่ากำลังจะทำอะไร จะรักษาอย่างไรเป็นขั้นเป็นตอน ตอนนี้น้องแมวหายสนิทแล้ว ประทับใจมาก น้องแมวที่บ้านทุกตัวก็ฉีดวัคซีนกับที่นี่ บุคลากรน่ารักเป็นกันเอง ให้คำแนะนำดี

หมอเก่งมากเลยค่ะ วินิจฉัยโรคน้องได้ละเอียดยิบให้คำแนะนำได้ดีมาก ไว้ใจที่สุดตั้งแต่ที่เคยผ่านโรงพยาบาลสัตว์มา คุณหมอและพี่เลี้ยงน่ารักทุกคนเอ็นดู สัตว์เลี้ยงของเราเหมือนเป็นเจ้าของเลย ราคาไม่แรงแต่บอกเลยหายแน่นอน ขอเป็นอีกหนึ่งเสียงนะคะ🥰🥰🥰

พาน้องแมวไปฉีดวัคซีนสะดวกดี เพราะ รพ. อยู่ติดถนนสุขุมวิท คุณหมอใจดีน่ารัก ทีมงานบริการดี แต่ต้องยอมรับว่า ค่ายา ค่าวัคซีนต่างๆ ในแถบพัทยา - ชลบุรี ราคาค่อนข้างสูงกว่าแถบ คลีนิคสัตว์ที่แถบ เขาใหญ่ และ อ.ปากช่อง ที่มีบ้านพักอยู่มากพอสมควรครับ

เอาเเมวไปอาบน้ำนัดไว้11โมงนัดล่วงหน้าไว้หลายวันก่อนที่จะพาเเมวไปอาบน้ำได้ไปโทรไปถามทุกอย่างเรียบร้อยโรงพยาบาลบอกให้เอาเเมวไปได้เลยคิวอาบได้เลย ทางเรานำเเมวไปส่งที่โรงพยาบาลตั้งเเต่11โมฃตามเวลานัดหมาย สรุปตอนบ่ายโมงตรงโรงพยาบาลโทรมาถามว่าเเมวเจ้าของคือใครเเละยังไม่ได้ทำการอาบน้ำให้เเมวค่ะ ทิ้งเเมวไว้ในกรงเเละขังเเมวไว้เป็นเวลานาน2ชม.ซึ่งเหตุการณ์นี้เเสดงให้เห็นถึงความไม่มีควาทรับผิดชอบของโรงพยาบาลเเละทำงานอย่างไม่เป็นมืออาชีพจึงทำให้เกิดความบกพร่องนี้ เเมวไม่ควรถูกขังไว้ในกรงเล็กๆนานถึง2ชม. ในที่ที่เเปลกที่เเละโรงพยาบาล ถ้าหากยังไม่ได้คิวอาบน้ำโรงพยาบาลก็ควรที่จะโทบอกจะได้ไปรับเเมวกลับบ้านก่อนค่ะเเต่ทางโรงพยาบาลไม่เเจ้งหรือไม่โทรบอกอะไรทั้งนั้นค่ะทั้งๆที่มีเบอร์โทรศัพท์เเละข้อมูลทุกอย่างหมดทำเเบบนี้คือไร้ความรับผิดชอบมากค่ะ ถ้าให้0ดาวได้ก็คงให้เเล้วค่ะ จะไม่พาเเมวที่เหลือเเละหมาที่เคยอาบน้ำกับที่นี่เข้าไปใช้บริการในครั้งต่อไปเเน่นอนรวมถึงโรงพยาบาลไม่รับผิดชอบอะไรทั้งนั้น ได้เเต่พูดว่าขอโทษซึ่งคำขอโทษนั้นไม่สามารถเเก้ไขปัญหาที่เกิดขึ้นได้ค่ะ
0x3102bfe7795ee2fd_0xc0eb30e5d3bec042.author: Amy

0x30e29da1fab10151_0xeb3fc140fa1c767.text: I had an excellent experience with my physiotherapist (Peter). From the very first session, they took the time to thoroughly assess my condition, clearly explain the root cause of my pain, and outline a personalized treatment plan. Their knowledge, professionalism, and genuine care made me feel confident that I was in the right hands. Each session was focused and productive, combining hands-on treatment with targeted exercises that I could continue at home. They were patient in answering my questions and always made sure I understood the purpose behind each movement and technique. I noticed steady improvement in my strength, mobility, and overall comfort within just a few weeks. What truly sets them apart is their compassionate approach and commitment to long-term recovery, not just quick fixes. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a skilled and supportive physiotherapist.
0x30e29da1fab10151_0xeb3fc140fa1c767.author: Noah Metheny

0x30e29da1fab10151_0xeb3fc140fa1c767.text: This is a bit long, but the bottom line is: I highly recommend this place for anyone wanting a lasting cure. You won't be disappointed. They treat you like family. Personally, I've tried many places, from physical therapy clinics that focused on equipment to several well-known private hospitals. For the past two months, I've been undergoing procedures 2-3 times a week, but my symptoms didn't improve. My case was quite complex and difficult to diagnose (severe office syndrome/TOS/herniated disc), with symptoms of arm weakness and finger numbness. I finally found my solution here, and my symptoms have been steadily improving thanks to the doctors here. They pay close attention to detail, from accurate diagnosis and treatment to the use of appropriate equipment and providing sustainable treatment plans tailored to each individual's symptoms.
0x30e29da1fab10151_0xeb3fc140fa1c767.author: Gloyz Jiemjit

0x30e29da1fab10151_0xeb3fc140fa1c767.text: I completed 5 sessions here 💆‍♀️, and my pain improved by 90%. The therapists are skilled, attentive, and the clinic is fully equipped. With a few more sessions, I believe I can reach 100% recovery 🙌. Truly a professional and reassuring place. 🚘 Parking is available at Ari Parking. Just inform the clinic, and they'll validate your parking ticket for free parking. ——————————————————————— I had the opportunity to complete 5 physiotherapy sessions here 💆‍♀️✨. My pain, as assessed by the physiotherapists, has improved by almost 100%. I think that with a few more sessions, I can achieve full recovery. The clinic has a team that understands the condition in detail 🩺 and is fully equipped for treatment. 🚘 You can park your car at Ari Parking and inform the clinic to get a free parking stamp.
0x30e29da1fab10151_0xeb3fc140fa1c767.author: Phatt H.

0x30e29da1fab10151_0xeb3fc140fa1c767.text: This clinic provides excellent service, starting from the moment I called to make an appointment. They were very helpful because I was in a lot of pain and they quickly found an appointment for me. I then met with a physiotherapist (I was examined by Fluke, who is very kind, trustworthy, and has a great personality). The examination was very thorough, and the treatment was precise and effective. I didn't expect to recover so quickly. They gave excellent instructions on how to care for myself after returning home and planned follow-up appointments. The price was reasonable, not expensive at all. The place is clean, and the equipment is high-quality. I highly recommend it! 🫶🏻❤️🫶🏻
0x30e29da1fab10151_0xeb3fc140fa1c767.author: Nattinee Kanittanan

0x30e29da1fab10151_0xeb3fc140fa1c767.text: The doctor gave excellent advice, explaining the lifestyle changes that were causing my symptoms in a way that wasn't judgmental or blaming. I'm usually terrified of going to the doctor because I'm afraid of being criticized, but here, they were understanding and tried to help me adjust to my life and career with kind, respectful, and friendly words. It was good for both my physical and mental well-being. Thank you, Dr. Best, for making my first ever physiotherapy experience such a positive one. It has given me the motivation to take better care of my health. (: Highly recommend as the physiotherapist is very professional, understanding, informative, and kind.
0x30e29da1fab10151_0xeb3fc140fa1c767.author: Wirada Saelim

0x30e29da1fab10151_0xeb3fc140fa1c767.text: I came here for back pain and a herniated disc problem, and the clinic is close to home. On my first visit, the physiotherapist examined me and planned a very detailed treatment. They didn't just focus on using equipment, but analyzed the root cause of the problem and provided friendly advice on self-care, lifestyle changes, and exercises to strengthen muscles. I've now had three treatments and my symptoms have improved. Each visit provides helpful advice. The clinic is clean, conveniently located, and has parking. Overall, I'm very impressed.
0x30e29da1fab10151_0xeb3fc140fa1c767.author: Boondarick Niyatiwatchanchai

0x30e29da1fab10151_0xeb3fc140fa1c767.text: I came in here for a free consultation for my finger (those of you at Tiger Eye Martial Arts will have noticed I'm often taping my finger) and was so impressed I ended up staying for treatment and was even further impressed and had to give this place a shout out for any athletes that have any nagging injuries that could use work. The staff at Senseio Physical Therapy Clinic was very knowledgeable and I have a high standard and expectations when it comes to these things. A great business to have in the Ari community
0x30e29da1fab10151_0xeb3fc140fa1c767.author: Bashir Ahmad

0x30e29da1fab10151_0xeb3fc140fa1c767.text: If you have aches and pains or symptoms similar to office syndrome, this place is the place to go. They know and treat every symptom accurately, they don't prolong treatment unnecessarily, and the price is reasonable for the service you receive. All the physiotherapists are very kind and humble. You don't have to worry about being judged; everyone is happy to give advice at any time. You can ask anything. I really like this place. (I pay for everything myself every time I come for treatment.)
0x30e29da1fab10151_0xeb3fc140fa1c767.author: Sarun Wattanasupinyo

0x30da3b3571d5c08f_0x9a7358b6eeca0855.text: I had a really wonderful experience here. My first real acupuncture and cupping appointment and I feel very satisfied. Yes, quite tired afterwards, but this means energy is in motion. The women there were very tending to me and they truly listen to your concerns. Coming from Canada and that healthcare system, this was the best experience I have had inquiring about my health. The Acupuncturists are very gentle, and attentive to your wellbeing during the process. They worked to release my tension and gave me a natural Chinese medicine to help with horomonal and emotional well being. They are very diligent and are patient to communicate about the process. I will definitely be back. (Also the longest review I’ve ever wrote) hahah. Thank you again 🙏🏼
0x30da3b3571d5c08f_0x9a7358b6eeca0855.author: Julie Cameron

0x30da3b3571d5c08f_0x9a7358b6eeca0855.text: I recently had my first acupuncture and cupping session at this location, and it truly exceeded my expectations. The staff was courteous and attentive, and the provider took the time to ask detailed questions to ensure my specific concerns were addressed. (For my English speaking patients, the provider's English was very good.) The facility was clean, and the staff followed proper hygiene protocols, including wearing gloves. This first experience was outstanding, and I decided to purchase additional sessions due to the excellent care I received. After the treatment, I felt noticeably better and enjoyed a restful night’s sleep. I look forward to returning in a few days.
0x30da3b3571d5c08f_0x9a7358b6eeca0855.author: A Sullivan

0x30da3b3571d5c08f_0x9a7358b6eeca0855.text: I went to this clinic for cupping and acupuncture every week over a course of a few months while I was staying in Chiang Mai. I felt super comfortable with the doctor who is a kind and competent young woman. During my treatment I felt listened to and she truly understood my symptoms and attended them carefully. As a result of the treatment I both felt physical and psychological relief of my symptoms. If I ever come back to Chiang Mai I will without a doubt go back for treatment. I recommend this place to anyone who’s struggling with physical or mental symptoms for a treatment that covers all areas of health. You will be in the best hands here🩷
0x30da3b3571d5c08f_0x9a7358b6eeca0855.author: k qh

0x30da3b3571d5c08f_0x9a7358b6eeca0855.text: 100/10 Would "HIGHLY" recommend. Kindness from start to finish. Extremely helpful, so caring and attentive to my needs; I could feel a difference before I walked out. I know my health is very unique but here I felt safe, my body felt seen and healing immediately began. She knew exactly what to ask but I could tell she just needed me to confirm it. Spot on each time. I received both acupuncture and herbal medicine 💯🫶🏽 If you truly want healing and the most natural way, this is the place for you! 🥂 to natural healing
0x30da3b3571d5c08f_0x9a7358b6eeca0855.author: Meli Dee

0x30da3b3571d5c08f_0x9a7358b6eeca0855.text: I was having a rotator cuff on my right shoulder as well as frozen shoulder. I purchased 4 acupuncture treatments and I know it will not be cured but at least feel better. Staff were very friendly and concerned about my condition. My condition should take a long time treatment and they did their best to comfort me. They provided me with a great customer service and I am very satisfied with their service. They truly concerned about my symptoms and did beyond what I expected.
0x30da3b3571d5c08f_0x9a7358b6eeca0855.author: Kaylie Enders

0x30da3b3571d5c08f_0x9a7358b6eeca0855.text: I sprained my left ankle and came here after seeing online reviews praising the effectiveness of acupuncture. The clinic staff communicated well in Chinese and conducted a thorough examination. The acupuncture lasted about ten needles and 20 minutes. The swelling subsided significantly immediately; walking was still a little difficult, but the pain was much less. The next day I felt much better and could walk much more easily! Thank you for the attentive treatment!
0x30da3b3571d5c08f_0x9a7358b6eeca0855.author: MAY

0x30da3b3571d5c08f_0x9a7358b6eeca0855.text: 4days in Chiang Mai, visited here twice. meeting a doctor at the first place, and trying acupuncture & cupping & tuina massage first time. acupuncture, what i picked is a facial kind. that helps on face lifting. i can obviously see a result since first time. cupping & tuina massage, it’s so relaxing. service wise, staffs are very friendly and able to explain things in detail. most recommended! will definitely visit again when im in Chiang Mai next time.
0x30da3b3571d5c08f_0x9a7358b6eeca0855.author: Chidchon “Pear” Vichainarong

0x30da3b3571d5c08f_0x9a7358b6eeca0855.text: I have come here around 6 times in less than a month. I initially came for an acupuncture appointment and it really worked wonders. I went back for the cosmetic guasha which was amazing - Jam is very soft and gentle and was always thoughtful and ready to help. I did not have any treatment with her colleague Por but she was kind whenever we had an interaction. I will make sure to come back whenever I come back to Chiang Mai!
0x30da3b3571d5c08f_0x9a7358b6eeca0855.author: Alice Vandestrick

0x30e299b8ee359fab_0x8c32da60bf23e8f4.text: After SEVERAL successful visits, with pleasant minor treatments, such as fillings, I went on to having major work done without worry.. and, it is an honor for me to declare my continued full trust to, and respect for “Teeth Talk” after what I would categorize as “major surgery.”. At first, I was a bit uncertain about weather is was a good idea, to have surgery done so far from home, as I was about to have two crowns, and three implants done in the same session, but I felt safe and well informed all through the process! Very kind, informative and HIGHLY professional dentist, great assistants, and even kind, and friendly front office staff… Looking forward for my next appointment, and later, for the final fitting the last three crowns on the implant fixtures, when the fixtures have “settled in”.. 😁 THANK YOU VERY MUCH - Greetings from Kasper - Denmark 👌🥰👍

0x30e299b8ee359fab_0x8c32da60bf23e8f4.en: The doctor gave excellent advice. The staff were lovely and polite. The clinic was very clean. I wasn't disappointed at all. The doctor was kind, gentle, and calm. The consultation was excellent. The assistants and staff were lovely. This is one of the best places I've ever received treatment. 💗

0x30da3baf8b872861_0x9ffb4950c8373cea.text: This is the best dental clinic in Chiang Mai! I was on vacation for 10 days and needed some work done on my teeth. I went to another dental clinic to get a cleaning and asked to get a crown made for one of my teeth that I recently had a root canal done on in Shanghai. The first dental clinic could not make my crown in the 10 days I was visiting and recommended me to AYESays clinic. When I arrived, I was greeted and welcomed into the clinic, the space was spotless and air conditioned and the dentist's certifications were displayed in a glass case behind the receptionist’s desk. Dr. Homdok was very knowledgeable and explained every part of the process to me and examined the rest of my teeth too. The clinic was able to make my crown in 3 days!!! I also asked to get braces so the doctor recommended Danish 3-D braces which would work for my teeth and could be made during my time in Chiang Mai. During our vacation my 5 year old son developed a huge hole in the middle of two molars and needed to have the infection removed and remedied plus a partial pulpectomy. Dr. Homdok was able fit my son into his schedule at a moments notice and complete the work without causing my son pain during or after the partial pulpectomy and filling. Dr. Homdok and his staff went above and beyond to provide exceptional services to me and my son as well as recommend places to visit in Chiang Mai. The receptionist, Shampoo called grab cabs for us and even dropped us off to our hotel a few times. We are grateful to this clinic for their dedication to their clients and for their affordable prices!!!! If you have a chance to visit to Chiang Mai and need teeth work, please visit AYESays Clinic or just drop in to say hello! We will be back for sure !

0x30e2994ad04f5897_0x9b5efe99070727f5.text: ได้มีโอกาสมาใช้บริการกับทางคลินิก เดินทางมาสะดวกมาก มีรถไฟฟ้า MRT ผ่าน สามารถลงที่สถานีบางขุนนนท์ได้เลย ใครที่มาทำฟันเสร็จแล้ว นอกจากจะออกมาเจอเซเว่นและ starbucks ที่ตั้งอยู่ด้านข้างคลีนิคแล้ว ยังสามารถช็อปปิ้งต่อได้ที่ถนนบางขุนนนท์ทั้งเส้นเลย ของกินอร่อยๆเยอะมาก🥰 ทางคลินิกฯ จะเน้นคุณภาพที่ได้มาตรฐาน + ราคาที่เข้าถึงได้ ที่สำคัญคุณหมอใจดีและมือเบามาก วันนี้ไปขูดหินปูนตอนแรกนึกว่าจะต้องอุดฟัน เพราะเคยเช็คจากที่อื่นมาเมื่อ 6 เดือนที่แล้วว่ามีฟันผุ แต่คุณหมอเช็คให้อย่างละเอียดเลย กลายเป็นไม่ต้องอุด เพราะจริง ๆ ไม่ได้ผุอะไร วันนี้ก็เลยขูดหินปูนอย่างเดียวสบายเลย คุณหมอยังสอนวิธีกลืนน้ำลายที่ถูกต้องให้ด้วย เพื่อช่วยไม่ให้ลิ้นมาดันฟันล่างหน้า ซึ่งจะทำให้เกิดช่องว่างระหว่างฟันได้🙂 ทางคลินิกรับประกันสังคม แบบไม่ต้องสำรองจ่าย เพื่อที่จะได้ดูแลสุขภาพฟัน คนในโซนจรัญฯ ได้อย่างครอบคลุมด้วย^^ ใครมีแพลนจะดูแลสุขภาพฟัน หรือมีแพลนจะจัดฟัน,ใส่ฟันปลอม,ทำรากเทียม ฯลฯ และอยากเจอคุณหมอที่ใจดี ไม่ดุ ทางคลินิกฯ มีแพ็คเกจดี ๆ เยอะเลย แนะนำนะครับ✨✨✨

0x30e2994ad04f5897_0x9b5efe99070727f5.en: I had the opportunity to use the clinic's services. It's very convenient to get there, as it's accessible by MRT; you can get off at Bang Khun Non station. After your dental appointment, besides finding a 7-Eleven and Starbucks next to the clinic, you can also continue shopping along Bang Khun Non Road, which has lots of delicious food options. 🥰 The clinic focuses on high-quality services at affordable prices. Importantly, the dentist is very kind and gentle. Today, I went for a teeth cleaning. At first, I thought I would need fillings because I had a checkup elsewhere 6 months ago that showed cavities, but the dentist checked thoroughly, and it turned out I didn't need fillings. Actually, there were no cavities at all. So, today I only had my teeth cleaned, which was great. The dentist also taught me the correct way to swallow saliva to prevent my tongue from pushing against my lower front teeth, which can create gaps between my teeth. 🙂 The clinic accepts social security insurance without requiring upfront payment, making it convenient for dental care for people in the Charoen Krung area. ^^ If you're planning to take care of your dental health, or have plans for braces, dentures, dental implants, etc., and want to see a kind and gentle dentist, the clinic has many great packages. I highly recommend it! ✨✨✨

0x30da251d8a8e5b81_0x8fd37ea3883ce98f.text: เนื่องจากไม่สามารถตอบคอมเม้นได้ ขอตั้งโพสใหม่และตอบกลับตามนี้นะครับ 1. เจาะเลือด ไม่ใช่ไม่เคยมีปัญหานะครับ คุณช่วยเช็คประวัติการทำงานของคุณก่อนนะ ว่าเคยแจ้งผิดไหม หรืออะไรไหม 2. เรื่องเล็บยาว พิมพ์ผิดพิมพ์ใหม่ได้นะครับ คุณเดินมาบอกว่าเล็บยาว เจ้าของต้องตัดและตะไบบ่อยๆ ไม่ใช่การแจ้งเพื่อขออนุญาติตัดนะครับ... ผมเองที่ขอให้คุณตัดให้นะ...และมันไม่ใช่การตัดเล็บครั้งแรก... ของหมา และผู้ช่วยที่คิดค่าบริการ 50+50 บาท ทำไมรอบก่อนๆถึงไม่เคยมีปัญหา แยกเขี้ยวหรือว่าขู่จะกัดละครับ.... ** หรือถึงจะกัดจริงๆ ทีมงานของคุณมีเดินกันวุ่นวาย ยืนกันเต็มเค้าเตอร์ขนาดนั้น คุณไม่เรียกไปทำงานละครับ ** นี่คุณเดินออกมาเรียกเจ้าของเข้าไปในห้องเพื่อให้ไปอุ้มหมาให้ ( แต่คิดเงิน ) ทั้งๆที่วิธีการก็มีเยอะเยะ ถ้าจะอ้างความปลอดภัย มันตลกครับ ทำงานอยู่กับสัตว์ +หมาตัวแค่นี้ถ้ากัดจริงคงไม่ตายหรอกครับ หมาปอม ไม่ใช่พิทบูล นะครับ คุณหมอประจำของน้อง ชื่อที่ ภ.ด. เขาจะรู้ดีครับ รอบที่แล้วก็ตัดให้ฟรี โดยที่ผมถามค่าใช้จ่ายก่อนด้วยซ้ำและไม่มีปัญหาแยกเขี้ยวอะไรเลยนะครับ ช่วยหาประวัติก่อนจะมาเถียงลูกค้าด้วยนะครับ และหมาเล็บยาว ไม่ใช่ผู้ช่วยจะพูดแนวที่ว่าโทษเจ้าของ(คนปัจจุบัน) นะครับ *ย้ำ ว่าช่วยเช็คประวัติด้วย เพราะผม adopt น้องหมาตัวนี้มาเลี้ยง ตั้งแต่วันที่มันชัก.... (เจ้าของเดิมจะปล่อยตาย) ถ้าผมเลี้ยงตั้งแต่เกิดมันไม่มีทางเป็นแบบนี้หรอกนะครับ (ค่าใช้จ่ายไม่เคยมีปัญหาสำหรับเราถ้าคุณให้การบริการที่ดีจริง) 3. เรื่องโต๊ะตามนั้นครับ เข้าใจว่าเคสเยอะ มันทำความสะอาดได้เท่านี้... 4. ก่อนคุณจะบอกผมรับยา ทุก2อาทิตย์ รบกวนช่วยกลับไปดูประวัติดีๆ ก่อนพูดอะไรมั่วๆ ครับ ยา ผมได้รับมาสำหรับ1 เดือน ตลอดนะครับ ยกเว้นช่วงแรกที่ย้ายตัวมา เพราะต้องตรวจเลือด หลังจากนั้นรับ1เดือนตลอด เพราะคุยกับหมอแล้ว ว่าไม่ได้อยู่เชียงใหม่ จะให้เดินทางบ่อยๆ มันลำบาก ( ไปสอบถามหมอประจำไข้ก่อนบ้างนะครับ ก่อนจะเถียงอะไร ) ส่วนยา ที่บอกใหัตัด “ 1/3 ของวงกลม” โดยใช้คัตเตอร์ธรรมดาตัด ผมขอแจ้งตรงนี้เลย ว่าไม่มีทางทำได้ ตัดยังไงปริมาตรา ยา ก็ไม่มีทางเท่ากัน ผมถึงขอให้ตัดให้ดู เพราะขนาดรอบที่แล้วหมอตัดให้ ก็ไม่เท่ากันสักชิ้น บางชิ้นเรียก( เซกเม้นด้วยซ้ำ ) เวลาตรวจเลือดออกมา ผมจะได้บอกได้ไงครับว่า หมอเป็นคนจ่ายยา และตัดปริมาณยาที่ไม่เท่ากันให้กินในแต่ละวัน....( ช่วยตัดทั้งหมด 15 เม็ดตามที่จ่ายยา ด้วยคัตเตอร์ธรรมดาและส่ง vdo ตอนตัดมาทีนะครับ อยากทราบครับ ) บ้านผมก็ทำอาชีพหมอรักษาคน มามากกว่า50ปี การตัดยาแบบนี้ มันทำยังไง?? ช่วยอธิบายแบบทางวิทย์ฯมาทีครับ และไม่ใช่เหตุผลว่า ตัดทิ้งส่วนนึงด้วยนะครับ ยานะครับ ไม่ใช่ขนมโมจิ ** ส่วนยา ถ้าคุณบอกว่าให้เยอะไป ยาจะเสื่อม งั้นที่ผ่านมา หมอ จ่ายยาผิดหรอครับ?? เพราะผมรับยา 1เดือนมาตลอด? ช่วยคุยกันเองกับหมอคนอื่นก่อนด้วยนะครับ ว่าสรุปยาเขาจ่ายกันแบบไหน??? (มีครั้งนีัที่ขอ 2เดือนเพราะมีตรวจอีกทีเดือน กันยายน และเราไม่ได้ base อยู่เชียงใหม่ จึงได้ขอ2เดือน) เรื่องการนัดหมาย... คุณย้อนกลับไปดูดีๆนะ บางทีไม่อัพเดทในไลน์เลยด้วยซ้ำ หรือบางครั้งอัพเดท ก่อนถึงวันนัดเพียง 1วัน (ไม่ถึง24ชม.ด้วยซ้ำ) และการนัดคือการ follow up ควรต้องเจอกับ แพทย์เจ้าของไข้ไม่ใช่หรอครับ หรือถ้าไม่ว่างควรมีการพูดคุยกันก่อนหรือหาข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับน้องหมาก่อนเพื่อให้ดูแลแทนไม่ใช่หรอครับ การนัดหมาย ครั้งถัดไป ควรมีเด้งเข้าไลน์ทันทีหลังจากจ่ายเงิน หรือเดินออก ร.พ. ไป ไม่ใช่ ผ่านไป 29 วัน ไลน์ถึงเด้งแจ้งนัดครับ ผลตรวจเลือดก็ขอให้ส่งในไลน์ทุกครั้ง แทบจะไม่ได้เลยย ไม่เข้าใจทำไมถึงไม่ส่ง ” ขอทุกครั้ง “ เพราะไม่มีเวลามานั่งรอรับสายจาก ร.พ. 5. ถ้าคนตอบเป็นเจ้าของจริง เมื่อวานคุณอยู่ในเหตุการณ์รึป่าวครับ ปกติผมจะเห็นเหมือนคุณลุง ที่ดูมีวุฒิภาวะ คิดว่าคนนี้คือเจ้าของ คอยสั่งทำความสะอาด กวาด เช็ด นุ้น นี้ นั่น แต่เมื่อวานเห็นแต่....หมอที่เหมือนพึ่งจบมาหรือพาทไทม์นะครับ ( ถ้าอยู่ก็ดีครับ ช่วยอ่านทั้งหมดและดูประวัติทั้งหมด ตรวจสอบให้หมดด้วยครับ ก่อนจะตอบอะไร) ** สุดท้ายผมขอคุณแจ้งผลเลือดทางไลน์แบบตัวหนังสือ และรูปภาพด้วยครับ พร้อมใบส่งตัวด้วยครับ ** จบนะครับ?
0x30da251d8a8e5b81_0x8fd37ea3883ce98f.author: Mybetter Lito69

0x30da251d8a8e5b81_0x8fd37ea3883ce98f.text: My dog ​​had a difficult delivery. I called around 4 AM (the information said it was a 24-hour animal hospital) to schedule an appointment to bring my dog ​​in. I drove from Lamphun. When I arrived, there were three male staff members at the hospital who were unenthusiastic. They said my dog ​​had a difficult delivery and the puppies might die if we waited. Instead of rushing, they just kept asking for my dog's history and made me wait. When I asked for the vet, they said the vet wasn't there. Why did they make me wait? Why didn't they tell me this when we talked on the phone? When I asked if they could do a preliminary check to see if the puppies were still beating, they said they didn't have the key; the key was with the vet. In the end, they took my dog ​​to the examination table to try and do a preliminary check, but said it was difficult because their hands were too big. My partner tried to do it herself. They said the puppies were definitely dead because they had been stuck in the womb for too long and told us to wait for the vet at 9 AM. What's the point of being open 24 hours if they can't even do a simple check? I really don't understand. After the check, they charged 250฿ for the examination without doing anything at all, just a simple check that they couldn't even do. So I took my dog ​​to another hospital about 1 km away. The service was much better, and they had a 24-hour vet. In the end, they didn't do a C-section; they just gave her an injection to induce labor. She gave birth naturally but arrived late, so 4 puppies died, leaving 4 alive. Now the puppies are all grown up. If I had trusted this vet, all the puppies would have died. Let me tell you, this animal hospital has staff problems. The vet might be good, but if the staff works like this, you'll only get negative comments like this.
0x30da251d8a8e5b81_0x8fd37ea3883ce98f.author: Thawatchai Chaiyo

0x30e29ed34ddddc3b_0xe681ea5d40b10889.text: The location is very convenient; just a few steps from the BTS station. The clinic is clean, spacious, and has bottled water in a fridge. The sofas are comfortable for waiting. I had an appointment at 5 PM, but I arrived at 4:40 PM and was able to get treated right away at 5 PM, exactly on time. For me, the scheduling was perfectly organized on that day. I went for a pre-orthodontic consultation. Free X-ray and 3D scan. I only paid 150 baht for the medical supplies. They also offered a detailed treatment plan and simulation to estimate the cost. There are several excellent doctors to choose from. They even have a doctor with a PhD. Personally, I was very impressed.
0x30e29ed34ddddc3b_0xe681ea5d40b10889.author: Pan Ma

0x30e29ed34ddddc3b_0xe681ea5d40b10889.text: I have been a patient of this dental practice in Bangkok for 10 years and have also recommended it to friends and family. I have seen three different English speaking dentists here and they have all been excellent. The dentists all seem to be conservative in their approach to treatment and I value that. They are professional and ethical and won't carry out a treatment unless they believe it's 100% right for the patient (this might explain a recent negative review by another English speaking reviewer!). As for me, I am very happy to recommend the clinic.

I’m a foreigner who came to Bangkok just to get my teeth done, and I had four teeth extracted in one visit. I was very nervous since it was my first time, but everyone — from the reception staff to Dr. Jirayu and her assistant ~was so kind, professional, and caring.Dr. Jirayu did an amazing job! I didn’t feel any pain during or after the procedure, and there was no swelling at all. Truly one of the best dental experiences I’ve ever had. Highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for excellent care in Bangkok!

I really like this place. The clinic is clean, the air conditioning is cool, there's plenty of seating, and the doctor is very kind and gives very detailed consultations. They have a very gentle touch. What I like best is that they give out free ice cream! If you're looking for a good dental clinic, I highly recommend this one.
0x30e29ed34ddddc3b_0xe681ea5d40b10889.author: Meo Meo

0x30e29ed34ddddc3b_0xe681ea5d40b10889.text: A very nice clinic! My case is not super difficult but I have enjoyed their service and the result of work! Veyr-very clean and sterile, good doctors and their staff. Everyone speaks English and the payment system is convenient. Reasonable price (which is crucial for people without any insurance here). I will def come back!

Nice place with a clean and welcoming atmosphere. The staff are friendly, professional, and very helpful. They also send reminders for my dental check-ups, which I really appreciate. Overall, a great experience and highly recommended!
0x30e29ed34ddddc3b_0xe681ea5d40b10889.author: teerawat suwannasin

0x30e29ed34ddddc3b_0xe681ea5d40b10889.text: They spoke clearly and was very professional in their assessment and recommendations.. Workmanship - great, my scaling and polishing and cavity looks and feels good. Price wise very affordable. Very gentle. No Hard Sell... Love it!

I've been receiving treatment there for so long that I've even had children now! All the dentists are very gentle, the service is excellent, they follow up for regular dental checkups, and they even give us free ice cream!
0x30e29ed34ddddc3b_0xe681ea5d40b10889.author: อัญชลี เลิศประพันธ์

0x30e29c1daaa7ad71_0x36e0171e2376f9fb.text: I had my wisdom tooth extracted by Dr. Wasu on the 12th of this month. He did an excellent job. Personally, I didn't feel any pain at all, from the moment the anesthetic was injected until the doctor said it was finished. I didn't even feel anything. I didn't even realize when he took the tooth out of my mouth. The doctor gave very good advice, but I didn't follow all of it because I went to play sports afterward. In summary, after the anesthetic wore off, I didn't feel any pain or swelling. I woke up the next morning with no pain or swelling and was able to go about my normal life. Thank you very much to Dr. Wasu Obnithicha and his assistants. Thank you! 🙏🏼
0x30e29c1daaa7ad71_0x36e0171e2376f9fb.author: bver b

0x30e29c1daaa7ad71_0x36e0171e2376f9fb.text: If I could give 10 stars, I would give 10. I’ve always been extremely afraid of going to the dentist, but here I found a really good doctor who truly understands how I feel. From the moment I walked in, the reception staff were very welcoming. I told them how nervous I was, and they really tried to help me feel more relaxed. When I went in to see the dentist, the doctor was incredibly kind and gentle, and the assistants were all very attentive and caring. I really recommend Bangkok Smile Dental Clinic to anyone looking for a dental clinic, they definitely won’t disappoint.

Thank you to Dr. Seeda and the entire team for taking such great care of my teeth. What is usually a stressful dental experience was made almost completely painless and stress-free. I truly appreciated the clear communication and explanations throughout every procedure. The costs were discussed openly in advance, the quality of work is excellent and very reasonably priced. 🫶

Today I came for a teeth cleaning (tartar removal). I had some concerns about dental procedures and was a little scared. I told the dentist beforehand, and she was very understanding and kind. She worked slowly, had a gentle touch, and encouraged me throughout. Thank you so much, dentist!
0x30e29c1daaa7ad71_0x36e0171e2376f9fb.author: Tassaneeporn Piluek

0x30e29c1daaa7ad71_0x36e0171e2376f9fb.text: Excellent experience with Bangkok Smile. A family of 4 with minimal Thai spoken, we were looked after superbly. 4 check ups and cleans for a very good price, and the staff were superb. Very kind. Will use them as our go to dentist from now on.

Excellent experience at Bangkok Smile Dental Clinic. Khun Mhor Thitipa is professional, gentle, and very attentive. She explained everything clearly and made me feel at ease. Thank you for giving me back my confident smile! Highly recommended.

I've been getting my dental work done regularly with Dr. Thapanee for many years. She's kind, and gives detailed, patient, and easy-to-understand advice on dental care. The clinic is also conveniently located near the BTS station.
0x30e29c1daaa7ad71_0x36e0171e2376f9fb.author: Pimchanok Kumlangngam

0x30e29c1daaa7ad71_0x36e0171e2376f9fb.text: The dentist was so lovely, and the reception staff were so kind. I hadn't been to a dental clinic in years, and this year I needed to start taking care of my teeth, so I chose this place because it's close to home. I'm so happy!
0x30e29c1daaa7ad71_0x36e0171e2376f9fb.author: 4500 Daowaree Leenalertsri

0x30e29f5b183e6ed5_0xd8dd9271a16b51ac.text: I had a really good experience at ReDerm Clinic! Even though I can speak Thai, everyone’s English was very good, so communication was easy. Dr. First was helpful, listened to my preferences, and didn’t pressure me or try to upsell anything. He was also very gentle, and I honestly didn’t feel any pain. The trainee assistants who applied the numbing cream were kind and careful. I also appreciated that the assistant showed me the sealed product and checked its expiration date. Everyone was friendly and helpful, and I would definitely recommend the clinic. Oh forget to mention, I did meSoFat.
0x30e29f5b183e6ed5_0xd8dd9271a16b51ac.author: Irene Kee

0x30e29f5b183e6ed5_0xd8dd9271a16b51ac.text: I had a great experience at Rederm Clinic. The clinic is very clean, modern, and in a convenient location. The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, and the doctor was professional, patient, and took the time to explain everything clearly. The treatment went smoothly, and I felt well taken care of throughout my visit. The pricing is also very reasonable for the quality of service you receive. I would definitely recommend Rederm Clinic to anyone looking for professional skincare treatments.
0x30e29f5b183e6ed5_0xd8dd9271a16b51ac.author: Herlan Setiawan

0x30e29f5b183e6ed5_0xd8dd9271a16b51ac.text: I had an amazing experience at Rederm Clinic! The entire team was incredibly friendly, helpful, and thorough throughout my visit. I felt so well taken care of from start to finish. A special thank you to Dr. Pear, Dr. First, Nurse Sandy, Nurse Monica, Nurse Pla, and Amin for their excellent care and clear explanations. They made me feel completely at ease. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for professional and attentive service!
0x30e29f5b183e6ed5_0xd8dd9271a16b51ac.author: Renni Noor

0x30e29f5b183e6ed5_0xd8dd9271a16b51ac.text: All the nurses (Sandy, Monica, PN, Nisa and the rest of them) + the doctor (Bamm) were super helpful throughout the entire process. They didn’t pressure me at all and they also clearly explained the pros and cons of each procedure while also continuously checking in. I could see some results right after the session. Additionally, they allowed to pay via paynow which was super convenient. Very enjoyable experience, will definitely recommend!
0x30e29f5b183e6ed5_0xd8dd9271a16b51ac.author: Ezra Yang

0x30e29f5b183e6ed5_0xd8dd9271a16b51ac.text: Everyone’s lovely and the procedure’s very fuss-free. They used the whole betadine+alcohol+saline+antiseptic procedure that made me felt very safe for injectables. Nurses very thorough and all staffs are very patient and kind. 0x30e29f5b183e6ed5_0xd8dd9271a16b51ac.author: P K

0x30e29f5b183e6ed5_0xd8dd9271a16b51ac.text: Visited Re Derm Clinic for my aesthetic treatment and had a really good experience. The staff were friendly and attentive throughout my visit. Dr. Nuk was honest and took the time to recommend only what I actually needed, without any hard selling or pressure to spend more. That’s quite rare in today’s competitive aesthetic market. Really appreciate the genuine advice and professional service.
0x30e29f5b183e6ed5_0xd8dd9271a16b51ac.author: Heng Lynn

0x30e29f5b183e6ed5_0xd8dd9271a16b51ac.text: The whole experience was very pleasant from the moment I stepped in the clinic to consultation to the treatment. The team was very attentive and friendly. Prices are very transparent too. Definitely will be back!
0x30e29f5b183e6ed5_0xd8dd9271a16b51ac.author: Janus Chang

0x30e29f5b183e6ed5_0xd8dd9271a16b51ac.text: Went to rederm today for aesthetic treatment . The staff were very friendly and make you feel at ease even though you are really nervous . They are transparent with their prices which is very important .

0x311d61dc6cccd757_0xf247c35572039b56.text: My daughter has been a patient for orthodontic care (braces) for over a year. The staff and doctors have been very kind and professional. 0x311d61dc6cccd757_0xf247c35572039b56.text: The clinic is very clean. The staff at the counter are lovely and friendly. I asked a lot of questions, but they answered so nicely. 0x311d61dc6cccd757_0xf247c35572039b56.text: บริการช้า จองคิวไว้ 18.00 ไปถึงตอน 17.45 นั่งรอ ไม่ได้ทำสักที (ขูดหินปูน) สังเกตคนที่มาทีหลังได้เข้าไปทำทันตกรรมแล้วหลายคน แถมคนที่วอร์คอิน ได้เข้าทำก่อน จนตอน 18.30 (ผ่านไปกว่า 45นาที) ตัดสินใจไม่รอ ออกมาเลย 😔 ไม่ค่อยประทับใจกับการบริหารจัดการคิว และเวลา ส่วนคุณหมอ เคยไปทำครั้งก่อน มือเบา พูดเพราะ

0x305031e5dcef26e7_0x12e63e89dc20b562.text: They're living in the future here! Poor France, where I live. I'll explain how it works for foreigners. You go in and they ask for some kind of ID; I gave them my driver's license or something similar just to complete the paperwork—it's easier than spelling it out. You're in the waiting room, and your turn comes. Be careful, it's up to you to figure out roughly when it's your turn because I thought they were calling me, so I let several people go ahead until I understood. Then you see the doctor, who writes his report and sends it to the assistant in the waiting room. She calls you in and gives you the medication that's been prepared for your treatment. Basically, it took me 30 minutes even though there were at least five or six people ahead of me, and it would have only taken 20 minutes if I'd been seen first. But even if it had taken an hour, I would still have been happy because in France it takes between 3 and 6 months to get an appointment with an ENT specialist. I woke up at 9 a.m., I was in pain, I looked up ENT on Google, and by the time I'd gone there on my scooter and come back, by 11:30 a.m. I was in my hotel room with my medication! Incredible!

0x30e29f003e278a17_0x9fcc92323109eb3d.text: I have chronic knee pain from sitting for long hours at work without getting up often, plus I have a habit of sitting with my legs folded and cross-legged. I've tried several treatments, including 6 PRP injections and medication. My first visit to Dr. Kong was incredibly worthwhile. Every second of the 1.5-hour session was exceptionally valuable. Dr. Kong explained everything in detail and gave realistic advice. For example, instead of telling me to stop because I'm used to it, he recommended getting up frequently to reduce the pressure on my knees. This helped me understand the purpose of the treatment. He didn't blame me for previous treatments but focused on follow-up. He asked many questions and explained the reasoning behind each one, which was perfect for someone like me who is inquisitive and often does or doesn't follow instructions. During the first treatment, Dr. Kong found that the muscles in the painful thigh were different from the unaffected side. He used heat compresses, laser treatment, and shockwave therapy. After treatment, the pain in the previously painful area decreased by 75%, but I need continued treatment to strengthen the muscles and prevent recurrence. I have my second appointment tomorrow. The admin staff was also lovely; they messaged me before my appointment to remind me. 🙏😍

0x311d603c39c88ad1_0x861505f2321cdeeb.text: 5 stars for the doctor, nurses, and reception staff 💐😊😇 My family and I have been patients here for over 10 years, receiving treatments like teeth cleaning, fillings, and crowns. The doctor is skilled, kind, and very good, and the nurses are all lovely. The reception staff are all excellent...except for the current manager. We've had two unpleasant phone calls from the manager. A year ago, I gave a rating and complained about the person who answered my dental appointment call. That's when I found out it was the manager. On May 20th, I called to schedule a consultation for a new crown. A staff member answered and scheduled an appointment for the 21st at 2 PM. After the call, they asked me if I, a customer who had previously given a rating and complained about a staff member, was going to return to the clinic?! (That's when I realized it was the same manager.) I was confused and said, "What? It happened a year ago, and I've forgotten about it." They said they remembered me. I replied, "Actually, if it was true, you should accept it and fix it." This isn't to blame the customer again. He: He's just a low-level employee. (He blamed us as if we had deliberately wronged him.) We: If you talk like that, we're not okay with it. You should improve your own work performance for making a mistake with the appointment, not blame the customer. We also said that if that's the case, we won't go anymore. But he insisted that the appointment was for May 21st at 2 PM...but it was his day off...we didn't respond. In short, we didn't go, and no employee called to reconfirm. We also assumed that he probably didn't record the appointment time. ***We're not blaming the employee for not calling. We went to another clinic instead; there are many dental clinics. ...The management can listen to this phone conversation... As mentioned, the conversation will be recorded to improve future services. We are adults, mature enough, never demanding, and would never deliberately harm an employee. We understand the feelings of a working person. We've been a patient here for over 10 years. Honestly, we're very disappointed. All the doctors and staff are excellent. Thank you.💐🌼

0x3102bf4625707245_0x85aa4f962358a33d.text: My experience at Clear Vision Care Pattaya was completely different from most optical stores I've visited. As someone who is very particular about choosing lenses, I really appreciated the professional and detailed explanations provided by all the store staff. Consultation is by appointment, so each customer receives personalized time and attention. Dr. Tew is also an experienced optometrist, who has also worked as a professor and collaborated with one of Bangkok's leading hospitals. He is supported by a team of friendly and competent assistants. Their service made me feel like I was being treated with utmost care, something I rarely encounter in the optical industry. One of the most impressive things is their dedication to helping customers understand the products they will use. Instead of simply showing catalogs, they provide live lens samples and explain the differences between each option in great detail. The explanations are very easy to understand and helped me make the right decision for my vision needs. In terms of pricing, I found the offerings quite competitive. They offer the same lens brands as other optical shops, but with a service and consultation that I find far superior. The combination of professional expertise, customer education, and reasonable prices provides a very attractive added value. For tourists visiting Pattaya, this shop is not located in the main tourist area. However, because it serves a large local clientele and has a good reputation among the Thai community, I feel more confident in the quality of the service provided. The shop is also quite easy to find and not too far from the city center. I highly recommend Clear Vision Care Pattaya to anyone looking for a trustworthy optical service. They don't just focus on sales, but also ensure every detail is meticulously checked before glasses are delivered to customers. Their commitment to quality and customer satisfaction is what I believe sets them apart from many other optical shops.
0x3102bf4625707245_0x85aa4f962358a33d.author: Krezdo

0x3102bf4625707245_0x85aa4f962358a33d.text: Clear Vision Care Pattaya stands apart from most optical retailers. As someone who is extremely particular about lens quality and precision, I was impressed by the level of professionalism and attention to detail provided by the team. Visits are by appointment, allowing the highly experienced optometrist, Dr. Tew (also a professor who previously works with a notable hospital in Bangkok), and her wonderful assistants to dedicate their full attention to each customer. This was my first experience with such a personalized and premium consultation process, and it made many of my previous visits to optical shops pale in comparison. I never expected this level of luxury and care from a technical retail business. What truly impressed me was their commitment to educating customers. Unlike many optical stores that simply present a catalog, the team took the extra step of showing me actual lens samples and carefully explaining the differences between various lens options. This made it much easier to understand the technical aspects and make an informed decision. In terms of pricing, I found their rates to be very reasonable, especially considering that they carry the same reputable lens brands offered by other retailers. The value for money is excellent given the expertise and service provided. For visitors to Pattaya, it is worth noting that the shop is located outside the main tourist areas, as it primarily serves local Thai customers and is very popular among the local community. However, it is still conveniently accessible and well worth the visit. I highly recommend Clear Vision Care Pattaya to anyone looking for trustworthy professionals who genuinely care about delivering the best possible vision solution. Especially Dr. Yo, who pays attention to detail in every step, explains the treatment results, the pros and cons, and clearly clarifies the costs, allowing patients to make informed decisions. They offer effective treatment options without breaking the bank. I've been there many times and it's become my go-to clinic. I've had scaling, fillings, implants, teeth whitening, and retainer replacements – everything has been excellent. The staff are also incredibly lovely. I highly recommend this clinic! ❤️❤️ The clinic has a cute, cafe-like atmosphere.

0x30e29db63f469177_0x109b1ff1ba533942.text: จัดฟันที่นี่กับหมอโย จ่ายแค่เดือนละ 1200 มาทุกเดือนหมอน่ารัก พนักงานบริการดี ใส่ใจโทรเตือนนัดล่วงหน้าทุกเดือน หมอตรวจหินปูนให้ตลอด บางครั้งหมอขูดให้ไม่คิดเงินด้วย บอกว่ามีนิดเดียว หมอใจดีมาก สียางก็มีให้เลือกเยอะ คลินิกดูดีมากแต่หมอคิดราคาไม่แพงเลย จัดฟันมา2 ปีตอนนี้ใกล้ถอดเครื่องมือแล้ว สียางที่นี่มีเยอะ สีน่ารัก มีสีเพิ่มขึ้นมาเรื่อยๆเลย พี่ๆที่คลินิกช่วยเลือกสียางทุกเดือน ประทับใจมาก
0x30e29db63f469177_0x109b1ff1ba533942.en: I'm getting braces here with Dr. Yo. It only costs 1200 baht a month. I come every month; the doctor is lovely, the staff are great, and they're attentive, calling to remind me of my appointments every month. The doctor checks for tartar regularly, and sometimes even cleans it for free, saying there's only a little. The doctor is so kind! They have a wide selection of rubber band colors. The clinic looks great, but the doctor's prices are very reasonable. I've been wearing braces for two years and am almost ready to get them removed. They have a huge selection of cute rubber band colors, and they keep adding new ones. The staff at the clinic help me choose colors every month. I'm very impressed!

0x30e29db63f469177_0x109b1ff1ba533942.text: คลีนิกสะอาดค่ะ ให้ฟีลเหมือนมาคาเฟ่ คุณหมอมือเบามากฉีดยาชาแทบจะไม่รู้สึก ใจดีมากๆด้วย สำหรับคนที่กลัวการทำฟัน ที่นี่คือตอบโจทย์มากค่ะ คุณหมอใจดี ผู้ช่วยใจดี คือลดความกลัวไปได้เยอะเลยจากใจคนกลัวหมอฟันมากๆ พี่ข้างหน้าดูแลนะคะ ให้คำปรึกษาดีตั้งแต่ครั้งแรกที่เข้ามาใช้บริการ
0x30e29db63f469177_0x109b1ff1ba533942.en: The clinic is clean. It feels like being in a cafe. The dentist is very gentle; I barely felt the anesthetic injection. They are also very kind. For those who are afraid of dentistry, this place is perfect. The kind dentist and assistants really reduced my fear, especially for someone who is terrified of dentists. The staff at the front desk are also very attentive and provide good advice from my first visit.

0x30e29db63f469177_0x109b1ff1ba533942.text: The clinic is clean, the seats are comfortable, and there are phone chargers. The doctor is kind, and the staff are cheerful and friendly. They offer comprehensive dental services. Highly recommended! It's also close to the Victory Monument.
0x30e29db63f469177_0x109b1ff1ba533942.author: hey u got drugs?

0x30e29db63f469177_0x109b1ff1ba533942.text: I was very impressed. The clinic is clean, the atmosphere is great, and all the staff are welcoming and provide detailed advice. The dentist was gentle and explained the treatment process clearly, making me feel comfortable throughout the …
0x30e29db63f469177_0x109b1ff1ba533942.author: Payuda Mongkam

0x30e29db63f469177_0x109b1ff1ba533942.text: I used to be scared every time I went to the dental clinics. This is my first time of feeling comfortable during the treatment. The dentist is skillful and so patient. Fully recommended!
เคยมาใช้บริการที่นี่หลายครั้งแล้วค่ะ ประทับใจ หมอผู้ชายมือเบามากกกก คลินิกดูสะอาด พี่พนักงานข้างหน้าก็น่ารักค่ะ จะมาใช้บริการอีกแน่นอน ใช้ประกันสังคมได้ บัตรประชาชนใบเดียวจบเลย คุ้มมาก
0x30e29db63f469177_0x109b1ff1ba533942.en: I've used their services many times before and I'm very impressed. The male doctor is very gentle. The clinic is clean and the staff at the front desk are lovely. I will definitely come again. They accept social security insurance; just your ID card is enough. Very worthwhile!

0x30e29db63f469177_0x109b1ff1ba533942.text: The doctor is lovely, speaks politely, and provides excellent care. The staff in the clinic are also polite and provide great service. It's conveniently located near the BTS station.
0x30e29db63f469177_0x109b1ff1ba533942.author: Yanisa Limthongbai

0x30e299e4f874571b_0x64ed5a4346968f82.text: I went there for the required medical examination for my visa application, and the results were ready within just two hours. The doctors and receptionists were very kind, professional, and helpful. Overall, it was a smooth and pleasant experience.
0x30e299e4f874571b_0x64ed5a4346968f82.author: Mykhailo

0x30e299e4f874571b_0x64ed5a4346968f82.text: Very great experience as a foreigner needing some blood work. There was a language barrier but staff was patient, kind, and got everything done fast. Highly recommend if you need any lab work done while in Bangkok.
0x30e299e4f874571b_0x64ed5a4346968f82.author: Sander Zhu

0x30e299e4f874571b_0x64ed5a4346968f82.text: I visited today the Lotus Azure Medical and it was a very good experience with the doctor and staff, they're very helpful and kind. Thank you so much
0x30e299e4f874571b_0x64ed5a4346968f82.author: Nathalia Barcelon

0x30e299e4f874571b_0x64ed5a4346968f82.text: Extremely efficient and high quality! I got the results even before I got home - only possible here.
0x30e299e4f874571b_0x64ed5a4346968f82.author: Soe Yu Naing

0x30e29b94b21ebc91_0x54ff3f98db900250.text: What an excellent experience today! By far the best dental clinic I have visited in Bangkok. A very calm, clean and comfortable environment to get your dental work done - no need to be scared of the dentist anymore. The staff are friendly and professional and the dental assistant has a very gentle touch. I was also very impressed with the technology in this clinic, their ฿1.3 million iTero machine gives you a 5D scan of your teeth showing all issues with your teeth clearly. 5 stars - thank you Dr. Seen and see you again for my next check up!

Very gentle dentist. I had an extraction and there was no pain. They checked every few minutes for pain and when I felt the pain coming back, they gave me another injection. The extraction was clean and easy. The English levels are good. I will always use this dentist from now on and I would recommend it to anyone, especially foreigners who need an English speaking dentist.

มาจัดฟัน Invisalign หมอซีน น่ารักใจดี ให้คำแนะนำได้ดีมาก ใส่ใจและละเอียดมากๆ ค่า ได้ผ่าฟันคุดกับหมอกิต คือมือเบามาก ไม่ระบม ไม่ช้ำ อาทิตย์นึงมาตัดไหม แผลปิดเกือบหมดแล้ว ตอนแรกก็ไม่กล้าเพราะฟันมันอยู่ลึกในชั้นกระดูก แต่คุณหมอใจดีและฝีมือดีมาก ยาชาไม่นานเกินหลังผ่าเสร็จ หน้าไม่บวมนานค่า มาขูดหินปูนที่นี่คุณหมอก็ทำดีไม่เจ็บเลยค่า เบิกประกันสังคมได้เลยสะดวกมากๆ ❤️
0x30e29b94b21ebc91_0x54ff3f98db900250.author: Pechaporn Pornpraipech
0x30e29b94b21ebc91_0x54ff3f98db900250.en: I got my Invisalign treatment with Dr. Seen, who is lovely, kind, and gave excellent advice. She's very attentive and thorough. I also had my wisdom tooth extracted by Dr. Kit, who was incredibly gentle. There was no pain or bruising. I went back a week to have the stitches removed, and the wound was almost completely closed. I was initially hesitant because the tooth was deep in the bone, but Dr. Kit was very kind and skilled. The anesthetic didn't last long after the surgery, and my face wasn't swollen for long. I also had my teeth cleaned here, and the doctor did a great job; it wasn't painful at all. They accept social security insurance, which is very convenient. ❤️

0x30e29b94b21ebc91_0x54ff3f98db900250.text: รู้สึกสบายใจมาปรึกษาและเคลียร์ช่องปากที่นี่ จัดฟันมา2 รอบแล้ว ไม่ได้ใส่รีเทนเนอร์ อิอิ 🤣 เลยมาจัดใหม่กับหมอต้น ตอนนี้จัดเสร็จฟันสวยแล้ว ขอบคุณคลินิกดีๆ พนักงานน่ารัก ขอบคุณคุณหมอค่าา🫶🏻 แนะนำเลยจัดฟันรอบสุดท้าย คลินิกสะอาด ที่สำคัญคุณหมอมือเบา อธิบายละเอียดทำให้เรารู้สึกมั่นใจกับการรักษา มากเลยค่ะ
0x30e29b94b21ebc91_0x54ff3f98db900250.en: I felt so comfortable coming here for a consultation and oral care. I've had braces twice already, but I didn't wear my retainer, haha ​​🤣 So I came for braces again with Dr. Ton. Now my treatment is complete and my teeth are beautiful. Thank you to the great clinic and the lovely staff. Thank you, doctor! 🫶🏻 I highly recommend this clinic for your final orthodontic treatment. The clinic is clean, and most importantly, the doctor is gentle and explains everything in detail, making me feel very confident about the treatment.

0x30e29b94b21ebc91_0x54ff3f98db900250.text: Nice cozy and clean place for dental treatment. Have specialized Doctor for Teeth, Gum, Invisalign and Implants. 360 degrees xray equipment. Easy to make appointments and deduct with social security. Provide car park ticket for a paid lot nearby. Been here as regular so recommended!!!

The doctor was excellent. I think his name was Supakit. He had a gentle touch; I didn't feel any pain. I feel very lucky to have had such good dental work done here. It was clean, the staff were good, and the officers were polite and spoke well. (Beautiful)
0x30e29b94b21ebc91_0x54ff3f98db900250.author: Pp Pp

0x30e29b94b21ebc91_0x54ff3f98db900250.text: เพื่อนแนะนำให้มาจัดฟันใสที่นี่ ตอนแรกกลัวว่าจะใส่ยาก แต่พอลองจริงๆ คือสะดวกกว่าที่คิด คุณหมอให้แผนชัดเจนเลยว่าแต่ละช่วงจะมีความเปลี่ยนแปลงยังไง รู้สึกว่าเขาไม่ได้แค่ทำฟัน แต่ช่วยวางแผนให้เรารู้ว่าจะไปถึงจุดไหน ราคาก็ถือว่าสมเหตุสมผลนะคะ เมื่อเทียบกับที่อื่น
0x30e29b94b21ebc91_0x54ff3f98db900250.en: A friend recommended this place for clear aligner treatment. At first, I was worried they would be difficult to wear, but after trying them on, they were easier than I expected. The doctor gave a clear plan outlining the changes at each stage. I feel like they're not just doing dental work, but also helping me plan my progress. The price is also reasonable compared to other places.

0x30e29b94b21ebc91_0x54ff3f98db900250.text: I just had my wisdom tooth extracted yesterday. Dr. Kit was very gentle; it didn't hurt at all! I looked at reviews of many clinics and decided to have it done here, and I'm so glad I did. All the doctors are lovely and provide excellent service. 🥰🥰 …
0x30e29b94b21ebc91_0x54ff3f98db900250.author: ชญาภา พลหนองหลวง

0x30da3196b8dadcc7_0xdd0bf038467723f0.text: Excellent Dental Care at Dental Plus, Chiang Mai I recently visited Dental Plus in Chiang Mai for a routine check-up and cleaning, and I couldn’t be more pleased with the experience. From the moment I walked in, the staff was incredibly welcoming and professional. The clinic itself is modern, clean, and equipped with the latest dental technology. Dr. Ohm was fantastic! They took the time to explain every step of the procedure and made sure I was comfortable throughout. The cleaning was thorough yet gentle, and I appreciated the attention to detail. It’s clear that the team at Dental Plus genuinely cares about their patients’ well-being. What stood out to me the most was the level of personalized care. Dr. Ohm provided me with tailored advice on how to maintain my dental health, which was very helpful. The pricing was also very reasonable, especially considering the high quality of service. I highly recommend Dental Plus to anyone in Chiang Mai looking for top-notch dental care. Whether you’re a local or an expat, you’ll be in great hands here!
0x30da3196b8dadcc7_0xdd0bf038467723f0.author: Narrapat Suparangsiri (Gunn)

0x30da3196b8dadcc7_0xdd0bf038467723f0.text: I had my upper and lower wisdom teeth extracted simultaneously. The lower wisdom tooth was horizontal. The dentist who performed the extraction was a man. He used a very mild anesthetic. The extraction itself was quick, and he explained every step of the process. He kept me company and kept me from feeling anxious. After the extraction, there was only minimal swelling. I could open my mouth, and it wasn't numb. I was very impressed. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for a place to have difficult wisdom tooth extractions.
0x30da3196b8dadcc7_0xdd0bf038467723f0.author: run runwayy

0x30da3196b8dadcc7_0xdd0bf038467723f0.text: The dentist is lovely and kind, and very friendly, which is great for reducing anxiety and fear of the dentist. She gives excellent advice. We used our government health insurance for scaling, fillings, and fluoride treatments. We're planning to use our benefits for next year so she can continue treatment. The clinic is clean and has certifications. Everyone, go get your teeth done soon! 👍👍 The assistant is also lovely, provides great service, and responds to messages regularly.
0x30da3196b8dadcc7_0xdd0bf038467723f0.author: คุณหนู P ยังมี WANG

0x30da3196b8dadcc7_0xdd0bf038467723f0.text: I chipped my composite bonding whilst travelling through Chiang Mai. Dental plus clinic were able to see me on the same day and fix the crack, speedy responses and very good treatment. Additionally they spoke great English and explained what they were going to do and the cost of the treatment. I was happy with both the fix & the price. Given this, the personality of the staff were a great addition to my appointment.
0x30da3196b8dadcc7_0xdd0bf038467723f0.author: Ryan Griffiths

0x30da3196b8dadcc7_0xdd0bf038467723f0.text: Getting dental work done at Dentel Plus clinic is really great! The dentist is incredibly gentle. I had a tooth extracted, had my teeth cleaned, and got braces done here. You won't be disappointed! The dental work is excellent. 👍🏻 The clinic is very clean, and most importantly, the dentist is lovely and very friendly. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ …
0x30da3196b8dadcc7_0xdd0bf038467723f0.author: Kallayanee Chatkaew

0x30da3196b8dadcc7_0xdd0bf038467723f0.text: The service here is excellent. The staff are friendly, the doctors are skilled and very kind, and they give accurate advice. The clinic is beautiful, easy to get to, and they also offer free orthodontic consultations. If you're hesitant, I recommend not to. This place might be a good choice.
0x30da3196b8dadcc7_0xdd0bf038467723f0.author: Anonymous

0x30da3196b8dadcc7_0xdd0bf038467723f0.text: The doctor gave excellent advice on my current oral health issues and recommended fluoride treatment, which the clinic provides free of charge. I've been coming here for two years now, with different doctors, but both are excellent. I'll definitely be back for other treatments.
0x30da3196b8dadcc7_0xdd0bf038467723f0.author: Gammie Sumpradit

0x30da3196b8dadcc7_0xdd0bf038467723f0.text: I've been coming here for two years in a row. The dentist gives excellent advice and takes great care of my teeth. They're gentle, and the work is done quickly. When I get fillings, the color is so natural, it's indistinguishable from my real teeth.
0x30da3196b8dadcc7_0xdd0bf038467723f0.author: Yanisa B.

0x30e2a7623e54a65b_0x7015f869f6ce5470.text: This was my first time using their services. I intended to use my government health insurance (Gold Card), which they accept here. But the current system is very complicated, so I paid out-of-pocket. The staff here are lovely. I called to check my eligibility for August 2026, but the quota was full. In early September, the clinic called back to inform me that there was an available slot. I give them 100% trust. Today I had two molars extracted. Before that, two days earlier I had five teeth extracted elsewhere. I encountered a female dentist who was weak, causing pain and making me wary… so I suggested changing clinics. Because molars are more difficult to extract. Here, I met a male dentist. He was polite, gentle, and it wasn't painful. There was very little bleeding. I complimented him all the way home. In short, I highly recommend this clinic. The price is also reasonable. Molar extraction is 800 baht per tooth. The clinic is located directly across from Pak Nam Market. There's a fruit stall blocking the view of the storefront.
0x30e2a7623e54a65b_0x7015f869f6ce5470.author: วิไลวรรณ จันทร์อ่อนแสง

0x30e2a7623e54a65b_0x7015f869f6ce5470.text: ประทับใจคุณหมอโบว์มากค่ะ เป็นคนที่กลัวการทำฟันและมีอาการแพนิคเวลาทำฟัน แต่คุณหมอใจดี ใจเย็น อธิบายทุกขั้นตอนและคอยดูแลตลอด ทำให้รู้สึกสบายใจขึ้นมาก จนสามารถอุดฟันได้สำเร็จโดยไม่เครียดเหมือนที่กังวลไว้ ขอบคุณคุณหมอและทีมงานมาก ๆ ค่ะ อยากให้ทุกคนมาทำฟันที่นี่ ทั้งสมุทรปราการเลยค่ะ ☺️🙏🏻 ❤️
0x30e2a7623e54a65b_0x7015f869f6ce5470.author: Alice Nakmee
0x30e2a7623e54a65b_0x7015f869f6ce5470.en: I was very impressed with Dr. Bow. I'm someone who is afraid of dental procedures and has panic attacks during them. But Dr. Bow was kind, patient, explained every step of the process, and took care of me throughout, which made me feel much more comfortable. I was able to get my filling done successfully without the stress I was worried about. Thank you so much to Dr. Bow and the team. I highly recommend this dental clinic to everyone in Samut Prakan! ☺️🙏🏻 ❤️

0x30e2a7623e54a65b_0x7015f869f6ce5470.text: I had a retainer made here for 3600 baht, which was very cheap. I also had two wisdom teeth extracted here. The doctor was very calm and did a great job extracting both easy and difficult cases. The doctor was also very punctual. I really liked the doctor!
0x30e2a7623e54a65b_0x7015f869f6ce5470.author: Apinya Boonluen

0x30e2a7623e54a65b_0x7015f869f6ce5470.text: ณ วันที่ลูกปวดฟันมากๆๆๆ อิแม่ก็ค้นหาคลินิกทำฟันที่มี “หมอเด็ก” ด้วยความไวแสง 🤣 ขอขอบคุณคุณหมอมากๆนะคะ ครั้งแรกของการทำฟันของน้องดาวเหนือ (รักษารากฟัน) รู้สึกประทับใจมากๆๆค่ะ น้องไม่กลัวการทำฟันเลย 🥰 ใครที่กำลังมองหาคลินิกทำฟัน แนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะ
0x30e2a7623e54a65b_0x7015f869f6ce5470.author: DRIWYAHOO KITTIWARAKUL
0x30e2a7623e54a65b_0x7015f869f6ce5470.en: On the day my child had a terrible toothache, I searched for a dental clinic with a pediatric dentist at lightning speed! 🤣 Thank you so much to the dentist! 0x30e29ee3688a11c1_0x92f8e56043a1d358.text: I am an a-level UK student hoping to study Dentistry and I was fortunate enough that Dr Thamrong allowed me to shadow dentists in Dental Design Clinic and Lab. This experience helped me gain greater insight into dentistry, and I couldn't have gotten a better experience ! All the staff were so welcoming, kind, and clear communicators; whilst watching you could tell they had the patients’ best interest kept in mind at all times, ensuring they were comfortable, if these certain dates fit their schedules (especially as many were tourists), and that what they were doing was the best solution for them. The staff was super friendly in general, speaking excellent English and it was a great atmosphere to be in overall. I got to shadow Dr. Suwat Oral Surgeon, Maxillofacial Surgery doing an implant is fascinating. Dr Mona and Dr Mei and Dr Nutcha were recently qualified but already skilled and compassionate especially to the younger patients who were nervous. Each doctor patiently explained every process to me after every treatment in a manner I would understand and Im given opportunity to ask questions. Dr Thamrong, the founder, is approachable and always ready to help and support everyone despite his own busy schedule. I can see everyone in the clinic works well together to ensure the patient is the number one priority. I would like thank you for allowing me to be part of your busy schedule. It was a truly inspiring time. This experience solidified my goal to become a dentist!!!! I hope I can work with you all again one day😇

This was my first dental implant experience, and I am glad that I chose to do it with Dental Design Clinic and Lab. After several conversations with Dr. Thamrong on social media about the implant procedure details, such as implant material, timeline healing process and cost, I decided to proceed. It was the best decision since the procedure was done painlessly by dental surgeon Dr. Sumet. He explained the steps in detail before and during the procedure. This was very helpful since I was very nervous about the implant titanium post placement procedure. The next day, I was able to resume normal activities without pain or swelling. After waiting about 3 months for the implant to heal, I returned for final dental implant abutment and crown fitting step. This step was done by Dr. Thamrong with excellent outcome. I was very impressed with the clinic environment and the latest equipment, especially the Dental CT scan. Although I only had a single tooth #30 implant procedure, I would not hesitate to have future dental procedure with Dr. Thamrong's clinic team. The office manager Fon who helped with scheduling and communicating compounded by the team's hospitality made this experience less scary. Overall, I highly recommend this clinic for all your dental needs. Thank you very much for excellent service Dr. Thamrong, Dr. Sumet and your team. Your dedication and attention to detail were truly appreciated.

0x30e29ee3688a11c1_0x92f8e56043a1d358.text: I want to start off by saying that I hate going to the dentist. Any dentist, especially in Canada, Vancouver that’s where I’m from. They are overwhelmingly expensive and pushes you to go to the extreme for dental work. I had what I needed done here for a tiny fraction of what it would have cost me in Canada, to achieve exactly what I wanted. When I decided to find a reputable dental clinic here that can help me achieve what I wanted, which also includes a few veneers, a cavity and chipped tooth, the search was overwhelming since there’s a dentist clinic on almost every corner in Bangkok, it feels like. I decide on the Dental Design clinic & Lab because they had a solid reputation, the pricing wasn’t too cheap and yet wasn’t too expensive. In my humble opinion, too cheap is risky business. This clinic also has a lab so I can get a fast turnaround on my veneers and night guard. Dr. Thamrong Limpanapa was great! He listened to my needs and spent a lot of extra time and care, above and beyond (without charging me more). He doesn’t talk a lot but he lets his work speak for itself. He’s highly skilled and didn’t push me to do more than I felt comfortable with in terms of unnecessary work and costs. Highly recommend. I’ll be back again next year to do more veneers and any dental work. PS I rarely leave reviews. Take it for what it is.

0x3054f557387b376f_0x208d6f6bce01195a.text: I recently purchased two pairs of eyeglasses from Piyapon Optical, and I couldn't be happier with my experience. The store, run by the dedicated optometrist whose name is "Golf", exceeded my expectations in every way. Compared to a previous experience at a store in Central Plaza a few years ago, Piyapon Optical was a breath of fresh air. Not only were the prices more reasonable here, but the attention to detail and customer care were exceptional. Golf took the time to explain everything related to my concerns about my vision, conducting a thorough eye examination and patiently addressing all my questions and needs. As an online teacher, comfort and durability were crucial to me, and affordability was equally important. Golf ensured that all my concerns were met. What impressed me even more was the speed of service. In less than seven days, my eyeglasses were ready for pickup, which was a far more efficient turnaround than what I experienced at a shopping mall in Chaweng. Piyapon Optical is a family-run business, and I believe in supporting local businesses like this one. Golf's dedication to his craft and his customers is evident, and I'm delighted to have found such a reliable optometrist. If you're in need of eyeglasses or eye care services, I highly recommend Piyapon Optical. They have my full support, and I'm grateful for the exceptional service I received.
0x3054f557387b376f_0x208d6f6bce01195a.author: A Baldwin

0x3054f557387b376f_0x208d6f6bce01195a.text: Golf (the owner) is a life saver. I lost my glasses in Koh Lipe and there were no optics there or in other small islands. I would only be in Koh Samui 1 week later and would stay for 3 days only, not enough time to make a new pair of glasses. I was lucky that my wife could track him down and talk to him to explain the situation. I had a digital copy my last prescription and we sent it to him. He said he would order the lenses for me, with no payment in advance, and once I would he in Samui I'd go the shop, chose a frame and he would cut the lenses into it "in less than 40 minutes. Maybe 20". A couple of days later I arrived in Koh Samui and went to the shop. He didn't have many options of frames that suited my needs. Instead of trying to compel me into buying one of his own, he encouraged me to look for frames in other shops (even gave me references where to go) and bring it to him. Very professional! Once I found a frame that fitted me, I brought it to Golf. He double checked my prescription by applying the sight test on me. As promised he did manage to assemble them in 20 minutes (impressive!). I was finally able to see properly after almost 2 weeks. And the price was more than fair. I paid significantly more for inferior lenses back home.
0x3054f557387b376f_0x208d6f6bce01195a.author: Henrique Barcelos

0x3054f557387b376f_0x208d6f6bce01195a.text: I recently spent three weeks in Koh Samui and needed to pre-order two different sizes of contact lenses before arriving. After reaching out to multiple optical shops, Piyapon Optical Samui stood out as the only one that responded quickly and helpfully. I contacted the shop via WhatsApp, and the owner, Mr. Golf, was incredibly responsive and professional. He didn’t even ask for payment in advance—he simply confirmed my arrival date and trusted that I would visit the shop once I arrived. Even though one of the lens sizes wasn't available in-store, Mr. Golf went out of his way to arrange it before my arrival. What impressed me the most was that when I contacted him after arriving in Koh Samui, he insisted on personally delivering the lenses to my hotel, so I didn’t have to make the trip to his shop. That level of customer service is rare and truly appreciated. Mr. Golf is not only reliable and trustworthy but also genuinely cares about his customers. If you're in need of optical services in Koh Samui, I highly recommend visiting or contacting Piyapon Optical Samui. Thank you very much, Mr. Golf, for your outstanding help and kindness!
0x3054f557387b376f_0x208d6f6bce01195a.author: ahmed samir

0x3054f557387b376f_0x208d6f6bce01195a.text: Piyapon Optical: My Go-To for Exceptional Eyewear and Service This is my third pair of eyeglasses from Piyapon Optical, and once again, I'm thoroughly impressed. Khun Golf, the owner, exemplifies professionalism and expertise. His understanding of my specific vision needs, including bifocals and transition lenses for my uneven eyesight, is remarkable. The turnaround time is incredibly fast. Even with my custom prescription, I never wait long to receive my new glasses. Khun Golf's efficiency is evident in every interaction – he knows exactly what needs to be done and wastes no time. The selection of frames at Piyapon Optical strikes the perfect balance. There's enough variety to find the perfect pair without feeling overwhelmed by endless choices. This makes the decision-making process straightforward and stress-free. I wholeheartedly recommend Piyapon Optical to anyone seeking high-quality eyewear and personalized service. Khun Golf's dedication to his craft and his customers is truly exceptional.
0x3054f557387b376f_0x208d6f6bce01195a.author: An'ton

I found Tan-diau pet Hospital on google and I messaged the clinic after closing hours (23:00/11:00pm) to my surprise they were fast to respond to my urgent request. - I explained the issue and the doctor told me he would prepare the staff and clinic ASAP! Within half an hour I was allowed to come and was greeted by the staff and doctor, they took my dog straight to xray and began treating him. Your pet will be in good hands while getting a treatment here.

0x30da3b146208107d_0x1245338c57cb2f17.text: As a digital nomad, I've experienced the discomfort of makeshift work setups while traveling. Following three more sessions, I felt incredible. The team is highly professional and knowledgeable about nerve and muscle connections. Mr. Patt accurately diagnosed my issue and provided effective treatment. Prices are reasonable at 1200 THB for the first visit and 1000 THB for subsequent sessions. They also offer certified sports massages for the same price, unlike many uncertified places in Thailand. The clinic is immaculate, and the service is exceptional from the moment you walk in. I highly recommend this place and will visit every time I'm in Chiang Mai!

0x30da3b146208107d_0x1245338c57cb2f17.text: The osteopathic adjustment experience here was excellent. The practitioner was very professional — not the kind of treatment where they just aggressively crack your joints. Instead, they first assessed my body condition carefully, then gradually worked on releasing muscle tension, used some adjustment tools, and finally performed the alignment treatment. After the session, my neck and shoulders felt much lighter, and my whole body felt more “open.” Even walking felt smoother and more natural. The environment was clean, quiet, and very relaxing. Overall, the experience felt professional, attentive, and responsible. If you sit for long hours, have neck, shoulder, or back discomfort, or feel tight and stiff after exercise, it’s definitely worth trying
