0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.text: My experience at Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai was nothing short of exceptional. While traveling in Thailand, I unexpectedly needed emergency medical care — always a stressful situation, especially in a foreign country. From the moment I arrived, the professionalism and efficiency of the hospital staff immediately put me at ease. The level of care I received was truly impressive. I underwent a comprehensive evaluation that included an ultrasound, a cardiogram (ECG), and a chest X-ray. I was examined by three different doctors, each thorough, attentive, and reassuring. Communication was clear, and the staff spoke excellent English, which made the entire process smooth and comfortable. What stood out even more was the cost. Without any insurance, the total for this extensive emergency workup came to approximately 200 US dollars. Considering the quality of care, modern facilities, and speed of service, the value was remarkable. The hospital itself is modern, clean, and extremely well organized — comparable to high-end private medical centers anywhere in the world. There was no sense of chaos or delay, just calm efficiency and genuine patient care. Travelers often worry about healthcare abroad, but my experience here completely changed that perspective. The combination of high-level medical expertise, excellent service, and reasonable pricing was extraordinary. I would not hesitate to recommend Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai to anyone traveling in Thailand. It provided peace of mind in a moment when it mattered most.
0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.author: Joe Pazzo

0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.text: My experience as a walk-in with minor injuries (road rash wounds & knee ligament damage from a bike accident), was top class 🙏 from the moment I got out of the taxi a porter was coming with a wheelchair to assist me. I was quickly assessed and then wheeled to the correct department where I was triaged and didn't have to wait long to see a doctor. It wasn't long again before I had an x-ray and again, a short wait until the results. Nothing was too much as they wheeled me and waited for two toilet visits and a cafe run (a very minimalist coffee/snack cafe in the hospital). The most note-worthy was my experience with a young female doctor and her assistant nurse. They were both so friendly and kindly spoke great English. They could see that gauze was stuck in my wounds from a previous treatment at a lesser establishment, and they were so delicate and gentle when removing them, constantly apologising and making sure I was ok! I'm from the UK and have never had a doctor spend time doing something like this, usually a nurse who is overworked and has to rush through. Their follow-up care and attention to detail with little gift-style hospital bags for prescriptions is a really nice touch. They have free water cups everywhere; high, wing-back comfy chairs; relaxing grand piano playing; high ceilings; large windows; plenty of light; modern interior and very friendly, relaxed atmosphere. Not very busy, just a nice steady pace. A very redemptive experience for me after some traumas in hospitals before.
0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.author: Miriam Marshall

0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.text: Broken Nose Surgery I’m sharing this because reviews here are mixed, and my experience was very positive. After a head injury that caused heavy bleeding and a cut near my eye, I was assessed quickly and given both an X-ray and CT scan. I initially wondered if this was excessive, but the CT revealed multiple fractures — so I’m glad it was done. I was then seen by a plastic surgeon who clearly explained the results and my options, without pressure. Based on the extent of the damage, she recommended immediate surgery under general anaesthetic. Naturally this was worrying (it’s your face), but everything was explained thoroughly, including risks, which I also independently verified with UK doctors in my family. The surgery went very well. My nose was realigned with minimal visible scarring once the stitches were removed. Aftercare was excellent, and the room and facilities were very comfortable. When you’re injured and anxious it’s easy to question timing, tests, or communication — I did at first. But with hindsight, the care was professional, thorough, and genuinely reassuring. If you have insurance, I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this hospital.
0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.author: Andrew Digby-North

0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.text: For the past 2 years I've gone to the Bangkok Hospital in Bangkok for my annual checkup. This year I noticed that the package I would normally get was just a bit different at the Chiang Mai location, and those differences made it more suitable for me. Chiang Mai is also closer to where I live. I was totally impressed with the facilities. With a new building added and the original site renovated, this is a super modern facility. Some of the equipment were things I've never seen before. Staff are excellent. There's an obvious high degree of training, and they're also nice people. The hospital also has a "plaza" as in Bangkok, but it was not all fast food. There is a food court with Thai offerings, a sit down Japanese, and a Starbucks. I did have to wait a bit longer than previously for my final consultation with Doctor Vatanapunpituk, but in the end I had a much longer and more in depth consultation than in either of my earlier checkups. The doctor not only reviewed everything, but spent time explaining what it all meant and what I needed to do next.
0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.author: Allan P

0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.text: My experience at Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai is: 1. The doctors are very childish. When giving advice, they don't offer reasonable recommendations. If they see you can afford it, they'll recommend extreme packages, making you spend more than necessary. It felt more like a cosmetic clinic selling hard-sell courses than genuine sincerity and the doctors' genuine concern for your health. 2. The hospital emphasizes comprehensive and modern equipment, and offers coffee and water, which is presumably included in the fee. 3. The follow-up system is terrible. Despite paying a high price, test results are slow to come out. The hospital tells you to check your email, with no notification system via Line or WhatsApp. Patients living abroad need to be prepared for this.
0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.author: Amy K

0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.text: If you want to experience the service, feel free to try it. But if you want to see a doctor, forget it. My stomach was killing me. In other hospitals, an ultrasound was enough to check for appendicitis or something similar. But here, they insisted on a CT scan. Fine, I have medical insurance. I'm not afraid of you charging me around 39,500 yuan for a CT scan. What angered me the most was that I was the only one getting the CT scan, and they made me wait for three hours. That was while I was writhing in pain. What good is having a nurse push me around during that time? And what's even more absurd is that after my test results came back, the doctor was still asking me questions that had nothing to do with my condition. Then he told me to wait until the specialist was on duty the next day to see me. I was stunned. The test results were already out: lymphadenitis, something that can be treated with antibiotics. I've been in pain here for four or five hours, and you're telling me the doctor is off duty and I have to wait until the doctor is on duty the next day. At first, he said he wasn't a specialist and couldn't prescribe any medication, but after I got angry, he was able to prescribe the right medication. Fine, you charge ten times more than other hospitals, but I need the quality of service I receive. Later, I went to another hospital for a CT scan. Even with a long queue, the results came out in twenty minutes. Compared to the Bangkok hospital where I was the only one getting a CT scan, it took three hours to get the results, which made me even more dissatisfied. For the same CT scan, you charge ten times more and are ten times slower. What's the point of coming here for treatment?
0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.author: feng yileng

0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.text: I have never felt so ripped off in my entire life across nine countries. Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai is, in my opinion, the last hospital a foreigner should consider in Chiang Mai. You will be charged exorbitantly for mediocre service. They charged 3,500 THB for medicine worth around 900 THB, leveraging my distress to extract a 160% overcharge. The bill even included a 200 THB fee just for putting my medicine in a bag... I am not joking. The nurse barely spoke English and tried to push unnecessary extra appointments and tests. The doctor was 25 minutes late, despite his department being empty, gave me 4 minutes of consultation, went back to doing nothing, and charged 950 THB. Completely useless and predatory. He cares so much about his patients than in spite of this being my third visit he still didn't know my name and I doubt he recognizes me. The second floor had litter around, and I tripped on sticky Starbucks coffee. They can’t even keep their premises clean. Staff are rude, obsessed by getting as much possible money as they can from you, and clearly don’t care about patient health. Cashier straight asked me " How much cash do you have on you"'?. I was bewildered. Last time I I heard that sentence I was getting mugged, not in an institution that is supposedly reputable. But hey, there’s a guy playing piano in the lobby, so I guess that makes their circus “classy” and “high-end”? This is the worst hospital experience I have ever had. Avoid at all costs.
0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.author: Tristan BILI

0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.text: A horrific, shameful, and deeply unethical experience! My husband was brought to Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai with a high fever of 38.7°C, severe weakness, and chronic asthma. We spent more than TWO HOURS in this hospital, and they did ABSOLUTELY NOTHING to help a vulnerable, suffering patient. They didn't even bother to take a basic blood test to check his infection markers or hydration levels! Instead, the staff spent the entire time aggressively pressuring us to sign overnight inpatient admission papers and demanding a massive 30,000 THB deposit upfront. They literally refused to provide emergency medical care without this cash payment, completely ignoring my husband’s deteriorating state and high-risk respiratory condition. This is pure financial extortion, not healthcare. Even the doctor eventually admitted that the insurance department was blocking everything and suggested we leave for another hospital. To make this nightmare even worse, after failing to provide any medical assistance, they forced us to stand in a long queue at the 'Hospital Pharmacy' for absolutely no reason, and then sent us to wait in another terrible, slow queue just to pay the basic doctor's fee before we could leave! Total chaos, bureaucracy, and absolute disrespect for human life. If you are a tourist or an expat with international insurance, avoid this place at all costs. They only care about your wallet, not your health. A total disgrace to the medical profession.

0x30e2b9a14d744067_0x3c7b4ce75b6240f0.text: สุดยอดของการอุดฟันที่เนียนที่สุดในมหาชัย คุณหมอเก่งมากก อุดฟันตรงที่ฟันกร่อนให้ ออกมาเนียนสวยไม่มีรอยต่อดูไม่ออกเลยว่าอุดฟันมา สุดยอด ประทับใจมากค่ะ
0x30e2b9a14d744067_0x3c7b4ce75b6240f0.author: Pond Dering
0x30e2b9a14d744067_0x3c7b4ce75b6240f0.en: The best and most seamless filling in Mahachai! The dentist is incredibly skilled. They filled the eroded tooth perfectly, and the result is so smooth and beautiful, you can't even tell it's been filled. Absolutely amazing! I'm very impressed.

0x30e2b9a14d744067_0x3c7b4ce75b6240f0.text: คลินิกสะอาด บริการเต็ม10ให้100 พี่หมอและพี่ๆพนักงาน พูดจาน่ารักมากก พี่หมอมือเบามาก ที่สำคัญ แอร์เย็นฉ่ำมาก สรุปคือดีทุกอย่างจ้า
0x30e2b9a14d744067_0x3c7b4ce75b6240f0.en: The clinic is clean, the service is 10/100/100! The doctor and staff are very lovely. The doctor is very gentle. Importantly, the air conditioning is very cool. In short, everything is great!

0x30e2b9a14d744067_0x3c7b4ce75b6240f0.text: คุณหมอ ผู้ช่วย น่ารัก ทุกคน มือเบา พูดเพราะมากกกกกก เอาไปเลย 100 เต็มไม่หัก อยากเชิญชวนให้มาลองใช้บริการที่ดี รับรองติดใจ
0x30e2b9a14d744067_0x3c7b4ce75b6240f0.author: Duangdee Namlang
0x30e2b9a14d744067_0x3c7b4ce75b6240f0.en: The doctor and assistants are all lovely. They have a gentle touch and speak very politely. 100 out of 100, no deductions. I highly recommend trying their excellent service; you'll definitely love it.

0x30e2b9a14d744067_0x3c7b4ce75b6240f0.text: ใครอยากจัดฟันแนะนำที่นี่เลย คุณใจดีมากๆและจัดฟันเข้าเร็ว สวย ทุกอย่างดีหมดเลย วันนี้ใส่รีเทนเนอร์แล้ว ขอบคุณมากๆเลยค่ะ
0x30e2b9a14d744067_0x3c7b4ce75b6240f0.en: I highly recommend this place to anyone who wants to get braces. The owner is very kind, the treatment is fast, and the results are beautiful. Everything is great. I'm wearing my retainer today. Thank you so much!

0x30e2b9a14d744067_0x3c7b4ce75b6240f0.text: บริการดีมากกค่ะ คลินิกสะอาดมากเเอร์เย็นฉ่ำ ที่สำคัญคุณหมอทุกคนใจดีพูดเพราะมาก เเนะนำค่ะสำหรับใครที่ลังเล❤️❤️
0x30e2b9a14d744067_0x3c7b4ce75b6240f0.author: Pawunrat Banpapurud
0x30e2b9a14d744067_0x3c7b4ce75b6240f0.en: The service was excellent! The clinic was very clean and the air conditioning was wonderfully cool. Most importantly, all the doctors were kind and spoke very politely. I highly recommend it for anyone who is hesitant. ❤️❤️

0x30e2b9a14d744067_0x3c7b4ce75b6240f0.text: คลีนิคสะอาด คุณหมอ ผู้ช่วย และพนักงานทุกๆท่านบริการดีมากๆค่ะ จัดฟันกับคุณหมอมายฟันเข้าเร็วมากๆ
0x30e2b9a14d744067_0x3c7b4ce75b6240f0.en: The clinic is clean, and the doctor, assistants, and all the staff provide excellent service. My orthodontic treatment with Dr. May was very quick; my teeth straightened very fast.

0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.text: A friend of mine in Jomtien recommended me to visit Ocean Dental Centre to investigate the cost of a crown, which my dentist in the UK had strongly advised me to have. After a thorough oral investigation I was quoted a price just a little over half what my UK dentist would have charged for a dental crown of the same quality. At my next appointment the excellent and friendly Thai dentist worked for over 2 hours with painstaking attention to every detail, right down to the matching of colours with neighbouring teeth – although ‘painstaking’ is an ill-chosen word here, as the whole procedure was completely painless. At the final session he fitted the newly minted crown, only to express some dissatisfaction with the seating, so he removed it, did a little remedial work, and finally the job was done. He handed me a mirror; I had to ask him, in all seriousness, which was the tooth he had treated. It was impossible to tell. This was serious, dedicated professional work. ‘Cherished’ is not a word I often use in connection with medical procedures, but here I felt cherished throughout. It’s common to hear people say ‘worth a detour’. Ocean Dental Centre is worth a very long detour indeed. Five stars, that being all the app will allow.
0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.author: John T

0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.text: My experience was TOP NOTCH ! ! ! Read on if you'd like to know why..... On an extended holiday I cracked an upper molar. Dr. Toto took x-rays and gave me a diagnosis and prognosis on the day I called. I was able to conveniently schedule all the needed dates for a root canal with a permanent crown. He and his staff were perfectly polite and professional. Every reasonable effort was implemented to reduce transmission of Covid-19. I've never had a numbing agent injection before that was administered with so little discomfort. I didn't feel it. The absence of pain is pleasure. As long as Dr. Toto is actively treating patients and I am in Thailand, I will never use another dentist. I am 100% sure, I could not find a better dentist. Price? I never checked around to compare. I can only say..... It seemed like a low price to me. Thank you again Dr. Toto and to all your wonderful staff. Francis
0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.author: Fran ram

0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.text: I had several fillings, some complex and deep. I wasn't sure how it is going to go. However my experience with Dr. Namo and their nursing staff has been at the best I could imagine. It took 8 appointments, spread over 3 weeks and the final result has been exceptionally good. I am glad that I chose Ocean Dental. Dr. Namo is a brilliant young dentist knowledgeable, cautious and skillful. He explained his treatment strategies clearly. I recommend him to any expat or like myself coming for dental tourism. The prices for treatment are very reasonable.
0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.author: Mike Ash

0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.text: I had 8 porcelain veneers installed one year ago, in February 2019. I have been completely satisfied ever since, and would highly recommend this clinic! Everyone is polite and professional, and the decor and equipment are are modern. The doctor/dentist has a calm, quiet presence, which really helped me through about 6 hours in his chair, over 2 visits. He is a man of few words, but his English was excellent, and his kindness and intelligence shine through. I visit Thailand every few years, and will use this clinic again on future visits!
0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.author: Doug Miller

0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.text: I haven’t been to the dentist for years and reluctant to go. Old school blues with treatment from years ago. I asked many customers over a week and Ocean Dentist came up many times. So I thought I’d give them a go. Wow is all I can say. I had an extraction and I had no pain at all. They are real professionals there and I highly recommend them. I will be telling all customers to go and see them in future. They have turned around my fear of dentists and turned it into a pleasurable experience. Thank you so much Dr Nano
0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.author: Steve Wombat

0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.text: I recently went in for a dental cleaning, check-up, and X-rays, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. My dentist was very professional, gentle, and thorough. She explained everything clearly and made me feel comfortable throughout the whole process. What I especially appreciate is how easy she is to reach she’s super responsive on WhatsApp, which makes scheduling or asking quick questions really convenient. She’s also very helpful and caring, which makes the whole experience stress-free. Highly recommend!
0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.author: Top G

0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.text: Went to see Dr.Totto and his lovely wife today and I must say this was by far the best experience I ever had at a dentist's office. They were so friendly and kind in very little time had my wisdom tooth removed it was so pain free I could not believe it when he told me he was finished. Absolutely amazing is all I can say I recommend this surgery highly staff are very friendly and their prices are very affordable.
0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.author: Tom O'Riordan

0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.text: I visited this clinic while in severe pain. The dentist explained that they could not use an anesthetic because of my high blood pressure. I later learned that anesthetics without epinephrine are available, so I felt disappointed that option was not discussed. I was prescribed Biocoxib and penicillin, although I had no clear signs of infection or inflammation. I was concerned about taking unnecessary antibiotics and other medication with increased cardiovascular risk. Based on my experience, I did not feel my concerns were handled with enough care, and I personally would not return to this clinic.
0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.author: Ronny Schibler

0x30502f4ed1ce7243_0xb4b6e3496ba586a.text: I rescued two 4-month-old kittens, Bob and Agnes, after their mother was hit by a car two weeks ago. I found them in a garage where my friend was working on his car. This same friend, who lives in Rawai, recommended Vetmed Animal Hospital in Phuket, and it turned out to be the best decision ever. After a blood test, it was revealed that both kittens had parvovirus, and one had mild FIV. The Vetmed team took exceptional care of Bob and Agnes, providing condition reports with pictures and videos at least three times a day. Their genuine passion for helping animals was evident, and they treated Bob and Agnes with incredible kindness. I would have loved for Vetmed to continue caring for them, but I live up north in Choeng Thale, so I had to bring them home after four days of being admitted. The doctor at Vetmed prepared all the necessary referral letters for me to take Bob and Agnes to a local vet to continue their treatment. As a first-time pet owner with no experience in looking after kittens, I was grateful for Vetmed’s ongoing support. They continue to reply to all my questions and even call to check on the kittens post-discharge. I am deeply grateful for their kindness and care for Bob and Agnes. I highly recommend Vetmed to any pet owners living in the Rawai and Chalong areas.
0x30502f4ed1ce7243_0xb4b6e3496ba586a.author: Belle P Hatherley

0x30502f4ed1ce7243_0xb4b6e3496ba586a.text: My baby cat died here yesterday after she stopped breathing when they did a leg surgery. Despite the loss and my absolute heavy heart I have to make this review because anything else wouldn’t be fair. I believe that everyone’s time will come and yesterday it was time for my little cat to thrive to heaven. This clinic is really outstanding and they have done a great job. From the first moment we came with our little cat Nazare they have tried everything to make sure she gonna be fine. They treated her very well and they were available for calls due out the whole day. Unfortunately they had to tell us that Nazare didn’t make it but even tho the surgery was already fully finished and she did after, they gave me all the money back without even asking for it. If you have animals and need them to take care of this is a fantastic place to go and I would always go back here if I have another animal. Rest in peace my little baby 🕊️❤️
0x30502f4ed1ce7243_0xb4b6e3496ba586a.author: Larissa Mannhöfer

0x30502f4ed1ce7243_0xb4b6e3496ba586a.text: I have visited Vetmed several times over the past few weeks, and I can say with confidence that all the staff truly love their work and animals and give them maximum attention. On our first visit, we brought in a street beach dog named Dune to have a tumor removed. The doctors demonstrated exceptional professionalism and care throughout the entire process. They were always ready to provide comprehensive information about the course of treatment. Thanks to their dedication, Dune now has a chance to live for many more years. Our second visit was for routine vaccinations for our pet cat, and everything went perfectly. I highly recommend Vetmed Animal Hospital for its outstanding service and compassionate care.
0x30502f4ed1ce7243_0xb4b6e3496ba586a.author: Artur Jakucewicz

0x30502f4ed1ce7243_0xb4b6e3496ba586a.text: Very good clinic. Good English communication skills make things easy. Doctors are very professional and can explain complicated medical words in simple words. Everyone there is very kind and patient. I booked sterilisation appointment for zaizai but was worried about the moving following the next day. I consulted their opinion and they suggest that I cancel if it may be a problem. I think they are their first because they all love and care for animals instead of business.(plus the price is very reasonable) I trust them for treating my zaizai and I recommend this clinic to everyone who seek for good care for their little friends.
0x30502f4ed1ce7243_0xb4b6e3496ba586a.author: bo celecta

0x30502f4ed1ce7243_0xb4b6e3496ba586a.text: ช่วงเดือนเมษายน 69 ที่ผ่านมา เราได้นำน้องหมาชื่อ"พี่ทอง" ขอคำปรึกษาจากคุณหมอ เนื่องจากเราไม่สามารถนำน้องหมาไปเจอคุณหมอได้ คุณหมอทั้งสองท่านก็ให้คำปรึกษา เเนะนำวิธีการรักษา มาเป็นอย่างดี เเละจัดยามาให้จนน้อง"พี่ทอง"มีอาการที่ดีขึ้น เนื่องจากน้องเป็นสุนัขที่มีอายุมากเเล้วเเละมีภาวะโรคที่เเฝงอยู่ในตัวน้อง ทำให้เรารักษาน้องได้เเบบประคับประคอง เเต่ก็เพิ่มเวลาในช่วงบั้นปลายชีวิตของ"พี่ทอง"ได้มากขึ้น
0x30502f4ed1ce7243_0xb4b6e3496ba586a.author: Maturot Kongdee

0x30502f4ed1ce7243_0xb4b6e3496ba586a.text: Excellent hospital! They sterilized a cat, the best price, high quality, fast, no extra charges or scams. The operation cost 1900 baht. In 2 other clinics they asked for 7000 baht and 5000 baht. Thanks to all the employees for the excellent service. I definitely recommend it. 5*
0x30502f4ed1ce7243_0xb4b6e3496ba586a.author: Алексей

0x30502f4ed1ce7243_0xb4b6e3496ba586a.text: Dr Peet and Dr Ben are great vets, The clinic staff are lovely and accomodating. Even after i left phuket and still sponsoring the stray sick kittens i found ( who are now adopted/fostered) , they continue to allow me to pay by transfer and continue to talk and communicate.
0x30502f4ed1ce7243_0xb4b6e3496ba586a.author: Kim Tan

0x30502f4ed1ce7243_0xb4b6e3496ba586a.text: If your animal has a serious condition I recommend you take it to another more equipped hospital. I brought my dog here after she was run over by a scooter, she was in incredible pain. They did X-rays and Ultrasound scan and told me they could not see anything wrong internally. They gave her a pain injection. She would not walk. The next day I took her back here as I was clearly worried and they gave her another pain injection, 1 hr later she died in my arms. She lasted 46hrs but I know in my heart she could have been saved if they had not been so incompetent. As a consequence of losing my dog and the associated grief I also lost my girlfriend of 4yrs we were due to get married. The loss caused grief beyond words. My life has been ruined. I know they missed something on the scans and they should have been honest and told me they were not equipped to deal with the situation and I would have taken her to a more professional place. I will forever regret bringing my dog here and will always wish I had taken her to a proper animal hospital where they would have admitted her and monitored her. All I got from this animal clinic were empty assurances and a dead dog.
0x30502f4ed1ce7243_0xb4b6e3496ba586a.author: Ray Man

0x3054f3e3bc1e57c7_0x3d4ed0d93dab51f2.text: After a less than pleasant experience at another studio, I contacted this one – and was met with the perfect support. She took plenty of time, listened to me, and took my situation seriously. The correction of my brow and lash lift was performed calmly, professionally, and with great sensitivity. The result is natural, even, and suits me perfectly. I especially appreciated the respectful approach, the honest advice, and the caring manner. I felt safe and well cared for from the very beginning. Thank you so much for your help and the fantastic work – I'm thrilled and can absolutely recommend this studio. ❤️ Keep up the great work!
0x3054f3e3bc1e57c7_0x3d4ed0d93dab51f2.author: Janett Pilis

0x3054f3e3bc1e57c7_0x3d4ed0d93dab51f2.text: A little haven of beauty in the heart of Samui, in the Lamai district 🌺✨ So Shine is THE place to know. You can go there with your eyes closed for all types of services—whether it's for waxing, a lash lift, or a facial—everything is done with infinite gentleness and impeccable expertise. Alyah is simply lovely: delicate, very professional, and attentive. She knows how to create a soothing atmosphere where you immediately feel at ease… and pampered as you deserve. Thank you for being there for us, the Farang, and for making beauty synonymous with kindness 💕 A place to recommend without the slightest hesitation! 🙏Bérangère
0x3054f3e3bc1e57c7_0x3d4ed0d93dab51f2.author: Bérangère L'HERMITE

0x3054f3e3bc1e57c7_0x3d4ed0d93dab51f2.text: A wonderful discovery! I had booked an appointment to pamper myself before returning to France... waxing, manicure, pedicure, polish on hands and feet, lash lift, and I took the opportunity to try the tannin treatment! I spent almost 6 hours at the salon (my daughter-in-law also had her lash lift and waxing done). The result: impeccable service and a lovely, professional, and attentive young woman! I highly recommend her; thank you for the wonderful afternoon we spent together!
0x3054f3e3bc1e57c7_0x3d4ed0d93dab51f2.author: Valerie Plasse

0x3054f3e3bc1e57c7_0x3d4ed0d93dab51f2.text: Tried a few highly–rated massage and big stores in Koh Samui and this little store was on a whole other level. I went for the "coconut oil massage" for 400 baht. It was an hour of intense, sustained, deliberate attention to every muscle in my body. The strength was mostly at the pain threshold, but there was not a hint of discomfort right afterwards. I can confirm the natural coconut oil is a good choice!! GREAT!!!
0x3054f3e3bc1e57c7_0x3d4ed0d93dab51f2.author: Yu Chen

0x3054f3e3bc1e57c7_0x3d4ed0d93dab51f2.text: Thank you so much for the beautiful baby pink pedicure! I got a full gel pedicure with exfoliation. My feet feel brand new, nice and soft. The owner was so kind and has gentle hands, asking time to time if I felt any discomfort. The price was fair, and would come back again if I can. I didnt expect to have a nice chat with a Parisian! :)
0x3054f3e3bc1e57c7_0x3d4ed0d93dab51f2.author: Eunbee Jo

0x3054f3e3bc1e57c7_0x3d4ed0d93dab51f2.text: My wife and I are currently on holiday in Samui, and she booked an appointment at this beauty salon, which is truly top-notch. The welcome is warm, and the quality is often even higher than in France, according to my wife. If you're ever in Samui, book an appointment at So Shine Samui.
0x3054f3e3bc1e57c7_0x3d4ed0d93dab51f2.author: Jordan Burlet

0x3054f3e3bc1e57c7_0x3d4ed0d93dab51f2.text: I am thrilled I found So Shine on Google. I now have a perfect manicure & pedicure with Gel polish, likely the best I've ever had. I would highly recommend booking in advance, and worth mentioning the excellent communication too. English & French speaking. Thank you, So Shine ✨
0x3054f3e3bc1e57c7_0x3d4ed0d93dab51f2.author: Shaki K

0x3054f3e3bc1e57c7_0x3d4ed0d93dab51f2.text: A truly lovely salon! I had my eyebrows lifted here for the first time. The result was quite good, but I wasn't 100% satisfied. I was immediately and very kindly offered to come back – and this time it turned out absolutely perfect! Thank you so much, I'll be back next time.
0x3054f3e3bc1e57c7_0x3d4ed0d93dab51f2.author: Lara Marixx

0x30da3be7dfcc4c87_0x843a6c20c13c7ae5.text: I visited an acupuncture clinic because the pain from tennis elbow was so severe that even clenching my fist was difficult. Although there are other long-standing and famous Chinese medicine clinics in Chiang Mai, I felt I would need multiple treatments, so I looked for a place nearby and ended up here. The doctor recommended five sessions, and I completed my fourth today. I had already been stuck in a vicious cycle of treatment and recurrence for tennis elbow in my left arm for nearly three years, and I have experience receiving Pro-Rinse injections twice in Korea and once in Chiang Mai. However, this time, I developed acute tennis elbow in my right arm, causing significant discomfort in my daily life, so I tried acupuncture treatment for the first time. Although it takes longer than Pro-Rinse injections, it is definitely effective, and I really appreciated being able to receive treatment for shoulder stiffness or wrist pain whenever I had them. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone suffering from chronic pain or sudden muscle and ligament pain. The doctor here is a young person who studied in China and is very kind and proactive. For your reference, communication in Chinese is the most fluent here for foreigners, but English is also available.
0x30da3be7dfcc4c87_0x843a6c20c13c7ae5.author: Edward Lin

0x30da3be7dfcc4c87_0x843a6c20c13c7ae5.text: It was my first acupuncture experience and it was great. Unexpected results almost in 24 hours. New place, clean and organized. I had a back and knee problem with a lot of pain. I received acupuncture. I also had a severe skin irritation and bleeding problem, for which I received acupuncture and some herbs. The doctor is professional and extremely gentle with the acupuncture. I was a little scared as it was my first experience but it has been painless and gentle. She is honest in telling you things about your symptom and treatment. The guy at the front desk very friendly, professional and smiling. I would definitely recommend this place 100%.
0x30da3be7dfcc4c87_0x843a6c20c13c7ae5.author: Samahia · Tribus Amma

0x30da3be7dfcc4c87_0x843a6c20c13c7ae5.text: Before arriving to Chiang Mai, I was diagnosed by a Spanish acupuncturist to have a lung Qi deficiency and I decided to continue my newly started treatment in Milada. And I'm glad I did. Now after five treatments, I'm back to balance. The female doctor injected the needles painlessly and very fast, and she provided me with the right herbs to accelerate the healing process. It was always pleasant to arrive there and the general ambience of the place was soothing and efficient.
0x30da3be7dfcc4c87_0x843a6c20c13c7ae5.author: Henrik Wilenius

0x30da3be7dfcc4c87_0x843a6c20c13c7ae5.text: I was traveling to Chiang Mai with my family. Suddenly, my family member felt uncomfortable in their hands. We were worried that massage would cause inflammation, so we wanted to see a doctor. The female doctor at this Chinese medicine clinic was very sweet and friendly, and she could speak Chinese. After the acupuncture, the discomfort in my family's hands was greatly relieved. Thank you doctor for your help!
0x30da3be7dfcc4c87_0x843a6c20c13c7ae5.author: Alison Wang

0x30da3be7dfcc4c87_0x843a6c20c13c7ae5.text: I have been doing acupuncture in several places in Chiangmai. And found a couple great places. But this place has been the most effective. I have had immediate results from the very first session, and it has helped me tremendously with my poor blood circulation and relieving my lower back pain. My highest respect to the doctor and all the staff in the clinic. Thank you so much for really attending to my pain 🙏
0x30da3be7dfcc4c87_0x843a6c20c13c7ae5.author: Maisa Al-Beik

0x30da3be7dfcc4c87_0x843a6c20c13c7ae5.text: This was my first visit. I had acupuncture and cupping therapy for my migraines, and it was very affordable. I'll definitely be back again to try other treatments (the facial acupuncture looks very interesting). They also have weight loss programs. The prices are reasonable, the doctor is lovely, and most importantly, they don't try to push you on packages or make you feel uncomfortable at all. ♥️♥️♥️
0x30da3be7dfcc4c87_0x843a6c20c13c7ae5.author: MHEW .Ananya

0x30da3be7dfcc4c87_0x843a6c20c13c7ae5.text: Though it opened not long, the practioner is very knowledgeable. She is a Thai, very well conversant in Chinese and English. She knows exactly what happened to my sprained ankle and recommended electric acupuncture with intake of some medicine. Had a package deal at a very reasonable price. 0x30e29eba0f1c6fb1_0xb7f77176114b23bc.text: What a well-oiled machine this place was! Everything ran smoothly and everyone working was kind and helpful. I was able to input the correct location on Grab so my driver dropped me off at the door of the right building. As soon as you walk in, you’ll be asked to scan a QR code to register, and you’ll leave your passport with a woman at a desk on the far left hand side. She’ll make a laminated card for you to bring with you and then you’ll go to the third floor. Go towards the right and check in with staff. I had a consultation with a doctor who spoke excellent English and discussed each location I’d be visiting on my trip and a specific timeline for when I’d need to begin taking malaria medication. I also spoke with him about my intended stops on my trip and he recommended a yellow fever vaccine. Top tier care. Would absolutely recommend.

0x30e29e5ab96bd301_0x198e636f2e2c9317.text: I had an excellent experience at Bangkok Hospital Dental Center, and I am truly grateful for the care and support I received from everyone there. From the moment I arrived, one of the staff members kindly guided me to the reception, and to my surprise, they arranged a same-day consultation for me with Assoc. Prof. Dr. Kanokwan Nisapakulthorn. When I reached the consultation floor, I was warmly welcomed. Even before meeting the doctor, the team took my X-ray and prepared everything thoroughly so the discussion with the doctor would be clear and efficient. After reviewing my case, the doctor recommended dental implants. Since I only had 7 days left on my trip, she suggested doing the implant on the same day, which I really appreciated. At that point, I was not fully prepared for the payment due to card limit restrictions from my home country’s bank. Ms. Jantima Kachenchart, the Dental Manager, personally stepped in and helped me with all the required documents to submit to the bank for the card limit extension. The admin staff (unfortunately I didn’t catch her name) was also extremely attentive and supportive throughout the process. After a short waiting time of about 10–15 minutes, Dr. Kanokwan was ready and took me in for the procedure. She was incredibly caring, friendly, and professional. She explained every step clearly and performed two dental implants with bone grafting very carefully within about 1.5 hours. There was no excessive pain, and I felt comfortable and well-informed throughout the entire procedure. Overall, I am extremely happy with the service I received at Bangkok Hospital Dental Center. From the reception to the medical team, everyone was kind, friendly, and genuinely helpful. I highly recommend this dental center to anyone looking for professional, efficient, and compassionate dental care.

We will always be grateful for that. What impressed us even more than her professional skills was the way she treated our daughter. From the very first appointment, it was obvious that caring for children is not just her profession—it is her calling. She was calm, patient, gentle, and genuinely cared about helping our daughter feel safe. Even during a painful emergency, she created an atmosphere of trust instead of fear. Before meeting Dr. Kulaya, every visit to the dentist ended in tears. Today, more than three years later, our daughter happily asks to see only Dr. Kulaya and even looks forward to her regular check-ups. For any parent, that says more than words ever could. This review is based on years of experience, not just one successful visit. Every appointment has confirmed that we made the right choice. For international families, I would also like to mention that Dr. Kulaya speaks excellent English. She explains every procedure clearly, answers every question with patience, and makes both parents and children feel comfortable and confident. If you are looking for a pediatric dentist in Bangkok, we recommend Dr. Kulaya Ratanapridakul without hesitation. She didn’t just save our daughter’s tooth—she helped her overcome her fear of dentists. That is a gift our family will always treasure. Thank you, Dr. Kulaya, and the entire team at Bangkok Hospital Dental Center. ❤️

0x30e285690dde6bc5_0xde9eedfcd9c11df7.en: I underwent 3D orthodontic treatment to reshape my face and jaw. Originally, my jaw was receding, making my chin appear short and obstructing my lower airway, causing difficulty breathing (this type of structure can lead to sleep apnea). My upper jaw was small, narrow, and protruding. Normally, jaw reshaping requires surgery, but I opted for a method to naturally expand my jaw using a device, instead of surgery. After the procedure, my chin is more defined, and it's more visible from the side. The doctor also moved my lower jaw forward, improving my breathing. My teeth are more aligned, and I feel more confident when I smile. If anyone has similar problems, feel free to consult with the doctor. The doctor and the assistants provided excellent care throughout the orthodontic treatment and even after the braces were removed.

0x30e285690dde6bc5_0xde9eedfcd9c11df7.text: It started with a crooked chin leaning to the left. The result is a straighter, more defined face (from a round, prominent jawline to a more slender face with a more defined chin), and beautifully aligned teeth. 0x30e29f514e4255df_0xb0c0fad80afcc926.text: I've been coming here for dental work for a long time because I used to work in the building next door, so it was convenient to walk. But what I love most is the teeth cleaning; it's no longer scary! The dentist is very gentle. They constantly ask how I'm doing, if it hurts, and tell me if it's painful or sensitive. If I can tolerate it, they'll continue; if not, they'll ask if I want a local anesthetic. I get everything done here related to teeth (except braces, because I don't know if the dentist does orthodontics, haha). Oh, and I don't think they do wisdom tooth extractions or other tooth extractions, so you'll have to go elsewhere. But for basic dental work like teeth cleaning and fillings, I highly recommend this place. Even after leaving my job to become a housewife in Samut Sakhon province, I still come here for dental work because it's so good I wouldn't dare go anywhere else. But if you want to come in for dental work, I recommend making an appointment in advance. Or if you really can't wait, you can call the nurses to ask about availability or schedule an appointment for the earliest possible date. ~There's parking for 2-3 cars in front of the clinic. ~There's seating for 2-4 people waiting inside the clinic. ~The place is clean and not crowded. ~The shop is located right by the road, just a short distance in, very easy to find. It's on the left-hand side. ~Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 11:00 AM to 5:00-6:00 PM (I think, but not sure because I've never been there close to closing time). ~Phone number: 02-681-2348

0x30e29f514e4255df_0xb0c0fad80afcc926.text: I was looking for a dental clinic near my condo in the Rama 3 area. After reading reviews, I decided to try their service. I had my teeth cleaned (tartar removed). The dentist was very gentle and explained everything in detail about my teeth and mouth. I also booked an appointment for fillings. The dentist did a great job and even called to follow up on my condition. *It is recommended to call and book an appointment to inquire about available times for your convenience.*
0x30e29f514e4255df_0xb0c0fad80afcc926.author: Ploy Chin

0x30e29f514e4255df_0xb0c0fad80afcc926.text: I've been going to this clinic for over 10 years. I've had everything done here, from teeth cleaning and fillings to root canal treatment. I really like how gentle the dentist is; they constantly ask if it hurts, if I'm okay, if I have sensitivity, and if I need to take breaks while keeping my mouth open. The dentist is very attentive, and the staff are always smiling. 👍🏻🦷 The clinic has parking, which is convenient. I recommend booking an appointment in advance.

0x30e29f514e4255df_0xb0c0fad80afcc926.text: This dental clinic is great. The dentist is lovely, explains everything in detail, and it's easy to understand. You can ask any question you want. Most importantly, they have a very gentle touch. But it's far from home, so I sometimes try other clinics, but in the end, I always come back here because the dentist is meticulous, gentle, and does a great job of scaling. I feel at ease knowing I don't have to worry about anything.

0x3054fcbad23093ad_0xa7fa3097922e41d8.text: I had a motorbike accident while making a turn at slow speed there was small gravel you couldn't see and bike wiped out. I went to a pharmacy that was close to where the accident took place and got it dressed and cleaned up, after 3 days noticing one of the scars wasn't healing fast enough I went to Ocean Medical Clinic. Nurse Ying and her team took great care of me! Staff was friendly and things were done sanitarily. And they always made sure I wasn't in pain as they were cleaning and removing dead skin, so that things would heal properly. I probably should have went sooner, even though it was much more expensive than what I was charged at the pharmacy can't really put a price on good health and the knowledge. And at ~US$275 total thats not too bad as it covered me going for 3 additional days to get everything changed. Would definitely have been way more back in the states
0x3054fcbad23093ad_0xa7fa3097922e41d8.author: William C

0x3054fcbad23093ad_0xa7fa3097922e41d8.text: I hurt my back whilst on holiday in Thailand and had to be seen as I was in that much pain. I took myself to the medical clinic and got seen within 10 minutes of waiting. The staff were really friendly and made me feel at ease for the pain I was in. They ensured I got everything I needed to take the pain away. They treated me with great care and ensured I was comfortable the whole night. They helped me with my insurance and got everything sorted out very quickly! I can’t thank them enough for looking after me. It was also very clean and the beds were very comfortable and they food they serve was also very fresh and tasty!
0x3054fcbad23093ad_0xa7fa3097922e41d8.author: Rachael Robb

0x3054fcbad23093ad_0xa7fa3097922e41d8.text: I went in for a blocked ear. The doctor and nurses were very competent, careful, and persistent. They couldn't remove the blockage because it was too large, so they applied a solution to leave on and asked me to come back that evening and the following morning, at no extra charge. They have a camera to see inside the ear canal, which is quite reassuring because you can follow what they're doing. The doctor's consultation cost 500 baht, the ear canal irrigation 1500 baht, and the Levofloxacin to be inserted into the ear for a week cost 900 baht.
0x3054fcbad23093ad_0xa7fa3097922e41d8.author: Tiffany Poupart

0x3054fcbad23093ad_0xa7fa3097922e41d8.text: Can't say better things about this entire group. I got a bacteria infection the night after jungle party and they acted quickly to diagnose symptoms, get me fluids, and then delived results of my blood work letting me know exactly what I needed. In parrallell to healing me, they worked with my travel insurance to initiate the claim and have that out of my worries. Daniel, the nurses, and the Doc are top notch. Not to mention a comfortable bed, Netflix, and PlayStation were a good way to make me feel better about missing full moon.
0x3054fcbad23093ad_0xa7fa3097922e41d8.author: Jordan Beam

0x3054fcbad23093ad_0xa7fa3097922e41d8.text: My experience here was fantastic. The staff were attentive, thorough, and took the time to make sure I fully understood the course of medications they were prescribing me. As an English-speaker I felt completely comfortable. All the staff were so kind; they even gave me a free umbrella since it started to rain while I was in the clinic and everyone waved and said “bye!” when I left. Overall, it was an experience that was even better than my experiences with walk-in clinics back home. I’m grateful for their help!
0x3054fcbad23093ad_0xa7fa3097922e41d8.author: Alyson Shane

0x3054fcbad23093ad_0xa7fa3097922e41d8.text: I walked into the clinic with an intense allergic reaction on my stomach caused by sea lice (jellyfish larvae in deep ocean). 0x3054fcbad23093ad_0xa7fa3097922e41d8.author: Karthik Rajanala

0x3054fcbad23093ad_0xa7fa3097922e41d8.text: I was there today because I wanted a vitamin C infusion, as I’ve had it several times before when I was sick, and it helped me a lot. He said, sure, vitamin C, we can do that. But when I later googled what they had administered, it turned out to be saline solution and an antibiotic (I absolutely did not want to take an antibiotic). When I asked why the vitamin C was missing, he said I didn’t need it and claimed that the saline solution was actually vitamin B, which he said was better for me. And all this for a price of $330 USD. I’m from Switzerland, one of the most expensive countries in the world, and even there, this wouldn’t cost that much. Now I’m out $330 USD, I’ve been given an antibiotic that I absolutely didn’t want, and I still haven’t had my vitamin C infusion.

0x30e29d1754930e6f_0xf42cb7786a24092b.text: We reserved a table for 6 people, but were given a round table and a separate ice table. They said this was a table for 6 people (?), but it was next to a wall on one side and another table reserved for 5 people on the other. At most, only 4 people could sit there. When we called a staff member over to inquire, they didn't seem very willing to serve. I don't know if they were forced to work there. We asked if we could switch tables to a different corner where we could at least sit at the head of the table, which would add 2 more people. The staff member just kept saying, "For 6 people, there are only 2 tables available, and all other tables are full" (?). Full? What does that even mean? We weren't asking for an extra table, just a change of location to a different table where the head of the table wasn't next to anything, so we could sit together. The staff member didn't try to listen or resolve the issue, repeatedly saying, "For 6 people, there are only 2 tables available, and all other tables are full." (Even though there were many other tables available that weren't full yet; if they had tried to switch tables, we could have sat together.) Then they went and found another table reserved for 4-5 people and swapped it with our table. How was that any different? I don't understand. It just made things complicated and wasn't a solution. Their problem-solving skills were zero. We ended up walking down to find a new restaurant nearby. When we went back up, the problem was still there, so we just asked for the bill and changed restaurants. That was the end of it. Even when we left, they acted like they were happy it was finally over. The real problem wasn't the customers, because we had a reservation. The problem was the restaurant staff, who were completely incompetent at managing anything. And if the restaurant thinks it's okay to have us sit there, I'd like them to show us how six people can sit like that.
0x30e29d1754930e6f_0xf42cb7786a24092b.author: Milkmeiji

0x3102950003630487_0x364be3e818b33875.text: Stop looking at other places, this is where you want to come get your treatments! Like many other travelers who use Google reviews to find English friendly places; I did the same. A famous Muay Thai fighter came and left a review which prompted me to visit myself. I showed up unannounced without an appointment on a Tuesday at 11am. The front desk was very professional and courteous while asking questions in order to determine what treatments are necessary. They offer cupping, acupuncture, blood letting, gua sha, ear points and a few others. After speaking with reception, I had lucked out and there was a cancellation. I was able to receive electroacupuncture (once the needles were in place a small current is pulsed through) and cupping. My arm was formally paralyzed from a car wreck and acupuncture is what initially restored it (this was over 10 years ago). I still have some nagging/dormant muscles around my shoulder blade area, this procedure was AMAZING, the doctor was able to pinpoint the precise problem areas. Now for those of you on the fence about needles, there isn’t any pain, you don’t feel the needle going in, now you will feel it when it reaches your problem area but any pain associated with it will be fixed (think of it like the gym, it has to hurt before it can get better). Acupuncture is REAL, it WORKS, trust the process. Don’t hesitate to come here, amazing personnel and bedside manner. Oh and if you will be here for a while they offer multiple session packages. They are available on both Line/Whatsapp as well. Again, you want to come here if you are in Pattaya and seeking traditional Chinese treatment methods. I will most definitely be returning in the future!!!
0x3102950003630487_0x364be3e818b33875.author: Fred Jones

0x3102950003630487_0x364be3e818b33875.text: What a blessing Acura acupuncture has been in my life. I came from the USA with a few issues that have been bothering me for years. I was actually a patient at a pain clinic for The last 5 years in the USA. Receiving strong pain medicine to deal with my issues. I stopped the medicine before coming to Thailand. I have degenerative arthritis. Neuropathy in both feet which wakes me up in the middle of the night with stabbing pain. Walking on both feet is very painful as well. My feet are mostly numb maybe 50% feeling. I also have a problem with my left leg. My knee which was replaced was a complete failure and a constant source of pain. Needless to say I don't get around very well these days. I have been going to Acura for the last 2 months. I saw early on results in my feet that encouraged me to continue treatments. The stabbing pain in the middle of the night is gone. In fact I don't have any pain throughout the night. The pain I felt while walking is also gone. My feet are still numb but not as much as before. They feel so much better. Acupuncture has also helped with other issues and pain. Dr. BB is very competent and knowledgeable. She listens intently and answers all questions. Dr. BB and the staff are excellent and very friendly. They also speak good English. I don't take opiates anymore for pain. The strongest medicine I ever use is ibuprofen. Acupuncture absolutely works. I highly recommend Acura. 👍👍

0x30e281052755c763_0x4644793a66528c67.text: Review of LASIK Surgery using the Trans PRK Method -Day 1: Morning, I had my eyes examined and my intraocular pressure measured. The curvature of my eye lens was checked using specialized equipment. Next, the doctor measured my vision by having me wear glasses to determine my prescription. After the first measurement, the doctor administered eye drops to dilate my pupils and measured my vision again with the glasses. Once the prescription was determined, the doctor calculated the values ​​and scheduled the LASIK surgery. -Day 2: LASIK Surgery Appointment My intraocular pressure was measured again, and I prepared to enter the operating room. The nurse instructed me to wash my face and hands thoroughly and administered anesthetic eye drops. "The anesthetic isn't as scary as you think, don't panic!" I waited about 15 to 20 minutes for the anesthetic to take effect. Then came the climax!! When the doctor called my name, my heart started beating unusually fast. I wasn't scared, haha! I lay down on the bed with a large laser machine above my head. The doctor began using an instrument to hold my eyes open, but I didn't feel any pain. The anesthetic must have been working. It felt like they were applying some kind of cream to my eyelids, and there was tape to prevent eyelashes from falling out or touching my eyes. After that, the doctor moved our heads to align with the laser mark. The doctor instructed us to stare at the laser machine, which had a green light mark. While we were staring, the doctor constantly reminded us to look at the green light mark and not to look away. When the laser started firing to open the eye tissue, we smelled a burning odor, similar to pulling out and burning hair, for about 8 seconds. After that, the doctor fired at the cornea. The image we saw was a small green light mark. During the procedure, the green light mark appeared as a very large dot. After a few seconds, the green light mark returned to its small size. Then the doctor put on contact lenses to cover our eyes. This was done for both eyes. After the procedure was finished, the doctor had us stand up and checked the curvature of our cornea again. The image we saw was incredibly clear, even clearer than 4K. The doctor then put anesthetic eye drops in our eyes again, covered our eyes with eye shields, and gave us painkillers. We rested for about 15 minutes, waited to receive medication, and were able to go home. -Day 3: Pain began to appear. The pain was similar to having sand in our eyes and around our eyes, like staring at a computer for a long time. However, the pain wasn't severe, probably because we had used anesthetic eye drops and taken painkillers. The doctor prescribed antibiotic eye drops four times a day, pain reliever eye drops four times a day, and artificial tears to use whenever my eyes felt dry. I was also instructed to clean the eyelids with saline solution and avoid washing my face or getting water on my eyes for 7 days. -Day 4 The symptoms were no different from day 3. I continued with the eye drops as prescribed and got plenty of rest. -Day 5 I could start opening my eyes, but there was still some slight pain, irritation around the eyelids, and sensitivity to light. My eyes felt sore when I opened them. I could eat normally, but I should probably avoid fermented and pickled foods, as with most surgeries. -Day 6 I had an appointment with the doctor to remove the contact lens cover. After removal, my vision, which was about 70%, decreased to 65%. It will gradually clear up. I continued using the eye drops and artificial tears as prescribed. I stopped using the antibiotic and pain relievers. I could open my eyes in bright light, but I needed glasses because my eyes were sensitive to light and prone to dryness. I had to use artificial tears regularly in the beginning. After that, I waited for follow-up appointments at 1 month, 6 months, and 1 year. The doctor and assistant were very friendly and polite. Excellent consultation. LASIK by: #LASIKbyDrNamphueng #KristasDhammajakEyeCenterLASIK "Thank you everyone for reading to the end until day 6. Please read a little more 55555" If you have vision problems, try consulting a doctor to see what methods are available. It's like getting a new world, a world of 4K and above 5555 Frequently Asked Questions # Many people ask, "When will my vision be 100% clear after the procedure?" The doctor says it depends on the individual; some may take 1 to 2 months, or 3 months. # Is it scary? I think it's not scary, it's a little tingly like riding a Viking ship. It doesn't even take a minute 55555 # Why did you choose LASIK? For me, I didn't want to wear glasses. When driving, my glasses fog up, or when riding a motorcycle, I have to constantly adjust them. And I have to change the lenses every 1 or 2 years. Many of my friends have had it done, so I decided to do it too. # Will my eyes be dry after LASIK? You still need to use artificial tears for 1-6 months after the procedure, but some people only need to use them occasionally, it depends on the person. I asked my friends, and they said, "My eyes are all dry! My wallet, that is! 55555

0x30e281052755c763_0x4644793a66528c67.text: This post is for those with poor eyesight who have worn glasses or contact lenses their entire lives. For me, I've had this problem for over 30 years because I had pterygium (a growth on the eye) since birth, and had it removed when I was 7 years old. Since then, my eyesight has never been the same. I had a detailed eye exam yesterday with an optometrist and doctor. My left eye has 350 diopters and lazy eye (astigmatism), and my right eye has 300 diopters. After a thorough examination, the doctor said that the scar from the pterygium removal is fine and I can have LASIK surgery without worry. Astigmatism causes double vision, especially in bright lights, and it worsens after prolonged exposure to strong lights. It can become very blurry, similar to nearsightedness, especially if the prescription is higher. I've managed to live without glasses purely out of habit, but it hasn't been without its impact. Lately, I've noticed my eyes getting very tired under strong stage lights, especially during competitions. My face looks tired all the time because my eyes are working harder than usual, which is affecting my appearance and confidence. So, I decided to have LASIK surgery at @crytal_lasik_center. The optometrist and doctor did a very thorough examination before the procedure. The entire morning was spent on eye exams: vision tests, intraocular pressure measurements, corneal thickness measurements, and a manual examination. Afterward, I had my pupils dilated with eye drops and re-examinations were performed to calculate the best possible vision correction and the available surgical method. Dr. Som then recommended the most suitable procedure for me. I was considering PRK, Trans PRK, and SBK Lasik (I later learned that Dr. Som is a highly skilled ophthalmologist). I ultimately decided on SBK Lasik because the recovery time is minimal, as I had a TV shoot in a few days. During the procedure, the nurses and doctor were incredibly professional and patient, explaining everything I asked until all my concerns were gone. The procedure itself was very quick, taking no more than 15-20 minutes for both eyes. I was able to walk around normally immediately afterward. The only discomfort was a slight irritation, like feeling like you've just been on a rollercoaster with flashing green and red lights. 🤣 The doctor gave me eye drops and explained post-operative care. The main things were wearing X-rays at night to prevent scratching, avoiding washing my face and hair for a week (just wiping them), and wearing sunglasses in bright light. Honestly, I went back to sleep and woke up at 6 pm and the pain was gone already! 5555 This morning, I finally understand what those who've had LASIK surgery mean. Everything is clearer and brighter than before. I used to squint and strain to see; the sharpness and brightness are completely different. Today is my first day post-surgery. The only thing I'm still getting used to is my improved vision. If anyone wants to consult with someone, feel free to message them. Or you can ask Jeans. I'm happy to share my experience and answer any questions I can. I consider this the most worthwhile procedure of my life! 👍🏻

This step required a lot of cooperation with the doctor for accuracy. 5. After the procedure, they checked the machine again to ensure the wound was in good condition, then I rested and observed my condition. They applied antiseptic eye drops and put on an eyelid stent, after which I was able to go home. I followed the doctor's instructions strictly for every step. The results were excellent! The day after the procedure, my vision was amazing; it was as clear as wearing glasses, but without them. It was fantastic! #SBKLASIK #CrystalLASIKDhammachak

0x30e29fb73001eab7_0x85a22bf90d3efcb6.text: Whilst searching for a good dentist in Bangkok with good reviews, I came across Spa Dental Clinic. This turned out to be an absolute stroke of luck. Right from the first contact and initial consultation, I was convinced I’d found the right place. My problem was that my teeth were in a terrible state. Dr Lilly said that my treatment would be her most challenging masterpiece. Throughout my six-week treatment, I felt well looked after at all times, with a highly professional and top-class medical standard of care. Over several sessions, teeth were extracted, posts were inserted into my jawbone, and finally the temporary restoration was fitted. Throughout the entire process, I only needed one painkiller, which speaks for itself. I cannot thank Dr Lilly enough for her utterly professional and empathetic work. She offered me the entire treatment at a very fair price. In Germany, I would have paid many times more for the same treatment and would certainly not have received the service that was provided to me by the Spa Dental Clinic in Bangkok. Now I can eat whatever I fancy again. Thank you very much for that, and I can only recommend to everyone that they seek treatment here with Dr Lilly.

0x30e29fb73001eab7_0x85a22bf90d3efcb6.text: I had lost a bridge while in the USA. I was soon traveling to Bangkok. A close friend recommended I go see Dr Lily. After a consultation she recommended a crown and 2 implants and 1 extraction. Same diagnosis I received in USA. She also added teeth whitening and a night guard for when I sleep. She assured me that her cost would include everything until it was complete and I was satisfied. Total cost was much cheaper than in the US. She began the process with professionalism and perfection. She was not finished until it was perfect. I was happy before she was! In the end I was completely satisfied and extremely happy with the dental work I received. I would highly recommend Dr Lily for anyone looking to get a job done to perfection. I will be using Dr Lily for all my dental stuff when needed. GO SEE DR LILY! SHES AMAZING! THANK YOU DR LILY FOR GETTING ME FIXED UP. I CAN ACTUALLY EAT ON THE LEFT SIDE AGAIN!

0x30e29fb73001eab7_0x85a22bf90d3efcb6.text: I recently visited Bangkok Dental Spa for a tooth whitening treatment. The experience was professional, efficient, and cost-effective. The entire procedure took around one hour, and the results were impressive—my teeth became noticeably whiter. The total cost was 150,000 THB, and I found it to be well worth the investment. The clinic is conveniently located near Soi Cowboy and close to popular tourist areas, making it easy to access. The staff are highly experienced, with over 20 years of service in the dental industry. I highly recommend Bangkok Dental Spa to anyone seeking dental services such as tooth cleaning, whitening, implants, or solutions for any dental issues. One area for improvement is that I experienced a slight burning sensation on my lips, which I assume was caused by the bleaching agent. It might be helpful if the clinic could find ways to minimize this discomfort in future treatments.

My husband has also had laser whitening on his teeth and two fillings replaced. We are both very impressed with Dr lily's demeanour, attention to detail and professionalism. She was flexible and accommodating with our time constraints, working after hours to ensure our dental work was completed. We are returning to Australia with beautiful smiles. 0x30e29f4637c1b683_0xb71a9acab1bf5f4a.text: I can't recommend enough the service of Dr. Jeeraphat for endodontic treatments. I had to do a root canal treatment for the second time on my tooth 45 following a new infection 10 years after my first treatment. And I am so grateful to have been recommended her service by another endodontist in Bangkok, as my case was looking very complicate on the X-Rays. Dr. Jeeraphat delivered an incredible attention to my case from the start to the end. She has such an experience in endodontic treatments and emits a positive and soothing energy which made me relaxed and worry free throughout the treatment. All in all, such an unmatched experience. My wife happened to have to do as well a second canal treatment on another tooth, and she felt the same about Dr Jeeraphat. Special mention for the caring staff accompanying Dr Jeeraphat and in the clinic. The communication was always easy through the Line chat of the clinic. Highly highly recommended

I have been a patient of Dr. Jeerapat for over a decade, and I can confidently say that she is the best root canal specialist I’ve ever had the pleasure of seeing. Her diagnostic skills are outstanding, and her approach of treating tooth pain and infected pulp is both precise and effective. Throughout the years, she has successfully handled even the most complex cases with remarkable care and expertise. Dr. Jeerapat is incredibly meticulous, with a wealth of experience that is evident in the quality of her work. The team at MDK Silom Clinic is equally exceptional-always professional, friendly, and attentive to patient needs. I highly recommend Dr. Jeerapat to anyone seeking top-tier dental care.

I was recently in Bangkok on holiday and found myself needing emergency root canal treatment. I was lucky to be staying in Silom, close by to MDK. I visited without an appointment and I again was lucky enough to be able to. See Dr Alisa Leesavan and her wonderful assistants I can't thank Dr Alisa enough for the emergency work she did on my tooth. Her emergency work allowed me to fly back to Sydney to the next day without any pain. I have no hesitation in recommending this dental practice as they do very good work .

The best dental clinic in Thailand. All dentists are the best. Superb service and very clean. I’ve been receiving dental treatment here for the past three years, and every dentist here is excellent. I had my orthodontic treatment done here, had my wisdom teeth removed, and regularly get scaling done. My family also had her root canal treatment here.
0x30e29f4637c1b683_0xb71a9acab1bf5f4a.author: Ratchaset Ketthanapat

0x30e29b2fafe38aeb_0xbc69159a78d1c6db.text: I had my wisdom tooth surgery with Dr. Top, and I’m very happy with the experience. My wisdom tooth was deep and close to the nerve, so I was quite nervous about the possibility of numbness. Dr. Top carefully reviewed my X-ray, explained the risks clearly, and discussed the option of a CBCT without pressuring me. The surgery itself was essentially painless. I only started feeling significant pain about 2 hours after the operation when the anesthesia wore off. After taking the prescribed medication, the pain was completely gone, and I had no bleeding. The next day, I honestly felt like nothing had happened—there was still some cheek swelling, but no pain at all. What I appreciated most was how Dr. Top explained every step during the surgery, so I always knew what was happening. He was very careful around the nerve and was able to remove the entire tooth successfully. The clinic is clean, modern, and well-equipped, and the staff were friendly and accommodating. The pricing is also very affordable and transparent, with clear post-op instructions and a medication guide provided. The online customer service is top-notch as well, and I’m very satisfied with the overall service. I’ve been to many dental clinics before, but this clinic is honestly on another level in all aspects. This is actually my first time ever leaving a review, because I’m genuinely very happy with the service I received. I’m now 14 days post-op and recovering very well. If you’re an expat looking for a good dental clinic in Bangkok, don’t hesitate—book an appointment already! Highly recommended.

ผ่าฟันคุดมามะวารค่ะ คุณหมอมือเบามาก และทำไวมาก ผ่า1 ซี่ ถอน 1ซี่ (ตอนทำคุณหมอบอกทุกขั้นตอนและฉีดยาชาไม่เจ็บอย่างที่คิด) คุณหมอนีท อธิบายเก่งและใจเย็นมากๆ พี่ๆผู้ช่วยก็ใจดี ให้ฟีลอบอุ่นมาก รวมๆประทับใจสุดๆ โดยเฉพาะ พี่เนย(พี่ที่ reception) ที่ให้ริการดีตั้งแต่ก่อนจะไปทำและหลังทำเสร็จ ดูแลดีเป็นกันเองสุดๆ สำหรับใครที่กำลังกลัวบอกเลยว่าไม่น่ากลัวเลยค่ะ คลีนิคสะอาดน่ารัก ตรงปกไม่ตกตา รู้สึกประทับใจมากๆ ⭐️ความเจ็บ :2/10 ⭐️service: 11/10 ⭐️เจ็บปวดหลังผ่าตัด :4/10 (เพราะปวดฟันคุดเจ็บและทรมานกว่ามาก) สำหร้บคนที่กำลังกลัวการผ่าฟันคุดนะคะ บอกเลยว่าไม่เจ็บและน่ากลัวอย่างที่คิด น่ากลัวแค่ตอนคิดไปเอง ตอนทำใจ พอหมอให้ยาชาปุ๊บบไม่รู้เรื่องแล้วว ของเราทำไปไม่เกิน 45 นาที บนล่าง หรืออาจจะน้อยกว่านั้น ความรู้สึกคือแปปเดียวเลยค่ะ อิอิ นี่คื รีวิวที่จริงใจที่สุ๊ดดดดกั้บบ ☺️✨
0x30e29b2fafe38aeb_0xbc69159a78d1c6db.en: I had my wisdom teeth extracted yesterday. The dentist was very gentle and quick. One tooth was extracted, one more removed. (The dentist explained every step of the process and the anesthetic wasn't as painful as I expected.) Dr. Neet was very explainable and patient. The assistants were also very kind and made me feel welcome. Overall, I was extremely impressed, especially with Ney (the receptionist) who provided excellent service before and after the procedure. She was very caring and friendly. For anyone who is afraid, I can assure you it's not scary at all. The clinic is clean, cute, and exactly as pictured. I was very impressed. ⭐️Pain Level: 2/10 ⭐️Service: 11/10 ⭐️Post-Surgery Pain: 4/10 (Because the wisdom tooth pain was much more painful and agonizing.) For those who are afraid of wisdom tooth extraction, I can tell you it's not as painful or scary as you think. The only scary part is the preconceived notions and the mental preparation. Once the dentist gives you the anesthetic, you won't feel anything! Mine took less than 45 minutes, both upper and lower, maybe even less. It felt like it happened in a flash! This is my honest review! ☺️✨

0x30e29b2fafe38aeb_0xbc69159a78d1c6db.text: รีวิว หลังผ่าฟันคุดค่ะ ตอนแรกกังวลคิดว่าตอนผ่าจะน่ากลัว แต่พอเข้าห้องไปเจอคุณหมอใจดีและบรรยากาศสบายๆ ใช้เวลาผ่าจริงๆไม่ถึง 5 นาทีเลยค่ะ ไม่เจ็บเลย คุณหมอมือเบามากกกกก👏🏻 แฟนที่มาขูดหินปูนยังบอกว่าคุณหมอมือเบามาก มีอาการวันแรกที่ยาชาหมดฤทธิ์ ปวดในระดับที่ทนได้ ไม่ต้องทานยาแก้ปวดเลย🥰 ไม่มีอาการบวมด้วย คุณหมอทำดีมากค่ะ เพิ่งไปตัดไหมมาคุณหมอบอกว่าแผลหายดีปกติ แนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะ 10/10 👍🏻
0x30e29b2fafe38aeb_0xbc69159a78d1c6db.en: Review after wisdom tooth extraction: At first, I was worried that the extraction would be scary, but once I entered the room, I met a kind doctor and the atmosphere was relaxing. The actual extraction took less than 5 minutes! It wasn't painful at all. The doctor had incredibly gentle hands 👏🏻 My boyfriend, who came for tartar removal, also said the doctor was very gentle. I just had the stitches removed, and the doctor said the wound has healed well. I highly recommend this place! 10/10 👍🏻

0x30e29b2fafe38aeb_0xbc69159a78d1c6db.text: วันนี้เข้ามารับบริการ คุณหมอกานต์อธิบายและแนะนำในการทำฟันดีมากกละเอียดสุดๆและที่สำคัญมือเบามากค่า สำหรับคนที่กลัวการทำฟันกลัวเจ็บมาที่คลินิกนี้ไม่ต้องกลัวเลย พี่ๆพนักงานเคาน์เตอร์และพี่ๆผู้ช่วยบริการดีมากก เป็นกันเองสุดๆ คลินิกสะอาด อบอุ่น ฟิลอยู่บ้าน ที่สำคัญคลินิกมีคาเฟ่ข้างหน้าด้วยน้าาา ใครจะทำฟันแนะนำที่นี้เลยค่ามีคุณหมอเฉพาะทางครบจบ

For those who are afraid of dental work or pain, you don't need to be afraid at this clinic. The counter staff and assistants are very friendly and helpful.
