0x30e29b2fafe38aeb_0xbc69159a78d1c6db.text: อยากชมว่าคลินิกสะอาดมากๆๆๆ พี่เจ้าหน้าที่บริการและพูดจาดีมาก แอร์เย็น คุณหมอให้คำแนะนำดีและใจเย็น มาผ่าฟันคุด 1ซี่ ถอน1ซี่ คุณหมอค่อยๆทำให้ และบอกที่ละขั้นตอน แนะนำดี ได้โปรผ่า 2999 พร้อมเอกซเรย์คุ้มสุดๆ ค่าถอนฟันคุดก็ไม่แพง รอบหน้าจะมาเอาออกอีก 2ซี่ แนะนำเลยคุณหมอและเจ้าหน้าที่น่ารัก -มีที่จอดรถ -คลินิกอยู่ชั้น3 อาคารเก่งรุ่งเรื่องชัย
0x30e29b2fafe38aeb_0xbc69159a78d1c6db.en: I want to commend the clinic on its exceptional cleanliness. The staff were very friendly and polite. The air conditioning was cool, and the doctor gave good advice and was very patient. I had one wisdom tooth extracted and another removed. The doctor performed the procedure slowly and explained each step carefully, offering great guidance. I got a great deal on the extraction for 2999 baht, including X-rays. The wisdom tooth removal fee was also reasonable. I'll be back next time to have two more extracted. I highly recommend this clinic; the doctor and staff are lovely. -Parking is available. -The clinic is located on the 3rd floor of the Keng Rungruangchai Building.

0x30e29b2fafe38aeb_0xbc69159a78d1c6db.text: ไปผ่าฟันคุดล่างพร้อมกันสองซี่ ไม่เจ็บเลย คุณหมอทำมือเบามาก ไม่รู้สึกเจ็บเลย ทำได้รวดเร็ว ระหว่างทำคุณหมออธิบายชัดเจนว่ากำลังทำอะไรอยู่ ทำให้รู้สึกสบายใจไม่กังวลเลยค่ะ เครื่องมือทันสมัย คลีนิกสะอาด พนักงานหน้าเคาน์เตอร์ก็บริการดี พูดจาน่ารัก ให้คำแนะนำชัดเจน บรรยากาศโดยรวมดีมากค่ะ 😊 และรีวิวก็ดีไปในทางเดียวกันหมด เลยตัดสินใจมาผ่าที่นี้
0x30e29b2fafe38aeb_0xbc69159a78d1c6db.en: I had two lower wisdom teeth extracted at once. It wasn't painful at all. The dentist was very gentle; I didn't feel any pain. The procedure was quick, and the dentist clearly explained what they were doing, which made me feel comfortable and not anxious. The equipment was modern, and the clinic was clean. The counter staff were also very helpful, friendly, and gave clear advice. The overall atmosphere was great. 😊 And the reviews were all positive, so I decided to have the extraction done here.

0x30e29b2fafe38aeb_0xbc69159a78d1c6db.text: วันนี้มาผ่าฟันคุดฟัน หมอมือเบาค่อยๆทำ อธิบายทุกขั้นตอน หายกลัวขึ้นเยอะเลย ระหว่างการผ่าก็มีคอยมาเช็คถามเป็นระยะๆด้วยว่าเจ็บมั้ย5255525 แถมก่อนผ่ามีทำCTช่องปากก่อนทำเพื่อความปลอดภัยด้วย ภาพรวมคลีนิคสะอาดดีมาก หมอใจดี ใจเย็น อธิบายละเอียดมาก
0x30e29b2fafe38aeb_0xbc69159a78d1c6db.en: Today I had my wisdom tooth extracted. The dentist was very gentle and careful, explaining every step of the process. It helped me feel much less scared. During the extraction, they checked on me periodically to see if I was in pain. They even did a CT scan of my mouth beforehand for safety reasons. Overall, the clinic was very clean, and the dentist was kind, patient, and explained everything in detail.

0x30e29ec4c05ab863_0x2ee4097c48c0cdb4.text: I recently visited IDENT Dental Clinic and had an amazing experience. From the moment I walked in, I was welcomed by a friendly and professional staff that made me feel comfortable. The clinic is modern, clean, and equipped with the latest technology, which gave me confidence in the quality of care I would receive. Dr. Pantira was highly skilled and took the time to thoroughly explain every step of my treatment, ensuring I understood my options and felt at ease. The procedure was smooth, and I was impressed by the attention to detail and the level of care provided. The entire team went above and beyond to ensure my comfort and satisfaction.

Modern dental clinic situated right in the middle of Bangkok. Nestled in the chidlom neighborhood, the location can be accessed by a few minutes walk from BTS Chidlom station. Parking is available at the building and you can get a complimentary of 1-hour to park for free. The staff and the dentists are quite experienced, approachable and kind. I would highly recommend to anyone who is looking for dental treatments in town!

I had a great experience at IDENT Dental Clinic. I came in for a dental cleaning and to have a new retainer made. The dentist was very kind, gentle, and professional throughout the entire treatment. Everything was done very smoothly and comfortably, and the prices were also very reasonable. I’m very happy with the service and would definitely recommend IDENT to anyone looking for a good dental clinic!
0x30e29ec4c05ab863_0x2ee4097c48c0cdb4.author: Phakorn On The Go

0x30e29ec4c05ab863_0x2ee4097c48c0cdb4.text: This is hands down one of the best dental clinics I’ve ever been to. The doctors there was kind, patient, and genuinely cares about my comfort. I was nervous at first, but the dentist explained everything in a calm and friendly way, which really helpful. The service was smooth and very professional. I left feeling relaxed and happy with the results. Most defo recommend!

I woke up this morning thinking about getting the airflow done. Checked the clinic in my area and found this one (good rating, good looking). I came as a walk in, I was lucky that had a time slot for me. The doctor was extremely nice and spoke good English. I liked the service it was fast, smooth and good

I had an excellent experience at this clinic. The professional cleaning and AirFlow treatment were very thorough, and I am extremely satisfied with the results. The staff was professional, friendly, and attentive throughout the entire visit. Highly recommended!
0x30e29ec4c05ab863_0x2ee4097c48c0cdb4.author: Rafael L.

0x30e29ec4c05ab863_0x2ee4097c48c0cdb4.text: I just found out about this place from my wife and they were able to schedule us the same day for a cleaning before we head back to the US. The service was professional and quick and they took great care of my teeth.

The team here is brilliant, I got my teeth cleaned in less than 30 mins and the results were amazing!! The clinic is super comfortable, centrally located and easy to reach from BTS Chid Lom. Highly recommend them!!!
0x30e29ec4c05ab863_0x2ee4097c48c0cdb4.author: Aaryaman Bhatia

0x30e299f639db53e3_0x9fbb1cda4d559f2a.text: Let me first say I don’t like going to dentist in general. I haven’t been to dentist for long time and I knew I have many cavities and problems. I went to couple of dentists in Thailand before this place and I didn’t feel very assured and confident. They just quickly checked, not much explanation, no xray, they give you the price and that’s it, language barrier is also a problem. Fortunately, I finally decided to go and fix them after my gf recommended this place. When I came to this place, after quick check dr Maple recommended xray right away to find some hidden issues, we found I had many cavities.(as expected). Because dr Maple was so frank and talked with me through those problems in great detail (spoke in great English by the way) I felt assured that this place is the one. Then I spent more than a week fixing immediate issues with both Dr Maple and Dr Techin. I’m very grateful and glad I had opportunity to have them help me and I cannot recommend both of them enough. They both are very professional and experienced doctors and I felt confident going there. I want to thank them both and their staff who help them. Now I have an appointment next month again, i pray and hope I won’t have many new issues anymore.
0x30e299f639db53e3_0x9fbb1cda4d559f2a.author: Ilia Muromets

0x30e299f639db53e3_0x9fbb1cda4d559f2a.text: We recently switched to Toothmate Clinic based on reviews. We felt our previous clinic wasn't good; they didn't discuss the treatment plan, and our teeth seemed to get worse with treatment – ​​it felt like we were wasting money every month. So we decided to come to Toothmate Clinic. The service is excellent, from the counter to the doctor. They provide great advice and consultations, create a treatment plan, and explain everything clearly. If you're having trouble with your current clinic, I highly recommend Toothmate! 💕 You won't regret your money! 😘 The doctor even gave us complimentary toothpaste and mouthwash. Thank you!
0x30e299f639db53e3_0x9fbb1cda4d559f2a.author: ปนัดดา เพชรอินทร์

0x30e299f639db53e3_0x9fbb1cda4d559f2a.text: From someone who is easily afraid of dental work, this place made me completely fearless. The dentists and staff are all incredibly kind and patient. I've had fillings, extractions, and wisdom tooth removal done here, and the dentists are incredibly gentle. I never experienced any pain. The wisdom tooth extraction was especially quick – there's nothing to be afraid of or worried about because they work so fast. I've also been wearing braces here for over a year now, and I can honestly say my teeth are moving every month. There's no unnecessary delay. I highly recommend this clinic for your dental work!
0x30e299f639db53e3_0x9fbb1cda4d559f2a.author: Preedaporn Nilmul

0x30e299f639db53e3_0x9fbb1cda4d559f2a.text: If you're looking for a reasonably priced dentist in the city, with top quality care and attention to detail, Toothmate is highly recommended. After having quite a bit of work done here, including root canal treatment with crown, fillings and cleaning, I'm pleased with the results and am glad to have found such a good dentist in Doctor Techin. Free on street parking is available if you get a morning appointment. Otherwise there's a small carpark opposite at a reasonable cost. Also not far from the BTS St Louis. An added bonus is the great coffee ships and small food shops in the area.
0x30e299f639db53e3_0x9fbb1cda4d559f2a.author: Angus

0x30e299f639db53e3_0x9fbb1cda4d559f2a.text: I can highly recommend this clinic! I had inquired about teeth whitening and initially wanted to take a home kit. After a brief and very friendly consultation in English, I decided to have the bleaching done directly at the clinic – an LED bleaching treatment with blue light, which gradually whitens the teeth. The entire treatment was completely straightforward and painless. I was finished in about an hour – and I'm really very happy with the result. My teeth are noticeably whiter and still look natural. I can wholeheartedly recommend this clinic and this bleaching method!
0x30e299f639db53e3_0x9fbb1cda4d559f2a.author: P. Paulus

0x30e299f639db53e3_0x9fbb1cda4d559f2a.text: Toothmate is an excellent dental clinic! I had a dental emergency while on vacation in Bangkok, and they completely saved my trip. They performed an emergency root canal and provided effective pain management right away. Both the dentists and the dental assistants did a wonderful job with the X-rays and treatment. The clinic is very clean,and hygienic, and the staff is extremely professional, caring, and attentive. I am so grateful for the outstanding care I received and highly recommend Toothmate to anyone in need of dental care in Bangkok! S.G
0x30e299f639db53e3_0x9fbb1cda4d559f2a.author: Sandra Gonzalez

0x30e299f639db53e3_0x9fbb1cda4d559f2a.text: I went here late in the afternoon with no appointment in great pain , they saw me and very kindly and professionally dealt with it the tooth. The staff are super kind and gentle and the whole place is extremely clean, with obvious procedures in place to keep.up this high standard, probably better than many places in Europe. Prices are more than reasonable too. After I left the clinic I had , as they said, no further pain and could continue my trip . I have no hesitation in recommending this Dental clinic to you.
0x30e299f639db53e3_0x9fbb1cda4d559f2a.author: robin natley

0x30e299f639db53e3_0x9fbb1cda4d559f2a.text: I got my Invisalign treatment with Dr. Maple. She's incredibly kind and meticulous. I was able to point out any areas of my teeth that I wasn't happy with. And most recently, I took my mom for veneers with Dr. Te. She did a beautiful job with my mom's veneers! She chose a shade that matched her skin tone, making them look natural and not artificial. The shape of each veneer is also very natural. The clinic is clean, the air conditioning is cool, and the waiting area is comfortable. 💕🫶🏻
0x30e299f639db53e3_0x9fbb1cda4d559f2a.author: ploylala kan

0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.text: เป็นการทำฟันที่ประทับใจมากค่ะ เคยไปขูดหินปูนที่รพ.แห่งหนึ่ง หมอและเจ้าหน้าที่ ทำเจ็บและไม่ค่อยได้แนะนำอะไร คุยกันตลอดเวลา และบ่นว่าเรา ทำให้ฝังใจ ไม่อยากไปทำฟันอีก จนวันนี้ ตัดสินใจมาทำคลีนิกที่นี่ เพราะน้องที่รู้จักกันแนะนำมา คุณหมอมือเบามากค่ะ และพี่ๆเจ้าหน้าที่ทุกท่านก็พูดจาไพเราะ และแนะนำวิธีการดูแลช่องปากให้เราด้วย ขอขอบคุณคุณหมอและเจ้าหน้าทุกท่านนะคะ ที่ใส่ใจการบริการ และให้คำแนะนำช่วยเหลือ
0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.author: Pin
0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.en: This was a very impressive dental experience. I once went to a hospital for teeth cleaning, but the doctor and staff were painful and didn't offer much advice, constantly chatting and complaining about me. It left a lasting impression, and I didn't want to go to the dentist again. Until today, I decided to come to this clinic because a friend recommended it. The doctor was very gentle, and all the staff were very polite and gave me advice on how to take care of my oral health. Thank you so much to the doctor and all the staff for your attentive service and helpful advice.

0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.text: เริ่ด งบไม่บานปลาย หมอให้คำแนะนำ การดูแลชัดเจน ผ่า/ถอนฟันคุดใช้ระยะเวลาและงบแต่ละเคสแตกต่างกัน โดยคุณหมอจะประมาณทุกอย่างเผื่อไว้ให้เรียบร้อย เคสนุ๊กเองใช้เวลาผ่าและถอนจบไวมากกว่าที่ตัวเองเตรียมใจไว้อีก แม้มีซี่ที่คด งอไปเบียดฟันปกติ😹❣️🫶🏻 หมอเชี่ยวชาญฟันคุดเข้าทุกวันอาทิตย์นะคะ แนะนำให้โทรเบอร์เพื่อสอบถามคลินิกค่า
0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.en: Excellent! The budget didn't spiral out of control. The doctor gave clear advice and aftercare instructions. The time and cost of wisdom tooth extraction vary from case to case, but the doctor estimates everything beforehand. My case was even faster than I expected, despite having a crooked or bent tooth that was crowding my normal teeth 😹❣️🫶🏻. The doctor specializing in wisdom teeth is available every Sunday. I recommend calling the clinic to inquire.

0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.text: I took my child to the dentist for the first time. The dentist was very kind and gave excellent advice. The service was great, and all the assistants were lovely and attentive to my child. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone who is afraid of dental work. 👍🏻👍🏻 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ …
0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.author: Phakjira Wannamas

0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.text: Convenient parking. Located on the main road but with parking available. The vet is gentle. I saw Dr. Sai; there are several vet doctors available. The price is 900 baht for the poultice plus 40 baht for fluoride. It's deducted from social security, so you don't need to pay upfront.
0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.author: PJ

0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.text: คุณหมอมือเบา น่ารัก และคุยดีมาก ทีมงานสุภาพ บริการดี คนไข้เยอะ ควรทำนัดก่อนไป รอไม่นานเท่าไหร่ คุณหมอทำเร็วแบบมืออาชีพ ในคลีนิคจะมีกลิ่นแปลกๆ หน่อย ค่อนข้างอึดอัด เหมือนอากาศไม่ถ่ายเท มีที่จอดรถหน้าร้าน และริมถนน ร้านอยู่ถัดจากตลาดพระราม 5 มานิดหน่อย
0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.author: Being Journal
0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.en: The doctor is gentle, lovely, and very talkative. The staff is polite and provides good service. There are many patients, so it's best to make an appointment beforehand. The wait isn't too long, and the doctor works quickly and professionally. The clinic has a slightly strange smell and feels a bit stuffy, like the air isn't circulating well. There is parking in front of the clinic and on the street. The clinic is located a short distance from the Rama 5 market.

0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.text: My son has had this procedure done several times, and we've been impressed every time. The speed varies, depending on the doctor's case. They always inform you beforehand, and you can consult with them. They are very attentive.
0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.author: Leela Steady

0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.text: This was my first time getting my teeth done here. The doctor was very kind and had a gentle touch. The assistants were lovely and provided excellent service. If anyone wants to get their teeth done, I recommend coming here.
0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.author: ปวีณา พูลจันทร์

0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.text: คุณหมอน่ารักและสุภาพมากครับ ให้คำแนะนำดีมากๆ ทำฟันได้ละเอียดดีมากครับ เจ้าหน้าที่และผู้ช่วยทุกคนก็สุภาพมากครับ มาใช้บริการครั้งแรกก็กลายเป็นลูกค้าประจำเลย ลูกก็ชอบมาใช้บริการที่นี้ ทำตั้งแต่ประถม จนเข้ามัธยมปลายแล้ว
0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.author: Doo Pook
0x30e290823b7b106d_0x4e13ece81606c14e.en: The dentist is very kind and polite. They gave excellent advice and did a very thorough job. All the staff and assistants were also very polite. I became a regular customer after my first visit. My child also loves coming here; they've been coming since elementary school until high school.

0x30da31a6d26d788f_0x5599a693e54bd2f4.text: While backpacking Thailand I found myself in Chiang mai and wanting to use some of my time to fill in some big cavities I had in my bottom molars and get a general complete thorough clean of my whole mouth, too. I'm always nervous going to the dentist anywhere, especially after I had a period of dental neglect. I just want to let anyone who is thinking of having their teeth done in Chiang Mai that this dental clinic is WONDERFUL. The dentist, Jean or Jin (sorry, I don't know how it is spelt) couldn't be nicer and more sensitive to your comfort and needs. She is clearly passionate about what she does and is very gentle and caring in general. As a huge plus she speaks good English as well! She informs you along the way as to what she is doing, seeing and thinking. She told me up front what I would be paying and there were no hidden costs or any rush to get you out. She even gave me some tips on dental maintenance and a free roll of floss to apply the knowledge given. The prices were as far as my research tells me, some of the cheapest in Chiang Mai. I highly recommend this clinic to everyone. THANK YOU SO MUCH 🙏 I Couldn't be happier. I wish you the best.
0x30da31a6d26d788f_0x5599a693e54bd2f4.author: Simon William Rowe Harris

0x30da31a6d26d788f_0x5599a693e54bd2f4.text: Don't be put off by the surrounding shops. These guys are amazing, and the surgury are very clean (first star). I mucked them around this morning after having my first grab pull out on me, which left me ten minutes late. And they shrugged it off. It was no issue. Understanding the customer. (Second star) I had a cap repair, and the job was so good. You would not even if it was a cap. Professional workmanship (third star) Also, I thought about having my Mercury fillings pulled out and replaced wth ceramic ones. The dentist convinced me that there is no need and leave them be. Now, the dentist could have actually gone ahead and done the job, thinking about the money, but she never did. Honesty (Fourth star) When I arrived, I only had a 1000bhatt note. Asked the dentist to change it, but having just opened, she also did not have change, so she gave me 100bhat of her own money to pay the taxi. Five stars deserved.
0x30da31a6d26d788f_0x5599a693e54bd2f4.author: Darrell Maddock

0x30da31a6d26d788f_0x5599a693e54bd2f4.text: Taking my farang partner to get his teeth cleaned and have some fillings done. The dentist is very professional and patient throughout the whole process. She speaks very good English, making communication easy with both me and my partner. After checking his teeth thoroughly, she explained what needed to be done, each step of the process, and how much everything would cost beforehand so we could decide if we wanted to continue. So far, this is the best dentist I’ve ever been to 👍 She’s so friendly that we didn’t feel any pressure or unnecessary stress. Highly recommended!💯💯 I randomly found this place here on Google Maps and saw she had good English reviews, so I gave it a try and I’m so glad we did!
0x30da31a6d26d788f_0x5599a693e54bd2f4.author: Keira Likit

0x30da31a6d26d788f_0x5599a693e54bd2f4.text: Dr Jin did a great job! We had a teeth clean and the price is around 900-1500 Thai baht depending on the complexity of your teeth. She tells you the price once she’s had a look into your mouth and before proceeding so you can make sure you agree with the price On another occasion I had some fillings done for me using an Estelite sigma quick resin, which matches the colour of teeth at around 700 baht per filling She is very personable, good at what she does and speaks very good English and keeps you informed throughout They don’t currently take card payments but there are ATMs right outside if required
0x30da31a6d26d788f_0x5599a693e54bd2f4.author: A & A

0x30da31a6d26d788f_0x5599a693e54bd2f4.text: I was really terrified to get my tooth taken out 😪 I even kept postponing my appointment but I finally did it! I got my molar removed and it was difficult but the surgeon and Ms. Jine always treat their patients with so much care!!! you are in great hands here I paid 1300 because it was more challenging. They also told me every way and option on how to treat it after a few months, awesome place I trusted them with my life and now I’m not afraid of the dentist anymore 🫶 I recommend ✨
0x30da31a6d26d788f_0x5599a693e54bd2f4.author: Lady Green

0x30da31a6d26d788f_0x5599a693e54bd2f4.text: Great dentist! Quick, professional, clean, friendly, and gentle. What more could you ask for? I came in (without an appointment)for a consultation, cleaning, and polishing and she was able to see me right away. She even gave me a floride treatment for free. The dentist's english was excellent which made it very easy for me as a foreigner. Very affordable prices was the cherry on top. 100 stars!
0x30da31a6d26d788f_0x5599a693e54bd2f4.author: Nancy Hunter

0x30da31a6d26d788f_0x5599a693e54bd2f4.text: I stopped in for a tooth cleaning while on vacation because of how long it takes to get an appointment at the dentist in the US (many months). They were able to see me later that same day! The dentist was kind, personable, professional, & spoke English. The hygienist was great too! They did a wonderful job with the cleaning. The facility was very clean and modern. 10/10
0x30da31a6d26d788f_0x5599a693e54bd2f4.author: Ryan

0x30da31a6d26d788f_0x5599a693e54bd2f4.text: The dentist was very nice. I am from the USA and she treated me very well and spoke good English. Her office has all of the standards I am used to from home. She explained the prices to me before, gave me xrays and showed them to me, cleaned my teeth, and did a filling. The office was also clean and bright. I would highly recommend
0x30da31a6d26d788f_0x5599a693e54bd2f4.author: jay prince

0x30e29ee3c28c5107_0x1557ff5f4d15a0f8.text: Came here to have my teeth cleaned. Walk in appointment and was seen to straight away! The dentist did an amazing job, I wish I took a before and after photo! My teeth look brand new and I couldn't be happier! The service was lovely, the staff are all super friendly, got seen really fast. Overall all very satisfied with my visit and would recommend this place for anyone needing their teeth cleaned. Thank you so much to the plus dental clinic for looking after me! 😊
0x30e29ee3c28c5107_0x1557ff5f4d15a0f8.author: P

0x30e29ee3c28c5107_0x1557ff5f4d15a0f8.text: I recently had a fantastic experience at Plus Dental Clinic in Bangkok and highly recommend them, Staff was incredibly friendly and supportive and specifically thanks to Ms. Thunya Ma'am, professional and helpful and the dentist team is really well experienced, they were thorough, patient and made me feel very comfortable.
0x30e29ee3c28c5107_0x1557ff5f4d15a0f8.author: Hiren H

0x30e29ee3c28c5107_0x1557ff5f4d15a0f8.text: Located near asok bts in times Square plaza mall near terminal 21. Even though it was very busy with locals only (10+ people) I was able to see a young female dentist with glasses dr. Nawapon (nawaporn?) filling took only 15min and she spoke good English. Cost 800 baht total for small filling
0x30e29ee3c28c5107_0x1557ff5f4d15a0f8.author: chris an

0x30e29ee3c28c5107_0x1557ff5f4d15a0f8.text: Both Dr. Patchanet and Dr. Kittiphan, who treated me, are highly skilled and compassionate. Their pricing is also reasonable compared to other clinics I have visited. The waiting time is also not absurdly long, but the appointment is recommended.
I came to get my teeth whitened at Plus Dental clinic The dentist is very good. I am very satisfied. The price is good staff can speak English I received good service.
One of the best dental clinic i ever visited. Has a very experienced dentists and a very polite staff. Must visit!!
Had a lovely Experience at Plus dental. Very good staff and very helpful people at the clinic. Fantastic experience

They cleaned my teeth in 15 minutes. That’s twice as fast as any cleaning I have ever had. I take good care of my teeth but still it seems like a little more time would have been warranted. It strikes me as assemble line dental care.

0x311d618fbd715bad_0xb23d11cc02b95b3a.text: The reception staff were friendly, smiling, and attentive to patients. The doctor was also excellent, gentle, constantly asking if I was in pain, and providing great treatment advice. This was my first time using their services, and I was very impressed.
0x311d618fbd715bad_0xb23d11cc02b95b3a.author: Kas_ 65

0x311d618fbd715bad_0xb23d11cc02b95b3a.text: พนักงานบริการดี สุภาพมาก น่ารักทุกคนเลยค่ะ การจัดการเป็นระเบียบ คุณหมอ ผู้ช่วยก็น่ารักพูดจาเพราะ เข้าใจง่าย อธิบายละเอียดมาก คุณหมอมือเบา ค่อยถามตลอดว่าเจ็บไหม ถ้าเจ็บให้บอกนะ ประทับใจมากค่ะ
0x311d618fbd715bad_0xb23d11cc02b95b3a.en: The staff were excellent, very polite, and lovely. The organization was great. The doctor and assistants were also lovely, spoke kindly, were easy to understand, and explained everything in detail. The doctor was gentle and constantly asked if I was in pain, and told me to let them know if it hurt. I was very impressed.

0x311d618fbd715bad_0xb23d11cc02b95b3a.text: Went in, they took my teeth out, felt no pain, Got out. As a person that is afraid of dental appointments they were really good at taking care of me. Really quick service as well.
Today I came for an orthodontic consultation at this clinic. It's clean, the doctor and staff are excellent, and they are very skilled in treatment and treatment planning.
0x311d618fbd715bad_0xb23d11cc02b95b3a.author: แอน วิรูปักษ์นาคา

0x311d618fbd715bad_0xb23d11cc02b95b3a.text: ประทับใจมากค่ะ! คุณหมอมือเบา ให้คำแนะนำดี พี่ๆ พนักงานก็น่ารัก คลินิกสะอาด เดินทางสะดวก เครื่องมือทันสมัย แถมแบ่งจ่ายสบายกระเป๋า ใครกำลังมองหาคลินิกจัดฟันแนะนำเลยค่ะ ✨🦷
0x311d618fbd715bad_0xb23d11cc02b95b3a.en: I was very impressed! The dentist was gentle and gave great advice. The staff were lovely, the clinic was clean, conveniently located, and had modern equipment. Plus, they offered flexible payment plans. If you're looking for an orthodontic clinic, I highly recommend this one! ✨🦷

0x311d618fbd715bad_0xb23d11cc02b95b3a.text: แนะนำเลยครับผมคุณหมอและฝ่ายบริการพูดดีมากครับสถานที่สะอาดมีมาตรฐาน มีการแนะนำแผนในการทำฟันที่ดีมีโปรโมชั่นมากมายและยัฃสามารถผ่อนชำระได้อีกด้วย
0x311d618fbd715bad_0xb23d11cc02b95b3a.author: 3-5 ทักษ์ดนัย อ่อนเกตุพล
0x311d618fbd715bad_0xb23d11cc02b95b3a.en: I highly recommend this clinic. The doctor and staff are very kind and helpful. The place is clean and meets high standards. They provide a good dental treatment plan, offer many promotions, and even allow for installment payments.

0x311d618fbd715bad_0xb23d11cc02b95b3a.text: The staff were very lovely and friendly. The doctor gave excellent advice. The complimentary items and post-treatment service were also great.
0x311d618fbd715bad_0xb23d11cc02b95b3a.author: กัลยรักษ์ อารีมิตร์

0x30e29d686198d17f_0xdd5b79ad906e7db3.en: I've been coming here regularly, every six months, for many years now. Whether it's fillings or scaling, I always get it done by Dr. Nat. She takes excellent care of my teeth; they're always clean and beautiful. She's always helpful and never tries to sell anything. She's kind and caring, making me feel less afraid during dental procedures. She really goes the extra mile for her clients. All the staff are also very attentive and provide excellent service. Today I had a biofilm treatment, which removes tea and coffee stains from my teeth – it was a game changer! Before, my teeth had a lot of stains. After the treatment, they were incredibly clean and smooth. I highly recommend this clinic. I've been to many clinics, but Dr. Nat is the best for scaling. She's so meticulous and thorough, removing all the dirt and grime. Before coming to the clinic, my teeth were a 2 out of 10 for cleanliness, but after leaving, they're a perfect 100 out of 10!

0x30e29f34e73aeecb_0x5bbd2188a5a24371.text: The dentist was very calm and explained every step before the procedure, which made me feel completely at ease during the tartar removal. The treatment didn't take long, and my teeth felt much smoother and cleaner. Using my government health insurance was very convenient; I had an appointment in advance and didn't have to wait long at all.

0x30e29f34e73aeecb_0x5bbd2188a5a24371.text: You should make an appointment before going. The service is reasonably priced. Dental X-rays are not expensive. I've been doing it for 2 years and have seen 2 doctors. The doctors don't push the disease. For small blemishes, they will recommend brushing your teeth well. They don't just tell you to fill anything (experience from other clinics where I had my tartar removed and then had 3-4 cavities filled in). They will recommend but not force or nag. Overall, I'm impressed here.

0x30503b00167d4e47_0xa05e6782ff3e426b.text: I came to LuxeSmile for my first teeth whitening treatment. I arrived to my 6 PM appointment at 5:55 PM. I was called to the back at 6:25 PM. The room is very nice and serene. I was treated by Ngam, who was the sweetest woman ever! She told me my teeth were pretty white naturally, and I didn’t really need to have them whitened. She did two 20 minute intervals of whitening. She wiped my teeth in between the sessions and reapplied the gel. I was given protective eye glasses/ goggles and a blanket to make me more comfortable. The process was extremely fast and easy- I was done at 7:20 PM and this included me rinsing my mouth and taking photos/videos. Upon doing my research, I learned that my whitening transformation was not going to be as dramatic- which was consistent with my results. I didn’t notice a huge difference, but was still satisfied with my experience. If I’m ever back in Phuket, I will definitely visit LuxeSmile for another round. Price: $2000 Thai Baht Thank you Ngam💕
0x30503b00167d4e47_0xa05e6782ff3e426b.author: Jay Tounkara

0x30503b00167d4e47_0xa05e6782ff3e426b.text: I recently got veneers done by Dr. Pim, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. The entire process was surprisingly quick because of Dr. Pim’s expertise. I had consulted several other clinics before, and most of them told me I would need braces first. However, Dr. Pim was able to solve my case without braces and created the exact smile I had always wanted. What impressed me the most was how easy Dr. Pim is to talk to and how well she understands dental aesthetics. Among all the dentists I’ve met, she has the best eye for designing natural, beautiful teeth that truly suit each person. The final result exceeded my expectations, and I’m absolutely in love with my new smile. Dr. Pim takes great care of every case and has never disappointed me. If you’re considering veneers, I highly recommend trusting Dr. Pim’s skills—you’ll be in excellent hands!
0x30503b00167d4e47_0xa05e6782ff3e426b.author: Markyn Jiraphonworachok

I highly recommend Dr. Pim and the LuxeSmile team to anyone looking for high-quality dental treatment.

0x30503b00167d4e47_0xa05e6782ff3e426b.text: I recently visited Pim at LuxeSmile Dental Clinic for Porselain veneers. Later I found that the same surgery in other hospitals takes much less time (and consequently less stress to the cat) and, surprisingly, much less time to restore. It may be his specific case, but together with a bunch of assistant staff mistakes (documental, informational, gender-reve-al) I doubt this was a coincidence. 0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.text: I moved to Bangkok in 2025 and knew I eventually needed to find a good dentist since it had been more than four years since my last dental visit. After watching a recommendation from a popular YouTuber and reading so many excellent reviews, I decided to give Edelweiss Dental House a try—and I'm very glad I did. I first visited in June 2026 for a cleaning and checkup. From the moment I walked in, everyone on the staff was friendly, welcoming, and professional. My dentist, Dr. Nutchaya Pakornsajjanun (Dr. Fern), was excellent. She took the time to explain everything clearly and made me feel completely at ease. The cleaning, examination, stain removal, and several X-rays cost just 3,500 THB (about $107 USD), which I thought was an incredible value. Back in the U.S., I had been quoted around $2,500 to replace just one crown, so I kept putting it off. I also knew that a couple of my older crowns needed attention. Dr. Fern replaced two of my crowns, and the entire experience was outstanding. She even noticed that the shade from the dental lab wasn't an exact match to what she had requested and offered to have them remade. Since they're in the back of my mouth, I told her it wasn't necessary, but I really appreciated that she cared enough to point it out. That kind of attention to detail says a lot about her commitment to her patients. The total cost for both crowns was 46,000 THB (about $1,400 USD), which was still much less than I had been quoted in the United States for a single crown. The quality of the work, the professionalism of the staff, and the overall experience made it well worth it. Could I have found a cheaper dental clinic in Bangkok? Probably. But when it comes to dental work, I'd rather have outstanding care than simply the lowest price. I'm extremely happy with the treatment I received at Edelweiss Dental House, and I highly recommend Dr. Fern and her team to anyone looking for excellent dental care in Bangkok.
0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.author: Anthony Hutton

0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.text: Dear Edelweiss Dental House, My young daughter and I visited your Sukhumvit 15 branch on June 13, following a recommendation from my wife’s colleague at Olympus (Thailand). I want to express our sincere appreciation for the outstanding care from Dr. Jirapat Jaroonvechatam and Dr. Jinnipa Rojsawatsuk. Both embody the philosophy of treating patients like family, providing personalized and precise care. To Dr. Jinnipa Rojsawatsuk: Thank you for your kindness and patience with my tween daughter. Your clear explanations of every step and procedure, as well as your gentle manner made her feel safe and respected— a rare quality that not all dentists extend to young patients. We deeply appreciate your dedication to building trust and comfort. To Dr. Jirapat Jaroonvechatam: Your expertise and gentle care made my treatment painless and reassuring. Despite the complexity of scaling, polishing, fillings, and extractions, the entire process was painless and transparent. The clear, pressure-free explanations and the fact that I experienced no pain even after extractions speaks volumes about your expertise and exceptional care. We look forward to our next visit this December for my daughter’s check-up and my molar implants. To the Front-Desk Team: Your warm welcome helped set a positive tone for our visits. Thank you for your professionalism and patience in explaining billing details and attending to us warmly. Once again, thank you all for your exceptional care and professionalism. With sincere appreciation 💐
0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.author: Vincent Teo

0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.text: This morning I had the pleasure of visiting Edelweiss Dental House Sukhumvit 15 branch, and I can't recommend them enough! From the moment I walked in, I was impressed by how welcoming and friendly the reception staff where (with a special mention to Wasinee 🤗) —they made the entire experience feel warm and inviting. I was able to walk in and make an appointment, which was incredibly convenient. The clinic itself is spotless, giving me instant confidence in their commitment to hygiene and patient care. When I met the dentist Dr Jirapat Jaroonvechatam and his assistant they were incredibly professional and took the time to thoroughly explain everything about the cleaning, polishing, and filling procedures. I felt fully informed and at ease throughout the entire process. Also the attentiveness in giving me a cosy blanket put me at more ease. The filling procedure was surprisingly quick and painless, which I really appreciated—no discomfort at all! Infact I didn't even realise the injection for the numbing of my gum had happened, Dr Jirapat is so gentle, offering me cleaning advice after the procedure. On top of all that excellent service, the pricing is extremely reasonable for the level of care provided. Overall, this has been the best experience I have ever had at a Dentist and will definitely be returning for my future dental needs. Highly recommend this clinic!
0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.author: TeAroha

0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.text: I traveled for other medical procedures and decided to see a dentist since I had been postponing it for years due to difficulties and previous experiences in my home country. With so many clinics in Thailand, it was hard to choose, but I went with Edelweiss Dental because the reception staff was very accommodating despite my restricted schedule. The dentists and support staff are exceptional. They take the time to explain what is needed, give you options, and are open to any questions. They listen to your feedback during the procedure and explain each step as they perform it. The nurses anticipate your needs, like saliva suction, without you having to ask. I saw two different specialists, and both were outstanding. I'm actually writing this review while still numb from the anesthetic. I have a wisdom tooth extraction coming up and will update afterward. Highly recommended, with reasonable prices for the excellent service provided.
0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.author: Patrick Rafferty

0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.text: I've been coming to this clinic over the past two years and it has been a great experience every single time. I had 2 wisdom teeth removed, one in 2024 and one in 2025, both by Dr. Jirapat Jaroonvechatam. He was so professional and efficient. I was nervous both times, but he made the whole process feel quick and easy. Honestly, I was surprised how smoothly it all went. This year I came back for several fillings, and Dr. Jinnipa Rojsawatsuk took great care of me. She is attentive, gentle and precise, exactly the kind of dentist you hope to find. I always felt completely comfortable and in good hands. I also want to give a shoutout to the assistants, whose names I unfortunately don't know, but they were just as wonderful at every visit. One thing I really appreciate about this clinic is the transparency. They always tell you the price before the procedure, no surprises or hidden fees.
0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.author: Asya Bolotnikova

0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.text: I wanted to get my teeth cleaned here in Bangkok and found this place on Google Maps close to my hotel. Was able to get a same day appointment and offered water both times in the lobby while waiting. During my initial dental check up 4 cavities were discovered and recommended to be treated. I was happy to go ahead with that and the original cleaning I wanted. The whole process was straightforward and painless. Approximately 5 minutes to treat each tooth and 15 minutes or so to clean. Glad I chose here. Prices are good and there’s a clear commitment to care from start to finish. I paid the equivalent of £150. Back home in the UK I had to pay almost £300 for just cleaning and 2 teeth to be treated on private treatment once. Thanks to all involved. Would definitely return for any more health or cosmetic work needed in future.
0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.author: Cameron McLean

0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.text: I recently had the best dental experience at this clinic! After years of feeling insecure about my teeth due to previous experiences with Western European dentists who often suggested unnecessary procedures for profit, I finally found a place that truly prioritizes patients well-being. Dr. Jirapat was incredibly kind, professional, and genuinely caring, making me feel comfortable and confident about my dental health. The entire staff was warm and welcoming, creating a friendly and relaxing environment. Scheduling was also a breeze with quick appointment availability, which made the process even smoother. This clinic offers the highest quality service I’ve ever experienced, and I can’t recommend them enough!
0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.author: Asta A

0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.text: I had a terrible experience here. I came initially because they pay influencers to promote to expats, but do not be fooled. I came for routine fillings that I have had replaced many times in different offices all over the world with zero problems. For my front tooth, I informed Dr. Kittipat Termteerapornpimol I have thin enamel and sensitivity on my front teeth, but he was completely dismissive of my anxieties. He then proceeded to grind and sand off the front of my enamel over 2/3 of my tooth surface. The next day, pain and increased sensitivity. Doctor showed zero concern or remorse. I did not seek a refund or follow up work. After going to TDH you could not pay me to return here. Enamel does not regenerate, do not risk it. If you come here copy/paste this name: Dr. Kittipat Termteerapornpimol and request a different doctor. Or better yet, spend the tiny bit more and go to TDH. Better safe than sorry.
0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.author: Stacy

0x30503196f6c5b019_0x5cb1070469c2cc3a.text: We have been visiting Dr Aud for the past 3 years and have always felt so satisfied with his care. As a parent I have been so pleased with his attention to my children’s’ teeth and the warm way he talks with them to put them at ease. My daughter has just finished having braces from Dr Aud and from start to finish we were impressed with the service and my daughter now has lovely straight teeth as well as a respect and understanding of the dental profession. I also must mention Dr Aud’s secretary who always greets us so warmly and takes care of the administration so efficiently. Thank you and we will continue to come to your practice as long as we live in Phuket - perhaps even longer!!
0x30503196f6c5b019_0x5cb1070469c2cc3a.author: Ned and Liv Symons

0x30503196f6c5b019_0x5cb1070469c2cc3a.text: I want to thank the clinic and the doctor for their sensitive management and help with a serious infection. My story: It turned out I had a serious infection. I came in with a swollen cheek, fever, and pain where I had a complex wisdom oak removed a month ago (not at this clinic). The doctor saw me, took X-rays, and examined everything thoroughly. He drained a lot of pus, prescribed treatment, and scheduled follow-up appointments to make sure everything was recovering. After the first appointment, I felt significantly better; the swelling and pain went away. I am very grateful to the doctor and recommend this clinic. The prices are very reasonable, and the service and professionalism are excellent!

0x30fdac0a9d3b4441_0x2fe13681e590118.text: This is more than a review. THIS IS THANK YOU! I am more grateful to Siwalai and her team of healers than words can ever say but I’m going to try with this review. If you want the short version… here: 10/10 HIGHLY RECOMMEND! If you want to know why, read on. After a military training accident, I had a spinal surgery to replace two discs in my upper spine. Since the surgery and for a period of more than 10 years, I suffered from radiating pains, tingling sensations, numbness, muscle spasms and constant stiffness in my arms and legs that was mostly tolerable but ALWAYS present. I accepted my condition and dealt with it the best I could. In 2023, my entire case took a nosedive and I went from walking on my own, to cane-assisted, to a walker, and even a motorized buggy. I was hospitalized for a short period, saw at least a dozen doctors and specialists and went through the whole alphabet in tests (X-Ray, CT, MRI, etc.). No treatment, therapy, or drug saw any real improvement and by the end of 2023, I’d accepted that this was just my new reality. Then my wife and I booked a 2 week vacation to Thailand and while looking at all the activities available, my wife did some Googling and found Patcharapat Spa. We took a chance, booked an appointment, and it was the best decision I’ve made in recent memory. Siwalai is NOT your average Thai masseuse and this is NOT your average Thai massage! If that’s what you’re looking for, take $10 or $20 and go to any of the dozens of massage parlors located within a block of your hotel. Khun charges a premium. A 90-min deep tissue massage is about $90 but I would’ve paid DOUBLE for what she did for me. After a brief consultation and a few questions about my history, they got to work. Siwalai and her assistant put me on a table and twisted me into every shape imaginable. This was not a relaxing massage. They smoothed out old pains, created some new ones, and then smoothed those out too. At times, I felt I was in an actual meat grinder but I came out of the other side feeling better than when she started. That night in bed, I could still feel THROBBING in the muscles she’d touched. On her recommendation, (and after negotiating a nice discount), I went to see her FIVE MORE DAYS IN A ROW! I dreaded seeing her every morning in the middle of my vacation but I could not argue with the results: My muscle spasms disappeared. I felt better. I moved better. I kept l forgetting my cane everywhere because I walked better! IT WAS AMAZING! I’m back home now and while I’m not cured, I don’t wake up in crippling pain anymore. I still carry my cane but it’s mostly for stability while I retrain myself how to walk. I’ve got to regain some muscle on one side and it’s going to take a lot of work on my part but I'm motivated. While she tortured my body, she beat it into my head that I’m the one who has to keep this up by stretching and exercising every single day. If I combine that with regular sessions by a trained masseuse, I’ll have years of active life left in me. My entire attitude has changed right along with the changes in my body and I am forever grateful to Siwalai and her entire team. See you all soon! My next trip to Thailand is already being planned!
0x30fdac0a9d3b4441_0x2fe13681e590118.author: J Jones

0x30fdac0a9d3b4441_0x2fe13681e590118.text: We visited Ms Siwalai about 20 years ago when she cured my husband’s chronic back pain after one session of therapy. 20 years older, my husband had new back and knee pains. Ms Siwalai cured him after 3 sessions again. For myself, I have had chronic headache, neck, and shoulder pain for the last 15 years for which I sought help from many other doctors and physiotherapists. Unfortunately, despite those visits, neither the cause was able to be diagnosed nor any improvement made after numerous times / types of treatment. I finally visited Ms Siwalai in January. After a few sessions, I would not say I am cured but certainly my condition has been greatly improved. Ms Siwalai’s massage is certainly not a relaxing massage. It is a therapeutic massage and quite physically demanding. I felt pain every time during my visit but on the other hand, my old chronic pain was being relieved. So, although painful, the treatment was helping me. The pain during the massage was paid off by gain. Yes, Ms Siwalai charges more than other masseuses charge but from my point of view it is worth every penny. This is not a simple relax massage, it is a physiotherapy treatment. Ms Siwalai is aware I could not come back to see her very often. Hence, she even taught me the exercises I should do at home to help myself. I still continue with the exercises she taught me and all my pain is definitely relieved. I have total trust in her and she is truly kind-hearted. Her motivation is to help release people from their pains and we are so glad to have met her.
0x30fdac0a9d3b4441_0x2fe13681e590118.author: Louisa Chan

0x30fdac0a9d3b4441_0x2fe13681e590118.text: I'm thrilled. A truly personalized therapeutic massage. After struggling for several years with constant twitching in my face, around my right eye, which had caused significant tension in my facial muscles, Siwalai's treatment brought me tremendous relief in just two sessions. The third treatment, shortly before our return trip, was the breakthrough. Surprisingly, she no longer massaged my face, but only various other areas of my body. While the massages were sometimes painful, they were incredibly relieving afterward, as not only did the facial mobility return—without the twitching—but my shoulder and hip pain also disappeared. Everything in the body is interconnected. Siwalai knows exactly where to work. She also gives helpful tips for the period after the treatment, back home, so you know what you can do yourself for lasting healing. Siwalai knows exactly where to work. Before, I was seeing a neurologist for my condition (he prescribed injections into the twitching nerve to suppress the reaction), and of course, I've been undergoing physiotherapy and osteopathic treatment for some time. This has always helped me to some extent, but not comprehensively. Other Thai massages I've tried haven't had the same effect either. I can highly recommend Spa Patcharapat and Siwalai as a massage therapist.

0x30e29f81c182ac23_0x722a410561402f51.text: ใช้สิทธิบัตรทอง 💳​ ขูดหินปูน ประทับใจมากกกกก ดูแลดีมาก 😳​ พอมาใช้บริการเองแล้ว เข้าใจเลยว่าทำไมรีวิวดีเยอะมาก โดยเฉพาะจากผู้ใช้สิทธิฯ พอออกจากห้องฯ เราถึงกับต้องถามชื่อคุณหมอกับ จนท. จึงทราบว่าเป็น "คุณหมอ ณัฐชนน เหลืองอร่าม" (เท่าที่สอบถามมา คุณหมอเข้า จ.-ศ.) ใครอยากลองมาฯ โทรจองคิวก่อนนะครับจะได้ไม่พลาด จะเป็นเบอร์กลางช่วยนัดให้ + วันที่มา ค่อยลงทะเบียนสิทธิ สปสช.ในไลน์ เพื่อรับรหัสจากระบบใหม่ ปีงบประมาณ 2569 เรามาทำศุกร์ที่ 10 ก.ค. 69 คิวแรก / ยังไม่มีคน ใครอยากไม่ต้องต่อคิว ลองนัด 11.00 แบบเรา 😆​ - คุณหมอตรวจฟันละเอียดมากครับ เราถึงกับต้องบอกกับคุณหมอเลยว่า...รู้สึกเหมือนตอนทำฟันที่คลินิกที่เสียเงินตอนจัดฟันเลย 😳​ เพราะคุณหมอใส่ใจและละเอียดมาก - ผู้ช่วยทันตฯ ในห้องขูดใส่ชุดมาตรฐานที่ดีมาก ที่สำคัญ ใส่ใจคอยดูดน้ำลายให้ดีตลอดเวลา ครบทุกจังหวะที่สำคัญ - ทั้ง จนท. (คุณรัน + คุณแว)​ สุภาพให้บริการแบบให้เกียรติ และเป็นมิตรครับ พอนัดแล้วโทรมาแจ้งเตือนก่อน 1 วัน ❗​ ใครใช้สิทธิบัตรทอง #ขูดหินปูน ถ้าครั้งก่อนขูดมาแล้วยังไม่ครบ 6 เดือน = ต้องรอ 6 เดือนก่อนนะครับ (เท่าที่ทราบจาก จนท.รัฐให้ใช้สิทธิเฉพาะขูดฯ คนละ 2 ครั้ง/ปี ส่วนสิทธิที่ 3 จะใช้ อุด หรือทำอย่างอื่นได้)​ ใช้สิทธิบัตรทอง 💳​ ขูดหินปูน ประทับใจมากกกกก ดูแลดีมาก 😳​ พอมาใช้บริการเองแล้ว เข้าใจเลยว่าทำไมรีวิวดีเยอะมาก โดยเฉพาะจากผู้ใช้สิทธิฯ พอออกจากห้องฯ เราถึงกับต้องถามชื่อคุณหมอกับ จนท. จึงทราบว่าเป็น "คุณหมอ ณัฐชนน เหลืองอร่าม" (เท่าที่สอบถามมา คุณหมอเข้า จ.-ศ.) ใครอยากลองมาฯ โทรจองคิวก่อนนะครับจะได้ไม่พลาด จะเป็นเบอร์กลางช่วยนัดให้ + วันที่มา ค่อยลงทะเบียนสิทธิ สปสช.ในไลน์ เพื่อรับรหัสจากระบบใหม่ ปีงบประมาณ 2569 เรามาทำศุกร์ที่ 10 ก.ค. 69 คิวแรก / ยังไม่มีคน ใครอยากไม่ต้องต่อคิว ลองนัด 11.00 แบบเรา 😆​ - คุณหมอตรวจฟันละเอียดมากครับ เราถึงกับต้องบอกกับคุณหมอเลยว่า...รู้สึกเหมือนตอนทำฟันที่คลินิกที่เสียเงินตอนจัดฟันเลย 😳​ เพราะคุณหมอใส่ใจและละเอียดมาก - ผู้ช่วยทันตฯ ในห้องขูดใส่ชุดมาตรฐานที่ดีมาก ที่สำคัญ ใส่ใจคอยดูดน้ำลายให้ดีตลอดเวลา ครบทุกจังหวะที่สำคัญ - ทั้ง จนท. 0x30e29f81c182ac23_0x722a410561402f51.en: I used my National Health Security Card (NHSO) 💳 for a teeth cleaning and was incredibly impressed! The care was excellent 😳. After experiencing it myself, I understand why there are so many positive reviews, especially from NHSO beneficiaries. After leaving the room, I even asked the staff for the doctor's name and found out it was "Dr. Natchanon Lueangaram" (from what I gathered, he's available Monday-Friday). If you want to try this service, call to book an appointment beforehand to avoid disappointment. They'll give you a central number to schedule your appointment and you can register your NHSO beneficiaries on LINE to receive a new system code for fiscal year 2026. I went on Friday, July 10th, 2026, the first appointment / there were no others. If you want to avoid queuing, try scheduling an appointment for 11:00 AM like I did 😆 - The doctor examined my teeth very thoroughly. I even told the doctor that it felt just like the dental work I did at a paid clinic when I had my braces 😳 because the doctor was so attentive and thorough. - The dental assistant in the cleaning room wore very good quality uniforms and, importantly, carefully suctioned my saliva throughout the procedure. Every important detail was perfect. - The staff (Khun Ran and Khun Wa) were polite, respectful, and friendly. They called to remind me one day before my appointment. ❗ If you're using the Gold Card (Thai National Health Insurance) for #dentalscaling, and your last scaling appointment was less than 6 months ago, you must wait 6 months. (As far as I know, government officials only allow 2 scaling treatments per year; the third benefit can be used for fillings or other procedures.) I used my Gold Card 💳 for dental scaling and was very impressed! The care was excellent 😳. After experiencing it myself, I understand why there are so many good reviews, especially from those using the insurance. After leaving the room, I even asked the staff for the doctor's name and found out it was "Dr. Natchanon Lueangaram" (from what I gathered, the doctor is available Monday-Friday). If you want to try this clinic, call to book an appointment beforehand to avoid disappointment. This will be a central number to help schedule appointments + specify the date of your visit. You can then register for your NHSO (National Health Security Office) benefits via LINE to receive a code from the new system for the 2026 fiscal year. We came on Friday, July 10th, 2026, the first in line / there were no other patients. If you want to avoid queuing, try scheduling an appointment at 11:00 AM like we did 😆 - The dentist examined our teeth very thoroughly. We even told the dentist that...it felt just like when we paid for orthodontic treatment at a clinic 😳 because the dentist was so attentive and thorough. - The dental assistant in the scaling room wore very good standard attire. Importantly, they carefully suctioned saliva at every crucial moment. - Both the staff (Khun Ran + Khun Wae) were polite, respectful, and friendly. They called to remind us one day before the appointment. ❗ If you are using your NHSO benefits for #dentalscaling and your last scaling was less than 6 months ago, you must wait 6 months before your next appointment (as far as I know). Government officials allow two scaling treatments per year under the universal healthcare scheme. A third benefit can be used for fillings or other procedures. From our perspective, a private dental clinic that provides such good care to those with universal healthcare coverage, resulting in such positive reviews, reflects the clinic's attitude and service standards. Even for services not covered by the universal healthcare scheme, we feel it's trustworthy. We intend to return for other dental work with the doctor here as well. P.S. The clinic is new and very clean.

After filling out the paperwork, I went straight into the cleaning room and it was done in less than half an hour – fantastic! I was very impressed. I highly recommend this place to anyone considering teeth cleaning.

0x30e2a27b92125829_0x6ccbf8ea0ff4965f.text: ก่อนหน้านี้มารักษาโรคเหงือกค่ะ ยังไม่ได้มารีวิวให้ แต่วันนี้พาลูกชายอายุ 9 ปี มาขูดหินปูน เลยได้โอกาสมารีวิว วันนี้ขอรีวิวว่าเหตุผลที่เลือกคลีนิคนี้ เพราะอยากได้หมอเฉพาะทางที่รักษาเหงือกโดยตรง ซึ่งตั้งแต่มาเริ่มรักษา คุณหมอทุกท่านที่เจอน่ารัก พูดจาเพราะ แนะนำดีค่ะ หมอที่ขูดหินปูนลูกชายแม่ชอบค่ะ ทำให้ลูกชายไม่เกร็งไม่ครียด เจ้าหน้าที่ตรงเคาน์เตอร์ และผู้ช่วยหมอก็น่ารักทุกท่านเลยค่ะ คลีนิคสะอาดค่ะ

0x30e2a27b92125829_0x6ccbf8ea0ff4965f.en: I previously came here for gum disease treatment and haven't had a chance to review it yet. But today, I brought my 9-year-old son for a teeth cleaning, so I'm taking this opportunity to write a review. Today, I'd like to explain why I chose this clinic: I wanted a specialist who focuses on gum disease treatment. Since starting treatment here, all the doctors I've met have been lovely, polite, and gave great advice. I really liked the doctor who cleaned my son's teeth; it made him feel relaxed and not stressed. The staff at the counter and the doctor's assistants were all lovely as well. The clinic is clean.

0x30e2a27b92125829_0x6ccbf8ea0ff4965f.text: คุณหมอมือเบามากกกกก แจ้งรายละเอียดแบบละเอียดมากถึงข้อดี ข้อเสียทั้งหมด ไม่มีหมกเม็ด(ไปที่อื่นจะให้รักษารากฟันท่าเดียว ทั้งๆ ที่ไม่เสียว ไม่ปวด ไม่อะไรเลย) คุณหมอละเอียดมากทุกขั้นตอน ราคาสมเหตุสมผล สถานที่สะอาด เครื่องมือครบครันมาก พนักงานต้อนรับสุภาพน่ารัก

0x30e2a27b92125829_0x6ccbf8ea0ff4965f.en: The dentist was incredibly gentle. They explained everything in detail, including the pros and cons, with nothing hidden (other places only offered root canal treatment, even though I didn't experience any sensitivity, pain, or anything). The dentist was meticulous throughout the process. The price was reasonable. The place was clean and well-equipped. The reception staff were polite and lovely.

0x30e2a27b92125829_0x6ccbf8ea0ff4965f.text: The clinic provides excellent advice, the orthodontic treatment is beautiful, they don't prolong the treatment unnecessarily, and you can consult them about anything anytime. The staff and the doctor are very kind. I'm very impressed.

0x30e2a27b92125829_0x6ccbf8ea0ff4965f.en: I had gum disease treatment and a tooth extraction with Dr. Supanee. I give her a perfect 10 out of 100! She's incredibly kind and gentle. 0x30e2a27b92125829_0x6ccbf8ea0ff4965f.text: The dentist was very attentive to the patient, explaining every step of the process. They thoroughly cleaned, polished, and removed tartar from every nook and cranny of the teeth. All the staff were lovely.

0x30e299e71e58439f_0xf693accc2b69b0d0.text: The doctor is very kind and the staff are very helpful. The clinic is clean and they offer free snacks and drinks. They have many dental treatment promotions and lots of freebies. The doctor is very gentle. I highly recommend this clinic!

The treatment then focused on reducing my prostrate size and this resulted in a calmness in my urinary tract that I haven't felt in years. I cannot recommend Yuji enough, the staff are professional (sending an appointment reminder before each session) and the doctor is very gentle and knowledgeable. Also hygiene is of the highest standard. I will definitely go back next time I am in Thailand for other ailments. Many thanks to you all, Richard Kubicki.
0x3102bf282a7b7deb_0x939846d279e1c699.author: richard kubicki

0x3102bf282a7b7deb_0x939846d279e1c699.text: I’ve tried many clinics in the area and Yuji Clinic is by far the best. I have chronic back pain after an accident that happened years ago, so I take daily pain killers and used to have a daily massage. Ever since visiting Yuji Clinic for dry needling and cupping, I no longer need the daily massage and instead just visit Yuji clinic once a week. Which also gives me a lot more time for myself during the week, not to mention far less pain than I’ve ever had in years. I highly recommend this to anyone who has muscle or nerve pain. Truly excellent 10/10
0x3102bf282a7b7deb_0x939846d279e1c699.author: lyle pillay

0x3102bf282a7b7deb_0x939846d279e1c699.text: I'm Korean. I usually stay in Pattaya half of the year for playing golf. I had back pain recently. I was afraid that I had to go to the doctor that I don't even know and especially in the foreign country. But her acupuncture completely changed my mind. Her acupunctureand Cupping is amazing. I felt that she was way better than the one's in Korea. All the staffs are kind and nice. From now on, I'll not hesitate to come and visit every time I have pain.
0x3102bf282a7b7deb_0x939846d279e1c699.author: blair Cha

0x3102bf282a7b7deb_0x939846d279e1c699.text: It's rare to find an acupuncture and TCM clinic in Pattaya. The TCM doctor speaks Chinese and has studied in China. The doctor's acupuncture skills are excellent. I've been receiving acupuncture here for over three months and have noticed a significant improvement in my sleep, feeling much lighter overall, less back pain, and even a 3kg weight loss. The staff are very friendly and attentive; it's been a wonderful experience.
0x3102bf282a7b7deb_0x939846d279e1c699.author: Qianrong Qi

0x3102bf282a7b7deb_0x939846d279e1c699.text: Arrived on the scene with a stiff neck, a very worrying and painful rotary cuff injury, and carpal tunnel tingly hands. After the first visit the improvements were huge. Followed up with a series of weekly treatments, and once again have proven to myself that a good Acupuncture clinic when you’re ailing is worthy of seeking out. Friendly, knowledgeable staff, and a clean and easy to find clinic.
0x3102bf282a7b7deb_0x939846d279e1c699.author: V Forrester

0x3102bf282a7b7deb_0x939846d279e1c699.text: This is a great clinic. The doctor provides excellent advice and the service is wonderful. The doctor is very gentle. I had a frozen shoulder and received acupuncture and electrical stimulation treatment just 3 times, and I'm much better now. The clinic always follows up on appointments, so you don't have to worry about forgetting. I'm so glad I chose this clinic.
0x3102bf282a7b7deb_0x939846d279e1c699.author: Katsinee Jantachumni

0x3102bf282a7b7deb_0x939846d279e1c699.text: First time doing electro acupuncture. The doctor was very gentle with me and very communicative. Attendants were kind and helpful. Cupping and a recommended spray were also very good. Will continue treatments at home but will come back when I'm in Pattaya again. This treatment was for my chronic carpal tunnel and tennis elbow.
0x3102bf282a7b7deb_0x939846d279e1c699.author: Minna N

0x30e2976f33e5a389_0x533400fddd159f8e.text: Dr. Mek is very attentive and caring. The staff is also lovely. I usually don't like going to dental clinics, but this place is well-decorated, making me feel comfortable. I had an appointment one day in advance and only waited a short time. The atmosphere while waiting was great, with soft music playing. The place is clean, and the equipment used is new and looks very good. The equipment is modern, which makes me feel at ease during treatment. And most importantly, the price is good too! I've found the clinic I use! This is it, I won't go to any other clinic.
0x30e2976f33e5a389_0x533400fddd159f8e.author: DJ J-MYX

0x30e2976f33e5a389_0x533400fddd159f8e.text: เห็นจากแอดในไอจี ขับผ่านหลายครั้ง วันนี้มีโอกาสได้เข้ามาปรึกษาและให้คุณหมอลีช่วยดูแล ประทับใจมากค่ะ คลินิคสะอาด เครื่องมือครบ ทันสมัย ที่จอดรถเยอะมาก สะดวกไม่ปวดหัวการหาที่จอด น้องๆพนักงาน counter ก็ตอบคำถามได้ดี วันนี้มาทำฝันผุ กับ ขูดหินปูน ใช้เวลาประมาณ 45 นาที คุณหมอลีมือเบามาก คอยถามตลอด ผู้ช่วยก็เก่งค่ะ ไม่มีตอนไหนขอให้หยุดเลย ปกติคือทรมานมากกกกก กลับมา check up ตลอดๆแน่นอนค่ะ

0x30e2976f33e5a389_0x533400fddd159f8e.en: I saw their ad on Instagram and drove past many times. Today I had the opportunity to come in for a consultation and have Dr. Lee take care of me. I'm very impressed! The clinic is clean, and the equipment is complete and modern. There's plenty of parking, very convenient and hassle-free. The counter staff were also very helpful in answering questions. Today I had a cavity removal and tartar removal done. It took about 45 minutes. Dr. Lee was very gentle and kept checking on me throughout the procedure. The assistant was also very skilled. They didn't ask to stop at all. Normally, it's very painful! I will definitely be back for regular check-ups.

0x30e2976f33e5a389_0x533400fddd159f8e.text: The clinic is clean and the service is excellent. The doctor has a gentle touch and explains the procedures clearly, making me feel comfortable throughout the treatment. He gives good advice and reasonable prices, without overcharging. Parking is also convenient. Overall, it was a very good experience. If you're looking for a quality clinic, I highly recommend this place.
0x30e2976f33e5a389_0x533400fddd159f8e.author: Champ Rosruen (Champ PY)

0x30e2976f33e5a389_0x533400fddd159f8e.text: คลินิกทำฟันใกล้บ้าน ตอบโจทย์ทุกการรักษาไม่ว่าจะขูดหินปูน อุดฟันทั่วไป รักษาราก รากเทียม คุณหมอเก่งเเละมือเบามากกก เป็นคุณหมอเฉพาะทางแต่ละด้าน คลินิกตกเเต่งสวยงามสไตล์มินิมอล ให้ความสบายใจ อบอุ่น ช่วงใกล้ปีใหม่คลินิกมีกิจกรรมให้ร่วมลุ้นรางวัลอีกด้วย 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻🩷🩷🩷🩷
