As the New Year draws near, the clinic is hosting activities with a chance to win prizes. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻🩷🩷🩷🩷

0x30e2976f33e5a389_0x533400fddd159f8e.text: The clinic is beautiful and clean, the prices are affordable, and the doctor is very skilled and meticulous. She explains things clearly and doesn't push sales. My mother had dental implants and root canal treatment done here, and it wasn't painful at all.
0x30e2976f33e5a389_0x533400fddd159f8e.author: Review Real

0x30e2976f33e5a389_0x533400fddd159f8e.text: I had a positive experience offline at the clinic and also online suggestion after the treatment Their online team was incredibly responsive. Highly recommend for anyone looking for top-notch dental care with great customer service!
0x30e2976f33e5a389_0x533400fddd159f8e.author: Thanna S.

0x30e2976f33e5a389_0x533400fddd159f8e.text: มาครั้งแรกรู้สึกประทับใจมาก ^^ คลินิกอยู่ชั้น2 มีลิฟท์ขึ้นลงถึงร้านเลย สะดวก สวยและสะอาดมาก คุณหมอใจดี อธิบายละเอียดเข้าใจชัดเจน มือเบา ไม่รู้สึกเจ็บหรืออึดอัดเลย เจ้าหน้าที่ทุกคนก็น่ารักเฟรนลี่สุดๆ
0x30e2976f33e5a389_0x533400fddd159f8e.author: grib gift
0x30e2976f33e5a389_0x533400fddd159f8e.en: My first visit was very impressive ^^ The clinic is on the 2nd floor, with an elevator right up to the clinic – very convenient. It's beautiful and very clean. The doctor was kind, explained everything in detail and clearly, and was very gentle; I didn't feel any pain or discomfort. All the staff were also lovely and super friendly.

0x30e2976f33e5a389_0x533400fddd159f8e.text: I've taken my dog ​​to the dentist many times. I like that the clinic is clean, the dentist has a gentle touch, there's parking, it's easy to get to, and the price is okay. I highly recommend it.
0x30e2976f33e5a389_0x533400fddd159f8e.author: Win

0x30e29f003af25125_0x3bf52496609ffc90.text: Great spot for coffee and a view of Victory Monument roundabout vibrancy! Stopped in for an iced coffee and a brownie after a clinic visit. It is a clean, well lighted place with giant curving windows and a great selection of coffee drinks along with both international and local Thai pastry. Service was super fast, professional, warm, and friendly. I’d come back here just for coffee and a gnosh because the vibe and service are so happy and chill. 10/10 punches above its weight as a fantastic lucky find when I just needed to sit down for a minute and collect my thoughts. I’ll prolly come back because the people watching on this busy corner is fascinating through the window of this air conditioned joint.
0x30e29f003af25125_0x3bf52496609ffc90.author: roy herron

0x30e29f003af25125_0x3bf52496609ffc90.text: I've been eating here since the shop opened until it started to settle in. At first, I saw many people helping at the counter. At first, it was slow, but it was delicious. There's a complete menu, oat milk or coconut milk recipes. As for the atmosphere, I've never sat down, only bought takeaway because I stopped by to buy some before going to work. The shop looks clean, clean, white, with a view of Anusawari. Later, I saw a young employee working at the counter, the same person all the time. Smiling, cute, making drinks faster, taking orders fast. If interested in desserts, the young employee gave good recommendations, there were some for tasting, so I hurried to review it.
0x30e29f003af25125_0x3bf52496609ffc90.author: Eve Kodchakorn

0x30e29f003af25125_0x3bf52496609ffc90.text: The drinks are affordably priced and taste great, I really liked them. The matcha coconut drink was perfectly sweet and fragrant. They have a variety of tempting food items on the menu, but I didn't order any. The staff were lovely. The shop is cute, clean, bright, and very comfortable. It's decorated in white and has two floors with beautiful views of the Victory Monument. It's easy to spot; it's a distinctive white building next to Rajavithi Pharmacy, near the pedestrian bridge on the Phahonyothin side that leads to Rajavithi Hospital.
0x30e29f003af25125_0x3bf52496609ffc90.author: Rose mary

0x30e29f003af25125_0x3bf52496609ffc90.text: The drinks are reasonably priced, and the cakes and brownies taste great. I really liked them. I ordered Thai tea and an Americano; they were fragrant, not too sweet, and just right. They have a variety of food items on the menu that looked tempting, but I didn't order any. The staff were lovely and explained things well. The shop is clean, bright, and very comfortable.
0x30e29f003af25125_0x3bf52496609ffc90.author: Palm Tps

0x30e29f003af25125_0x3bf52496609ffc90.text: Don’t pass this nondescript cafe without dropping by! The food tastes deliciously home cooked and the iced americano is well-balanced. There are 3 floors to this cafe, with power plugs on every floor so you can work comfortably there. Plus, there’s good WiFi. The beautiful view of victory monument is a bonus too.
0x30e29f003af25125_0x3bf52496609ffc90.author: Eldora Tan

0x30e29f003af25125_0x3bf52496609ffc90.text: This cafe has a great atmosphere, the air conditioning is nice and cool, the food tastes delicious, just like eating at a restaurant, and the prices aren't too high. The coffee is also good, and the cakes aren't too sweet. It's a one-stop shop for everything you need.
0x30e29f003af25125_0x3bf52496609ffc90.author: nu maweja

0x30e29f003af25125_0x3bf52496609ffc90.text: This is a minimalist, white, elegant Korean-style cafe with a full range of food, drinks, and desserts. Everything is excellent, especially the prices. I highly recommend trying their desserts; you'll definitely love them. They also have promotional set meals.
0x30e29f003af25125_0x3bf52496609ffc90.author: gingkamon leangruksa

0x30e29f003af25125_0x3bf52496609ffc90.text: I love everything on the menu that I've tried. It's the only cafe near the Victory Monument on the Phramongkutklao Hospital side that has seating. It's a shame it closes so early; I'd love to sit longer and wait for my ride before taking the bus home.
0x30e29f003af25125_0x3bf52496609ffc90.author: Tanisa Aoy Hanpinitsak

0x30e29f49b456bb8d_0xb0d98b9f13da218e.text: I was in the area waiting for my boyfriend to finish some errands, so I stopped by to do some work. I could sit here for a long time; the owner is very kind. The Thai tea was excellent; the "less sweet" option was perfect for me.
0x30e29f49b456bb8d_0xb0d98b9f13da218e.author: Porntita Kasemteerasomboon

0x30e29f49b456bb8d_0xb0d98b9f13da218e.text: The white chocolate latte is rich, fragrant, and delicious. The green tea latte is also fragrant, creamy, and tasty. The staff at the counter are also very friendly and provide excellent service.
0x30e29f49b456bb8d_0xb0d98b9f13da218e.author: Varisa Chaturapornkul

0x30e29f49b456bb8d_0xb0d98b9f13da218e.text: I eat here every morning. The shop and staff are lovely. They've expanded and now have more seating. (If you're looking for pure matcha in this building, this shop has the best price-to-value.)
0x30e29f49b456bb8d_0xb0d98b9f13da218e.author: CT

0x30e29f49b456bb8d_0xb0d98b9f13da218e.text: The staff are friendly and the service is excellent. The drinks are delicious too, the Thai tea is amazing! 🙌🏻 I used to go there often when I went to work at the clinic across the street.
0x30e29f49b456bb8d_0xb0d98b9f13da218e.author: khwankhong

0x30e29f49b456bb8d_0xb0d98b9f13da218e.text: The iced Thai tea is amazing! 👍👍👍 It's strong and delicious. The atmosphere is great, and there's a place to sit and work. Most importantly, the price is good – great value! 💞 …
0x30e29f49b456bb8d_0xb0d98b9f13da218e.author: Yuwanda P

0x30e29f49b456bb8d_0xb0d98b9f13da218e.text: The staffs are friendly and willing to give any information. The coffee is good and not expensive, so this is a good place for chill out with friend while coffee break.
0x30e29f49b456bb8d_0xb0d98b9f13da218e.author: Natchapon Petaitiemthong

0x30e29f49b456bb8d_0xb0d98b9f13da218e.text: I'm a regular customer here! I love the Thai tea and hot chocolate so much, I drink them almost every day. The staff are so lovely. I'll definitely be a loyal customer!
0x30e29f49b456bb8d_0xb0d98b9f13da218e.author: Pornthip Niwat

0x30e29f49b456bb8d_0xb0d98b9f13da218e.text: The purple sweet potato latte is delicious! They have plant-based milk options. The shop is quiet on weekends. The staff are friendly and polite. The seating is good.
0x30e29f49b456bb8d_0xb0d98b9f13da218e.author: Mi Khunakorn

0x30da3b8f5f8b55eb_0xd9328cf3e85b6a0d.text: I recently had a root canal treatment, a cleaning, and a filling at Wellsmiles Dental Clinic, and I can confidently say it was the best dental experience I’ve ever had. From the very beginning, everything was exceptional. The reception staff were amazing—accommodating my schedule and arranging my treatments around my travel plans seamlessly. Their professionalism and friendliness set the tone for the whole experience. Dr. Arpaporn was outstanding. During the initial consultation, she thoroughly explained the treatments, steps, and all the details in between. Her care and precision ensured that everything went exactly as planned. The results were excellent, far exceeding my expectations. Having the unpleasant experience of dealing with the U.S. healthcare system and dental clinics before, I can unequivocally say this was a superior experience in every way—better care, better service, and better results. I highly recommend Wellsmiles Dental Clinic to anyone in need of dental treatment in Chiang Mai. Thank you, Dr. Arpaporn and team, for the exceptional care!
0x30da3b8f5f8b55eb_0xd9328cf3e85b6a0d.author: Aymen Taha

0x30da3b8f5f8b55eb_0xd9328cf3e85b6a0d.text: I had an implant with sinus lift and bone grafting done here, and I’m extremely satisfied with the whole experience. The implantologist was highly professional, careful, and explained every step clearly, which gave me great confidence during the treatment. The staff has been really kind and always checked on me during my recovery, which I really appreciated. The clinic itself is modern, spotless, and equipped with the latest technology, which made me feel I was in very good hands. I truly recommend this clinic for anyone looking for high-quality dental care.
0x30da3b8f5f8b55eb_0xd9328cf3e85b6a0d.author: Damián Calvo

0x30da3b8f5f8b55eb_0xd9328cf3e85b6a0d.text: I recommend this Dental Clinic. The doctors are really patient with the patients. They told us everything about good and bad and they told us how to take care of the tooth carefully. They really taking care of their patients with love. The way they treated us is like family. So I recommend you to this Wellsmiles Dental Clinic. You can discuss with them in details. The staffs from clinic are so sweet too ❤️ Thank you so much
0x30da3b8f5f8b55eb_0xd9328cf3e85b6a0d.author: Rebekah Richard

0x30da3b8f5f8b55eb_0xd9328cf3e85b6a0d.text: Very friendly, excellent service. I came for a checkup since I had not been to the dentist for a few years and the dentist suggested only what I needed and she told me that some of my concerns about my teeth were actually ok and no extra work was required. Very happy with the experience and the service. Highly recommend. Very modern equipment and excellent English.
0x30da3b8f5f8b55eb_0xd9328cf3e85b6a0d.author: M. R.

0x30da3b8f5f8b55eb_0xd9328cf3e85b6a0d.text: I’ve had many procedures done at this dental office. I am very happy with all aspects of this practice. Customer service and communication has been great. I just completed my total tooth implant and I can’t be any happier. Everything went perfect from start to finish. I highly recommend this dental office.
0x30da3b8f5f8b55eb_0xd9328cf3e85b6a0d.author: Hank Wrigley

0x30da3b8f5f8b55eb_0xd9328cf3e85b6a0d.text: Dr. Jay speaks really good English and explains your condition clearly before proceeding with the treatment. She’s very thorough with the teeth cleaning and you could tell that she’s very experienced. Staff there were very pleasant and welcoming as well. Would definitely be back for future treatments.
0x30da3b8f5f8b55eb_0xd9328cf3e85b6a0d.author: Travelisme

0x30da3b8f5f8b55eb_0xd9328cf3e85b6a0d.text: I got the root canal treatment, crown and teeth cleaning. The dentist was very friendly and soft-hand. All of the treatments was totally painless. The staff were very helpful. I feel grateful for all of the service here. Well smiles dental clinic is the best dental clinic in Chiangmai.
0x30da3b8f5f8b55eb_0xd9328cf3e85b6a0d.author: tawhan jenjirap

0x30da3b8f5f8b55eb_0xd9328cf3e85b6a0d.text: Dr. Somsinee Noparatkailas saw my mother and me very quickly and did an excellent service. My mother’s teeth were repaired and I was able to get a new retainer in just two days. The staff were also very polite, helpful and well-spoken. Very good English 😁 …
0x30da3b8f5f8b55eb_0xd9328cf3e85b6a0d.author: jess

0x30e298d31141e91b_0x9ff2469a25ccd4d4.text: YOU WILL NOT FIND A BETTER DENTAL EXPERIENCE ANYWHERE. I have been a patient at Metropolitan since the day it opened, more than 10 years ago. Everything about it is outstanding. Dr Chanavut runs an extremely impressive operation, with highly-trained staff and state-of-the-art equipment. And, on top of all that, it is very cost-effective by comparison to USA, Europe, Australia etc. I am over 60 years old. I have lived in 7 countries and visited dozens of dentists, including USA, UK and New Zealand. None of these come close to Dr Chanavut and Metropolitan. There are many hundreds of dental facilities in Bangkok. Do not be influenced by one or two negative reviews or comments. Do some research. Or visit Metropolitan and see for yourself. Or call and speak to Dr Chanavut. I can be quite confident in saying it is unlikely, in the extreme, that you will find a better dental experience in Bangkok (or anywhere else).

I cannot recommend this clinic enough, especially for anyone who feels a bit nervous about dental work. From the moment you walk in, the environment is exceptionally clean, friendly, and well-organized. The dentist was incredible—they took the time to explain every single step of the procedure with genuine care and consideration. What really stood out to me was the soothing, calm ambiance of the office. It genuinely helped lower my stress levels and made what usually feels like a "scary" procedure feel manageable and relaxed. Cleanliness: 5+ Stars. Both the facility and the equipment are spotless, which gave me complete peace of mind. If you are someone who is usually afraid of the dentist, this is the place to go!

Excellent service, beautiful and clean clinic. Orthodontic treatment is quite expensive, but they take responsibility until the end (excluding teeth cleaning and extractions). The Invisalign price covers everything from cutting to completion; it's for 2 years and 80 sets. I'm very satisfied with the results (my teeth were spaced apart for over 20 years; the dentist at that time told me to get braces, and they even added a tooth to widen the gap). Here, they straightened my teeth until they were close together, and they also corrected my malocclusion (my teeth didn't meet properly). It's amazing! I've recommended it to many friends. Personally, I think it's worth the price. (The photos are of the clinic.)
0x30e298d31141e91b_0x9ff2469a25ccd4d4.author: Ratana Chawana

0x30e298d31141e91b_0x9ff2469a25ccd4d4.text: An emergency dental visit while away from Home is never ideal but after contacting the metropolitan dental clinic via their business whatsapp and giving them a brief summary I was booked in for an emergency appointment (they confirmed upfront initial Costs also, very helpful) and on arrival found it to be extremely clean and the staff helpful. A few hours later I was discharged with a treatment plan, medication and what to do if I needed further support and for a very reasonable cost. Highly recommend this clean and professional practice especially if you have little Thai language skills as the full staff have impeccable English language skills. Would use again if needed!

I went to the clinic for teeth whitening since I no longer smiled because my teeth had yellowed and stained too much. I was skeptical that I would get a satisfactory result, but I did. I also had 6 filling replaced. Dre. Supisara was very professionnal, answered all my questions clearly, informed me step by step as she was doing work and always checked in that I was doing ok. The whitening is very sensitive/painful but it was alright. I felt that she really took the time to be conscientious, whereas in Canada I always feel that they are rushing to the next patient while my mouth is still open. Highly recommended!

Dr Duangporn Wiriyapak and her assistants provided excellent care. I had a rather complex case of fracture in one tooth and she really took the time to make sure it would get properly cleaned and healed over several months. She was very thorough and saved my tooth. The clinic admin staff was really nice, always making sure to communicate clearly and to book every appointments necessary even on short notice. Can highly recommend Metropolitan Dental Clinic.

I've been using this clinic for over 7 years, getting 5 dental implants, fillings, and teeth cleaning every 6 months. The dentist is very skilled and can handle everything. The teeth cleaning is very gentle and painless. The assistants and the staff at the counter are all very attentive. The prices are reasonable for the treatment and service. The location is convenient with good parking. Highly recommend.
0x30e298d31141e91b_0x9ff2469a25ccd4d4.author: Piboon Tharaputi

0x30e298d31141e91b_0x9ff2469a25ccd4d4.text: I have dental appointment check up with metropolitan clinic every 6 months for the past 10 years. Early dental risks were detected and looked after. My dental health have been prudently looked after. The dentists are well qualified and their performance are professional. The team (assistants and nurse and admin) are also professional, kind, understanding and helpful.
0x30e298d31141e91b_0x9ff2469a25ccd4d4.author: wilai tapaneeyangkul

0x30da315d1c7b3d8d_0xf944de49f7fdd5d0.text: #Clinic for those afraid of dentists. Today was my first time trying dental treatment here. I had a cavity at the age of 29 😳🦷. I'm usually afraid of dentists and hate going to the dentist, but I came because I know Dr. Pippo, a pediatric dentist. I booked an appointment with her because I thought a child dentist would be gentle 😆🤍. When I arrived, I was surprised to see so many children's toys! Once the treatment started, I was even more surprised when the doctor asked if I wanted to watch TV. So I asked her to put on a cartoon 5555 (but I had to wear glasses to avoid eye strain, so I chose Pikachu). During the procedure, the doctor kept telling me what I would feel, letting me know what stage we were at and how much was left 🤣. She didn't leave me wondering how long it would take! And importantly, she had a technique to distract me from the pain when injecting the local anesthetic. This was amazing! I followed her instructions, and before I knew it, it was all over 😌. I loved it – a new experience at the age of 29! If you're afraid of dentists, I recommend trying this place. Dr. Pippo is lovely and very kind!
0x30da315d1c7b3d8d_0xf944de49f7fdd5d0.author: Nae Kim

0x30da315d1c7b3d8d_0xf944de49f7fdd5d0.text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Dr. Penphong was very thorough and professional. She checked all my daughter’s teeth first before treating the complaint tooth. She also advised us to wait until my daughter is around 14 to see how a possible problem tooth develops, which made sense since teeth are still developing at this age. Honest advice, gentle care, and a clean, child-friendly clinic. Highly recommended.
0x30da315d1c7b3d8d_0xf944de49f7fdd5d0.author: marco antonio almonte

0x30da315d1c7b3d8d_0xf944de49f7fdd5d0.text: This clinic is welcoming for both children and adults. The atmosphere is lovely, the staff are wonderful, and the service is excellent. Dr. Por is incredibly kind and attentive to patients. I especially appreciate how she notices when patients are scared or anxious and finds great ways to talk to them. The staff even hold their hands! Dental procedures don't feel scary anymore! 💫🦋✨💕🫶🏻🦷
0x30da315d1c7b3d8d_0xf944de49f7fdd5d0.author: Nunnaphat Punyapor

0x30da315d1c7b3d8d_0xf944de49f7fdd5d0.text: Arteeth Chiang Mai is very welcoming and family-friendly. They have a lovely play area for kids which helps prepare them before their dental appointment and comfort them after treatment. The staff speaks English well, which makes communication easy. Dr. Penphong is charming, gentle, and makes both children and parents feel at ease. Highly recommended for families!
0x30da315d1c7b3d8d_0xf944de49f7fdd5d0.author: Christine Almonte

0x30da315d1c7b3d8d_0xf944de49f7fdd5d0.text: excellent dentist, perfect for children. sweet, caring, and fast working. she had some dental work done before and was scared, but with dr arteeth no crying and lots of smiles. she enjoyed watching tv while getting the work done and enjoys the toys in the waiting area (but they have never made us wait long!)

0x30e2b9f163504959_0xe8d32990b8c61a79.text: คุณหมอทำดีมาก บอกรายละเอียดว่าฟันของเรามีปัญหาอะไรบ้าง ใจเย็น ใจดีที่สุด เก็บรายละเอียดทุกซอก อีกอย่างพนักงานยิ้มแย้ม อธิบายได้เข้าใจง่าย

0x30e2b9f163504959_0xe8d32990b8c61a79.text: วันนี้มาครั้งที่ 3 แล้ว คุณหมอน่ารัก น้องๆผู้ช่วยบริการดี ร้านสะอาด ปลอดภัย มาใช้สิทธิ์บัตรทอง ครั้งที่3 ฟรีไม่เสียค่าใช้จ่ายจริงค่ะ👍👍👍👍

0x30e2b9f163504959_0xe8d32990b8c61a79.text: พาน้องมาอุดฟัน คุณหมอใจดีมากๆมือเบา ปกติทำที่อื่นน้องจะไม่อยากกลับไปทำต่อ ที่นี่ที่แรกในสมุทรสาครน้องไม่ร้องหรือกลัวเลย
0x30e2b9f163504959_0xe8d32990b8c61a79.en: I brought my younger sibling to get a filling. The dentist was very kind and gentle. Usually, after treatment elsewhere, my sibling doesn't want to go back for further visits. This is the first place in Samut Sakhon where my sibling didn't cry or show any fear.

0x30e28129c26fe887_0x64fa3035323273f4.text: รากฟันผุเสียหาย1ซี่ เข้ามาทำรากฟันเทียมที่ The Dent Clinic รังสิต ราคากันเองดีครับ สถานที่โอ่โถง สะอาด การบริการดีมาก คุณหมอที่ทำให้ก็ okครับ ครั้งแรกเข้ามาถอนฟันที่เสียออกพร้อมใส่รากฟันเทียมไว้ก่อน คุณหมอแนะนำฉีดเพิ่มเนื้อฟันเพื่อช่วยหุ้มรากฟันไว้ด้วยเลย ครั้งที่2เข้ามาตัดไหมที่เย็บไว้ วันนี้เข้ามาตามนัดครั้งที่3 เพื่อพิมพ์ฟัน ขั้นตอนอาจจะมีหลายขั้นตอน แต่ก็ถือว่าละเอียดดี เพื่อฟันใหม่ของเราเมื่อแล้วเสร็จจะได้ใช้งานเป็นปกติไปอีกนานๆ เดิมทีไม่แน่ใจจะทำดีไม่ดี แต่พอมาทำจริงก็ง่ายไม่ยุ่งยาก เป็นฟันกรามด้วย จะได้มีใช้งานบดเคี้ยวอาหาร ก็นับว่าตัดสินใจถูกต้องละครับ ระหว่างนั่งรอเวลาตามนัด เบรคกาแฟสบายๆและคิดว่าบันทึกเพื่อใครที่รากฟันเสียหาย และยังไม่แน่ใจจะทำใหม่ดีหรือไม่ ก็จะได้มีข้อมูลเพื่อตัดสินใจได้ง่ายต่อไปครับ ขอให้ดูแลทนุถนอมฟันของเรา จะได้มีใช้งานกันยาวๆ
0x30e28129c26fe887_0x64fa3035323273f4.en: I had a damaged tooth root and had an implant done at The Dent Clinic in Rangsit. The price was reasonable, the place was spacious and clean, and the service was excellent. The dentist who performed the procedure was also great. On my first visit, I had the damaged tooth extracted and the implant placed. The dentist recommended injecting dentin to help surround the root. On my second visit, I had the sutures removed. Today, I came for my third appointment to have the impressions taken. The process may involve several steps, but it's very thorough, ensuring my new tooth will function normally for a long time after completion. Initially, I wasn't sure if it was right for me, but the process was easy and straightforward. It's a molar, so I'll be able to use it for chewing food. I think it was the right decision. While waiting for my appointment, I enjoyed a relaxing coffee break and thought I'd record this for anyone whose tooth root is damaged and is unsure whether to get a replacement. This information will help them make an easier decision. Take good care of your teeth! So you can use them for a long time!

0x30e28129c26fe887_0x64fa3035323273f4.text: มาถอนฟันคุด เป็นครั้งที่2ในชีวิตนี้ แต่เป็นครั้งแรกที่รับบริการร้าน The Dent ตอนแรกว่าจะลองเดินเข้าไปถามราคาเฉยๆลังเลไม่รู้จะทำเลยดีมั้ย สรุปใช้เวลารวมตั้งแต่เลี้ยวเข้ามาจอดจนฟันหลุดจากปากไม่เกิน20นาที😂(ทั้งๆที่ก็มีลูกค้าเค้าก็นั่งรอกันพอสมควรอยู่นะ ประมาณ5-6คน) บริการประทับใจตั้งแต่พนักงานต้อนรับไปจนถึงพนักงานผู้ช่วยฯทันตกรรม ดูมีมาตรฐานดีทุกจุด และหมอเก่งชำนาญ(ถอนกับอาจารย์นที นนทภาษโสภณ) แนะนำดี ให้ถามได้และตอบดี นับเป็นระบบบริการทันตกรรมครบวงจรที่ประทับใจที่สุดตั้งแต่เคยใช้บริการมาในชีวิตนี้ (ปล.ทั้งชีวิตทำฟันประมาณ10ครั้ง🥹) มาใช้บริการอีกแน่นอน ว่าแต่เค้ารับประกันไหมไม่รู้ลืมเชค วันนี้ดันจ่ายสดไปแล้วเพราะราคาไม่แพงเลย 1900บาท(หมอบอกว่าเป็นเพราะถอนง่าย)
0x30e28129c26fe887_0x64fa3035323273f4.en: This was my second time having a wisdom tooth extracted, but my first time using The Dent clinic. Initially, I just wanted to ask about the price, hesitating whether to go ahead with the procedure. In the end, the entire process, from parking to the tooth being removed, took less than 20 minutes 😂 (even though there were quite a few customers waiting, about 5-6 people). The service was impressive, from the receptionist to the dental assistants. Everything was top-notch and the dentist was highly skilled and experienced (extracted by Professor Natee Nonthaphasophon). They gave good advice, answered all my questions, and were very helpful. This is the most impressive comprehensive dental service I've ever used in my life. (P.S. I've only had dental work done about 10 times in my life 🥹) I will definitely be back. I forgot to check if they offer a guarantee though. I paid in cash today because the price was very reasonable, 1900 baht (the dentist said it was because it was an easy extraction).

0x30e28129c26fe887_0x64fa3035323273f4.text: ตั้งแต่แรกที่มาปรึกษา ไม่เคยรู้สึกว่าคิดผิดเลยที่เลือกที่นี่เราจะจัดฟันรอบ 2 คุณหมอชี้แจงแบบชัดเจนดูอยากช่วยเหลือคนไข้ให้ฟันออกมาเว่อชั่นที่ดีที่สุด คุณหมอสวยแล้วยังพ๔ดจาน่ารักมากๆ ยันมารอบที่เราต้องเคลียร์ช่องปาก ก็ได้เจอกับคุณหมออีกท่านบอกเลยว่าทั้งสองท่านบริการดีมากดีมากพูดจาดี ให้คำแนะนำดีทำให้การหาหมอฟันเป็นเรื่องสบายใจ ในด้านของราคาบอกตรงๆ สมเหตุสมผลไม่มีคำว่าแพงกระเป๋าฉีกแน่นอน วันนี้ล่าสุดเลยเราถอนฟันและผ่าฟันคุดพร้อมกัน บอกเลยว่าคุณหมอทำไวมือเบา พี่ๆผู้ช่วยก็ทำงานดีพูดจาอ่อนหวานทำให้เราไม่เครียด พนักงานตั้งแต่เคาน์เตอร์ยันผู้ช่วยหมอบริการดีมากคลินิกสะอาดโปร่งโล่งสบาย มีบริการขนมนมน้ำพร้อม ประทับใจมากๆค่ะ❤️❤️❤️❤️
0x30e28129c26fe887_0x64fa3035323273f4.author: onto will
0x30e28129c26fe887_0x64fa3035323273f4.en: From the first consultation, I've never regretted choosing this clinic. I'm getting my second round of orthodontic treatment, and the doctor explained everything clearly, showing a genuine desire to help patients achieve the best possible results. The doctor is beautiful and speaks incredibly kindly. During my recent check-up, I met another doctor, and I must say, both doctors provided excellent service. They were kind, gave great advice, and made dental work a very comfortable experience. Regarding the price, honestly, it's very reasonable; nothing is overpriced. Most recently, I had a tooth extracted and wisdom tooth removed at the same time. The doctor was quick and gentle, and the assistants were excellent and spoke sweetly, making the experience stress-free. The staff, from the counter to the doctor's assistants, were all fantastic. The clinic is clean, bright, and comfortable, and they even provide snacks and drinks. I was extremely impressed! ❤️❤️❤️❤️

0x30e28129c26fe887_0x64fa3035323273f4.text: ทำฟัน จัดฟันมาหลายที่ไม่เคยประทับใจที่ไหนเท่าที่นี่เลย ราคาเท่าๆกับคลินิกทั่วไป แต่คุณภาพเกินราคามาก คุณหมอ พี่ผู้ช่วย พนักงาน แม่บ้าน คือน่ารักมาก บริการแบบแทบอุ้มเข้าห้อง พูดเพราะ หน้าไม่เหวี่ยง ระบบจัดการคิวโอเค ที่สำคัญคลินิกสะอาดทุกเวลา กว้างขวางไม่แออัด มีขนมกาแฟน้ำดื่มพร้อมบริการตลอด คุณหมอผู้หญิงน่ารักอะไปทีไรอารมณ์ดีตลอด 🥰🩷
0x30e28129c26fe887_0x64fa3035323273f4.en: I've had dental work and orthodontic treatment at many places, but I've never been as impressed as here. The prices are comparable to other clinics, but the quality far exceeds the price. The doctor, assistants, staff, and cleaning ladies are all incredibly lovely. The service is exceptional; they practically carry you into the room. They speak politely, and their faces are never grumpy. The queuing system is efficient, and importantly, the clinic is clean at all times. It's spacious and not crowded, and they always have snacks, coffee, and water available. The female doctor is so lovely; I always feel good whenever I go there. 🥰🩷

0x30e28129c26fe887_0x64fa3035323273f4.text: ได้รับบริการขูดหินปูนและทำรีเทนเนอร์ใหม่ ทุกขั้นตอนแจ้งค่ารักษาอย่างชัดเจนพนักงาน ผู้ช่วย จนถึงหมอบริการดีมากกกกกกกกกก คลีนิคสะอาดมากมีที่จอดรถและ รปภ คอยโบกรถให้ หมอจินและผู้ช่วยใจดีใส่ใจคนไข้ แนะนำดี และมือเบามากค่ะ ครั้งต่อไปก็จะกลับมารักษาที่นี่อีก💖💖
0x30e28129c26fe887_0x64fa3035323273f4.en: I received teeth cleaning and a new retainer. The costs were clearly explained at every step. The staff, from the assistants to the doctor, were all excellent. The clinic is very clean, has parking, and security guards to direct traffic. Dr. Jin and the assistants were kind, attentive, gave good advice, and were very gentle. I will definitely return for treatment here again. 💖💖

0x30e28129c26fe887_0x64fa3035323273f4.text: Dr. Ben had a very gentle touch and explained everything clearly. Dr. Chok performed the root canal treatment; it wasn't as painful as I expected and was done quickly. The denture performed by Dr. Pan feels just like a real tooth.
0x30e28129c26fe887_0x64fa3035323273f4.author: Teerapot Wessapan

0x30e28129c26fe887_0x64fa3035323273f4.text: หมอใจดี สียางสวย พนักงานงานสวยทุกคน บริการดีทุกขั้นตอน มีโทรแจ้งล่วงหน้า และให้คำแนะนำที่มีประโยชน์อย่างมาก เช่น ยาสีฟันสมุนไพรส่วนใหญ่ทำให้ฟันเหลืองง่ายเพราะมีเม็ดขัดฟันใหญ่เกินไป จึงทำให้สารเคลือบฟันพังเร็ว เป็นต้น
0x30e28129c26fe887_0x64fa3035323273f4.author: Chonlada Khongchai
0x30e28129c26fe887_0x64fa3035323273f4.en: The dentist was kind, the rubber bands were beautiful, and all the staff were pretty. The service was excellent at every step. They called ahead and provided very helpful advice, such as the fact that most herbal toothpastes can easily stain teeth because they have abrasive particles that are too large, causing enamel erosion faster.

0x30e28129c26fe887_0x64fa3035323273f4.text: Excellent! Highly recommended. The doctor gave superb advice. The staff provided excellent service. The place is spacious, parking is convenient, and it's easy to find as it's located right on the main road.
0x30e28129c26fe887_0x64fa3035323273f4.author: Rothporn Angkeratana

0x30e29ed2695d5989_0xca1c6a6253ce0abf.text: If you want to relax and get around easily, I recommend Beechu Siam Square One. The staff are lovely and always smiling. You won't be disappointed!
0x30e29ed2695d5989_0xca1c6a6253ce0abf.author: Jiab Sweetmonkey

0x30e29ed2695d5989_0xca1c6a6253ce0abf.text: I'm a regular customer at another branch because I feel my hair is healthier there. I even bought a package that can be used at all branches. I happened to be in the Siam area and wanted to try a different branch. I found that this branch wasn't as good as my usual one. The staff member seemed inexperienced and didn't apply the treatment as thoroughly as before. They even smeared the hair on my neck, which left it red, irritated, and itchy after drying – something that's never happened to me before. I even took pictures. The way they tucked the plastic wrap around my collar to prevent stains was also done haphazardly, allowing water to seep in during the hair rinsing. Another issue is the limited space. Staff eat in the inner area, creating strong odors that affect customers. The hair washing station isn't comfortable; you have to walk past other customers' feet. I think one visit is enough for this branch.
0x30e29ed2695d5989_0xca1c6a6253ce0abf.author: Krungsri_Muay TAT

0x30e28550272f50d9_0x905bfaea67625656.text: Convenient, close to home, and the doctor is lovely. I finished my orthodontic treatment here a year ago, and I still come for checkups because the doctor is so lovely, explains things well, and is very thorough. Before getting braces, I consulted with several places. Personally, I trusted the reasonable price and the doctor I could communicate with. Ultimately, I decided to get braces here because the doctor explains things in detail and gives good advice. They don't force you to do everything perfectly, but rather prioritize your convenience. I was able to ask questions and get advice to help me make decisions. Most recently, I had my crowns replaced. Everything happened so quickly – removing the old ones and installing the new ones. It was done surprisingly fast, but the new ones are more comfortable than the old ones. I'm surprisingly impressed, so I haven't gone anywhere else.
0x30e28550272f50d9_0x905bfaea67625656.author: Pitcha P

0x30e28550272f50d9_0x905bfaea67625656.text: We come here regularly. The staff is excellent. The pediatrician is very gentle and kind. My children aren't afraid of the doctor at all. They always give the children a reward after each treatment. I highly recommend this place!
0x30e28550272f50d9_0x905bfaea67625656.author: Tanasin Foods

0x30e28550272f50d9_0x905bfaea67625656.text: I have used this place many times over the years, including bringing my wife and daughter. Today, because I was so impressed with the service, I brought my mother-in-law along.
0x30e28550272f50d9_0x905bfaea67625656.author: ลินดา หลิมไพโรจน์

0x30e28550272f50d9_0x905bfaea67625656.author: Maneepun Aum

0x30e28550272f50d9_0x905bfaea67625656.text: ร้านทำฟันLDC สาขาราชพฤกษ์ บริการดีมากค่ะ บรรยากาศในร้านสะอาดดูดีมาก มีบริการเครื่องดื่มและเก้าอี้นวดสำหรับลูกค้าด้วยดีมากค่ะ แนะนำที่นี่นะคะ🤙🤙🤙
0x30e28550272f50d9_0x905bfaea67625656.author: pattama suaynoi
0x30e28550272f50d9_0x905bfaea67625656.en: LDC Dental Clinic, Ratchaphruek branch, provides excellent service. The atmosphere in the clinic is very clean and well-maintained. They also offer complimentary drinks and massage chairs for customers, which is great. I highly recommend this place! 🤙🤙🤙

0x30e28550272f50d9_0x905bfaea67625656.text: มาหาที่นี่เป็นประจำ พนักงานบริการดีมากค่ะ หมอเด็กมือเบามากและใจดีมากค่ะ ลูกๆไม่กลัวหมอเลยค่ะ ทำเสร็จมีรางวัลให้เด็กๆ ทุกครั้งเลย แนะนำเลยค่า

0x30e28550272f50d9_0x905bfaea67625656.en: We come here regularly. The staff is excellent. The pediatrician is very gentle and kind. My children aren't afraid of the doctor at all. They always give the children a reward after each treatment. I highly recommend this place!

0x30e28550272f50d9_0x905bfaea67625656.text: If you're thinking of seeing a dentist, think of this place...the dentist is lovely...the staff provides good service...
0x30e28550272f50d9_0x905bfaea67625656.author: AiRi-アイリ Ch.

0x30e28550272f50d9_0x905bfaea67625656.text: The doctor was very lovely, kind, and not strict at all. I liked that. The place was clean and I was very satisfied.
0x30e28550272f50d9_0x905bfaea67625656.author: จุฑารัศมิ์ หลิมไพโรจน์

0x30e285ddf1b93997_0x57d0e4ac8197004c.text: บรรยากาศที่ดีช่วยให้รู้สึกเป็นมิตรกับการทำฟัน เป็นคลินิกประจำเลย เป็นคลินิกประจำ สะอาด สบายตา พื้นที่กว้าง แอร์ฉ่ำ มีเพลงเปิดคลอ มี2 ชั้น ที่นั่งรอเป็นโซฟาสบาย ห้องน้ำสะอาดดูหรู คุณหมอและพยาบาลที่นี่ เจอหลายคนใจดีกันเองทุกคน
0x30e285ddf1b93997_0x57d0e4ac8197004c.en: A pleasant atmosphere makes dental treatment feel welcoming. This is my go-to clinic. It's clean, comfortable, spacious, has great air conditioning, and background music. It has two floors, comfortable sofas in the waiting area, and clean, luxurious-looking restrooms. The doctors and nurses I've met here are all kind and friendly.

0x30e285ddf1b93997_0x57d0e4ac8197004c.text: สาขาปากเกร็ด ประกันสังคมได้ บัตรทองได้ หมอผู้หญิง มือเบามาก ใจดีมากๆ เรากลัวการทำฟันมากหมอยังเข้าใจเราอยู่ มีช่วยป้ายยาชาก่อนฉีดยาชาด้วยทำให้ไม่ค่อยรู้สึกเจ็บอะไร มุมมองการทำฟันเปลี่ยนไป จากที่กลัวไม่กล้าทำมาหลายปี 🫶🏻🥺🩷🤏🏻✨
0x30e285ddf1b93997_0x57d0e4ac8197004c.author: phanwadee sitthikedkan
0x30e285ddf1b93997_0x57d0e4ac8197004c.en: The Pakkret branch accepts Social Security and the Universal Health Coverage (Gold Card) insurance. The female dentist is very gentle and kind. I'm very afraid of dentistry, but she understood. She even applied numbing cream before injecting the local anesthetic, which made it much less painful. My perspective on dentistry has completely changed after years of being afraid and not daring to get it done. 🫶🏻🥺🩷🤏🏻✨

0x30e285ddf1b93997_0x57d0e4ac8197004c.text: เพิ่งไปถอนฟันมาคุณหมอน่ารักมาก มือเบาไม่เจ็บเลย ตอนแรกกลัวมากความดันพุ่งเกิน160 คุณหมอช่วยได้เยอะจริงๆ ขอบคุณมากๆเลยแถมพนักงานเคาตอร์หน้ายิ้มแย้มพูดจาดีทั้งคลีนิคเลย แฮปปี้ๆค่ะ

0x30e285ddf1b93997_0x57d0e4ac8197004c.en: I just had a tooth extracted and the dentist was so nice and gentle, it didn't hurt at all. I was really scared at first, my blood pressure was over 160! The dentist really helped a lot. Thank you so much! Plus, all the counter staff were smiling and polite throughout the clinic. I'm very happy!

0x30e285ddf1b93997_0x57d0e4ac8197004c.text: คุณหมอให้คำแนะนำดีมือเบามากค่ะ ผู้ช่วยน่ารักพูดจาดี เคาน์เตอร์บริการดีมาก ชอบมากค่ะคลินิกนี้ประทับใจค่ะ
0x30e285ddf1b93997_0x57d0e4ac8197004c.en: The doctor gave great advice and was very gentle. The assistant was lovely and spoke well. The service at the counter was excellent. I really liked this clinic; I'm very impressed.

0x30e285ddf1b93997_0x57d0e4ac8197004c.text: The doctor was very kind, gave good advice, and was very attentive to patients. I was very impressed.
0x30e285ddf1b93997_0x57d0e4ac8197004c.author: Peung Peungmink

0x30e285ddf1b93997_0x57d0e4ac8197004c.text: หมอผู้ชายที่ถอนฟัน มือเบามากค่ะ ฉีดยาชาไม่เจ็บเลยยย มือเบามากๆๆๆๆ เเบบบมากๆๆๆ 10/10 เลยค่ะ ชอบมากก
0x30e285ddf1b93997_0x57d0e4ac8197004c.en: The male dentist who extracted my tooth had a very gentle touch. The anesthetic injection was painless! He was incredibly gentle, like, super gentle! 10/10! I loved it!

0x30e285ddf1b93997_0x57d0e4ac8197004c.text: The staff were friendly, lovely, and helpful. The dentist was kind. My teeth look amazing!
0x30e285ddf1b93997_0x57d0e4ac8197004c.author: Jojo Joejoe

0x30e285ddf1b93997_0x57d0e4ac8197004c.text: เดินเข้าไปพนักงานเคาน์เตอร์ปากหนักไม่สวัสดีต้อนรับ จนต้องเดินไปถึงหน้าเคาน์เตอร์จึงจะพูด จากนั้นสอบถามประวัติ และเราแจ้งว่าขอเอกสารเพื่อเบิกเพิ่ม พนักงานก็รับทราบ จากนั้นทวนสิทธิ์เป็นขูดหินปูนประกันสังคม เราจองออนไลน์มาเป็นขูดหินปูน+ขัดฟัน ราคาโปร 1,100฿ เมื่อขึ้นไปทำชั้น 2 ผู้ช่วยเรียกเชิญคนไข้ แต่ไม่เรียกชื่อ ทำให้ลูกค้าที่นั่งอยู่หลายคนงงว่าสรุปแล้วเรียกคนไหนกันแน่ แอบสงสัยว่าพนักงานที่นี่ทำงานกันยังไง พอเจอหมอ หมอผู้ชายดูแลดี ใจเย็น และทำการขูดหินปูนเพียงอย่างเดียว เราจึงบอกว่าจองโปรขัดฟันมาด้วย หมอบอกว่าเคาน์เตอร์เขียนใบสั่งมาแค่ขูดหินปูน แต่หมอก็ขัดฟันให้ตามที่เราแจ้ง เรารู้สึกไม่พอใจที่ทำไมแอดมินกับสาขาถึงไม่ประสานงานเรื่องโปรของลูกค้า จากนั้นลงไปเคลียร์บิล/เอกสารที่เคาน์เตอร์ พนักงานก็ทวนเอกสารปกติ นึกขึ้นได้ว่าทิ้งบัตรประชาชนที่เคาน์เตอร์ไว้ตั้งแต่ตอนแรกที่เข้ามา รู้สึกไม่สบายใจ แต่ไม่เป็นไร (คลินิคอื่นขอบัตรเสร็จธุระก็รีบคืนให้เลย ไม่เก็บของลูกค้าไว้โดยไม่จำเป็น) ตอนรับบัตรคืนก็ไม่ใส่ซองพลาสติกคืนมาให้ จนต้องเอ่ยปากขอ แม้กระทั่งตอนยื่นเอกสารเบิก ก็ไม่มีซองจดหมายใส่มาให้เรียบร้อย เราต้องถามอีก บอกเลยว่าเหนื่อยแทน พนักงานเคาน์เตอร์ดูสติล่องลอย ไม่ค่อยมีสมาธิ ถ้าเทียบกับคลินิคในบริเวณใกล้เคียง การบริการถือว่ายังไม่ผ่าน รู้งี้กลับไปคลินิคข้างๆดีกว่า มาใช้บริการครั้งแรก เมื่อ 16/04/26 14.00
0x30e285ddf1b93997_0x57d0e4ac8197004c.author: Lady Snake

0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.text: My child was injured while visiting Japan for a short visit. We treated him in Japan, but his condition worsened, so we had him undergo surgery here. Because the injury occurred in Japan, insurance didn't cover it. We initially went to a private hospital, but the cost was so high that we requested surgery here. We were told that foreigners cannot be admitted to the general ward at Ramathi Hospital, so we went to the premium ward. When we explained that we didn't have insurance, we were told that, according to regulations, foreigners have to pay two to three times the price of Thai people. Even so, we were able to have surgery here for less than half the price of a private hospital. The hospital room is just as clean as a municipal hospital, and many doctors and nurses speak English, so it's reassuring. However, since the instructions are primarily in Thai, it may be difficult if you don't speak any Thai at all. A decent level of English is essential for the consultation. We paid the full cost out of pocket, and even with X-rays and blood tests, the total cost was within 1,000 to 3,000 baht. At a private hospital, the same tests would have cost 8,500 baht.
0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.author: Asuka

0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.text: From someone who used to use the regular ward at Ramathibodi Hospital: The regular ward is extremely crowded, and the wait times are incredibly long. You don't know when you'll be seen; you could go at 5:00 AM and leave almost in the evening. It's not an exaggeration to say you'll be at the hospital all day. But once you switch to Ramathibodi Premium, you'll realize the wait times aren't as long as the regular ward. The waiting times might not be as good as private hospitals, with a slight variation of +/- 1.5 hours due to more complicated cases from previous patients, but rest assured, the doctors here are incredibly skilled, and the equipment is top-notch and modern.
0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.author: Bow Auan

0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.text: The Premium Clinic in the Sirikit Building (or Princess Maha Chakri Building) at Ramathibodi Hospital is a premium outpatient service emphasizing convenience and speed. Examinations and treatments are provided by a team of expert physicians. The clinic offers comprehensive services, including specialized disease diagnosis, blood tests, medication purchases, and payment, all in one place. It is open every weekday/evening and offers health check-up packages. (Faculty of Medicine, Ramathibodi Hospital, Mahidol University)
0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.author: fc zbing z.

0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.text: Inside the hospital, every floor is clean. There are clean bathrooms on every floor. The service is good. There are plenty of chairs on every floor, enough for all users. The service is good and of high quality. There is also a dining area for the elderly and wheelchair users to sit and eat conveniently. Everything is good. There is always a shuttle service.
0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.author: Tewan Thai

0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.text: The process is well-organized and efficient. There's a QR code scanning system for each doctor's group, and an admin calls you in a LINE group when your turn is approaching. This allows you to eat or walk around while waiting, instead of having to sit and wait in front of the doctor's room. It's very convenient.
0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.author: 11-7 ฮีโร่

0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.text: The medication wasn't too expensive, affordable. I went to an ophthalmologist. - The doctor provided excellent service. - The nurses weren't okay at all. I'd like to see improvement in their service. I know nursing is tiring, but their tone of voice was unpleasant. - The staff outside of finance, but who assist patients with blood pressure, weight, and temperature checks, didn't know the answers to questions. I asked if patients could scan to pay, and they seemed to receive some kind of benefit from this service. - The restrooms were clean. - The vegetarian food by Krua Nang Loeng was very good. - It's a shame they don't accept walk-ins; you have to make an appointment and check in via the app. Checking in via the app is convenient and great. - It's a pity that it's difficult to use social security insurance here because it's fully booked.
0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.author: Wiramon Jancharoen

0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.text: Every time I go, I'm confused. The entire hospital is confused. They don't explain anything after registration. Do I have to wait until my appointment time? Do I need to get tested first? Do I need to wait for the next checkup? Every time I go, I have to keep running around asking questions. One person says one thing, another says another. The patient is confused. Not to mention the time when the surgery cost was estimated at 80,000 baht, but on the actual day, they asked me to pay 180,000 baht. What would someone do if they didn't have the money? It's not even a hundred or two hundred baht difference. They didn't tell me what medications to stop taking before the surgery. Stop guessing. When they rescheduled, they didn't tell me what time to come. The patient has to think about the questions first. The staff didn't give me any details. It's a human life. There should be a better system. They should train their staff to help guide patients or provide complete information. Don't make patients run around trying to find information like this. I only give the doctor a score. The surgeon who performed the surgery was excellent. He was kind and caring.
0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.author: Nani

0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.text: A 'premium' diabetes and endocrine clinic on the 4th floor, Zone V. Dr. Phakwan has very poor manners. She doesn't listen to family members' explanations and doesn't answer questions clearly. She speaks curtly and belittles patients as if this is a charity clinic. After taking a medical history, she points to the door, indicating that it's time to leave and the next in line (I assume it's a turnaround). I'm numb. This is the first time I've ever encountered this...a premium clinic?!?! The 6-minute examination costs 600 baht, the same price as a private clinic. I received no advice whatsoever from the doctor. The worst part is the medical certificate. The doctor was in such a hurry that he didn't even write the treatment he was receiving, just stamped a careless rubber stamp that read "I'm here for a real checkup." I'm so disappointed. Where can I complain? I'm receiving treatment at Phyathai Hospital. I'm 100 times more impressed. The treatment costs are about the same. I shouldn't have come here.
0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.author: Nattana Tungpong

0x30e29d003a0a91bb_0xaa902c648592ae79.text: I took my sister here and had a wonderful experience here. The atmosphere is calm, warm, and very private, which made she feel completely at ease. The doctor and staff were professional, gentle, and respectful. I truly appreciated the attention to detail and the focus on patient comfort. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a safe and reassuring women’s health clinic.

0x30502e1c5fa6f951_0xfd702200d09d6d92.text: I have visited this dermatologist several times, and unfortunately my experience has been disappointing. The first time, I went for pigmentation and mild acne. I was prescribed antibiotics and advised to undergo laser treatment (which was offered at a very high cost). I trusted the recommendation and followed the treatment plan, but I saw no improvement whatsoever. When I returned and explained that there was no progress, I was told there were no other treatment options—only the same laser procedure, which I had already tried without results. I also felt pressured into cosmetic procedures. At one point I was told: “You are pretty but you can be prettier”, and fillers and Botox were suggested. Eventually, I agreed to Botox, which was again very expensive. Unlike my experiences in other countries, no follow-up appointment was included two weeks later to check results or make adjustments. When I requested one, I was told I would need to pay for another consultation, even though the Botox was clearly ineffective (the wrinkles remained). To make matters worse, two days after the injections I developed a facial allergic reaction. I asked for an urgent appointment and not only was I charged for it, but I was also prescribed antibiotics yet again. As a healthcare professional myself, I fully value and respect the work of doctors and believe medical services should never be “free.” However, when treatments don’t work—or worse, when they trigger an adverse reaction—the minimum expectation is proper follow-up and patient care. In this clinic, that was never the case. The focus seemed to be entirely on charging for additional procedures, regardless of whether they benefited my health. One comment in particular made me very uncomfortable: I was told that because of the watch I was wearing, it meant I had “a lot of money and could spend a lot here.” This reinforced my impression that the priority was not patient wellbeing, but profit. It is disappointing to have to write this review, but I feel it is important to share. In my experience, this clinic is driven more by financial gain than by genuine patient care. I cannot recommend it. UPDATE: After reading the clinic’s response, I would like to clarify one detail: I made a mistake regarding the price of the Botox. The correct amount was 12,500 baht. The amount I originally mentioned (30,000 baht) referred to the laser treatment I had done, not the Botox. That said, I must emphasize that all of my other comments remain exactly the same. It is not true that the clinic provided follow-up. I was the one who had to reach out several times. After the Botox, I developed an allergic reaction and I had to insist repeatedly to get an appointment, because there was no genuine concern shown for the reaction I experienced. I also had to write multiple times to say that my wrinkles had not improved. I understand the concept of a “natural look,” but there is a clear difference between natural results and no results at all. My wrinkles remain very visible, as can be seen in the photo I am sharing. I want to make it very clear that nothing I have written is false. Everything I shared about my experience and about what the doctor said to me is true, and it saddens me that this is the attitude of the clinic. I tried many times to express my dissatisfaction directly to the clinic, but the response was always to charge more, never to genuinely resolve my concerns. That is the only reason why I felt the need to write this review. Furthermore, being threatened with legal action for sharing my honest experience feels extremely unfair and upsetting, especially considering that everything I have said is true. As a healthcare professional myself, I know how important it is to show empathy and prioritize the wellbeing of patients, which is why I find this situation so disappointing. Lastly, I am not the only one who has felt this way. I personally know other patients who have been to Dr. Patt and who have had the very same impression I did.
0x30502e1c5fa6f951_0xfd702200d09d6d92.author: Yeya García - SoyEsaMamá

0x30e281569150d283_0xf28f40ef9ca5b54.text: 👍 มาอุดฟันที่นี่ประทับใจมากๆ ครับ ผมเป็นคนไข้ของคุณหมออาภิชา คุณหมอใจดี มือเบา และเก่งมากๆ ครับ ทั้งชีวิตมาเข้าใจคำว่ามือเบาจากคุณหมอเลย ขอบคุณมากๆ เลยครับที่ช่วยแก้ไขอาการเสียวฟันจากการอุดกับคลินิกก่อนหน้า ที่สร้างประสบการณ์ที่โหดร้ายสำหรับผมมาก ถือว่าโชคดีมากๆ ที่เจอคุณหมอที่เก่ง ที่สำคัญคลินิกที่นี่ใกล้บ้านมาก สามารถเดินไปได้เลย พี่พนักงานหน้าเคาน์เตอร์ก็บริการดีสุดๆ ยิ้มแย้มแจ่มใส ใครมองหาคลินิกทำฟันที่จริงใจ สะอาด บริการได้มาตรฐาน แนะนำที่นี่เลยครับ ขอบคุณมากๆ อีกครั้งนะครับ ไว้จะไปใช้บริการอีกแน่นอน ❤️
0x30e281569150d283_0xf28f40ef9ca5b54.author: Naravich Kanthadong
0x30e281569150d283_0xf28f40ef9ca5b54.en: 👍 I was very impressed with my filling here. I'm a patient of Dr. Apicha. He's very kind, gentle, and highly skilled. I truly understood the meaning of "gentle touch" after seeing him. Thank you so much for fixing my tooth sensitivity from a previous filling at another clinic, which was a terrible experience for me. I feel very lucky to have found such a skilled doctor. Importantly, the clinic is very close to my home; I can walk there. The staff at the counter are also incredibly helpful and always smiling. If you're looking for a sincere, clean dental clinic with high-standard service, I highly recommend this place. Thank you so much again! I will definitely be back for more services. ❤️

0x30e281569150d283_0xf28f40ef9ca5b54.text: On January 10th, 2025, I had my teeth cleaned (tartar removed) for the first time in many years. I was very scared, but the dentist (a woman) was very gentle. She kept me informed of any additional issues with my teeth, pointed out problems, and gave recommendations. In terms of service, the clinic was clean and the service was good. Overall, I liked this place on my first visit.
0x30e281569150d283_0xf28f40ef9ca5b54.author: วิจิตรา พิเนตรเสถียร

0x30e281569150d283_0xf28f40ef9ca5b54.text: If you have an appointment, the wait time isn't long. However, if you see several doctors, the treatment plan may differ. The staff at the counter and the doctors are friendly and helpful, providing good advice. They even call to follow up on your condition after the dental work is complete.
0x30e281569150d283_0xf28f40ef9ca5b54.author: R N

0x30e281569150d283_0xf28f40ef9ca5b54.text: The dentist gave excellent advice. I'm really afraid of dentists, but the dentist at the clinic was very kind. They had a promotion for teeth whitening, polishing, and scaling for 990 baht. I only paid the 90 baht difference with my social security contributions. Five stars!
0x30e281569150d283_0xf28f40ef9ca5b54.author: Surasak Raksee

0x30e281569150d283_0xf28f40ef9ca5b54.text: I used to use the services at the Cosmo branch before, and now that they've moved to the Tiwanon branch, the service is still just as excellent. You can rest assured that you'll leave with beautiful teeth here. P.S. Dr. Narisara has a very gentle touch! 👍🏻
0x30e281569150d283_0xf28f40ef9ca5b54.author: Natty P.

0x30e281569150d283_0xf28f40ef9ca5b54.text: The dentist was very gentle and gave excellent and kind advice. The staff were also welcoming, helpful, and polite. The clinic is beautiful, clean, and has nice photo opportunities. I'll definitely bring my family here for dental treatment again! ♥️💯 …
0x30e281569150d283_0xf28f40ef9ca5b54.author: ประสบพร สุวรรณศิลป์

0x30e281569150d283_0xf28f40ef9ca5b54.author: Kittiya Sawatworawong

0x30e281569150d283_0xf28f40ef9ca5b54.text: I had a filling done by Dr. Natthanicha. She's so lovely, gave great advice, and was very attentive to patients. She did a great job, paying close attention to detail. The dental work went by so quickly! Thank you, Dr. Natthanicha!
0x30e281569150d283_0xf28f40ef9ca5b54.author: Natchanan Jirawasinsit

0x311d5f9caaff522f_0xbc0a15a0fca652ab.text: This is probably the best dental clinic in Thailand. Usually, people are afraid of the noise and stressed about the pain when going to the dentist, but at SOL, as soon as you enter, you're greeted with a pleasant aroma. The soft, soothing music plays in the background. The place is spacious and incredibly clean. The moment you open the door, the receptionist is smiling, offers you a small bottle of mineral water, takes your blood pressure, and chats in a friendly manner. You completely forget you're there for dental work! Hahaha, it's like getting a Thai massage. And that's not all. Once the doctor is ready, as soon as you enter the room, the first thing you see is two nurses and the doctor, all bowing respectfully and greeting patients in a friendly way—they all bowed in perfect unison! The view in the back is of lush, green trees, very relaxing and pleasing to the eye. The doctor invites you to sit in the patient chair, and in front of you is a monitor displaying "Welcome, Mr./Ms./Ms./Mr./Ms ... After they finished, they checked my teeth again to see if there were any problems with any other teeth. I was very impressed. Normally, if it's another place, I'd be put off for a while afterward, but here, I feel like I really want to go back here for dental work again. Excellent!
0x311d5f9caaff522f_0xbc0a15a0fca652ab.author: Apiradee Apichitchai

0x311d5f9caaff522f_0xbc0a15a0fca652ab.text: This clinic is definitely worth recommending. The dentist is extremely professional, kind, and patient. They took the time to explain my dental condition in detail and made sure I understood every step of the treatment. I visited three different clinics before coming here, but none of them made me feel as comfortable or confident as this one. Some clinics seemed to be in a hurry to finish work, while others didn’t take the time to explain my case properly. The clinic itself has a clean and welcoming environment. The dental assistants and the receptionist are also very polite and friendly, which made the whole experience even better. The treatment cost is similar to the other clinics I’ve visited, but the overall experience here is completely different. I am very satisfied with this clinic. I 100% recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a great dental clinic. Don’t hesitate to come here—I truly believe you’ll be satisfied with the care and service you receive.

I can’t say enough good things about this place. I’m from America and did a lot of research to find a good doctor and location to get my teeth done. First off the location is great. Once you get off the plane at BBK the doctor office is literally only 15 to 40 minutes away depending on traffic you know how that is in Bangkok. So it’s right in between the airport and the chaos of Bangkok. Great location for whatever you want to do it the city. There are some great places to stay that are a 5 minute grab ride away from the office as well. The staff is great the doctor is also great. They were very accommodating for me. I had to have several visits for my procedure and it was always what worked for me. I wish I had this place back home. The price was also very reasonable I spent about 10k usd for what would have cost 40-50k in untied states. All in all great people,place, and location.
0x311d5f9caaff522f_0xbc0a15a0fca652ab.author: Geno 75

0x311d5f9caaff522f_0xbc0a15a0fca652ab.text: The Most Impressive Dental Clinic I've Ever Visited! This clinic is absolutely beautiful, clean, modern, and welcoming. The atmosphere is so relaxing that it instantly puts you at ease. I had my wisdom tooth removed here, and to my surprise, I didn’t feel any pain at all. The procedure was smooth and professionally done. I also started my orthodontic treatment with Dr. Nokweed, a true specialist, and within just one year, my teeth are almost perfectly aligned! The price is surprisingly affordable for the quality of service you get. The staff is incredibly friendly, attentive, and always ready to help. Overall, everything is just perfect especially the atmosphere. If you’re looking for a dental clinic that combines expertise, comfort, and value, I highly recommend this place!

Thank you for creating such a wonderful place. I can see all the effort and attention to detail. Now I'm determined to take better care of my teeth, and this will be my go-to dental clinic. :) If you're concerned about cleanliness, equipment, service etiquette, and not just treatment but also aesthetics and meticulous work, I highly recommend this place! Also, one last thing I want to commend is the management. I learned that they aim to be a dental clinic that doesn't evoke negativity towards clients. Besides respecting privacy, they have a rule against staff joking or gossiping. This is truly beyond amazing! How many places, and how many managers, have such a mindset and consider this a serious matter? I commend them! :D
0x311d5f9caaff522f_0xbc0a15a0fca652ab.author: panchewa navaraj

0x311d5f9caaff522f_0xbc0a15a0fca652ab.text: A new dental clinic has opened near our house, and they have a specialist pediatric dentist. The clinic is beautiful and clean, the dentist is kind, and the work is excellent. The children cooperated very well during their checkups and fluoride treatments. Choosing the right clinic and dentist for your child is very important, as it will be their first dental experience. If the children are happy the first few times, they are less likely to refuse future visits. For those in the Bang Na area, I recommend SOL Dental Clinic. It's easy to get to, has convenient parking, and the children are happy, making mom and dad happy too! ❤️
0x311d5f9caaff522f_0xbc0a15a0fca652ab.author: Polpatoo Wattana

0x311d5f9caaff522f_0xbc0a15a0fca652ab.text: This dental clinic breaks all the rules! It's as beautiful as a five-star hotel, the location is very convenient, and there's plenty of parking. The young man/woman at the front desk is incredibly cute and has amazing service mind (10/10/10). The treatment rooms are like suites – modern equipment, clean, and minimalistly decorated. The dentist is gentle, and the prices are reasonable for what you get. Scaling is 1300 baht, fillings are 2000 baht. I walked in without an appointment, but everything was quick and efficient. Excellent service. I'm entrusting my teeth to them! Love it!
0x311d5f9caaff522f_0xbc0a15a0fca652ab.author: araya rungsang

0x311d5f9caaff522f_0xbc0a15a0fca652ab.text: Accidentally stopped at the wrong clinic on the way to Sol Dental. After arriving at the right clinic (Sol Dental) I was able to compare the two offices. Sol Dental was presented much better. Everything was clean, staff was immediately there to help. Just walking in to the clinic was a much much better experience. And then the doctor showed up quickly to introduce himself. A very pleasant fellow. After my examination, I was very impressed with the whole experience. Very professional, answered my questions, and spent as much time with me as needed. I would definitely return.

0x30e29f0046a0c1ad_0x95dd636abe525e95.author: Ingrid Siciliano

0x30da3009af68cb8f_0x25d8153a586d6f04.text: I arrived in CM four years ago with my 9 yoa Tonkinese. I've been to many clinics across the US, and one other in CM during the past 19 years as a cat owner. I brought a neighborhood soi cat into another CM clinic closer to my home a few months ago for treatment of wounds received from fighting, and a general exam. The very large size clinic treatment was satisfactory, with an English-speaking vet that I knew nothing about i.e., years of experience, education, etc. He did an adequate job, but the experience was somewhat impersonal and detached, making me feel as if we were on a conveyor belt along with the many other pets, doctors and staff that were running around this clinic. Several weeks ago Chai was afflicted with vestibular disease which devastated me, and was also difficult for Chai, needless to say. After a lengthy internet search for a clinic I could feel comfortable with we arrived at Dr. Nook's. Treatment for this disease requires office visits one/two times a week for several months, so we have been working with Dr. Nook for a couple months now. I could go on at length about Dr. Nook and staff, but instead tell you that I am thoroughly satisficed and comfortable with her and the clinic, and would highly recommend Dr. Nook if in the need of veterinary care while in CM.
0x30da3009af68cb8f_0x25d8153a586d6f04.author: Brian Meyers

0x30da3009af68cb8f_0x25d8153a586d6f04.text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly Recommended! We recently left our poodle Vader at this animal clinic while we were away, and I couldn’t be happier with the care he received. You can truly see how well they looked after him — he came home happy, relaxed, and clearly comfortable from his stay. The staff treated him like their own. They gave regular updates, made sure he was safe, well-fed, and cared for, and they even paid attention to his little quirks and habits. It’s such a relief knowing that Vader was in a warm, friendly environment instead of feeling stressed or lonely. Thank you to everyone at the clinic for taking such good care of our boy. We will definitely trust you again the next time we travel. Highly recommended for pet owners who want peace of mind while they’re away! 🐾❤️ — Vader’s Owner
0x30da3009af68cb8f_0x25d8153a586d6f04.author: Christine Almonte

0x30da3009af68cb8f_0x25d8153a586d6f04.text: If you take your pet (my cat, in my case) to Chiang Mai and something goes wrong with it, go here! They are kind and explain exactly what to do in great detail! I failed the rabies antibody test I had done in Korea, so I had the test done here here, just like in Bangkok, Thailand. (Of course, I received the rabies shot at this clinic a month before the test.) I had my blood drawn a month after the rabies shot, and 25 days later, I received the rabies antibody test results for entry into Korea. When departing, you come to this clinic to get a health certificate (700 baht), then go to the Chiang Mai Quarantine Office and hand over your prepared documents to receive an exit permit (250 baht). See the photo below for the documents you need to prepare.
0x30da3009af68cb8f_0x25d8153a586d6f04.author: 홍콩쾌남

0x30da3009af68cb8f_0x25d8153a586d6f04.text: I have no words to explain how much I love Dr Nook and her team. They have saved the life of my cat after a wrong diagnosis by another vet, and made me feel at ease from the moment I reached out to them. Staff are caring, polite, great English and highly competent. I knew exactly what I was paying and was informed about the step by step treatment plans throughout. The team were one of the best surgery’s I have every visited in Thailand for their care and attention, and I’ve lived in the country over 20 years now. If you are in Chiang Mai, there is really no better practice (even the ones that claim to be). If you have a sick pet, both short term or long term issues, this is the place to come.
0x30da3009af68cb8f_0x25d8153a586d6f04.author: Kel Willis

0x30da3009af68cb8f_0x25d8153a586d6f04.text: Veterinary staff is knowledgeable and explain the medical treatment clearly(make sure you give all symptoms and ask relevant questions) in English. They don't try to upsell you on unnecessary treatments and sell Science Diet wet food, treats, small collars, Bravecto, med/small soft cones, animal's dental health products and more. If your furry friend requires medication they will try to help give the first dose at their office. They also wash and cut animal fur. I've had my dog washed there before and they did such a good job brushing him I genuinely thought they gave him a trim at first. **They do provide euthanasia services as well.**
0x30da3009af68cb8f_0x25d8153a586d6f04.author: D L B

0x30da3009af68cb8f_0x25d8153a586d6f04.text: We’ve been bringing Kasha to Dr Nook Animal Hospital for her arthritis care for the past year and a half, and we couldn’t be happier with the care she’s received. The vet has been incredibly professional, compassionate, and attentive to Kasha’s needs, ensuring she’s as comfortable as possible. We also trust them to look after our other two cats as it is clear they genuinely care about their well-being. We trust that our cats are in capable and caring hands, and appreciate the wonderful care they continue to provide.
0x30da3009af68cb8f_0x25d8153a586d6f04.author: Leo Chambers

0x30da3009af68cb8f_0x25d8153a586d6f04.text: I simply can't say enough good things about Dr. Nook and her staff. She has been my go to vet since we first moved to Chiang Mai eight years ago. From routine appointments for vaccinations, to annual teeth cleaning and even delicate surgery on my dog's eyelid to remove a growth, our three dogs are treated gently, and with compassion and kindness. I can always count of a quick response when I text the clinic with a question or concern and on more than one occasion, this has spared me a trip to the clinic.
0x30da3009af68cb8f_0x25d8153a586d6f04.author: Anthony James

0x30da3009af68cb8f_0x25d8153a586d6f04.text: Dr. Nook is the best vet in town! And those “in the know” know it! Whether your pet needs routine vaccinations or requires a life-saving surgery, she’s the one you want. EXCELLENT COMMUNICATION skills in Thai and English, combined with STELLAR CLINICAL EXPERTISE are what sets her apart from the rest. She is also compassionate in matters involving end-of-life treatment. Look no further!
0x30da3009af68cb8f_0x25d8153a586d6f04.author: Bronte Browning

0x311d6713a162104f_0x4d7810046ccad536.text: The vet was incredibly skilled and thorough. They explained everything clearly and comprehensively. The vet and staff seemed to love animals very much and took excellent care of our dog. 💗🙏🏻 We were very impressed. Our dog had a tumor in her mouth, so we took her for a checkup. The vet examined her oral cavity and recommended a tartar removal as well. The examination was very thorough beforehand because our dog is older (13 years old). We were very worried before the procedure, but everything went well. The vet was truly amazing. Highly recommend! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
0x311d6713a162104f_0x4d7810046ccad536.author: Thanwarat S

0x311d6713a162104f_0x4d7810046ccad536.text: Pingping came for teeth cleaning and tooth extraction. The doctor and nurses were very kind and explained everything clearly, which greatly reduced my anxiety. At first, I was very worried because she only weighs 1.3 kg, but she recovered very quickly. After recovering, she was cheerful and not withdrawn at all. The wound healed very quickly, and she ate well. Thank you to the doctor and nurses for taking such good care of Pingping. This picture was taken after she got home; she happily played with her toys.
0x311d6713a162104f_0x4d7810046ccad536.author: Mia Nana

0x311d6713a162104f_0x4d7810046ccad536.text: Before my daughter Brownie's teeth fell out, she had terrible bad breath for a long time. She had watery eyes and difficulty breathing, and we couldn't find the cause anywhere else. We came here, and the problem was solved. Dr. Nun gave us the right explanation, and she was incredibly skilled and kind. She really seemed to love my daughter. This clinic has become my favorite; she's a true expert in dental care and provides excellent overall care. I'm so glad we found this place!
0x311d6713a162104f_0x4d7810046ccad536.author: Thanyaporn SIRITHAMKHANTI

0x311d6713a162104f_0x4d7810046ccad536.text: Great doctor and staff, very friendly and answered my concerns patiently. Went to get my boy’s teeth checked and used their grooming services. The check-up was much more thorough than other places we’ve been to. She also demonstrated how to correctly and effectively brush his teeth. Pricing was also very affordable. Sometimes they get a bit busy and won’t get to pick up phone calls, but they will call back or you could message them on Facebook as well.
0x311d6713a162104f_0x4d7810046ccad536.author: Soundy Vejasilp

0x311d6713a162104f_0x4d7810046ccad536.text: I brought my Corgi in for a dental checkup because a permanent tooth had fallen out. The vet checked his teeth, especially for tartar buildup, and took X-rays to examine the tooth roots. Dr. Nun is kind, an expert in veterinary dentistry, attentive, answered all my questions, and taught me the correct way to brush his teeth. The place is beautiful, clean, and well-equipped. Highly recommend! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
0x311d6713a162104f_0x4d7810046ccad536.author: Patty Santana (Rinnypinny)

0x311d6713a162104f_0x4d7810046ccad536.text: This is the best animal hospital I've ever been to. The doctors and assistants are all lovely and friendly, and they genuinely love animals. The prices are affordable, the service is excellent, and they are very attentive. 0x30fd01c9a9793e41_0x77a0c5cf3593853a.text: I came for a Thai massage at Avani Well. The staff member, named P' Na, gave me a great massage and focused on specific areas. Before the massage, they gave me a form to fill out with my name and the specific areas of my body I wanted to focus on. I told them I wanted to focus on my neck and shoulders. After filling in the details, they took me to the massage room on the second floor. When I found the massage room, it was amazing! They use a spa massage room with a spa massage bed so I could sleep comfortably and breathe easily. They really pay attention to every detail of the customer. They start by having me lie face down, starting from my shoulders. They slowly and patiently massage my shoulders and back until both sides are done. Then, they apply a hot compress, making me feel even more comfortable and relaxed. In addition to the comfortable shoulder massage, they also massage other parts of my body, such as my legs and arms. The pressure was excellent. I fell asleep during the massage and woke up feeling recharged. After the massage, the staff member served tea in different colors for the day. We went on Saturday and it was roselle tea. The tea was delicious and fragrant and they came with two small snacks. Overall, I really like this spa. It's worth the price for the massage. I felt that it really hit the aching spots and relieved the pain. The staff member is really attentive and dedicated to the massage. I'm telling you, I definitely have to come back here again.
0x30fd01c9a9793e41_0x77a0c5cf3593853a.author: Hattaya Hattaya

0x30fd01c9a9793e41_0x77a0c5cf3593853a.text: I had the pleasure of receiving an aromatherapy massage from therapist Wi, and it was truly a rejuvenating experience. The soothing blend of aromatic oils enhanced the experience, creating a calm and tranquil atmosphere that allowed me to fully unwind. Wi’s attention to detail and gentle yet effective approach made a noticeable difference in relieving my tight muscles. She intuitively knew exactly where to focus, ensuring a deeply satisfying massage. If you’re looking for a skilled therapist who combines professional expertise with a soothing touch, I highly recommend Wi. Her dedication to creating a relaxing and therapeutic experience is unmatched. I’ll definitely be returning for another session!

0x30e299a07690dc63_0x230d8b2053c4bda1.text: Today, I had my first visit with Dr. Sam in Bangkok. I’ve been dealing with lower right back pain for years from playing ice hockey and trying to play golf. A year ago, I had an MRI done in Colombia, but two different doctors gave me two different diagnoses. After just one visit with Dr. Sam, he was able to pinpoint the exact issue—and it wasn’t my lower back or spine, as previously thought. Shockingly, Dr. Sam discovered a rare problem common among soccer and golf players: a misaligned floating rib on my right side, likely due to being right-handed. I was genuinely impressed by his thoroughness and expertise. It’s refreshing to have a real doctor who prioritizes quality over quantity when it comes to patient care. He took the time to get it right, and I walked out pain-free. Dr. Sam is the real deal. Hopefully, I won’t need to see you again, Dr. Sam—but if I do, it’ll be by appointment only! Regards, Wayne Carlson (@CaboWayne)

0x30e299a07690dc63_0x230d8b2053c4bda1.text: I had a couple of appointments with Dr. Samuel Adams who did spinal adjustments and with the physical therapist lady, who helped me with massage, stretching, electrical stimulation and ultrasound therapy. My case was I had lower back pain and stiffness for about the last 10 years of my life, and recently that started to affect also my upper back. I am most thankful for Dr. Sam and especially also to the physical therapist lady. She did such an amazing work, and was very friendly as well, just like Dr. Sam. The treatments have completely resolved my lower back and upper back pain. I also found out on my own that I was not properly stretching, especially the abdominal muscles. Today I happily say that I am without any pain. I can bend forward, I can jump and land on the feet without having pain on my lower back. I just want to say how much I appreciate you guys. God bless you clinic.

0x30e299a07690dc63_0x230d8b2053c4bda1.text: I’ve been seeing Dr Sam at Family Chiropractic on trips to Bangkok since 2018 and can highly recommend this chiropractor. As ever the treatment was so good and apart from a little tightness the next day, the main issue was resolved without further pain in nearly a month. If you have sciatica, back or neck pain or other muscular or nerve pain, I highly recommend Dr Sam.

0x311d618d8ab606b1_0x44f69f47aa949313.text: Positively great experience at Wish Dental Clinic…I’m am American from California and come to Thailand often for all sorts of (the right) reasons and happened to need some dental work done. I feel so fortunate to have found this clinic. Basically I needed new retainers and thought why not just have my teeth cleaned since they were almost due, therefore negating the same thing in the Bay Area with my usual (I.e. insurance plan) dentist who I never thought was actually truly good. Proceeded to absolutely get the best, most thorough, cleaning I’d ever had. The doctor (Dr. Mick, and hope the spelling’s correct) saw that restorations that were done several years ago were not in good condition which I sort of suspected because I could actually feel rough edges. This was not something my regular dentist back home even once mentioned and I’d seen her less than 9 months ago. Dr. (speaking English) explained exactly what was going on with my teeth and showed me with the X-rays they had just taken and with a mirror so I could see directly…and, or course what he could do (very honestly) to re-restore seven teeth needing work. Instinctively I completely trusted him and his professional expertise…one just knows that they are in totally capable hands. We scheduled the appointment, I went back and could not be happier…Dr. showed me the procedure step-by-step in a mirror as each tooth was being done and gave me a little education on dentistry that NO dentist had ever come close to doing…He’s a true professional that clearly enjoys practicing dentistry. Even though I reside in Palo Alto, California, my new dentist is here in Bangkok, Thailand…I see him again in November for another cleaning and check up. Hopes this helps with anyone’s search for awesome dental care. Two days later I returned to Wish Dental Clinic to receive my new retainers. It was an another great visit…Dr. Mick tested the fit which was perfect and instructed me how to place them and take them out properly. He had me do it a couple of times to insure I did it right. He explained proper cleaning, storage and what could ruin them. I also got whitening gel which he also throughly explained the use of and how much whitening I should expect over how long. Again, I could have dreamed of receiving better dental care from Dr. Mick and his staff…I’ll wear the retainers tonight and if there are any issues (which I highly doubt) Dr. Mick wants to know so that they can be brought to the clinic and made perfect. Wish Dental Clinic is more than I could have ever wished for, and I feel super blessed to have found them!
