0x30fdb3a938c627b7_0xe397df4a0a312714.text: We brought our child to this hospital because we read impressive reviews about the kind and friendly doctor who explained everything before and after the cherry eye surgery, even the medication details, and the attentive follow-up. We were also amazed by the reasonable and affordable cost of the surgery. The staff were all lovely. It's a small but clean and quiet hospital, easy to find. My husband and I will be regular patients for our children.
0x30fdb3a938c627b7_0xe397df4a0a312714.author: moo tot

0x30fdb3a938c627b7_0xe397df4a0a312714.text: The vet was so kind! I just took my cat there for treatment. The injection was very gentle and quick. Normally, my cat hisses at people who get close or try to touch him; he's hissed at every clinic except this one. The price was surprisingly cheap! Two injections, one vial of eye drops, and they even gave us three packets of medication. It was very affordable. I highly recommend this clinic! 🐶🐱🧑🏼‍⚕️
0x30fdb3a938c627b7_0xe397df4a0a312714.author: Ananya Jronram

0x30fdb3a938c627b7_0xe397df4a0a312714.text: The vet was very kind and gave great advice regarding symptoms, care, and importantly, the price. They explained the reasons behind the cost in a way that made it easy to understand. The vet was very patient with the animals, and the price was reasonable and understandable.
0x30fdb3a938c627b7_0xe397df4a0a312714.author: OUZANEE ONNUAM

0x30fdb3a938c627b7_0xe397df4a0a312714.text: We came here during our holiday because one of our dogs was showing signs of eye pain. We arrived, and helped us immediately. They were so kind and sweet. Especially the vet. Thank you so much for helping our little Sachi. Highly recommended. ❤️❤️❤️
0x30fdb3a938c627b7_0xe397df4a0a312714.author: July Roseco

0x30fdb3a938c627b7_0xe397df4a0a312714.text: I read reviews that it was good, so I took my cat to get his ears checked. The doctor was lovely, explained everything in detail, made it easy to understand, and gave good advice. The staff were very friendly.
0x30fdb3a938c627b7_0xe397df4a0a312714.author: soraya2 nakpong

0x30fdb3a938c627b7_0xe397df4a0a312714.text: The doctor and staff were very lovely. They gave great advice, the prices were affordable, and it was easily accessible. The service was just like being in a real clinic. I was very impressed.
0x30fdb3a938c627b7_0xe397df4a0a312714.author: พิชญ์พิมล เพ็ชรแก้ว

0x30fdb3a938c627b7_0xe397df4a0a312714.text: The place is clean. The doctor is very kind and takes good care of the dogs. He explains everything in detail and seems willing to help. The price is reasonable and he is very attentive.
0x30fdb3a938c627b7_0xe397df4a0a312714.author: Mike Life

0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.text: Other than my basic TDAP boosters [covered by my insurance stateside(USA)], which I received at a Walgreens [George Dieter & Pebble Hills, El PasoTX-USA] walk-in, I knew that the following travel shots/jabs [yellow fever, Japanese encephalitis, typhoid, rabies] would be muy caro/very expensive—unless obtained overseas. Other than a quick layover in Shanghai to ride the World-famous MAGLEV, ChiangmaiTHAILAND was my destination. My primary objective was visiting family, but also to finish the injections. The only place I could get the (lifetime) Yellow Fever shot/jab was in the Capital, Bangkok. After arrival there, it took me most of the day (11OCT2018) to figure out how to get to this FANTASTIC hospital/travel clinic. Fortunately, I had ample assistance, beginning with my first stop, Red Cross. The nurse not only gave me oral directions, but she also gave me an excellent map to my next location, adjacent to the snake house. Unfortunately, they were out of the Yellow Fever vaccine, but readily gave me excellent directions to the Hospital for Tropical Diseases. Using the highly efficient BTS elevated trains, I was soon at registering at this hospital and then whisked upstairs to the travel clinic where the Yellow Fever shot was administered. I did have to wait another 45 minutes afterwards to ensure no immediate (bad) reaction to it (there is a very slim chance that “older” people can die from it), but heck, life itself is a risk! Besides less cost, my valid passport was also required to ensure all paperwork/documentation was correct. I am so thankful & grateful to this clinic, hospital and all Thai—THANK YOU! You certainly have my enthusiastic “Wheel of Approval!”
0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.author: John “Juanito Hayburg” Eyberg

0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.text: Today I went for my vaccination. The doctor took a thorough medical history before the injection and provided excellent advice, demonstrating true medical ethics (unlike some private hospitals where people act more like salespeople getting commissions). The doctor explained and analyzed the situation clearly, which I found very impressive. The nursing staff were also efficient and provided good service. However, the finance department doesn't yet have a scanning payment system; you have to use a credit card, debit card, or cash. Booking online was very convenient. Upon arrival, there was already a list of those who had booked. I just needed to fill out a few additional forms. Actually, you can fill it out online or print it out and complete it. The parking in the building was always full. I had to park at the valet parking lot next door, which is an apartment building. It cost 40 baht for the whole day. I circled around 4-5 times before I found a parking spot. 😅
0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.author: Ying Onarnin

0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.text: You can come here as a foreigner without health insurance and they will accept you as a walk-in! Some of the staff speak just enough English to communicate the registration process (which can be done online via QR code when you arrive). Came specifically for the Thai Travel Clinic on the third floor to treat diarrhea. They’ll ask for a stool sample and have it analyzed in an hour. Afterwards the doctor can discuss your results with you and prescribe the necessary antibiotics and oral rehydration salts. At the time of this review, the visit cost around 500 baht and the medication cost around 500 baht, so you should expect to pay around $30-40 USD if you are needing treatment for food poisoning or something similar. You can pay with Visa! Highly recommended for foreigners who need a walk-in clinic on a short notice.
0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.author: Frienditas

0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.text: Schedule services online or walk-in during clinic hours for travel-related medical care including a wide range of vaccines (influenza, COVID-19, rabies, hep A and B, yellow fever, you name it they probably offer it), traveler’s diarrhea, malaria and other ailments, at this efficiently run university-managed clinic. Clinic is on the 3rd floor, accessible by lift. Staff on each floor are very helpful directing visitors to where they need to go. Consultation with physician is included with all services, even vaccinations. Cash or card payment accepted. Service was very prompt even for walk-in patients like myself. On the way out you will encounter food stalls with enticing offerings, as well as a canteen that serves staff and visitors alike.
0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.author: P W

0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.text: I came here from Canada to get the Japanese Encephalitis (JE) and rabies vaccines. I booked my appointment online and arrived 30 minutes early, but they took me in right away. Everyone speaks English, so communication was very easy. The doctors are kind and helpful and took the time to answer all of my questions and concerns. The clinic is very organized and efficient. The price is also very reasonable - for two shots including all fees, I paid the equivalent of CAD 70. I need a second rabies shot, and they simply advised me to book online again - it only takes a couple of minutes. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking to get vaccines that are difficult or impossible to access back home.
0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.author: Aimee V

0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.text: I visited the clinic for vaccination and had made a reservation online in advance, so everything went smoothly. First, I checked in and ① filled out and submitted a medical questionnaire. ② I had a consultation with the doctor to decide on the vaccine. At this time, I told them where I was visiting so they could give me advice. In my case, it was PAK. ③ I paid after deciding on the vaccine; credit card payment is accepted. ④ I received five doses of the vaccine (one in each arm). ⑥ After vaccination, I had a consultation and waited for 30 minutes. The website clearly states the cost of the vaccine and consultation, so I recommend it for its transparent pricing.
0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.author: M Maro

0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.text: Excellent service - Anyone who is worried about getting vaccinations abroad, don't be, this clinic had far more information than we were provided with in the UK (Check out their website). All the staff were very helpful, accommodating and professional. We each received 4 vaccines (JE, Rabies, Influenza, Hep B) after discussing the various ones we might need for our trip across South East Asia with their team. I worked out it was roughly 10 times cheaper than getting them in the UK.
0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.author: Matty

0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.text: The nurses provided good service and were polite. The price was okay. However, our only issue was the day we went to see Dr. Phil, who was selling medication. We intended to get a chickenpox vaccine, but when we saw him, he tried to sell us …
0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.author: Rung Nirattakarn

0x30e29909061f0847_0xd8e1350ebd465321.text: Before getting braces, I had problems with crooked and overlapping teeth. I had some teeth extracted and am now getting braces from Dr. Sup. I've been getting braces for over a year and I'm very impressed with how well the doctor and staff take care of me. I can ask questions anytime I have concerns. My lower teeth that were overlapping moved into place quickly, and my upper teeth that protruded a lot also improved. My teeth are moving quickly, the doctor is gentle, and he explains the process and the appliance attachment process in detail. The clinic is also very clean.
0x30e29909061f0847_0xd8e1350ebd465321.author: Nattaya Darin

0x30e29909061f0847_0xd8e1350ebd465321.text: I had a problem with spaced teeth. Initially, I got braces because my teeth were spaced apart and slightly protruding, which made me feel self-conscious when I smiled.😅 I got braces here, and the doctor explained the treatment plan clearly and provided excellent care at every adjustment appointment. Now, after more than a year of treatment, my teeth are much straighter, the gaps have closed significantly, and the protrusion has improved. I can smile with much more confidence. Overall, I'm very impressed and feel like I made the right decision.
0x30e29909061f0847_0xd8e1350ebd465321.author: sasitorn rairub

0x30e29909061f0847_0xd8e1350ebd465321.text: ประทับใจการบริการของคลินิกทันตกรรมแห่งนี้มากตั้งแต่ก้าวแรกที่เข้ามา คุณหมอทวิตให้คำแนะนำดีมาก อธิบายปัญหาและทางเลือกในการรักษาอย่างเข้าใจง่าย ไม่เร่ง ไม่ขาย รู้สึกได้ถึงความเป็นมืออาชีพและความใส่ใจคนไข้จริง ๆ เจ้าหน้าที่หน้าเคาน์เตอร์ให้การต้อนรับดี ยิ้มแย้ม ให้คำแนะนำชัดเจน อธิบายขั้นตอนต่าง ๆ อย่างละเอียด ทำให้รู้สึกสบายใจตั้งแต่เริ่ม ผู้ช่วยทันตแพทย์ดูแลดีมาก ใส่ใจในรายละเอียด คอยถามอาการตลอด ไม่รู้สึกเกร็งหรือกังวลระหว่างการรักษา เป็นคลินิกที่ให้ความรู้สึกอบอุ่น มั่นใจ และอยากกลับมาใช้บริการอีกแน่นอน
0x30e29909061f0847_0xd8e1350ebd465321.author: นิวบอนมอ จ้า
0x30e29909061f0847_0xd8e1350ebd465321.en: I was very impressed with the service at this dental clinic from the moment I stepped in. Dr. Wit gave excellent advice, explaining the problem and treatment options in an easy-to-understand way. He wasn't rushed or pushy; I could really feel his professionalism and genuine care for the patient. The front desk staff were welcoming, smiling, and provided clear instructions, explaining each step in detail, making me feel comfortable from the start. The dental assistants were very attentive, paying attention to detail and constantly checking on my condition. I didn't feel nervous or anxious during the treatment. It's a clinic that gives you a warm, confident feeling, and I definitely want to return for their services again.

0x30e29909061f0847_0xd8e1350ebd465321.text: ตั้งแต่มาทำที่นี่ครั้งแรกแล้วติดใจเลยค่ะ 🥰 พนักงานทุกคนน่ารักมาก บริการเกินร้อย ดูแลเหมือนคนในครอบครัวเลย คุณหมอพูดจาดีมากๆเลย ใจเย็น อธิบายละเอียด ไม่เร่งรีบ มือเบามากจนแทบไม่รู้สึกเจ็บเลยค่ะ จากที่เคยกลัวหมอฟัน ตอนนี้รู้สึกสบายใจขึ้นมาก ใครที่กำลังลังเล แนะนำเลยค่ะ ที่นี่ทั้งบริการดี คุณหมอเก่ง น้องๆผู้ช่วยช่วยเลือกสียางตลอดเลยค่ะเพราะเราตัดสินใจไม่ค่อยจะได้ฮ่าๆๆๆ ที่สำคัญบรรยากาศดีมาก บางเดือนอาจจะรอนานหน่อยค่ะ แต่ไม่ซีเลยนั่งชิวๆไป🤍✨ ใครอยากทำแนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะ เราจัดฟันกับคุณหมอซุปนะคะ💐
0x30e29909061f0847_0xd8e1350ebd465321.author: Wan Rd
0x30e29909061f0847_0xd8e1350ebd465321.en: I've been hooked since my first visit here! 🥰 All the staff are so lovely, the service is beyond excellent, and they treat you like family. The dentist is incredibly kind, patient, explains everything in detail, and is very gentle – I barely felt any pain. I used to be afraid of dentists, but now I feel so much more comfortable. If you're hesitant about getting braces, I highly recommend this place. The service is great, the dentist is skilled, and the assistants are always happy to help you choose the perfect rubber band color because I have trouble deciding, haha! Most importantly, the atmosphere is fantastic. There might be a bit of a wait in some months, but it's not a big deal; you can just relax and chill. 🤍✨ I highly recommend this place for anyone considering orthodontics. I got my braces done with Dr. Sup. 💐

0x30e29909061f0847_0xd8e1350ebd465321.text: Before getting braces, I lacked confidence in my smile because my lower teeth overlapped my upper teeth, making it look bad. After my teeth were straightened, my smile became so bright! I got braces from Dr. May, who is very kind and easy to talk to about anything I didn't like. The clinic is clean and trustworthy. 💖🦷 Today I came for teeth cleaning and wisdom tooth extraction with Dr. Ong. He is very kind, gentle, and it didn't hurt at all. He gave great advice on everything.
0x30e29909061f0847_0xd8e1350ebd465321.author: Achita Inthasut

0x30e29909061f0847_0xd8e1350ebd465321.text: I had problems with gaps between my teeth, protruding teeth, and an unattractive smile. A friend recommended this clinic, so I came for a consultation about orthodontics. I had my braces done by Dr. An and I was very impressed. Dr. An is lovely, patient, gentle, and provides excellent advice and consultation. The clinic is clean, and the staff and assistants are wonderful and provide excellent service. I highly recommend this clinic. Thank you so much!
0x30e29909061f0847_0xd8e1350ebd465321.author: Penprapa Krufong

0x30e29909061f0847_0xd8e1350ebd465321.text: I’ve recently visited the clinic. Totally satisfied with the experience. Paid 950 baht for tartar removal. Paid in cash because they don’t accept visa. The staff and the doctor are able to speak English. Didn’t wait too long to get the procedure, despite the fact i didn’t have an appointment. The procedure was done carefully and rapidly. I would recommend this place. Probably one thing to improve is to add an option to pay via foreign bank cards.
0x30e29909061f0847_0xd8e1350ebd465321.author: Volkov Evgenii

0x30e29909061f0847_0xd8e1350ebd465321.text: I got my braces done here because my front teeth protruded and my lower teeth were crooked. I'm seeing Dr. Sup. She's lovely and kind. I've been using her services for two years now, and my teeth are straightening very quickly. They're already starting to align beautifully. I'm very impressed. The clinic is clean, the air conditioning is nice and cool, and the doctor is very gentle. I love it! I love Som Clinic 🧡
0x30e29909061f0847_0xd8e1350ebd465321.author: P araya

0x311d5dd554545423_0x55f082c9c592a2d9.text: ใช้สิทธิบัตรทอง30บาทมาทำฟันกะแฟนครั้งแรกที่นี่, สะดวกมาก เจ้าหน้าที่ช่วยโหลดแอปและทำข้อมูลให้, คุณหมอผู้ชายใจดีมาก พูดจาไพเราะ ทำให้หายเกร็งไปเยอะเลย มือก็เบา ใช้เวลาทำไม่นานมาก, ที่จอดรถส่วนตัวได้ซัก10คัน, ขอบคุณมากๆครับ วันนี้มาอุดฟันครั้งที่2, สะดวก รวดเร็ว คุณหมอใจดีเหมือนเดิม, แนะนำเลยครับ
0x311d5dd554545423_0x55f082c9c592a2d9.author: Suchat Komutphan
0x311d5dd554545423_0x55f082c9c592a2d9.en: I used my 30-baht universal healthcare card for my first dental visit here with my girlfriend. It was very convenient. The staff helped download the app and fill out the information. The male dentist was very kind and spoke politely, which made me feel much less nervous. He was gentle and the procedure didn't take long. There's private parking for about 10 cars. Thank you very much! Today I came for my second filling. It was convenient and fast, and the dentist was just as kind. I highly recommend this clinic!

0x311d5dd554545423_0x55f082c9c592a2d9.text: มาอุดฟันที่นี่ 3 ครั้งแล้วค่ะ ใช้สิทธิ์ 30 บาท เจ้าหน้าที่ ให้คำแนะนำ และตอบคำถาม ที่ซักถามไป คุณหมอก็น่ารักใจดี คลินิก กว้างขวางและสะอาด เครื่องมือแพทย์ก็ทันสมัย โดยรวมดีมากค่ะ
0x311d5dd554545423_0x55f082c9c592a2d9.en: I've had fillings here 3 times already, using my 30-baht health insurance. The staff gave good advice and answered all my questions. The dentist is lovely and kind. The clinic is spacious and clean, and the medical equipment is modern. Overall, it's very good.

0x311d5dd554545423_0x55f082c9c592a2d9.text: บุคลากรที่นี่น่ารักทุกคนเลย ใจดี พูดจาน่ารักมากกก รับสิทธิ์บัตรทองด้วย คุณหมอมือเบามาก กลายเป็นคลินิกประจำไปแล้วค่ะ พายายมาจากต่างจังหวัดก็มาถอนฟันที่นี่ค่ะ
0x311d5dd554545423_0x55f082c9c592a2d9.author: suthinan somsri
0x311d5dd554545423_0x55f082c9c592a2d9.en: All the staff here are lovely, kind, and very polite. They accept the government health insurance card too. The dentist is very gentle. This has become my regular clinic. I even brought my grandmother from out of town to get a tooth extracted here.

0x311d5dd554545423_0x55f082c9c592a2d9.text: มาใช้สิทธิบัตรทอง มีที่จอดรถสะดวกสบาย สะอาดกว้างขวาง คุณหมอใจดี เจ้าหน้าที่ให้บริการด้วยความใส่ใจ ประทับใจครับ
0x311d5dd554545423_0x55f082c9c592a2d9.en: I used my universal healthcare benefits. There's convenient parking, the place is clean and spacious. The doctor is kind, and the staff are attentive. I'm very impressed.

0x311d5dd554545423_0x55f082c9c592a2d9.text: คลินิกทำฟันดีดีคุณหมอมือเบามากเลยค่ะพนักงานต้อนรับหน้าตายิ้มแย้มแจ่มใสร้านสะอาดสะอ้านสุดยอดเลยค่ะ
0x311d5dd554545423_0x55f082c9c592a2d9.en: This dental clinic is excellent; the dentist is very gentle, the reception staff are friendly and cheerful, and the clinic is spotlessly clean.

0x311d5dd554545423_0x55f082c9c592a2d9.text: มีที่จอดรถสะดวกสบาย ร้านสะอาดกว้างขวาง คุณหมอใจดี เจ้าหน้าที่ให้บริการด้วยความใส่ใจ ประทับใจครับ
0x311d5dd554545423_0x55f082c9c592a2d9.en: There is convenient parking. The clinic is clean and spacious. The doctor is kind, and the staff provides attentive service. I was very impressed.

0x311d5dd554545423_0x55f082c9c592a2d9.text: A dental clinic that offers great value, excellent service, and a clean, hygienic environment.
0x311d5dd554545423_0x55f082c9c592a2d9.author: Nadiar T.

0x311d5dd554545423_0x55f082c9c592a2d9.text: จองคิวตอนเช้า ตอนเที่ยงมารอทำฟันได้เลย สะดวกดี หมอให้คำแนำนำดี เพราะก่อนมามีความกลัวการถอนฟัน
0x311d5dd554545423_0x55f082c9c592a2d9.en: I booked an appointment for the morning and arrived at noon to have my dental work done. It was very convenient. The doctor gave good advice, which was helpful because I was afraid of tooth extraction before coming.

0x311d5f0905081fdb_0x993bcdde561c99dc.text: I had my wisdom tooth extracted by Dr. Jenkrit, a specialist. I chose the minimally invasive technique (no gum incision), which was excellent. There's no surgical scar, no stitches to remove, and recovery is very fast. Importantly, Dr. Jenkrit is incredibly skilled and the procedure didn't take long. He has excellent communication skills and is very good with patients. If you're looking for a clinic for wisdom tooth extraction, I highly recommend this one.
0x311d5f0905081fdb_0x993bcdde561c99dc.author: Narath Suchada

0x311d5f0905081fdb_0x993bcdde561c99dc.text: I've been avoiding dental work for a long time! I finally found a gentle and kind dentist. I highly recommend her. I got my fillings done by Dr. Am, and I'll be back next year to get my wisdom teeth removed. There's another dentist who specializes in wisdom teeth treatment as well.
0x311d5f0905081fdb_0x993bcdde561c99dc.author: Naan Tan

0x311d5f0905081fdb_0x993bcdde561c99dc.text: I went to get my teeth cleaned (tartar removed). The dentist was very gentle; it hardly hurt at all. The procedure didn't take long, and the dentist let me know which teeth might be painful beforehand. I used to be afraid of teeth cleaning, but now I'm not scared anymore! 😊 …
0x311d5f0905081fdb_0x993bcdde561c99dc.author: Gik Pran

0x311d5f0905081fdb_0x993bcdde561c99dc.text: I came based on reviews; the clinic is lovely. The doctor has a gentle touch. 0x30e29d0058033a13_0xba52e4f2c9c714d1.text: เป็นคนที่กลัวการถอนฟันมากกกก ตอนเด็กๆวิ่งหนีคุณหมอเพราะไม่อยากถอนฟันแต่เลือกที่นี่เพราะใกล้บ้านและดูจากรีวิว พอได้มาใช้บริการ ก็เป็นตามที่รีวิวเลย คลินิกสะอาด ตกแต่งสวยงามพนักงานหน้าเคาเตอร์แนะนำดีบริการสุภาพมาก คุณหมอให้คำแนะนำดีมากค่ะ บอกขั้นตอนการทำตลอดคลายความกังวลได้ดี ปกติจะแค่ขูดหินปูนปีละ 1-2 ครั้ง ใช้สิทธิ์ข้าราชการตามโรงพยาบาลรัฐทั่วไป ครั้งนี้เป็นการผ่าฟันคุดเลยเลือกใช้บริการที่คลินิกค่ะ เพราะความกลัวมากๆ ประทับใจค่ะ ราคาเหมาะสม ครั้งต่อไปขูดหินปูนใช้บริการกับที่นี่อีกแน่นอนค่ะ
0x30e29d0058033a13_0xba52e4f2c9c714d1.author: Linda Lokhansa
0x30e29d0058033a13_0xba52e4f2c9c714d1.en: I'm someone who is terrified of tooth extraction. When I was a child, I would run away from the dentist because I didn't want to have teeth removed. But I chose this clinic because it's close to home and I saw good reviews. When I finally used their services, it was exactly as the reviews described. The clinic is clean, beautifully decorated, and the front desk staff were very helpful and polite. The dentist gave excellent advice and explained the procedure step-by-step, which greatly eased my anxiety. Normally, I only get tartar removed 1-2 times a year using my government employee benefits at a regular public hospital. This time, it was for wisdom tooth extraction, so I chose this clinic because of my extreme fear. I'm very impressed. The price is reasonable. I will definitely use their services again for my next tartar removal.

0x30e29d0058033a13_0xba52e4f2c9c714d1.text: ไม่ชอบเข้าคลินิกทำฟัน จนหินปูนสะสมเป็นคราบเหลือง คนรอบตัวทักจนต้องมาขูดหินปูน คุณหมอและทีมผู้ช่วย รวมถึงพี่รีเซปชั่น น่ารักมาก บริการดี เปิดใจให้คนไม่ชอบคลินิกทำฟันแบบเรา มันสบายใจ ระหว่างทำคอยบอกตลอด ใกล้เสร็ตแล้ว ไม่ต้องเกร็ง(คือบอดี้มันเผบอเกร็งไปเองงงงง) หายใจตามสบายนะคะ แถมคุณหมอแนะนำดีมากๆ ทั้งใช้ไหมจัดฟัน สอนแม้กระทั้งวิธีแปรงฟัน แนะนำเลยค่า มีที่จอดรถ เลิศเลยล่ะ
0x30e29d0058033a13_0xba52e4f2c9c714d1.author: The Chu
0x30e29d0058033a13_0xba52e4f2c9c714d1.en: I hate going to the dentist, and my tartar built up so much that people started commenting on it, so I finally had to get it removed. The dentist, the assistants, and the receptionist were all so lovely and provided excellent service. They were so open-minded and understanding, especially for someone like me who dislikes dental clinics. It was so relaxing. During the procedure, they kept telling me things like, "It's almost finished, don't be nervous" (my body was unintentionally tense!), and "breathe comfortably." The dentist also gave great advice, explaining how to use floss and even how to brush my teeth properly. I highly recommend this clinic! There's also parking available, which is great.

0x30e29d0058033a13_0xba52e4f2c9c714d1.text: The doctors were very kind and professional. The dentist was very gentle and explained everything step by step. I'm usually very scared of dentists and the injection but after visiting the clinic I don't feel so scared anymore. It didn't hurt at all and the dentist dis an amazing job. I would highly recommend this dental clinic for everyone.

Exceptionally clean. Polite and professional staff who also work quickly and efficiently. The waiting area is nicely cooled and the furniture is very comfortable. Highly recommend as a foreigner in Thailand, although you may need a friend or Google to help you translate some more complicated concepts for those who do not speak Thai.

0x30e29ed25bcd523f_0x64feaa901f070913.text: I've been here for a long time and it's been great. It's easy to get to, located right across from the Chulalongkorn University Bookstore. They offer a variety of procedures. I've had filler and Botox injections, acne treatment, and mustache laser treatments at this clinic. Most recently, I brought my girlfriend here for Volnewmer, and it was amazing! It lifted my face to the max. I was so impressed from the first step I took. I've been using the clinic for three years now. I love it! Dr. Tank gave me detailed consultations, explained the procedures, and explained how to care for my skin after each procedure, making me feel comfortable and confident every step of the way. The prices are reasonable and affordable. The clinic is very clean, brightly colored, and the equipment is new and well-maintained. All the staff are polite, smiling, and attentive to detail. The procedures are professional and never rushed, making me feel truly cared for. Overall, it was a great experience. Perfect for anyone looking for a clinic specializing in filler injections, acne treatment, mustache laser treatments, or other procedures. I highly recommend it! 👌
0x30e29ed25bcd523f_0x64feaa901f070913.author: Benjarong Roongmaneekul

0x30e29ed25bcd523f_0x64feaa901f070913.text: I had a wonderful experience at Dermatiks Clinic. From the moment I walked in, the staff was incredibly welcoming and accommodating. The clinic itself is extremely clean, modern, and very professional, which immediately made me feel comfortable and confident in their care. Tong at the front desk was absolutely amazing. She speaks excellent English and has such a positive, warm, and friendly energy that made the entire experience even better. She was very helpful and made sure everything went smoothly. Dr. Tank was outstanding. He took the time to answer all of my questions and explained everything clearly. He was very professional and extremely gentle while performing the procedure, and you can truly feel that he cares about his patients. The entire team did a fantastic job, and I’m very happy with my experience. I would highly recommend Dermatiks Clinic to anyone looking for quality care and a professional, welcoming environment.
0x30e29ed25bcd523f_0x64feaa901f070913.author: Eric McClure

0x30e29ed25bcd523f_0x64feaa901f070913.text: I've been a patient here for a long time, ever since I had acne until it cleared up. Now I'm getting treatments like skin tightening here because I trust the doctor's skills. Dr. Tik is a specialist and a professor of medicine. I'm confident in the safety measures. They focus on the patient's problems and needs, without pressure from salespeople trying to meet quotas like in most beauty clinics. It's conveniently located, the service is fast, and there are no long waits. I highly recommend it.
0x30e29ed25bcd523f_0x64feaa901f070913.author: Shalisa S.

0x30e29ed25bcd523f_0x64feaa901f070913.text: This is my first time in the beauty industry, and I decided to try this clinic after reading reviews. And I wasn't disappointed at all! It was totally worth it! If you're looking for a clinic for beauty treatments, I highly recommend it. From someone who is a first-time beauty enthusiast.
0x30e29ed25bcd523f_0x64feaa901f070913.author: Kanokporn Suklamoon

0x30e298b9dffe0173_0x131f4a9398eaa49b.en: The dentist and staff were lovely, and their touch was incredibly gentle. I barely felt any anesthetic during my tooth extraction. Even though it was painful, the dentist kept asking me how I was doing, finding solutions, and letting me rest. If I encountered any difficulties, the dentist would stop and find additional ways to resolve them. My case, which I described as painful, was unique compared to others. Before coming here, I had tried other clinics, but they couldn't extract my tooth. But they handled it perfectly. Excellent! Truly excellent!

0x30e298b9dffe0173_0x131f4a9398eaa49b.text: เข้ารับบริการขูดหินปูน ครั้งแรกก็ประทับใจมากๆครับ พนักงานทุกท่านสุภาพเรียบร้อย คุณหมอมือเบามากๆ สุภาพน่ารักครับ อธิบายรายละเอียดให้เข้าใจถึงสุขภาพฟันและจำเป็นต้องรักษาฟันที่ผุอย่างไร รวมถึงราคาค่าใช้จ่ายที่ต้องชำระก่อนตัดสินใจ ราคาไม่แพงอย่างที่คิดนะครับ สถานที่สะอาด ด้านหลังร้านมีที่จอดรถ คราวหน้าจะขอเป็นลูกค้าประจำอีกครับ ขอบคุณมากครับ
0x30e298b9dffe0173_0x131f4a9398eaa49b.en: My first time getting my teeth cleaned was a great experience! All the staff were polite and courteous, and the dentist was incredibly gentle and kind. They explained everything in detail about my dental health, the necessity of treating my cavities, and the cost before I made a decision. The price wasn't as expensive as I thought! The place was clean, and there's parking available at the back. I'll definitely be a regular customer next time. Thank you so much!

0x30e298b9dffe0173_0x131f4a9398eaa49b.en: I just got my teeth cleaned here for the first time today and I'm so impressed! The dentist is lovely. I had a lot of tartar (I hadn't had it cleaned in many years), but she didn't complain at all. She was very gentle, and after the procedure, I was able to eat normally without any inflammation. I highly recommend it!

0x30e298b9dffe0173_0x131f4a9398eaa49b.text: Best clinic in town. Not fake smile, they really help you and take responsibility for their work. And they discuss all with you. Thank you a lot. I never have that good experience.

Will definitely come back for more services and also introduce my friends as well.

0x30e29f52bd0fe6f9_0xa371df686285912f.text: I didn't take any photos at the clinic. The atmosphere was nice and clean. The staff were very lovely, and importantly, they didn't push sales, which made me feel comfortable during my visit. I had Botox injections in my shoulders 2 weeks …

0x30e29f52bd0fe6f9_0xa371df686285912f.text: Dropped by to have a drip, also decided to add extra ingredients for the drip. Reasonable price, fantastic service. Will go back again when I visit BKK next time!

0x30e29f52bd0fe6f9_0xa371df686285912f.text: The best location to get fillers, Botox and the other skin boosters. My first experience is super satisfied with Thier proficient process and great …

0x30e29f52bd0fe6f9_0xa371df686285912f.text: My usual clinic for Thera V and botox in Bangkok! Tried their Q switch laser this time for pigmentation. Super convenient location near Nana BTS.
0x30e29f52bd0fe6f9_0xa371df686285912f.author: Mabel Tan

0x30e298c2f7550691_0xd009c65fb54fd6df.text: This was my first time getting a wax, and the results were excellent! Normally, appointments are required, but I had an urgent matter and booked a day-trip. The staff were very polite and patiently explained all the service details. After arriving and waiting about 5 minutes, a staff member (I believe it was the owner, as there was only one person in the shop – apologies if I'm wrong) invited me to change. During the waxing process, the wax was at a comfortable temperature, not too hot to tolerate. The waxing was done smoothly, quickly, and with minimal pain. They also removed any remaining hairs with tweezers (underarms were painless, the Brazilian wax was a little painful but tolerable – much less painful than plucking at home). The owner was incredibly clean, washing her hands almost every time she touched something, and washing again after leaving and returning the room. During the waxing, she explained aftercare instructions and how to treat ingrown hairs. The shop has a points accumulation program (scan points via the LINE app). After 10 services, the next service is free (up to 1,000 baht). (If I remember correctly) Prices, promotions, and opening/closing days can be found on their Facebook page. This isn't a paid review; honestly, if there were 10 stars, I'd give it a perfect score. I'll definitely be back. I highly recommend this salon to anyone looking for waxing services.
0x30e298c2f7550691_0xd009c65fb54fd6df.author: Paweeya Amnajhankij

0x30e298c2f7550691_0xd009c65fb54fd6df.text: I often read that waxing is for some people relaxing and not hurtful. I have done waxing for many times and I have to say, at two portions it was so comfortable. It almost didn't hurt, she was very professional and used desinfection and gloves. The price is a little higher than in most common places (Bikini and buttock 1300baht) but since my last - cheap - and very painful waxing experience in Chiang Mai I prefer a better waxing studio. It says on the sign at the door that you need an appointment but I just went there and got immediatly an appointment. 100% recommend!
0x30e298c2f7550691_0xd009c65fb54fd6df.author: Bella Flora

0x30e298c2f7550691_0xd009c65fb54fd6df.text: Originally I thought the price was a bit expensive but after receiving my waxing, I was very pleased by the service offered here. I have to say that in my limited experience, this place really offers quality waxing and attention to detail. The staff seem to know basic English but aren't really chatty. I don't mind this but others might prefer it. I would definitely come back here. ------------------- Please note that the location on Google Maps is slightly wrong. You need to find the Vue building down the road. The exact address is on Two Portions website.
0x30e298c2f7550691_0xd009c65fb54fd6df.author: Harvey Williams

0x30e298c2f7550691_0xd009c65fb54fd6df.text: They do a great job – carefully, extremely gently (not even particularly painful), no breakage. I've been here several times now – and I've had minimal ingrown hairs. The studio itself is very pleasant, and the stylists are very polite. It's a bit pricey, but worth it. I've had my hair done elsewhere a couple of times – they broke all my hair, and then they all grew back, which was terrible.
0x30e298c2f7550691_0xd009c65fb54fd6df.author: Diana Tsareva

0x30e298c2f7550691_0xd009c65fb54fd6df.text: I booked an appointment at "Two Portions Waxing" during my stay in Bangkok. The esthetician, Nan, was incredibly gentle and professional: she was very hygienic and respectful of my privacy. I even fell asleep during the session, which shows how skilled she was! Bravo! :-) So the price (quite reasonable) is justified: excellent value for money. I highly recommend them! Thank you!
0x30e298c2f7550691_0xd009c65fb54fd6df.author: Audrey M.

0x30e298c2f7550691_0xd009c65fb54fd6df.text: Very good service. The location is a little weird (basement floor of an office building), but it’s very clean. They did a great job and it was fairly quick. It was *slightly* more expensive than the usual place I go to, but I think the service here is actually better so it’s worth the extra ฿100.
0x30e298c2f7550691_0xd009c65fb54fd6df.author: M R

0x30e298c2f7550691_0xd009c65fb54fd6df.text: I'm not gonna tell you its painless but they are quick and they don't do any sloppy work either. I got my lady parts waxed and she was not shy in making sure she got all the hair on the inner lip if you know what I mean. My kitty looks flawless. plus I got my legs waxed; smooth like butter.
0x30e298c2f7550691_0xd009c65fb54fd6df.author: Pamela Collins

0x30e298c2f7550691_0xd009c65fb54fd6df.text: The location is very clean and the person pays very well attention to the areas. The person who did my waxing was also very gentle and made sure to sanitize each area before putting on wax. She also put a soothing gel afterwords that felt relieving. Would definitely come again.
0x30e298c2f7550691_0xd009c65fb54fd6df.author: Nicole Bermeo

0x30da301ac3803597_0x2d700b85c518b291.text: Ms. Kanamori has been the best person to talk to when it comes to miscommunication with the Thai staff and nurses. Not only that she has a nice personality but she is outstanding in terms of problem solving and getting the right solutions for international patients like me. The Thai staff are hard working and polite but sometimes we can't help but misunderstand because of the communication barrier we have. Ms. Kanamori has helped me and other friends I've had referred to Rajavej countless times, she works around the clock and sometimes stays a bit longer than she should just to get people situated. A lot of the foreign patients (including myself) are sad to hear that she's leaving so soon. I wish she could have stayed a tad bit longer in Rajavej! Thank you for the countless times of assisting me with my appointments and miscommunication with the Thai staff and nurses. I hope the next person they put in her place can match up to her standards and skills. One of your most frequent and cutest patients, Coach Earl Sideno General Manager Core Combat Chiang Mai
0x30da301ac3803597_0x2d700b85c518b291.author: Earl Nicolle Sideño

0x30da301ac3803597_0x2d700b85c518b291.text: I had to go in on a Sunday morning because I was concerned I may have a arm fracture after a bad roadside fall. Staff were very friendly and helpful. Doctor was thorough, kind and gentle. Xray completed quickly and revisit to doctor was fast. Prices for ER, xray, orthopedic consullt and medication. was very reasonable (under 50 USD). Basically, I was in and out the door with medications in hand in just over one hour. Turns out my true test of this hospital was the next evening. I arrived by ambulance after sliding on some greasy liquid near a street market. Face first on concrete resulted in many facial abrasions and a cracked lip that severed a blood vessel and required 12 stitches. Ambulance ride, exceptional ER care, doctor, nurses, stitches, tetanus shot plus meds and ambulance ride cost was very affordable. I was asked to come in several times after to check on my wounds. I am thankful for such excellent care and compassionate doctors and nurses. I would 100 percent recommend this hospital to anyone needing medical care.
0x30da301ac3803597_0x2d700b85c518b291.author: Candy S

0x30da301ac3803597_0x2d700b85c518b291.text: I had a health checkup at Rajavej Hospital today and was very impressed. The staff, doctors, and nurses were all incredibly kind and provided excellent service. Most importantly, I got my results the same day! So convenient and fast. 10/10! The health checkup center is on the 2nd floor. I recommend checking out the food court on the same floor; if you walk straight ahead and then turn left, you'll find it. I tried it for the first time today. They have rice and curry (the staff said the menu changes daily!) and à la carte dishes. The taste was much better than I expected – they really know how to cook! Before leaving, I grabbed some bakery items downstairs; the prices were surprisingly reasonable. Overall, it's a very convenient, well-equipped hospital with excellent service.
0x30da301ac3803597_0x2d700b85c518b291.author: Piyathida Che. (อันอัน)

0x30da301ac3803597_0x2d700b85c518b291.text: This was my first experience as a foreigner with no insurance paying out of pocket. I was recommended to this hospital after not being able to walk in at a local clinic due to being booked. Overall my experience was fairly good. The doctors & nurses were able to speak good enough English for me to understand and communicate effectively. I was treated very well, and was in & out fairly quickly (2hours). I was able to get Consultation, chest x-rays, IV & medication all for around $ 2,500 Baht. I would recommend this hospital.
0x30da301ac3803597_0x2d700b85c518b291.author: Spence Didd

0x30da301ac3803597_0x2d700b85c518b291.text: Rajavej Hospital is quite good and convenient. The prices are acceptable. I had spine surgery there, and the team was very supportive, helpful, and caring. I was very satisfied with the hospital during my 5-day admission. Heartfelt thanks to my fantastic surgeon, Dr. Waroon, who is technically skilled, patient, gentle, and kind. He communicated clearly and helped me feel confident in my decision. The interpreters were also always ready to help. I am happy to write this positive review for Rajavej Hospital Chiang Mai!😍
0x30da301ac3803597_0x2d700b85c518b291.author: Annie Sein

0x30da301ac3803597_0x2d700b85c518b291.text: Went for just an Annual medical check up. I ended up seeing multiple specialist as I was able to get appointments with other specialists and the cost was not so high. There was a gentleman who advised; helped me cross the language-barrier; coordinated my multiple appointments and even escorted to the specialist's office when needed. I would like to thank the gentleman(unable to recall his name, but he is the tall-one with eye glasses) for the help. This hospital is going to be my first choice, going forward.
0x30da301ac3803597_0x2d700b85c518b291.author: John Doe

0x30da301ac3803597_0x2d700b85c518b291.text: I had a very disappointing experience at this hospital during a recent visit to obtain a medical certificate for visa purposes. During registration, I asked whether they required my social security card for their records. The staff member initially assumed I was referring to payment and told me it would be cash only. I clarified that I was not asking about payment, but whether the card was needed for registration. Despite this, the situation escalated unnecessarily. Another staff member was called over, and I was incorrectly described as trying to use a social security card to avoid paying. I had to repeat myself to clarify that this was not the case. Although that misunderstanding was eventually acknowledged, the overall interaction left me feeling uncomfortable and misrepresented. The situation worsened during a routine blood pressure check. I was still processing what had just happened and felt confused. Instead of guiding me calmly, the nurse became impatient and physically pulled my arm into position in a rough manner, which I found inappropriate and unprofessional. The entire experience felt disorganized, lacking in clear communication, and unnecessarily stressful. I chose this hospital for its convenience, but based on this experience, I would not return.
0x30da301ac3803597_0x2d700b85c518b291.author: Gulfem Catal

0x30da301ac3803597_0x2d700b85c518b291.text: For these couple of years, I've assisted my aunt by taking her to her doctor's appointments and "every time" the appointments are delayed and end up taking longer than they were supposed to be, if at least arranged properly. We end up having to spend at least 2 hours uninformed. I wouldn't mind at all if the approximate time and details were given for each and every appointment. Time-consuming would be the best word used to describe their service here. Imagine waiting around when there are so many people in the room then witness all of them leave with more people coming in. I've been counting on this hospital since I was a kid, but I may have to consider counting on a more professional and well-organized hospital.
0x30da301ac3803597_0x2d700b85c518b291.author: Rin W

0x311d7e9f2d5027e7_0x2c0cece7cd1ada30.text: Free check-ups available at Lad Sawai Market today at 2 PM. Fast results! Instant blood sugar results / Accurate Hepatitis C screening... Interested in other tests? Stay tuned for offers!
0x311d7e9f2d5027e7_0x2c0cece7cd1ada30.author: Somchai Toprasert

0x311d7e9f2d5027e7_0x2c0cece7cd1ada30.author: บุญญาดา บุณยสิทธิ์พิชัย

0x311d7e9f2d5027e7_0x2c0cece7cd1ada30.text: The nurses provided excellent service. The staff were polite and friendly. Very good overall.
0x311d7e9f2d5027e7_0x2c0cece7cd1ada30.author: Bigtun Big

0x311d7e9f2d5027e7_0x2c0cece7cd1ada30.text: The patient was exhausted. The nurse told the doctor was on break and sent them elsewhere. The clinic was closed at noon. What a mess! The clinic is closed. I recommend you don't provide service if you're not ready.
0x311d7e9f2d5027e7_0x2c0cece7cd1ada30.author: ็HENGDEE ESTATE

0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.text: คุณหมอจัดฟันดี ขูดหินปูนดีไม่เจ็บไม่เสียวฟันเลยสำหรับเรา ผ่าฟันคุดก็โอเค ราคาสูงหน่อยแต่ดูจากรีวิวและประสบการณ์ของเราเองที่มาใช้บริการก็ถือว่าคุ้มราคา ใช้บริการคลินิกมา 5 ปี เพิ่งมีปีนี้ที่ทางคลินิกนัดไม่เป็นนัด นัดไว้บ่ายสอง ตอนโทรมาคอนเฟิร์มบอกให้มาบ่ายสาม เป็นหลายครั้งมากจนงงว่าแล้วจะให้ระบุเวลานัดทำไม กับเราไม่มีปัญหาอะไรหรอกแต่ถ้าเจอคนที่มีแผนอะไรของตัวเองเอาไว้แล้วจะทำยังไง ไม่รู้ครั้งอื่นๆเป็นที่หมอเลื่อนหรือพนักงานจัดเวลามั่วนะ แต่ครั้งแรกที่เจอว่าผิดนัดคือพนักงานมั่ว นัดเราไว้ห้าโมง ตอนโทรคอนเฟิร์มบอกให้มาตั้งแต่สองโมงเลยก็ได้ เคสเราแค่เช็กฟันนิดเดียวใช้เวลาไม่นาน เลยไปจองดูหนังไว้ พอจองเสร็จพนักงานคนเดิมโทรกลับมาใหม่ว่าต้องเป็นห้าโมงเหมือนเดิม สองโมงไม่ได้ แล้วไม่มีคำขอโทษไรเลย เหมือนแค่มาแจ้งให้ทราบ จนต้องเลื่อนวันไปวันอื่นเพราะเราก็ไม่สะดวกแล้ว อยากให้ปรับปรุงตรงนี้นะคะ เพราะปีก่อนๆหน้านี้ไม่มีปัญหาเรื่องเวลานัดเลยจริงๆ คลินิกตรงเวลามาก
0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.author: Jh Jj
0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.en: The orthodontist is good, the scaling was painless and sensitive for me, and the wisdom tooth extraction was also okay. The price is a bit high, but based on reviews and my own experience, it's worth it. I've been using the clinic for 5 years, and this year is the first year they've had appointments that haven't been kept. They scheduled an appointment for 2 PM, but when they called to confirm, they said to come at 3 PM. This has happened so many times that I'm confused why they even bother giving appointment times if they don't need to specify a time. It's not a problem for me, but what if someone has their own plans already? I don't know if the other times were due to the doctor rescheduling or the staff messing up the schedule, but the first time they missed an appointment was because of staff error. They scheduled me for 5 PM, but when they called to confirm, they said I could come at 2 PM. My case was just a quick check-up, so I booked a movie ticket. After I booked it, the same staff member called again saying it had to be 5 PM, not 2 PM, without any apology. It was like they were just informing me. I had to reschedule for another day because it wasn't convenient for me anymore. I hope they improve this aspect of their service. In previous years, there were never any problems with appointment times; the clinic was always very punctual.

0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.text: I went for a consultation about orthodontics. The dentist was lovely and explained everything in an easy-to-understand way. The staff were also lovely and attentive. The counter staff were very helpful and friendly, which made me feel very comfortable. It was a great experience!
0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.author: อมรชัย

0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.text: จัดฟันที่ Csmile Dental Clinic มา 3 ปีแล้วครับ รอบนี้เข้ามาให้คุณหมอกี้ช่วยเช็ครีเทนเนอร์ให้ ผลลัพธ์คือฟันยังเรียงสวยเป๊ะเหมือนเดิมเลยครับ คุณหมอใส่ใจและดูแลดีมากๆ ตั้งแต่วันแรกจนถึงช่วงดูแลหลังจัดฟัน ใครที่กำลังมองหาคลินิก จัดฟันดีๆ แนะนำที่นี่เลยครับ ไม่ผิดหวังแน่นอน
0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.author: thanawat phooplub
0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.en: I've been getting braces at Csmile Dental Clinic for 3 years now. This time I came in for Dr. Kie to check my retainer, and the result is that my teeth are still perfectly aligned! Dr. Kie is very attentive and caring, from the first day until the post-braces care. If you're looking for a good orthodontic clinic, I highly recommend this one. You won't be disappointed!

0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.text: Wisdom tooth extraction!! I'm someone who is very afraid of needles, plus I have panic attacks and am very afraid of dentists. In my case, I had Dr. Kraisorn take care of me. He gave good advice. The clinic applied anesthetic before …
0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.author: K. S.

0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.text: I went to get a tooth extracted. The dentist was very gentle. The staff were friendly and attentive, from the counter staff to the assistants in the extraction room. It made the extraction a very relaxing experience. Thank you!
0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.author: Po Po

0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.text: I came here to get my teeth straightened. All the doctors were lovely, friendly, and gave excellent advice and service. All the assistants provided excellent service. I highly recommend coming to Csmile Dental Clinic.
0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.author: PATREE CHAMYENURA

0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.text: The dentist is kind, gentle, and doesn't prolong treatment unnecessarily. The tartar removal process is very thorough. My orthodontic treatment took about 2 years before I could get my retainer. 🥰 …
0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.author: Klaokanlaya Papaung

0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.text: แพงจริงค่ะ เราจัดเสร็จมาประมาณ 3 ปีแล้ว รีเทนเนอร์แบบใส 1 ชุดฉีกขาด อีกชุดหาย เคยโทรไปขอทราบราคาเพื่อทำใหม่ บอกคิดชุดละ 4,000 เราถามมีส่วนลดสำหรับลูกค้าที่เคยจัดที่นี่มั้ย บอกต้องคุยกับหมออย่างเดียว แล้วใครจะไป มาตรฐานราคาไม่ได้ บริการหลังการขายไม่มี และเอาจริงๆ ราคาแบบนี้ทำที่ไหนก็ได้เลย เราไปได้รีเทนเนอร์จากคลีนิคแถวเกษตรแนวรถไฟฟ้า 2 ชุด 3,600 แบบเดียวกันเลย โดยไม่สนใจเลยว่าเราจะจัดจากไหนมา ยินดีบริการและแนะนำดีมากๆๆๆๆ
0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.author: Napat Loetthakonkun
0x30e29c5ab5f008a1_0xb1acc8c0c571fcae.en: It's really expensive. We finished our orthodontic treatment about 3 years ago. One set of clear retainers tore, and the other is lost. We called to inquire about the price for new ones, and they said 4,000 baht per set. We asked if there was a discount for former patients, and they said we had to talk to the doctor. Who would go there then? The pricing is substandard, there's no after-sales service, and honestly, you can get retainers at this price anywhere. We got two sets of the same retainers from a clinic near Kaset-Skytrain for 3,600 baht, without them caring where we had our treatment done. They were very helpful and gave great advice.

0x30e296972c7a0753_0x668709d7fbebdf8e.text: หมอบริการดี ราราเป็นกันเอง คลีนิคมีตัดเบิกประกันสังคมด้วย👍 เคาร์เตอร์พูดจาสุภาพน่ารัก มีการนัดวันที่แน่ชัด ก่อนถึงเวลามีการโทรคอนเฟิร์มด้วย เกือบลืมวันนะดแค่คลีนิคโทรเตือนดีมากเลยค่ัะ ในเรื่องของการรอคิวรอไม่นานเลยค่ะ มาถึงตามเวลานักแปบเดียวก็ได้เข้าพบคุณหมอเลย มีคำแนะนำสำหรับการทำฟันแต่ละครั้ง แนะนำเกี่ยวกับการดูแลเป็นอย่างดี มีนัดติดตามอาการทุกๆ6เดือนด้วย หลังผ่าฟันคุดเสร็จยังมีนัดเข้ามาดูแผล ค่าบริการสำหรับการพบหมอก็ไม่แพงถ้าเทียบกับที่อื่นๆ คลีนิคสะอาด ห้องน้ำก็สะอาด รวมๆแล้วประทับใจค่ะ
0x30e296972c7a0753_0x668709d7fbebdf8e.en: The doctor provides excellent service, the prices are reasonable, and the clinic accepts social security insurance. 👍 The reception staff are polite and friendly. They schedule appointments clearly and even call to confirm beforehand – I almost forgot the date, but the clinic's reminder was great! The waiting time was very short. I arrived on time and was able to see the doctor almost immediately. They provide good advice for each dental procedure and aftercare. There are follow-up appointments every 6 months, including after wisdom tooth extraction to check the wound. The fee for doctor's visits is also reasonable compared to other clinics. The clinic and restrooms are clean. Overall, I'm very impressed.

0x311d67aaf620c035_0x81c01dc3db15739a.text: คุณหมอให้คำแนะนำที่ดีมากๆเลยค่ะคุณหมอใส่ใจดูแลอย่างละเอียดเป็นอย่างดีเลยค่ะมีโอกาสจะแนะนำเพื่อนๆและคนรอบข้างมาทำที่นี่ด้วยค่ะ
0x311d67aaf620c035_0x81c01dc3db15739a.en: The doctor gave excellent advice and provided very attentive and thorough care. I will definitely recommend this clinic to my friends and family if I have the opportunity.

0x311d67aaf620c035_0x81c01dc3db15739a.text: คุณหมอน่ารักแนะนำดีมากๆค่ะมือเบา พูดดีมากคะชื่นชม *****แต่อยากให้ปรับปรุงเรื่องการบริการตรงเค้าเตอร์ค่ะการใช้น้ำเสียงอยากให้ใช้น้ำเสียงที่น่ารักกว่านี้ค่ะ บริการคลินิกไม่คิดจ้างหรือเปลี่ยนคนหรือคะ เพราะอยากให้แนะนำดีกว่านี้ค่ะ อยู่ๆโทรหายังไม่ได้รับคำตอบวางสายคืออะไรคะ บริการแบบนี้หรือคะ แย่คะ *****เพราะบางคนเจอครั้งแรกอาจจะไม่เข้าใจเรื่องการใช้น้ำเสียงว่าเป็นปกติ(ที่ไปใช้บริการเพราะดูรีวิวคุณหมอน่ารักแต่คนบริการที่อยู่เคาเตอร์บริการแย่มาก)
0x311d67aaf620c035_0x81c01dc3db15739a.author: puji puji
0x311d67aaf620c035_0x81c01dc3db15739a.en: The doctor was lovely and gave great advice. She was gentle and spoke very well. I highly commend her. *****However, I would like to see improvements in the service at the counter. The tone of voice should be more pleasant. Does the clinic consider hiring or changing staff? Because I want better advice. Suddenly, when I call, they hang up without answering. Is this the kind of service you provide? It's terrible.***** Some people might not understand that using a different tone of voice is normal. (I went there because of the reviews saying the doctor was lovely, but the service at the counter was terrible.)

0x311d67aaf620c035_0x81c01dc3db15739a.text: เพิ่งไปมาวันนี้เป็นวันแรกพนักงานแผนกเอกซเรย์พูดไม่เพราะเลยแต่คุณหมอพูดจาดีน่ารักมากเลยค่ะ
0x311d67aaf620c035_0x81c01dc3db15739a.en: I just went there today, it was my first time. The staff in the X-ray department were very impolite, but the doctor was very kind and lovely.

0x311d5d1c06876d51_0xb0875d9904191a8d.text: ผ่าฟันคุดที่นี่พร้อมกัน 4 ซี่ ตัดสินใจผ่าที่นี่เพราะคุณหมอมด เชื่อว่าคุณหมอรับมือเคสเราได้ดีแน่นอน และมันก็เป็นแบบนั้น ทุกคนที่รู้ว่าผ่าฟันคุดพร้อมกัน 4 ซี่ตกใจกับผลงานคุณหมอมาก เพราะบวมน้อยจนแทบจะมองไม่ออก ไม่มีอาการม่วงช้ำ และบอกว่าหมอต้องเก่งมากๆแน่ๆ ระหว่างที่ผ่าตัดมันเจ็บ แต่เจ็บแบบทนได้ ไม่แย่เท่าที่คิด เรากลัวหมอฟันมากๆเลยคิดว่ามันต้องเจ็บมากๆ แต่หมอเก่งสุดๆ ทั้งหมอและพี่ๆให้คำแนะนำการดูแลแผลได้ดีมากค่ะ
0x311d5d1c06876d51_0xb0875d9904191a8d.author: YT MP
0x311d5d1c06876d51_0xb0875d9904191a8d.en: I had four wisdom teeth extracted here at the same time. I decided to have them done here because of Dr. Mod; I trusted her to handle my case well, and she did. Everyone who knew I had four wisdom teeth extracted was amazed by Dr. Mod's work. The swelling was minimal, almost unnoticeable, and there was no bruising. They all said she must be incredibly skilled. The surgery was painful, but bearable – not as bad as I expected. I'm really afraid of dentists, so I thought it would be extremely painful, but Dr. Mod was amazing. Both she and the staff gave excellent advice on wound care.

0x311d5d1c06876d51_0xb0875d9904191a8d.text: The dentist was very talkative and quick, which helped alleviate my child's fear. There was a TV above the treatment room for the children to watch, keeping them entertained and reducing anxiety. The clinic was spacious and not crowded, with plenty of toys to help children relax. 😍 The staff were lovely. The clinic informed us of the price and treatment details before starting. Highly recommended!
0x311d5d1c06876d51_0xb0875d9904191a8d.author: Dinsor LaLa

0x311d5d1c06876d51_0xb0875d9904191a8d.text: This clinic is where our whole family gets their dental work done! They have a specialist pediatric dentist, and parents get their dental work done too. We can schedule appointments for the whole family at once, which is so convenient! The clinic is clean, the dentist is kind, gentle, and loves children. My little ones have been coming here since they were tiny.
0x311d5d1c06876d51_0xb0875d9904191a8d.author: AkiraLegoWorld J

0x311d5d1c06876d51_0xb0875d9904191a8d.text: I brought my child to the dentist here. The dentist is lovely, and there are plenty of assistants who are helpful and give lots of advice. Importantly, my child loves coming here because while lying down for treatment, the dentist has cartoons on a screen for him to watch, which keeps him entertained. Kids really enjoy it!
0x311d5d1c06876d51_0xb0875d9904191a8d.author: Preeyathida Thammasit

0x311d5d1c06876d51_0xb0875d9904191a8d.text: I love it! The clinic is clean, the staff are lovely, and it's very kid-friendly. They even have toys for the kids to choose from as a reward after their dental treatment. Our family has a regular dentist, Dr. C, who is kind, gentle, and very understanding of children. I highly recommend this clinic!
0x311d5d1c06876d51_0xb0875d9904191a8d.author: Phatsupha Ruangboonsong

0x311d5d1c06876d51_0xb0875d9904191a8d.text: The clinic is clean. My son came for dental treatment for an overbite (lower teeth overlapping upper teeth). The staff were friendly, cheerful, polite, and provided good information. The dentist is skilled and kind. The children loved it. I recommend this children's dental clinic.
0x311d5d1c06876d51_0xb0875d9904191a8d.author: เกวลี พุทธวงษ์

0x311d5d1c06876d51_0xb0875d9904191a8d.text: I brought my 9-year-old daughter to the dentist. The pediatric dentist here is excellent. We had a special case for pediatric orthodontics. Thank you, doctor, for taking care of my daughter Ida's teeth. 🥰🙏 ✅Clean, good service, convenient parking. Highly recommended! 👍 …
0x311d5d1c06876d51_0xb0875d9904191a8d.author: Sirinphan Sirikannasut

0x311d5d1c06876d51_0xb0875d9904191a8d.text: เป็นคลีนิคทำฟัน ที่มีครบทั้งระบบ ทำฟันเด็กด้วย หมอเก่ง และเป็นกันเอง พนักงานที่เค้าเตอร์บริการดี ให้คำแนะนำดี พื้นที่ของคลีนิคกว้างขวางไม่แออัด มีหลายชั้น มีห้องตรวจหลายห้อง สะดวกสบาย อยู่ติดริมถนน บางพลี-ตำหรุ เป็นทางเลือกที่ดีอีกที่นึงย่านบางพลี
0x311d5d1c06876d51_0xb0875d9904191a8d.author: กู้เกียรติ์ หลักคำ
0x311d5d1c06876d51_0xb0875d9904191a8d.en: This is a full-service dental clinic, including children's dentistry. The dentists are skilled and friendly. The counter staff are helpful and provide good advice. The clinic is spacious and not crowded, with multiple floors and many examination rooms, making it convenient. Located right on Bang Phli-Tamru Road, it's a great option in the Bang Phli area.

0x30e285af45803497_0xdc1dd67e81edd698.text: It's been one year since I had my nose corrected by Dr. Ton at API Clinic. The shape is beautiful, looks soft and natural, and there are no problems at all. I love it! The doctor is very skilled. 💖✨ …
0x30e285af45803497_0xdc1dd67e81edd698.author: Areeya Saelim

0x30e285af45803497_0xdc1dd67e81edd698.text: I highly recommend this clinic. The doctor and staff are very attentive and you can ask questions anytime. The doctor personally oversees every visit. The clinic is clean and safe.
0x30e285af45803497_0xdc1dd67e81edd698.author: Thamrong Prasopsilp

0x30e285af45803497_0xdc1dd67e81edd698.text: I'm very impressed with the results! The doctor gave excellent advice. Before the procedure, I felt insecure, but afterwards, I feel like I have a new nose. I love it!
0x30e285af45803497_0xdc1dd67e81edd698.author: Natheekarn Tanthanaphong

0x30e285af45803497_0xdc1dd67e81edd698.text: The service was good, with regular follow-up appointments, which helped to put my mind at ease if I had any concerns.
0x30e285af45803497_0xdc1dd67e81edd698.author: paricha chomchery

0x30e29d22368b18e7_0xa9653ee21c7d16f7.text: It has become my regular clinic. 1. Location: Clean, air-conditioned, not many people. It is a small shophouse but the interior of the clinic is beautifully decorated. If you go during a festival, there might be snacks to give away. 2. Price: Compared to other clinics outside, it is very cheap and not expensive at all. Dental scaling does not cost more than 1,200-1,300 depending on the amount in the mouth. Those who have social security can claim it without having to pay in advance. 3. Service: The service at the counter is good, polite, and explains details clearly. The admin answers questions on the page very quickly. You can make an appointment via chat. 4. Dental work: The doctor is very kind, polite, not fierce, patient, and can consult if you have any questions. It is fast. It takes less than 15 minutes to get dental scaling and 20-30 minutes to fill the tooth. He gives very good advice and is very skilled and has a gentle hand. 5. Travel: The disadvantage is that there is no parking in front of the shop. Those who drive a car will have a hard time finding a parking spot. Motorbikes can be parked on the sidewalk in front of the shop. I recommend coming by MRT or public transportation. There are buses passing by and it is close to Bang Son MRT. Get off at this station and walk for about 3-5 minutes.
0x30e29d22368b18e7_0xa9653ee21c7d16f7.author: icutmyhair

0x30e29d22368b18e7_0xa9653ee21c7d16f7.text: My wife and I went to this dental clinic for cleanings. It was a very pleasant and efficient experience. Both of our cleanings were about 30 minutes in total. The dentist spoke English and was very thorough in explaining the procedure and any issues we had with our teeth. They were also very gentle, and this was a virtually painless experience. The price was very fair, considering that in our home country, the cost was literally 15x more expensive.
0x30e29d22368b18e7_0xa9653ee21c7d16f7.author: Nik Starchild

0x30e29d22368b18e7_0xa9653ee21c7d16f7.text: Easy to get to, near Bang Son MRT station. - The staff provides excellent service; they are calm, have a pleasant tone of voice, and are not harsh. - The clinic is clean. - The dentist is very kind and gentle. Before the procedure, they clearly explain what needs to be done and the price so that the patient can decide whether to proceed. After the procedure, the dentist provides detailed follow-up advice.
0x30e29d22368b18e7_0xa9653ee21c7d16f7.author: D K

0x30e29d22368b18e7_0xa9653ee21c7d16f7.text: The dentist was very kind. He explained my dental problems and the treatment in detail. He gave excellent dental care advice, which gave me the motivation to continue treatment. When I was a child, I was too afraid to go to the dentist because I was terrified of dentists. Now that I'm older, I need to get a lot of dental work done.😭 …
0x30e29d22368b18e7_0xa9653ee21c7d16f7.author: หมู ฉึกๆ

0x30e29d22368b18e7_0xa9653ee21c7d16f7.text: เป็นคลินิกทำฟันที่สะอาดให้บริการดีโดยคุณหมอทำฟันทันตแพทย์ผู้เชียวชาญรอคิวไม่นานนัดหมายล่วงหน้าเดินทางสะดวกประทับใจมาก 🧡👍 It is a clean dental clinic with good service by an expert dentist. The waiting time is not long. Make an appointment in advance. It is convenient to travel. I am very impressed. 🧡👍
0x30e29d22368b18e7_0xa9653ee21c7d16f7.author: Sam Paul
0x30e29d22368b18e7_0xa9653ee21c7d16f7.en: This is a clean dental clinic with excellent service from an expert dentist. The waiting time is short, so it's best to make an appointment in advance. It's also conveniently located. I'm very impressed! 🧡👍

0x30e29d22368b18e7_0xa9653ee21c7d16f7.text: The dentist was very kind. I'm really afraid of dentists, but during the procedure, the dentist talked a lot, which helped to relieve my stress and fear. The price wasn't too expensive either. Overall, I'm very satisfied. If I have any more dental problems, I'll definitely go back here. ❤️❤️❤️
0x30e29d22368b18e7_0xa9653ee21c7d16f7.author: Thunvarat tt

0x30e29d22368b18e7_0xa9653ee21c7d16f7.text: The dentist is kind, gentle, explains things in detail, and gives advice on oral care. Prices are quoted before the service, and treatments can be arranged in installments according to your budget. The clinic is clean, the appointment booking system is efficient, and the staff are courteous.
0x30e29d22368b18e7_0xa9653ee21c7d16f7.author: C C

0x30e29d22368b18e7_0xa9653ee21c7d16f7.text: This clinic is very clean. The dentist is gentle and speaks very well. I'm usually afraid of dentists, but the dentist here spoke in a tone that greatly reduced my fear. This has become my regular clinic. The price is moderate, in my opinion, but I really like this place❣️❣️
0x30e29d22368b18e7_0xa9653ee21c7d16f7.author: ธันวลักษ์ ต่างใจเย็น

0x30e29f0036d696d5_0x1526128f060e08d1.text: The clinic is newly opened, and everything feels modern, well-organized, and exceptionally clean. The facilities are spotless, and the overall atmosphere is comfortable and welcoming, which helped me feel relaxed from the moment I arrived. The staff were very friendly, professional, and attentive throughout my visit. They took the time to explain the process clearly and made sure I was comfortable. The dentist was gentle, patient, and skilled, making the treatment much easier than I expected. If you’re someone who feels nervous about dental appointments, you’ll appreciate how careful and light-handed the doctor is. Another big advantage is the convenient location in Sindhorn Building. There is ample parking available, making it easy to visit even during busy hours. The area also has plenty of restaurants and cafés nearby, so family members or companions can comfortably wait while you are having your appointment. Free Wi-Fi is also provided, which is a nice touch for anyone needing to work or stay connected while waiting. Overall, Evercare Dental offers excellent service, a clean and modern environment, convenient facilities, and a great patient experience. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a quality dental clinic in Bangkok. Definitely a place I will return to for future dental care.
0x30e29f0036d696d5_0x1526128f060e08d1.author: JaN SaBaLahey

0x30e29f0036d696d5_0x1526128f060e08d1.text: rarely write reviews, but Evercare Dental truly deserves one. From the very first consultation until the final appointment, the entire experience was outstanding. The team was professional, friendly, honest, and made me feel comfortable throughout the whole treatment. Every step was explained clearly, and I always felt that they genuinely cared about achieving the best possible result rather than rushing the process. I had veneers done, and I honestly couldn’t be happier with the outcome. They look incredibly natural while giving me the smile I always wanted. The attention to detail, precision, and craftsmanship are simply exceptional. Traveling abroad for dental treatment can feel like a big decision, but choosing Evercare Dental was one of the best decisions I’ve made. The quality of the work, the modern clinic, and the level of care exceeded my expectations in every way. A heartfelt thank you to the entire team for your professionalism, kindness, and dedication. I am truly grateful and would recommend Evercare Dental without hesitation to anyone looking for world-class dental treatment in Bangkok. Thank you for giving me my confidence and my smile back!

Evercare Dental Service at the Sindhorn office is highly recommended. We reside in the Muniq condominium on Tonson Road. Upon arrival, we were warmly welcomed and promptly scheduled an appointment for a dental cleaning the following day. The staff and our dentist were exceptional. Their services were top-notch, and they were friendly, knowledgeable, and attentive throughout the process. We highly recommend this place to anyone seeking high-quality dental work and exceptional service.
0x30e29f0036d696d5_0x1526128f060e08d1.author: Paul Itti

0x30e29f0036d696d5_0x1526128f060e08d1.text: I discovered this dental clinic by chance and decided to book a teeth-whitening treatment. Everything was very professional from start to finish. Each step of the treatment was explained to me in detail, and I felt very comfortable throughout the whole process. I’m extremely happy with the whitening results! If I’m ever back in the Sindhorn area, I would definitely come here again for another teeth-whitening treatment without hesitation. Five stars from me – highly recommended!

The doctor was incredibly kind and gave great advice. I was able to use my social security benefits, which made everything even more convenient. The staff were all so friendly and welcoming. Since it’s a newly opened clinic, everything was spotless, smelled amazing, and felt very clean. There weren’t many people, so I didn’t have to wait long at all. Overall, it was such a comfortable and reassuring experience. Highly recommended! 😉🩺💗🤌🫶🥳✅

I got my retainer made super fast! I got it in just one week. There are so many designs to choose from, so many cute ones I couldn't decide! The service was excellent and very quick; no long waits. The doctor paid close attention to every detail when taking impressions and even adjusted the metal brackets. It's so comfortable to wear, and they offer a three-month guarantee for further adjustments. I'll definitely be back next time!
0x30e29f0036d696d5_0x1526128f060e08d1.author: Alitsara P.Charern

0x30e29f0036d696d5_0x1526128f060e08d1.text: Dr. Panpan was very attentive and explained very well about the dental care I need from the clinic. All the staffs were also very knowledgeable and professional. I even received a follow-up call from the clinic, whether I had an issue after I recieved the service from the clinic. This was certainly beyond my expectations. Thank you all the team at Evercare for such excellent services!

A new dental clinic has opened in the Sindhorn Building. The service is excellent, and the doctors and staff are very attentive. They also have promotions going on right now. I highly recommend this dental clinic. The service is top-notch, and the doctors are very skilled. If any of my Chinese friends have dental problems, they can come here 👍
0x30e29f0036d696d5_0x1526128f060e08d1.author: Pattarapong

0x30e285006258d2ed_0xe10511637c063a23.text: บริการดีมากคะ แอดมินพูดน่ารัก หมอและผู้ช่วยน่ารักมากคะ สถานที่ใหญ่มาก มีมุมเครื่องดื่มให้ด้วยคะ มาไม่ผิดหวังแน่นอนคะ จะแวะมาใช้บริการอีกคะ เต็บสิบคะ🩵
0x30e285006258d2ed_0xe10511637c063a23.en: Excellent service! The admin was very friendly, and the doctor and assistants were wonderful. The place is very spacious and has a drinks corner. You won't be disappointed! I'll definitely be back. Ten out of ten! 🩵

0x30e285006258d2ed_0xe10511637c063a23.text: มาทำวีเนียร์กับคุณหมอฟาค่า คุณหมอน่ารักใจดีมากแบบมากๆๆๆๆๆ จากเป็นคนที่กลัวหมอฟันมาก ตอนนี้คือรักหมอฟันเลยค่า ,, คลินิคบรรยากาศดี สะอาดมากค่า

0x30e285006258d2ed_0xe10511637c063a23.en: I got veneers done with Dr. Faka. She's incredibly kind and lovely! I used to be terrified of dentists, but now I love them! The clinic has a great atmosphere and is very clean.

0x30e285006258d2ed_0xe10511637c063a23.text: ดีเยี่ยมค่ะ คุณหมอน่ารัก พนักงานต้อนรับบริการดี ใช้บริการครั้งที่ 3 แล้ว ยังประทับใจเหมือนเดิมค่ะ เป็นคลินิกทำฟันเจ้าประจำไปแล้ว ❤️
0x30e285006258d2ed_0xe10511637c063a23.author: Manocha Boonchu
0x30e285006258d2ed_0xe10511637c063a23.en: Excellent! The doctor is lovely, and the reception staff provide great service. This is my third time using their services, and I'm still as impressed as ever. It's become my go-to dental clinic! ❤️

0x30e285006258d2ed_0xe10511637c063a23.text: คลินิกกว้างมากค่ะ สะดวกสบายมีที่จอดรถเยอะ เจ้าหน้าที่บริการดี ที่สำคัญคุณหมอแนะนำดีมาก อธิบายเข้าใจง่าย จะกลับมาใช้บริการอีกค่ะ
0x30e285006258d2ed_0xe10511637c063a23.en: The clinic is very spacious and comfortable with plenty of parking. The staff provides excellent service, and most importantly, the doctor gives great advice and explains things in an easy-to-understand way. I will definitely come back for more services.

0x30e285006258d2ed_0xe10511637c063a23.text: คลิกนิกกว้างสะดวกสบายที่จอดรถเยอะ พนักงานน่ารักบริการให้ข้อมูลครบถ้วน รักษาฟันที่นี่ไม่ผิดหวังเลยค่ะ หมอโชคเก่ง มือเบามากค่ะ
0x30e285006258d2ed_0xe10511637c063a23.author: Ahfei Krungsuntei
0x30e285006258d2ed_0xe10511637c063a23.en: The clinic is spacious and comfortable with plenty of parking. The staff are lovely and provide complete information. I wasn't disappointed with my dental treatment here. Dr. Chok is very skilled and gentle.

0x30e285006258d2ed_0xe10511637c063a23.text: คลินิก สะอาด กว้าง ที่จอดรถเยอะสะดวกมากๆ พนักงานใส่ใจดูแลดีมาก คุณหมอวโรชช์มือเบามากครับ ผ่าฟันคุต ไม่เจ็บเลย แนะนำครับ 😀✨

0x30da3aa27418f391_0x868bb7d7058ee961.text: The Professional Face Lifting class was an amazing learning experience. I’ve studied Head and Face massage at several other Thai schools, and I even teach it at my own school. But I signed up for this course as much to learn from Dr. Nooy as to explore this specific modality. And now I've just completed an incredible two-week, 60-hour journey learning Traditional Thai Abdominal Detox Massage with Dr. Nooy. I have never been more exhausted from learning, but never been more satisfied with how much I have learned in these two weeks. From day one, I was blown away by this Dr. Nooy's techniques. Not a single technique overlapped with what I already knew from hundreds of hours of studying Thai massage. Plus Dr. Nooy’s teaching style focused on identifying what needed to be addressed rather than simply memorizing a sequence without considering the client’s unique needs. I was fortunate to be her only student for the Abdominal course, which meant that Dr. Nooy taught me at the speed I could understand. In the first week I did feel a bit overwhelmed, but after countless hours of working with clients that she brought in for me, by the end of the second week I was doing 2-hour treatments using techniques that were all new to me. The abdomen is essential to Traditional Thai Medicine for a number of reasons, but this is the first school and the first teacher who has not only given me practical techniques for working the abdomen, but, more importantly, helped me understand how to assess and treat what needs to be done for my clients. I haven’t even returned home to Canada yet, but I already have numerous bookings from clients eager to try both the Thai Face Lifting and the Thai Abdominal massage treatments. I highly recommend these courses to anyone looking to learn from a true master in the field. I am forever grateful that I found Sirichan Thai massage school. Thank you Dr. Nooy for the gift you have given me.
0x30da3aa27418f391_0x868bb7d7058ee961.author: Grant Martens

0x30da3aa27418f391_0x868bb7d7058ee961.text: Being already a certified massage therapist, I was looking some who could teach me new skills and techniques. So I chose Dr. Nooy's clinic in order to learn the art of traditional thai massage and bone setting. After taking the courses, I can only recommend Sirichan clinic and dr. Nooy to anyone who wants to seriously study massage in order to be able to heal others. Not only were the lessons very comprehensive, but Dr. Nooy has always been available to explain the details, demonstrate the techniques and clarify all doubts. Certainly what distinguishes this course is a great attention to the correct learning of the student and the application of massage techniques as a real tool to help the client heal. Furthermore, during the practice I had the opportunity to follow and massage various people and clients of the clinic, immediately putting into practice what I had learned. This is really a big plus, since in many massage courses you usually only practice with other students. Here, however, you have the opportunity to put into practice what you have learned on real cases, under the careful supervision of Dr. Nooy. Furthermore, the atmosphere is pleasant, familiar and relaxed, which certainly favors learning. If you are looking for a traditional Thai massage course or if you are looking for someone who can help you solve physical problems through this art of care, look no further and trust the Sirichan Clinic.
0x30da3aa27418f391_0x868bb7d7058ee961.author: Carlo Crestani

0x30da3aa27418f391_0x868bb7d7058ee961.text: Sirichan Clinic is so much more than the best massage you'll ever get. Having been in Asia for over a year, I've made frequent visits to massage places with mixed success. Sirichan Clinic is definitely a unique treatment compared to anything else! Dr. Sirichan Maneechai, aka Nooy, began learning traditional massage and medicine at the age of 8 from her grandmother Wissim. She later pursued formal education, eventually earning a doctorate in Thai medicine, midwifery, and massage therapy. Dr. Nooy has since developed her own unique approach to healing, incorporating over 12 Thai modalities. She specializes in a range of treatments, including traditional Thai massage, face massage, and herbal treatments, among others. Her approach is holistic, combining expertise with a clear understanding of health, body, and mind. You won't only get a massage. Dr. Nooy will give you the check-up that you perhaps didn't even know you needed! She fixed my leg so I could walk again and adjusted a muscle in my other leg. Furthermore, she worked on my entire body, using both acupuncture and abdominal massage. I came out as a new functional being! Before I went, she even gave me herbal medicine to drink before bedtime! This is the treatment we dream about every time we visit a masseuse! Thank you so much for a calm and holistic experience that I have never before encountered! Treat yourself to this. It's a true blessing 🙏☯️
0x30da3aa27418f391_0x868bb7d7058ee961.author: Leonardo Degn

0x30da3aa27418f391_0x868bb7d7058ee961.text: I recently completed the entire 4-week course with Dr. Nooy and her team and was truly satisfied with the wonderful Thai massage, walking massage, and bonesetting sequences I learned. Nooy teaches using a traditional method, emphasizing the development of the ability to sense the qualities of the body's tissues, all with a clinical approach. Therefore, in addition to the sequences with the related SEN SIB theory, you acquire the tools to perform a careful assessment of the body to perform functional, personalized, and completely safe treatments. Furthermore, she and her team, in addition to being generous and empathetic, are open to receiving during the lessons, and as a result, you receive precise and useful feedback to understand exactly how to correctly perform the techniques. Thanks to Fred in particular, I was able to clearly understand mistakes and correct them session after session. Furthermore, you have the opportunity to participate in the clinical evaluation of her clients. It's important to remember that Nooy is a traditional doctor and knows the various aspects of Thai medicine. Being very accessible, one has the opportunity to gain a wealth of information on this immense subject, in addition to receiving his highly effective treatments. Thank you, Sirichan School, for your professionalism and kindness. I will always cherish this experience. Roberto Cerato
