A huge plus, they offer fully private rooms, which makes the experience much more relaxing and exclusive. As far as I know, they are the only ones on the street offering this level of privacy. If you are looking for a premium massage experience with real quality standards, this is definitely the place to go. Thanks Le Karn ! We will come back 😃
0x3054f1d350fe6f3f_0xcc3bef44f76b534d.author: TENDLUX

0x3054f1d350fe6f3f_0xcc3bef44f76b534d.text: I came across Le Karn Massage & Beauty as I was walking to the Fisherman’s Village. It is nearby to my resort. I had the relaxing organic oil massage and it was one of the best Thai massages I have ever had. From the moment I walked in and received a cooling tea and cool face washer to the finish where I received a hot tea, Thai dessert (yum!!) and warm face towel. The whole experience was first class and I would highly recommend this salon. Very professional, very friendly, very clean and VERY relaxing. This was a birthday treat to myself and I am so grateful that I chose to come here. I will definitely be back. Thank you for giving me the best birthday present!
0x3054f1d350fe6f3f_0xcc3bef44f76b534d.author: Jane Barnett

0x3054f1d350fe6f3f_0xcc3bef44f76b534d.text: Absolutely Exceptional Pedicure Experience 🌿✨ I had the most amazing pedicure at Le Karn. From the moment I arrived, the experience felt thoughtfully curated — a refreshing welcome juice and a cool towel set the tone perfectly. The pedicure itself was excellent, with great attention to detail, and the added comfort of the massage chair made it even more relaxing. What truly stood out were the thoughtful finishing touches — a soothing ginger tea and a light treat served after the treatment, which elevated the entire experience. A big thank you to the Le Karn team for such warm hospitality and a truly memorable visit. Highly recommended!
0x3054f1d350fe6f3f_0xcc3bef44f76b534d.author: Jacques du Preez

0x3054f1d350fe6f3f_0xcc3bef44f76b534d.text: Hello everyone. Me and my family have been to this spa while vacationing in Koh Samoi. I have to say indeed, they are so precessional and they provided all the services diligently to all of us. After seeing their effort , services, kindness, compassion and professionalism I got impressed and thought the amount you paid is totally worth it for the service you get here. At the beginning and at the they served us herbal tea too. Hygiene 10/10 Services 10/10 Customer dealing 10/10
0x3054f1d350fe6f3f_0xcc3bef44f76b534d.author: Sadaf Naz

0x3054f1d350fe6f3f_0xcc3bef44f76b534d.text: After 5 weeks in Thailand, on the day before i go home - i finally find the best massage. Unlike 90% of other massage places i have been, they have the right techniques (right pressure, slow place, not just rubbing with endless oil), delightful music, amazing chairs, and great service. This really was a premium massage, just sad i found it so late in my travels 😭❤️ but i hope i help someone else find that really good massage place they are looking for.
0x3054f1d350fe6f3f_0xcc3bef44f76b534d.author: Daniel Thu

0x3054f1d350fe6f3f_0xcc3bef44f76b534d.text: I’ve been traveling around Thailand for the past two months, and this was by far the most professional massage I’ve experienced. The level of care, knowledge, and technique was exceptional. I came in with an injury and left feeling truly healed and relieved. Thank you for making me feel so good and for taking such amazing care of my body. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a truly professional and therapeutic massage 🙏
0x3054f1d350fe6f3f_0xcc3bef44f76b534d.author: Elad Dayan

0x311d61975dc4a72d_0xcca4d3bb4241c497.text: I had an amazing experience at MSDC. From the moment I walked in, the staff was warm, welcoming, and highly professional. The front desk team was efficient and friendly, making the check-in process smooth and stress-free. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for top-notch dental care. They go above and beyond to ensure a positive and comfortable experience. Thank you for your exceptional service!

ร้านใหม่ สะอาดมาก พนักงานบริการน่ารัก เป็นกันเอง เหมือนทันตแพทย์จะมีแค่ 1 คน แต่สุภาพ แนะนำดีมาก ถ้าจะไปทำทันตกรรมควรโทรสอบถาม หรือนัดก่อนจะดีกว่า มีค่าบริการ เบื้องต้น 200 บาท เป็นค่าปรึกษา และค่า phisical hygieness 100 บาท
0x311d61975dc4a72d_0xcca4d3bb4241c497.en: The new clinic is very clean, and the staff are lovely and friendly. It seems like there's only one dentist, but they are polite and give great advice. It's best to call and make an appointment beforehand if you plan to have dental work done. There is an initial service fee of 200 baht, which includes a consultation fee and a physical hygiene fee of 100 baht.

0x311d61975dc4a72d_0xcca4d3bb4241c497.text: คุณหมอมือเบามากค่ะ ทำดี สะอาด อธิบายขั้นตอนเข้าใจดีค่ะ ต้องถามหมอเยอะหน่อย ส่วนตอนทำรู้สึกว่าผู้ช่วยจะเกรงใจหมอไม่ค่อยกล้าดูดน้ำลายให้คนไข้เท่าไหร่ มีสำลักบางเล็กน้อย น่าจะปกติของการทำฟัน
0x311d61975dc4a72d_0xcca4d3bb4241c497.author: Rosie
0x311d61975dc4a72d_0xcca4d3bb4241c497.en: The dentist was very gentle, did a good job, and was clean. They explained the procedure well. I had to ask the dentist a lot of questions. During the procedure, I felt the assistant was hesitant to suction the patient's saliva out of respect for the dentist. There was a little bit of choking, which I think is normal for dental work.

0x311d61975dc4a72d_0xcca4d3bb4241c497.text: The shop is clean and the atmosphere is very good. The doctor is polite and the tartar removal is very gentle. I didn't feel any pain at all. The staff provided excellent service.
0x311d61975dc4a72d_0xcca4d3bb4241c497.author: ปิยะนุช ไตรปกรณ์กุศล

0x311d61975dc4a72d_0xcca4d3bb4241c497.text: I came here to get my teeth filled. The price is not expensive. The dentist has a gentle touch. The shop is clean. Next time I will bring my son to get his teeth done here.
0x311d61975dc4a72d_0xcca4d3bb4241c497.author: monsicha sitthi

0x311d61975dc4a72d_0xcca4d3bb4241c497.text: Nice reception, cleanliness, and the dentist is carefully and professionally ka, I came here for yearly Tartar, and I appreciated na, gentle but firm.
Today I had my teeth cleaned with Dr. Thanasarn (Dr. Pon). He was very gentle and the service was excellent. The clinic was clean.
0x311d61975dc4a72d_0xcca4d3bb4241c497.author: wuthhikon pewkarm

0x311d61975dc4a72d_0xcca4d3bb4241c497.text: The dentist is kind and did a great job with the teeth cleaning. The place is clean, spacious, and offers comprehensive services.
0x311d61975dc4a72d_0xcca4d3bb4241c497.author: ขวัญวิมล สื่อสกุล

0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.text: มาอุดฟัน คุณหมอผู้หญิงใจดี มือเบา หลังทำฟันเสร็จ หมอให้คำแนะนำเกี่ยวกับการแปรงฟัน ควรใช้แปรงสีฟันขนนุ่ม ควบคู่กับการใช้ไหมขัดฟัน เพื่อรักษาอาการร่นของเหงือก กลับบ้านมาผมจึงปรับเปลี่ยนเป็นใช้ขนเป็ดมาแปรงฟันและใช้ส่วนของก้านขนเป็ดขัดซอกฟัน เพื่อสุขภาพในช่องปาก (อันนี้ล้อเล่นครับ) คลีนิกอยู่ชั้น 2 ในตึก มีที่จอดรถ นำใบจอดรถมาแสตมป์ที่คลีนิก สถานที่ดี นั่งรอคิวสะดวกสบาย มี figure ต่าง ๆ ให้ดูเล่นเพลิน ๆ และมีขั้นตอนเปลี่ยนรองเท้าเพื่อรักษาความสะอาดภายในคลีนิก
0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.author: Dawud
0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.en: I went to get a filling. The female dentist was kind and gentle. After the procedure, she gave me advice on brushing my teeth. She recommended using a soft-bristled toothbrush and dental floss to prevent gum recession. When I got home, I decided to switch to using a feather duster to brush my teeth and the feather tip to clean between my teeth for better oral health (just kidding!). The clinic is on the 2nd floor of the building. There's parking available; just get your parking ticket stamped at the clinic. The place is nice, with comfortable waiting areas and various figures to look at while you wait. There's also a shoe-changing procedure to maintain cleanliness within the clinic.

0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.text: I'd like to recommend a dental clinic in the Rama 3 area. I'm very impressed. Dr. Pong is kind, lovely, and has a gentle touch. Dr. Than does excellent fillings and is also gentle. All the assistants are friendly and smiling. The clinic is new, clean, and modern. I'm glad I came here. Thank you, doctor. :)
0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.author: Natsakorn Boonbumrungchai

0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.text: The doctor and staff are committed to providing the best possible treatment to patients. The emphasis here is on understanding, listening, and selecting the most suitable treatment for each individual. They provide excellent advice. Overall, it's a very good experience. #Importantly, they are very gentle.
0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.author: 动呐沫素琶德

0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.text: The service was excellent! The clinic was clean, and the dentist was very gentle and attentive to patients. They even let me choose my own music before the teeth whitening procedure, so I could listen to my favorite songs while waiting. I was very impressed!
0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.author: Nithiwadee Thongdee

0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.text: คุณหมอใจดีมากกก สะอาด ปลอดภัย มีที่จอดรถ ห้องน้ำก็ยังสะอาด แนะนำเลยค่ะ น้องพนักงานช่วยเหลือแนะนำเวลาเลือกสีจัดฟัน น่ารักค่ะ เคยทั้งถอนฟัน และก็จัดฟันอยู่ที่นี้ … 05/69 มีขนม กาแฟ น้ำดื่มด้วย บริการดีค่ะ
0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.author: Pasta BB
0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.en: The doctor is very kind. It's clean and safe, with parking available. Even the restrooms are clean. I highly recommend it. The staff are helpful and give advice when choosing braces colors; they're lovely. I've had both teeth extracted and braces done here... 05/69 They also have snacks, coffee, and water. Good service.

0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.text: I came for a teeth cleaning after 5 years. I thought I'd need anesthesia, but it wasn't necessary. The dentist was very gentle, and my teeth felt incredibly clean. I highly recommend it.
0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.author: สมูท กริบ

0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.text: ดีค่ะ แนะนำมา คุณหมอให้ข้อมูลคำปรึกษาสำหรับการจัดฟันใสดีมากค่ะ มีความยืดหยุ่นในแผนตามที่เราต้องการ แอดมินน่ารักค่ะ บริการดี มีโทรนัดหมายก่อนเวลา คลินิกสะอาด เครื่องมือพร้อมค่ะ
0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.author: Cee Sa-nguanjaturaphuti
0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.en: Great! I highly recommend this clinic. The doctor provided excellent information and consultation regarding clear aligners. They were very flexible with the treatment plan to suit my needs. The admin was lovely and the service was excellent. They called to schedule an appointment beforehand. The clinic was clean and fully equipped.

0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.text: The clinic is clean, the doctor is kind and very calm. The wisdom tooth extraction was incredibly gentle. I will definitely have my other wisdom tooth extracted here. 👍 …
0x30e299cdf41b73db_0x82bc5882d4764d32.author: Harakun Chutimataewin

0x30e29f3da02248fb_0x7f461a2d7730d1b0.text: Excellent service. Very nice and clean. Fast and efficient. Thank you guys. First time here and very impressive. Waiting room also has some snacks, coffee tea water milk and many favors of ice cream.
0x30e29f3da02248fb_0x7f461a2d7730d1b0.author: Anucha Read

0x30e29f3da02248fb_0x7f461a2d7730d1b0.text: Easiest to get cheap PrEP and PEP in Bangkok for foreigners, free for Thai❤️. Welcome for walk-in. One point service clinic for STDs.
0x30e29f3da02248fb_0x7f461a2d7730d1b0.author: P K

0x30e29f3da02248fb_0x7f461a2d7730d1b0.text: They offer Free check-up (Twice a year), Super friendly, Clean and great service! ⏰ You can get your results in just an hour.
0x30e29f3da02248fb_0x7f461a2d7730d1b0.author: Bowiito

0x30e29f3da02248fb_0x7f461a2d7730d1b0.text: Best clinic ever. Friendly and welcome to all. If you need some advice and don't want go hospital. …
0x30e29f3da02248fb_0x7f461a2d7730d1b0.author: Suwatchai Chieosapphakit

0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.text: I saw this place on Magazine B and really wanted to visit. The old building is beautiful, and the pharmacist(?) who served me was very kind. I think the four kinds of handmade Cheongsimhwan are their signature medicine, but honestly, I was worried so I didn't take a picture. The green balm mentioned in the book seemed similar to tiger balm. The packaging is pretty and makes a great gift. The digestive medicine in a tin case is available at the duty-free shop.
0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.author: SooKyung Koo

0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.text: A pharmacy nestled in an old house, nestled in a winding alley. It's not a modern pharmacy, but rather a traditional establishment that manufactures and sells pills, massage oil, and balms. It may seem closed, but upon entering, you'll find a staff member who asks if you'd like to watch a DVD of their history. It's a delight to see their pride, and I highly recommend it for souvenir shopping and sightseeing tours!
0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.author: 이범홍

0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.text: Banmowan Pharmacy, a place where tradition meets sophistication🌿 Since COVID-19, the building hasn't been open yet, but the products were already on display at the door. From the newly released tube balm to the signature tin-case digestive aid, the pharmacist was kind enough to explain everything and even help me test it out, so I was able to buy them without much fuss☺️
0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.author: 현경alphapurple

0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.text: Really traditional thai herb and medicine from generation to generation. All stuffs and things are all original. Very great atmosphere surrounded by the thai herb scents. Wonderful and friendly owner who is awesomely informative. The gate is always closed, once arrived just ring the bell. One of the best hidden gems of Bangkok.
0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.author: Sarah Watt

0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.text: This is a really cool century-old herbal medicine shop. They provide information in both Chinese and English, and the staff are very friendly and will help you take photos and give you a tour! The small outdoor space also has a lot of historical charm, so it's definitely worth a visit!
0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.author: HUI

0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.text: This authentic traditional Thai medicine shop, known as Baan Mor Wan, is run by a highly respected practitioner of traditional Thai medicine. Established during the reign of King Rama VI, the business has been passed down through generations. The building is a beautiful yellow colonial-style structure. Inside, it not only sells medicine but also houses a museum showcasing the shop's history, displaying traditional ingredients and tools used in medicine preparation. Staff are available to provide information and share the shop's stories.
0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.author: Panghom Jaa

0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.text: The century-old pharmacy has been repackaged, but the storefront has been preserved in its original form. It sells over-the-counter medicines for colds, headaches, and indigestion, both topical and oral, as well as massage creams that have been featured in foreign magazines and reports. The shopkeeper is a young woman, so I came here specifically to take a look (you have to ring a bell and take off your shoes to enter).
0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.author: Ray Chan

0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.text: Due to COVID-19, the storefront remains closed and is not yet open in autumn 2022. However, some products are available for purchase online or at the Siam Museum and the general store on the first floor of the Bangkok Art and Culture Centre. I can't wait to see their beautiful store.
0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.author: Cha Tora

0x3051935abd98d251_0x65c4b377e02edaf.text: “Dr. Ball's Clinic is truly a haven for pets in Nuea Khlong! The doctor provides attentive and friendly service, from vaccinations and spaying/neutering to general illnesses and postpartum care. Every step is done with gentleness and professionalism. The clinic is clean, well-equipped, and open every day from morning till evening, giving pet owners peace of mind every time they visit. For anyone who loves animals and wants their pets to receive the best possible care, Dr. Ball's Clinic is the answer you've been looking for!”
0x3051935abd98d251_0x65c4b377e02edaf.author: กานต์ แก่นแก้ว

0x3051935abd98d251_0x65c4b377e02edaf.text: The treatment is good and the price is affordable. I wasn't satisfied with the results at other clinics, but I was satisfied at Dr. Ball's, and it's not expensive. He gives good advice, he speaks kindly, and all the staff are lovely.
0x3051935abd98d251_0x65c4b377e02edaf.author: พิพอ นุชศิลป์

0x3051935abd98d251_0x65c4b377e02edaf.text: Excellent care. The staff are friendly and attentive to customers in line, and the vet is highly skilled. The treatment costs are very affordable, and they even sell imported pet food. A truly outstanding veterinary clinic.
0x3051935abd98d251_0x65c4b377e02edaf.author: Kolok

0x3051935abd98d251_0x65c4b377e02edaf.text: I took my female cat, Som, to get spayed by Dr. Ball. Her blood test results weren't good, so we have to wait 10 days and she's taking medication in the meantime. We've already entrusted three of our cats to Dr. Ball.
0x3051935abd98d251_0x65c4b377e02edaf.author: Teacher Get

0x3051935abd98d251_0x65c4b377e02edaf.text: All my sick dogs recovered after being treated here. The vet is skilled, explains things well, and doesn't prolong treatment unnecessarily. The prices are affordable for everyone. Excellent!
0x3051935abd98d251_0x65c4b377e02edaf.author: Arisa Densuwanrangsi

0x3051935abd98d251_0x65c4b377e02edaf.text: The doctor provided excellent care, and the treatment costs were reasonable. The doctor's assistants, both a young man and a young woman, were lovely. Overall, the clinic was outstanding!
0x3051935abd98d251_0x65c4b377e02edaf.author: Krabi noi Temple

0x3051935abd98d251_0x65c4b377e02edaf.text: The treatment was excellent. Dr. Ball is very friendly, and all the assistants are lovely. They provide excellent veterinary care at a reasonable price. I highly recommend them!
0x3051935abd98d251_0x65c4b377e02edaf.author: Pear Prapaslita Wilinpon

0x3051935abd98d251_0x65c4b377e02edaf.text: The prices aren't too high, the treatment is decent, the service is good, and the staff are polite. I get my cats spayed/neutered here very often.
0x3051935abd98d251_0x65c4b377e02edaf.author: Chayanan We

0x30e2957c792d595f_0xaee564375266ee3e.text: I was so impressed by the attentive care the vet gave to our beloved pet, who we treat like a child. The vet took excellent care of Boston. Thank you so much! I recommended this clinic to my sister, who has four cats, encouraging her to switch to this hospital. I regret not asking for the vet's name, but I hope other vet members will care for our four-legged friends as well as that lovely vet, who was both beautiful and incredibly caring towards Boston. Even though it was 9 PM, the vet wasn't rushed and provided excellent care. I was so impressed. It's a shame about Boston. (Also, for anyone wondering where to care for their pets after they pass away, I recommend this clinic near Wat Takian, Rama 5. You can Google for details.) The clinic is new, clean, spacious, has parking, closes at 9 PM, and the air conditioning is great. I hope they maintain this standard of care.
0x30e2957c792d595f_0xaee564375266ee3e.author: Kaikaew Rosenvang

0x30e2957c792d595f_0xaee564375266ee3e.text: Our first dog was a Thai dog, and we brought him here for vaccinations and care since he was one month old. Now he's seven or eight months old, so we brought him here to be spayed for seven days. The care here is excellent, from the vet to the caregivers (Dr. Bell is very kind to the dogs). The place might not be very big, but the care is thorough, clean, safe, and comfortable. The price is also reasonable compared to other places nearby. We've been impressed with this place from the first day until now. I would highly recommend it to any dog ​​parents who are hesitant. The care here is excellent and attentive. Highly recommended!
0x30e2957c792d595f_0xaee564375266ee3e.author: Orenchi Specialty Coffee

0x30e2957c792d595f_0xaee564375266ee3e.text: Our cat is 10 years old and hasn't had vet visits or vaccinations in 4-5 years. We made the right decision to bring her to this clinic. It's new, clean, and everything feels welcoming. The doctor and staff are incredibly kind and helpful. The prices are reasonable, not as expensive as we thought. All the equipment and tools are standard. Our cat had a blood test (results in 15 minutes), received two vaccinations, flea and tick treatment, and deworming – all in one visit for just over 2,000 baht! The price was amazing! There's also a pet hotel upstairs.
0x30e2957c792d595f_0xaee564375266ee3e.author: ภคพร เกตุศิริ

0x30e2957c792d595f_0xaee564375266ee3e.text: I brought my cat in for spaying. This was my first visit. The clinic is beautiful and very clean. The service was excellent, from the doctor to the staff. The doctor called to inform me about the blood test results and the surgery time, and also kept me updated on my cat's recovery after the surgery was complete. This greatly eased my anxiety. The doctor gave great advice and suggested adding the clinic's LINE account for quick answers to questions. They also provided daily updates on my cat's condition, including videos.
0x30e2957c792d595f_0xaee564375266ee3e.author: pattreeaya ingon

0x30e2957c792d595f_0xaee564375266ee3e.text: I brought my dog ​​to get spayed/neutered. The service was excellent, and they even educated me about my dog's patellar luxation. The spaying/neutering was done very well; the incision is beautiful. The clinic is clean. I was very impressed. The price was reasonable, not expensive at all. The clinic also provided excellent post-operative care. I highly recommend them!
0x30e2957c792d595f_0xaee564375266ee3e.author: Panyaphorn Bertsch

0x30e2957c792d595f_0xaee564375266ee3e.text: The vet is lovely and kind, the clinic is very clean, and the staff are polite and courteous. What's best is the reasonable price. Previously, we went to a clinic near Phutthamonthon Sai 4 with our other dog, but we weren't impressed. This will likely be our family's regular clinic.
0x30e2957c792d595f_0xaee564375266ee3e.author: patcharapa w

This location is closer to my residence, and the results of each massage are quite noticeable, even though I rotate therapists without specifying a particular therapist or making appointments in advance. I just contact them when it's convenient and come for a massage when they're free, averaging about once every two weeks. There was a break during the COVID-19 period when the clinic had to close due to the government's regulations. This resulted in me missing some massage sessions here for a while. Lately, I've been accumulating 10-hour sessions through reimbursement, and then coming for massages when convenient. This year, I've probably accumulated around 30 hours and am gradually using them. I mostly come for massages to treat neck, shoulder, and back pain (the ailments of people who work at computers all day). 0x311d6305f8b9a61f_0x817b9d4f9068f824.en: I recently used their services and I have to say I was extremely impressed!! 10000/10! I liked them from the moment I contacted them via LINE. The admin was excellent, answering my questions and providing complete and clear information. I even asked for the doctor's name, and they sent a picture and name of the doctor I would see if I came that day. That's how I decided to use this clinic. The front desk staff were also very helpful, polite, and didn't try to push unreasonable packages. I consulted with a female doctor about orthodontics. She was incredibly kind, explained everything clearly and in detail. She answered all my questions about my dental problems. As for the price of dental treatment, it was very reasonable, not overpriced. I've never been this impressed with a clinic before!

They didn't show any displeasure or complain about any further questions I had. The doctor had me prepare my mouth before starting the orthodontic treatment plan. 0x305025c6fd2758d1_0x5e151ba8f871dbf1.text: I originally came in looking for the Thai sticks Thailand is known for, and from the moment we walked into the shop, Mr. Stoney made us feel welcomed. He was incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and passionate about both the product and the culture behind it. As someone from Oregon who’s experienced with high-quality cannabis, I was genuinely impressed. The variety he had available was astounding. Everything was extremely aromatic, the buds were dense and clearly well cared for, and you could immediately see the passion and dedication from the growers behind it. After purchasing a Thai stick pre-roll, we stayed and spent time talking with Mr. Stoney, his colleagues, and friends. They treated us like family. I was later offered the opportunity to try one of Stoney’s personal selections, and honestly, it became one of the most profound and spiritual experiences I’ve ever had. I felt deeply connected to the universe and even reflected on my late father-in-law in a way that was genuinely healing. Throughout the experience, Mr. Stoney and everyone there looked after both me and my wife with kindness, hospitality, and care. It went far beyond just being a cannabis shop. It felt authentic, personal, and rooted in real culture and community. Hands down, some of the best people and growers I’ve ever met. Mr. Stoney feels like a modern-day legend keeping the tradition and spirit alive that many of us only ever heard about or read about years ago. Highly recommend visiting. Highly recommend getting to know the people behind it. LEGEND

0x30da3b1749577373_0xd4deb5893e68325e.text: Very happy with the service. I was nervous as there was only one other review but I saw an ad on Instagram and decided to give them a try to touch up my lip filler. I only do 1cc and it had been over 7 months since I last touched it up in my home country. I was concerned because I am not a fan of the 'cherry lip' shape that is most popular here and most of the result photos on Insta were of clients who had requested that shape. I met with the Dr and explained that I liked the shape of my lips and just wanted them fuller with a few adjustments. The Dr asked if I had any photos of the shapes that I like and I showed him. He suggested 2 different types of filler - restylane kysse and Flore. I chose the Flore because it is more cost efficient (I think around 7,000THB per cc). Once the Dr made the suggestions I then left with the sales associate who showed me the products and took me through pricing. I paid, sat with the numbing cream for about 40 minutes and then the Dr administered the filler. He was extremely nice and professional, took his time and told me that we could take a break whenever I wanted and also asked me if I was okay several times. The assistant was also so sweet and attentive. The clinic is well-managed, pretty and clean. Everybody smiles at you and they provide water while you wait. 4 days later and the swelling has gone down and I'm SUPER happy with the results. There is some swelling but the shape and feel is exactly what I wanted - soft and smooth with no bumps or hardness. I will go again for any other aesthetic needs and highly recommend. Lastly, they did not offer any incentive for a review and nor did I request or expect one - they did not even mention a review. Adding this as another clinic I went to offered me a discount for a 5-star review and that made me concerned that the reviews I had seen were not honest.

0x30e29fd0ab1794f9_0xc62352c8206c53ae.text: This is my second time getting braces. I had them 12 years ago at another clinic. Dr. Ing gave good advice (my front teeth are misaligned; the doctor suggested implants, costing 4500-5000 baht, but it's optional. If I do it, treatment will take up to 5 years. The X-ray also showed a root problem with one tooth and a chance of one front tooth dying, but the doctor said it might not happen). The treatment plan is for 2-3 years. I'm a little worried and scared because I'm older now, and I've been afraid of dentists since I was a child. I'm getting braces because my teeth feel spaced out, my front teeth protrude, and they're starting to become crooked (I didn't wear my retainer regularly). I've read good reviews, and it's close to home. I'll give it a try and share my review later. Currently, the braces cost is 2100 baht for cleaning and scaling (900 baht under social security, plus 400 baht for the rest). The first time the braces are fitted is on August 19th, 2025 (upper teeth, lower teeth not yet fitted; the doctor said to adjust). The doctor asked... We chose the orthodontic treatment package, Package 1, priced at 37,000 baht. The first four months were paid at 3,000 baht each, followed by 1,000 baht per month thereafter. The first payment included a brush set and service fee of 350 baht, bringing the total to 3,350 baht. On 23/9/68, the rubber bands were changed, the lower braces were reattached, and the front teeth were hitting the braces, requiring the last tooth on each side to be lifted (1,000 baht). The total cost was 4,100 baht. The tooth lifting caused a malocclusion; I can't bite properly and have to eat soft foods in small bites for now. On 26/10/68, the wire at the back came loose from the bracket. I had to see the dentist urgently and also got my teeth stained (3,100 baht).

0x30da3aa6cdeb45fb_0x2e9cf506833dd80d.text: I ve been a patient of Dr Tawatchai and his clinic staff for 35 years . Im 70 now and in great health . My brother and several other members of my family are also doctors so I often consult with them before or after visiting the clinic . To make a long story short Dr Tawatchai has always cured my problems and his strategy has always been spot on with what I was advised would be the approach by medical professionals in Canada. He 's recommended the very best specialists in CM for me and subtly and with great diplomacy steered me away from others. Most recently we saw him for annual health check up .First time we have had it done in Thailand (covid has had us here for almost 2 years now,). It was extremely thorough .chest and abdomen x ray EKG and myriad blood tests etc. Blood drawn in the morning all lab results by 6 pm and a very thorough explanation of all results including very diplomatic suggestions on what he would recommend as strategies to stay healthy or remedy issues. There is no computers in his office {maybe one at the reception now) so he looks a you not a computer screen when you visit. He was great doctor 35 years ago and he has aged like fine wine . I cant say enough about him . Fine doctor and fine human being as are all his staff.
0x30da3aa6cdeb45fb_0x2e9cf506833dd80d.author: Stephen Hartwick

0x30da3aa6cdeb45fb_0x2e9cf506833dd80d.text: Saw a wonderful doctor there who spoke very good English post- a Muay Thai injury. Ascertained that my toe wasn’t broken - just swollen and infected inside the skin. Prescribed a course of antibiotics and a tetanus jab - all done within an hour. Toe has healed well after a week or so. Local Thai prices (all in for 670 baht) as it serves the local Thai community - though still very willing to help me as a young British male. Helpful, capable and friendly nurses and staff. Likely best to arrive at around 7.30am before the clinic opens to be within the first customers as many arrive around 8am. There are two entrances - maybe best to stand/sit at the entrance facing the coffee shop as that is where most people line up. I sat on the side entrance and had to be saved by a lovely Thai lady who knew I was second in line as I arrived a 7.15am or so. I can recommend very highly - I will aim to go again should I ever be in Chiang Mai and need to visit a clinic.
0x30da3aa6cdeb45fb_0x2e9cf506833dd80d.author: F. Lyon

0x30da3aa6cdeb45fb_0x2e9cf506833dd80d.text: I had a bad cough and wanted to get looked at by an english speaking doctor and was lucky enough to find this clinic. Everyone was calm and orderly, I was checked, got an xray and was given meds. Just amazing! Our doctors at home have alot to learn from them. Dr spoke english, clearly explained everything, no stress at all. They open at 8am. If you want to you can get there earlier as there will be a queue. Payment is in cash only after treatment. You wait till you are called and the whole process took 90 mins, but so calm and everyone waits their turn patiently. After the xray and seeing the dr again, he gave me a full explanation of which meds etc and the pharmacy there prepared and gave them to me. And all this for 720 bht! And without computers, just human beings treating human beings. I was so worried about being sick in Thailand and this place completely upturned my preconceptions! Big Thanks to this clinic
0x30da3aa6cdeb45fb_0x2e9cf506833dd80d.author: Michelle Attiach

0x30da3aa6cdeb45fb_0x2e9cf506833dd80d.text: I visited the doctor for a bronchitis / sinusitis that did not want to go away (more than a month). The doctor was really nice, took some X-ray and did an exam while explaining what he was doing and how he came to his conclusion. I felt very safe and had a very good experience with him and all of his staff. You do need to get there early if you want to see the doctor. I got there around 8:45 am and I saw the doctor around noon. I would recommend going there as soon as it opens at 8 am. It costs me 1040 baht including X-ray and medication (15 days antibiotics and pills for my cough and congestion). He speaks good english and answered all my questions. I would recommend going to this clinic if like me you need to see a doctor for something that is not urgent but requires treatment while you are traveling in Chiang Mai.
0x30da3aa6cdeb45fb_0x2e9cf506833dd80d.author: kym bousquet

0x30da3aa6cdeb45fb_0x2e9cf506833dd80d.text: Friday 7:45 a.m. - 5 people waiting 8:00 a.m. - 15 people 8:25 a.m. - 24 people 9:45 a.m. - 35 people It's not a very big place so, if you don't want to wait forever, get here at 7:30 sharp You need to wear a proper mask. They won't accept anything else. Drinking water available for free in the waiting area I arrived at 7:45 and was completely finished with everything at 9:45 Got two x-rays completed and doctors consultation total price 560 baht I was quoted 3000 baht at the Saipat hospital for the same thing I busted my foot and thought I broke my toe, needed X-rays and doctors consultation Doctor was very professional, spoke perfect English, knows what he's doing, staff was professional, about 20 seats in waiting room, no AC, only fans! If you're on a budget I recommend this place
0x30da3aa6cdeb45fb_0x2e9cf506833dd80d.author: Meowski

0x30da3aa6cdeb45fb_0x2e9cf506833dd80d.text: What a happy doctor and so reasonable. He is probably in his 60s speaks fluent English and very competent .He is very popular and liked by the community. They do not take appointments so you must attend before 8.00am if you can ,to get a place in the queue. The doctor doesn’t arrive until after 9.30am. You can leave and come back but if you loose your place bad luck.I was 3rd in line and saw the doctor at 10.00am. While I was waiting patients came in to see the doctor and after leaving their name were told to come back after 11.00 am. The pharmacist prepare the medication while you wait. They don’t give you a prescription to be filled. How great is that ! Total cost THB 480 incl the medication The guy is an angel.

0x30e29f8bd4107e0b_0x45458aed3fae74f7.text: Convenient location near BTS On Nut, less than 100 meters away. Clean restrooms. You can schedule appointments online in advance. No waiting upon arrival; appointments are scheduled on time. The person in charge of coordination and management provided excellent and detailed information. I inquired about social security benefits and was informed that they could be used (ID card required). Regarding treatment costs, a clear list of treatments and prices was provided. The prices are standard, but considering the convenience of the location, the time saved from scheduling in advance, and the service and treatment itself, it was more than worth it. I was treated by Dr. Lertlak Ruangsinpinya. Upon entering the examination room, the doctor asked about my symptoms and explained the possible causes. Then, the doctor began examining my teeth, offering me a mirror to view my teeth while she examined them, so I could understand what was happening. After a (detailed) examination, the doctor mentioned a small cavity and offered three options: 1. X-ray for a more detailed examination of any problems. 2. Filling (optional, as the cavity was small, but prompt filling was recommended). 3. Scaling (tartar removal). The cost of each item was also explained. I opted for all three treatments. It started with an X-ray. When the results came back, the doctor pointed out and explained every detail, showing where the dark spots (on the film) might be and why. The doctor then thoroughly examined the problematic areas. The results showed only one cavity, exactly as the doctor had initially examined. Then they began filling the tooth and scaling. During the treatment, these are some of the things I remember hearing: "Close your mouth, rest your mouth," the doctor knew my mouth was tired (lol), "Raise your left hand if it hurts," "I need to go a little deeper here," "Relax your mouth," "Turn to the right, bend down a little," "Adjust the chair." Everything I've written here is to convey that the doctor communicated with the patient exceptionally well, clearly, professionally, and always considered the patient's needs. I knew in advance what would happen during the treatment. Other doctors I've been treated by elsewhere were also very good, but Dr. Lertlak was exceptional. She paid attention to every detail (lol), and it created understanding and peace of mind as a patient. The doctor's assistant was also very helpful in answering questions and highly skilled. The doctor communicated with the patient throughout the treatment, but the assistant hardly needed to be told what to do. Then, during the post-scaling irrigation, the assistant suctioned the water very well. I didn't feel like my mouth was flooded with water at all. While writing this, I also saw reviews about other doctors here. They all provide excellent treatment. I recommend you try it! For foreigners reading this review, you should definitely visit this clinic. I couldn’t recommend it more. The service and treatment are excellent. The price is standard—actually even cheap compared to what you receive. You can check the prices before deciding, as they clearly list all prices and keep them fair.

0x30e2979947f01313_0x31226823fad3079.text: ★★★★★ A dentist friend recommended Teeth Time BKK to me because I had been dealing with a chronic dental issue. I had already received treatment elsewhere, but unfortunately the problem never completely went away. My friend suggested that I see Dr. Duang, and I’m very glad I did. Dr. Duang was excellent. He took the time to examine my case carefully and explained everything in great detail from what might be causing the problem to the different treatment options available. His explanations were clear and easy to understand, and you can really tell that he is very experienced, especially with more complicated cases. I never felt rushed at any point. I also had a CT scan done here. The clinic has comprehensive and modern equipment, the whole process was quick and efficient, and the price was very reasonable. I really appreciated being able to have the examination, scan, and consultation handled smoothly in one place. The entire team deserves a compliment as well. Everyone was friendly, helpful, and attentive. Their teamwork is noticeable, especially in how well they manage appointments and coordinate everything. Even though there were several steps involved in my visit, everything moved quickly and I didn’t have to wait unnecessarily. One small detail that impressed me more than I expected: this is the first dental clinic I’ve visited where they simply used my Thai ID card to register and create my patient record. No sitting around filling out the same information on multiple forms. This is exactly how it should be in 2026! 😂 It’s a small thing, but it immediately made the whole experience feel modern and well organized. As for the clinic itself, it’s extremely clean, professional, and well equipped. Everything feels organized and properly maintained, which gives you confidence when you’re undergoing treatment. Overall, I’m extremely impressed—from Dr. Duang and the dental team to the staff, equipment, and overall system. For someone like me who has been dealing with a persistent problem even after previous treatment elsewhere, finally meeting a dentist who carefully investigates the issue and clearly explains what is happening makes a huge difference. Easily one of the best dental clinic experiences I’ve ever had. Highly recommended, especially if you have a complicated or persistent dental problem and want a dentist who takes the time to properly investigate and explain your case.

0x30e2979947f01313_0x31226823fad3079.author: Cck
0x30e2979947f01313_0x31226823fad3079.en: I went for root canal treatment and a crown... I was impressed with everyone working there. From the moment I called, it was the only place where I told them I had a toothache and needed root canal treatment. They were the only ones who asked if it was convenient for me to come that day. I was afraid of dental work, and they took note of it and said they would inform the dentist in advance. I had inquired at several other places, and the waiting lists were quite long. Other places also told me to tell the dentist on the day of the procedure that I was afraid of dental work. When I met the root canal specialist, he explained everything in detail, and he listened attentively to my fears, truly ready to help me. The dentist's assistant also helped me feel relaxed. The crown specialist was also very kind. The people at the counter spoke politely and smiled. The cleaning staff in the restroom were also humble and helpful. It might seem like small things, but the overall feeling was great. Finally, today was my last visit, and I haven't scheduled anything further. It was raining, and the cleaning staff saw my small umbrella and offered to give me a larger one. These little things I received from this place weren't just about getting treated or having good treatment... The cost of the treatment was also excellent. It was worth receiving such good treatment...but what I gained in return, emotionally, is truly even more valuable....I'm lucky to have come here...Thank you all so much.

0x30e2979947f01313_0x31226823fad3079.text: ครั้งแรกกับที่นี่เช่นกัน ได้ข่าวว่าบริการดีสะอาดสะอ้านแล้วก็สมคําร่ำลือของจริง แนะนําว่าต้องนัดก่อนเข้ามาไม่สามารถ walk in ได้ ก่อนวันนัดจะมีการโทรคอนเฟิร์มอีกที มาถึงแล้วลงทะเบียนเป็นคนไข้ก่อน จากนั้นวัดความดัน แล้วก็ไปเช็คอัพที่ห้องได้เลย ที้นี่มี 5-6 ห้อง ต้องเช็คคิวหมอดีๆ คุณหมอ GP น่ารักมาก ขูดหินปูนสะอาดมาก ใช้เวลาในการขัดทีละซี่ ไม่ได้ขูดลวกๆ เลือดไม่ไหลสักหยด ถ้ามีปัญหาอื่นๆปรึกษาได้เลย เช่น เสียวฟัน แนะนํา ยาสีฟันช่วยลดเสียวฟันให้ ดูแลอย่างดีในราคา 2ใบเทา มีทอนนะ ส่วนใครที่ทํารากเทียมที่นี่มีให้เลือกราคาหลายระดับหน้า ไม่ว่าจะเป็นเกาหลี หรือยุโรป แวะมาเช็คราคากัน
0x30e2979947f01313_0x31226823fad3079.author: Izy Naamkaeng
0x30e2979947f01313_0x31226823fad3079.en: This was my first time here too. I heard the service was good and it was very clean, and it really lived up to the hype. I recommend making an appointment beforehand; walk-ins are not accepted. They will call to confirm your appointment the day before. Upon arrival, register as a patient, then have your blood pressure checked, and then proceed to your room for your check-up. There are 5-6 rooms here, so be sure to check the doctor's schedule carefully. The GP was very nice and thorough with the scaling. They took their time polishing each tooth individually, not just doing it haphazardly. Not a single drop of blood was shed. If you have other problems, you can consult them, such as tooth sensitivity. They recommended toothpaste to help reduce sensitivity. Excellent care for 2,000 baht (with change). For those considering dental implants, they have several price ranges available, whether Korean or European implants. Stop by and check the prices.

0x30e2979947f01313_0x31226823fad3079.text: I've been bringing my daughter to this dental clinic since her first tooth, and now she's 3 years and 9 months old. I'm impressed with both the location and Dr. Mew Patcharee, who takes such good care of my daughter's teeth. She doesn't cry anymore and isn't afraid of dental work; she's so happy and even wants to play on the slide at the clinic! I'm also very impressed; the doctor and all the staff are truly dedicated to providing excellent service. If you're still hesitant about finding a good dental clinic in the Thonburi area, I highly recommend this one! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
0x30e2979947f01313_0x31226823fad3079.author: Sivaporn Theerasoradej

0x30e2979947f01313_0x31226823fad3079.en: I was unimpressed with the service staff at the reception desk. I waited outside for almost 20 minutes until I had to go and ask. I was told that I was finished and could leave, that there were no charges, and that there was no appointment. I had to tell them that the staff inside said there were appointments before they checked. If I hadn't gone to ask, I probably would have waited until the clinic closed. However, the doctor who treated my wisdom tooth and the staff inside the examination room were excellent. I would give them 5 stars. But encountering these two instances of inaccurate service staff treatment was very frustrating.

0x30e28f3bc7195c43_0x962d42a09af9ba2b.text: The vet, assistants, and housekeepers are all wonderful. They all care for our cat as if she were their own, showing genuine concern and love for animals. They remember all their patients, both at the clinic and the pet hotel. Honestly, it's incredible how attentive they are, to the point that we feel a little embarrassed by their care. Thank you so much to the vet, nurses, and housekeepers. From a patient's perspective, they don't just care for individual cases; they care for every single one. While waiting in the clinic, I could feel the positive energy the vet and nurses had for our pets. I don't know how to repay them all. I wish you all the best and hope you all prosper! Paopao loves Marilyn very much! 🥹🥹

0x30e28f3bc7195c43_0x962d42a09af9ba2b.text: I used Malinee Cat Hotel and Clinic. During the several days I left my cat at the hotel, the staff updated me daily on details of my cat's eating, sleeping, playing, etc. Leaving my cat here was completely safe and worry-free. The cat hotel is very clean. The rooms are well-categorized by type. The air inside is cool and comfortable, not stuffy. The staff are all very helpful and provide excellent advice. The vet gave excellent advice regarding my cat. My cat, Latte, is a regular customer here, both as a cat hotel guest and as a vaccination patient at the clinic. Latte received all her vaccinations as scheduled by the vet. Latte highly recommends this place. 10/10 Everything you need in one place.

0x30e28f3bc7195c43_0x962d42a09af9ba2b.text: It's me, Guay. We didn't intend to come to the vet, but we stayed at a cat hotel here. The cat hotel is comfortable, with 24-hour cameras. While staying at this wonderful hotel, one day I became seriously ill with multiple ailments 😿. We went to several places, but Dr. Pim and her team are lovely and genuinely love animals – 10/10, no complaints! The price is also good. If you're in Bang Bua Thong or Sombat Buri, I highly recommend bringing your cat here for treatment ❤️❤️. Thank you so much to the doctor for being so kind to me and treating me until I was well 🥰🥰😺

Normally, the cat is very scared, but when I come here, the cat isn't stressed at all. I'm very impressed, it really lives up to its reputation in the reviews. 👍

0x30e28f3bc7195c43_0x962d42a09af9ba2b.text: The vet and staff are kind and love animals very much. The atmosphere is nice and clean. 0x30e28f3bc7195c43_0x962d42a09af9ba2b.author: Pon Pon

0x305029d63f715887_0xa02ec675d1786117.text: Healing and Luxury at Chivitr, Phuket After more than a year of unsuccessful treatments in Hamburg - in clinics, with orthopedists, and physiotherapists, using a variety of medications and painkillers - I finally found relief at Chivitr in Phuket. The team applied traditional Chinese and Thai medicine such as massage, acupuncture, and cupping, which alleviated at least 70% of my elbow and shoulder pain. A few months later, I am delighted to report a complete recovery. Beyond the exceptional medical care, Chivitr itself is a fantastic place. The architecture is stunning, blending luxury with traditional elements. Its location near one of Phuket's most beautiful beaches makes it an ideal holiday destination. I highly recommend staying here and would like to extend my deepest thanks to Or and the entire team.
0x305029d63f715887_0xa02ec675d1786117.author: Arjan S

0x305029d63f715887_0xa02ec675d1786117.text: This place is very unique and there is nothing like it anywhere. I would rate it 10 stars, if I could. It is a result of 10 years of work by the owner, every single detail from rain water collection system to every single piece of furniture that was custom designed and made from the finest materials, design fabrics, teak wooden floors, 128 antique wooden doors, all appliances, salt water pools reflect love and passion for excellence and creativity that is second to none. There are only 8 units and they're all unique in style , art work, size and decor located around a big pool. Property is elevated over the sea level and there is always a pleasant breeze making guests comfortable even in the middle of hot day. I came as a guest and I left my heart there longing for return..
0x305029d63f715887_0xa02ec675d1786117.author: Vladimir Lozovsky

0x305029d63f715887_0xa02ec675d1786117.text: Chivtr is a healing place like no other. Like a precious gem set against a hill overlooking a vast pond, this artfully built oriental-inspired estate is a private and luxurious enclave for healing and rejuvenating tired bodies, minds and souls. My experience with the owner, Or, and her staff were second to none on the several treatments I had for my eczema outbreak. The atmosphere is professional, warm and calm from beginning to end. Within one or two treatments, the flare subsided substantially. Or was kind enough to even cook some of the most delicious and healthy dishes that I will never forget. Chivitr is a dream home away from home where you can stay for a few days or drop-in for the best care, programmes and treatments to heal and rejuvenate holistically.
0x305029d63f715887_0xa02ec675d1786117.author: Sabrina Renee Chong

0x305029d63f715887_0xa02ec675d1786117.text: A unique high-class resort with 11 rooms and exclusive therapy options. The carefully selected hotel style, the rooms, and the spa are impeccably clean and a blend of traditional and modern. The therapists and the owner are professional, friendly, and very attentive. I highly recommend the signature treatments and the Watsu treatments. Chivitr is a gem in southern Phuket for those seeking quality, sustainability, and professional Far Eastern healing (Traditional Chinese Medicine & Traditional Chinese Medicine). Guests will not only find what they're looking for here but will be more than pleasantly surprised by the diversity of Chivitr Wellness. Thank you, my top address in Phuket.
0x305029d63f715887_0xa02ec675d1786117.author: Caterina Carbone

0x305029d63f715887_0xa02ec675d1786117.text: I recall with great delight and sincere gratitude our two-week vacation at the boutique hotel our daughter found and booked for us. The 10-room hotel allowed us to rest and relax. During our entire stay, we only met another guest once. The huge pool in front of the Water Villa was entirely ours. The hotel offered a wide range of wellness programs, massages, and spa treatments, which we, of course, took advantage of and left feeling recharged and emotionally charged. There are places to connect with nature, practice yoga, and a healthy breakfast delivered to your room. Chivitr is our place of power and our secret place in Phuket.
0x305029d63f715887_0xa02ec675d1786117.author: Elena Burykina

0x305029d63f715887_0xa02ec675d1786117.text: Comments speak for themselves, but I wanted to add one more! We stayed at the resort and had a remarkable, healing, and lovely time. The rooms are gorgeous, they offer a broad array of treatment (massage, ELT, sound therapy, water/float therapy and more) and they are really well done. It's a very high level of service and care. Treatments were incredible and they'll personalize a plan for your stay. Thank you to the staff and shoutout to Or! If you're coming to Phuket looking for wellness with overnight stays then this is a world class option.
0x305029d63f715887_0xa02ec675d1786117.author: Stephan Leeds

0x305029d63f715887_0xa02ec675d1786117.text: It's a place that comes very close to my idea of ​​paradise, if such a thing ever existed. Each suite is furnished with impeccable taste, every detail is carefully considered, nothing is left to chance. You come here to be reborn, the treatments are designed by professionals. Everything is carefully planned to restore body and mind. The person who manages the facility is attentive to every wish, what more can I say? Even if only once in your life, you have to treat yourself to such a dream.
0x305029d63f715887_0xa02ec675d1786117.author: Sandra Bozzarelli

0x305029d63f715887_0xa02ec675d1786117.text: Quite a nice hotel but evidently they have not seen the same occupancy during the pandemic. 0x311d7965e46439a3_0x651115c6edc7f8f.text: I've used this clinic many times before because it's close to home. I've always paid for everything myself and have always been impressed with the service. But yesterday was terrible. The first thing they said was, "You're arriving very late? If the clinic is about to close, you can let us know. But we're still serving those before us." We had to wait in line for the medical history check. The clinic was still open even after we left for treatment. The tone of voice was rude. They said, "Your insurance isn't here, you have to pay yourself. The antiviral flu medication is 60 baht per tablet," and went on and on. I waited for the nurse to finish speaking before saying, "It's okay, my youngest child is also treated here and we pay ourselves." The nurse replied, "Okay, you should have informed us beforehand." Honestly, they could have just informed us. The tone of voice was one thing, but the way they talked and acted, like they weren't welcoming, really bothered me. It's a shame about the poor service, especially since the doctor is excellent. My previous visits have always been impressive, and I always made a point of coming here. This will probably be my last visit. I'd rather go to another clinic. I don't want to experience something like this again that made me feel so bad.

I'm very impressed with the service at this clinic, from the dentist (gentle touch, not much pain) to the friendly and attentive staff at the counter. Thank you.

0x30fdaa5319eea7a3_0x98f98203176b8172.text: I have been living in Thailand for several months. This is the first time I have felt so angry about a service experience. Today, I went to pick up my tailored tooth retainers. I asked the receptionist whether they had been cleaned, and she replied that they had already been cleaned. After that, I put them in my mouth. Immediately, a strong bitter taste spread across my tongue, and I started vomiting. I went to the restroom and washed the retainers myself, but it did not help. I continued vomiting and felt extremely uncomfortable. During this time, none of the nurses or receptionists asked whether I was okay or offered any assistance. I showed them the blue chemical residue on the retainers, but they did not seem to know what to do. Later, an elderly lady approached me and said, “You need to wash it by yourself.” I replied, “I already washed it.” Eventually, another dentist came and helped me clean the retainers using a different type of solution, after which the bitter taste finally disappeared. Up to now, I still do not know what those blue chemical residues were or whether they are harmful to my health. After this incident, I began to question whether the politeness and humble image of Thai people is sometimes only superficial. When a patient is vomiting, shouldn’t medical staff at least ask if the patient is okay?

Where to begin… First up, the 14-day retreat program last year was truly powerful. I lost some weight and it helped with a skin issue I had, but it was the results after the program that had the most impact. I felt like I had a new mindset and started noticing lots of little synchronicities. For example, some new job opportunities essentially fell into my lap, I met some very interesting new people, and some small things I'd wanted for a long while seemed to just materialize in my life. It’s difficult to explain, but it felt like there had been a change externally as well as internally. I’d wanted to stay longer, but had to go back to work, so I decided to return this year after a trip to Singapore and do the full 21 days to keep the positive momentum going and complete the change in myself (but as the detox to-go option, so I could still follow my regular routine). Initially, it was a little more difficult, and I felt I needed to increase the amount of juice I was drinking to match the energy I was spending on work and going to the gym. Ivor was on-hand to talk me through the process though and give me some recommendations. After 21 days (and two liver flushes), I lost 8kg! And my skin issue had cleared completely. Even though the process was a little harder during the longer detox, I finished with a remarkable sense of peace and clarity. I was a bit worried I was too relaxed (!) and had lost my drive a little, but my motivation soon returned after I slowly reintroduced food. Apparently this calm feeling was related to clearing all the acid waste from the body, as it had become much more alkaline. If you’ve ever fasted before, you know the detox clarity I’m talking about. It’s not like your problems disappear, more that you aren’t so worried about dealing with them, and are content to let things just unfold. I really feel like it has been the ultimate reset for my body, both physically and mentally. I’m writing this just over a week later and it’s like I have an entirely new perspective. Everything feels remarkably in flow. It’s going to be exciting to see what changes happen in my life as a result. If you can’t do the retreat program, it’s entirely doable to make the juice yourself at home or elsewhere on Koh Samui and go about life as normal with the detox to go (I did it in an Airbnb nearby and Ivor lent me a juicer!). I highly recommend doing the full 21 days if you can. It feels life changing!
0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.author: Simon Fogg

0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.text: This is my first time completing a Detox Program of this nature. I have used colonics over the years and occasionally done parasite cleanses which I haven't successfully completed because they're too hard to take. I like to detox in the spring. Since my family and I are now based in Asia, I did a Google search for "Detox program in Asia" (after not hearing back from a certain program in the Philippines). The Source popped up & I emailed to express my interest and motivation to do the program in a few weeks. Ivor at The Source immediately responded, reached out to me on Whatsapp & gave me instructions and recommendations for where to stay etc. The whole process of logistics was easy, thanks to Ivor's help. Getting to Thailand and finding accommodation was the easy part. The harder part was doing the Detox. Truth told, I wanted it to work but was low key worried, nervous and anxious that it may not work due to my sensitivity in general and food sensitivities in particular. I had a sense of how colonics worked but had no reference point for this herbal detox program. Upon my arrival in Koh Samui & going to The Source for my first consultation, Ivor did his best to educate and reassure me without hyping up the program and for that I am grateful. I got started on the OJ Fast that same morning and couldn't believe how easy it was to take everything including the capsules, syrups, tonics, tinctures. Everything was surprisingly tasty. 4-1/2 days and several bathroom trips later I have lost a lot of waste from my guts and approximately 9 pounds! I nearly cried in disbelief at what had happened and how quickly. I gained healthier, glowing skin and I am learning to eat foods in the right way at the right time! There are so many amazing bonuses built into this program like the amazing massages at The Spa Resorts and the incredible sessions with the man, the mystic, the Master himself, the Healer Jet Lee. ✨️ His sessions alone are priceless. I just got home from the program and for the first time in my life, I am enjoying eating a salad; not just tolerating it! I am loving tomatoes now which was a food I couldn't have before due to sensitivities. ❤️ This program is a game-changer for anyone seeking to live a sustainably healthy lifestyle or anyone struggling with weight loss issues. I highly recommend this program! I think it's one of the best in the world! I am already recommending to family and am planning to do it again!
0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.author: Lorna Blake

0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.text: I did Program B at the Source in April for 2 weeks on the OJ fast after trawling through reviews of all the available detox programs on Koh Samui. Previously I did a one week program at The Spa Resorts about 5 years ago. While I had great results then losing 5kg in a week, I was keen to try a program without colonics. I expected to lose at least 5kg again but ended up losing about 1 kg a week instead. I still highly recommend this program as I feel it was a holistic reset and one that is good for your body and soul. I would definitely do it again because I continued to lose weight when I got home even though I was eating again. While I am mindful of what I eat, social events meant I was dining out and drinking and even having dessert but the weight still came off. I think this is because of a full body reset plus introduction of some healthy habits (introduction of 5 minute HIIT workout daily). The entire program genuinely helped me to recover my energy levels. I became very unwell during Covid with my thyroid function destroyed by autoimmunity. The extra weight stacked on during lockdown, being over 40 and having PCOS all worked against me and for the past few years I felt exhausted all the time with no energy. Since coming home from the program my energy levels have returned and I have the bounce back in my step. My skin became insanely soft and silky smooth during the program. I’m back to my pre-Covid figure. I’ve lost weight on the areas that matter especially all the belly fat I was carrying. Jet Lee (not the actor - LOL) I had the privilege of seeing Jet Lee 4 times as I was on Program B. This was unlike anything I had previously experienced and I would say it is worth traveling to Koh Samui just for this treatment. I don’t want to say too much more because I feel that it is very much up to the individual - what you personally are ready to get out of the treatment - that sets the tone for your results. For me, it was completely unexpected what happened for me and far exceeded my expectations. Ivor provided excellent support throughout the whole process. He answered questions, provides you handouts, and communicates regularly via WhatsApp. He sends you further info and support there when you need it. So if you’re reading this review and still wondering whether to book, just do yourself a massive favour and reach out to Ivor. It will be the best thing you’ve done all year.
0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.author: Jae Yeo

0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.text: I have just completed a 7 day detox with Ivor at the Source in Lamai . Although I have a healthy lifestyle and follow a balanced, natural plant based diet I was feeing a bit sluggish and noticing that some patterns had snuck in, like ‘needing’ a daily afternoon pick me up or a sweet treat at the end of the day and decided that a detox would be a good way to reset. The program is simple to follow and well supported and you will receive as much individual attention as you need through the process. I opted for the orange juice fast for the first 3 days and then moved to green juices and clear vegetable broth ( in the evenings ) for the remaining 4 days - I would have stayed with the orange juice for a longer period but my supply dried up after the 3 days so moved to plan b. After feeling a bit of fatigue for the first 2 days a real sense of clarity and lightness prevailed for the remainder of the week. The herbs and tonics support the detox process nicely and I noticed that my digestion continued to work well though the week. This was a gentler detox than ones I have done in the past and I really appreciated the natural approach. I loved the fact that once you have the herbs you could really do this detox wherever you find yourself provided that you have easy access to fruit and vegetables and some extra time on your hands to truly get the full benefit of the experience. I came to the end the week feeling clear and alert, sleeping really well and also noticed a significant decrease to my resting heart rate - a good indication that my body was functioning well. My sweet cravings had also completely gone- this really was an excellent reset! . I would definitely recommend this program if you are looking to reset, it is so easy to follow, comes with excellent guidance and the optional extra acupressure treatments from Jetlee are a must! Such a wonderful, balancing addition to the program!
0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.author: Gill Breetzke

0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.text: I live and work on Koh Samui where The Source is based and, despite being surrounded by wellness retreats, gyms, open spaces and mountains, beaches, pools and yoga venues, I only really manage to go out on my bicycle in terms of fitness, albeit for reasonable distances at a time. 0x30e29eb241f8f455_0x52e49db99432eed8.text: My father had an open heart surgery here. It is important to share how it went as it is a very dangerous and critical procedure. The hospital services were poor. As a very high ranking retired government official (non military), he had the privilege equivalent to his rank. That still required a great deal of going to many stops to get paperwork done, very much like everyone else. That was annoying but okay. The very bad part was that there was no primary case doctor. It was hard to know step by step what will happen, what is happening, what (if any) could go wrong, who has the big picture on the full multi-step process. The family met the surgeon only one time the day before surgery for less than 10 minutes. Once he was wheeled into surgery he would go straight to ICU for a few days. There was no procedure to update the family on how anything went. We had to wait around for hours in hope of catching the doctors on their lunch break. Unacceptable. Inside the ICU the button for the patient to call the nurse was unplugged, making it impossible to get help while on the ventilator. It was unclear whether his departure from ICU was because he was better or that they needed the room. The doctors themselves were quite skilled. Very good work on the surgeons. The procedure went smoothly. He healed quickly. The doctors-in-training were very kind as well. However, the hospital's overall service design creates confusion and anxiety for both patients and family throughout the process. I hope this review helps the operations management team address these small but important improvements, and for families considering this hospital to know what to expect.
0x30e29eb241f8f455_0x52e49db99432eed8.author: Thaniya Keereepart

0x30e29eb241f8f455_0x52e49db99432eed8.text: In General, the hospital is well established and capable of handling a large number of patients for various specialized treatments. I have been working in the healthcare business for over 30 years and one of the most important issue is hospital staff attitude. I have visited this military hospital twice in the past 2 months as a companion with my Thai female partner and I have been very happy with the setup and the staff. However, during both my visits, one particular ENT doctors' attitude was extremely rude and unprofessional which has given me a bad impression. My partner is unable to speak because she has a tracheotomy and is unable to give any details or answers easily and needs me for assistance. when my partner was called in, I waited outside and told her to take permission from the doctor first for me to go in. Both times, my partner called for me in and this doctor just looks at me and the first time he did not even acknowledge my presence. He asked the nurse to tell me to go out and wait outside. The second time, again, my partner called for me and the same doctor just looked at me then turned his face away and started talking to my partner ignoring me totally so I just walked away. Doctors should be taught on how to behave with patients and their companions before they are allowed to perform any treatments. I understand that in some cases, a patient may need some privacy and the doctor should politely inform me that I should wait outside or something. Other than that, some minor issues need to be addressed on hygiene, signage, staff management, queuing system, organised timed appointments, etc

คุณหมอมีความเข้าอกเข้าใจลูกค้าที่ลำบากในเรื่องการนัดหมายเดินทางมาไกลจาก ตจว. และคลีนิคก้อมีเทคโนโลยีทันสมัย ที่พิมพ์ปากโดยใช้เครื่องสแกนแทนการพิมพ์ปากแบบดั้งเดิมซึ่งแม่นยำลดโอกาสผิดพลาดจากการพิมพ์ปากไม่เนียบ ทำให้ผมได้ลดจำนวนครั้งที่ต้องบินขึ้น(อันเปนที่มาของรายจ่ายส่วนอื่นๆ) เรื่องที่2 เคสผม ผมมาในสภาพมีอุปกรณ์จัดฟันและช่วยปกปิดฟันหลอของผม เมื่อหมอจัดฟันแถวบ้านผมแจ้งว่าส่วนของจัดฟันคือเสร็จแล้ว แต่ผมปรึกษาหมอจัดฟันแถวบ้านแถวว่ายังไม่อยากเอาอุปกรณ์ออก 0x311d5d0039f8f385_0x5af467b31c087bae.author: Amazan Nileah
0x311d5d0039f8f385_0x5af467b31c087bae.en: Finished with 2 dental implants + a 3-piece bridge crown. 🥰 I have a much more confident smile now. No matter how difficult or complex the case, I think the doctor can definitely handle it. The doctor is easy to talk to, plans the treatment with the patient, and works very efficiently and quickly (how could they not be efficient? They must have thousands of dental implants!). And it wasn't painful at all. The only pain was during the anesthetic injection and when the anesthetic wore off (but it was much less painful than wisdom tooth extraction). What impressed me: 1. According to the plan, I had to fly from the south to see the doctor 4 times because I have thin bone due to a long-standing loss of my front teeth from an accident, requiring bone grafting, which is why it took 4 visits (if I had just had the teeth extracted and implants placed, it would only have taken 3 times). The doctor was understanding of the difficulties patients face in scheduling appointments and traveling long distances from other provinces. The clinic also has modern technology, using a scanner to take impressions instead of traditional impressions, which is more accurate and reduces the chance of errors from incomplete impressions. This saved me the number of trips I had to make (which led to other expenses). 2. In my case, I came in with braces to help cover my missing teeth. When my local orthodontist informed me that the orthodontic treatment was complete, I consulted with another orthodontist nearby about not wanting to have the braces removed yet because I didn't want a gap between the implant placements (this was the most serious issue. Clinics near my house said I'd have to have a gap between the implant placements, and then it would require separate bone grafting and implant placement). But after finding this clinic and consulting with the doctor, they said they could do both the bone grafting and implant placement at the same time. The braces would remain in place to anchor the dentures that would cover my gap... In short, everything was perfect and exactly as I hoped! 😍😍😍 3. Regarding follow-up: If I had any questions (I'm quite anxious and inquisitive), the admin always helped connect me with the doctor and find answers without getting annoyed. 4. Price and quality of treatment: 👏👏👏 I can't think of anything else, but overall I'm extremely satisfied. 5. The clinic is clean and spacious, and all the staff are very welcoming. If you're still hesitant, try consulting this clinic. .....Normally, after the treatment process is complete, the doctor schedules a follow-up appointment in 2 weeks. But the dentist was understanding of my difficulties traveling so far, so he scheduled another appointment for six months from now. He also said that I should let him know if I have any problems. ....I'm determined! Next time, in six months, when I won't have braces anymore, I'll take a course of scaling, air flow treatment, and teeth whitening. The price is great! 🥰 ....A heartfelt review for anyone who is still hesitant....

0x30e29f2b1dae2c01_0xe558c9ead37fd837.text: Office syndrome is a problem many people face. I was one of them. The symptoms would come and go, and this had been going on for a long time. There was a little pain at first, but as the massage continued, I felt much better and lighter. ❤️❤️ If you have similar problems and don't know where to go, try consulting this clinic. 0x30e29f27b7b68775_0x4ade461d83edea9a.text: Relatively fast and seems to be the cheapest place to get vaccinations. I needed a Japanese encephalitis vaccine and originally tried to book an appointment with a travel clinic based on googling, but that clinic was fully booked up. Found this on Google maps and this was perfect. No appointment needed, the clinic is purely for vaccinations so they have a very streamlined process. I showed up at 9AM on a Saturday, was a bit longer than expected, but the process kept moving. Shots received by 10:10, out the door by 10:25 after the 15 min monitoring period. JE shot 600THB, Rabies 350THB. Fees 50+20THB. Really accessible pricing, considering I was going to pay a private clinic 1000 for just JE. Most prices are all on the website. However, the whole thing is a process and all the locals seem to know the steps, while we didn’t at all. Some tips: - the pic on Google maps is not the building for the vaccination clinic, at least not as of March 2024. Walk to the left of the building (see attached pic). It is directly across from Snake Farm, like 10 steps away. Sorry I forgot to take a pic of the building. - bring passport / local ID - grab a number and fill out the patient intake form at the booth outside. Once they call your number (in Thai only), they will register you. Prob a good idea to keep eyes peeled for people that grabbed a number before/after you so you know if your number is called - take your passport and new paperwork, walk inside the building and put into the bin at the registration desk. They will do more processing. Tell them you don’t speak Thai if you need help and they’ll keep an eye out for you. The rest was straightforward! Hope this helps!!
0x30e29f27b7b68775_0x4ade461d83edea9a.author: Janice Leung

0x30e29f27b7b68775_0x4ade461d83edea9a.text: Highly systematic and professional vaccination experience. This place is incredibly well-managed and the whole operation is very fast and systematic. When you arrive, it starts with a pre-screening where you get a queue and then measure your blood pressure yourself at a self-service station—it’s very easy, you just have to press one button. After that, you wait for your queue to be called so the staff can check your results and confirm the vaccine you’re taking. Then you move inside for a consultation with the doctor, who was the highlight for me—very nice, helpful, and provided such deep knowledge. Once you've made the payment, you’ll receive your vaccine in a small basket to carry with you to the final vaccination room. Even though there were many patients, the staff remained very active, calm, and professional throughout. The atmosphere is nice and clean, and the entire process is just exceptionally efficient. Highly recommended!
0x30e29f27b7b68775_0x4ade461d83edea9a.author: NNchan

0x30e29f27b7b68775_0x4ade461d83edea9a.text: Best place to come for vaccinations with highest availability and cheapest price. They don’t take reservation, only walk in. Simple facility in a beautiful old building but has no air condition, but serve the purpose for just quick vacations. I have come here 4 times and found the queue is always quick. Open 8.30-16.30 except 12.00-3.00 lunch break for Mon-Fri and Sat 8.30-12.00. While visiting, you can go to snake farm next to the vaccination center for a visit which is totally worth a visit as they house most complete snake varieties. Ticket 200B for adult and 50B for Thai.
0x30e29f27b7b68775_0x4ade461d83edea9a.author: Chutinunta Mee

0x30e29f27b7b68775_0x4ade461d83edea9a.text: It was excellent. I got a number, had my blood pressure taken, registered, entered the lobby, got a number, saw the doctor, registered at the nurse's station, paid, got the vaccine, got my record book at the nurse's station, and then got the shot. Everything was very good and smooth. The staff were incredibly nice. The male nurse who gave me the shot was especially welcoming and wonderful. Thank you 🙏🏻. By the way, this place only accepts cash, so remember to bring cash.
0x30e29f27b7b68775_0x4ade461d83edea9a.author: Jeffrey Wong

0x30e29f27b7b68775_0x4ade461d83edea9a.text: Best place to get vaccines in Thailand from my personal experience in other facilities in the country. All the staff, doctors and nurses are super efficient and can speak well English. The doctor I met took all her time to answer all my questions regarding rabies and Japanese encephalitis vaccine. I felt safe and heard. It was fast and cheap. Overall amazing service :) If you can, get your vaccines here. They do all types of travelers needed vaccines.
0x30e29f27b7b68775_0x4ade461d83edea9a.author: Raquel Pina

0x30e29f27b7b68775_0x4ade461d83edea9a.text: Easiest vaccine clinic in Bangkok. Walk-in. No appointments. They have rabies, typhoid, yellow fever, the new Dengue vaccine, flu, tetanus (Tdap) and more. Cash or QR scan only. No credit cards accepted. Can call them before arrival to triple check. There is an English prompt when you call. Super friendly. This is very quick. You won't be here long. Location: take MRT to Samyan or can walk from Silom/Sala Daeng BTS station. 10/10 highly recommend 💯

0x311d7fb125c17687_0xd5f461d5b8404ece.text: ใช้บริการครั้งแรก สะดวกมากเพราะใกล้บ้าน ไปก่อนเวลานัด ทำประวัติเรียบร้อยก็ได้เข้าตรวจเลย คุณหมอน่ารัก พูดจาดี อธิบายอาการและขั้นตอนให้เข้าใจ มือเบา บอกด้วยว่าตอนนี้กำลังทำอะไรให้ เพื่อลดความเครียด ราคากำลังดี สำหรับการถอนฟันกราม รวมเอกเรย์และยา กระบวนการทั้งหมดประหยัดเวลาคนไข้ได้มากค่ะ
