0x30e29d503dd6c947_0x64530a4542f7717.text: Had to do some dental maintenance that arent out of the ordinary for a person in their 20's (dental clean, wisdom teeth extraction, new set of retainers). Admission was quick, they examined my teeth and did a 3d scan on the same day that I had come in. The dental cleaning was thorough and quality. Wisdom tooth extraction was done well and quick, the surgeon has administered anaesthetic effectively so the procedure wasn't painful (if there was any pain/discomfort, he made sure to inject more quickly). Afterwards I've received clear instructions on post op recovery so there wouldnt be a risk of an infection or dry socket. Creating Impressions for retainers was a smooth experience, without much discomfort that this procedure usually entails. The expected time for retainers was after I would depart so I had to ask if the retainers could be made quicker. They went out of their way to arrange retainers to be done in another lab on time, which fit my schedule perfectly. The retainers themselves were well made and fit without problems. The pricing for all the procedures has been very reasonable as well. Really great clinic, I have nothing but good things to say about it. I hope to visit it again!

Located just across Tao Poon market, Melodent Dental Design is exceptionally clean and well-maintained. The specialist are experienced and professional. The staff are helpful. However, if you plan to get a package, make sure you ask about other extra fees beforehand. I was informed that the equipment cleaning fee is not included in the monthly payment, so it came as a surprise after my first month's visit. It is best to clarify all ongoing cost upfront.

Excellent service clean and bright office and treatment rooms. Dr. Spoke English and explained everything clearly. Follow-up appointment to fix an issue with my implant went superbly well. The Dr. patiently explained the procedure step by step and answered all of my questions. The staff were also excellent. Also, the cost of treatment was very reasonable. Right across from Tao Poon market.

Luckily, I intentionally dressed shabbily that day, using a tote bag and no makeup, so I looked genuinely poor and declined, saying I didn't have much money. The doctor made a face, seemed to think they couldn't sell me anything, and then said, "Okay, do as per the current promotion." After that, they were quiet and not as talkative as when I first walked in. The procedure was painful as the numbing cream wore off, but it was bearable because the energy wasn't very high. But there was a moment that startled me. The doctor asked, "Oh, does it hurt?" I replied, "A little." She continued massaging my face without saying anything, without giving any advice, not even saying, "Bear with it," or anything. Anyway, whatever. After she finished, the package I bought actually included 3-4 more treatments, but in the end, she only did the Ultraformer, Chanel, and some kind of Soft treatment. There was no drip or Botox at all. She did it quietly and discreetly, then invited me to leave the room and go home. And after she finished, she just walked into another room without even saying, "It's finished." It's like she had a lot of clients, or something. No talking, no feeling at all. Great. I guess she really did have a lot of clients. The wait is at least 1-2 hours, and there are hardly any seats. Some clients occupied three chairs, but nobody warned them because they bought a lot of packages, acting like VIPs. The clinic has thousands of clients! I'm done with this brand. There are also a lot of influencer-led reviews. Check the comments and decide for yourself. I understand that for a 9,999 baht package in Siam, this is probably the kind of service you get.

Luckily, the clinic noticed and scheduled a follow-up appointment to teach me how to properly bandage. I brought my housekeeper along to watch and help. I tried to walk less, stay home more, and try to stay in an air-conditioned room with a fan to prevent sweating. My housekeeper helped with the bandaging, and the swelling really subsided in about 3-4 days. I remember my staples starting to come loose about 3 weeks later. In the beginning, every time I had an erection, I was nervous and afraid the wound would separate and I'd need stitches again. But I survived. For those who have recently been circumcised, I recommend bringing your housekeeper to watch how to bandage. If I had done it myself, the wound probably wouldn't have healed well. Now the wound has healed, and the scarring is gone. Cleaning is so much easier now. For those who are still hesitant, I highly recommend being patient for the first 1-2 weeks after the circumcision.

0x30da3b412002c12b_0xa2dcd77622a01c4b.text: I'd like to share my positive experience with this physiotherapy clinic. 💙 I took my brother for treatment of Office Syndrome. Initially, we didn't inform the clinic that my brother was undergoing cancer treatment. They had already prepared an electrical muscle stimulation device. However, upon learning of his cancer, and knowing that electrical stimulation could potentially stimulate cancer cells, they immediately canceled the treatment for my brother's safety. What impressed me most was the incredible kindness of the staff and physiotherapists. They showed no frustration or displeasure at all, even though they had to cancel the entire preparation. They were incredibly patient, explained everything in detail, and even taught us physiotherapy exercises that could be done correctly at home. 🙏 Importantly, the clinic didn't charge us anything, despite the time and equipment they had already prepared. I could truly feel their care and professionalism. Thank you for prioritizing patient safety and providing such sincere advice. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a physiotherapy clinic that offers knowledge, professionalism, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. 💙

0x30da3b412002c12b_0xa2dcd77622a01c4b.text: I came here to get treated for an Iliotibial (IT) band injury that had been frustratingly holding me back for months. From the very first session, the level of professionalism and expertise was absolutely top-notch. A special, heartfelt thank you goes to Film. Their deep knowledge, patience, and targeted treatment plan made all the difference in my recovery. Film didn't just treat the symptoms; they took the time to explain the root cause of the injury and gave me the exact tools and exercises I needed to rebuild my strength and prevent it from happening again. Looking back, my only regret is that I didn't come here sooner! I wasted so much time trying to rest it on my own when I could have been healing under their expert guidance. If you are dealing with any sports injury, do yourself a favor and book an appointment right away. They are worth every single star!

0x30da3b412002c12b_0xa2dcd77622a01c4b.text: I came here for help with severe upper back and neck tightness ("Office Syndrome") from spending long hours at a desk. The machine was able to break up the deep stiffness in a way that manual massage just couldn't. The staff was incredibly professional—they listened carefully to my medical history (I have an old lower back fracture) and tailored the treatment to be safe while still being effective on my problem areas. If you have a neck that feels like concrete and normal massage isn't cutting it, I highly recommend skipping the spa and coming here for the shockwave treatment. Worth every baht for the relief.

0x30e29f27a309808f_0x2ee13772ab4f3a27.text: Review of Pico Laser Treatment at 22 Square Clinic This was my first time getting laser treatment for brighter skin. First, I consulted with Dr. Bank about my skin problems before the Pico Laser treatment so he could recommend which areas I should treat. I had a total of 6 Pico modes done. The main focus was on reducing dark spots, small freckles, acne redness, stimulating collagen, tightening pores, and reducing sebum production. It only took 15-20 minutes. The doctor was very meticulous, paying attention to every detail. Each problem area was treated with a different Pico mode, tailored to each person's skin. After the treatment, the doctor gave me advice on post-laser skincare and followed up on my progress via Line. They were incredibly attentive to their patients from start to finish. Another thing I really loved about 22 Square Clinic is the staff. They are so caring and lovely. It feels so cozy and homey. Plus, there's plenty of parking. Super convenient! In short, I'm very happy with my Pico Laser treatment here because, in addition to my beautiful, smoother skin, the doctor gave excellent advice and the service was superb. After the procedure, I couldn't open my mouth and talk, it hurt even more than during the procedure. After 6 hours the pain was still strong, I took paracetamol and went to sleep. 0x311d7df408b50fa1_0xa00bda6d9d203fa9.text: I initially came here because they had the medication I needed, so I chose this place. The result is that I currently have one last injection left, this coming Friday. My current weight is 57.10 kg. Weight loss using the pen isn't 100% automated; you must also use the pen to control your hunger through diet and food intake. 1. You must consume a balanced diet with both protein and calories, calculated based on your weight and height. 2. Eat less than your TDEE (Total Daily Energy Expenditure), but not too low. 3. Combining this with exercise will yield the best results. My behavior included frequently eating salty foods (like spicy papaya salad) and sugary drinks almost every day. After starting the pen treatment, I changed my behavior because I wanted to see results after paying for it. I adjusted my diet to consume as much protein as possible equal to my body weight, while keeping my calorie intake within my TDEE. I stopped drinking sugary drinks and started buying protein shakes to mix with my coffee. Protein shakes are beneficial and high in protein. My diet focuses on vegetables first, followed by protein and calories in the right proportions. I include some carbohydrates, but avoid excessive consumption. The result is the weight you see! Thank you to the doctor for the recommendation. I bought the Monjaro pen, 5mg size. I do it myself at home because the doctor did it the first day and it wasn't painful. This way I can manage the long travel time every week. Each person's body requires different dosages, so I recommend consulting your doctor. I want to say that they don't pressure you into buying courses. The doctor is kind, and the staff and doctor follow up continuously every week. I highly recommend them if you want to lose weight effectively. I was someone who couldn't lose weight for many years. When I tried to lose weight on my own, I would gain it back, and I didn't achieve the same level of health. Anyone interested should contact the doctor; it's excellent and well worth the money.

0xa93ea7a2f8e66321_0x953d359894d3402d.author: supattra somnuek

0xa93ea7a2f8e66321_0x953d359894d3402d.text: The doctor gave very good advice. We had all our questions and he answered them all. He also provided good service and spoke politely. He didn't treat the dog harshly and he treated blood parasites well.
0xa93ea7a2f8e66321_0x953d359894d3402d.author: Nongnueng Yochae

0xa93ea7a2f8e66321_0x953d359894d3402d.text: The vet provided excellent consultation, the treatment fees were reasonable, and the place was clean. During treatment, they kept me informed of appointment dates and updated me on my pet's condition.
0xa93ea7a2f8e66321_0x953d359894d3402d.author: Pranveerin Phanyamungjai

0x30da3b23031b7fb1_0x60518723b582b7f5.text: Had a little toothache in Chiang Mai which ended up being analysed by the doctor as 4 root canals and 5 new crowns plus some other misdemeanours from a misspent youth. I’ve been having work done for 40 years in Thailand and I’ve never had better service or work done by three separate dentists. Dr Lee , Kang and Pum were all specifically tasked to do a duty. They were kind and delicate as well as very caring to an old softie who hates dentistry at the best of times. I never write critiques but on this occasion the service warranted comment. CIDC was an 11/10 because of people like may and soft from reception who were two beautiful and efficient staff who made everything happen. Constant texts to not just confirm appointments but also to see how I was feeling. Two unsung superstars. Thank you all again. You have made me once again realise that health is wealth.
0x30da3b23031b7fb1_0x60518723b582b7f5.author: Shawn Redden

0x30da3b23031b7fb1_0x60518723b582b7f5.text: I dread going to the dentist, as I was so traumatized from watching MARATON MAN as a kid. THAT chilling scene between Dustin Hoffman sitting on the chair and Lawrence Olivier, as the dentist, interrogating: IS IT SAFE? IS IT SAFE?!!! The fear is totally irrational, I know. So, based on a string of 5-star reviews heaped on CIDC, I made an appointment for deep cleaning and a couple of fillings. That day, I saw Dr. Thanyalak, and she explained to me in fluent English as to what the dental procedure would entail. Gentle solo piano music played in the background, and my anxiety eased under the very capable hands of the doctor deftly doing the work. The whole experience was quite pleasant really. Kudos to Dr. Thanyalak for her warmth, empathy, and professionalism! And to the receptionists who cheerfully accommodated my busy traveling schedule!
0x30da3b23031b7fb1_0x60518723b582b7f5.author: Kyle Pang

0x30da3b23031b7fb1_0x60518723b582b7f5.text: My daughter broke a front tooth quite badly while we were on holiday. The treatment she received at CIDC was absolutely first class and the only disappointment is that we did not have enough time to complete the work while we were in Chiang Mai. On our return to the UK the dentist that we have consulted to finish the work was very complimentary about the treatment and advice given to my daughter by CIDC. The dentist was friendly, spoke excellent English and explained everything clearly, gave good rationales for the work he could do and couldn't do. My daughter is very anxious about all forms of dentistry and dentists and was made to feel entirely at ease during her treatment. I can see there are a couple of lower starred reviews for CIDC but I can honestly say this was not reflective of our experience and I would recommend them.
0x30da3b23031b7fb1_0x60518723b582b7f5.author: Toby Teg

0x30da3b23031b7fb1_0x60518723b582b7f5.text: They took great care of my fangs quickly and efficiently! I have a composite extension on an upper canine. The composite margin has lifted slightly and tilted because of pressure from the lower tooth. There was dark staining along the margin and some bacteria accumulation. I needed removal/cleaning of the margin, polishing and repair of the composite to restore a smooth surface, and maybe occlusal adjustment if needed to avoid further pressure. I came as a private patient without referral, the doctor spoke great English and was explaining everything beforehand. The occlusal adjustment wasn’t necessary in my case, the whole procedure took about 10 minutes and costed me 550 baht. I recommend this clinic! Attached is the picture of before and after treatment.
0x30da3b23031b7fb1_0x60518723b582b7f5.author: Lizard King

0x30da3b23031b7fb1_0x60518723b582b7f5.text: I have been coming here for 3 years and have had a variety of work done. Root canal, and implants. Beyond the great prices compared to the west, the level of customer service and personal attention is second to none. You are treated with kid gloves and the staff is very personable and extremely professional. The facilities are immaculate and clean. They are very customer focused and fit any work you need done into your schedule, not just what's suits their time. Again, it's very customer based. I cannot recommend them enough. Thank you to all the great staff who take care of me while I am there.
0x30da3b23031b7fb1_0x60518723b582b7f5.author: Barry Kachkowski

0x30da3b23031b7fb1_0x60518723b582b7f5.text: I recently had my teeth whitening treatment with CIDC, and I’m genuinely impressed with the results. The entire process was explained clearly, and I felt comfortable throughout. My teeth are noticeably brighter, and the shade is very natural, not overly white or artificial-looking. The staff were professional, friendly, and made sure I was at ease from start to finish. I also appreciated the aftercare advice to maintain the results. If you’re looking for a confident smile boost, I highly recommend their teeth whitening service. I will definitely return for future treatments.
0x30da3b23031b7fb1_0x60518723b582b7f5.author: Emil Raev

0x30da3b23031b7fb1_0x60518723b582b7f5.text: I am highly satisfied with the recent dental cleaning, which met European standards of quality. The procedure was performed by a doctor, rather than a hygienist, which further enhanced the professional experience. The doctor was exceptionally thorough, concluding the cleaning with a meticulous polishing of my teeth. I appreciate that no unnecessary additional services were proposed. The pricing was very competitive, and I fully intend to return for future treatments.
0x30da3b23031b7fb1_0x60518723b582b7f5.author: Renia Yoga

0x30da3b23031b7fb1_0x60518723b582b7f5.text: I found this dental clinic because it is located near my home. Although I noticed quite a few one-star reviews, I decided to give it a chance and judge the service for myself. I contacted the clinic through the provided channel and successfully made an appointment. After the appointment was scheduled, I sent a message to confirm the treatment fees. My message was read almost immediately, but I received no reply. A full week later, someone finally contacted me to confirm the booking. Unfortunately, Chiang Mai has no shortage of dental clinics. Since I could not get a timely response or confirmation, I chose another clinic instead and had my dental issue resolved there without any problems. While I never became a patient of this clinic, I believe that healthcare service begins with the very first interaction. In my experience, the clinic failed to provide timely and effective communication during the initial consultation stage, which did not inspire confidence in their overall service. In a way, I am glad I discovered this before undergoing any treatment. At least for me, the one-star reviews I had seen beforehand now make more sense.

0x30e283a611acd111_0x78df58f65bde42a3.text: ไปใช้สิทธิ์บัตรทอง ขูดหินปูน นัดล่วงหน้าก่อนไปใช้บริการ พอก่อนถึงวันนัด โทรมาคอนเฟิร์ม วันนัด ไปก่อนเวลา รอไม่นาน ก็ได้เข้าทำเลย คุณหมอมือเบามากกก ขูดละเอียดมากก จนท.บริการดี ให้ข้อมูลดีมาก หน้าตายิ้มแย้ม แจ่มใส บริการดีสุดๆ เต็มสิบ ไม่หักเลยค่ะ แนะนำเลยค่ะ ปล.ไป 2 คน กับแฟน ถ้าหินปูนไม่เยอะ ไม่ต้องชำระเพิ่ม แต่ของแฟนหินปูนเยอะ ชำระเพิ่ม 300 บาท
0x30e283a611acd111_0x78df58f65bde42a3.author: Jaoa Nathathai
0x30e283a611acd111_0x78df58f65bde42a3.en: I used my government health insurance card. I had a teeth scaling procedure done. I made an appointment in advance. They called to confirm before the appointment day. On the day of the appointment, I arrived early and didn't have to wait long before being able to get the procedure done. The dentist was very gentle and thorough in the scaling. The staff were very helpful, provided a lot of information, and were always smiling and cheerful. The service was top-notch, a perfect 10 out of 10. I highly recommend it. P.S. My boyfriend and I went together. If there isn't much tartar, there's no extra charge, but my boyfriend had a lot and had to pay an extra 300 baht.

0x30e283a611acd111_0x78df58f65bde42a3.text: Had a teeth whitening treatment whilst in Bangkok on a trip from the UK. Amazing service and results. The dentist and assistant were very kind and professional. The dentist also spoke with me in English.
0x30e283a611acd111_0x78df58f65bde42a3.author: Paul Miller

0x30e283a611acd111_0x78df58f65bde42a3.en: The doctor is lovely, calm, and gentle. The staff are friendly and polite. The clinic is very clean, the equipment is modern, and they accept the universal healthcare scheme (Gold Card). It's excellent!

0x30e283a611acd111_0x78df58f65bde42a3.text: ให้บริการดีมาก ให้คำแนะนำที่ดีมาก และเป็นประโยชน์กับคนไข้ เดินทางสะดวกมาลงที่btsสะพานใหม่ คลินิกอยู่ชั้น3ที่ยิ่งเจริญสแควร์
0x30e283a611acd111_0x78df58f65bde42a3.en: The service was excellent, the advice was very good and helpful to patients. It's conveniently located near Saphan Mai BTS station. The clinic is on the 3rd floor of Ying Charoen Square.

0x30e283a611acd111_0x78df58f65bde42a3.text: ทำฟันที่นี่คุณหมอใจดีและมือเบามากค่ะ บรรยากาศในร้านดี พี่ๆในร้านยิ้มแย้มแจ่มใส ราคาไม่แพงด้วยค่ะ👍🏻❤️❤️

0x30e283a611acd111_0x78df58f65bde42a3.text: พี่พนักงานบริการดีมาก ช่วยเหลือให้คำแนะนำดี คุณหมอใจดีมาก 🙏🏻 มาขูดหินปูนรอบที่สองดีเหมือนเดิมมม ❤️

0x30e283a611acd111_0x78df58f65bde42a3.text: คุณหมอดูแลดี พนักงานก็ดูแลดีน่ารัก คอยให้คำแนะนำตลอด แนะนำร้านนี้เลยค่ะ ราคาดีไม่แพง
0x30e283a611acd111_0x78df58f65bde42a3.en: The doctor provided excellent care, and the staff were lovely and attentive, offering advice throughout the process. I highly recommend this clinic. The prices are good and not expensive.

0x30da31d892242779_0x41841c3eefb6c066.text: This is a truly trustworthy dental clinic. They handled all my dental problems. The clinic is clean, the doctor is kind, and they clearly explain the treatment process and costs. I went to the doctor because I had two broken teeth within a year 🥹. The doctor tried to save the original teeth, and it ended with crowns. For the other tooth, it wasn't possible to fix it, so it had to be removed and fitted with an implant and crown. The implant treatment takes a long time, depending on the individual, so you need to be patient, which I was able to do 👍🏻. Importantly, the cost is divided into installments according to the treatment stage, and it wasn't as expensive as I thought. They follow up on my treatment every month. Now, I've had the implants for almost three months, and the crowned tooth for six months, and it's working perfectly. If you have any dental problems and are choosing a clinic, I highly recommend consulting with the doctor there.
0x30da31d892242779_0x41841c3eefb6c066.author: pawinee ruengsana

0x30da31d892242779_0x41841c3eefb6c066.text: I've had unpleasant experiences at various dental clinics in Chiang Mai. However, I highly recommend this particular clinic to my wife, colleagues, and friends. Dr. Ploy, the dentist, is exceptional, paying careful attention to each client. I used to struggle with "dentophobia" or "odontophobia," but she consistently helps me overcome my anxiety during every visit. New visit, 9 Oct 2025. I’ve been a loyal patient of this clinic for over 5 years now — yes, five! Even after moving to Hat Yai, I still fly all the way to Chiang Mai just to see Dr. Ploy. That should tell you how good she is! ✈️🦷 I used to have serious dentophobia (the kind where just hearing the drill made me sweat). But Dr. Ploy’s gentle hands and warm personality somehow turn every visit into something close to… enjoyable? I never thought I’d say that about a dentist! Totally worth the trip every single time.
0x30da31d892242779_0x41841c3eefb6c066.author: Apollo Kujira

0x30da31d892242779_0x41841c3eefb6c066.text: I’ve just completed my braces treatment, and I couldn’t be happier with the results! A huge thank you to คุณหมอ ต้น for all the care and dedication throughout my orthodontic journey. He is incredibly attentive, always takes the time to explain everything clearly, and makes every appointment feel comfortable. One thing I really appreciated was how flexible he is with scheduling. Since he works at multiple clinics, seeing him in Bangkok is also an option, which is really convenient for anyone who travels or has a busy schedule. Thank you again, คุณหมอ ต้น, for making this such a positive experience. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for an orthodontist who is professional, caring, attentive, and genuinely puts his patients first!

I loved my experience with Invisalign at Esth Dental Clinic, I had it for about 2 years to straighten out my teeth, and I now have my retainers 😊 Dr.Warut Thongerd explained everything thoroughly before starting. His attention to detail with whatever procedure you're having done is impeccable. If you have any questions or concerns, he always takes extra time if necessary and never makes you feel rushed. Dr. Warut and his staff really are the best and I would highly recommend Esth dental clinic to anyone looking for a great dentistry experience. Overall, extremely happy with my results!
0x30da31d892242779_0x41841c3eefb6c066.author: pimmada prachadetsuwat

0x30da31d892242779_0x41841c3eefb6c066.text: This was me and my girls first time visited the ESTH Dental Clinic. We were impressed with how professional Dr. Ploy is. She was so patient with my girls, had a lot of empathy towards them. And she was so understanding when my youngest (3 yrs old) wanted me to hold her while checking up! Not only how professional and knowledgable Dr. Ploy is, the clinic is also very clean and very customer-oriented! I highly recommend this dental clinic, very kids and family friendly and staff are very nice, and Dr. Ploy was so gentle taking care of our teeth! The best experience ever!
0x30da31d892242779_0x41841c3eefb6c066.author: Sirintira Utzler

0x30da31d892242779_0x41841c3eefb6c066.text: I went for a wisdom tooth extraction, the experience from start to finish was incredible. Once you go in and make an appointment they contact you via WhatsApp so you have them if you need to update or change anything. I was in and out within 30 mins and the dentist doing the extraction was amazing. Very well spoken English and soothed any nerves I had. Spoke me through from start to finish and guided me through each step of the process. And the cheapest prices I’ve seen about anywhere. Highly highly recommend
0x30da31d892242779_0x41841c3eefb6c066.author: Louis Antell

0x30da31d892242779_0x41841c3eefb6c066.text: I got my 4 wisdom teeth extracted here. They were impacted (horizontal) which made it more complicated. Still, the doctor was so sweet, soft, kind and delicate 🥰 He guided me through all the process and I’m finally free 🙌🏼 They gave me the medicines there, classified by time, amount, etc. 🥲 Best service I’ve ever received. The staff and the clinic were lovely too. Pd: all my friends have a crush on the doctor! 🫶🏼
0x30da31d892242779_0x41841c3eefb6c066.author: Valeria Flores

0x30da31d892242779_0x41841c3eefb6c066.text: I brought my mom to see me after the dental implant procedure. The doctor explained the treatment results and gave me excellent advice on care. My mom's chewing has improved. At first, she said she was afraid it would hurt before the procedure, but it didn't hurt at all after the procedure. If I had known, I would have done it a long time ago. Thank you to the doctor and everyone.
0x30da31d892242779_0x41841c3eefb6c066.author: Jarin Ya

0x3050370f5dde0f13_0x7d4982141ba42576.text: I recently had the pleasure of visiting the Family Health Care Center in Phuket, Thailand, for my health care certificate, a requirement for obtaining a driver's license. The experience was outstanding, largely due to the exceptional service and the warm atmosphere of the center. From the moment I entered, the staff greeted me with genuine smiles and a friendly demeanor, setting a welcoming tone for my visit. Their professionalism and approachability were evident throughout my time there, making the entire process smooth and enjoyable. The efficiency and helpfulness of the staff at the Family Health Care Center were particularly noteworthy. I was attended to promptly, and the procedures for obtaining the health care certificate were explained with clarity and detail. This level of guidance and support was invaluable, especially in navigating the specifics required for the driver's license health certificate. Moreover, the center itself presented a comfortable and clean environment, reflecting their commitment to patient care and comfort. In conclusion, my experience at the Family Health Care Center in Phuket was exceptional. It stands out as an exemplary health care provider, especially for those seeking a health certificate for a driver's license. The combination of friendly staff, efficient service, and a pleasant environment made my visit memorable. I highly recommend this center to anyone in need of medical services in Phuket, as their professionalism and warmth truly set them apart.
0x3050370f5dde0f13_0x7d4982141ba42576.author: Jay Lopez

0x3050370f5dde0f13_0x7d4982141ba42576.text: Dr. Jasmine Suriya, MD was extremely helpful and thorough. She diagnosed me with Upper respiratory tract infection with Eustachian tube dysfunction causing ear blockage, which makes perfect sense. I was really surprised my ears weren’t full of wax or water, because they’re so stuffed. The Eustschian tube dysfunction makes it make sense. I also got a nebulizer treatment, because my lungs were too closed to let in good medicine (I have Sarcoidosis, so my breathing is bad, anyhow). I’m glad to finally know what’s been bothering me the last ten days. Everyone who works there are really kind and supportive. They made me feel safe and not alone. I really appreciate the care they showed me. I also like how there are rails next to the toilet for people who need help getting up. If the toilet seat were higher, that would help even more elderly and disabled. I will definitely go back here soon. The prices are affordable if you don’t have insurance. I really appreciate that, because when you’re sick, you worry if you can afford treatment.
0x3050370f5dde0f13_0x7d4982141ba42576.author: Maria

0x3050370f5dde0f13_0x7d4982141ba42576.text: I recently attended the family health care clinic with a shoulder injury I got from boxing this resulted in muscle loss I made a appointment with their in house physiotherapist the lady’s name Khun Asfia Interat for a free consultation She examined me and demonstrated a series of exercises for me to carry out Within a week I was training again after carrying the injury for two months From my initial contact to leaving all the staff were PROFESSIONAL and I would highly recommend you check out their website for a full list of the services they provide
0x3050370f5dde0f13_0x7d4982141ba42576.author: Mike Biesty

0x3050370f5dde0f13_0x7d4982141ba42576.text: The service that was provided at this clinic surpassed my expectations and I would happily recommend to anyone in need of medical assistance while overseas. Prior to seeing a doctor I was anxious being so far from home, but they made me feel very comfortable with their kindness, understanding and knowledge. I found their prices to be extremely reasonable as well. I’m very grateful for Dr. Jasmin and her lovely team of nurses.
0x3050370f5dde0f13_0x7d4982141ba42576.author: Madison Lavigne

0x3050370f5dde0f13_0x7d4982141ba42576.text: I had a great experience seeking treatment for sinus pain. The staff was professional, caring, and attentive, ensuring a smooth and comfortable process. The treatment was effective, and what stood out most was the thorough follow-up care. They checked in after the visit to see how I was doing and ensured my recovery was on track. Their dedication and genuine concern made me feel truly supported. Highly recommended!
0x3050370f5dde0f13_0x7d4982141ba42576.author: Hinna K

0x3050370f5dde0f13_0x7d4982141ba42576.author: Nisarat Siralert

0x3050370f5dde0f13_0x7d4982141ba42576.text: I had a wonderful experience at this clinic. The staff was incredibly friendly and professional, making me feel comfortable from the moment I walked in. The clinic itself was spotless and very well-maintained, which gave me a lot of confidence in the quality of care they provide. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for excellent service in a clean and welcoming environment!”
0x3050370f5dde0f13_0x7d4982141ba42576.author: Nattamon Mola

0x3050370f5dde0f13_0x7d4982141ba42576.text: My wife and I have been having their general Checkups for nearly 20 years. They miss NOTHING, and the doctors and nurses are highly professional. It would take months and months to have the same checks done in our country. James Cawood is the excellent Coordinator - he’s fluent in Thai and arranges exactly what one needs. The prices are more than reasonable, and one can see a specialist very quickly, and MRIs and CT scans are done same day if needed. Our latest visit was again excellent, new equipment and important tests (heart) have been introduced. My only complaint is the English is sometimes mediocre, but the results are all written in plain English, so there’s really no issue. Overall, full marks to the hospital and the super staff.
0x3050370f5dde0f13_0x7d4982141ba42576.author: Brian CLUER

0x30e2994d4732f35b_0xd0721f04fbadd0f3.text: I've seen Dr. May three times now. She's incredibly skilled; she diagnoses quickly and accurately pinpoints trigger points. First visit: I came in with lower back pain. Two or three shockwave treatments relieved it. Following the physical therapist's exercise regimen completely cured it. Second visit: Office syndrome, right neck, shoulder, and upper back pain. Three shockwave treatments completely resolved the issue. Third visit: My left hand was numb and my left neck, shoulder, and upper back were very stiff. I had trigger point injections; it was sore for three days, but the lump on my shoulder disappeared. Another shockwave treatment was done by P'Yui (the physical therapist), and the numbness in my hand is 90% gone. It's not just the doctor who's amazing; all the physical therapists here are incredibly skilled. They hit the right trigger points every time, are thorough and attentive to patients, and answer all questions. I trust this place completely. It was painful, but the results were amazing. I don't want to come back again, but if I have muscle pain, I probably will! 🤣 P.S. The key is to observe yourself carefully to see which stretches help and which postures trigger pain or numbness. This will ensure targeted treatment.
0x30e2994d4732f35b_0xd0721f04fbadd0f3.author: Wannida Sapyen

0x30e2994d4732f35b_0xd0721f04fbadd0f3.text: Positive aspects: - The physiotherapists are lovely and truly understand sports injuries better than anywhere else. The senior physiotherapist provided excellent service; she was kind, caring, and attentive. - They taught exercises and stretches appropriate for the injury. - The focused shockwave therapy was very effective in reducing injury severity. It's the same machine used in major hospitals, and I saw results after just two sessions. Minor drawbacks: The price is relatively higher than other places because some physiotherapy treatments require multiple sessions. However, I personally think it's worth it. It's advisable to inquire about the price before deciding on any procedure.
0x30e2994d4732f35b_0xd0721f04fbadd0f3.author: mameao meao

0x30e2994d4732f35b_0xd0721f04fbadd0f3.text: I had chronic knee pain for 7 months, but after seeing the doctor here, I've improved so much! It's almost back to normal. The doctor here is lovely and gives great self-care advice. The physiotherapist staff are also wonderful, attentive, and update me on my progress every time I visit. They give me stretches and exercises tailored to my condition, and following them has significantly improved my symptoms. I highly recommend this place for anyone with chronic, persistent knee pain. It's easy to get here, parking is convenient, and the place is very clean. #RealPersonalReview
0x30e2994d4732f35b_0xd0721f04fbadd0f3.author: MJ VV

0x30e2994d4732f35b_0xd0721f04fbadd0f3.text: I highly recommend the May Clinic for sports injury treatment and recovery. After a post-marathon knee injury with tendon inflammation, I was forced to stop training with a crucial marathon looming in 3 months. The clinic delivered accurate diagnosis, effective treatment, and a swift recovery plan. I'm back running in just 3 weeks! Dr. May and her team are super professional, courteous, and friendly – she personally checked on me multiple times.
0x30e2994d4732f35b_0xd0721f04fbadd0f3.author: Nosherwan Ali

0x30e2994d4732f35b_0xd0721f04fbadd0f3.text: I was very lucky to notice my plantar fasciitis from running and get diagnosed and treated at May Clinic. In my first session, I met the doctor, received shockwave therapy and physical therapy, and even got homework assignments. It was a complete package. Personally, if I get any sports injuries in the future, I think I'll definitely return to rely on this doctor and the same team.
0x30e2994d4732f35b_0xd0721f04fbadd0f3.author: Pongsathorn Tiranun (Moopz)

0x30e2994d4732f35b_0xd0721f04fbadd0f3.text: I received treatment from a doctor and physical therapist for left buttock pain radiating to my left heel, which was severe when walking. The treatment included acupuncture, shockwave therapy, and spot massage. My symptoms improved, and I'm able to walk and resume my daily life normally again. Furthermore, the physical therapist provided excellent post-treatment care advice.
0x30e2994d4732f35b_0xd0721f04fbadd0f3.author: Kittisak Chotikkakamthorn

0x30e2994d4732f35b_0xd0721f04fbadd0f3.text: It’s my 20th time every time I have injury I will always come back here. My sessions were trickle point injections and shockwave. The staff are really friendly. The price is suitable leaning towards the higher side, but if I’m cured, I’m OK with it. The doctor is really good she gives you advice and on how to save cost on some of the sessions even.
0x30e2994d4732f35b_0xd0721f04fbadd0f3.author: Dmisa Poppy

0x30e2994d4732f35b_0xd0721f04fbadd0f3.text: I had chronic pain for a long time. After receiving treatment from the doctor at the clinic, including acupuncture and shockwave therapy, the pain has significantly improved, almost completely gone. The doctor's staff are lovely and very attentive to patients. The clinic is new, clean, and well-organized.
0x30e2994d4732f35b_0xd0721f04fbadd0f3.author: สุณี กมลคุณากร

0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.text: ถูกใจกับผลลัพธ์ที่ได้มามากค่ะ พึ่งจัดฟันมาแค่ 1ปีนิดๆ ไม่คิดว่าฟันตัวเองจะเข้าเร็วมากกกกก เนื่องด้วยเราเป็นคนที่มีฟันซ้อน ฟันเกหลายซี่ ก่อนหน้าก็คือไม่กล้ายิ้มเห็นฟันเลย อายเพื่อนมาก จนได้มาจัดฟันที่นี่ ทำให้เรากล้าที่จะคุย จะยิ้มกว้างๆ มีความมั่นใจขึ้น ที่นี่คุณดูแลดีมากค่ะ เป็นกันเอง น่ารักพูดเพราะ มากี่รอบๆ ก็ดูแลดีเหมือนเดิม🥰❤️ ปลื้มที่สุด🫶🏻 ใครที่กำลังหาคลินิกจัดฟัน แนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะ👍🏻🫶🏻
0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.author: ซูซาน สิริเต๊ะ
0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.en: I'm so happy with the results! I've only had braces for a little over a year, and I never thought my teeth would straighten so quickly! Before, I had many crowded and crooked teeth. I was so embarrassed to smile and show my teeth in front of my friends. Getting braces here has made me confident enough to talk and smile widely. The care here is excellent. They are friendly, lovely, and speak kindly. Every visit is consistently great. 🥰❤️ I'm so pleased! 🫶🏻 If you're looking for an orthodontic clinic, I highly recommend this one! 👍🏻🫶🏻

0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.text: บริการค่อนข้างดีเลยครับ คุณหมอกับผู้ช่วยดูเป็นมืออาชีพมากไม่เก้ ๆ กัง ๆ อธิบายทุกขั้นตอนที่ทำเลยครับ มีตรวจฟันด้วยแถมแนะนำการดูแลรักษาครับ ระยะเวลาที่ไปทำฟันใช้เวลาไม่นานเลยเร็วมากกกก มือหมอค่อนข้างเบาเลยทีเดียว ราคาเป็นกันเองครับ อยู่ใกล้ที่พักด้วยย เสียอย่างเดียวไม่มีที่จอดรถยนต์เลย เพราะติดริมถนน แนะนำเลยครับ ที่นี่เข้าใจง่ายสุดแล้วครับ
0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.author: แม่บ้าน นอนเที่ยว
0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.en: The service was quite good. The dentist and assistant were very professional and not awkward at all. They explained every step of the procedure. They also did a dental check-up and gave advice on aftercare. The treatment didn't take long at all, very quick! The dentist had a very gentle touch. The price was reasonable. It's also close to my accommodation. The only downside is there's no parking for cars because it's right on the street. I highly recommend this place; it's very easy to understand.

0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.text: เดิมเป็นคนไข้คุณหมอมอสค่ะจากโรงพยาบาลเอกชนชื่อดัง ตอนนี้ทุกคนที่บ้านตามมาทำฟันกับคุณหมอที่นี่ค่ะ คุณหมอใจดี ทำงานดีมาก ดูแลและใส่ใจคนไข้ดีค่ะ คลินิกคุณหมอสวยทันสมัยมากค่ะ ที่จอดรถสะดวกสบายค่ะ
0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.en: I used to be a patient of Dr. Moss from a well-known private hospital. Now, my whole family has come to have their dental work done by him here. Dr. Moss is kind, does excellent work, and is very caring and attentive to patients. His clinic is beautiful and modern, and parking is convenient.

0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.text: คุณหมอกับพี่ผู้ช่วยใจดีมากครับ ปกติผมชอบจะอาเจียนเวลาอ้าปากนานๆ เวลาขูดหินปูน คุณหมอกับพี่ผู้ช่วยใจดีมากไม่ว่าเลย ปักหมุดเป็นร้านหมอประจำไว้เลยครับ
0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.author: Piriyapong Jaruensuk
0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.en: The dentist and his assistant were very kind. Normally, I tend to vomit when I keep my mouth open for a long time during teeth cleaning, but the dentist and assistant were so kind and didn't mind at all. I've added this clinic to my list of regular vet appointments.

0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.text: คุณหมอน่ารักมาก ฝีมือดีจริงๆครับ ไปถอนฟันมา ปกติเหมือนจะเจ็บกว่านี้ แต่นี้ไม่มีอาการเจ็บเลย ดีมากๆครับ สถานที่ก็ดีงาม พนักงานดูแลดีมากครับ ❤️❤️❤️
0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.author: Tonn CNXvillage
0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.en: The dentist was so lovely and truly skilled. I had a tooth extracted, and usually it's more painful, but this time there was no pain at all. It was amazing! The place is also beautiful and the staff were very attentive. ❤️❤️❤️

0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.text: I recommend going to Ramkhamhaeng 24 Hospital. It's the same team of doctors, and they're just as kind. The prices are also affordable.
0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.author: ทิตยาพร กันโสม

0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.text: คลินิกทันตกรรมที่ได้มาตรฐาน ราคาประหยัด โดยคุณหมอผู้เชี่ยวชาญด้านต่างๆ ย้ายจากรามคำแหง24 ปากซอยแยก14 มาตรงนี้แล้วค่ะ คุณภาพดีเหมือนเดิม
0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.en: Our standard-certified, affordable dental clinic, staffed by specialist dentists, has moved from Ramkhamhaeng 24, near the intersection of Soi 14, to this new location. The quality remains the same!

0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.text: หมอต้นอ้อ และ ผู้ช่วย อุดฟันได้ดีที่สุดที่เคยทำมา (ที่จอดรถเยอะสะดวกสบาย ซอยติดร้านแกงป่า ด้านข้างคลีนิคเลย) คลีนิคสะอาดมาก ราคาไม่แพง
0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.author: sopon c
0x311d61fcef3d3e25_0x5925229562cf9e24.en: Dr. Ton-ao and her assistant did the best filling I've ever had. (Plenty of convenient parking, located in the alley next to the Gaeng Pa restaurant, right beside the clinic.) The clinic is very clean and the price is reasonable.

0x30e2a1c3accae137_0xabc0de015ee4114.text: I have known and worked with Brett, since 2013. He has always been a very professional and conscientious clinician. He forms very strong therapeutic relationships with his clients. Always based on trust,respect and a genuine desire to help. I worked with Brett as part of a large therapy team in Thailand. He brought a very positive energy to the team. He was always keen to grow as a therapist, Utilising team supervision and exploring his own process. In order to better help his clients. In 2018 I helped support Brett with an clinical intervention. We helped support a young client into residential care. Brett had very carefully and mindfully laid all the groundwork. He had developed a very supportive relationship with the clients family. and had built up trust and hope in the client. All leading to a very positive outcome. The question I often ask is. Would I send a family member to this therapist? With Brett the answer is yes.
0x30e2a1c3accae137_0xabc0de015ee4114.author: Sean Jeffreys

0x30e2a1c3accae137_0xabc0de015ee4114.text: Seeking therapy was the hardest thing I had to do, but luckily through a friend of mine, she reccommended me Counselling Thailand. I was unsure due to my past experiences with therapists. But let me just say that the experience and sessions that I've had with Counselling Thailand's Sus, has helped lifted me out from a place that I no longer wish to be at. Everyone was professional, on-time, kind, and responsive. They are focused on your journey and support your journey to healing and recovering. I honestly can't thank Sus enough for the work she's done. She has been incredible. Thanks to Brett as well for always answering with so much kindness and understanding yet remain incredibly professional. I would highly reccomend if anyone felt that they needed someone to talk too, Counselling Thailand is the place for you to find it. I'm forever thankful for what they've done, and would always reccommend them to friends and family.
0x30e2a1c3accae137_0xabc0de015ee4114.author: Em Sri

0x30e2a1c3accae137_0xabc0de015ee4114.text: My online sessions have been very helpful. They've changed how I view some relationships in my life and made it easier to live with them, with peace of mind. It's also been very validating and helpful to hear an expert's view on things. I was worried as I had previously had a few bad experiences with counselling, especially since I was younger back then. And still am pretty young (24) so I was worried they would not take me seriously. However, every person I've interacted with (all online) have been nothing but helpful and kind. I've already recommended this place to some of my family and would highly recommend to anyone else as well, be it young or old. Edit to Add: My counselor is P'Jip.
0x30e2a1c3accae137_0xabc0de015ee4114.author: Anna Kuvinichkul

0x30e2a1c3accae137_0xabc0de015ee4114.text: It’s taken me years to find someone like Brett. Been relying on him for 2 years now. He genuinely cares about you and after every session that I input he has a defined output with a certain process or steps to follow. He has also gone out of his way to help me with certain legal matters and shows authentic concern and care when things aren’t going well. Even when things are going well he’s beneficial and a good chap to talk to. I have a feeling I will know this guy for a long time. Highly recommend.
0x30e2a1c3accae137_0xabc0de015ee4114.author: Daniel G

0x30e2a1c3accae137_0xabc0de015ee4114.text: Brett is thoughtful, patient and authentic. His approach is very warm and personable. I always feel like he's sincerely listening to me and I believe him when he say's I can overcome issues. I look forward to every session I've schedule with him. Life as an expat can be hard, especially in a country like Thailand. If you are feeling like you need help, don't hesitate to reach out to Brett. I'd highly recommend him to anyone needing a helping hand.
0x30e2a1c3accae137_0xabc0de015ee4114.author: David Lantz

0x30e2a1c3accae137_0xabc0de015ee4114.text: I can't speak highly enough about the professionalism and compassion demonstrated by this company. They possess a rare ability to connect with their clients on a deeply personal level while offering practical strategies for overcoming challenges. Thanks to their guidance, I've experienced significant positive changes in my life and would enthusiastically recommend them to others.
0x30e2a1c3accae137_0xabc0de015ee4114.author: kwachtk

0x30e2a1c3accae137_0xabc0de015ee4114.text: My first time approaching a counsellor turned out to be a very straightforward and easy process with Brett. A consistent level of good advice, helpful reading material and professional but friendly attitude was a great support and helped me overcome some personal issues that had been getting out of control. Would definitely recommend.
0x30e2a1c3accae137_0xabc0de015ee4114.author: Nick Fenwick

0x30e2a1c3accae137_0xabc0de015ee4114.text: The counselling services provided here were exceptional. My therapist (Tao) was not only highly skilled but also genuinely caring and compassionate. They helped me uncover deep-rooted issues and guided me towards healing and growth. I am forever grateful for their support and highly recommend their services!
0x30e2a1c3accae137_0xabc0de015ee4114.author: Mojojojoe Naja

0x30e29f73f71c2c1f_0x2072822649dfed17.text: พาน้องแมวมาหาหมอด้วยอาการฉี่ไม่ออก คุณหมอทำการสวนท่อเพื่อระบายของเสียออกให้ทันที ที่ประทับใจคือคุณหมอไม่เลี้ยงไข้เลย ให้คำแนะนำที่ตรงไปตรงมาเรื่องการปรับพฤติกรรมและการดูแลต่อเนื่องที่บ้าน ไม่ยัดเยียดขายเคสเพิ่ม หมอเน้นให้เราเฝ้าสังเกตอาการอย่างใกล้ชิดและให้ยาเท่าที่จำเป็นจริงๆ หากน้องกลับมาฉี่เองได้ปกติคือจบก็ไม่ต้องกลับมานัดพร่ำเพื่อ เป็นคลินิกที่จริงใจและใส่ใจสุขภาพสัตว์เลี้ยงจริงๆ ครับ ที่สำคัญคือราคาดีมาก

คุณหมอใจดี พูดสุภาพ บริการดี ออกมาจากใจจริง ตอนแรกคิดว่าราคาแรงแน่เลย พอได้มา ประทับใจ การบริการอันดับแรก และคุณหมอที่น่ารักสุภาพและตรงจุดรายละเอียดลึกและจริงใจที่รักษา แบบไม่เลี้ยงไข้ไม่เอาเปรียบ ผู้มาใช้บริการแน่นอน ขอบคุณที่มีคลินิคที่เห็นแก่การรักษามาก่อน เรื่องเงิน เราเองไม่ค่อยมีเงินแต่อยากให้น้องได้รักษาได้หายจนได้มาเจอคลินิกนี้ จากรุ่นพี่ที่แนะนำบอกต่อ ขอบคุณหมออีกครั้งทางนี้เลยนะคะ💕👍🙏🏿
0x30e29f73f71c2c1f_0x2072822649dfed17.author: Tata koya

0x30e29f73f71c2c1f_0x2072822649dfed17.text: แนะนำครับ ราคาไม่แพง คุณหมอเก่งและเป็นกันเองมากครับ น้องที่บ้านฉี่ไม่ออกเลยพาไปหาคุณหมอ คุณทำการสวนฉี่ให้และให้ยามาทาน ตกเย็นมาน้องดีขึ้นมากๆและฉี่ออกแล้วครับ ขอบคุณมากๆครับ คุณหมอทั้ง 3 ท่านน่ารักมากๆครับ อธิบายสาเหตุและวิธีป้องกันได้ดีและเข้าใจมากครับ 🙏🏻
0x30e29f73f71c2c1f_0x2072822649dfed17.author: Nonners Dangerous

0x30e29f73f71c2c1f_0x2072822649dfed17.text: ใช้บริการประจำครับ คุณหมอและสต๊าฟเป็นกันเอง รักษาดีราคาไม่แพงครับ มีที่พักฟื้นให้สำหรับผ่าตัดเล็ก Good service mind and skills with reasonable prices. Recommended for those within vicinity.
0x30e29f73f71c2c1f_0x2072822649dfed17.author: Arkorn Soikaew (Dimmy)

0x30e29f73f71c2c1f_0x2072822649dfed17.text: คุณหมอใจดีมาก ให้คำปรึกษาละเอียดทุกอย่าง ราคาก็ถูกมากอันไหนไม่จำเป็นคุณหมอจะไม่จ่ายยาให้ ให้การรักษาแบบเมตตาสัตว์จริงๆ สงสัยอะไรถามคุณหมอตอบแบบเต็มใจทุกครั้ง ขอบคุณมากๆนะคะ
0x30e29f73f71c2c1f_0x2072822649dfed17.author: parinorn chusri-eam

0x30e29f73f71c2c1f_0x2072822649dfed17.text: เป็นคลินิก 1 ห้อง คุณหมอดีมาก ใจดี คิดถึงใจน้องๆ ที่มารักษา ค่ารักษาไม่แพง ราคาเท่าๆ กับที่อื่น หมอผู้ชายรักษาน้องหมา น้องแมว ถ้าหมอผู้หญิงต้องวันอาทิตย์รักษาสัตว์อื่นได้
0x30e29f73f71c2c1f_0x2072822649dfed17.author: Orawan Srichan

0x30e29f73f71c2c1f_0x2072822649dfed17.text: โชคดีมากที่เจอร้านนี้ แมวที่บ้านไปทำหมันที่ร้านทั้ง3 ตัวเลย คุณหมอเก่งและใจดีทั้งหมอผชและผญ อธิบายขั้นตอนชัดเจน ไม่ยัดเยียดอะไรที่ไม่จำเป็น ราคาสมเหตุสมผล
0x30e29f73f71c2c1f_0x2072822649dfed17.author: Kaneun Bungrapue

0x30e29f73f71c2c1f_0x2072822649dfed17.text: หมอเก่งค่ะ แมวตัวก่อนนี้ตายเพราะที่อื่นรักษาไม่ได้ แต่ที่นี่คลีนิคเล็กๆ แต่หมอเก่งอธิบายการรักษาก่อนอาจจะดูพูดเยอะแต่เขาต้องการให้เราเข้าใจ
0x30e29f73f71c2c1f_0x2072822649dfed17.author: a.orawan2518@gmail.com aofikq0204

0x311d61c42c56eb01_0xe0af12b62c795830.text: I went for a teeth cleaning. It was a newly designed, clean and cute space. I really enjoyed the friendly response from the counselors and the comfortable treatment provided by the doctor(Dr. Ramitta) Thank You
0x311d61c42c56eb01_0xe0af12b62c795830.author: 안은영

0x311d61c42c56eb01_0xe0af12b62c795830.text: คลินิคสะอาด สะอ้าน เจ้าหน้าที่สะอาด ยิ้มแย้ม ห้องทำฟันสะอาด มีที่จอดรถข้างๆ คลินิค คุณหมอ อุดฟันเก่งมาก แนะนำเลย แถว บึงหนองบอน ทำฟันเสร็จไปเดินเล่นสวนต่อ
0x311d61c42c56eb01_0xe0af12b62c795830.en: The clinic is clean and tidy, the staff are clean and friendly, and the treatment rooms are clean. There's parking next to the clinic. 0x3051949ecce9e4bd_0x56a4cfd9d9374573.text: After a very long flight, a vigorous jungle trek, and carrying a travel bag over one shoulder for days, I had a headache in three places and really need a chiropractic adjustment. I found out there are no chiropractors in Krabi (couldn’t find one in Bangkok either) but lucky for me a person at my hotel told me about this place. This therapist used pressure, heat, ultrasound and I think one other thing and yes my headaches went away! As a huge proponent of chiropractic I was thrilled and frankly surprised that physio could do this for me. I have had my share of physio treatments but she is different so I went back the next day to see what she could do for my chronic recurring hip tightness and pain. She used laser, TENS, ultrasound, heat, another type of laser and a magnetic device. Wow. That night falling asleep I still help a minor amount of pain but today my hips feel amazing. She also gave me basic good physio advice on how to take care of myself going forward— be gentle, be consistent, stretch and strengthen daily….all the things I know but need to be reminded of. You want to go here!
0x3051949ecce9e4bd_0x56a4cfd9d9374573.author: Shelley Barva

0x3051949ecce9e4bd_0x56a4cfd9d9374573.text: I had been suffering for several months with frozen shoulder which was extremely painful. I had been to hospital but their treatment was not working. I heard about a treatment using “Shock wave” but the hospital didn’t have the equipment. Doing further research I found “Krabi Physical Therapy Clinic”. The physiotherapist graduated from Mahidol University, top university in Thailand, and she has experience for 30 years. She also had done many additional trainings here in Thailand as well as abroad. She has all the modern equipment as well as using hands on manipulation. Over the weeks that I have been seeing her my shoulder has improved by leaps and bounds. It still isn’t completely right but the improvement has been extraordinary. I highly recommend her, Krabi Physical Therapy Clinic, to anyone who is suffering with chronic pain. Mark R Miller
0x3051949ecce9e4bd_0x56a4cfd9d9374573.author: Mark Miller

0x3051949ecce9e4bd_0x56a4cfd9d9374573.text: I visited Ms. Tantapakul’s clinic after I strained something in my arm and/or neck, and the mild but persistent pain had been driving me crazy for three days straight. She asked very detailed questions about my symptoms, then gave me a physical therapy session followed by an EMS treatment (electrodes are placed on the muscles and a gentle current is used to help them relax). After about an hour, the pain was gone. It returned slightly later in the afternoon, but after a good night’s sleep it was mostly gone the next day — and it completely disappeared the day after that. Ms. Tantapakul also showed me her impressive collection of diplomas from therapeutic courses with trainers from all around the world, which gave me even more confidence in her expertise. Highly recommended.

0x30e29fac08c782a1_0x50a2558ecc627260.text: I’ve tried a few dental clinics in this area, and one thing I noticed is that many places tend to push extra treatments right away (like X-rays, deep cleaning packages, etc.), which can feel a bit overwhelming if you’re just going in for something simple. What I appreciated about Dental Wise Clinic is that they took a much more straightforward approach. I went in for teeth whitening, and instead of immediately upselling, they first checked my teeth and explained my options clearly. There was no pressure to do additional procedures, which made me feel a lot more comfortable. The staff were attentive and professional, and the whole process was smooth from start to finish. One small but important thing: they’re very responsive on LINE, which made booking and asking follow-up questions really easy. If you’re considering this clinic, I’d say it’s a good option if you want: • a no-pressure consultation • clear explanations before committing to anything • easy communication and quick responses That said, I still recommend checking a couple of clinics first, prices and approaches can vary a lot in this area. But based on my experience so far, this is one of the more honest and comfortable ones I’ve been to.

0x30e29fac08c782a1_0x50a2558ecc627260.text: I'm currently receiving Invisalign treatment here. I've always had fairly good teeth alignment, and I never thought orthodontic treatment would be necessary for me. However, as I've gotten older, my upper and lower front teeth started clenching together, causing pain. Initially, I suspected cavities and visited DentalWise, but Dr. Napon explained that the problem was due to a bad bite. After having a scan done and seeing my teeth objectively, I started noticing my overbite, something I hadn't worried about before. I couldn't forget the straight, beautiful smile I saw in the simulation, so I decided to start Invisalign here. I remember feeling relieved when they told me, "Many of our patients undergo orthodontic treatment not only for straighter teeth, but also to keep their natural teeth healthy for a long time." The staff are all warm and kind. I want to congratulate myself for making the bold decision to undergo orthodontic treatment in Thailand. It's a bit embarrassing, but I've included photos of my significantly overbite before treatment and my beautiful teeth afterward for reference. (The left is before, and the right is after. No teeth were extracted.)

0x30e29f5bc70798cb_0xfd41581cac9f9a1c.text: I had the worst experience at Wild clinic. My friend and I booked the ‘Glamerous’ package which clearly says it was a 60 minute package. We booked for 2pm on 01/12 and unfortunately due to traffic I reached at 2:10 and my friend was a few minutes away. The minute I reached and said my friend was shorting arriving, my therapist immediately rushed me up the steep stairs and directed me to my room without even asking me if I wanted to wait for my friend so we can begin together. The facial started around 2:15. It started off okay and I was immediately feeling better. She somewhat explained certain steps and constantly asked if I was feeling sensitive which was nice. However, during the treatment, she told me she will shortly be back and just disappeared for a good 15 minutes. When she finally came back, I clearly said ‘I’m so confused you disappeared for so long’ and she just didn't reply to me and continued the treatment. Soon after, she said we are all done. I was shocked and looked at the time- it was only 2:55. I asked isn’t this a 1 hour treatment ( it has only been 40 minutes and she disappeared for at least another 15). She said it ended faster than usual because I didn’t want to do the acne removal process. To be honest, that explanation didn't make any sense as you didn’t even mention pimple extraction in your description for ‘Glam more rous’. Shortly after, my friend came down. She also didn't get a full hour of treatment even though she did the acne removal process. However she told me her experience was rather really good- her therapist treated her nicely, welcomed her with water, didn't leave her alone in the room at all and even showed her the ‘waste’ that came out from her face. I clearly didn't get any of that. Where is the standard of treatment? Im just genuinely confused how unprofessional this clinic is after charging people so expensive per session. Maybe I just had a horrible experience and it wouldn’t be like this for everyone, but please make sure you get what you pay for. I’d like to advice the team to remove the ‘60 minute’ part out of your description, add the acne removal part in your description, and train all the therapists to have a more standardized procedure.
0x30e29f5bc70798cb_0xfd41581cac9f9a1c.author: Alana Khorana

0x30e29edc5428c6a5_0xe498e020917054a7.text: From my very first conversation with the clinic, they were patient, transparent, and answered every question I had about Thermage FLX and CO₂ laser spot treatment. That immediately gave me confidence. Dr. Ploy was wonderful. She took the time to examine everything carefully, explained her recommendations honestly, and never made me feel rushed. During the Thermage FLX treatment—which isn’t exactly painless!—she and the entire team were incredibly compassionate, constantly checking on me and making sure I was as comfortable as possible. What impressed me the most, though, was what happened after the procedure. In my experience, it’s uncommon to find a clinic that genuinely wants to see you back weeks later just to make sure you’re healing well and are happy with the results. That level of follow-up says a lot about how much they care about their patients, not just the procedure itself. The results have been great so far, yet I’m actually looking forward to my follow-up appointment to discuss a few small touch-ups. That’s the kind of trust Dr. Ploy and her team have earned. Thank you, Dr. Ploy and everyone at SKYN Station Clinic, for your kindness, professionalism, and genuine care. I rarely recommend aesthetic clinics without hesitation, but this is definitely one I can recommend. I’ll be sure to update this review again after my follow-up. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

0x30da24d520e3cbdd_0x9d615d948913d6f7.text: This clinic provides consultations for health problems related to our daily activities, such as working from home leading to office syndrome, incorrect exercise postures causing muscle pain and stiffness, or even long-distance driving that negatively affects back and abdominal muscles. I received acupressure treatment, a manual therapy method performed by a skilled and experienced physiotherapist who understands the connections between various muscle pain and stiffness. After approximately two months of consistent treatment, my stiffness and pain significantly decreased. The clinic's physiotherapist also guided me on correct exercise techniques, stretching, and practical daily routines to prevent muscle injury and strengthen muscles, in conjunction with acupressure therapy. I recommend that anyone unsure whether they should consider physiotherapy try consulting with the clinic first. I believe the clinic can recommend a treatment and self-care program tailored to each individual's needs.

0x30e29f1fd5e01287_0x829be335803b656b.text: Out of 10, I'd give it an 11 for the service. I'm very impressed by both the optometrist and Oat. I started by wanting to find good glasses for my dad, as he usually buys pre-made ones himself and complains that his vision isn't very clear while driving. I happened to be looking for a shop that accepts tax-deductible E-Receipts, so I stopped by without an appointment. I was very welcomed. The optometrist took my dad to get his eyes measured right away. He measured and checked his eyes carefully, showing him how to read them. He seemed to understand eyes very well. He asked if my dad had diabetes. Out of curiosity, I asked how it was related. He explained it very well. I could see the picture. He explained that older people might start to develop pterygium, what causes it and what the effects are, and why older people tend to have presbyopia. He explained well, answered questions, and was very patient. After the examination, he took me to get recommendations on lenses, which brands were available, how they differ, and what the prices were. He also offered a selection of frames, from plastic to famous brands. Oat explained the differences and compared prices. The prices at the shop were in line with the quality of the lenses and frames we chose. After comparing with other shops, it was quite okay. You can pay through any payment method. At that time, I didn't bring my wallet because my original intention was to just go jogging in the park, so I only brought my phone. Since I also wanted to accumulate credit card points, the staff helped me find a way to pay using my phone. They were very patient. Overall, I was very impressed. If anyone has any suggestions, I would definitely recommend this shop. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

0x30da3a8694206771_0x209e29e9fd76703b.text: Remember that you are being educated by the same money that controls the suppression of life saving medication. Iver-m3ctin is one of the top 10 essential drugs in the world for humans yet has been almost completely eliminated locally from retail for humans (and animals!) because it was a business threat during 2020-2022. You can’t replace it with Albendazole. Over 500 studies in multiple countries showed it decreased Covid mortality by ~85%. India used it. Indonesia used it. Then they got strong armed into not using it and the death rate increased 5X. That is not manslaughter. That is murder. For those who are indoctrinated by political pressures - think what if it was your family on life support… would you want a repurposed drug costing 3 Baht to reduce your family member’s chance of dying by 85%? Or would you continue the institutional status quo? The media narrative. Learn what you need to learn - but examine the dogma, do your own thinking 🙏 Understand the origins of modern allopathic medicine, what it replaced and when, and how the education model was constructed to serve it.

The dentist gave good advice and explained everything in detail, which made me feel less nervous. Overall, I was impressed.

0x311d6135e8e7a4fb_0xa2754b3607bc964c.text: มาทำครอบฟัน หมอใจดี ทำดีและสวยมาก ฟันที่เคยรักษารากแตกมา และใส่รีเทนเนอร์ด้วย เคสยากแต่หมอยังรับทำ ราคาไม่แพงเท่าที่สอบถามมาหลายๆที่แล้ว โอเคเลยค่ะ พนักงานพยาบาลน่ารักมาก ขอบคุณมากค่ะ ครั้งหน้าจะใช้บริการอีกค่ะ
0x311d6135e8e7a4fb_0xa2754b3607bc964c.en: I came to get a crown made. The dentist was kind, did a great job, and the result is beautiful. My tooth had a fractured root canal and I also wear a retainer. It was a difficult case, but the dentist still took it on. The price wasn't as expensive as I'd found after inquiring at several other places. It was great! The staff and nurses were very lovely. Thank you so much! I will definitely use your services again next time.

0x311d6135e8e7a4fb_0xa2754b3607bc964c.text: จากที่ไม่กล้าเข้าคลินิกทำฟันเพราะกลัวหมอฟันมานานมาก รอบนี้ปวดฟันเลยต้องมาถอนฟัน โชคดีเลือกคลินิกพายิ้ม ใกล้บ้านด้วย คุณหมอกับเจ้าหน้าที่น่ารัก ให้คำแนะนำดี ราคาไม่แพงมาก แนะนำเลยค่ะ
0x311d6135e8e7a4fb_0xa2754b3607bc964c.en: For a long time, I was too afraid to go to a dental clinic because I was scared of dentists. This time, I had a toothache and needed to have a tooth extracted. Luckily, I chose Payim Clinic, which is close to home. The dentist and staff were lovely and gave good advice. The price wasn't too expensive. I highly recommend it!

0x311d6135e8e7a4fb_0xa2754b3607bc964c.text: คุณหมอใส่ใจดูแลเป็นอย่างดี เจ้าหน้าที่ก็น่ารัก ให้บริการดีมากๆทุกคน เด็กๆชอบการมาทำฟันมาก แนะนำเลยค่ะ ที่บ้านมาทำฟันที่นี่กันทั้งครอบครัว ตั้งแต่คุณยายไปจนถึงหลาน
0x311d6135e8e7a4fb_0xa2754b3607bc964c.en: The doctor was very attentive and caring, and the staff were lovely and provided excellent service. The children loved coming to the dentist. I highly recommend this place. Our whole family, from grandmother to grandchildren, comes here for their dental work.

0x311d6135e8e7a4fb_0xa2754b3607bc964c.text: Nice service and well-managed queue system. The staff, whose professionalism makes this clinic a very good one, were kind, service- minded. Would recommend.

0x311d6135e8e7a4fb_0xa2754b3607bc964c.text: มาขูดหินปูนและฟอกฟันที่นี่ครั้งแรกประทับใจมากค่ะ ราคาไม่แพง คุณหมอรุจรวีทำดีมากกกกก พนักงานก็สุภาพน่ารัก อีก 6 เดือนเจอกันใหม่ค่ะ
0x311d6135e8e7a4fb_0xa2754b3607bc964c.en: This was my first time getting my teeth cleaned and whitened here and I was very impressed. The price was affordable, Dr. Rujrawee did an excellent job, and the staff were polite and lovely. See you again in 6 months!

0x311d6135e8e7a4fb_0xa2754b3607bc964c.text: คุณหมอมือเบามาก แบบ กลัวมากแต่ที่สุดไม่เจ็บเลยตลอดการทำ เข้าใจเราด้วย ขอบคุณค่ะ ใครกลัวหมอฟันแนะนำที่นี่แล้วจะเลิกกลัวน่า
0x311d6135e8e7a4fb_0xa2754b3607bc964c.en: The dentist was very gentle. I was very scared, but it didn't hurt at all throughout the procedure. They understood my feelings too. Thank you! If you're afraid of dentists, I highly recommend this place; you'll overcome your fear!

0x311d61eefbcb5d59_0x58bcd603dc334ef1.text: The good reviews bought me here. On entry the property is extremely clean and fresh. The receptionist was helpful and organised me a clean & polish. I went through straight away. The dentist spoke excellent English and made me feel very comfortable. The clean was the least painful clean I’ve ever had! Normally in UK & NZ it’s painful and I bleed lots. The dentist and assistant were really gentle with me. Thank you so much, I’m really happy with my teeth 😃 Excellent value too…3X the price in England with 2 month waiting list! NZ is more than double the price with a couple of weeks wait. I will be coming back to SmileTag again in the future 🙏
0x311d61eefbcb5d59_0x58bcd603dc334ef1.author: Travel Co.

0x311d61eefbcb5d59_0x58bcd603dc334ef1.text: Excellent! I went to get my wisdom tooth extracted. At first, I thought it would require surgery, but it was just a simple extraction. From the moment I walked into the clinic until I paid, it felt like less than half an hour. The doctor explained everything well and gave good advice. It only hurt a little when they injected the local anesthetic; everything else was very comfortable.
0x311d61eefbcb5d59_0x58bcd603dc334ef1.author: ชาลา เฮ็ดชาลา

0x311d61eefbcb5d59_0x58bcd603dc334ef1.text: วันนี้ได้มาผ่าฟันคุดกับคุณพริม คุณหมอน่ารักๆมากๆใจดีมากๆ และที่สำคัญคุณมือเบาสุดๆ ขนาดฉีดยาชายังไม่รู้สึกเจ็บเลย ใครที่กำลังมองหาคลินิกทันตกรรมแนะนำเลยค่ะ เรามาผ่าคุดฟันครั้งแรก และจะให้เป็นคลินิกประจำสำหรับกับการทำฟันตลอดไปค่ะ พนักงานบริการดีและน่ารักด้วย ขอบคุณคุณหมอด้วยนะคะ ตอนนี้หลังผ่าเสร็จหมดฤทธิ์ยาชาแล้ว ยังไม่ปวดเลยค่ะ คุณหมอมือเบาและเก่งมากๆเลยค่ะขอบคุณมากนะคะ

0x311d61eefbcb5d59_0x58bcd603dc334ef1.en: Today I had my wisdom tooth extracted by Dr. Prim. She's incredibly kind and gentle, and most importantly, has an amazing touch. I didn't even feel any pain from the local anesthetic injection. I highly recommend her to anyone looking for a dental clinic. This was my first time having a wisdom tooth extracted here, and I'll be making this my go-to clinic for all my dental work. The staff are also lovely and provide excellent service. Thank you so much, Dr. Prim! Even now that the anesthetic has worn off after the extraction, I'm not in any pain. She's incredibly gentle and skilled. Thank you so much!

0x311d61eefbcb5d59_0x58bcd603dc334ef1.text: I came for a teeth cleaning after 2 years. 😁 I also brought my 1-year-old daughter for a dental check-up. 😄 The dentist gave good advice and was very kind. 0x30e299d64665afe1_0xb0053a00f44d5469.text: The ultimate in innovative treatment! 😇 The clinic is new, clean, and modern. The equipment and tools are imported from Taiwan. The staff and doctors are lovely, friendly, and very informative. This time, I tried the electric glove treatment program primarily to relieve pain for those with office syndrome. 🔰 Step 1: Upon arrival, go to the counter and inform them of your reserved program. The staff will then guide you through filling out your personal history and pain details. Be sure to fill in as honestly as possible so that the doctor can use it to assess your symptoms during the physical examination. 🔰 Step 2: A deep balance check with the doctor. They will use a device to measure energy along the meridian points in your wrists and ankles to assess any underlying symptoms you may not be aware of. Once the results are received, the doctor will explain the areas requiring treatment and how to take care of yourself. 🔰 Step 3: The treatment will begin by applying the electric glove to the points the doctor has specified. All clothing and jewelry must be removed. I wore only the paper underwear provided by the clinic. My treatment started at my neck, shoulders, and back > arms > legs and hips > abdomen > head. Each area was sore depending on the severity of my symptoms. The staff were lovely and informed me of any areas that might be particularly sore, so I could prepare myself. 🔰 Final step: Drink warm water and listen to post-treatment self-care instructions. Then, I made my next appointment. I was very impressed. 🥰 The clinic seemed safe. The doctor and staff were lovely. The massage room was clean and private. The post-massage symptoms were not severe or painful. I recommend anyone looking for a massage clinic to give it a try.
0x30e299d64665afe1_0xb0053a00f44d5469.author: METHA'S WAY

0x30e299d64665afe1_0xb0053a00f44d5469.text: I came for a check-up and treatment with electroconvulsive therapy gloves. Normally, I have trouble sleeping... For the past two days, I've been falling asleep as soon as my head hits the pillow. When I wake up, I don't feel the fatigue I used to. I'm quite surprised. And most importantly, this is very noticeable: Normally, when I sit in my work chair or even sleep, I have a dull, aching pain. As a friend told me,temple massage is the best, it’s one of the original places to learn about thai massage, there are some certifications like papers hanged at the entrance, if you don’t know whether a massage place is good or not,those certifications can be an endorsement。 overall， its a very great experience in Chiangmai old town. 0x30da3b2d49d7f79f_0x111fd74163e5210a.text: I got a foot massage. The environment was clean, but a little shabby, so I was a little worried when they wiped my feet with wet tissues, but the massage was so so so cool that I fainted ㅜㅜ They even applied tiger balm to the bruises on my legs. The massage was really the best, much better than the expensive shop I went to yesterday. I got a massage while feeling the breeze from the fan, so it was cool for me, who easily gets hot. I highly recommend it for a short break while traveling. The person I got the massage from was ubon!

0x30da3b2d49d7f79f_0x111fd74163e5210a.text: For such a low price, it's truly excellent value for money! There's no air conditioning or relaxing music; but the auntie with incredibly strong massage skills, the naturally ventilated environment, and the sounds of insects and birds make it all worthwhile. It actually helps you feel more integrated into Chiang Mai life. Unlike other massage parlors where tourists dominate, this place seemed to have a significant local population. Overall, at such a low price, it's fantastic and well worth it.
0x30da3b2d49d7f79f_0x111fd74163e5210a.author: Cho J.

0x30da3b2d49d7f79f_0x111fd74163e5210a.text: It was a wonderful experience here. I stayed for two days, once for a foot massage and once for a full body massage. The foot massage was painful, but excellent. The lady knew exactly what she was doing; she knew exactly how far she could go. The second day, a full body massage—well, we Westerners could learn a thing or two from that. Both times, even with short breaks, they massage with all their heart and soul, and it shows. Kind regards, because it was fantastic, Harry.
0x30da3b2d49d7f79f_0x111fd74163e5210a.author: harryvandereerden rosalien

0x30da3b2d49d7f79f_0x111fd74163e5210a.text: The best value massage in Chiang Mai. They offer over 60 minutes of massage alone, rather than pre- and post-service services. Don't expect fancy interiors or couples rooms. Don't be surprised if they wipe your feet with wet wipes beforehand. (I wasn't surprised, since I read reviews on Google beforehand.) It seems like a popular spot for locals. The masseuses appear to be professionals with decades of experience. The entrance feels like a temple, so it's easy to miss.
0x30da3b2d49d7f79f_0x111fd74163e5210a.author: 사랑해강쥬

0x30da3b2d49d7f79f_0x111fd74163e5210a.text: We stumbled upon this place and were surprised by the price difference compared to other Thai massage parlors. Entering through a narrow alley, we saw satisfied customers leaving, all agreeing that the massages offered in the temples were well worth trying. And they were right. They gave us clean clothes to change into and treated us to an authentic Thai massage from head to toe. The place was air-conditioned with relaxing background music, although some of the masseuses were talking amongst themselves and on their phones during the massage, which was a bit distracting. You leave exhausted but refreshed.

0x30da3b2d49d7f79f_0x111fd74163e5210a.text: the man who was doing the massage was talking and laughing with his partner all the time. Later I realized that they were laughing at me. We discussed that I had a flight in a few days. We discussed multiple treatment options and decided that a myringoplasty was the best option for removing the blockage. Dr. Warangkana explained the procedure and the risks. She the expertly performed the procedure. After 3 days, the ear was still blocked. I returned to the clinic. She examined my ear and showed me that the swelling in my ear had subsided. She inspected my nose and throat again. She wrote a detailed medical certificate noting all the medications and treatment for my doctor when I return to Australia. About 2 hours after leavjng the clinic my ear began to feel air and then finally popped. I flew to Bangkok. I followed the Dr. Instructions on the flight and the last of the blockage came out as the plane decended. My hearing has now fully returned. Thank you so much for your immediate, kind, and honest treatment. I am so thankful to have my hearing restored.
