0x3102bdfe5d7390d1_0xa1147f4d920450e1.text: First and foremost just want to state that this review was made out of good will and for contribution to patients and the doctors and nurses in the medical industry. As commonly seen Thai doctors and nurses are amazing kind and especially skillful by industry standards. No ill intentions or prejudice against particular persons. Went to seek urgent cure as I suspected i had cholera or diarrhoea due to food poisoning. But after getting registered a government hospital nearby to this private hospital suggested waiting was too long for my urgent condition so the counter staff helpfully redirected me to come to Pattaya Memorial hospital. And so I was here and got registered at the front counter staff was ok. But not the second staff at another counter who took my body temperature. She passed the thermometer and gestured to insert under my armpit. I then answered an important call as I need to prepare payment for hospital expenses and inform my family members and work partners in case I need be hospitalised after. That nurse was frowning and looking horrid while seeing me busy talking over the phone, she finally reacted to point at my arm meaning she wanted to retrieve the thermometer from me. So I took it out and handed it to her and she didn't even know to say thanks or excuse.Next she told me to wait there but who was she talking to I'm not sure me or another patient, and where exactly outside which room and the way she said it to me was like definitely rude because by medical care standard she should have gently shown the patient so there was no error. So judging from her initial attitude, the patient service outcome would be expectably far worse if my wife (Thai) wasn't with me all the while there. Soon my turn came the doctor examined me. He was courteous, attentive and cautious when checking my condition.He finished off with instructions to stop taking solid, indigestible, spicy and sour food during treatment period and prescribed oral medicine. We wai thanks and goodbye to him and he warmly wai back to us. Later experience with the pharmacist, the cashier was great too. But bill was over 2000baht bit too costly for outpatient treatment of this category. Main factor for improvement is hopefully the pricing and also taking greater care in hiring of nurses as wrong staff selection pose a risk to patient's wellness and health.
0x3102bdfe5d7390d1_0xa1147f4d920450e1.author: Sun Thon

0x3102bdfe5d7390d1_0xa1147f4d920450e1.text: I was looking for a dermatologist to check for skin cancer as I have had previous basal cell carcinoma that required treatment and surgery. I hadn’t had a checkup for two years. I researched a number of hospitals in the Pattaya/ Sattahip region and made a decision on Pattaya Memorial Hospital. Pricing varied across the four different hospitals I contacted from 1,400 THB - 2,500 THB which was for the consultation with the dermatologist and additional costs for any treatment. I hadn’t been to any hospitals in Thailand so my first experience was very positive. I was advised that no appointment was needed and just turn up which I did, on arrival I went to the registration desk advised what I wanted, I provided my passport, confirmed my address and phone number. They took my photo, photocopied my passport and directed me to another station where my weight and blood pressure was checked. I was then directed to take a seat. This was undertaken within 10 minutes of arrival. A staff member came over and provided a registration form which had my details completed including my photo, I was asked to sign the form and wait for the dermatologist. A further 5 minutes passed and I noticed that there were signs requesting that everyone wear a mask, I asked one of the staff and they obtained a mask for me. I was then admitted to see the dermatologist who checked the area’s of concern, she explained very clearly which spots were potentially problematic and used photos to explain why. Treatment was provided liquid nitrogen and ointment was recommended for the following month with a further evaluation in 6 months. I paid for the consultation, treatment and ointment and was out of the hospital within 35 minutes of arrival. I found that the whole process was extremely efficient and the staff engaging and importantly for me the dermatologist had an excellent command of English. The waiting room was clean and comfortable. The bill was higher than expected but I would definitely recommend this hospital. Thank you to everyone who assisted me yesterday ✌️

0x3102bdfe5d7390d1_0xa1147f4d920450e1.text: This hospital accepts both Japanese and foreign emergency patients. The hospital staff are kind, the facilities are clean, and the medical fees are reasonable. There are no staff members who speak Japanese, but thanks to the development of translation apps, there were no communication problems. An acquaintance of mine had eyelid edema due to an acute allergy and was referred to this hospital's emergency department by Muang Pattaya Hospital. There were various patients including Westerners, Japanese, and Thais. The patient registration process for emergency patients was very smooth, and they were guided to the emergency department without any problems. My acquaintance received emergency medication and recovered quickly, so they were discharged in an hour. The billing for discharge and the handover of medication after discharge were also smooth. The total medical cost was about 15,000 yen. Incidentally, a Japanese person who had been treated for a back injury in a traffic accident was told that their emergency visit, X-ray diagnosis, and medication treatment cost about 20,000 yen.

0x30e29b42ba40c393_0x47db7fe1200f9e5c.text: At first, I looked at a lot of places. I'd tried other IUI treatments without success until I stumbled upon Premier Clinic on Facebook. I felt a connection, and combined with the knowledge I gained from the egg collection doctor's page (Dr. Ueanong, who is beautiful and very kind), I felt confident that this was the place to make my dream come true. I actually looked for a long time, visiting the clinic several times before finally going in (waiting for the right time). But I loved it from the first visit. The clinic is beautiful, clean, has a good atmosphere, a beautiful view, and is very new. I want to thank Dr. Ueanong Thongthap, the team of scientists, and all the nurses (let me secretly tell you, for those afraid of needles, Nurse Oil has a very gentle hand. My husband, who's afraid of needles, said it was very easy, didn't hurt at all when she drew blood. He was so impressed that he had to get a flu shot with her). They took care of me, supported me, and answered all my questions until I successfully completed the embryo transfer. After just one session, we had a cute little baby boy. It was a birthday present for my parents at the ages of 36 and 41. I want to tell anyone who's looking for information or is hesitant, I suggest you visit this home first. You'll know how warm it is. If you've been disappointed elsewhere, come see me for yourself. I'm so chill and amazing. I've never felt pressured or stressed during my visit. 🩷🩷 The first thing I heard from the doctor, and every time I had concerns, was, "Don't worry. I'll handle everything. Leave everything to me. Your job is to give me injections and take all the medication as prescribed. Keep fighting, Mom!" 😊

0x30da3bac1d08398d_0x5678f21a3167d6bd.text: 🧡 My First Acupuncture + Cupping Therapy Experience 🧡 I came in with shoulder and neck pain from working on the computer and using my phone a lot for work, causing stiffness in my shoulders and pain radiating to the back of my neck. ‼️ Acupuncture Procedure ‼️ It wasn't scary or painful at all. You'll feel a slight sensation when the doctor inserts the needles, but it's not painful at all! ⚡️Electrical Stimulation for Muscle Relaxation⚡️ ‘It was amazing!’ The muscle twitching lasted 20 minutes. During the treatment, I felt rhythmic twitching. ⚠️(Don't worry about electric shock. The doctor uses a low energy level. If you feel too much twitching, you can ask the doctor to reduce the energy level.)⚠️ 🔮 Cupping Therapy 🔮 I felt a slight tightness on my skin when the cups were placed. Because the cups create a vacuum, they suck the skin in, stimulating blood circulation and helping to relax muscles. The cups were left on for 8-10 minutes. (If you feel the cups are too tight and causing pain, you can ask them to loosen them slightly.) The feeling while the cups were on was amazing, like my soul was being sucked out!🤣 It was incredibly relaxing. And when the cups were removed, it felt like the ultimate bliss! I feel my muscles are relaxed, and the hard lumps in my shoulders have softened a lot. ❓Compared to massage❓ I feel that acupuncture and cupping are much better at solving the problem. Sometimes when I get a shoulder massage, it's very stiff, and the masseuse massages too hard, which can cause more muscle inflammation and shoulder pain. Overall, it's very good. The clinic responds to messages quickly. There's only one doctor in the clinic, but they do things very quickly. The doctor speaks well, but a little too fast (I couldn't quite understand)🤣 📌 Most importantly, the doctor is handsome📌 Let's get acupuncture ❤️

0x30da3bac1d08398d_0x5678f21a3167d6bd.text: I injured my back doing Muay Thai and it was so bad I could not sleep for three nights and it affected my stomach so I would wake up nauseous. The acupuncture on my stomach settled my sickness and the cupping (WOW) was the good old fashioned kind where they use flame (instead of a lame pump) and she ran up and down the sides of my spine and then filled my back with the glass vacuums for eight minutes and my mind went blank. I was sooo tired that day, but could sleep that night and much better feeling the next day and even more the next. I have been back for a couple of weeks and had good results both time and will go again just to get on a healthy basis. Much respect for their skill. Bravo!

0x30e29f40529b4625_0x87ec10e46f53f701.text: I have just completed a series of hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) sessions at Abloom Wellness Centre, and I cannot say enough good things about the experience. After surgery, I was looking for a place to support my recovery, and Abloom more than delivered. From the moment I walked in, I was struck by how knowledgeable and friendly the staff are. They took the time to explain exactly what the hyperbaric oxygen process would involve, answered all of my questions patiently, and made me feel completely at ease. That level of care made a huge difference — especially in a recovery phase where trust is everything. Each session left me feeling surprisingly energized. It was more than just relaxing; I genuinely felt renewed, like my body was getting a deep reset. I’m confident that these treatments are helping my wounds heal faster, and that sense of progress has been deeply reassuring. What really sealed the deal for me was the ambiance. The view from the centre is absolutely amazing — particularly if you book an evening session. Watching the city lights as you enjoy a drink after your session adds a peaceful touch to the therapy. Beyond HBOT, Abloom offers a wonderful range of services — from infrared sauna and ice baths to IV drip therapies and therapeutic massage. It’s clear they’ve curated a holistic wellness program that goes far beyond standard treatments. All in all, I would highly recommend Abloom Wellness Centre to anyone looking for professional, effective, and deeply restorative care. Whether you’re recovering from surgery or simply need a wellness boost, it’s a sanctuary that truly backs up its promise of helping you “come back to yourself.”
0x30e29f40529b4625_0x87ec10e46f53f701.author: Tanz Roxburgh

0x30e29f40529b4625_0x87ec10e46f53f701.text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 — Exceptional Wellness Experience at Abloom Wellness Spa I recently enjoyed the Longevity Package at Abloom Wellness Spa, and it was an outstanding experience from start to finish. The combination of a 60-minute foot reflexology session and traditional Thai massage was deeply relaxing and skillfully performed — the therapists were clearly well-trained and highly knowledgeable in alternative medicine techniques. The highlight for me was the Hyperbaric Oxygen Room, which left me feeling rejuvenated and refreshed. The staff took time to explain the benefits and made sure I was comfortable throughout. The spa itself is beautifully maintained, with state-of-the-art, accredited facilities that reflect true professionalism and care for clients’ wellbeing. It’s clear that Abloom Wellness Spa takes a holistic and evidence-based approach to health and relaxation. Highly recommended for anyone looking to invest in their wellness and longevity — I’ll definitely be returning!

0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.text: I can say without a shadow of a doubt that selling my car to fund my time at The Dawn was the absolute best decision of my entire life. Healing is rarely ever supposed to be comfortable. In a community setting like this, you will run into every type of personality that exists in the outside world, often in its most extreme form. Other clients will complain, and the process will feel incredibly challenging at times. But there is a profound, undeniable healing that happens through authentic connection. Here, I learned to get used to discomfort, to finally speak aloud the things heavily tied to guilt, shame, anxiety, and fear. I learned that it is okay to say the wrong thing, and that true growth happens when you allow yourself to drop the mask and be seen. The staff and doctors here are elite professionals who intimately understand the mechanics of trauma: Robert, my focus therapist, is genuinely the best therapist I have ever had in my entire life. Helen, the clinical director, proved to be not only an exceptionally skilled practitioner in the healing process during our brief talks, but also an avid, inspiring leader. The entire staff, from the nurses to the support team, is incredibly polite, compassionate, and professional. In two months, I did not encounter a single person who showed attitude or didn't want to be here. I chose the Viva package (off-site residence) for two months, though due to renovations, I spent the first six weeks on-site. While the Viva accommodations are perfectly good enough to get the job done, staying on-site is incredibly useful because it gives you immediate access to professional help, nurses, and medications at odd hours of the night. Furthermore, being on-site allowed me to utilize the amenities, like the gym and the piano, for an extra two hours a day, which is surprisingly worth it. Every single aspect of the programming is intentionally tailored toward mental health and nervous system regulation. The activities, including TRE (Trauma Releasing Exercises), sound healing, massage, yoga, and Muay Thai kickboxing, are purposeful. Even the food is scientifically part of the narrative. Having studied nutrition for mood stability myself, I immediately noticed the intentional inclusion of beets, pumpkin seeds, and dried apricots. Furthermore, when the intense "cycle" of processing trauma triggered massive cravings for carbohydrates and chocolate, I was incredibly grateful that the dining room always had cookies and snacks on hand, and that the store had plenty of treats to help. If you are considering coming here for trauma, I HIGHLY recommend booking 56 days over 28. That extension grants you access to the specialized trauma group. You absolutely need those first 28 days in the regular groups just to stabilize, understand the process, and learn how the community works before diving into the deepest layers of your past. I thought I learned everything I needed until I entered the second group, and I couldn't believe how much deeper the path of connection and acceptance could go. It may not feel comfortable every day, but please trust that this place knows exactly what they are doing. I am leaving with a sense of groundedness I didn't think was possible, and I cannot wait to see where life takes me from here. — Joseph
0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.author: Joe Bryan

0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.text: Struggling with mental health and addiction while living on a vacation island in Thailand isn't fun at all. I’d never felt properly diagnosed, and my anxiety was creeping into every corner of my life, especially work. Things were getting harder to manage. After diving into some online research, I found The Dawn. I reached out, and Nathalie from the admissions team got in touch right away. She explained everything to me with patience, answering every one of my (many!) questions. Deciding to spend a month there was a big choice—work commitments meant I couldn’t stay longer—but looking back, it turned out to be one of the BEST decisions I’ve ever made for my well-being. Thank you very much to the Dawn!!! From the moment I arrived in Chiang Mai, the warm and welcoming staff made everything so smooth. I was greeted at the airport and driven to The Dawn, where I got a full tour of the grounds: the relaxing pool, a spacious gym and wellness center, a little convenience store, the sleek library, meeting rooms, and a gorgeous dining area overlooking the river. After settling into my cozy room, I had time to relax before meeting the rest of the team and my peers. The team at The Dawn is incredible—professional, compassionate, and always there when you need them. The support staff were ready to listen and hold space for me, my therapist Albert was not only extremely knowledgeable but truly passionate, and the doctors and nurses were top-notch. Then, there’s the fantastic gym team, the skilled massage therapists, and the people working behind the scenes—cooking delicious meals, maintaining the beautiful grounds, and keeping the whole place running smoothly. You’ll meet peers from all over the world who truly understand your struggles. The treatment blends Western and Eastern approaches, giving you a holistic path to healing. Each day is packed with group sessions (where you gain valuable insights from peers), individual counseling, educational sessions on psychology, fitness classes (like yoga, pilates, gym workouts, walks, aqua fitness, pickleball, zumba), meditation, sound bowl sessions, and evening time for journaling, exploring emotions, and practicing gratitude and CBT. If you’re struggling, don’t hesitate to ask for help. It’s not easy to face your fears and deepest, darkest secrets, but the relief that comes with shedding that weight is worth it. Don’t expect to walk out fully “healed”—this is real work, and it requires vulnerability. But with the incredible team at The Dawn guiding you, you’ll be equipped with tools that, if you continue to use them, can set you on the path to your best self for the future. Just remember: from dusk till dawn, take it one day at a time, one step at a time.
0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.author: Sandra Schneeweiss - Representative Koh Samui

0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.text: I’m writing this review on the final day of my second one-month stay at The Dawn, and I can only describe both of my experiences here as fantastic and life-saving. If you're considering a residential treatment facility, I strongly recommend reaching out — just make an enquiry and see for yourself the brilliant, holistic program they offer. I first came to The Dawn in April 2024, in the depths of addiction and the mental health issues that came with it. After my initial stay, I returned home clean and went on to live an awesome and fulfilling life for nine months. Unfortunately, a series of significant life events triggered a return to addictive behaviours. But thanks to the strength, knowledge, and tools I had gained from my first time at The Dawn, I was able to hit the brakes early and return — this time in a very different, much stronger place. During my second stay, my counsellor and I quickly identified what felt like the missing piece of the puzzle. I focused all my energy on that work, fully engaging with the facilities and the wide range of activities and practices that support every core aspect of the program. I’m leaving this stay feeling strong, confident, and empowered. The opportunities are here — and you truly get out what you put in. From start to finish, the staff at The Dawn are incredible people who want nothing but the best for every client. Their ethos of care, compassion, and friendliness is all-encompassing — from the cleaning staff and security guards to the counsellors, support team, admissions staff, chefs, fitness and yoga instructors, massage therapists, and the nursing team. Everyone plays a role in creating a deeply supportive environment. And then there are the clients. Across both my stays, I’ve met some of the most amazing, inspiring people I’ve ever known — many of whom I’m still in touch with and plan to stay connected to. The level of support and solidarity within the group was unlike anything I’ve experienced before. We came from different backgrounds with different struggles, but we all shared the same goal: to become the best versions of ourselves. As I now move into the next chapter of my recovery, I can’t thank The Dawn enough. My family and I will be forever grateful. Keep up the amazing work!
0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.author: Andy Threapleton

0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.text: This was my second experience of residential treatment. I arrived with an understanding of what therapeutic work involved, but not what this specific process would ask of me. I planned to stay four to six weeks. I stayed several months. I arrived at The Dawn numb and in a state of near emotional paralysis. A few years of recovery under my belt, yet more disconnected from myself than ever. The setting itself is inherently healing: beautiful grounds, comfortable accommodation, and a holistic programme that attends to the whole person. It is a genuinely good place to do hard work. It's worth noting that The Dawn isn't only for people in early recovery. I came seeking deeper psychological work, and the facility was fully equipped for that. The therapeutic offering goes well beyond addiction treatment. The work here is serious and substantive. I was able to engage with a range of modalities, including somatic work, held by clinicians who clearly understand that recovery isn't just about the mind. The emphasis on reconnecting with the body, not just processing cognitively, made a profound difference for me. This isn't a facility that offers one-size-fits-all treatment. The team took time to understand what I needed and built something around that. And when I had feedback, it was genuinely listened to and, where appropriate, acted upon. There were moments during my time at The Dawn where I couldn't see a future waiting for me on the other side of the gates. As is often true of any meaningful therapeutic process, things got worse before they got better. And they got better. I leave equipped with the skills to sit in discomfort rather than run from it, to move towards a fulfilling life rather than away from myself, towards a future aligned with my values and one that doesn't require me to contort myself into impossible positions (unless on a yoga mat). After a lifetime of jumping from buoy to buoy, fighting the tides, I seem finally to have learned to swim with rather than against them. I'm not looking for the next goal, but moving in a direction. And much like The Dawn itself, all I have to do is keep showing up. To everyone at The Dawn, thank you for all that you do.
0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.author: C D

0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.text: My experience at The Dawn Rehab Centre in Chiang Mai has been nothing short of life-changing. When I arrived, I was struggling deeply with addiction and trauma, unsure of who I was or how to move forward. After completing a 12-week bespoke program, I can genuinely say that I feel like a completely different person; grounded, empowered, and truly ready to step back into the real world. A huge part of this transformation is thanks to the incredible people who supported me every step of the way. My focal therapist, Alan Wood, guided me with compassion, insight, and unwavering care. His approach helped me confront the core of my issues and rebuild myself from a place of understanding rather than shame. I also want to express my gratitude to Helen Wells, the Clinical Director, whose leadership and vision shape the remarkable therapeutic environment at The Dawn. Her presence and expertise were felt throughout the entire program. The support team was equally extraordinary. I want to thank David, Abdulla, Pang, Jack, Top, Bas, Ping, Nora, Mary, Beam, Mun and Linh each of you played a unique role in my healing. Whether it was a conversation, a smile, or guidance during difficult moments, your kindness made all the difference. And to the amazing admissions team, Alex Holland, Marcus, Daryl, and everyone else involved, thank you for making the process smooth, reassuring, and filled with genuine care from the very beginning. The entire staff at The Dawn work together like a family, and during my stay, I truly felt part of that family. The environment, the personalized therapy, the structure, and the warmth of the community created the perfect space for deep healing and growth. I leave The Dawn with clarity, confidence, and a renewed sense of purpose. This journey has changed my life in ways I will forever be grateful for. Thank you, The Dawn. You gave me my life back.
0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.author: Aniket Patel

0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.text: During my time here I have gained the insight to address my mental health issues. I arrived thinking I was depressed and that my anxiety was under control. I see now that anxiety and burnout played a much bigger role than I realized. I was told that you will get out what you put in' and I fully agree with that. I can't say what specifically caused a shift, but I participated in the programs and very quickly started noticing changes. My therapist, John, was extremely knowledgeable and was able to identify issues I had no idea were causing me problems. I felt heard and understood and he has really helped me reclaim my life. He provided handouts and videos and books to help me understand what was going on, and more importantly, how to manage this in the future. This was my first time participating in peer groups, and as uncomfortable as they were at times, they were valuable. The facilitators provided little pearls of wisdom' during almost every session that will stick with me. The holistic and fitness sessions helped me feel a sense of peace for the first time in a very long time. The MBI sessions with Amanda were very beneficial. She has a gift that she is generously sharing with the clients here. I am leaving feeling like I have the tools to navigate life.
0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.author: France Pichakorn

0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.text: This is a continuation of my review - one year on from when I joined The Dawn and at one year sober, one day at a time. I remain very grateful to all the staff at The Dawn and in truth I sometimes rather miss the tranquility of the place, the friendliness, the myriad of things to do, but life carries on and luckily for me, The Dawn has allowed me to carry on with life, sober and certainly more at peace than I was before. Thank you The Dawn. I had a great experience at The Dawn and am very grateful for all the support and care I got. This hasn't been my first rehab, but undoubtedly it was the best. The staff are amazing - from the Support team, to the fitness team and of course the counsellors - but all of them play a part in welcoming you, making you feel at home and getting you back on track. The experience isn't as rigid as some of the UK rehabs I have been to but the outcome is significantly better. There is a lot of focus on CBT - and I now realise that unless I change my thinking, I will always go back to the hell that is addiction. I will be forever grateful to The Dawn - a fantastic rehab with excellent facilities, lovely people and a great atmosphere.
0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.author: Wyndham Clark

0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.text: I attended this facility seeking urgent clinical support during a severe crisis which was later followed by a significant mental health diagnosis. Prior to arrival, I communicated that I was experiencing a high level of distress and instability. Based on my personal experience, I did not feel adequately assessed, supported, or stabilised during my stay. Instead, I left feeling more distressed than when I arrived, and the experience had a significant emotional and financial impact on me. One of my main concerns was the difference between my expectations and my experience. The facility advertises personalised, trauma-informed care, but I personally found much of the treatment to be relatively generic and not sufficiently tailored to my individual circumstances. More than two weeks into my stay, I still did not have a clear treatment plan, had not had a one to one with a lead clinical specialist, and had received less productive one-to-one therapeutic support than I had expected based on my discussions during the admissions process. I was also concerned by what I experienced as limited on-site medical support at the campus where I stayed. During my time there, I was not aware of any on site doctors, and my understanding was that residents requiring a higher level of medical support would be transferred to a local hospital. There were also several practical issues that added stress during my stay, including: • Inconsistent access to food and amenities. Food was available on a different campus which was only accessible at certain times, and I recall experiencing power cuts and issues with running water. • Transport charges that I do not recall being clearly explained beforehand. • Concerns about room cleanliness. • Restrictions on personal coping strategies that I did not understand and which were never explained. • An inability to change therapists despite requesting this. • I did not receive feedback regarding complaints I raised. • I can’t recall the refund policy being explicitly discussed with me during the admissions process. I was disappointed that some of the specialised trauma-focused therapies I had expected were not available within the timeframe originally discussed before admission. During my stay, extending my admission was discussed as a way of accessing additional treatment. Personally, I found this frustrating given the significant financial commitment already involved. The aspect I found most difficult was the feeling that my increasing distress during the admission process and my stay was not recognised in the way I had hoped. Looking back, I do not feel that the environment was the right fit for the level of support I needed at that time. I did, however, meet several compassionate and supportive staff members, including a coordinator who was particularly helpful, and many members of the local support team treated me with kindness throughout my stay. While others may have a different experience, this was mine. In my case, I did not feel safe, sufficiently assessed, or provided with the level of personalised care I had expected based on the facility's descriptions of its services. Anyone considering treatment may wish to ask detailed questions in advance about staffing, treatment planning, clinical support, costs, policies, and the availability of specific therapies so they can determine whether the service is appropriate for their individual needs. I also noticed that several significant staff members who were present during my stay no longer appear on the facility's website. I cannot comment on the reasons for this, but prospective clients may wish to make their own enquiries regarding staffing and continuity of care.
0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.author: Toby Earle

0x30e29ef1a03bcda7_0xc3e59407e7582280.text: It's about a 5-minute walk from MRT Phetchaburi Station. From the station, walk straight along Phetchaburi Road. If you accidentally go around to the back, you'll end up entering through the back. The prices are reasonable, and there were only about 20 women there. It was less crowded than other places, but if you go around 7 PM, there might be more. Prices range from 2,000 to 8,000 baht. I came here before COVID-19, and there are still many Japanese customers. Unlike other places, there was a nasal test upon entry (this may no longer be available). It's located along Phetchaburi Road in a 5-minute walk from MRT Phetchaburi Station. About 20 women were staying. Prices are about 3,000-9,000 baht on the price list.
0x30e29ef1a03bcda7_0xc3e59407e7582280.author: Yskoao Euuyn

0x30e29ef1a03bcda7_0xc3e59407e7582280.text: I went there on the last day, after spending a month and a half in Thailand, exploring every corner of the country. What I can say is that if you want a little "extra relaxation," this is the perfect place. How can I put it? Miss Bangkok was chatting with Miss World, and I chose Miss Universe, that's how good it was... I'm going back to Bangkok next month. I already have her phone number. When I arrived, she greeted me with a big smile, then took me to a room worthy of a 5-star hotel. She put me in a large bathtub and soaped me all over. I'll let you imagine the pleasure she was so quick to give me; it was a magical moment.
0x30e29ef1a03bcda7_0xc3e59407e7582280.author: Jm B

0x30e29ef1a03bcda7_0xc3e59407e7582280.text: A dream come true! The rooms are spotless and modern, definitely much better than in Pattaya. As for the selection, I imagine it depends on the time of day. There weren't many rooms available, but they were all beautiful (especially mine)! The average tourist (who doesn't know the drill) will get ripped off elsewhere. It's expensive here, but the quality is there, and there's no scam.
0x30e29ef1a03bcda7_0xc3e59407e7582280.author: Pierre-Henri Legros

0x30e29ef1a03bcda7_0xc3e59407e7582280.text: Went there 3 times in last 1 year. Every time the experience was GREAT. Always went for the "models" which start from B6.5K. Yes, expensive compared to what the city usually offers, but they are worth it! NOTE: 1. This is NOT a soapy massage place but they do have bath tub if you like it soapy. 2. The place is very much open, not closed as other reviews suggests.
0x30e29ef1a03bcda7_0xc3e59407e7582280.author: Raiden S

0x30e29ef1a03bcda7_0xc3e59407e7582280.text: First time in Bangkok, first time in MP. I went in in the evening. There were four regulars and three in the high-class section to the right. The regulars are quite flirtatious, so as a timid person, I'm naturally drawn to them. It was less than 4,000 baht, so she was a fairly low-ranking girl. I think she was in her 30s. Her legs weren't particularly slim, but When I went to the room, she had a nice figure. Maybe it was because she had her hair slicked back. She had a lovely smile that reminded me of Mai Asada, the older sister of figure skater Mao Asada. The service was completely average, and I didn't see any strange acting. To be honest, the host probably didn't see me as a loyal customer. I didn't feel like he was paying me any attention. He didn't even look me in the eye when I was leaving. Is this the global standard? Is Japan just an anomaly? I'd like to return and try other places. That's my impression.
0x30e29ef1a03bcda7_0xc3e59407e7582280.author: ヒポポタマス1124

0x30e29ef1a03bcda7_0xc3e59407e7582280.text: The overall environment is old but clean. The busiest time is from 5 PM to 7 PM. The part-time workers and young models next to the bar are good-looking and have amazing figures. They provide attentive and patient service, starting at 500 RMB. A 90-minute experience is guaranteed to be satisfactory.
0x30e29ef1a03bcda7_0xc3e59407e7582280.author: 芭提雅外围Outcall Services

0x30e29ef1a03bcda7_0xc3e59407e7582280.text: It was after a thorough sifting that I've decided to come here. Tara is costly with girls starting that day from 7k but the girls were top notch I'd say. But at La Belle, the girls coded P are top notch too at a much lower price. I'd recommend them. I personally have taken D and she rode me like a goddess. The bath and the massage were okay. Overall, I'd recommend it. The Old man over there is good to talk to and he recommends based on your requirements and he's true to his words. Thanks. I personally regret that I've not taken the P coded girl, but that's fine. Look out for P, they're just stunning for the price. They're pretty with good figure. 🤌
0x30e29ef1a03bcda7_0xc3e59407e7582280.author: Hardhi Kinki

0x30e29ef1a03bcda7_0xc3e59407e7582280.text: Came here because we had an Air BnB across the road and was very disappointed. Prices start at 4k but that's for the bottom tier girls. Prices go up to 8k for the 'prettier ones.' My girl was very un-enthused, appalling so. We went to the room and she poured the 'spa' which was essentially a giant bath. Supposedly you're supposed to get a foam rub down but she did it reluctantly. Just for context, I'm a 26yo fit Aussie guy. No fat old man here. Then there was the sex; was like making love to a cardboard box. then after, you supposed to get a massage. she sat on the side of the bed and with one hand moved it along my back. With the other hand she used her phone. It was not a massage at all. One of my mates left happy, but another had the same experience as me. I went to Nana Plaza and had a much better time there.
0x30e29ef1a03bcda7_0xc3e59407e7582280.author: George Bowell

0x30e29b21fd604257_0xbcf90c35ebde81e5.text: จองผ่านแอปgowabi ขุดหินปูน+ขัดฟัน ไม่ได้เจ็บอย่างที่คิด แค่เสียวฟันเล็กน้อย คุณหมอมือเบา ให้คำแนะนำดีค่ะ ทำประมาณ20นาที สถานที่สะอาดดี มีที่จอดรถด้านหน้าคลินิกค่ะ เสียค่าปลอดเชื้อเพิ่มอีก60บาท ไว้จะมาตรวจสุขภาพฟันใหม่นะคะ
0x30e29b21fd604257_0xbcf90c35ebde81e5.author: m.
0x30e29b21fd604257_0xbcf90c35ebde81e5.en: Booked through the Gowabi app for tartar removal and polishing. It wasn't as painful as I expected, just slight sensitivity. The dentist was gentle and gave good advice. The procedure took about 20 minutes. The place was clean and there's parking in front of the clinic. There's an additional 60 baht charge for sterilization. I'll be back for a follow-up dental checkup.

0x30e29b21fd604257_0xbcf90c35ebde81e5.text: พาเด็กๆ มาทำฟันที่นี่ คุณหมอใจดี พูดเพราะ ให้คำแนะนำและอธิบายในเรื่องของการดูแลช่องปากดีมากค่ะ การเดินทางสะดวกมีที่จอดรถหน้าคลินิก แถมมีของเล่นให้เด็กๆเล่นรอก่อนการรักษา ทำให้คลายความกังวลของเด็กๆได้มากทีเดียวค่ะ
0x30e29b21fd604257_0xbcf90c35ebde81e5.author: Chantima Uea Areesinsuk
0x30e29b21fd604257_0xbcf90c35ebde81e5.en: I brought the kids here for dental treatment. The dentist is kind, speaks nicely, and gave excellent advice and explanations about oral care. It's conveniently located with parking in front of the clinic. Plus, they have toys for the kids to play with while waiting for treatment, which greatly helped to ease their anxiety.

0x30e29b21fd604257_0xbcf90c35ebde81e5.text: I have been coming here with my family for a long time. We often come for teeth cleaning. The doctor and staff are always kind and provide great service. The treatment is also painless.
0x30e29b21fd604257_0xbcf90c35ebde81e5.author: 平山宗一郎

0x30e29b21fd604257_0xbcf90c35ebde81e5.text: เจ้าหน้าที่และคุณหมอดูแลดีมากๆค่ะ ทำให้การมาหาหมอฟันเป็นเรื่องที่ไม่น่ากลัวอีกต่อไป ตอนนี้กำลังจัดฟันที่นี่อยู่ค่ะ เพื่อนๆพี่ๆน้องๆและคนรอบตัวก็มาดูแลช่องปากที่นี่กันเยอะเลยค่ะ
0x30e29b21fd604257_0xbcf90c35ebde81e5.en: The staff and doctors are very caring, making going to the dentist no longer scary. I'm currently getting orthodontic treatment here. Many of my friends, family, and people around me also come here for their oral care.

0x30e29b21fd604257_0xbcf90c35ebde81e5.text: คลินิกสะอาดมากค่ะบริการดีด้วย มาทำแล้ววประทับใช้มากค่ะ มาจัดฟันที่นี้คุณหมอก็น่ารักตลอด มือเบามากๆค่ะๆ พี่พนักงานบริการดีทุกคนเลยค่ะ
0x30e29b21fd604257_0xbcf90c35ebde81e5.author: Lunalixi Lixi
0x30e29b21fd604257_0xbcf90c35ebde81e5.en: The clinic is very clean and the service is excellent. I was very impressed with my experience here. The orthodontic treatment I received here was excellent, and the dentist was lovely and very gentle. All the staff were also very helpful.

0x30e29b21fd604257_0xbcf90c35ebde81e5.text: คุณหมอและเจ้าหน้าที่ดูแลดีมากค่ะ คลินิกสะอาด มีของเล่นให้เด็ก ๆ ระหว่างรอด้วย ตอนนี้รีเทนเนอร์กับAir flow มีราคาโปรโมชั่นด้วยค่ะ
0x30e29b21fd604257_0xbcf90c35ebde81e5.en: The doctor and staff were very attentive. The clinic was clean and they had toys for the children while they waited. They're currently having a promotion on retainers and air flow devices.

0x30e29b21fd604257_0xbcf90c35ebde81e5.text: ใครกำลังมองหาคลินิกทำฟันสำหรับเด็กๆ มีคุณหมอเด็กทำดีมาก มีโซนเด็กให้เล่นของเล่น สะอาดกว้างขวางที่จอดรถมีให้ แนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะ

0x311d619cd3a50ae1_0x2825ee7f5d6db04.en: Our whole family gets our dental work done here. We've been impressed since our first visit. The service is excellent, the quality is great, and we love how clean the clinic is. We don't understand much about teeth, so we had a lot of questions. The doctor (Dr. Boss) patiently explained everything to us. He was very attentive to detail and gave great advice. During the procedure, we felt the doctor was very gentle. We were very impressed with the results. Plus, we had a problem with tooth erosion, and after treatment here, our tooth sensitivity disappeared completely. We've brought our 3-year-old son with us several times. All the doctors explain things well and in an easy-to-understand way. Most recently, our son saw Dr. Praewa, who has experience in caring for children's teeth. She's kind, patient, and the children aren't afraid. Originally, our son had deep pits and grooves in his teeth, and he had fissure sealants treated by her. The treatment was very good and helped slow down the progression of cavities. There are many restaurants around the clinic, and it's easy to get there. Finding parking is always easy.

0x30e29da9afcd3e4b_0xa65dcbb44beb6cec.text: Started my Invisalign here and so far it’s been a good experience. The clinic is clean, parking’s easy, and the staff are really helpful with follow-ups. I saw lots of Invisalign boxes around, so feels like they’ve got plenty of cases and know what they’re doing. Price is fair with a clear timeline, and now I’m just excited to see the results in the next 10 months. ——— **[10-Month Update]** I am updating my review after completing my initial treatment plan to provide a more comprehensive reflection of my experience. When I signed up, I opted for the extra plan which was presented as including refinements if the initial results weren't fully satisfactory. (They do offer a 39k promotional plan, but it came with conditions and excludes refinements). After completing my first set of 20 aligners, some gaps still remain and further adjustments are needed. There’s an additional fee for rescanning and ordering the new refinement lot (anyway, the new set of refined aligners are already included in the plan). Including various miscellaneous costs along the way, there’s around 5k additional fees on top of the original plan—and this does not yet include the post-treatment retainers. Regarding the clinical care, I once met with the dentist during the initial consultation, scanning, and treatment planning phase. The explanation provided at the time was quite brief. For all subsequent visits—including the placement of attachments, progress monitoring, and the final check of the first 20 sets—the care was delivered entirely by dental assistants. In conclusion, this clinic delivers the service, but it is important for prospective patients to be aware that you may not see the doctor during your routine visits, and you should anticipate additional miscellaneous costs beyond the base package price. Btw, staffs are wonderful.
0x30e29da9afcd3e4b_0xa65dcbb44beb6cec.author: Alice Torpiyatham

0x30e29da9afcd3e4b_0xa65dcbb44beb6cec.text: After researching different types of orthodontic treatment for a while, I decided to have my son get Invisalign at Bliss Dental. The treatment cost was reasonable. After receiving an appointment to receive the braces, the staff taught us how to properly remove and insert the Invisalign aligners. He started wearing the aligners about 10 days ago, and the treatment program will take almost a year.

0x30da3bcc4fd0f04d_0x2ac623a448035ad8.text: Before I met Dr. Bee, my cat, Giant, had peeling paws and sores on his mouth. I took him to many vets, and they all said it was a fungal infection or an allergy to floor cleaner. But he didn't get better, and his condition worsened. He couldn't eat, vomited, and when his mouth hurt, he would drink very little water. He also had digestive problems. Then I met Dr. Bee, who is incredibly kind. She diagnosed Giant with a protein allergy and has been treating and caring for him ever since. Whenever we leave Giant with her, we feel so secure, like we're raising him ourselves (he's even happier with a vet than with us, haha). Dr. Bee seems to genuinely love Giant. Normally, Giant is very timid and dislikes vets, but since being with Dr. Bee, he's not afraid at all. Regarding baths, Giant's fur always gets wet no matter where we bathed him. Then we met Dr. Bee, who recommended a special shampoo. She's the only vet who can dry Giant's fur so quickly that we don't need to come back to blow-dry him anymore. For us, it's well worth the price.💓💓 Sometimes they even have promotions and discounts, and they also do photo shoots for various festivals. As for boarding at a pet hotel, Dr. Bee and her assistant take such good care of Giant that he's become quite fond of it. Every time we leave him at the hotel, Giant never wants to go home!
