0x87d111d9e021bed3_0x1544a8b5d0203f09.text: Booking a Brazilian laser hair removal treatment here was amazing! I was so impressed with my first visit. I've had underarm laser hair removal elsewhere before, using diode lasers as well, but here it wasn't painful, hot, or irritating at all. I'm so glad I chose to come here. I'm thinking of trying another course after this one. I highly recommend it! The service is excellent, I'm extremely impressed! 10/10! 💕🫶🏻
0x87d111d9e021bed3_0x1544a8b5d0203f09.author: Kornwalai Kamlert

0x87d111d9e021bed3_0x1544a8b5d0203f09.text: I had Ultraformer done two years ago, and it was better than my last time. It seems like the clinic had a promotion that made it look like a good deal, but in reality, you get significantly fewer shots. The doctor emphasized the correct frequency very little. I was a little disappointed, but I really liked my first session here.
0x87d111d9e021bed3_0x1544a8b5d0203f09.author: Kanda

0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.text: ตามหาคลินิกที่ใช้สิทธิบัตรทองได้ มาเจอที่นี่ จากการสุ่มโทรถาม พนักงานน่ารักมากๆ ตอบคำถามดีสุดๆ คอยโทรแจ้งนัดล่วงหน้าตลอด หรือถ้ามีคิวว่างล่วงหน้าก็จะโทรมาแจ้งถามความสมัครใจตลอด อัธยาศัยดี คำถามไหนตอบไม่ได้จะไปถามคุณหมอมาตอบให้เรา ส่วนคุณหมอน่ารักทั้งผู้หญิงและผู้ชายเลย คุณหมอมือเบากันมากๆ พูดจาดีด้วย ตัดสินใจถูกมากๆที่ใช้บริการที่นี่ (ล่าสุด 6/1/2026การรับคิวไม่แม่นยำ มีการโทรมา แต่พอเราไม่ได้รับก็หาคิวแทรกทันที ไม่รอให้เราได้โทรกลับเลยพอโทรกลับไม่มีคนรับเราเลยเลือกทักไลน์ ก็มีการแจ้งคิวให้ว่าเรามีนัดกี่โมง พอมาถึงบอกว่าอีกคนไม่ลงคิวยืนยันเรา บอกเราไม่ยอมรับสาย แต่คือมีการแจ้งคิวทางไลน์ให้เรานะ ก็เลยงงๆว่าความผิดเราสินะ เขาแจ้งว่าปกติไม่ให้คิวแล้ว เพราะถือว่าเราไม่ยืนยัน แต่ในไลน์ที่ทักไปถามเรื่องเวลานัด ไม่ได้แจ้งว่ายกเลิกเรานะ มาแจ้งตอนหน้าเค้าเตอร์ เขาบอกรอบนี้ให้เข้าพบหมอได้ เรื่องคิวลงเวลาผิดเจอมาหลายรอบแล้ว, มีทำนัด2คน แต่ลงคิวให้1คน ,เรานัดวันที่เราลาหยุดไว้ แต่ดันลงให้ก่อน , อยากให้ละเอียดกว่านี้นิดนึงค่ะ ส่วนเรื่องอื่นๆดีหมดค่ะ ยังมาใช้บริการเรื่อยๆค่ะ แอบอยากให้การรับคิวไม่ถี่ เพราะบางทีคุณหมอใช้เวลาต่อคนไข้1คนนานพอสมควร ที่นั่งไม่ได้มีมากพอให้คนไข้ที่มารอคิวเยอะขนาดนั้นด้วยค่ะ)
0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.author: Jump pornlapat P.
0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.en: I was looking for a clinic that accepts the government's universal healthcare scheme and found this one after randomly calling around. The staff were incredibly lovely and answered all my questions perfectly. They always called to schedule appointments in advance, or if there were any available slots, they would call to ask for my consent. They were very friendly and helpful. If they couldn't answer a question, they would ask the doctor and get the answer for me. The doctors, both male and female, were wonderful. They were very gentle and spoke kindly. I made the right decision to use their services. (Latest update 6/1/2026: The scheduling process was inaccurate. They called, but when I didn't answer, they immediately added a slot without waiting for me to call back. When I called back, no one answered, so I contacted them via LINE. They confirmed my appointment time. When I arrived, they said the other person hadn't confirmed my appointment and that I didn't answer the phone, but they had confirmed my appointment via LINE. I was confused, wondering if it was my fault. They said they normally wouldn't give me a slot if I hadn't confirmed, but the LINE message confirming my appointment time didn't mention my cancellation. They only informed me at the counter that I could see the doctor this time. They said they've encountered this issue of incorrect appointment times several times before. There were appointments for two people, but only one person was scheduled. I had an appointment scheduled on a day I was off work.) But you posted it prematurely. I wish the details were a little more detailed. Everything else was great. I'll continue to use your services. (I secretly wish the queuing system wasn't so frequent, because sometimes the doctor spends quite a long time with one patient, and there aren't enough seats for all the patients waiting in line.)

0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.text: ขอบคุณคุณหมอของ Goody Dental พัทยา มากๆคะ 🙂✨ ครั้งแรกที่ไปทำฟันโดยใช้สิทธิ 30 บาท ที่ Goody Dental ได้ทำฟันกับคุณหมอผู้หญิง คุณหมอเก่งมาก ประทับใจมาก พูดเพราะ ใส่ใจคนไข้ ช่วยคิดแนะนำในการแก้ไขปัญหาในช่องปากที่คนไข้ต้องการอย่างจริงใจ หลังจากทำเสร็จ สำรวจฟันตนเองที่ทำกับคุณหมอ คืองานดีมากๆ เช่นอุดคอฟัน งานที่คุณหมอทำให้เนียนเนี๊ยบ✨มากๆ เมื่อเทียบกับหมอคลีนิคอื่นๆที่เคยทำผ่านมา และแล้วก้ต้องกลับมาทำที่คลีนิคนี้ Goody Dental เช่นเดิม เพราะ ประทับใจฝีมือคุณหมอ และคุณหมอน่ารัก นิสัยดี พูดเพราะ อยากชมคุณหมออีกเยอะเลย เพราะนี่คือเรื่องจริงคะ 🙂👏👏👏
0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.author: Daisuke Arowana
0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.en: Thank you so much to the dentists at Goody Dental Pattaya! 🙂✨ This was my first time getting dental treatment using my 30 baht health insurance at Goody Dental. I had my teeth treated by a female dentist who was incredibly skilled and impressive. She was very kind, attentive to patients, and genuinely helped and advised on solutions to my oral health problems. After the treatment, I examined my teeth and the work done by her was excellent. For example, the fillings were incredibly neat and precise ✨ compared to other clinics I've been to before. I will definitely be returning to Goody Dental because I am so impressed with her skills, and she is so lovely, kind, and speaks so nicely. I want to praise her even more because this is the real story! 🙂👏👏👏

0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.text: Came here with toothache from root canal 25 years ago. Had previously been to another local place but they couldn't see me for 24 hours. Came here and was very happy with the service, the bubbly attitude of all the staff. They were all very professional and efficient. Just had a 2nd molar tooth removed, cost was about 1100 baht to put me out of intense pain. Great job.
0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.author: Ben Williams

0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.text: เห็นคลินิคทำฟันเปิดใหม่แถวหนองปรือ พัทยา อยู่ริมถนนมีที่จอดรถยนต์เลยแวะเข้ามาใช้บริการขูดหินปูน คุณหมอมือเบา แทบไม่เสียวฟันเลย ตอนขูดเสร็จแทบไม่รู้ตัว ขูดหินปูนสะอาดมากกกก แถมหมอแจ้งโปรโมชันเปิดคลินิคใหม่ เคลือบฟลูออไรด์ มูลค่า 500 บาทฟรีด้วย ส่วนด้านนอกคลินิคกว้างขวาง แอร์เย็น คนนั่งรอก็รอสบาย ไว้โอกาสหน้าจะมาใช้บริการอีกครับ
0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.author: Apirak Nantaseree
0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.en: I saw a newly opened dental clinic near Nong Prue, Pattaya, located on the main road with parking, so I stopped by for a teeth cleaning. The dentist was very gentle; I barely felt any sensitivity during the procedure. The cleaning was incredibly clean! The dentist also mentioned a new clinic opening promotion: a free fluoride treatment worth 500 baht. The clinic itself is spacious and air-conditioned, making it comfortable for those waiting. I'll definitely be back for more services in the future.

0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.text: ใช้สิทธิ์บัตรทองฟรีปีละสองครั้ง ดีกว่าบัตรประกันสังคมอีก ไม่เสียค่าอะไรเพิ่ม หมอ ทำโคตรนานโคตรสะอาด ไม่ทำลวกๆ บริการดีไม่ได้ขายอะไรเพิ่มให้คำปรึกษาดีพูดดีเย็นตรงต่อเวลาเคยไปที่อื่นรอแม่งเป็นชั่วโมงแถมทำแป๊บเดียวหินปูนยังไม่ทันออกหมดชอบค่ะตอนแรกคิดว่าจะหลอกซะละ 555
0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.author: euamporn sawangsab
0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.en: I use my universal healthcare card for free twice a year, which is better than social security. There are no extra charges. The doctor takes their time but is incredibly clean; they don't do a sloppy job. The service is excellent; they don't try to sell you anything extra, give good advice, speak kindly, and are punctual. I've been to other places where I waited for hours and the work was done so quickly that the tartar wasn't even completely removed. I like this place; at first, I thought they were going to scam me! 555

0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.text: มาทำฟันใช้สิทธิ์บัตรทองที่นี้พนักงานพูดจาดี ติดตามโทรหาแจ้งลูกค้าดีมากไม่มีการขายครอสขายของเหมือนร้านอื่นๆหมอพูดจาดีมากให้คำปรึกษาแนะนำไม่เซ้าซี้ลูกค้าและถอนฟันไวมากและทำดีค่ะมาทำพร้อมเพื่อน เพื่อนก็ชมว่าคุณหมอมือเบามากค่ะ
0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.author: Nampet Lapatum
0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.en: I came to this dental clinic using my universal healthcare card. The staff were very polite and followed up by phone, keeping me informed of my condition. They didn't try to push sales or packages like other clinics. The dentist was also very kind, giving advice and recommendations without being pushy. The extraction was very quick and the work was done well. I came with a friend, and she also commented on how gentle the dentist was.

0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.text: My dentures came out, so I went looking for a nearby dentist. They explained everything to me carefully and glued them back in place. I'll definitely come back and see them again if I have any dental problems.
0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.author: K. Imai

0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.text: The doctor has a gentle hand, the assistants provide good service, and the staff at the counter are lovely. Everyone gives good advice and calls to remind me of every appointment.
0x310295aafa1426e3_0xdabd190c8fbb6d79.author: Benchawan Buadang

0x311d65d582390d53_0xab4bce264d80931c.text: อุดฟันมากับหมอผู้หญิง บริการดีมาก ทั้งคุณหมอและผู้ช่วย พูดจาสุภาพอ่อนหวาน ให้คำแนะนำดี ไม่เร่งให้ตัดสินใจคอยจนกว่าเราจะมั่นใจ ราคามาตราฐานปกติทั่วไป มีที่จอดรถ สถานที่สวยงาน เครื่องมือดูดีครับ 30/4/2023กลับไปถอดไฟพร้อมอุดฟัน กับหมอผู้ชาย ทำดีมากพอใจส่วนเรื่องอื่นดีเหมือนเดิม ยังมีคิวไป ทำต่ออีกแล้วจะพาลูกไปทำด้วย ถ้าใครอยู่แถวนี้แนะนำร้านนี้เลยครับ
0x311d65d582390d53_0xab4bce264d80931c.en: I had a filling done by a female dentist. The service was excellent, both the dentist and the assistant were polite and gentle, giving good advice and not rushing me into a decision, waiting until I was confident. The price was standard. There is parking available, the place is beautiful, and the equipment looks good. On April 30, 2023, I went back to have my lights removed and another filling done by a male dentist. He did a great job, I was very satisfied. Everything else was good as before. I have an appointment again and will be bringing my child along. If anyone is in the area, I highly recommend this clinic.

0x311d65d582390d53_0xab4bce264d80931c.text: ขอให้คะแนน 10000/10 กับฝีมือทพ.วงศธร (คุณหมอเดียร์) ค่ะ วันนี้ไปรักษารากฟันมา คุณหมอมือเบามากๆๆๆๆๆๆ ไม่เจ็บ และมืออาชีพมาก ทำเร็ว เก่งมาก เทพมาก สมคำรีวิวค่ะ ขอแนะนำเลยค่ะ จนท.ผู้ช่วยทุกท่านให้บริการดีมากๆ อบอุ่น เป็นกันเอง แนะนำดีมาก ชี้แจงราคาชัดเจนมาก คลินิกก็สะอาด ประทับใจมากๆ แนะนำเลยค่ะ ขอบคุณมากนะคะ เป็นคลินิกที่เอาใจไปเลย
0x311d65d582390d53_0xab4bce264d80931c.en: I'd give Dr. Wongsthorn (Dr. Dear) a 10000/10 rating for his skill. I had root canal treatment today, and he was incredibly gentle – it was painless. He was extremely professional, fast, and incredibly skilled – truly amazing, just as the reviews said. I highly recommend him! All the assistants were also incredibly helpful, warm, friendly, and provided excellent advice. The pricing was very clear. The clinic was also spotless. I was extremely impressed. Thank you so much! This clinic has won my heart!

0x311d65d582390d53_0xab4bce264d80931c.text: รอบแรก- ไปขูดหินปูนที่สะสมมาเนินนาน คุณหมอ ขูดได้เกลี้ยง โล่ง เหมือนได้เกิดใหม่ กลิ่นปากหายเลย คะ รอบสอง-ไปเการากฟัน แอบตกใจเล็กน้อย คุณหมอดูแข็งแรง มือจะหนักมั้ยน้า พอไก็เริ่มทำ คุณหมอมือเบามาก ตอนนี้ ฟันหายโยกและหายปวดแล้ว มันสุดยอด มาก ขอบคุณค่ะมากๆคะ
0x311d65d582390d53_0xab4bce264d80931c.en: First visit - I went to get tartar removed, which had accumulated for a long time. The dentist cleaned it all up thoroughly. It felt so good, like I was reborn. My bad breath is gone too! Second visit - I went for root canal treatment. I was a little surprised; the dentist looked strong and I wondered if he would have a heavy hand. But once he started, he was very gentle. Now my tooth is no longer loose and the pain is gone. It's amazing! Thank you so much!

0x311d65d582390d53_0xab4bce264d80931c.text: คลินิกสะอาด มีที่จอดรถ ราคาถูกมาก ทำที่อื่นขูดหินปูนราคาสูง แต่ที่นี่ราคามิตรภาพค่ะ เบิกประกันสังคมได้ด้วย หมอใจเย็น เราถามเยอะ หมออธิบายดีค่ะ แนะนำค่ะ ร้านเพิ่งเปิด สะอาดมาก
0x311d65d582390d53_0xab4bce264d80931c.en: The clinic is clean, has parking, and the prices are very affordable. Other places charge a lot for teeth cleaning, but here the price is very reasonable. They also accept social security insurance. The doctor is patient; I asked a lot of questions, and the doctor explained everything well. I highly recommend it. The clinic just opened and is very clean.

0x311d65d582390d53_0xab4bce264d80931c.text: คลินิกสวยสะอาด คุณหมอน่ารัก เจ้าหน้าที่ให้บริการดี ราคาไม่แพง ที่จอดรถเยอะ พาลูกไปตรวจสุขภาพฟันประจำปีและเคลือบฟลูออไรด์ป้องกันฟันผุ คุณหมอมีของเล่นแถมให้เด็กๆด้วย 🥰
0x311d65d582390d53_0xab4bce264d80931c.en: The clinic is beautiful and clean, the doctor is lovely, the staff provides good service, the prices are affordable, and there's plenty of parking. I took my child for their annual dental check-up and fluoride treatment to prevent cavities. The doctor even gave the children a free toy! 🥰

0x311d65d582390d53_0xab4bce264d80931c.text: คุณหมอ เข้าใจคนไข้ดีมาก เป็นคนกลัวหมอฟันมาก หมอพูดคุย ให้กำลังใจ ลดภาวะเครียดตลอด มือเบาสมคำร่ำลือ ไม่ต้องลังเลเลยครับ คลินิกทันตกรรมนี้ คุณค่าที่คุณคู่ควร
0x311d65d582390d53_0xab4bce264d80931c.en: The doctor is very understanding of patients. I'm very afraid of dentists, but the doctor talked to me, encouraged me, and reduced my stress throughout the procedure. The doctor's touch is as gentle as rumored. Don't hesitate, this dental clinic is worth it.

0x311d65d582390d53_0xab4bce264d80931c.text: ทำดีมากกกกค่ะ ขูดหินปูนไม่เจ็บเลย ออกหมดเกรี้ยง ไม่มีเลือดซิบด้วย คุณหมอและพี่พนักงานให้คำปรึกษาและบริการดีมากๆ ราคาไม่แพง แนะนำเลยค่ะ
0x311d65d582390d53_0xab4bce264d80931c.author: Prapapan Asawalertleela
0x311d65d582390d53_0xab4bce264d80931c.en: Excellent service! The tartar removal was painless, everything was removed completely, and there was no bleeding. The doctor and staff provided great advice and service. The price was also very reasonable. Highly recommend!

0x311d65d582390d53_0xab4bce264d80931c.text: มาทำฟันกับคุณหมอประจำ คุณหมอย้ายมาจากคลินิกข้างๆ ให้คำแนะนำดีเหมือนเดิม ถอนฟันมือเบามากๆ คลินิกสะอาด ราคาถูก👍🏻
0x311d65d582390d53_0xab4bce264d80931c.en: I came to see my regular dentist. He moved from the clinic next door and gives just as good advice. He's very gentle when extracting teeth. The clinic is clean and the prices are affordable 👍🏻

0x30e2996417a364b9_0xa06e620ed1dc7926.text: The clinic is clean, has modern equipment, and offers comprehensive treatments. The care and attention from the doctors are especially excellent; they are easy to understand, provide appropriate advice, and all the staff are lovely. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone with bone and joint problems.
0x30e2996417a364b9_0xa06e620ed1dc7926.author: Parinya Phasukkul

0x30e2996417a364b9_0xa06e620ed1dc7926.text: I came to get my hepatitis B immunity checked. The service was quick, and all the nurses were lovely. I'm terrified of needles, so they even offered me smelling salts 😅 Thank you so much! I highly recommend this place. The price is also very reasonable 👍 …

0x30e2a3e25149dec5_0xef5572fb697bf88a.en: Based on the reviews, the staff are quite rude, and their responses to comments are extreme. From my own experience and that of my sibling, our teeth became crooked and we had to seek treatment elsewhere. To make matters worse, at another clinic, the dentist said they had pulled out a baby tooth (the permanent one) – I was shocked! Was this even a real dentist? Not only were our teeth crooked, but the dentist said it would be done once the pulling was finished. Then we switched to a new dentist, and it was a huge headache. It was difficult to fix, costing us more than before, and it took forever to complete the treatment. As for the staff, it's exactly as others have commented. We went there when they first opened, and the staff were lovely. It's only after a new staff member came in that the situation changed that it's no surprise they're getting so many negative reviews. The staff should accept reality. Does the owner even see these terrible reviews? Think carefully before you decide to go here. Your teeth might look better before treatment, but read the reviews before spending your money. P.S. Staff, feel free to comment whatever you want, because your attitude won't change.

0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.text: ⭐Tourism Hemodialysis Experience at Krabi Nakharin Hospital⭐ My father is a CKD patient who requires routine hemodialysis. Here's the breakdown of our experience for those who are looking: - I contacted several hospitals in Thailand's beach destinations >3 months in advance to decide on the potential place for our holiday. This hospital was the first to reply (all their responses were very prompt, typically <30 minutes). - They have a fully functioning Dialysis Suite that divided their sessions into 3 appointment slots: 6AM, 10AM, and 2PM. We managed to book a 2PM session on a Saturday. - Try to book as early as you can. Booking is FOC, but you will need to send a follow up email with the medical documents / blood test reports for their team's reference. They will reply with a confirmatory email upon receiving all your documents. - Our impression during the visit: facility feels newly renovated with a clean and comfortable environment. Spacious but not too big. Not much difficulty to navigate self around. - We first had to register at the Reception Counter near the Emergency Department. Standard procedure for registration was done (make sure to bring your passport!). Once registration was complete, a staff member accompanied us to the Dialysis Suite. - At the Dialysis Suite, standard procedure was carried out by the Nursing team to check vital signs, weight, general assessment. All the nurses were very professional and experienced. My father was hooked to the HD machine by 2:15PM and finished by 6:20PM. He was regularly assessed in 30 minute intervals and was very comfortable throughout. - Last but not least: PRICING! Charges were very reasonable and, most importantly, did not break the bank. We were already informed of the exact price upfront during booking and no hidden costs were charged during payment. Please be noted there is a 4% credit card fee if using any type of card payment, which we were informed too. If you would like to avoid this, then carry cash with you. Just some other points to add for reference: - Please do not pack your schedule too tightly if planning for an appointment on the same day. We booked the 2:00PM slot but started the dialysis session slightly later at 2:15PM. As this is a hospital, we understand that appointment times are tentative and can vary depending on the situation. - Meals aren't provided during treatment (which is a common practice at our regular HD Centre). I'm not sure if it's because ours was the 2PM slot (after lunchtime). Please eat before you arrive and bring some light snacks with you, where necessary. - There isn't much commercial shops around. There's a 7Eleven at a walkable distance, but apart from that there's not much else. Be prepared to hang out at the hospital if you're waiting it out. There's plenty of sofas at the lobby if you'd like to lounge. - For Muslims, there's a musolla / prayer room at the Ground Floor to pray. Halal food joints aren't many around the area and are either mostly closed during daytime or only accepts cash. The locals at the shops aren't fluent in English either (as I think the area is less commercial compared to other parts of Krabi). Bring cash if you'd like to try and eat nearby, or just take a Grab to eat someplace else. - For non-Muslims, there's plenty of food joints around the area that are at a walkable distance. We didn't try visiting them, but I would also suggest to carry cash if you want to eat nearby. All in all, we've had a very good experience here and are happy that we found a reliable facility for my father to get his routine dialysis during our holiday. Thank you to the wonderful Nursing and Reception team who were very kind and professional throughout! If we were to visit Krabi again, we'd definitely utilise the services again when needed 😊
0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.author: Farah Yunos

0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.text: I just want to say that you never plan an accident and you never plan where you're going to be getting the care to work yourself back to being healthy again. I can say beyond a doubt that this Hospital and staff along with the nurses the support staff were fantastic. I was so lucky and blessed to have been able to recover from a serious accident with a motorcycle running me down on the street that the ambulance took me to this place for recovery. The doctors nurses and staff did a fantastic job and it was reconfirmed by the orthopedic surgeon here in Canada. My physiotherapist could speak good English and was able to help me with some of the issues around the language barrier. She became a friend. One thing I learned is the Thai people in Thailand are some of the most beautiful people in the world. Thank you again for your care and compassion towards me even though there was a huge language barrier we figured it out. Thank you again and I can't wait to come back and say thank you and walking on my own 2 feet. Also thank you Lisa and your colleagues in the international hospitals office for all your help and getting all the right forms to my insurance companies. This was much appreciated. Your Canadian friend Dave
0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.author: Dave Fischl

0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.text: My wife and I were blown away by our experience at Krabi Nakharin. We suffered an ATV accident. Luckily the agency organising it had insurance and we were rushed to Krabi Nakharin. All we had to do was email them our passports and they sorted out everything for us. Treatment started immediately, they treated us with great care. X Rays were done. Nurses were available for our dressing. Since my wife had a fracture, they admitted us and gave us a very high quality room with a side bed so I could attend to her and sleep. The doctor had a surgery in the evening but made sure to drop in during the night to consult with us and was very helpful in articulating options. Every little detail was attended to and great care was provided. They even offered to drop us to the airport and had an accompanying attendant who spoke Thai and arranged for the wheelchair from the airline staff. We have lived in India and Singapore which have high health standards and this hospital took it to a different level. Outstanding, world class experience international experience! THANK YOU team Krabi Nakharin and the staff! I would highly recommend this hospital to international patients.
0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.author: Ramesh Gopalakrishna

0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.text: Our insurance company contacted this hospital on January 1st at 12:00 PM. Our child had a stomach infection. We arrived in very poor condition. We were admitted quickly, no lines, and immediately given an IV and medication for vomiting and diarrhea. The symptoms subsided immediately, but by evening our temperature had risen, and we decided to stay overnight. Over the course of 24 hours, we were given four 900ml IVs. We were placed in a large room with a regular bed for our child, a sofa bed for my husband and me, a separate kitchen with a sink, kettle, and microwave, and a large shower. We were also given everything necessary for hygiene. The nurses were very helpful; they inserted the catheter very carefully and secured everything so that our child slept peacefully and nothing was damaged. They came frequently to measure our temperature, blood pressure, and blood oxygen levels. We didn't stay the next day, even though we could have; we were given medications to take home and discharged. A huge thank you to the doctors, nurses, and insurance partners of T-Bank!
0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.author: Карина Лахтычкина

0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.text: I was "lucky" to end up at this medical facility on the morning of January 1st with a high fever, headache, back pain, and joint pain. The doctor was alone at the time, so I had to wait about an hour and a half. Seeing that I wasn't feeling well, they put me on the couch - I even took a short nap. They took some tests and within an hour at most, they diagnosed me with Dengue Virus. Dr. PIBUN explained all the treatment and options in detail - since I sought treatment in a timely manner, there was the option of being treated at a hotel, but he recommended staying in the hospital. I listened and have never regretted it. It was a difficult couple of nights. And it was impossible to get such treatment, monitoring, and care at a hotel. The level of care was extremely high in literally everything - from daily tests and monitoring to the room/room and food. I stayed there for almost 5 full days. I thank the entire staff for my speedy recovery 🙏 p.s. I am surprised by the hospital's low rating.
0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.author: Александр Соловьев

0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.text: Yesterday and today I was at this hospital, after a small wound had become infected earlier during my tour of Thailand. Yesterday I was helped in the friendliest way and felt very much at ease. A pleasant intake and also cleaning of the wound, including a new waterproof bandage. The price was slightly higher than the intake at the hospital in Kanchanaburi. But then again, this is a private hospital visit, so I find it somewhat understandable. I went home with a positive feeling and was given a note saying I could come back the next day between 6 and 8 pm. So I did that. When I arrived, I was ushered into the examination room quite quickly and was told that it would cost 5,000-6,000 baht! to clean the wound and put a new waterproof plaster on it. Knowing that the intake, cleaning, and bandaging cost 3,500 baht the day before, I was quite perplexed. At the hospital in Kanchanaburi, I paid about 680 baht. The reason given was that there was now a more expensive doctor. I would have liked to have heard that yesterday. Fortunately, I had the bill from the day before. The final price has been set the same as the day before, which is really still way, way too much for removing a plaster, cleaning it, and putting on a new one. In short, this hospital leaves a sour taste in my mouth.
0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.author: Bjorn Janssen

0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.text: The amenities in the guest rooms should be upgraded to look more international and worth the price. The sofa is torn, the mattress has a hard metal frame that causes back pain, the pillows are very thin and flat, and the blankets are very rough; they should be replaced with duvets like those in other private hospitals. Sachet coffee is not provided in a container but placed on the refrigerator wall instead. The doctors were all very attentive. I commend the nursing assistants; when a child had a fever, they immediately took him/her to bathe or wipe him down without being asked. They continuously monitored his/her temperature until it subsided. However, the professional nurses seemed unprofessional and not as attentive to the patients as they should have been. It took a long time to get the fever medication. The nursing assistant had already finished bathing and wiping the child down before we received the medication. We had to ask for it before they were enthusiastic enough to draw it from the bottle and give it to us. They just handed us the medication without saying a word, without explaining what kind of fever reducer it was, or how many hours apart to take it. They just handed out the medication haphazardly. To get details about the medication, we had to ask. Basic things like this should be explained to the parents. There are many different medications, and parents should know what they are receiving and any side effects so they can deal with the symptoms. Improvements are needed.
0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.author: Ww Mm

0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.text: We were admitted to a private hospital in a city for recovery after having an appendectomy at a public hospital. We handled all the arrangements ourselves. A private hospital vehicle picked us up from the public hospital. Everything was great; the staff and nurses were excellent. We were admitted for one night. Around noon on the 6th/7th, my husband went up to the sixth floor and overheard a doctor and nurse arguing about why we didn't have surgery with them and why we were recovering with them when they had their own doctors. At that moment, I wasn't angry. A little later, I asked my husband to get the necessary documents. A short while later, a nurse wearing glasses brought them with a tone and expression that wasn't very pleasant. This made me very uncomfortable, so I had my husband inform the nursing counter that we wanted to go home. Once everything was settled, we walked out of the room. We had just had surgery, but there was no wheelchair to take us out of the room. We walked down to the car ourselves. But as we passed the counter on the 6th floor, we encountered the same nurse with glasses who looked at us with an unpleasant expression and turned her face away as usual. I want to tell her, if you're not ready to provide good service, please resign. Don't tarnish the organization's reputation. The other nurses were very lovely and caring. We were just patients who wanted care. We weren't ready to confront anyone. Please consider your own conduct.
0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.author: ปิยะมาศ ช่วยเหลื้อม

0x311d7fcb104f7c0d_0xc919356ad4778ae8.text: โทรจองคิว ก่อนวันนัด 3 สัปดาห์ จนท รับเรื่อง พร้อมแจ้งว่าจะติดต่อแจ้งเตือนก่อน 1 วัน เราไปกัน 4 คน พ่อแม่ลูก พอไปถึง จนท ทำงง ไม่มีรายชื่อบ้านเราในคิว สรุปกลายเป็น walkin แทน นั่งรอตั้งแต่ 16:00-19:00 นานมากเพราะคิวที่พวกเราจะได้ต้องรอให้คนไข้ท่านอื่นที่อยู่ในคิวทำให้เสร็จก่อน คือสุดมากอะ ไหนๆก็มาละก็เลยรอ โชคดีที่น้องคนสุดท้ายให้คิวลูกเราก่อน น้องน่ารักมากยอมสละคิวให้ ซาบซึ้งมาก คุณหมอที่ทำให้เป็น ผช มือหนักมาก อ้าปากค้างตลอดการขูดหินปูน ไม่มีพักเบรคเลย กรามแทบค้าง 😅
0x311d7fcb104f7c0d_0xc919356ad4778ae8.en: We called to book an appointment 3 weeks beforehand. The staff took our request and said they would contact us a day before. We waited from 4 PM to 7 PM, which was incredibly long because we had to wait for other patients in line to finish first. It was unbelievable. Since we were already there, we decided to wait. Luckily, the last person in line let our child go first; they were so kind and gave up their turn. We were so grateful. The dentist who performed the teeth cleaning was a man with a very heavy hand. I kept my mouth open the entire time he was scaling; there was no break at all. My jaw almost locked up! 😅

0x30fdabad4a288cb7_0x9ad7f12f1e7b0877.text: Pongsak Clinic Review (Eyelid Surgery + HIFU & IPL) I originally went to Pongsak Clinic for a consultation about ptosis surgery on my right eyelid. First and foremost the customer service is world class. The staff are so warm, welcoming, and genuinely kind that you forget you’re even in a cosmetic clinic. My consultation went amazing. The doctor was very knowledgeable, took time to answer every question, listened to all my concerns, and gave his honest medical opinion. I instantly felt confident I was in good hands, so I went ahead and scheduled the surgery for the following week. Surgery day came, and even though I usually get nervous, the staff made me feel completely at ease. The doctor was meticulous with his work precise incision, gentle technique, and the results were beautiful. Two weeks later, my eyelid functions perfectly and looks completely natural. I’m so happy with how it turned out, and I know it’s only going to get better as it heals. Now, let’s talk about the beauty side of things make sure you pay attention to all the gorgeous women working there because they’re walking skincare goals .I immediately asked about sun damage and how to keep my skin looking youthful. Even though I’m in my I still want to feel confident and fresh …especially in Thailand’s heat, where I don’t always want to wear makeup. They gave me a personalized skincare regimen and suggested two treatments HIFU and IPL, which I got done right after my stitches were removed. It’s only been a few days, and I can already see my skin improving smoother, brighter, and tighter. You can go to any skin clinic and get basic treatments, but what sets Pongsak apart is their honesty and professionalism. They don’t try to upsell you on unnecessary services. Their bedside manner, transparency, and genuine care for their clients are what make them stand out. Overall 10/10 experience. Highly recommend this clinic to anyone considering cosmetic or skincare treatments in Hua Hin. 💕
0x30fdabad4a288cb7_0x9ad7f12f1e7b0877.author: Ju-li Suzuki

0x30e29fe05f2048ff_0x703b2c483bc2ee50.text: Amazing experience from start to the end!!! LiveWell is still a new establishment so they don’t have a website up yet hence why it’s difficult to self-book. I reached out via Instagram (@livewell.bangkok) and they were very responsive & patient with me. Definitely recommend booking a few days ahead because spots fill up quick given the long procedures and limited physiotherapists! Anna took such good care of us. I tried for 2 days to book and it didn’t work out but due to cancelled plans, we were lucky to fill open spots, even luckier to go during a time they have buy 1 get 1 Exion face AND new customerdeal for the advanced PT plus (includes posture analysis, ultrasound/shockwave/peripheral magnetic stimulation therapies, heat compress). If you’re from the states like me, I highly recommend you book a PT treatment as the advanced technology they use is usually inaccessible unless you have an actual health problem or you’re rich. My boyfriend and I did the exion face & advanced PT plus (60 min+ 60min). I cannot say enough about Anna. She worked from 11am-5pm nonstop (from me to someone to my bf) & despite obvious fatigue settling in, she kept up her physical strength & diligence whilst performing each procedure. She is the best! P.s. when I finished, they let me watch Netflix and order food until it was my boyfriend’s turn. It was so cozy & felt like a second home 🥹 Tip: the building is hard to find. see my photos for some help!

0x30da3bb7840afc33_0x6ffe0067f8135201.text: I was so impressed I had to write a review! First of all, I had severe ear blockage and couldn't hear anything. They used ear drops to soften the earwax three times because I kept complaining of pain. It's very hard and close to the eardrum, so ideally, ear drops should be used beforehand to soften the earwax for easier removal. However, the doctor didn't try to remove the hard part further. After removing all the earwax, they showed me the remaining earwax and examined my ear while explaining everything. The cost was very reasonable, as other reviews mentioned. And importantly, even though there were many patients, the doctor remained patient and didn't rush the treatment. 🥹💖

I often do not look forward to working with a therapist, as I have had so many. However, now I like too, and want to with Brett. Many therapists are too academic, some are too 12-step based and some have had no real-life experience with the subject matter at hand. Brett knows all sides, which for me keeps it objective, realistic, and balanced. Some therapists just ask open ended questions and are too agreeable. Brett is able to offer up different viewpoints, often to the point where I can learn, as opposed to someone who just agrees with me all the time is often just not helping me, in my experience. This becomes a waste of time and resources and I do not get better or begin to change/heal. He offers suggestions regarding short and long term strategies, whilst offering up specific tactics (actual means) on how to achieve those goals, too. I need the tactics, more so than just the strategy (just an objective/aim). Thanks Brett for your continued support, and I finally feel I am making some ground up on how to live life, live life clean and sober, with purpose and more HOPE. 0x30e29cfd0101df13_0xdfe1ddc8ff466622.text: เมื่อ 2-3 ปีก่อนตอนที่หมูอยากจัดฟัน หมูไปมาหลายที่ ทั้งร้านที่ขึ้นป้ายโฆษณาขนาดใหญ่ตามทางผ่านจนมาถึงร้านแถวคอนโดเพราะคิดว่าถ้าต้องมาบ่อยขอใกล้หน่อยดีกว่า หมูเริ่มตั้นแต่ร้านใหญ่ดูทันสมัย ร้านขนาดกลาง ขนาดเล็กหลานร้านซึ่งก็ได้ข้อมูลราคาไม่ต่างกันเท่าไหร่จนมาถึงร้านสุดท้ายที่เกือบจะไม่แวะเพราะเหนื่อยแล้ว ถือว่าเป็นร้านที่เล็กที่สุดและดูเก่า(ดูอยู่มานาน)สุด แวะเข้าไปแค่จะถามราคาแต่พนง.บอกว่าลองคุยกับคุณหมอดูมั้ยคะ คุณหมออยู่พอดี ปรึกษาฟรีค่ะ รู้สึกแปลกใจที่เค้าให้เจอคุณหมอและแอบลังเลเพราะยังไม่อยากตัดสินใจตอนนี้ คุณหมอพูดจาดี น่ารัก ราคาก็พอ ๆ กับร้านที่ผ่านมา มาแพ้ทางเอาตอนที่คุณหมอพูดว่า "คุณหมูเป็นคนสวยนะคะ ถ้าได้จัดฟันจะสวยกว่านี้ค่ะ" เจอประโยคนี้เข้าไปหมูตัดสินใจจ่ายมัดจำทำกับที่นี่ทันที 555 ซึ่งคุณหมอก็ไม่ทำให้ผิดหวัง คลีนิคเล็ก ๆ แต่อบอุ่น หมอที่นี่ใจเย็นพูดจาดีกับหมูทุกคนแม้บางครั้งหมูอาจจะเกเรไม่ยอมดูแลฟันตัวเองไปบ้าง แต่ไม่มีคำพูดไหนทำร้ายน้ำใจหมูเลย นับว่าฝีมือดีแล้วยังมีจิตวิทยาคุยกับลูกค้าด้วย นอกจากนี้คลีนิคคุณหมอยังตกแต่งด้วยภาพสวยใส่กรอบแขวนตามผนัง ไปแต่ละครั้งต้นไม้ ดอกไม้มีการผลัดเปลี่ยนไม่ซ้ำทำให้รู้สึกสดชื่นเวลาเดินเข้ามาในคลีนิค แม้แต่ด้านนอกก็ยังจัดเป็นสวนกระถางเล็ก ๆ ข้างถนนอย่างบรรจงเท่าที่จะทำได้ เราเป็นชอบปลูกต้นไม้ดูรู้เลยว่าต้องใช้ความพยายามและใส่ใจขนาดไหนถึงได้ผลลัพธ์ออกมาแบบนี้ วันนี้มีน้องในคลีนิคมาให้เรารีวิวเราก็ทำให้ด้วยความเต็มใจ ประสบการณ์ทำงานในธุรกิจบริการระดับโรงแรมห้าดาวสัมผัสได้ถึง service mind จากคลีนิคเล็ด ๆ แห่งนี้ เป็นการทำธุรกิจที่ใส่ใจและได้ใจลูกค้าไปเต็ม ๆ ค่ะ 🌷❤️👍
0x30e29cfd0101df13_0xdfe1ddc8ff466622.author: กชพร ปรีดากิตวรกุล
0x30e29cfd0101df13_0xdfe1ddc8ff466622.en: About two or three years ago, when I wanted to get braces, I visited many places. From clinics with huge advertising signs along the way to those near my condo, I thought it would be better to be close if I had to come often. I started with a large, modern-looking clinic, then medium-sized ones, and several small ones. The prices weren't much different, until I almost didn't go to the last one – I was too tired. It was the smallest and looked the oldest (it seemed like it'd been around for a long time). I just went in to ask about the price, but the staff suggested I talk to the doctor; he was there and the consultation was free. I was surprised and hesitant because I didn't want to make a decision right away. The doctor was kind and lovely, and the price was comparable to the other clinics. I was won over when the doctor said, "You're a beautiful person, Ms. Moo. You'll be even more beautiful if you get braces." That's what made me decide to pay the deposit immediately! 555 And the doctor didn't disappoint. It's a small but warm clinic. The doctors here are patient and kind to everyone, even if I'm sometimes naughty and don't take care of my teeth regularly. None of their words hurt my feelings. Not only is the clinic highly skilled, but they also have a great understanding of customer psychology. In addition, the clinic is decorated with beautiful framed pictures on the walls. Each visit features a different set of plants and flowers, creating a refreshing atmosphere. Even the exterior boasts meticulously arranged small potted gardens along the roadside. As someone who enjoys gardening, I can see the effort and care that goes into achieving such results. Today, a staff member from the clinic asked me to review their clinic, and I gladly obliged. My experience working in the five-star hotel industry reflects the exceptional service mindset of this small clinic. This is a business run with genuine care and a true customer satisfaction! 🌷❤️👍

0x30e2979e79da0e43_0xd3757ff866f350aa.text: ตัดสินใจไม่ผิดที่จัดฟันกับคลินิคนี้ค่ะ คุณหมอน่ารักมากค่ะ เป็นกันเอง แก้ไขปัญหาฟันที่ซับซ้อนให้เข้าที่ มีรอยยิ้มที่สดใส น้องผู้ช่วยก็น่ารักทุกคนค่ะ พูดเพราะ ยิ้มหวานทุกคน

0x30e29d83a419e117_0x60157472a7ba0511.text: ประทับใจตั้งแต่เดินเข้าคลินิกเลยค่ะ สะอาดมาก ตกแต่งสวย บรรยากาศอบอุ่นจนแอบรู้สึกเหมือนนั่งอยู่คาเฟ่ 😄 พนักงานต้อนรับน่ารัก พูดจาดี และมีโทรมายืนยันนัดก่อนเข้ารับบริการด้วย วันนี้เราใช้สิทธิ์ประกันสังคมแบบจ่ายตรง ส่วนพี่ที่มาด้วยใช้สิทธิ์บัตร 30 บาท สะดวกมากค่ะ คุณหมอมือเบา คอยถามตลอดว่ามีอาการเสียวฟันไหม ทำให้ไม่รู้สึกกังวลเลย ฟอกสีฟันมาด้วย ราคาดีมาก ผลลัพธ์คือฟันขาวขึ้นจนสังเกตได้เลย คุ้มสุด ๆ 🩵 คลินิกทำฟันที่บริการดี ใช้สิทธิ์ประกันสังคมได้ แนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะ มีที่จอดรถบริเวณ 7-Eleven สะดวกมากค่ะ
0x30e29d83a419e117_0x60157472a7ba0511.en: I was impressed from the moment I walked into the clinic. It was very clean, beautifully decorated, and the atmosphere was so warm it felt like I was sitting in a cafe 😄 The reception staff were lovely and spoke kindly, and they even called to confirm my appointment beforehand. Today, I used my social security direct payment benefits, while my companion used her 30-baht card. It was very convenient. The dentist was gentle and constantly asked if I had any tooth sensitivity, which made me feel less worried. I also got teeth whitening done at a great price. The results were noticeably whiter! Definitely worth it 🩵 This dental clinic offers excellent service and accepts social security benefits. I highly recommend it! There's parking available near the 7-Eleven, which is very convenient.

0x30e29d83a419e117_0x60157472a7ba0511.text: I visited this clinic for both fillings and teeth cleaning, and I was very impressed. The dentist was very gentle; the procedure was painless, and I felt comfortable throughout. The staff were lovely, polite, and provided clear information. The clinic atmosphere was clean and welcoming. If you're looking for a good dental clinic, I highly recommend this one.

0x30e29f097c1d74d9_0x145e1ea9e98c450a.text: Overpriced & Not Transparent*** ราคาค่อนข้างสูงมากกกกกกกเมื่อเทียบกับหลายคลินิกที่สอบถามมา ถ้าเป็นเจ้าของสัตว์เลี้ยงมือใหม่หรือยังไม่ค่อยมีความรู้มาก แนะนำให้สอบถามรายละเอียดค่าใช้จ่ายและขั้นตอนการรักษาให้ชัดเจนก่อนเซนต์ประเมินและก่อนตัดสินใจรักษา ควรถามด้วยตัวเองว่าอะไรจำเป็น ไม่จำเป็น ตรงไหนตัดได้บ้าง เพราะที่นี่ไม่สามารถให้รายละเอียด options และการอธิบายแบบนั้น ในกรณีของเรา ไม่ได้รับคำอธิบายที่ละเอียดเกี่ยวกับค่า Lab 1,700 บาท ว่าเป็นการตรวจอะไร มีขั้นตอนอย่างไร และจำเป็นจริงๆไหม เทียบกับที่อื่นแล้วรายการตรวจเหมือนกัน ราคาต่างกันมากกกกๆ และมีการอธิบายแบบชัดเจน นอกจากนี้ ทางคลินิกไม่อนุญาตให้เข้าไปอยู่กับน้องระหว่างการตรวจ โดยให้เหตุผลว่าเกรงว่าน้องจะตื่นเต้นหรือตกใจ ซึ่งสำหรับเราไม่สบายใจมากๆ เหตุผลนี้ยังไม่ชัดเจน หากเป็นเรื่องของมาตรฐานความสะอาด ความปลอดภัย หรือข้อกำหนดของคลินิก ยังสามารถเข้าใจได้มากกว่า รู้สึกไม่ค่อยมั่นใจกับความโปร่งใสของการสื่อสาร ความน่าเชื่อถือ และรู้สึกว่าความคุ้มค่าของบริการไม่สอดคล้องกับราคาที่จ่าย และคงไม่กลับมาใช้บริการอีก เพราะเป็นประสบการณ์ที่แย่มาก ---------------------------------------------- Overpriced & Not Transparent*** The pricing here is significantly higher than several other clinics I contacted. If you're a first-time pet owner or don't have much experience, I highly recommend asking for a detailed breakdown of all costs and treatment steps before signing the estimate or agreeing to any treatment. Make sure to ask which procedures are necessary, which are optional, and whether any items can be excluded, as I did not receive that level of explanation or discussion of available options here. In my case, I was not given a clear explanation of the THB 1,700 laboratory fee—what specific test was being performed, how it would be conducted, or whether it was genuinely necessary. After comparing with several other clinics, I found that the same type of examination was offered at a much lower price, and the procedures and charges were explained far more clearly. In addition, I was not allowed to stay with my pet during the examination. The reason given was that my pet might become nervous or frightened. Personally, I felt very uncomfortable with this explanation, as it did not seem sufficiently clear. If the reason had been related to hygiene standards, safety protocols, or clinic policy, I would have understood much more easily. Overall, I was not confident in the transparency of the communication or the professionalism of the service. I also felt that the value of the care I received did not justify the price I paid. Based on this experience, I will not be returning to this clinic. It was a very disappointing experience.

0x30fdabf3f2dd9df9_0xedb50c81347a34c0.text: ★★★★★ 5/5 – Hands-down the best optician experience in Hua Hin (and probably anywhere!) I just got my new glasses from Monique Vision, and wow—what an outstanding experience from beginning to end. The service was genuinely phenomenal: professional, attentive, and warm all at once. The staff are super friendly and welcoming; they made me feel like a valued guest rather than just another customer. We ended up having such a beautiful, flowing conversation that the whole visit felt enjoyable and relaxed instead of rushed. Beyond the excellent eye care, they went way above and beyond. When the topic of lunch came up, they didn’t just give generic suggestions—they genuinely listened to the kind of food I like (spicy, authentic Thai with a bit of international flair) and recommended several fantastic local restaurants I would never have found on my own. Those tips turned out to be spot-on, and it was such a thoughtful, unexpected bonus that really made the visit memorable. And then there’s the craftsmanship: unreal. The frames suit my face perfectly, the lenses are impeccably fitted and crystal-clear, and you can see (and feel) the attention to every tiny detail. The quality is evident in how comfortable and precise everything is—no adjustments needed later, which is rare. If you’re reading this because you’re looking for new glasses (or even just a reliable optician), seriously—look no further. Come to Monique Vision. Whether you’re visiting Hua Hin or live nearby, the combination of top-tier optical work, friendly expertise, and that rare personal touch makes this place exceptional. Highly, highly recommended—you’ll leave happy with your glasses and probably a great new restaurant to try. 🙌
0x30fdabf3f2dd9df9_0xedb50c81347a34c0.author: Darkon London

0x30fdabf3f2dd9df9_0xedb50c81347a34c0.text: Today, I stopped by to try a new look at the optical shop. 🕶️✨ I was impressed from the moment I stepped in! All the staff were incredibly friendly and helpful. 🫶🏻 As soon as I walked in, I was greeted and offered recommendations for different frames to suit my style and face shape. No need to worry about choosing the wrong one, they were incredibly helpful. 🥰 They have a huge selection of glasses, from Korean fashion to minimalist and elegant to prescription options. 👓 The prices are reasonable, not too steep, and they always have great promotions. 💸✨ I chose a frame I'd never worn before, and it turned out even cuter than I expected. 😳❤️ The kind staff let me try on several styles until I found the perfect fit. The eye exam was thorough and professional, making me feel confident that my glasses would fit and be comfortable. ✅ If you're looking for a great eyeglasses shop with a warm atmosphere, reasonable prices, and friendly service, I highly recommend checking this place out! I guarantee you'll leave with a smile and a stunning new look. 🫶🏻💖
0x30fdabf3f2dd9df9_0xedb50c81347a34c0.author: Chorchat Chattong

0x30fdabf3f2dd9df9_0xedb50c81347a34c0.text: Not as expensive as I thought!! This was my first time getting glasses from an optometrist, and I saw a huge difference compared to getting them at a regular shop. Both the equipment and the method were excellent. I truly understand the importance of getting glasses correctly. The optometrist explained different lens types, their pros and cons, and prices, providing very helpful information to help me make a decision. 👓✨️ The staff and the assistant were also very attentive. The shop has a wide selection of frames, both high-end and budget-friendly. There was no pressure to buy anything; I was able to try on as many as I wanted, which was very comfortable. 😊 I paid on the same day. The price was acceptable and felt very worthwhile considering the service. I'm so excited to get my new glasses! If you're hesitant, I highly recommend it. I was very impressed! 💯🙏 📍 I recommend allocating extra time for the eye exam if it's your first time, as the optometrist is very thorough!!! It takes about 45 minutes to an hour.
0x30fdabf3f2dd9df9_0xedb50c81347a34c0.author: Jirapat D

0x30fdabf3f2dd9df9_0xedb50c81347a34c0.text: I visited this shop after reading the reviews, and I was not disappointed. The staff is extremely professional, patient, and friendly. They took the time to carefully check my prescription, which took almost an hour. Throughout the process, they remained patient and friendly. I've been to many optometrists in my life, but this was the best experience I've had. I felt very comfortable, like there was no rush and I was the only customer in the world, which I really appreciated. They also offer a wide range of frames and lenses at reasonable prices. I highly recommend this shop to anyone looking for new glasses or lenses. I've been to several places in town, and this one is by far the best. Personally, I won't go anywhere else from now on—only this shop.
0x30fdabf3f2dd9df9_0xedb50c81347a34c0.author: Shai Cohen

0x30fdabf3f2dd9df9_0xedb50c81347a34c0.text: My first ever serious review of getting prescription glasses! I was very impressed with everything: the service, the location, the consultations. They did a very thorough eye exam, without any pressure or pushy sales tactics. It was a very comfortable experience. Personally, I just found out I have presbyopia (farsightedness). Before, I just felt like my eyesight wasn't normal, but I didn't realize the real problem. But here, they did a very detailed exam and asked about my vision problems, resulting in comfortable glasses that perfectly correct my vision issues. The vision is sharp and beautiful! Thank you for the service and attention to detail. 🙏🥰
0x30fdabf3f2dd9df9_0xedb50c81347a34c0.author: o-pol sudamanee

0x30fdabf3f2dd9df9_0xedb50c81347a34c0.text: I happened to be traveling in Hua Hin when my glasses broke. Luckily, there was an optician's shop near my accommodation. The staff there were very helpful and informed me that the lenses were heavily scratched from being dropped. So, I took the opportunity to get new lenses. The optometrist at the shop did a great job with my eyesight, speaking very patiently. They even adjusted my glasses for me. I was very impressed. However, it took a while to get the lenses because they were German-made. The shop offered free delivery. I highly recommend this shop for anyone looking for a glasses shop in the Hua Hin area 👍
0x30fdabf3f2dd9df9_0xedb50c81347a34c0.author: Loganrx' Mos

They were able to see me the same day and provided a very thorough eye exam, assisted with frame selection, measured and trailed the lenses to be certain they would work well for me in my day to day activities and had the frames and lenses ready for pick up within a few days. Excellent service, a large variety of frames to select from and very professional care.
0x30fdabf3f2dd9df9_0xedb50c81347a34c0.author: Christina Roux

0x30fdabf3f2dd9df9_0xedb50c81347a34c0.text: The service was excellent! The two owners were very polite. The optometrist did a very thorough examination, lasting almost an hour. I was very impressed. This is an eyewear shop I would highly recommend. My entire office now uses glasses from this shop. We are truly impressed!

Don’t expect it to be the same for everyone some cases may cost higher. Tourist from Philippines 💕

0x30da3a9c891ec5ef_0x9edf74a2b0291ed.text: The clinic is clean, the reception staff are friendly and smiling, the doctor is kind, scheduling an appointment was easy, and they responded quickly on their Facebook page. 0x30da3a9c891ec5ef_0x9edf74a2b0291ed.text: I came here for a teeth cleaning because I saw the good reviews but I was disapointed. Negative: - It was not soft at all, going quick around the teeth with the machine, a bit brutal - A regular cleaning just includes the machine around the teeth. You have to pay 200 THB extra if they use the manual pic for tartar. - They don’t actually clean your teeth with tooth paste neither pass the floss, they really just go around the gums. - I had water all over my face, it was dripping in my neck and the water was warm. - They advertise a price of 700-1200 THB but you don’t know how much if will be until you are done. Even though I have quite good teeth (last cleaning 9 months ago), I was charged 900 THB). - The cleaning only lasted 15 min. Positive: - They had a availability right away - They speak good enough english - I don’t have tartar between my bottom teeth which was the main reason I came to them. - It’s clean. Conclusion: I would not come back here neither recommend it to a friend. I did not feel like it was a complete cleaning at all. I feel like it was really expensive for the service I got.

0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.text: I was having an issue with one of my eyes. I thought it might be another “floater” but it was more than that. With some “prompting” from my friends they recommended I see Dr. Pairat at the Pairst Eye Clinic in Hua Hin for an eye examination. I saw him the next day and after a thorough examination he advised me I had a detached retina! As a guest to Thailand, going home for treatment was not an option given the urgency of the situation. Dr. Pairat recommenced I attend a hospital in Bangkok for treatment purposes. He referenced a few hospitals, so after discussion with others who underwent eye treatment in Bangkok, I selected the Rutnin Eye Hospital. That is where I underwent surgery to repair the damaged eye. The treatment and care I received at this hospital was superb. Following discharge from the hospital I saw Dr. Pairat for checkup purposes. Once again he conducted a thorough examination of my eye and recommended the desired treatment until I am able to return home and see my doctors there. So thank you Dr. Pairat, along with the support staff at your Clinic, for the service you provided me. It was truly appreciated. You may well have assisted in my not losing the sight in my eye. i would not hesitate at all recommending your Clinic to others in need. Many thanks for the service you extended me and may you enjoy continued success! Kindest regards.
0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.author: Frank Anderson

0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.text: I had lens replacement surgery on my eyes in Korea several years ago. The process was painful and left me almost blind for 2 weeks. Hence I was reluctant to have invasive surgery on my eyes again. I was buying increasingly more powerful spectacles to overcome the challenges I was having seeing my laptop, reading and any close up work. This came to a head yesterday when I bought my 3rd pair of spectacles in as many weeks, that were again not entirely successful. Therefore I visited Dr. Pairat. He gave me a thorough examination and said he could repair the damage to my eye with laser treatment. He explained that it would be entirely painless and only take a few minutes. I agreed and true to his word, it was painless and quick and I had no difficulty driving home afterwards. After a nights sleep, I have no discomfort and am writing this on my phone, which would have been impossible previously. Also not forgetting the ladies in the doctor's office. They all spoke excellent English, were friendly, professional and a credit to their profession and I thank them very much for making my visit so pleasant.
0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.author: Keith Brown

0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.text: Dr Pairat has been around and seen more than a few farangs that are after cheap and high quality service and staff that can explain any eye problem in English language or in the case of French farangs the use of graduate level French language - Germans naturally in high German language, not Bavarian. Preferably in an office surrounded by all the latest high tech equipment that can speak any language determined by AI and back-noised by digital gadgets and of course headsets for everyone. You are better off going back to Miami, London Harley street or Heidelberg. I had work done at Dr Pairat for many years, including cataract surgery performed by him at the Bangkok Hospital, and found it very acceptable although the 'shoes off' and sitting there for an hour can sometimes feel a bit boring. That's what the neighbouring massage parlours are there for. Of course also no English and another 250 Baht gone. But that's OK!
0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.author: Fredi Sievert

0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.text: I have recently had my second cataract surgery by Dr Pairat, the first was about a month earlier. I cannot recommend Dr Pairat high enough, his explanation of the procedure was very detailed and in English. the aftercare was again very detailed, although I could not attend his clinic for an appointment, after the second surgery, due to a stomach complaint. I followed Dr Pairat's instructions as accurately as I could, so after the stomach complaint was over, I felt There was no need to take up the good Doctors time, as my second eye was fine. I strongly recommend if you have eye problems visit his clinic. As for Pat David, it is obvious this person has not been in Thailand very long, and should keep his/her comments to themselves, the doctor is far from arrogant, a nice friendly chap! Remember English is not the receptionists first language, but will be better than your Thai!
0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.author: brian hepburn

0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.text: We were in Hua Hin on holiday when my son's overnight contact lens got stuck in his eye. After much panic and pain, I found Dr. Pairat on Google and was sceptical at first but had didn't really have any options. I was pleasantly surprised by the kind and helpful staff, and even more impressed by Dr. Pairat's professionalism and responsiveness. Super grateful for him saving my son's eye! Definitely recommend anyone in need to see him! ------------------------------------------- Dr. Pairat, thank you so much for saving my eye. I had a contact lenses in the morning I could not get it out so my dad helped me but the eye lens was already out but he didn't know so he was actually pulling my eye out. It hurt so much,😭😭😭then I finally convinced my dad to bring me to this eye doctor . And he helped make my eye much better.,🙂. Michael 10 years old from Hong Kong.
0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.author: Gary Lau

0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.text: My first visit to Khun Dr Pairat was almost 2 years ago. At that time, he diagnosed a cataract and glaucoma. The cataract was already very advanced, so an operation on both eyes was arranged promptly. Khun Dr Pairat's advice regarding the lenses was very sound and in line with the latest state of the art. Khun Dr Pairat carried out both operations at Bangkok Hospital with great care and absolute professionalism. Thanks to the choice of lenses, I can now see very well without glasses, both far and near. Because of my glaucoma, I continue to have quarterly check-ups. My intraocular pressure has largely normalised. I can recommend Khun Dr Pairat as an excellent doctor and a very likeable person. I feel that I am in the very best of hands with him.
0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.author: Rainer Plessmann

0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.text: Although the price is expensive compared to other clinics, the doctor provided excellent consultation and advice. As for the staff, which many previous reviews mentioned as not being very good, it's true that those reviews weren't helpful. 😅 …

0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.text: Seriously go somewhere else. Terrible front desk staff who are rude and extremely unprofessional. I wanted to leave straight after speaking with them but my wife convinced me to stay. There is no appointment system offered, you just have to wait your turn (I waited over an hour) in a hot and uncomfortable waiting room. Saw the Dr who told me what I already knew about my eye condition. I wasn’t in his company more than 5 minutes but was charged 500 baht. For me it was a waste of time and money. There are much better options in Hua Hin that will treat you with respect, courtesy and humility whilst offering excellent value for money.

The price is reasonable, the clinic is in a great location on a main road with parking, very convenient. Now it's my regular clinic. I highly recommend it.

0x30e2bd52a6503d2f_0x81b114de87647fc.text: เอาจริงๆ เราเป็นคนนึงที่กลัวการถอนฟันม๊ากกก แต่มาที่นี้คืออุ่นใจ เพราะคุณหมอมือเบามาก ฉีดยาก็คือเจ็บนิดเดียว คุณมือจะคอยบอก คอยชวนคุย ถอนฟันเสร็จแบบเราไม่รู้ตัวเรา😅 จนหันไปถามคุณหมอว่าเสร็จแล้วหรอค่ะ ทำฟัน ถอนฟัน ใดๆเกี่ยวกับฟันคือต้องที่นี้เท่านั้นค่ะ🥰
0x30e2bd52a6503d2f_0x81b114de87647fc.author: Sutida Banchongkhayai
0x30e2bd52a6503d2f_0x81b114de87647fc.en: Honestly, I'm someone who's terrified of tooth extraction, but coming here was so reassuring. The dentist was incredibly gentle; the injection was only slightly painful. The dentist kept guiding me and chatting with me, and the extraction was finished before I even realized it! 😅 I even turned to ask the dentist if it was already done. For any dental work, including extractions, this is the only place to go! 🥰

0x30e2bd52a6503d2f_0x81b114de87647fc.text: มาใช้บริการครั้งแรก ปกติขับรถผ่านไม่เคยสังเกตว่ามีคลินิกทำฟันตรงนี้ สถานที่สะอาดสอ้าน แอร์เย็น คุณหมออชิตพงศ์มือเบามาก สุภาพมาก ขออวยยศให้ ใช้สิทธิบัตรทอง ขูดหินปูน/อุดฟัน/เคลือบฟลูออไรด์ ได้ 3 ครั้ง/ปี ที่เหลือก็ชำระเองเพิ่มเติม มีที่จอดรถด้านหลัง
0x30e2bd52a6503d2f_0x81b114de87647fc.author: Khemachart Chattrastrai
0x30e2bd52a6503d2f_0x81b114de87647fc.en: This was my first time using their services. I usually drive past and never noticed a dental clinic here. The place is clean and tidy, the air conditioning is cool, and Dr. Achitpong is very gentle and polite. I highly recommend him. I used my government health insurance for 3 treatments per year: teeth cleaning/filling/fluoride treatment. I paid for everything else separately. There's parking available at the back.

0x30e2bd52a6503d2f_0x81b114de87647fc.text: คุณหมอใส่ใจ สุภาพ มือเบาสุดๆ แจ้งเราตลอดว่าจะเสียวฟันหน่อยน้าา ตึงฟันหน่อยน้าาตรวจสุขภาพฟันให้ด้วย นัดรักษาต่อเนื่องไปเลย พนักงานก็น่ารักพูดจาดี อยู่ใกล้บ้านน่าจะเป็นลูกค้าประจำแน่นอนค่ะ
0x30e2bd52a6503d2f_0x81b114de87647fc.author: Patchuda Ruangruedee
0x30e2bd52a6503d2f_0x81b114de87647fc.en: The dentist was very attentive, polite, and gentle. They kept me informed throughout the process about potential tooth sensitivity and tightness, and also performed a dental check-up. They scheduled follow-up appointments. The staff were also lovely and spoke kindly. It's conveniently located near my home, so I'll definitely be a regular customer.

0x30e2bd52a6503d2f_0x81b114de87647fc.text: บริการดีมาก พยาบาล ผู้ช่วยพยาบาล คุณหมอ สุภาพมาก บริการดีสุดๆ สะอาด มือเบา เอาใจใส่ มาใช้บริการที่นี่3-4ครั้ง ประทับใจทุกครั้ง ค่ะ คุณพยาบาล และ ผู้ช่วย น่ารักมาก คุณหมอ หล่อมากๆค่ะ
0x30e2bd52a6503d2f_0x81b114de87647fc.author: Pream
0x30e2bd52a6503d2f_0x81b114de87647fc.en: Excellent service. The nurses, nursing assistants, and doctors are very polite and provide top-notch service. The place is clean, gentle, and attentive. I've used their services 3-4 times and have been impressed every time. The nurses and assistants are lovely, and the doctor is very handsome!

0x30e2bd52a6503d2f_0x81b114de87647fc.text: ผมมาถอนฟัน/พาแม่มาทำฟันปลอม หมอและบุคลากรบริการดี สถานที่สะอาด ต้องโทรมานัดก่อน มีคนมาใช้บริการตลอด เปิดทุกวัน มีที่จอดรถด้านหลังอาคาร คุณภาพตามราคา
0x30e2bd52a6503d2f_0x81b114de87647fc.author: Kong Vanut
0x30e2bd52a6503d2f_0x81b114de87647fc.en: I came to have my teeth extracted/bring my mother to have dentures made. The doctor and staff provided good service. The place was clean. You have to call to make an appointment first. There are always people using the service. It is open every day. There is parking behind the building. The quality is according to the price.

0x30e29f6fda04fe7f_0xcb77bf3247ff3734.text: ประทับใจมากค่ะ Tooth and Smile Dental Clinic เป็นคลินิกทำฟันที่สะอาดและน่าเชื่อถือ อยู่ในจามจุรีสแควร์ ชั้น 3 เดินทางสะดวก MRT ทางออก 2 ขึ้นลิฟท์ก็เจอร้านเลย คุณหมอมืออาชีพ ฟอกสีฟันไม่เจ็บ หลังทำฟันขาวขึ้นชัดเจน พนักงานให้คำแนะนำเป็นกันเอง แนะนำให้ทำแอร์โฟลว์และขูดหินปูน ฟันสะอาดและสดใส ใครกำลังหาคลินิกทำฟันดีๆ แถวนี้เหมาะมากค่ะ 😁✨
0x30e29f6fda04fe7f_0xcb77bf3247ff3734.en: I was very impressed! Tooth and Smile Dental Clinic is a clean and trustworthy dental clinic located on the 3rd floor of Chamchuri Square. It's conveniently accessible via MRT, exit 2; just take the elevator and you'll find it right away. The dentist is professional, the teeth whitening was painless, and my teeth were noticeably whiter afterwards. The staff were friendly and gave helpful advice. They recommended airflow dentition and scaling. My teeth are clean and bright now. If you're looking for a good dental clinic in this area, this is highly recommended! 😁✨

0x30e29f6fda04fe7f_0xcb77bf3247ff3734.text: คลินิกพนักงานอัธยาศัยดี สุภาพ บริการอย่างเป็นมิตร คุณหมอจุมภฏเป็นคุณหมอที่มีประสบการณ์ดี เป็นคนปากแคบ แต่หมอก็ยังผ่าฟันคุดออกได้ The staff at the clinic is polite and friendly. Doc. Jumphot is also a skilled Dentist. Even for people with small mouth, he could still operate without problem.
0x30e29f6fda04fe7f_0xcb77bf3247ff3734.author: Ken M
0x30e29f6fda04fe7f_0xcb77bf3247ff3734.en: The clinic staff are friendly, polite, and provide excellent service. Dr. Jumphot is a highly experienced dentist. Even for someone with a narrow mouth, he was able to successfully remove my wisdom tooth.

0x30e29f6fda04fe7f_0xcb77bf3247ff3734.text: หลังจากมาฟอกสีฟันที่ Tooth and Smile ไปแล้ว รู้สึกว่าฟันขาวขึ้นชัดเจนจริงๆ ค่ะ เวลายิ้มดูมั่นใจมากกว่าเดิมเยอะ ไม่เจ็บ ไม่เสียวฟันเลย คุณหมออธิบายละเอียดและดูแลดีมากๆ จนสบายใจ ตอนนี้ตั้งใจไว้ว่าจะกลับมาตรวจเช็คและทำซ้ำทุก 6 เดือน เพราะทำแล้วเห็นผลจริงค่ะ
0x30e29f6fda04fe7f_0xcb77bf3247ff3734.en: After getting my teeth whitened at Tooth and Smile, I can definitely say my teeth are noticeably whiter. I feel much more confident when I smile. It wasn't painful or sensitive at all. The dentist explained everything in detail and provided excellent care, which made me feel comfortable. Now I plan to come back for check-ups and repeat treatments every 6 months because I'm really seeing results.

0x30e29f6fda04fe7f_0xcb77bf3247ff3734.text: ฟอกสีฟันกับทางคลินิกฟันขาวขึ้นแน่นอนแบบไม่ต้องลุ้น ที่เราไปทำกันมาฟันขาวขึ้นทุกคนแล้วก็ราคาไม่แพงด้วย ได้ทั้งขูดหินปูนแอร์โฟลว์ ฟอกสีฟัน คุณหมอก็ทำอย่างละเอียดดูแลดีเป็นกันเองใช้สิทธิ์ปกส.ไม่ต้องสำรองจ่ายสะดวกดีค่ะ
0x30e29f6fda04fe7f_0xcb77bf3247ff3734.en: Teeth whitening at this clinic is guaranteed to make your teeth whiter, no need to worry. Everyone who's been there has seen whiter teeth, and the price is affordable. They offer scaling, airflow tartar removal, and teeth whitening. The dentist is meticulous, caring, and friendly. You can use your social security benefits without having to pay upfront, which is very convenient.

0x30e29f6fda04fe7f_0xcb77bf3247ff3734.text: เพิ่งมาฟอกสีฟันด้วยตัวเองค่ะ เป็นคนดื่มชา กาแฟประจำ ฟันค่อนข้างหมอง คุณหมอและพนักงานให้คำแนะนำละเอียด ตรวจเช็กสภาพฟันก่อนทำ ใช้เวลาประมาณ 45 นาที–1 ชั่วโมง เราเลือกแพ็กเกจที่รวม แอร์โฟล์ว ฟันขาวขึ้น 8 เฉดเลยค่ะ 😍
0x30e29f6fda04fe7f_0xcb77bf3247ff3734.en: I recently had my teeth whitened at home. I drink tea and coffee regularly, so my teeth were quite dull. The dentist and staff gave detailed advice and checked my teeth before the procedure. It took about 45 minutes to an hour. I chose the package that included Airflow whitening, and my teeth are 8 shades whiter! 😍

0x30e29f6fda04fe7f_0xcb77bf3247ff3734.text: เพิ่งมาฟอกสีฟันที่ Tooth and Smile Dental Clinic ชั้น 3 จามจุรีสแควร์ ฟันขาวขึ้นเห็นชัดประมาณ 7 เฉดในครั้งเดียว ไม่เจ็บหรือเสียวฟันเลย 😁 ค่าบริการดี พนักงานต้อนรับสุภาพและจัดคิวดี เดินทางสะดวกด้วย 🦷✨
0x30e29f6fda04fe7f_0xcb77bf3247ff3734.en: I recently got my teeth whitened at Tooth and Smile Dental Clinic on the 3rd floor of Chamchuri Square. My teeth are noticeably about 7 shades whiter in just one session! It wasn't painful or sensitive at all 😁 The service fee was good, the staff were polite, and the scheduling was efficient. It's also conveniently located. 🦷✨

0x30e29f6fda04fe7f_0xcb77bf3247ff3734.text: คลินิก Tooth and Smile Dental Clinic หาง่ายมากๆ เดินทางสะดวก ขึ้นลิฟท์แก้วมาชั้น 3 เจอคลินิกเลยค่ะ พนักงานและคุณหมอน่ารัก เป็นกันเอง แถมคลินิกสะอาด ทำให้รู้สึกสบายใจเวลาเข้ามาใช้บริการ 🥰
0x30e29f6fda04fe7f_0xcb77bf3247ff3734.en: Tooth and Smile Dental Clinic is very easy to find and conveniently located. Just take the glass elevator to the 3rd floor and you'll find the clinic right away. The staff and dentists are lovely and friendly, and the clinic is very clean, making you feel comfortable when you come for treatment. 🥰

0x30e29f6fda04fe7f_0xcb77bf3247ff3734.text: Worst dental care ever. I've done both coolight whitening and dental scaling .. the scaling was painful. Their whitenting made my teeth surface feel rough and have grainy texture. It's really bad here my big mistake. When back to the state, I have to done many dental treatments to cure this side effects. By the way, at least they are nice that is the only 1 star is for on this review.
0x30e29f6fda04fe7f_0xcb77bf3247ff3734.author: Zoe Hw

0x30e29bd9d830825d_0x91d0949043ec680c.text: ไปทำมาเมื่อวานค่ะ ถามว่าหาข้อมูลจากไหน ก็ใน Google เลยค่ะ เสิร์จหาที่ใกล้ๆที่พัก คุณหมอใจดีจริงค่ะ ที่สำคัญเรามาคุณหมอกมลเพราะมีคนรีวิวว่ามือเบา อันนี้เบาจริง คอนเฟิร์มจากคนขี้กลัวการทำฟันแบบเราเลยค่ะ คุณหมอเก่งมาก เมื่อวานไปถอนฟันมา ฟันผุจนปวดทนมาอาทิตย์นึง ไม่ไหวแล้ว เลยตัดสินใจไปหาหมอ คุณหมอแนะนำให้ถอนก็ถอนเลยค่ะ เคยถอนมาซี่นึงแล้ว คุณหมอท่านเดิมก็เก่งถอนไวเหงือกไม่ช้ำแต่อยู่ต่างจังหวัดไม่สะดวกไป เลยมาคุณหมอกมล ประทับใจมากค่ะ ใจดี ฉีดยาชาได้มือเบามากกก ปกติแค่ขูดหินปูนเราก็น้ำตาซึมแล้ว เมื่อวานถอน รวมฉีดยาชาน่าจะไม่เกิน 20 นาที ออกมาคุยต่อได้อีก น้องทักเลยว่าไม่บวมเท่าตอนน้องถอน ครั้งนี้หมดไป 900 แลกกับการถอนฟันที่ไม่เจ็บ คุณหมอใจดี คุ้มมากค่ะ (ฟันคุดด้านบนซ้ายค่ะ) ปล.คุณหมอน่าจะชอบเพลงคันทรี่ สไตล์ชนบทอังกฤษ ฟังตอนถอนผ่อนคลายบมากกค่ะ^^
0x30e29bd9d830825d_0x91d0949043ec680c.author: Cake P.
0x30e29bd9d830825d_0x91d0949043ec680c.en: I went yesterday. You might ask where I found the information? I searched on Google for places near my accommodation. The dentist is really kind. Importantly, I chose Dr. Kamol because of reviews saying she has a gentle touch. And she really is! Confirmed by someone like me who's easily scared of dental work. The dentist is very skilled. Yesterday I had a tooth extracted. It was decayed and painful for a week, I couldn't take it anymore, so I decided to see a dentist. The dentist recommended extraction, so I went with it. I'd had one extracted before by the same dentist who was also skilled, quick, and didn't bruise my gums, but they live in another province and it wasn't convenient to travel. So I came to Dr. Kamol. I was very impressed. She's kind, and the anesthetic injection was incredibly gentle. Normally, even just getting tartar removed makes me tear up, but yesterday the extraction, including the anesthetic injection, probably took less than 20 minutes. I was even able to talk afterwards! My younger sibling even commented that it wasn't as swollen as when they had theirs extracted. This time it cost 900 baht, which was worth it for a painless extraction and a kind dentist. (It was an upper left wisdom tooth.) P.S. The dentist seems to like country music, the style of the English countryside; it was very relaxing during the extraction.^^

0x30e29bd9d830825d_0x91d0949043ec680c.text: อยู่​ซ.จ​รัญ​ 71​ ฝั่งตรงข้ามร้านคุณ​หมอกมล​ แต่พึ่งเคยมาใช้บริการด้วยตัวเองเป็นครั้งแรก​ ตามมาจากรีวิวร้านหมอฟันแถวๆนี้ร้านนี้ดีสุด วันนี้มาด้วยอาการฟันกรามขวาบิ่นนิดนึงเนื่องจาก​เคี้ยวกากหมูแข็งๆ​ ตอนก่อน​มาวิตกกังวลมากพอสมควรกลัวจะเป็นเรื่องใหญ่​ แต่พอมาให้คุณหมอ​ดูก็แจ้งว่าสามารถ​อุดได้​ โล่งใจมาก​ เพราะว่าเป็นคนกลัวร้านหมอฟันสุดๆ​ รวมอุดฟันแผลใหญ่กับขูดหินปูน​ไปด้วยเลยไม่พอครึ่งชั่วโมงดี​ กับค่าเสียหาย​ 800+500 โอเคมาก​ จะเป็นลูกค้าประจำต่อไปและแนะนำเพื่อนฝูงคนอื่นๆด้วย​
0x30e29bd9d830825d_0x91d0949043ec680c.author: korawit komolrit
0x30e29bd9d830825d_0x91d0949043ec680c.en: Located on Soi Charan 71, opposite Dr. Kamol's clinic, but this was my first time using their services. I came here based on reviews saying this dentist in the area is the best. Today I came because my right molar was slightly chipped from chewing on hard pork rinds. Before coming, I was quite worried that it would be a big problem, but after the doctor examined it, they said it could be filled. I was so relieved because I'm terrified of dentists. The filling and scaling were done in less than half an hour, and the cost was 800 + 500 baht, which was great. I will be a regular customer and recommend them to my friends.

0x30e29bd9d830825d_0x91d0949043ec680c.text: กลัวการทำฟันมาก แต่ปวดฟันมากเลยจำเป็นต้องถอน หาข้อมูลเจอหมอ ไกล้บ้านรีวิวว่าหมอมือเบา วันนี้ไปถอนมาแล้ว สรุปคือ ไม่มีความเจ็บเลยจ้า ฉีดยาชาก็ไม่เจ็บเลย จนถอนเสร็จก็ไม่เจ็บเลยแม้แต่น้อย ก่อนไปคือกลัวมากกก กลัวเจ็บบ ใครกลัวไปหาได้เลย เราถอนแบบผ่า หมอเก่ง มือเบา ค่าเสียหาย1000บาท
0x30e29bd9d830825d_0x91d0949043ec680c.author: Nune Mi
0x30e29bd9d830825d_0x91d0949043ec680c.en: I'm terrified of dental work, but my tooth was hurting so much I needed it extracted. I found a dentist near my house with reviews saying they were gentle. I went for the extraction today, and surprisingly, it wasn't painful at all! Even the anesthetic injection hurt, and I didn't feel any pain after the extraction was complete. Before going, I was so scared of the pain. If you're afraid of pain, you should go see them! It was a surgical extraction, the dentist was skilled and gentle, and it cost 1000 baht.

0x30e29bd9d830825d_0x91d0949043ec680c.text: 👱คุณหมอใจดีและมือเบามากเลยค่ะ ใครที่กลัวหมอฟันมากกก แนะนำเลยค่ะ คุณหมอถอนให้ 2 ซี่ ภายใน 15 นาทีแบบชิวๆ ช่างเป็นการถอนฟันขั้นเทพมาก 🙏 กราบขอบคุณคุณหมออีกครั้งน่ะค่ะ💐 😁รู้งี้มานานล่ะปวดอยู่ได้ตั้งนาน อิอิ 👍
0x30e29bd9d830825d_0x91d0949043ec680c.author: porntip trimuck
0x30e29bd9d830825d_0x91d0949043ec680c.en: 👱 The dentist was so kind and gentle! For anyone who is terrified of dentists, I highly recommend her. She extracted two teeth in just 15 minutes – truly a masterful extraction technique! 🙏 Thank you again, dentist! 💐 😁 I wish I had come sooner! I've been in pain for so long! Haha 👍

0x30e29bd9d830825d_0x91d0949043ec680c.text: คุณหมอกมล ถอนฟันรักษารากฟัน ราคา ประทับใจ คุณหมอมือเบาใจดีมาก ถ้ากลัวการถอนฟัน หรือทำฟัน ได้เจอคุณหมอนะคะ แล้วจะต้องอุทานเบาๆว่า รู้แบบนี้ มาตั้งนานแล้ววว แนะนำเลยคะ ขั้นเทพ บอกเลย หัวการันตีคะ

0x305030f213e8fec5_0x5463bc6a7cffdf8a.text: Doctor's name: Khun PONGSAKORN. Removal of old breast implants due to suspected rupture. For personal reasons, I could not undergo the procedure under general anesthesia. I do not tolerate certain types of anesthesia well, and even tooth extraction is life-threatening. Clinics and hospitals (I consulted in 4 places) refused to use local anesthesia. In addition, I wanted the incision to be made along the old scar around the areola, and not under the breast, but the implants were very large. This surgeon was the only one who communicated with me properly, listened to my wishes, and did everything perfectly. He made incisions over the old scar and removed the implants under local anesthesia. ✅️Quick and painless. ✅️Without new scars. ✅️The cost was extremely reasonable for me, several times lower than anywhere else. He has a perfectly clean and advanced operating room on the second floor with all the necessary equipment. He has many years of experience behind him and has done many things hundreds of times. His assistants have been working for 18 years and are very experienced. Linens and "patient clothing," instruments, optimal, safe anesthesia - he doesn't relax and takes care of us. He is a man who changes people's lives. I am also sure that he has the best-invisible sutures in the world and that he performs Botox injections flawlessly. He is a master of his craft, very passionate about his work, a true professional, and a very good person. You can trust him with your secrets. He is very professionally honest. A heart of gold and golden hands are what distinguishes this doctor.
0x305030f213e8fec5_0x5463bc6a7cffdf8a.author: Rose

0x305030f213e8fec5_0x5463bc6a7cffdf8a.text: The doctor is lovely and very kind. She doesn't try to sell you any courses or push anything on you. The nurses and assistants are also lovely, always smiling, cheerful, and speak very well. I've had two nose surgeries with the doctor. It's not that the doctor is bad or unskilled; it's just that my original nose shape was very thin. In the first series, the skin around my nose could only stretch a certain amount.😅 That's what the doctor said. But the result is very natural; no one can tell unless you tell them. So, I went for the second series, and this time the skin around my nose could stretch even more. Now I have the high nose bridge I wanted!👍 I always get Botox injections with the doctor. I've had injections elsewhere before, and my eyes looked slanted and I always looked shocked. But here, the doctor injects very well. My eyes don't look stiff or shocked at all. The Botox package is all-inclusive; if you're not satisfied or it's not tight enough, you can come back for unlimited refills. I also got filler injections for my nasolabial folds with the doctor. At first, the doctor didn't want to inject them, saying they were still okay. I had to persist, and then the doctor agreed!5555 The filler is definitely authentic; it doesn't migrate, sag, or feel hard or overflowing. It's incredibly smooth. This isn't just the doctor; this is the father who gave birth to my new face! ❤️

0x30e29e0702183123_0x3d06f4a1b93e043b.text: I have been going for a few years now as well as all my family members: 2 sons and a husband. 🚗 The staff is professional, friendly and kind. The clinic is easy to find and has parking spaces nearby. 🏥 The clinic itself is very clean, very comfortable and with the latest equipments. It looks luxury but with affordable prices I feel. My older son have had there diamond metal braces there and all went smoothly. My younger son has been treated for molar tooth decay and has been feeling very confident and relaxed going there. As for my husband and myself, we have been going for all things like tooth cleaning, check ups, crowns, and today for me tooth extraction and implant. 💉 For my tooth extraction and dental implant, I had a first consultation with Dr Phung whom explained me in details the procedure, the budget and the timeline. ✨ She has a very good English so very easy to communicate (my thai is too basic!). But what struck me the most is that she is very calm, very professional and makes you feel at ease. I was scared and stressed about the procedures: she explained me what she was doing for each step to reassure me, describing which sensations will come which each step. Really something to be highlighted here as this is not common in Thailand. ✨ So overall highly recommended ✨
