0x30da3a7d9a4abd79_0xab608efde5483493.text: I needed to have a wisdom tooth extracted. I read the reviews of all the dental clinics. There was one for this place that I trusted. The bad reviews made me wary, but they were about poor service. My experience was great! Everyone was very kind! At all times! There are several steps to follow upon arrival, which might be confusing. But it's super easy, and many people speak English. If you have trouble, I recommend using your phone's translator. Also, read the directions to the places to go upon arrival, which are in one of the comments. First, you have to go to reception and fill out a form, then go to another area, then to the dentist who will evaluate you. If you need to have the tooth extracted or go to another area, they will tell you. If you have to go to area 3, which is for the tooth extraction, when you arrive, you have to open the window and leave the pink slip of paper in the basket, and they will call you later. This is important because you might arrive at department 3 and sit and wait, and they never call you. Remember, if you have any questions, ask; everyone is very kind and will help you. Then a student will attend to you and extract the tooth. If they have any complications, they'll call the professor. You pay when you leave. I had asked how much it would cost beforehand, and they charged me what they told me: 4 euros. They explained the ENTIRE procedure to me at ALL times. I got very nervous and cried from fear before starting, and the student who attended to me held my hand, calmed me down, and told me that we wouldn't start until I felt ready, that she would wait as long as I needed, and not to worry, that she was there for me. She was an angel. Very professional. When they finished, they gave me gauze. I'm very grateful. It's important to understand that this is a faculty where you're seen by students supervised by professors, so obviously it's not the same as going to a specialist. There's a risk that something might go wrong, but there are very professional professors, and the price is very affordable. Everything was incredibly quick and painless, and everyone was so kind. Dentists in Thailand are highly professional! And everything is very hygienic. My congratulations to the student and professor who treated me, as well as the reception staff and all the other personnel!
0x30da3a7d9a4abd79_0xab608efde5483493.author: Carol Ramallo

0x30da3a7d9a4abd79_0xab608efde5483493.text: I can directly compare my experience at this facility with expensive UK private healthcare for the same issue, and this place was so much more efficient, it's scary. I had a rare abscess in the root of a tooth, it had been developing for about a year and was just getting bigger and bigger. I went to a regular dentist in CM, who referred me here. It took about 3-4 hours for me to get assessed, referred to various departments, x-rayed, and presented with treatment options. I chose the surgical option but was told I would have to wait 3 weeks for the surgery. I was due to visit home in the UK in 3 weeks, so I decided I would get it done in the UK when I went back. I made an appointment with my UK dentist for the day after I arrived in the UK. He referred me to a specialist, that was about a 6-week wait (and this is private healthcare, NHS probably would have taken a year). The specialist didn't need to take x-rays, because I brought my CT scan from CMU Dental Faculty, if I didn't have it, that would have been another referral and more weeks/months waiting. The UK specialist (a renowned facial reconstructive surgeon, it turned out), gave me the EXACT treatment options I received at CMU Dental Faculty. Again, I choose the surgical option. The wait for surgery was another 6-8 weeks. If I had done the entire thing in the UK, it would have taken about 4 months to get to the same stage it took 4 hours to get to at CMU Dental Faculty. Then the wait for surgery was more than double. My surgery in the UK went amazingly, my Doctor was one of the best facial surgeons in the world, so I'm very happy with the outcome. But I don't understand how UK healthcare can't move as fast as it does here. Everyone I saw at CMU Dental Faculty was knowledgeable and able to explain to me what was going on and what my options were. I felt in good hands all the way.
0x30da3a7d9a4abd79_0xab608efde5483493.author: Charlie Parker

0x30da3a7d9a4abd79_0xab608efde5483493.text: I needed to have my wisdom tooth removed. Not a single clinic in Chiang Mai agreed to do this and everyone referred me here. 0x311d5d7090eb437d_0x7618170bcc273878.text: Real-life Review: Lower Back Pain Radiating to Hips for Years, Cured with Acupuncture I had chronic lower back pain radiating to my hips for a very long time. I tried every physical therapy method, including Shockwave, PMS, and Ultrasound, but nothing completely cured it. So I decided to try acupuncture to stimulate the muscles directly at the painful point. The first 1-2 sessions might not show much effect because the muscles were sore from years of treatment. But by the third session, my symptoms improved steadily. Now, after completing a course of 6 sessions, my pain level has dropped from 8.5/10 to just 2/10. My life is easier and I'm much less stressed. Things I liked: 🩷 Doctor: Kind, gave precise advice, the acupuncture was painless and took about an hour (acupuncture + cupping). 🩷 Service: The admin responded quickly and managed the appointments very well. 🩷 Location: The clinic is located in a gas station, easily accessible with plenty of parking. For anyone experiencing similar chronic pain, I recommend trying acupuncture treatment consistently. It's definitely worth the money. This is based on my personal experience.💯

0x30da3ae9e183baeb_0x172427bc8f1c1441.text: I'm an older adult who experienced a very sudden vision symptom -- one which could rapidly lead to sudden blindness. I went to St Peter Eye Hospital for diagnosis and possible treatment. My experience there was excellent, and I highly recommend them. HERE'S MY STORY: My scary symptom was sudden-onset floaters in my left eye combined with light flashes in the same eye. I discovered these symptoms could be indications of a detached retina. My USA ophthalmologist directed me to have this checked out immediately -- it might be something minor or it be something that might rip further at any time causing blindness in one eye. This definitely got my attention and created some natural anxiety. I reached out to several friends I trust here in Chiang Mai for recommendations and insights. They each recommended Dr. Kupakanjana at St Peter Eye Hospital based either on personal first-hand experience or word of mouth. Although he had just landed that day from a flight, Dr. Kupakanjana (or Dr. Nickie for short), took my call that afternoon. He then had his staff make an appointment for me the next morning. I received a thorough examination (actually several types of exams). The news I received was mixed -- no emergency or risk of sudden blindness, but instead an age-related degeneration that might continue to advance over time (much like a mole on my retina). But I was very relieved. I also appreciated the professionalism of the staff there and the time Dr. Nickie took to explain the problem and my future options. By noon I was finished and able to return to my apartment with my wife (my eye was dilated from one of the exams). The cost for his services was very fair. As an indication of the value at St Peter -- I ordered two pair of bifocal prescription sunglasses while I was there because they were a better value than the optical stores I had visited in town. This was unrelated to my emergency visit, but I felt good enough about my care that I made these additional optional purchases. Note: there were a few reviews I read (only a handful of 1-star reviews) about St Peter that gave me pause as I did my initial research about selecting an eye doctor. I realized those reviews were ALL old 5+ years and with a different doctor. Recommend you google Dr. Kupakanjana and note his credentials and record. He came from a strong practice elsewhere to Chiang Mai for family reasons. I feel very fortunate that he relocated here!
0x30da3ae9e183baeb_0x172427bc8f1c1441.author: ALM

0x30da3ae9e183baeb_0x172427bc8f1c1441.text: I would have awarded Dr. Nikki Tayakorn 10 stars but we are only given a maximum 5. I am very nervous about my eyes, not least because I had laser surgery for a torn retinal 10 years ago and was given the prognosis of early cataract complications as a result. My eyesight for the past 3 years has plummeted to the point where I was virtually blind in my left eye. I met with Dr. Nikki, through a personal recommendation of another patient - explained my nervousness but that I understood the technicalities of the cataract replacement procedure. Dr. Nikki explained everything in perfect detail, calmly, kindly and slowly and thoroughly reassured me to the point that I willingly agreed to have the procedure done via local anesthetic only. During the procedure of the lens replacement Dr. Nikki kept me fully informed of exactly what was happening, so there were NO SURPRISES. His surgical and patient skills are exceptional. My follow up appointment a few weeks later was a very detailed examination resulting in prescription medication to take care of a not uncommon condition that follows this type of surgery. I am usually quite a demanding hospital patient, requesting detailed reasons for medical advice.............NOT with Dr. Nikki, whose every professional opinion I accepted without question, such is the confidence. he instills in me. I live in Bangkok and chose St. Peter hospital on the recommendation of a close friend who had cataract surgery last year but more importantly because of Dr. Nikki - the safest pair of hands I can imagine. He has restored my sight in my left eye to the same strength I had as a young boy and I can't really begin to describe the improvement in the quality of my life as a result. Thank you so much Dr. Nikki and your wonderful staff - and see you next month for my next check up.
0x30da3ae9e183baeb_0x172427bc8f1c1441.author: Richard

0x30da3ae9e183baeb_0x172427bc8f1c1441.text: Trifocal lenses have truly changed my life. For about three years, I'd been feeling frustrated and annoyed with the difficulties of daily routines and driving because I had to switch glasses for reading and driving, both day and night. In short, I needed three pairs of glasses in my bag for every activity. Forgetting one would be inconvenient. So, I consulted an ophthalmologist about how to make life easier. The ophthalmologist conducted a thorough examination and asked many questions. They recommended cataract removal and a trifocal lens replacement, which would allow me to see without glasses anymore. The doctor mentioned that I might experience some glare initially, especially when driving at night, and that it would take some time to adjust. I had the cataract removal and lens replacement on the 10th and started driving during the day on the 14th, and everything went perfectly. On the 18th, I drove at night for almost an hour. When glare from oncoming traffic or from cars behind me reflected in the rearview mirror, I experienced a slight glare, but it wasn't significant. Overall, I give my left eye, which underwent cataract removal and a trifocal lens implant this time within just 8 days, a 90 out of 100. I will be scheduling an appointment with the doctor for cataract removal and a trifocal lens implant for my right eye as well. I would like to express my sincere gratitude for the detailed consultation, explanations, excellent advice, and surgery performed by Ophthalmologist Thayakorn Kupkanjana (Dr. Nickie) St. Peter Eye Hospital, Chiang Mai.
0x30da3ae9e183baeb_0x172427bc8f1c1441.author: Jomkwan Donavanik

0x30da3ae9e183baeb_0x172427bc8f1c1441.text: This hospital is amazing. I came in for cataract surgery and IOL placement. Dr. Nickie decided to start with one eye, and wait two months to evaluate as I was leaving for a 2 month trip to Vietnam. In my job, I am used to work with highly trained professionals. Dr. Nickie is nothing less than excellent. He provided detailed yet understandable information about my problem and the treatment procedure. The surgery was a breeze. Impressive work. One day later, I could read and write without my glasses. After two months, I came back for evaluation and assessment of the other eye. Dr. Nickie and I decided together not to treat the other eye, as my distant sight was still very good in that eye. So I had the best of both worlds. I can’t be more happy with the result. I am used to European hospitals. St. Peter exceeds the quality easily: in service, in kindness, and in professionalism. At every moment, I felt like the most important person in the room. Isn’t that the most wonderful feature for a hospital? Thank you Dr. Nickie and staff. Highly recommended!
0x30da3ae9e183baeb_0x172427bc8f1c1441.author: patrick kreydt

0x30da3ae9e183baeb_0x172427bc8f1c1441.text: My heartfelt thanks to Doctor Rewat and Doctor Tayakorn for performing a successful procedure with excellent results (even better than expected). In my opinion these two highly skilled Ophthalmologists are some of the best practitioners in Chiang Mai if not all of Thailand. Dr. Rewat not only has a lifetime of surgical experience under his belt but is constantly striving to fine tune his technique and knowledge. Dr. Tayakorn for his part is a rising star in his field and yet has the patience and kindness to explain in tremendous detail the various treatment options available, the precise physiology of an individual’s condition, the risk factors and the state of current technologies and their relevance (or lack thereof) to the case at hand. He explains complex issues in a way that the layman can understand. I’ve never met a doctor in fact who is as generous with his valuable time as Dr. Tayakorn (Nikki) and consequently felt tremendous confidence in the selection of intraocular lens, operating procedure and post operative care.

0x310295fd683462cb_0xe649c843be6f5443.text: I like this Dental clinic. I first went there in November of 2023 after much research on Dentists in the area. Everyone agreed they did good work and that their prices were reasonable. I saw Dr Monthirada Leekpai for a cleaning and assessment. I knew the assessment was necessary since I had not seen a dentist for over 8 years. The cleaning was fast and efficient, No issues and no pain. The cost of the cleaning was 700 THB. I needed to get 2 crowns and 2 fillings. On my second appointment it took 1 hour to prep the teeth for 2 crowns and finish 1 filling. Total cost was 18,000. I elected to go for the ceramic crowns at 9000 THB each. The porcelain crowns were only 5000 THB each. I did ask about the gap in my front teeth, I have had various dentists attempt to fix the gap by attaching tooth material there. Dr. Monthirada told me that it would probably not work well and that I did not need it. I find this to be admirable, instead of trying to sell me another fix, she was honest about the outcome. One week later I was back to have the crowns installed and the second filling - which turned out to be fixing a chipped tooth. I do not really remember what I paid for this visit. Maybe 500 to 700 THB. Now - fast forward to June 2025 and while chewing a toffee one of my crowns popped off. Luckily I was able to save it. I called the dentist on Monday morning and was told to come in at 3 pm. I arrived early and was seated by 3 pm. Dr Monthirada arrived shortly after and asked me how many days ago did the crown pop off. I saidf 3 days. She immediately got to work putting the corwn back into place. Making sure my bite was still good with the re-installed crown. It took about 1/2 hour. She told me I should get my teeth cleaned, but that was it. I went back to reception to pay for having the crown re-attached. Shortly thereafter the assistant came out to tell me that there was no charge to re-attach the corwn. I was very surprised. I have had nothing but good experiences at Dental Care Center. I definitely recommend them for professional service and reasonable prices.
0x310295fd683462cb_0xe649c843be6f5443.author: Alexander Beviss

0x310295fd683462cb_0xe649c843be6f5443.text: I had all-ceramic crowns and one dental implant done on my upper jaw here, and six molars replaced on my lower jaw. The dentist is very skilled. Before, when I had dental work done in China, it was incredibly painful; my body trembled the first time I sat down. But this dentist is amazing; the entire treatment process was virtually painless for several months, with only one or two painful episodes that subsided after medication. The treatment took about 7-8 months, from January to October 2024, and my teeth are still functioning normally. I'll definitely come back to him if any problems arise in the future. I think his wife's skills aren't as good as his; she has room for improvement because once when she gave me the anesthesia, it hurt so much I cried. 😆 Overall, I think this is a clinic with reasonable prices and excellent doctors. 😁

0x30e29ed2500b5899_0xcd79ccc9f5dc2353.text: Nawabutr Siam IVF Clinic truly stands out as a compassionate and highly effective fertility center. My experience there, particularly undergoing IUI with Dr. Annop (คุณหมออรรณพ), was overwhelmingly positive, culminating in success on the second attempt – a testament to their expertise. From the moment you step in, the clinic's environment is remarkably spacious and impeccably clean. This creates a very reassuring and comfortable atmosphere, which is so important during what can be an emotionally taxing journey. The waiting area is well-appointed, and they thoughtfully provide complimentary milk and water, adding a touch of warmth and care for patients. What truly sets Nawabutr apart, however, is the exceptional service from Dr. Annop and all the staff. Everyone, without exception, is incredibly friendly, warm, and genuinely supportive. They go above and beyond to make you feel comfortable and at ease, which significantly reduces the stress often associated with fertility treatments. Dr. Annop's expertise is evident, and his approach, combined with the team's dedication, instills a strong sense of trust and confidence. In terms of logistics, the clinic's location is incredibly convenient. You can easily reach it via BTS, making public transport a viable option. For those who prefer to drive, the ability to park directly within the Chula Book Centre building (Wittayakit Building) is a huge advantage in this busy part of Bangkok, ensuring a stress-free arrival and departure. For anyone navigating the path of infertility, I wholeheartedly recommend them for their professional excellence, comforting service, and convenient accessibility.

0x311d7fefa3878123_0x6d6640a927e7d522.en: This clinic has the worst queue management I've ever experienced. I booked an appointment for a teeth cleaning on Wednesday, the 16th, at 4:30 PM. A staff member called to confirm the appointment on Tuesday, the 18th. However, on the day of the appointment, I arrived at 4:30 PM, and the staff said, "Sorry, the queues outside and inside don't match. There are a lot of walk-in customers, and no doctors are available. Could you reschedule?" Honestly, I was shocked and very disappointed. My mother and sister are also regular customers here and recommended this clinic to me. After this experience, I will definitely not be coming back. Anyone considering booking an appointment at this clinic should think carefully. ***The doctor has contacted me to apologize for the incident. I understand that the doctor is very concerned and willing to take the mistake into consideration for improvement. The doctor did not request a change to the review, but I have decided to change the star rating.***

0x3102967c006afda3_0xd99b475a54a6d3af.text: I called and spoke with the English speaking receptionist, and I got an appointment about 7 days out. Walking in, I was very impressed with the office, professionally decorated and immaculate clean. Although in a busy area, it is very quiet inside. The treatment rooms are upstairs and are also very quiet. Dr. Korn speaks English very well and he did a thorough inspection of my mouth, prior to cleaning. He used a rotary cleaner & descaler that got all the calculus off my teeth, followed by a polishing. My teeth have never felt so smooth as they did after his treatment. The staff and the doctor are all very professional and the pricing is very reasonable. I felt like I was in Good hands and well taken care of. - I would come here again for more treatments, I highly recommend this clinic. They get High marks in professionalism and services provided. Motorbike Parking on side street, or ride cab, bhat bus. Car parking may be difficult.

0x3102967c006afda3_0xd99b475a54a6d3af.text: Outstanding dental clinic. Receptionists and other staff are friendly and professional. Comfy waiting area. He did the restorations about 7 months ago. I came back recently for a follow up and all looks good. I also had a mouth guard for Bruxism made and I am happy with that product. It is not the cheapest dental clinic in Pattaya but well worth the premium price. And still a fraction of what I would have paid back home for the same work.

0x30e29c197a9c08f5_0x6a9615bcab70a629.text: Open Rhinoplasty using ear cartilage: 79,000 THB (excluding medication and supplements) Overall, I was unimpressed even before the surgery. The consultation lasted less than 15 minutes. There was no analysis or drawing of the nose shape before surgery like seen in review videos. Furthermore, there were no facial X-rays, even for an open rhinoplasty! It was incredibly unconventional. The place was quite small, with no recovery room; I went home immediately after the procedure. The results didn't match the reference images I provided to the doctor. After 3 months, my nose felt only slightly more prominent, and after 6 months, it looked almost unchanged from before the surgery. I had previously seen many 1-star reviews, including comments on other platforms, about people needing revision rhinoplasty after the procedure. Initially, I thought this was normal, as no clinic can satisfy everyone, and I never expected it to happen to me. I had previously left a 1-star review, and the clinic called to ask me to remove it and wait 6 months for my nose to settle. I waited as instructed, but after 6 months, the result was even worse than after 3 months – completely sunken! I understand that everyone has a different nasal structure, and I knew my original nose was quite large and had a bulbous tip. However, if it's assessed that the desired shape cannot be achieved, this should be communicated before the surgery so that the patient can consider it carefully. Another issue is the 5,000 baht deposit required before the consultation with the doctor, which made the decision quite difficult because I didn't want to lose the deposit. I want to share my experience for those who are deciding: if you have any doubts or suspicions from the start, you should research and consider carefully before making a decision. For me, even after reviewing and observing for months before the procedure, I still made a mistake – losing money, time, and feeling disappointed. I didn't go to the consultation as the clinic requested because I had lost confidence and trust in them. I also felt that if the final result wasn't the desired shape, I might have to pay for corrections again anyway. So I chose to research and get it done elsewhere. 😂 This clinic might be suitable for people with small noses who prefer a natural, traditional look. Those who prefer a more prominent nose might be in the wrong place. P.S. I had the procedure done at the Chiang Mai branch with Dr. Da.

0x3102b777e240e6ad_0x7a915a12160762e.author: Janenies L

0x30e2a3b3c24de721_0x170c96f16590ccf9.text: เราเข้ามาปรึกษาเรื่องจัดฟันที่คลินิก เพราะมีปัญหาฟันซ้อนและไม่ค่อยมั่นใจเวลายิ้มค่ะ ตอนแรกแอบกังวล แต่พอได้เข้ามาที่คลินิก บรรยากาศสะอาดและพนักงานต้อนรับดีมาก ทำให้รู้สึกสบายใจขึ้นเยอะ คุณหมออธิบายขั้นตอนการจัดฟันละเอียดมาก ทั้งเรื่องแผนการรักษา ระยะเวลา และค่าใช้จ่าย ไม่มีการบังคับตัดสินใจเลยค่ะ ทำให้เรารู้สึกมั่นใจ ตอนติดเครื่องมือครั้งแรกตึง ๆ บ้างตามปกติ แต่คุณหมอให้คำแนะนำดีมาก และมีนัดติดตามผลสม่ำเสมอ ตอนนี้ฟันเริ่มเรียงตัวดีขึ้น เห็นความเปลี่ยนแปลงชัดเจน รู้สึกมั่นใจเวลายิ้มมากขึ้นค่ะ โดยรวมประทับใจมาก แนะนำสำหรับใครที่กำลังมองหาคลินิกจัดฟันค่ะ 😊
0x30e2a3b3c24de721_0x170c96f16590ccf9.author: Jidapa Tubtimkhiew
0x30e2a3b3c24de721_0x170c96f16590ccf9.en: I came to the clinic for a consultation about orthodontic treatment because I had crowded teeth and lacked confidence when smiling. Initially, I was a little worried, but once I arrived at the clinic, the clean atmosphere and the welcoming staff made me feel much more comfortable. The doctor explained the orthodontic treatment process in detail, including the treatment plan, duration, and cost. There was no pressure on my decision, which made me feel confident. The braces felt a little tight at first, as is normal, but the doctor gave excellent advice and scheduled regular follow-up appointments. Now my teeth are starting to align better, and I can see a clear improvement. I feel much more confident when I smile. Overall, I am very impressed and would recommend this clinic to anyone looking for orthodontic treatment. 😊

0x30e2a3b3c24de721_0x170c96f16590ccf9.text: The doctor gave very good advice. When the doctor told me I needed to have my tooth extracted, at first I was very scared. The doctor gave straightforward advice, but when it was actually done, it only hurt when the anesthetic was injected, like a fish bone stuck in my gums. When it was extracted, I didn't feel anything at all. After the extraction, the doctor gave me advice so I could act normally. The clinic is clean and the price is not as high as I was worried about... Thank you very much, doctor and team.
0x30e2a3b3c24de721_0x170c96f16590ccf9.author: NAPACHAI KLINDEE

0x30e2a3b3c24de721_0x170c96f16590ccf9.text: โทรนัดก่อนนะครับ คุณหมอเยอะแต่คิวก็เยอะด้วย จะได้ไม่มาเสียเที่ยว พนักงานต้อนรับดี บริการเก่ง ตั้งแต่โทรมาให้คำแนะนำดี นัดหมายเสร็จ พอมาถึงเสาร์อาทิตย์จอดรถหน้าร้านได้ หรือจอดที่ลานจอดของห้างข้างๆ ได้ ร้านมีชั้นบน สะอาด ตกแต่งดี วันนี้มาขูดหินปูนและอุดฟัน ใช้เบิกประกันกลุ่มได้เลย คุณพอพูดเพราะแนะนำดี
0x30e2a3b3c24de721_0x170c96f16590ccf9.author: Pitchanok Champathong
0x30e2a3b3c24de721_0x170c96f16590ccf9.en: Please call to make an appointment beforehand. There are many doctors, but also many waiting lists, so you won't waste your trip. The reception staff are friendly and provide excellent service. They gave good advice over the phone and helped schedule the appointment. On weekends, you can park in front of the clinic or in the parking lot of the mall next door. The clinic is upstairs, clean, and well-decorated. Today I came for teeth cleaning and fillings. I was able to use my group insurance. The dentist was polite and gave good advice.

0x30e2a3b3c24de721_0x170c96f16590ccf9.text: วันนี้มาใช้บริการที่นี้ คุณหมอใจดีมาก ให้คำแนะนำดี ประทับใจมากเลยค่ะ วันนี้มาปรึกษาคุณหมอเรื่อง ฟันห่างข้างหน้าด้านล่าง คุณหมอแนะนำให้ อุดร่องฟัน ไม่ต้องดัดฟัน ถูกใจมากกค่ะ 🥳 ซึ่งใช้เวลานิดเดียวไม่ถึงชั่วโมงทำเสร็จแล้ว ไวมากกค่าาา ออกมาสวยยเลยย ประทับใจมากๆค่ะะะ จะกลับมาใช้บริการอีกค่ะ
0x30e2a3b3c24de721_0x170c96f16590ccf9.author: Non
0x30e2a3b3c24de721_0x170c96f16590ccf9.en: I visited this clinic today and the doctor was very kind and gave great advice. I was very impressed! Today I consulted the doctor about my gap between my lower front teeth. The doctor recommended filling the gap so I wouldn't need braces. I'm so happy! 🥳 It only took a short time, less than an hour, and it was done very quickly! It looks beautiful now. I'm very impressed and will definitely come back again.

0x30e2a3b3c24de721_0x170c96f16590ccf9.text: ทำฟันกับคลินิกนี้ตั้งแต่สมัยฟันน้ำนมเลยค่ะจนตอนนี้อายุ 22 แล้ว มาจัดฟันกับคุณหมอรามเชื่อใจและวางใจคลินิกนี้ที่สุดเลยค่ะ และแนะนำเพื่อนหลายๆคนมาทำฟันที่นี้เหมือนกันพูดเป็นเสียงเดียวกันหมดเลยค่ะว่าดีมากคุณหมอมือเบามากและดูแลดี พนักงานก็น่ารักทุกคนเลยค่ะ

0x30e2a3b3c24de721_0x170c96f16590ccf9.en: I've been getting my teeth done at this clinic since I had baby teeth, and now I'm 22. I'm getting braces from Dr. Ram, and I trust this clinic completely. I've recommended many friends to get their dental work done here, and they all say the same thing: it's excellent, the doctor is very gentle, and the care is great. The staff are all lovely too.

0x30e2a3b3c24de721_0x170c96f16590ccf9.text: I've trusted and chosen Dr. Ram for over 10 years now, whether it's fillings, extractions, root canals, bridges, or most recently, dental implants. He's gentle, patient, and provides excellent advice.
0x30e2a3b3c24de721_0x170c96f16590ccf9.author: ผาติรัตน์ ดวงสวัสดิ์

0x30e2a3b3c24de721_0x170c96f16590ccf9.text: อยากจัดฟันมานานแล้วแต่กลัวต้องถอนฟัน และไม่ชอบเหล็กดัดฟันกลัวเจ็บ เลยตัดสินใจมาจัดฟันแบบ invisisalign เพราะเชื่อในมาตราฐานและฝีมือของคุณหมอ ใครสนใจลองมาสอบถามกันนะครับ
0x30e2a3b3c24de721_0x170c96f16590ccf9.en: I've wanted to get braces for a long time, but I was afraid of having teeth extracted and I didn't like metal braces because I was afraid of the pain. So I decided to get Invisalign because I trust in the doctor's standards and skill. If anyone is interested, feel free to inquire.

0x30e2a3b3c24de721_0x170c96f16590ccf9.text: Very impressed with good service. Dentist was very professional and detail. Really recommend for who looking for a good dental clinic and reasonable price

0x30e285f0cf4f94af_0x9193141cb77c8ea7.text: ประทับใจมาก มาขูดหินปูนประจำปี ราคาน่ารัก หรือ มีประกันสังคมมาใช้ได้เลย คุณหมอมือเบา ใจดี คลินิคสวยสะอาด เครื่องมือทันสมัย เดินทางง่ายมาก จอดรถที่ใต้สะพาน(ช่อง2) ชม ละ 5 บาท ติดกันเลย
0x30e285f0cf4f94af_0x9193141cb77c8ea7.en: Very impressed! I came for my annual teeth cleaning. The price is very reasonable, and you can use your social security insurance. The dentist is gentle and kind. The clinic is beautiful, clean, and has modern equipment. It's very easy to get to, and you can park under the bridge (lane 2) for 5 baht per hour right next door.

0x30e285f0cf4f94af_0x9193141cb77c8ea7.text: เจ้าหน้าที่ บริการดีค่ะ คุณหมอใจดีค่ะ คลินิกสะอาดค่ะ ส่วนตัวเป็นคนชอบลืมว่านัดวันไหนไว้ แต่พี่ๆเจ้าหน้าที่โทรมาแจ้งก่อนนัดทุกรอบเลยค่ะ แจ้งชัดเจนว่าต้องทำอะไรยังไงบ้าง ดีต่อใจฝุดๆค่า
0x30e285f0cf4f94af_0x9193141cb77c8ea7.en: The staff provided excellent service. The doctor was kind, and the clinic was clean. I tend to forget my appointments, but the staff called to remind me before every appointment, clearly explaining what needed to be done. It was very helpful!

0x30e285f0cf4f94af_0x9193141cb77c8ea7.text: The doctor is very meticulous, detailed and very much attentive. Took such a good care with my teeth :)
ขูดหินปูน+Airflow+Fluoride เร็ว,ไว ไม่เจ็บ สอบถามและบอกคนไข้ก่อนว่าต้องการทำอะไรบ้างค่าใช้จ่ายเท่าไหร่👍
0x30e285f0cf4f94af_0x9193141cb77c8ea7.en: Scaling + Airflow + Fluoride: Fast, efficient, and painless. Ask and inform the patient beforehand what they want and how much it will cost. 👍

0x30e285f0cf4f94af_0x9193141cb77c8ea7.text: ดูแลฟันที่คลินิก Helo ตลอดเลย มีการโทรตามด้วย เพราะส่วนตัวขี้ลืม หมอน่ารัก ห้องน้ำสะอาดมาก
0x30e285f0cf4f94af_0x9193141cb77c8ea7.en: I've had excellent dental care at Helo Clinic. They even called to follow up because I'm quite forgetful. The dentist is lovely and the restrooms are very clean.

0x30e285f0cf4f94af_0x9193141cb77c8ea7.text: Impressive experience. Skillful and friendly dentists . Clean and tidy environment :-)
คลินิกสะอาด คุณหมอมือเบา ไห้คำปรึกษาดีมากๆๆพูดคุยเป็นกันเอง ไว้จะมาใช้บริการอีกนะคะ🙏
0x30e285f0cf4f94af_0x9193141cb77c8ea7.en: The clinic is clean, the doctor is gentle, and provides excellent advice. They are very friendly and easy to talk to. I will definitely come back again. 🙏

0x30e285f0cf4f94af_0x9193141cb77c8ea7.text: ควรถามราคาก่อนทำ เพราะราคา ค่อนข้างแพง เราขุดหินปูนจับเวลาไม่เกิน 5 นาที ราคา 1200 แก้ไขเพิ่ม *** วันนี้เรามาส่องดูฟัน ไม่สะอาดด้วย เลยต้องไปขูดเพิ่มที่คลินิกอื่น เราคงไม่กลับไปอีกแล้ว เสียความรู้สึกที่นั่งรอ ติดป้ายแจ้งราคาไว้? เรท900-1200 แต่ขูด5นาทีคิดที่ ราคาสูงสุดเลยเหรอ หรือ อุดฟัน20-30นาที ทางคลินิกไม่ควรมาอ้างเรื่องเวลา เพราะเราไม่ได้ทำฟรี เวลามันนานหรือสั้นก็ต้องทำมั้ย? แต่ถ้าจะอ้างก็เอาความจริงมาพูดดีกว่า คือ โดยรวมขูดหินปูน 5 นาที ฟันอุดไม่ได้มีปัญหาเยอะ รวม10นาที พอ
0x30e285f0cf4f94af_0x9193141cb77c8ea7.en: You should ask for the price before proceeding because it's quite expensive. We had our teeth cleaned (tartar removed) in under 5 minutes for 1200 baht. ***Correction/Addition:*** Today, we came back to check our teeth and they weren't clean, so we had to go to another clinic for further cleaning. We won't be going back again. It was a disappointing experience waiting. They have a price list displayed? Rates are 900-1200 baht, but they charged the highest price for a 5-minute cleaning? Or a filling that takes 20-30 minutes? The clinic shouldn't use time as an excuse, because we weren't getting it for free. Whether it's a short or long time, it has to be done, right? But if they're going to make excuses, they should tell the truth. Overall, the tartar removal took 5 minutes, and the filling didn't have many problems, so the total was 10 minutes. End

0x30e29701ddb92a33_0xb1acc5251708aa69.text: Our family has been receiving treatment here since our son was in kindergarten, and now he's working. The doctor is wonderful and explains everything clearly before treatment. The staff are also incredibly lovely and provide excellent service. 👍
0x30e29701ddb92a33_0xb1acc5251708aa69.author: R.SOONTORNWAN

0x30e29701ddb92a33_0xb1acc5251708aa69.text: I liked the care and the follow-up on appointments; they didn't leave me hanging! Also, the doctor explained every step of the procedure, which made me feel relaxed. Parking was convenient too, with parking available at the back of the clinic.

0x30e29701ddb92a33_0xb1acc5251708aa69.text: I've been getting my dental work done here for a very long time. The dentist, assistants, and staff provide excellent and impressive service. The clinic is clean. I recommend it.

0x30e29701ddb92a33_0xb1acc5251708aa69.text: Dr. Supron is lovely. Convenient parking. Spacious waiting area. We come as a whole family. My daughter has been coming here since she was a child until she's all grown up now.

0x30e29701ddb92a33_0xb1acc5251708aa69.text: For those who need to have a tooth extracted here, there's no need to be afraid because it's not painful at all and the extraction is very quick. It'll be done in no time.

I pay a lot for retainers and have to pay again for ridiculous 200 baht Good on you!!!!!!!!!!!

0x311d5fd4628c8561_0xbb4522a45e006656.text: Finally found a good physiotherapy clinic near my house. It's convenient and has parking. The initial treatments improved it, but due to my lifestyle and work, the condition hasn't completely gone away. However, the doctor and the team are patient and understanding in their treatment. If you're looking for a good physiotherapy clinic in the ABAC area, I highly recommend trying this one 👍

0x311d5fd4628c8561_0xbb4522a45e006656.text: Based on my experience taking my father for treatment for a stroke that caused weakness on the left side of his body, starting from being unable to care for himself, to now, 8 months later, he can walk on his own although he still needs a crutch, but he is much better than before. The doctors and nurses provided excellent service, caring for us like family. The clinic was clean, the service was friendly, it was conveniently located, and there was ample parking. In summary, everything was excellent. 💕
0x311d5fd4628c8561_0xbb4522a45e006656.author: แล้วแต่ คนชอบ

0x311d5fd4628c8561_0xbb4522a45e006656.text: This is a very sincere physiotherapy clinic. All the staff are very caring. Dr. Tukta, who runs the clinic, is even more concerned about us than we are about ourselves. I went for physiotherapy for Bell's Palsy (facial paralysis) and after 5 sessions, my condition improved. I highly recommend it. You'll recover quickly with physiotherapy here.

The staff here are friendly, give great advice, and provide excellent care.

0x311d63863244f36d_0x272fa4ab4c214bbe.author: Muthita Kwangausen
0x311d63863244f36d_0x272fa4ab4c214bbe.en: The atmosphere at this clinic was very warm and welcoming. The staff were friendly and remembered who was who and what they were doing. Dr. Anut, the orthodontist, gave excellent advice, had a gentle voice, and was very gentle. I saw a clear change after the treatment was completed. I'm very impressed! Before, I didn't like showing my teeth, but now I smile a lot no matter what I'm doing. My protruding teeth made me very self-conscious; people would always ask about my teeth and stare, which I didn't like. I was always shy about smiling and hiding my teeth in photos. But after the treatment, I'm so confident and I smile all the time! I love looking in the mirror and smiling all the time. I was a little worried at first about the results and if the cost would spiral out of control, but once the payments were complete, there were no additional charges. There might have been some minor tartar removal, but if you maintain good dental hygiene, you won't need to pay extra. I was a little concerned because it took longer than I expected, probably because everyone's teeth are different and maybe my own habits also played a role. But believe me, the results are amazing! Finally, thank you so much to the doctor and all the staff for taking such good care of me and helping someone who didn't dare smile to smile again. Thank you!

The doctor whitened his teeth three times over a two-hour period, resulting in perfect whitening. The cost was also cheaper than in Korea. My husband was very satisfied. If you need a dentist in Chiang Mai, I highly recommend this place.

0x30da31832c2f075f_0xa83b3bdf9436cfd3.en: A casual visitor to Chiang Mai. This year I haven't used my social security benefits at a dental clinic yet because it's almost the end of the year. So I wanted to get my teeth cleaned (tartar removed). I searched for dental clinics in Chiang Mai and ended up at Groove Dental Clinic based on reviews. *I wasn't disappointed!* From the moment I stepped into the clinic, two female receptionists were smiling, cheerful, and very friendly. 🤗 I had my teeth cleaned by Dr. Chutima (I found out her name later), who was incredibly gentle. Picking my teeth hurt more than this! 555 I highly recommend this clinic. If you've had painful or sensitive teeth cleaning elsewhere, try this place. I'll definitely use their services again next time I visit Chiang Mai. 5 stars!

0x30da31832c2f075f_0xa83b3bdf9436cfd3.text: We chose this office based on distance from our accommodation. We were able to book an appointment through Facebook messenger. 0x3054f65b515fd31b_0x483a8866aa78da35.text: I had the most wonderful experience with Rapheepan Clinic throughout my entire pregnancy and delivery. Dr. Rapheepan guided my pregnancy from the very beginning, and I always felt safe, supported, and truly cared for. She is calm, highly professional, and very confident in her decisions — which gave me so much trust during such an important time in my life. My labor was extremely long — 35 hours of contractions — and it was not easy. With another doctor, I am quite sure I would have ended up with a C-section. But Dr. Rapheepan gave me the opportunity to continue naturally. She monitored everything carefully, supported me patiently through the process, and when necessary, we made the decision to break my water. Thanks to her experience and steady guidance, I was able to give birth naturally. I am deeply grateful for that. Now I happily bring my daughter for regular pediatric checkups at the clinic as well. It feels comforting to stay with the same team who supported me throughout my pregnancy journey. Highly recommended for any mother looking for professional care with genuine heart and dedication. 💛

0x3054f65b515fd31b_0x483a8866aa78da35.text: Dear ladies, I strongly advise against using this clinic's services. I contacted them with questions about my reproductive function, wanted to get tested, have my hormonal levels assessed, and was planning a pregnancy. At the very first consultation, they immediately offered me several options for planning a pregnancy, including ovulation stimulation, and many other options, assuring me that they specialize in reproductive function. After the tests and hormones (my levels were fine, except for low AMH), we moved on to ovulation stimulation, and there were so many nuances that it became clear they had no experience in this area, and their desire to help me was more likely a profit motive. But I was already taking hormonal medications. The main points: I wasn't seen by a single doctor; out of five appointments, I only saw two different doctors, and those were different doctors. The other appointments were with nurses and an intern (but they always charged full fees for the doctor's visit, even for a short consultation with the intern). During the follicle stimulation phase, the doctor ignored my requests to pay attention to my short cycle and to have a follow-up ultrasound to assess follicle growth (before the hCG injection). I was scheduled for a period well after ovulation, even though hCG should be administered before ovulation. I insisted on two additional ultrasounds. The ultrasounds showed low endometrial levels. I was refused prolactin support or other medications during the second phase of stimulation twice. At the follow-up and most important ultrasound to assess follicle growth, an intern was present and told me he was not competent to evaluate the images. I waited over an hour while they consulted with a doctor in Bangkok. After the hCG injection, I was given no advice about the consequences, normal discharge, or anything else, despite repeatedly asking for my appointments to be addressed and endometrial growth support to be performed after the hCG injection. Later, when I expressed my concerns, they treated me rudely and suggested I go to a specialized clinic for IVF before the procedure was even completed. After the hCG injection, they didn't interact with me at all, never asking how the pregnancy stimulation process went, how I was feeling, whether there were any side effects, etc. I then consulted with other doctors. While this stimulation likely resulted in fertilization, the fetus didn't attach to the endometrium, and I had prolonged bleeding. Doctors at other clinics, including Bangkok Hospital, confirmed that the ovulation stimulation process had been carried out with several violations and that this clinic was not competent in matters of reproductive function. Unfortunately, I received reviews about the clinic from other women and expats too late. Furthermore, the clinic insisted on me buying vitamins and supplements from them, as a matter of course. I was very nervous, realizing that I was taking hormonal medications without proper support and supervision from doctors. It took me time to recover physically and mentally. I really hope my review will help someone avoid a similar experience.
0x3054f65b515fd31b_0x483a8866aa78da35.author: Алена Штаер

0x3051c1ee2d845cdf_0xca35720d32aa55cd.text: The service was excellent, it is very clean, modern & comfortable! Dental Box Clinic is fairly new to AoNang, approximately 12 months old, it wasn’t here during our previous visit. So we decided to give this new dentist a try last night. We both had our teeth cleaned and scaled and are both very satisfied. The prices are reasonable and the clinic is in a good location, easy to travel to while staying in AoNang. At times it was a little hard to hear or understand what the dentist is saying to you, as he is wearing a mask and also a shield. So just be a little patient and ask him politely to repeat himself, or let him know that you can’t hear him. I was very impressed with their communications, as I contacted them by WhatsApp to make enquires and a booking, they responded promptly! Keep up the good service and well done to the staff at this practice! 🙏👍

Since returning home The Dental Box have kindly sent details through of their findings together with xray photos for my local dentist so i can continue my treatment. Thank you for your care.

0x30da3b4a464dc33b_0x521cf0aa7f8655b8.text: When it comes to physiotherapy, injuries and physical pain what i value most is a human approach mixed with top notch skills and professionalism. I come here for rehab after a nasty fracture, prehab for a complex reconstruction surgery, weekly sports massages to maintain my high intensity training routine and will also come here for rehab after my surgery. One of the best if not the best physiotherapy and sport clinics in Chiang Mai! 0x30da3b4a464dc33b_0x521cf0aa7f8655b8.text: I highly recommend this physiotherapy clinic. They genuinely focus on identifying and treating the root cause of your problem rather than just masking symptoms or telling you to stop exercising. The approach here is movement-based: instead of prescribing rest or painkillers, they work with your body to restore proper function. The team is highly professional and clearly experienced in working with athletes. I’m active in tennis, cycling, and gym training, and I came in with two issues: shoulder pain and numbness in my thigh. Both problems were resolved fairly quickly. My treatment included physiotherapy sessions, cupping, and hands-on muscle release techniques. Most importantly, they taught me specific exercises to activate the correct muscles, improve strength, and build an effective warm-up routine for tennis. Overall, I’m very satisfied with the results and the level of care.

0x30da3b4a464dc33b_0x521cf0aa7f8655b8.text: I’ve been doing knee rehab with Man for the past 11 months after ACL surgery and I’ve been so impressed with his knowledge and skills. 0x3051bfec4e5d0e01_0xca8810d05aea059c.text: I needed to get a PCR test in Krabi, and I came here because it was conveniently located and seemed to have good reviews. In my case, I had to leave on Monday night, so I emailed to ask if the clinic was open on Sunday. I received a promising response that even if I got the test on Saturday, it would still be available on Sunday. They also said that if I got the test before 10 AM on Monday, the results would be available by 5 PM. This made my trip much more comfortable. I initially went at 5:20 PM on Saturday, but it was already closed, so I was disappointed. I went on Monday morning, got the test done, and received the results by email around 3 PM. Thanks to them, my trip was smooth. The person who tested me was very friendly, and they even had a cat with them.

0x30503159f71be5cf_0x2301ad4f7cfeecd7.text: I just had a tooth extracted yesterday. I had tooth sensitivity for about two weeks, but I thought it was just a simple cavity, so I went to a clinic in another province to get a filling. After the dentist examined me, they recommended extraction because the cavity was deep and a filling probably wouldn't hold. But I'm afraid of needles and tooth extraction, so I insisted on getting a filling first. The dentist filled it but warned me that if I still had pain or sensitivity after a month, I should get it extracted. Before filling, the dentist asked if I wanted local anesthesia, and I said no. It was very sensitive during the procedure, and afterward, it hurt a lot for about three hours. Even paracetamol didn't help. About 1-2 weeks later, I started having pain in the same tooth that had been filled, so I decided to have it extracted at this clinic because I'd seen good reviews. Honestly, I was terrified before the extraction. The staff checked my blood pressure twice because my heart was beating fast. After the examination and X-rays, the dentist said the tooth was decayed. I decided to have it extracted. The dentist injected local anesthesia, and I didn't feel any pain. I waited 10 minutes for the anesthesia to take effect. Then, the dentist extracted the tooth in 10 seconds – it was very quick and easy. I was still wondering if it was over already; it was so fast! The dentist was great, and the staff were polite and provided good service. They also gave me a post-extraction instruction sheet. Having a tooth extracted at this clinic wasn't as scary as I thought. When I got home, the anesthetic was wearing off, so I ate some meatballs. After the anesthetic wore off, I didn't feel any pain at all. Now I just have to wait for the wound to heal.
0x30503159f71be5cf_0x2301ad4f7cfeecd7.author: นุสรา โส๊บเหม๊าะ

0x311d66a0272c18f5_0x62d167c056446c9e.text: I had my wisdom teeth removed with Dr. Nang. She and her assistants were very kind. The wire was pushing into my cheek, causing a long-lasting wound. My previous clinic told me it was normally inserted, and then they left it there for a long time. Here, the doctor asked if it hurt, but didn't ask, just ignored it. He asked if I could cut the wire. After the procedure, my mouth felt so comfortable that I wanted to transfer my orthodontic treatment to her. Haha. I'm very afraid of anesthetic needles, and I already have low blood pressure. The assistant offered me a hand to squeeze. The doctor said he would push the anesthetic very slowly so it wouldn't hurt. During the procedure, the doctor and assistants kept asking if it hurt, not to tense up, if I could take a break, if my gums were numb. "Breathe, don't hold your breath." The doctor explained in stages what to do next. She's meticulous, works slowly, and doesn't rush. She prioritizes the patient's feelings and pain, rather than rushing through a large number of cases. I was quoted nearly 5,000 baht per tooth at other places because I have a difficult-to-reach wisdom tooth. Especially now that October has a promotion for wisdom tooth extraction, it's 2,500 baht. Come here, it's cheap, I paid 2,700 baht and got medicine to take home. The counter staff were friendly and helpful. There's plenty of parking available along the street.

0x30e2833d34de55cd_0xe3415a3ed68de2be.text: มาอุดฟันกราม เพราะ ที่อุดฟันเก่า 30 กว่าปีแตกหลุด โทรมานัดไว้ล่วงหน้า วันอังคาร บ่าย 2 ไม่มีคิว จนท.ต้อนรับ จนพี่แม่บ้าน และ จนท.รปภ ช่วยโบกรถออกถนนใหญ่ บริการ ดูแลดี รอประมาณ 10 นาที ก็ได้ทำฟัน คุณหมอ ทพ.ศุภวิทย์ ทัศนะเมธี ละเอียด ส่องจนพบฟันผุใต้ที่อุดฟันไว้เพิ่ม และเลาะสารที่อุดฟันที่เหลือให้ อุดใหม่ทั้งหมด ใช้เวลาน้อยมาก อุดรวม 20 นาที ฟันบน-ล่างขบกันได้พอดีเป๊ะ ไม่มีอะไรนูนออกมา ไม่เสียวหรือเจ็บขณะทำฟัน ทั้งที่เตรียมใจไว้แล้ว 😊 (อีกส่วนนึงนอกจากฝีมือความชำนาญของคุณหมอ อาจเป็นเพราะยังไม่ใกล้เส้นประสาทมากหรือเปล่าไม่รู้) ครั้งนี้ก็ยังเลือกอุดด้วยสารอะมัลกัม สีเงิน ไม่สวย แต่ทนทานไม่หลุดแตกง่าย จนท.ดูดน้ำลาย ก็ดูดตลอดเอาใจใส่ดีมาก อุด 1 ซี่ 2 ด้าน ราคา 2150 บาท ใช้ ปกสค ไป 900 บาท เหลือจ่ายจริง 1250 บาท ขอบคุณ คุณหมอ และ จนท.ทุกท่านมากค่ะ ประทับใจ🥰 🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀 ห้องโถงรับรอง กว้าง ดูทันสมัย มีเก้าอี้นวดอัตโนมัติ มีน้ำหวานเฮลบลูบอย น้ำเปล่า ขนมขบเคี้ยว และ เครื่องทำกาแฟอัตโนมัติ ไว้รับรองระหว่างรอ กาแฟมีความหอมในตัวบอกคุณภาพได้ระดับนึง ที่จอดรถมีอยู่ด้านหน้าริมถนน 2 ช่อง และเลยไปเข้าซอยด้านข้าง มีที่จอดรถด้านหลังได้อีกหลายคัน

0x30e2833d34de55cd_0xe3415a3ed68de2be.en: I came to get a molar filled because my old filling, over 30 years old, had cracked and fallen out. I called to make an appointment in advance for Tuesday at 2 PM. There were no available slots. The staff, including the cleaning lady and security guard who helped direct me to the main road, were very welcoming and attentive. I waited about 10 minutes before getting my tooth done. Dr. Supavit Tasnameethee was meticulous, examining the tooth thoroughly and finding additional decay under the old filling. He removed the remaining filling material and replaced the entire tooth. It took very little time, about 20 minutes in total. My upper and lower teeth fit together perfectly afterwards; nothing protruded. I didn't experience any sensitivity or pain during the procedure, even though I was prepared for it 😊 (Part of it, besides the doctor's skill and expertise, might be because it wasn't too close to a nerve, I don't know). This time, I chose amalgam filling again; it's silver, not aesthetically pleasing, but durable and less likely to crack or fall out. The staff suctioned my saliva. The dentist was very attentive and provided excellent care. The filling for one tooth (two sides) cost 2150 baht. I used my social security benefits for 900 baht, leaving me with 1250 baht to pay. Thank you so much to the doctor and all the staff. I was very impressed. 🥰 🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀🍀 The waiting area is spacious and modern, with automatic massage chairs, complimentary Helly Blue Boy syrup, water, snacks, and an automatic coffee machine. The coffee has a nice aroma and reflects its quality. There are two parking spaces in front along the street, and several more parking spaces in the back via the side alley.

0x30e29ff87d5c3c31_0x96e61010e15cab30.text: One person's experience is just a story; you have to experience it yourself. 0x30e29ff87d5c3c31_0x96e61010e15cab30.text: I'm writing this honest review to provide information for those who are making a decision, and hopefully, it will serve as feedback for the clinic to improve. First, I must confirm that my previous dental implant treatment with Dr. Arthiphan was excellent; the implants worked normally without any problems. I can attest that he is gentle and provides good advice, which is why I have always trusted him. However, after two years, the crown came loose, requiring treatment with another doctor. I didn't mind this, as I thought either doctor would do. What I encountered was: - A lack of clear explanation of the treatment plan. - Unanswered questions, leaving the patient confused about what was happening. - The atmosphere and methods during the procedure lacked professionalism, making me feel unsafe. *After the treatment: - Less than 24 hours later, the implant came loose again. I wouldn't question the quality or procedures if I had received better communication. - I experienced pain and numbness in my face, from below my eyes down to the corners of my mouth, for up to three days. This is very worrying for a patient. - My messages on LINE were read but not replied to multiple times. • Phone calls went unanswered. • When I urged for a quicker response, I was simply told to wait. Without any assistance in assessing symptoms or providing any information, during a time when the patient was experiencing significant distress and anxiety, the lack of response or such a response is not just a matter of service, but a matter of “responsibility towards the patient” that should be given greater importance. Even though I later met with the attending physician who provided the same level of care and explanation, the previous incident clearly impacted my confidence. Hopefully, this feedback will help the clinic improve its patient care.
0x30e29ff87d5c3c31_0x96e61010e15cab30.author: Primo

0x30da3b3b453b4fe1_0xe8a544e713732605.text: The clinic, conveniently situated on the main road of Chotana Road, is easy to locate and offers a clean and cozy atmosphere. Today, I went for an eye check-up, and I was impressed by the friendly doctor who provided honest suggestions for maintaining my eye health. For those living in the area, I highly recommend this clinic, especially as the doctor speaks English fluently.
0x30da3b3b453b4fe1_0xe8a544e713732605.author: Ern Weerakan

0x30da3b3b453b4fe1_0xe8a544e713732605.text: I had a bump on my eye for several days, and eye drops didn't help. I saw Dr. Satthawat, who diagnosed it as a stye. He lanced it gently, and my symptoms improved in two days. Thank you so much, doctor! I highly recommend this clinic. The prices are reasonable, the doctor and the counter staff are very helpful and provide excellent information. Parking is convenient.
0x30da3b3b453b4fe1_0xe8a544e713732605.author: Kannanat ChareonphongThai

0x30da3b3b453b4fe1_0xe8a544e713732605.text: I had an excellent experience at Sattawas Eye Clinic! The staff were incredibly friendly and professional, and the doctor took the time to explain my eye condition thoroughly. The clinic is clean, modern, and the hours are very convenient—they even stay open late on weekdays. I highly recommend this place to anyone needing eye care in Chiang Mai!
0x30da3b3b453b4fe1_0xe8a544e713732605.author: Jerry Cao

0x30da3b3b453b4fe1_0xe8a544e713732605.text: I visited this clinic twice for an eye problem. My condition seemed to be improving, but I received a phone call reminding me to return the next day for a follow-up visit. The reminder call made me feel a little pressured to return. During the second visit, I was charged more than the first visit, which was unexpected for a follow-up appointment based on my past experiences at other clinics. I was also given the same medicine that I already had, and I still had a significant amount of the medicine from the first prescription remaining at that time. Also, unlike other clinics I have visited, I did not receive a detailed receipt for the medication. I could not see how much was charged for the consultation and how much for the medicine. I hope the clinic can provide clearer explanations about whether follow-up visits are really necessary, avoid re-prescribing medicine when patients already have enough remaining, and give patients a detailed receipt for transparency.
0x30da3b3b453b4fe1_0xe8a544e713732605.author: SEONGKWON KIM (SEIZEPOWER)

0x30e281b678ffed13_0x4d91ed13628c1691.en: This dental clinic was a fantastic first for my child, and I was so impressed! From the service at the counter to the treatment, everything was excellent. My child even said they want to come back again! The clinic is very clean and has lots of toys to help children relax before their appointment. Most importantly, the prices are very reasonable. If you're in the area, I highly recommend this clinic! 👍👍👍 👩🏻‍⚕️ Dental Clinic 🚘 Parking available in front of the building.

The price was very reasonable, comparable to the clinic I used to go to Chulalongkorn University. My child says they want to come back again! 😅

0x30e281b678ffed13_0x4d91ed13628c1691.en: The doctor was very kind and patient. She had great chemistry when talking to children, explaining and teaching them how to care for their teeth. 0x30e281b678ffed13_0x4d91ed13628c1691.text: Excellent location, very happy with the dental services for my son. He loved the playroom downstairs and was all smiles during his one year old exam too.

0x30e281b678ffed13_0x4d91ed13628c1691.text: Very comfortable atmosphere not only for the kids but also their parents. Easy to find and convenient parking lot. …

0x30da3a62732e16bd_0x8271f5cfccb7a48f.text: So after spending countless hours in airplanes and airports I arrived in Chiang Mai Thailand completely jet lagged. An exact 12 hour difference meant day was night and night was day to my body. So I decided to go to Absolute Health Clinic for some hyperbaric oxygen therapy. I must say that they have a courteous and knowledgeable staff, and doctor. The clinic is in a nice area near the airport very comfortable inside the rooms. The booth was equipped with a reclining chair as they pumped 95% oxygen into the pressurized space and for an hour I just breathed. That was yesterday and last night was the best sleep I have had this trip.
0x30da3a62732e16bd_0x8271f5cfccb7a48f.author: blaise cuff

0x30da3a62732e16bd_0x8271f5cfccb7a48f.text: Top notch facility, staff and doctor. I had not done my labs since before the pandemic and happy to have discovered this place a few weeks ago. Select staff and the doctor himself speak English well and I like their naturopathic approach to health. The Dr. answered all of my many questions about natural health and is very kind overall. Prices are reasonable and well below similar Western facilities back home. This will surely be my go to health care facility/provider while I am in Chiang Mai.
0x30da3a62732e16bd_0x8271f5cfccb7a48f.author: Will Manuel

0x30da3a62732e16bd_0x8271f5cfccb7a48f.text: I had a very positive experience with this clinic for hyperbaric oxygen therapy. The staff were professional, knowledgeable, and made sure I felt comfortable throughout the session. The facility was clean and well organized, and everything was clearly explained before starting treatment. The sessions themselves were calm and well monitored, which made the process easy and stress-free. I appreciated the care and attention to detail and would recommend this clinic to anyone considering HBOT.
0x30da3a62732e16bd_0x8271f5cfccb7a48f.author: R No

0x30da3a62732e16bd_0x8271f5cfccb7a48f.text: I did EDTA Chelation today and decided I will extend my stay in Chiang Mai and complete my long term chelation here rather than in Bangkok. The doctors and the nurses, the professionalism of the place, the comfort and service all class A and made my chelation feel a lot easier. I will continue treatment here for my Uranium poisoning. Thank you
0x30da3a62732e16bd_0x8271f5cfccb7a48f.author: Michelangelo Mangione

0x30da3a62732e16bd_0x8271f5cfccb7a48f.text: If you are concerned about your health, then this is the place for you. Highly sophisticated facility, offering cutting edge treatments at remarkably reasonable prices. The service, staff efficiency, and overall satisfaction could not be higher. Thanks, Absolute Health, you have given me hope again. I can't wait to book further appointments.
0x30da3a62732e16bd_0x8271f5cfccb7a48f.author: Nick Williams

0x30da3a62732e16bd_0x8271f5cfccb7a48f.text: The atmosphere is great. It's spacious, clean, and very well-organized. All the staff provide excellent service; they are always smiling and polite. The doctor is kind, gives detailed advice, and takes attentive care throughout the process. I feel comfortable every time I come; it feels more like a vacation than a doctor's appointment.
0x30da3a62732e16bd_0x8271f5cfccb7a48f.author: Tanisorn nalamplun

0x30da3a62732e16bd_0x8271f5cfccb7a48f.text: I went here on a recommendation from another foreigner. The treatment I received for back and neck pain was ok. I asked the doctor about hrt and he pretended to know what he was doing. I had to take 2 blood tests which were expensive because he "forgot" to do the proper blood work for hormones. So I had to pay again for more blood work even though it was their mistake. Then I was given low grade estrogen cream and progesterone cream which wasn't even the right ratio to protect my uterus. All for almost $600 USD later. Those creams were ordered off of Lazada for barely $30 usd and put into cute little syringes to look fancy. They charged me almost $400 USD for crappy low grade creams .Then I had to pay for 2 blood tests. I have had different hrt in USA. I ACTUALLY COULD TELL THE DIFFERENCE. It did nothing for me except take money. I personally would like my money back. I went to a Gyn here at another clinic and the hormones were actually effective and only about $15 USD. Don't trust this place. They think foreigners are too stupid. I should have realized when they messed up blood work and made me pay again both times were almost $200 USD. I'm disappointed because I thought the medical professionals here we're honest. Now I learned. I value integrity especially when it comes to my personal well being and health.
0x30da3a62732e16bd_0x8271f5cfccb7a48f.author: misty pope

0x311d63e79e15bd95_0xff7857000c337969.text: Today I used my 30-baht healthcare benefit. The doctor was very skilled, conducted a thorough examination, and gave excellent advice. She was very cheerful and lovely. The staff and nurses also provided excellent service.
0x311d63e79e15bd95_0xff7857000c337969.author: Kornchanok Warapakornkul

0x311d63e79e15bd95_0xff7857000c337969.text: This is a clinic that accepts the universal healthcare scheme. The doctor was very polite, gave good advice, and asked detailed questions about my symptoms. I was very impressed, even though it was my first visit.
0x311d63e79e15bd95_0xff7857000c337969.author: อําไพ บัวหุง

0x311d63e79e15bd95_0xff7857000c337969.text: The doctor and the staff were so lovely! I went yesterday and they spoke very politely and without any hesitation. We paid in cash for the medication and examination, so it was very cheap.💖 …

0x311d63e79e15bd95_0xff7857000c337969.text: Today I went to get a medical certificate for 200 baht. The staff at the front desk were very helpful. The interior was clean, smelled nice, and was hygienic.

0x311d63e79e15bd95_0xff7857000c337969.text: The staff are so lovely! I'll be coming back often. ❤️❤️ The one wearing glasses is the cutest!

0x30e29dee7ea48845_0x5986fb1f46d86474.text: Spacious area with easy parking, a variety of restaurant brands, plus a Foodland, dental clinic, pet food store, and hair salon nearby. It's right next to a PTT gas station with a Kasikorn Bank, so you don't have to go far at all. Plenty of parking available, and there's even a car wash. I highly recommend this place.
0x30e29dee7ea48845_0x5986fb1f46d86474.author: Amando_gg

0x30e29dee7ea48845_0x5986fb1f46d86474.text: When I visited, it was a soft opening and the place wasn't fully completed yet. There's parking both in front and on the side, next to the PTT gas station on Soi Saimai 56. It's a new place with different restaurants than those at PTT and Saimai Avenue. If you have the chance, I recommend checking it out.
0x30e29dee7ea48845_0x5986fb1f46d86474.author: Nuts k

The only drawback is the lack of an ATM.

0x30e29dee7ea48845_0x5986fb1f46d86474.text: There is a Foodland supermarket and a variety of restaurants such as Hajiban, Salad Factory, MK. It is quite convenient. There is enough parking.

0x30e29dee7ea48845_0x5986fb1f46d86474.text: The parking lot on the side should be improved. The angle of the parking line is not good, making it impossible for cars to park in the correct spaces.

0x311d644ff0feb1b9_0x9b854dbd9b45e6b3.text: Thank you to the doctor and the support team for taking such good care of Chompoo and bringing her back to our family. From the day we brought her in, she was very weak, had a catheter inserted, wasn't eating, was vomiting, not urinating, and was walking unsteadily with her leg bent. She was admitted to Pet House Veterinary Hospital for 7 days. The price was friendly, and the deposit was very reasonable. On the second day, I asked the doctor, and she said she was eating. At first, I didn't believe it, so I came to feed her and visit almost every day. She really was eating! She's been home for two days now. She's urinating frequently, but still not completely recovered. We're following the doctor's advice, continuing with medication and IV fluids. Thank you for saving Chompoo's life. Thank you also for letting this veterinary clinic pop up in my feed when I was looking for a new one for her, as it's not far from home.💖 I will definitely recommend them to others.
0x311d644ff0feb1b9_0x9b854dbd9b45e6b3.author: Piyakron Suksri

0x311d644ff0feb1b9_0x9b854dbd9b45e6b3.text: I took my dog ​​to the vet urgently late at night. I dropped him off and when I picked him up, his nose seemed to have been cut by grooming scissors; it was bleeding profusely. The vet and assistant staff were very attentive. The nighttime clinic fees were also very reasonable. Highly recommend this clinic in the Rom Klao area.

0x311d644ff0feb1b9_0x9b854dbd9b45e6b3.text: I was very impressed with the doctor and his assistants. I once took a stray cat in for treatment, and the doctor did everything he could to provide excellent care. I was very impressed.

0x30e29bafb19a0615_0xa3dda20141b1e2e0.en: Today I had a front tooth filled and a teeth cleaning done by Dr. Chompoo. She's available every Sunday. The filling was done beautifully. The teeth cleaning was a little sensitive, but I've never had such a gentle touch before. She's lovely and kind, and the clinic provides excellent service. I highly recommend it to my friends!

0x30e29bafb19a0615_0xa3dda20141b1e2e0.text: บริการดีมาก จัดฟันครั้งที่2 ผ่าฟันคุดหมอมือเบามาก หลังผ่า2-3วัน ไม่มีอาการปวดเลย ทานยาตามที่หมอสั่งอาการปวดเจ็บแผลไม่มีเลย บวมนิดหน่อย 💖

0x30e29e4e870f1a39_0xe4437edad85767fc.text: I had two dental implants with Dr. Warangkana in 2024. Before the procedure, I was afraid of the pain, but the doctor injected anesthesia with a very gentle hand. Afterward, there was only a little swelling and pain. I took only one pill to reduce the swelling. I only took the painkiller for one day because there was no pain or discomfort, so I stopped taking it. Today, 10/10/25, marks the third month since I had crowns. I returned for a checkup. The doctor gave me advice on care and maintenance, and I was satisfied with the results. Today, I had some questions about flossing, so I asked the doctor about brushing and the proper way to floss. The doctor recommended using flat floss and should do so after brushing. Avoid using toothpicks or small toothbrushes, as they can cause gum recession. I personally like the atmosphere at the clinic; it's like a spa, and it's not crowded.

0x30e29e4e870f1a39_0xe4437edad85767fc.text: อยากมาเล่าประสบการณ์ การจัดฟัน ก่อนจะมาจัดฟันที่คลินิกนี้และได้พบกับคุณคุณหมอที่น่ารักที่คลินิก กับคุณหมอวรางคณา คุณหมอมือเบามาก มีสียางให้เลือกเยอะ คลินิกสะอาดที่สุดและเราอยากจะบอกว่าเคยผ่านการจัดฟันมาแล้วที่คลินิกเดิม (ของไม่เอ่ยชื่อคลินิกเดิมคะ) จัดกับคลินิกเดิมปี ไแลไม่รู้สึกว่าฟันเข้าที่เลยและถอนฟันเราได้เกือบทุกเดือน ไม่มีการแนะนำจนทำให้เราตัดสินใจย้ายคลินิกและได้ค้นพบคลินิก The Tooth Club การจัดฟันที่คลินิกนี้เป็นการจัดฟันครั้งที่ 2 ซึ่งเป็นการย้ายเคส ที่เรียกว่าย้ายคลินิกเพื่อจัดฟันใหม่อีกครั้งนั่นเอง จะบอกว่าประทับใจมากที่ได้เจอคุณหมอที่เก่ง ทางเราขอคุณหมอจัดฟันให้เสร็จภายในหนึ่งปีซึ่งตอนนี้ก็เข้าเดือนที่ 6 แล้ว และอีกไม่กี่เดือนก็จะได้ถอดเหล็กจัดฟัน ซึ่งบอกตรงตรงเลยว่าเป็นการจัดฟันที่ไม่เสียเวลา ไม่เลี้ยงไข้ ค่าใช้จ่ายชัดเจน ที่สำคัญคือคุณหมอแนะนำดีมากๆคะ การจัดฟันควรเลือกคลินิกที่ดีๆจะได้จบตั้งแต่แรก ใครที่มองหา แนะนำที่นี้เลยนะคะไม่ผิดหวังแน่นอน
0x30e29e4e870f1a39_0xe4437edad85767fc.en: I want to share my experience with orthodontic treatment at this clinic. Before coming to this clinic, I met the lovely doctor, Dr. Warangkana. She's incredibly gentle, has a wide selection of rubber band colors, and the clinic is spotlessly clean. I want to mention that I previously had orthodontic treatment at a different clinic (I won't mention the name). After a year there, I didn't see any improvement in my teeth, and they extracted teeth almost every month without any explanation. This led me to decide to switch clinics and discover The Tooth Club. This is my second orthodontic treatment here, essentially a case transfer to a different clinic. I'm incredibly impressed with the doctor's skill. I asked Dr. Warangkana to complete the treatment within a year, and I'm now in my sixth month. In a few more months, I'll be able to remove my braces. Honestly, the treatment has been very efficient, with no unnecessary complications. The costs are clear, and most importantly, the doctor provides excellent guidance. Choosing a good clinic for orthodontic treatment ensures a successful outcome from the start. If you're looking for orthodontic treatment, I highly recommend this clinic; you won't be disappointed.

0x30e28fc150c2e169_0x95e5566bf0b32d7e.en: I went to a random clinic for teeth cleaning because my social security insurance was expiring at the end of the year. It wasn't just a simple cleaning; I felt the dentist paid attention to the tartar in small crevices that would be difficult to remove. They also polished my teeth, which some clinics don't do. Especially with social security insurance, I highly recommend this clinic. I'll be back next month for fillings. 🦷🪥

The staff were also lovely. After the anesthetic wore off, I thought I would be in a lot of pain... but I barely felt any pain at all, just a little soreness at the wound site. It hurt a little when they took the impressions, as the dentist pressed against my gums slightly, haha. But it was bearable, so I didn't mention it. If I had, they would have been so gentle. 🥰 Overall, the dentist and staff provided excellent service. I'll definitely come back for more teeth cleaning. They even gave out stickers, so I bought a vaccine course package. It was very worthwhile. I've been looking for a good children's clinic like this in Phuket for a long time. The doctor called to inform me of the results and sent them to me as well. It's excellent! I highly recommend it. I'll bring her back for another checkup in 6 months.

0x30e285199072c433_0x1fec0af9badb742d.text: I previously suffered from chronic back pain for 10 years due to prolonged driving and heavy lifting. I sought treatment at many places and through various methods, including Thai and Chinese medicine, physical therapy, shockwave therapy, acupressure massage, etc. Everywhere said the same thing: my back was very stiff, the condition was severe, and it would take a long time to treat. They advised me to avoid long drives, take frequent breaks, and avoid heavy lifting. However, in my work life, it was unavoidable. I became discouraged and started taking Norgesic and Arcoxia, but even those medications were not good if taken excessively. I just endured the pain on days I didn't take them, until a relative recommended this clinic. My first meeting with the doctor was very attentive and thorough. The physical examination took about 15-20 minutes before starting treatment. I was curious and asked many questions, and the doctor happily answered them all. They weren't just giving short, dismissive answers; they were polite and explained things clearly. Before I left, they gave me physical therapy exercises to do at home to speed up the treatment process. They weren't prolonging the treatment unnecessarily; they were honest with their patients – saying if I needed to come back, I should, and if not, I shouldn't. This was the first place that told me my condition wasn't severe because the adhesions hadn't formed yet. Hearing that gave me hope. After the treatment, my pain disappeared completely. From weekly appointments to once every 1-2 months in just a few months, my condition improved rapidly thanks to my own home physical therapy, which helped both the doctor and myself, as I wanted to be free from this suffering quickly. I am very impressed and highly recommend this place. The doctors are very kind and lovely, both male and female. You won't be disappointed. This is a review from a real patient, not a paid endorsement.
0x30e285199072c433_0x1fec0af9badb742d.author: Natjeanna Thiratthanan

0x30e285199072c433_0x1fec0af9badb742d.text: Very friendly and kind people who are great at what they do! And they speak excellent English as well which makes everything much easier for us who don't speak great Thai yet! I went in with a complicated back/leg issue involving a herniated disc, some sciatica, and a loss of feeling and strength in my left calf. The very kind lady took her time examining me and discussing the issue with me before performing a range of techniques and teaching me some excercises to do at home. While it didn't solve the problem immediately, I did notice a considerable improvement over the next few days, which I can only attribute to the physio performed at the clinic. Definitely well worth a visit if you're looking for a great physio clinic!

0x30da3b948177b74d_0xfca1d581e83331f0.text: Dr. Poj Multidisciplinary Clinic is a comprehensive clinic that instills confidence from the moment you step inside. The new building is clean, modern, and spacious, with greenery in the center creating a relaxing atmosphere. The interior is well-organized, avoiding a cramped feeling, and there's convenient parking at the back for patients. In terms of treatment, it offers a full range of services, including general medical checkups, physiotherapy, and consultations with specialist orthopedic doctors. Additionally, there's a professional beauty clinic with proven results and a dental clinic that accepts social security insurance, making it a one-stop shop for both health and beauty needs. A standout feature is the friendly and attentive nature of the doctors, who provide detailed explanations, along with the polite and welcoming counter staff who provide excellent service to both Thai and international patients. Overall, it's a complete, convenient, and well-equipped multidisciplinary clinic, ideal for those seeking quality medical care in this area.

So I decided to get all 11 fillings done. I was impressed from the moment I walked in. The doctor was kind and lovely, the clinic was very clean, and parking was convenient. I love myself and my body so I can be with the people I love and my family for a long time. It's important to observe and take care of yourself, and most importantly, have a doctor you trust to help you and be honest about the body that you need to be with for a long time. 0x3054f054115765cd_0xdcd0f8ffec8ac421.text: Before coming here, I honestly did not understand what a true dental consultation should be. From my past experiences, a “consultation” usually meant lying on the chair, the dentist taking a quick look, and then giving a short explanation. That was all I knew. But here, it was completely different. The process began with a very thorough and structured examination. The doctor and team took detailed photographs of my teeth, performed comprehensive assessments using advanced equipment to evaluate the gums, nerves, and overall dental condition, and completed both small and full-mouth X-rays so I could clearly understand the full picture of my oral health. What impressed me the most was what happened next. Instead of a quick explanation, the doctor invited me into a consultation room and spent more than 30 minutes carefully going through everything with me. Every detail was explained clearly, patiently, and in a way I could truly understand. The doctor continuously encouraged me to ask questions, and even asked several times if there was anything more I would like to clarify, making sure I felt completely comfortable and informed. Then, what surprised me even more—the doctor spent additional time summarizing everything in a structured and professional format, printed it out, and provided it to me as a complete documentation of my condition and possible treatment options and estimate price. When I reflected on the entire process, I realized that the doctor had spent well over 1 hour of time, attention, and expertise only for this session. That level of dedication alone made me feel that the consultation at this clinic was truly worth it. and reflect their price. At that moment, I understood something very important. This clinic is not focused on rushing into treatment. Their priority is to ensure that the patient fully understands before making any decision. For me, this level of care was truly impressive. And now I clearly understand why this place is not comparable to typical street clinics in terms of pricing. The difference is not just in treatment—but in the depth of care, time, precision, and respect given to each patient. If you are looking for the cheapest option, this may not be the right place. But if you value clarity, professionalism, and a truly comprehensive approach, this experience is absolutely worth it.
