0x3054f054115765cd_0xdcd0f8ffec8ac421.text: Let me share my experience. This clinic is not for everyone — and that is exactly why it stands out. If you are looking for cheap dental treatment, this is not the place for you. The standard here is not just international — in my opinion, it is even higher than many international hospitals. This is a truly medically-driven clinic where every step follows strict professional protocols. Before coming here, I visited two other dentists. They were cheaper, yes — but the quality was simply not comparable. Only after coming here did I truly understand what real medical standards should look like. The price you pay here is absolutely worth it. This is not a place for quick fixes. Every procedure is carefully planned with long-term success in mind. They take the time to diagnose properly, explain in detail, and execute treatment with precision. Nothing is rushed, nothing is compromised. They use premium Western equipment and materials, and it clearly reflects in the outcome. In my case, they were able to solve a complex problem that my previous dentist considered too difficult. Here, it was handled with confidence, expertise, and a clear strategy. I strongly encourage anyone to come here for quality — not for price. If you value long-term results, true medical standards, and professional integrity, this clinic is absolutely worth it. I have deep respect for the doctor and the entire team. 😊

0x3054f054115765cd_0xdcd0f8ffec8ac421.text: I was on vacation in Koh Samui in November 2025 and developed excruciating tooth pain—so bad that I couldn't even eat. After several attempts at different dental practices that couldn't (or wouldn't) help me, I finally ended up at Dental Home. At reception, there's a tablet with a translator for those who don't speak English. I briefly explained my situation, and after only a 10-minute wait, I was seen. The dentist examined my teeth very carefully and then took X-rays. Diagnosis: Inflammation of the tooth root. Afterward, I received excellent advice, and all the treatment options, along with their respective prices, were printed out for me in German. This allowed me to calmly decide what I wanted to do. The dentist recommended root canal treatment. I agreed, and everything was done immediately—no appointment necessary, no calling ahead. I just walked in. My pain was completely gone the next day. This dentist definitely saved my vacation. The whole thing cost approximately €750. I received a detailed invoice, and everything was covered by my insurance. I can't understand the bad reviews – it was one of the best dental experiences I've ever had.

The physiotherapy and ear calcium deposit check were done well, without rushing, and with careful examination. Afterward, the physiotherapist also relaxed my neck, shoulder, and upper back muscles. They were very skilled at relaxing the muscles in the correct locations, which significantly improved my symptoms. Then, they examined my hand and finger muscles. The physiotherapist checked to make sure there was no bone issue, according to treatment principles, and used shock wave and ultrasound stimulation, which made my muscles feel much more relaxed and improved. In total, the treatment took about 3 hours and cost 3000 baht. I consider the price reasonable given the lengthy time and the fact that the clinic informed me of the cost beforehand. This was my first time at a physiotherapy clinic, and I was very impressed.

0x30da25e8117f7519_0x66ef961f1fc173d7.text: When you find a good doctor, you have to share! I'm an amateur golfer who has suffered from chronic injuries from the sport for over two years. My right back is hunched, I have chronic pain in my right shoulder blade, shoulder, and neck, stiffness in my right hip and lower back, and severe pain in my knee and ankle – basically, the entire right side is problematic. In the past, I've received recommendations from well-wishers to seek treatment, including injections, massage therapy, and chiropractic adjustments at various places, both in Bangkok and at well-known clinics throughout Chiang Mai. In fact, I was listed as a patient at all those famous places. But two days ago, these symptoms returned. This time, I decided to consult Google, read reviews, and called to inquire about the cost. I found out that a course of treatment (approximately 1 to 1 hour 40 minutes, depending on the severity) was less than 1000 baht, which I found acceptable. So I went there. I found a small clinic in San Na Meng Subdistrict, San Sai District, located almost at the end of a right-hand side street. There was a small parking area. The team consisted of three people: a tall, well-built male doctor named Dr. Ko, a female doctor, and a nurse assistant. They took my medical history... They checked my blood pressure and inquired about my symptoms, following the standards of a good clinic. They then described the treatment methods they thought were suitable for my condition. Since my symptoms were numerous, I opted for two courses. It started with a muscle relaxation massage, followed by cupping therapy (I'm allergic to cupping), and other miscellaneous treatments. The female doctor had very strong fingers; it wasn't painful because she pressed on the right pressure points, but with great power. Meanwhile, the other doctor, a man in his 40s, engaged in pleasant conversation and exchanged insightful ideas. Then came the chiropractic course, which I must admit was unlike anything I'd ever experienced before. Both doctors worked together, meticulously manipulating, pressing, and adjusting the bones. I was particularly impressed by their use of a cloth to manipulate my neck (a technique only some well-known clinics offer). The most impressive technique was their ankle-locking method to apply force to my hip bones (which I've had chronic pain in), a technique they waited until the end after everything else had relaxed. I'd never seen this method anywhere else. After the treatment, I felt incredibly relieved, more so than ever before. The treatment took about 3 hours, included a large packet of herbal medicine, and cost a total of 1905 baht, which was still cheaper than many well-known clinics I've been to. After returning home... In the evening, there was some soreness (as Dr. Ko had predicted in advance), but I slept longer at night, only waking up to go to the bathroom once (compared to the usual 2-3 times a night). In the morning, I felt relieved, my head felt better, and my body felt more relaxed. I need to go to the hot springs and cold springs and choose to eat only one type of fruit all day for one day to detox my intestines before returning for further treatment here. I have found hope, a feeling that my chronic condition can be completely cured here.
0x30da25e8117f7519_0x66ef961f1fc173d7.author: Bomb Suppradit

0x30da25e8117f7519_0x66ef961f1fc173d7.text: I highly recommend Youdoo — truly outstanding care. 0x30e2977c2fc09b6d_0x3f5c1e9b390f96c5.en: Please stop using the same old apology pattern. This isn't just a communication error; it concerns dental treatment, which requires high precision and responsibility. A clinic that advertises its standards should have a better verification system. Repeated mistakes undermine patient confidence. Last time, during a filling, one piece of the appliance was removed, and it wasn't fully reattached. This time, it hasn't been corrected, even though I'm scheduled to have my braces removed next month. Furthermore, I was scheduled for a scaling appointment, supposedly before braces removal, but they didn't check that I had just had one done about two months ago. Also, I recently had a filling done, yet they recommended an X-ray for cavities. This highlights the need for thorough internal coordination. Even something as small as the dentist providing rubber bands, but the counter staff charged 100 baht, further highlights the need for improved internal communication. Parents entrust their dental health to this clinic; they shouldn't have to constantly monitor and verify mistakes themselves.

0x3054f681b7231897_0x4366064a62cf021a.text: My experience getting a motorbike license in Thailand Documents required: • Passport • Residence certificate • Medical certificate • Copy of passport • Copy of entry stamp You need to come on Monday, Wednesday, or Friday around 7:20–7:30 AM, take a queue number, and wait for your turn. When it’s your turn, the lady at the counter will check your documents and send you to wait in the classroom. Then you’ll take the physical test, which includes: • Identifying whether the light appears on the left or right • Choosing the correct color (red, yellow, or green) • Gas/stop reaction test • Aligning two sticks to the same level After that, you’ll watch 3 hours of traffic rules videos, then have a lunch break from 12:00 to 13:00, followed by one more hour of video. Then you’ll take the theory test on a computer (phones must be placed in lockers, and you can’t use it for translation, but you can ask for clarification if needed). If you pass the theory test, you’ll take the practical test the next day at 10:00 AM. It includes: • Riding onto the track, using the left turn signal, and stopping before the stop line • The slalom test • Riding along a narrow line on a small slope If you already have some riding experience, it’s quite easy. You get two attempts. The hardest part for me was the narrow line, but don’t worry - you can always retake the test on another day. Once you pass, you go to pay the fee, check that your name and details are correct, take a quick photo, and get your license within a few minutes. In total, the whole process takes about 2 days. Good luck!
0x3054f681b7231897_0x4366064a62cf021a.author: Kris Yaskevich

0x3054f681b7231897_0x4366064a62cf021a.text: I was there on Friday at 7 AM. For the driving license test(Motorbike), you have to go to the 2nd floor. I didn't have an appointment. Around 7:30 AM, the first staff members arrived. They told me I needed an appointment and a QR code.(DLT Smart Queue App) I said I didn't have one and that I was from Koh Phangan. Because of that, I was told to wait until 8 AM, if there were any spots left, I could take the test today. And that’s exactly how it went. I had all the documents. Copies of: * Visa * Passport * Yellow Book and Pink Card * Medical Certificate (Samui Home Clinic, 100 THB) That was it. Then I was sent to Room 1, where you wait to be called. After that, you have to do 3 different tests. But no vision test regarding distance. After that, you have to watch 5 hours of video material, with a 1-hour lunch break. Then the test on the PC begins. You have to hand in your mobile phones. If you pass it successfully (45/50)... ...you can take the practical test on the next working day. Everyone speaks English; if necessary, you can communicate using Google Translate. Everyone was super nice, great service. PS: If you fail the test, you can retake it on the next day.
0x3054f681b7231897_0x4366064a62cf021a.author: Patrick Felician Mayer

0x3054f681b7231897_0x4366064a62cf021a.text: I passed my Category A driver's license here in two days, having prepared all the necessary documents in advance. It's important to note that Monday, Wednesday, and Friday are the days when they accept your motorcycle documents, while other days, I assume, are for a car. On the first day, I watched five hours of lectures and took a test in English, which the DLT training website was a great help in preparing for. The questions in the actual exam are different from the preparatory tests you can find, but the logic remains the same. Thanks to completing numerous practice exams, I passed the official exam 46 out of 50 on my first try. You need to score at least 45. The organization was excellent, with minimal delays. The pleasant staff members were helpful and literally held my hand, explaining everything clearly. I took the practical part of the exam at 10:00 AM on the second day, riding my bike. This is convenient. If you fail the theory test on the first day, you need to come back at 9:00 AM and try again. The hardest part is the theoretical exam; if you pass it and ride a bike well, you won't have any problems with the practical test.
0x3054f681b7231897_0x4366064a62cf021a.author: Алексей Рябик

0x3054f681b7231897_0x4366064a62cf021a.text: On 5-8-2025 I went to DLT Koh Samui for renewal car and motorbike license. I arrived as a 'walk-in' at 09.20 am and everything was done at 11.00 am. Quick, easy and smoothly. Documents I provided: -2x copy of passport personal info page and visa page. -2x health certificate. (1x original, 1x copy). -2x copy yellow house book and pink ID card. (with the yellow house book there's no need for a certificate of residence). -Original passport, yellow house book, pink ID card and old driving licences. -760 thb total for car (505 thb) and motorbike (255 thb) license. -I made the online e-Learn test a few days before, I got the QR code, but they weren't interested in this. -Tip: If you go a few days after your expiring date you get automatic 6 years instead of 5 years. I'm good now untill July 2031. Great service, no worries.! 🙏🏼👍🏼
0x3054f681b7231897_0x4366064a62cf021a.author: Hans Weber

0x3054f681b7231897_0x4366064a62cf021a.text: The Samui Transport Office definitely needs improvement in terms of service. You can hardly get any useful information over the phone, meaning you really have to go there in person every time. I've been there four times now, which is why I'm happy to share this information and these pictures. Driving tests are always on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays; be there by 7:30 a.m. to get in right away. First, you'll do some physical tests (an interesting experience), and then there are several videos about the rules, signs, etc., until about noon. There's an hour's lunch break, and then it continues from 1:00 p.m. to 2:30 p.m. Afterward, there's the theory test with 50 questions, of which only 5 can be answered incorrectly. The following day, you can either retake the written test in the morning if you don't pass, and the practical driving test starts at 2:00 p.m. You have to take the test twice for both car and motorcycle licenses. There are also several websites to help you prepare for the test. The official Thai websites are only in Thai, but there are excellent English alternatives.

0x30e29eaab671b12f_0xb502c4c4ca8424d8.text: Located in the Phaya Thai / Dusit area of Bangkok, this classic ground-level railway station is a historic intermediate stop offering a glimpse into authentic local neighborhood life. Core Features Nostalgic Local Atmosphere: Retains an open-air platform design and classic railway tracks surrounded by old neighborhoods and street food stalls, capturing everyday Bangkok lifestyle. Transit Stop: Serves as a key intermediate station along the State Railway of Thailand (SRT) Northern and Northeastern lines for local commuter trains. Experience & Advice Nearby Access: Positioned conveniently near both the Ari neighborhood and the Dusit administrative district, making it a pleasant stop for off-the-beaten-path urban exploration and photography. Practical Tip: Station facilities are basic and mostly open-air. While convenient for quick local train rides, travelers catching long-distance express routes should head to Krung Thep Aphiwat Central Terminal.

0x30da3bc7ad694363_0x85fecbd20be68d57.text: I just returned from Thailand and had the most amazing time at Ayurah Spa during their Rejuvenate Wellness Retreat. I was warmly welcomed with a delicious herbal drink (no sugar, which I loved!) and then had a wellness consultation with Miss Waew. She was so kind and professional, guiding me through a private yoga session where she patiently helped me with poses and breathing techniques. Next, I experienced a deeply relaxing oil massage and traditional Tok Sen therapy with Miss Na, a skilled and caring therapist. Her touch melted away all my tension—I felt completely renewed. I also had a Tibetan Bowls sound healing session with Miss Nan, which was truly incredible. The vibrations and sounds brought me into such a deep state of calm that words can’t fully describe the benefits. The day continued with a nourishing organic lunch from their wellness menu—healthy, clean, and absolutely delicious. I ended the retreat with breathwork, meditation with Tibetan bowls, a detoxifying body wrap, and a facial massage. Every step of the experience was thoughtfully designed and delivered with so much care. I can confidently say this was one of the best spa experiences of my life. If you are looking for a true wellness escape—one that heals your body, mind, and spirit—I highly recommend Ayurah Spa. I will definitely return again.

If you are struggling with hormonal issues, low testosterone symptoms, lack of motivation, low energy, or simply want to optimize your health under proper medical supervision, I would strongly recommend this clinic. 0x30e2a1a5bbb68d87_0xf7d92e5a31085743.text: I used to frequent this clinic because it's close to home and the service has always been good. However, recently, they've had a huge number of patients and not enough doctors, yet they're accepting so many bookings that the doctors are rushing through the procedures. I was constantly being told to hurry them up. Most recently, I had a pre-booked appointment and arrived on time. I understood that it could be faster or slower depending on the case. But after waiting for 40 minutes, the receptionist informed me that I might have to wait another 20 minutes, and if I wasn't finished, they would call a doctor or quickly switch me to a different doctor if one finished earlier. However, I had already checked and confirmed that the doctor was available at that time. It shouldn't have been an hour late. Why was my appointment scheduled for this time, and why weren't there that many patients today? Why did they make me sit and wait for almost an hour? I had already planned my time based on my appointment. This will be my last visit.

0x30da2f9f80bdbcf9_0xc639046ff6fd4b42.text: I had bilateral knee replacement surgery six months ago and was able to stand and walk within 24 hours. However, I needed a walker for about three weeks, then switched to crutches, and finally stopped using them in the third month. Initially, I had to take painkillers and anti-inflammatory medication, but I stopped in the third month because the pain lessened. I only experienced some stiffness at the surgical site and fatigue when walking or standing for long periods, as the surgical wounds needed time to heal. However, I could bend and straighten my legs immediately after the surgery and had good flexibility in movement. The doctor was pleased with my progress. Two and a half months later, I traveled back to my home country, using a wheelchair but no longer with crutches, and continued with physical therapy abroad to strengthen my muscles. Getting up, sitting down, and climbing stairs were the most time-consuming tasks, but by the fourth month I could do it, by the fifth month it was easier, and by the sixth month it was almost back to normal. I'm so happy to have regained my quality of life. With my knees free from pain and suffering from osteoarthritis, my mental state has also improved. Now I can walk normally, although I still need to be careful when climbing stairs. There's a little stiffness at the surgical site, but it's nothing to worry about. I'm incredibly grateful to the doctor for the best advice and treatment. When the doctor sees patients, he takes his time and listens attentively; he never makes you feel rushed. Anyone with chronic knee pain should consider this. I highly recommend consulting your doctor.
0x30da2f9f80bdbcf9_0xc639046ff6fd4b42.author: Chongcharoen Sornkaew

0x30da2f9f80bdbcf9_0xc639046ff6fd4b42.text: (In short) Dr. Warakorn is very attentive to his patients. He provides clear advice and answers all questions (very patient, answers all questions, explains everything until all doubts are clear). He is highly skilled in treatment, and the cost of treatment (at the clinic) is reasonable (cheaper than expected). (In longer) I brought my father to see Dr. Warakorn for treatment of osteoarthritis of the hip. Dr. Warakorn gave excellent advice regarding the diagnosis and treatment. He explained the treatment options, the types of hip replacements, the advantages and disadvantages of each type to help with the decision, and estimated the cost of the surgery (very close to the actual cost). He also clearly explained the pre- and post-operative care. Therefore, we decided to have hip replacement surgery with him. The surgery was excellent. My father recovered well, the surgical scar is beautiful (not a centipede-like scar), and there were no complications. Dr. Warakorn provided clear instructions on post-operative care and precautions, scheduled follow-up appointments, and took excellent care of my father. He answered all questions and explained everything clearly to my father and family, giving us confidence in the treatment.
0x30da2f9f80bdbcf9_0xc639046ff6fd4b42.author: Peanutz R.

0x30da2f9f80bdbcf9_0xc639046ff6fd4b42.text: We would like to express our sincere gratitude and appreciation to Dr. Warakorn for performing the Total Hip Replacement (THA) surgery on our Venerable Abbot. Our Venerable Abbot had been experiencing AVN (Arthritis of the Joint) for over 10 years, with degenerative hip disease and increasing pain. Previously, he was not ready for surgery. After consulting with Dr. Warakorn at his clinic, Dr. Warakorn recommended THA surgery, and our Venerable Abbot decided to proceed with the procedure. Dr. Warakorn is highly skilled and experienced. The surgery was successful and safe. After the surgery, our Venerable Abbot (who is 81 years old this year) was able to walk within 24 hours. He experienced no pain and his post-operative recovery exceeded expectations. There were no post-operative complications. The pain has decreased. Two weeks after the surgery, the wound was healed well. Dr. Warakorn explained the THA procedure using a model, clearly illustrating the process. He also provided excellent instructions on post-operative care, physical therapy, and muscle exercises for rehabilitation. On behalf of the disciples, we extend our deepest gratitude to Dr. Warakorn for his invaluable care and surgery for our Venerable Abbot.
0x30da2f9f80bdbcf9_0xc639046ff6fd4b42.author: Juthamas Inchai

0x30da2f9f80bdbcf9_0xc639046ff6fd4b42.text: Dr. Warakorn is excellent. I took my mother to the clinic for treatment of knee pain and wobbly walking. We had the left knee operated on first, and after 6 months, she no longer experiences pain. She recently had the right knee operated on two weeks ago. Since the surgery, my mother's walking is no longer wobbly and she's starting to walk normally again. The doctor has scheduled follow-up appointments until the wounds heal and she can walk normally again. Both the doctor and the staff have provided excellent care and advice.

0x30da2f9f80bdbcf9_0xc639046ff6fd4b42.text: I was a normal person, never had any accidents, and lived a normal life without any bone or joint problems. Ultimately, my condition did not improve, so I consulted a doctor and underwent a CT scan. The scan revealed necrosis of the hip head. I then consulted with Professor Warakorn and scheduled surgery. The surgery was very successful. I am now back to living a normal life. It's like having a new lease on life. Thank you very much, Professor Warakorn.

0x30e29a03f448e001_0xfa6a9fb02206935.text: ถ้าใครไม่ชอบอ่านเยอะ เราขอรีวิวสั้น ๆ ว่า 1.หมอฟัน (ไม่ว่าเป็นคนที่รักษาราก ครอบฟัน ขูดหินปูน ทำรีเทนเนอร์)เก่ง ละเอียด ใจดี น่ารัก สวย 2.เจ้าหน้าที่น่ารัก เอาใจใส่ สุภาพ มีวุฒิภาวะ ไม่เหวี่ยงแน่นอน และก็สวยเหมือนกัน 3.สถานที่สะอาด สว่าง สงบ มีน้ำดื่ม นม กาแฟสดบริการ มีที่จอดรถ ถ้าใครชอบอ่านเยอะ อยากเก็บครบทุกบริบทก็อ่านรีวิวเต็มเราด้านล่างนะคะ เราตั้งใจจะริวิวหลายรอบแล้ว แต่ตามสไตล์การรีวิวของเรามันต้องเก็บครบประสบการณ์ที่สัมผัส เลยไม่มีเวลาว่างเขียนค่ะ 55555 วันนี้ก็ขอทำตามสัญญานะคะ ประมาณปลายปี 2567 เราปวดฟันมากกกก แบบมากที่สุด และช่วงนั้นติดสอบหลายวิชา อ่านหนังสือไม่ได้เลย จึงพยายามหาที่ทำฟันให้แบบเร่งด่วน ซึ่งร้านทำฟันประจำของเราในตอนนั้น หมอไม่ว่าง พยายามขอคิวแค่ไหนก็ไม่ได้ เราเลยเปิดเสิร์ชกูเกิ้ลนี่แหละ พบว่าที่ใกล้ ๆ แต่เราก็ไลน์ทิ้งไว้ว่าหากมีคิวที่ว่างไวกว่าที่เรานัดรบกวนบอกที ซึ่งเจ้าหน้าที่น่ารักมากแบบมากกกกกก ตอบคำถามได้ละเอียดมาก และจดจำเคสเราได้ด้วย (สงสัยโทรไปนัดแบบทรมานเกินไป) ปรากฏว่าก่อนวันนัด เจ้าหน้าที่ไลน์มานัดให้เราเข้าไปหาหมอ ขอบคุณที่จำได้นะคะ ช่วยชีวิตมาก เราดีใจมากๆ เพราะปวดฟันมาเกือบ 1 อาทิตย์ แล้วหลังจากนั้นเราก็ไปทำฟันที่นี่เรื่อย ๆ ก็พบว่าเจ้าหน้าที่ (ที่เจอบ่อยเห็นสองคน) น่ารักทั้งคู่ค่ะ สุภาพ ยิ้มแย้มเป็นมิตร มีวุฒิภาวะ และควบคุมอารมณ์ได้ดีมากค่ะ 2. คุณหมอน่ารักใจดี มือเบา ให้ห้าดาว พอไปหาหมอเลยเจอความประทับใจสอง เพราะหมออรอุษาบอกว่าถ้าปวดฟันมาก เป็นไปได้ว่าอาจจะต้องรักษาราก จะรักษารากเลยไหม เพราะจะเรียกหมอรักษารากมาให้เลยในวันนั้น ซึ่งเราก็อยากรักษารากฟันมาก ๆๆๆๆๆ เหมือนกัน แต่วันนั้นมีสอบตอนบ่าย ก็เลยนัดวันอื่น อดทนไปสอบแบบปวดๆ แต่ก็เป็นความประทับใจจริง ๆ เพราะทุกคนที่นี่ พยายามช่วยเหลือเราอย่างสุดกำลังความสามารถ แม้เราจะเพิ่งมาก็ตาม 3. การรักษารากฟันและการครอบฟัน ให้ห้าดาว ถ้าในเรื่องราคา เราขอพูดตามตรงว่าเราเคยรักษารากมาราคาถูกกว่านี้พอสมควรค่ะ อย่างไรก็ตาม ถ้าเทียบฝีมือ เราให้ที่นี่อันดับหนึ่ง ทั้งความเอาใจใส่ ความละเอียด มือเบา คุณหมอรักษารากฟันที่นี่มือเบามากจริง ๆ แล้วตอนหมอรักษารากเรา รู้สึกว่าสะอาดละเอียด เอาอะไรไปถูๆๆที่รากฟันเราสี่รากแบบหมดจด (รู้สึกเอง ใช้ฟีลลิ่งไม่มีหลักวิชาการรองรับ) สิ่งสำคัญประการหนึ่งเลย คือ หลังจากรักษารากฟัน เราไม่เจ็บ ไม่มีอาการปวด ไม่มีอาการเลย ซึ่งแตกต่างจากคลินิคเดิมที่เราทำมา เพราะตอนนั้นปวดตรงที่รักษารากประมาณ 2 อาทิตย์ (ซึ่งเราคิดว่านั่นคือปกติของการรักษารากฟัน) ดังนั้น ถ้าในแง่ของความมือเบา ละเอียด เราให้ที่นี่เลยค่ะ แต่ราคาก็แพงขึ้นมาหน่อย แต่เอาจริงถ้าเทียบค่าเฉลี่ยราคารักษารากฟันของแต่ละคลินิครวมกัน ราคาที่นี่ก็อยู่ในแนวโน้มราคาถูกไปจนถึงปานกลางของราคารักษารากฟันนะคะ การครอบฟันก็เช่นกัน คุณหมอรักษารากกับคุณหมอครอบฟันเป็นคนละคนกัน คุณหมอครอบฟัน คือ หมออรอุษา ซึ่งละเอียด และใจดีมาก ๆ อยู่แล้วค่ะ เราเคยขูดหินปูนก็เป็น หมออีกคน ก็ใจดีน่ารักเหมือนกันค่ะ สรุปแล้วหมอเก่ง น่ารัก ละเอียดทุกคนเลยค่ะ 4. การทำรีเทนเนอร์ใหม่ เพื่อแก้ไขฟันห่าง ซึ่งตอนนี้ฟันกลับมาชิดแล้วค่ะ ให้ห้าดาว หลังจากเรื่องรากฟันเสร็จ ก็มีปัญหาเรื่องฟันประการถัดมาค่ะ คือ เราเคยดัดฟันหลายปีมาแล้วค่ะ แล้วหลัง ๆ เราไม่ขยันใส่รีเทนเนอร์ ฟันก็ล้มค่ะ พอฟันล้มกระทบฟันซี่หน้า ทำให้ฟันหน้าเราห่างจนหลายคนทัก ก็เลยปรึกษาหมอก่อน หมอบอกให้ลองทำรีเทนเนอร์ใหม่ แต่ถ้าฟันหน้าไม่กลับมาชิดเหมือนเดิมต้องดัดฟันใหม่ เราเชื่อหมอ ก็ทำรีเทนเนอร์ พยายามใส่ตลอด ซึ่งตอนนี้ฟันหน้าเรากลับมาชิดเหมือนเดิมแล้วค่ะ พอใจมากเลย แต่หมอก็แนะนำให้ฝึกกลืนน้ำลายใหม่ด้วยค่ะ เพราะเรากลืนน้ำลายแบบเด็ก (555 เขินจัง) 5. สถานที่สะอาด มีน้ำดื่มบริการ กาแฟ (เจ้าหน้าที่เดินมาเสิร์ฟน้ำทุกครั้งที่มาหาหมอเลยค่ะ น่ารักมาก แต่ว่าเหมือนถ้าเราไปหยิบเองก็น่าจะทำได้เช่นกันนะคะ) มีที่จอดรถ ให้ห้าดาว ดังที่กล่าวไปข้างต้น คิดว่าละเอียดพอสมคววรเท่าที่นึกออกแล้ว หวังว่าจะเป็นประโยชน์แก่หลาย ๆ คนที่หาร้านทำฟันที่ดี น่ารัก เพื่อเป็นร้านเจ้าประจำเหมือนเรานะคะ ขอบคุณทีมคุณหมอและเจ้าหน้าที่มาก ๆ นะคะ หากได้อ่าน หวังว่าข้อความนี้จะเป็นกำลังใจให้รักษาสิ่งดี ๆ ไว้เช่นนี้ต่อไปดุจเกลือรักษาความเค็มนะคะ

0x30e29a03f448e001_0xfa6a9fb02206935.en: If you don't like reading a lot, here's a short review: 1. The dentists (whether for root canal treatment, crowns, scaling, or retainers) are skilled, meticulous, kind, lovely, and beautiful. 2. The staff are lovely, attentive, polite, mature, and definitely not rude. They're also beautiful. 3. The place is clean, bright, and quiet. There's complimentary drinking water, milk, and fresh coffee. There's parking available. If you like reading a lot and want a complete review, please read the full review below. I've intended to write this review many times, but my review style requires a complete account of my experience, so I haven't had the time. Haha. Today, I'll keep my promise. Around the end of 2024, I had terrible tooth pain, like the worst possible. I was also busy with several exams and couldn't study. So I tried to find a dental clinic urgently. My regular dentist at the time was unavailable, no matter how much I tried to get an appointment. So I searched on Google and found this clinic near my house with pretty good reviews. That's why I went to this dentist, and after that, I never went back to my first regular clinic again. No matter how close it is (555555555555), we'll share our experience in detail, one thing at a time, in case it's helpful for those looking for emergency dental care like us. 1. The staff is incredibly lovely. Five stars! When I called, the queue was long, but I left a message on LINE saying that if there was an earlier appointment, please let me know. The staff were incredibly lovely, answered my questions in detail, and even remembered my case (I guess I waited for the appointment for ages!). It turned out that before my appointment, the staff messaged me to schedule my visit. Thank you for remembering me! It was a lifesaver! I was so happy because I had been in pain for almost a week. After that, I continued to go to this dental clinic, and I found that both of the staff (the two I saw most often) were lovely. They were polite, friendly, mature, and had excellent emotional control. 2. The doctor is lovely, kind, and has a gentle touch. Five stars! On my next visit, I was very impressed. Dr. Oranusa said that if the toothache was severe, it was possible I might need root canal treatment. She asked if I wanted root canal treatment right away, as she could call a root canal specialist that day. I really wanted root canal treatment, but I had an exam in the afternoon, so I scheduled it for another day and endured the pain while taking my exam. But it was truly impressive because everyone here tried their best to help us, even though we were new here. 3. Root Canal Treatment and Crowns: Five stars. Regarding price, to be honest, we've had root canal treatment much cheaper elsewhere. However, in terms of skill, we rank this place number one. The attentiveness, meticulousness, and gentle touch of the dentist here are exceptional. During the root canal treatment, it felt incredibly clean and thorough, meticulously cleaning all four of our root canals (this is just my feeling, not based on scientific evidence). One of the most important things is that after the root canal treatment, we experienced no pain, no discomfort, and no side effects at all. This is different from the previous clinic we went to, where we experienced pain at the treatment site for about two weeks (which we thought was normal for root canal treatment). Therefore, in terms of gentleness and meticulousness, we give this place the top spot. The price is a bit higher, but honestly, if you compare the average price of root canal treatment across all clinics, this place is in the affordable to mid-range price range. The crowns are also different people; the root canal specialist and the crown specialist are different individuals. The dentist for the crown is Dr. Oranusa, who is very meticulous and kind. I also had tartar removed by another dentist, who was also kind and lovely. In short, all the dentists are skilled, lovely, and meticulous. 4. Making a new retainer to correct the gaps between my teeth, which is now back together. Five stars. After the root canal treatment, I had another dental problem. I had braces for many years, and lately I haven't been diligent in wearing my retainer, so my teeth shifted. This shifting affected my front teeth, causing a gap that many people commented on. So I consulted the dentist. The dentist suggested trying a new retainer, but if my front teeth didn't close up again, I would need braces again. I trusted the dentist and got a retainer, trying to wear it consistently. Now my front teeth are back together again. I'm very happy. But the dentist also advised me to practice swallowing saliva again because I swallow like a child (haha, so embarrassing). 5. The place is clean, with drinking water and coffee available (the staff served water every time I came to see the dentist, which was very nice, but I think I could have gotten it myself too). There is parking available. Five stars. As mentioned above, I think this is a sufficiently detailed review for what I can remember. Hopefully, this will be helpful to many people who are looking for a good and lovely dental clinic to become their regular clinic like we were. Thank you very much to the team of doctors and staff. If you read this, I hope this message will be an encouragement for you to continue maintaining such good things, like salt preserves its flavor.

0x30e29a03f448e001_0xfa6a9fb02206935.text: The doctor's clinic is across from my village, so I've seen it for a long time. My family, including my siblings and nieces and nephews, are all his clients. Initially, we came for dental checkups. The doctor was very kind and gave excellent advice. The clinic is clean, and the staff are very welcoming. After that, we came for regular checkups, and he learned that I'm older and my lower teeth were worn down. He advised that I needed a full crown replacement. At first, I was scared and didn't dare do it because I was afraid of the pain. I waited almost half a year to make a decision. When I was sure, I came back. The doctor gave me a schedule for treatment, and I followed his plan. Within a month, I saw the doctor as scheduled, and the pain wasn't as bad as I expected. The doctor explained how to relax and understood the feelings of an elderly person when considering a full crown replacement. It's been a year since the procedure, and my teeth are still in good condition. Before this, I had a checkup, and the doctor said my teeth were still good. He said my case was very difficult to treat and required a gradual approach. But now, it's a successful outcome. I'm impressed with the clinic's cleanliness; it's still as clean as ever. Just like five years ago, the cleanliness is still the same. The welcome is very welcoming. The doctor makes us feel like we're not just coming to see a doctor, but to change the atmosphere of our lives. When we need help, the doctor gives good advice, and the results are excellent. Thank you to the doctor and all the staff.

0x30da17fc008c6805_0xcbe380b10e5da5cc.text: เป็นคลีนิกรักษาสัตว์ที่คู่ควรแห่งการแนะนำอย่างยิ่ง สำหรับทาสหมาแมว เพราะคุณหมอน่ารัก ถามได้ทุกเรื่อง ค่ารักษาอธิบายได้ชัดเจน ราคาไม่แพงเหมือนคลีนิกรักษาสัตว์อื่นๆย่านสันทราย ที่จะพยายามให้ตรวจด้วยเครื่องมือพิเศษ นั่นนี่โน่นจนกระเป๋าฉีก แพงกว่าค่ารักษาคนทั้งๆที่เป็นโรคเดียวกัน ควรจะมีคลีนิกแบบนี้ไว้ให้คนรักสัตว์บ้างในยุคข้าวยากหมากแพง คลีนิกอยู่ในตรงข้ามตลาดเจดีย์แม่ครัว จากตลาดเจดีย์แม่ครัวไปทางพร้าว ให้ยูเทิร์นแรกหลังจากเลยตลาดมาแล้ว ขับตรงมาเลยวัดแล้วจะเจอซอยเล็กๆทางซ้ายมีตึกเมืองไทยสินเชื่อด่วนอยู่ปากซอย ใครจะทำหมันหมาแมวต้องนัดหมายล่วงหน้า

0x30503b9cb60457d7_0xcf90cacb91120043.text: We are a family from Switzerland, and during our stay in Phuket we were looking for a very professional clinic to do the important health check for our baby at the 12-week stage of pregnancy. After some research, we came across this OB-GYN clinic, and we were immediately impressed by the modern and very clean interior as well as the excellent reviews. From the moment we arrived, everything exceeded our expectations. The doctor is incredibly friendly, warm-hearted, and highly professional. He took the time to answer all our questions with patience and made us feel completely at ease. What we appreciated most was the punctuality and organization — we had an appointment and every time we were seen even earlier than scheduled, which shows their respect for patients’ time. Coming from Switzerland, we are very familiar with high medical standards, and we can honestly say that this clinic offers the same level of quality and professionalism. We felt truly cared for and safe, and we can recommend this clinic 100% to anyone who is looking for excellent prenatal care in Phuket. Thank you so much to the doctor and the whole team for such a wonderful experience — it gave us a lot of confidence and peace of mind for our pregnancy journey.
0x30503b9cb60457d7_0xcf90cacb91120043.author: Melina Luana Mock

0x30503b9cb60457d7_0xcf90cacb91120043.text: I had a checkup and ultrasound. I was very impressed. It was clean, the equipment was new and modern, and the examination was thorough. The staff spoke English and used a translator during difficult moments. When I arrived, they immediately took my weight and blood pressure. They also gave me a skirt to wear during the examination, which I liked. They also sent me to take a pregnancy test on the spot. They answered my question without offering anything unnecessary. The price was reasonable; it wasn't covered by insurance. I paid 2,650 baht for the doctor's appointment, speculum examination, and ultrasound. A huge thank you to the doctor and nurse! I left very happy.
0x30503b9cb60457d7_0xcf90cacb91120043.author: G C

0x30503b9cb60457d7_0xcf90cacb91120043.text: Nice, very cozy, clean clinic. One doctor, several offices. The doctor is male, very caring and neat. You are carefully given a floor-length skirt, so that during the examination you are not embarrassed and do not have to lie half-naked. At registration they give an express pregnancy test. 0x30da2f0ea91af537_0x418b9aaee806751d.text: Allow me to share my own experience. I decided to have a hair transplant at Meda Clinic because I had confidence in the medical team and the clinic's standard of care. Before the procedure, there was a detailed consultation, explaining the process and clearly assessing the treatment plan. This made me feel confident from the first visit. It's now been about 3 months since the hair transplant, and the results are very satisfying. My hair is growing clearly, looks natural, and has restored my confidence. In addition, the entire team has provided excellent care. They continuously followed up after the procedure, checking on my condition and reminding me of every appointment. They also provided guidance on post-operative care. I could really feel their genuine care. If anyone is looking for a hair transplant clinic, I highly recommend Meda Clinic as a worthwhile option. Based on my personal experience, I am very impressed. 🙏✨

0x30da2fe5552e74ef_0xa3f090b040ec63f0.text: แนะนำคลีนิคนี้เลยค่ะ ลูกของเราไม่เคยทำฟัน เรากลัวลูกเจ็บ ก่อนไปคลีนิคนี้เราหาข้อมูลร้านทำฟันทั่วเชียงใหม่เลยค่ะ ไปมาแล้วไม่ผิดหวังเลยค่ะ ครั้งแรกไปX-rayฟันและขูดหินปูน ครั้งล่าสุดไปรักษารากฟันอุดฟันชั้นลึก ถามลูกไม่เจ็บเลย ตอนฉีดยาชาก็ไม่เจ็บเลย ลูกเราบอกง้างปากนานปวดกรามมากกว่า🤣 การันตีความมือเบาของคุณหมอค่ะ ประทับใจมากๆค่ะ ตอนกำลังทำฟันคุณหมอใส่ใจคอยถามและบอกว่าจะทำขั้นตอนอะไรต่อไปอยู่ตลอด เปิดเพลงให้ลูกเราฟังด้วยค่ะ😄 พี่ๆพนักงานน่ารักทุกคน ขั้นตอนการเข้ารับบริการรวดเร็วค่ะ🙂
0x30da2fe5552e74ef_0xa3f090b040ec63f0.author: Joy ly joice
0x30da2fe5552e74ef_0xa3f090b040ec63f0.en: I highly recommend this clinic! Our child had never been to the dentist before, and we were worried about the pain. Before going to this clinic, we researched dental clinics all over Chiang Mai. We weren't disappointed at all! The first time was for X-rays and scaling. The most recent time was for root canal treatment and a deep filling. My child didn't feel any pain at all, not even with the anesthetic injection. My child said that having to keep their mouth open for so long hurt their jaw more! 🤣 I can vouch for the dentist's gentle touch. We were very impressed. During the treatment, the dentist was attentive, constantly asking and explaining what the next step was. They even played music for our child! 😄 The staff were all lovely, and the service process was quick. 🙂

0x30da2fe5552e74ef_0xa3f090b040ec63f0.text: This dental clinic is awesome. The place is very clean. The doctors are really kind and they can speak good english.I have panic disorder and everytime I go to the dentist, it's very difficult for me to lay still but here at Chiangmai 89 dental the treatment process was smooth and calm. I am looking forward to many better experiences in my upcoming visits too. I highly recommend this place 👌 💯

0x30da300e2851a37b_0xca86709c6ef6bddb.text: Allow me to share my experience and impressions of Your Smile Dental Clinic. Yesterday, I had severe toothache and swollen gums, which worried me because I had a week-long trip to the mountains with a group in just two days. A worsening condition during the trip would have been very difficult. So, I called the clinic, even though it was close to closing time and the staff were packing up. When I explained my concerns about the upcoming trip, the doctor was incredibly kind. She inquired about my symptoms and said that if I could arrive in time, she would be happy to wait and treat me. That simple answer relieved me and filled me with gratitude. I immediately went to see the doctor. Throughout the treatment, the doctor was attentive, explaining the cause of the problem and the treatment plan in detail. She was patient and genuinely listened to my concerns, making me feel confident and comfortable, even while dealing with the pain and anxiety about the trip. Besides the doctor, the assistants and all the staff were equally impressive. Everyone was polite, smiling, friendly, and willingly helpful, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere in the clinic from the moment I walked in. What impressed me even more was that after the root canal treatment and I returned home, the clinic called to follow up on my condition the next day. They inquired about any pain, swelling, or other additional problems, a small act of kindness that means a lot to the patient. Today, my pain and swelling have significantly improved, making me feel more comfortable and confident for my upcoming journey. I believe that good treatment isn't just about professional expertise, but also about care, understanding, and compassion towards the patient, which I received in abundance here. Thank you to the doctor, the dental assistants, and all the staff at Your Smile Dental Clinic for helping me when I needed it most, and for providing me with both excellent treatment and a heartwarming feeling. If anyone is looking for a dental clinic that provides excellent treatment, cares for patients, and serves with genuine sincerity, I highly recommend this place based on my personal experience. 🙏😊

0x30e29d870b99abb5_0x13c697dea18d0999.en: The staff were rude. They made me wait an hour even though another person who came for the same procedure only waited 10 minutes. The doctor didn't even ask if I wanted the procedure done; they just started working without asking. I didn't even get a chance to mention that I wanted tartar removed. They took a long time to send my information, but there was no coordination. When I arrived, the staff asked when I contacted them. If I hadn't booked an appointment, I wouldn't have come. And when I asked for a medical certificate, they said they were busy and asked if I wanted to wait. If I waited, it would be another 4-5 hours. I'm confused. What kind of service is this?

0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.text: Clinics rarely have high ratings, because when people are dissatisfied—especially in a vulnerable state—they almost always leave a negative review. But when everything goes well, most just pass by and forget. While I was in this hospital, I kept thinking about how underrated the doctors’ work is: day and night they save lives, run examinations, provide help, and still remain kind and attentive. To me, that is an act of true heroism. I want to share my experience. At another clinic, I was given a wrong diagnosis—food poisoning. Medications and painkillers didn’t help. Appendicitis was suspected. I came here at 7 p.m. to the emergency department. They admitted me immediately, ran all the tests, and despite many patients (including accident victims and burn cases), they soon sent me for a CT scan, which confirmed the diagnosis. Before that, I was given IVs, and they constantly checked my pulse, blood pressure, and temperature. The hospital has very modern, high-quality equipment, even though it is public. Before surgery, a woman came up to me, held my hand, and said: “Now I am responsible for you. You are safe with me. I will make sure everything goes perfectly.” In that moment—facing severe pain and pre-surgery anxiety—that reassurance meant the world to me. Thanks to her, I went into the operation completely calm. The surgery went well, the wound was carefully stitched, and afterwards I was transferred to a ward. I spent a day in a private room with a beautiful view and very attentive care from the nurses. They were kind, many spoke English, constantly checked on me, changed IV lines, and helped with any request, even getting up to the bathroom. The food was surprisingly good for a hospital: shrimp soup, rice porridge with meat, little omelets. The doctor encouraged me to get up and walk right away to avoid adhesions. Just 36 hours after surgery, I was discharged, since they follow modern protocols and don’t keep patients longer than necessary. They used waterproof dressings, so I could take a shower. After that, I was prescribed oral medication and outpatient dressing changes. Now it’s the fifth day after the surgery, and I feel well. Unfortunately, I don’t know the names of the people who saved my life, but I am endlessly grateful to each of them for their dedication and care. P.S. The view was amazing
0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.author: Anna Rodina

0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.text: T-Bank Insurance assigned me to this clinic when I applied, and it took me 40 minutes to get there by car. Everything was organized inside: they took my medical history and documents right at the entrance, and gave me a ticket with directions to the 5th floor. On that floor, they assigned me to a staff member, scanned my passport and insurance card, and waited about 30 minutes for them to test me for COVID and flu. After the test, I waited about 2:30 for the results. Based on the test results, the doctor examined me and prescribed medication. The assigned person collected my medications about 30 minutes after the examination. I didn't have to pay on the spot; my T-Bank insurance allows direct payments (the bill was 5,100 baht) (the bank manager was always in touch and coordinated everything). Overall, everything was very convenient, but the wait time was extremely long. I arrived at 9:50 AM and left at 2:00 PM (there were no lines). The staff was polite and helpful. Special thanks to T-insurance for having good clinics as partners.
0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.author: Anastasiya Shvabauer

0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.text: I went to this hospital yesterday for mysterious bite. It’s a bit confusing where to go due to construction, parts of the hospital being closed, and signs being small and sparse, but just ask any staff and they point you to where you need to go, so it’s no problem. You have to talk to quite a lot of staff from start to finish, but overall the process was quite smooth and adequately explained. I spent slightly over an hour there, including a 30 minute observation period post injection. So not bad all things considered. Medical care was good. The reason I’m giving this hospital a five star overall is because they called to check up on my condition the following evening, and the lady on the phone was so sweet and caring. It felt highly personalized, which was so refreshing. Hope they keep the good service.
0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.author: Mika Apichatsakol

0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.text: This government-run hospital, affiliated with the Provincial Administrative Organization, offers services comparable to private hospitals. The doctors are very thorough in their examinations and explain things well to patients (general practitioners). The system is efficient, eliminating the need for long waits like in typical public hospitals. There's a restaurant on the 3rd floor. During the COVID-19 pandemic, entry to the building was very strict. The parking lot is spacious and ample (most public hospitals nationwide have 100% parking problems, but this one doesn't). There's a convenience store, making it easy to buy goods and food. The staff provides excellent service.
0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.author: Chanwit “ChanPhuket” Kittiwongsuntorn

0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.text: I had my first check-up two days ago. There weren't many patients because I went during after-hours, so I was seen very quickly. I feel my quality of life has improved a lot because I don't have to wait long anymore. It's been a long time since I used a government hospital, so this one was great. The doctor examined me and explained everything well, saying to come back if I didn't get better. I did get better, so I went back. They diagnosed me with influenza A. The doctor gave good advice. Thank you very much to the doctor. The nurses were also very helpful and polite.
0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.author: Sritong Sritong

0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.text: My wife has had a cough, sore throat, and phlegm for three days. At 5 a.m., we decided to go to the hospital. Tinkoff Insurance sent us to this hospital (it turned out to be a long way). We arrived at the hospital around 6:30 a.m. While we were figuring out what was going on, at 7:30 a.m., a nurse gave us plane number 1 and told us to wait for the doctor until 9:00 a.m. We spent an hour and a half sitting outside on chairs. A young doctor came, gave us a quick examination, and sent us to wait for a prescription. About 15 minutes later, Mrs. Maxim, the doctor, took us to the 5th floor of the hospital, asked us to email her the insurance policy, and then sat us down again. About 15 minutes later, my wife returned, we signed the paperwork, and we were given 4-5 packets of pills. It seemed fine, but it took a very long time. If we hadn't arrived in the morning, we would have spent another hour or more in line... It seems like it's a paid appointment... We don't have to wait for paid appointments.
0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.author: Евгений Белых

0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.text: A cautionary tale for all patients: The nurses were excellent, but the female doctor in the emergency room on the night of March 9, 2025, Dr. Nuchada Khontai (fair-skinned, plump, Chinese-looking), was terrible. The nurse said she wasn't a resident doctor and only came occasionally. Everyone who encounters this doctor is pitiful. She was awful. She told a patient with diarrhea from a rotavirus infection that it might be colon cancer and refused to admit the patient, even though the patient had diarrhea for six consecutive days, almost 60 times, and was losing their balance due to severe dehydration. The doctor used many inappropriate words directed at a patient, even ignoring the patient's relatives standing beside them. She even brought up politics in the conversation. Doctor, if you're not ready to be a doctor, please resign. I understand you're tired and don't get enough rest, but do you know that the patients who come for emergency treatment are genuinely unwell and need your help? If they had a choice, they wouldn't want to come to the hospital. But you generalized and spoke in a way that people would call "disgusting." You have absolutely no medical ethics. And your medical school education is expensive! It takes many years to graduate, but it's unfortunate that doctors don't learn psychology and how to communicate with patients. If a doctor isn't ready to examine a patient, they should tell the hospital director. The director can then find staff who are more compassionate. Most importantly, if a doctor hasn't clearly diagnosed the illness, please don't speak to a patient like that; it can cause shock. No matter the patient's age, every life is precious. It's a shame that a doctor lacks courtesy and professionalism. Ultimately, they allowed the patient to stay in the hospital because we, the patient's family, insisted. Even though the blood test results were normal, the patient was very weak, barely able to stand. The doctor still couldn't figure it out and said he didn't want problems with the family. Finally, the hospital diagnosed the patient with rotavirus, requiring four days of intravenous fluids and treatment. If we had listened to the doctor that day, we would have sent the patient home. The patient only drank electrolyte solution, went to the bathroom more than ten times a day, couldn't eat anything, and vomited everything out. The patient would surely have gone into shock at home. (From a family who actually took the patient for treatment.) And I feel really bad. P.S. If the doctor is tired and not in the mood to see patients, the doctor should write on the emergency room door on the days they are on duty: "Do not get sick while the doctor is on duty." That way, patients will understand. Thank you.
0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.author: PK BJ

0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.text: Refuse if offered. Never come here. They sat with a baby for an hour waiting, then examined our children in a cold room with fevers for an hour. They barely persuaded us to take blood from our older daughter, ignored our questions, and then sent us to the hospital for three days. Now the saddest thing is that they prescribed a bunch of medications for our older daughter, including an antibiotic, even though her test results were good. When we asked why and for what reason they prescribed the antibiotic, they pretended not to understand. On the last day, they disconnected the baby's IV literally five minutes after they brought the medication. When we asked why they brought it, they told us the senior doctor ordered it, and we followed it. We later realized she did it so they could send us home quickly, even though we hadn't asked for anything, as it was important to us that our child fully recovered. They didn't treat our older daughter at all. Tinkoff sent us here.
0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.author: Павлик Павликович

0x3102f24818ff9cb1_0xe3f543cb65c7dda2.text: The dentist, dental assistants, and front desk staff have always provided excellent service throughout my orthodontic treatment here. However, today I called to schedule an appointment because my braces chain had come loose and I was experiencing severe tooth pain. I didn't know how many sides of the chain were attached. The staff member's tone was unpleasant, and they hung up before I could finish my question. This might have been due to a high volume of patients or some other reason, which I'm not aware of. I apologize for my lack of knowledge on this matter, as I didn't know the exact number of sides of the chain. I'm not an expert in dentistry, but because I paid the clinic for comprehensive dental services, I haven't researched this further. I would like to suggest that the clinic provide more training for its staff regarding customer service. Employees who lack a passion for customer service have many other career options based on their abilities and aptitudes. I also want to address the staff member who acted substandardly towards patients: your words, tone, and demeanor are damaging the clinic's reputation. Please use your judgment before taking any action that could harm the clinic's image, as the staff who currently provide excellent service will also be affected. I hope the clinic will implement measures to prevent and address such incidents in the future. Thank you very much 🙏☺️ I will be reducing the rating until I receive service of a higher standard again, then I will increase it again 🙇
0x3102f24818ff9cb1_0xe3f543cb65c7dda2.author: Atirat James Ati

0x3102f24818ff9cb1_0xe3f543cb65c7dda2.text: This was the first clinic I decided to go to, and I wasn't disappointed at all. The staff and doctors at the clinic are so lovely. If you're hesitant, I highly recommend going! It's amazing! 💕

0x3102f24818ff9cb1_0xe3f543cb65c7dda2.text: I had an appointment for a filling at 2:00 PM. I arrived 20 minutes early. There was one patient already waiting. At 2:00 PM, the patient who arrived first went in for their filling. Meanwhile, another patient arrived, presumably with an appointment around 2:30 PM. At 2:10 PM, the patient who went in before me came out, so I went to the restroom because it was supposed to be my turn. But when I came out, the patient who arrived after me was gone. So I asked the receptionist how much longer it would be until my turn. They replied that they had called my name, but I went to the restroom, so they let the other person go in first... What a mess... I used the restroom in your clinic, not somewhere else! Never mind, I'll go somewhere else. There are many other dental clinics with better service in Ban Chang. I will never come back to this clinic again.

I've decided to pursue a 10-session treatment. I'll update you after I complete all 10 sessions.

0x30e2811d33acaf41_0x3c8ca726fdbd1254.text: I came to the clinic to treat numbness in my right hand when twisting the throttle of a motorcycle. They used four machines for four different treatments, and I was cured after the first session! I'm so happy. However, I still need to come back for further treatment to ensure a complete cure. But even just after the first session, the numbness disappeared, and I could even open a water bottle with the strength to do so. I'm already very happy with that.
0x30e2811d33acaf41_0x3c8ca726fdbd1254.author: Bell Vintre

0x30e2811d33acaf41_0x3c8ca726fdbd1254.text: I came in with tightness on my shoulders and upper back. We were just going to inquire, but since they accept walk-ins despite today being a busy weekend. The manager, Khun Poona, was very helpful and accommodating and patiently communicated the whole process. I felt such a big relief after the session. I’m excited for the next one.

0x30e29f2ebaee5b65_0x3fe96e506a2f9aa6.text: I received treatment at Sala Daeng Physical Therapy and was very impressed. It started with a tennis elbow injury. I went to Sala Daeng Physical Therapy and met with a physiotherapist who gave excellent advice. Before treatment began, I had pain in my right elbow, which radiated to the nerves in my neck. They found a problem with the muscles in my right shoulder blade, which were tight, and also issues with my cervical spine. The symptoms were similar to office syndrome, with added symptoms like rounded shoulders and forward head posture. Treatment began at the cervical spine, using acupressure to release nerve and muscle tension. They applied pressure to various points around my shoulder blade and the muscles around my right elbow. They also used several tools, such as shockwave therapy, ultrasound, infrared, and a PMS machine. Hot and cold compresses were used, along with neck stretches. The final step involved hot compresses and electrical stimulation on my back and elbow. Before I left, the physiotherapist gave me excellent advice on stretching exercises and self-care after each treatment. I received treatment four times in total. My back and neck function have improved significantly; I can raise my arm fully to my ear. It's like having a new body! The right elbow still requires more treatment, but it's much better now. And then I received good news from Sala Daeng Physical Therapy that I won a backpack and two doll figurines as a prize, which my daughter loves very much. Thank you very much! I highly recommend Sala Daeng Physical Therapy.

0x30e29fba2eb26f89_0xb337a1f7692da616.text: 5 STARS! I’m from Canada and was walking around to see what different clinics in Bangkok had to offer. I ended up booking underarm laser hair removal and underarm Botox with them and I have to say I had such an incredible experience at this clinic! The staff were so warm and attentive — their hospitality honestly made me feel completely at ease considering I was unsure of how the quality of treatments would be in Bangkok given this is my first time visiting. The clinic itself is spotless and beautifully maintained. The doctor does the treatments, he is Korean and has a second clinic in Korea. He only uses Korean laser hair removal equipment and Korean Botox, he used 2 different lasers on me one for removal and one for ingrown hair prevention and lightening of the underarm. My results have been amazing for the Botox; I’m not sweating at all even in this +33 weather! The pricing is also amazing for the level of expertise and technology they provide. I left feeling like I got exceptional value for my money. If you’re looking for a clinic that combines professionalism, cleanliness, and genuine care with outstanding results in Bangkok, this is the one. I can’t recommend them enough!

0x3102be000c13381f_0x9a2966014fc7a1c4.text: I didn't go to this clinic to use their service, but saw an ad on Facebook and wanted to share with you my story. I had my ink removed on my four fingers in Canada. The total sessions were 2 visits. I was supposed to go one more time, but I was happy with the result and didn't go on the 3rd and final session. The cost per session was about $100-$120 CAD, but that was over 15 years ago. I wouldn't pay more than 10,000 baht for some small black and white tattoos in Canada or Thailand. Big, colorful tattoos will need a lot more sessions and cost more. Also note, the tattoos I had on my four fingers were done by hand. So the ink probably didn't go too deep into my skin and came off more easily than machine-done tattoos. Maybe that's why I needed 2 sessions. The guy below me was asked to come for 12 sessions. So I think that's a rip off, for only black ink WITHOUT color. It worked for 2 sessions on me, plus technology should have improved since I had mine removed 15 years ago. I think even color tattoos don't need 12 sessions, unless it's a really big ink.

0x3054f04bacc23397_0x4d0d346f08a7e62d.text: A 10/10 Dental Experience in Koh Samui ​I had been putting off much-needed dental work, hoping to get it done affordably in Thailand. I was even told by another clinic that getting two crowns done in my two-week timeframe wouldn't be possible. Thankfully, I found Chaweng Dental and was completely blown away by the service. ​From the moment I walked in, I was met with professionalism and genuine care. Dr. Nuntida Lorprasertkul and Dr. Watchara Suksong were incredible. They were not only meticulous and highly skilled but also spoke fluent English, which made everything so much easier. They assured me that I could get all the work I needed done within my two-week trip. ​What started as needing two crowns turned into a full mouth transformation. I ended up getting three crowns, four fillings, a deep clean, and a whitening treatment. The most unbelievable part? The total cost was the same price I was quoted for just two crowns back in Australia. ​The entire experience was a pleasure. The staff were fantastic, and I honestly looked forward to my daily appointments. This was, without a doubt, the most positive dental experience I have ever had. If you're in Koh Samui and need a top-notch dentist, don't look anywhere else. The entire team at Chaweng Dental gets a 10 out of 10 from me!🦷💯
0x3054f04bacc23397_0x4d0d346f08a7e62d.author: Helen Mouzakiti

0x3054f04bacc23397_0x4d0d346f08a7e62d.text: My wife and I are both in our sixties and we both needed some work done and which we were told by our dentist that crowns and root canal work would need to be done, the cost of this was excessive and as we were going to Koh Samui for a holiday and after a extensive search on the web I selected Chaweng Dental Care. It was one of the best decisions I have made, our Dentist, Dr Watchara Suksong was so caring that he made us feel very safe in his hands. I had some veneer work done which also involved a crown and my wife had a filling done, at home she was told she would need root canal work and a crown. The cost of this work was well under the quote I received at home(Australia) it was pretty well painless and at all times Dr Suksong and his staff kept my welfare and comfort as a premium concern. I would recommend Chaweng Dental Care to anyone wanting dental work done, the savings in having the work done there well and truly off set the cost on my holiday when compared to the cost of the proceedure if done at home.
0x3054f04bacc23397_0x4d0d346f08a7e62d.author: David Pratt

0x3054f04bacc23397_0x4d0d346f08a7e62d.text: Like most people, I'm not exactly a big fan of visiting a dentist, especially in another country. But Dr. Nuntida changed my mind. She speaks very good English, and also knows how to listen. Another thing that I like is that she's not trying to force anything on you and saying openly that some things are most likely unnecessary at this point (wisdom teeth removal and a crown on one of the molars). The clinic itself is clean and neat. It also well-equipped: they have portable x-ray and panoramic x-ray. They also readily send the scans to your e-mail or messenger. Pricing is also seems adequate. All in all the place leaves a good impression of an establishment where people know what they are doing. If you happened to need a dentist attention during your stay on Samui, pay Dr. Nuntida a visit — even if only for a consultation. Adequate evaluation of your situation is a crucial first step. You'll then decide for yourself what a best course of action should be. Stay healthy and happy everyone. Cheers!
0x3054f04bacc23397_0x4d0d346f08a7e62d.author: Andreas Flanco

0x3054f04bacc23397_0x4d0d346f08a7e62d.text: This business has recently moved to a new clinic at 83/14 Moo 2, Bo Phut, Koh Samui. The new clinic is beautifully fitted with modern equipment and decor (see new pictures) and is run by a lovely husband and wife team. Prices were very competitive when comparing to other dentists in the area: -1,500 Baht for teeth cleaning using Airflow technology. -10,000 Baht for teeth whitening which included clean + Airflow, scale, polish, LED whitening and home kit. -1,000-1,500 Baht per filling -9,000-10,000 Baht per Veneer. I had all of the above done and was very impressed with the results. The staff at the clinic were gentle and caring throughout the process. They were also able to accommodate appointments at short notice and the overall cost was a fraction of what I would have paid at home. Definately worth looking into - I did my research and was glad I chose Chaweng Dental Care!

0x30e2997a8e768451_0xe3b8542f5664a8c6.text: The doctor is incredibly kind, and the atmosphere is warm and friendly. Coming here made me feel comfortable, relaxed, and stress-free. The doctor and the medical team are very attentive and caring. The clinic looks modern and very clean. The doctor is very friendly and easy to talk to, creating a relaxing atmosphere. They offer fragrant tea, osmanthus tea, and cookies while you wait to see the doctor. The doctor inquired about your symptoms and examined your physical condition, explaining how to balance your body according to Traditional Chinese Medicine and determining a treatment plan including acupuncture, cupping, and herbal steam therapy. On your first visit, the doctor will perform a pulse diagnosis and ask about your symptoms. They will check the functioning of your internal organs, blood circulation, and pulse to restore balance to your body. The doctor's diagnosis was very accurate. The doctor also showed videos on breathing exercises to lower blood pressure and abdominal massage. I was very nervous and afraid it would hurt during my first acupuncture and cupping session. It turned out the doctor was very gentle; it didn't hurt at all, just felt like something was passing through my skin. Some felt less painful than an ant bite, but it was worth it because it helped various systems in my body function better. It wasn't as painful as I expected. It was great! The doctor's conversation made me feel less stressed. I also brought my father, who received electrical stimulation and targeted acupuncture. Those experiencing aches, pains, and stiffness in the neck, shoulders, and upper back can receive acupuncture treatment simultaneously. If two people come, the doctor uses a red infrared lamp focused on the acupuncture area, creating a warm sensation. Soft music is played to help relax. Essential oils are rubbed on the palms and inhaled to promote relaxation beforehand. After acupuncture, cupping therapy is performed. The first time, you'll feel a warm, tense sensation at the points where the cupping is done, accompanied by a pleasant herbal aroma. The heat in the cups draws blood to the surface, relieving blocked circulation and relaxing muscles, reducing neck and back pain. Cupping itself isn't painful, just a slight tension in several areas of the back. Afterward, there are purple circles on the back. The doctor explained that this might indicate areas with poor blood circulation, and that the treatment improves bodily functions. The treatment is then complete. Afterwards, you change into a gown and are ready to go home. The doctor provides healthy tea, healthy snacks, and cooling patches to try. The cost is very reasonable. The doctor and the treatment team are very attentive and caring. The location is convenient with ample parking. After the acupuncture, I felt I slept better and more soundly. My bloating and gas decreased, my stomach felt more active, and my blood circulation improved. I also found it easier to fall asleep earlier than before. I woke up feeling refreshed and not tired. I was very impressed with the treatment and the doctor's advice. I want to continue treatment to further improve my health and body balance. Coming here makes me feel relaxed, like I'm on vacation. I'm so glad I came to Rela Traditional Chinese Medicine Clinic.
0x30e2997a8e768451_0xe3b8542f5664a8c6.author: Mong Thanathip

0x30e2997a8e768451_0xe3b8542f5664a8c6.text: I've wanted to try acupuncture for a long time, but never went because I didn't have many external physical problems. However, my girlfriend complained of back pain, so I took the opportunity to take her to try acupuncture and cupping therapy. I also recently learned that acupuncture can help with breathing for people with allergies, so we opted for the package deal. Importantly, Dr. Mada and Dr. Madi provided excellent consultation and advice. Their demeanor, speech, and overall attitude showed genuine care, dedication, and sincerity. The clinic also had a warm atmosphere, like walking into a friend's house. They offered unlimited tea and snacks – a truly welcoming experience. Especially the cheerful male staff member who constantly chatted and joked while we waited for the doctor, and kept trying to get us to eat more snacks until I had to tell him to stop – I was already full! It was a fantastic first experience at a traditional Chinese medicine clinic. My girlfriend and I were very impressed and will definitely go again. (Unfortunately, I forgot to take pictures of the atmosphere!)
