0x30e2997a8e768451_0xe3b8542f5664a8c6.text: A newly opened Traditional Chinese Medicine clinic in the Charan area that provides very meticulous care. They also offer herbal supplements for treatment. Parking is convenient. Today I brought my parents for treatment, and they left feeling well cared for and impressed. I'll definitely come back for treatment myself next time.
0x30e2997a8e768451_0xe3b8542f5664a8c6.author: Pinetawee Sinlapawanich

0x30e2997a8e768451_0xe3b8542f5664a8c6.text: It was my first time trying acupuncture and cupping, and I had a great experience. The doctor was very kind and took the time to help me feel calm before the treatment. I felt well taken care of throughout the session. The clinic is new, clean, and has a relaxing, spa-like atmosphere. I'll definitely be back again.
0x30e2997a8e768451_0xe3b8542f5664a8c6.author: MsGlessy

0x30e2997a8e768451_0xe3b8542f5664a8c6.text: Highly recommend this TCM clinic! It was my very first time getting acupuncture and cupping, and they made it a great experience. Very helpful consultation and great care overall. Looking forward to the next one! Bonus points that they could communicate in English!
0x30e2997a8e768451_0xe3b8542f5664a8c6.author: Michelle Laurice Aguas

0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.text: Awesome chiropractor! I went for the first time today. And though it was 1000 Baht for the first trip (500 for subsequent visits) it was worth it. My lower back has been hurting which has been causing my mid and upper back to adjust and hurt as well. The chiropractor spent time talking with me and getting a sense of what’s wrong. His English wasn’t fluent but was very functional. He then popped the mess out of my back! But never in a painful or seeming dangerous way - it was always methodical and smooth. Afterwards, he gave me advice on stretches and exercises to do to help avoid the problem in the future. When I asked if he wanted me to return, I fully expected him to say “oh yeah, this will require many visits” as maximizing income has been a motivation for some of the chiropractors I’ve visited in the past. Instead, he said that I should wait a week and see how I feel. If I still hurt then I should return, otherwise I’m good to go. Very refreshing! Don’t be put off by this being in a neighborhood and at his house. That’s just the way Thais roll sometimes. If you’re looking for a good chiropractor, stop digging cause you’ve struck gold.
0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.author: T Cason

0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.text: I had a good experience with Krit. (He was trained in Taiwan.) I had not seen a Chiro since Dr. Perry moved earlier this year. I struggle with my hips and eventually, overtime, my right leg ends up short than my left...usually only 1/2 inch or so. Well, it was 2 1/2 inches shorter when I saw him yesterday. My right knee had been hurting a lot and I could just tell when I ran that something was wrong. Every Chiro I have seen from Mauritius to Kenya to the USA to Thailand has treated my issue differently. Krit also treated differently. He was a lot gentler in his approach and when he finished my legs were the same length again. Today I could tell a difference on my run and my knee is barely hurting today....so thankful to have found someone who can fix this issue when it flares.
0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.author: Denise Gray

0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.text: I very rarely leave reviews, but I’ve found one of the best chiropractors ever here in Chiang Mai for a ridiculously cheap price too. I’ve needed regular adjustments for 20 years, which is problematic when travelling and have visited some shockers and charged the Earth for it (£100 for a quack in Jakarta in October). He certainly knows he stuff; identified my subluxations immediately and cleared them with the most gentle manipulations I’ve ever had. As it had been 2 months, there was a lot to do and I went back a week later and was charged only 500. Baht as opposed to 1,000 for a first visit. His place is some 12 kms from town in a suburban street, obviously his home = he’s well cheap; but I’d be prepared to pay way more, he’s that good!
0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.author: steve Pulvernis

0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.text: We were on vacation and my husband really needed an adjustment after our long flight, and he has a chronic knee issue that impacts his back and posture. This was a great experience. The chiropractor was knowledgeable, spoke good English, and had some good suggestions for longterm care and maintenance, too. I speak Thai as well, but he didn’t need any translation. I also appreciated that I asked if I needed an adjustment, and he examined me and said that a little massage would loosen me up so he didn’t need to work on me. He has a conservative approach, and he isn’t in it for the money.
0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.author: Pensiri Kongkaw

0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.text: He's a Thai guy who understands and speaks functional english. I've been to dozen's of chiropractors and had hundreds of adjustments in many countries, and must say he is very good. Know's his stuff. Very practical, he even looked at the wear on my shoes and asked many questions to diagnose why my problem is happening. Gave me specific exercises to loosen the tight muscles creating the problem. He's in a residential backwater neighborhood in a private residence, but very professional. First treatment 1,000 baht, after that 500bt. I would go back.
0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.author: Jaden Fox

0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.text: First visit…no appointment but he took me right away and found same problem as my chiro in Canada! Same treatment and excellent almost immediate results! I’d give more stars if I could!! He’s knowledgeable and didnt push me for another visit…just said see what you feel like in one week…if you need to come back welcome 🙏 SECOND VISIT….slightly different problem but treated and fixed within 10 minutes!! No pain…good explanation…in and out and off to buy a new bed 👍😀
0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.author: Brad Grier

0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.text: I've been to visit Khun Krit many times now. He consistently resolves my diversity of odd pains on the first visit. He understands body mechanics, posture and muscle function at a depth I've not seen in most western Chiropractors. He offers precision suggestions for preventing future problems and checks different ways to see that my spine is aligned. He's practical, down to earth and genuinely caring.
0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.author: Jaden Fox

0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.text: I think Dr. Krit is a genuinely nice guy. However my experience Friday was not a good experience. I called the day before (Thursday) to make an appointment for the following day (Friday 11am). I arrived around 10:45am since it was my first time finding his office. After an unsuccessful attempt to call him. He was nice enough to respond through text to tell me the name of his office (Tiens Massage), which I thought was Chiangmai Chiropractor. Anyhow, I can understand when unexpected meetings come up. I would understand if he had given me a phone call or text prior to arriving to his office. I don't mind rescheduling because I understand unexpected things arise. What I don't understand is how a professional like himself didn't honor my appointment time nor give notice or make a simple apology for making a potential client wait forty five minutes. I was very displeased with the level of professionalism. There was no regard for my time.
0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.author: Min Kim

0x31029668009da175_0x3e7b435da507d30d.text: How Dr Patrick saved my life Dear Sir / Madam I am a patient of Mrs Gay at the rehabilitations centre. She is fantastic at her job and has really helped me . I have a trapped sciatic nerve which she has been treating. Dr Patrick suggested I have a neck and spine X-ray , which I went and had done. Unbelievably , Dr Patrick noticed something on my X-ray and asked me to go and arrange to have a heart checkup . I already have a full heath check annually at a hospital . So regardless , I called Bangkok Bangkok hospital in Bangkok and arranged to go and see a specialist to get further tests . They found most of my arteries were blocked with calcium, my right leg was 85% blocked and around my heart was also not so good . The specialist said , thank god Dr Patrick noticed this , or at the most ,6 months you would have had a massive heart attack . I have had 4 stents fitted around my heart , then next week I will go back in for my leg . Dr Patrick , I would like to thank you , you really saved my life. You deserve a medal Regards Martin Holmes
0x31029668009da175_0x3e7b435da507d30d.author: Martin Holmes

0x31029668009da175_0x3e7b435da507d30d.text: I recently visited Sure Cell Medical Clinic in Pattaya and had a fantastic experience from start to finish. The clinic is modern, professional, and offers some of the most advanced stem cell and regenerative therapies available. A special mention to the Australian manager, Aaron, who went above and beyond to make me feel comfortable and informed throughout the process. His knowledge, honesty, and friendly approach made everything easy to understand, and he genuinely cares about helping patients achieve the best possible outcomes. The entire team was welcoming, professional, and attentive. Whether you’re interested in stem cell therapy, vitamin drips, anti-ageing treatments, or general wellness, I highly recommend Sure Cell Medical Clinic. Excellent service, cutting-edge technology, and outstanding patient care. Five stars all the way! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
0x31029668009da175_0x3e7b435da507d30d.author: Scott Sargeant

0x31029668009da175_0x3e7b435da507d30d.text: I had two sessions a year ago (Dec 2024) for my shoulder and can now play a full round of golf. A 25% improvement would have been good and only dared hope for 50% but now would put it at 75%. Previously I had to stop playing for 5 months hoping it would heal by itself. It took a couple of months after the injections to improve and but continued improving for 6 months. I had a historic motorbike crash landing heavily on my shoulder so do not expect a complete cure.
0x31029668009da175_0x3e7b435da507d30d.author: Scott O

0x31029668009da175_0x3e7b435da507d30d.text: 4 months after receiving 3 sessions of PRP shoulder injections for rotary cuff tear, I am virtually pain free. I feel so much better after 2 years of continuous pain. At first I was skeptical about this procedure, but after doing some research I decided to give it a try. Thank you Surecell.
0x31029668009da175_0x3e7b435da507d30d.author: Craig Obermaier

0x31029668009da175_0x3e7b435da507d30d.text: I have been going here for many years. The treatment is fantastic and the staff are warm and friendly. They almost feel like family. Also, extremely good value. ¼ of the price of a similar service (physiotherapy) of another place I tried when Surecell couldn't accommodate me.
0x31029668009da175_0x3e7b435da507d30d.author: Anthony Thomas

0x31029668009da175_0x3e7b435da507d30d.text: Fantastic professional clinic Aaron assisted myself and my husband with prp we both are very happy with the results , we will continue using this clinic when we come back and we're very happy to learn they have a clinic in Malvern Victoria thank you Aaron and team
0x31029668009da175_0x3e7b435da507d30d.author: Rhonda Whitehead

0x31029668009da175_0x3e7b435da507d30d.text: Have made 3 PRP treatments on both of my Hip Joints. Left Hip is with advanced OA (Osteoarthritis), not getting anything better. Maybe have to try this VERY expensive Stem Cell therapy by taking Fat instead of just blood like with the PRP.

0x30da3197c8afd491_0x9c611cba51993ca0.text: จากใจเจ้าของแมวที่รักเขาเหมือนลูกคนหนึ่งน้องเป็นแมวจรที่เก็บมาเลี้ยงขี้โรคมากรักษามาแล้วหลายๆคลินิกแต่รู้สึกไม่ค่อยประทับใจสักเท่าไหร่แต่เดือนที่แล้วมีโอกาสได้โทรมาปรึกษาคุณหมอเรื่องที่น้องท้องเสียได้รับคำปรึกษาจากคุณหมอผู้หญิงคุณหมอแนะนำดีมากอธิบายเข้าใจง่ายรู้สึกประทับใจมากๆพอน้องหายป่วยวันนี้ได้เอาน้องมาทำวัคซีนประจำปีที่คลินิกได้เจอกับคุณหมอผู้หญิงคุณหมอน่ารักพูดจายิ้มแย้มให้การบริการได้ดีมากๆน้องๆผู้ช่วยก็น่ารักคลินิกดูสะอาดรู้สึกประทับใจกับครั้งแรกที่เข้ามาใช้บริการหลังจากนี้ตัดสินใจแล้วจะให้เป็นคลินิกประจำบ้านไปเลยค่ะ #จากใจคนที่เข้ามาใช้บริการของแนะนำเลยค่ะขอบคุณค่ะ🙏🏻👩🏻‍⚕️🏩

0x30da3197c8afd491_0x9c611cba51993ca0.text: อยากแชร์มากๆ น้องหมาเราอายุ 14 ปีแล้ว เนื่องจากน้องไม่ค่อยทานขนมขบเคี้ยวทำให้มีหินปูน แต่บวกอายุมากพาไปที่ไหนก็บอกไม่ควรทำ จนหาข้อมูลมาว่าคลินิกนราวดี มีหมอจบด้านทันตกรรมโดยเฉพาะ ทำให้ตัดสินใจ เพราะ สุนัขแก่ต้องตรวจเลือด เอ็กซ์เรย์ วางยา เราก็ทำการตรวจทุกอย่างจนผลไปได้สวย แรกๆก็ใจไม่ดี กลัวไม่รอด แต่หมอบอกน้องสุขภาพดี ออกห้องผ่าตัดมาไม่ถึง5นาทีฟื้น เห่าลั่นรพ. กลับบ้านกินข้าวกินยาได้ปกติ ร่าเริงไม่ซึมไม่มีปัญหาใดๆ ใครคิดจะรักษา มาตรงนี้เลยค่ะ หมอใส่ใจตามเคส และแนะนำดี ราคาไม่แพงมาก

0x30da3197c8afd491_0x9c611cba51993ca0.text: ขอบคุณครับ คุณหมอ แมวเจ็บขา ปวดขาอยู่หลายวัน ไปพบคุณหมอได้ทำการตรวจแล้ว รับยามา น้องเสือไม่ทานยาเลย เลยไม่ได้การรักษาหรืออาการดีขึ้นเลยเป็นยิ่งกว่าเก่า(เพราะไม่ทานยา) ตัดสันใจกลับไปหาคุณหมออีกครั้ง รอบนี้คุณหมอแนะนำให้ฉีดยาแทน 3 วัน ติด ณ ตอนนี้ อาการน้องเสือ ดีขึ้นมากครับดีขึ้นตามลำดับ ขอบคุณคุณหมอมากนะครับ สำหรับการช่วยเหลือน้องเสือ และคำแนะนำอื่นๆ ครับ ไว้คราวหน้าจะไปใช้บริการอีกครั้งนะครับ คุณหมอ Goodjob.

0x30da3197c8afd491_0x9c611cba51993ca0.text: ไม่เคยผิดหวังเลยสักครั้งที่เข้าไปใช้บริการที่คลินิกแห่งนี้ตั้งแต่เปิดประตูเข้าไปจนได้เข้าห้องตรวจไปพูดคุยกับคุณหมอคุณหมอผู้หญิงน่ารักแนะนำดีมากพูดเพราะเป็นกันเองมากๆน้องผู้ช่วยก็น่ารักค่ารักษาไม่แพงและเวลาน้องแมวที่บ้านไม่สบายโทรไปปรึกษาคุณหมอคุณหมอก็ให้คำแนะนำดีมากยกให้เป็นคลินิกประจำของบ้านและเป็นคุณหมอประจำตัวน้องแมวที่บ้านทุกตัวเลยค่ะ👩🏻‍⚕️🏩🏥🐶😻💗

0x30da3197c8afd491_0x9c611cba51993ca0.text: พาน้องแมวมาทำวัคซีนเป็นประจำทุกปีค่ะ คลีนิกบริการดีมากค่ะ เรามีแมวสามตัว ผู้ช่วยจะมาช่วยตั้งแต่ลงรถเลยค่ะประทับใจมาก ทั้งคุณหมอและผู้ช่วยยิ้มต้อนรับเราเสมอค่ะ คุณหมอให้คำปรึกษาดีมาก เข้าใจง่าย เรื่องการรักษาไม่มีกังวลเลยค่ะ ให้คำแนะนำดี ทำให้รู้สึกเป็นกันเองสุดๆ แนะนำเลยค่ะไม่ผิดหวังสำหรับทาสแมวอย่างเราแน่นอนค่ะ☺️

0x30da3197c8afd491_0x9c611cba51993ca0.text: คุณหมอและผู้ช่วยให้บริการที่ดีค่ะ การทำหมันน้องแมวทั้ง2ตัวก่มาทำที่นี้ปลอดภัย ที่สำคัญน้องตื่นแล้วถึงพากลับบ้านได้ค่ะ มียาให้ มีนัดล้างแล้ว แผลแห้งเร็วดีและแผลเล็กนิดเดียวค่ะ ราคาย่อมเยาว์ด้วยค่ะ มีให้บริการทั้งรักษาอาการป่วย ทำแผล,ทำหมัน,ฉีดวัคซีน,ถ่ายพยาธิ,หยดหมัด etc

0x30da3197c8afd491_0x9c611cba51993ca0.text: Great vet and affordable prices! I recently took in a stray cat and the clinic staff has been wonderful with helping us make sure our girl is up to date on vaccines, blood work & sterilization. Great communication and good English. Highly recommend!
0x30da3197c8afd491_0x9c611cba51993ca0.author: Angelique M

0x30da3197c8afd491_0x9c611cba51993ca0.text: เคยใช้บริการเมื่อ 3 ปีที่แล้วตอนคลินิกเปิดใหม่ๆ และให้รีวิวไว้ 5 ดาว จากการดูแลของแพทย์ผู้ชาย ที่ซึ่งวันนี้เหมือนจะออกจากการทำงานที่คลินิกนี้ไปแล้ว (สังเกตุจากรูปและใบประกาศนียบัตรที่ถูกถอดออกจากผนัง) วันนี้ได้มีโอกาศกลับไปใช้บริการใหม่ แพทย์หญิงดูมีความรู้มากพอจะไว้วางใจให้รับบริการ แต่การแสดงออกและวาจายังไม่สมกับเป็นมืออาชีพ เทียบได้กับปากแม่ค้าตลาดสดแต่มีองค์ความรู้ทางสัตวแพทย์ก็ไม่เกินเลย แม้ชั้นเชิงการใช้คำพูดจะสูงจากสังคมที่มีการศึกษา แต่ก็เพราะผมมีการศึกษาเหมือนกันเลยมองออก คิดว่ายังต้องปรับปรุงในด้านมุมมองและทัศคติทางการบริการอีกมาก เพื่อให้เหมาะสมกับมาตรฐานฝีมือ รู้สึกผิดหวังและเสียความรู้สึกดีๆที่เคยมีให้คลินิกแห่งนี้ คิดว่าจะไม่กลับมาใช้บริการและแนะนำคลินิกให้กับคนไกล้เคียงอีกต่อไป ขอบคุณที่เปิดโอกาศให้หนึ่งในลูกค้าตัวเล็กๆของคุณได้แสดงความคิดเห็นและได้เข้าใจเป้าหมายของการให้บริการ ณ คลินิกแห่งนี้ สวัสดี 🙏
0x30da3197c8afd491_0x9c611cba51993ca0.author: kane kane

0x30e29f1d36790ccb_0x2c696ee33dd65679.text: I recently tried the XERF treatment at Entrio Clinic and was quite impressed. From the moment I entered the clinic, the atmosphere was clean and professional. The staff provided excellent advice, weren't pushy about buying courses, and explained everything clearly and easily, making it perfect for men who might not have tried this type of treatment before. The doctor was excellent; calm, attentive, and explained every step before starting, which made me feel confident. During the treatment, they constantly asked if I was okay, providing truly attentive care. The XERF machine felt warm on my skin during the treatment, but it wasn't as painful as I expected. Afterwards, my skin felt firmer and my face looked slightly more toned and radiant, with no downtime required. Overall, I loved it – both the service and the results. I highly recommend it! 👍
0x30e29f1d36790ccb_0x2c696ee33dd65679.author: Formost Wasupong

0x30e29f1d36790ccb_0x2c696ee33dd65679.text: I’ve been a regular at Entrio Clinic for many treatments, including Botox, Morpheus8, and Oligio. 0x30e299f132eaa2c5_0x1a8f1c74d5ee1fb3.text: Okay, finally a review! It's been a week since I said goodbye to glasses! ...Many people might wonder why I decided to get LASIK. To be honest, I was tired of wearing glasses. I personally had three pairs of glasses that I'd leave lying around the room, sometimes I couldn't find them, sometimes I'd forget them. So, I decided to get it done two days before the procedure – I booked an appointment right away. For this LASIK procedure, I had it done with Dr. Namphueng at Thonburi Bamrungmuang Hospital. I chose the femto LASIK technique, which uses a laser for surgery. ...Before the procedure, the nurse initially measured my corneal thickness, intraocular pressure, etc., to prepare for meeting the doctor. Initially, my cornea was slightly thinner than average, and I almost didn't get the femto technique. But the nurse said, "Wait until you see the doctor, and they'll reassess." ...Once I met the doctor, she assessed my cornea and said it was fine, which was a huge relief. I chose this technique because it has a shorter recovery time. For my profession, I didn't want a long recovery period because a long recovery means losing income. However, for those whose cornea is very thin after the procedure, the doctor will recommend the regular LASIK technique. (Which means a longer recovery period.) Before the surgery, the doctor will give you a consultation and do a detailed eye exam to determine how clear you want your eyes to be and how comfortable you want them to be. The doctor measures very precisely, even down to adjusting the angle of your eyes. It's amazing! …During the surgery, I wasn't very worried, the only thing I felt was cold. Maybe it's because I'm someone who gets cold easily, and the air conditioning in the operating room was so cold that I had to ask the nurse for a blanket. During the surgery, there wasn't much to it. The doctor would have me look at a single point of light. The nurse would put anesthetic eye drops in before the surgery, so there's no need to worry about pain or anything. It didn't hurt at all during the procedure. But when you see something close to your eye, it feels a little strange. But the nurses were great, they built up the atmosphere so well, it was amazing. The doctor was also great, constantly telling me, "I'm going to fire the laser now," "I'm firing it now," "Counting down 9 seconds." They explained every step, which really eased my anxiety. But, I have to whisper, when they fired the laser, it smelled like burning fuse, like using a mosquito swatter. Hahaha. That's it. 10 or 15 seconds. I think the whole procedure for both eyes took less than 15 minutes, or maybe even faster. I'm not sure, but it felt like it didn't take long at all. It was amazing! …The post-procedure symptoms were eye irritation, like dry eyes all the time. The doctor advised me to sleep and avoid using my eyes for 4-6 hours. After sleeping, when I woke up, wow, my vision was starting to clear up to about 80% (as far as I could see through the eye shields). I woke up, ate, took my medicine, and went back to sleep. The first day I woke up, I took off the eye shields, and I could see like crazy! Crystal clear, full HD! A thought flashed through my mind: "I should have done this a long time ago!!!!" I don't know what I was afraid of. …Today marks one week since the procedure, and I feel like my vision is almost 100%, but at night, when I look at lights, they still appear blurry. The doctor said this is normal and will gradually improve after a week. …From the moment I had the procedure until now, I feel I made the right decision to get LASIK with Dr. Namphueng. The doctor is kind and explained everything clearly. The nurses and staff are all lovely, especially the staff at Thonburi Bamrungmuang Hospital. They are so cheerful and helpful; they even stand by the elevator, press the button, and constantly ask if I need anything. It's amazing! …Finally, I want to say that for anyone deciding whether or not to get LASIK, I highly recommend Dr. Namphueng. Let me tell you, it's great! If you have the money, just do it. Plus, the hospital offers installment payments via credit card, which is amazing! And another thing, the femto technique I had done is currently at a really good price. It even includes a free night's stay at the hospital! It's totally worth it because after the procedure, you only need to come back for a check-up the next day, so it's super convenient. You just wake up and go straight down for your check-up without having to travel. It's especially easy if you're traveling alone (but it's better if you have someone with you). The rooms are also great and very clean. Check out the admin and their current promotions. (I had mine done in February 2026)
0x30e299f132eaa2c5_0x1a8f1c74d5ee1fb3.author: Pimmy Makeup

0x30e299f132eaa2c5_0x1a8f1c74d5ee1fb3.text: The story is that I've been nearsighted since the first year of high school, so I've worn glasses ever since, and contact lenses occasionally. Around the fourth year of high school, a friend got LASIK surgery. She told me about it, and it was terrifying! The machine was making loud noises, the lights would disappear while she was looking, and all sorts of other problems (90s technology, you know, so it must have been as scary as she described). I wanted to do it too. At first, I planned to ask my parents, but I was afraid of going blind. I'm not handsome, and if I went blind, would I even be able to find a wife? So I put it off and just wore glasses and contact lenses ever since. Time flew by… Then, three years ago, Som got it done. When she came back, she asked me again, "How was it?" This time, the plot changed! There were no loud banging noises, the machine was very quiet, and it didn't hurt at all. So I got motivated again. I wanted to do it, but asking my parents for money wasn't an option anymore. I had to work and save up, scrimping and ditching. But by the time I saved enough, I needed lenses, a flash, a light… everything went wrong. So I started researching again. Actually, I was going to do it before I went to the Koh Larn Trail photoshoot. But I was afraid of going to the beach because of the strong sun and dust, plus riding a motorbike, and after Koh Larn I had a packed schedule with no free time. I asked the doctor, and they said it was possible, but to be careful of sweat getting in my eyes. I sweat a lot, so I postponed it. I finally got an appointment yesterday with Dr. Namphueng for LASIK double eyelid surgery. There was a discount promotion, and it included a room in the hospital. After booking, I drove there alone. When I arrived at the Thonburi Bamrungmuang LASIK Center by ACRS, I registered and had a preliminary eye exam. I wasn't nervous yet while waiting to see the doctor. When the doctor came, she did a detailed eye test. I also have farsightedness. The doctor let me choose whether to remove all the grafts or leave some for reading. I chose to remove them all. So, I opted for femto. While waiting for the procedure, I started to get nervous. They alternated between anesthetic and antibiotic eye drops. When it was time to go under the knife, I lay down. The doctor and nurse were very calm. They explained every step. "Open the corneal flap," they said. "Look at the light, the instrument will block your view. Look at the light, 3, 2, 1, done!" They said. I rested for a bit, then they did the other eye until it was finished. I thought to myself, "Wow, I was just scared for nothing. There was nothing to be afraid of." I went up to my room, took my medicine, and slept from the afternoon until morning, waking up and falling asleep intermittently. When I woke up in the morning, I washed my eyes as the doctor recommended, took a shower, and then stood looking out the window. The first thing I saw was... I could see Wat Phra Kaew (Temple of the Emerald Buddha) so clearly with my own eyes! I wish I had done this sooner. I just went to the doctor to check the wound; everything's fine. There's still some irritation, but the doctor said to use artificial tears frequently. I can drive home now. In short, I should have done this a long time ago. If anyone is considering it, I highly recommend it. It's not as scary as you think. In short #2, I can finally wear my sunglasses that I've been collecting!
0x30e299f132eaa2c5_0x1a8f1c74d5ee1fb3.author: RUNPIX

0x30e299f132eaa2c5_0x1a8f1c74d5ee1fb3.text: 👀🫰🏼 New Eyes Near Me ❤️ 🎉 Review of LASIK Surgery for New Eyes Near Me I had Femto LASIK surgery at Thonburi Bamrungmuang Hospital with Dr. Namphueng. She's very kind, friendly, and lovely. 👁️ First, I had a consultation with the doctor, but the procedure couldn't be done because I had an infection and clouding in both eyes, so I had to recover for a week. 👁️ The following week, I went to see the doctor, feeling incredibly anxious about whether I could have the surgery. Finally, the doctor said I could, so I decided to go ahead with it immediately. 💕 The doctor was so kind and gave me the option of a razor-blade procedure, which might save money, but I was already set on Femto LASIK. 👁️ When it was time for the procedure, the doctor was very kind and explained everything that would be done. When the laser was fired, I smelled burning, as they say, but I didn't feel any pain because they used a lot of anesthetic. After the procedure, the doctor checked my eyes and took me to my room. 💕 This package included a one-night stay. In the room, my sister was there to keep me company, which was great. Everything was complete, the room was clean, and I slept comfortably. The nurses were very attentive and caring. 💕 My boyfriend brought me food and drinks, which was great. 👁️ In the first few days after the procedure, my eyes hurt, and when I slept, my eyes would tear up a lot, causing a burning sensation on both the left and right sides alternately. I couldn't open my eyes, even though the doctor told me to rest for 6 hours. I kept waking up even after taking the sleeping pills the doctor gave me. 👁️ When I woke up the next morning, my vision started to clear up, and I could see on my own again. This time, the doctor had me wear sunglasses for another eye checkup, and then I was able to go home. ❤️ In summary, if anyone is considering LASIK surgery, I recommend Dr. Namphueng. She's lovely, friendly, and I was very impressed. I also recommend Thonburi Bamrungmuang Hospital; it's clean, luxurious, and not expensive. ❤️ Finally, I want to thank all my friends and family for their support and for taking such good care of me throughout the procedure and my hospital stay. ❤️ Thank you to my sister for taking such good care of me. ❤️ Thank you to my husband for paying for it so I could see a new world, and for buying me food and drinks. ❤️ Thank you to myself for having the courage to do it and for opening my heart to this new pair of eyes. It's amazing! 🙏🏻 I apologize if I haven't replied to everyone, but thank you for all the encouragement. I couldn't use my eyes for two days, but today I'm much better. 💕 LASIK Double Eyelid Surgery by Dr. Namphueng

0x30e299f132eaa2c5_0x1a8f1c74d5ee1fb3.text: Review of LASIK and ICL Implant at Thonburi Bamrungmuang LASIK Center by Dr. Namphueng (ACRS) Left Eye: Femto LASIK -7.75 diopters, -4.00 diopters Right Eye: ICL -13.50 diopters, -3.50 diopters I was very impressed with Dr. Namphueng and I am grateful for her excellent care from the first consultation and decision to have LASIK. It was a very good decision. Before the surgery, my vision was already blurry; it felt like I was only using my left eye, while my right eye couldn't see anything at all, only close up. I could barely see signs while driving. So I decided I should get LASIK. However, because of my high prescription, most doctors recommended ICL implants, so I waited because I was scared. Then I consulted with Dr. Namphueng and finally got treatment. They explained that my left eye could have Femto LASIK with full diopter, although some refractive error might remain, but my right eye needed ICL. I decided to go ahead with it because of the thorough explanation and information. Initially, I was very scared about the eye that needed the ICL implant, especially after watching videos of the procedure. On the day of the surgery, I requested additional local anesthesia for peace of mind (normally it's not necessary). The procedure itself wasn't scary at all. The doctor explained every step. I only felt something pushing against my eye. It was over in less than 15 minutes. Then I moved to another room for the Femto LASIK surgery on the other eye. I just lay still and looked at the green lights above me. The doctor and nurses told me to stay still for only 20 seconds, and it was done. This felt much easier than the lens implant surgery. Everything was done. Dr. Namphueng and the nurses did an excellent job. I was very impressed. Afterwards, they had me stay overnight. The rooms and the nurses at this hospital were excellent, much better than many other hospitals. They were very kind. One day after the surgery, my vision was somewhat clear, with some blurriness. I didn't feel any pain, just some tightness in the eye that had the ICL surgery, and some dryness in the Femto eye. I was even able to drive myself home, which was great. Seven days after the surgery, my vision gradually improved. Sometimes it was clear, sometimes slightly blurry, but nothing abnormal. Post-operative care was simple: just use the eye drops as prescribed by the doctor, avoid washing your hair, and prevent activities that cause sweating. Also, keep water out of your eyes. **Highly recommended for anyone interested in LASIK surgery. The doctor is excellent, 10/10.**
0x30e299f132eaa2c5_0x1a8f1c74d5ee1fb3.author: sorrakrit thirapaisit

0x30e299f132eaa2c5_0x1a8f1c74d5ee1fb3.text: Happy Birthday to me! 🎂🎂 This year, I gifted myself LASIK surgery to say goodbye to my glasses. This year has brought many changes in my life, but what remains is my warm family, my supportive sister, my lovely friends, my demanding but stable job, and now my wonderful husband and his family. May this year be filled with happiness for me and my family, may my parents be healthy, may my savings increase, and may my shifts be smooth and not exhausting. 🙏🙏🏻 Review of my birthday gift: “New eyesight, closer to me!” 12 years of wearing glasses and 3 years of deciding to get LASIK. I was about to insert a tube in a patient when sweat got into my eyes. I couldn't wipe it off because it was on my glasses, they kept falling off, and my eyes stung and tears streamed down my cheeks. After the doctor finished inserting the tube, I rushed to wipe the sweat off, feeling very frustrated because it was an emergency situation. I started researching LASIK, looking for hospitals where people I knew had it done, and reading reviews about the pros and cons. Everyone said the benefits outweighed the drawbacks; it makes life easier because you don't have to wear glasses, although you might experience dry eyes sometimes, which can be helped by artificial tears. Because of my fear, I wasn't brave enough to get it done yet. I kept reading reviews and checking out different hospitals until today. Okay!! I don't want to wear glasses anymore. At work, I won't have to worry about sweat getting in my eyes and not being able to wipe them clean. This year, another problem arose: when my husband kisses me, my glasses get scratched, so I have to wipe them clean constantly. So, I decided to just do it. I'd read reviews and researched quite a bit. Dr. Namphueng, Dr. Suthanee Sorthirathi, is a skilled doctor with many reviews. But… on the day of the procedure, I was still scared. My eyes… eye procedures are scary! 😂 But the doctor explained everything from the initial eye exam to the completion of the procedure, including post-procedure care. Everything was explained in an easy-to-understand way, which reduced my fear. After the procedure, I took Paracetamol and Diazepam and slept for about 5 hours. When I woke up, my eyes were crystal clear! My new eyesight is truly near-perfect. Bye-bye, Paphat's glasses! 👐🏻❤️💕
0x30e299f132eaa2c5_0x1a8f1c74d5ee1fb3.author: Papassara Wapeeka

0x30e299f132eaa2c5_0x1a8f1c74d5ee1fb3.text: Hello! Today, I'd like to share my own fresh and up-to-date LASIK experience (surgery on December 4th) at Thonburi Bamrungmuang Hospital with Dr. (Ph.D.), Asst. Prof. Dr. Theerathep Tantayakom. I have to say... I was absolutely impressed from start to finish. ❤️ Previously, I was extremely nearsighted, with a thin cornea. Plus, I spent a lot of time at the computer due to work. I experienced flashes of light for a while, which led me to a very thorough eye exam. And that's when I met Dr. Theerathep. The doctor had me treat my corneal ruptures first (both eyes 😭). He didn't rush me to have surgery, saying, "Let your eyes be strong first. Safety is more important." I really liked that. He took me step by step, didn't push me on packages, and didn't push me on anything. After the procedure, he started his LASIK assessment. The pre-surgery exam was incredibly thorough, detailing everything from corneal thickness, curvature, and dry eye level. The doctor also explained in a very easy-to-understand way that there are many techniques, including Femto, PRK, and ReLEx. There's not just one type of LASIK, as many people think. Femto was a good choice for me because my cornea is quite thin and I use the computer a lot. The doctor said it was the safest option for my eyes and emphasized "safety over clarity." I felt like he was choosing based on my true eye condition, not trying to sell me anything. I was surprised when I entered the surgery room. It wasn't scary at all. The doctor had a very gentle hand, constantly saying, "Just one more step," "Easy, easy, easy," and really helped me relax. It was so quick, I didn't even have time to think about it. 😂 After the procedure, my vision was immediately clearer, about 70–80%. It felt like HD vision, but there was some fog, which the nurse said was normal. He explained in great detail what eye drops to use, when to use them, what to do and what not to do, and how to rest my eyes to reduce dryness in the early stages. Overall, it was really great. The doctors, nurses, and all the staff were friendly and caring. For anyone who's hesitant, I can tell you that LASIK isn't as scary as you think. If you're looking for a truly thorough examination, considering your true eye condition, and not pushy sales pitches, this hospital is the best! ✨❤️

0x3102bf25de0dfd2f_0x2a85782a1182f7ad.text: I started researching online from various sources until I found reviews about this Pattaya LASIK center, which was known for its specialized expertise. I contacted them and found them responsive and regularly updated with information, so I decided to go with them. 1. The first step is an eye examination, costing approximately 1500 baht. The doctor will then assess whether your eyes are suitable for the procedure. “We don’t make the decision ourselves, that’s important!” 2. If the doctor determines that you are suitable, they will inform you of the procedure and cost, and schedule a surgery date. 3. On the day of the surgery, your face and eye area are sterilized before the procedure. It was a very unique experience for me – just looking at green and red lights for less than 5 minutes. It wasn't painful, just exciting and surprising that it was already over! 4. After the procedure, you can see immediately, but you should close your eyes frequently to aid healing and prevent infection, as advised by the doctor. 5. Follow-up appointments are scheduled for 1 day, 7 days, 1 month, 3 months, and 6 months, including eye drops as prescribed. *During the first 7 days, I experienced sensitivity to bright light, eye fatigue, and light scattering. However, this improved after that period. The only issue is occasional glare at night; it doesn't make life that difficult. Overall, I'm very satisfied with the results. 6. I didn't receive any benefits; I'm just someone who wanted to share information in case others wanted to try it. My prescription was -350-400. After the procedure, I no longer need glasses. I can swim and play sports freely. I'm 25 years old, which makes me want to try many more things in life. Consider it yourself: consult a doctor, save money, and set goals.
0x3102bf25de0dfd2f_0x2a85782a1182f7ad.author: THEPTARIN MONYANONT

0x3102bf25de0dfd2f_0x2a85782a1182f7ad.text: I lived in Löbau, Germany until 1.5 years ago and had cataract surgery. Now I'm in Pattaya, Thailand. After the surgery, I was extremely sensitive to light. In the evenings and in supermarkets, LED lights in particular caused me to see blurry lines and an aura around the light source. I could only see distant objects as if through a fog. It was very distressing. Then I read about YAG laser treatment. They dilate the pupils with drops, and then the laser is applied to the eye. After 24 hours, I can see clearly again, I have no more blurry vision, and no more aura around light sources in the dark. It's wonderful! I just wonder: WHY DIDN'T I HAVE THIS DONE SOONER? The total cost was about 13,000 baht, using the latest technology from Zeiss. Thank you to the whole team and the doctor. Very professional! Unfortunately, I had already been to the same hospital in Bangkok a year ago. Two nights of extreme abdominal pain (antibiotic overdose) cost well over 200,000 baht. Against medical advice, I discharged myself because I didn't want to spend any more money and was feeling somewhat better. When it came time to pay for the eye surgery, they seriously claimed I still owed 40,000 baht?! I explained that I had discontinued the treatment because I wasn't prepared to pay that exact amount if I were to continue. I specifically confirmed with the treating physician that everything was paid for and completed, and that my medication was already included in the final payment. Disappointingly, even though it had been clarified and agreed upon, I was left feeling like someone who hadn't paid their bill. Annoying, but it seems that discrepancies frequently occur there.

0x3102bf25de0dfd2f_0x2a85782a1182f7ad.text: 7 days after Femto LASIK surgery ✨ with Dr. Bandhit Leethanaporn, I'm reviewing my experience and I'm very impressed 🩷 From the consultation day, the eye examination was very thorough. On the actual surgery day, the doctor provided detailed information, was patient, and explained each step clearly, making me feel confident and comfortable before the procedure. The nursing team and staff provided excellent service. They were attentive, provided detailed instructions on post-operative care, including eye drops, face washing, and eye use, and responded quickly to my messages. My questions after the procedure were answered promptly, which made me feel very secure. My post-operative results: * The day after the procedure, my vision was much clearer, feeling almost like when I was wearing contact lenses. * Initially, my eyes were dry, but I could use artificial tears frequently as advised. * After about 3 days, the symptoms improved significantly, but there was still slight irritation occasionally. * Now, 6 days later, my eyes feel much more comfortable, and life is much easier. * My distance vision is still not 100% sharp in some areas, but I understand this is part of the recovery process. The doctor explained that it might take about 1-3 months for my vision to fully stabilize. Overall, I was very impressed with the results, the care, and the post-procedure follow-up. I feel like I made the right decision choosing this place 😊 If you're hesitant about LASIK, I highly recommend coming in for a consultation. They have great payment plans available, which made the decision easier 🩷

In conclusion, my hair transplant procedure was well worth the reasonable cost. Our hair resources are scarce. We have therefore only undergone hair restoration surgery twice. I'm convinced that broadly certified doctors truly matter to ensure an effective outcome. For me, a very meticulous and skillful procedure was delivered by Dr. Suradej and his team. I expected my consultation with him to result in a second hair transplant, but in fact, he has completely persuaded me not to do this (yet), putting my long term success ahead of short term financial profits. He took the time out of his schedule to sit with me, free of charge, to advise me on everything I could do without actually paying for surgery. This is the opposite approach of other clinics I have spoken to, who are trying to force you into surgery after the first 2 minutes of conversation. The staff in THTC were all very welcoming and accommodated me at short notice. A superb experience, because of superb people. Reason #5000 why I love Chiang Mai.
0x30da3a88d00506a9_0x3c8f1ecd5468a5f7.author: Max A.

0x30da3a88d00506a9_0x3c8f1ecd5468a5f7.text: I admit, I was a little skeptical about getting a hair transplant abroad. Coming from Australia. I first got one done nearly 10 years ago from Dr Pong. I have had a couple of touch ups since then. So 3 hair transplants now. Dr Pong and the team are not only super friendly but also they are extremely good at what they do. Dr Pong and the team leaves no stone unturned to make your hair transplant as easy as possible. I have terrible hair genetics, but Dr Pong has allowed me to survive my 20’s and now 30’s with a full crop of hair. I can’t thank him enough. Best investment I have made. Look no further. Fantastic value and even better service. 5 stars *****
0x30da3a88d00506a9_0x3c8f1ecd5468a5f7.author: Ryan Grundy

0x311d635105b30e4b_0xd45dabe7682c14ce.en: Today, I decided to pursue my dream. I spent a long time choosing a clinic, and finally settled on this one. I have to say, I was incredibly impressed. From the front desk service to the staff and the doctor, everything was wonderful. Everyone was so lovely and friendly; I didn't feel intimidated at all. I could ask the doctor anything I didn't know and get advice right away. The doctor gave excellent recommendations; they weren't pushy or trying to force me to do anything just to make money. Their advice was straightforward and honest. They didn't force me to do a specific number of teeth; they let me know my budget and allowed me to do as many as I wanted. And the doctor was incredibly gentle, even though she's a pediatrician, her skills are exceptional. I'm so impressed and will definitely be a patient and continue to receive treatments at this clinic in the future. ❤️🥰

0x30e29ed001aacf57_0xad8f448f8bb2e7f6.text: I had six zirconia crowns done at this clinic, perfectly adapted to my existing implants, and the quality is outstanding. Several months have passed, and everything still feels perfect — no discomfort, no food getting stuck, no issues at all. After a very bad experience with crowns made in Turkey, I finally understand how important true quality is. This clinic is not cheap, but the work is done at the same professional level as in Switzerland. My dentist at home confirmed that the results are excellent and of the highest standard. The clinic is spotless, the atmosphere is calm and welcoming, and the staff is incredibly kind and professional. The doctor was gentle, caring, and made me feel completely safe throughout the treatment. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone who values their health. Thank you for the excellent care — I will definitely come back.

Dr. Joy and her team are caring, kind, and thoughtful. I was well taken care of! Dr. Joy invested time and energy to help give me the best smile. They also took the time to explain the dental treatment I was receiving, for which I am grateful as I appreciate it when health professionals support my health literacy. I am so happy I found them!

This clinic was recommended to me by the hotel staff at The Athenée when I had a small dental emergency while on holiday in Bangkok. The team at PaYa speaks English very well, the pricing is transparent, and everything was explained carefully to me. Thank you very much for the help!

The treatment and environment itself is very good, staff are very friendly and accommodating, however, in my opinion, it seems that in case if foreigners the goal is to get as much money as possible. I went there specifically for teeth cleaning. They do unnecessary scan (why do it for teeth cleaning?) and told me I need to do 4 fillings. Upon return to Germany I went immediately to my regular dentist and I was told my teeth are fine and do not require fillings at the moment, except for one which he recommended to do later due to wearing Invisalign. If you have money or insurance pays, you can go there. Seems like more of a clinic expats who don’t mind spending cash. Maybe good place for Americans but as a European no. I recommend Already trusting Dr Tapasit for some years for my wreck damaged teeth. Recently had a difficult extraction to do on a molar tooth with the root only remaining to extract. Was done in less than 10 minutes without pain and difficulties though it is usually a difficult task to perform. Special care is brought by the team to avoid the pain. Even they use local gum anesthetic before doing main injection !! Prices are quite fair, especially for big jobs (implants, etc..) and there is no cheating : I normally had to set up 2 implants and some bone adding...but it finally ended with only one implant as the space between teeth was not enough to set up 2 implants. Dr Tapasit speaks a perfect English, so communication is quite easy and he is really pleasant to deal with. I highly recommend Adenza dental, especially for foreigners who are usually quite demanding.

Dr. Tapasit is a professional, skilled and very personable dentist who was trained in the United States at Georgetown University. His Pattaya practice is a cut above the rest and definitely state-of-the art. Both his parents are physicians and he speaks perfect English since he was raised in the US from age 9, returning to Thailand 25 years later. While he could, no doubt, be a top tier dentist in any wealthy American city, he has (like many of us) opted for a less stressful life in Thailand where he has raised a family with his Thai wife. If you are an expat American, Aussie or Brit, Dr. Tapasit is definitely someone that you will feel comfortable with and you will likely make Dr. Tapasit your dentist, just as I have done.

0x311d7ee17bf29df9_0x91c69eb3f9890ebe.en: After my teeth cleaning (tartar removal), my teeth still felt rough and not clean. I asked the dentist to polish one spot again, but other areas still felt rough. Honestly, they should have made my teeth smooth from the start. It wasted my time, but the dentist was kind and addressed my complaint. However, I feel that tartar removal should be more thorough to ensure smooth and clean teeth. I also had three fillings done, which took less than an hour. I have minimal tartar buildup because I take good care of my teeth. There's some tartar in deeper areas that are hard to reach with a toothbrush, but it's very little. Since I get annual tartar removal, I want my teeth to be clean and smooth in every nook and cranny. I'm paying for it, after all.

0x30e299c2f26c470d_0x7df28135db5f6490.text: อยากมารีวิวคลินิกทันตกรรมนี้ เพราะประทับใจมากจริง ๆ ค่ะ ปกติเป็นคนกลัวหมอฟันมาก แต่ที่นี่ทำให้ความรู้สึกกลัวลดลงไปเยอะเลย ตั้งแต่เดินเข้าคลินิก พนักงานต้อนรับพูดจาดี สุภาพ ยิ้มแย้ม ให้คำแนะนำดีมาก บรรยากาศในคลินิกสะอาด เครื่องมือดูใหม่และทันสมัย ทำให้รู้สึกปลอดภัย ก่อนทำ คุณหมอจะตรวจและอธิบายรายละเอียดก่อนทุกขั้นตอน บอกว่าควรทำอะไร ไม่ควรทำอะไร แนะนำตามสภาพฟันจริง ๆ ไม่ได้ขายคอร์สหรือบังคับทำเพิ่มแบบที่เคยเจอบางที่ ตรงนี้รู้สึกดีมาก เพราะรู้สึกว่าคุณหมอคิดถึงคนไข้จริง ๆ ตอนทำฟัน คุณหมอมือเบามาก คอยถามตลอดว่าเจ็บไหม ไหวไหม ถ้าเริ่มเสียวหรือเจ็บสามารถยกมือได้ คุณหมอหยุดให้พักทันที ไม่รีบทำ งานละเอียดมาก หลังทำเสร็จคุณหมอยังแนะนำวิธีดูแลฟัน การแปรงฟัน การใช้ไหมขัดฟัน และการดูแลหลังทำอย่างละเอียด เรื่องราคา คลินิกแจ้งราคาก่อนทำทุกครั้ง ไม่มีบวกเพิ่มทีหลัง ราคาสมเหตุสมผล ไม่แพงเกินไปเมื่อเทียบกับคุณภาพและการบริการที่ได้รับ สรุปเลยคือ ประทับใจทั้งคุณหมอ พนักงาน การบริการ ความสะอาด และความใส่ใจคนไข้ ใครที่กลัวการทำฟันหรือกำลังมองหาคลินิกทันตกรรมดี ๆ แนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะ ตอนนี้ตัดสินใจให้เป็นคลินิกประจำแล้ว และจะแนะนำเพื่อนกับคนในครอบครัวมาทำที่นี่แน่นอนค่ะ

0x30e299c2f26c470d_0x7df28135db5f6490.en: I wanted to review this dental clinic because I was truly impressed. I'm usually terrified of dentists, but this place significantly reduced my fear. From the moment I walked in, the reception staff were polite, friendly, and gave excellent advice. The clinic was clean, and the equipment looked new and modern, making me feel safe. Before treatment, the dentist examined and explained every step in detail, outlining what should and shouldn't be done. They provided personalized recommendations based on my teeth's condition, without trying to push extra treatments or packages like I've experienced at other places. This felt really good, showing the dentist genuinely cared about the patient. During treatment, the dentist was incredibly gentle, constantly asking if I was in pain or if I could manage. If I felt sensitivity or discomfort, they would stop immediately to let me rest. They were very meticulous and didn't rush the process. After treatment, the dentist gave detailed instructions on how to care for my teeth, including brushing, flossing, and post-treatment care. Regarding pricing, the clinic informed me of the cost before every procedure, with no hidden fees. The prices were reasonable considering the quality and service received. In summary, I was impressed with the dentist, staff, service, cleanliness, and the patient's care. If you're afraid of dental work or looking for a good dental clinic, I highly recommend this one. I've now made it my regular clinic and will definitely recommend it to friends and family.

0x30da3198d3ec88a5_0x4e67415e8d1c156f.text: I had a hair transplant at this clinic in early 2026. The doctor and all the staff provided excellent service and offered detailed and friendly advice regarding hair care/hair transplantation. The doctor was gentle and highly skilled; the procedure was almost painless (it took one day), and lunch was provided. After the procedure, the clinic offered wound cleaning and washing services for 9 days. Importantly, the clinic was clean and equipped with modern equipment for FUE and DHI transplants, and also offered PRP and light therapy. After 9 days, the doctor prescribed medication, shampoo, and hair supplements for continued hair care. I had a shaved-head transplant with 1917 grafts, and the price was affordable. For those who are hesitant, don't be afraid, and I recommend consulting with Dr. Peera to find the cause and treatment options for hair loss. Guarantee you won't be disappointed. 10/10 I completed a hair transplant at MP clinic in Jan 2026. Overall, the doctors and staff personnel were extremely professional and friendly. They are true experts in this field and can answer any of your hair related questions/concerns. The clinic had various high tech equipments to facilitate the FUE and DHI transplant. They also offer PRP, red-light therapy. The transplant had minimal pain and took 1 day to complete. (They also give you lunch). After the transplant, the clinic provided 9 days of post care treatment which included hair cleaning and scab removals. The whole procedure went smoothly. After the transplant, you will obtain medication, and supplemental products for your hair. I personally performed a transplant of 1917 grafts and paid a very reasonable price for it. If you are on the fence, don’t hesitate to visit the Clinic and discuss with Dr. Peera to find the best solution and treatment for your hair problems. I highly recommend this place. 10/10

0x30da3198d3ec88a5_0x4e67415e8d1c156f.text: I’m from Canada, and like most people considering a hair transplant, I first looked at Turkey and Bangkok. When I got to Chiang Mai, I visited a few of the “top” clinics that looked great on paper — glossy posters, glowing reviews — but the vibe felt off. Too salesy, too transactional. Then I found MP Clinic. From the first visit, it was different. The doctor, the staff, even the owners — everyone treated me like a human being, not a number. No push, no pressure. Just straight professionalism and genuine care. Now, after actually going through the procedure and recovery here, I can say this: it’s a no-brainer choice compared to the others I visited. They went above and beyond at every step, and made what could have been a stressful process into something I’m actually grateful for. MP Clinic is a hidden gem in Chiang Mai. If you’re researching like I was, save yourself the second-guessing — this is the place.

0x30da3198d3ec88a5_0x4e67415e8d1c156f.text: I have to say, I've had hair thinning problems for many years. At first, I thought it was normal, maybe due to stress or lack of sleep. But as time went on, my hair started thinning noticeably, especially in the middle of my head and on my forehead. This significantly reduced my self-confidence. I didn't dare tie my hair up or style it in a way that showed my forehead. So, I decided to look for a serious hair thinning treatment clinic. 0x310295fd3e3c682b_0xda32ff6e6dc9173b.text: I want to give this clinic's doctor a good review. The mole on the bottom right corner had been treated with laser in China once, which was basically ineffective. I came to this clinic last October for treatment; the price was 2500 baht for two moles. The mole on the bottom right corner was almost completely gone after one treatment. As you can see in the picture, it was due to hair growing from a follicle and some small amount of gray pigment deposition. Overall, I'm very satisfied; the mole is now smooth. The mole on the top left corner was almost completely removed after one treatment, but there was still a tiny bit left. I had it treated a second time in January. The doctor didn't penetrate too deeply with the laser to avoid scarring, but a very small spot still remained. Today was my second touch-up treatment. This time, the doctor increased the laser intensity and told me that if it wasn't completely removed, surgical removal might be necessary. I won't do it again this time, regardless of whether it's completely removed or not, because I'm generally satisfied. The last two laser treatments were free. The doctor is an elderly gentleman who only sees patients for a total of 4 hours each day, in the morning and afternoon, so remember to make an appointment in advance if you want to see him.
0x310295fd3e3c682b_0xda32ff6e6dc9173b.author: heyimcccui

0x310295fd3e3c682b_0xda32ff6e6dc9173b.text: I had a wart behind my ear that I wanted removed. At Memorial Hospital, I was first examined by a dermatologist (THB 1050). She told me that the wart could simply be cut off, but that she didn't have enough experience with it. Therefore, the dermatologist referred me to an ear, nose, and throat specialist, who also examined the wart (THB 850) and told me that he could cut it off immediately. Memorial Hospital quoted me THB 16,500 for the entire procedure, including the removal and examination! Because that was far too much for me, the doctor offered to remove the wart at his own private clinic for around THB 8,000-9,000. Since that was still too expensive, I searched online for an experienced dermatologist. There I read several positive reviews about Dr. [Name of dermatologist missing in original text]. Somnuek. I finally had him remove my wart with a laser. It took less than 10 minutes and cost just 2000 THB! Two weeks have passed since then, and I haven't had any problems at all. I get the impression that Dr. Somnuek is very experienced and trustworthy. The price-performance ratio is also excellent. Therefore, I can highly recommend him and give him 5 stars!
0x310295fd3e3c682b_0xda32ff6e6dc9173b.author: Markus Breitenstein

0x30e29e55a8dbc7bd_0xe4fb214a7fe4600c.text: Our whole family uses their services. Especially when our children catch a cold, we can almost always get an appointment even on the same day, which is a great help when we need to see a doctor urgently. When I go for appointments myself, DYM's interpreters are often very skilled; they listen carefully to what I want to say to the doctor and translate it for me, so I don't feel much of a language barrier, which makes the visit very stress-free. Also, being able to make and change appointments via LINE is very helpful. The health checkups are especially quick, so even though I usually go to a designated general hospital, I always think I'd like to have them done at DYM. They are very thorough, providing results for mammograms and ultrasounds on DVD. The only thing that always causes me trouble is the medication. The "dosage and administration instructions" are clearly written on the Ziploc bag containing the medication, but there is nothing written on the medication itself. (Especially bottled medication) I have to write "2ml 3 times a day for [medical condition]" myself with a marker and store it in the refrigerator. Sometimes, even permanent markers repel the ink and disappear... and I wonder whose it is... I wish they would put labels on the medication itself. That's about the only thing that bothers me; the hospital staff are really kind and even entertain the children during examinations.
0x30e29e55a8dbc7bd_0xe4fb214a7fe4600c.author: Hanae ohi

0x30e29e55a8dbc7bd_0xe4fb214a7fe4600c.text: [DYM International Clinic 49 Branches] In October 2023, I visited Bangkok, Thailand for the first time on a business inspection. A representative from a Japanese company in Thailand told me, "There's a hospital where Japanese tourists and Japanese residents in Thailand can feel safe." I was given special permission to tour the inside of the hospital. It appears to be the first medical institution in Thailand operated by a Japanese company, and of course, the staff are available in Japanese. It appears to provide specialized medical care comparable to that of a large hospital, including internal medicine and pediatrics, and is equipped with a variety of specialized medical equipment. It appears to be frequently used for employee health checkups at Japanese companies, and is also highly valued as aftercare for those working overseas. I feel at ease because I have many friends and acquaintances who are doctors in Japan, but I'll have no worries when I visit Thailand in the future if I suddenly become ill. They told me about a great hospital. 😊
0x30e29e55a8dbc7bd_0xe4fb214a7fe4600c.author: 太田英樹

0x30e29e55a8dbc7bd_0xe4fb214a7fe4600c.text: I'm Japanese. Unvaccinated people currently need a negative certificate for nucleic acid amplification testing (e.g., PCR testing) or quantitative antigen testing before returning to Japan. This hospital is the first medical facility in Thailand operated by a Japanese company, and I found it because it had good reviews from Japanese people. I immediately emailed them to make an appointment. They responded within 1-2 hours, and since I emailed five days in advance, I was able to get an appointment at the date and time I wanted. (Note: Currently, email responses are only available on weekdays.) I don't speak any Thai, so having a nearby hospital that speaks Japanese was extremely helpful. I recommend it.

0x3050318f53e771bd_0xb9884a958ae075d8.text: Had an infection on my hand, I was on antibiotics from a local pharmacy, but after a few days the wound still didn't look great so I decided to come here. Staff were very helpful, everyone spoken enough English that the process was clear and easy. Arrived on Monday at 11:00AM, was promptly seen for paperwork and then a nurse for initial assessment. Total wait time of 5 or 10 minutes. They scheduled an appointment for the same day at 2:00pm with a doctor. At 2:00 I was seen immediately by the doctor! I was amazed that a big busy hospital like this was on time with appointments. The doctor wanted to get a tissue sample, so I went to another room and waited for a bit while things were prepared. The doctor came in, cleaned the wound and took a sample. I told the doctor I didn't want freezing as the wound didn't really hurt, and he listened and respected my choice. I then waited about 20 minutes for the test results, and they came back negative, nothing to worry about. Can't recommend this place enough to travellers! It would have been easier for them to just give me some mega dose of antibiotics and send me on my way (and they could have made more money off me). But they took their time, did it right, and were very professional. And all said and done total cost: only 1500 Bhat! Can't beat that. Amazing service.

0x30e29b8c64d5fe77_0x160fcd8d81add07d.text: I happened to have to make two visits to Bang Po Hospital. Four or five years ago, I broke my left foot. I was staying in the Saphan Kwai district, close to Bang Po. My foot was X-rayed, I was shown the cracked bone and the orthopedic surgeon advised me to wear a special shoe and keep my feet up for two weeks. He and the nurses and staff were very professional and able. Two years ago, I developed a bad infection in my right elbow. It hardened like stone and started to spread down to my hand and up to my shoulder. Again, I went to Bang Po Hospital. They admitted me and the admitting doctor wan another orthopedic surgeon. It turned out I had MRSA, myocin resistant staph infection. Luckily, my surgeon opened my elbow and cleared out as much of the infectious material in my elbow that he could reach. It took awhile but I was OK. The charges for both trips were staggeringly cheap. With MRSA, I had a private room for a week, outpatient for a week, surgery, prescription meds, etc. and it was about $2,000 US. I cannot recommend this hospital strongly enough!

0x30e29b8c64d5fe77_0x160fcd8d81add07d.text: Absolutely do not recommend ever coming to this hospital. Was given ciprofloxacin + cerebrex for "prostatitis" (I saw my paperwork and saw no bacterial infection, so i was given this for no reason!!) by a urologist. The urologist was kind but I was given one of the most dangerous medicines in modern medicine. they absolutely do not follow most up to date health guidelines. I have had my health destroyed at 22 years old by this hospital and the damage will most likely be permanent. By the 5th dose I had a nervous system damage which destroyed my breathing pattern followed by anaphylactic shock and I am still trying to recover my health 112 days later. I was not informed of the possible deadly side effects this drug could have. My neurologist believes the damage will be permanent due to its severity. I am short of breath all day and cannot take care of myself due to this hospitals mistake. I also have developed autonomic neuropathy as a result of this hospitals procedures, my life has been ruined by this hospital. Please stop dispensing fluoroquinolone drugs like they're candy, they're meant for confirmed infections and as a last line treatment!
0x30e29b8c64d5fe77_0x160fcd8d81add07d.author: Michael Morales

0x30e29b8c64d5fe77_0x160fcd8d81add07d.text: Quite a disappointing visit to this hospital. This review is in relation to the hospital's drive through covid19 testing facility. Upon reaching the facility at 1.30 pm, we were told that we could not have the test done, as only 100 slots are available. Our various attempts to clarify the situation went in vain and the nurses / staff were rude and did not spend much time explaining further possibilities. Lack of clarity and obligation towards the general public is something that makes this a very disappointing visit. They could at least provided some affirmation in terms of the situation rather than being completely dismissive. A truly sad experience.

0x30e286d62ff2abff_0x9e0ac5b4b8d25cd9.text: แนะนำที่นี่นะครับ ผมเป็นคนที่กลัวการทำฟันมากกก คุณหมอนิลุบลอธิบายนานเกือบชั่วโมง จนผมหายกลัว และมีกำลังใจจะผ่าฟันคุด และหมอฟันคุด ก็เก่งมากกก ปรบมือ ตอนแรกคิดว่าผ่าใช้เวลานาน แต่ของผม 20-25 นาที ระหว่างทำหมอจะแจ้งตลอดว่า จะทำอะไร และหมอร้องเพลงให้ฟังตลอดระยะเวลาที่ทำ เก่งมากก ชื่นชมครับ รวมถึงเจ้าหน้าที่ทุกคนด้วยนะครับ ✌🏻👏😊
0x30e286d62ff2abff_0x9e0ac5b4b8d25cd9.en: I highly recommend this place. I'm someone who is terrified of dental work. Dr. Nilubol explained everything for almost an hour until my fear subsided and I felt confident enough to have my wisdom tooth extracted. The wisdom tooth extractor was also incredibly skilled – applause! I initially thought the extraction would take a long time, but mine only took 20-25 minutes. During the procedure, the doctor kept me informed of what she was doing and even sang songs for me the entire time. Amazing! I commend her and all the staff as well. ✌🏻👏😊

0x30e286d62ff2abff_0x9e0ac5b4b8d25cd9.text: หมอมือเบามากค่ะพี่ๆดูแลดีมากพูดจาไพเราะคุณหมอพูดจาไพเราะพูดจาดี มือเบา ฉีดยาชาคือถามหมอว่านี่ฉีดแล้วหรอคะ มือเบามาก ถอนฟันก็มือเบาสุดๆ กลัวหมอฟันมาก เกิดมา25ปีที่นี่ปีแรกที่มาทำฟันปกติไม่เคยเข้าเกี่ยวกับฟันเลยเพราะกลัวมากที่นี่ที่แรกที่เปิดใจ I LOVE Smile melody Dental Clinic เลยค่ะ 🥰
0x30e286d62ff2abff_0x9e0ac5b4b8d25cd9.en: The dentist was very gentle, and the staff were very attentive and polite. The dentist was incredibly gentle; I even asked if I'd already had the anesthetic injection because she was so light. The tooth extraction was also extremely gentle. I'm terrified of dentists! In my 25 years of life, this is the first time I've had dental work done here. I've never been to a dentist before because I'm so afraid, but this is the first place that has opened my heart to dentistry. I LOVE Smile Melody Dental Clinic! 🥰

0x30e286d62ff2abff_0x9e0ac5b4b8d25cd9.text: คุณหมออธิบายดีมาก มีครบทุกสาขา คลินิกสะอาด เครื่องมือทันสมัย ที่สำคัญคุณหมอมือเบามากๆ พนักงานเป็นกันเอง พูดจาไพเพราะ มีโทรแจ้งเตือนนัดทุกครั้ง ส่วนตัวประทับมากคะ แนะนำคลินิกนี้เลยคะ ราคาดีด้วยนะ👍🏻👍🏻

The clinic is clean, the equipment is modern, and most importantly, the doctor is very gentle. The staff are friendly and polite. They always call to remind you of your appointment. I was personally very impressed. I highly recommend this clinic. The prices are good too! 👍🏻👍🏻

0x30e286d62ff2abff_0x9e0ac5b4b8d25cd9.text: คุณหมอมือเบามากๆ ให้คำแนะนำดี คอยบอกคอยถามอาการระหว่างทำการรักษาตลอดเลย ประทับใจมากเลยค่ะ ใครกำลังหาคลินิกทำฟันแนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะ

0x311d7c5dacda8b8f_0x80ba13afe65291ff.text: เป็นการเข้าคลีนิคทำฟันครั้งแรกในรอบเกิน 10 ปี ปล่อยปละละเลยมานานมาก… จริงๆ มีแพลนจะจัดฟันอยู่แล้ว และประกอบกับช่วงที่เหงือกอักเสบพอดี เลยได้โอกาสนัดเข้ารับการรักษา ขั้นตอนการรักษารัดกุม คุณหมอให้คำปรึกษาชัดเจนมากๆ ที่สำคัญคือมือเบาและเซอร์วิสไมน์ดีมากๆ ครับ ก็เลยเริ่มต้นรักษาเหงือก ขูดหินปูน และอุดฟันไปด้วย ก่อนจะเข้ารักการปรึกษาเพื่อจัดฟัน และทำวีเนียร์ต่อ ซึ่งเดี๋ยวรอนัดหมออีกที โดยรวมประทับใจครับ ใกล้บ้าน สะดวก นัดหมายชัดเจน ชี้แจงเรื่องราคาแบบตรงไปตรงมา มีอ็อพชั่นให้เลือก ใครมีแพลนทำฟันย่านสายไหม ผมว่าที่นี่ถือว่าเป็นตัวเลือกที่ดีมากๆ ครับ ขอบคุณ คุณหมอ และเจ้าหน้าที่ทุกคนครับ
0x311d7c5dacda8b8f_0x80ba13afe65291ff.author: Motorsportlives TV
0x311d7c5dacda8b8f_0x80ba13afe65291ff.en: This was my first visit to a dental clinic in over 10 years. I'd neglected it for so long… I actually had plans to get braces anyway, and coincidentally, I had gum inflammation, so I took the opportunity to schedule an appointment. The treatment process was thorough, the doctor gave very clear advice, and most importantly, was very gentle and provided excellent service. So, I started with gum treatment, scaling, and fillings. Before proceeding with a consultation for braces and veneers, which I'll schedule another appointment for later. Overall, I was impressed. It's close to home, convenient, the appointment scheduling was clear, the pricing was explained straightforwardly, and there were various options to choose from. If you're planning dental work in the Sai Mai area, I think this is a great option. Thank you to the doctor and all the staff.

0x311d7c5dacda8b8f_0x80ba13afe65291ff.text: 1. เข้ามาพบเจ้าหน้าที่ให้คำแนะนำดี พูดจาไพเราะ ยิ้มแย้มทุกท่าน รวมถึงผู้ช่วยในห้องคุณหมอ คลินิกสะอาด 2. Walk in มาพบคุณหมอเพื่อปรึกษาปัญหาฟันคม ทำให้กัดริมฝีปากบ่อย คุณหมอแนะนำดี พูดจาดี ยิ่มแย้มน่ารักมาก เน้นหาวิธีแก้ไขที่เหมาะสมกับเราจริงๆ ไม่เน้นขายของ เป็นคลินิกที่ดีที่สุดที่เคยใช้บริการมา ถ้าจะดัดฟัน จะกลับมาดัดที่นี่แน่นอนค่า ใครมีปัญหาเกี่ยวกับฟัน แนะนำให้เข้าไปปรึกษาคุณหมอที่นี่ได้เลยนะคะ #เป็นคลินิกที่ดีต่อใจผู้ใช้บริการ

0x311d7c5dacda8b8f_0x80ba13afe65291ff.en: 1. The staff were very helpful and spoke politely. Everyone, including the assistant in the doctor's room, was smiling. The clinic was clean. 2. She focused on finding a solution that was truly suitable for me, not on pushing sales. This is the best clinic I've ever used. If I need braces, I will definitely come back here. If anyone has dental problems, I highly recommend consulting the doctor here. #A clinic that makes patients feel good.

0x311d7c5dacda8b8f_0x80ba13afe65291ff.en: I went for a teeth cleaning and scaling service. The service was polite and didn't confuse me. They also gave good advice. The dentist was attentive and encouraged me throughout the treatment, keeping me aware of each step. The medical system here is of high quality, with excellent hygiene, service, and specialist dentists. Safety is ensured, and there's a relaxing environment for everyone. The treatment costs are still affordable and negotiable. I also have government-funded medical care, covering the expenses to ensure my safety.

0x30e29f49ca9f2c79_0x8266a7e581f81080.text: Since turning 40, I've experienced hair loss and thinning, leading to a lack of confidence and a anguish spent countless hours cutting and styling my hair. I tried many solutions, but the results were unsatisfactory. Finally, I decided to consider hair transplantation and researched several clinics. Pavicon Hair Clinic was one of the options I considered, and I wasn't disappointed. After the consultation, I was impressed with the doctor and staff who provided insightful advice directly addressing my specific needs. I decided to have the procedure done at Pavicon on my first day. A week later, I had my transplant appointment. I have to admit, I was very nervous and afraid of the pain, but after witnessing the doctor's professionalism, skill, and procedures, I felt relieved, even though the procedure took a long time due to its precision. (I secretly thought to myself, I'm just lying there, but the doctor and team have to stand for much longer; if they can endure it, so can I!) After six hours, everything went well. Before leaving, the doctor gave me post-operative care instructions. The first night was slightly sore, and I had follow-up appointments for wound cleaning and light therapy. We'll have to wait and see what the results are, as the doctor is scheduling follow-up appointments throughout the year. If you're looking for a hair transplant clinic, I highly recommend Pavicon Hair Clinic as a top choice.

0x311d7b0012e8fdc3_0xad31a4e9b8ddbf54.text: มาทำฟันที่นี่หลายครั้งแล้ว คุณหมอมือเบามาก อธิบายดี ตอบสิ่งที่เราสงสัยได้ทุกข้อ พนักงานต้อนรับอัธยาศัยดียิ้มแย้ม ใส่ใจคนไข้ดี และพูดจาไพเราะ มาคลินิกนี้จากต่างจังหวัดตามคำแนะนำของเพื่อน ส่วนตัวมักจะเจอปัญหาเครื่องดีเลย์ ทำให้ต้องเลื่อนเวลานัด พอทราบว่าจะดีเลย์ก็จะโทรแจ้งคลินิกก่อน น้องพนักงานเคาน์เตอร์แก้ไขปัญหาเฉพาะหน้าได้ดี โดยเฉพาะเรื่องคิว ทำให้ได้เข้ารักษาตามนัด และไม่มีผลกระทบต่อเที่ยวบินขากลับครับ
