I highly recommend him/her. Feel free to stop by for a consultation; the doctor is very friendly and doesn't push unnecessary sales. Highly recommend this clinic! The doctor is friendly, approachable, and has excellent skills. I always feel comfortable and confident in their care.
0x30da3b002ea89001_0xecbe097578c26f7b.author: Chain A

0x30da3b002ea89001_0xecbe097578c26f7b.text: The clinic is super clean, smells great, and the air conditioning is cold. Snacks and drinks are available. The treatment promotions are very affordable and accessible, with no hard selling. The doctor is very attentive and personally oversees every case, every step of the way. He's very gentle and kind. The staff who assist the doctor are all very nice and kind, and everyone is fun to talk to. 🥰
0x30da3b002ea89001_0xecbe097578c26f7b.author: Melody Machin

0x30da3b002ea89001_0xecbe097578c26f7b.text: Today I got filler injected into my cheeks with Dr. Hua. She has a very gentle touch. She also injected filler into other areas, making my face look much softer. The atmosphere in the clinic was great; there were no salespeople at all, making me feel very relaxed. After the injection, I was very impressed; there was no bruising at all. I'm extremely happy! 🥰
0x30da3b002ea89001_0xecbe097578c26f7b.author: Chutimon Khiaonetr

0x30da313613230e65_0x251d6f0f30a76285.text: I’d like to give this clinic 10/10 for their dignity and principle. We could feel how much they actually cared for our cat. Out of 4 clinics we took our cat to for a treatment or get antibiotic this clinic was the only one that actually cared while the other 3, we’d be charged ridiculously high prices even more than human’s med/treatment this kind of behavior made us sick and scared every time we thought about taking our cat to the vet but this clinic change our mind. It means a lot to know there’s a clinic that we can trust. May they continue to thrive!❤️ We’ll continue to support and recommend this clinic to anyone that needs their pets to be treated properly.
0x30da313613230e65_0x251d6f0f30a76285.author: Cake

0x30da313613230e65_0x251d6f0f30a76285.text: วันนี้พาน้องสีฟ้ามาตรวจหัวใจที่ ผิวใสใจดีสัตวแพทย์ (Heart & Skin Vet Clinic) ประทับใจตั้งแต่ก้าวแรกที่เข้ามาเลยครับ คุณหมอและทีมงานน่ารักมาก อธิบายอาการและผลตรวจละเอียด ใจเย็น และดูแลน้องอย่างอ่อนโยน ทำให้เจ้าของรู้สึกสบายใจมากครับ คลินิกสะอาดมาก กลิ่นหอม ไม่มีกลิ่นโรงพยาบาล บรรยากาศอบอุ่น เป็นกันเอง พนักงานบริการดี ยิ้มแย้มตลอด ใครกำลังมองหาคลินิกสำหรับตรวจโรคหัวใจหรือดูแลสุขภาพน้องหมาน้องแมว แนะนำที่นี่เลยครับ ประทับใจทั้งการบริการ ความสะอาด และความใส่ใจของคุณหมอ ขอบคุณคุณหมอและทีมงานที่ดูแลน้องสีฟ้าเป็นอย่างดีครับ ❤️🐱

After many failed efforts by other experienced vets, Dr. Omsin has helped our senior dog to get his severe and persistent skin issues under control. This has made a huge difference in his quality of life, as well as his looks. The doctor patiently explained the causes and available treatment options. Staff are very kind and helpful. Highly recommend this clinic for complex skin issues.
0x30da313613230e65_0x251d6f0f30a76285.author: Mark Stelzner

0x30da313613230e65_0x251d6f0f30a76285.text: พาน้องหมามาตรวจหัวใจที่คลินิก ประทับใจตั้งแต่เข้ามาเลยค่ะ เจ้าหน้าที่และคุณหมอให้คำแนะนำดีมาก อธิบายผลตรวจและแนวทางการรักษาอย่างละเอียด ทำให้เข้าใจอาการของน้องและสบายใจขึ้นมาก ระหว่างตรวจคุณหมอใจเย็นและเอาใจใส่น้องเป็นอย่างดี เครื่องมือตรวจครบถ้วน บรรยากาศสะอาดและเป็นระเบียบ หากใครกำลังมองหาคลินิกสำหรับตรวจโรคหัวใจหรือดูแลสัตว์เลี้ยง แนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะ 🐶❤️
0x30da313613230e65_0x251d6f0f30a76285.author: Areeya Kanta

0x30da313613230e65_0x251d6f0f30a76285.text: บรรยากาศร้าน : สะอาด หอมมาก ไม่อับเลยค่ะ หอมจนต้องถามว่าใช้น้ำหอมอะไรคะ 😅 พาน้องแมวมาตรวจหัวใจ ได้คิวเร็ว รีเซฟชั่นและทีมงาน : ทุกคนเป็นมิตร และยินดีตอบคำถาม น่ารัก 🤍 คุณหมอและอุปกรณ์ : คุณหมอตรวจละเอียด ใส่ใจ เครื่องมือทันสมัยมาก เช็คหัวใจละเอียดทุกซอกทุกมุม 🤓📝🤍 ยอมขับรถมาจากแม่ริมเพื่อมาเลย

If someone were to ask me for a recommendation for a veterinary clinic, I would not hesitate to recommend this place. We will never forget the sincere and attentive care you gave to our cat. This is a hospital that truly understands and cares for the hearts of pet owners.
0x30da313613230e65_0x251d6f0f30a76285.author: Amande

0x30da313613230e65_0x251d6f0f30a76285.text: ขอชื่นชมการให้บริการของคลินิกแห่งนี้เป็นอย่างยิ่ง เจ้าหน้าที่ทุกท่านให้การต้อนรับอย่างสุภาพ เอาใจใส่ และให้คำแนะนำอย่างมืออาชีพ คุณหมอให้การรักษาด้วยความละเอียดรอบคอบ อธิบายขั้นตอนและแนวทางการดูแลอย่างชัดเจน ทำให้ผู้มารับบริการรู้สึกอุ่นใจและเชื่อมั่นในคุณภาพของการรักษา
0x30da313613230e65_0x251d6f0f30a76285.author: ฐิติวัลคุ์ กัมพลาวลี

0x30da313613230e65_0x251d6f0f30a76285.text: น้องยุนอา อายุ 13 ขวบ 7 เดือน ป่วยเป็นโรคหัวใจ เข้ารักษากับคุณหมอตั้งแต่เริ่มป่วย ตอนนี้โรคหัวใจดีขึ้น เรื่อหัวใจไว้ใจคุณหมอได้ คุณหมอมือหนึ่งเรื่องหัวใจและผิวหนัง การดูแลรักษาน้องหมาน้องแมวดีมากค่ะ เต็ม 100 ไม่หักค๊า
0x30da313613230e65_0x251d6f0f30a76285.author: JEN JI YEON

0x30e29ea7c8671115_0xd21e599b050eec82.text: Highly recommended. The clinic has top tier professionals in every specialism (many also working in Thailand's top teaching hospitals). Patient care is beyond expectations. I was about to have to cancel an overseas trip owing to a wisdom tooth infection, but the team were able to bring in an oral surgeon especially for me within just one hour. The tooth was removed painlessly and with no issues at all during the recovery period, and I was on the plane the very next day. They are also very sympathetic towards nervous patients!
0x30e29ea7c8671115_0xd21e599b050eec82.author: Tony Newman

0x30e29ea7c8671115_0xd21e599b050eec82.text: This is hands down the best dental practice I have ever been to. The concept of having a family practice that has all specialists together to provide a wholistic well rounded care without the expense of an over-rated hospital is incredible. There is no guess work, no unnecessary treatment protocols - only what is best for the patient. I have found that each practitioner is fully updated with most advanced knowledge that is explained clearly. Highly recommended!
0x30e29ea7c8671115_0xd21e599b050eec82.author: Siraya Chunekamrai

0x30e29ea7c8671115_0xd21e599b050eec82.text: Absolutely a great dental clinic. The dentist gave a very nice experience to the patient with calm and professional service. I love how detailed the dentist is providing! The planned treatment is well done with full explanation (great collaboration among the dentists, radiologists and other boards) on why and how, the steps required to be taken and how to overcome if any.

I would recommend this clinic for anyone with kids based on my experience with them. I have been to a few other clinics but my children didn’t like them & refused to cooperate. This was the first clinic where I felt they understood children and made them feel comfortable before treating them. I never thought I’d have this problem but now my daughter can’t wait to return.

My initial encounter with this Clinic was quite positive. I had a pleasant meeting with Dr. Pintippa but I have decided to switch to a different clinic simply because it is closer to my home and more convenient. The clinic is very clean, the staff is extremely friendly and nice, especially the professional Dr. Pintippa. I highly recommend this location to all of you.
0x30e29ea7c8671115_0xd21e599b050eec82.author: Fon Smith

0x30e29ea7c8671115_0xd21e599b050eec82.text: I highly recommend this clinic. It is very clean and the doctors are very professional and gentle. As a regular patient, I have not experienced any pain during my treatments. it is rare! The clinic set up is also very children friendly.
0x30e29ea7c8671115_0xd21e599b050eec82.author: van porleng

0x30e29ea7c8671115_0xd21e599b050eec82.text: บริการดีตั้งแต่เข้าไป จนรับบริการเสร็จ คุณหมอแนะนำดี พูดดีมาก คลินิกสะอาด เครื่องมือทันสมัยมาก มีบริเวณสำหรับเด็ก ๆ ด้วย เป็นคลินิกที่ใส่ใจคนทุกวัยจริง ๆ
0x30e29ea7c8671115_0xd21e599b050eec82.en: The service was excellent from the moment I arrived until the treatment was complete. The doctor gave great advice and spoke very kindly. The clinic was clean and the equipment was very modern. There was even an area for children. It's a clinic that truly cares for people of all ages.

0x30e29ea7c8671115_0xd21e599b050eec82.text: Disappointing. The dentist was constantly checking the watch while she was working.. she did the teeth cleaning in just ten minutes, and as a result her work was not very accurate or thorough. I paid over 2000 baht and my teeth feel not thoroughly clean. Worse dentist experience in Bangkok so far

0xfae76c2f9c636c1_0x5c5ea16a20fc29ce.text: This clinic impressed me from the moment I stepped inside. The atmosphere was clean and modern. The staff were welcoming, polite, and attentive throughout my visit. They also offered complimentary water, tea, and coffee while I waited. What impressed me most was the consultation with the doctor. She was very friendly and detailed, answering all my concerns comfortably. This time, I had the opportunity to undergo two procedures: * Skin Bright Vitamin Drip: To brighten my skin, making it look fresher and healthier. It also helps reduce fatigue, leaving me feeling refreshed and energized. * Skin Oasis Facial Treatment: This took about 30 minutes and was a deep facial treatment to quickly hydrate and brighten my complexion. For those with limited time, both procedures can be done simultaneously, saving a lot of time. The clinic also has private rooms for those who prefer privacy, and a convenient powder room for makeup and grooming after the treatments. Overall, it was a wonderful experience. The service from the doctor and staff was excellent, and the results from the procedures were very satisfying. If you're looking for a comprehensive and high-standard skin and beauty clinic, this is highly recommended. I highly recommend this place.
0xfae76c2f9c636c1_0x5c5ea16a20fc29ce.author: C C

0xfae76c2f9c636c1_0x5c5ea16a20fc29ce.text: I came for the Skin Oasis program and I love this clinic so much! 🤍✨ The atmosphere is great, clean, and the high ceilings give it a spacious and airy feel. Importantly, it's very private, located at the very back of the Park Silom building 🌿 It's not crowded, making me feel relaxed from the moment I walked in. The staff are very attentive and lovely, providing excellent service throughout the process 🫶🏻 After the program, I immediately felt my skin was more moisturized 💧 and deeply cleansed. My face looks noticeably brighter ✨ It's perfect for those with dry skin, or who feel their face isn't clean enough after cleansing, or anyone who wants brighter skin 💖 You should try it! I really loved it 🥹 I'll definitely be back again 💕
0xfae76c2f9c636c1_0x5c5ea16a20fc29ce.author: Dainty biscuit

0xfae76c2f9c636c1_0x5c5ea16a20fc29ce.text: 1. The doctor gave an excellent consultation. She analyzed my overall facial features, combined with my needs, prioritized the problems, explained the causes, and outlined treatment options to help me make my decision. 2. I appreciated that the doctor explained every step of the process, was attentive, and constantly asked how I was doing. It really helped reduce my anxiety! The doctor was incredibly gentle. 3. The clinic is located in a building with plenty of parking, making it convenient to get to. From a distance, it looks like a cafe; the clinic is pink and very girly. 🌟10/10, no deductions. P.S. My doctor was Dr. Q.
0xfae76c2f9c636c1_0x5c5ea16a20fc29ce.author: Tanasub Leelasubwong

0xfae76c2f9c636c1_0x5c5ea16a20fc29ce.text: Today, I came to the clinic for their Skin Oasis program. There's parking available in the Park Silom building. Or, if you're traveling by MRT Sala Daeng or BTS Silom, it's a very convenient walkway. The clinic is beautiful, with a lovely color scheme, like a cafe. There's a waiting room with a great view and atmosphere; I got lots of beautiful photos there. The treatment itself was incredibly relaxing; I even dozed off! Afterwards, my face felt amazing, my skin looked brighter, firmer, more hydrated, and healthier. I highly recommend it!
0xfae76c2f9c636c1_0x5c5ea16a20fc29ce.author: Suchaya Thongsri

0xfae76c2f9c636c1_0x5c5ea16a20fc29ce.text: Before visiting the Hindu temple, I stopped by AESphere Clinic in Park Silom building for a beauty treatment. The Skin Oasis program only took 30 minutes, and I have to say, my face was so radiant and glowing! The machine is amazing and targets the right spots. My skin is plump, hydrated, and bouncy – absolutely stunning! The staff were also lovely and friendly, providing top-notch service. Don't miss this program! It's perfect for dull skin. It's easy to get there, with a direct connection to the BTS Sala Daeng station.
0xfae76c2f9c636c1_0x5c5ea16a20fc29ce.author: Parveda P.

0xfae76c2f9c636c1_0x5c5ea16a20fc29ce.text: I came for the Skin Oasis treatment and it was amazing, 10/10! My face feels brighter and whiter, it stimulates collagen, and my skin looks radiant and firmer from the first time. (Blackheads came out and pimples dried up quickly thanks to the clinic's special treatment formula!) 🤩 The staff were very nice, lovely, and polite. 💖 The clinic is clean and comfortable, like a cafe. 🚝 It's conveniently located near Silom and Sala Daeng MRT stations.
0xfae76c2f9c636c1_0x5c5ea16a20fc29ce.author: 65-2067 รุ่งทิพย์ เพ็ชรวงศ์

0xfae76c2f9c636c1_0x5c5ea16a20fc29ce.text: Today I came for the Skin Oasis program at the clinic. It's very convenient to get there; just take the MRT to Sala Daeng station and there's a connecting walkway. The clinic is beautiful, with lovely colors, and has a waiting room with a great view. The atmosphere inside is very relaxing, like being at home. The treatment process itself was amazing; my face felt so relaxed and healthy afterwards. Highly recommend it!
0xfae76c2f9c636c1_0x5c5ea16a20fc29ce.author: Supawade Wongnok

0xfae76c2f9c636c1_0x5c5ea16a20fc29ce.text: Today I came in for a consultation with Dr. Kwan about getting filler injections to reshape my face. She explained everything in detail, which I really appreciated. After the filler injection, my face looks so soft and beautiful. Dr. Kwan has such a gentle touch! The clinic is beautiful, the staff are lovely and attentive, and the prices are very reasonable. I'm definitely coming back here! ☺️
0xfae76c2f9c636c1_0x5c5ea16a20fc29ce.author: สาวน้อย กระทู้

0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.text: คราวที่แล้วเขียนรีวิว สาขา2 ซึ่งดีมากๆอยู่แล้ว คราวนี้มารีวิวสาขานี้บ้าง สาขานี้เป็นสาขา OG ฟีลบรรยากาศอบอุ่น cozy style เดิมทีผมเป็นคนกลัวหมอฟันมาก แต่คุณหมอที่นี่มือเบามาก ในวันนี้ผมได้ไปอุดฟันที่นี่ แทบไม่รู้สึกถึงความเจ็บปวดเลย แถมยังมีคำแนะนำที่ดีและถูกต้อง ปล.แปรงฟันให้สะอาดเป็นเรื่องดี แต่ถ้าแปรงไม่ดีต้องมาคลีนิคทันตแพทย์ สุรันต์-ยงจิต ครบจริงเรื่องฟันฟัน
0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.author: patipan piyakulmala
0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.en: Last time, I reviewed Branch 2, which was already excellent. This time, I'm reviewing this branch. This is the OG branch, with a warm, cozy atmosphere. I used to be very afraid of the dentist, but the dentist here has a very gentle touch. Today, I had a filling here, and I barely felt any pain. They also gave me good, accurate advice. P.S. Brushing your teeth thoroughly is good, but if you don't brush well, you need to come to the Suran-Yongjit Dental Clinic. They truly are the best when it comes to your teeth.

0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.text: เป็นคลินิกที่ดีม๊ากกก พี่พยาบาลให้คำปรึกษาดี ล่าสุดพาลูกสาว8ขวบไปถอนฟัน ฟันพุทั้งปาก กลัวหมอจะดุที่พ่อแม่ดูแลลูกไม่ดีจนฟันทั้งปากเป็นแบบนี้ ผลรับกลับตรงกันข้าม คุณหมอผู้ชาย พูดจาดีมากกก สุภาพ ให้คำปรึกษาและคำแนะนำที่ดีมากๆ แนะนำให้มาเลยค่ะ ขอบคุณคุณหมอนะคะ ❤️29/08/69
0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.en: This is a really great clinic! The nurses give great advice. Recently, I took my 8-year-old daughter to get teeth extracted because she had a lot of decay. I was worried the doctor would scold me for not taking good care of my child, resulting in such a bad condition. But the opposite happened! The male doctor was incredibly kind, polite, and gave excellent advice and recommendations. I highly recommend this clinic. Thank you, doctor! ❤️ 29/08/69

0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.text: clean and very professional , the doctor explained my symptom very clear and help me create good solution for my teeth. There are many car park available behind clinic building. recommended!
0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.author: Pongsakon Taksintaveesup

0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.text: ชอบบุคคลากรคลินิกนี้มาก มี service mind สุดๆ ตั้งแต่หมอ ผุ้ช่วย ไปจนถึงเค้าเตอร์ ดีมากกก ตั้งใจตอบคำถาม บริการด้วยใจ พาญาติผู้ใหญ่มาทำที่นี่หลายคน ละทุกคนปลื้มกันหมด🤍
0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.author: Araschaporn T.
0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.en: I really like the staff at this clinic. They have amazing service minds, from the doctor and assistants to the counter staff. They are all excellent, attentive to questions and provide service with a genuine heart. I've brought several elderly relatives here, and everyone has been very pleased. 🤍

0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.text: พอดีแฟนปวดฟันคุด เลยพามาผ่าออก คุณหมอทำไม่เจ็บเลยครับ ระหว่างนั่งรอเลยขูดหินปูนด้วยเลย ทำเบามือมาก ชวนคุยระหว่างทำด้วย ให้คำแนะนำที่ดีครับ ไว้จะมาใช้บริการใหม่นะครับ
0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.author: Eievui Eve
0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.en: My girlfriend had a wisdom toothache, so I took her to have it removed. The dentist didn't hurt at all. While I was waiting, they also scraped off tartar. He was very gentle and chatted with me during the procedure. He gave me good advice. I'll definitely be back.

0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.text: All of the staff are caring, professional, and go out of their way to ensure that your experience is a great one! Highly recommended for both Thais and foreigners!!
0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.author: Meform P.

0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.text: Great dental clinic in Bangkok, very helpful staff with foreigners as well. I would definitely recommend it if you're planning any kind of dental work in Thailand
0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.author: Giacomo Rossi

0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.text: ครอบฟันหลุดจึงไปปรึกษาหมอที่นี่เพื่อรักษารากฟันและทำเดือยใหม่ คุณหมอบอกว่าโอกาสที่กรอฟันแล้วรากฟันจะแตกมีมากถึง 70 เปอร์เซ็นต์ แต่เราก็ตกลงเพราะคิดว่าเราจะเป็นส่วน 30% นั้นที่ทำสำเร็จ แต่ตอนที่ตกลงกับคุณหมอ คุณหมอดูน้ำเสียงไม่ค่อยมั่นใจว่าจะทำได้ ระวังที่ทำไปผู้ช่วยคุณหมอก็พูดแนะนำคุณหมอตลอด เอาตรงๆเหมือนหยั่งกับผู้ช่วยรู้มากกว่าคุณหมออีก สุดท้ายก็เป็นไปตามคาดรากฟันแตกทำให้จากที่จะแค่รักษารากฟันทำเดือยใหม่ไม่เกิน 10,000 บาทกลับกลายเป็นว่าต้องทำรากเทียม ซึ่งค่าใช้จ่ายโดยรวมน่าจะตกอยู่ที่ประมาณ 60,000 บาท เนื่องจากทำที่นี่แล้วรากฟันแตกจึงไม่ไว้ใจที่นี่อีกแล้วเลยไปหาคุณหมออีกคลีนิคนึง คุณหมอคลินิกใหม่บอกว่าหมอเก่าที่กรอฟันให้ทำไว้ซะเละเลย เอาตรงๆถ้าคุณหมอคิดว่าทำไม่สำเร็จก็น่าจะบอกคนไข้ว่าทำไม่ได้มีหมอคนอื่นที่ทำเก่งกว่าหรืออะไรก็ได้ไม่ใช่เสี่ยงทำ โดยรวมแล้วถือว่าฟาดเคราะห์ ที่มาเจอที่นี่ หมอให้นัดรอบ 2 แต่คงไม่นัดแล้วเพราะไม่ไว้ใจที่นี่แล้ว แถมด้วยผู้ช่วยคุณหมอกิริยาค่อนข้างแย่ พาไปเอกซเรย์เสร็จแล้วเดินออกจากประตูแทนที่จะเปิดประตูรอสักนิดกับปล่อยประตูให้เด้งมาชนเกือบชนหน้าผม โดยรวมแล้วคิดผิดจริงๆที่มาที่นี่
0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.author: Teerachote Homom
0x30e29857ccc4cde3_0xb88f61a4ff02860.en: My crown came loose, so I consulted a dentist here for root canal treatment and a new post. The dentist said there was a 70% chance the root would break during drilling, but we agreed, thinking we'd be part of that 30% chance of success. However, during the consultation, the dentist seemed unsure if they could do it, and the assistant kept giving the dentist advice – honestly, it was as if the assistant knew more than the dentist. As expected, the root broke, turning what should have been just a root canal treatment and a new post costing under 10,000 baht into a need for an implant, likely costing around 60,000 baht in total. Because of this experience, I no longer trust this clinic and went to another. The new dentist said the previous dentist had messed things up. Honestly, if the dentist thought they couldn't do it, they should have told the patient, suggested other, more skilled dentists, or something, instead of taking the risk. Overall, it was a stroke of bad luck. The dentist scheduled a second appointment, but I won't be going back because I no longer trust this clinic, and the assistant's attitude was quite poor. After the X-ray was finished, instead of holding the door open for me a little, they let it spring open and almost hit me in the face. Overall, I really made a mistake coming here.

0x30e29f20de86781d_0x85b839b2a45aac26.text: 5 Stars are not even enough. I make it short 3 1/2 years ago 2 herinated disc. Pain for over 2 years until it got better. In the past I tried everything possible. And when I went here right after the first session there was improvement...after the second session I got some motion back. And why? Because she is professional and know what she is doing. Rather than just pushing on the area of the disc she actually went to find out what the trigger could be and helped there and even told me what I need to work on to prevent it from happen again... AMAZING I wish I could give 10 Stars.

0x3054ef003a93f087_0xa8f4a3e4abacf351.text: Male 54years 204cm tall 126kg weight My history is that I was a professional rugby player, playing at a high level around the world. After retiring aged around 30 due to injury I then ran my own fish and chip shops for over 20 years which involved bending over a fryer and heavy lifting potato sacks daily! These activities led to me suffering serious lower back pain for the last 20 years! I have honestly tried every avenue to get some relief: chiropractor, osteopaths, massage, gadgets, acupuncture, cupping etc etc. Some of which provided minimal relief some made my situation worse! To the point of last year on a visit to Australia whilst in excruciating pain, in my back and hips whenever I was stood, I then lost all sensation in my legs and started to collapse and fall to the floor which was the most frightening feeling I have ever had. On my arrival to Koh Samui in December I had heard wonderful things about Aveya clinic so as a last chance to get my life back I came and had a visit. I have been having spinal decompression treatment followed by photodynamic laser treatment twice a week. Then, another staff member, who seemed to have just seen the message, replied that the clinic doesn't require upfront payment; it can be deducted from social security, and the starting price is 800 baht. We were confused. Is this even the same clinic? They're giving conflicting prices and information. If we actually go there, will the price be accurate? 0x30e2997b0b980529_0xb39cb84055491217.text: Today I got a special promotion for the grand opening of THE TOUCH Wellness Centers at the new Central Park mall, which I finally got to visit. Since I was already planning on getting treatments, they provided additional recommendations based on my needs: dry skin, clogged pores, dull complexion, dark circles, and wrinkles. In the end, I received UPL Laser, RF Lifting, Glow Purity, and Glassy Glow treatments. It took 2-3 hours, very relaxing. The staff said the results were good, and I agree! 5555 I might need to wash my face and see the results again tomorrow. These things don't show results in just one session, but it's better than nothing! 🤣 It's perfect for people like me who don't know what to do but want to try something new. I saw they also have health and wellness programs, like fitness, office syndrome, vitamin drips, etc., which look interesting. The staff were all lovely and helpful. They answered all my questions. The place is beautiful, clean, and has a great atmosphere with cool air conditioning. I even dozed off a few times during the treatments! 🤣 P.S. The mall is conveniently located, with both BTS and MRT stations right in front of it. I drove, though. I recommend heading straight down to the 2nd floor because the 1st floor is packed. It has offices and a hotel, just like CentralWorld. But if you're driving a Super Car, there might be plenty of space. 55555

0x311d7be7edf0028f_0x26f8f4deb0ba5194.text: ขูดหินปูนราคา เริ่มต้น800 คิดเงินออกมาราคาพันกว่าบาท ส่วนตัวคิดว่าหินปูนไม่ได้เยอะเพราะขูดเสร็จไวมากประมาน10นาทีแต่คิดเต็มราคา น่าจะเขียนราคาเต็มไปเลยไม่ต้องมีราคาเริ่มต้น และน่าจะไม่มีใครได้จ่ายราคาเริ่มต้น

0x311d5fef28a1eb3b_0x909a2bb9e96e13f3.text: Review ประสบการณ์การเข้ารับบริการขูดหินปูน จากคนที่มีปัญหาเหงือกร่น กลัวการขูดหินปูนเพราะความรู้สึกเสียวฟันที่อาจจะมากกว่าคนอื่น ต้องเปลี่ยนคลินิกทุกปีเพราะยังไม่เจอที่ไหนที่ตอบโจทย์ เห็นคลินิกนี้เพราะอยู่ใกล้บ้าน ขับรถผ่านประจำ สถานที่สวยมาก เหมือนคาเฟ่ คิดในใจว่าค่าบริการต้องสูงมากแน่ๆ ลองค้นหาใน Google มีแต่ Feedback ดีๆจากลูกค้า ก็เลยคิดว่าควรจะต้องมาลองใช้บริการดู พอถึงวันที่จะต้องขูดหินปูน ก็นึกถึงที่นี่เป็นที่แรก ประทับใจตั้งแต่การตอบแชท คำตอบที่ทำให้ลดความกังวลและรู้สึกถึงความยินดีที่จะต้อนรับ ความประทับใจต่อมาคือการบริการและการให้เกียรติ ไม่ว่าเราจะแต่งตัวซอมซ่อแค่ไหน ทุกคนในคลินิกก็ยิ้มให้และบริการอย่างเต็มที่ อาจารย์หมอเอ้ใจดีมาก เข้าใจความกังวลของเรา เราขอฉีดยาชา เพราะมีประสบการณ์ไม่ดีมาก่อน อาจารย์ฉีดให้แค่ฟันล่างที่เหงือกร่นมากๆ ทำให้รู้ว่าอาจารย์มือเบาและใจเย็นมากๆ ค่อยๆปักเข็ม ค่อยๆเดินยา ไม่รู้สึกเจ็บเลย ตอนขูดหินปูนฟันบนที่ไม่ได้ฉีดยาชา ก็ไม่มีความเสียวฟันเลย ทั้งๆที่แต่ก่อนโดนขูดทีไร ต้องยกมือขึ้นหยุดหมอรัวๆเพราะทนไม่ไหว ผู้ช่วยอาจารย์ก็ดูแลดีมากๆ เราไม่สำลักน้ำเลย (ทำที่อื่นสำลักตลอด) พูดเพราะ ใจดี ใจเย็น อาจารย์บอกว่าอาจารย์เป็นหมอผ่าตัดรากเทียม ไม่ได้ขูดหินปูนให้ที่ไหนเลย ขูดให้เฉพาะลูกค้าที่คลินิกนี้ที่เป็นของอาจารย์เอง และก็อยากทำคลินิกให้สำหรับคนที่กลัวการทำฟัน รู้สึกโชคดีมากๆที่ได้เจออาจารย์ ได้ลบภาพจำแย่ๆจากการขูดหินปูนครั้งก่อนๆ ส่วนราคาที่เคยกังวลว่าจะเอื้อมไม่ถึง ก็เป็นราคาคลินิกเอกชนปกติ สามารถใช้สิทธิ์ประกันสังคมได้ สรุปคือประทับใจมากค่ะ ได้เจอคลินิกที่ตอบโจทย์แล้ว
0x311d5fef28a1eb3b_0x909a2bb9e96e13f3.author: Rynpapas Sithisurasart
0x311d5fef28a1eb3b_0x909a2bb9e96e13f3.en: Review of my experience getting a dental scaling treatment from someone with receding gums who was afraid of scaling because of the sensitivity that might be more severe than others. I had to change clinics every year because I hadn't found one that met my needs. I saw this clinic because it's near my house and I drive past it regularly. The place is beautiful, like a cafe. I thought the service must be very expensive. I searched on Google and found only good customer reviews, so I decided to try it. On the day of my dental scaling appointment, this was the first place that came to mind. I was impressed from the moment I messaged them; their responses reduced my anxiety and made me feel welcome. My next impression was the service and the respect they showed. No matter how shabbily I was dressed, everyone at the clinic smiled and provided excellent service. Dr. Ae was very kind and understood my concerns. I requested local anesthesia because of a bad experience before. Dr. Ae only injected anesthetic into my lower teeth where gums were severely receding, showing how gentle and patient she is. She carefully inserted the needle and administered the anesthetic; I didn't feel any pain. Even when scaling my upper teeth, which weren't anesthetized, I didn't experience any sensitivity, whereas before I would repeatedly stop the doctor because I couldn't bear the pain. Dr. Ae's assistant was also very attentive. I didn't choke on the water at all. (I always choke when I get teeth cleaned elsewhere.) The doctor was polite, kind, and patient. The doctor said he's a dental implant surgeon and doesn't do scaling anywhere else; he only does it for clients at his own clinic. He also wanted to create a clinic for people who are afraid of dental procedures. I feel very lucky to have met him; it erased my negative memories from previous teeth cleaning experiences. As for the price, which I was worried about being unaffordable, it's the normal price for a private clinic, and I can use my social security insurance. In short, I was very impressed. I've found a clinic that perfectly meets my needs.

0x311d5fef28a1eb3b_0x909a2bb9e96e13f3.text: เป็นการตัดสินใจในรอบ 10 ปีหาหมอฟันเหตุคือปวดฟันคุดมากๆและจะต้องหาคลินิกเพื่อผ่าฟันคุดออก ซึ่งเป็นคนกลัวเข็มมาก กลัวการฉีดยาชา เพราะคนรอบข้างที่หาหมอฟันจะบอกว่าเจ็บแค่ตอนฉีดยาชา ซึ่งเราต้องการคลินิกที่ฉีดไม่เจ็บ ดูรีวิวหลายที่จนกระทั่งมาเจอที่นี่ รีวิวเกือบ 100% บอกว่าฉีดยาชาไม่เจ็บเลยจึงตัดสินใจมา ประทับใจอย่างแรกมาที่นี่คือเจ้าหน้าที่และคุณหมอน่ารักมาก พูดเพราะ สถานที่ผ่านคลายเหมือนคาเฟ่ และประเด็นสำคัญคือตรวจฟันพบว่ามีฟันคุด 4 ซี่ 2 ข้างบนล่างคุณหมอแนะนำให้เอาออกเลยทีละ 2 ซี่บนล่าง ซึ่งต้องผ่า1ถอน1 กลัวมากๆๆๆๆเพราะฟังจากคนรอบข้างที่เคยผ่าจากที่อื่นบอกว่าหลังผ่าแค่ 1 ซี่ปวดมากกกกกินไรไม่ได้เลย ให้เอาออกทีละ 1 ซี่ เพราะถ้า 2 ซี่เลยคงปวดมากกก แต่ก็ตัดสินใจเอาออก 2 ซี่เลย วันที่ไปคือตื่นเต้น กลัว นอนไม่หลับ อันดับคแรกคือฉีดยาชา ไม่เจ็บเลยไม่รู้สึกด้วย คะเเนนความเจ็บ 0/10 หมอมือเบามากๆ จะมารู้สึกตอนน่าจะงัดฟันหรือผ่าฟันอะไรไม่รู้ตอนใช้เครื่องมือ แต่คุณหมอจะบอกตลอดว่าตอนไหนจะรู้สึกเจ็บหรือไม่รู้สึก ไม่ต้องกังวลเลย พอหลังทำเสร็จ กัด gauze 2 hr รู้สึกตุ้บๆเริ่มจะรู้สึกว่าอาจจะปวดแน่ๆ พอเอา gauze ออกทานยาพาราแค่ 1 เม็ด นอนตื่นขึ้นมา ไม่ปวดเลยย ทานอาหารอ่อน ~ 1 วัน จากนั้นกินปกติเลย จนถึงวันตัดไหมก็ไม่ปวดเลยไม่รู้สึก แก้มบวมเล็กน้อย ถ้าไม่สังเกตดีๆจะดูไม่ออกว่าบวมเลย สำหรับใครที่กลัวการผ่าฟันคุดหรือกลัวเข็มฉีดยาชาแบบเราแนะนำมาที่นี่ได้เลยค่ะ ดีมากๆๆ ✨🫶🏻
0x311d5fef28a1eb3b_0x909a2bb9e96e13f3.author: Praweena Chanchompoo
0x311d5fef28a1eb3b_0x909a2bb9e96e13f3.en: This was my first decision in 10 years to see a dentist because I had terrible wisdom tooth pain and needed to find a clinic to have them removed. I'm terrified of needles and anesthetic injections. People around me who have been to dentists say that only the anesthetic injection hurts, but I wanted a clinic where the injection wouldn't be painful. I looked at many reviews until I found this place. Almost 100% of the reviews said the anesthetic injection was painless, so I decided to come here. The first thing that impressed me was how lovely the staff and dentist were; they spoke so politely. The place was relaxing, like a cafe. The main point was that the dental check-up revealed I had four wisdom teeth, two above and two below. The dentist recommended removing them two at a time, which meant one would be extracted and the other would be surgically removed. I was terrified because I'd heard from people who had had them removed elsewhere that even just one tooth would cause excruciating pain and make it impossible to eat. They recommended removing them one at a time because removing both at once would be incredibly painful. But I decided to have both removed at once. On the day of the procedure, I was excited, scared, and couldn't sleep. First, the anesthetic injection was painless; I didn't feel anything at all. Pain score: 0/10. The dentist had a very light touch. I only felt something when they were probably prying or extracting the tooth with the instruments. But the doctor always tells you when you might feel pain or not, so don't worry. After the procedure, I bit on the gauze for 2 hours and felt a throbbing sensation, starting to feel like it might hurt. Once the gauze was removed, I took just one paracetamol tablet and slept. When I woke up, I didn't feel any pain at all! I ate soft foods for about a day, then ate normally until the stitches were removed, and I didn't feel any pain at all. My cheek was slightly swollen, but you wouldn't notice it unless you looked closely. For anyone who is afraid of wisdom tooth extraction or afraid of needles like me, I highly recommend coming here. It's great! ✨🫶🏻

0x311d5fef28a1eb3b_0x909a2bb9e96e13f3.text: I recently had dental implants done with Dr. Prakarn, and I'm incredibly impressed. After the procedure, there was no swelling, bleeding, or pain. 0x30e29db90ac93b0b_0x3c20aa9dcfa20a4d.author: KK EE
0x30e29db90ac93b0b_0x3c20aa9dcfa20a4d.en: The doctor and assistant provided excellent service. They were very polite, explained the procedure clearly, and were very helpful to the patient. If you're interested in their services, I recommend contacting the clinic directly for a better price. I found a review through GoWabi about a wisdom tooth extraction for 950 THB, but the assistant said that booking directly with the clinic costs 900 THB. 🥹 I recommend contacting them directly! Overall, I was very impressed. The doctor was very gentle, explained every step of the process, and spoke softly and calmly, making me feel less scared. They worked very quickly; it was over in no time! There was no soreness or inflammation at all. The wound was fine after only two days. I'm very impressed and highly recommend them! Also, since I work and don't get to the clinic until after 6 PM, they extended the waiting time for patients like me who can't take time off work.

0x30e29db90ac93b0b_0x3c20aa9dcfa20a4d.text: คุณหมอมือเบามากๆและตั้งใจทำดีมาก นัดอุดฟันครั้งแรกเลยกับคลินิกนี้ ติดต่อทางไลน์สะดวกดี มีแจ้งราคาข้อมูลครบถ้วนก่อนมาทำ(ซึ่งดีมาก เพราะจะได้วางแผนค่าใช้จ่ายถูก) มาถึงคุณหมอแนะนำดีมาก เลยอุดฟันไป3ซี่ ค่าใช้จ่ายไม่ถึง2,000บาท ถูกที่สุดตั้งแต่เคยอุดฟันมาเลยค่ะ ไม่มีบวกเพิ่ม คุณผู้ช่วยหมอ/แอดมินบริการดีมาก ทุกท่านใจเย็น อารมณ์ดี ทำให้การทำฟันไม่น่ากลัว มีโอกาสกลับไปใช้บริการอีกแน่นอนค่ะ ซอยทางเข้าแคบ แต่รถยนต์เข้าได้ จอดรถหน้าคลินิกได้2คัน

0x30e29db90ac93b0b_0x3c20aa9dcfa20a4d.en: The dentist was very gentle and dedicated. This was my first time getting fillings at this clinic. Contacting them via LINE was convenient, and they provided complete price information before my visit (which was great for planning my expenses). Upon arrival, the dentist gave excellent advice, and I ended up getting three fillings for less than 2,000 baht – the cheapest I've ever paid! There were no hidden charges. The dentist's assistant/administrator were also very helpful and patient, making the dental procedure feel less intimidating. I will definitely return for more services. The entrance lane is narrow, but cars can access it. There is parking for two cars in front of the clinic.

0x30e29db90ac93b0b_0x3c20aa9dcfa20a4d.en: The dentist, dental assistant, and administrator provide excellent service. 👍🏻 I've been getting my dental work done here for many years. The decor is in brown and black tones with green plants. Payment methods include cash and QR code scanning. The clinic accepts social security insurance; no upfront payment is required. Parking for cars is a bit difficult as there are many apartments in the area. Motorcycle parking is available around the clinic.

0x30502e1f3c4ec187_0xb9178831d6ad370f.text: We were very lucky that the specialist was available and saw us right away, even though we were experiencing wisdom tooth pain. 0x30e29e189e4a7abb_0x9bcdcbdc26df9cd.text: ก่อนอื่นต้องขอขอบคุณ คุณหมอ และเจ้าหน้าที่ผู้ช่วยในคลินิกทุกท่าน ที่ดูแลเป็นอย่างดี อบอุ่นใจมากค่ะ ทุกคนที่นั่นคอยเป็นห่วงและสอบถามจนเราเดินทางกลับถึงที่พักปลอดภัย (ดูแลอย่างดีเหมือนครอบครัวและเป็นกันเองมากๆ) เนื่องจากเราต้องเดินทางไกลคนเดียวจากต่างจังหวัด (ภาคใต้) ไปรักษาฟันที่นั่น ขอบคุณอีกครั้งนะคะ เมื่อเดินทางไปถึงคลีนิค อย่างแรกก็ประทับใจ เจ้าหน้าที่พี่ผู้หญิงน่ารักมากๆ ต้อนรับเราอย่างดี พี่พูดคุยดีมาก น่ารักเป็นกันเอง เพราะเราได้โทรคุยนัดหมายกับพี่เขาก่อนหน้านี้ พี่ให้คำแนะนำที่ดี เป็นผู้นำช่วยคิดและแนะนำให้เราตัดสินใจได้ง่ายขึ้น เจอพี่ผู้ช่วยคุณหมอ เรียกเราให้เข้าไปในห้องทำฟัน พี่เขาน่ารักและพูดจาดีมาก ในส่วนของการรักษาฟัน คือเราเป็นคนที่ค่อนข้างต้องหาข้อมูลก่อนทำอะไร อย่างละเอียดและต้องเลือกที่ดีที่สุด และเราก็ตัดสินใจเลือกที่นี่ (ไม่มีลังเล) เพราะมั่นใจและหาข้อมูลมาอย่างดีแล้ว **เมื่อได้พบคุณหมอ คุณหมอใจดีมากๆน่ารักพูดจาไพเราะเสียงหวานหวาน และเป็นคนอารมณ์ดี เราชอบมากๆ ^^ คุณหมอแนะนำ และรับฟังในสิ่งที่เราต้องการ คุณหมอทำฟันอย่างประณีต ผลงานออกมา สมบูรณ์แบบและสวยงามมากๆ ตรงตามที่เราต้องการ มีความสุขมากๆ ที่ได้รอยยิ้มใหม่ที่มั่นใจ ไม่ผิดหวังเลย เป็นการตัดสินใจที่ถูกต้อง ที่ได้ไปทำฟันที่คลินิกแห่งนี้ ถ้ามีโอกาสจะกลับไปใช้บริการอีกอย่างแน่นอนค่ะ

0x311d5ff0ae107675_0x82cfbf5e01d8e4b0.text: จากที่ได้ ปรึกษา ประสบอุบัติเหตุ ฟันหน้าหักครึ่ง ได้เข้ามาพบคุณหมอ แนะนำขั้นตอนการรักษา คือ เริ่มรักษารากฟัน และ ปักเดือย กรอฟัน เพื่อเตรียมทำครอบ เซรามิก จนครอบเสร็จ ตั้งแต่เริ่มหัตถการ คุณหมอพูดจาไพรเราะ เพราะมากมือเบามากฉีดยาชาไม่รู้สึกเลย ทำดีมาก และ งานละเอียด เนียนมาก รวมระยะเวลารักษา ทั้งหมด 15 วัน ซึ่งเร็วกว่าการประเมิน จากที่อื่น เนื่องจาก มี Lap ในการทำครอบฟันเป็นของตัวเอง ดังนั้น ขอแนะนำใครที่จะ รักษาสุภาพฟัน ต่าง ๆ หรือต้องการปรึกษา สามารถเขาไปได้เลย ที่สำคัญ ราคา ดีมากๆ พนักงานก็บริการดี

0x311d5ff0ae107675_0x82cfbf5e01d8e4b0.en: After consulting with the dentist following an accident that broke my front tooth in half, I came to see the dentist who explained the treatment process. It started with root canal treatment, placing a post, and preparing the tooth for a ceramic crown. From the beginning of the procedure, the dentist was very polite, gentle, and I didn't feel any anesthesia. The work was excellent, detailed, and very neat. The entire treatment took 15 days, which was faster than estimated by other places because they have their own lab for making crowns. Therefore, I recommend this dentist to anyone who needs dental care or consultation. Importantly, the price is very good, and the staff provides excellent service.

0x311d5ff0ae107675_0x82cfbf5e01d8e4b0.text: The clinic is clean and tidy. Scheduling is easy and someone always responds to messages. Dr. Cha-em gives excellent advice and recommendations. 0x311d5ff0ae107675_0x82cfbf5e01d8e4b0.en: I had my braces removed here and it was a great experience. The service was excellent, and the procedure was meticulous and attentive (I had my braces done elsewhere). The price was reasonable. The staff were very helpful and polite. The doctor was patient, kind, and gave great advice. During the procedure, the doctor explained each step, what to expect, what tools to use, and what I would feel. This was very helpful for those who are afraid of braces, reducing anxiety. The clinic isn't large, but it's clean and maintains high standards. I highly recommend it!

0x311d5ff0ae107675_0x82cfbf5e01d8e4b0.text: I found the clinic on Facebook and messaged them to inquire about veneer prices. They responded very thoroughly, so I decided to come in for a check-up. The prices were much better than other clinics, and the dentist is a specialist in cosmetic surgery. If you want to get veneers done by an experienced dentist, I think this place is a good choice.

0x30da3b6574f28301_0xa3dbaf69077c929f.en: I am a Taiwanese tourist 🇹🇼 and I wanted to leave a message to thank all the dentists and assistants who performed my surgery yesterday. You truly saved me. For me, going to the dentist abroad was very challenging, but now I feel this was one of the best decisions I've ever made. Thank you so much, Doctor (I was in so much pain I forgot to ask your name!). If you see this message, please accept my heartfelt gratitude. Thank you all so much 🙏💙

0x30e29dffca5a8ffd_0xed9fc6674714b660.text: I'm sharing my firsthand experience with Picosure treatment from start to finish at Amarante. The housekeeping staff, the other staff, and even the doctors were all incredibly friendly, attentive, supportive, and provided excellent service. The equipment was of the highest standard and quality. I received treatment directly from Dr. Ton (I was so happy!). He was incredibly kind and friendly. During every treatment, I felt his dedication, carefully adjusting the equipment and changing the heads to address my specific problems – a true professional with extensive experience. He also provided encouragement and advice throughout the treatment. My skin problems, including dark spots from scratching due to seborrheic dermatitis (I kept scratching until I bled), and dark marks around my neck from weight gain due to psychiatric medication, all faded noticeably. Even my acne scars, which I'd had since middle school (the kind that people used to tease me about as "crater-like" or "toad skin"), have significantly improved. People around me even complimented me on how much better my skin looked in just a few months. I want to express my deepest gratitude for helping me regain my confidence and allowing me to dress up and wear makeup without worrying about what others thought. You don't need to be reborn to become more beautiful; you just need to choose the right clinic and see the right doctor. External treatment isn't just about looking good; it's about healing your mind as well. Simply looking better and more beautiful in your own way, and receiving compliments from those around you, is a step towards overcoming your fears and anxieties about what others think and say. If you're deciding or researching, I hope my experience can help you make a decision more easily, and I assure you that you will receive the same excellent care I did.

0x30da319d71f41cc1_0xf491a29a2987b0ac.text: I’ve been so grateful for Dr. Kittipan’s help with varicose veins. I recently had an easy, minor surgery to correct varicose vein leakage and was thrilled with the results. A friend recommended Dr. Kittipan to me as a very kind, caring doctor. Upon meeting him, I found that to be very true. He is so personable and easy to talk to. I felt perfectly comfortable being able to ask him questions and talk about my vein problems. He speaks English perfectly which made our conversations very easy. At Dr. Kittipan‘s clinic, he used ultrasound to show me the problem with vein leakage. He discussed this with me and showed me photos of ulcers that can occur if this type of vein is left untreated. Then he explained various options for treatment and gave me his recommendation to insert a tiny laser fiber into my leg to inject the vein with high heat which seals the vein and solves the leakage problem. The body then absorbs the sealed vein over time and creates a new vein if necessary. This procedure has around a 98% success rate. The surgery was handled in the most professional way in the operation room at Rajavej hospital. All the staff were kind and helpful. Dr. Kittipan was very reassuring as well. The surgery only took a short time, maybe just under one hour! I was awake through the process and felt no pain other than the quick, initial anesthetic injection. I spent around one more hour in the recovery area walking around to make sure all was well. There were no problems whatsoever and although I got a ride home just to be safe, I honestly felt I could have driven myself home from the hospital! I hardly had any pain in my leg after the surgery, just a bit of tenderness. I barely even had any need for pain medication afterward. I was given an elastic nylon stocking to wear from my foot to my knee which really helped to support my leg for the week after the surgery. I was told I should walk around 30 minutes per day to help with the healing process. This was no problem. There was a waterproof bandage on my leg so that I could shower regularly until Dr. Kittipan removed the bandage at our one week follow up appointment at his clinic. At my one month follow up visit, I was shown by ultrasound how the vein had been absorbed and the leakage problem solved. I honestly can’t think of how the surgery could have been any easier, less invasive or problem free! I have had complete trust in Dr. Kittipan throughout this process. He has been very helpful in talking with me about various vein issues I have and the different options for treating spider veins that might just need easy, in clinic cosmetic treatment to varicose veins like mine that require minor surgery. I highly recommend Dr. Kittipan and his leg/vein clinic. Act quickly so that your problem will not increase in severity. He can direct you regarding the best option for you.

0x30da319d71f41cc1_0xf491a29a2987b0ac.text: I can't recommend Dr. Kittipan and his clinic highly enough. For several years I have a pain in my leg when walking and Drs in the UK only treated with tablets and did not take it seriously. I had an ultrascan at the clinic and a doplarscan which confirmed low pressure in my leg and very weak pulse. Dr Kittipan arranged for an MRA scan within days which identified a severely blocked main artery and suggested inserting a stent to widen the artery before it got worse. 0x30da29440f4dc1db_0xe46a305a582933c5.text: Where do I even begin? This was the most incredible experience with the most professional company I’ve ever encountered. From start to finish, everything was seamless. Quick communication and incredibly helpful staff made the process so easy – I even booked the day before via chat! It was no problem for them. They arranged a private driver to pick me up, and I was greeted with a brand-new car that smelled great and a driver who was courteous and professional. Upon arrival, I was asked to wait briefly, signed my waiver, and then got suited up with a helmet. Although the staff didn’t speak much English, Google Translate bridged the gap effortlessly. From the very first step, I felt completely safe and well-cared for. They even provided water and a stunning sunset view while I waited for my turn. When my time came, they strapped me in, handed me a GoPro, and off we went. The view was breathtaking – like stepping into a painting. Words can’t describe the feeling of being up there; you have to experience it yourself. The pilot was professional, ensuring a safe and smooth ride both up and down. I highly recommend the 30-minute sunset flight – it’s truly magical. I left with the biggest smile and wished I could give them more stars than Google allows. Truly unforgettable!

0x30da29440f4dc1db_0xe46a305a582933c5.text: This is a powered paragliding experience in Chiang Mai, offering breathtaking aerial views of fields, mountains, and countryside. The feeling of flying is both thrilling and liberating, making it a truly unique and unforgettable experience. Highlights • The powered paragliding experience is truly unique, allowing you to genuinely feel the sensation of "flying." • Takeoff and landing are handled by professional instructors, making it suitable even for beginners. • Wide-open views of the surrounding natural scenery of Chiang Mai. • A smooth yet exhilarating flight experience. Pricing • Flight price: 3000 THB/person • Photo + video service: 2500 THB (1-2 people) Important Notes • Advance booking is recommended, as flight times are subject to weather conditions. • Wear comfortable clothing and closed shoes. • Those with a fear of heights or health conditions should participate with caution. Overall Review This is a highly recommended high-altitude experience. While not inexpensive, the flight perspective and overall experience are exceptional. If you want to add a true aerial adventure to your Chiang Mai trip, this is a worthwhile option.

0x30e281f06752a2ef_0x38d3e19d3e4e632c.text: The clinic offers a number of promotions and a fairly large clientele. However, one area I'd like the clinic to consider improving is their "time management." Their time management is quite poor. The first time I went for a walk-in, I had to wait in line, but I wasn't bothered by it. This time, I made an appointment in advance because the online queue was full and they weren't accepting phone appointments. I went to the clinic around 2:00 PM to make an appointment for 7:00 PM. As the appointment time drew near, I arrived at the clinic at 6:46 PM, but I still had to wait until 7:25 PM before I could receive service. After the procedure, I asked the staff at the counter why I had already made an appointment. The staff member replied that I had already made an appointment, but that I should focus on the front desk. Even with an appointment, I still had to wait. The question is: 1. If I make an appointment and still have to wait, why is this considered an appointment? 2. If the clinic has already made an appointment but can't manage internally, why would they accept appointments? This may seem trivial, but it all reflects the clinic's management. No matter how good the promotion is, this type of management will likely determine whether or not to continue using the clinic.

0x30e29f3ad9823fdf_0xc26324bb23396a5c.text: First of all, I have to say I'm terrified of dentists. Lately, I've had symptoms like my teeth were falling out, they were all loose, I had cavities everywhere, and I've been experiencing unexplained migraine headaches. I also had lead fillings on three molars (two on the innermost upper jaws and one on the lower jaw). After enduring it for so long, I finally went to the dentist. Ultimately, I needed root canal treatment on two upper right molars (they removed the fillings and redid the rest), and another on the left. I was terrified, but unbelievably, the dentist was incredibly gentle, kind, and careful not to let anything go into my throat. Dr. Jirihathai, a small female dentist, was like a goddess to me. I expected the injection to hurt, but it didn't at all. When she drilled the root canal, it felt so comfortable, like someone was massaging my nerves. That's when I realized my migraines were coming from my inflamed root canals. When she treated the other root canal, I felt so much better. The migraine pain in my forehead, left eye socket, and back of my head disappeared completely. I finally understood that the left-sided migraines I'd been experiencing for ten years, taking painkillers daily, were actually caused by inflamed root canals. The dentist was excellent. They were quick, gentle, and meticulous, ensuring no saliva or debris entered my throat. For me, being a dentist isn't just about skill; compassion and care are equally important. I give them a perfect 10/10 for skill, a perfect 10/10 for care and attention to detail, and a perfect 10/100 for making me overcome my fear of dentists. Dr. Peerapat also did my crown, which is beautiful and incredibly detailed. My tooth was crooked, and he carefully prepared around it to prevent me from biting my cheek. I'm allergic to lead, and he was wonderful. When he removed the silver filling, my tooth cracked, but he secured it and crowned it after the root canal treatment. I was very worried about lead leaking into my throat, but it was perfectly fine. There was also Dr. Sornsiri, a male dentist, who helped remove the silver lead fillings from both lower molars. He worked very quickly and painlessly. The fillings turned out beautifully. He was very attentive, preparing the crooked tooth that I couldn't reach to make using a dental floss easier. He even used a rubber gauze to prevent any debris from entering my throat during the procedure. His attentiveness and explanations made me feel comfortable lying with my mouth open for the treatment. I want to express my sincere gratitude. This is a genuine review. I paid for everything myself; no one paid for it, and there were no discounts. But I really liked the treatment I received here and am very thankful for it, which is why I'm writing this review. Thank you, Dr. Jirihathai, for helping me overcome my fear of dentists. Thank you also to Dr. Peerapat and Dr. Sornsiri. This is Walirat.
0x30e29f3ad9823fdf_0xc26324bb23396a5c.author: Appleja Kanta

0x30e29f3ad9823fdf_0xc26324bb23396a5c.text: This clinic is beyond excellent and I would give it more than 5 stars if I could. My son goes here for Invisalign. His doctor is Dr. Chidchanok. She is an incredible orthodontist. She is an expert on Invisalign and knows every trick there is for getting the best results from Invisalign. She also is extremely flexible. We do not live in Thailand, but fly in and out a couple of times a year. Although it is not ideal to see the doctor so infrequently, she understands how to use Invisalign so well that she is able to make it work. My son's teeth are getting better and better. I have been impressed with her from day one, but with each visit I see more and more of the depth of her knowledge. After our last visit, it just seemed wrong not to praise her publicly. If you live in Bangkok or travel in and out of Bangkok somewhat regularly, I highly recommend her. I find it very hard to believe that you would find better care anywhere in the world, including the West.

As foreign I was having hard time choosing between Bumbringrad or BIDH and I visited both. I like both hospitals and their prices are almost the same but upon arrival Bumbringrad focus on more my need than BIDH. My main reason was treat my front teeth filling where I had poorly done somewhere on street dental. I felt odd and it looks bad inside and outside. I discussed the same issue both doctors Bumringrad actually did Xtray on the teeth and give me solution I needed urgently BIDH just checking oral and give me treatment plan which was great but wasn’t my first need. I did not look for aesthetic solution at that time. In fact I definitely was not into veneers that was out of necessity and my need I decided to do my real treatment with Bumbringrad. If you okay starting zero to full aesthetic then BIDH is okay but if you are looking for sustainable solution on your problem Bumbringrad can be better

0x30e29f3ad9823fdf_0xc26324bb23396a5c.text: This is an excellent clinic. Ignore the people complaining about the prices in the reviews. It is expensive but it is quality and if you are the type of person who bargains with dentists then I would maybe reconsider your priorities in life. I had an impacted wisdom tooth removed by Dr. Winal Kittidumkerng. It is the day after my surgery and I feel zero pain and there is no excess trauma to my mouth. It’s almost as if I didn’t even have surgery and the procedure was flawless with zero pain. They are doing world class dental surgery at this place and it’s worth every penny than going to a cheaper place. I went to a dentist in Turkey in 2022 that did an awful job removing another impacted wisdom tooth and it left me in pain for weeks after and a vow never to go back to the dentist. Zero problems here in Thailand at BIDH. Thank you Dr. Kittidumkerng and BIDH!

0x30e29f3ad9823fdf_0xc26324bb23396a5c.text: over 2+ weeks ago, I had 4 impacted wisdom teeth removed here at BIDH. I also went through general anesthesia during the procedure. They made me stay overnight in a room since I was by myself and the nurses were very kind and provided good food and made sure there was no complications from the anesthesia. The overall staff was great. Doctors did a wonderful job and it was a smooth successful procedure and clear communication on the recovery steps. Before I came to BIDH, I read the reviews and I think if there’s issue with pricing, all I can say is first, you are in Thailand. Complaining about price of an operation says a lot about where you are in your life. Second, I would rather pay for high quality treatment than worry about potential serious after effects. You can come to BIDH with high confidence and know you are in good hands.
0x30e29f3ad9823fdf_0xc26324bb23396a5c.author: Jon Son

0x30e29f3ad9823fdf_0xc26324bb23396a5c.text: I’ve had a string of awful experiences at this dental clinic. Would not recommend. A few months ago, I came in for a simple cleaning and they damaged one of my existing fillings during the appointment. That alone should’ve been a huge red flag. The second time I returned, I clearly asked for three things: 1. the damaged filling to be repaired, 2. a cleaning, 3. and simply the whitening kit — not an in-office whitening treatment, just the kit. Instead, they told me that I “shouldn’t” do the fillings now and insisted they had to be done after whitening, even though I explained repeatedly that these fillings are not visible at all. They still refused to listen. They then told me to arrive early for my appointment, which I did — and yet they still didn’t do the fillings, even though that was one of the main reasons I came. The cleaning they performed was also extremely painful and felt completely wrong. I had to ask them several times to stop because it hurt so much. They didn’t stop the first time I asked; I had to insist before they finally did. Despite being early, despite the fillings being small and straightforward, and despite explaining everything clearly, they did not finish the work and told me to come back yet again. And now here I am at the next appointment — and they’re already 30 minutes late. Add to that the difficulty of making even a basic appointment and it’s just been a nightmare from start to finish. Based on how many issues I’ve had here, I absolutely would not recommend this clinic to anyone.
0x30e29f3ad9823fdf_0xc26324bb23396a5c.author: Andra Dimitriu

0x30e29f3ad9823fdf_0xc26324bb23396a5c.text: While the staff is very accommodating and the hospital is modern the quality of treatment was disastrous! They misdiagnosed me although 5 x-rays were done and I saw 2 different doctors! Neither of them advised me correctly but put a new filling on top of an infection! This led to me getting surgery a week later at a different dentist who used BIDH’s x-ray to identify the infection. The whole experience was very unpleasant! I’ve spend hundreds of Euros at BIDH to find out a week later through immense pain that the tooth needs to be pulled! When I corresponded with BIDH about the issue they now recommend a root canal using the same X-ray they made prior! Be aware of choosing this hospital.

0x311d5fe9173fb217_0xa1e1db7367d20760.text: I'd like to say that I'm really impressed with everything. ❤️❤️ I had my teeth scaled and my retainer fitted at Have Fun Dental Clinic, which was recommended by a friend. I don't usually get my teeth scaled very often because I once went to a clinic where the doctor was really rough and hit my gums in several places. He did it really fast and hard, and my teeth were really sensitive. Afterwards, my teeth were sensitive for a day and my mouth was sore. 😓 I was so taken aback and thought that other places would be similar. However, my friend recommended Have Fun, saying that the doctor had a very gentle touch, so I gave it a try. The clinic has enough parking space for customers, and next to it is a cute, minimalist cafe with very delicious drinks, I can confirm. You can sit and wait in the cafe, and the staff at the cafe will call you when it's your turn. The wait isn't that long, but I wanted to have a chill drink first, so I sat and waited at the cafe. The service at the clinic, from the receptionist, the assistant doctor, and the doctor, was beyond my expectations. They were all very friendly and impressed with their service mind. Most importantly, the doctor had a very gentle touch. They kept asking me if it hurt or if it was too hard or if it was okay. You can tell the doctor. And it didn't hurt my gums at all. After scraping, they also applied fluoride for free. My teeth are clean and white. It's worth more than the price. The price is also very friendly and not expensive. I highly recommend this place @have fun dental clinic 💕💕😍😍

0x30e29b00543aa863_0xf2bf0b0679d6ce1d.text: This is a newly opened dental clinic near my house, but it's the most impressive dental clinic I've ever been to. From the moment I stepped in, I felt the warm and friendly atmosphere. The reception staff were cheerful and provided detailed information and advice. The dentist who owns the clinic is very skilled and gentle; I didn't feel any pain during the procedure. The dentist explained the treatment process in detail, which made me feel comfortable and less anxious. The instruments and equipment used are modern, clean, and meet high standards. In addition, the clinic is spotlessly clean, with excellent hygiene and sanitation standards. The treatment costs are reasonable and worth the quality received. Overall, I am very impressed with the service. It has become my family's regular clinic. If anyone is looking for a good dental clinic that pays attention to every detail, I highly recommend this place. You won't be disappointed.
0x30e29b00543aa863_0xf2bf0b0679d6ce1d.author: Gan Chankajon

0x30e29b00543aa863_0xf2bf0b0679d6ce1d.text: Today I took my younger brother to see Dr. Duangjai, the owner of Tooth Tonic, for a dental appointment. She's amazing! My brother has acid reflux and can't lie down, but he had several cavities, some on the inside of his teeth. Dr. Duangjai was so kind and filled three of his teeth while he was still lying down, and then did a tartar removal. I can tell she must have had a sore back from all that work! Tooth Tonic clinic is very clean, with a minimalist style and the air conditioning is wonderfully cool, making it very relaxing. Most importantly, the prices are excellent, not as expensive as I secretly thought. 😊 I was a little worried that my brother might be sore afterwards, but he wasn't. Dr. Duangjai has a very gentle touch. If you're looking for a skilled dentist, a clean clinic, and affordable prices, I highly recommend Tooth Tonic!
0x30e29b00543aa863_0xf2bf0b0679d6ce1d.author: นราวดี จิวากานันต์

0x30e29b00543aa863_0xf2bf0b0679d6ce1d.text: I came for teeth whitening service and was impressed from the moment I stepped in. The atmosphere was clean, comfortable, and beautifully decorated. The dentist and assistants were very lovely and friendly. They explained the process in detail. During the procedure, I felt relaxed and experienced no pain or irritation. After the treatment, my teeth were noticeably whiter. I'm very impressed and feel much more confident when I smile now.

0x30e29b00543aa863_0xf2bf0b0679d6ce1d.en: Dr. Duangjai has such a gentle touch! Usually when I get tartar removed by other dentists, I have to constantly raise my hand, but Dr. Duangjai is so gentle. I didn't feel any sensitivity at all; it was like a light touch, yet she was so thorough, and my teeth were incredibly clean. And she's so kind! Other dentists often tell me to open my mouth wide, which makes my mouth tired, but Dr. Duangjai is the first one who told me to relax. She's truly amazing! That's what expertise is all about. I traveled a long distance, but it was totally worth it. The price was also very reasonable. 10/10 out of 10! I'm already a regular customer.

The clinic changes its atmosphere regularly, making it look clean and inviting, and I always feel good when I visit. 0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.text: I am a workaholic - have known this about myself for many years. And, my long term career in the US entertainment industry has been a perfect outlet for my addiction. What I've also known about myself for many years is there were some deeply traumatic events in childhood and early adulthood that weren't properly addressed resulting in a C-PTSD diagnosis at the end of last year. And, it all came crashing down at once. After many, many years of running myself into the ground, I had a major life event at the start of 2025 that I couldn't put my head down and work through - the end of a long term relationship. The lack of foundation having never done "the work" ultimately led to a mutually agreed separation of employment at the same time. And I'm grateful it did -- because without those two things happening concurrently, I'm not sure I ever would've taken the time to stop, center myself, and face the trauma I had been trying to outrun for many years. In researching places to go, I heard about New Paradigm through a mutual friend who had a friend that went through the program and called it "life changing." I made an inquiry immediately as I was desperate to get on the first flight out of the US so I could "fix it" and get back to the grind. It didn't quite work out that way. There were a lot of things I needed to "fix" within myself on home soil first. I spoke to Dirk for the first time in February and we decided together that I needed to be a bit more emotionally stabilized before making the 26 hour trip to attend the program. So, I started regular counseling sessions with him and began to dive in to EMDR. I dedicated every minute of the next 3 months prepping for my trip which was scheduled for May. I felt like a different person and that all the "healing" I'd done would make the program a breeze. It wasn't. It was hard. Really hard (especially the first week). And my deep seated need to try to control my environment was the first major hurdle. I had developed hyper vigilance over the years as a form of protection to keep myself safe, not realizing it was doing exactly the opposite. I quickly realized that this wasn't my show and I wasn't in control - but that wasn't an easy surrender. The second major hurdle was the surrender of all forms of technology. When that happened, my brain kicked into ruminations lasting what felt like every hour of the day from sun up to sun down. Dirk worked with me using methods to try to break the ruminations, but they were incessant. And my brain? It was focused solely on my relationship dissolving. The grief and shame that I had for not showing up differently as a partner due to my burnout / depression from my job. Guilt for not going to therapy sooner when I was being pushed to do it. The resentment for how it ended. We did a lot of EMDR around it, but still there was little relief. After about the 9th day Dirk had a talk with me and said "we're going to cut the fuel line to what's going on. There are all these fires around you that we're putting out, but we need to cut the gas." So, we went deeper and back to childhood where we found the root cause of the issue. Adandonment. Feelings of unworthiness. Unresolved issues with my mom that mirrored some issues in my romantic relationship. And once we did EMDR around those things, the clouds started to lift. Now, nearly a month of from the program having had some time for the EMDR to really set in and lots of reflection, I feel good. Really good. In fact, I'd say my time time at New Paradigm was life changing. I learned more about myself in 14 days than I had in the previous 38 years. I can clearly see when my work addiction developed, why, and how my lack of relationship to self led me to a REALLY dark place. My focus now is on implementing the tools to aid in my recovery and I know for absolute certainty that I will NEVER be in the position I was in at the start of the year -- because now I have a foundation. I know who I am and I love myself. I highly recommend New Paradigm - it was the best thing to ever happen to me.
0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.author: DaLyn Bauman

0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.text: Having received traditional treatments of Mental health Challenges such as Talk Therapy (CBT) and multiple Medications for half a decade, I can say that nothing has pulled me out of my Misery and Self Deprecation as much as the Full, Complete Holistic treatment that Dirk offers at New Paradigm. My journey into the world of Mental Health Challenges are like many others who suffer a great difficulty navigating their own mind. Constant depression, Severe Anxiety, Lack of energy and passion, Self Sabotages, Failed relationships etc. When I realised my mind was a threat to my being, to my livelihood, to my health, I started rushing to seek help. It started with talking with friends and family, then Counselling, then "Self improvements", then Therapy, then medication, lastly Hospitalisation. Even with all the unraveling alongside seeking help, It wasn't clear to me that the treatments I was receiving was not helping me and some even made me worse off. Until I was at my lowest and was referred to New Paradigm by a professional that beliefs in innovative approach to treating Mental Health challenges and illnesses. It might be obvious where I am going with this message right now, yes New Paradigm pulled me out of the mud that is my mind, my thoughts, and yes just as others have said the Place is absolutely amazing and beautiful and one of the most comfortable stays you'll ever have. However, the core of what makes me believe in New Paradigm for treatment to Severe personal and medical mental challenges is truly the "Holistic" Approach. To me, Holistic encapsulates treatment that focuses on The Whole, the body, the mind, the spirit and any other things you got inside of you. At New Paradigm, you aren't just taught through talking and thinking, you are also taught through not talking and not thinking. You are taught through movements (exercises, walks, swimming), but as importantly you are taught through not moving (meditation, sitting, breathing). Everything in the programme have their reasons and those reasons are to heal and strengthen you, most importantly to allow you to be that version of yourself that persists through the storm, to be able to sit or walk in serenity and enjoy each day and each task again with peace and joy. To conclude, New Paradigm treats you like a family that are equipped with decades of knowledge and tools around mental health challenges. Once you arrives you are a part of that family, sure you have some daily tasks but as a small tight knit community everyone has a part to play. Luckily all parts are there just for you to regain your inner Peace and Health. New Paradigm will treat you like a member or a friend, and not a patient or a client. If you are lost, if you feel you need help with your mind, if you have chaos in your head, contact Dirk and His family. They will change you for the better. ps. from the bottom to the top of my heart, Thank you Dirk, Kae, Atith and other staffs at New Paradigm for giving me another perspective on life, a new beginning. and Thank you to my family for supporting me and allowing me a chance at New Paradigm. I am eternally grateful
0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.author: Nino Jj

0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.text: Throughout my life and professional career, I never felt that I needed professional help. Somehow, I always managed challenging situations myself, both in my personal and in my work life. A few months ago, however, I started to have mental blockages, strong and constant neck pain and I felt an emotional exhaustion beyond anything I had experienced before. It took me a while to realise that I was “burned out” on several levels and that a beach holiday with the family would not be enough to put me back into shape. In retrospect, no wonder, given that I work and live most of the time, away from my wife and children, in a “frontier” country that currently is at war with itself. Over there, daily life and work means daily crisis management and dealing with a lot of negativity, with varying intensity, and over a long period of time. Luckily, I realised that I need professional help and started do the research, looking for a program that I could join and that specialises in dealing with “burn out” cases and trauma, as I was quite sure that some older, traumatic experiences would need to be addressed as well, as certain thought patterns kept coming up, again and again. In other words: I was looking for a holistic program that could address my specific needs and restore my mental strength and emotional imbalance in a relatively short time. The one program that stood out and that resonated with me instantly was the one of New Paradigm in Chiang Mai, Thailand: a maximum of 4 participants only are accepted at a time, for a 14-day retreat that sounded intense but holistic, designed to address the mental, emotional, and spiritual aspects of oneself. To cut an incredible, life-changing experience short: I finished the program a week ago and have to say that it was the right program at the right time with the right “content”, developed and operated by the right expert: Dirk J. Lambert has grown up in the West, specialised in trauma treatment, hence understands the Western mindset, and at the same time is a two times ordained Buddhist monk who is living in Asia for more than 35 years. His uniquely designed program combines Western “treatment” models with Asian spiritual practices, resulting in a very practical and not difficult to apply “path” of recovery. Stepping onto the path helped me to gain back my mental strength and more importantly provided me with the tools, the self- care and the confidence that will prevent me from running into the same mental “traps” again. I could not have asked for a better retreat and for better personal guidance. Thank you, Dirk & team – you did an outstanding job!
0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.author: Jens Uwe Parkitny

0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.text: New Paradigm’s program successfully blends mindfulness practices with modern trauma modalities to create space for new growth and a new sense of hope. Some of the philosophies (waking early, observing silence for the majority of the day, restricted electronics access) may seem intense at first. After completing the program, I would not want it any other way and know it would not be as effective without them. Dirk has a kind of mindful maverick quality to him that makes him a very effective therapist. While grounded in researched backed methods like meditation and EMDR, he diverges from the conventional strategies of talk therapy and seeks to dive into the root of the issue without wasting time with extraneous tangents. He will challenge you, sometimes directly, but never without compassion and your best interest at heart. I found this to be a refreshing approach compared to past experiences with traditional psychologists. After all, most of us have come to New Paradigm’s gate because the conventional methods haven’t yielded much success. It is clear that all the pieces of the program have been well thought out to work together and were fine tuned over many years and many patients. Try to remain open minded, listen more than speak and slowly put the ideas into practice over the two weeks. When the work is challenging, sustenance is all the more important and that’s where Kae comes in to the program with her amazingly delicious, healthy meals and afternoon snacks. Gratitude comes easier in the morning when you know you have three of her meals to enjoy during the day. There is also a fun cooking class towards the end of the retreat and recipes to take home! Sonny is the yoga and fitness instructor who can generally be seen working hard and uplifting people with his positive spirit. He really is the definition of diligence and his morning walks, albeit feeling painfully early at first, became something I looked forward to. If you’re feeling stuck or can’t move on from the past, I would recommend New Paradigm as a potential catalyst for a healthier perspective. None of us can change the past, but we can remodel our view of it to better suit a positive path moving forward. Thanks for all the wisdom, care, food, memories and good laughs. All the best to you Dirk, Kae and Sonny, Sean
0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.author: Sean Cooper

0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.text: It was a last-minute decision for me to join the 7days retreat at New Paradigm in Chiang Mai. I had been comparing many mental health well-being retreats in Koh Samui, Phuket, Indonesia, the Philippines and Bangkok, but New Paradigm in Chiang Mai felt much more personal and intimate. They only accept four people in the program and during my stay there were just three clients including me, which made the experience very focused and genuine. On the first day everything felt a little unfamiliar, but I chose to trust the process and go with the flow. Dirk listened deeply and gave me a sense of psychological safety that I had not felt in a long time. I finally felt understood in my struggles, my weaknesses and the reasons behind some of my reactions and behaviour patterns. He taught me powerful techniques that helped me transform negative energy into something that supports me rather than hurts me. And more important for me personally is the power of letting go and forgiveness. You must be willing to open your mind, heart and soul for the healing to work. Dirk provides the foundation, but you must participate and take action. The true change happens when you embrace the learning and commit to the journey. Sunny, the son of Dirk, kept us on track with all the physical activities. He supported us with so much passion and genuine encouragement. Every time he said you can do it, he truly meant it. He is also an all-around support for the retreat and even takes care of cleaning our rooms. The quality of his work shows how much love and care he puts into everything he does. Kae, the wife of Dirk, cooked the most delicious Thai food. You can feel the love she pours into each meal. Her warm smile each day added so much comfort to the experience. Dirk has created a very unique focus program for people who are ready to help themselves and take responsibility for their healing. With the balanced support of Sunny and Kae, the experience becomes a true renewal of life. Thank you Dirk for your wisdom and care. Thank you Sunny for your motivation and uplifting energy. Thank you Kae for your loving meals and kindness. I am truly grateful to each of you for helping me reconnect with myself, renewed, stronger and ready to face the present & future. All the best, Vivian of Switzerland

0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.text: Sometimes all it takes is letting go of what was and taking a little better care of yourself. During an intensive retreat in Thailand, my days started at 5:30 in the morning with a quiet walk, followed by the sauna and ice bath, and then morning meditation. After breakfast, we had counseling and trauma therapy, light therapy, Muay Thai training, and Thai massages to bring our bodies back into balance. I can honestly say this was the most beautiful and necessary experience of my life. Not only because of the journey itself, but because of the people I met along the way. Ross and Chris from Australia and England, Sunny who guided us through all activities, Kae who cooked the most delicious food every day and cared for us with so much love, and Dirk, who guided us through deep treatments that allowed us to reconnect with our past and transform the way we carry our pain. We were also given the chance to say goodbye to someone we miss, or to someone we were never able to say goodbye to in the past, simply because we couldn’t let go or didnt know how to. And in between all that healing, there was so much laughter. Chris even drew a picture of the three of us, me as Super R the Meerkat, Ross as a hamster, and Chris as the whale. We called ourselves the Holy Trinity of trauma treatment and laughed our asses off. These moments are now memories but will stay with me forever. It was a truly magical time. If you ever feel the need to pause, realign, or take time for yourself, I can only say this is an experience I deeply recommend. Speaking as someone who didn’t take enough care of herself and was constantly overworking and trying to hold everything together: take care of yourself and don’t be afraid to let go and stand alone. When you surrender unconditionally, the most beautiful things can happen. Love, Remke
