I recommend inquiring, booking an appointment, and discussing your needs and preferences. Parking is available at the mall across the street, probably Top or Big C. Get your parking ticket stamped for free parking at the clinic. There's also a Go Ang Hainanese Chicken Rice shop that just opened next to the dental clinic. You can stop by for a meal!

0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.text: ร้านทำฟันอยู่แถวๆ ตรงข้ามร้านอาหารตงเพ้ง ไม่มีที่จอดแต่สามารถจอดได้ที่ เดอะเชลเตอร์วังหิน (แสตมป์บัตรจอดได้1ชม) แนะนำโทรจองก่อน 1-2 อาทิตย์ (ถ้าคุณหมอเจ้าของร้าน 2 ชม) ไม่โทรก่อนจะได้คิวแทรกที่ต้องนั่งรอ (อาจจะนาน) บรรยากาศโดยรวมโอเค กึ่งเก่ากึ่งใหม่ แอร์เย็น โซฟานั่งรอสบาย มีที่นั่งเยอะ มีกาแฟ/น้ำ/ขนม ทานฟรี ห้องน้ำสะอาด เจ้าหน้าที่บริการดี คุณหมอเจ้าของแนะนำดี ใจดี มือเบา ขูดหินปูน 900-1000 (ถ้าฟันเหลือน้อยก็จะลดราคากว่านี้) โทรสอบถามราคา จองคิวก่อนได้
0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.author: MEE KKE
0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.en: The dental clinic is located across from Tong Peng Restaurant. There's no parking available, but you can park at The Shelter Wanghin (parking validated for 1 hour). It's recommended to call and book an appointment 1-2 weeks in advance (2 hours if the owner dentist is available). Not calling ahead might result in a last-minute wait. The overall atmosphere is okay, a mix of old and new. The air conditioning is cool, the waiting area has comfortable sofas, and there's plenty of seating. Free coffee, water, and snacks are available. The restrooms are clean, and the staff provides good service. The owner dentist is kind, helpful, and gentle. Teeth scaling costs 900-1000 baht (the price will be lower if there are fewer teeth remaining). Call to inquire about prices and book an appointment.

0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.text: ที่บ้านรักษากับคลินิกนี้มาตั้งแต่เรียนมัธยม จนตอนนี้ทำงานแล้วก็ไม่เคยคิดไปทำที่อื่น ทีมหมอมีความละเอียดและเบามือมาก โดยเฉพาะหากได้หมอสาโรจน์ถือว่าโชคดีไปอีก มือเบา X10 จอดรถได้ที่บิ๊กซีฝั่งตรงข้าม ทำฟันเสร็จก็มีร้านข้าวมันไก่โกอ่างอยู่ติดกับคลินิก
0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.author: Boat Pheerawat
0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.en: My family has been receiving treatment at this clinic since high school, and now that I'm working, I've never considered going anywhere else. The team of doctors is very meticulous and gentle, especially if you get Dr. Saroj – that's incredibly lucky, his touch is ten times gentler! You can park at Big C across the street. After your dental appointment, there's a Go Ang Hainanese Chicken Rice restaurant right next to the clinic.

0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.text: แผนกต้อนรับน่ารัก คุณหมอดูแลดีมากค่ะ มีพี่พยาบาลวัดความดันก่อนตรวจ คลินิคมีมาตรฐาน คุณหมอพูดคุยด้วยความน่ารักจริงใจ และที่สำคัญ เป็นการถอนฟันที่ไม่เจ็บสักนิดเลยค่ะ ฉีดยาชายังไม่เจ็บเลยค่ะ จะใช้บริการต่อไปนะคะ 🥰
0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.author: Preamwadee K
0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.en: The reception area was lovely, and the doctor provided excellent care. A nurse checked my blood pressure before the examination. The clinic was well-maintained and the doctor was very kind and sincere. Most importantly, the tooth extraction was completely painless! Even the anesthetic injection was painless. I will definitely use their services again. 🥰

0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.text: แผนกต้อนรับและพนักงานบริการดีมาก จองคิวมาล่วงหน้ามาถึงคลินิกแล้วนั่งรอไม่นาน คุณหมอน่ารักแนะนำดี ทำฟันไม่เจ็บเลย มาใช้บริการที่นี่3ครั้งเเล้ว เริ่ดๆค่ะ
0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.author: Ying oiw
0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.en: The reception and service staff were excellent. I had booked an appointment in advance and didn't have to wait long when I arrived at the clinic. The doctor was lovely and gave good advice. The dental procedure was painless. I've used their services three times now and it's fantastic!

0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.text: Been going since I was a child and my whole family goes there. Now I have a child and I will take her there one day.
0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.author: Natalie Tangsakul

0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.text: ถ้าเรื่องทำฟัน คลินิกนี้ดีมากๆ เรื่องความสะอาด ดูแลคนไข้ แผลหลังถอน หรือรากเทียม ที่นี่ดีที่สุดคะไม่เจ็บเลย
0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.author: kittnat channel
0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.en: If it's about dental work, this clinic is excellent. Cleanliness, patient care, and post-extraction wound care for implants are top-notch; it's painless.

0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.text: มาใช้บริการคลินิกครั้งแรกประทับใจมากค่ะ คลินิกสะอาด มีสิ่งอำนวยความสะดวกครบถ้วนและคุณหมอลลิดามือเบามากค่ะ
0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.author: Pornsiri Pairo
0x30e29dc1b8379271_0xb81147f33a6c5b30.en: This was my first time at the clinic and I was very impressed. The clinic is clean, has complete facilities, and Dr. Lalida is very gentle.

0x311d610ca4469913_0xd92c9560dfb1ace5.text: The clinic is clean, spacious, and well-organized. The staff are friendly and lovely, and Dr. Aom is attentive to every case. She's my top choice of doctor; I've never had any problems with injections or procedures I've had done there. The …
0x311d610ca4469913_0xd92c9560dfb1ace5.author: Ratty Rattikan

0x311d610ca4469913_0xd92c9560dfb1ace5.text: It was fantastic service; everybody was very friendly and professional. I picked this clinic because it has the most modern equipment, and the doctors are highly qualified. Thank you for taking care of me <3
0x311d610ca4469913_0xd92c9560dfb1ace5.author: Teddy Kaspar

0x311d610ca4469913_0xd92c9560dfb1ace5.text: The clinic is brand new and very clean. Doctor Aom took the time to explain procedures and answered all the questions I had. The staff were really polite and friendly too!
0x311d610ca4469913_0xd92c9560dfb1ace5.author: Than Raskul

0x311d610ca4469913_0xd92c9560dfb1ace5.text: Great experience with affordable prices. I'm really happy with all your services.
0x311d610ca4469913_0xd92c9560dfb1ace5.author: Teddy Kaspar

0x311d6598738c6eef_0x2132ee47d3529de5.text: All the staff at the clinic are very friendly and approachable. We had a great time chatting! The restrooms are clean. I recommend telling the doctor what you want and challenging their abilities as much as you like. My equipment came loose often, but the doctor never scolded me. Of course, you still have to pay for the replacement equipment as usual.
0x311d6598738c6eef_0x2132ee47d3529de5.author: VA Len

0x311d6598738c6eef_0x2132ee47d3529de5.text: My first orthodontic treatment at another clinic was a bad experience; they weren't willing to treat me. My second treatment at this clinic was excellent. Dr. Yadana is lovely and kind, explains the treatment in an easy-to-understand way, and creates a detailed and attentive treatment plan. I'm very impressed with this aspect. ❤️❤️
0x311d6598738c6eef_0x2132ee47d3529de5.author: Kunwadee Nimwoun

0x311d6598738c6eef_0x2132ee47d3529de5.text: The clinic is clean and the air conditioning is comfortably cool. The doctor gives good advice and speaks politely. The assistants are attentive and highly skilled. Both the doctor and the assistants are excellent! 😊 …
0x311d6598738c6eef_0x2132ee47d3529de5.author: Ntc.

0x311d6598738c6eef_0x2132ee47d3529de5.text: The staff were all lovely, providing good advice and always smiling. They were happy to serve us and made us feel very comfortable. I highly recommend their service; you won't be disappointed!
0x311d6598738c6eef_0x2132ee47d3529de5.author: Hawa Boonrod

0x311d6598738c6eef_0x2132ee47d3529de5.text: The service was excellent. The staff were very kind, and the doctor kept explaining what they were doing throughout the entire process. It was a great experience. The pricing was clear.
0x311d6598738c6eef_0x2132ee47d3529de5.author: Pakaporn Leesuwan

0x311d6598738c6eef_0x2132ee47d3529de5.text: Clinic was very clean, staff and doctor are very friendly. Hopefully they will keep it up again. I came here to clear all my teeth for the first time. Anyway I’m impressed thanks 😊 …
0x311d6598738c6eef_0x2132ee47d3529de5.author: AMIETAVIN TONG

0x311d6598738c6eef_0x2132ee47d3529de5.text: The doctor was very kind and gave excellent advice. The staff were also very kind and lovely. The clinic was clean and very easy to get to. It's right next to the BTS Pink Line! ☺️💗🎉
0x311d6598738c6eef_0x2132ee47d3529de5.author: Jutharat Chorakhenoi

0x311d6598738c6eef_0x2132ee47d3529de5.text: จะไปใช้บริการเมื่อ 1/6/68 ติดต่อทางเพจเฟสบุคจะไปขูดหินปูนแจ้งว่าให้รอสายติดต่อกลับ ครึ่งชม.ก็ยังไม่มีการติดต่อกลับ เลยโทรเข้าสาขาจองเพื่อจองคิว โทรไปบ่ายโมงเจ้าหน้าที่รับสายเป็นทอม ทางเราแจ้งว่ามีคิวว่างมั้ย พนง.แจ้งว่ามีให้เข้ามาได้เลย มีคิวก่อนหน้า4-5ราย เราจึงสอบถามว่ารอคิวนานมั้ย เจ้าหน้าที่แนะนำให้เราเข้าไปบ่ายสอง ก็นัดไว้บ่ายสองไว้เสร็จ พอไปถึงก็ไปนั่งรอจนถึงบ่ายสองกว่าก็ยังไม่ได้ขูด เลยสอบถามเจ้าหน้าที่ผญที่เคาท์เตอร์ว่าเหลืออีกกี่คิว แจ้งกลับว่ามีคิวก่อนหน้า4-5คิว รอประมาณ40นาที อ้าวงงสรุปต้องรออีกเป็นชั่วโมง ไม่ได้คิวตามที่นัดไว้ ที่นี่เขาจัดคิวกันยังไงอะงง ไปคลินิกอื่นนัดเวลาไหนก็ได้เวลานั้น +-15-30นาทีก็พอไหว แต่ที่นี่จัดคิวแบบงง @_@ อุตส่าหาคลินิกใกล้บ้าน ที่มีชื่อเสียงแต่การบริการทำเรางงมาก
0x311d6598738c6eef_0x2132ee47d3529de5.author: P S
0x311d6598738c6eef_0x2132ee47d3529de5.en: I went for a teeth cleaning service on June 1st, 2025. I contacted them via their Facebook page and was told to wait for a call back. After half an hour, I didn't receive a call, so I called the branch to book an appointment. I called at 1 PM, and a woman (a tomboy) answered. I asked if there were any available slots, and she said yes, there were 4-5 people ahead of me. I asked how long the wait would be, and she suggested I come at 2 PM. I scheduled my appointment for 2 PM, but even after 2 PM, I still hadn't had my teeth cleaned. I asked the female staff member at the counter how many people were left, and she said there were 4-5 people ahead of me, and they were about 40 minutes ahead. I was confused; it turned out I had to wait another hour. I didn't even get my scheduled appointment. How do they manage their scheduling here? At other clinics, you get your appointment at any time, within a 15-30 minute grace period. This clinic's scheduling is baffling. I chose this clinic near my home, and despite its reputation, the service was terrible.

0x30e281e7bc374a63_0x9c93fc5813044bda.text: คลินิกสะอาดมากๆครับ บรรยากาศดีไม่อึดอัดเหมือนที่อื่น มีน้ำตก ปลาคราฟ ให้ชมและเพลงให้ฟังผ่อนคลายก่อนเข้าทำฟัน พี่ๆพนักงานบริการดีมากครับ ยกมือไหว้ตลอด คุณหมอก็จัดฟันดีมากครับอธิบายทุกครั้งเลยครับ แนะนำครับ ตอนนี้แถมรีเทรนเนอร์ฟรีด้วยครับ
0x30e281e7bc374a63_0x9c93fc5813044bda.en: The clinic is very clean, and the atmosphere is nice and not cramped like other places. There's a waterfall and koi fish to admire, and relaxing music to listen to before your dental appointment. The staff are very friendly and always greet you with a respectful bow. The orthodontist is excellent and explains everything clearly. I highly recommend this clinic. They're even giving away free retainers now!

0x30e281e7bc374a63_0x9c93fc5813044bda.text: วันนี้มาขูดหินปูนกับคุณหมอธนภศ ดีมากเลยครับรู้สึกดีมากลบประสบการ์ณที่เคยขูดหินปูนเจ็บๆไปเลยครับ ทางคลินิกนัดเวลาและะตรงต่อเวลาดีมากครับ แนะนำเลย คุณหมอชลธิศก็อธิบายการจัดฟันทุกครั้งที่เข้ามาพบคุณหมอดีมากครับ พี่ๆบริการน่ารักครับ
0x30e281e7bc374a63_0x9c93fc5813044bda.en: Today I had my teeth cleaned with Dr. Thanaphat, and it was great! It completely erased my previous painful teeth cleaning experience. The clinic scheduled my appointment and was very punctual. I highly recommend them. Dr. Chonlathit also explained the orthodontic treatment thoroughly every time I visited, which was excellent. The staff were lovely too.

0x30e281e7bc374a63_0x9c93fc5813044bda.text: คุณหมอที่ลงวันอาทิตย์ เป็นมิตรมากค่ะ ให้คำปรึกษาดี ตรวจละเอียดยิบ มือเบามาก ขนาดฉีดยาชายังไม่รู้สึก😍😍 คิวตรงเวลาเป๊ะ<ควรนัดไปก่อน โทรตรงกับคลินิคเลยดีกว่าค่ะเพราะline/FBอาจจะตอบช้า😋>ราคาเป็นมิตรแต่คุณภาพดีเลิศ แนะนำจ้า😆😆😆
0x30e281e7bc374a63_0x9c93fc5813044bda.en: The doctor on Sunday is very friendly, provides excellent advice, conducts a thorough examination, and is very gentle—I didn't even feel the local anesthetic injection! 😍😍 Appointments are taken exactly on time. <It's best to make an appointment beforehand and call the clinic directly as they might be slow to respond on Line/Facebook. 😋> The prices are reasonable, but the quality is superb. Highly recommended! 😆😆😆

0x30e281e7bc374a63_0x9c93fc5813044bda.text: คุณหมอแนะนำดีมาก พูดคุยเป็นกันเองมากๆเลยค่ะ บรรยากาศร้านสวยมากมีสวนน้ำตกและปลาคาร์ฟให้ชมระหว่างรอด้วย เพลงในร้านก็เพราะมากเลย มาถึงไม่ต้องนั่งรอนาน ตรงเวลามากถึงเวลานัดก็เข้าบริการเลยค่ะ พนักงานบริการดีมากค่ะ😊💓
0x30e281e7bc374a63_0x9c93fc5813044bda.en: The doctor gave excellent advice and was very friendly. The clinic's atmosphere is beautiful, with a waterfall garden and koi fish to enjoy while waiting. The music was also very pleasant. We didn't have to wait long; everything was very punctual, and we were served right on time for our appointment. The staff provided excellent service. 😊💓

0x30e281e7bc374a63_0x9c93fc5813044bda.text: จัดฟันกับคุณหมอชลธิศ​ คุณหมอดีมากๆเลยคะ​คลินิก​สะอาด​มีเพลงเพราะๆให้ฟัง​ทั้งตรงที่นั่งรอ​และในห้องทำฟัน​ บรรยากาศดีมากๆ​ มีปลาให้ดูด้วย คุณหมอตรงเวลามาก นัดตอนไหนได้เข้าตามเวลาทุกครั้ง พนักงานบริการดีทุกท่านคะ
0x30e281e7bc374a63_0x9c93fc5813044bda.en: I had my braces done with Dr. Chonlathit. He's a really great doctor. The clinic is clean, and there's nice music playing in the waiting area and in the treatment room. The atmosphere is wonderful, and there are even fish to look at! The doctor is very punctual; I always arrive on time for my appointments. All the staff are very helpful.

0x30e281e7bc374a63_0x9c93fc5813044bda.text: ของหนูเป็นเคสฟันล่างคล่อมฟันบนจัดเสร็จเรียบร้อยแล้วค่ะ ไม่ต้องผ่าตัดขากรรไกรเลยค่ะ คุณหมอน่ารักค่ะใจดีมากพูดเพราะ แนะนำดีทุกอย่าง คลินิคสะอาดมากค่ะ เดินทางสะดวกด้วยค่ะ
0x30e281e7bc374a63_0x9c93fc5813044bda.en: My case involved an overbite (lower teeth overlapping upper teeth), and I've successfully completed the straightening treatment. No jaw surgery was required! The doctor is lovely, kind, and speaks very nicely. She gave excellent advice throughout the process. The clinic is very clean and conveniently located.

0x30e281e7bc374a63_0x9c93fc5813044bda.text: มาขูดหินปูนก่อนสิ้นปี คิวที่นี่มีพอดี เข้าคลินิกมา คือน่ารักมากตกแต่งที่น่ารักมากๆธรรมชาติสุดๆชอบมากต้นไม้เยอะเลี้ยงปลาคาร์ฟด้วย คุณหมอ+ผู้ช่วย มือเบามากกกก
0x30e281e7bc374a63_0x9c93fc5813044bda.author: Natthanicha She
0x30e281e7bc374a63_0x9c93fc5813044bda.en: I came for a teeth cleaning before the end of the year. There was a slot available here. When I entered the clinic, it was so lovely, the decor was adorable and very natural, I loved it! Lots of plants and they even have koi fish. The dentist and assistant were very gentle.

0x30e281e7bc374a63_0x9c93fc5813044bda.text: คลินิกเดอะคัลเลอร์สมาย บรรยากาศดี พี่ๆใจดีทุกคนรวมถึงคุณหมอด้วย เป็นกันเองมากๆ ตลอดการจัดฟันฟันเข้าเร็วมากๆ มาจัดฟันกันเยอะๆนะคะ🫶🏻❤️✨
0x30e281e7bc374a63_0x9c93fc5813044bda.en: The Color Smile Clinic has a great atmosphere, and all the staff, including the doctor, are very kind and friendly. My teeth straightened very quickly throughout the orthodontic treatment. I highly recommend getting your braces done here! 🫶🏻❤️✨

0x30e2841db5ddc357_0xdfa36eacca198c1b.text: I always have a great experience here. The service is excellent, the staff are professional and caring, and the place is very clean and comfortable. Highly recommend this clinic.
0x30e2841db5ddc357_0xdfa36eacca198c1b.author: Prissatha U.

0x30e2841db5ddc357_0xdfa36eacca198c1b.text: The service is great, I come here regularly. I like the staff, they are very high quality, beautiful and have clear skin. I like the atmosphere in the shop.
0x30e2841db5ddc357_0xdfa36eacca198c1b.author: Jareerut Putharak

0x30e2841db5ddc357_0xdfa36eacca198c1b.text: Excellent service, I was very impressed. All the staff were very polite. The laser hair removal was painless and left my hair completely smooth.
0x30e2841db5ddc357_0xdfa36eacca198c1b.author: เบญจพร พะวิงรัมย์

0x30e29f304c3eba4f_0x6c8a2cc93bfd15f1.text: I would like to express my deepest appreciation and gratitude to Associate Professor Dr. Thany Ingkakul for his care and surgery. This allows patients and their families to understand the situation and make confident decisions. What impressed me most was his dedication and diligence in caring for his patients. He prioritizes close monitoring of my condition, answering questions and providing detailed advice, demonstrating genuine care. Furthermore, his calm, confident, and approachable demeanor greatly contributes to a sense of comfort and confidence in the patient. Throughout the treatment process, I felt exceptionally well cared for and under the responsibility of a physician possessing both knowledge, skill, and a true medical professionalism. Therefore, I would like to express my sincere gratitude to Dr. Ingkakul for his dedication and consistently excellent care. Finally, I would like to thank the nurses, nursing assistants, and all staff in the surgical department for their excellent service regarding appointments and follow-up. Every step was perfect. - Cee Pensupang Tansiri Date of treatment: March 2-14, 2026

0x30e29f304c3eba4f_0x6c8a2cc93bfd15f1.text: Advance Surgery Center - BKK Hospital The medical staff did such an amazing job here. Located in Building D. I came here to get a minor surgery done. From meeting with my doctor to consult my options, to nurses prep. It was so smooth. The surgery was done under 45 minutes and I was able to check out same day. My two nurses (I wish I remembered their names) were so kind, with a smile and helpful 😊 After the surgery my nurses said we will do additional testing on the surgery tissue to make sure everything is ok with no issues. They gave me pain killers and the pills were very good. I had no pain the day of the surgery or the week after. Few weeks later, as promised, I received an email with my final results. They sent me few images as additional proof, along with entire written results. Everything came back great, nothing to worry about. After your Surgery Center visit, you will go outside the glass doors into a large patient waiting area to pay and get your medication. In this spacious area, you will find comfortable seats. You will also feel at ease, listening to live piano music with violin playing. If you’re traveling to Thailand and looking to get your medical services done, I would highly recommend this facility. No one was rude with me and I felt comfortable during my visit.

I'd tried countless clinics, including the supposedly good Pink House, Green House, and Blue House, but nothing worked. I'd spent tens of thousands of baht and felt completely discouraged. Then, my current boyfriend recommended Dr. Pannarat. This gave me renewed hope and motivation to try acne treatment again. And the results are amazing! I'm so happy this day has finally arrived. Dr. Pannarat is incredibly kind. She doesn't rush patients and treats them with the genuine intention of curing me. Before treatment, she checks my skin condition and plans a treatment program, considering my budget. I told her I could afford no more than 3,000 baht a month, and she said that was perfect. I was overjoyed! And then, today, she said I won't need to take medication anymore! I almost cried. She gave me topical medication, a face wash, and sunscreen, and said we'd see each other again in 3 months. Honestly, not needing medication anymore was the last thing I'd wanted to hear. I never thought this day would come. A day without acne and no medication because I'm planning to donate blood! 0x30fdabb040b887b1_0xd441f5ee2e743cf.text: When our child is sick, the first place we think of is Dr. Prapan, a pediatrician at San Paulo Hospital. Our child has been seeing him here since birth, for vaccinations and illnesses. This time, our daughter was admitted with influenza A. She came in with a high fever. The staff, including the doctor, were incredibly helpful. They explained that because of the high fever, hospitalization would allow for better monitoring and assessment of her condition compared to home care. And indeed, once our daughter was admitted, the children's ward was beautifully decorated and perfect for young children. The staff didn't wear their uniforms, so our daughter wasn't afraid and was happy with the care. The food was delicious too. Most importantly, on the second night, she improved significantly after receiving medication, medication adjustments, nebulizer treatment, and the care from the assistants and nurses. (Our daughter loved Auntie Chu so much! She helped bathe and dress her, even getting wet herself, and she didn't scold her at all.) Before going home, we also got to see the playroom, which was so fun, with a ball pit and other toys. If you're still looking for a pediatrician, we highly recommend Dr. Prapan. You won't be disappointed! #VeryKindDoctor

I stopped visiting Bangkok Hospital, as I felt they overcharged my insurance company and were only interested in cash and not me as a patients. So I hope San Paulo does not become the same.
0x30fdabb040b887b1_0xd441f5ee2e743cf.author: STWB

0x30fdabb040b887b1_0xd441f5ee2e743cf.text: Absolutely Appalling Experience - Avoid San Paolo Hospital Hua Hin. We had a deeply disappointing and frustrating experience at San Paolo Hospital after our daughter had a fall and injured her wrist. When we initially called, we clearly explained her symptoms. We were assured that a pediatric orthopedistwas available and that we could come any time, with clear information about X-ray and consultation costs. Reality turned out to be a completely different story: 1. We were deceived. The specialist we were told would be there simply wasn't. Instead, a general practice doctor handled the case and took the most unprofessional route imaginable: he consulted the bone doctor via WhatsApp - yes, WhatsApp! - by sending over the X-rays. This non-direct “consultation” alone cost us 4,500 Baht. 2. The X-ray technician took images of both wrists - even though only one was injured. There was no medical justification for this and it clearly felt like a move to inflate the bill. 3. The doctor’s fee was significantly higher than what we were initially quoted. No transparency, no proper explanation - just a higher charge. 4. After examining the X-ray, the general doctor gave us two dramatic options: surgery (seriously?!) or a cast. Naturally, we opted for a cast -Tomato Split. The total cost? 14,275 Baht for a minor wrist crack. We were completely stunned. When we asked for a breakdown of the charges, it took nearly 45 minutes for the staff to figure things out due to poor English and a clear lack of competence. Only when the German chief doctor stepped in did things start to make sense - but even he delivered explanations with robotic coldness and a fake smile. Not comforting at all. Due to visa-related delays, we hadn’t yet sorted medical insurance and were forced to pay out-of-pocket. Our daughter’s birthday was around the corner and we couldn’t delay treatment - but this experience left a bitter taste. It became painfully clear that the hospital’s goal is to milk as much money as possible, ideally from insurance. Sadly, I now realize this may be part of a wider pattern in modern hospital-insurance dynamics - but I naively hoped that my favorite Thailand would be different. Sadly, not this time. I try not to generalize - of course, there are doctors with big, non-profit-driven hearts. And here’s the proof: just to compare prices and attitude, after returning from Hua Hin to Chiang Mai, we visited Lanna Hospital for a follow-up to get a dynamic X-ray, bandage change, and a second opinion. The entire process was smooth, professional, compassionate - and it cost us just 900 Baht. But moreover, the new doctor seemed surprised by the incorrect size of the cast, which didn’t fit the wrist as it should have ??!! No comments here, right? I strongly advise against using San Paolo Hospital, Hua Hin. You’ll find neither medical professionalism nor basic human compassion - just inflated costs, misinformation, and a sense that you're just a number on a bill. Please take good care of your health and stay far away from this place.
0x30fdabb040b887b1_0xd441f5ee2e743cf.author: Sun Shine

0x30fdabb040b887b1_0xd441f5ee2e743cf.text: Sorry for the bad review. But I came here to get a radiologist findings report of a foot Xray. I did not get that! I got Xray dose and charged, but the ‘radiologist report’ doesn’t say anything of the findings - at all! I’m a RN. I came here to have right foot xray and I was told by my doctor who sent me here that my xray will be read by radiologist and report of radiologists findings. See “Radiologist report” that only says, patient is here for suspected fracture. Correlated with clinical context” IT SAYS NOTHING OF WHAT IS SEEN IN THE XRAY. When checking in and in cray I made sure it would be read by radiologist and I would get a written report. Radiologist can frequently see things much better with their tools and experience than a regular physician can read an x-ray. This is why I came here and paid the money and took the x-ray dose but now I will have to go get the order again and go to a different hospital and repeat x-ray dose and repeat expense. The x-ray is not because I have suspected fracture from an injury two months ago. It’s because I’m having increased pain and the doctor suggested an x-ray first to see if we saw anything in there which may require a radiologist ‘fine tooth comb’ reading capability. A radiologist report for an X-ray is a detailed document that describes the findings of the imaging test, including a summary of the images and the radiologist's interpretation. It typically includes sections for medical history, technique, and findings, and concludes with an "impression" or a summary of the most important observations and potential next steps. This report is sent to the requesting doctor, who will then explain the results to you. As it turned out from a MRI after that X-ray, I had bone marrow edema and at risk for stress fracture. Then while wearing the orthopedic boot even, I did have a stress fracture of the foot just from walking while wearing the orthopedic boot even. I wish I had my X-Ray read and interpreted by a radiologist as I specifically asked and paid for!
0x30fdabb040b887b1_0xd441f5ee2e743cf.author: ian panton

0x30fdabb040b887b1_0xd441f5ee2e743cf.text: If you're considering choosing SPH, then I suggest that you first read the LOWEST reviews. After having chosen SPH myself, I can now say that my experience there was eerily similar in so many respects to those poor reviews. For the past two decades I've had my annual checkups at Bumrungrad and Bangkok Hospital. But being in Hua Hin for awhile I thought I'd save a fair amount of pocket money on this year's checkup by trying SPH. Intake was fine. The various tests went well with professionalism shown by all staff. It seemed that we were on schedule to complete the diagnostic processes in right about 2 hours, as I had been told. Then it seemed like someone had slammed on the brakes, and I was spending much more time sitting in the waiting area instead of, as happens like clockwork at Bumrungrad and Bangkok Hospital, moving from test to test. After 3 hours I was finally done with all tests and told to return in a couple of hours to review the test results with a doctor. That review was when the wheels fell off. Almost every doctor I've seen in Thailand is world class, and over the decades I've seen quite a few. God I hope the doctor at SPH is an outlier. I'll avoid criticizing his professional skill, and I do have such criticisms, but I must question why a person who can barely speak English is placed servicing patients in the "International Service Center"? As for professional attire... a doctor in bare feet and rubber slippers, with pant legs so long that they drag on the floor does not convey professionalism. And, for reasons unknown to me, he decided that he had to disclose on a medical certificate for my Thai driver's licence application that I previously had a vasectomy. As another one-star reviewer wrote, sometimes you get what you pay for and, I too would not return to SPH. This review isn't meant to be a poor reflection on those staff members at SPH whose professionalism and service were excellent but, regrettably, it only takes a few bad eggs to spoil the omelet.

I took antibiotics and other prescribed medications for five days, experiencing discomfort and hoping for improvement. I have a question: how could they not distinguish between a fungal infection and a bacterial one? Due to the misdiagnosis, I wasted time, money, and spent several days on unnecessary antibiotics. 0x30e29e488f9a790b_0xee4fb3cd21fce71a.text: We went for our first cervical cancer screening and ultrasound. We saw good reviews on Google and decided to use their services. Things we liked: The doctor was very skilled and caring. The staff were lovely and friendly. During the examination, a staff member held my hand and offered encouragement, which made me feel much more at ease. Reasons for giving 4 stars: 1. We were asked about the examination items four times, even though we had informed them in advance via LINE what we wanted. Upon arrival, we were repeatedly asked by the lobby staff, nurses, the doctor, and the staff in the examination room, in that order. It felt like there was a lack of communication within the organization, resulting in us having to explain our medical history repeatedly. 2. Issue with the deposit deduction. When paying the deposit, we asked the page admin if the deposit would be deducted from the total amount upon payment. We were confirmed to do so. However, on the day of payment, the lobby staff charged the full amount without deducting the deposit. We had to object ourselves to get it resolved. 3. Difficulty contacting them. We called several times to inquire about information, but no one answered. 4. Appointment time discrepancy. We had an appointment with the doctor at 6:00 PM, but had to wait almost half an hour because the doctor was busy with another case. (Understandable that this was an unforeseen circumstance, but we would have preferred to be informed in advance if there would be a delay.)

0x30e29e488f9a790b_0xee4fb3cd21fce71a.text: This is my first time at this branch. The clinic is clean and spacious, and the reception staff are friendly. However, today I brought my boyfriend for an acne treatment package that includes acne injections. I inquired beforehand about whether the doctor would be in, and the staff said yes (normally at the Siam branch, the doctor always performs the acne injections). But when we arrived, it turned out to be a nurse who performed the treatment. The staff said the doctor had gone out for an urgent errand. I understand that it's a procedure that a nurse can perform, but not informing me in advance and having the patient find out later that the doctor wasn't performing it (I found out after the doctor had already extracted the pimples) felt a bit unpleasant. Moreover, there were two nurses who performed the treatment, and they were talking amongst themselves, saying things like, "Is this the correct dose and dilution?" They were asking each other these questions right in front of the patient, who was lying there. How would that feel? I usually really like MedicCare (I thought all branches would have the same standards), but after this experience, I think I'd go back to the Siam branch instead.

0x30e29ee2f6d57d05_0xc9576020f5d00a2b.text: I am 70 years old and retired in Bangkok and I recently suffered a chip on one of my lower front teeth. As it was not painful I was debating perhaps not visiting a dentist but my sense of caution outweighed my lackadaisical tendencies NEOSMILE is on my daily walking circuit so I walked in yesterday afternoon and made an appointment for this morning at 11:30 I arrived at 11:00AM and was in the dentist’s chair by 11:15. The actual office is quite old and perhaps off-putting but Dr Chongcharoenjai is a master of his craft and after an x-ray confirmed a deep cavity he gave me two options which were entirely my choice : he could remove the cavity and repair the tooth or I could have a root canal to prevent any possible future pain. I opted for just the filling understanding the possible future ramifications and the procedure lasted 45 minutes The office staff are both kind , professional and fluent in English and the total cost including x-ray, pain killer and the good dentist’s time was 2,650 Baht which is a very economic price. I will gladly return for any future dental issues as it was a highly satisfactory experience in all regards.

0x30e29b5e901376e5_0x7010b8b3ba4b4172.text: ***I think I won't be coming to this dental clinic anymore. It's not that this place is bad; it's good, many of the doctors are good, and the staff are polite and courteous. But I encountered one doctor who spoke to me rudely.*** The story is: In 2023, I came because my tooth was broken. The staff said the doctor would assess and examine my tooth first, and then I had to book an appointment. They said I wouldn't get any treatment yet. The staff informed me that: During regular hours, I would have to wait approximately 5-10 months. (Because there was a backlog from the COVID-19 closure period.) Outside of regular hours, the appointment would be faster, but I would still have to wait approximately 3-6 months. The service fees are as shown in the image. Outside of regular hours, the price is about 30% higher than the regular hourly rate. February 22, 2024: I returned for another check-up on the same broken tooth. (The tooth that made me wait since the previous year.) I felt like I had waited too long, so I went to another clinic to get a filling. The dentist there said it could be filled, because if I left the broken tooth untreated... It would increase the risk of root infection, so I had it filled. After the filling, there were no symptoms; no pain, sensitivity, or swelling. I lived my life normally. Then, six months later, a different dentist from the dental institute called to say it was my turn. I consulted with the dentist on the phone about having already had it filled elsewhere. The dentist said, "Let me check the X-ray of your root canal first," and then said, "From what I see, the root doesn't seem to be seriously damaged. If it's filled now, it's fine, and you don't need root canal treatment yet." So, I didn't come to my appointment. **Yesterday, February 21, 2024,** the filling fell out. So today, I came to the dental institute, intending to have root canal treatment. I met a male dentist. He told me, "You can't have it done today. You have to wait in line for another year." (I understand about the waiting list. If I had an appointment, I would wait because I intended to have treatment at the dental institute anyway.) The dentist had me lie on the chair and examined my mouth for 2 minutes. Then he said, "Why did you get it filled elsewhere and not wait in line here?" I told him, "Last year when I came, the dentist didn't fill it for me." "So you have to go get it filled elsewhere. If you leave it, germs can get into the tooth root." Doctor: "Let me tell you first, root canal treatment is expensive. And can you afford it? Because most of the people who come for treatment have government employee benefits and can claim them." I replied to the doctor: "If I'm planning to get treatment, I have to be able to pay, doctor. Root canal treatment already costs over 20,000 baht. The difference in cost, I can pay extra." The doctor continued: "In your case, the gum is starting to cover the tooth cavity. We might have to cut the gum and put in a post. And can you afford to wait in line? Let me tell you first, the treatment is expensive. There are other costs you'll have to pay extra, it might be around 25,000-30,000 baht. **And can you afford it?" Me -_- Reply: "So, what you're saying is, you want me to go to another clinic, right?" Doctor: "I'm not telling you to go elsewhere, I'm asking if you can afford it? It's expensive. And if you want an x-ray..." "You'll have to pay extra for the x-ray," the doctor said. "But the tooth hasn't been treated yet. So, what do you want? Do you want the x-ray?" (I was like -___________- The doctor kept emphasizing the cost of the treatment, saying it was expensive, and asking if I could afford it.) So I replied, "If you're saying that, I think I won't get root canal treatment here. I'll probably go to an outside clinic. I'd rather pay more than here, but have peace of mind." Then, the doctor said, "It's up to you. I'm not telling you to go elsewhere, I'm just letting you decide." So I walked out of the examination room, paid the fee, and left. Sometimes, when a doctor says to someone who's genuinely interested in treatment, "Can you afford it? Do you know how expensive it is? Can you really afford it?" It's very disrespectful and insulting. Why would the doctor think that people who come for treatment here don't have the money to pay for it? Speaking disrespectfully to others reveals a lot about one's character. And it seems completely unethical. I felt really bad when I encountered something like this.
0x30e29b5e901376e5_0x7010b8b3ba4b4172.author: Yaowalove Review

0x30e29b5e901376e5_0x7010b8b3ba4b4172.text: I went for a teeth cleaning (tartar removal). When I entered the room, the dentist asked what I was there for. I said I was there for tartar removal and to have my teeth checked to see what else needed to be done. Before I could even finish, and before the tartar removal began, the dentist told me to lie down. There was no attempt to examine my mouth or do any further checks. I thought the dentist would examine my teeth during the tartar removal and then give me post-treatment advice. I understand that dental work can be painful, but the dentist was very harsh and unfriendly. It's like, "Isn't it normal to feel pain and tense up during the procedure?" Then, near the end of the tartar removal, the dentist spoke close to my ear, but I couldn't hear clearly because the instrument was so loud. I only heard "wisdom tooth" and the words "impacted tooth." After the removal was finished, I asked if I had any impacted teeth, and the dentist responded sharply, "I said no!" I felt very uncomfortable, but I still asked if I needed any fillings. The answer was yes, or I could have them extracted. I could tell the dentist lacked compassion and wasn't willing to provide good service. I don't need overly excellent service, just compassion, professionalism, and ethics from a dentist is enough. Or perhaps it's been so many years that the doctor can't even remember how the professor taught when they were students. Thank you.

0x30e29c50a35fbf31_0xec5e11c75f0bd468.text: I had a really positive experience at Avatar Treatment and it stood out from most massage places in Bangkok because the session felt much more focused on how the body actually functions rather than just a standard relaxation routine. After explaining the areas I was dealing with, the therapist adjusted the treatment and worked specifically on areas where tissue felt restricted and where adhesions had formed. Instead of just applying pressure, they used a combination of techniques to gradually release tension and improve movement. During the session they used several methods including hands-on manipulation, targeted work on fascia and soft tissue, and instrument techniques. They also used a wooden therapy tool and a small hammer-style instrument to help stimulate deeper tissue and loosen adhesions. It reminded me more of sports therapy, myofascial release, or chiropractic-style bodywork than a typical Thai massage. What I appreciated most was that the therapist seemed to understand the mechanics of the body and how tension in one area can affect movement elsewhere. The treatment was clearly adjusted based on what they found during the session rather than following a fixed routine. It’s obviously not a miracle cure, but I did leave with noticeably less pain and much better mobility than when I walked in. If you’re looking for therapeutic massage in Bangkok, especially something closer to structural bodywork, fascia work, adhesion release, or sports-style treatment rather than a simple spa massage, this place is definitely worth trying.
0x30e29c50a35fbf31_0xec5e11c75f0bd468.author: Rollo

0x30e29c50a35fbf31_0xec5e11c75f0bd468.text: I have had problems with my lower back for months on and off, and i tweeked my shoulders doing a workout at my hotel which is by the MBK mall. I went in to see if they could do a couple of adjustments and maybe massage the knots out and give my lower back some relief as well. They went through a whole process of adjustments and hitting pressure points, doing what we call in Canada, A.R.T…active release therapy, and they dug in deep with elbows into my shoulders and my lower back, and while it was a bit uncomfortable at times, its definitely needed and I felt quite relieved after the appointment. The lady doing my therapy also gave me a numbing spray and also gave me capsules to help with sleep and vision, they were so nice to me and went out of their way to make sure they did the best they could to help cause they could see I was suffering a bit from the back discomfort. If you are having deep muscle and tissue problems, I highly recommend coming here, its gonna be uncomfortable at times but this is seriously the only thing that has helped me in a long time and I do dry needling back home with massage/physio therapy as well. Its too bad I got to only see them once before I have to go back home. Located on the 6th floor. Well worth the money!

0x30e293f34bf274c1_0x50fdca43bbb4827e.text: วันนี้ไปถอนฟันมา หมอฉีดยาชาไม่เจ็บเลย มือเบามาก ตอนนี้กลับมาเกิน 3 ชั่วโมงและยาชาหายไปหมดแล้ว แต่ยังไม่มีอาการปวด มีแค่อาการคัน เดียวกลับไปใช้บริการใหม่ครับ จะไปทำฟันปลอม และคุณหมอแนะนำดีมากๆ แต่ติดที่ผมทำผิดกฎ เพราะกลับมาก็กินเหล้า
0x30e293f34bf274c1_0x50fdca43bbb4827e.en: I had a tooth extracted today. The doctor gave me the local anesthetic without any pain; they had a very gentle touch. It's been over 3 hours now, and the anesthetic has worn off, but I still don't have any pain, just itching. I'll be back soon to get dentures. The doctor gave excellent advice. However, I broke a rule because I drank alcohol after I got home.

0x30e293f34bf274c1_0x50fdca43bbb4827e.text: Clean facilities, lovely space, knowledgeable dentists, friendly and helpful staff! Amazing place! My family and I have been coming here for our dental checks and any tooth problem for so long and are never disappointed!
0x30e293f34bf274c1_0x50fdca43bbb4827e.author: firstname lastname

0x30e293f34bf274c1_0x50fdca43bbb4827e.text: เป็นเคสย้ายมาจากที่อื่นเพราะจัดนานแล้วแต่ฟันไม่เข้า จบที่คุณหมอเกดเก่งมากประเมินเคสตามจริง ฟันเข้าเร็วมากค่ะไม่ถึงปี พี่ๆบริการน่ารักโทรเตือนทุกครั้งก่อนเข้าบริการ
0x30e293f34bf274c1_0x50fdca43bbb4827e.en: This was a transfer case from another clinic because the teeth had been undergoing treatment elsewhere for a long time without aligning. Dr. Kate is excellent; she assesses the case accurately, and the teeth aligned very quickly—in less than a year. The staff are lovely and call to remind me before every appointment.

0x30e293f34bf274c1_0x50fdca43bbb4827e.text: จัดฟันที่นี้ คุณหมอกับผู้ชาวยบริการดีมาก สุภาพน่ารัก คลินิกสะอาดมีของเล่นให้เด็กสำหรับคนที่พาลูกมาทำ รวมแล้วดีมากๆค่ะ
0x30e293f34bf274c1_0x50fdca43bbb4827e.en: I got my braces here. The doctor and the staff were excellent; very polite and lovely. The clinic is clean and has toys for children, which is great for those who bring their kids. Overall, it was a great experience.

0x30e293f34bf274c1_0x50fdca43bbb4827e.text: มาทำฟันประจำที่นี่ ขูดหินปึทุก6เดือน หมอกิ๊บมือเบาน่ารัก พนักงานบริการดีค่ะ แนะนำค่ะ
0x30e293f34bf274c1_0x50fdca43bbb4827e.en: I come here regularly for dental work, getting my teeth cleaned every 6 months. Dr. Gib is gentle and lovely, and the staff are very helpful. I recommend this clinic.

0x30e293f34bf274c1_0x50fdca43bbb4827e.text: คุณหมอมือเบา แนะนำดี บริการประทับใจ ใครตามหาคุณหมอใจดี มือเบา ผมขอแนะนำเลยครับผม
0x30e293f34bf274c1_0x50fdca43bbb4827e.en: The doctor is gentle, gives good advice, and the service is impressive. If you're looking for a kind and gentle doctor, I highly recommend him/her.

0x30e293f34bf274c1_0x50fdca43bbb4827e.text: งงใจกับการนัดหมายมาก ทำนัดเวลา 14.30 น. ไว้ เราโทรบอกที่คลินิกว่ามาช้าหน่อยได้ไหม มีธุระด่วนจะเข้ามาประมาณ 16.00 ผู้รับสายบอกได้แต่อาจต้องรอหน่อย พอมาถึง 16.00 น. เคาท์เตอร์บอกให้ทำนัดใหม่สะงั้น แล้วทำไมไม่ให้เราทำนัดใหม่ตั้งแต่ที่เราโทรมาขอเลื่อนเวลา ทำให้เรามาเสียเที่ยวเลย พนักงานพูดจาดี คุณหมอก็น่ารักดี แต่เจอระบบแบบนี้ก็ไม่ไหวนะคะ ( ค่ารักษาของเรา อุดฟันซี่ละ 1,000 ครอบฟันเซรามิก แบบไม่รักษาราก 14,000 ค่ะ )
0x30e293f34bf274c1_0x50fdca43bbb4827e.en: I'm very confused about the appointment process. I had an appointment for 2:30 PM. I called the clinic to ask if I could arrive a little later, around 4:00 PM, because I had an urgent matter. The person who answered said yes, but I might have to wait a bit. When I arrived at 4:00 PM, the counter told me to reschedule. Why didn't they let me reschedule when I called to reschedule? It was a wasted trip. The staff were polite, and the doctor was lovely. But this kind of system is unacceptable. (My treatment cost was 1,000 baht per filling and 14,000 baht for a ceramic crown without root canal treatment.)

0x30e2836e763c73a3_0x8b75fc3473749c0a.text: I was incredibly impressed from the moment I stepped into the clinic. The receptionists were all polite and provided excellent service. I didn't have to wait long, my appointment was on time, and the clinic was clean and breezy with cool air conditioning. The doctor was very lovely, had a very gentle hand, and explained every step in detail from start to finish. He provided easy-to-understand treatment recommendations. He also gave excellent advice on dental care. He was very polite and patient. He always told me what to do. If it hurt, I could tell him. But it didn't hurt at all. 👍 Most importantly, the price was reasonable, not as expensive as I thought. Plus, I can claim my Social Security benefits. The service was fast, and there was no need to wait long. If you're looking for a good dental clinic, I highly recommend this place. I was extremely impressed. 💖
0x30e2836e763c73a3_0x8b75fc3473749c0a.author: Sujika Piyarat

0x30e2836e763c73a3_0x8b75fc3473749c0a.text: The doctor and staff were very attentive. I was personally very afraid of dentistry and then had to have my wisdom teeth removed. Dr. Napat had a gentle hand, was attentive, and always asked questions and checked on me. After the surgery, the staff called to check on my condition and took excellent care of me. It was my first time here and I was very impressed.
0x30e2836e763c73a3_0x8b75fc3473749c0a.author: jeeranan thp

0x30e2836e763c73a3_0x8b75fc3473749c0a.text: I came here to get my mouth cleaned and get braces fixed. The doctor and all the staff took very good care of me. They called to follow up after I had my braces removed. Today I came in for an appointment to have my tartar scraped off after 6 months. The doctor took very good care of me. I highly recommend this place.

0x30e2836e763c73a3_0x8b75fc3473749c0a.text: I've been getting my teeth cleaned here for many years. The clinic is clean, not crowded, the dentist is gentle, and the staff are very polite and lovely. I use my social security insurance, so I don't have to pay upfront. I recommend this clinic.

0x30e2836e763c73a3_0x8b75fc3473749c0a.text: The front desk staff provided excellent service and spoke politely. The doctor gave good advice and was very gentle. The doctor's assistant spoke politely and provided excellent service.

0x30e2836e763c73a3_0x8b75fc3473749c0a.text: The service was excellent, and they even followed up on the patient's condition. The doctor was very attentive to the patients, and the staff were lovely.
0x30e2836e763c73a3_0x8b75fc3473749c0a.author: Plawan Papit

0x3054f3442b7426ab_0x44b7b8bff6185620.text: I am profoundly grateful to the entire crew for saving my little girl, and for doing so with immense love and care. Even Sky, my dog, who is usually wary of clinics, willingly returned here. Each time, she'd pull me inside, leaving me in the waiting area as she made her way to the nurses for wound dressing. Her trust in this place speaks volumes, far beyond what words can express. After the horrifying car accident, we were uncertain if she would survive, let alone walk again or keep her leg. The odds seemed insurmountable. But they defied all expectations, accomplishing what felt like the impossible. I must say the cost of this miraculous intervention was equivalent to the price of three and a half well-bred Dobermans. Yet, to me, it's immeasurable. They not only saved my dog but also restored hope and happiness in our lives. My gratitude knows no bounds and will endure indefinitely.
0x3054f3442b7426ab_0x44b7b8bff6185620.author: Диана Чемазокова

0x3054f3442b7426ab_0x44b7b8bff6185620.text: Couldn’t thank the vet and all of the staff here more. They were all helpful, polite and very careful to make sure they explained everything to us very clearly. I could see they were always giving the best care and attention they possibly could for my cat - they genuinely cared to give him the best medical attention & advice. They also allowed us inside the vet room to help hold our cat who is very nervous at the vet & I could then see that they were very caring towards him and always did their best to handle him very gently & try to help him feel less nervous. I was really happy to see how gentle they were when handling him as I’ve been to other vets before where both the cats and I didn’t like how rough they were when handling them. We are very grateful. Thank you.
0x3054f3442b7426ab_0x44b7b8bff6185620.author: Roma Syed

0x3054f3442b7426ab_0x44b7b8bff6185620.text: Five days ago, we had our dog's internal organs ultrasounded at Animalia Pet Hospital. The doctors and staff at this veterinary clinic provided us with excellent, attentive service, loving care for our dog, and a flawless examination. The ultrasound lasted an hour, and our dog tolerated it well. After the ultrasound, we were provided with all the materials (ultrasound screens) of each organ and the doctor's report on each internal organ examined. The cost was completely justified for such a veterinary service. The doctor and staff are highly qualified, and the ultrasound equipment is excellent. We are very satisfied and grateful, and we highly recommend Animalia Pet Hospital. I give it 5 stars, but I would give it 10 if I could.
0x3054f3442b7426ab_0x44b7b8bff6185620.author: Tatiana Samoilova

0x3054f3442b7426ab_0x44b7b8bff6185620.text: A veterinary clinic I trust completely 🐶❤️ My two dogs have been treated there several times, including overnight stays, and I couldn't have asked for better care. The team is professional, gentle, and truly attentive—whether it's for treatment, advice, or simply reassuring us when we're worried. You can tell they genuinely love animals and are passionate about their work. My dogs have always been well cared for, carefully monitored, and I've found them calm and confident after each stay. A huge thank you to the entire team for their kindness and professionalism. I highly recommend them!
0x3054f3442b7426ab_0x44b7b8bff6185620.author: Coc’s

0x3054f3442b7426ab_0x44b7b8bff6185620.text: This vet saved my tortoise!!! I bring her my 3 parrots, our dog and my tortoise to take care of. This little guy needed X-rays, antibiotics, a cast on his shell and vitamins. I really believed he would die but tonight he is eating! He’s back from deaths door and I’m so thankful. The receptionist loves my animals. Everyone is so kind to them. They are loving and sweet. In addition, the vet speaks impeccable English. Never any doubt that she knows what she is doing.
0x3054f3442b7426ab_0x44b7b8bff6185620.author: Adina

0x3054f3442b7426ab_0x44b7b8bff6185620.text: Came all the way down from Koh Phangan with my puppy Rottweiler. They really took care of her and did the necessary exams…even 3 times to be sure of the diagnostic. Unfortunately they couldn’t help with the matter for a bunch of reasons but made some calls around the island to find someone able to do it… which they did. Without their help I would have find my puppy in a very dangerous position.
0x3054f3442b7426ab_0x44b7b8bff6185620.author: Helbkk

0x3054f3442b7426ab_0x44b7b8bff6185620.text: I left my cat. Until I wrote and asked to send photos, no one sent me anything. The conditions are really not very good. The space for the animal is very little. I took the cat all dirty. Apparently it is very hot there, he sweated and all the dirt on him. Well and the calculation of days they certainly strange. I left the cat in the morning on April 20 and took him back on April 23 as soon as they opened. It's actually 3 nights like a hotel. I was charged 4 days. Not pleasant of course (((( The staff is polite. The doctor does a checkup before leaving the cat. It would be nice if they did it afterwards. The cat was very scared when I picked him up. There is a bruise and a bump on his back paw, apparently he bumped it when they were trying to get him out. They took advantage of the fact that I was in tears because of my cat's condition and cheated me. I wrote to them on Line and they ignored me. I do not recommend this clinic. Because of this incident I decided not to vaccinate my cat in this clinic. And I'm very happy about it. I got my vaccination today at the clinic in Bangrak. A completely different attitude towards animals. They were very attentive to my pet and all manipulations were done very carefully, slowly and gently so that he is not even scared. A week of rewriting, contacting the manager and I got a 1 day refund. Everything was resolved, but the residue remained. I will not come to this clinic again.
0x3054f3442b7426ab_0x44b7b8bff6185620.author: Lana Panasenko

0x3054f3442b7426ab_0x44b7b8bff6185620.text: I took my baby sugar glider here three days ago after noticing symptoms that turned out to be a parasite. The vet assured me it was minor, told me not to worry, and prescribed medication—no mention of probiotics, no warnings for her age and size, that it was commonnand she will be fine. By day three, she was having seizures and muscle spasms. I rushed her to another exotic vet who immediately told me the medication wasn't appropriate, especially without probiotics, and that it was likely too strong for such a young glider. The doctor mentioned 3 days ago it should have also been put in special care and monitored closely. She died shortly after visiting this doctor. When I returned to confront the original clinic, they refused to take any responsibility—despite admitting the parasite was "strong" and that they knew this . So why did they tell me not to worry? it's seems they only cared about the 1000bhat they made off me. If you love your pet, please think twice before trusting this clinic. They gave me false reassurance, improper treatment, and ultimately cost my glider her life.
0x3054f3442b7426ab_0x44b7b8bff6185620.author: Squad Six

0x310295ef86d937d5_0x800d601758166c4.text: Update after reviewing my experience below: The next day, I was contacted by the clinic manager. They called to inform me that the clinic and the doctor were aware of the problem that occurred. And they would immediately resolve the issue. This shows that the clinic listens to and values ​​customer feedback. They didn't ignore the problem and took quick action. Thank you to the clinic for listening to its customers. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- I received Botox injections at the clinic. Before going, I searched for reviews of reputable clinics. The doctor has awards to their credit, even though the price might be higher than other places. The staff who prepared my face were very helpful and polite. The staff who recommended the treatment courses did a great job. I had my injection with Dr. Aoo, who gave good advice on the Botox. They showed the box of the Botox in front of me, which made me feel confident. The injection itself was painless (my first time having any procedures). After the injection, there were no bruises and no pain. The Botox results were good and satisfactory. The doctor is skilled. But finally, something I want to review and would like the clinic to pay attention to is: The clinic should have water and snacks available, but I wasn't offered or told to use them. Perhaps it was because I was a new customer and they couldn't sell me any courses. (We only bought 50 units of Botox, I think it was 12,900 baht, not sure.) Because we saw the staff serving water and snacks to regular customers who came after us. And we didn't dare to take them without permission because we weren't informed or offered them beforehand. That's why we haven't gone back. Because we felt discriminatory treatment. They didn't treat all customers equally. My friend who went with me felt the same way.
0x310295ef86d937d5_0x800d601758166c4.author: Bussaba muakthong

0x310295ef86d937d5_0x800d601758166c4.text: I'm so impressed with this place! I trust The Wish to take care of my beauty needs. I've had MMFU treatment here, and the results are amazing. My face looks smaller after just the first treatment. I also had laser hair removal. If you want laser hair removal, I highly recommend this place. They use a Long pulse nd yag laser. I've had 6 sessions already, and it's not painful at all. I can comfortably lie down and use my phone. From having a lot of hair, now I barely have any! 🥰 I feel so much more confident. And most recently, I had Discovery Pico treatment, which is very popular right now. The recovery time was only a few days, but I got amazing new skin. 🤍🤍 The staff are so attentive, and Dr. Aoo is incredibly skilled and gives excellent advice. Everything you need is here!
0x310295ef86d937d5_0x800d601758166c4.author: watcharaporn rouypong

0x310295ef86d937d5_0x800d601758166c4.text: Today I consulted with Dr. Aoo at The Wish Clinic about dissolving under-eye filler. Dr. Aoo gave excellent advice. I came to get filler done because I previously had filler injected at another clinic and the results were lumpy, making me feel insecure. I also had filler injected into my temples and nasolabial folds, and I'm very impressed with the results. The doctor is lovely and has a very gentle touch; it wasn't painful at all. 🥰 The clinic is clean, and the staff are very helpful.
0x310295ef86d937d5_0x800d601758166c4.author: Kunsiri Jun

0x310295ef86d937d5_0x800d601758166c4.text: Today I had under-eye filler injections with Dr. Aoo. The reason I came back was because I had previously had filler injections at a different clinic, and the results were lumpy, which made me feel insecure. So I decided to have it corrected with Dr. Aoo. I also had filler injected into my temples and nasolabial folds, and I'm very impressed with the results. The doctor is lovely and has a very gentle touch; it didn't hurt at all. 🥰 The clinic is clean, and the staff are very helpful.
0x310295ef86d937d5_0x800d601758166c4.author: นิลาวัณย์ ประหมวด

0x310295ef86d937d5_0x800d601758166c4.text: I usually suffer from acne and it leaves dark scars. I've been researching for a long time, and luckily a friend recommended I consult a doctor at The Wish Clinic. 0x310295ef86d937d5_0x800d601758166c4.text: I've been a regular customer for many years, but this time I'm extremely disappointed. The staff pushed a promotion, saying I needed 150 units, but when I actually saw the doctor, they said only about 70 units would be enough. So what was the point of selling 150 units? More importantly, they claimed it was US Botox, but they didn't show me the box in front of me. The medication was pre-mixed; customers have no way of knowing what they're injecting or how many units are being used. I paid tens of thousands of baht, but there's absolutely no transparency. I feel pressured into buying more than I needed and am very upset.

0x30e2834ea0a7202b_0x8e62b5252387c51f.text: 21/7/67 วันนี้ไปปักรากฟันเทียม 2 ซี่ ที่ คลินิกทันตกรรมการ์เด้นเดนเต้ ดอนเมือง Garden Dente Clinic คลินิกสะอาดสะอ้าน บรรยากาศแบบสวนหลังบ้าน มีที่จอดรถได้ประมาณ 4-5 คัน พนักงานทุกคนน่ารักอัธยาศัยดี ตอบทุกคำถามด้วยการอธิบายจนเข้าใจ คุณหมอนทีใจดี ใส่ใจและมือเบามาก ฉีดยาชาไม่เจ็บเลย คอยถามตลอดว่าเจ็บไหม รู้สึกตึงๆ หนักๆ ไหม ถ้าเจ็บบอกหมอนะ จะได้ฉีดยาชาเพิ่ม สรุปทำจนเสร็จไม่ได้ฉีดยาชาเพิ่มเลย ประทับใจทุกอย่างเลยค่ะ รากฟันเทียมซี่ละ 21,990 ยี่ห้อไบโอเท็ม (BIOTEM) ประเทศเกาหลี ปลูกกระดูกร่วมด้วย 1 ซอง 4,500 #บอกเลยว่าที่นี่ราคาดีที่สุดแล้ว อีก 5 เดือน ใส่ครอบฟัน เราจะมีฟันกรามข้างขวาไว้เคี้ยวข้าวแล้ว😁

0x30e2834ea0a7202b_0x8e62b5252387c51f.en: July 21, 1967 Today I had two dental implants placed at Garden Dente Clinic in Don Mueang. The clinic is clean and has a backyard garden atmosphere. There's parking for about 4-5 cars. All the staff are lovely and friendly, answering all questions with clear explanations. Dr. Natee is kind, attentive, and very gentle. The anesthetic injection was painless. He constantly asked if I was in pain or felt any tightness or heaviness, and told me to let him know if I felt any discomfort so he could add more anesthetic. In the end, I didn't need any additional anesthetic injections. I was very impressed with everything. Each implant cost 21,990 baht, brand BIOTEM from Korea, with bone grafting costing 4,500 baht per sachet. #I can honestly say this clinic has the best price. In 5 months, I'll have the crowns placed. Then I'll have a right molar to chew food with! 😁

0x30502fe8c894dbcb_0xfcf080b0fc7e34ed.text: I’m shocked that there are only 5 reviews here. I can honestly say that this service is one of the best investments I’ve ever made in my life. To really get to know your body and to sit with someone who is passionate about teaching you about your body and how to treat it right and reach your goals is something special, something that would probably cost hundreds of dollars and possibly 1,000+ back home. (USA) If you come to this area of Phuket you probably have fitness goals, and you may get advice from influencers or whatever on social media and YouTube on how to get the results you want with your fitness and body, but our bodies are different and unique, what one person may need to reach a similar goal as yours may be completely different than you need (calories, macros, specific workout routine etc.) so by following the advice of what works for one person may leave you spinning your wheels and getting no where, it’s very frustrating. So because our bodies are different and unique, we need something customized to our needs if we are going to reach our fitness goals without wasting precious time we can’t get back. That’s what this service gives you, one on one time with a professional who will analyze your body with the best equipment available and break everything down to you so you can understand it and move forward. If you are serious about your health, don’t skip this. It’s worth every baht, dollar or whatever, you came all this way to change for the better and I can’t think of a better way to start than here. Good luck 🙏

0x30e29bd3e5ae0beb_0x23afc7ec2e768a79.text: การรับผิดชอบห่วยแตกมาก ห้องข้างในไม่เหมือนที่คิดไว้ แจ็คพอตเจอคุณหมอกับผู้ช่วยที่ไม่เป็นมืออาชีพ ดีอย่างเดียวแค่พนักงานต้อนรับพูดจาดี แอดมินเพจก็ห่วยแตกรับจองคิวอย่างเดียวไม่คัดกรองไม่ช่วยแก้ปัญหาอำนวยอะไรได้เลย โทษลูกค้าอีก 0/10 แจ้งทางแชทล่วงหน้าแล้วชัดเจนว่า “จัดฟันอยู่และมีใบส่งตัวเพื่อถอนฟัน” แต่เมื่อไปถึงคลินิกกลับไม่สามารถทำได้ โดยเหตุผลที่ได้รับมีเพียงคำว่า “คุณหมอไม่กล้าถอนเพราะมีลวดในปาก” ซึ่งเป็นคำอธิบายที่ไม่ชัดเจนและทำให้คนไข้เสียความเชื่อมั่นมาก สิ่งที่ควรเกิดขึ้นคือการคัดกรองเคสตั้งแต่ตอนนัดหมาย หรืออย่างน้อยควรสื่อสารอย่างมืออาชีพ เช่น แจ้งว่าจากที่ประเมินแล้วเพราะมีเหล็กเลยจะให้คุณหมอที่มีประสบการณ์มากกว่าดูเคสให้ดีกว่าพร้อมคำขอโทษต่อเหตุการณ์ที่ทำให้คนไข้เสียเวลา แต่สิ่งที่ได้รับคือคำว่า “ไม่กล้าถอน” ซ้ำๆ น้ำเสียงเหมือนเด็กน้อยเหมือนนี่คือเรื่องเล่นๆของพวกคุณ หมออาจจะยังไม่ชำนาญพอเข้าใจนะแต่การแสดงออกมาคือไม่กล้าถอนฟันกับหมอที่นี่ค่ะและพูดแต่ไม่กล้าถอน “โดยไม่มีคำอธิบายหรือคำขอโทษใดๆหรือคำอธิบายเพิ่มเติมเลย” การจัดการหน้างานก็ไม่เหมาะสม ผู้ช่วยทันตแพทย์มีน้ำเสียงค่อนข้างแข็ง และแจ้งให้มาใหม่วันถัดไปหรือวันอื่น โดยไม่คำนึงถึงเวลาของคนไข้เลยทั้งที่หลายคนต้องจัดสรรเวลาเรียน งาน และการเดินทาง รวมถึงเราที่มีแพลนถอนฟันพักฟื้นแต่วุ่นวายไปหมด ทุกคนไม่ได้ว่างค่ะ สภาพภายในห้องทำฟันยังทำให้รู้สึกไม่สบายใจ เป็นคลินิกแรกที่ทำให้รู้สึกงี้ทั้งที่คิดว่าน่าจะดีเห็นมีหลายสาขาละรูปก็ดูดี ตะหงิดตั้งแต่แรกก่อนจะเกิดเหตุการณ์อีก เช่น ความสะอาดและอุปกรณ์บางอย่างดูไม่เรียบร้อย ก๊อกน้ำมีทิชชู่อุดไว้กับหนังยางรัดแกงรัด?? แก้วบ้วนปากดูเก่ามาก ทำให้รู้สึกอึดอัดและไม่มั่นใจในมาตรฐานของคลินิก ในส่วนของการประสานงานผ่านแอดมินเพจ ก็ไม่มีประสิทธิภาพเลยเหมือนรับหน้าที่เพียงจองคิว แต่ไม่มีการคัดกรองเคสหรือประสานงานกับสาขาให้เหมาะสม ทั้งที่แจ้งรายละเอียดเคสไปแล้วชัดเจน หลังเกิดปัญหา พยายามติดต่อเรื่องการคืนเงินค่าจองมากกว่า 3 วัน เพราะไม่โอเคกับการบริการด้วยถ้าพูดจาดีกว่านี้ก็คงจะมาวันอื่นให้ค่ะ และแจ้งชัดเจนว่าไม่สะดวกรับสายและขอให้สื่อสารผ่านแชท แต่แอดมินเพียงตอบว่า “รับเรื่อง” โดยไม่มีความคืบหน้าใดๆ และยังพยายามให้รอรับสายอย่างเดียว แล้วก็พยายามจะให้กลับไปทำที่คลินิกทั้งที่แจ้งแล้วว่าไม่สะดวกเดินทาง และทำที่คลินิกอื่นแล้ว เหมือนแอดมินสมองเสื่อม ไม่ได้อยากแรงนะแต่หงุดหงิดมาก คุยดีจนกลายเป็นมีแต่คำวีนๆในแชทก็เพราะการประสานงานของพวกคุณ ที่แย่คือมีการเปลี่ยนเหตุผลภายหลังว่าเป็นเพราะ “ไม่นำใบส่งตัวตัวจริงมา” ทั้งที่ในวันที่เข้ารับบริการไม่มีใครแจ้งประเด็นนี้เลย และได้แสดงไฟล์ใบส่งตัวให้ดูแล้ว ซึ่งเป็นรูปแบบที่คลินิกให้มาอยู่แล้ว เนื่องจากคลินิกต้นทางอยู่ไกล ไม่สามารถเดินทางไปเอาเอกสารตัวจริงได้ และก็ได้แจ้งข้อมูลนี้ไว้ล่วงหน้าแล้วเช่นกัน เพื่อความเป็นธรรม ในวันถัดมา เลยไปถอนฟันกับคลินิกอื่นโดยใช้เพียงไฟล์ใบส่งตัวเช่นกัน และสามารถทำได้ตามปกติ คุณหมอมีความเป็นมืออาชีพ อธิบายชัดเจน และให้ความมั่นใจกับคนไข้ได้มากกว่ามาก สรุปคือ ปัญหาไม่ได้อยู่ที่เคสของคนไข้ แต่อยู่ที่การสื่อสาร มาตรฐานการให้บริการ และการจัดการของทางคลินิกเองค่ะ หวังว่าจะนำไปปรับปรุงนะคะ รู้สึกแย่และเสียความรู้สึกสุดๆค่ะ
0x30e29bd3e5ae0beb_0x23afc7ec2e768a79.author: PunPun MooMoo
0x30e29bd3e5ae0beb_0x23afc7ec2e768a79.en: The service was terrible. The clinic room was nothing like what I expected. I hit the jackpot with an unprofessional dentist and assistant. The only good thing was the polite receptionist. The Facebook page admin was awful; they only took bookings, didn't screen patients, and didn't help solve any problems or provide any assistance. They even blamed the customer. 0/10 I clearly informed them via chat beforehand that I was "undergoing orthodontic treatment and had a referral for tooth extraction," but upon arrival at the clinic, it couldn't be done. The only reason given was, "The dentist is afraid to extract because of the wires in your mouth," which was an unclear explanation and greatly undermined my confidence. What should have happened was better case screening during the appointment, or at least professional communication. For example, stating that after assessment, due to the braces, they would have a more experienced dentist examine the case, along with an apology for the inconvenience. Instead, I received only the repeated phrase, "Afraid to extract," in a childish tone, as if this were a joke. I understand the dentist might not be experienced enough, but their demeanor was clearly unprofessional; they just kept saying "Afraid to extract" without any explanation, apology, or further clarification. The on-site management was also inappropriate. The dental assistant had a harsh tone and told me to come back the next day or another day, without considering the patient's time constraints, as many patients need to manage their studies, work, and travel arrangements. This includes us, who had planned for tooth extraction and recovery, but everything was hectic and everyone was busy. The condition of the treatment room was also unsettling. This is the first clinic that has made me feel this way, even though I thought it would be good, considering they have multiple branches and the pictures looked good. I had a bad feeling from the start, even before the incident occurred. For example, the cleanliness and some equipment seemed untidy. The faucet had tissue and a rubber band stuck in it? The mouthwash cups looked very old. It made me feel uncomfortable and unsure about the clinic's standards. The coordination through the page admin was also inefficient. It seemed like they only handled booking appointments but didn't screen cases or coordinate appropriately with the branches, even though I had clearly provided case details. After the problem, I tried to contact them about a refund for the booking fee for more than 3 days because I wasn't happy with the service. If they had been more polite, they would have offered to come on another day. I clearly stated that I wasn't available to answer calls and asked them to communicate via chat, but the admin only replied "received the request" without any progress updates. They kept telling me to wait for calls and tried to get me to come back to the clinic, even though I had already explained that it was inconvenient to travel and that I had already had treatment at another clinic. It's like the admin has memory problems. I don't want to be harsh, but I was very frustrated. Polite conversations turned into angry exchanges in the chat because of your inefficiency. What's worse is that the reason given was later changed to "not bringing the original referral letter," even though no one mentioned this on the day of service, and I showed them the referral letter file in the format they already provide. This is because the original clinic is far away and I couldn't travel to get the original document. This was also stated in advance. To be fair, the next day I had my tooth extracted at another clinic using only the referral letter file, and everything went smoothly. The doctor there was much more professional, explained things clearly, and provided much more reassurance to the patient. In short, the problem isn't with my case, but with the communication, service standards, and management of the clinic itself. I hope this will be improved. I feel terrible and extremely disappointed.

0x30e29ed26abee065_0x8594f2e6103372b7.text: One of the most wonderful clinics I have visited in Bangkok so far has to be Central Clinic that is located in the most ideal location in Bangkok, especially if you are a tourist since Siam Square One is in the vicinity of popular touristic spots such as Siam Paragon Mall and is right next to the Siam BTS Sky train station. Central Clinic is definitely one of the finer clinics in the city which goes above and beyond to serve its patients from the moment they enter the clinic! The staff is so friendly and accommodating and clearly explained the entire process step by step and also offered some refreshments with snacks! I was thoroughly impressed by their organization and ability to work so smoothly to deal with every patient, foreign or local. I think it is very important to research well when it comes to clinics in Bangkok so if you’re looking for a good place, this is definitely one to check out! I went for their HIFU treatment for the face and also to get their YAG Laser done on the elbows to lighten some discoloration. I also received a relaxing and beneficial facial treatment that really improved the appearance of my skin and removed any discoloration/sunburn that was there as well. If you’re a tourist in Thailand, this is something you can definitely benefit from before heading back home as well! The staff is very helpful and you can ask them about the treatments during your visit and they’ll address everything very nicely for you! The doctor was extremely knowledgeable and understanding when I spoke about my expectations from the HIFU treatment and where exactly I needed it (Jaw and Neck area specifically). You’ll definitely not have any issue in communication since the doctor along with the staff know English quite well. They made sure that I wasn’t feeling any pain during the treatment as well and had applied general anaesthesia to the area beforehand as well which was great since I have done the HIFU treatment before as well and sometimes it does feel painful because of the anaesthesia not being enough time to fully work on the targeted area. I really appreciated how they all worked together to make sure that I was comfortable throughout the treatments! I was informed about all the possible symptoms and also post-treatment care for better results in the form of a small pamphlet which is an extra step that I haven’t seen many clinics doing so I really liked that too! It’s been a month since I have been to the clinic and can really see visible results from both the laser and the HIFU. My elbows are visibly even-toned and the discoloration has really subsided plus the HIFU has really improved the structure of my face and helped slim it out in the way I had hoped for. Overall, I’d highly recommend this clinic for their excellent service, wide variety of services and great follow-up procedures as well where they make sure to be in constant contact with the patients after they have completed a treatment and they made sure that I shared any symptoms I had later on and even advised me how to correct them easily!
0x30e29ed26abee065_0x8594f2e6103372b7.author: shahzain mustafa

0x30e29ed26abee065_0x8594f2e6103372b7.text: I was looking for a studio that doesn't only do steaming and cleansing like all the little ones, but also extraction. Here I got a cleaning and then they took every little spot out. It took quite a while and afterwards she cleaned my face again with some cold water or so which was really relaxing. Then I got a anti acne mask out on followed by several creams. All in all much more than what I expected as I just found this studio walking past and it was super cheap! Paid 300 baht. All the other places that do extractions (which I found online) wanted more than 1500 baht. So highly recommended! I tipped 20% (didn't have more on me) because it was defs worth more than the 300. Thanks a lot! ❤

0x311d66a5d17255d1_0x76490d8dc35201b0.en: I am very grateful to the dentist for being so patient with someone who is terrified of dentists. The explanations were excellent, and my fear disappeared once I trusted the dentist. I went for treatment for a toothache and asked for a tooth extraction. The dentist said it wasn't decayed, examined it thoroughly to be sure, and ultimately didn't extract it, suggesting it was likely due to another cause. What the dentist said was true; the pain is gone today, and it was due to gingivitis. The dentist did a great job scaling my teeth; even though they said it might cause sensitivity, it wasn't that bad. Their touch was very steady and gentle. I'm no longer afraid. I highly recommend this clinic.

0x30e29fac0e11e9b3_0x47e1dc3b8fb95c05.text: I wanted to write a review because I was so impressed with the service. The clinic is beautifully decorated, giving a relaxing spa-like feel that greatly reduced my fear of the procedure. The treatment rooms, restrooms, and cleanliness standards are on par with a hotel. Everything was convenient and comfortable. The location is excellent, conveniently accessible via the Phloen Chit BTS station. It's located next to the Four Points Hotel BTS Phloen Chit, accessible from both the side alley and the hotel itself. If you park in the hotel, take the elevator to the lobby. From the lobby, walk towards the bar, and there's a side exit; open it, and you'll find the clinic on your right – no need to walk outside. I decided to have my first Ulthera treatment here because I was confident in the quality of the equipment and the doctor's professionalism, based on my consultation before the treatment. The results were excellent; it wasn't as painful as I expected. I could feel the meticulous attention to detail and care from the doctor and the entire team. I want to support such a high-quality, honest clinic. For anyone looking for a clinic, I highly recommend this one. Try scheduling a free consultation with the doctor before deciding. The prices are standard; while it looks luxurious, they aren't more expensive than other places, and not suspiciously cheap either. They don't push unnecessary things. From someone who consulted at many places, I finally chose this clinic from the very first meeting with the doctor. I had the consultation and then proceeded with the procedure right away, and I'm truly not disappointed. Thank you so much to the doctor and the team for taking such good care of me.

0x30e29f421401cb9b_0x275ab29bbacc81c9.text: Highly recommend this clinic. We were traveling in Bangkok and had raw shrimp in the evening. Since it was already after 9 PM, most clinics were closed, and this was one of the few places still open, so we came here immediately. Dr. Pungkava Sricharoen was extremely professional, careful, and patient. He measured my brother’s vital signs thoroughly, examined his symptoms in detail, and provided immediate treatment with injections. After the treatment, he also asked my brother to stay for observation to make sure his condition had improved before allowing him to leave. I am writing this review about 40 minutes after my brother received treatment, and most of his symptoms have already disappeared. We are truly grateful for the doctor’s professionalism, kindness, and excellent care. This is a very reliable clinic, especially for travelers who need urgent medical help in Bangkok.
