0x30e29fdb283edaab_0x99c3fbe243634d0f.text: I heard that Regina is the place to go for blemish removal in Bangkok! So, I decided to try "Sylfirm X," which is effective for melasma, something I'd been interested in for a while. As someone who doesn't speak English or Thai, I was very anxious about my first treatment abroad, but the Japanese staff provided excellent support, which was very reassuring. Sylfirm is a machine that pricks your face with needles, so I wondered if it would be painful... but they took their time applying the anesthetic cream, so there was absolutely no pain. There was also a cooling mask for downtime, so by the time I left, there was almost no redness. On my way out, I bought AC cream and AHA cream and received a cute drawstring bag with a reindeer pattern!
0x30e29fdb283edaab_0x99c3fbe243634d0f.author: のり

0x30e29fdb283edaab_0x99c3fbe243634d0f.text: I visited the clinic for the removal of warts and moles on my face and neck. It was my first time having warts removed, so I was a little anxious, but the staff were very considerate, and I was able to complete the procedure with peace of mind. I had many warts and some were in sensitive areas, so there were times during the procedure when it was painful, but the staff encouraged me by saying, "We'll be finished soon," and "Hang in there," which made me feel very reassured. I'm not a fan of the intense pain and aggressive sales tactics at cosmetic medical clinics in Japan, so I visited this clinic while I was in Bangkok, and I'm so glad I made the trip. Thank you very much.
0x30e29fdb283edaab_0x99c3fbe243634d0f.author: Germany Rilla

0x30e29fdb283edaab_0x99c3fbe243634d0f.text: Since I'm staying in Thailand for six months, I decided to try medical hair removal, something I'd been curious about for a while. I don't speak any English or Thai, so I was worried about communication, and it was my first time getting laser hair removal, so I was quite nervous. However, a Japanese staff member assisted me, and the treatment went smoothly. Even if you're worried about pain, you can consult and order the irradiation level and number of treatments, so I recommend it. It's much more affordable than getting it done in Japan, so if you're staying in Thailand for a long time or living there and are interested in hair removal, I highly recommend it.
0x30e29fdb283edaab_0x99c3fbe243634d0f.author: んて

0x30e29fdb283edaab_0x99c3fbe243634d0f.text: I had my first ever freckle removal treatment in Thailand. The consultation was very thorough and easy to understand, and although I was nervous, I decided to go ahead with the procedure. There was a Japanese staff member, so I was able to ask questions about various things, and they kept me well-informed throughout the treatment, which made me feel at ease! This experience has made me want to have another treatment when I come back to Thailand! I'm looking forward to seeing the changes in a week and beyond!
0x30e29fdb283edaab_0x99c3fbe243634d0f.author: 守田貴子

0x30e29fdb283edaab_0x99c3fbe243634d0f.author: ST

0x30e29f7e394e33bb_0x2231316e9ec2b16b.text: I'm constantly creating content, often outdoors: in the sun, in the water… As a result, my skin got a deep tan, not just on my face but all over. But let's be honest, my face is what I use the most. Even with makeup, you could see my skin looked dull and tired… 🥹 Before the treatment, my skin was dry and dull from the sun (especially the day I wore the pink Thai outfit). Then a friend recommended I go to Labelle for a Hydra Facial. Honestly, the price is super reasonable (4990), as I've found it more expensive elsewhere, and I could see all the impurities coming off my skin 😳 dead skin cells, blackheads, clogged pores… everything just washed away with the water. What I loved was that before applying the vitamins, there's a deep cleansing. So, the skin really absorbs everything thoroughly. The team and the doctor are lovely 🥰 For those who need a quick glow, I also recommend asking for the Skin Booster as an add-on. You can contact the clinic directly for advice and pricing. The result? From the very same day, my skin was much more hydrated, radiant, with a more even complexion, and my blemishes and acne marks were diminished. The difference is clearly visible between the day I wore the silver Thai outfit and the day of the Louis Vuitton photoshoot (the same day!). My makeup stayed perfectly in place, and my skin was glowing. And a week later, at a hotel event, everyone complimented my skin 🥹 I even have a makeup-free photo taken in my room. My skin is still tanned, but it's so much more hydrated, soft, and luminous, as if it had been plumped up. Thank you so much, Labelle 💖 I'm truly impressed. For those who need to get in top shape quickly, like me... I 100% recommend it! I'll definitely be back 🤗✨
0x30e29f7e394e33bb_0x2231316e9ec2b16b.author: Jenny La Thailandaise

0x30e29f7e394e33bb_0x2231316e9ec2b16b.text: I visited Labelle Clinic last Sunday for laser hair removal on my arms, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. More than 20 years ago, I tried laser hair removal at another clinic (I don’t remember the name), but back then it was very expensive, painful, and the results were disappointing. This time at Labelle Clinic, everything was different — in the best way. The price is very reasonable, the service is excellent, and the whole process was comfortable and professional. I honestly had the best time, and I can confidently say this was a 5-star experience! Highly recommend Labelle Clinic if you want great results with top-quality care.

0x30e29f7e394e33bb_0x2231316e9ec2b16b.text: Finally got to do Ultra + Botox here and I’m honestly so happy with the experience ✨ Not only do I love how natural and refreshed my face looks, but the whole service made me feel super comfortable from the moment I walked in. 0x30e298eec655b869_0x19f2eb67cdcdc887.text: Public Health Center 28, Krung Thonburi Road This was my first time here, for dental treatment. I couldn't get it done yet because I only recovered from COVID two weeks ago. I need to be fully recovered for a month before I can have dental work done. So I made a new appointment. I needed teeth cleaning and fillings, but the staff informed me that only one procedure can be done at a time. If you need dental treatment, you need to arrive early in the morning to get a queue number. Arrive no later than 7:00 AM because they only issue 10 queue numbers per day. The service process is: 1. Get a queue number. 2. Wait to be contacted by staff downstairs before going up to the second floor. 3. Present your queue number at the registration counter. 4. Weigh yourself, measure your height and proportions, have your temperature and blood pressure checked. 5. Wait to be called to your examination room. 6. Enter the examination room. Overall, the staff provided good service.

0x30da3b04e1660925_0x144172fec11615ed.text: If possible, I would rate Dr. Tanyathorn Teeranoraseth higher than 5 stars. I had been unable to smell and taste for more than a year due to benign polyps in my nasal cavity. Dr. Tanyathorn saw me on short notice, CT scans confirmed the presence of the polyps, and she led the surgical team that removed the polyps. What should have been a 1-2 hour surgery took over 5 hours because Dr. Tanyathorn discovered numerous additional polyps in my sinus cavities. She expertly removed all the polyps, and also fixed my deviated septum. Over the following three weeks, I had three follow-up appointments with Dr. Tanyathorn. She answered my questions (in excellent English), explained to me approximate timelines for recovery, and carefully removed scabs, clots, and fibrin. I felt slightly embarrassed to see some of the stuff Dr. Tanyathorn was pulling out of my nasal passages, but she just said, “It’s okay, it’s my job!” To say I feel relief would be an understatement. My nasal passages feel clearer than they ever have, and I’m so grateful to Dr. Tanyathorn for helping improve my quality of life. She explained that the first month would be the toughest, and I’m at three weeks post-op today. I started to regain my senses of smell/taste a few nights ago, and while not 100% yet, it’s better than the 0% I’ve had for the last year. I had my last follow up appointment with Dr. Tanyathorn, then went to the Saturday Walking Street. I felt like I was being led by my nose: meats grilling, waffles baking, durian on display, incense burning, perfume … After not being able to smell for a year, I felt overjoyed to remember what it was like. If you are suffering from any ENT (ear/nose/throat) issue(s), especially sinus, I would highly recommend Dr. Tanyathorn without hesitation. She is kind, professional, communicative, and a subject matter expert in sinus-related issues. Thank you for massively improving my life, Dr. Tanyathorn! Khup khun mach, khup! 🙂
0x30da3b04e1660925_0x144172fec11615ed.author: Dominic Alexander

0x30da3b04e1660925_0x144172fec11615ed.text: When you’re in a foreign country and something bad happens - things can get scary very quickly. So if you’re in Chiang Mai with a ENT issue… This is your place. My partner and I came here on holiday when we had a freak accident during an underwater activity in Pattaya. My partner’s ears were compromised and we were absolutely shook. Dr. Chaiwat answered the phone a little before opening hours and let us know that we could walk-in. His patience, understanding and generosity to carefully listen and help a frantic Korean couple (us) meant a lot! Of course, his expertise and communication skills in not only diagnosing but meticulously explaining why and what has happened was truly impressive and appreciated. My partner’s ears were bloody from ear barotrauma due to a sudden change in pressure. Thereafter, we left with solutions and hope for recovery with appropriate medicine and medical advice. On the taxi back to our hotel, my partner and I discussed how not even in Australia nor South Korea could you find such a doctor who would hear out all of your questions and thoroughly answer them with a such a sincere heart. He is truly leading and outshining the new generation of healthcare professionals in Thailand + yonder. Thank you again Doctor and we wish you all the best!
0x30da3b04e1660925_0x144172fec11615ed.author: Elias Bak

0x30da3b04e1660925_0x144172fec11615ed.text: The doctor was kind and provided good service. The treatment was accurate and the price was reasonable. I had severe ear congestion and ear pain. 0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.text: ก่อนอื่นผมต้องบอกก่อนว่าคลีนิคนี้คือคลีนิคทำฟันที่ดีที่สุดในชิวิตเกือบ 70 ปีของผม เหนือทุกสิ่งคือฝีมือคุณหมอร้านนี้ ต้องบอกว่าเก่งที่สุดๆๆๆๆๆ ก่อนทำสามารถวินิจฉัยอย่างถูกต้องแม่นยำ ตอนทำก็แสนสบาย ไม่เจ็บ ไม่เสียว สบายๆ จนบางครั้งเผลอหลับไป ทำเสร็จแล้วไม่เคยมีปัญหา ไม่ต้องมาแก้ อยากกระซิบว่าคุณหมอไฉ่ใจดีมากๆ บางทีทำไปร้องเพลงคลอเบาๆไปด้วย ช่วยให้ผมไม่เคยเครียด บอกตรงๆว่าผมไว้ใจและเชื่อในฝีมือหมอไฉ่มากๆๆๆๆๆๆ หมอคนอื่นห้ามมายุ่งกับปากผม สถานที่ เครื่องมือ เครื่องมือทันสมัยมาก หมอจิมจะศึกษา จัดหาและนำเครื่องมือใหม่ๆที่ทันสมัยเข้ามาใช้ในคลินิคอยู่ตลอด นอกจากจะช่วยให้เวลาในการรักษาเป็นไปอย่างรวดเร็ว และยังทำให้งานที่ได้ออกมามีคุณภาพสูง และช่วยยกระดับความสะอาด การปลอดเชื้อใช้ในคลินิค ราคา พอๆกับคลินิคคุณภาพสูงอื่นๆ ไม่เคยคิดว่าแพงเมื่อเทียบคุณภาพของรักษา ทั้งก่อน ขณะทำการรักษาและหลังการรักษา พนักงาน สุภาพ มารยาทดี มีฝีมือและประสบการณ์สูง สถานที่ กว้างขวาง สอาด แอร์เย็นสบาย มีที่นั่งรอสบายๆไม่แออัด อยู่ตรงทำเลที่เดินทางสดวกทั้งรถยนต์ส่วนตัว และระบบขนส่งมวลชนสาธารณะ เช่น รถไฟฟ้าสายสีเหลือง ที่จอดรถ แบบในร่มแบบเหลือเฟือ ไม่ต้องแย่งกับใคร ไม่ร้อนแดดและไม่เปียกฝน มีจุดชารต์ไฟสำหรับรถยนต์ไฟฟ้า
0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.author: Titivut Rugsaj
0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.en: First of all, I must say that this clinic is the best dental clinic I've ever been to in my almost 70 years of life. Above all, it's the skill of the dentists here. They are incredibly talented. Before treatment, they make accurate diagnoses. During treatment, it's incredibly comfortable; there's no pain or discomfort, just pure relaxation—sometimes I even fall asleep. After treatment, there are never any problems; I never need any touch-ups. I want to whisper that Dr. Chai is incredibly kind. Sometimes he even sings softly while treating me, which helps me avoid stress. Honestly, I trust and have complete faith in Dr. Chai's skills. No other dentist is allowed to touch my mouth! The facility and equipment are very modern. Dr. Jim constantly studies, procures, and introduces the latest and most advanced equipment to the clinic. This not only speeds up treatment times but also ensures high-quality results and enhances the cleanliness and sterilization of the clinic. The price is comparable to other high-quality clinics. I've never considered it expensive considering the quality of treatment before, during, and after. The staff are polite, well-mannered, highly skilled, and experienced. The place is spacious, clean, and comfortably air-conditioned. There's a comfortable, uncrowded waiting area. It's conveniently located for both private cars and public transportation, such as the Yellow Line Skytrain. There's ample covered parking; no need to compete for spaces. It's also protected from the sun and rain. There are charging stations for electric vehicles.

0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.text: คุณหมอและที่ร้านบริการดีมากๆ ประทับใจทุกครั้งที่ใช้บริการครับ อธิบายขั้นตอนละเอียดตลอด ผมใช้บริการที่นี่เป็นประจำทั้งตรวจสุขภาพฟัน จัดฟัน ทำรีเทรนเนอร์ รวมถึงดูแลฟัน เคสจัดฟันของผมทำได้ยากแต่ที่นี่ทำได้ ผมประทับใจจริงๆครับแนะนำเลย The dentist and the staff here are always excellent. I’m impressed every time I visit. They explain every step clearly, and I regularly come here for dental check-ups, orthodontic treatment, retainers, and overall dental care. My orthodontic case was quite complicated, but they handled it successfully. I’m truly impressed and highly recommend this clinic.
0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.author: kohhei sakai
0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.en: The dentist and the staff at this clinic are excellent. I'm impressed every time I visit. They explain every step in detail. I use their services regularly for dental check-ups, orthodontic treatment, retainers, and overall dental care. My orthodontic case was complex, but they managed it successfully. I'm truly impressed and highly recommend this clinic.

0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.text: Nice professional family-owned dental practice on Ladprao Road. I had to have root canal and needed a new crown and Khun Bundjerdlak and Khun Jim reassured me all would be well. All my visits were pain-free aside of the anaesthetic wearing off. They communicated with me every step of the way - from putting in the temporary crown to my thoughts on the colour of the crown. They're clearly experienced and they use cutting-edge 3D-scanning technology too. Reasonable prices. Really recommend this dental practice.
0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.author: Susie Chan

0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.text: มาที่นี่รับรองว่าไม่ผิดหวังแน่นอนค่ะ ติดตามทางช่องเพจมาเป็นปีๆ ติดตามมานาน น่าจะ3-5 ปี ได้ วันนี้ได้เข้ามาบริการที่นี่ บอกเลยว่าประทับใจมากกับการเลือกที่นี่ คุณหมอไม่ดุเลย คุณหมอบรรเจิดลักษณ์ น่ารักมากๆๆๆๆค่ะ และ แนะนำดีมากๆๆๆ สถานที่สะอาด กว้างขวาง พนักงานน่ารักและเป็นกันเองทุกคน ประทับใจสุดๆเลยค่ะ
0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.author: By Pt
0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.en: You definitely won't be disappointed coming here! I've been following their page for years, probably 3-5 years. Today I finally got to use their services, and I must say I'm very impressed with my choice. The doctor is not harsh at all; Dr. Banjerdlak is incredibly lovely and gives excellent advice. The place is clean and spacious, and all the staff are lovely and friendly. I'm extremely impressed!

0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.text: ขอแนะนำคลินิกฟันทันตการฟันขาว ลาดพร้าวซอย116 คุณหมอที่นี่ และผู้ช่วยคูณหมอทุกคนอัธยาศัยดี ใจดีมากค่ะ เป็นกันเองดูแลดี คุณหมอที่นี้ใจดีด้วยพูดคุยเป็นกันเอง สอนเรี่องดูแลฟันแนะนำดีมาก อยากให้แวะมาดูแลสุขภาพช่องปากและฟันที่นี่ดูกันนะคะ
0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.author: ワロシャ磯海
0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.en: I highly recommend the Teeth Whitening Dental Clinic on Ladprao Soi 116. The dentists and assistants here are all very friendly and kind. They are welcoming and provide excellent care. The dentists are especially kind and easy to talk to, offering helpful advice on dental care. I encourage you to visit them for your oral and dental health check-up.

0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.text: The doctor gave good advice. The place is clean with air purifiers in every room and UV sterilizers in the examination room. There's an X-ray machine, but the air conditioning was a little too warm.
0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.author: surawat bumrungyat

0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.text: จัดฟันกับที่นี้ คุณหมอผู้หญิงเจ้าของไข้ เก่งและใจดีมากๆ ให้คำแนะนำดีเยี่ยม ส่วนคุณหมอท่านอื่นๆ ที่ขูดหินปูน อุดฟัน มือเบามากๆ แนะนำหากใครสนใจจัดฟัน ที่นี่เป็น 1 ในทางเลือก
0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.author: Thanawat Phlaingam
0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.en: I had my braces done here. The female dentist in charge is very skilled and kind, and gives excellent advice. The other dentists who did scaling and fillings were also very gentle. I highly recommend this place if you're interested in getting braces.

0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.text: จากที่ได้ทำฟันที่คลินิกทันตกรรมสีขาว เนื่องจากฟันห่างและฟันล่างคร่อมฟันบน ไม่กล้ายิ้ม จนตอนนี้ฟันเรียงสวย กล้ายิ้มอย่างมั่นใจ ที่นี่คุณหมอทุกคนน่ารัก ใจดีมากๆเลยค่ะ
0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.author: yada thong
0x311d6200630cf2fb_0x1219390b0b2e9801.en: I got my teeth done at White Dental Clinic. I had gaps between my teeth and my lower teeth overlapped my upper teeth, so I didn't dare smile. Now my teeth are beautifully aligned, and I can smile confidently. All the dentists here are so kind and lovely.

0x30e29f004aca6489_0xa44e739e5ec7a508.text: The doctor is incredibly lovely! Out of all the clinics I've been to, Dr. Jenny is the sweetest. She speaks so kindly and has a gentle voice. During the procedure, she chatted with me, making it a relaxing experience. The pre-treatment consultation was also excellent. I loved it so much! The receptionist was also lovely and spoke so nicely. The clinic is very clean. My first time had a picotherapy treatment; my face was red and a little sore, but bearable. My face felt warm and tingly afterwards. I'm looking forward to seeing the results! 💖💖💖💖

The clinic is clean and well-maintained. The staff and doctor are very kind and provide excellent service. It's easy to get to, located behind Central Rama 9, accessible via the MRT Rama 9 station. They offer great advice and consultations. The doctor is very kind, and the staff are lovely. There's a wide variety of procedures to choose from. The air conditioning is comfortable, and you can wait comfortably. I'm so glad I chose this clinic. It was a great first-time medical procedure experience.
0x30e29f004aca6489_0xa44e739e5ec7a508.author: ณัฐวดี ทัดเทียม

0x30e29f004aca6489_0xa44e739e5ec7a508.text: The clinic is clean, the staff and doctor are friendly, and it's conveniently located near the MRT Rama 9 station. The doctor provided excellent consultation. I personally had problems with acne scars, so I opted for the Pico treatment, but the clinic offers many different programs, so I recommend consulting with the doctor first.
0x30e29f004aca6489_0xa44e739e5ec7a508.author: jaJunejunes

0x30e29f004aca6489_0xa44e739e5ec7a508.text: This is my first time getting cosmetic procedures in Thailand. I'm trying the non-invasive Hyaluronic Acid (HIFU) treatment. They have Chinese-speaking staff, so I can clearly understand what I want to improve and how to address it. The price is much more affordable than in Taiwan. I'm looking forward to the results.
0x30e29f004aca6489_0xa44e739e5ec7a508.author: Queenie Shih

0x30e29f004aca6489_0xa44e739e5ec7a508.text: I came to try picosecond laser treatment today to shrink pores and remove acne scars. There was a promotion, so it was only 2999 Thai Baht, which was a great deal. Communication was no problem; there were Chinese-speaking staff at the store. 👍🏻 …
0x30e29f004aca6489_0xa44e739e5ec7a508.author: Jiang Wei Wei

0x30e29f004aca6489_0xa44e739e5ec7a508.text: I had the opportunity to try Pico laser treatment at this clinic, and it was amazing! The doctor was lovely and treated my skin problems accordingly. All the staff were very nice. I'll definitely come back again when I have the chance.
0x30e29f004aca6489_0xa44e739e5ec7a508.author: Kongpukun Chantawarang

0x30e29f004aca6489_0xa44e739e5ec7a508.text: I went in for laser hair removal (Diode). The staff provided excellent service. It was convenient to get to. Importantly, the front desk staff can communicate in English and Chinese. Foreign customers should be very happy. 🥰 …
0x30e29f004aca6489_0xa44e739e5ec7a508.author: Ipop Studio

0x30e29f004aca6489_0xa44e739e5ec7a508.text: This is my second visit. I initially just intended to try it out… but now it's become my regular clinic! Dr. Jenny is so gentle, I'm surprised it was over. Before I knew it, my face was already firm and toned!😆 …
0x30e29f004aca6489_0xa44e739e5ec7a508.author: Rajit Suksawat

0x30e2981f517139c3_0xd8651e425a6cc12e.text: ดิฉันเป็นแอดมินของคลินิกทันตกรรมขวัญใจค่ะ ขออนุญาตใช้พื้นที่นี้ชี้แจงรีวิวของคุณ kan saibua นะคะ ถ้าเคสนี้ครอบฟันหลุดอย่างเดียว ทางเรารับประกันยึดครอบให้ไม่มีค่าใช้จ่ายเลยค่ะ แต่เคสนี้คือนอกจากครอบฟันหลุดแล้ว เดือยฟันหายไปด้วยค่ะ จึงต้องทำเดือยฟันใหม่ ซึ่งมีเฉพาะค่าทำเดือยใหม่เท่านั้นค่ะ (คุณหมอก็เห็นใจคนไข้ให้ส่วนลดด้วยนะคะ) ส่วนการยึดครอบนั้นคุณหมอทำให้โดยไม่มีค่าใช้จ่ายค่ะตามที่เรารับประกันไว้ค่ะ ขออนุญาตยกตัวอย่างเปรียบเทียบเพื่อเข้าใจชัดเจนยิ่งขึ้นนะคะ เหมือนเราซื้อโทรศัพท์มือถือใหม่ ใช้งานไปสักพักหนึ่งเกิดกระแทก เคสโทรศัพท์มือถือเปิดออก (เปรียบเทียบคือ ครอบหลุด) เราใส่เคสกลับคืนเองไม่ได้เลยเอาไปให้ร้านใส่เคสให้ พอไปถึงร้าน ช่างรับมือถือมาดูและพบว่าแบตเตอรี่มือถือหายไป (เปรียบเทียบคือ เดือยฟันหายไป) ทางร้านจึงแนะนำให้เราซื้อแบตเตอรี่ใหม่มาใส่ก่อนแล้วค่อยใส่เคส และในฐานะที่เราซื้อมือถือกับเขาหลายเครื่องเลยให้ส่วนลดอีกด้วย จากนั้นช่างก็ใส่แบตเตอรี่ใหม่และใส่เคสให้เราเรียบร้อย โดยเราจ่ายเฉพาะค่าแบตเตอรี่ก้อนใหม่ไม่ต้องเสียค่าบริการในการใส่เคสให้เข้าที่ เรื่องนี้ก็ประมาณนี้เลยค่ะ ^^ ปล. กรณีครอบฟันหลุด คลินิกเรารับประกันยึดครอบให้โดยไม่มีค่าใช้จ่าย 6 เดือนนับแต่ทำครอบฟันเสร็จค่ะ ทั้งนี้คุณหมอท่านมักจะใจดียืดระยะประกันให้ถึง 1ปีเลยค่ะ ถ้าใช้ไปนานๆแล้วเกิดครอบหลุด เลยระยะประกันไปแล้ว มีค่าใช้จ่ายในการยึดครอบ 500-800บาทค่ะ
0x30e2981f517139c3_0xd8651e425a6cc12e.author: Daruni S
0x30e2981f517139c3_0xd8651e425a6cc12e.en: I am the administrator of Khwanjai Dental Clinic. I would like to use this space to clarify your review, kan saibua. If only the crown had come loose, we would guarantee to reattach it free of charge. However, in this case, not only was the crown loose, but the post was also missing. Therefore, a new post had to be made, and there was only the cost of the new post itself. (The dentist also gave a discount out of consideration for the patient.) The crown reattachment was done free of charge, as per our guarantee. Allow me to use an analogy to illustrate further: Imagine buying a new mobile phone. After using it for a while, it gets bumped, and the phone case comes off (comparable to the crown coming loose). You can't put the case back on yourself, so you take it to a shop. When the technician inspects the phone, they find that the battery is missing (comparable to the post). The shop recommends buying a new battery and installing it before putting the case back on. They also give you a discount because you've purchased multiple phones from them. Then, the technician installs the new battery and case, and you only pay for the new battery, not the service fee for reattaching the case. That's a similar scenario. ^^ P.S. This applies to cases where the crown has come loose. Our clinic guarantees free crown placement for 6 months from the date of crown placement. In fact, our dentists are often generous enough to extend the guarantee to 1 year. If the crown comes loose after the warranty period has expired, there will be a charge of 500-800 baht for crown placement.

0x30e2981f517139c3_0xd8651e425a6cc12e.text: เคยฟันแตกแล้วไปอุดจากที่อื่นปรากฎว่า7วันที่อุดไว้หลุด สุดท้ายต้องมาให้ที่นี่แก้ให้ หลังจากนั้นก็เป็นลูกค้าประจำมาตลอดค่ะ สถานที่เล็กแต่สะอาดพี่ๆเจ้าหน้าที่สุภาพและดูแลดีมาก ถอนฟันคุดกับคุณหมอผู้ชาย(จำชื่อไม่ได้) ตอนนั้นกลัวมาก คุณหมอเลยเอายาชามาทาให้ก่อน ช่วยได้เยอะเลยค่ะ ถอนเสร็จไม่ปวดไม่บวมเลย แนะนำเพื่อนมาถอนฟันคุดกับจัดฟันที่นี่หลายคนเลยค่ะ ส่วนตัวตอนนี้ดัดฟันกับคุณหมอบุศรินทร์ คุณหมอเก่งและใจดีมากค่ะ
0x30e2981f517139c3_0xd8651e425a6cc12e.author: Tharinee Ratanasatien
0x30e2981f517139c3_0xd8651e425a6cc12e.en: I once had a cracked tooth and got a filling elsewhere, but it fell out after 7 days. I had to come here to get it fixed, and since then I've been a regular customer. The place is small but clean, and the staff are polite and very attentive. I had my wisdom tooth extracted by a male doctor (I don't remember his name). I was very scared, so he applied numbing cream beforehand, which helped a lot. After the extraction, I didn't feel any pain or swelling. I've recommended many friends here for wisdom tooth extractions and orthodontics. I'm currently getting braces from Dr. Busarin; she's very skilled and kind.

0x30e2981f517139c3_0xd8651e425a6cc12e.en: The place is very clean, especially the restrooms. There are toothbrushes available. In short, coming here in the first place would have been better. You can drive into the alley next to the clinic and park in the lot behind the clinic (10 baht parking fee). I usually come here regularly, but after moving, I tried other places, but I would definitely drive back here for my dental work.

0x30e2981f517139c3_0xd8651e425a6cc12e.en: The female dentist, who wore glasses, was very heavy-handed. She inserted and removed the mouth-opening instrument without any prior warning. After the procedure, I had abrasions on the corner of my mouth from the mouth-opening tool and the instruments rubbing against it. My gums were swollen. The staff told me to buy mouth ointment from a pharmacy; it only costs a few tens of baht. Instead of offering me water, tea, or coffee, wouldn't it be more considerate and responsible for the cost of the mouth ointment?

0x30502ff8b4af8ce9_0x89b2e4b0a43ae2c6.text: Dr. SU Clinic is an excellent place for anyone dealing with persistent pain. The clinic has a very welcoming atmosphere, and the staff are attentive, organised, and genuinely supportive from the first moment you enter. Dr. Su is highly qualified in rehabilitation and physical therapy, with advanced training that clearly shows in the way she works. Her approach is modern even cutting edge, precise and based on current scientific methods rather than outdated general techniques. She quickly identifies the real cause of the problem and explains the treatment clearly, without jargon. In my case, the improvement has been significant. After dealing with long-term pain, her targeted methods finally made progress where other treatments had not. Dr. Su offers several advanced procedures, including: Ultrasound-guided dry needling Extremely precise, even in difficult areas such as around the throat and deep neck muscles. Ultrasound-guided hydrodissection A technique where sterile fluid is injected to gently separate stuck or irritated muscle and fascia layers. This reduces friction, decreases pain, and improves mobility. The procedure was done with clarity, caution, and excellent control. Botox for therapeutic use Applied to relax overactive muscles when clinically appropriate. Her level of education, technical skill, and confidence with complex anatomy set her apart from most clinics. You feel that she knows exactly what she is doing, and that gives a lot of trust during the treatment. Overall, Dr. SU Clinic is professional, science-driven, and very patient-focused. I can fully recommend it to anyone looking for effective and modern pain management in a supportive environment. Thank you so much to all of you. 🙏🙏🙏

0x30e29fc5ade56393_0xac257c2e705d5650.text: On February 1, 2026, we underwent an Oligioplasty procedure at the clinic. However, during the treatment, an error occurred, resulting in a burn approximately 2 centimeters in size on the left side of our neck. On the day of the incident, the clinic did not take responsibility or offer any further care. The following day, the wound began to blister. We had to contact the clinic ourselves, and it took several months of communication and follow-up before the clinic finally refunded the procedure fee. Concerned about the resulting scar, we informed the clinic that we wished to seek treatment from a dermatologist. The clinic sent a letter stating they were willing to cover the additional costs. We then decided to proceed with treatment at the dermatology specialist clinic and provided the clinic with a medical certificate and receipts as requested. Throughout the process, we cooperated fully, providing photos of the wound, medical documents, details of the treatment costs, and following up multiple times. However, we received no clear answers or guidance, only notifications that someone would contact us. Meanwhile, we continued to receive promotional messages from the clinic, leading us to feel that our follow-up and handling of this issue were not given the importance it deserved. Finally, in June, the clinic informed us that our decision to seek treatment at another medical facility was a personal one, and therefore they would not be responsible for the treatment costs. This raises questions for us regarding the clarity of their initial explanation. The clinic stated that they had taken responsibility for the incident by refunding the service fees and paying compensation. However, when it came to the actual costs of treating the scars resulting from the incident, they claimed that these costs were incurred due to the patient's own decision. Since then, we have received no further contact or clarification from the clinic. We are deeply saddened because we never wanted this to happen. The resulting scars have significantly impacted our mental health, and we have incurred ongoing treatment costs and time. All we received in return was silence and a lack of follow-up or clarification from the clinic. This experience has made us realize that before deciding on any procedure, thorough research and reviews are crucial. This includes not only the treatment results but also the professionalism of the doctor, the service of the staff, and their approach to handling unexpected issues. For us, this was a very disappointing experience, and to this day, no one from the clinic has contacted us to inquire about our condition or provide any further clarification.

0x30da3ba3934eefc7_0xb7b9d4a660329c56.text: *Things to Read Before Receiving Treatment* So you don't have to go through what we did (I felt so disappointed). The story is, I had braces done elsewhere, and my teeth were actually already quite straight. Then I moved to Chiang Mai and wanted to finish my orthodontic treatment, so I contacted them through their page, made an appointment to see the doctor, and discuss the orthodontic treatment plan. ⛔ On April 28, 2025, I met Dr. Ice (the doctor was very helpful). The doctor said that my teeth could start treatment at the clinic, meaning they would remove the braces from the old clinic (okay, understood). I had a lot of cavities; 5 teeth needed fillings, and I also needed scaling and crowns (I was okay with this). After talking to the doctor, I went to talk to the staff at the counter to calculate the expenses I needed to prepare. This staff member took my case form from the doctor. ♦️The 5 teeth that needed fillings cost a total of 💰8,101💰 (a lot, right?), but I was okay with it and would do it gradually. ♦️Crown cost another 💰13,000💰 (done after braces are finished) ⛔That day we removed the braces and cleaned off the glue, costing 💰2,000💰. We bought the 299 baht braces package (the staff only informed us of what was included in this package and that there would be a 10% discount if we had our mouth cleaned there). ♦️They didn't mention that we couldn't use our Gold Card benefits at other clinics. In total, we paid 💰2,299💰 that day. #Before the second appointment, we went for scaling and a filling at a clinic that accepts Gold Card benefits (to reduce costs). So now we only have 4 teeth left to fill. ⛔9/05/68 Same staff member At the registration counter, I informed them I needed two fillings, and everything went smoothly. After the fillings were done, I went to pay. 💰3,780💰 10% discount ⛔15/05/68 There was a *different* employee (this person didn't know the details of my treatment and didn't even read my medical history). She was a bit overweight, heavier than all the other employees in the clinic. When I arrived, I informed them I had an appointment for fillings. (I don't know what happened, but she suddenly asked if this was the person who used the gold card.) The other employees there looked confused, and I didn't know what to say. So I replied that I had already used my gold card to get one filling done, and today I was here to get the remaining one. Then she went on a long rant, saying that I couldn't get fillings done elsewhere because it wouldn't be in line with the doctor's treatment guidelines. #But I haven't even had my braces put on yet!🙄 What is this?? #Her words were like she was a partner in the clinic. She was being overly dramatic, and then she told me I couldn't get the freebies from the 299 baht braces promotion (because I used my gold card elsewhere). But when I booked the promotion, nobody mentioned this condition. I was only informed that there was a 10% discount on oral cleaning here. *I was starting to get annoyed 🙄 Last time I had two fillings here, no staff member said anything. ♦️Finally, I went up to get another filling, then came down to pay at the counter 💰1,200💰 with the 10% discount. Then we immediately found a new clinic. I was very disappointed with this staff member. You weren't the one handling the case, you didn't even know the customer's information. You just kept talking and talking and talking. You didn't ask me if anyone had informed me that I couldn't use my government health insurance from another clinic (I was so angry). If you don't understand the customer, you should at least ask other colleagues about the case, because you weren't the one handling the case from the beginning. ⚠️Initially, the doctor told me that I needed to continue orthodontic treatment for another 20 months.⚠️ But now, I've switched to another clinic because of this staff member. Even though other clinics don't have the 299 baht promotion, I can still afford it.

0x305031fe3438b74b_0xbf218fcaa0db48e8.text: The service was excellent, and I was very impressed with all the staff at the Phuket branch. From the receptionist to the operating room staff and even the wound dressing technician, everything was great. They even offer wound cleaning service, which is great because I'm not confident doing it myself, so I often go to the clinic for them. Jane, the person who took care of me, was wonderful from start to finish. The staff who dressed my wound were so gentle and lovely. During the surgery, the doctor did a great job of reducing my anxiety. I have panic attacks and am prone to worrying, and the doctor really helped me relax during the procedure. I was especially touched when the doctor sang to me during the surgery; it really helped me feel less anxious. Highly recommend! This is my first and only implant, and I hope it stays with me for life. 🫶🏻❤️

0x30e29f58c59e1f2f_0xd814b8f64c475ef4.text: คลีนิคสะอาด พนักงานพูดเพราะ คุณหมอมีความชำนาญการ เดินทางง่ายใกล้รถไฟฟ้าและป้ายรถเมล เลือกจัดฟันที่นี่เพราะคุณหมอให้คำแนะนำดีมีเทคนิคการจัดฟันต่างๆให้เลือกและมีการคำนวนค่าใช้จ่ายให้ก่อนที่จะเริ่มจัดฟัน การทำหัตถการต่างๆใช้สิทธิ์ประกันสังคมได้ และบางช่วงก็จะจัดแคมเปญต่างๆรวมถึงโปรโมชั่นดีๆ ตอนนี้ได้จัดฟันเสร็จแล้วฟันเรียงสวยดีมาก ซึ่งหลังจากจัดเสร็จแล้วคุณหมอยังมีการตามอาการ เช็คสุขภาพช่องปากและให้คำแนะนำในการดูแลช่องปากด้วย การบริการดีแบบโฮ่งแบบตะโกน ไม่มีการรวบตึงผู้ใช้บริการด้วย👍
0x30e29f58c59e1f2f_0xd814b8f64c475ef4.en: The clinic is clean, the staff are polite, and the doctor is highly skilled. It's conveniently located near the BTS Skytrain and bus stops. I chose this clinic for my orthodontic treatment because the doctor provides excellent advice, offers various orthodontic techniques, and calculates the cost before treatment begins. All procedures are covered by social security insurance, and they occasionally have special campaigns and promotions. I've now finished my orthodontic treatment and my teeth are beautifully aligned. Even after the treatment, the doctor followed up, checked my oral health, and provided advice on proper oral care. The service was excellent – ​​not at all pushy or controlling. 👍

0x30e29f58c59e1f2f_0xd814b8f64c475ef4.text: ประทับใจที่นี่มากๆๆ เราจัดฟันที่นี่พื้นฐานคือฟันเก ซ้อนกันหนักมาก ไม่มั่นใจมาเป็นสิบๆปีไม่กล้ายิ้มเพราะอายคน แล้วก็ๆด้มาเจอที่คลินิกนี้ จัดไม่ถึงปี ฟันเข้าที่ไวมาก ของเราเป็นเคสที่ต้องถอน 4ซี่ บนล่าง คุณหมอเก่งมากๆๆ พี่ๆก็บริการดีช่วยเหลือทุกอย่าง พูดเพราะด้วย 💖 ไม่คิดว่าจะเข้าไวแล้วก็ดี เหล็กไม่หลุดเลยตั้งแต่จัดมา 6-7 เดือน ไม่เลี้ยงไข้ คือจัดปุ้ปเห็นผลปั้ป เปลี่ยนเหล็กทุกเดือน มีการเปลี่ยนแปลงดีขึ้นทุกเดือน ดีใจมากก กล้ายิ้มมากขึ้น กล้าคุยไม่อายฟันแล้วค่าา 🦷💖💖💖
0x30e29f58c59e1f2f_0xd814b8f64c475ef4.en: I'm so impressed with this clinic! I got braces here because my teeth were severely crooked and overlapping. For years, I was so self-conscious about my teeth and didn't dare smile because I was embarrassed. Then I found this clinic, and in less than a year, my teeth were straightened so quickly! My case required extractions of 4 teeth, upper and lower. The doctor is incredibly skilled, and the staff are so helpful and kind. 💖 I never thought my teeth would straighten so quickly and be this effective. None of my braces have come loose in the 6-7 months I've been wearing them. They don't prolong treatment unnecessarily; I saw results immediately. They changed the braces every month, and there was improvement every month. I'm so happy! I can smile and talk to people without being ashamed of my teeth anymore! 🦷💖💖💖

0x30e29f58c59e1f2f_0xd814b8f64c475ef4.text: ใช้ประกันสังคม ขูดหินปูนประจำที่นี่ทุกปี ค่ะ หมอมือเบา ราคาไม่แพง บริการดี สนใจอยากดัดฟันเลือกคุณหมอจัดฟันมานาน เห็นผลงานแล้วตัดสินใจจัดฟันต่อกับคุณหมอธนา คุณหมอเป็นมืออาชีพมากค่ะ แก้ปัญหาฟันตรงจุด จัดฟัน งานสวย คนชมเยอะเลยค่ะว่าดูดีขึ้นมากๆ ประทับใจ แนะนำเพื่อนๆที่ทำงานต่อทุกคนประทับใจ^^
0x30e29f58c59e1f2f_0xd814b8f64c475ef4.en: I use my social security insurance and get my teeth cleaned here every year. The dentist is gentle, the prices are affordable, and the service is excellent. I was interested in getting braces and had been looking for an orthodontist for a long time. After seeing his work, I decided to continue my orthodontic treatment with Dr. Thana. He is very professional, addresses my dental problems directly, and the results are beautiful. Many people compliment me on how much better I look. I'm very impressed and have recommended him to my colleagues, who are all also very satisfied.^^

0x30e29f58c59e1f2f_0xd814b8f64c475ef4.text: Professional service for dental care (x-ray, fillings, etc. ) Fully recommend in case you need a dentist, you will pay fair price for great service, as it’s not located in overpriced rent shopping malls, but still easily accessible via BTS- Victory Monument station.
0x30e29f58c59e1f2f_0xd814b8f64c475ef4.author: Tomas Smetana

0x30e29f58c59e1f2f_0xd814b8f64c475ef4.text: ผมมาทำฟันที่นี่ครั้งแรก จากคำแนะนำของเพื่อนร่วมงาน บอกว่าที่นี่บริการดี หมอใจดี ผมแนะนำเพื่อนผมมาทำต่ออีกคน ก็ยังได้รับบริการที่ดีเช่นเคย ผมและเพื่อนเป็นคนต่างชาติไม่ค่อยเข้าใจภาษาไทย แต่พี่พนักงานที่นี่ก็ช่วยผมได้ดีมากๆครับ ขอบคุณที่พบกันครับ

0x30e29f003f8ba4fb_0xa57986c76b58a648.text: 😊👍 เป็นคลินิกที่บริการดีมากเลยค่ะคุณหมอก็น่ารักแนะนำหลายๆเรื่องได้ตรงปัญหาตรงจุดและแนวทางการรักษาและได้ความรู้ใหม่ๆเกียวกับฟันของเราด้วย พนักงานทีคลินิกทุกคนสุภาพเรียบร้อยน่ารักทุกคนเลย 🙏🏻😊❤️

0x30e29f003f8ba4fb_0xa57986c76b58a648.en: I came to get my teeth cleaned (tartar removed) with Dr. Fight after a long time. The doctor did a great job. He communicated with the patient throughout the procedure and was happy to answer all my questions. The staff were also very helpful.

0x30e29f003f8ba4fb_0xa57986c76b58a648.text: ไปอุดฟันมา คุณหมอทำมือเบามากก ละดีมาก มีการแนะนำ อธิบายให้เข้าใจด้วยย คุณหมอใส่ใจสุดๆ แนะนำคลินิกนี้ๆๆ ใกล้ๆมีที่จอดรถสะดวก หมดปัญหาเรื่องที่จอดรถ
0x30e29f003f8ba4fb_0xa57986c76b58a648.en: I went to get a filling. The dentist was very gentle and did a great job. They gave advice and explained everything clearly. The dentist was extremely attentive. I highly recommend this clinic! It's nearby and has convenient parking, so parking isn't a problem anymore.

0x30e29f003f8ba4fb_0xa57986c76b58a648.text: หมอดูแลดีมากค่ะ คลีนิคสะอาดมาก พนักงานพูดจาเพราะ หมอแนะนำตรงจุด ไม่ยัดเยียดให้ทำ ถ้าไม่จำเป็น คลีนิคทำฟันดีบอกต่อค่ะ รอไม่นาน
0x30e29f003f8ba4fb_0xa57986c76b58a648.en: The dentist provided excellent care. The clinic was very clean, and the staff were polite. The dentist gave straightforward advice and didn't pressure me into unnecessary treatments. I would highly recommend this dental clinic. The wait time was short.

0x30e29f003f8ba4fb_0xa57986c76b58a648.text: คลีนิกนี้ดีงามมากค่ะ มีเครื่องเอกซเรย์ 3มิติ เห็นผลชัดเจน หมออธิบายดี ละเอียดและใส่ใจมาก ทำฟันอย่างมืออาชีพมากๆแนะนำจริงๆ
0x30e29f003f8ba4fb_0xa57986c76b58a648.en: This clinic is excellent. They have a 3D X-ray machine that provides clear results. The doctor explains things well, is detailed and very attentive. The dental work is very professional. I highly recommend it.

0x305028a2e7c83857_0x43b0aaa6412bc42c.text: A small but professional clinic conveniently located on the main road next to the Aussie bar in Rawai. I was seen immediately by the very friendly, English speaking nurse who passed me over to speak to the doctor after asking some relevant and intelligent questions. The doctor was very knowledgeable and provided an immediate course of treatment. My follow-up appointment needed further attention but they only charged me for the medicine. This clinic is the perfect option for common medical requirements and is much cheaper than private hospitals that are located much further away.
0x305028a2e7c83857_0x43b0aaa6412bc42c.author: Kieron

0x305028a2e7c83857_0x43b0aaa6412bc42c.text: The service from andaman clinic is outstanding. Doctor sakda ruamrungsee and his lovely wife are doing their best to help us all. Yesterday I broad a friend from Switzerland having some problems with his feet there, and the doctor came right away from his home to give a hand. Much appreciated his actions and we are all happy now. Even myself been there for many years for different services and everytime I could feel the kindness of the hole team. I can highly recommend andaman clinic at all times. Captain Domiinic doerig
0x305028a2e7c83857_0x43b0aaa6412bc42c.author: Dominic Doerig

0x305028a2e7c83857_0x43b0aaa6412bc42c.text: Getting pneumonia in Thailand is very dangerous. When I stumbled into Andaman Healthcare Clinic in Rawai, I could barely walk to the back rooms for treatment. Dr. Sakda quickly diagnosed my condition and recognised it was pneumonia. He immediately gave me the right injections and put me on a three-day course that helped me recover quickly. While it still takes time to fully heal from this kind of illness, I’m incredibly grateful that Dr. Sakda and his team were there when I needed them. Thank you so much.
0x305028a2e7c83857_0x43b0aaa6412bc42c.author: Rohan Watt

0x305028a2e7c83857_0x43b0aaa6412bc42c.text: Been coming to the Andaman clinic for about 5 years now The doctor here is incredibly knowledgeable and speaks excellent English and always very clear on what the problem is. I've maybe used the clinic 5+ times during this period including a very minor skin procedure with stitches. Every time I've been, I've always felt better quickly and received the correct treatment. Would definitely highly recommend
0x305028a2e7c83857_0x43b0aaa6412bc42c.author: Ry Vin Diesel

0x305028a2e7c83857_0x43b0aaa6412bc42c.text: What a lovely Doctor and he knows what he is doing. Not like in some of the better hospitals here where they put you in hospital for 3 days no matter what’s wrong ... as long as you have insurance. I had stomach cramps. He checked me out thoroughly. Gave me an injection and pills. More importantly he explained the problem. Highly recommend him if you are staying in the south of Phuket
0x305028a2e7c83857_0x43b0aaa6412bc42c.author: Susanne Ultmann

0x305028a2e7c83857_0x43b0aaa6412bc42c.text: Andaman Clinic is an excellent facility, Dr Sakda is a very pleasant caring man, he is thorough in his examination, informative with his diagnosis. I had the misfortune of becoming dehydrated and both the nurse and doctor were outstanding and soon had me back in my feet. Definitely a far better option for non critical medical requirements than the international hospitals.

0x305028a2e7c83857_0x43b0aaa6412bc42c.text: RUN AWAY, HE'S A CHARLATIST! I came to this clinic from Hua Hin (650 km) for a cortisone injection recommended by my French doctor, as no other treatment has worked since April. This injection was supposed to be administered by infiltration, and the syringe, which was ready to inject, only contained 1 ml of cortisone. However, I saw the assistant prepare an injection, filling it almost halfway, and then the doctor supposedly gave me the injection. It was done in less than 2 seconds, and I didn't even feel the slightest prick. Injecting that much product in 2 seconds is impossible. Furthermore, he didn't even disinfect with alcohol beforehand. 0x30e29f5a2466d167_0x1f59d477fb918e37.text: The clinic is stunning—modern, clean, and very welcoming. The whole place gives off a calming vibe, which really helps if you’re feeling a bit nervous. I came in to get a composite filling for a chipped tooth, and I was a little anxious at first, worried it might be painful. But the dentist was incredibly gentle and attentive, making sure I was comfortable throughout. They explained what they were doing at every step, which put me at ease and made the whole experience feel less daunting. When it was done, I was honestly amazed by the result. The filling matched my natural tooth so perfectly that I had to compare it with old photos to even remember which tooth had been chipped! The color blend is flawless, and it looks just like my original tooth. On top of that, the dentist gave me great advice on how to take care of my teeth moving forward, which really shows how much they care about their patients even after the procedure. I highly recommend!

0x30e284f272fb914b_0xf3d3e03a6cfbd5c4.text: Based on your review, Im kira: As I was the doctor who examined you today, Im kira, you were a new patient who hadn't made a prior appointment. You needed teeth cleaning. The counter staff inserted you into the queue for an examination to determine if you could be treated by a general dentist. After the examination, it was found that you have periodontitis [commonly known as gum disease], requiring treatment with scaling and root planing by a specialist. This requires a new appointment. I explained the treatment procedure and the approximate cost to you personally and advised you to inquire about the appointment date, time, and detailed cost with the counter again. The fact that you have periodontitis necessitates treatment from a specialist because the treatment procedure requires local anesthesia to prevent pain, as all tartar needs to be removed both above and below the gums. Because our clinic has a team of specialist dentists in each field, to best benefit our patients, it is necessary to examine and diagnose patients before referring them. Therefore, patients who come on that day may not receive treatment on the same day.

After the ice bath, we continued with a sound bath. I think it was amazing. It felt like clearing my energy and helping me refocus. It was very relaxing, and I slept well when I got home. 0x30da31e94c0d36ef_0xa98468c69f6e10d7.text: It's extremely difficult to contact the attending vet directly; it's almost impossible. You have to call the central office, and then they'll coordinate. The cat ward definitely doesn't have anyone watching 24/7. From my experience visiting my cat, the cat ward is very enclosed. You wouldn't know how your cat is unless you went inside. If your cat really needs to be admitted, I'd say move it. I admitted my cat for just one night. The next morning, the vet informed me that my cat had stopped breathing because a staff member fed it and it choked on food, causing shock and respiratory arrest. Was there any staff member there? How long did the cat stop breathing? How many minutes later were they seen? The cat certainly didn't vomit immediately after eating. I'm still bothered by this. I'd love to see the CCTV footage, but that's probably difficult. Even the vet is hard to contact. My cat stayed in the intensive care unit for another two days. The cat wasn't doing well, and the attending vet and the intensive care unit vet disagreed on whether to give it anti-seizure medication. The attending vet wanted it, but the intensive care unit vet didn't. In the end, they gave it at 9 PM. The cat received the medication, but it was too late. The cat had already had seizures that morning, and its brain was severely damaged. The treatment process was very slow and unprofessional. I'm extremely disappointed with this hospital. My recommendation is: if you bring your dog or cat for symptomatic treatment and don't need admission, I strongly advise against it. I think there are many doctors here, and many specialists. But the service is very slow. Even though our cat had a slot with a professor doctor, we were still transferred to another doctor. However, the doctor who took over the case seemed very dedicated to providing care. But regarding other services, such as boarding, don't transfer your cat to another hospital. At least at other hospitals, you can talk directly to the doctor, request to see CCTV footage, and the boarding area has someone watching 24/7. There aren't as many rules as here. Our cat stayed at this hospital for 3 days and it cost over 10,000 baht. It's not cheap at all. I recommend going somewhere else based on my honest experience.

0x30da3a9fdf6eb275_0x6a6a54a132bf1f30.text: รีวิวคลินิกทันตกรรมหมอวรพจน์ (รักษากับคุณหมอบีม) ผมเพิ่งไปผ่าฟันคุดล่างและถอนฟันคุดบนกับ คุณหมอบีม มาวันนี้ ต้องบอกเลยว่าประทับใจมาก ตั้งแต่ก้าวแรกที่เข้าไปจนทำเสร็จ กลายเป็นประสบการณ์ผ่าฟันคุดที่ดีแบบคาดไม่ถึงครับ คุณหมอบีมอธิบายทุกขั้นตอนละเอียด ชัดเจน เข้าใจง่าย ตั้งแต่ดูผลเอกซเรย์ วิเคราะห์ตำแหน่งฟันคุด ไปจนถึงความเสี่ยงต่าง ๆ (ผมอายุ 33 และเป็นเบาหวาน หมอก็ให้คำแนะนำอย่างระมัดระวังมาก) ก่อนผ่า หมอเช็กความดัน อธิบายทุกอย่างอย่างใจเย็น และบอกทุกจังหวะว่าจะทำอะไรต่อ ทำให้สบายใจมาก ไม่กังวลเลย ยาชาฉีด 2 รอบเพื่อให้ชาครอบคลุมจริง ๆ รอบแรกก็ชาแล้ว แต่หมอใส่ใจมากจนอยากให้ริมฝีปากชาด้วยเพื่อความสบายตอนผ่า พอเริ่มผ่า…บอกเลยว่า มือหมอเบามาก ฟันคุดล่างของผม “นอน” ด้วย แต่ใช้เวลาไม่ถึง 10 นาทีเท่านั้น พอเสร็จ หมอถามว่าถอนไปเลยไหม ผมก็ตกลง และฟันคุดบนใช้เวลาไม่ถึง 1 นาที ก็เรียบร้อย ตลอดการทำ หมอพูดกับผมตลอด “ตรงนี้จะได้ยินเสียงดังนะครับ” “ตรงนี้จะรู้สึกดันนิด ๆ นะครับ” “อีกนิดเดียวครับ เก่งมากครับ” ฟีลลิ่งดีมาก เหมือนหมอจับจังหวะคนไข้ได้ดีและละเอียดจริง ๆ หลังทำเสร็จ คุณหมอบีม สรุปการปฏิบัติตัวหลังผ่าอีกรอบละเอียดมาก รวมถึงให้ผ้าก๊อต ยา และนัดตัดไหมเรียบร้อย เรื่องราคา ผมถือว่า แฟร์มาก ๆ X-ray: 500 บาท ผ่าฟันคุดล่าง + ถอนฟันคุดบน: 3,700 บาท (รวมตัดไหมแล้ว) ค่ายา: 40 บาท รวมทั้งหมดคือคุ้มมากเมื่อเทียบกับงานละเอียดและความใส่ใจที่ได้รับ ใครที่กลัวหมอฟัน กลัวเจ็บ หรือเคยมีประสบการณ์ผ่าฟันคุดแย่ ๆ มาก่อน ผมแนะนำคุณหมอบีมจริง ๆ ครับ มือเบา ใจดี อธิบายเก่ง ทำไว ทำดี และปลอดภัยมาก ⭐ ผ่าเสร็จแล้วเดินออกมาด้วยความรู้สึกว่า “ดีจังที่มาที่นี่” ประทับใจจริง ๆ ครับ 🙏💚

0x30da3a9fdf6eb275_0x6a6a54a132bf1f30.en: Review of Dr. Woraphot's Dental Clinic (Treatment with Dr. Beam) I recently had my lower wisdom tooth extracted and my upper wisdom tooth removed by Dr. Beam today. I must say, I was very impressed. From the moment I walked in until the procedure was complete, it was an unexpectedly positive wisdom tooth extraction experience. Dr. Beam explained every step in detail, clearly, and in an easy-to-understand way, from reviewing the X-rays and analyzing the wisdom tooth's position to the various risks involved (I am 33 years old and have diabetes, and the doctor gave very careful advice). Before the surgery, the doctor checked my blood pressure, explained everything calmly, and told me exactly what he was going to do next, which made me feel very comfortable and not anxious at all. He injected the anesthetic twice to ensure complete numbness. The first injection was enough, but the doctor was so attentive that he even wanted my lips to be numb for added comfort during the surgery. Once the surgery began… I must say, the doctor's touch was incredibly gentle. My lower wisdom tooth was also "lying" (intermittently), but it took less than 10 minutes. Afterward, the doctor asked if I wanted to have it extracted completely, which I agreed to. The upper wisdom tooth took less than a minute to complete. The doctor spoke to me throughout the procedure. “You’ll hear a loud sound here.” “You’ll feel a slight push here.” “Just a little more. Excellent!” The feeling was great. It was like the doctor was perfectly timed and meticulous. After the procedure, Dr. Beam gave a very detailed post-operative instruction summary. He also provided gauze, medication, and scheduled an appointment for suture removal. Regarding the price, I think it was very fair. 0x30da3a9fdf6eb275_0x6a6a54a132bf1f30.text: Today I went to the doctor for gingivitis. The doctor diagnosed it as tartar buildup causing swollen gums and pus. He recommended getting a tartar removal after my braces are removed and just gave me medication. That's it!!! But I went because it was swollen and painful, making it impossible to eat. I asked if the pus could be removed (my understanding, as someone who isn't a doctor, was that pus wouldn't just go away with medication; I thought it should be removed). I'd been to another clinic before where the doctor examined me, said it was due to food particles, then injected local anesthetic, drained the pus, cleaned my tooth, and gave me mouthwash and oral medication. It cleared up in 1-2 days. After asking if the pus could be removed, the doctor here said yes. They removed the pus using a special instrument, pressing it out of the gum without any anesthetic. They pressed very hard and repeatedly; it was incredibly painful and agonizing. I cried uncontrollably on the operating table with my mouth open. It was embarrassing, but I couldn't hold back. I just burst into tears. Even without gingivitis, I would have felt pain, but this was the most excruciating pain I've ever experienced in my life – the kind of pain that makes you unable to eat. The doctor here is terrible. She's a young doctor who seems inexperienced. Why would they hire her when this is a famous clinic in Chiang Mai? I went because someone recommended it, saying it's been open for a long time, but this is the worst dental clinic experience I've ever had.

0x30e29f7d05adb82b_0xe1ac2143b0b4f3fe.text: Through a referral from a Thai hair transplant service in Japan, I underwent a no-shave, 2500-graft FUE hair transplant at HAIR RESTORE BY DHT CLINIC during the May holidays. DHT CLINIC was a clean and comfortable clinic. The medical questionnaire was in English, and another male patient was also there, and they kindly explained everything to me, allowing me to undergo the surgery. Thank you so much. While Japanese anesthesia can be painful, DHT CLINIC administered the anesthetic after cooling the area, so there was no pain during graft harvesting and implantation, which was reassuring. During the surgery, there were breaks, and I was given khao man gai, snacks, juice, and bottled water each time. During the surgery, I was kindly allowed to use the restroom about five times, showing consideration for the burden and pain of the surgery. A nurse gave me a full-body massage. Despite the burden of the surgery and my hands being sore from the massage, their kindness and consideration allowed me to undergo the surgery with peace of mind. Thank you so much. The following day, the aftercare was very warm, and the massage nurse kindly lent me a portable fan. Despite it being a day off, they provided kind, gentle, and thorough treatment and explained everything in translation. I had two unsatisfactory hair transplant surgeries in Japan, but at DHT CLINIC, I was able to recover from those two failures with their state-of-the-art hair transplant surgery. I believe that if I had chosen DHT CLINIC from the beginning, the grafts wouldn't have been wasted. They also showed concern for my post-operative progress, and I receive monthly post-operative photos. To everyone at HAIR RESTORE BY DHT CLINIC: You welcomed me, a foreigner, with a smile, and provided kind, gentle, and thorough care. The pain and downtime were minimized, and I was able to receive state-of-the-art hair transplant surgery with great satisfaction and peace of mind before returning home. Thank you so much.

Incidentally, I also had a consultation at a well-known clinic in Shinjuku, Tokyo, but frankly speaking, I felt that DHT was on a completely different level in terms of "service," "attentiveness," and "technique" (and the price was reasonable too!). If you're worried about your hair, I highly recommend it. When your confidence returns, your mindset changes too. If you're hesitating, please take that first step. It will change your life. I had a hair transplant at DHT Clinic, and now, 7 months later… it’s honestly incredible. My hair is noticeably thicker, fuller, and healthier — I’m beyond satisfied. 0x30e29f7d05adb82b_0xe1ac2143b0b4f3fe.text: This was my second time getting an FUE surgery. The first time, I had it done elsewhere, and sadly, the result did not meet my expectations. This time, I took my time researching reputable doctors in Thailand and several names came up, including Dr. Pathovamich and Dr. Laoorwong. Initially, I considered getting the surgery from either of these two doctors, but during further research, I discovered Dr. Ramida. Although she is still young and has less experience in the hair transplant field, a quick search reveals she has won many awards in this area. Dr. Ramida is actually a student of Dr. Pathovamich. Impressively, Dr. Ramida is the first Thai to achieve the rank of number one in the world in the field of hair transplantation. My whole experience, from consultation to the transplant, was perfect. All of the staff were very generous. After the surgery, one staff member (sorry, I forgot the name) even walked me to my hotel. I was able to sleep through most of the procedure as there was no pain (the first time I had it done elsewhere, it was very painful). I just got the transplant yesterday, so I can't comment on the results yet, but I have a very good feeling it will turn out well this time. I asked the staff why they don't have many reviews on Google, and she told me that they are a branch of the DHT clinic and they just opened about a year ago. I think Dr. Ramida will become well-known in this field very soon. I am glad that I was able to get it done by her.

0x30fdabe786cbe597_0xed60d4369bcc806a.text: I took my Forpus parrot to the vet, and the price was exorbitant. The vet was terribly rude, even cursing my bird and saying it could die right then and there. Why would I bring it to the vet if that's the case? We brought it to get better, not to die! I've raised many birds, and I know what happens if a bird is going to die. I don't understand why they would lie. They said admission was the only option and made me sign a document refusing treatment, with a note stating that they had informed me of the risk of death. The price for the first day's admission was 8,500 baht, and then 3,000 baht per day thereafter. Even large animal hospitals in Bangkok don't charge that much, and they have better equipment and facilities. The total cost for medication and treatment that day was 3,300 baht, which is the most expensive I've ever seen. It felt like I was scammed because when I showed the X-ray films to a specialist veterinarian in Bangkok, they said the films were almost unreadable and not clear enough. The vet didn't seem to have enough knowledge of treating exotic animals, yet claimed they could treat my bird. From the first sentence, I knew all birds need deworming medication once a year. Forpus parrots eat grains, so where would they get parasites from? And the price they charged was completely contrary to their knowledge. The vet tried to psychologically manipulate us by saying the animal was going to die, trying to trick us into admitting it, which was really not okay. It felt like we were being deceived and I felt terrible and disappointed. It made it seem like we lacked knowledge. People who keep exotic animals do enough research; they don't just keep them haphazardly. We don't just believe everything the vet says. If anyone is planning to take an exotic animal to this hospital, I would not recommend it. The prices are exorbitant, and the animal might die because the vet is essentially cursing the animal.
0x30fdabe786cbe597_0xed60d4369bcc806a.author: Aum Kesara

Highly recommended for anyone dealing with similar issues!

Upon returning to his residence, he radioed one of his personal dentists to send a patient with a toothache for treatment. The dentist eagerly awaited the patient. 0x30e29ed700000001_0x978284a9b3b0f200.text: I have had two surgerys with this surgeon. An initial rhinoplasty which I wasn't happy with and then a revision rhinoplasty that was even worse than the first surgery. Both times I gave him photos of what I'd like my nose to look like. He assured me that he would be able to give me what I wanted but completely missed the mark. I have had a large pimple on my nose since he took the cast off. I was told that it would be gone in a week, years later im still dealing with it. It constantly gets inflamed and puss comes out from it. I also have a 1cm by 1cm lump on one side of my nose that is very noticeable. It gets really sore and harder when the weather changes. Since my revision I had emailed his clinic a few times. Every time they would ask me to send photos, I would do so and then I'd get a request to send more photos or never hear from them again. I recently saw him again while I was holidaying in Bangkok to enquire about a second revision rhinoplasty. He did not acknowledge that there was anything wrong with my nose or that there had been any mistakes made by himself. He was more interested in telling me that I had put on allot of weight since he had last saw me, I was shocked when he said that and explained that I had put on weight from being depressed since he ruined my nose. He then told me wanted to widen my nose as it looks feminine. When I asked him if he would he use rib cartlidge, he told be he planned on using cartlidge from a donar bank. Which I can only assume would come from a deceased person. I was then quoted a ridiculous amount of money for a second revision rhinoplasty. When I told the nurse who quoted me the price that I wasn't happy with the high price she said the only way to bring it down was to have the surgery done under a local anaesthetic instead of general. I can't imagine anything worse than lying there awake while he operated on me. I told her that if I was going to pay again, I might aswell just go to another surgeon that could give me what I wanted. When I was paying for the first revision his head nurse (shower cap) assured me that he would get it right and if he didn't that the next revision would be free. While in Bangkok I went to consults at two international Hospitals and with two private surgeons. No one wanted to touch my nose as they said it looked like it may be infected and they did not know what they would find when they opened it up. One surgeon said it might take two separate operations to fix it. Don't fall for the marketing like I did. I had read posts online claiming that he is the "Michael Angelo of the nose". I went in for a Michael Angelo and came out with a Pablo Picasso. It goes to show that going to the most expensive surgeon in Bangkok does not mean they are the best or does it guarantee a good result. Overall a terrible experience. That I would not wish upon anyone.

0x311d5da85ebff6cf_0x755925b33ecc6d29.text: Last time to treat and use the service here ☹️ (It's a bit long, please consider) - Took my cat to the clinic for a bath and haircut at around 10.20 am. The staff said it would be a bit slow. We were okay with that (according to “our” understanding, a bit slow should be around 3 hours). When we got there, there was no queue for a bath before. We took her earlier than this and the shop said the technician would arrive at 10.00 am. - Called at 12.14 pm, the shop said the bath was not finished yet. - Went at 13.50 pm, the shop said they just dried her hair ??? - At 14.40 pm, called several times, the shop didn't pick up. - At 14.50 pm, decided to pick her up even though she wasn't finished because we didn't want her to be thirsty and hungry for that long. The shop called back and said she wasn't finished yet, so we should pick her up at 16.00 pm. ??? - When we arrived at the shop, she looked depressed. The staff didn't seem happy and didn't smile. They carried her and the first sentence was "Next time, bring your bag with you." The cat was in a bad mood when holding it. “Speaking nicely but with an expressionless face The question is - Why blame the cat? Working with animals, don’t you really know that animals must be hungry after taking such a long time to bathe and cut their fur? - Why did the shop take so long and it’s still not finished? What are you doing? - If you said the cat was in a bad mood and couldn’t cut it, why didn’t you call to let us pick it up? Why did you force it to cut it? - Didn’t you estimate the time for the animal? You took it to bathe and cut its fur in the morning and planned to cut it until the evening? How would the animal survive? Would it be hungry if you were yourself? I really wonder. - How long does the shop normally take to bathe and cut a cat? Based on other shops that have queues, they don’t take this long. - If the shop honestly informed us what the problem was that it took so long or that they weren’t ready to cut its fur, they would happily pick it up but it’s not okay to work for so long and blame the animal for being in a bad mood. ——————————————————————————— ** I use this shop regularly because it’s the closest to my house. The staff remembers the names of my dogs and cats every time I take them there. ** What’s surprising is that when my cat comes to bathe regularly, they should know that it’s not fierce at all. Normally, it doesn’t bite unless it’s hurt or locked up for a long time. This is normal for animals. Why was it okay to bathe in the past? ** Other shops that I have bathed my dog have never had any problems. ** Many times, the shop forgot to cut its nails, clean its ears, and there were frequent mistakes. But I tried not to worry because I wanted to find a place close to home and I thought it wasn't a big deal. ** The condition of my dog's fur recently was as bad as I thought. As the shop said, it wasn't finished cutting yet, but I chose to take my dog home because I felt sorry for him. He looked very hungry, and when we got home, he immediately ran to eat as I thought. Pros: - The doctor spoke well, seemed kind, and was always lovely. The service was good. - Cheap price. Cons: As described above, and you have to be prepared for the staff's facial expressions. The service is according to the price.
0x311d5da85ebff6cf_0x755925b33ecc6d29.author: irada Prakobkij

0x311d659faa2b6353_0xa669f536323815d9.text: มาใช้บริการทั้งหมด 7 ครั้ง (ตั้งแต่ตุลา 67-เมษา68) ใช้บริการการจัดฟันรอบที่ 2 บอกเลยว่าไม่เคยเจออะไรที่เคยเจอที่คลินิคแรกมาก่อนเลย ไม่ว่าจะเป็นการบริการ ลำดับขั้นตอนต่างๆ การ inform ข้อมูลคนไข้ การส่งเวรระหว่างหมอและคนไข้ และอื่นๆ -ในฐานะคนทำงานบริการ เป็น customer service ในอุตสาหกรรมทางการแพทย์เหมือนกัน ขอติเรื่องการบริการค่ะ ผู้ช่วยหมอพูดจาดีมาก พนักงานต้อนรับที่ใส่ฮิญาบและคนที่ใส่แมสบริการดีมาก แต่อีกคนพูดจาและท่าทางแย่สุดๆ เจอมา 2 รอบให้หลังแย่ทุกรอบ ชักสีหน้า พูดจาห้วนๆ รอยยิ้มไม่มี คุณไม่มี service mind อย่างแรง -เรื่องการส่งเวรระหว่างหมอและผู้ช่วย หรือหมอและพนักงานต้อนรับ (ไม่แน่ใจว่ามีลำดับขั้นยังไง) แต่ขออนุญาตติ เพราะมาทราบข้อมูลสำคัญจากพนักงานต้อนรับไม่ใช่หมอ อยู่ๆพนักงานต้อนรับแจ้งว่ามีอุดฟัน 3 ซี่ (ในการใช้บริการครั้งที่ 6 เดือนมีนา) ทั้งๆที่พึ่งเคลียร์ช่องปากไปไม่ถึงครึ่งปี และหมอก็ไม่ได้แจ้งในห้องตรวจ แถมพอเราโต้งไปว่าหมอไม่ได้แจ้ง พนักงานต้อนรับก็ชักสีหน้าและพูดว่า ก็หมอเขียนมาแบบนี้ พอเราถามซ้ำ มีเจ้าหน้าที่อีกคนมาช่วยดู ถึงคอนเฟิร์มให้ว่าไม่มีอุดฟันแล้ว งงค่ะ สรุปคือยังไง ข้อมูลคุณไม่ชัดเจน หรือหมอลง diag ผิดคน หรือยังไง ไม่รู้ต้องไม่ประทับใจอะไรก่อน -เรื่อง process การรักษา: พึ่งอุดฟันไปเดือนมกราคม จู่ๆเดือนเมษามาแจ้งว่าให้อุดฟัน เช็คช่องปากตัวเองก็ปกติดี มีหินปูนบ้างนิดหน่อยแต่ไม่แย่เหมือนตอนมกราคม (ที่เรารีเควสขูดไปเอง) แต่นี่หินปูนน้อยมาก จู่ๆจะให้ขูด มันเป็น process การรักษา หรือยังไงนะคะ? เดินออกคลีนิคครั้งล่าสุดมามีแต่คำถาม จะลองให้โอกาสใช้บริการอีกรอบ ถ้ายังแย่อีกจะย้ายคลีนิคแล้วค่ะ ไม่ไหวจริงๆ
0x311d659faa2b6353_0xa669f536323815d9.author: Lyna Mw
0x311d659faa2b6353_0xa669f536323815d9.en: I used their services a total of 7 times (from October 2024 to April 2025). This was my second round of orthodontic treatment, and I can honestly say I never experienced anything like what I encountered at my first clinic. This includes the service, the procedures, the way patients are informed, the handover between doctors and patients, and more. -As someone who works in customer service in the medical industry, I'd like to criticize the service. The doctor's assistant was very polite. The receptionist wearing a hijab and the one wearing a mask provided excellent service. However, another person had the worst attitude and demeanor. I've encountered her twice recently, and both times she was unpleasant. She made faces, spoke abruptly, and didn't smile. She has absolutely no service mind. -Regarding the handover between the doctor and assistant, or the doctor and receptionist (I'm not sure of the hierarchy), I'd like to criticize the process. I received important information from a receptionist, not a doctor. Suddenly, the receptionist informed me that I had 3 fillings (during my 6th visit in March), even though I had just had my mouth cleared less than half a year ago, and the doctor hadn't mentioned this in the examination room. When I pointed this out, the receptionist made a face and said, "That's what the doctor wrote." When I asked again, another staff member came to check. I'm confused after they confirmed that there are no more fillings needed. What's the conclusion? Is your information unclear, or did the doctor diagnose the wrong person, or what? I don't know what to be dissatisfied with first. -Regarding the treatment process: I just had a filling in January, and suddenly in April they're saying I need another filling. My oral checkup looks normal; there's a little tartar, but not as bad as in January (when I requested a scaling). But this time, there's very little tartar, and suddenly they want me to get a scaling. Is this part of the treatment process or what? I left the clinic with many questions. I'll try giving them another chance, but if it's still bad, I'll switch clinics. I really can't take it anymore.

0x30e2954df5d15e2b_0x3c6fcc068c4d1b19.en: Terrible. They were only after money from start to finish. They charged for everything. If you're not going to provide good service like this, you shouldn't even open a clinic.

0x30e28f95b0a441f1_0xb3c3ef97bffaa560.en: The doctor gave excellent advice. I had my orthodontic treatment here and now it's finished. The doctor scheduled follow-up appointments every 6 months, which helped me stay disciplined and take care of my teeth regularly.

0x30e28f95b0a441f1_0xb3c3ef97bffaa560.text: คุณหมอให้คำแนะนำดีมาก มือนิ่มมากๆ ครับอัธยาศัยดีมาก มีของให้กลับบ้านด้วย และ น่ารักครับ
0x30e28f95b0a441f1_0xb3c3ef97bffaa560.author: Pruek Posuk
0x30e28f95b0a441f1_0xb3c3ef97bffaa560.en: The doctor gave excellent advice, had very gentle hands, and was very friendly. They even gave me something to take home, and they were lovely.

0x30e28f95b0a441f1_0xb3c3ef97bffaa560.text: คุณหมอให้ข้อมูลและคำแนะนำเกี่ยวกับการรักษาได้ดี สามารถตอบคำถามและให้คำปรึกษาได้อย่างละเอียด จึงได้แนะนำให้คุณแม่มาใช้บริการด้วย อย่างไรก็ตาม คุณแม่เป็นผู้สูงอายุและค่อนข้างกังวลกับขั้นตอนการพิมพ์ฟันเพื่อทำฟันปลอม แม้ว่าคุณหมอจะพยายามอธิบาย แต่จังหวะการสื่อสารและการดำเนินการอาจค่อนข้างรวดเร็วสำหรับผู้ป่วยที่ต้องการเวลาในการทำความเข้าใจและการปรับตัว และในขั้นตอนการพิมพ์ฟัน มีการใช้วัสดุในปริมาณค่อนข้างมากจนล้นออกมาพอสมควร และเกือบไหลลงคอ ทำให้คุณแม่รู้สึกไม่สบายตัวระหว่างทำหัตถการ ททำให้บรรยากาศในวันนั้นอาจทำให้คนไข้รู้สึกกดดันมากกว่ารู้สึกได้รับการปลอบโยนหรือสร้างความมั่นใจ อย่างไรก็ตาม โดยรวมยังถือว่าเป็นประสบการณ์ที่ดี และชื่นชมในความรู้ ความใส่ใจ และความตั้งใจของคุณหมอในการให้คำปรึกษา เพียงแต่อยากสะท้อนประสบการณ์ในวันที่เข้ารับบริการไว้เป็นข้อเสนอแนะค่ะ
0x30e28f95b0a441f1_0xb3c3ef97bffaa560.author: Titipada Kaewjarus
0x30e28f95b0a441f1_0xb3c3ef97bffaa560.en: The doctor provided good information and advice about the treatment, answered questions thoroughly, and offered detailed consultations. Therefore, I recommended this clinic to my mother. However, my mother is elderly and quite apprehensive about the process of taking dental impressions for dentures. Although the doctor tried to explain, the communication and procedure were quite fast-paced for a patient who needs time to understand and adjust. Furthermore, during the impression-taking process, a considerable amount of material was used, overflowing and almost flowing down her throat, causing my mother discomfort during the procedure. This created an atmosphere that may have made the patient feel more pressured than comforted or reassured. Nevertheless, overall, it was a positive experience, and I appreciate the doctor's knowledge, attentiveness, and dedication in providing consultation. I just wanted to share my experience from that day as a suggestion.

0x30e29ecde8e29203_0xf461befafc37af4d.text: I went on a visit on 11/10/2024 due to tooth pain is totally unbearable. BTW, this dental was my 2nd option, after consulting first dental that refused to do anything, insisted that i go country and as a foreigner, i’m helpless because i’m in so much pain. Im pretty thankful & grateful & to be able to meet dentist Pichet Wongsolisuween (Hopefully i spell his name correct) Who did the extra mile for me to get rid of my pain 100% , after his professional service, i felt so much better & enjoyed thru my next 3 days in BKK. Special shout out to this dentist! 🤩 No regrets walking into this clinic & meeting such an awesome dentist! Credit to the team that was with him on 11/10/2024. Thank you everyone 🙏🙏🙏🙏
0x30e29ecde8e29203_0xf461befafc37af4d.author: ANG ZI XIN

0x30e29ecde8e29203_0xf461befafc37af4d.text: I was here in Bangkok on vacation when my crown suddenly fell out while I was eating dinner. I was able to call Dent@paragon and schedule an appointment for the next day at noon to fix it. I didn’t have a Thai phone number, so they communicated with me through WhatsApp. The appointment overall went really smoothly! The doctor spoke English well and talked me through each step. The pricing was also very fair considering I don’t have health insurance here. Thank you to Dent@paragon for letting me enjoy the rest of my vacation worry-free and with all of my teeth!!
0x30e29ecde8e29203_0xf461befafc37af4d.author: Carrie Lin

0x30e29ecde8e29203_0xf461befafc37af4d.text: I’m very Thankfull to this lady in front counter for your kind help today. My teeth Suddenly feel hurt a lot last night. As foreigner I’m urgently look any dental doctor near siam. But cannot get any appointment. Try to visit This dental clinic dent@paragon and meet this lady in receptionist. She is very care and want to help me a lot (very difficult find such person nowdays in any clinic or hospital). I’m very Thankfull to the doctor and lady at front counter for helping me today. God bless you all.
