0x30e29ecde8e29203_0xf461befafc37af4d.text: I have been a patient at Dent Paragon for many years and have always had excellent, professional care and treatment of my teeth. I have always felt confident that the wonderful dentists make the right decisions for me and give me the best advice for self care. The dentists and staff are kind and welcoming and so a trip to my dentist is a happy one!
0x30e29ecde8e29203_0xf461befafc37af4d.author: Elizabeth Hughes

0x30e29ecde8e29203_0xf461befafc37af4d.text: I was very impressed with the care and advice from the staff here. The doctor was lovely and very attentive. I highly recommend this place. It's worth coming here for treatment and dental care for the whole family. I'm extremely impressed!
0x30e29ecde8e29203_0xf461befafc37af4d.author: yingyooy yooy

0x30e29ecde8e29203_0xf461befafc37af4d.text: Wonderful treatment. From the entrance with the kind knowledgeable receptionist to the doctor. As travelers that are leaving the city tomorrow we came very worried and received a proper esthetic temporary solution. Thank you very much
0x30e29ecde8e29203_0xf461befafc37af4d.author: Galit Nahum Leumi

0x30e29ecde8e29203_0xf461befafc37af4d.text: I’ve been coming to Dent@paragon since COVID. Since I come from America, it’s great to have them speak perfect English and explain in detail what they are cleaning. The dentists are extremely knowledgeable. I highly recommend!
0x30e29ecde8e29203_0xf461befafc37af4d.author: Mark G

0x311d650041aced89_0xe2a7f701b019c4e2.text: ไม่เคยทำฟันที่ไหนแล้วเอ็นจอยได้ขนาดนี้เลยค่ะ คุณหมอน่ารักและเป็นกันเองมากๆ(แถมมือเบาสุดๆ)ปรึกษาปัญหาฟันได้ทุกเรื่องจริงๆ มีคำแนะนำและทางเลือกในการรักษาฟันให้อีกด้วย รวมไปถึงพี่หน้าเคาน์เตอร์และพี่ผู้ช่วยคุณหมอ บริการดีน่ารักกันทุกคนเลย คิดว่าในอนาคตมาซ้ำโปรแกรมอื่นอีกแน่นอน เป็นคลินิกเปิดใหม่ที่อยากให้ทุกคนมาลองกันนะคะ มีโปรดีๆอีกมากมายเลยค่ะ โซจึ้ง!!
0x311d650041aced89_0xe2a7f701b019c4e2.en: I've never enjoyed a dental visit this much! The dentist was so lovely and friendly (and incredibly gentle!). You can consult them about any dental problems, and they'll give you advice and treatment options. The reception staff and the dentist's assistants were all wonderful and provided excellent service. I'll definitely be back for other treatments in the future. This is a newly opened clinic that I highly recommend everyone try. They have many great promotions! Amazing!!

0x311d650041aced89_0xe2a7f701b019c4e2.text: คุณหมออีฟมือเบามาก ทำให้หายกลัวและกังวล (ปกติกลัวหมอฟันและการทำฟันมาก)ให้คำอธิบาย คำแนะนำเข้าใจง่าย รอยยิ้มของหมอ และคำถามตลอดว่าเจ็บไหม อบอุ่น และไม่เจ็บเลยค่ะ แนะนำคลีนิคนี้ดีจริงๆ
0x311d650041aced89_0xe2a7f701b019c4e2.author: sasiya thipsuk
0x311d650041aced89_0xe2a7f701b019c4e2.en: Dr. Eve has a very gentle touch, which helped alleviate my fear and anxiety (I'm usually terrified of dentists and dental procedures). Her explanations and advice were easy to understand. Her smile and constant questions about whether it hurt were heartwarming, and the procedure itself was painless. I highly recommend this clinic.

0x311d650041aced89_0xe2a7f701b019c4e2.text: คลินิกเปิดใหม่ใกล้บ้านไปมาสะดวก ร้านสะอาด มีที่จอดรถ มีคุณหมอเฉพาะทางฟันคุด มารับบริการ คุณหมอฟรีค่าเอ็กซเรย์ หมอใจดีมือเบามาก คุยสนุก ทีมงามบริการดีมาก แนะนำร้านนี้นะครับ
0x311d650041aced89_0xe2a7f701b019c4e2.en: A new clinic has opened near my house, it's easy to get to, the place is clean, and there's parking. They have a specialist in wisdom teeth treatment. I received free X-rays from the doctor, who is very kind, gentle, and fun to talk to. The staff provides excellent service. I highly recommend this clinic.

0x311d650041aced89_0xe2a7f701b019c4e2.text: ไปขูดหินปูน ใช้สิทธิ์ปกส คุณหมอผู้หญิงดีมากค่ะ ละเอียด ใส่ใจ และเอ็กเรย์ ฟันที่เหมือนมีปัญหาให้ฟรี จอดรถสะดวก ร้านสะอาด แนะนำค่ะ
0x311d650041aced89_0xe2a7f701b019c4e2.en: I went for a teeth cleaning using my health insurance. The female dentist was excellent; thorough, attentive, and provided free X-rays for any teeth that seemed to have problems. Parking was convenient, and the clinic was clean. Highly recommended.

0x311d650041aced89_0xe2a7f701b019c4e2.text: ปกติจะกลัวหมอฟันมากๆ แต่พอมาที่นี่ คุณหมออีฟน่ารักมาก เป็นกันเอง มือเบาสุดๆ จนท.ทุกคนก็น่ารัก เป็นคลีนิคประจำเราแน่นอน
0x311d650041aced89_0xe2a7f701b019c4e2.en: I'm usually terrified of dentists, but here, Dr. Eve is so lovely, friendly, and has a very gentle touch. All the staff are also wonderful. This will definitely be my regular clinic.

0x311d650041aced89_0xe2a7f701b019c4e2.text: คุณหมอมือเบามาก ถามคนไข้ตลอดการผ่าฟันคุด น่ารักมาก เป็นคนกลัวหมอมาก แต่คิดว่าที่นี่ทำให้หายกลัว เป็นปริดทิ้งเลย
0x311d650041aced89_0xe2a7f701b019c4e2.en: The dentist was very gentle and kept asking the patient questions throughout the wisdom tooth extraction. She was so kind. I'm usually very afraid of dentists, but I think this place completely overcame my fear.

0x311d650041aced89_0xe2a7f701b019c4e2.text: คลินิกสะอาด กว้างขวาง พนักงานมี service mind ดีมากๆ คุณหมอน่ารัก เป็นกันเอง ให้ 100/10 ไม่หักเลยค่ะ👍💕☺️
0x311d650041aced89_0xe2a7f701b019c4e2.author: Warathaya Srisawang
0x311d650041aced89_0xe2a7f701b019c4e2.en: The clinic is clean and spacious, the staff have excellent service minds, and the doctor is lovely and friendly. I give it 100/10, no complaints at all! 👍💕☺️

0x311d650041aced89_0xe2a7f701b019c4e2.text: Very clean. The staff are polite and kind. The dentist gives clear advice and is also very polite.
0x311d650041aced89_0xe2a7f701b019c4e2.author: Amari

0x30e29f266581b575_0xa75e369270eae5cf.text: This clinic is very luxurious. It's so clean and feels very high-end. The parking lot is spacious, and the service is impressive. The doctor is very gentle and provides excellent advice. They never recommend buying courses; they assess your skin and face and give great recommendations. It's a lovely clinic, and I highly recommend visiting. You'll be impressed.
0x30e29f266581b575_0xa75e369270eae5cf.author: nutrada pholknit

0x30e29f266581b575_0xa75e369270eae5cf.text: We did botox at this clinic. The doctor advised us on which areas to place it on our face. I appreciated how they only reccomended treatments that were suitable for our face structure. She had a gentle hand, clinic was clean and prices were reasonable. Very happy with the results and would definitely come back
0x30e29f266581b575_0xa75e369270eae5cf.author: Sherilyn Estelle

0x30e29f266581b575_0xa75e369270eae5cf.text: The sales representative named Khun Nong provided excellent service. She didn't push any courses and gave very helpful information. The clinic was clean, all the staff were very helpful, and the doctor was very attentive and gave good advice. 👍👍 …
0x30e29f266581b575_0xa75e369270eae5cf.author: Lunnapada D-ngam

0x30e29f266581b575_0xa75e369270eae5cf.text: A very clean clinic in the heart of Bangkok. Spacious parking available. The clinic has new equipment and the manager is not a ‘hard sell’ type of man. Absolutely wonderful clinic! Prices are extremely reasonable compare to market prices.
0x30e29f266581b575_0xa75e369270eae5cf.author: Alex Rentwo

0x30e29f266581b575_0xa75e369270eae5cf.text: The doctor is lovely, has a gentle touch, and focuses on every spot with precise pressure, no skimping on shots, no pushy treatments, and transparent pricing. Love it!
0x30e29f266581b575_0xa75e369270eae5cf.author: Patita Sukulwiriyabutr

0x30e29f266581b575_0xa75e369270eae5cf.text: The seren clinic was very nice to me the doctors and samar they were like a family They care about your healthcare and well-being they took care of us.

0x30e29f266581b575_0xa75e369270eae5cf.text: I just got Botox injections. The doctor was very gentle. They opened a new box in front of me, so I'm confident it's 100% authentic.
0x30e29f266581b575_0xa75e369270eae5cf.author: Asmah_tanee Tanee

0x30e29f266581b575_0xa75e369270eae5cf.text: Easy parking. The clinic is new, clean, and modern. The staff provides excellent service, and the doctor gives very good advice.
0x30e29f266581b575_0xa75e369270eae5cf.author: Peerapol Tevavichulada

0x30da3aa3ef6cf1a3_0xe4812c5bb30434ca.text: Panu Clinic from Dr Panu MD is a private run, independant clinic where one can get prescribed and buy Methadon liquid. Ps: All Infos Updated August 2018 Rate: 600Thb/100cc Methadon (1mgr=1cc). Rates: Reypnol1mg - Ritalin10mg - Xanax1mg and others --> All 40Thb per unit. Quantity : unlimited They have also medicine related consultation regardant sleeping, anxiety, sexual disorders, hyperactivity and various other addictions. Bring your Passport, ID or a copy for subscriptions and in order to get a member card. OTHER & SIMILAR SERVICES IN C.MAI The other Clinic in CM. to offer these kind of medical serices for addictions and disorders and serving Methadon is Pha Mai on Sinitron Rd. 0x30da3aa3ef6cf1a3_0xe4812c5bb30434ca.text: It's good that there are prescribed medications starting from methadone, even though the price is expensive 100mg 700baht! so you don't get into trouble. although prekabalin doesn't seem to be available anywhere in the drugstore, were the shelves full of prekabalin? the clinic in question is undoubtedly the best. I was surprised that the same name is on the other side of the world?. T.panu from. Finland Finland

0x30da3aa3ef6cf1a3_0xe4812c5bb30434ca.text: Wonderful doctors that treat you with respect and have been a benefit for a very large community of people that are either in recovery or have physical / psychological conditions that are not widely treated using a humane western approach. Please make a note of the opening hours as they are varied from morning to evening hours depending on the day. Some weekdays are closed while Saturday mornings are open.
0x30da3aa3ef6cf1a3_0xe4812c5bb30434ca.author: Hank

0x30da3aa3ef6cf1a3_0xe4812c5bb30434ca.text: Dr Panu has been reliable over many years. I’m very grateful to have a doctor I can rely on in Thailand. He is easy to communicate with and knowledgeable. He is able to provide necessary treatments that can otherwise be difficult to access in Thailand, which I really appreciate.
0x30da3aa3ef6cf1a3_0xe4812c5bb30434ca.author: Anna

0x30da3aa3ef6cf1a3_0xe4812c5bb30434ca.text: The only clinic that has been so helpful, welcoming and open to continue helping me with my mental health here in Chiangmai. They are able to refill the prescriptions that are difficult to find here.

0x30da3aa3ef6cf1a3_0xe4812c5bb30434ca.text: I just called the clinic to ask about a consultation for today for a simple matter. The doctor answered the phone and gave me a consultation free of charge.

0x30da3aa3ef6cf1a3_0xe4812c5bb30434ca.text: Amazing doctor helped my friend who needed Clonazepam and ran out of prescription. Was kind and very reasonably priced. Speaks English. Highly recommend!
0x30da3aa3ef6cf1a3_0xe4812c5bb30434ca.author: Elron Tal-Haim

0x30da3aa3ef6cf1a3_0xe4812c5bb30434ca.text: That’s the only one private Clinique that I know in Chiangmai and in Thailand, where a real Psychiatrist will take care about any patient that suffers from addiction and need Metadone or some Benzodiazepines and other medicines, especially hard to get in Thailand. The Dr. Panu is efficient pragmatic and moreover he speaks English well! His Father too takes care of the Clinic when the son is absent. 1 bottle is 30cc= 100mg. Methadone with almost no syrup inside. The prices are correct upstairs in the previous comment: methadone 750 thb/ 100 mg..../ the metadone comes in plastic bottles of 100 mg. And it is possible t take home some.
0x30da3aa3ef6cf1a3_0xe4812c5bb30434ca.author: Enki Cocoliso

0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.text: แนะนำเลยครับคลินิกนี้ ผมใช้บริการประจำ ตั้งแต่ขูดหินปูนจนถึงถอนฟันคุด สามารถออกใบเบิกประกันได้ ล่าสุดเพิ่งไปทำรากฟันเทียมมา คุณหมอเก่งและเชี่ยวชาญมากครับ ทราบมาว่าเป็นทีมหมอจากมหิดล ให้คำปรึกษาตรงไปตรงมาดีมาก เครื่องมือใหม่สะอาดสะอ้านทันสมัย ตอนทำไม่เจ็บอย่างที่คิดเลยครับ ราคาถือว่าดีมากเมื่อเทียบกับคุณภาพที่ได้รับ คิดว่าเป็นคลินิกที่คุณหมอใจดีและเป็นมืออาชีพจริงๆ
0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.author: norataj P
0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.en: I highly recommend this clinic. I'm a regular customer, from teeth cleaning to wisdom tooth extraction. They accept insurance claims. I recently had dental implants done here. The doctor is very skilled and experienced. I understand they're a team of doctors from Mahidol University. They give very straightforward advice. The equipment is new, clean, and modern. The procedure wasn't as painful as I expected. The price is very reasonable considering the quality of service. I think this is a clinic with truly kind and professional doctors.

0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.text: คุณหมอทำฟันเด็ก ๆ เลยทำให้สบายใจและใจดีรู้สึกผ่อนคลาย ขูดหินปูนละเอียด ถอนฟันกรามชิวมาก ๆ หายกลัวการทำฟันไปเลย ตรวจความดันก่อนถอนฟันคุณหมอแนะนำดีมาก พนักงานต้อนรับดีมาก และแนะนำครบถ้วน แนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะ
0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.author: Abby
0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.en: The dentist who works with children is very kind and makes you feel relaxed. The scaling was thorough, and the molar extraction was very easy. My fear of dentistry is gone! The doctor checked my blood pressure before the extraction and gave excellent advice. The reception staff were very friendly and provided complete information. I highly recommend this clinic.

0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.text: ร้านนี้คุณหมอใจดีมากค่ะ มือเบาสุดๆๆ ทุกคนในร้านมีความเป็นกันเอง ประทับใจมากค่ะ จะใช้บริการร้านนี้ตลอดไปเลย

0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.en: The doctor at this clinic is very kind and has a very gentle touch. Everyone at the clinic is very friendly. I was very impressed and will definitely use this clinic's services forever.

0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.text: ลูกชายวัย 8 ขวบฟันโยก ร้องขอคุณแม่ให้โทรนัดคุณหมอหญิง อยากนำฟันโยกออก เพื่อหลีกทางให้ฟันจริงขึ้นค่ะ

0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.en: My 8-year-old son has a loose tooth. He asked his mother to call and make an appointment with a dentist to have the loose tooth removed so that the permanent tooth can erupt.

0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.text: คลินิกสะอาด บรรยากาศดี คุณหมอน่ารัก พาลูกสาวไปทำฟันตั้งแต่ตัวเล็กๆ จนตอนนี้ไม่กลัวหมอฟันอีกเลยค่ะ 🩷

0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.author: Vorrarat Thanetwanit
0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.en: The doctor is kind, gives good advice, and does a great job. Our whole family uses this clinic. My mother, who is 84, is very impressed with the doctor.

0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.text: โชคดีที่ได้เจอหมอฟันดีๆที่นี่ค่ะ สอนใช้ไหมขัดฟันให้เก่งขึ้นด้วย มีที่จอดรถ…แนะนำที่นี่ค่ะ🩷
0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.author: Lady P
0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.en: Luckily, I found a great dentist here. They even taught me how to use dental floss better! There's parking available… I recommend this place. 🩷

0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.text: ครั้งนี้เป็นครั้งที่ 2 ที่มาทำที่คลินิกนี้ครั้งแรกก็คิดว่าโอเคคุณหมอน่ารัก ก็เลยนัดทำครั้งที่ 2 ปรากฏว่าครั้งนี้ ใช้เวลาทำไม่ถึง 10 นาทีงงมากๆ คือไม่เคยเจอจริงๆนะที่ทำได้เร็วขนาดนี้ ไม่แน่ใจว่า มีการตรวจสภาพฟันให้หรือเปล่าแต่ที่แน่ๆไม่ เคลือบ ใส่ฟลูออไรด์แน่ คิดราคา 950 บาทก็ไม่แน่ใจว่าถูกหรือแพงปกติ ครั้งแรกที่จ่ายไปจำได้ว่า 1,100 บาท กลับบ้านมาถามสามีว่าเป็นยังไงบ้างเพราะเขาเข้าไปทำก่อนหน้า บอกแบบเดียวกันว่าไม่ถึง 10 นาทีคืองงสุดๆ ไม่อยากไปเปรียบเทียบกับที่ต่างประเทศที่เคยไปทำฟันตรวจสภาพฟันและขูดหินปูนเขาใช้เวลาในการ ที่ทำฟันให้เรานานมากๆเกือบชั่วโมงทุกครั้งแล้วงานละเอียดมาก (ราคาต่างประเทศแพงกว่าแน่นอน แบบจ่ายเองจะ ประมาณ $60 ถือว่าคุ้มค่ามาก ) ไม่คิดว่าจะมาเปรียบเทียบนะเพราะว่าทำใจไว้แล้วอย่างที่เคยบอกแต่ครั้งนี้ไม่ไหวจริงๆที่ให้ 3 ดาวเพราะ คิดว่าครั้งแรกทำดีเลยให้เพิ่มไม่งั้นจะให้ไม่ถึงดาว
0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.author: Ladyluk
0x30e29babd8a5b4f7_0xa0a61a74c644eb25.en: This is my second time at this clinic. The first time, I thought the dentist was nice, so I scheduled a second appointment. This time, the treatment took less than 10 minutes! I was so surprised – I've never experienced anything this fast before. I'm not sure if they checked my teeth or not, but they definitely didn't do a fluoride treatment. The price was 950 baht, and I'm not sure if that's cheap or expensive. The first time I paid, I remember it was 1,100 baht. When I got home, I asked my husband about his experience because he went in before me, and he said the same thing – less than 10 minutes! I'm completely baffled. I don't want to compare it to the dental work I've had abroad, where checkups and scaling take almost an hour each time, and the work is much more meticulous. (The prices abroad are definitely higher; paying in person would be around $60, which is much more worthwhile.) I didn't expect to compare because I'd prepared myself for this, as I've said before, but this time was just too much. I'm giving it 3 stars because I thought the first time was better, otherwise I wouldn't have given it even 10 stars.

0x311d63d65d3db7b1_0xa7d49e0f2029cd82.text: อยากจะรีวิวเป็นล้านดาวไอ้เราก็กลัวหมอฟันซะด้วยเจอคุณหมอหยูทำฟันให้ว้าวุ่นเลย😁❤️คือคุณหมอใจดีมือเบาสวยน่ารักครบจบที่นี่เลยค่ะ น้องๆผู้ช่วยก็น่ารักมากกกก ตั้งแต่หาหมอฟันมา30กว่าปีคือหมอหยูคือชนะเลิศค่ะ ใครที่กลัวหมอฟันต้องมาที่นี่เลยค่ะ ความคิดคุณจะเปลี่ยนไปแน่นอนค่ะขอบคุณคุณหมอมากกกกกกกล้านตัวค่ะ👍❤️😍

0x311d63d65d3db7b1_0xa7d49e0f2029cd82.en: I want to give a million stars! I'm so afraid of dentists, but Dr. Yu made all the difference! 😁❤️ She's so kind, gentle, beautiful, and lovely – everything you could want in a dentist! The assistants are also incredibly nice. In over 30 years of seeing dentists, Dr. Yu is the best! If you're afraid of dentists, you HAVE to come here. Your perspective will definitely change. Thank you so much, Dr. Yu, a million times over! 👍❤️😍

0x311d63d65d3db7b1_0xa7d49e0f2029cd82.text: วันนี้มาตรวจเช็คสุขภาพฟันประจำปี มีเรื่องอยากอวดด้วยยยย เจ่เจ้ทำรากฟันเทียมกับคุณหมอหยูมา 7 ปีแล้วนะเออ ดูน้องซิยังดูสวยงามแข็งแรงดีมากอยู่เลย คุณหมอเก่งมาก ใจดี ฝีมืออย่างเนี้ยบอ่ะ รักหมดใจเลยค่าาา❤️ ปอลอ. 0x311d63d65d3db7b1_0xa7d49e0f2029cd82.en: The male dentist was very polite, had a very gentle touch, and finished quickly; I didn't even realize it. He gave good advice. -The service was excellent, the dentist was polite, and gave good advice. Thank you.

0x311d63d65d3db7b1_0xa7d49e0f2029cd82.text: ไปทำฟันมาแล้วทั้งครอบครัว คุณหมอเก่งมาก มือเบามากอุดฟันขูดหินปูนสบายๆ ราคาไม่แพงอย่างที่คิดมีราคาให้ดูก่อนทำ แนะนำก่อนทำโทรจองคิวก่อนนะครับ

The price wasn't as expensive as we thought; they showed us the price list beforehand. I recommend calling to book an appointment beforehand.

0x311d63d65d3db7b1_0xa7d49e0f2029cd82.en: The doctor is lovely and gives good advice. The staff provides excellent service. There is parking available in front of the shop. The shop is next to the Slete restaurant.

0x305047427a72b46d_0xacb5ac7db227370a.text: I can highly recommend this physiotherapist. I have visited him on two separate occasions for different Injuries and he is attentive, professional and experienced. His English language skills are good so it is possible to both describe details of the injury and pain experienced and receive good explanations of treatments, causes and exercises - which the doctor will readily do. He is generous with his time and his manner. The clinic is well equipped with the latest technologies for treatment and exercise.

0x305047427a72b46d_0xacb5ac7db227370a.text: Our 11 y. old son (complex spine issues) was examined (we were impressed with level of detail) and had excercises for several days here. Highly professional physio with a pleasant approach and nice attitude. You can tell he invested much work in his education/expertise. He has identified a few important points missed previously back in europe. Exceeded our expectations by far, great professional. Fully reccomended.
0x305047427a72b46d_0xacb5ac7db227370a.author: Mihailo Sundic

0x305047427a72b46d_0xacb5ac7db227370a.text: I came in with severe SI joint pain, and I left feeling little to no pain at all. He even showed me exercises to do on my own if it flared up again. He was very thorough and asked the right questions to find the root issue. Other clinics refused to see me because I am 5 months pregnant, but this one was very kind and accommodating. He spoke English very well, and we had no issues communicating at all.
0x305047427a72b46d_0xacb5ac7db227370a.author: Cassidy S

0x305047427a72b46d_0xacb5ac7db227370a.text: I slept on my shoulder wrong, the most excruciating pain ive had in years. Booked an appointment and was seen to promptly. Great treatment and he knew his stuff! Clinic was very clean with all the newest equipment. I can finally breath and move again with minimal discomfort! Highly recommend this clinic!
0x305047427a72b46d_0xacb5ac7db227370a.author: Mooshie Moon Pie

0x305047427a72b46d_0xacb5ac7db227370a.text: An excellent physical rehabilitation specialist. Proficient in many "gold standard" techniques—Mulligan, Mackenzie, Pear, yoga therapy, exercise therapy, etc. If something hurts, bothers you, or you've had an injury, it's definitely worth trying. She provides recommendations and exercises.

0x30e2917c03391c85_0xe627be18bc29a69f.text: ประทับใจมากๆ คุณหมอให้คำแนะนำละเอียด ใจเย็น ตรวจฟันอย่างละเอียดทุกครั้ง พนักงานบริการดี นัดตรงเวลา คลินิกสะอาด จัดฟันแล้วไม่เจ็บอย่างที่คิด ดูแลต่อเนื่องดีมาก แนะนำเลยครับ 👍

0x30e2917c03391c85_0xe627be18bc29a69f.en: This branch is great! The doctor is kind, and the assistants are lovely. The assistant who is small, like a mole, is very cute and speaks very well. The service is excellent.

0x30e2917c03391c85_0xe627be18bc29a69f.text: คุณหมอบริการดีมากค่า เป็นกันเอง คุณหมอสุภาพพูดจาเพราะให้คำปรึกษาดีมากเลยค่ะ แนะนำคลีนิคนี้เลยย
0x30e2917c03391c85_0xe627be18bc29a69f.en: The doctor provided excellent service. They were friendly, polite, spoke kindly, and gave great advice. I highly recommend this clinic!

0x30e2917c03391c85_0xe627be18bc29a69f.text: ไปอุดฟันใช้สิทธิ์บัตรทองวันนี้มาแล้ว คุณหมอมือเบาทำดีมากรวดเร็ว ประทับใจค่ะ ขอบคุณมากนะคะ
0x30e2917c03391c85_0xe627be18bc29a69f.en: I went to get a filling today using my universal healthcare card. The dentist was very gentle and did a great job quickly. I'm very impressed. Thank you so much!

0x30e2917c03391c85_0xe627be18bc29a69f.text: จัดว่าดีเลยค่ะ แนะนำพี่พี่หลายหลายท่านที่กำลังลังเล คุณหมอเป็นกันเองให้คำแนะนำดีค่ะ ชอบๆ

0x30e2917c03391c85_0xe627be18bc29a69f.text: คุณหมอใจดี มือเบา ให้ความสำคัญกับคนไข้มากค่ะ ผู้ช่วยน่ารักทุกคน สะอาด บริการดีมากค่ะ
0x30e2917c03391c85_0xe627be18bc29a69f.en: The doctor is kind, gentle, and very attentive to patients. All the assistants are lovely. The place is clean and the service is excellent.

0x30e2917c03391c85_0xe627be18bc29a69f.text: คุณหมอมือเบาพี่พยาบาลน่ารักมากค่ะให้คำปรึกษาเเนะนำในการรักษาฟันครั้งต่อไปด้วยดีมากๆ
0x30e2917c03391c85_0xe627be18bc29a69f.en: The dentist was gentle and the nurses were very kind. They gave great advice and recommendations for my next dental treatment.

0x30e2917c03391c85_0xe627be18bc29a69f.text: ตอนแรกคิดว่าการที่เจ้าหน้าที่ไม่ใส่ใจในการลงนัดหรือไม่ตอบแชทลูกค้า จะเป็นแค่การลืมเป็นครั้งคราว เลยรอดูสักพัก ยังไม่ได้มารีวิว จนตอนนี้ สรุปว่าเป็นทุกครั้งจริงๆ - ตั้งแต่นัดแรก ไม่ได้ลงคิวนัดให้และไม่โทรคอนเฟิร์มนัด แต่ก็ไม่ได้อะไร - จนรอบ2 ก็ไม่โทรคอนเฟิร์มนัดอีก แต่เราจดคิวนัดเองอยู่แล้ว แต่ปัญหาคือ พอไม่มีคิวในระบบ ทำให้การที่เราจะทำหัตถการตามที่แพลนไว้ มันไปชนกับคิวคนอื่นซึ่งเสียเวลาทุกคนเราจึงเลือกที่จะช่างมัน ในรอบที่ 2 นั้น มีการเถียงกับเจ้าหน้าที่นิดหน่อยเรื่องการคอนเฟิร์มนัด สรุปได้ว่า กรณีที่เป็นเคสใหม่ การใช้บริการครั้งแรกจะไม่โทรคอนเฟิร์มนัดอยู่แล้ว สรุปที่2 เจ้าหน้าที่กรอกเบอร์เราไม่ครบเลยไม่ได้โทรมา ตรงนี้เจ้าหน้าที่มีการขอโทษแล้ว - ครั้งที่ 3 คิดว่าน่าจะบันทึกชื่อเราลงในระบบและใส่เบอร์ถูกต้องแล้ว เพราะครั้งนี้มีการโทรคอนเฟิร์ม ขอบคุณนะคะ - ครั้งที่ 4 เจ้าหน้าที่ได้โทรมาคอนเฟิร์มนัดแล้วแต่ไม่ได้รับสาย เรามีการขอเลื่อนนัดเองในช่องทางไลน์ และแจ้งเหตุผลเรียบร้อย และสอบถามถึงเวลานัดในรอบถัดไปแล้ว เจ้าหน้าที่แจ้งเวลาเรียบร้อย แต่ ในวันเข้ารับบริการ เจ้าหน้าที่ถามว่ายังใช้เบอร์เดิมอยู่รึป่าว เพราะเราไม่รับสาย และถ้าหากอยากจะคอนเฟิร์มนัดรบกวนให้เราแจ้งกลับในไลน์หรือโทรกลับไป ซึ่ง ใช่ เราทำแล้ว และมีเจ้าหน้าที่คอนเฟิร์มเวลากับเราเอง แต่ทำไมถึงยังไม่ลงนัดในระบบอีกแล้ว? - ครั้งที่5 มีเจ้าหน้าที่โทรคอนเฟิร์มนัดปกติ และเราตอบคอนเฟิร์มไป ขอบคุณมากๆค่ะ แต่วันนั้นเรามีเหตุผลที่ไม่สามารถไปได้ ในเวลากะทันหันมากๆตรงนี้ขอโทษด้วยค่ะเพราะยุ่งจนลืมแจ้งกลับ และล่าสุดเมื่อวานเราขอลงนัดไว้เป็นนัดของเราเอง และลงให้คนที่บ้านเป็นเคสใหม่ รอบแรกเจ้าหน้าที่ตอบคอนเฟิร์มแล้วเรียบร้อย และเราได้สอบถามเพื่อลงให้คนในครอบครัวเพิ่มอีก 1 คิว จนข้ามวันมาก็ยังไม่มีการตอบกลับว่ามีคิวว่างอีกไหม แต่มีการอ่านข้อความแล้ว ซึ่งการอ่านแล้วไม่ตอบคำถามของเราไม่ได้เกิดขึ้นครั้งแรก แต่ก็ยังมีการส่งข้อความที่เหมือนเป็นข้อความอัตโนมัติอื่นๆมาเพิ่มอีก จริงๆเราก็เลือกคลินิกจากรีวิว เหมือนคนอื่นๆ รีวิวดีมากๆ ซึ่งคุณหมอก็น่ารักตามรีวิวจริงๆ ให้คำปรึกษาดีมากๆ แต่เรื่องการบริการตรงนี้ก็ไม่เข้าใจเหมือนกัน ในครั้งแรกก่อนรับบริการก็ให้ข้อมูลอะไรดีมาก พอเข้ามารับบริการจริงๆกลับไม่ได้ใส่ใจขนาดนั้น หรือเพราะเป็นลูกค้าที่ใช้บริการโปรโมชั่น? เราไม่ได้สนใจเรื่องโปรอยู่แล้ว อีกเหตุผลที่เลือกคือใกล้บ้านใหม่ที่เรากำลังจะย้ายไป ช่วงแรกที่ใช้บริการเราต้องเดินทางไกลจากบ้านเดิมไปคลินิก ซึ่งการไม่ลงนัดให้มันเสียเวลาจริงๆ เพราะจากการจะทำหัตถการที่แพลนกับคุณหมอไว้ก่อนหน้านั้นให้ครบในวันเดียว กลายเป็นว่าตอนนั้นเหมือนเราเป็นคิวแทรก และถ้าจะทำก็ต้องเราคนทั้งคลินิกทำให้เสร็จ เราถึงจะทำตามแพลนได้ ซึ่งเราก็เลือกจะช่างมันแล้วเข้าไปทำในครั้งถัดไปแทน ใจจริงอยากจะย้ายคลินิกเหมือนกัน แต่ก็เหมือนไปเริ่มใหม่อีกรอบ เสียเวลาอีกรอบ เราพอใจกับคุณหมอที่นี่ แต่อยากให้อบรมเจ้าหน้าที่เรื่องความใส่ใจลูกค้ามากกว่านี้นิดนึงก็ยังดีค่ะ
0x30e2917c03391c85_0xe627be18bc29a69f.en: At first, I thought that the staff's inattention to scheduling appointments or not responding to customer messages would just be occasional forgetfulness, so I waited a while and didn't write a review. Now, it turns out it's happening every time. - From the first appointment, they didn't schedule it and didn't call to confirm, but I didn't mind. - Then, the second time, they didn't call to confirm again. I already kept track of my appointments myself, but the problem was that not having a slot in the system meant that my planned procedure clashed with other people's appointments, wasting everyone's time, so I chose to just let it go. During the second appointment, there was a slight argument with the staff about confirming the appointment. It turned out that for new cases, first-time service, they don't usually call to confirm the appointment. In short, the staff didn't fill in my phone number completely, so they didn't call. The staff apologized for this. - The third time, I think they finally recorded my name and phone number correctly because this time they called to confirm. Thank you. - The fourth time, the staff called to confirm the appointment, but I didn't answer. I requested to reschedule via LINE and explained the reason, and asked about the next appointment time. The staff confirmed the time, but on the day of the service, the staff asked if I was still using the same phone number because I wasn't answering their calls. And if we wanted to confirm the appointment, we were asked to reply via Line or call back, which we did, and a staff member confirmed the time with us. But why hasn't the appointment been registered in the system yet? - This is the 5th time. A staff member called to confirm the appointment as usual, and we confirmed and thanked them very much. However, we had a sudden reason why we couldn't come that day. We apologize for this because we were so busy that we forgot to inform you. And most recently, yesterday, we requested to register an appointment for ourselves and also for a family member as a new case. The first time, the staff confirmed everything. We then inquired about registering another appointment for a family member. Even after a day, there's still no response about whether there are any available slots, although the message has been read. This isn't the first time they've read our message but haven't responded; they've also sent other automated messages. Actually, we chose the clinic based on reviews, like many others. The reviews were excellent, and the doctor was indeed lovely and provided excellent consultations. But we don't understand the service issue. The first time before the service, they provided very good information. However, during the actual service, they didn't seem as attentive. Is it because we were customers using a promotion? We weren't interested in promotions. Another reason we chose the clinic was that it's close to our new home that we're moving to. Initially, we had to travel a long distance from our home to the clinic. Not making an appointment was a real waste of time, because what we had planned with the doctor to be done all in one day turned into us being treated like a last-minute rush. If we wanted to proceed, the entire clinic would have to finish our procedures first. So we decided to just move on and do it at a later date. Honestly, we'd like to switch clinics, but that would feel like starting over and wasting more time. We're happy with the doctor here, but we wish the staff would receive more training on customer service.

0x30e29178d86f52b3_0xd5ac604430d5375c.text: เป็นคนไข้ต่างสาขา(ต่างจังหวัด) มีเหตุจำเป็น(ลวดหลุด) จึงขอความอนุเคราะห์สาขานนทบุรีให้ช่วยใส่ให้ สาขานนทบุรีน่ารักมากเลยค่ะ รับพิจารณาและดำเนินการให้ ไม่ปล่อยผ่านด้วยคำว่า “ต้องเข้าที่สาขาที่มีประวัติ” แต่คำนึงถึงความสะดวกและความจำเป็นของคนไข้ น่ารักตั้งแต่ operatorเลย รับเรื่องพูดคุย และส่งต่อ ขอบคุณคุณหมอและเจ้าหน้าที่มากนะคะ ได้ใจเลย💕💕💕✌️ น่าย้ายเคสมาที่นี่จัง 💕
0x30e29178d86f52b3_0xd5ac604430d5375c.en: I'm a patient from a different branch (out of town) and had an urgent need (a wire came loose), so I requested the Nonthaburi branch to help reinsert it. The Nonthaburi branch was so kind! They considered my request and took action, not just dismissing it with the excuse that "you have to go to the branch where you have your history." They considered my convenience and need. Everything was lovely, from the operator onwards. They received the request, spoke with me, and transferred me. Thank you so much to the doctor and staff! You've won my heart! 💕💕💕✌️ I should transfer my case here! 💕

0x30e29178d86f52b3_0xd5ac604430d5375c.text: อยากให้คุณหมอน่ารักแบบนี้ตลอดไป ทั้งดูแลเอาใจใส่ ทั้งคำพูดที่ทำให้ประทับใจ สาขานี้น่จะเพิ่งเปิดใหม่ และยังไม่มีนไข้เยอะมากเท่าไหร่ คุณหมอดี ผู้ช่วยดี ใช่ค่ะคือไปครั้งแรกก็รู้สึกประทับใจแล้ว สียางเยอะ คลินิกสะอาด คาดหวังไว้กับที่นี่เยอะมากหวังว่าจะไม้ทำให้ผิดหวังนะคะ
0x30e29178d86f52b3_0xd5ac604430d5375c.en: I hope the doctor stays this lovely forever. So caring and attentive, and such kind words that leave a lasting impression. This branch seems to be newly opened and doesn't have many patients yet. The doctor is good, the assistants are good. Yes, I was impressed from my first visit. They have a wide selection of dental floss colors. The clinic is clean. I have high expectations for this place and hope it doesn't disappoint.

0x30e29178d86f52b3_0xd5ac604430d5375c.text: ปรึกษาจัดฟันครั้งแรกพี่ๆเจ้าหน้าที่เป็นกันเอง ดูแลดีมากค่ะ คุณหมอมือเบาและที่นี่มีสียางให้เลือกเยอะแบบมากๆถูกใจมากๆค่ะ 🤟🩷
0x30e29178d86f52b3_0xd5ac604430d5375c.author: Little Ginny
0x30e29178d86f52b3_0xd5ac604430d5375c.en: My first orthodontic consultation, and the staff were friendly and took great care of me. The doctor had a gentle touch, and they have a huge selection of rubber band colors to choose from, which I really like. 🤟🩷

0x30e29178d86f52b3_0xd5ac604430d5375c.text: คุณหมอมือเบามากเลยค่ะ ผู้ช่วยก็น่ารัก น้องหน้าเคาเตอร์ก็น่ารักค่ะ มาปรึกษาจัดฟันที่นี่ครั้งแรก ประทับใจมากเลยค่ะ
0x30e29178d86f52b3_0xd5ac604430d5375c.en: The dentist was very gentle, the assistants were lovely, and the girl at the counter was also very nice. This was my first time consulting about orthodontics here, and I was very impressed.

0x30e29178d86f52b3_0xd5ac604430d5375c.text: พาลูกสาวมาจัดฟันค่ะ ชอบนะคะสะอาดดี ที่จอดรถก็สะดวกดีค่ะ จนท.บริการดีค่ะ คุณหมอน่ารัก
0x30e29178d86f52b3_0xd5ac604430d5375c.en: I brought my daughter for orthodontic treatment. I like it here; it's clean, and the parking is convenient. The staff are helpful, and the doctor is lovely.

0x30e29178d86f52b3_0xd5ac604430d5375c.text: คลินิกบริการดีค่ะ แต่ค่อนข้างรอคิวนาน ไปอุดคอฟันมา1ซี่ รอบแรกไม่มีอาการใดๆ แต่ฟันมีร่องในส่วนที่อุด แล้วไปให้หมอดู เพราะกลัวมีเศษอาหารติดแล้วฟันจะผุง่ายหรือป่าว สรุปมีร่องจริง จึงได้ทำการแก้ แก้อุดฟันไม่เสียค่าใช้จ่ายใดๆ แต่รอบ2 กลับมารู้สึกเสียวฟันในซี่นั้นมากๆ แต่ไม่ใช่ตรงคอฟัน แต่เป็นด้านหน้าของฟันในซี่ที่อุด เลยติดต่อไป ทางคลินิกบอกว่าปกติของการอุดฟัน2สัปดาห์ก็จะหายไปเอง แต่จนถึงวันนี้ก็เสียวฟันค่ะ เสียวฟันมากกว่าเดิม บ้วนน้ำแปรงฟันก็เสียวฟัน ทั้งใช้ยาสีฟันลดเสียวฟันและเจลลดเสียวฟันก็ไม่หาย เลยคิดว่าจะไปแก้ที่ใหม่ดีกว่า แต่อย่างอื่นโอเคค่ะ สถานที่สะอาด พนักงานพูดจาดี คุยหมอคุยดี แต่อาจจะไม่ตอบโจทย์ในการรักษาสำหรับเรา
0x30e29178d86f52b3_0xd5ac604430d5375c.en: The clinic provides good service, but the wait time is quite long. I had one tooth filled. The first time, there were no symptoms, but there was a gap in the filled area. I went back to the dentist because I was worried about food particles getting stuck and causing decay. It turned out there was a gap, so they fixed it. The filling was fixed free of charge. However, on the second visit, I experienced severe sensitivity in that tooth. It wasn't at the neck of the tooth, but on the front side. I contacted the clinic, and they said it was normal for fillings and would subside within two weeks. But even now, the sensitivity is worse than before. Rinsing and brushing my teeth cause sensitivity, and even using sensitive toothpaste and sensitivity gel doesn't help. I'm thinking of getting it fixed elsewhere. Everything else was okay. The place is clean, the staff are polite, and the dentist was friendly. However, it might not be the right treatment for me.

0x30e29c23cc13e5ab_0x7c0d196e1ffc74bd.text: We booked a wonderful excursion through GetYourGuide: a half-day tour: "From Bangkok: Half-day tour to the Mahasawat Canal." The trip was beautiful, and our guide, Wes, answered all our questions on a wide range of topics, not just the lotus farm. He's a super nice, wonderful person with a wealth of knowledge and life experience. We were so glad to meet you and have such a lovely morning. We'd love to do it again.
0x30e29c23cc13e5ab_0x7c0d196e1ffc74bd.author: Jennifer Bardon

0x30e29c23cc13e5ab_0x7c0d196e1ffc74bd.text: I went with Guide Nok and she was absolutely wonderful! It felt like going with a friend 💕 really appreciate the time, effort and fun! What I’m also grateful for is how kind the tour operators were- they accommodated my request of seeing the dragon temple. for that, I’m even more grateful! Thank you for an amazing private tour. Highly recommend 💕
0x30e29c23cc13e5ab_0x7c0d196e1ffc74bd.author: Nadia Volpe

0x30e29c23cc13e5ab_0x7c0d196e1ffc74bd.text: Our boat tour with this group was incredible!! Our guide was very friendly and knowledgeable, and he had great answers for all of our questions. We had a large group (about 20 people), and I would definitely recommend for either small or large groups!
0x30e29c23cc13e5ab_0x7c0d196e1ffc74bd.author: Gabrielle Page

0x30e29c23cc13e5ab_0x7c0d196e1ffc74bd.text: What a great tour outside of Bangkok to the floating market and to the Maeklong Station. Mr Kriangkrai was wonderful and provided many details. Dao was a Save Driver and did a great Job.
0x30e29c23cc13e5ab_0x7c0d196e1ffc74bd.author: Frank Basler

0x30e29c23cc13e5ab_0x7c0d196e1ffc74bd.text: The tour was fun and the tour guide is so knowledgeable about the culture and places we visited! We'll come back for more! Thankyou, Mr Wes!
0x30e29c23cc13e5ab_0x7c0d196e1ffc74bd.author: Karmina Arredondo

0x30e29c23cc13e5ab_0x7c0d196e1ffc74bd.text: It was so much fun! The tour was excellent, very attentive, and they kept checking in on us throughout the trip. :)
0x30e29c23cc13e5ab_0x7c0d196e1ffc74bd.author: Yawittha Pechnuam

0x30da3aaf60f92399_0xa79fc9b940d648a2.text: I had researched breast augmentation at many places, and most reviews mentioned pain and the need for drainage tubes for 2-3 days after surgery, which made me very hesitant. Then I found this clinic, one of the few in Thailand that uses endoscopic breast augmentation with an axillary incision and no drainage tubes. So I decided to come for a consultation in person. The doctor was very gentle, explaining everything clearly and straightforwardly – ​​the advantages, precautions, and post-operative care. This gave me a lot of confidence. On the day of the surgery, the team took excellent care of me, and the atmosphere was relaxed. After waking up, I felt less pain than I expected, and most importantly, the scar is very small, almost invisible. As weeks pass, it blends seamlessly with the skin, making it almost impossible to tell I ever had surgery. I recovered almost normally in just a few days, without the worry of drainage tubes or discomfort I experienced with the traditional method. Now my breasts have settled beautifully and look natural. I feel much more confident wearing any type of clothing. When I wear a swimsuit or tank top, no one notices that I've ever had surgery. What impressed me most was the doctor and the team's attention to detail in every aspect, from planning, size, and silicone selection to post-operative follow-up. Every step made me feel safe and confident that the results would be excellent. If you're hesitant because you're afraid of pain, a long recovery period, or concerns about scarring, I highly recommend this clinic. I guarantee you'll be impressed from the very first day you step inside.

0x30da3aaf60f92399_0xa79fc9b940d648a2.text: I decided to have the procedure done at Dr. Alex Aesthetic Clinic because I saw that they use a endoscopic technique with an axillary incision. 0x30e29f11815fd233_0x6883fef98929bb28.text: เมื่อ 3 ปีก่อนผ่าฟันคุดและถอนฟันกับคุณหมอปทุมา ประทับใจมากถึงขั้นที่ว่าอยู่อ่อนนุชต้องนั่งรถไปคลองเตย คุณหมอมือเบามาก คือฉีดยาชา มดกัดยังเจ็บกว่า บอกขั้นตอนทุกอย่างละเอียดหมด คือเรารู้ว่าหมอกำลังจะทำอะไรกับเรา ใดๆคือคุณหมอทำเร็วมาก ชั่วพริบตาได้กลับบ้าน คลินิกสะอาด โซฟานั่งสบาย การบริการดีมากค่ะ #ความโชคดีคือหมอปทุมาเข้าวันนี้ด้วย โทรเช็คคิวตอนเช้าวันนี้เลย แล้วคิวว่างช่วงบ่าย 3 ปล. คุณหมอยังสวยและน่ารักเหมือนเดิมค่ะ
0x30e29f11815fd233_0x6883fef98929bb28.en: Three years ago, I had my wisdom tooth extracted and other teeth removed by Dr. Pathuma. I was so impressed that I even traveled all the way to Khlong Toei from On Nut to see her. Dr. Pathuma has an incredibly gentle touch; even an ant bite hurts more than the anesthetic injection! She explained every step in detail, so I knew exactly what she was doing. Above all, she worked incredibly fast; I was home in the blink of an eye. The clinic is clean, the sofas are comfortable, and the service is excellent. #Luckily, Dr. Pathuma was in today! I called to check for availability this morning, and there was an opening at 3 PM. P.S. She's still as beautiful and lovely as ever!

0x30e29f11815fd233_0x6883fef98929bb28.text: ไม่เคยเข้าร้านทำฟันเลย อายุ 35 ขวบ 🤭 กลัวไปหมดดูข่าวด้วยคนนั้นคนนี้พูดด้วยว่าเจ็บ แต่มาทำที่นี้ผ่าฟันคุดด้วยฟันเป๋นแมงอีก 😅 ตอนแรกเราอายโทรไปถามก่อนเลยว่าหนูไม่เคยทำฟันเลยค่ะ ฟันหนูเชี้ยมาก หนูอายหมอ คนรับสายตอบไม่ต้องอายค่ะ 💜 เราเลยลองเปิดใจทำ 💜 คือดีมาก เพื่อน งง มากเลยว่าผ่า 2 ซีด ทำไมอีกวันไม่เจ็บไม่บวม เพื่อนแค่ถอนฟันธรรมดายังเจ็บ 2 ถึง 3 วัน
0x30e29f11815fd233_0x6883fef98929bb28.en: I'd never been to the dentist before. I'm 35 years old 🤭 I was so scared, I'd seen the news and heard people say it was painful. But I had my wisdom tooth extracted here, and it was decayed too 😅 At first, I was so embarrassed I called to ask, "I've never been to the dentist before. My teeth are awful. I'm so embarrassed to see the doctor." The person who answered the phone said, "Don't be embarrassed." 💜 So I decided to give it a try 💜 It was amazing! My friends were so surprised that after having two wisdom teeth extracted, they weren't in pain or swollen the next day. They say even regular tooth extractions hurt for two or three days.

0x30e29f11815fd233_0x6883fef98929bb28.text: มาใช้บริการถอดฟันคุต คุณหมอใจดี ใส่ใจ บอกขั้นตอนก่อนเริ่มทำ หลังทำแนะนำการประคบเย็น ประคบร้อน อาการที่จะเกิด ผมทำตามคำแนะนำ สามารถลดอาการปวด และแผลหายเร็ว ใครถอนฟันคุต หรือหาที่คลีนิค ทันตกรรม แนะนำครับ
0x30e29f11815fd233_0x6883fef98929bb28.en: I came for wisdom tooth extraction. The dentist was kind and attentive, explaining the procedure before starting. After the procedure, they advised on applying cold and hot compresses and the symptoms I might experience. I followed their advice, which helped reduce pain and speed up wound healing. I highly recommend this dental clinic to anyone needing wisdom tooth extraction or looking for a dental practice.

0x30e29fa09b44667b_0xa7e318028aedb5fe.text: *Procedure from last year, specifically a Jawline Lift.* Two months after my first filler injection by Dr. Nok. My problem was a round face with a wide, high forehead, a long nose, but a short chin. When I smiled, my face looked a bit pointy, and my jawline was blurry. Dr. Nok recommended injections in three areas: the jawline, chin, and cheeks. A total of 4 cc was injected using Teoxane (a premium filler) and YVOIRE from LG Chem. The result? More than 5 people have commented that I look thinner 😂 even though my weight is the same! My face looks smaller and more defined. My under-eye circles and nasolabial folds are fuller. Overall, my face looks brighter, less tired, and not strange at all. It's my face, but a more beautiful version of myself. Before, I was a little worried because I'd seen friends who had negative experiences with chin fillers. But nowadays, there are better quality fillers available than before, combined with the expertise of the doctor. This was my most impressive first filler injection experience! 💓🫶 If you're interested, I highly recommend Dr. Nok at Charm Clinic by Dr. Nok.

0x3050318767080131_0xfc0fa098afa1d884.text: I recently had the pleasure of visiting this new dental clinic in Phuket, and I must say, it exceeded all my expectations. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warmth, and the modern, comfortable, and impeccably clean interior immediately put me at ease. The dentist, who also happens to be the owner, was incredibly friendly and took the time to explain every step of the teeth whitening procedure to me, as it was my first time. Before starting, he recommended a thorough teeth cleaning for optimal results, which turned out to be the most gentle and thorough cleaning I've ever experienced. For someone who's usually apprehensive about dental visits, I can confidently say that this clinic is perfect for anyone with dental anxiety. Throughout the whitening procedure, the staff stayed by my side, constantly checking on my comfort level. When I experienced discomfort in my neck, they promptly offered a pillow for support. Moreover, when the treatment became too uncomfortable for me, the dentist acted swiftly to end it, ensuring my well-being was the top priority. Although I experienced some discomfort (commonly referred to as zingers) for a day following the treatment, I found that doing it in the evening after a substantial meal helped, and by the next day, I felt much better. The results were remarkable, and all my friends noticed the difference in my teeth – a testament to the clinic's expertise and care. I wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone seeking professional dental care in Phuket. It's rare to find such a combination of modern facilities, skilled professionals, and genuine concern for patients' comfort and well-being.

0x30da29df19d4d3e1_0x8181805125969910.text: แม้ผมจะใช้บริการของโรงพยาบาลสัตว์แห่งนี้อยู่บ่อยครั้ง แต่ประสบการณ์ล่าสุดทำให้ผมรู้สึกแย่มาก ต้นเดือนนี้ผมพา “ลูกชาย” ของผม (แมวเพศผู้) มาทำหมันที่นี่ เนื่องจากวันนั้นผมมีธุระต้องไปต่างจังหวัด จึงฝากเขาไว้ที่โรงพยาบาลสัตว์นี้ 3 คืน พอกลับมาก็มารับเขากลับบ้าน ไม่กี่วันต่อมา ลูกชายเริ่มมีอาการไม่สบาย หายใจหอบ ต้องอ้าปากหายใจ และพยายามจะร้องแต่ไม่มีเสียง ผมจึงพาเขากลับมาที่นี่เพื่อตรวจซ้ำ คุณหมอบอกว่าน่าจะเป็นเพราะก่อนทำหมันไม่ได้ตรวจเลือดก่อน ซึ่งมีแมวบางตัวที่ไม่เหมาะสมจะดมยาสลบด้วยแก๊สโดยตรง จึงอาจเกิดผลกระทบไม่พึงประสงค์นี้ วันนั้นแมวมีไข้สูง คุณหมอจึงฉีดยาลดไข้ให้ และทำเอกซเรย์แต่ไม่พบปัญหาที่หัวใจหรือปอด จากนั้นให้ยากลับมาทั้งหมด 4 ชนิด โดยไม่ได้สนใจว่าเราจะสามารถป้อนยาได้สำเร็จหรือไม่ (และผลคือเราไม่สามารถป้อนยาได้เลย) เรื่องนี้ยังไม่จบ แต่อาการที่แย่กว่ากลับตามมาอีก สามวันหลังจากที่แมวตัวแรกมีอาการ แมวตัวที่สองและตัวที่สามก็เริ่มมีอาการเหมือนกัน และอีกไม่กี่วันต่อมา แมวทั้งหมด 11 ตัวในบ้านผมต่างก็มีอาการแบบเดียวกันทั้งหมด เช่น อาการหายใจลำบาก (อ้าปากหายใจ) มีไข้สูง และมีความลำบากในการส่งเสียง เราจึงเริ่มตระหนักว่าสำหรับตัวแรก มันไม่ใช่ผลข้างเคียงหลังการทำหมันของแมวตัวแรก แต่เป็น “โรคไข้หวัดแมว” เราจึงรีบพาแมวทุกตัวไปตรวจที่คลินิกอื่น และผลก็ยืนยันว่าเป็นโรคไข้หวัดแมวจริง คุณหมอที่คลินิกใหม่สอบถามประวัติอย่างละเอียด และเนื่องจากแมวตัวแรกที่ป่วยคือแมวที่เราเอาไปทำหมันเมื่อต้นเดือน และช่วงที่เริ่มมีอาการก็ตรงกับเวลาที่เราฝากเลี้ยงไว้ที่โรงพยาบาลสัตว์นี้ จึงสรุปได้ว่าช่วงที่ฝากเลี้ยงนั้น น่าจะถูกเลี้ยงรวมอยู่ในห้องเดียวกับแมวที่ติดเชื้อ จึงทำให้ติดโรคมา คลินิกแห่งนี้คิดค่าบริการไม่ถูกเลย แต่ละครั้งที่ไปจะมีทั้งค่าตรวจและค่าบริการจากคุณหมอ แต่เพราะเรารักแมวทุกตัวในบ้าน เราจึงเต็มใจจ่ายเสมอ ทว่าไม่คิดเลยว่าความไว้วางใจที่มี เพียงการทำหมันครั้งเดียว จะทำให้แมวโตทั้ง 11 ตัวในบ้านติดโรคไข้หวัดแมว และลูกแมวอีก 5 ตัวที่เพิ่งเกิดก็มีความเสี่ยงสูงตามไปด้วย ซึ่งทำให้เราต้องเสียค่าใช้จ่ายในการรักษาเพิ่มขึ้นหลายเท่า ประสบการณ์ครั้งนี้แย่มากสำหรับเรา และเราหวังว่าโรงพยาบาลสัตว์แห่งนี้จะนำเหตุการณ์นี้ไปเป็นบทเรียน อย่านำแมวป่วยมาเลี้ยงรวมกับแมวที่แข็งแรงในห้องเดียวกัน เพราะจะทำให้เจ้าของต้องสูญเสียทั้งเงินและแรงกายใจอย่างมากในภายหลัง

I was so confused when I arrived and found out there were 4 other people who had booked appointments at the same time, 5:30 AM. Isn't that called an appointment? A queue means each person has their own time slot, right? If someone has already booked that time, they should just move the other person to the next slot. To anyone thinking of trying this, I recommend you run far away. You'll just waste your money, time, and get frustrated. I really want to change clinics. 0x30e2998ac07b0d4d_0x9691f700f4ce3d48.text: I decided to write this review as information for those considering this clinic. I purchased a laser hair removal course for my arms and legs because the price was very cheap. I had already prepared myself for somewhat low quality. The results were indeed commensurate with the price. After 9 sessions, the hair still grew back in patches because the staff weren't very precise during the treatment and missed several spots. However, the staff themselves were lovely and provided good service, so I didn't mind and intended to get it over with. But the point that made me decide to "cancel the course" was the clinic's management system and honesty. Recently, the clinic called to suddenly reschedule my appointment on the day it was supposed to be mine, claiming the "laser machine was broken." I understood and agreed to reschedule. But what really upset me was that my friend also had treatment there, and they were able to go in without any problems. In short, the machine wasn't broken; the clinic either mismanaged the scheduling or miscalculated the time and chose to "lie" to the customer to avoid problems. When I contacted them for an explanation, the clinic couldn't provide one. The appointment management is terrible. Booking an appointment a month in advance and then having it cancelled so easily is a huge waste of time and very frustrating. If you're looking for laser hair removal, I recommend paying a little more and finding a clinic with better management and honesty with its customers. Don't be tempted by cheap prices and end up with the same bad experience I had.

0x30e29efb7183283d_0x7bf2dd9c02376551.text: I had a disappointing experience with Maximum Performance Wellness Center Bangkok after using them for a blood test package on 2 April 2026. Two important markers — Homocysteine and CRP — were not successfully provided. In WhatsApp communication, the clinic initially stated that “there was a lab issue” and later said it may have been due to an “unavoidable technical issue from the lab process” or possible sample quality issues. However, in a later formal email, the explanation changed to specimen quality / dehydration, and the clinic stated that this could not be attributed to an administrative or technical failure on their side. For me, the concern is not only the missing results, but the inconsistent explanation and the limited resolution offered. The clinic only offered a repeat test or credit worth 1,800 THB, which is the nominal value of the two missing tests. For an international patient, returning to Bangkok just to repeat two markers means additional flights, hotel costs, time, and inconvenience. Also, if the repeat test is done weeks later after lifestyle and supplement interventions, the results may no longer be comparable with the original baseline. I requested a more reasonable solution, such as a complimentary re-test of the full core panel to establish a consistent new baseline, but the clinic refused to go beyond the 1,800 THB value. Based on this experience, I personally would not recommend this clinic to international patients who need complete, timely, and clinically consistent blood test results. Update after clinic response: Thank you for your response. The key issue remains unresolved. If the laboratory has issued a formal explanation, please provide the actual documentation — such as a specimen rejection report, sample quality report, lab incident record, or written laboratory note explaining why Homocysteine and CRP could not be processed. A general statement that the sample was unsuitable due to “specimen quality factors, including hydration status” does not explain what objective sample-quality issue was identified, how hydration status was determined, or why both tests became unreleasable. I acknowledge that the listed value of the two missing tests is 1,800 THB. However, for an international patient, this is not simply a 1,800 THB issue. Returning to Bangkok requires flights, hotel costs, time, and schedule disruption. More importantly, if these markers are repeated weeks later after lifestyle and supplement interventions, they may no longer be clinically comparable with the original baseline. My request for a full core panel re-test was not a disproportionate compensation demand. It was a request to restore clinical consistency and create a meaningful new baseline after an incomplete package. The initial WhatsApp communication stated that “there was a lab issue” and later referred to a possible “technical issue from the lab process.” The later explanation changed to specimen quality / hydration. If that final explanation is correct, please provide the objective laboratory documentation supporting it. I remain open to a transparent resolution, but I do not consider a 1,800 THB credit sufficient when the package was incomplete, the explanation changed over time, and no objective laboratory documentation has been provided.

0x30e29e83cd1efdff_0x9118cd8fd1563fbe.text: I've been coming to see a doctor here since high school, and it's been 25 years now, and I'm still coming regularly. Today, I went to see a doctor with flu symptoms. Usually, I can recover by self-medicating, but this time, after taking medicine for 4 days, it didn't go away, so I decided to see a doctor and get a medical certificate. While they were taking my blood pressure, they asked what I needed the certificate for. I said I needed it to confirm to my workplace that I was genuinely sick—I'm working from home, I just can't go to the office. I've been sick for 4 days. The nurse said they couldn't issue it retroactively and spoke in a tone as if I was asking for a certificate to use for something bad. I said okay, I was just explaining that I'd been sick for 4 days. After that, they told me to sort out the medical certificate with the doctor myself. I said okay. When I went to see the doctor, I explained my symptoms. The doctor's question was, "Why did you wait 4 days before coming to see me? Why didn't you come on the first day?" Well, I didn't think it was a fever, I thought it was just a common cold with medicine, which would go away with normal medication. I hardly ever come to see a doctor. Then the doctor examined me superficially and said the medical certificate only covered today's sick leave. But the point is, I didn't take any leave! I was working from home when I developed a fever. Then they said okay, they'd prescribe some medicine. In the end, when I checked later, they gave me everything except cold medicine, because the doctor focused too much on the medical certificate. It made me forget what illnesses the patients had or what questions needed to be asked. In the end, I had to go back to the pharmacy to buy more medicine. My whole family is done with them, we're never using them again. 😡👎👎👎 ----------------------------------------- Update: After reporting the issue, the clinic called to inquire and ask for permission to provide services again, and they offered complimentary items and discounts on some tests. Personally, I'm okay with that and will return for their services because their intentions were good and I want to continue using their services. Regarding the things that weren't okay, the clinic promised to improve, which I completely agree with, because I've used their services hundreds of times. 👍
0x30e29e83cd1efdff_0x9118cd8fd1563fbe.author: Rassarin Buaprasert

0x311d675d2d5d3825_0x2122d9d5c1bb7919.text: คุณหมอใจดี พูดเพราะ บริการดี มือเบา ผู้ช่วยพูดจาดี บริการดี พูดเพราะ พนักงานตรงจุดบริการเคาน์เตอร์พูดจาดี พูดเพราะ บริการดี นัดคิวได้ตามคิว มีการติดตามคนไข้ดีมาก โทรสอบถามก่อนนัดทุกครั้ง ที่ชอบที่สุดคือปรึกษาหมอได้แบบ พูดได้หมด ข้องใจอะไรถามได้หมดและได้คำแนะนำดีมากๆ ขอบคุณบุคลากรทุกคนที่อยู่ที่คลินิกนะครับ ประทับใจมาก เพราะเคยมีประสบการณ์เกี่ยวกับเข้าคลินิกจัดฟัน แล้วโดนผู้ช่วยหมอพูดจาไม่ดี ไม่มีมารยาท พูดจาแย่มากๆ ใส่ แล้วเจอพนักงานจุดบริการเคาน์เตอร์ทั้งหน้าบูด ทั้งเหวี่ยงใส่ (เป็นประสบการณ์ที่แย่ จนไม่กล้าเข้าคลินิกที่นั่นอีกเลย) อ่อ เกือบลืม ที่เก่าทำรีเทรนเนอร์มาแล้วใส่ไม่พอดี แล้วทำให้เหงือกเราเจ็บ บอกเราให้ใส่อย่างเดียวไม่มีการแก้ไขใดๆ แต่ที่นี่หมอให้รีเทรนเนอร์มาวันแรก หมอใส่ให้ไม่พอดี หมอสั่งทำให้ใหม่ แบบด่วนเลย นี่คือหมอใส่ใจคนไข้มากๆ นะครับ มีข้อเล็กๆ น้อยๆ อีกหลายข้อที่ประทับใจ แต่คงยาวมาก ขอสรุปว่าแนะนำเลยครับ มีปัญหาเรื่องฟัน หรืออยากดูแลสุขภาพฟันแนะนำที่นี่เลยครับ ❤️

0x311d675d2d5d3825_0x2122d9d5c1bb7919.en: The doctor is kind, speaks politely, provides excellent service, and is gentle. The assistants are also polite and provide good service. The counter staff are also polite, speak politely, and provide good service. Appointments are scheduled as planned, and there is excellent follow-up, with calls made before every appointment. What I liked most was being able to consult with the doctor and ask anything I was unsure about, and receiving excellent advice. Thank you to all the staff at the clinic. I am very impressed, especially since I had a bad experience at another orthodontic clinic where the assistant was rude and disrespectful, and the counter staff were unfriendly and unfriendly (a terrible experience that made me hesitant to go back to that clinic). Oh, almost forgot, at my previous clinic, my retainer didn't fit properly and caused gum pain. They just told me to wear it without making any adjustments. But here, the doctor made a new retainer on the first day, and it didn't fit properly, so they made one urgently. That shows how much the doctor cares for their patients. There are many other small things I appreciated, but it would take too long to list them all. In short, I highly recommend this clinic. If you have any dental problems or want to take care of your dental health, I highly recommend this place. ❤️

0x311d675d2d5d3825_0x2122d9d5c1bb7919.author: Tarinee H
0x311d675d2d5d3825_0x2122d9d5c1bb7919.en: 📌Orthodontic treatment via case transfer, special offer 999 THB - 13 free items (1999 THB * 2 months, remaining 1000 THB until the case is finished). This is for anyone considering this procedure. On the first consultation day, we agreed to transfer the case immediately. It seems they were either in a hurry or the counter staff forgot and didn't let me read the entire contract (without my signature acknowledging receipt 😂). This is very important: if you have an urgent matter or cannot come, you MUST NOT reschedule for more than 30 days (the contract states 60 days from the last treatment). Otherwise, you will lose the entire promotion, incur additional monthly charges, and may not receive your retainer upon completion of the case. The person calling to schedule an appointment didn't mention this at all. However, the doctor and assistants were very kind and accommodating. We were very insistent, and they genuinely forgot to inform us. We were unaware of this 5555. P.S. I've been receiving dental treatment for over a year now. The doctor is gentle, the wait times are short, the assistants always call to remind me of my appointments, the clinic is beautiful and clean, there's parking, and everyone is very nice. 😘

0x305031fee0e5c4ff_0x5d28a49d08e01bb4.text: It's difficult to share my experience as a guide and encouragement for doctors. The picture is from breast augmentation done 10 days ago by Dr. Kob Naruephon. I decided to have it done here because a clinic I used recommended him. We consulted, agreed on the price, and decided to use Motiva Ekinmonic silicone with an embedded chip, the top model at the clinic, because I liked how soft and natural the silicone was. Personally, I wanted my breast augmentation to look natural. On the day of the surgery, I arrived as scheduled at 9:00 AM. The doctor gave me one pill to relax me (I heard some places require nine pills!). The surgery was at 10:00 AM. I have to say, the anesthesiologist was very skilled and professional. I think other women should also be aware of this. With over 20 years of experience, the doctor explained what to expect, talking to me and gently stroking my arm to keep me calm. Importantly, this clinic uses a scarless technique – no stitches, just grafts. You can get it wet immediately; no need to wait weeks. I woke up looking great. I don't know if others experienced this, but I woke up without dizziness or pain. I thought, "Okay, day two is going to be tough." Day two arrived, though slightly painful because I was wearing a tight bra and couldn't lie flat properly (initially I had to lie with my head elevated at 45 degrees). I took one pill and it was fine. Day three was very relaxed; I didn't need anyone to help me get up, sit up, or shower because there was no pain, just some stiffness. On day three, I went to the beach. On day 4, I ate out. On day 5, I drove because I didn't feel any pain at all. I didn't see the point in staying home. On day 6, I went to work and drove comfortably. The doctor wasn't worried at all about this case. The doctor said I could start exercising in a week, like walking or cycling. Weightlifting should wait 3-4 weeks. Things to avoid: alcohol, beer, cigarettes, and fermented/pickled foods. (I drink alcohol, but don't try this yourself! Everyone's body is different. I didn't experience any pain.) I'll end it here for now. "Being run over by a truck" is a myth. Implantable contraception is much more painful, I'm telling you!

0x30e2990011bbf78d_0xc300c6fe384a52a1.text: I want to say what a wonderful experience I had over the past couple of days with the team at Quora Medical Wellness located in the lobby of the Bangkok Peninsula Hotel. Coming from the states and being treated by doctors in the US I came in with a preconceived notion of what I was looking for. I had just taken a comprehensive blood test as part of my US quarterly regime and forwarded it on for the Quora doctor's review. I was staying at the Peninsula Hotel so for me access was a piece of cake. At the time of my appointment, I was met there by three wonderful young women: the manager, the nurse and an assistant speaking the Queens English. Each of these young women was smartly dressed and professional. All were extremely attentive and kind. I was escorted into meet the doctor who is extremely qualified and professional. When I told him the injection medication I was looking for he politely questioned my choice. Then of course he asked the right question which was what am I trying to accomplish. He explained why what I was asking for was outdated and based on the issues I presented the alternatives seem much more in line than what I had asked for. Again believe it or not when it comes to wellness and longevity East Asia has us beat. I proceeded with one of the drip intravenous treatments and a different hormone compound than the one I was seeking. Looking at the medical Journal graphs and other information I was presented the injection I would receive should be more potent for a longer period of time than what I have been taking and what I had asked for. Following each procedure I was given time to relax, offered tea and stacks and enjoyable conversation. I cannot recommend this group more as they are not only extremely kind and gentle but very competent as well. I had little pain from the glute injection and no mark from the IV. Throughout the entire time the young women were kind, gentle and caring. Certainly something that is lacking in the medical offices where I come from. I would not hesitate to wholeheartedly recommend this group and please take the time to explain your issues and what you're trying to accomplish and leave it up to them, these cutting edte professionals, to present a plan.
0x30e2990011bbf78d_0xc300c6fe384a52a1.author: R K

0x30e2990011bbf78d_0xc300c6fe384a52a1.text: This is my third time visiting Quora, and every visit has been a great experience. From the moment I step in, the atmosphere and the staff make me feel at ease—it doesn’t feel like a typical clinic at all. What I appreciate most is the personalized approach to treatment. I recently tried ONDAMED therapy (EMP), and the doctor was incredibly knowledgeable and attentive. She took the time to explain everything, helping me understand my body better. The treatment itself is both diagnostic and therapeutic, and I’m already noticing positive changes. I always leave Quora feeling better, both physically and mentally. It’s rare to find a place that combines medical expertise with such a warm and calming environment. Looking forward to coming back for more treatments!

0x30e2990011bbf78d_0xc300c6fe384a52a1.text: There are wellness clinics… and then there are places that genuinely feel like they understand the relationship between science, prevention and human care. 0x30502e29179da9ed_0x62d43c85b4aee144.text: Excellent hospital. Highly recommended especially for Farang (foreigner). Its highly affordable and excellent service. They speak rather good English too. I was in and out with medication in about 40minutes costing about AUD $95, with 3 medical professionals. This is VERY affordable. A General Doctor in Australia costs this much, let alone all the medication given. The medication is also very easily identified with exact instruction. Bring and wear a mask. If not "emergency" but is urgent, suggest go at random hours (e.g. the day I went at about 530am, no traffic, no patients). I picked this instead of Chalong as I believe that's public and longer wait times. I also picked this instead of a local doctor because I wanted to be seen then instead of waiting for an appointment

0x30502e29179da9ed_0x62d43c85b4aee144.text: I see a lot of mixed reviews. Maybe it depends on staff. Me and my wife went there for stomach infection or food poisoning. Was in and out in an hour with meds for 800 baht. Nice hospital and nice staff but felt like more of a business than a hospital with a focus on making money and health is secondary. 0x30e281001b92de83_0x7603664d7b1b97ad.text: The admin didn't seem very knowledgeable about customer information. When I arrived, they didn't know what I wanted to do, only what treatments were available and assumed I wanted to do all of them. I had to tell them I couldn't do everything; I was only there for Botox injections (my third session). I booked one package, but the doctor recommended a much more expensive one, saying some of the treatments I'd booked wouldn't be effective because of the low number of shots. (Then why offer packages in the first place? Are you just trying to trick customers into coming in?) I upgraded to the package that included the Ultraformer 400-shot program. They didn't let me check the number of shots as advertised on their page until after the procedure. And I didn't see any noticeable change afterward. I also had under-eye and chin filler injections on the same day as the Ultraformer. They used the expensive Restylane filler, which they claimed lasts up to a year, depending on lifestyle. It looked good immediately, but only three months later, my under-eyes are almost back to how they used to be. I didn't expect it to last a year, but three months went by so fast for this price and such a good brand. And finally, the worst part: I went in for a 100-unit Botox injection for a facelift and wrinkles. As soon as I arrived, they took the bottle out of the refrigerator, mixed it immediately, and were ready to inject. There was no opening a new box in front of me, no drawing the medication, no mixing the medication in front of me. They definitely used an old bottle that wasn't full 100 units. I was in shock at that point. I didn't dare question it because I didn't know what they were doing to my face. If they were serious, they should have done it properly from the start. They should have opened a new box, drawn the medication, and mixed it in front of me for my peace of mind. After all, I paid for this service; I wasn't asking for it for free. Thank you. A bad experience that will make me wary for a long time. I recommend everyone think carefully and make decisions before purchasing any procedure. I hope you find a good doctor and clinic.

0x30e2990e6c636b59_0x68cee3db0148f2bd.text: I requested information about one of their standard IV services listed on their website. When I asked for the specifics (which Vitmains, minerals and the dosage for each) they said they could not share this information as this violated their policy. This is a MAJOR RED FLAG. This is completely standard information that any health care provider, IV drip clinic, should disclose to you. It couldn't be more basic and simple. Patients deserve to know exactly what they're putting into their body (is the dosage too high? Or is it in fact quite low, which doesn't justify their pricing?). I've used multiple IV drips for years and I have never encountered a provider who wouldn't share this information. Until VIVID Bangkok Siam. I also clarified if they could share this information over the phone so they didn't have to put it in writing? Again, they refused, repeating a standard, boiler plate response. I'm happy to read that many people have positive reviews here, but I can not imagine putting an IV in my arm and receiving treatment from a provider who won't disclose what it is their putting into the patient's body. Again, dosage, not simply the vitamin/mineral, is an essential component of this information, as any standard disclosure on a medicine bottle reminds us. I would like to other good options in the area for IV treatments.
0x30e2990e6c636b59_0x68cee3db0148f2bd.author: Jim Johnson

0x30e29dc36de00acd_0x3edde5a72104bec1.text: Flew from Singapore to Bangkok 3 weeks ago to have my hair transplant at Grow and Glow Hair Clinic, and I couldn’t be happier with my decision. Dr. Benz is accredited by both ABHRS and IBHRS, and was extremely impressed by her expertise, particularly her hairline design and the in-depth explanation she provided throughout the process. She took the time to clearly explain the surgical procedure, what to expect afterwards, and the overall recovery journey. The hairline design is also very natural-looking, with great density without appearing artificial or overly drawn. The surgery itself was completely painless, and the entire team took excellent care of me throughout the procedure and during the post-surgery period. Dr. Benz also provided very detailed instructions on the do’s and don’ts during the critical first 10 days, which gave me a lot of confidence during the recovery process. All in all, I couldn’t be happier with my choice of Grow and Glow Hair Clinic. For anyone considering a hair transplant and looking for a highly experienced and accredited surgeon who genuinely cares about both the results and patient experience, I would highly recommend this clinic.

0x30e29de85c6c59a5_0xf9f5eab9b80a97c2.text: ห่วยดีค่ะ ทำฟันไป อุดฟัน 1 ซี่ 1 ด้าน ผ่านไป 1 วัน ฟันที่อุด หลุด!! ติดต่อไปขอแก้ฟัน ตั้งแต่วันที่ 2 (หลังจากทำฟัน) รู้ตอนเย็น เช้ามาโทรหาเลย แล้วพอโทรเช็คนัดวันทำ พนักงานบอกหมอเข้าอีกทีวันเสาร์ แจ้งนัดวันเรียบร้อย พอมาวันเสาร์ หมอไม่เข้าบอกเราจำวันผิด !!???? ตอนเราโทรไปแจ้งวันที่คอนเฟิร์มเรียบร้อย แย่มากเลย พนักงานต้อนรับก็หน้าไม่รับแขก เจ้าของที่นี่น่ารักนะคะ แต่ระบบต่างๆ ล่าช้ามาก จะแก้ฟันที รอเป็นสองสัปดาห์ ไม่เคยทำฟันที่ไหนต้องรอนานขนาดนี้ คงเป็นเคสแก้รึป่าวคะ ถึงยาก รอนาน ไปเสียเวลาอีก เรายกเลิกนัดงาน กับลูกค้า มาหาหมอ ฟันแค่ซี่เดียว แย่จังบริการแย่มาก วันแรกที่ไปก็ต้องรอ ชั่วโมง สองชั่วโมง ราคาก็ไม่ได้ถูก แต่เมื่อเทียบกับบริการแล้วถือว่าแย่มาก บริการได้ไม่ดีเลย ถ้าจะไปนะถามรายละเอียดการแก้ฟันก่อนเลยหมอเข้าบ่อยแค่ไหน คนไหนเข้าบ่อยสุด เวลามีปัญหามาจะได้เร็วหน่อย เจอแบบนี้ คงรอแก้ฟันเสร็จ แล้วอย่าพบกันอีกเลย พอแล้วกับที่นี่ คิดว่าใกล้เอาซะดวก สะดวกไหมละ ต้องเสียเวลาไปแล้วไม่ได้ทำ!!!

0x30e29de85c6c59a5_0xf9f5eab9b80a97c2.en: Terrible experience. I had a tooth filled on one side. One day later, the filling fell out!! I contacted them to arrange for a fix on the second day (after the procedure). I found out in the evening and they called me the next morning. When I called to confirm the appointment, the staff said the doctor wouldn't be in until Saturday. I confirmed the date, but on Saturday, the doctor wasn't there and said I'd gotten the day wrong!!???? I'd already called to confirm the date. It was awful. The receptionist was unfriendly. The owner is nice, but the system is incredibly slow. Getting a tooth fixed takes two weeks! I've never waited this long at a dental clinic. Maybe it's a corrective case, that's why it's so difficult and takes so long. I wasted so much time; I canceled work appointments with clients just to see the doctor for one tooth. The service was terrible. On the first day, I had to wait for an hour or two. The price isn't cheap, but the service was terrible. If you're going, ask about the details of the tooth repair beforehand, like how often the doctor is in, and who's most frequent. That way, if you have a problem, things will be faster. After this experience, I'll wait until the tooth repair is finished and never go back again. I'm done with this place. I thought it would be convenient because it's close by, but it was a complete waste of time!

0x30e29f595fcf2e47_0x973ba20431dec050.text: Aestheta at Central World is an excellent place to benefit your wellbeing. They offer many services including Colon Hydrotherapy, Hyperbaric chamber, IV drip for stem cell, Vitamin, boosters and much more. I came in for a IV drip booster and tried for the first time the Hyperbaric Oxygen Treatment or HBOT. Several months ago I fortunately did a Stem Cell treatment of 20 million millilitres and wanted to start looking for more ways to increase stem cell stimulation. Welcome to HBOT, it is where you are relaxed in a lounge chair for a certain amount of time and oxygen is penetrating your body. This has many benefits for stem cell regeneration, organ health, wound healing, demential treatment and artistic symptoms. If you do some research, there is also beneficial help for people with diabetes HBOT and so much more. Besides not being able to bring electronics into the chamber, I suggest you bring a book. Otherwise, the experience is typical of a small airline business class cubical, a comfortable chair, music and two port hole windows. You disrobe and put on a wrap around robe take off your shoes and make yourself relax. You'll feel your ears pressure up and this is the time to equalize your ears. You get to watch the atmosphere pressure gauge, oxygen level, time start and amount left. After 1 hour for my session, 3 minutes before the technician does her thing to depressurize the chamber. BTW, there will be a technician sitting near the chamber to monitor you for the whole session so you don't have to worry. I suggest you use the bathroom before entering. I felt relaxed but also slept good that night. I hope to continue many more sessions and hope you are able to try this also. Highly Recommended!
0x30e29f595fcf2e47_0x973ba20431dec050.author: Larry Cortez

0x30e29f595fcf2e47_0x973ba20431dec050.text: I recently visited this health clinic in Bangkok, Thailand, and it was hands down the **best doctor’s experience I’ve ever had**. From the moment I walked in, the staff were incredibly friendly, attentive, and professional. They took the time to explain every step of my treatments in detail, making me feel completely comfortable and confident in their care. While I was receiving my IV, they even served me a warm bowl of meat soup — such a thoughtful touch that made the experience feel personal and relaxing. I tried several treatments, including **cryotherapy**, **ab sculpt**, and the **oxygen chamber**, and each one exceeded my expectations. The cryotherapy and ab sculpt treatments were amazing, and the oxygen chamber gave me the perfect chance to unwind afterward. I also did a **vitamin drip**, and I could genuinely feel the difference — I left feeling energized and refreshed. What really stood out was the follow-up care. The doctor personally called me for a 25‑minute conversation to go over my results in detail and provided guidance on how to improve my overall health going forward. That level of care and attention is rare and truly appreciated. The clinic itself was **beautiful, spotless, and modern, with a calm atmosphere that made the whole experience even better. I can’t speak highly enough of their services, staff, and professionalism. If you’re in Bangkok and looking for a place that genuinely cares about your well-being, I highly recommend this clinic— it’s an experience that goes above and beyond expectations. I’ll have a video up on YouTube about this experience Cosmic’s experience is the channel name

0x30e2815273e80909_0xdae6c61320b3446d.en: The service and welcome were good, but the time management was very poor, including the management of the number of patients to the doctor. Appointments were never scheduled at the appropriate time. And it wasn't just me who had to wait; others also had to wait like me. I understand, but this is the main issue. After handing in my appointment card, the staff always informed me of the queue, which I understood. However, when I actually waited and counted the people who went in before me, I was surprised to find that the number of people in line was not what the staff had stated earlier. Almost every time, it was the same number. Sometimes, people who arrived later were served before me, which was confusing. But I tried to think positively. Sometimes, I couldn't wait and had to leave because it was getting late, or I had other errands planned. Two hours later, they called to check on me. I had already eaten and gone to sleep. I wanted to film a review from beginning to end.

0x31029579133fd51d_0x72362a0d523e59f7.text: I wrote a review after getting my braces removed...adding an update today. My retainer broke in less than 2 months...terrible!!! 😡 I just had my braces removed and am currently wearing a retainer. It's awful. Before getting braces, I clearly told the doctor that I didn't want any tooth extraction, I didn't want to change my facial shape, I didn't want my jaw to change or become narrower. I liked my square face and didn't want it to become narrower. I just wanted my teeth to be aligned... The doctor promised, "Yes, yes, yes, yes, we can do it." Over 3 years later, after getting the braces off, my lower teeth are still crooked, my upper teeth are still uneven, and my jaw has narrowed, making a very noticeable gap between my lips and teeth when I smile. It makes my face, especially when I smile, look like a buck-toothed parrot. Now I hate looking at photos of myself, I hate looking in the mirror, I hate smiling... I'm looking for another clinic to get braces done so my teeth don't look like a parrot's. I'd rather pay more than live with a face I can't accept.

0x30502f85faa2d047_0x669e3086d969b67f.text: I ran in a marathon last year. I really injured my knee. I had an MRI. The doctor told me I couldn't exercise. It was awful. 9 months later, I still hadn't exercised for almost a year. I was NOT very hopeful when I went to Choojai because I'm not really that familiar with Thai Traditional medicine and I didn't think anything could help after physical therapy with lasers and ultrasounds and anti-inflammatory medications didn't help. I was very skeptical when herbs were put on my knee and set on fire. It looked really cool, but I didn't see how it could help. But guess what? IT DID. It's not just ONE treatment and you're fixed, but the Thai Traditional doctors have a diagnosis process that is far more personal and attentive than when you visit a hospital. They use different techniques to identify problem areas. They actually know what they are doing with their hands. They don't just press in one or two spots and make a diagnosis. They really check everywhere. Now, after several weeks of treatments, my knee is starting to feel better. I can actually walk down stairs without being in pain. I'm undergoing treatment for another issue now that has bothered me for YEARS and Choojai Clinic is the first place that has made any progress. I'd give them 6 stars if I could. It changed my life.
