วันนี้มิ้นเข้ามารับบริการขูดหินปูน คุณหมอพูดจาไพเราะ มีจรรยาบรรณและแนวทางที่ดีในการดูแลคนไข้มากๆนะอยากฝากคลินิคแห่งนี้ให้ผู้ใช้บริการ ท่านอื่นๆได้เข้ามาเปิดใจ🤍👩‍⚕️ คุณหมอแก้วตา ดูแลคนไข้ทุกคนมาตราฐานเท่ากัน และมือเบามากๆค่ะ รู้สึกดีใจมากๆ ขอบคุณอีกครั้งนะคะสำหรับการดูแลในวันนี้และเจ้าหน้าที่ดูแลลูกค้าดีจริงๆ ขอให้ตั้งใจ บริการด้วยใจแบบนี้ตลอดไปค่าา🫶🏻🙏🏻
0x311d61900102174d_0xd25c4f8e031efd62.author: รถบ้านพัฒนาการ 69
0x311d61900102174d_0xd25c4f8e031efd62.en: Today, I came in for a teeth cleaning. The doctor was very kind, ethical, and had a great approach to patient care. I highly recommend this clinic to others. I encourage everyone to give this clinic a try 🤍👩‍⚕️ Dr. Kaewta treats all patients with the same high standard. And she's very gentle. I'm so happy and grateful for the care today and for the excellent customer service from the staff. I hope you continue to provide such dedicated and heartfelt service! 🫶🏻🙏🏻

0x311d61900102174d_0xd25c4f8e031efd62.text: A very empathetic and pleasant dentist. I went to her on the recommendation of my Thai friend. I had a professional teeth cleaning. The whole process was extremely pleasant. I would definitely come back anytime to have even more extensive dental issues addressed. Very good price! Thank you so much! 🙏 …
0x311d61900102174d_0xd25c4f8e031efd62.author: MrBrightside

0x311d61900102174d_0xd25c4f8e031efd62.text: I came for an orthodontic consultation. The doctor took impressions and X-rays, and I'll have to wait a week for the treatment plan. The doctor explained everything very well, in detail, and it was easy to understand. The doctor was very kind, and the pricing and details were very clear.
0x311d61900102174d_0xd25c4f8e031efd62.author: นาเดียร์ หวังจิ

0x311d61900102174d_0xd25c4f8e031efd62.text: คลีนิคทำฟันตรงสี่แยกประเวศ คลีนิคสะอาด ใหม่มาก คุณหมอ คุณผู้ช่วย น่ารักกันทุกคนมากๆ ใจดี ทำฟันดีมากๆ รวดเร็ว ไม่เจ็บเลยค่ะ ขูดหินปูนมา สะอาดมาก ส่วนหลาน3ขวบมาเคลือบฟลูโออไรด์ ไม่มีร้องไห้เลย ทีนี่ใช้สิทธิบัตรทอง/ประกันสังคมได้ด้วยค่ะ ไม่เสียเงินเลย สะดวกสบาย ดีมากๆ แนะนำมากๆค่ะ
0x311d61900102174d_0xd25c4f8e031efd62.author: Sutapat Phungern
0x311d61900102174d_0xd25c4f8e031efd62.en: This dental clinic is located at the Prawet intersection. The clinic is very clean and new. The dentist and assistants are all very kind and lovely. They do a great job with dental work; it's quick, painless, and the teeth cleaning was excellent. My 3-year-old niece had fluoride treatment and didn't cry at all. They accept the government health insurance/social security here, so it's free! Very convenient and highly recommended.

0x311d61900102174d_0xd25c4f8e031efd62.text: เป็นครั้งแรกที่มาใช้บริการที่คลีนิค ใช้สิทธิบัตรทอง พนักงานบริการดี คุณหมอน่ารัก ยิ้มแย้ม พูดจาดีมากๆ ประทับใจ ทำไว ไม่เจ็บ มือเบาแนะนำค่ะ
0x311d61900102174d_0xd25c4f8e031efd62.en: This was my first time visiting this clinic using my government health insurance. The staff were excellent, and the doctor was lovely, smiling, and very kind. I was very impressed. The procedure was quick, painless, and had a gentle touch. I highly recommend it.

0x311d61900102174d_0xd25c4f8e031efd62.text: คุณหมอแก้วตาคือดีมาก เอาไป 10/10 ใจเย็น พูดเพราะ บอกทุกขั้นตอน ลดความกลัวไปเยอะเลย พี่ๆผู้ช่วยก็พูดจาดี แนะนำคลินิกนี้เลยค่ะ ❤️
0x311d61900102174d_0xd25c4f8e031efd62.en: Dr. Kaewta is amazing, 10/10. She's calm, speaks kindly, explains every step of the process, and greatly reduced my fear. The assistants are also very nice. I highly recommend this clinic! ❤️

0x311d61900102174d_0xd25c4f8e031efd62.text: คุณหมอแก้วตา ผู้ช่วยทุกท่าน อัธยาศัยดี คุณหมอมือเบา คลินิกสะอาด ที่จอดรถสะดวก รับสิทธิประกันสังคม บัตรทอง ด้วย
0x311d61900102174d_0xd25c4f8e031efd62.author: Supawee Aurchaikarn
0x311d61900102174d_0xd25c4f8e031efd62.en: Dr. Kaewta and all her assistants are friendly. Dr. Kaewta is gentle, the clinic is clean, and parking is convenient. They accept social security and universal healthcare benefits.

0x30e2832e49492d99_0xa82a82653bef08a2.text: ประทับใจนี้มากๆเลยค่ะ 💖✨ คลินิกสะอาดกว้างขวาง ที่นั่งรอสบายไม่แออัด เดินทางง่าย รถเมล์มีผ่านหลายสาย สามารถลง bts สายหยุดหรือ bts สะพานใหม่เดินมาได้สบายมากก 🚝 ขอพูดถึงคุณหมอก่อนนะคะ คุณหมอทำฟันได้ดีและทำฟันได้รวดเร็วมาก ถ้าได้ลองทำแล้วจะรู้ได้เลยว่าคุณหมอเก่งจริงๆค่ะ แถมราคาน่ารักมากๆแนะนำเลยยย 👨‍⚕️ ใครหาคลินิกดีและราคาน่ารัก อยากให้เลือกคลินิกนี้เป็นตัวเลือกแรกเลยค่ะ 🥇 แต่ถ้าใครสนใจอาจจะต้องเผื่อเวลาหน่อยนะคะ เพราะคิวแต่ละวันค่อนข้างเยอะแล้วรอนาน ส่วนตัวมา 3 วันติด รอประมาณ 2-3 ชั่วโมง ระหว่างนั้นสามารถไปเดินเล่นหาข้าวกินตลาดยิ่งเจริญเพลินๆก่อนได้เลยน้า เดินได้ไม่ไกลมากค่า ส่วนตัวมาทำครอบฟันที่คลินิกนี้ คิวจองค่อนข้างนานเลยเลือกวันธรรมดา ลาพักร้อนมาทำฟันเลยค่ะ แต่คุ้มค่าสุดๆราคาถูกกว่า 3-4 คลินิกที่ไปสอบถามมา ที่นี้ราคาถูกกว่าที่อื่นที่ไปสอบถามหลักหมื่นเลยค่ะ 🏆 คุณภาพคุ้มค่ากับการรอมากๆเลยค่ะ ดีใจที่มาเจอและรู้จักคลินิกนี้นะคะ ส่วนตัวพูดได้เลยว่าเป็นคลินิกที่คุณหมอเก่งและราคาดีที่สุดในชีวิตเลยค่า ☺️🤍✨
0x30e2832e49492d99_0xa82a82653bef08a2.en: I'm so impressed! 💖✨ The clinic is clean and spacious, with comfortable and uncrowded waiting areas. It's easy to get there; many bus lines pass by, and you can easily walk from BTS Sai Yud or BTS Saphan Mai stations. 🚝 Let me talk about the dentist first. The dentist is excellent and works very quickly. You'll see how skilled they are once you experience it. Plus, the price is very reasonable. I highly recommend it! 👨‍⚕️ If you're looking for a good clinic with affordable prices, I highly recommend this clinic as your first choice! 🥇 However, if you're interested, you might need to allow extra time because the queue is quite long each day. I personally waited about 2-3 hours for three consecutive days. In the meantime, you can go for a walk and enjoy some food at the Ying Charoen Market. It's not too far to walk. I personally had a crown done at this clinic. The waiting list was quite long, so I chose a weekday and took time off from my vacation. But it was totally worth it! The price was tens of thousands of baht cheaper than the 3-4 other clinics I inquired at. 🏆 The quality is definitely worth the wait! I'm so glad I found and discovered this clinic. Personally, I can honestly say it's the best clinic I've ever been to in terms of doctor skill and price! ☺️🤍✨

0x30e2832e49492d99_0xa82a82653bef08a2.text: เจอร้านนี้จากในพันทิป เค้าบอกว่า ยกให้เป็นร้านทำฟันที่ดีที่สุดในโลกเลย ก็เลยตามมารักษา รอคิวนานจริง เพราะคนไข้เยอะ แต่ถูกมาก ดีมาก ทำฟันที่นี่ทั้งบ้านมาสองปีแล้ว ถอนฟันคุด 200 บาทเองค่ะ คุณหมอใจดีมากๆ อะไรที่ไม่จำเป็น ไม่อยากเสียเงินก็ไม่ให้เสีย ร้านอื่นบอกเราต้องอุดฟัน แต่คุณหมอบอกว่า ฟันไม่ได้ผุ จะอุดทำไม แต่ส่วนตัวไม่ชอบแม่บ้านคุณหมอเลย ปกติที่ร้านจะเปิดให้ลงชื่อ แม่บ้านจะเอาป้ายชื่อมาติด คนไข้ก็จะมาเขียนชื่อไว้ จากนั้นก็เรียกตามคิว เคยไปรอแต่เช้า แม่บ้านก็ไม่ยอมเอาชื่อมาติดให้ พอเราเคาะเรียกก็ด่าเราว่า ปิดอยู่ไม่เห็นเหรอ คือ มารยาทแย่มาก โดนไปสองครั้ง อีกรอบ เราไปยืนรอจะลงชื่อ ตอน 7 โมง ก็ไปเคาะ ละดันกดปุ่มปิดร้าน เพราะไม่รู้ เค้าด่าเราว่า จะมาปิดทำไม เดี๋ยวเรียกตำรวจมาจับนะ นิสัยไม่ดีสุดๆ
0x30e2832e49492d99_0xa82a82653bef08a2.en: I found this dental clinic on Pantip (a Thai online forum). They said it was the best dental clinic in the world, so I came here for treatment. The wait is long because there are so many patients, but it's very affordable and the service is excellent. My whole family has been getting dental work done here for two years. A wisdom tooth extraction only cost 200 baht. The dentist is very kind. They don't charge for unnecessary things or things we don't want to spend money on. Other clinics told me I needed a filling, but this dentist said my tooth wasn't decayed, so why would I need a filling? However, I personally dislike the dentist's cleaning lady. Normally, the clinic opens for people to sign in, and the cleaning lady puts on name tags for patients to write on. Then they call patients in order. I once waited early in the morning, and the cleaning lady refused to put up a name tag. When I knocked, she yelled at me, saying, "Can't you see it's closed?" Her manners are terrible. This happened twice. Another time, I was waiting to sign in at 7 am and knocked, but I accidentally pressed the button to close the clinic because I didn't know. She yelled at me, saying, "Why are you closing the clinic? I'll call the police!" Her attitude is awful.

0x30e2832e49492d99_0xa82a82653bef08a2.text: ตั้งแต่ตัวเองอายุ 20ต้นๆถึง40+ มีลูกก็พามาที่นี่จากลูกฟันน้ำนมเข้าสู่ฟันแท้ ก็ฝากชีวิตเรื่องฟันของทั้งครอบครัวไว้กับที่นี่ที่เดียวมา 20 กว่าปี คุณหมอมือเบา เก่งและเชี่ยวชาญมาก รู้สึกปลอดภัยที่สุด ราคาเป็นธรรม เครื่องมือทันสมัย คลินิกสะอาด พี่ๆ น่ารักทุกคนบริการดีจำกันได้หมด ใครหาคลินิกทำฟันดีๆ อยู่ แนะนำเลยค่ะ รีวิวจากผู้เข้ารับบริการจริง ไม่เคยคิดจะเปลี่ยนใจไปที่อื่นเลยคะ
0x30e2832e49492d99_0xa82a82653bef08a2.en: From my early 20s to my 40s, I've brought my children here, from their baby teeth to their permanent teeth. For over 20 years, I've entrusted my whole family's dental care to this clinic. The dentists are gentle, skilled, and highly experienced. I feel completely safe here. The prices are fair, the equipment is modern, the clinic is clean, and the staff are all lovely and provide excellent service; they even remember me! If you're looking for a great dental clinic, I highly recommend this one. This is a review from a real patient. I would never consider going anywhere else!

0x30e2832e49492d99_0xa82a82653bef08a2.text: คุณหมอเก่งมากๆค่ะ เขาทำเพื่อรักษาคนไข้จริงๆ ไม่เอาเปรียบเลย ทำฟันกับที่นี่มานานแล้ว อะไรที่ไม่จำเป็นแกก็บอกตรงๆ เพื่อให้เราไม่เสียเงินโดยใช่เหตุ ราคาไม่แพงเลยเหมือนทำฟันเอาสังคม555 หมอมือเบา ใส่ใจทุกเคส ใจดีสุภาพ และมืออาชีพสุดๆ ที่1ในใจเลย *แต่คิวแน่นนะ ถ้าwalk inไปไม่ได้ทำแน่นอน
0x30e2832e49492d99_0xa82a82653bef08a2.en: The doctor is amazing! He's truly dedicated to treating patients and doesn't take advantage of anyone. I've been getting my dental work done here for a long time. He's honest about things that aren't necessary so I don't waste money unnecessarily. The prices aren't expensive at all; it's like getting dental work done for the sake of socializing, haha. The doctor is gentle, attentive to every case, kind, polite, and incredibly professional. He's my number one choice! *But the waiting list is long. If you walk in, you definitely won't get treated.*

0x30e2832e49492d99_0xa82a82653bef08a2.text: คุณหมอน่ารักและเก่งมาก ดูแล รักษาฟันคนไข้ด้วยตัวเองเกือบทุกอย่าง ทำให้คนไข้ได้บริการที่ดีและราคามิตรภาพ แม้จะ walk in ไม่ได้แต่การเข้าคิวก็ไม่ใช่เรื่องแปลกนะ ถ้าเทียบกับโรงพยาบาลหลายๆแห่ง ถ้ายังไม่เคยไปใช้บริการเชิญชวนเลยค่ะ สำหรับตัวเองประทับใจคุณหมอมากค่ะ👍👍👍
0x30e2832e49492d99_0xa82a82653bef08a2.en: The doctor is lovely and very skilled. She personally oversees almost all of the dental care for her patients, ensuring excellent service at a friendly price. Although walk-ins aren't allowed, queuing isn't unusual compared to many other hospitals. If you haven't used her services yet, I highly recommend it. I was personally very impressed with the doctor. 👍👍👍

0x30e2832e49492d99_0xa82a82653bef08a2.text: คุณหมอเก่ง ทำฟันที่นี่มา 3 ปีแล้ว ทั้งครอบครัว ✨ ราคาคือดีมากๆ อุดฟัน 300-500 ฿ ใช้สิทธิประกันสังคมได้ หัตถการอื่นๆก็ราคาดีมาก คุณหมอแก้ปัญหาฟันได้หมด มือเบาไม่เจ็บ เครื่องมือดี มีเครื่องเอ็กซเรย์ใหญ่ ถูกมากๆ คิวเยอะหน่อย แนะนำมาตอนเช้าเปิดคลินิก 👏🏻👏🏻
0x30e2832e49492d99_0xa82a82653bef08a2.en: The dentist is excellent. My whole family has been getting our teeth done here for 3 years. ✨ The prices are great. Fillings are 300-500 THB, and we accept social security benefits. Other procedures are also very reasonably priced. The dentist can solve all dental problems, has a gentle touch, and the equipment is top-notch. They have a large X-ray machine, and it's very affordable. There's usually a long queue, so I recommend coming in the morning when the clinic opens. 👏🏻👏🏻

0x30e2832e49492d99_0xa82a82653bef08a2.text: คุณหมอสุภาพใจเย็น ฝีมือดี มือนิ่ม อธิบายดี ใช้เทคโนโลยีทันสมัย ราคาไม่แพง จองคิวแบบครึ่งเช้าหรือครึ่งบ่าย ไม่มีระบุเวลาตายตัว ไปถึงคลินิกแล้ว อาจต้องรอนานหรือนานมากแล้วแต่จังหวะคิวก่อนหน้า
0x30e2832e49492d99_0xa82a82653bef08a2.en: The doctor is polite, calm, skilled, has a gentle touch, explains things well, uses modern technology, and the prices are reasonable. Appointments can be booked for either the morning or afternoon, but there's no fixed time. Upon arrival at the clinic, you may have to wait a long time, or a very long time, depending on the queue ahead of you.

0x30e2832e49492d99_0xa82a82653bef08a2.text: ทำฟันที่นี่มาจะ10ปีแล้ว คุณหมอ พี่เจ้าหน้าที่ที่เกี่ยวข้องน่ารักมาก ใจดีมาก ไม่ดุ ติดปัญหาตรงไหน พี่ก็ใจดีช่วยเหลือให้หมดเลย แนะนำคลินิกนี้เลยค่าา
0x30e2832e49492d99_0xa82a82653bef08a2.en: I've been getting my dental work done here for almost 10 years. The doctor and the staff are all wonderful, kind, and never strict. They're always helpful with any problems I encounter. I highly recommend this clinic!

0x30e29be3d9f62241_0x429a294858da7b4c.text: The dentist did a great job and performed the scaling gently on my teeth. She took her time to clean every hidden part of my teeth, and my teeth feel fresh now. She communicated clearly in English after the scaling was done and gave some feedback on how to take care of my teeth. The staff are also very friendly and professional. Would highly recommend this little clinic with decent prices.
0x30e29be3d9f62241_0x429a294858da7b4c.author: Krub Phom

0x30e29be3d9f62241_0x429a294858da7b4c.text: วันนี้ไปขูดหินปูนกับใช้โปรโมชั่น 5 รายการ 1,290 บาทมา เป็นสิ่งที่รู้สึกคุ้มราคามากๆเลย แถมยังได้รับบริการที่ดีมากๆจากพี่พนักงานและแอดมินในเพจเฟสบุ๊คของร้าน รวมถึงคุณหมอที่ขูดหินปูนมือเบามาก แนะนำการดูแลรักษาอย่างระเอียด ทำให้วันนี้ประทับใจมากๆกับคลินิกนี้ค่ะ จะแนะนำคนรู้จักให้มาที่นี้อีกแน่นอนค่ะ 😍
0x30e29be3d9f62241_0x429a294858da7b4c.en: Today I went for a teeth cleaning and took advantage of their 5-item promotion for 1,290 baht. It felt like such great value for money! Plus, I received excellent service from the staff and the admin on the clinic's Facebook page, as well as the dentist who performed the cleaning – they were very gentle and gave detailed aftercare instructions. I was very impressed with this clinic today and will definitely recommend it to my friends and family. 😍

It's not like talking to a salesperson who tries to push this and that and then tries to force you to buy things. I went to another place near Ruam Chok, and the salesperson was so pushy, trying to get me to buy things. When I finally saw the doctor, she said I really shouldn't have done it because I didn't have that problem. It was crazy! I immediately thought of the doctor again 😭 If I plan any more procedures, I'll definitely go see her. Sending you my full support! 😁

0x30e29fa625a323d9_0xd3bbf810e037638f.text: Upon arrival, the atmosphere was great and the staff were very friendly. 0x30e29fa625a323d9_0xd3bbf810e037638f.text: This was my first time at Tangerina Clinic and I was very impressed! The staff were friendly and gave detailed advice. 0x30e29fa625a323d9_0xd3bbf810e037638f.text: I came here for Juvelook under-eye filler and lip filler. After listening... I nodded in agreement with everything. In summary, today I got ✨ lip filler ✨ under-eye filler ✨ temple filler ✨ and nasolabial fold lift. As for the Juvelook, the doctor said, "Wait for the filler to settle first.

0x30e29bd5467fec27_0x2c69d5606a7b9212.text: เราเลือกจัดฟันที่นี่ได้ยังไงเดี๋ยวเราจะเล่า เรื่องคือ เราได้ทำการหาคลินิกจัดฟันแถวที่เราอยู่อาศัย แต่เราเข้าไปปรึกษาหลายคลินิกก็แล้ว คุณหมอแต่ละที่ให้เหตุผลเดียวกันว่า เคสเรา เคสยาก บลาๆๆ จนเราถอดใจที่จะไม่อยากจะไปต่อแล้ว เราเลยปรึกษากับเพื่อนที่เรียนอยู่ที่เดียวกัน เพื่อนคนนี้เลยแนะนำว่า มาจัดฟันที่คลินิกนี้สิ คุณหมอที่นี่เก่ง เผื่อทำไห้ได้ เราเลยมีหวังอีกครั้ง เราเลยเข้าไปปรึกษาที่คลินิกและเข้าพบคุณหมอ สรุปว่า คุณพี่!! ณ วันนั้นที่หมอหลายคลินิกบอกว่าฉันเคสยาก คุณหมอที่นี่จัดการไห้เราเรียบร้อย ผ่าตัดเอาฟันที่ฝังอยู่ในเหงือกใกล้โพรงจมูกออกให้ ก่อนนัดเคลียช่องปากครั้งถัดไป ณ วันนั้นที่เข้าไปปรึกษาเลย เคสเราประจำกับคุณหมอเจี่ย คุณหมอเจี่ยเก่งมากๆเลยค่ะ และเคสเราที่ว่ายาก คิดว่าจะได้ลากยาวหลายปี สรุปว่า กับคุณหมอเจี่ยเราได้จัดฟันแค่26เดือน ฟันเรียงสวยเป๊ะ เราประทับใจมากๆ ทุกเรื่องเลย ทุกท่าน สุภาพเรียบร้อย คลินิกสะอาด คำแนะนำเริ่ด เราเล่าเรื่องของเรากับความประทับใจที่นี่ให้ฟังแล้ว ไปเถอะค่ะ แนะนำเลย คุณหมอที่นี่เก่ง เอาอยู่แน่นอน🩷🩷

0x30e29bd5467fec27_0x2c69d5606a7b9212.en: Let me tell you how we chose to get braces here. The story is, we were looking for orthodontic clinics in our area. But after consulting with many clinics, each doctor gave the same reason: our case was difficult, etc., etc., until we were about to give up. So we consulted with a friend who studies at the same university. This friend recommended this clinic, saying the doctors here are skilled and might be able to help. So we had hope again and went for a consultation. And wow!! On that very day, the doctor at this clinic who said our case was difficult handled it perfectly. They surgically removed the impacted tooth near our nasal cavity before our next oral cleaning appointment. We were assigned to Dr. Jia, who is incredibly skilled. Our case, which was thought to be difficult and would take many years, turned out to be completed in just 26 months with Dr. Jia. Our teeth are perfectly aligned. We are incredibly impressed with everything. Everyone is polite and courteous, the clinic is clean, and the advice is excellent. I've shared my story and my positive experience here. Go there! I highly recommend it. The doctors here are skilled and will definitely get your teeth done. 🩷🩷

0x30e299980a45da1b_0x9df73981d6f050e6.text: It's a small dermatology clinic. The waiting area is quite limited, but the place is clean. The doctor is a specialist in dermatology. The staff provides good service. I brought my mother to have skin tags removed from her face with a CO2 laser. There was one large tag and several smaller ones. The doctor estimated a flat rate of 15,000 baht for the entire face (excluding the neck). After the procedure, we received: * 2 tubes of ointment for the wounds * 1 tube of anti-inflammatory cream * 1 tube of cream to reduce dark spots * 1 tube of moisturizing cream Additional medication and doctor's fees were 1,240 baht. Total initial payment: 16,240 baht. The price is quite high, but we chose to have it done because the doctor is a specialist and it's conveniently located near our home. There was a follow-up appointment in about 1 month. The doctor informed us that post-laser hyperpigmentation could be treated with additional laser treatments. However, if there's no rush, you can continue applying the cream for about 3-6 months to gradually fade the scar. My mother chose to continue applying the cream first. The second time, there was an additional cost of 440 baht for medication and an additional 300 baht for follow-up and doctor's fees. I've reviewed the costs and procedures in case it's helpful information for those who are making a decision. A point I'd like to see improved is the documentation of expenses. After paying both times, we did not receive a receipt or a summary of the treatment costs. Issuing such documentation would help patients understand the details of the expenses more clearly. Additional note: The clinic now provides complimentary drinking water while waiting.

0x30e29f9845e08bcf_0x6aba818ad5111003.text: I had to come in for a wound cleaning every day because the doctor ordered it. I've been using this service for about a week and I've felt okay every time until today, Wednesday, September 15, 2015. I arrived around 7:20 PM. A fat lady (I don't know if she's a doctor or a nurse) came to clean me up and said I had to come no later than 7:00 PM. I told her I probably wouldn't make it in time, so she said 7:15 PM. I was confused as to why, even though the cutoff time for cases is 7:30 PM, I've been coming at this time every day and never had a problem. When I finished, I asked the nurse at the counter what time they closed, and she told me to come no later than 7:15 PM (even though I've been here every day and they say they close at 7:30 PM, and they just changed it today). She didn't wear gloves when she cleaned my wound. When I said I probably wouldn't be able to come in time, she said I didn't have to come every day, and that I should come every two days, even though the doctor at the hospital ordered that I have to clean my wound every day. I'd like to ask the person in charge here to check this out. I don't know if she was in a hurry to go home or what. Not everyone has free time to come when you want. They've set opening and closing times, and they're on time. They don't change them just because it's late. And regarding cleanliness, they have gloves available for you to use, so wear them. Don't be careless. I don't know what you've been touching. I've been here many times and they all wear gloves. Today, only the fat lady didn't wear them.
0x30e29f9845e08bcf_0x6aba818ad5111003.author: Krisakorn Boondech

0x30e29f9845e08bcf_0x6aba818ad5111003.text: I went to the clinic because it was nearby. My symptoms had improved enough to walk, so I came early. The counter staff were okay, but the doctor I encountered was very rude. It was like he treated me like I was a stranger. I had food poisoning and couldn't go anywhere all day. When I finally had enough strength to walk, he just told me to go home without examining me or anything. I felt terrible. He didn't talk to me or ask any questions. When he found out my symptoms had improved and I could walk, he came to check on me and asked for a medical certificate. He said I was better and couldn't issue one, and just told me to go home. He didn't listen to me at all. In the end, he called a taxi to a larger hospital instead. They examined me, gave me medication for post-food poisoning recovery, an injection, and a medical certificate allowing me to rest. The doctor at the hospital even asked if I wanted to be admitted or go home to rest, but I didn't want to be admitted and asked to go home. I almost couldn't get back on my own because the hospital had to take me. After resting on the bed for a while and my symptoms improved, the hospital called a taxi for me and even took me to my car in a wheelchair. My symptoms were very severe, and I had walked all the way here because it was nearby so I could rest. I felt awful because the doctor told me to leave after only a minute of seeing him. (The doctor was an older man.)

0x30e29926ae2b9da3_0xcb799077eca6ac9a.text: จากประสบการณ์จริง จัดฟันที่นี่มาเข้าปีที่6 ย้ายหมอ2รอบ 3คน การย้ายหมอรอบที่1 ผิดที่เราเวลาไม่ตรงกับหมอและอยู่ไกล แต่หมอท่านแรกดีค่ะชม หมอที่2 ที่ทำเคสต่อ พิมพ์ฟันให้ไม่พิจารณาอะไร ไม่เอาอะไรแล้วเพราะจะไปเรียนต่อ จะจบเคสแบบง่ายๆ แต่ไม่อยู่จบเคส่ง พิมพ์ฟันทิ่งไว้เฉยๆสรุปไม่ได้ถอดเพราะฟันเคลื่อนแต่จ่ายค่ารีเทนเนอร์ไปแล้ว เพราะวันที่คลีนิคนัดมาถอดไม่มีหมอเข้า เจอแม่บ้านบอกไม่มีหมอเข้า ทำไมไม่โทรมาถามก่อน คือคนไข้ผิดที่มาตามนัดที่คลีนิคลงในใบนัดให้ ทางคลีนิคขอโทษละโยนเคสให้หมออีกคน หมอคนที่3 และบอกเสนอให้รีฟรี1คู่ จนปัจจุบันจะถอดแล้ว ถามทางคลีนิคไปว่าครอสที่จ่ายไปรวมอะไรบ้าง ตอบมาว่าฟรีชุดฟอกเองที่บ้าน และรีใส 1คู่ และการจัดฟันไม่ใช่หมอเช็คนะว่าโอเคพร้อดถอดยัง คนไข้ต้องพิจารณาเองว่าอยากถอดยัง อาจจะเพราะเป็นเคสที่ฝากมาเลยไม่ดูแล สรุปคลีนิคนี้ไม่ได้จัดการปัญหาอะไรได้เลย การจัดการเหมือนเด็กเล่น พนักงานก็พูดไม่ดี เคยไปคนที่ 2ตามนัดแล้ว พนง.ลืมส่งชาร์ทข้อมูลให้ห้องหมอ แล้วเม้าท์มอยฉ่ำรอนานจนคนที่มาหลังได้เข้าไปทำจนเสร็จ สอบถาม พนง.บอกลืม ให้รอ โวยไป พนง.ที่เป็นทอม สวนมาแล้วลูกค้าจะเอาอะไร ไม่มีservices mind สุดๆ หน้าไม่รับลูกค้าสุดๆ ทำที่นี่คิดดีๆค่ะอาจจะถูกกว่าที่อื่น และแย่กว่าบางที่แน่นอนค่ะ ให้1ดาวยังมากไปกับประสบการณ์ที่เจอมา
0x30e29926ae2b9da3_0xcb799077eca6ac9a.author: sup k.
0x30e29926ae2b9da3_0xcb799077eca6ac9a.en: Based on my personal experience, I've been undergoing orthodontic treatment here for almost 6 years, and I've changed doctors twice, with 3 different doctors. The first doctor change was due to conflicting schedules and distance, but the first doctor was excellent; I commend them. The second doctor, who continued my case, took impressions but didn't consider anything, saying they didn't want anything done because they were going to further their studies and wanted to finish the case easily. However, they didn't stay to finish the case, leaving the impressions unfinished. In the end, I didn't have my braces removed because my teeth shifted, but I had already paid for the retainers. The reason the doctor wasn't there on the scheduled removal date was that they didn't have one. The cleaning lady said the doctor wasn't there and asked why I didn't call beforehand. It was the patient's fault for coming to the appointment as scheduled. The clinic apologized and passed the case on to another doctor. The third doctor offered a free pair of retainers. Now, I'm about to have my braces removed, and I asked the clinic what was included in the course I paid for. They replied that it included a free home whitening kit and one pair of retainers. They also explained that orthodontic treatment isn't something the doctor checks to see if you're ready to have your braces removed; the patient has to decide for themselves whether they want to remove them. Perhaps because it was a case referred to them, they didn't provide proper care. In short, this clinic hasn't resolved any problems at all. The management is like children's play, and the staff are rude. I went to the second doctor's appointment, and the staff forgot to send the chart information to the doctor's room. Then, we chatted for so long that people who came after us were able to get their service done first. When we asked about it, the staff said they forgot and told us to wait. We complained, and the female staff member (who looked like a tomboy) retorted, "What do you want, customer?" She had absolutely no service mind and was incredibly unwelcoming. Think carefully before choosing this place; it might be cheaper elsewhere, but it's definitely worse. Giving it one star is too much for the experience.

0x30e2bf4c89718331_0x7c50847d11ee8c8.text: เป็นการไปหาหมอที่แฮปปี้มากกก คือหมอมือเบา เครื่องมือก็ทันสมัย บรรยากาศคือทำให้คนกลัวหมอฟัน ใจชื้นมาก ไว้ครบกำหนดจะไปอีกแน่นอน

0x311d62af3c83cbdb_0x9f03893b23611621.text: I had my wisdom teeth removed here. The service was excellent and the doctor explained everything in detail. You should call ahead to make an appointment.

0x311d5f89ae397c5f_0xcea0f9a6fbd82539.text: ตอนแรกคิดว่าจัดฟันต้องรอนานเป็นปีๆ แต่ที่นี่ให้คำแนะนำดีมาก จัดแผนการรักษาชัดเจน เราเลือกจัดฟันแบบดามอน ไม่ต้องเปลี่ยนยางบ่อยๆ ฟันขยับเร็ว รู้สึกว่าไม่เจ็บมากเท่ากับแบบปกติ คุณหมอใส่ใจมาก ตอบทุกคำถามละเอียดสุดๆ ประทับใจมากกกก

We chose Damon braces, which doesn't require frequent rubber band changes, allows for faster tooth movement, and feels less painful than traditional braces. The doctor was very attentive and answered all my questions in detail. I was extremely impressed!

0x311d5f89ae397c5f_0xcea0f9a6fbd82539.text: พาลูก 6 ขวบ มาจัดฟันใสในเด็ก หรือ อินวิสไลน์ First เพราะฟันล่างคร่อมฟันบน คางดูยื่นๆ คุณหมอที่นี่เก่ง ลูกเราก็ใส่เครื่องมือตามคุณหมอสั่งดีมาก 55 ผลเลยออกมาดี ฟันเรียงสวยขึ้น แถมไม่ต้องโดนล้อที่โรงเรียนแล้ว คุณแม่ปลื้มมาก

0x311d5f89ae397c5f_0xcea0f9a6fbd82539.en: I brought my 6-year-old child to get Invisalign First because their lower teeth overlapped their upper teeth and their chin looked protruding. The dentists here are excellent, and my child followed the dentist's instructions perfectly. The results were great; their teeth are now straighter, and they don't get teased at school anymore. I'm so happy!

0x311d5f89ae397c5f_0xcea0f9a6fbd82539.text: คุณหมอมือเบามาก ดูแลคนไข้ดีสุดๆ พนักงานที่คลินิกก็สุภาพ ยิ้มแย้มตลอด ตั้งแต่ก้าวเข้ามารู้สึกได้รับการดูแลเป็นอย่างดี ตอนขูดหินปูนไม่เจ็บเหมือนที่เคยไปทำที่อื่น ที่นี่ใช้เครื่องมือดีจริงๆ กลับบ้านแบบฟันสะอาด สดชื่นมากๆ

I went home with clean, refreshing teeth.

Most importantly, the price wasn't as high as I thought. I'm very impressed.

0x30e29f52273f3ecb_0xe8bfc4e55d81572c.text: Replenishing my skin's nutrients and getting a health checkup today at the Ploenchit branch. The place is clean and the welcome is friendly. A specialist doctor oversees and advises on this, and finally, the doctor asks, "What are your biggest concerns?" This helps us address them first. Today, I received NAD, glutathione, and Therapy Ultimate treatments before the doctor gave me supplements to take home... Feeling refreshed and energized afterwards!

0x30da3000da824ccb_0xf64120c7ed6462fa.text: I received treatment, applied cream, and took antihistamine medication for about a week, but my symptoms didn't improve. So I called the clinic back and asked if I could use cold-pressed coconut oil along with the antihistamine cream because my itching worsened when my skin was dry. I was worried that it would worsen the allergy and itching. However, I was met with laughter and ridicule at my question. I would like to request training for staff on etiquette regarding expressing feelings. I don't understand what was so funny about my question. My illness is a form of suffering. Laughing like that shows that the patient's question was nonsensical. The response I received was, "We are not doctors, we cannot answer that. Please come back to see a doctor." I know you are not a doctor, but you should have a way of informing the patient or asking someone who knows, not laughing at the patient. In the end, it seemed like a pharmacist took over the call from the counter staff and gave an answer within the scope of what they were capable of providing. I want to reiterate!!! I was asking about using other creams or lotions along with the medication I was taking because I was concerned, and hearing laughter and ridicule showed that you treated another person's suffering as trivial.
0x30da3000da824ccb_0xf64120c7ed6462fa.author: Nuntaporn Vaiyakorn

0x310295c4bac94c27_0x4d0ef5be73d78a9.text: A few days ago, a little stray cat started coming to our house and crying. We began feeding her, she slept on our porch, and little by little she started asking to come inside. We already have a cat, so we were worried about his health. We also knew that if this sweet girl became part of our family, we would never let her live on the street again. That meant we needed to take care of her health first. Before visiting, we contacted PPT Pawpital Pet Hospital online. Everyone was very polite, replied quickly, and answered all of our questions in English. We explained that we wanted to spay the cat, and they told us that she would need vaccination first and then the spay surgery. Everything was explained clearly. Today we visited the hospital, and we were really impressed. The clinic is very clean, modern, and comfortable. There are no bad smells, the staff are kind, and even small details like indoor slippers for visitors make the place feel welcoming. They explained the treatment plan step by step, prepared her vaccination passport, and told us exactly when to come back for the next vaccination and her spay surgery. They also suggested grooming because she had been living outside and still had ultrasound gel on her fur. We wanted her to come home clean so we could cuddle her without thinking about her life on the street. While we were away, the staff sent us photos and videos of her after grooming. She was even wearing funny little sunglasses. It was such a sweet surprise. I really appreciated that they kept us updated instead of simply waiting for us to return. It made us feel that they truly cared about our cat. After we picked her up, they explained everything again, including the next steps. Later, I also had a few questions about parasite treatment and contacted them again. They answered quickly and explained everything clearly. I really appreciate that because I am still learning about these things. Now our beautiful girl is home, clean, healthy, and with her vaccination passport. We are very happy with our experience and will definitely continue bringing both of our cats to PPT Pawpital Pet Hospital. Thank you to the whole team for your professionalism, kindness, and genuine care for animals. We highly recommend this hospital.

Thank you very much！🙏 I only recommend this is the best place for your lovely family numbers.❤️ I found a heavy injured stray cat in Pattaya two months ago may couldn't survive，he stay in Pawpital two months like his home ，everyone in Pawpital give him professional treatment，comprehensive and kindly care，with full of love and patience，cost always very reasonable. Finally he full recovered and stronger，traveled out of Thailand，have a new happy life in my family from now on！

0x30da31e9cfa65085_0x11b0baeeb7b877d9.en: My first time having a molar extracted, and I was terrified, but it was necessary because the root had penetrated the nerve cavity. The pain was excruciating, and countless thoughts raced through my head. I searched many places for a dentist who could alleviate my fear until I found Dr. Pu's clinic. We only spoke a few words, and Dr. Pu was incredibly kind to arrange an appointment for me. Before the procedure, she used effective conversational skills to ease my anxiety by about 90%. She explained everything clearly in a gentle, soothing voice that made me feel very safe. Before I knew it, the procedure was complete in just 15 minutes. Seeing my tooth afterward, I realized that dental work, as I had imagined, wasn't as scary as I thought. The price was clear and very reasonable. Another thing I can't forget is Dr. Pu's sister, who was incredibly welcoming, and her assistant, who was always smiling and lovely throughout the procedure until I left. I highly recommend Dr. Pu's clinic; you'll want to keep coming back! Thank you so much, Dr. Pu, for completely relieving my pain. ❤️🙏🙏🙏❤️

0x30da31e9cfa65085_0x11b0baeeb7b877d9.en: Dr. Pu is incredibly kind. My great-grandfather, who is 84 years old, had a toothache and wanted to have it extracted, but the anesthetic wasn't working. Dr. Pu examined him for free, without charging for the anesthetic or painkillers… 💕 He also had a small tooth stuck in his front, which she removed for free as well. Anyone in Hang Dong should consider visiting her clinic. The doctor and staff are very kind, the clinic is clean, and the service is excellent. The doctor and staff are also very polite. Dr. Pu is the kindest doctor I've ever met. May she receive abundant blessings and may her business prosper and have many clients. My great-grandfather also blessed Dr. Pu all the way home. A month later, my great-grandfather had another toothache and asked to buy medicine from Dr. Pu again, saying it was a miracle cure. I explained that my great-grandfather wanted to buy the medicine, but elderly people tend to be stubborn, and he might be fussy if I bought it elsewhere. Dr. Pu gave him the medicine anyway, even though I could have bought it elsewhere. She was so kind to give it to him. Thank you for your compassion and pity for the elderly. Dr. Pu was busy but still went to the trouble of leaving this for my grandfather... Thank you again from the bottom of my heart 🤍🤍🤍🤍 This review is to express my gratitude.

0x30e29ec4ebef6ac1_0x136f065288a839d9.text: Jetanin has a world-class facade and charges world-class rates, but their medical standards and expertise are anything but. This is our observation and opinion, having travelled from Singapore for two weeks. As we learned later back home, a good IVF outcome is underpinned by three key parties: the doctor, the embryologist, and of course, the patient/couple. A key role that the doctor plays is calibrating the FSH dose (injectable hormone medication) to promote the best ovarian response (quantity and quality). There is no one size fits all protocol for every patient or patient age group because every body is unique, hence a doctor's experience and judgement matter a lot, and that comes with attentive monitoring too. The embryologist play an invisible, yet also a very critical role that can't be overstated. They are literally the scientists who can help make babies happen with expert handling, culture and preservation. Our overall experience with Jetanin was a let down, a big waste of money and time as we did not receive the best possible care and advice from the doctor and embryologist. I think—and it is evident from seeing the hoard of patients from China in the clinic—that most people turn to Jetanin for the purpose of gender selection. If a woman is still in her prime (ovarially speaking), I think she'll find good success in this or any IVF clinic. But if a woman is slightly older and require a more expert hand, I think she would be better off looking elsewhere.
0x30e29ec4ebef6ac1_0x136f065288a839d9.author: Keith M

0x30e29ec4ebef6ac1_0x136f065288a839d9.text: I paid THB 650,000 for the Success Plus package and underwent two egg retrievals. What disappointed me most was the lack of individualized treatment. Both stimulation protocols were essentially the same, and after the first failure, there was no meaningful analysis or clear strategy to improve the second attempt. In my opinion, younger women with a larger number of good-quality eggs may have a reasonable chance of success at many clinics. But women more than 40 seek IVF precisely because they have fewer eggs and egg quality is naturally not the same as that of younger women. This is exactly where I expected an experienced fertility clinic to demonstrate its expertise and provide a real advantage. Unfortunately, my personal experience did not show any particular advantage or professionalism at Jetanin. After two failed cycles, I got zero transferable embryos, and very little meaningful analysis or effort to improve the outcome.By the way,I was just 40. A very disappointing experience, especially considering the THB 650,000 I paid — and this does not even include the additional fees for other services and procedures.It is a waste of my time and money. 不值得，避雷

0x30da31f0826bfda5_0x3b37c6418ae3c9e9.text: I have had varicose veins and leg pain for 3-4 years, and the pain has been severe for about a month. I wanted to see Dr. Kittiphan for treatment. I started by researching and asking friends from Chiang Mai, and then contacted Dr. Kittiphan via Line to plan my trip. I received excellent responses, saving me travel time. I was able to check before leaving whether Dr. Kittiphan's clinic was open that day. I arrived at 5:15 PM. The housekeeper suggested I have something to eat first. The nurse arrived at 5:30 PM, and Dr. Kittiphan arrived at 6:30 PM. This allowed me to plan everything. Upon examination, Dr. Kittiphan, with his high level of expertise, found an abnormality and scheduled surgery for the next day. He explained the treatment plan, including laser and radiofrequency treatments, including saline and cooling treatments, and inquired about my insurance coverage. We decided to have surgery at the Sri Phaphat Building. The surgery didn't take long; I was able to get out of bed and practice walking in the recovery room soon after. There was no pain or swelling. No pain, no swelling, no bruising. Dr. Kittiphan explained how to behave and basic first aid if any abnormalities occurred. The treatment exceeded expectations because there was no pain at all. I rested overnight without any pain or wounds. The room was comfortable and clean. The next day, the doctor visited, and I was able to go home and have a follow-up appointment in one week. The doctor also recommended that I bring my mother for a check-up. I was very impressed. The doctor provided close care, explained things thoroughly, and gave excellent advice. This treatment felt like receiving care from a family member, truly cared for with all their heart. Thank you to all the team members, and my deepest gratitude to Dr. Kittiphan. The pain is gone, the swelling in my leg has significantly decreased, and I can walk normally now!

0x30da25342eef4c91_0x7db9b8847e2aed8.text: The female employee with long, slightly plump hair at the service counter provided terrible service. We told her we'd already checked, and she then said, "Just get a new SIM card with the same number," and took our phone, turning to another employee and saying, "It's not suspended, it just has no signal," in a very irritated and frustrated manner. It seemed she was upset because the Wi-Fi center was down, and she took it out on us, even though we were asking politely and without knowing the answer. 0x30e29f3133d6c9ef_0x7c0792b7f43cbc94.text: From the moment I walked into Shu Clinic, I wasn’t completely sure what to expect. I had a lot of questions and some hesitation—but that quickly changed. The front desk team were welcoming and patient, and by the time I sat down with the doctor, I felt genuinely comfortable and listened to. The advice I received was honest, clear, and tailored to what I actually needed—not just what I thought I wanted. I ended up getting Juvelook at a really great price, and the results speak for themselves. The doctor’s work is precise and natural—she really understands how to create that balanced, refreshed look without overdoing anything. What stood out most to me was the level of care. I’ve been visiting aesthetic clinics for about two years now, and I can honestly say I’ve never experienced this kind of service before. It didn’t feel rushed or transactional—it felt professional, thoughtful, and genuinely focused on the client. As a bonus, I also received a complimentary Chanel treatment, which was a really nice touch, and I booked my second Juvelook session straight away because I trusted the process. If you’re looking for fair pricing, excellent service, and a doctor who truly knows what she’s doing, I’d definitely recommend Shu Clinic. This isn’t a sales pitch—it’s just my real experience.

0x30e29f3133d6c9ef_0x7c0792b7f43cbc94.text: Every time I went for service, the wait was extremely long. Allow 4-5 hours (I once experienced 6 hours) because they have so many appointments. Booking an appointment is difficult; sometimes you need to book 2-3 weeks in advance. And then, upon arrival, you have to wait many more hours. The staff are not nice. They speak rudely, make faces, are clueless, and give poor advice. They can't answer questions and always require you to call ahead to check. For example, I came for an appointment to consult a doctor about an unusual condition, and the staff were terribly unhelpful, inattentive, and dismissive, simply saying "Please sit and wait." Meanwhile, another customer who was doing multiple treatments was incredibly polite, chatting at length with a sweet voice. The admin on LINE doesn't coordinate with the counter staff; everything is out of sync and completely disorganized. The medical assistant isn't Thai, speaks Thai poorly, and the name embroidered on their scrub isn't a Thai name (I understand that names can be embroidered on scrubs, but their poor Thai and lack of understanding are unacceptable). It's questionable whether they have the necessary licenses. Why hire someone like this who can't build customer confidence? The doctor's skill varies. Personally, I've had no problems with Dr. Gift's treatments, and I've seen good results. The prices here are significantly cheaper than other places (which is a little scary!). I recommend doing your research and making your decision carefully. However, the service, staff, and the reliability of their hiring process are very low. As for other doctors, I've encountered situations where they didn't even introduce themselves or explain their problem beforehand. They just sat me down and started the procedure, which was very confusing. Plus, they didn't even draw the medication in front of me; they just showed me the vial but didn't draw the medication in front of me, which was also scary.
0x30e29f3133d6c9ef_0x7c0792b7f43cbc94.author: Naenae

0x30e29f3133d6c9ef_0x7c0792b7f43cbc94.text: A negative experience. I'm dividing this review into two parts: 1. The Ultraformer III machine used: The clinic claimed it had Thai FDA approval from Pu Princess. ***** The genuine machine in Thailand is the Quantum type from Paragoncare, the sole importer. I've never heard of Pu Princess. The clinic stated that using the Quantum machine requires an additional payment, despite their promotional images showing the Quantum machine. 2. Extremely long waiting times (over 3 hours): The first time, I waited 2 hours just to get the numbing cream applied. After that, I had to wait another hour, so I left. On my second appointment, I requested a time slot without a long wait. Upon arrival, I waited almost 3 hours again. In summary, I received nothing but apologies and was charged extra to use the Quantum machine. The clinic suggested canceling the appointment if I didn't pay the extra fee, and offered a refund after a 2-hour wait.

0x30da3aa256240333_0x277b227bb68fef3f.text: Seeking advice from a dermatologist is a worthwhile investment for those with chronic skin problems. A dermatologist can accurately diagnose conditions such as clogged pores, rashes, or abnormal moles, which is far better than randomly buying and applying creams yourself, potentially worsening the condition. Furthermore, you'll receive medical-grade medication that is more concentrated and effective than typical skincare products, along with scientifically-based advice on proper self-care. This helps restore skin health and boost confidence in the long term.

0x30da3aa256240333_0x277b227bb68fef3f.text: Terrible service. Don't come here. I had hives all over my body and went to see a doctor. The doctor barely examined me, prescribed medication, and quickly cleared the queue to call the next person. I barely saw the doctor for five minutes. And what's even worse is the terrible service from the staff at the examination room!! At first, they rushed me to pay for the medication and asked me to transfer the money, stating the price was 374 baht (the medication packaging didn't even say what it was). I asked if they would provide a medical certificate and receipt because I needed them for leave and reimbursement. They said I had to ask for them in the doctor's room. While they were writing the receipt, they kept saying, "You have to ask the doctor in the room." I had to tell them, "I don't know, this is my first time." After writing the receipt and medical certificate, this time they said the price was 500 baht. I was confused because the first price was over 300 baht, but this time it was 500 baht. They even mentioned a consultation fee. I was very confused because the first price didn't include the consultation fee. As soon as I asked for the receipt and medical certificate, they added the consultation fee. When I got the receipt, they only ticked the medication cost, 500 baht. I was confused and asked, "Didn't you say there was a consultation fee too? Why did you only tick the medication cost?" Finally, they changed the receipt to 360 baht for medication and 160 baht for the examination. Anyone who isn't confused will be very confused. The receipt was also very detailed; it lacked a tax identification number and the breakdown was extremely illegible. Is it acceptable for the staff at the examination room to charge whatever they want? I warn you, if you don't want to experience this, don't come here.

0x311d5f57288489d3_0x68a85d39e2cc1cd4.en: I had my teeth cleaning and polishing done here for the first time today and I'm very impressed. Dr. Timphika was very thorough and professional. The entire process was clean, comfortable, and painless. Throughout the treatment, the doctor explained each step clearly, which made me feel confident. The clinic is located on the main road, easy to get to, and has ample parking. The clinic itself is clean and spacious, and the entire staff is friendly and professional. I highly recommend this clinic for anyone looking for a dentist in the Bang Phli area. Smile Up Dental Clinic, this branch is well worth it!

0x311d5f57288489d3_0x68a85d39e2cc1cd4.text: J'ai adoré le service de cette clinique. Ils m'ont reçu en urgence afin d'inspecter une sensation que j'avais sur une molaire. La gentillesse du personnel et l'atmosphère détendue était vraiment agréable. J'ai fait une radio X-ray et le dentiste m'a rassuré chaleureusement que je n'avais pas besoin de soins dentaires. Une honnêteté que l'on voit rarement, un sérieux et un professionnalisme sincère. Je reviendrai.

0x3054f6521da4919f_0x63e1b8b1f6f0d43a.text: I couldn't equalize after landing and could barely hear the entire day of my arrival. I then called the clinic at 4:55 p.m. and immediately got an appointment for the next morning at 9:30 a.m. The clinic looks a bit unusual by European standards, but everyone was wearing masks and gloves, and the doctor disinfected all instruments during treatment. So I have no concerns about hygiene. The young receptionists are very friendly and speak good English. After they briefly took my medical history and measured my blood pressure, I was immediately allowed to sit down in the examination room. The doctor came right after and asked me about my problems. I told him my ear was blocked and I would like to have my ear canals cleaned. He did that and then examined my ears and nose with an electronic otoscope. His diagnosis: incipient middle ear infection. He then gave me helpful tips for everyday life, how to prevent it, performed a nasal irrigation, and administered medication. I got all of that (shower, 2 sprays, drops, antibiotics, effervescent tablets) along with silicone earplugs for swimming. Those helpful and pleasant 20 minutes cost me 3,300 baht. I can't understand all the complainers here. The travel insurance covers the costs anyway. If you don't have any, you've probably taken the risk knowingly... Especially since 3,300 baht for competent medical treatment + medication is affordable from a "Western perspective.
0x3054f6521da4919f_0x63e1b8b1f6f0d43a.author: Sebastian Lerf

0x3054f6521da4919f_0x63e1b8b1f6f0d43a.text: I visited Dr Ning due to stuck water in my right ear. The diagnosis was fast and clear - I had a little opening in my eardrum and a very little infection - which wasn't too serious. She cleaned my ear using some sort of specifically designed "vacuum cleaner" to prevent the infection of spreading and gave me some antibiotics that I was supposed to take for 7 days. Although I still couldn't hear properly - she basically did the best thing there was to do at that time. I am now back in Germany and visited a local doctor here and he gave me another appointment for upcoming Friday and said that Dr Ning did everything in a correct manner and that the hole will probably grow back together on its own... so I am now on supervision. I payed 2100 Baht for the antibiotics and the whole treatment which seems very fair to me - I will try to get the money back from my insurance here in Germany. Thank you DR Ning for treating me!
0x3054f6521da4919f_0x63e1b8b1f6f0d43a.author: Leon Spanier

0x3054f6521da4919f_0x63e1b8b1f6f0d43a.text: Excellent service from this clinic. I had a very painful ear infection and this clinic was highly recommended by several parties. The cost seemed reasonable to me, especially for the level of care and compared to other clinics I've visited. THB 2200 including consultation, packing the ear, antibiotics, ear drops, anti-inflammatories, and stomach protection meds. The follow was 1200 including additional ear drops. (Pics below.) The doctor and staff also provided documents in English for me to claim with my insurer. Top notch and highly recommended.

0x3054f6521da4919f_0x63e1b8b1f6f0d43a.text: I recently visited Ning Clinic with severe pain in my left ear, and the experience was nothing short of alarming. The facility itself looked disturbingly unsanitary, as though cleanliness were more rumor than reality. The medical equipment appeared outdated and unclean, and it hardly inspired confidence in their sterilization methods. To make matters worse, my encounter with Dr. Suphot Thaweethawonsawat was profoundly disappointing. He dismissed my thoughts about how the infection may have started, speaking to me as if I were an inconvenience rather than a patient. During the exam, he hastily placed a cotton wad in my ear without cleaning or sterilizing the area, causing additional pain and raising serious concerns about basic medical protocols. When I asked about paying only for the consultation—since I already had antibiotics and preferred not to purchase more—he threatened to involve the police if I didn’t comply with his instructions. He even suggested removing the cotton (the one he’d just inserted) at an extra 1000bhat charge if I refused his medication. It's ridiculous... Needless to say, I left the clinic in worse pain than when I arrived, both physically and emotionally. If you value professionalism, hygiene, and your peace of mind, I strongly recommend avoiding Ning Clinic at all costs. My visit has left me worried about the state of my ear and utterly shocked by how a supposed medical institution could operate this way. Very very bad.
0x3054f6521da4919f_0x63e1b8b1f6f0d43a.author: Nikolai Shelekhov

0x3054f6521da4919f_0x63e1b8b1f6f0d43a.text: On a Thursday, I called to see about how long of a wait they had. As the wait was long, I instead made an appointment which they said would give me priority over walk-ins. Their next availability was the following Monday at 10:30am which I made. They said to arrive 10 minutes early. I showed up at 10:15 and 4 people were in front of me and one in with the doctor. At 10:35, the person with doctor came out and they brought in one of the 4 people. I asked about my turn as we made an appointment to avoid waiting. I was told the person who went in also had an appointment at 10:00 am but that I would be next. Made sense. After that person came out, they took another one of the non-appointment people—I left. So although I cannot comment on the doctor’s ability, their staff cannot handle simple office management and I will give my business to someone else more professional.
0x3054f6521da4919f_0x63e1b8b1f6f0d43a.author: Tom Heffernan

0x3054f6521da4919f_0x63e1b8b1f6f0d43a.text: I’ve been coming to this clinic since I moved to Samui and have always had positive experiences with the female doctor. 0x30e29f95d20f4f69_0x36641f60c3ad661.text: I've been a repeat customer many times, but this time the booking service was absolutely terrible. I was contacted on the day of my appointment saying they needed to reschedule because of machine maintenance. If it was scheduled maintenance, why did I even book it? When I asked if there would be compensation, my LINE message was read but ignored. I tried a different date and time, but couldn't adjust my schedule, so I contacted them again for another time, but that was also read but ignored. What's going on? On my previous visit, my credit card wouldn't work. It had worked before, so when I pointed this out, they suggested my credit card might be faulty and asked me to buy a drink using it next door. When I tried, it worked perfectly. The problem was with the store's card reader; it worked after a restart. However, there was no compensation for the drink I unnecessarily bought, and I felt like I wanted my time back. Furthermore, I requested laser treatment, but the therapist suddenly told me at the counter on my way out that I had pre-existing burn scars and asked me to sign a consent form. They took pictures of the area during the treatment, so I was confused, but when I pointed this out, another therapist looked at the photos and said it wasn't a burn and therefore I didn't need to sign. I had a bad feeling about this new therapist I'd never seen before, and it turns out he was no good. And now, after this incident, my trust in him has plummeted. I still haven't heard from him, even though it's the day of the appointment...

0x311d62c825643fd7_0x44a4edf8451be915.en: Monday, November 12th: Had a dental appointment. Tooth impressions and X-rays were taken. The equipment was ready. Scheduled for a crown appointment. I'll be seeing Dr. Mali, a specialist who is very skilled. She previously helped fix a case done by a dentist in the Wong Sawang area. The price is standard, not expensive. Monday, November 19th, 2023: Appointment with Dr. Mali at 4:20 PM. Here, they have different dentists for each case: tooth extraction, specialization, root canal treatment, crowns, orthodontics. There are several dentists who rotate in caring for patients. There's parking for two cars in front of the clinic. If it's full, you have to go 50 meters further to the Top Charoen eyewear store; there's a parking lot. If you get your parking ticket stamped by the clinic, it costs 20 baht for parking over an hour. Sunday, January 7th, 2023: Had a wisdom tooth (lower left molar) extracted by Dr. Trin.
