0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.text: คุณหมอชิดชนก จัดฟันเก่งมากๆค่ะ ตามมาจากรีวิวในโซเชี่ยลท่านหนึ่ง พอมารักษาพบว่าคุณหมอเก่งและใส่ใจมากจริงๆค่ะ ประทับใจตั้งแต่ที่เข้ามาปรึกษา เพราะไปปรึกษาจัดฟันมาแล้ว 7-8 ที่ ไม่มีที่ไหนวางแผนการรักษาแบบที่คุณหมอแนะนำเลยบางที่แจ้งว่าจัดแบบปกติไม่ได้ต้องจัดแบบ brius หรือใสเท่านั้น แต่คุณหมอชิดชนกแนะนำว่าเคสนี้จัดปกติก็ได้ เนื่องจากคุณหมอวางแผนการรักษาเก่งด้วยเลยจัดธรรมดาได้ ที่สำคัญคุณหมอไม่ hard sale เลยค่ะ มาจัดกับคุณหมอรู้สึกเห็นแสงสว่าง ราคาไม่โอเวอร์เลย ประเมิณมาต่ำกว่าที่คิดเพราะคุณหมอจบเฉพาะทางจัดฟันมากๆเลยคิดว่าราคาจะแรงมาก แต่ไม่เลยค่ะ คุณหมอให้คำแนะนำดีมาก อธิบายครบ มือเบา ใจเย็น พูดเพราะ ตอบทุกคำถามละเอียด ตรง ไม่มีคำถามให้กลับบ้านไปสงสัยอีก และให้เกียรติคนไข้มากๆค่ะ สายไม่กี่นาทีคุณหมอยังขอโทษคนไข้ ซึ่งไม่เคยเจอมาก่อนค่ะ รู้สึกดีใจที่ได้เจอคุณหมอ ต้องขอบคุณโพสที่มารีวิวด้วยค่ะ หากใครนำรถมาแล้วอยากจอดรถสะดวก แนะนำให้จอดที่ฟอร์จูนทาวน์แล้วเดินมาได้ค่ะ ไม่ไกล ไม่ต้องข้ามถนน *** มาอัพเดทหลังจัดฟันผ่านไป 1 ปี นะคะ ฟันดีขึ้นกว่าเดิมเยอะและเร็วมาก⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️*** ผ่านมา 1 ปี ฟันเรียงตัวจนแบบแค่นี้ก็พอใจแล้วค่ะ ดีขึ้นมากๆ จัดฟันรอบก่อนมา 4 ปี ฟันยังไม่คืบหน้าเท่าจัดกับคุณหมอปีเดียวเลยค่ะ ส่วนตัวฟัน scissors bite แบบ 3 คู่ ไปปรึกษามาแล้ว 10 ที่ 8 ที่บอกเคสยากมาก จัดโลหะไม่ได้แน่นอน ถ้าจัดไม่รู้จะเป็นยังไงแพลนหน้างาน น่าจะนานถึง 8 ปี ให้จัดใส หรือ brius เท่านั้น มีแค่ 2 ที่ ที่แจ้งว่าจัดโลหะได้ คือ อาจารย์แพทย์ที่จุฬา กับ คุณหมอชิดชนกที่คลินิกนี้ แต่เลือกที่นี่เพราะคุณหมออธิบายแผนการรักษาได้เคลียมาก มีแผนการรักษาทางเลือก ตอบทุกข้อสงสัยตั้งแต่จัดฟันวันแรกจนผ่านมาเป็นปี คุณหมอยังเหมือนเดิมเป๊ะ ฟันเรียงตัวเร็วมากๆ ปัญหาที่คลินิกอื่นบอกแก้ไม่ได้ ถ้าแก้ก็นานมากหลายปี(Fact เพราะรอบก่อนจัดมา 4 ปี ฟันที่เกยังเกเหมือนเดิม เพราะแก้เรื่อง scissors bite ไม่ได้แม้แต่นิดเดียว) แต่คุณหมอทำได้ภายใน 1 ปี ฟันเรียงยิ้มมั่นใจ อาจจะยังแก้ได้ไม่เสร็จ แต่มีการเรียงตัวของฟันที่ดีขึ้นมากๆ ยกให้คุณหมอเป็นหมอฟันประจำตัวเลยค่ะ แนะนำคนรอบข้างไปหมดเลย ว่ายังไงก็ให้มาปรึกษาคุณหมอชิดชนกก่อนเท่านั้น! จะได้ความคิดเห็นที่ดี และไม่ hardsale ขอบคุณที่เจอคุณหมอนะคะ เป็นสิ่งมีรู้สึกโชคดีมากอีกหนึ่งสิ่งในชีวิตที่ได้เจอคุณหมอดีๆ🙏
0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.author: Lalipons Kosuma
0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.en: Dr. Chidchanok is an amazing orthodontist! I found her through a social media review. After receiving treatment, I found her to be truly skilled and caring. I was impressed from the consultation. I had consulted with 7-8 other orthodontists, and none of them had a treatment plan like Dr. Chidchanok's. Some said traditional braces weren't possible and only Brius or clear aligners were suitable. But Dr. Chidchanok suggested that traditional braces were possible for my case because of her excellent treatment planning skills. Importantly, she wasn't pushy at all. I felt like I saw a ray of hope when I started treatment with her. The price wasn't exorbitant at all; it was even lower than I expected, considering she's a specialist in orthodontics. I thought it would be very expensive, but it wasn't. She gave excellent advice, explained everything thoroughly, was gentle, patient, spoke kindly, answered all my questions in detail and directly, leaving no room for lingering doubts. She was incredibly respectful of her patients; she even apologized for being a few minutes late, something I've never experienced before. I'm so glad I found her. Thank you to the reviewer for sharing this information! If you're driving, convenient parking is available. I recommend parking at Fortune Town and walking over. It's not far and you don't need to cross the street. ***Update after 1 year of orthodontic treatment: My teeth are much better and much faster than before! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️*** After 1 year, my teeth are so well-aligned that I'm already very happy. The improvement is incredible. My previous orthodontic treatment took 4 years, and my teeth didn't progress as much as they did after just one year with this doctor. Regarding my scissor bite (3 pairs of teeth), I consulted with 10 clinics, and 8 said my case was very difficult and metal braces weren't possible. They said even if I did get metal braces, they weren't sure what the outcome would be, and it would likely take up to 8 years. They only recommended clear aligners or Brius. Only 2 clinics said metal braces were possible: a professor at Chulalongkorn University and Dr. Chidchanok at this clinic. I chose her because she explained the treatment plan very clearly, offered alternative treatment options, and answered all my questions from the first day of treatment until a year later. She's still exactly the same! My teeth are aligning very quickly. Other clinics said this problem was irresolvable or would take many years to fix (Fact: my previous treatment took 4 years, and my crooked teeth were still crooked). (Because the scissors bite problem couldn't be fixed at all) But the doctor managed to fix it within a year. My teeth are now perfectly aligned, and I can smile confidently. It might not be completely fixed yet, but the alignment of my teeth is significantly improved. I've made her my go-to dentist. I've recommended her to everyone I know, telling them to always consult Dr. Chidchanok first! You'll get a great opinion and she won't be pushy. Thank you for finding her, Dr. Chidchanok. It's one of the luckiest things in my life to have met such a good doctor. 🙏

0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.text: ก่อนหน้าจะผ่าฟันคุดซี่สุดท้าย (คุดนอน รากหงิก ) เรากลัวเจ็บมาก จนอดทนทิ้งไว้ เกือบยี่สิบปี จนซี่เท่าหนึ่งข้อปลายนิ้วก้อย 🥹 ใหญ่มาก รากเริ่มเเทงจนปวดข้างเเก้ม และ เศษอาหารก็ติดตลอด จนต้องพกฟลอสติดกระเป๋า จนสุดท้ายต้องไปต่างประเทศ เลยตัดสินใจปรึกษาน้องในสายงาน ว่าผ่าที่ไหนดี เค้าเเนะนำที่นี่ บอกว่าเจ็บน้อยมาก หายไว ไอ้เราก็ไม่อยากเชื่อเท่าไร แต่ก็ไป มีการ Xray รากฟัน ดูสภาพองค์รวม โอเค นอนเกย เเถม รากมีหงิกด้วย คุณหมอเก่งมาก ยังหนุ่มอยู่เลย ตัดสินใจกรอฟันจนเป็นเสี่ยงๆเเละค่อยๆคีบดึงออก แทนการงัด เพราะไม่ต้องการให้เราเหงือกช้ำและทรมานในการดึง เหงือกเป็นรูขนาดเท่าฟันที่ถูกกรอออกไปเป๊ะๆขอบเเผลเรียบ สวยมาก ดูไม่ช้ำเลือดช้ำหนองแบบที่เคยเห็นมาในอากู๋ เย็บซ่อนไหมสวยเเนบกับเเนวกรามเป๊ะมาก คือตอนอ้าปากได้เเล้ว เห็นแผลยังเเบบ โห งานเรียบร้อยมาก ตอนจะผ่าเรากลัวมากกก เกือบสติเเตก เเต่พอจบขั้นตอน หลังยาชาหาย จะมีปวดมาก แค่ครึ่งชั่วโมง เอาน้ำเเข็งมาประคบแก้ม แปปเดียวก็ทุเลา เเล้วจากนั้นไม่มีความเจ็บอีกเลย มีเเค่ตึงๆไหมที่เย็บไว้ เอาลิ้นไปเเตะๆเเผล ยังเเค่ปวดๆ คือไม่เจ็บเลยอะ ถ้าไม่โดนก็เฉยๆเลยจนงง นี่คือผ่าฟันคุดจริงอะ เเค่ระวังเรื่องเศษอาหารหล่นไปในรูฟันอย่างเดียว ต้องเขี่ยออก หรือ เเบบเรา เราใช้ไซริงจ์ป้อนยาเด็กฉีดน้ำเกลือเข้าไปในรูที่ผ่าน เศษอาหารก็จะออกมา สนุกมาก 🤣🥹 แผลหายไว ไม่ถึงสองวีคหายดีเลย ตอนดึงใหม่ก็เอาออกง่ายมาก ลื่นๆปรื้ด อุดฟันต่อเลย อีก แปดซี่ หมอบอก อุดไปคราวนี้ อยู่ไปเลยยาวๆอีกเกือบๆสองปีเลยนะ ให้คะเเนนเลย สิบเต็มสิบ ที่นี่ดีมากกกกกกกกกก
0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.author: JANA TAN
0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.en: Before having my last wisdom tooth extracted (a prone tooth with a crooked root), I was so afraid of the pain that I endured it for almost twenty years. It grew to the size of my little fingertip 🥹 – huge! The root started causing pain in my cheek, and food particles constantly got stuck, forcing me to carry floss in my bag. Finally, while traveling abroad, I consulted a colleague about where to get it done. They recommended this clinic, saying it was minimally painful and healed quickly. I was skeptical, but I went anyway. They X-rayed the root and overall condition; it was prone to overlapping and the root was crooked. The doctor was incredibly skilled and quite young. He decided to grind the tooth into pieces and then carefully extracted it with forceps, instead of prying, to avoid further gum trauma and pain. The hole in my gum was exactly the same size as the tooth that was ground away, with a smooth, clean edge. It didn't look bruised or infected like I'd seen in Google posts. The sutures were neatly hidden and perfectly aligned with my jawline. Even after I could open my mouth, the scar looked incredibly well-made. I was so scared during the surgery, I almost had a meltdown. But after the procedure and the anesthetic wore off, there was a lot of pain for only about half an hour. Applying ice to my cheek quickly relieved the pain, and then there was no more pain at all. There was just a slight tightness from the stitches. Touching the wound with my tongue only caused a little ache. It didn't hurt at all; it was completely indifferent unless touched, which surprised me. This was a real wisdom tooth extraction! The only thing to watch out for is food particles getting into the tooth cavity. You have to either remove them or, like I did, use a children's syringe to inject saline into the cavity, and the food particles come out. It was so much fun! 🤣🥹 The wound healed quickly, in less than two weeks. The extraction was also very easy, just a smooth, slippery motion. I had eight more teeth filled right away. The dentist said these fillings would last almost two more years. I give this place a perfect ten out of ten. It was amazing!

0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.text: ประทับใจมากกับการใช้บริการที่คลินิกนี้ครับ นัดหมายไว้เวลา 18:00 น. และเมื่อมาถึงก็ได้เข้ารับการรักษาทันที ตรงเวลาสุด ๆ พยาบาลที่นี่ให้บริการดีมาก เป็นมืออาชีพ ขอชาร์จโทรศัพท์ก็ให้ความช่วยเหลืออย่างดี ห้องน้ำสะอาดมาก แถมมีกลิ่นหอมสุด ๆ จนไม่กล้าใช้ให้เลอะเลย (แต่อยากให้มีทิชชูสำหรับเช็ดมือหรือหน้าตรงอ่างหน่อยนะครับ มีแต่ทิชชูม้วนไม่กล้าเอามาเช็ดเลย) ครั้งนี้คุณหมอผู้ชายเป็นคนขูดหินปูนให้ ทักทายก่อนลงมือทำ ท่านมือเบามาก ทำให้การรักษาผ่านไปด้วยดี และยังเปิดโอกาสให้ซักถามได้ ท่านมีความเป็นมืออาชีพและวุฒิภาวะที่น่าเชื่อถือ พอเสร็จก็สรุปผลให้ถึงสุขภาพฟัน *แต่อยากแนะนำสิ่งหนึ่งครับ ว่าน่าจะมีผ้ามาปิดรอบปากให้หน่อย หรือมีผ้าห่มผืนบางๆ ให้คนให้ขณะทำฟัน *อันนี้เป็นคำถามส่วนตัวนะครับ ไม่ได้เกี่ยวกับการบริการ ไม่แน่ใจว่าคลินิกทำฟันปกติเค้ามีมาตรฐานเครื่องมือหลังทำเสร็จได้เปลี่ยนทุกครั้งไหม เช่น ตัวกรอฟัน แก้วน้ำบ้วนปาก อาจจะเอาสิ่งนี้ไปโฆษณาเป็นมาตรฐานความสะอาดของคลินิกได้ ที่นี่สามารถใช้สิทธิ์ประกันสังคมได้ และสามารถขอใบเสร็จฉบับเต็มเพื่อนำไปเบิกประกันได้เช่นกัน การเดินทาง: • ถ้ามาจากฝั่ง ดินแดง คลินิกจะอยู่ก่อนถึงธนาคารกสิกรไทย ฝั่งซ้ายมือ • ถ้ามาจากฝั่ง พระราม 9 ให้เลยแยกพระราม 9 ไป กลับรถมา แล้วมองซ้ายมือก่อนถึงธนาคารกสิกรไทย
0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.author: rubber j
0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.en: I was very impressed with the service at this clinic. I had an appointment at 6:00 PM and was treated immediately upon arrival – perfectly on time! The nurses here are excellent and professional. They were very helpful when I asked to charge my phone. The restrooms were very clean and smelled wonderful – I was hesitant to use them for fear of making a mess! (However, I wish there were tissues for wiping hands and face at the sink; there were only rolled tissues, which I didn't dare use.) This time, a male dentist performed the tartar removal. He greeted me before starting and had a very gentle touch, making the treatment go smoothly. He also allowed me to ask questions. He was very professional and mature. Afterward, he summarized my dental health. *One suggestion, however, is that it would be nice to have a gauze or a thin blanket to cover my mouth during the procedure.* *This is a personal question, not related to the service. I'm not sure if regular dental clinics have a standard practice of changing instruments after each treatment, such as drills and mouthwash cups. This could be used to advertise the clinic's cleanliness standard.* This clinic accepts social security insurance. You can also request a full receipt to claim insurance benefits. Directions: • If coming from Din Daeng side, the clinic is on the left before Kasikorn Bank. • If coming from Rama 9 side, go past the Rama 9 intersection, make a U-turn, and look to your left before reaching Kasikorn Bank.

0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.text: ประทับใจมากๆเลยค่ะ ผ่าฟันคุดนอนซี่ล่าง ทำใจหนีมา3ปี(เพราะเคยผ่าซี่แรกที่อื่นเจ็บฝังใจ) กว่าจะตัดสินใจผ่าอีกซี่นานพอสมควร แต่พอมาผ่าจริงๆที่นี่ คุณหมอสมชายมือเบามากๆๆๆๆ ใจดีมากๆ หายตื่นเต้นเลย ฉีดยาชายังแทบไม่รู้สึกเลย ตอนแรกตั้งใจจะมาผ่าแค่ซี่ล่าง1ซี่ก่อนเพราะยังกลัวๆ(มีคุดข้างบนด้วยถอนได้ปกติ) คุณหมอแนะนำให้เอาออกทีเดียว2ซี่ไปเลย จังหวะจะเอาออกซี่ที่สองคือไม่กลัวแล้วเพราะซี่แรกผ่าเสร็จไปก็ไม่เจ็บเลยยสักนิด หลังผ่าตอนยาชาหมดปวดแค่นิดหน่อยทานยาก็หายย ขอบคุณคลินิกที่เอาฟันคุดของหนูออกไปหมดแล้ว 🙏🏻🙏🏻 ใครหาที่ผ่าฟันคุดแนะนำที่นี่เลยค่า จากคนที่กลัวการผ่าฟันคุดสุดๆมาก่อน หมอมือเบา ไม่เจ็บเลยจริงๆค่า
0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.author: Chanissara Promket
0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.en: I was so impressed! I had my lower wisdom tooth extracted here. I'd been avoiding it for 3 years (because of a painful experience with my first wisdom tooth extracted elsewhere). It took me quite a while to decide to have another one done, but when I finally got it done here, Dr. Somchai was incredibly gentle and kind. My anxiety disappeared completely! I barely felt the anesthetic injection. Initially, I only planned to have one lower wisdom tooth removed because I was still a bit scared (I also had an upper wisdom tooth that could be extracted normally). The doctor recommended removing both at once. When it was time to remove the second one, I wasn't scared anymore because the first one was painless afterwards. After the anesthetic wore off, there was only a little pain, which was relieved with medication. Thank you so much to the clinic for removing all my wisdom teeth 🙏🏻🙏🏻 I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for wisdom tooth extraction. From someone who was terrified of wisdom tooth extraction before, the doctor was incredibly gentle and it really didn't hurt at all!

0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.text: ต้องขอบพระคุณ รศ.นพ.ทพ.สมชาย ผู้มีความเชี่ยวชาญในการทำรากเทียมและศัลยกรรมช่องปากและขากรรไกรสูงมากกก สามารถทำรากเทียมให้ผู้สูงอายุ (95ปี) ได้อย่างราบรื่นไม่มีปัญหา ใช้งานได้ดีมีความสุขขึ้นมากกก ท่านเคยเป็นอาจารย์ภาคศัลยกรรมที่คณะทันตแพทย์ มหาวิทยาลัยจุฬาฯ และจบทั้งคณะทันตแพทย์ และคณะแพทยศาสตร์ แนะนำสำหรับผู้ที่มีปัญหายากๆ เกี่ยวกับฟันเลยค่ะ
0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.author: Kulruedee Otaganonta
0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.en: Many thanks to Associate Professor Dr. Somchai, DDS, who is an exceptionally highly skilled expert in dental implants and oral and maxillofacial surgery. He successfully performed a dental implant procedure on a 95-year-old patient without any problems. The patient is now much happier and more functional. He was formerly a professor in the Surgery Department at the Faculty of Dentistry, Chulalongkorn University, and holds degrees from both the Faculty of Dentistry and the Faculty of Medicine. I highly recommend him for anyone with complex dental problems.

0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.text: เป็นคลินิกทันตกรรมที่เปิดมายาวนานหลายสิบปี คนแถวนั้นรู้จักดี เราก็ใช้บริการมานานตั้งแต่เด็ก ๆ คุณหมอมีฝีมือ และอุปกรณ์ครบครันได้มาตรฐานค่ะ This dental clinic has been opened for decades and well known by locals. I have been using the clinic since I was young. High experienced dentists and standard equipments are provided.
0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.author: Theresa O. C.
0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.en: This dental clinic has been open for decades and is well-known in the area. I've been a customer since I was a child. The dentists are highly skilled, and the equipment is complete and meets high standards.

0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.text: ขอบคุณทันตแพทย์ และผู้ช่วยสำหรับการขูดหินปูน และขัดทำความสะอาดฟันค่ะ ขณะที่ขูดหินปูนกับทันตแพทย์ และผู้ช่วย วันที่ 16 ธค มีละอองน้ำกระเด็นค่อนข้างมาก อาจหาวิธีป้องกันค่ะ เพราะ ไม่สามารถกลั้นหายใจตลอดระยะเวลาการขูดหินปูน (ประมาณ 20 นาที รวมเวลาพักสักครู่ระหว่างฟันบน ฟันล่าง) การหายใจขณะที่มีละอองน้ำอาจทำให้เกิดอาการระคายในระบบทางเดินหายใจได้
0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.author: vipawee lsk
0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.en: Thank you to the dentist and assistant for the scaling and polishing. During the scaling procedure with the dentist and assistant on December 16th, there was quite a lot of spray. I might consider finding a way to protect myself because I couldn't hold my breath for the entire scaling procedure (approximately 20 minutes, including short breaks between upper and lower teeth). Breathing in the presence of spray could cause respiratory irritation.

0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.text: Poor service quality, inconvenience location, no parking lot, most of staff do not speak English and especially crazy expensive. (Implant THB65,000 per tooth) Highly NOT recommended!
0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.author: DongHoon Lee

0x3054f30bab201f0f_0x8cf0e61308d22790.text: I’ve been going to Sweet Skin by Sam for about 3+ years now, and I can confidently say Sam is the best esthetician on the island. I visit her monthly for my self-care routine and have experienced a wide range of her treatments — from anti-aging and acne facials to dermaplaning, LED light therapy, face massages, microdermabrasion, and even non-peel chemical peels (I’ve done four sessions so far!). Sam knows her products inside and out and always customizes treatments for my very sensitive, acne-prone skin. I trust her completely with my simple skincare regimen — cleanser, moisturizer, and sunscreen — and I buy all my products directly from her because she imports high-quality brands from the U.S. that aren’t available in Thailand. Beyond her expertise, Sam is genuinely passionate about what she does. She’s knowledgeable, meticulous, and caring, and she’s helped me feel confident in my own makeup-free skin. I’m so grateful to have found such a wonderfully informed and dedicated esthetician here on Koh Samui. Highly, highly recommend!
0x3054f30bab201f0f_0x8cf0e61308d22790.author: Jaspreet Narang

0x3054f30bab201f0f_0x8cf0e61308d22790.text: I've been receiving an anti ageing facial from Samantha once a month for the last 2 years and I am always over the moon with the treatment and the results. I always leave with glowing skin! I don't do a whole lot for my face inbetween sessions and don't feel like I have to because her facials are enough to keep my skin looking great. Her treatment room is peaceful, comfortable bed. I loooove the face and arm massage she gives me every time, I can tell she's doing it with a lot of presence and care. She uses top of the range products and really cares about your skin. Do not hesitate to book in with her for your facial while you're in Samui. You won't regret it! Thanks Samantha you're awesome 😊❤️
0x3054f30bab201f0f_0x8cf0e61308d22790.author: Lexi Hyman

0x3054f30bab201f0f_0x8cf0e61308d22790.text: I had such a wonderful experience today. I’m truly very satisfied with the facial treatment I received. It had been a long time since I allowed myself to take a little time just for me, and this was exactly what I needed. The consultation was incredibly thorough and attentive — I really felt that my skin was carefully analyzed and understood. The entire treatment was deeply relaxing, and the atmosphere was absolutely magical, making it easy to completely unwind. On top of that, the location itself is simply stunning and adds so much to the overall experience. I’m genuinely very happy with everything and would highly recommend it.
0x3054f30bab201f0f_0x8cf0e61308d22790.author: Giulia

0x3054f30bab201f0f_0x8cf0e61308d22790.text: Best esthetician on the island! Goes above and beyond any other esthetician. She Really listens to your concerns, she revises all of the products you’re using to make sure they don’t create issues in the future and gives you suggestions that our budget friendly. She also uses a great product line that you can easily purchase from her That isn’t too expensive either. Samantha really listens in general and creates a luxurious experience from top to bottom, and she also connects her services with breath and meditation and her face massages are the best.
0x3054f30bab201f0f_0x8cf0e61308d22790.author: Sasha Jarufe

0x3054f30bab201f0f_0x8cf0e61308d22790.text: I enjoy coming to Samantha for treatments. She takes a comprehensive approach to her work — it’s not just about the procedure itself, but also about finding skincare products tailored specifically to your skin and its needs. She helps adjust your nutrition and lifestyle as well. I’m always satisfied with the results, and the space itself is simply wonderful — complete relaxation combined with her massage. I highly recommend her, you won’t regret it.
0x3054f30bab201f0f_0x8cf0e61308d22790.author: Irina Pavlova

0x3054f30bab201f0f_0x8cf0e61308d22790.text: Love Sam! She has healed my face, it is glowing and radiant! She helps me pick the best products that suit the climate here and I see her monthly for treatment, it has been life changing! I didn’t understand the importance of face care for anti aging and health before I started seeing her, and now I definitely do! I’d highly recommend her services! She is so passionate about what she does and it radiates through the experience AND the results 💛💛💛
0x3054f30bab201f0f_0x8cf0e61308d22790.author: Kelly Hogan

0x3054f30bab201f0f_0x8cf0e61308d22790.text: Sam is a wonderful esthetician! I've had a few anti-aging facial treatments and I'm always so happy with the results! Not only is she very knowledgeable, she's also passionate about what she does, and it shows in how she pinpoints skin problems, tailors treatments, and recommends specific skincare regimens. In addition, she has a very warm personality, so it's always such a pleasant experience to get a treatment. Highly recommend!
0x3054f30bab201f0f_0x8cf0e61308d22790.author: G L

0x3054f30bab201f0f_0x8cf0e61308d22790.text: Samantha is a true professional! She takes the time to get to know your skin inside out and treats according to your needs. She has really helped my get my rosacea and acne under control and I always feel so fresh and relaxed after my facials! I have been going to Samantha for over 3 years now and wouldn’t let anyone else near my skin!
0x3054f30bab201f0f_0x8cf0e61308d22790.author: Paula Thompson

0x30da3a6798ffd4f5_0x68100f0b9ee03df0.text: วันนี้เราไปขูดหินปูน ใช้สิทธิ์บัตรทอง ไม่เสียเงินเลยเลย พี่พนักงานที่เคาน์เตอร์ใจดีมาก พูดเพราะ ให้บริการดีมาก บอกว่ามาใช้สิทธิ์บัตรทองก็ให้บริการดีมากๆ น่ารักมากค่ะ ส่วนคุณหมอ ก็ขูดหินปูนได้ดีมาก ไม่เจ็บ ไม่ระบมเลย แล้วก็ตรวจฟันละเอียดมาก ตรวจดูว่าเรามีฟันผุไหม มีหินปูนมากแค่ไหน ชอบมากๆ ค่ะ ใครกำลังใครกำลังลังเลว่าจะมาที่นี่ไหม แนะนำเลยค่ะ ดีมาก 🥰
0x30da3a6798ffd4f5_0x68100f0b9ee03df0.author: jurarat meelongloi
0x30da3a6798ffd4f5_0x68100f0b9ee03df0.en: Today I went for a teeth cleaning using my government health insurance card, so I didn't have to pay anything. The staff at the counter were very kind, polite, and provided excellent service. They even mentioned that I was using the government health insurance card, which made the service exceptionally good. So lovely! The dentist did a great job cleaning my teeth; it wasn't painful or sore at all. They also did a very thorough checkup, examining my cavities and the amount of tartar buildup. I really appreciated the service. If you're hesitant about coming here, I highly recommend it! It's excellent! 🥰

0x30da3a6798ffd4f5_0x68100f0b9ee03df0.text: คุณหมอบริการดีมาก​ ให้คำแนะนำเป็นอย่างดี​มือเบาแทบไม่เจ็บเลย​ พนักงานบริการดี​ ควรจะต้องนัดหมายล่วงหน้า​เพื่อความสะดวก​ สถานที่หาง่ายใกล้แยกภูคำ​ สถานที่กว้างขวาง​ สามารถ​จอดรถไว้หน้าคลีนิก​ได้​ ใช้สิทธิ​บัตรทองและประกันสังคม​ได้​ ไม่ต้องสำรอง​จ่าย
0x30da3a6798ffd4f5_0x68100f0b9ee03df0.author: Chai Nataphat Pinchaithana
0x30da3a6798ffd4f5_0x68100f0b9ee03df0.en: The doctor provided excellent service and advice. The procedure was very gentle and painless. The staff were also very helpful. It's recommended to make an appointment in advance for convenience. The location is easy to find, near the Phukham intersection. The place is spacious, and you can park in front of the clinic. They accept the National Health Insurance (Gold Card) and Social Security, so no upfront payment is required.

0x30da3a6798ffd4f5_0x68100f0b9ee03df0.text: คุณหมอ และ เจ้าหน้าที่น่ารักมาก เป็นการขูดหินปูนในปากที่ละเอียดมาก ขัดฟันก็ละเอียดมากแม้กระทั่งจุดเล็กๆหมอก็ไม่มองข้าม ประกันสังคมไม่มีค่าใช้จ่ายเพิ่มเติมจริง มีจ่ายแค่ที่ทำเพิ่ม ราคาน่ารักมาก
0x30da3a6798ffd4f5_0x68100f0b9ee03df0.en: The doctor and staff were very kind. The scaling and polishing were very thorough, even the smallest details weren't overlooked. There were no additional charges under social security insurance; I only paid for the extra services provided. The price was very reasonable.

0x30da3a6798ffd4f5_0x68100f0b9ee03df0.text: เมื่อวานไปขูดหินปูนมา ใช้สิทธิ์บัตรทอง พนง.เค้าเตอร์พูดจา บริการดี เข้าไปในห้อง ผู้ช่วยกับคุณหมอ ก็ดีเยี่ยมค่ะ ขูดหินปูนไม่เจ็บเลย มาใช้บริการครั้งแรกค่ะ รบกวนจองคิวก่อนเข้าใช้บริการค่ะ
0x30da3a6798ffd4f5_0x68100f0b9ee03df0.author: อาส้ม
0x30da3a6798ffd4f5_0x68100f0b9ee03df0.en: I went for a teeth cleaning yesterday using my government health insurance card. The counter staff were very polite and provided excellent service. Inside the room, the assistant and the dentist were also excellent. The teeth cleaning was painless. This was my first time using their service. Please make an appointment in advance.

0x30da3a6798ffd4f5_0x68100f0b9ee03df0.text: สิทธิบัตรทอง สะดวก ไม่ต้องสำรองจ่าย บริการเหมือนจองVVIP มา คุณหมอมือเบา พูดจาไพเราะ ขูดหินปูนเสียวนิดหน่อยเเละไม่เจ็บเลย ไม่เคยขูดหินปูนที่ไหนเเล้วไม่เจ็บ จนกระทั่งที่นี่ เเนะนำเลยค่ะ
0x30da3a6798ffd4f5_0x68100f0b9ee03df0.author: Alanza ME
0x30da3a6798ffd4f5_0x68100f0b9ee03df0.en: The universal healthcare scheme is convenient, no upfront payment required, and the service is like having a VVIP appointment. The dentist is gentle and speaks kindly. The tartar removal was slightly painful but not at all. I've never had tartar removed anywhere else without pain until here. I highly recommend it!

0x30e29f4099779269_0x878adc3e0f7e99c3.en: There are three clinics near my house that offer veneer treatments by specialist doctors, but I chose EDEN ONE because it seemed the most reputable. The staff were also very knowledgeable and provided great consultations. I checked and found out they have over ten years of experience – both the doctor and the staff are highly skilled. Everyone who saw the results complimented how beautiful and natural the veneers looked. I made the right decision getting my veneers here. If you're considering it, I highly recommend this clinic. You won't be disappointed.

0x30e29f862868af81_0xc6ac629d89fe5de4.text: I had the pleasure of visiting SHIELDS Medical Center Bangkok about a year ago with my significant other, and it remains one of the best healthcare experiences we’ve ever had. From the moment we arrived, the entire process was exceptionally organized, professional, and welcoming. The health assessment was incredibly comprehensive and thorough, giving us confidence that every aspect of our health was being carefully evaluated. A special thank you to Dr. Kang, who was outstanding. He took the time to explain every finding, answered all of our questions with patience, and genuinely cared about our long-term health. His expertise and bedside manner made the entire experience feel personalized rather than rushed. If you’re looking for a world-class medical center in Bangkok for a comprehensive health checkup, I highly recommend SHIELDS Medical Center and Dr. Kang. We left feeling informed, reassured, and truly well cared for.
0x30e29f862868af81_0xc6ac629d89fe5de4.author: Ted Vuong

0x30e29f862868af81_0xc6ac629d89fe5de4.text: I had such a great experience at Shields Medical Center Bangkok! Dr. Kang and Dr. Ingfa are absolutely amazing—so warm, approachable, and genuinely caring that it felt like I’d known them for years. They explained everything clearly and made me feel completely at ease throughout my visit. Special shoutout as well to their super friendly and well-spoken receptionist (I know I asked for your name—sorry, I’m terrible at remembering names 😅✌️). And their nurse? Highly skilled and efficient—I felt I was in excellent hands from start to finish. The facility itself is clean, modern, and calming. I really appreciated how they respected my privacy and attended to my needs with such urgency and professionalism. Highly recommend for anyone looking for trusted medical care in Bangkok!
0x30e29f862868af81_0xc6ac629d89fe5de4.author: Orion 21

0x30e29f862868af81_0xc6ac629d89fe5de4.text: I recently visited Shields Clinic and had a great experience. The location is super convenient — just a short walk from both the MRT and BTS stations. The first thing I noticed was how clean and well-maintained the clinic is. The atmosphere felt calm and professional. The receptionist was very welcoming and friendly, which made me feel comfortable right away. I had a few questions about their IV drip options, and the doctor took the time to explain everything clearly. They were very knowledgeable and patient, making sure I understood the different types of drips and what would suit my needs best. It really helped put me at ease and showed they genuinely care about their patients. Overall, I’m really happy with the service and care I received. Highly recommend! 😁⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

0x30e29f862868af81_0xc6ac629d89fe5de4.text: Came to Shield Medical Center today for a driver’s license check and my work permit doctor’s certificate, 5-star experience. Bonus points: there are actually interesting books, so I almost forgot I was waiting. Then Dr. Kang showed up, greeted me, and handled everything quickly and flawlessly. The whole process was smooth from start to finish. He’s professional, kind, very reassuring… and let’s be honest, probably the most handsome doctor in town. 0x30e29f862868af81_0xc6ac629d89fe5de4.text: I had the privilege of meeting the founder of Shield in person—someone who impressively balances caring for patients by day and looking out for partygoers like us at night. 0x30e29f862868af81_0xc6ac629d89fe5de4.text: I have had a great experience at Shields Clinic. 0x311d67214c440eef_0xdd703a29b109a6c8.text: I recently visited for a PRP treatment at this clinic, I've had this done more than eight times with other clinic without any issues and I am a regular blood donor, so I was well-prepared and well-hydrated. I left feeling disappointed and frustrated with the overall experience. I hope this feedback is taken into consideration to help improve your services.

0x311d61e2f92c5123_0xaf9d4a462395ec5.text: วันนี้มาตรวจสุขภาพฟันและช่องปากที่คลินิกนี้เป็นครั้งแรก(ปกติจะทำฟันคลินิกใกล้บ้าน) ได้พบกับคุณหมอผู้หญิง ซึ่งเคยเป็นทั้งอาจารย์หมอ&รองคณบดีคณะทันตแพทย์ที่มหาวิทยาลัยขอนแก่น คุณหมอใจดีน่ารักมากๆ ใส่ใจคนไข้ดีมาก เรามีปัญหาเรื่องคราบหินปูนเกาะฟันง่ายต้องขูดหินปูนบ่อย ซึ่งคุณหมอคลินิกแถวบ้านเคยบอก แต่ไม่ได้อธิบายสาเหตุว่าเพราะอะไร การได้พบคุณหมอวันนี้ คุณหมออธิบายสาเหตุให้เข้าใจแบบกระจ่าง เพราะเรามีฟันซ้อนทำให้การแปรงฟันเพียงอย่างเดียวทำความสะอาดไม่ทั่วถึงคุณหมอจึงให้คำแนะนำการทำความสะอาดฟันโดยการใช้ไหมขัดฟันแบบตลับและสอนการขัดฟันที่ถูกต้อง เราจึงรู้ว่าที่เราใช้ไหมขัดฟันแบบด้ามพลาสติกไม่สามารถขจัดคราบหินปูนออกได้หมด รู้สึกประทับใจและจะกลับมาที่นี่อีกแน่นอน ป.ล. 1.ค่าตรวจฟัน เสียค่าใช้จ่ายเพียง100฿เป็นค่าอุปกรณ์ แต่ได้รับคำแนะนำดีๆและการอธิบายต่างๆเพียบ คุ้มค่ามากๆจนอยากแนะนำทุกคนมาใช้บริการที่นี่กันเยอะๆนะคะ คลินิกเพิ่งเปิดครบ 1ปี 2.ที่นี่รับสิทธิประกันสังคมและ บัตรทอง(สปสช)ด้วยนะ แต่ใช้ร่วมกันไม่ได้ค่ะ(เงื่อนไขของรัฐให้เลือกอย่างใดอย่างนึง)

0x311d61e2f92c5123_0xaf9d4a462395ec5.text: ปกติไม่ค่อยรีวิวให้ใครค่ะ แต่ วันนี้เต็มใจรีวิวมากเลยค่ะ ประทับใจตั้งแต่คุยทางโทรศัพท์ กับน้อง Dear ค่ะ สอบถามเกี่ยวกับสิทธิ์ทันตกรรมบัตรทองค่ะ เพราะมีการเปลี่ยนแปลงการจอง ก็ถอดใจจะไม่ทำฟันแล้วค่ะ😵‍💫แต่ น้องเดียร์ให้รายละเอียดดีมากค่ะ😃 พอไปถึง Little Walk ก็มีเจ้าหน้าที่รปภอำนวยความสะดวกในการจอดรถ 🙂 พอไปถึงคลินิกน้องเดียร์ก็ให้การต้อนรับอย่างดี รอไม่นานค่ะ พอได้พบคุณหมอ คุณหมอก็ทำการตรวจสุขภาพโดยรวมให้ ตัดสินใจอุดไปหนึ่งซี่ ถึงแม้ว่าในรีวิวจะบอกว่าคุณหมอมือเบามาก ก็ยังเกร็งเกร็งค่ะว่าจะเสียวไหม🤔 ยืนยันนะคะ คุณหมอมือเบามากมากค่ะ 😄 ใจดีด้วยค่ะ🥰 แนะนำค่ะ

0x311d61e2f92c5123_0xaf9d4a462395ec5.en: I don't usually write reviews, but today I'm so happy to share! I was impressed from the moment I spoke to Dear on the phone. I inquired about my Golden Card dental benefits because my appointment had changed and I had almost given up on getting treatment.😵‍💫 But Dear gave me excellent details.😃 When I arrived at Little Walk, the security guard helped me with parking. 🙂 Upon arriving at the clinic, Dear greeted me warmly. I didn't have to wait long. After seeing the dentist, she gave me a general check-up. I decided to get one filling done. Even though the reviews said the dentist was very gentle, I was still a little nervous about whether it would be painful.🤔 I can confirm that the dentist was incredibly gentle! 😄 And very kind too. 🥰 Highly recommend!

0x311d61e2f92c5123_0xaf9d4a462395ec5.text: วันนี้ไปคลินิกทำฟันมา ตอนแรกตั้งใจไปขูดหินปูน แต่เจอว่ามีฟันแตก คุณหมอแนะนำให้อุดฟันก่อนแล้วค่อยขูดหินปูน คุณหมอใจดีมาก อธิบายละเอียด เข้าใจง่าย บริการประทับใจสุด ๆ ใครมองหาคลินิกทำฟันดี ๆ แนะนำที่นี่เลยค่ะ!

0x30502fd066cf7e49_0x3a3c30375e3b75c5.text: Hi everyone! Today is our last day at this wonderful preschool, and I can't help but mention it. Honestly, the only thing we'll miss when we leave Phuket is this preschool. It's simply wonderful! We've been taking our daughter to Yana (the speech therapist and preschool director) since last May, for a year and three months now. At first, we took her to a speech therapist because as soon as we arrived, we immediately enrolled her in preschool (a different one at the time). Only then did we start looking for a speech therapist, since at three, our Eva barely spoke (well, maybe a little in her own language, but it was practically impossible to understand). Within a year, she started speaking fully, everyone understood her, and all that was left was to correct her speech impediment. But then, the preschool we attended ran out of children. Last year, they were there for a while in the summer, but this year, almost everyone went home for the summer, and Eva was left with only her four-year-old and a two-year-old girl, and that was it. It was a complete disaster, as they say. This happened literally at the end of May, a little less than three months had passed. We couldn't stand it anymore, and knowing that our favorite speech therapist, Yana, had a group of Eva's peers, we decided to ask them to join us for at least three months before leaving, so that Eva wouldn't be alone at the preschool. So, we changed preschools and were simply stunned by the conditions. Honestly, I still can't believe this is possible. There, we had to bring snacks and even bottled water with us because they only fed us once (they gave us some food in the morning, of course, some crumbs, but only one proper lunch). Here on the first day, Yana said, "Why did you bring anything with you?" We have everything here, we'll feed them four times.... Karl!!! Four times a day.... Oh my God, four times. I'm shocked. All the food is Russian, I started eating porridge because of it; I never ate it at home before, but they taught me here. There's always compote, soups, everything Russian. It's simply amazing. Besides the excellent food, I can't help but mention the five teachers who work with the children all day. Among them are two speech therapists. And this is with about 10-12 children, and they're always there in such numbers. Imagine having five people watching and caring for your child, not two at most like we had before. It's a world of difference. Everything is in Russian, the children are Russian-speaking (although they teach English, of course), which certainly helps with their development. But such care and nutrition aren't everything; there's an even more important thing that we never expected. Eva started speaking completely within her first month there, even starting to pronounce the letter "R"; she now communicates completely in a completely understandable language. Her development has begun before our eyes; it's clear that she's being given time. She draws a lot, draws at home too, sings songs—in short, there are no words. I'm writing this review with great pleasure; we were so lucky to have chosen Yana. If we'd known, we would have gone there from the very beginning; it just happened that way. But these three months have been a godsend for us; we're truly lucky to have this preschool. Honestly, those Thai international preschools are a bit of a bummer; when you try everything a little, you end up with no results. But as soon as we arrived at the Russian preschool, she changed dramatically. It's a shame that we'll have to go to another preschool in another country. We really wouldn't want to leave, but as they say, it can't be helped. Today, as I already said, is our last day here. I recommend everyone send their child here; you will be very grateful in the end, I know it!
0x30502fd066cf7e49_0x3a3c30375e3b75c5.author: Вадим Забелин

0x30502fd066cf7e49_0x3a3c30375e3b75c5.text: In short, it's a wonderful preschool! I hadn't planned on sending my daughter to preschool until she was at least three, but after arriving in Phuket, she became very interested in other children, so we decided to give preschool a try. Although this preschool wasn't the most conveniently located option, several children from our condo were already attending, and everyone was very happy. We listened to the reviews and didn't regret it. I'm so glad my daughter's first preschool turned out to be exactly like this! The adjustment to preschool was extremely smooth, and pretty soon she started staying for naps, which still amazes me, because at home, no one but me can get her to sleep, but at preschool, we managed it! What I especially want to note: Since this was my daughter's first preschool, it was very important to me to have access to information about her progress. Yana always sent me photos, and if anything was bothering me, she responded promptly. The children have a lot of photos and videos, which is wonderful and important to us. During her time at the preschool, my daughter's speaking skills have improved greatly; she can pronounce more complex words. She even learned a few English words. Her horizons have broadened—almost every time we ask her in surprise, "How did you know that?" she replies, "I learned it at preschool." Wonderful developmental and creative activities—the children were constantly drawing, gluing, and sculpting. The food was Russian, and my child loved it. The teachers were very kind and attentive. My daughter preferred to communicate with Russian-speaking teachers, but from what I saw, the Thai teachers were also always responsive and attentive. In general, the issue of teachers and educators is, in my opinion, the most important thing in a preschool, and we are doing just fine in this regard: it's clear the specialists are genuinely interested in the children and genuinely care. Wonderful holidays—the children had a wonderful New Year's celebration with Father Frost, games, and gifts. For March 8th, the children learned poems about their mothers, drew portraits, and gave gifts. The attention to detail and shared care are also one of the reasons why our kindergarten has become so important to us. A natural challenge after our wonderful kindergarten—it seems we'll have a hard time finding a kindergarten in Moscow that even partially meets the high standards set by Yana and her wonderful staff.
0x30502fd066cf7e49_0x3a3c30375e3b75c5.author: Ольга Гаврилова

0x30502fd066cf7e49_0x3a3c30375e3b75c5.text: We attended this preschool for over a year, only stopping because we moved from the island. To say it's the best preschool is an understatement! The way the teachers manage to combine their boundless love for the children with their insistence on following the rules is worthy of not only respect but also admiration! Moreover, the preschool is inclusive, as the teachers can find an approach to any child and teach them to do the same. The educational activities were a separate criterion for me choosing this preschool. The development of emotional intelligence and critical thinking, sensory integration, art therapy, and speech therapy are just some of the areas the children are taught. My daughter learned self-regulation (given her age, of course), how to follow instructions, and how to understand and communicate her feelings. She felt loved, needed, special there, and, of course, safe. There's no reason why I wouldn't recommend this preschool. If you are looking for a place where your child will not only be taught, but also loved - this is it!
0x30502fd066cf7e49_0x3a3c30375e3b75c5.author: Татьяна Костылева

0x30502fd066cf7e49_0x3a3c30375e3b75c5.text: We are very happy that our daughters are in this private kindergarten. We see how much they are growing and developing. They enthusiastically tell us what they've learned today. The progress in their speech skills is obvious—they've become better and more clear, and they've also started using English words and expressions. Every day is filled with enriching activities and delicious food (according to the girls), and this is very pleasing. I'd especially like to note the atmosphere in the kindergarten—the girls enjoy coming to kindergarten; they say they're loved there! They feel cared for and cared for by the teachers. It's very clean and cozy, with wonderful celebrations and gifts afterward. This kindergarten has become a true second home for them, where they develop, learn many interesting things, and have fun. We're absolutely happy with our choice and will definitely return in the fall!
0x30502fd066cf7e49_0x3a3c30375e3b75c5.author: Кристина Рыженкова

0x30502fd066cf7e49_0x3a3c30375e3b75c5.text: My wife and I contacted this center seeking help with behavioral correction and speech development for my son, who has a diagnosis of ASD. I express my deepest gratitude to Yana, a speech therapist, special education specialist, and neuropsychologist. She was not afraid of such responsibility and was able to establish a rapport with my son, something I personally struggle with. During the first session, my son was literally acting wild, running around chaotically and grabbing everything in sight. Since working with Neurologo, we've learned to speak his first few phrases, he's become much more patient, his play skills have improved, and most importantly, he enjoys attending classes, which speaks volumes about Yana's professionalism, as we've previously worked with two centers where the staff worked for the money rather than the results. I highly recommend this center to all parents.

0x30503a98680bb22f_0xc3a4ce0f09509128.text: I wanted to give an amazing review to pay back for the time and effort to help me with my dental emergency . I am on holiday from Australia and my white filling fell out from my front tooth . This was really going to be a problem and I still had over a week till I returned home . So a little voice on my head said get it fixed here . So I googled and researched . Read the reviews and also this dental surgery was in walking distance . Of course nerve wracking because I’m in a different country . Well I walked in off the street and was helped with kind and professional staff . I knew this filling was going to need more as I was told this back home . I was listened to and things were discussed for the best option and one that was not to invasive too . A veneer and was going to be way better than another filling that could fall out . I was helped by an extremely skilled dentist and beautiful nursing staff . I am now going home with a better dental job than what I came here with . I can also tell that the dentist came back on the Saturday to finish things off especially, so thank you . For those worried about dental work, this was performed with utmost care and professionalism . Also painless ! All care to your comfort taken . The cost was way less than it would cost me back home . Which I would have had to face no matter what . So if I am ever back I’ll bring extra cash for a clean or something . With confidence I can recommend this practice and you are in good hands . I am going home now very happy and who would have thought with a better tooth than when I came . Glad I listened to that little voice . Thank you to my dentist, you are extremely skilled and to your staff .. thankyou xx

0x30503a98680bb22f_0xc3a4ce0f09509128.text: Came to Patong to do my crown, polish and whiten my teeth. And... The service, quality of dental procedures and professionalism far exceeded my expectations! Dr Pook did my crown and she's truly an expert! This is my second zirconia crown (first one did it in a private clinic in Singapore) and the experience is far better than my first. Dr Pook was gentle and very efficient, completed my temporary crown in 1 hr. I had no problem with it at all and my permanent crown was ready in 4 days and once again Dr Pook installed it gently and efficiently and improved it even by leaving a smaller gap between teeth. My first experience had my temp crown coming loose in just 3 days and took 2 weeks for my perm crown to be ready. Dr Tanya took care of my polishing and whitening, and she was super professional advising me on the pros and cons of whitening due to my 2 front teeth having an existing filling. She gave me the best advise for my benefit allowing me to device whether to proceed with whitening and on the polishing work, she did a superb job, removing all stains and smoothening rough teeth surfaces! Highly recommended and not forgetting to mention, costs a lot less than in SG (the crown costs less than half of my first one) while able to enjoy a relaxing holiday here in Phuket!! Double thumbs up for Dr Pook, Dr Tanya and the team at Dental Plus Patong!

0x30503a98680bb22f_0xc3a4ce0f09509128.text: First let’s start with the office staff they are pleasant and polite and explained everything clearly. They do their best to accommodate all requests. I also paid for three Zoom whitening sessions to whiten all of my teeth. after the conclusion of the three whitening sessions the dental technician looked at my teeth and said I think you need one more session which she did at no additional charge. My experience is my teeth are perfectly white and almost glow in the dark. Now the doctor she was polite and professional and very thorough. They deserve all five stars that I gave them. The staff explained to me that there would be a little pain after the process and that it would go away in three days and gave me a local anesthetic that I could rub on my gums for the next couple of days but in reality it doesn’t hurt and one ibuprofen seems to take all the pain away.

0x30e29f289a310035_0x6f9b89002536a197.text: Twenty years of visiting Thailand has taught me a lot, including where to get good dental care. In all that time, I've had every kind of work done here: cleanings, scaling, fillings, root canals, even an implant. For years I stayed loyal to one dentist who was skilled, fair, and easy to trust. Then his company grew, and so did the bills. Eventually his prices rivaled those of the top-tier dentists in Bangkok, so I started looking around. I live near Siam, so I tried Century Plaza, right by Victory Monument BTS station. There are more than a dozen dental clinics in and around the building. The one I visited was clean and modern, with state-of-the-art equipment and a team of young, recently graduated dentists. Their prices beat my old dentist's, but something still felt off. When I mentioned it to a friend who has lived in the Victory Monument area for over 30 years, she pointed me to a clinic just 250 meters from Century Plaza. I needed a crown, so I went to see for myself. I'm glad I did. Dr. San was highly skilled, spoke excellent English, and had a great sense of humor. He looks young, but he told me he's in his forties. The difference was striking. The Century Plaza clinic said I needed a root canal, nudged me toward their most expensive crown, and quoted five weeks to finish. Dr. San wrapped up everything in one week, at a price about 30% lower. That gap isn't surprising: clinics on the BTS line pay steep rent and invest heavily in the latest equipment, and patients end up covering it. Daily Smile is a bit off the beaten path and may not have all the shiny new gadgets. What it does have is solid, transparent, skilled dentistry at a fair price. That's all I need, and I'll be going back to them from now on.
0x30e29f289a310035_0x6f9b89002536a197.author: Tom “Roundstone”

0x30e29c2cb67afa49_0x7759801c0ad28f8.text: To be honest, I was really skeptical regarding getting the surgeries done at this clinic. I agreed for a rhinoplasty and liposuction altogether. I had my face to face consultation with the plastic surgeon and we went through what would be done. Please be aware that he has limited spoken English, however there is one nurse who speaks fluently English, Margi, I believe her name is. She has been very helpful in the communication gaps. Ensure that you have a list of questions. Information is provided when asked. The process prior to the surgery day, is that they sent you to the hospital to get all the blood tests, ECG and consultation with a cardiologist to get the all clear. Once this is done, I waited till the day. On the day, you go to the clinic and the anaesthetist, who you mean only on that day will put a canular on and put you to sleep. Once you're asleep, that's when the job is done. ~3 hours later, you are woken up with no pain, just a numbness at the cut area. You are taken to a room where you recover. I have chosen to stay in the room overnight but you have the options to return to your hotel room dependent on your state. I went unaccompanied, which in hindsight wasn't the greatest decision. The following day, I was discharged with all the medications and care instructions, with several follow ups. This is day 5 post op, and I'm on the mend for the next few weeks. In turn of pain post op, it was quite minimal for me. I'm tender and swollen in those areas, which makes the experience quite uncomfortable. In hindsight, I probably would have done only one surgery instead of two in one go. In terms of the outcome, I'm pleased. I hope this review is helpful. What I found is the reviews here were minimal. So I have tried to provide as much as I could. See below a picture of my abdomen day 3 post op.

0x311d7e23b9b9b4e9_0x4a0afa3c069595ea.text: เป็นคนไข้ที่ขอเล่ายาวๆแบบคุณหมอมั่งครับ ผมเป็นคนไข้ที่กลัวการทำฟันมากๆ ล่าสุดหาคลีนิคทำฟัน เลือกอยู่ 2 ปี ก็ไม่รู้จะไปที่ไหนดี บ้านอยู่สะพานใหม่คลีนิคทำฟันเยอะมาก แล้วเราจะรู้ได้ยังไงว่าคุณหมอเข้าใจคนไข้ว่าเป็นคนกลัวการทำฟัน เพราะจากที่ผ่านมาเจอแต่ที่หมอรีบทำให้เสร็จๆ ถามว่าจะทำซี่ไหน ไอ้เราก็คิดในใจ คุณหมอก็ดูหน่อยเถอะ ฟันซี่ไหนที่ควรทำก็บอกผมมาเถอะ สุดทัายก็ทำได้แค่ซี่เดียวที่บอกไป แล้วก็เปลี่ยนคลีนิคใหม่ เพราะคิดว่าที่นี่คงไม่เหมาะกับเรา ที่แล้วที่เล่าต้องเปลี่ยนไปเเรื่อยๆ จนวันศุกร์ที่ 27 ได้เห็นเพจคุณหมอที่พูดถึงคนไข้แพนิค กลัวการทำฟัน คุณหมอเล่าว่าตอนเด็กคุณหมอจะกลัวเข็ม วิ่นหนีไปซ่อน เฮ้ย ! ! เหมือนเราเลย หมอคนนี้แหละเหมือนบุปเพสันนิวาส ทำให้คนไข้ที่กลัวการทำฟัน ตัดสินใจหาเพจของคลีนิค หาเบอร์โทร ทำการนัดทันที เพราะในเพจคุณหมอต้องการคนไข้ทำฟันของประกันสังคมวันสุดท้ายของปี 68 โอ้โห ถูกใจอีกแล้ว ประกันสังคมทำฟัน ว่างมา 2 ปี วันที่นัดได้ วันจันทร์ที่ 29 บ่าย 3 เร็วทันใจวัยรุ่น ได้ทันใช้ประกันสังคมปี 68 เลย และแล้ว เจ้าชายก็ได้เจอกับเจ้าหญิง ม่ายใช่ คนไข้ที่กลัวการทำฟันที่เลือกหมอ ก็ได้เจอกับคุณหมอที่ต้อนรับคนไข้ทุกคน
0x311d7e23b9b9b4e9_0x4a0afa3c069595ea.en: I'm a patient who wants to share my story in detail, just like you, doctor. I'm a patient with a terrifying fear of dentistry. Recently, I spent two years searching for a dental clinic, and I couldn't decide where to go. I live in Saphan Mai, where there are so many dental clinics. How could I know if a doctor understood my fear of dentistry? In my experience, doctors always rushed through the treatment, asking which tooth needed attention. I'd think, "Doctor, please take a look! Tell me which teeth need treatment!" Ultimately, they only treated the one tooth I mentioned, and then I switched clinics, believing the previous one wasn't right for me. It was a cycle of changing clinics. Then, on Friday the 27th, I saw a post on a doctor's page discussing patients with panic attacks and a fear of dentistry. The doctor mentioned being terrified of needles as a child, running to hide. Wow! That was exactly like me! This doctor was like a matchmaker. He helped me, a patient with a fear of dentistry, find the clinic's page and phone number, and make an appointment immediately. Because the doctor's page wanted dental patients covered by social security insurance on the last day of 2025. Wow, perfect! Social security dental coverage has been unavailable for two years. I got an appointment on Monday, the 29th at 3 PM. Quick and convenient! I can use my social security insurance in 2025. And then, the prince met the princess... No, not really. The patient who was afraid of dental work and chose a particular doctor finally met a doctor who welcomes all patients.

0x311d7e23b9b9b4e9_0x4a0afa3c069595ea.text: ขอบคุณนะนะคะ ที่ใส่ใจคนป่วยมากๆ **เป็นsleไปหาหมอ หลายคลีนิคมาก แต่ไม่มีใครรับทำเลย (ปกติเค้าจะให้ทำรพ.ที่เรารักษา ไม่มีเวลาด้วย เลยตั้งใจเก็บเงินเพื้อมาทำฟันกับคุณหมอโดยเฉพาะ) ติดตามคุณหมอ มาตั้งแต่ ปีที่แล้ว ประจวบกับน้องปิดเทอม เลยมาเซอร์เวสถานที่ และสอบถามเจ้าหน้า เจ้าหน้าที่เคาเตอร์ แนะนำดีมาก เรียบร้อย สุภาพ น่ารักด้วย พี่ๆผู้ช่วยคุณหมอ ก็สุภาพเรียบร้อย น่ารักทุกคน เราเอา ใบผลเลือด ให้คุณหมอดูฟัน แล้วขึ้นไปเอกเรร์ จากวันที่มาติดต่อ พี่จนท.แนะนำให้หยุดยาละลายลายลิ่มเลือดมาเลย เผื่อเราทำได้ จะได้ไม่เสียเวลา สุดท้าย ได้ถอนจริง ๆ ดีใจมากๆ กลัวก็กลัว แต่ดีใจที่คุณหมอทำให้มากกว่า แปปเดียวก็เสร็จ คุณหมอน่ารักลดค่ารักษาพยาบาลให้ด้วย พอเช้าวันถัดมา พี ขนม.โทรมาถามอาการ ว่ามีเลือดออกไหม มีอาการอย่างอื่นไหม ประทับใจมากๆ คะ คุ้มค่ากับการเดินทางไปคลีนิคมาก ถึงแม้จะไกลก็ตาม *ฝากถึงคนป่วยที่ต้องการไปทำฟัน ลองมาติดต่อดูที่คลีนิคก่อนนะคะ หรือโทรไปสอบถามก่อนได้เลย 10/10 +ให้อีก 100 ด้วย ❤️😁🙏🙏🙏
0x311d7e23b9b9b4e9_0x4a0afa3c069595ea.author: Wichuta Fakprasert
0x311d7e23b9b9b4e9_0x4a0afa3c069595ea.en: Thank you so much for your care and attention to patients. **I have SLE and have been to many clinics, but none would treat me (usually they would recommend the hospital I'm currently being treated at, and I don't have the time, so I saved up money specifically to have my teeth done by you). I've been following you since last year. Coincidentally, my sister was on school break, so we came to check out the place and ask the staff. The counter staff were very helpful, polite, and lovely. The dentist's assistants were also all very polite and lovely. We showed the dentist our blood test results and went for an X-ray. From the day we contacted them, the staff advised us to stop our blood thinner medication in case we could have the tooth extracted, so we wouldn't waste time. Finally, we were able to have the tooth extracted! I was so happy, even though I was scared, but I was more relieved that the dentist did it. It was over in a short time. The dentist was so kind and even reduced the treatment cost. The next morning, my sister called to ask about my condition, whether there was any bleeding or other symptoms. I was very impressed. It was worth the trip to the clinic, even though it's far. *For anyone who needs dental treatment, please try contacting the clinic first or call to inquire. 10/10 +100 points! ❤️😁🙏🙏🙏

0x311d7e23b9b9b4e9_0x4a0afa3c069595ea.text: Honestly the best dental experience of my life. Super clean and professional. Friendly and helpful staff. The dentist on duty communicated in excellent English. He explained everything before the procedure, even the price. I ended up paying under 2000 Baht for everything, which was a wonderful surprise. The dentist had to surgically remove some stubborn bone as well, and the x-ray of the tooth was included in the price. I recommend this place to all foreigners. I even received medicine to take home. Thank you to everyone at My Mind Clinic, you were amazing!!!
0x311d7e23b9b9b4e9_0x4a0afa3c069595ea.author: Inge Breedt

0x311d7e23b9b9b4e9_0x4a0afa3c069595ea.text: เริ่มจากปวดฟันคุดแบบกะทันหันคลินิกประจำก็หยุดยาวถึงเดือนหน้าระหว่ากำลังคิดว่าจะเอาไงต่อหน้าฟีดเฟสก็ขึ้นโพสของคุณหมอep21ตอน4โมงครึ่งเลยเช็กว่าอยู่ไหนสรุปไม่ไกลมากตอนแรกคิดว่าจะไม่โทรเนื่องจากเย็นแล้วคิวน่าจะเต็มลังเลอยู่นานจนเพื่อนทนไม่ไหวโทรมาเองเลยจองคิวให้เสร็จเรียบร้อย ผลที่ได้คือดีมากๆตั้งแต่แผนกตอนรับคุณหมอผู้ช่วยหมอ ทุกคนพูดเพราะน้ำเสียงใจเย็นมาก สำหรับคนขี้กลัวแบบเราทำให้สบายใจได้มากเลย อธิบายให้คำแนะนำก็ดีมากค่ะแถมมีผู้ช่วยให้กำลังใจเป็นน้องหมีแสนน่ารักให้กอดอีกด้วยที่สำคัญค่ารักษาอยู่ในเลทที่รับไหวค่ะ❤️❤️
0x311d7e23b9b9b4e9_0x4a0afa3c069595ea.en: It started with a sudden wisdom toothache, and my usual clinic was closed until next month. While I was figuring out what to do, I saw a post from the doctor (ep21) on Facebook at 4:30 PM. I checked the location and it wasn't too far. At first, I thought I wouldn't call because it was already late and the schedule was probably full. I hesitated for a long time until a friend couldn't wait and called to book an appointment for me. The result was amazing! From the reception area to the doctor and assistants, everyone was so polite and calm. For someone as easily frightened as me, it made me feel so comfortable. The explanations and advice were excellent, and the assistant even gave me an adorable teddy bear to hug as encouragement. Most importantly, the treatment cost was within my budget. ❤️❤️

0x311d7e23b9b9b4e9_0x4a0afa3c069595ea.text: คลีนิคให้คำแนะนำและติดตามคนไข้ดีมากๆๆเลยค่ะ ประทับใจทั้งก่อนทำและหลังทำ ถึงแม้การวินิจฉัยเคสของหมอท่านแรกผล ออกมาจะทำให้กังวลใจมากก็ตามแต่พอมาทำจริงๆหมออีกท่านสามารถแก้ไขให้ได้โดยไม่เหมือนที่หมอท่านแรกระบุไว้และคนไข้ก็พึ่งทำฟันเป็นครั้งแรกเลย ทำเบามือแนะนำจนครบทุกอย่างเลยค่ะ

0x311d7e23b9b9b4e9_0x4a0afa3c069595ea.text: ประทับใจมากค่ะ คุณหมอ พี่พยาบาล พี่เจ้าหน้าที่น่ารักมากๆๆๆ วันนี้ไปถอนฟันคุดมา 2 ซี่ ตอนแรกกลัวมาก แต่คุณหมอคอยบอกตลอดว่ากำลังจะทำอะไรทุกขั้นตอน พี่พยาบาลน่ารักค่ะ ดูแลดีมากเช่นกัน พี่เจ้าหน้าที่ก็ใส่ใจทุกขั้นตอน ยกให้เป็นคลินิคประจำแล้วค่ะ 👍

0x311d7e23b9b9b4e9_0x4a0afa3c069595ea.text: มีพี่แนะนำมาที่นี่ เลยหาข้อมูลดูรีวิวไปด้วย เห็นรีวิวดีเลยมาตัดสินใจไม่ผิดเลยค่ะ 100/10 โชคดีไปอีกคือวันที่ไป อาจารย์ใหญ่เข้าคลินิก 🙏🏻ให้ข้อมูลดีมากๆค่ะ พี่เจ้าหน้าที่ พี่พยาบาล ใจดีมากๆค่ะ เป็นกันเอง ให้ข้อมูลอย่างดีค่ะ ขอบคุณมากๆค่ะ
0x311d7e23b9b9b4e9_0x4a0afa3c069595ea.en: A friend recommended this place, so I did some research and read reviews. Seeing the good reviews, I made the right decision to come. 100/10. I was also lucky that the professor was at the clinic the day I went 🙏🏻 and gave us great information. The staff and nurses were very kind, friendly, and helpful. Thank you so much!

0x311d7e23b9b9b4e9_0x4a0afa3c069595ea.text: คุณหมอ มือเบา เข้าใจคนไข้ ไม่รีบ ใส่ใจทุกรายละเอียด ให้คำแนะนำตั้งแต่วิธีการแปรงฟันด้วนแปรงธรรมดาและไฟฟ้า เป็นห่วงทุกกระบวนการรักษา รู้ว่าคนไข้แพนิค และกั้นหายใจ พยายามสร้างบรรยากาศผ่อนคลาย ตลอดกระบวนการรักษา จะไปใช้บริการตลอดครับ
0x311d7e23b9b9b4e9_0x4a0afa3c069595ea.en: The doctor has a gentle touch, understands patients, doesn't rush, and pays attention to every detail. They provide guidance on how to brush teeth properly, both with a regular toothbrush and an electric one. They are concerned about every step of the treatment, aware of patients' panic attacks and breath-holding, and strive to create a relaxing atmosphere throughout. I will definitely use their services again.

0x30e29f5bb5eb13bf_0x71297c8b611ea1d7.text: The physical therapist gave excellent advice and treatment. I had constant, severe, sharp headaches. Bending over to study caused neck pain, and sleeping was uncomfortable, like my skull was constantly pressing against the pillow. I went to the hospital for four months, and the doctors kept changing medications, but nothing helped. So I tried a physical therapy clinic. An X-ray revealed cervical spondylosis (curvature and tilting) and a misaligned skull base, potentially compressing nerves and causing severe neck and shoulder muscle tension. I received treatment involving neck tracing (gentle traction to adjust the skull base), ultrasound to release tense muscles around the neck, electrical stimulation, and hot pads. My symptoms have gradually improved. Importantly, the physical therapist was very friendly and fun to talk to.

0x311d59692c66fb91_0x1007f805424c9a20.en: If anyone is considering braces or any dental work, I highly recommend this clinic. Dr. Jeab is incredibly skilled. From my personal experience, I learned about her clinic from a senior colleague at a hotel in Phuket. I had crooked teeth and gaps between my teeth. I consulted several clinics, but none would treat me because I had too much cartilage in the upper part of my mouth where it connects to the gums. They all suggested I have the bone removed first before I could get braces, which was extremely expensive at the time. I was quite discouraged. But after meeting Dr. Jeab, I gained renewed hope. She gave me very straightforward advice. I had gum surgery, fillings, extractions, and even my wisdom teeth removed (which were growing at an unusual angle). I also decided to have all the cartilage removed by her because I believed that all teeth, especially the wisdom teeth, are connected to the nervous system. I felt very confident in Dr. Jeab. My case was one of the most challenging, requiring extensive corrections, but I overcame it. Dr. Jeab provided excellent care and guidance, helping me achieve my current confident smile. Thank you so much, Dr. Jeab! Since then, I recommend this clinic to all my friends and colleagues who need braces. She's incredibly skilled and trustworthy. ❤️❤️

0x30e29fcd225e0a1d_0x781026fb1d03154a.text: Le Physio Clinic is all about action. They don’t make empty promises — they deliver. The staff are friendly, highly professional, and their approach is simple yet supported by advanced technology, such as PMS therapy. They focus on treating you with the fewest visits necessary, while still giving the recovery process the care and time it needs. There hasn’t been a single injury they couldn’t help me with. A torqued ankle that I thought would make racing impossible was fixed within a day, allowing me to fly to Chiang Mai and successfully compete in the MTCM. A lower-back disc prolapse that left me partially paralyzed improved within three visits using the stretch bed and PMS. My shoulder, which limited most back and lateral movements, is already improving — and I’m looking forward to the next session. Highly recommended for athletes and anyone dealing with chronic pain who feels like they’ve run out of options. P.S all staff speak perfect English so there is not such thing as “lost in translation” situation.

0x305031ed2560f659_0x41a7911af8800153.text: While on holiday, my mum was rushed here in critical condition for emergency treatment. Initially I was skeptical and the language barrier made me more anxious but as I observed their actions in the emergency room, I realized they were doing their very best, to a remarkable standard. They stabilized my mum within an hour, and she was put under observation for a week. The hospital and the general ward aren't luxurious, but were comfortable enough, and our main concern was quality medical care, which she got. The nurses and doctors were meticulous about every detail that was contributing to her condition, and periodically checked on her every hour, sometimes more when there was an issue. I've seen some negative comments about the politeness of staff but I disagree, the one thing that made our week here bearable was the warmth and care that the nurses gave my mum, and the patience with which they showed us how to help in caregiving. There were always some nurses that knew some English and were able to communicate with us effectively. Even the insurance department were patient with us when our insurance company were taking long to respond to the claim. All in all, I would definitely place my faith in this hospital, from my experience
0x305031ed2560f659_0x41a7911af8800153.author: Vocalize Your Vision (Mathew George)

0x305031ed2560f659_0x41a7911af8800153.text: On Tuesday, I went to get a queue number at 4:00 AM and got a slot at 4:30 AM. I registered at 5:00 AM to see a specialist. However, when it was my turn, the nurse informed me that I had previously been seen by Doctor A and suggested I come back on Monday because Doctor A wasn't there that day; only Doctors B and C were available. She said that if I saw another doctor, they would refer me back to Doctor A because he/she had seen me before, and Doctor B and C already had patients. I was there because I was sick, but my usual doctor wasn't available. Couldn't another doctor treat or advise me instead? I wasn't aware of this situation beforehand. The hospital's system is convenient for both staff and doctors, but the patient management system is never convenient. Doctors can change their appointment days without asking if it's convenient for the patient, but patients have no choice; they have to follow the doctor's instructions. I tried to follow all the procedures, but the system didn't facilitate anything. In the end, I couldn't see my doctor because he/she wasn't available, and I have to come back on Monday. The nurse did the best she could by issuing an appointment slip. Please improve your system, as accessing specialists in each department is difficult for patients.
0x305031ed2560f659_0x41a7911af8800153.author: PLOYLADA SKINCARE

0x305031ed2560f659_0x41a7911af8800153.text: Absolutely terrible experience with the staff at this hospital. Unfriendly, unwilling and uncompasioate. My mother passed away and was transported here, I asked to see her body as soon as I arrived as I flew in to Phuket from Rayong. I was told I could not see her until the doctor arrived again next Tuesday.. Once the doctor arrived I learned that no preparation had been done and the body had just been sat in the refrigerator for the past 4 days...so what would the difference have been seeing her Saturday? It would have helped ease my pain seeing her but instead I suffered all weekend wanting to let her know I was there. When asking the unfriendly manager downstairs in the international department , all I recived were cold uncaring answers. Really could not have been any less compassionate and understanding than that woman. Once transporting my mother's body out of the hospital, the mortuary staff carrying her were laughing and joking around whilst I watched my mother's corpse loading into the back of a truck. I know it is not there mother and they are not grieving but they could at lease have the courtesy to show a small amount of respect... From what was already the most painful experience I have had in my life and still going through, I can say this hospital did nothing in any way to make thing easier and more comfortable for me. Absolute discrace. I hope you never have to go through what you put me through
0x305031ed2560f659_0x41a7911af8800153.author: alexdales

0x305031ed2560f659_0x41a7911af8800153.text: 8 dec 23. Come here because have SSO card and need sick leave. Cough, running nose, fever. At first, it is really hard to park vehicle and navigate. Register n.8 send to register number 1, which was busy and finally registered at number 2. She send to counter 24, and nurse there said that quew at 13.00 is full already (time was 13.10) and they will start accepted cases again at 17:00. Because they have only one doctor who work. But have five nurses who literally have nothing to do. Any large amount of sick people who come to see doctor and can not. Maybe if there be 5 doctors in 5 examination rooms there be good service, but right now hospital save money for doctors and spend it for nurse. If you have choice and pay by yourself, there is better option on Phuket who can care better. 0x305031ed2560f659_0x41a7911af8800153.text: I had the worst experience at this hospital in Phuket. I arrived on my own, in a critical condition with a racing heartbeat, dizziness, and I even collapsed in the street before getting there. I felt like I was about to die but nobody seemed to care. The very first thing they did was ask for my passport at such a difficult moment. After some time, they finally took me to the observation area, threw me on a bed, and completely ignored me. No one spoke to me, no one checked on me, and when I tried to ask something, they either didn’t answer or replied in a rude, dismissive way. If this was a foreigner in my country (Kuwait) in such a condition, they would have been treated immediately with respect and proper care. I’m extremely disappointed with how I was treated here. To be fair, there was one doctor I don’t remember his name who was very kind, reassuring, and respectful. He was neither thin nor heavyset, and he truly stood out as the only compassionate person I encountered. But the rest of the staff? Completely uninterested, even if I had died there.
0x305031ed2560f659_0x41a7911af8800153.author: Aziz Abwah

0x305031ed2560f659_0x41a7911af8800153.text: My father was admitted to this hospital on vacation. They put him into a coma due to acute kidney failure they said. They contacted our family saying he was very sick and in a coma. Then wanted all his medical insurance information. I called regularly asking if he was awake and they told me he was on a ventilator and couldn't talk. Even after a week. I called the US embassy and notified them of his condition. They sent a representative to check on him. He was awake after 3 days from admission and was being treated horribly. The hospital lied and kept him looking for insurance money. If the embassy wouldn't of checked on him he would of been in trouble. I personally believe this hospital is in the business of extorting foreign visitors. If I would not have notified the US Embassy of my father being in this awful hospital he would maybe be dead. Be safe if you can and never go to this criminal hospital.
