0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.text: At 32 years old, I found myself trapped in a cycle of crippling depression, burnout, and anxiety. For years, I had turned to different therapies, medications and doctors with no success. I tried everything. I often turned to drugs and alcohol to help numb the pain, and I knew deep down that this was not the life I wanted to live but I had no hope of ever actually recovering. I eventually started looking at inpatient mental health treatment and spent months searching for an inpatient center in the U.S. that I could afford, but everything was so expensive and often had unsettling reviews and policies I was not comfortable with. I found nothing that seemed to fit what I was looking for that was even remotely within my means. Then, during one of my many desperate Google searches, I discovered a Reddit thread discussing rehab centers in Thailand and their affordability and world class reputation. After doing extensive research, I narrowed it down to four options. Among the options, The Diamond definitely stood out immediately, and after my first call with Clinical Director, Craig Bilton, I knew this place was it. That initial conversation filled me with a hope I hadn’t felt in years, and now, I can confidently say that choosing The Diamond was the best decision I have ever made. What sets the Diamond apart from others is that it doesn’t just treat surface-level issues—it addresses the root causes of your struggles with compassion, precision, and expertise. It is mind, body and soul rehabilitation. Craig Bilton and Travis Roby, who are without a doubt the most skilled and insightful therapists I’ve ever encountered, played an instrumental role in my healing journey. Their intelligence, dedication, and genuine care for their clients created a therapeutic environment where I felt truly seen and supported. They didn’t just help me work through my challenges—they gave me the tools and understanding to take control of my life in ways I never thought possible. The progress I made during my 10-week stay was nothing short of miraculous. The depth of knowledge and healing I gained under their guidance was life-changing, and I will always credit my recovery to their incredible work. It isn’t just the world-class therapy at Diamond, but also its holistic approach to creating a supportive, comfortable, and nurturing environment that makes it so unique. Every client has their own private villa, which ensures privacy and peace, while cleaning and laundry services take away everyday stressors so you can focus on your recovery. The gourmet food, cooked to order, is another touch that shows how much they care about every detail of your well-being. On weekends, the excursions are not only fun but also help you reconnect with the joy of life and the world around you. This isn’t just a facility—it’s a sanctuary designed to make you feel safe, cared for, and valued as a person. The sense of community at The Diamond is unlike anything I’ve experienced. The staff, from the nurses to the therapists, genuinely care about you, and their kindness makes you feel deeply supported every step of the way. The nurses, in particular, became like surrogate mothers to me, always ready with a kind word or comforting gesture when I needed it most. The clients I met there were incredible, ranging in age from their 20s to their 70s, each with their own unique stories and strengths. I formed bonds with people who I now consider lifelong friends—people who understood me in ways others couldn’t. This sense of connection and shared growth was one of the most healing aspects of my time there. Looking back, I can only describe my experience at The Diamond as transformational. It is, without a doubt, the best rehab in Thailand and easily one of the best in the world. I only wish I had gone sooner. The Diamond didn’t just help me recover—it gave me my life back in ways I could not have imagined. For anyone struggling with mental health challenges or addiction, I cannot recommend this place enough. It’s not just a rehab center; it’s a place where miracles happen.
0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.author: Taylor Michel

0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.text: I will forever be grateful to The Diamond, and to everyone who makes this place the life-changing sanctuary that it is — the counselors, psychologists, nurses, massage therapist, support staff, housekeepers, kitchen team, and security. From the moment I arrived, every single person treated me with kindness, understanding, and compassion. When I came here eight weeks ago, I was completely broken, lost, and hopeless. I didn’t believe I had anywhere to turn. But through the combination of powerful group sessions and deeply personal one-on-one work, I slowly began to rebuild myself. The journey was not always easy — it was filled with tears, anger, and uncomfortable self-work — but also moments of joy, laughter, connection, and deep gratitude. Extending my stay from one month to two was one of the best decisions I have ever made. Today, I am leaving with not just sobriety, but with hope and the knowledge, tools, and sense of self I never thought I’d find again. The Diamond is more than just a rehab center — it is a community. I will never forget anyone I have encountered here. From the moment I arrived, I was surrounded by people who understood me in a way the outside world often couldn’t. Fellow clients quickly became confidants, cheerleaders, and mirrors, reflecting both my struggles and my progress back to me with honesty and compassion. The staff foster an environment where bonds can form naturally, and where vulnerability is met with understanding rather than judgment. This sense of connection has been just as healing as the therapy itself, reminding me that recovery doesn’t happen in isolation, but in the presence of people who truly care. I want to say a heartfelt thank you to Caroline, my psychologist, for always being so kind, patient, and caring. She created a safe space where I felt truly heard, and she gently guided me as I unpacked and worked through my past. Her calm, reassuring presence helped ease my anxieties and gave me the confidence to keep moving forward. I’m deeply grateful for the compassion and understanding she’s shown me throughout our sessions. Last but not least, I want to thank the clinical director and my counselor, Travis, who I truly believe gave me a second chance at life. He is, without question, the best counselor I could have hoped for — deeply dedicated to his work, to helping others, and to every single one of his clients. Travis has an extraordinary ability to truly see and hear his clients, to understand not just the words they say but the pain, hurt, and deep-seated emotions beneath them. He pushed me to do the uncomfortable work that was necessary for my growth, balancing firmness with compassion in exactly the way I needed. He put his heart and soul into working with me, often taking extra time between sessions to check in if I was struggling, making sure I had the strength to get through the day. That kind of care is rare, and I will never forget it. I don’t think I would have extended my stay if it weren’t for his guidance and support. He treats each client as a person, not a number, and his dedication is felt in every interaction. Through our work, he helped me begin transforming my self-hatred into acceptance, my hurt into laughter, and my hopelessness into a belief in the future. I am walking away from The Diamond with more self-awareness, resilience, and hope than I ever thought possible — and for that, I will always be grateful to him. The Diamond has given me far more than sobriety — it has given me a new beginning. I leave here feeling stronger, wiser, and ready to face life with clarity and courage. My gratitude for this place and these people is endless. Thank you all ❤️
0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.author: Laura

0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.text: 17 Oct 2024 I was feeling REALLY low – worst ever and thought I had better do something about it I have been to Thailand at Rehab before and started to google places. Luckily I found the Diamond!! My wife and I read all about it and decided this is the place I need to go. I have been suffering from Mental Health issues, mainly depression for over 25 years now. I have tried everything, hypnotism, sound treatment, courses, treatments, pills, meditation etc etc – everything I could get my hands on over the years. Over the last year we have been through some VERY trying times financially and this has led me to drink excessively and not cope as things dragged out. I got worse and worse until finally the tank was empty, physically and mentally drained beyond belief, I could barely string a sentence together, zero energy. We have built up a nice lifestyle, properties etc over the years and this was looking like me may lose a large chunk of it, not ideal at the age of 60 when you’re supposed to be enjoying your retirement you worked for! I made the decision to book for a month – talked to Craig, who is awesome, and made a plan. I got so run down I actually moved the date forward a month and off I went. Well what an experience! This place is right up there with the best in the world, and affordable! The staff are all awesome, smiling all the time, greet you and acknowledge you when they see you, even the chefs and kitchen staff. The food is prepared fresh every day and is exceptional. Accommodation you have your own Villa which again is 5 star, deck out front facing the pool to relax in the warmth. Everything you need is there and if its not they will get it for you. Grounds are kelp to a very high standard and pool serviced regularly. There is a nurse onsite 24 hours for medication dispersal, pain help, blood pressure in monitored every morning. There is a doctor on call if you need more help. They are extremely friendly and helpful and help you to feel at ease. Craig, & Travis are legends with over 20 years and more experience, they really know their stuff. There are 3 sessions each day and all very interesting and helpful. Then there are one on one sessions to personally suit you. The other counsellors are also top class and there to help and listen – absolutely nothing is a problem. During my time I unfortunately went into serious pain. Nurse examined me immediately and off to the hospital immediately. Within an hour I was under sedative, admitted, had a CT scan, X ray, MRI and surgery that night!! Unbelievable service. I got my gall bladder removed and was back at the Diamond in 2 days. During my stay Craig, his wife and a counsellor Lorraine visited every day and evening between them. Over and above the call of duty, they take personal caré and attention to us all. The programme at Diamond definitely works and is a result of Craig and Travis’s personal experiences over the years, not from a book or u tube etc. On interview I told Craig I need an oil change, I left with a complete overhaul haha! I can honestly say this has been the best 5 weeks of my life ( I extended a week). Feel fantastic more and more each day all day, something I have missed for years! It is the best thing I have done for myself ever, no question. Don’t look any further this is the place! Don’t procrastinate – JUST DO IT. I am happy for Craig to release my contact details should anyone have any further questions Mark Wikstrom - New Zealand
0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.author: Mark Wikstrom

0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.text: My 7-week stay at The Diamond Luxury Rehab in Hua Hin for a gambling addiction, a condition I've learned is a serious mental disorder, has been nothing short of transformative. While the resort and pool are clearly 5-star and provide a comfortable and serene environment, it is unequivocally the staff and counsellors who elevate this facility to a true luxury rehab. During my time here, I received a comprehensive and personalised treatment plan, which included four therapy sessions per week – two with an addiction specialist and two with a psychotherapist. Travis, my addiction specialist, has been instrumental in what I can only describe as saving not only my life but also the future of my family. His insightful approach helped me uncover critical blind spots in my behaviour that were fuelling my addiction. Without his guidance, I wouldn't have gained the understanding I now have of my actions and their consequences. Caroline, my psychotherapist, was equally brilliant. Her kind, caring, and compassionate nature created a calming and trusting space where I felt comfortable enough to delve deep into my actions and the underlying reasons for them. Her support was a crucial element of my healing process. Beyond Travis and Caroline, every single member of the team at The Diamond is extraordinary. From the dedicated cleaners who maintain the immaculate environment to the incredibly supportive staff (extra credit to Chai, Judi, Pink and Noey) everyone greets you with a genuine smile. Their collective positivity significantly contributes to the creation of a calming atmosphere. Adding to the recovery experience, weekend excursions provided unforgettable opportunities to explore the beauty of Thailand, offering a welcome balance to the intensive therapeutic work. I cannot recommend The Diamond Luxury Rehab highly enough. They have genuinely changed my life for the better, equipping me with the tools and understanding to move forward. I will forever be grateful to the entire team for their dedication, professionalism, and unwavering support. This place is a beacon of hope.
0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.author: Chris Nottage

0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.text: The Diamond Rehab truly changed my life, and I am forever grateful for the incredible team there—especially their Clinical Director, Craig Bilton. This was my second attempt at recovery from substance use disorder, and the difference in my experience at The Diamond compared to my first treatment program was nothing short of transformative. Unlike the rigid, one-size-fits-all 12-step-based program I had previously attended, The Diamond Rehab took a holistic, individualized approach that catered specifically to my needs. Not only did the program address my substance use, but it also supported me in managing co-occurring mental health conditions, including long-standing depression and ADHD—an undiagnosed condition that had been overlooked for years. Craig Bilton was pivotal in this breakthrough. Within just 20 minutes of our first counseling session, Craig identified signs of ADHD, a suspicion that was quickly confirmed by a clinical diagnosis. This moment was life-changing. Despite seeing numerous doctors, therapists, and psychologists over the years, ADHD had never been considered, let alone diagnosed. Craig’s keen insight, coupled with his compassionate and solution-focused approach, was instrumental in helping me understand and manage this underlying challenge. The entire team at The Diamond Rehab was exceptional. Travis and Jessica also played key roles in my recovery journey, offering unwavering support and guidance throughout my program. Their dedication, empathy, and expertise made all the difference. Thanks to The Diamond Luxury Rehab, I am genuinely excited about life again. For the first time in years, I feel hopeful, empowered, and equipped to face the future. I cannot thank Craig, Travis, Jessica, and the entire team enough for giving me my life back. If you’re looking for a program that goes beyond just treating symptoms to truly transform lives, I cannot recommend The Diamond Rehab highly enough.
0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.author: Cody Parrish

0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.text: I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to the entire team at Diamond who supported me throughout this journey – the therapeutic staff, psychologists, nurses, support staff, kitchen staff, housekeepers, and security guards. Each and every one of you played a meaningful role in a process that truly changed my life. I will never forget this experience, or any of you. The road was not easy. At first, I came for just one month, but following the advice of those around me – and realizing for myself that I needed more time – I decided to extend my stay. What was meant to be one month eventually turned into three months. There were difficult moments, times when I wanted to give up and leave early, but there was always a listening ear, a caring and supportive team, people who knew when to offer a hug, and when to tell me the hard truths – always with compassion and a genuine desire to help. Over time, the moments of doubt gave way to feelings of safety, love, and family. This place gave me immense support, real tools to face life’s challenges, and a true sense of home. I arrived here in a very difficult state – a broken person, physically, emotionally, and struggling with addictions – and I found myself again in a warm, open, and accepting environment that genuinely listens to its patients and allows them to grow, both as part of a group and in their own individual ways and perspectives. If you expect only “sunshine and butterflies,” you might be surprised – because real work is done here. Sometimes there is pain and tears, but this work is rewarding, empowering, and leads to real change. I am leaving here as a new person – filled with hope, strength, and faith in the journey ahead. I wholeheartedly recommend Diamond to anyone who is looking for true change and is ready to invest in themselves. A huge thank you to each and every one of you! ❤️
0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.author: Romi Zuki

0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ The Diamond Rehab Thailand saved my life. I spent 15 weeks at Diamond, and I can honestly say it changed everything for me. 0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.text: After some dramatic events in my life, and the recognition that I have an alcohol addiction, I came to The Diamond at my wits' end. But the warm and sincere attention of all therapists quickly gave me a safe and familiar feeling. In addition to the valuable group sessions, there is plenty of room for individual conversations. Searching together for the causes of your addiction. But your character, bad habits, background and past are also discussed extensively. In addition to gaining the necessary self-knowledge, you are given many practical tools, substantiated with the necessary theoretical explanation. An incredibly smart and well-thought-out program. In addition, there is ample time for joint relaxing activities, sports and games, short outings and, for example, the movie night. And especially the group feeling makes the treatment so special. It is constantly pointed out that you can achieve much more together than alone. Trust each other and confide in each other. That makes The Diamond special. The second month everything started to sink in, and the realization came that this intensive program has set in motion changes for the rest of my life. I am typing this on my last day, after 9 intensive, emotional but educational and especially hopeful weeks: to the entire team of the Diamond: THANK YOU!

0x310293066061a7d3_0x95fa63862129f169.text: November 2025 I cannot express enough gratitude to Paul and his team at Hope House. They are truly dedicated to helping people overcome their addictions. When Daniel experienced a relapse, they didn’t judge him, they welcomed him back with open arms and unwavering support. Daniel is now back in treatment, and this time he is genuinely learning to take responsibility for his actions, including addressing some of the challenging behaviours he struggled with previously. Choosing Hope House in Thailand has been a game changer for Daniel’s recovery. It offers incredible value compared to the UK, three months of excellent care in Thailand costs only slightly more than one month in England. Being away from triggers and able to focus fully on his recovery has brought my son back. December 2023 What can I say but I've got my son back. When my son went to Hope 6 months ago he was in a very bad place with Cocaine and Cannabis, being an active addict for around 15 years. He has tried getting clean previously by going to meetings and previous rehabs but always came unstuck. I have much more hope this time as Paul and the team have spent alot of time challenging my son's behaviour and working with him to overcome and address his issues. I can't sing Paul and the team's praises enough, Paul has always been available for me to speak to him. The dedication of the team for recovery addicts and alcoholics is amazing. Brilliant, thank you.
0x310293066061a7d3_0x95fa63862129f169.author: Debbie Mcgettrick

0x310293066061a7d3_0x95fa63862129f169.text: As someone who has been through numerous treatment centers and sober houses etc, I can honestly say Hope House is one of the best places. Other places have treated me poorly, kicked me out at night and left me homeless, and essentially robbed my family of their money. That doesn't happen at hope house. Paul is the only person who has let me come in without an immediate down payment. He is flexible when necessary and really cares about his clients, as well as the rest of the staff. When they say they will help you achieve a goal they actually follow through with it. For example they helped me become an english teacher. (which other places said they would do but actually didn't) They have tons of activities to do there. Meditation, exercise, muay thai, step work, counseling, fishing, teaching english, and taking classes are some of the many many possibilities available. And theres plenty of relaxing too! It's a great place for those who already have some clean time but are weary of stepping back fully into the real world. Many good supportive friends can be made here as well which is an essential part of recovery. No program is perfect. But as someone who's had some awful experiences with other programs, I can definitely say hope was a great experience for me.
0x310293066061a7d3_0x95fa63862129f169.author: 125 guy

0x310293066061a7d3_0x95fa63862129f169.text: Had a wonderful experience at Hope House! Grateful for Paul taking me in and everyone else there for helping me come out feeling stronger. They had a pool, gym, sauna, ice bath, bikes, meditation room and a huge dining area where you can all hang out! The rooms were perfect and the bed was to die for! If you had any problems they’d fix it for you asap! The sessions, classes and excursions were the perfect opportunity to help me get out of my shell. We had the Orphans come to visit and that really made me feel good to give back to the community. I would definitely recommend Hope House to anyone who needs help because the people there were so friendly and welcoming. Missing Hope House already and the team and of course Jerry and Sushi 🐈‍⬛ Jasmine
0x310293066061a7d3_0x95fa63862129f169.author: Jasmine Lindsay

0x310293066061a7d3_0x95fa63862129f169.text: Hope House literally saved my life. I arrived struggling with heavy alcohol dependence and anxiety. 0x311d634145530b31_0x488e8208d88a2509.en: What a cute dentist clinic!! 🦷 The clinic is so cute! This is an honest review, not a biased one. I wanted to write this review myself; no one asked me to. Regarding the treatment: ✅ Scaling: Thorough, with some finishing touches. My mouth feels so clean afterwards. ✅ Wisdom tooth extraction: I'd been searching for a clinic and mentally preparing myself for over ten years, even offering free extractions, but I still didn't dare do it. However, because my teeth were decaying more and more this year, I finally decided to get it done. Also, a friend had been there before and said it wasn't painful or scary, so I chose this clinic. It's also newly opened, looked clean and nice. During the procedure, the dentist injected local anesthetic; it wasn't painful at all. I even felt comfortable in my gums (I was surprised myself!). I didn't feel any pain during the procedure, although the instruments were a bit noisy. After the procedure, the dentist gave me medication. The stitches were removed within a week, and I could eat normally. In short, I recommend it. Don't be afraid. The dentist is easy to understand, quick to act, and efficient with the assistant. They have a gentle touch and give good advice. Regarding the location: ✅ Parking available. ✅ Very clean. The treatment room is also spotless. ✅ The clinic is well-designed. This dentist's office is a game changer from my childhood! 🩵 If you get cold easily, bring a small blanket or wear a jacket because it's very chilly inside (but the assistant will actually cover you with a blanket). ✅ 100% Recommended!

0x311d634145530b31_0x488e8208d88a2509.text: I had dental implants done. It was painless, without swelling or bleeding from the first day after the procedure. It's a shame I didn't need bone grafting because of my age; it could have been completed in one day. I have to wait for the grafted bone to integrate before the teeth can be fitted. I'm so happy I met a skilled dentist who gave detailed advice. The dentist, though small, is surprisingly strong (I realized this during the extraction...lol). I'm waiting for my appointment to get the teeth fitted. This is for anyone still afraid of dental implants. (It's not expensive. Don't just choose the cheapest option; the dentist's expertise is crucial.)

0x30502f68baf853a5_0x465570e012cb5c7a.text: I contacted the clinic during a difficult time in my life, when I realized I couldn't overcome my addiction on my own. I chose this clinic because of its recommendations and specialization in IV detoxification. I felt supported from the first call: the administrator explained the treatment stages in detail and emphasized anonymity, which was crucial for me. The doctors performed a full diagnosis and prescribed a personalized IV detoxification regimen. The procedures were comfortable: the offices were clean and the equipment was modern. After the first few sessions, I felt relief—the shaking and nausea subsided, and I felt stronger. The nurses were constantly by my side, monitoring my condition and providing emotional support. I especially want to commend the professionalism of the addiction specialist, who not only prescribed treatment but also explained in detail how to restore the body after prolonged use. The clinic's psychologist also helped me begin to understand the causes of my addiction, which was an important step toward sobriety. Thanks to the IV treatments and the comprehensive approach, I was able to overcome withdrawal without complications. I'm still in rehabilitation, but the first and most difficult stage was here. The clinic gave me not only medical care but also self-confidence. I highly recommend it to anyone facing similar challenges—they truly save lives here. A special thank you for the organization: the treatment was anonymous, which allowed me to focus on recovery.

0x30502f68baf853a5_0x465570e012cb5c7a.text: A huge thank you to these guys! I think it's a miracle that fate sent us these people. They took him to their clinic, provided the necessary medical care, and prepared him for the long flight. They drove him and his friend to the green zone and escorted him. I still can't believe it. My son is home, under the doctor's care. A deep bow. True professionals. P.S. It's very difficult to find Russian-speaking doctors from Moscow in Thailand. We were lucky. God bless them.

0x30e29f0045dd0ccd_0x83a6a03842ec8336.text: Today, I brought my sister to get filler dissolved. She had previously had filler removed elsewhere, and wasn't satisfied with the results. As someone who also works in the beauty clinic industry, I chose this clinic because they use an ultrasound machine to check the location of filler within the skin layers and test the dissolving solution beforehand to see if my sister would have an allergic reaction. I was impressed from the moment I met Dr. Tao. She's very friendly and provides excellent advice. Having worked with many doctors before, I felt very comfortable entrusting my sister's care to Dr. Tao. Dr. Tao is lovely, meticulous, attentive, and doesn't pressure you into buying anything. She's flexible and accommodating, offering personalized recommendations based on your needs. Importantly, the clinic is clean, charming, and well-decorated, creating a comfortable and relaxed atmosphere from the moment you arrive until you leave. This is another clinic I highly recommend. Filler dissolution should be precise, and they should have the equipment to check the skin layers to determine the exact location of any previously injected filler. Even with my extensive experience in beauty clinics and seeing many doctors, I still strongly recommend seeing Dr. Tao and getting a thorough checkup. And you can have the doctor fix anything you don't like. I highly recommend this place.

0x30e29f0045dd0ccd_0x83a6a03842ec8336.text: A waste of time & money. I travelled from overseas because I trusted in Dr Tao’s “expertise” with dissolving filler. During the procedure, I felt extremely uncomfortable from the pain, and told her I don’t want to continue. While the needle was still deep in my face, she did not stop - instead, she continued to inject more product into my face. By that point, I was already crying from the discomfort & pain. Even though I was visibly upset, she kept insisting that we finish what has been started. That itself is a massive red flag… As a “doctor”, why are you unable to listen & accept when a client cannot take any more of the pain? After all this, she tried to charge me for the entire amount… even though half of that product was FORCEFULLY injected after I already told her I wanted to end the treatment. Dr Tao became extremely rude & defensive at this point, and she struggled to understand how unethical it is to continue treating a patient who has asked to stop. In the end, she agreed to only let me pay for what was actually used. When I asked her what will happen if I return in a few days, and there’s been no improvement or results, Dr Tao just told me “don’t come back.” What an ugly attitude & complete disappointment. Clearly a money-hungry business with doctors who don’t care about ethics or the patient’s actual results. Makes me wonder how many of these previous reviews are fake… EDIT: The clinic’s response to my review is SHOCKING & really shows how untrustworthy they really are. Not once did they ever offer me a “1 week follow-up appointment”, Dr Tao’s literal last words to me were “Do not come back.” They never contacted me again for a “follow-up”… Clearly they continue to lie just to look good & uphold their “reputation” as a new business. Furthermore, even after I paid, Dr Tao threatened me multiple times saying that there is CCTV footage of me. She also threatened that she will call the police if I don’t show her my passport. (I don’t feel comfortable giving my passport details to ANYONE, so why would I give it to a “doctor” demanding it just to threaten me). When I asked why is it necessary if I’ve already paid, she struggled to find an answer and couldn’t supply an explanation for me. Thirdly, saying that “multiple patients witnessed my behaviour” is a lie & a poor attempt to try to embarrass me. There were NO PATIENTS in that room with us, literally just me, Dr Tao & her assistant. Artistic Clinic, instead of taking accountability, you choose to lie to discredit me for the purpose of making yourself look good. A real shame.

0x30502d728b0a18c1_0xf0a28e39c2fd5fd0.text: This place is truly amazing and for anyone in need of rehabilitation please come here. I am an alcoholic and have been to many rehab centres in the UK and Turkey without any success but truly for the first time I have hope of a new life without alcohol which I never had previously. They collect you from the airport and you are looked after the moment you enter the rehab. There are many more rehabs out there which are more expensive but in this case more expensive does not mean better:) The rooms are really nice and I stayed in an ocean view room with a relaxing terrace next door to have my morning coffee. The food is fantastic with a real variety in choice from authentic curries to fish and so much more made by chef Ramen.. Coffee machine is available with multiple choices . You get 3 meals a day so no need to worry about food . A special shout goes to John my therapist with whom I had three one to one sessions a week with. He really understands you and has a very calming persona which allows you to open up. You have many group sessions with the lovely Toni & Gift (also John) which teach you new life skills and how to cope with triggers and craving and I have learnt things I never knew to help me in my recovery. There is many activities you can participate in (It is your choice) such as Yoga, Singing bowl Muay thai massages and art classes. You also have weekend excursions to beaches ,night markets and temples (optional again) and many more. It sometimes feels like you are on holiday :) Another special mention to the lovely Dawie who takes the yoga classes(also she is a support worker)s she is a breath of fresh air and has such an infectious bubbly personality and is good to be around. With regards to all other staff I cannot fault anyone as this truly is a great place which I would recommend to anyone in need of addiction treatment. I honestly never write reviews but felt I had to this time as I reached rock bottom but this place has made me believe I can enjoy live away from alcohol and has given me many tools to put in place to deal with my issues. I actually turned up really drunk(shock for an alcoholic ha) but was given a diazapem program and got through the withdrawal which as anyone with an addiction is aware withdrawal is the hardest part and makes you still use but I came through it . I will continue online therapy sessions with John online . These people really care about you so do yourself a favour , If you have lost all hope get in touch with Kevin and get yourself booked in. Kevin is a great guy also and makes the process so easy with excellent communication . I called one day and was there 5 days later . The support staff Ye ,,Khao Alex and Dawie who take you on excursions are all really nice people and always ready to help with anything you nee Take what you want from this review but it is all true and I hope everyone who is active addiction there is hope and this place can 100% get you felling so much better at a fraction of the costs of over rehabs. So thank you to everyone at Phuket Island Rehab for giving me hope again. Over & Out Matthew(Recovering alcoholic)
0x30502d728b0a18c1_0xf0a28e39c2fd5fd0.author: Matthew Barry

0x30502d728b0a18c1_0xf0a28e39c2fd5fd0.text: I really want to thank Phuket Island Rehab for all they did for me. At first I was a little worried because of the one negative review of the place but I’m so happy I trusted my gut as it was the BEST thing I could have done for myself. From the moment I arrived, I felt safe, supported, and genuinely cared for. The facilities are absolutely beautiful. The environment is peaceful and clean, and everything is designed to help you feel calm and grounded. The rooms were spacious and extremely comfortable. I never once felt like I was missing anything. Every level of care was provided without me even needing to ask. The food was incredible. Every meal was fresh, healthy, and full of flavor. You could tell the staff put thought and effort into making sure we were nourished and well-fed. Eating well every day played a big part in helping me feel stronger, both physically and emotionally. The therapy I received was on a completely different level. Toni and John have an incredible ability to truly understand addiction and the underlying pain that comes with it. They helped me dig deep and process things I had avoided for years. Their honesty, empathy, and insight made such a difference. I will never forget what they taught me. The support workers were absolutely amazing. Daiwe, Gao, Ye, and Alex were always there when we needed something. Whether it was helping with day-to-day tasks, checking in with us, or just having a kind word ready when the days were tough, they always made us feel comfortable. Their presence created such a calm and safe atmosphere, and it meant a lot knowing they were always close by. The outings I had were also so beautiful and gave a sense of freedom. Phuket Island Rehab gave me a second chance. I arrived unsure of myself and uncertain about my future. I left with clarity, strength, and a deep sense of gratitude. I will carry this experience with me for the rest of my life. If you are thinking about getting help, this is the place. They do not just help you get clean. They help you heal. All my love to the staff and other clients 💕
0x30502d728b0a18c1_0xf0a28e39c2fd5fd0.author: Connor

0x30502d728b0a18c1_0xf0a28e39c2fd5fd0.text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I cannot thank this rehab center enough for the role it has played in my recovery journey. What was initially supposed to be a short stay turned into a full 3-month program — and that decision truly changed my life. I came in struggling with major depressive disorder which led to excessive alcohol use, feeling completely lost and hopeless. From day one, the environment here felt safe, welcoming, and judgment-free. The staff went above and beyond to make me feel comfortable and supported. Everyone — from the support staffs, cooks, nurses to the counselors — treated me with kindness, compassion, and patience. One of the things I appreciated most was that the center doesn’t enforce recovery through pressure or control. Instead, they guide you with empathy and give you the space to heal at your own pace. They empower you to take accountability for your actions, which helped me feel more in control of my recovery rather than being forced through it. That sense of trust and personal responsibility made a huge difference in my growth. A special thank you to my therapists, John and Gift. Their approach to therapy was not only professional but deeply human. I was able to open up about past traumas and finally begin to work through layers of pain I had buried for years. With their guidance, I learned practical coping skills, gained emotional insight, and started believing in recovery again. This place became more than just a treatment center — it became a turning point in my life. I’m walking away stronger, clearer, and finally hopeful. If you or a loved one is struggling, I cannot recommend this place enough.

0x30e29be3a7ba320f_0x3a49662e1ab22a62.text: the moment Luke and I arrived in Bangkok, our experience with Destination Beauty was absolutely outstanding. From being picked up at the airport and taken to our hotel, through my pre-operative appointments, hospital admission, surgeries, recovery and post-operative care, right through to our safe return home to Australia, we felt supported every step of the way. I cannot thank Vita enough for all her help, support and reassurance throughout the entire journey. A very special thank you also goes to Dr Ring, whose skill, professionalism and care were exceptional, and to Nurse Aom, who was absolutely wonderful and made me feel safe and cared for during my recovery. I can genuinely say that I have never experienced this level of service and care in Australia, which is one of the reasons I chose to travel to Thailand. I am so glad I made that decision. My experience with Destination Beauty was extremely positive from beginning to end, and I will always be grateful to everyone who was part of my journey. I would highly recommend Destination Beauty to anyone considering surgery in Thailand. 0x30e29be3a7ba320f_0x3a49662e1ab22a62.author: Catherleen Andriske

0x30e29be3a7ba320f_0x3a49662e1ab22a62.text: From the minute I landed, the Destination Beauty team were absolutely amazing! When I arrived at the Hotel, the staff again, went above and beyond helping with absolutely everything. My surgeon was Dr Weerachai. I had an ETT, BL and BA. I had lost a significant amount of weight, and had quite loose skin on my lower stomach. I had been planning this surgery for about 18months. My biggest fear was replacing something I hated (my loose skin) with something I hated even more (a horrific scar). Dr Weerachai specialises in his stitch work and I could not be more happy with my lines. His attention to detail, his constant checking in. I seen Dr Weerachai every single day I was in the hospital. I felt very cared for and not just another number. He listened to what I was hoping to achieve and went above my expectations. The nursing staff at the hospital were brilliant as well! I travelled over solo and was slightly worried how I would go without a support person. However, with the nurses, there really isn't a need for a support person as they are right there helping you with everything. I would 100% recommend Destination Beauty and Dr Weerachai to anybody that's looking at contouring their body. The professionalism and attention to detail are unmatched.
0x30e29be3a7ba320f_0x3a49662e1ab22a62.author: Sarah McHenry

0x30e29be3a7ba320f_0x3a49662e1ab22a62.text: I had a really lovely experience with Destination Beauty! From start to finish, .The care, professionalism, and support I received throughout my journey were outstanding. My husband came along as my support and was truly amazing,I could not have gone through this without him by my side. My 2 surgeons Dr Ring and Dr Weerachai did an outstanding job with my surgeries, and I absolutely love my results. The sweet nurses at the hospital were so kind and caring, and the Destination Beauty team consistently checked in on me—both in person and via text—to make sure I was recovering well and had everything I needed. I felt truly cared for every step of the way. I highly recommend them to anyone considering surgery abroad, honestly far better than anything I've experienced here in Australia. I'm now 1 year post-op,and I couldn't be happier with my results. Dr Weerachai performed my breast lift with implants, and Dr Ring performed my arm lift, back bra line lift, and liposuction. Thank you DB for making my experience such a positive one! Just be sure to follow all the pre- and post-op care instructions, and you’ll be in great hands
0x30e29be3a7ba320f_0x3a49662e1ab22a62.author: Jayne Louise

0x30e29be3a7ba320f_0x3a49662e1ab22a62.text: Absolutely outstanding service, support and care! I had skin removal surgery with Destination Beauty 7 months ago and my experience was second to none. I could not have asked for better or more genuine care from start to finish. My entire journey - planning and guidance from my rep, pre surgery consults, 24/7 care by the nursing staff before, during and after surgery and recovery care in a hotel - was a dream come true. It was 1/3 of the price I was quoted in Australia, which not only included the surgery by an excellent surgeon whose work was impeccable, it included all airport, hotel and hospital transfers, recovery care in a beautiful hotel with free buffet breakfasts each morning, complimentary outings, mini afternoon 'high teas' , regular nurse visits and do you believe it included taking along a support person! I have never received the level of care that I received with Destination Beauty. I would and do recommend them to anyone wanting surgery of any kind!!

0x30e29e4aaa18cb33_0xdb114d40666fa967.text: ฟันแท้ลูกซ้อนฟันนำ้นมค่ะ วิธีแก้ก็คือถอนฟัน ซึ่งเด็กกลัวมากค่ะ แต่คลีนิค U smile dental อุบายถอนฟันเด็กดีมากค่ะ หมอบอกสบายว่ามียาสตรอเบอรี่ ที่จะดันให้ฟันหลุดได้ เราคิดว่าคือ ยาชาแบบป้าย แล้วที่เหลือก็ตามขั้นตอนปกติ ฉีดยาชา (ขอปั้มลมให้เหงือกพองหน่อยนะคะ) ลูกร้อง อิ๊ๆๆๆ ระหว่างฉีดยาชา ระหว่างรอชาก็เล่าเรื่องฟันไปเรื่อยๆ โอ้วว เกือบหลุดแล้ว เดี๋ยวหมอเอากอซรองหน่อยนะคะ แล้วก็ดึงออกมาค่ะแบบเด็กหลับตาไม่ได้เห็นเครื่องมือที่น่ากลัว แนะนำนะคะ หากเจอเคสแบบเดียวกัน ไม่ร้องไห้เลยค่ะ ไม่รู้เรื่อง555 ค่าถอน 400 บาท คลีนิค ติดตั้งระบบอากาศกรองเพิ่มเติม ในยุคโควิด มีการฉีดน้ำยาฆ่าเชื้อโรคอย่างจริงจัง (จากกลิ่น) เด็กมาตรวจฟรี ถ้าไม่มีปัญหา ลูกไปหาคุณหมอมา2ปีแล้ว เพิ่งเสียเงินรอบนี้นะคะ ในเคสผู้ใหญ่ใช้สิทธิ์ประกันสังคมได้ค่ะ

0x30e29e4aaa18cb33_0xdb114d40666fa967.en: My child's permanent tooth was crowding a baby tooth. The solution was extraction, which my child was terrified of. But U Smile Dental Clinic had a great technique for extracting children's teeth. The dentist explained that they would use a strawberry-flavored anesthetic to help the tooth come out. I think it was a topical anesthetic. The rest was the normal procedure: injecting the anesthetic (they asked for a compress to inflate the gums). My child cried "Eeeee!" during the injection. While waiting for the anesthetic to take effect, they kept talking about the tooth. "Oh, almost came out! I'll put some gauze under it," they said, and then pulled it out. My child closed their eyes and didn't see any scary instruments. I highly recommend this clinic if you encounter a similar case. My child didn't cry at all; they were completely unaware! The extraction cost 400 baht. The clinic has an air filtration system installed, in the context of COVID-19. They disinfect thoroughly (judging by the smell). Children's checkups are free if there are no problems. My child has been seeing this doctor for two years; this was the first time we paid. For adults, social security insurance is accepted.

0x30e29e4aaa18cb33_0xdb114d40666fa967.author: suranan_Ch
0x30e29e4aaa18cb33_0xdb114d40666fa967.en: Yesterday, I used their services, and the thing that angered me the most was the complete lack of price information. I went in for a teeth cleaning (tartar removal) and inquired about the price. The staff replied with a price range of around 1,000 baht. I then asked about fillings, and they said they would check with the dentist. After that, we made an appointment. On the actual day, which included teeth cleaning, X-rays, and other checks, the bill came to 1800 baht, including a 900 baht deduction for social security, leaving me with a 900 baht difference to pay. The point that confused me the most was why they didn't inform me of the X-ray or other check-up costs. What if I had only brought money for the teeth cleaning or didn't have social security? Telling me the service fees wouldn't be a secret, but they only revealed it after the procedure. 0x30e29e553294ea33_0xf7ebe332f7b3d967.text: Exceptional Dental Care Experience in Bangkok As an Austrian traveler who encountered an unexpected dental mishap, I found myself in a situation that could have easily derailed my journey. While brushing my teeth, my front tooth crown just fell off at 3 am in the morning. What a nightmare! At least i could recover the crown and i had 2 options - fly home and get the work done at my dentist or try it here. I was very fortunate to find outstanding care at the Dental Hospital. The next morning, thanks to the prompt and professional service at this clinic, my worries were swiftly put to rest. Upon contacting the clinic, they demonstrated understanding the urgency of my situation, scheduling an appointment within the next hour. Arriving at the clinic, I was friendly greeted by the ladies at the reception who had my information already available from previous visits (in the past I went there twice for routine dental cleaning). This was eliminating any unnecessary paperwork. During my consultation, the dentist thoroughly assessed the situation, taking the time to listen to my concerns and explaining the treatment options available to me. His expertise and reassurance really gave me confidence that I was in capable hands and every aspect of my dental health was examined, including X-rays. The dentist not only addressed the immediate issue of the fallen crown but also took the time to discuss preventive measures and options for ongoing care. The clinic itself is also very impressive, with modern facilities spread across multiple levels, each dedicated to different aspects of dentistry. This setup gives me the confidence that whatever dental concern one might have, it could be addressed under one roof. During my visit, I received not only the necessary treatment but also a complete dental cleaning. The professionalism by the dentist and the assisting personnel, was truly commendable. What stood out the most was the genuine care and attention given to me as a foreigner in a foreign land. Despite the language barrier, the staff ensured clear communication, making me feel comfortable and well taken care of throughout the process. The entire experience, from the initial consultation to the final result was exceptional. And to top it off, the pricing was fair and transparent, offering great value for the high-quality service received. Also worth mentioning: Not only did they provide me with all the necessary X-rays via email for my records, but they also offered a complimentary shuttle service to and from the nearest BTS station, making transportation hassle-free, if necessary. Of course I was lucky because my case was not the worst case scenario. As someone with a long history of dental problems, i know that there are many cases where you will need more extensive treatments. And a dentist is not a magician who can fix all your dental problems in 3 hours. But if you ever find yourself in need of dental care in Bangkok, I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic. Whether for emergencies or routine check-ups, you can trust that you'll be in the hands of skilled professionals .
0x30e29e553294ea33_0xf7ebe332f7b3d967.author: Silvia Franz

0x30e29e553294ea33_0xf7ebe332f7b3d967.text: I have nothing but the highest praise for this Dental Hospital. Everything is state of the art (all their dental equipment is Swiss made) and most importantly: superb cleanliness (I even saw a cleaning team disinfecting the handrails on the staircase). The receptionists on the various floors are so friendly, I never had to wait longer then 10 minutes for my appointments (I made 7 consecutive trips to the hospital as I came over from Europe for ceramic veneers, root canal treatments, to fit a few crowns, have a few fillings and a molar extraction). The total cost was 1/3 of what I would have paid in Europe. I left with a complete new set of teeth (ceramic veneers) and the overall health of all my teeth was very well cared for. Dr Sumana truly transformed my mouth. I saw various doctors, and their assistant, they were all highly skilled and they'd trained either in USA or in the UK. The patient care, the incredible high standard of hygiene, combined with fantastic doctors truly impressed me. After returning to Europe my family members simply could not believe how natural and amazing my veneers looked. I am confident recommending this hospital for any dental treatment.
0x30e29e553294ea33_0xf7ebe332f7b3d967.author: Alexandra Newman

0x30e29e553294ea33_0xf7ebe332f7b3d967.text: This has been my go-to dental clinic for more than 10 years, and I try to visit regularly when I am in Bangkok. Living in Europe I have tried several clinics, and this is by far the most outstanding I have ever been to. It is modern, clean, efficient, professional, and the staff is friendly. I never feel as welcome anywhere else than here. Thank you! The hospital itself is located in a quiet oasis in Bangkok. You will feel relaxed as soon as you arrive. I usually come from the Siam/Asok side, taking the BTS to avoid traffic - get off at the ‘Phra Khanong’ station and wave down a taxi to drive me the last 5 minutes. The reception orders me a taxi for return. I understand many of my European pilot colleagues also use this hospital, which I very well understand. Highly recommended!
0x30e29e553294ea33_0xf7ebe332f7b3d967.author: Erlend R.R. Næss

0x30e29e553294ea33_0xf7ebe332f7b3d967.text: I recently visited the dental hospital and overall, I had a good experience. The facilities were well-maintained, and the doctors and nurses were decent. However, there was one issue that I would like to highlight. The lack of floor signs inside the elevators was quite problematic. When I entered the elevator, I found myself unsure of which floor to go to. I assumed that the first floor would be the reception area, but to my surprise, there was no one there. I decided to check the second floor, only to find out that it was dedicated to children department and the nurses there directed me to the 6th floor, where the main reception was located. I found it puzzling that a hospital, a place where clear directions are crucial, did not have any signs inside the elevators indicating the different floors. When I mentioned this concern to the reception, they informed me that there were signs placed outside the elevators. While I understand their point, it would have been much easier for customers like me to know where to go if there were signs inside the elevator as well. People can often forget to read signs or may not notice them in the first place. In a public place such as a hospital, having signs inside the elevator is a common practice and helps customers navigate more easily. Considering the limited space inside the elevator, I suggest that if putting signs for each floor seems too burdensome or cluttered, they could at least have a sign indicating that the main reception is located on the 6th floor. This way, customers would be aware of the specific floor they need to reach without overwhelming the elevator with multiple signs. Unfortunately, the receptionists did not seem receptive to my suggestion. They did not show any willingness to address the issue or take the suggestion forward. They appeared certain that everyone should know that the reception area is located on the 6th floor. This lack of willingness to improve their services was disappointing, especially considering the reputation of this hospital. Overall, I had a positive experience at the dental hospital in terms of the facilities, doctors, and nurses. However, I believe that the hospital's reception could benefit from additional training and should be more open to customer feedback. Implementing a sign inside the elevator, even if it's just for the 6th floor indicating the main reception, would greatly enhance the overall experience for patients and visitors, ensuring that they can easily find their way without unnecessary confusion.
0x30e29e553294ea33_0xf7ebe332f7b3d967.author: u295164

0x30e29e553294ea33_0xf7ebe332f7b3d967.text: Agree with another reviewer. Dentists and specialists are good and do a great job especially with teeth cleaning. 0x30e29e553294ea33_0xf7ebe332f7b3d967.author: Josephine M.

0x30e29e553294ea33_0xf7ebe332f7b3d967.text: My family had been going to Dental hospital for many years because their old location used to be convenient to where we used to live. I've been hearing many bad reviews about them and my most recent experience, with Dr.Panapa Sinthuprasirt, proved me how horrible their service really is. Dr. Panapa offered me a good deal for a dental crown after the Covid-19 lockdown and sent me for root- canal in preparation for that procedure. When i went back after a few weeks, she refused to honor our agreement. I waited for more than an hour only to be told to arrange for an appointment with a "filling" doctor. I was so surprised as replacing my filling was what she discouraged me to have done in the first place. She was making all sorts of excuses to back out of what we agreed on. I questioned her on why i had a root-canal and she said it was because i asked for it. How can a patient order a doctor for a procedure she doesn't need? I went there previously for a simple cleaning and was told that my filling had a problem and was referred to a specialist. I was not even in pain. Dr. Panapa was desperate to cut a deal and sold me the idea that a dental crown is my only option as putting a new filling would only damage the nerve. I assumed that since business was starting to pick- up, she didn't need to keep our agreement, not to mention grant me the discounted price she offered. It was horrible and so degrading on her part to have to see a doctor "lie through her teeth"' I refused to argue and go down her level. I just walked off.

0x30e29e553294ea33_0xf7ebe332f7b3d967.text: Horrible, horrific experience. I came all the way from the UAE specifically to remove my metal fillings and replace them with ceramic ones. I had even booked an appointment in advance for this and brought along my X-rays, which were only two weeks old. However, I was told new X-rays were required, so I went ahead and did everything they asked. Finally, I was sent to Dr. Romvalai Mankosol for the procedure, only to be told there wasn’t enough time to complete all three fillings and that I should come back another day. I explained that the sole purpose of my visit was to get these fillings done, especially since I had travelled such a long distance. Without any proper explanation of what she planned to do, the dentist gave me two injections, which were quite painful. When I told her this, she completely ignored me. She then started working on the fillings in a rushed manner, which made me extremely uncomfortable. Throughout the procedure, she kept making sounds under her breath, which added to my distress. After enduring this for as long as I could, I finally asked her if she was in a hurry. Her response was, “Obviously, I had to squeeze you in—what do you think?” This place has really gone downhill. I’ve now been waiting for the manager for over half an hour, and he still hasn’t shown up. Half my mouth is numb, my treatment is incomplete, and I am left feeling extremely disappointed. I will never travel this far again for such an awful experience.

0x23b81252c29c47b_0x5c6fc9db96d9bfea.text: I visited Andreas Gschliesser at Rehab-point in HuaHin, for four sessions of physiotherapy. whilst I was on holiday visiting my Father. I have recently had surgery on my shoulder, and wanted to keep attending Physiotherapy whilst away from home, so as not to lose momentum in rehabilitation. My sessions with Andreas were extremely beneficial and I made progress in my range of movement even in the short time we worked together. Andreas is extremely knowledgeable, and I learnt so much from him about my condition, and how the body responds and recovers from trauma and surgery. Andreas was extremely generous with his time and he even took time to discuss some concerns I have about my son, in relation to concerns about movement. Andreas took the time to signpost me to further information and services that he felt may be of use to myself and my son. I was so glad that I visited Andreas at rehab point, the clinic was easy to find with ample parking and was a lovely spacious light and airconditioned space to work in. I am now implementing the exercises and movements that Andrea recommended, I feel I have a much better understanding of the rehabilitation process and recovery for my individual circumstances. I now have a clear pathway thanks to the time Andrea took to explain and work with me to show me a suitable rehab programme and to signpost me to relevant information and other therapists that may be able to help me in my home country. Thankyou so much to Rehab-point and to the wonderful Andreas, I will be back to see you the next time I am in town to show you my progress!!
0x23b81252c29c47b_0x5c6fc9db96d9bfea.author: Ruth Bahadur

0x23b81252c29c47b_0x5c6fc9db96d9bfea.text: I came to Andreas with a herniated disc in my cervical spine. During our initial consultation, he took a lot of time to understand my symptoms in detail, identify possible causes, and develop a suitable treatment plan. It's immediately apparent that he is very experienced and competent. My cervical spine problems improved after just a short time. We conducted targeted tests to better understand the problem. This alone – along with his advice – gave me back the confidence to actively move my cervical spine again. Combined with the treatments and individually tailored exercises to do at home, I soon saw a significant improvement. He works in a very scientific and solution-oriented manner, clearly explaining what is possible, what is necessary, and where the limits lie. He avoids the shady "joint cracking" approach you hear from chiropractors or osteopaths around the corner. Thank you, Andreas!

0x30da3a706f48b95f_0x40cb5ad38c52a665.text: Unsatisfactory service and overpriced, and suspected cheating ... Me and my wife found good google comments for this clinic, so we called to book teeth cleaning but was told only 4 or 5 pm are available in the coming week. We book on Wednesday hoping no too busy and can have better service. When we arrived, we saw a young man coming into the clinic and followed "some kind of instruction" of the nurse staff to enter an open partitioned place with a surgery chair. We later found out that's the place for us. The overall place doesn't seem to be well maintained. Some areas like the pantary beside the washroom look a bit messy and shouldn't appear in a dental clinic. We lived in Thailand for almost 20 years. We have visited dental clinic in Phuket and Bangkok may be around 10 times and I must say this is the worst experience. The young man serving us doesn't look professional/skillful and in sometime causing me pain. Last but not least, when I make booking the staff explained that the price for teeth cleaning is 800 to 1200 Bahts, the lower price is for easy and simple good teeth while the higher price is for relatively "difficult to clean" not so good teeth. Mine is the latter taken about 12-15 minutes, and my wife's is the former taken less than probably 8 minutes. However, we were billed the same highest 1200 Bahts. Having pointed out and disputed with the staff, the bill was finally rectified to 1200 Bahts for me and 800 Bahts for my wife. Further follow up ; Yesterday, the young man who did the teeth cleaning for me told me I have 3 teeth with 5 decay that need filling. The offered cost is 800 Bahts for each filling, total 4000 Bahts. I had my teeth cleaning and checking about 1.5 years ago in Bangkok and didn't feel anything bad. I doubted how could so many tooth decay occurred so fast and therefore rejected his offer. In order to double-check my teeth, I went to another reputable dental clinic with high google rating. The place is clean and well maintained, the dentist is professional and very attentive to my concern. After my explanation, she examined thoroughly and concluded that my teeth are fine and no need to pay unnecessarily for any filling. Responding to my concern, she suggested conducting an X ray examination. The result reaffirmed her conclusion. It's quite obvious that the young man from Canny Smile is not only unprofessional but dishonest trying to cheat money, probably especially from non-local, non-Thai customers.
0x30da3a706f48b95f_0x40cb5ad38c52a665.author: Brendan Hung

0x30e29c10c61aba31_0x467259af1871a216.text: I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to the doctors, nurses, and all the staff at the clinic. Today, when I came for treatment (food poisoning, almost died!), I thought of this clinic because it's close to my workplace, and it was my first time here. One thing I clearly felt was that it wasn't just the treatment I received, but also the care, kindness, understanding, and encouragement from everyone. On days when I feel anxious, scared, or unsure of what to expect, small words from the doctor, advice from the nurses, and the smiles and attentiveness from all the staff mean so much to a patient. Sometimes these things may seem small from the perspective of the healthcare provider, but for someone facing health concerns, they are a huge source of encouragement. Thank you to the doctor for taking the time to explain everything in detail, providing knowledge, advice, and making me feel that there are always people ready to care for and help me. Thank you to all the nurses who cared for me with gentleness and patience, whether it was the smallest steps or things that needed to be repeated, they still cared for me willingly. And thank you to all the staff behind the scenes in caring for the patients, whether it was welcoming, coordinating, managing queues, providing information, or assisting at every step. Everyone contributed to making this treatment visit go better and felt warmer than I expected. Sometimes, people working in the medical field may not realize that... What everyone does each day is invaluable to the patients. But for us, we want everyone to know that I remember and am truly grateful for every word, every act of kindness, and every help I received. Thank you for not only caring for the illness but also for caring for the patients' feelings. Thank you for making me feel reassured on days when I was worried. May all the doctors, nurses, and staff receive abundant blessings in return, just as the goodwill you have given to the patients. May you all have good health, happiness in your work, and the strength to continue caring for people every day. Thank you from the bottom of my heart. For all the kindness, attention, and care. I will always remember the good feelings I received here. ❤️
0x30e29c10c61aba31_0x467259af1871a216.author: dutsaya susirachoct

0x30e29c10c61aba31_0x467259af1871a216.text: The receptionist said, "It's just a broken toenail," acting as if I didn't need to come to the clinic for something so trivial. It was as if they saw I wasn't feeling well, so they just asked me to wait. How could they say that? I had to take antibiotics/anti-inflammatory medication for two weeks and have the wound cleaned daily. Plus, when I was leaving, the receptionist gave me a business card and said, "Maybe you'll come again." What?! Who wants to be sick or in pain? I understand it's their job to sell something, but they could have chosen a better wording. And the wait was extremely long. However, the nurse was excellent. She was gentle with the wound, spoke kindly, was attentive, and gave great advice. Thank you! 🙏🏻 But I definitely won't be going back here again, even though it's the closest to my house. If you need urgent help, I wouldn't recommend this place. I had a very unpleasant experience. I'd rather go further afield.

That kind of genuine energy is rare and meant a lot to me. The procedure was explained clearly and thoroughly, and after a quick consultation with the doctor, I was able to get everything done right away—no waiting, no nonsense. I had Botox, Liftera, and a few other treatments, and all of them were performed by the doctor herself, not a nurse (which is honestly so rare, unless you pay extra in most other clinics). They turned what’s usually a slightly uncomfortable experience into something that actually made me smile. I left feeling more like I came from a spa than a clinic! I’m honestly in love with this place. I can’t imagine going anywhere else from now on. If you’re looking to have any beauty procedures done, I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic. It’s a hidden treasure on the island.

0x30502e3764660359_0x748e5764d00e322e.text: I saw Dr. Akhin today for a filling replacement. So, "holding my breath," I went to see Dr. Akhin (hoping it could be filled just one more time) and he was able to do it! Yay!!! Not only that, he also did it entirely without the need to give me a shot. That's a first for me! Anytime in the past I was told that I wouldn't need a shot, there was always that twinge of pain...and then they had to end up giving me the dreaded shot. But not so this time! I'm not sure how he managed it, but I never felt any pain in the tooth the whole time he was drilling. (Great job, Dr. Akhin!) I also really appreciated his "bedside manner" as he is very conscious of the comfort of his patient. He let me take breaks to rest my jaw and neck whenever I needed them. (And I needed several...) It takes a lot to impress me, but this dentist has impressed me more than any dentist I've ever had in the states (USA.) (Yes! By that I mean my entire life!) Not only that! It was also less than a third of the cost of the last time I had the same exact filling done a little over a year ago back home. You just can't beat that! 😀

0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.text: I had a medical emergency for an existing health condition while on holiday. Visited on a Sunday. Very impressed with the service and professionalism. Once I registered and they took my pressure and recognized it was an emergency, they rushed me straight into the Emergency ward and the doctor and nurses were with me in literally a minute. After treating me, they also kept me for observation for 2 hours to monitor my condition. Adequate English spoken by both medical staff and administrative staff. Nurses were kind and patient. Doctor took care to explain. The bill was extremely fair for the quality, extensiveness and speed of medical attention. I read mixed reviews before coming here and was initially hesitant to come to this government hospital (instead of one of the private hospitals on the island that cater more to tourists and insurance, with exorbitant price tags to match). I wanted to leave this review because my experience at Ko Samui Hospital was very positive and the price was very reasonable. If you are a visitor who needs medical attention while in Samui, don't hesitate to come to this hospital. Although the building and infrastructure may look a bit "old" and in need of some maintenance at the entrance, the service, medcial equipment, facilities (at least at the Emergency ward) and medical attention provided are as good and modern as any international hospital.
0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.author: Lynn Tan

0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.text: The Koh Samui hospital dealt with my acute gastro- enteritis (I remember their diagnosis from march 1988 even now) SO very well. I thought I was a gonna as I had deteriorated over two or more weeks living in a (then) isolated Chaweng beach with no idea of what was wrong then, but I DID know I needed help very much. A week and a half later I was cured and strong enough to leave the hospital. But I still think of the time they saved my life, with great care and efficiency, and I thank God they were there for me, 38 years ago. Beautiful people, in a beautiful hospital, on an island which I gradually saw was heaven. (I was utterly delirious when I was brought in, with no idea of where I was, or what was wrong) The doctors and nurses were so very patient, and the nurses fed me to allow me to recover. It was only after this I learned that dysentery and acute gastro- enteritis is the greatest cause of death across the world. I say a prayer of gratitude whenever I now think of that time. Should any of the hospital nurses or doctors read this, I thank you from the bottom of my heart. Sawadee cap. 🙏🏻
0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.author: Paul McNicholas

0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.text: Good for Thai government hospital....inexpensive compared to private hospitals. Most doctors and nurses speak reasonable good English.... Start at booth 1 and fill out your data, you'll be directed to get blood pressure and other basic info... then proceed to the area (by number you are directed too) Many hospital services provided here....including a good Physio therapy unit. If non emergency treatment is required avoid Mondays and Friday mornings, if possible....although afternoons generally less busy. Closed for lunch between 12 noon and 1 pm. Although the doctors work with great efficiency of getting patients seen too. Emergency Dept open 24 hours... In case of snake bite (rare) this is the only hospital on Samui that has Antivenom. Pharmacy is very well stocked, however you must have a prescription from a doctor. They accept credit cards, with a 3% extra charge. In case of having to be admitted, there are General wards, semi private rooms (6 beds) or spacious private rooms with 1 bed, fridge, couch and TV... (additional charge of course). Great sea view too!
0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.author: Jim P

( office 10). And the food not so bad , sure I m back here if I need.
0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.author: Gothai Biz

0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.text: Had to find our own wheelchair when I brought my friend in who was in severe pain and couldn’t walk. Never told us where they were taking us when they grabbed him and pushed his chair around and just left him by the front door or in a corner. Stayed overnight in private room. Not a single blood pressure check or anything even though they promised they would check on him. Stacked rusted furniture in hallways, dead crushed roach on the floor. I brought all of his regular meds in that weren’t working and all they were trying to give him were weaker versions of the same meds. No ID bracelet. No pain help. No results from blood tests. He had a weeping wound and they didn’t clean it or do anything for it. They didn’t care at all. Everything was dirty. No one available to greet you at the ER. Had no way of knowing what to do. I pulled him out of there the next day and brought him to the purple hospital where they always treat us well and are kind. One more thing- if someone stays overnight, someone else has to stay with them. You cannot be alone. They have no pillow and blanket for the extra person and it’s a sort of couch thing. Even though we paid for the room where they said “24 hour service” not at all. Maybe they are okay at some things but not for being caring and clean and healing. I added a photo of the ER. No one helped us or told us where to go or what to do
0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.author: Adina

0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.text: Our experience at this hospital was extremely disappointing. When my wife went in to give birth, she was taken into a room and kept there for nearly 19 hours without any updates. I was not allowed to contact her, and even when she asked staff to call me, they refused. This left us both stressed and worried during a time when support and communication are most needed. To make matters worse, one of the specialty nurses was aggressive and rude toward my wife, which only increased her anxiety. Instead of care and compassion, we were met with neglect and poor treatment. A hospital should provide clear communication, respect, and empathy — especially during childbirth. Sadly, this hospital failed in all of these areas, and I cannot recommend it to others.
0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.author: Phyo Phyo

0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.text: This happened a while ago, and I've decided to share it. Around the 11th of the month, I went to get a queue number for a dental appointment at 6:00 AM. It was for a wisdom tooth extraction. I waited until about 11:00 AM, and was called in to be informed that my next appointment was on the 28th of that month. I asked if it could be extracted now, and the answer was simply, "No, there are no doctors available to perform it." I think this is a terrible system. Just informing people about the next appointment at the end of the month should be prioritized more. It was a huge waste of time. The work process is disorganized, and the hospital staff lacks a service-oriented attitude.
0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.author: Pumm Paige
