I was confused by this part because I just wanted an injection to relieve the nerve pain in my leg. Do I have to wait 4 weeks? My leg might die before then! Terrible service. Everything was terrible.
0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.author: Jamie Dechsuwan

0x30503700288f8a75_0x47fa52f4f25afe98.text: ศักยภาพในการรักษา ดูแลสัตว์เลี้ยงของเราเต็มที่มากค่ะ ผู้ปกครองน้องหายห่วงได้เลยค่ะถ้ามาที่นี่ เราพาน้องหมาพันธุ์ไซบีเรียนไปรักษาที่นี่ ด้วยอาการที่สาหัสมาก (น้องมีอาการเหมือนคนหมดเรี่ยวแรง,พยายามหายใจแบบโรยริน,ตัวร้อน ไข้ขึ้นสูง,มีสิ่งแปลกปลอมอุดตันกระเพาะ/ทางเดินอาหาร ทำให้น้องไม่สบายตัว ปวดท้องตลอดเวลา,กินอาหารตามปกติไม่ได้ กินน้ำและนมได้นิดหน่อย ต้องป้อนโดยใช้ไซริงค์ แบบจับอ้าปากป้อน) จังหวะที่รถพาน้องไปถึงโรงพยาบาล รีบเดินเข้าไปบอกพนักงานด้านใน ว่าน้องอาการไม่ไหวแล้ว เหมือนคนจะหมดลมหายใจ ผู้ช่วยด้านใน รีบเรียกผู้ช่วยชายให้ยกน้องใส่รถเข็นไปพบหมอด้านใน พอยกน้องลงมาใส่รถเข็น จังหวะตัวน้องนอนลงในรถเข็นแล้ว น้องหมาเราชักกระตุกแบบแรงมาก 2 รอบ แล้วหมดลมหายใจไปเลยค่ะ ได้รับแจ้งจากหมอที่ตรวจน้องว่า ตอนน้องชักกระตุก น้องอ้วก ขับถ่ายของเสียออกมา เป็นสีน้ำตาลค่ะ ความพร้อมในการบริการของที่นี่เต็ม 100% ค่ะ

ช่วงค่ำโทรไปถามเวลาทำการ เผื่อต้องพาลูกสาวไปหาหมอฉุกเฉินตอนกลางคืนเพราะน้องอาการไม่ค่อยดี คุณหมอและทีมงานน่ารักมาก แม้ว่าจะไม่ได้พาน้องเข้าไปใช้บริการ แต่ที่ รพ. ก็โทรมาสอบถามอาการน้องและให้คำแนะนำเบื้องต้น หากเกิดเหตุฉุกเฉินกลางดึก ประทับใจมากๆค่ะ 🥰 เป็นกำลังใจให้ทีมงานนะคะ ถ้ามี 10 ดาวก็ให้ 10 ดาวเต็มค่ะ ✨️

วันนี้แต๊งกิ้วไปหาคุณหมอเพื่อตรวจผิวหนังในแพ็กเกจโปรโมชั่นมาฮะ 💖 ประทับใจมากกก พี่ๆ ทุกคนบริการดี น่ารักสุดๆ ตั้งแต่พี่หน้าเคาน์เตอร์ ผู้ช่วยคุณหมอ ไปจนถึงคุณหมอเลยฮะ คุณหมอให้คำแนะนำละเอียดมาก อธิบายเข้าใจง่าย ไม่เร่งรีบเลย รู้สึกสบายใจสุดๆ 🥰 คลินิกก็สะอาด บรรยากาศดี สบายตามากค่ะ 👍🏻👍🏻

ดูแลและสนใจให้ความเป็นส่วนตัวความปลอดภัยเด็กๆดีเลยค่ะ อัปเดตการทานอาหารและสุขภาพละเอียด แม่ๆก็อุ่นใจไปด้วยเลยค่ะ สะอาด พี่พยาบาลพนักงานก็บริการดีพูดจาไพเราะ พี่หมอแพทย์ก็อธิบายเข้าใจง่ายเลยค่ะมีโอกาสจะกลับไปใช้บริการอีกแน่นอนค่ะขอบคุณสำหรับการดูแลน้องๆอย่างดีค่ะ🙏🧡🩶

พนักงานน่ารัก คุณหมอก็น่ารัก ใจเย็น ป้อนยาเด็กๆ เก่งมาก น้องแมวของที่บ้านทั้ง 2 ตัวฉีดวัคซีนและใช้บริการกับที่นี่ตลอดตั้งแต่ยังไม่เปลี่ยนชื่อ อุปกรณ์ทันสมัย สะอาด รพ.เปิดตลอด 24 ชม. ด้วย มีเคสดึกๆ คือหายห่วงได้เลยค่ะ 🐱❤️
บริการดีและดูแลน้องดีมากค่ะ พาน้องมารักษาประจำ ฝากน้องไว้กับที่โรงพยาบาลมีการอัพเดทอาการตลอด ทำให้เราสบายใจ น้องก็ปรับตัวเข้ากับที่นี่ได้ดี พี่ๆพยาบาลน่ารัก

สาขาอื่นไม่รู้ยังไง แต่สาขาภูเก็ต ที่ใช้บริการครั้งแรก ฝากน้องหมา ถูกสุนัขอื่นที่ฝากในรพเหมือนกัน กัด พยาบาลบอกตะปบ แต่แผลที่เป็นอยู่คือกัด ไม่มีอะไรที่ทำให้เรารู้สึกอยากกลับไปใช้บริการอีก ขอพักถาวร โคตรรู้สึกแย่ คำพูดหรือoffer ต่างๆ เราไม่พูดไม่ขออะไรไป เพราะอยากจะรู้เขาจะรับผิดชอบด้านไหนอะไรบ้างหรือoffer อะไรที่ทำให้เรารู้สึกดีรู้สึกอยากจะลองให้โอกาสเขากลับมาใช้บริการอีก แต่สุดท้ายก็ไม่ได้มีอะไรที่ทำให้เรารู้สึกว่า เราอยากจะกลับไปใช้บริการอีก ใครจะไปฝากก็คิดดูให้ดี เพราะตอนเข้าไปรับน้องหมาวันนั้น พยาบาลอุ้มอีกตัว อีกตัวหลุด วิ่งไล่อยู่ เห็นคาตา เป็นเรื่องสะเพร่าที่ไม่สมควรจะมีคำว่าผิดพลาดเกิดขึ้น ทำให้เห็นชัดเจนว่า พึ่งมาเปิดในภก ทุกอย่างใหม่หมด แม้กระทั้งคนดูแล ไม่มีความ professionalสักนิด

อยากจะให้-10ด้วยซ้ำ ห้องพักไม่สะอาด แอร์ไม่ได้เปิดตลอด หมอไม่คุยกัน พยาบาลดูแลไม่ละเอียด เปลี่ยนเวนหมอตลอด มาก็แค่อ่านตามchart เมือกเลือดยังคาอยู่ตรงสายแท้ๆ แต่chartบอกไม่มีก็เชื่อตามนั้น จนต้องเรียกมาชี้ถามว่านี้ใช่เมือกมั้ย ท่อฉี่น้องหลุดเป็นรอบที่2ไม่มีการแจ้ง โทรสอบถาม ทำการสวนรอบที่3ไปเลย เพิ่งมาทราบเรื่องตอนเข้าเยี่ยมช่วงค่ำ? Admitมาอาทิตย์กว่าหมอยังไม่ทราบสาเหตุของอาการหรือแนวทางจะรักษาต่อ ขอบายตลอดกาล หมอบางท่านก็ดี แต่โดยรวม ไม่ค่ะ

0x30e298d2ded84aed_0x4ae0a75bebfd825a.text: I feel blessed and grateful that I had found Silom Dental Building more than one year ago. I flew to Bangkok from Australia three times. Now, I have perfect smile and perfect bite for the price I could only dream about. But regardless the much lower price compare to Australia which is about 60% I had experienced superb quality service by highly qualified processionals in a comforting and relaxing atmosphere. Everyone in their office is very genuine and friendly. Every doctor explained every treatment in full details and the result is simply amazing! I highly recommend this clinic as the best clinic in Bangkok.

I had dental work done here during my time in Bangkok and couldn't be happier with the experience. The team is genuinely professional from start to finish — clear communication, no upselling, and a real sense that they're acting in your best interest. The quality of the work is excellent and the attention to detail is obvious. On top of that, the value is outstanding compared to what I'd pay back home. I trusted them completely and would recommend them without hesitation to anyone visiting Bangkok or living here. Five stars.
0x30e298d2ded84aed_0x4ae0a75bebfd825a.author: Ben Sweales

0x30e298d2ded84aed_0x4ae0a75bebfd825a.text: 10 years ago I had extensive dental work done and was saved from having to have dentures. The work was done to a very high quality and I have not had to have any dental repairs done since then until recently eating a crunchy toffee which cracked the porcelain on a crown. I have just returned from a trip to Bangkok to have it replaced. Thank you so much to the doctors at Silom Dental Building for my beautiful teeth and a smile with confidence

Silom dental building has changed my life and the way I look forever. I am so happy and grateful to have found Silom Dental and I will never forget the experiences I had there. For those who is looking for a dental clinic, come to silom dental and I am sure that you will have a wonderful experience.

Client since 2009, had every type of treatments from basic cleaning to crowns. Always had perfect service, kind and efficient staff and doctors. Was checking the bad reviews, they sound fake, prices are very reasonable and I never had to wait much (assuming I always take an appointment in advance)

I had made an appt with Siam Dental, but they wanted to pull my tooth. I went to Silom Dental for a 2nd opinion. She saved it, prepped it for a crown, and got me in down the street at Verizon Dental for a root canal - NO WAITING!!! FANTASTIC!!! I was absolutely thrilled...

We came here as tourists and couldn’t be happier with the experience. The clinic is very clean, safe, and well organized. The dentist did an excellent job and was very professional. I highly recommend this place to any tourist who needs dental treatment.
0x30e298d2ded84aed_0x4ae0a75bebfd825a.author: פאולה אריאלה

0x30e298d2ded84aed_0x4ae0a75bebfd825a.text: I am writing to file a formal complaint regarding the unacceptable service I received at your clinic today. I came for dental treatment and was charged for the procedure in advance. Local anesthesia was administered, but immediately after, the dentist refused to perform the treatment, saying it could not be done. Despite not receiving any actual dental work, I was still asked to pay, and no solution or alternative was offered. This left me not only in physical discomfort (due to unnecessary anesthesia), but also in emotional distress, as I felt deceived and dismissed. Such conduct is highly unprofessional and unacceptable, especially in a medical setting where patients come in trust and vulnerability.

0x30e299097e3d1353_0x1fb72e37217acd6a.text: Since turning 40, I've experienced hair loss and thinning, leading to a lack of confidence and a anguish spent countless hours cutting and styling my hair. I tried many solutions, but the results were unsatisfactory. Finally, I decided to consider hair transplantation and researched several clinics. Pavicon Hair Clinic was one of the options I considered, and I wasn't disappointed. After the consultation, I was impressed with the doctor and staff who provided insightful advice directly addressing my specific needs. I decided to have the procedure done at Pavicon on my first day. A week later, I had my transplant appointment. I have to admit, I was very nervous and afraid of the pain, but after witnessing the doctor's professionalism, skill, and procedures, I felt relieved, even though the procedure took a long time due to its precision. (I secretly thought to myself, I'm just lying there, but the doctor and team have to stand for much longer; if they can endure it, so can I!) After six hours, everything went well. Before leaving, the doctor gave me post-operative care instructions. The first night was slightly sore, and I had follow-up appointments for wound cleaning and light therapy. We'll have to wait and see what the results are, as the doctor is scheduling follow-up appointments throughout the year. If you're looking for a hair transplant clinic, I highly recommend Pavicon Hair Clinic as a top choice.
0x30e299097e3d1353_0x1fb72e37217acd6a.author: Santi Nettip

0x30e299097e3d1353_0x1fb72e37217acd6a.text: Since deciding to undergo a hair transplant at this clinic, I've been impressed from the very beginning. The staff has been warm, informative, and attentive, answering all my questions without rushing me. I can feel the professionalism and sincerity of their service. The surgeon who performed the hair transplant was very kind and explained the procedure in detail, including the techniques used, expected results, precautions, and post-operative care. Everything was clear and made me feel comfortable and confident about the procedure. Regarding the cost, I must say it's reasonable, and the clinic provides clear estimates and pricing information in advance, making it easy to plan.
0x30e299097e3d1353_0x1fb72e37217acd6a.author: รังสรรค์ ดวงแก้ว

0x30e299097e3d1353_0x1fb72e37217acd6a.text: I had my hair transplant at Pavicon Hair Center. During the consultation, Dr. Nay gave excellent advice and shared great knowledge about hair, so I decided to have my hair transplant done at Pavicon. On the day of the actual hair transplant, there was a hairline design session, and the doctor allowed us to participate in designing the hairline we wanted. I was very impressed. During the actual hair transplant, it only hurt when they injected the local anesthetic. Once the anesthetic took effect, I just lay comfortably while the medical team performed the hair transplant.
0x30e299097e3d1353_0x1fb72e37217acd6a.author: นพรัตน์ ถาวรรัตน์

0x30e299097e3d1353_0x1fb72e37217acd6a.text: This is my third hair transplant that I’ve done. My first 2 times were at another clinic and the results were questionable… so I decided to come here for my third and final time. The staff is welcome trained with exceptional customer service. Dr.Nay attention to detail is unmatched. I was getting ready for the pain of the first night sleep but it never came. It was painless! Compare to my first 2 times at another clinic get like a trunk keep crashing onto my head. Conclusion, Great Service, Great Staff, and Great doctor.
0x30e299097e3d1353_0x1fb72e37217acd6a.author: Icey Kingsley

0x30e299097e3d1353_0x1fb72e37217acd6a.text: I was very impressed with the service at this clinic! From the initial consultation to the hair transplant procedure, the medical team and staff provided close attention and explained everything clearly, making me feel confident throughout the process. After the procedure, my hair grew as expected, looks natural and healthy. Importantly, there was no pain or scarring to worry about. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a high-quality hair transplant clinic.
0x30e299097e3d1353_0x1fb72e37217acd6a.author: nomad 15

0x30e299097e3d1353_0x1fb72e37217acd6a.text: I was very impressed with Dr. Nay's hair transplant clinic. From the moment I stepped in, I felt clean and organized. The reception staff were attentive and provided clear instructions. The doctors and staff were skilled and attentive to every detail, making me feel confident and comfortable throughout my visit. The results were very satisfying. It was definitely worth the investment.
0x30e299097e3d1353_0x1fb72e37217acd6a.author: Jəw Suparoekz

0x30e299097e3d1353_0x1fb72e37217acd6a.text: I have fine hair and consulted several places, but they refused to do the procedure because they were afraid of the bad results. Now, it's been three months since my hair transplant, and my hair is starting to grow. This has given me some encouragement and made me feel more confident. My friends have even commented that I have hair now. The doctor is very skilled!
0x30e299097e3d1353_0x1fb72e37217acd6a.author: ชิต โจโจ้

0x30e299097e3d1353_0x1fb72e37217acd6a.text: The doctors from HAIR A NICE DAY CLINIC (located in Rayong Province) came here to learn hair transplant surgery techniques including FUE, DHI, and Micrograft. This is a very high-standard hair transplant institute with a luxurious atmosphere, excellent service, and great assistance, including convenient parking.
0x30e299097e3d1353_0x1fb72e37217acd6a.author: Benjarong Roongmaneekul

0x311d7f41fac88a87_0x590bad57263302d3.text: ปกติไม่ค่อยรีวิวให้ใคร แต่คลินิกทำฟัน รังสิตสมาย ไม่มารีวิวไม่ได้เลยค่ะ เมื่อวานเหงือกบวมแล้วก็ฟันมีปัญหา เพิ่งย้ายมาอยู่รังสิต ก็หาร้านหมอฟัน จริงๆตามรีวิวมาอีกที แต่รีวิวใน Google ไม่ผิดหวังค่ะ ขอยกให้เป็นร้านหมอฟันอันดับหนึ่งในใจตอนนี้ และคงเป็นร้านประจำ ถ้าเรื่องฟันยังไงก็ต้องมาที่นี่ ร้านสะอาดมากค่ะ พนักงานต้อนรับ ที่ซักประวัติข้อมูลก็ถามข้อมูลอย่างละเอียดถี่ถ้วนแล้วพูดจาดีมาก มี ความรู้ และมาจุดที่เจอคุณหมอ คุณหมอใจดีใจเย็น ที่สำคัญคือมือนิ่งมาก เหมือนหมอฉีดหน้าเลยค่ะ เพราะว่าเมื่อวานจะต้องถอนฟันคุด แล้วมีจุดที่จะต้องฉีดยาชา มือคุณหมอนิ่งมากและเป็นการฉีดยาชาครั้งแรกในชีวิต ที่ไม่เจ็บเลย คุณหมออัปเดตอาการตลอดเวลาที่มีการรักษา พูดคุย บอกเราว่ากำลังทำอะไรกับช่องปากและฟันเราอยู่ ทุกอย่างรวดเร็วเรียบร้อยสะอาดมาก รวมทั้งน้องผู้ช่วย น้องผู้ชาย ที่คอยช่วยคุณหมอ มีความคล่องตัวและมีความรู้ เอาง่ายง่ายไม่รู้จะติอะไรของทางคลินิกเลยค่ะ รับไปถอนฟัน เพียงหนึ่งวัน จนตอนนี้ครบ 24 ชั่วโมงแล้ว สามารถมารีวิวได้ปกติ คืออาการหายแล้ว ไม่ปวดไม่ระบมหน้าไม่บวม ขอบคุณคุณหมอแล้วก็ทางคลินิกมากๆอยากให้รักษามาตรฐานการบริการการรักษาไปนานนานค่ะ และสัญญาเลยว่าใช้บริการเป็นร้านประจำของครอบครัวไปตลอด
0x311d7f41fac88a87_0x590bad57263302d3.author: Thanika Rasameeaksornsakul
0x311d7f41fac88a87_0x590bad57263302d3.en: I don't usually write reviews, but I just had to review Rangsit Smile Dental Clinic! Yesterday, my gums were swollen and I had a dental problem. I recently moved to Rangsit and was looking for a dental clinic, actually based on reviews I found on Google. And I wasn't disappointed! I'd rate this as my number one dental clinic right now, and it will definitely be my regular clinic. If I need any dental work, I'll come here. The clinic is very clean. The reception staff who took my medical history were very thorough and polite, knowledgeable, and spoke very well. As for the doctor, she was kind, patient, and most importantly, had incredibly steady hands, like a professional giving injections to the face! Yesterday, I had a wisdom tooth extracted, and there was a spot where they needed to inject local anesthetic. The doctor's touch was so steady that it was the first time in my life that I didn't feel any pain at all. The doctor updated me on my condition throughout the treatment, talking to me and explaining what they were doing to my mouth and teeth. Everything was quick, efficient, and very clean. The male assistant who helped the doctor was also very efficient and knowledgeable. Simply put, I can't find anything to criticize about the clinic. I had a tooth extracted just one day ago, and now it's been 24 hours, and I can write this review normally because the symptoms have disappeared. No pain, no swelling, no bruising. Thank you so much to the doctor and the clinic. I hope they maintain this standard of service and treatment for a long time. And I promise we'll make it our family's go-to restaurant for life.

0x311d7f41fac88a87_0x590bad57263302d3.text: ประทับใจการบริการมากค่ะ มาใช้บริการที่นี่ครั้งที่สองแล้ว บินกลับมาจากสวีเดนก็มาทำฟันเลยค่ะ น้องที่เคาท์เตอร์น่ารักและเป็นกันเอง คุณหมอน่ารักมากๆๆๆกลับมาไทยรอบหน้าก็จะมาใช้บริการอีกแน่นอนๆๆค่ะ แนะนำเลยค่ะใครที่มองหาคลีนิคทำฟันคุณภาพเยี่ยมแถวรังสิต เลิฟฝุดๆค่ะ
0x311d7f41fac88a87_0x590bad57263302d3.en: I was very impressed with the service. This is my second time here. I came straight here after flying back from Sweden. The staff at the counter are lovely and friendly. The dentist is incredibly kind. I will definitely come back here again next time I'm in Thailand. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for excellent quality dental care in the Rangsit area. I love it!

0x311d7f41fac88a87_0x590bad57263302d3.text: คุณหมอมือเบามือมากคะ รักษาหลายอย่างมากเลย สุขภาพฟันมีปัญหาหลายอย่าง มาปรึกษาคุณหมอ แนะนำดีมากคะ ถอนฟันไม่เจ็บเลย จัดฟันมือเบาทุกครั้ง พนักงานบริการดีคะ สุภาพ ถามจุกจิกตอบได้หมด ใจเย็น ใสใจลูกค้าดีคะ

Tooth extractions were painless, and the orthodontic treatment was very gentle every time. The staff were also very helpful, polite, and answered all my detailed questions patiently and attentively.

0x311d7f41fac88a87_0x590bad57263302d3.text: วันนี้ไปขูดหินปูน คุณหมอมือเบามาก ตอนแรกตัดสินใจว่าจะไปดีไหม เพราะเคยทำตอนเด็กแล้วเจ็บ สรุปคือ คุณหมอมือเบาสุดๆ ไม่เจ็บเลยย ให้คำแนะนำดีมาก 💖💖

0x311d7f41fac88a87_0x590bad57263302d3.en: I went for a teeth cleaning today. The dentist was very gentle. At first, I hesitated because I had it done when I was a child and it was painful. But it turned out the dentist was incredibly gentle; it didn't hurt at all! They also gave great advice. 💖💖

0x311d7f41fac88a87_0x590bad57263302d3.text: The staff from the clinic are very friendly, and the dentist is very patient. The best dental clinic in Pathum Thani that you shouldn’t miss.

0x311d7f41fac88a87_0x590bad57263302d3.text: ได้ไปใช้บริการ อุดฟัน ขูดหินปูน และรากฟันเทียม คุณหมอพูดเพราะทุกคนให้คำแนะนำดี และทำดีมาก สถานที่สะอาด การบริการ ประทับใจค่ะ
0x311d7f41fac88a87_0x590bad57263302d3.en: I had fillings, teeth cleaning, and dental implants done there. The dentist was very kind, everyone gave good advice, and did a great job. The place was clean, and the service was impressive.

0x311d7f41fac88a87_0x590bad57263302d3.text: ทำมาปีกว่าแล้วค่ะอุปกรณ์ไม่มีหลุดเลย คุณหมอทำดีมากพี่ๆที่คลีนิคก็บริการดีมากเลยค่ะ ใครลังเลหนูแนะนำนะคะ100/100ไม่หัก🤩

0x311d7f41fac88a87_0x590bad57263302d3.text: บริการดีมากค่ะพนักงานบริการให้คำแนะนำดีมากค่ะ คุณหมอก็เป็นกันเอง มือเบามากค่ะประทับใจในการดูแล แนะนำมาที่นี่นะคะ

This clinic is perfect for anyone wanting to get a blood test in Chiang Mai without having to wait in long queues at a large hospital.

0x30e29fee9df48d5f_0x5b0a2e170adef588.text: I feel the service at this clinic is much better than in China, and the staff here are all very attractive and have beautiful appearances. It would be great if they offered nail services; I could come here more often.

0x30e29fee9df48d5f_0x5b0a2e170adef588.text: I had a wonderful experience at this aesthetic clinic. The environment was comfortable and relaxing, creating a pleasant atmosphere from the moment I arrived. The staff were friendly, professional, and always attentive to my needs. I especially appreciated their ability to communicate in multiple languages, which made the consultation and treatment process smooth, easy to understand, and reassuring. Overall, I felt welcomed, well cared for, and highly satisfied with the service provided.

0x30e29fee9df48d5f_0x5b0a2e170adef588.text: This is my favorite shop! The environment is very clean. You need to change into disinfected slippers upon arrival. The staff are also very helpful. Both men and women can get treatments, including IV drips, hyaluronic acid injections, and laser treatments. If you're ever in Thailand, you absolutely must check this place out!

0x3102b70078ef5429_0xb7b17e7157954e46.text: I just had my first time getting my pimples extracted here. The doctor and staff were so lovely and friendly, like older sisters talking to younger ones. I'll definitely come back if I have the chance.

0x3102b70078ef5429_0xb7b17e7157954e46.author: nunu gomm

0x30e29f3eb3b5da07_0xa56d1aaa5a9711ce.text: I recently visited Tooth Therapy Dental Clinic in Bangkok for a dental cleaning, and I must say, my experience was nothing short of amazing. Coming from a very traumatizing dental experience in New Zealand, I’ve always had severe anxiety about visiting the dentist. However, Dr. Mana and her incredible team changed that for me. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warmth and genuine care. The entire team went above and beyond to ensure I felt comfortable and at ease. Dr. Mana's professionalism, coupled with her compassionate approach, made a world of difference. She took the time to explain each step of the process, addressing all my concerns with patience and understanding. The level of comfort and love I received from everyone at the clinic was truly exceptional. They created a calm and reassuring environment, making my dental visit a positive experience for the first time in years. I cannot thank Dr. Mana and her team enough for their outstanding service and dedication to patient care. If you’re looking for a dental clinic that prioritizes your comfort and provides top-notch professional care, I highly recommend Tooth Therapy Dental Clinic. They have genuinely transformed my outlook on dental visits, and I am incredibly grateful for their exceptional service.
0x30e29f3eb3b5da07_0xa56d1aaa5a9711ce.author: Karishma Govind

0x30e29f3eb3b5da07_0xa56d1aaa5a9711ce.text: Absolutely fantastic. First saw them in 2007 for major bridge and crown works which would have taken about 10 sessions and cost $50,000 in Sydney.in Bangkok, all prep work was done in one day on the way to a business trip in Europe and completion in half a day on my return at a total cost of just over $11,000! 11 years later all Bridges and crowns are still intact and I never had any issue. My Aussie dentist stated that the work done in Thailand was a lot better than what he has seen in Australian. Highly recommended! A great professional team. Thank you DC One!

0x30e29f3eb3b5da07_0xa56d1aaa5a9711ce.text: This is the gold standard in dental care not only in Bangkok but globally. Very attentive polite and caring staff. The Doctor I used Dr. Sumaporn was exceptional and explained in detail the procedures and process. Combines the best of art and medicine. Very caring. The office manager was very detailed kind and diligent. Went over in detail over the procedure. Cannot find a place better than this.
0x30e29f3eb3b5da07_0xa56d1aaa5a9711ce.author: Maheshwar Prasad Srivastava

0x30e29de1473aa607_0xfd82c47ff7102ef7.en: I had my teeth cleaned (tartar removed) with Dr. Thanat. Compared to previous times I've had it done elsewhere, this was a huge difference! There was virtually no discomfort (or maybe very minimal, almost imperceptible). I felt great, not scared or worried at all. I just relaxed and felt completely at ease. 🤗😘 The work was excellent and clean. I loved it! I'll definitely be back here for my next teeth cleaning. 🤗🫰🫰🫰 **For anyone who's afraid of teeth cleaning, I highly recommend coming here. The doctor has a very gentle touch.**

I highly recommend it because coming here, dental work won't be scary anymore 😊

They contacted me late at night when my tooth cracked and scheduled an appointment for me the next morning – it was amazing! I'll definitely be using their services regularly. Recently, I've recommended this clinic to both my friends and my boyfriend.

0x30e29de1473aa607_0xfd82c47ff7102ef7.text: I visited the town in town branch as walk in to get my back tooth extracted ,after two failed attempts in uk I was a bit nervous icl… I went in randomly to inquire and booked for work same day. Very good services recommended

0x3054f1c9d6d16fe3_0x3b3819db2375d770.text: I applied to the clinic for the removal of my lower wisdom tooth. The staff is very friendly and speaks English. They took an X-ray and provided an approximate cost. Since there was no available time when I arrived, they suggested I come back later so the doctor could assess the situation and give me the exact cost of the removal. The doctor turned out to be a pleasant man; he examined me and asked when I was ready to have the tooth removed—now or later. Since the doctor was free, he began the extraction immediately. The entire process lasted about an hour; it was incredibly scary, and at times I was shaking, but there was no pain. I have a fear of dentists and the sound of the drill =))) After the appointment, they gave me a lot of medication and instructed me to return in 10 days to have the stitches removed. Today is the second day, and the wound hardly hurts. I am taking painkillers and believe everything will heal quickly. Thanks to the staff for handling everything neatly and relatively quickly. Lower wisdom teeth are dreadful. The procedure is certainly not cheap, but I decided to have the tooth removed because it started to break and hurt. All together, including X-rays, injections, and medications, the total cost came to over 6,000 baht, which is quite expensive, but they saved me from a problem that had been bothering me for more than a month. Thank you!

0x30e2a36faba91e7b_0xd16bfb2a4b23766a.text: This was my first experience with acupuncture and cupping, and I'm someone who lacks energy in life because I have mild depression. Acupuncture helped me; I felt my inner energy flowing normally. Dr. May wasn't stingy with the needles at all; she was very gentle and it wasn't as painful as I expected. Even people who are afraid of needles can try it. 😊 Cupping is great for relieving muscle aches in the neck, shoulders, and back. You tell the doctor where it hurts, and you can come back for repeat treatments. It also helps to expel toxins from the body. ✅ As for the service at Xin Yi Clinic, Dr. May is very friendly and easy to talk to. If you have any problems, just tell her directly, and she'll provide whatever you need without hesitation, and you'll definitely feel better.

0x30e2a36faba91e7b_0xd16bfb2a4b23766a.text: On my first visit, I tried acupuncture, cupping, and electrical stimulation. It was more effective than massage and deep tissue work. I felt better in just a short time. The service was also affordable. The doctor provided a pulse diagnosis and additional advice on what to be careful about. I will definitely come back.

0x30e29eb120b8d9d5_0x14151193c4086ccf.text: My wife who is Thai ( I am Australian ) has just come back to our hotel room bright smile beaming after visiting this dental surgery for the first time . We have recently gotten implants in another country where it felt like a production line whereas Dr Khun’s staff all were caring , knowledgeable and lovely and always asking if my wife was ok . This was also quoted on at some very competitive pricing while she was there. On top of all that did I mention how convenient it is to the Victory Monument BTS station ? Get a picture then get your teeth cleaned and checked !

0x30e2997f056535bb_0xca373a778eed275f.text: ตัดสินใจมาจัดฟันที่นี่เพราะเพื่อนแนะนำมาค่ะ ตอนแรกกังวลเรื่องการถอนฟันมาก แต่คุณหมออธิบายละเอียดมากว่าเคสเราจำเป็นต้องถอนเพราะอะไร พร้อมเปิดฟิล์ม X-ray ให้ดูเปรียบเทียบ พี่ๆ ผู้ช่วยน่ารักมาก คอยไลน์เตือนนัดทุกเดือน ใครขี้ลืมคือหายห่วง ความสะอาด: คลินิกสว่าง เครื่องมือดูใหม่และสะอาดมากครับ ราคา: ชอบที่มีความโปร่งใส ไม่มีค่าใช้จ่ายแอบแฝง ยอดแบ่งจ่ายต่อเดือนคงที่ ทำให้วางแผนการเงินง่าย

0x30e2997f056535bb_0xca373a778eed275f.author: ze.like. j

0x30e2997f056535bb_0xca373a778eed275f.text: รีวิวตามความจริงที่เจอมา ตลอดระยะเวลาที่จัดฟันมาตั้งแต่ 20 ก.ค67 ตามโปรโมชั่น ต้องมาทุกเดือน ถึงจะได้รีเทรนเนอร์แบบใสฟรี แต่เราไม่ได้สิทธิ์นี้ เพราะเราขอไม่มา ในเดือน ม.ค.และก.ค. (เพราะมีศัลยกรรม) ไม่สามารถอ้าปากกว้างได้เพราะเจ็บแผล แต่เราแจ้งล่วงหน้าก่อนไปทำศัลยกรรม แล้วทางคลินิคไม่ทักท้วงว่า ถ้าไม่มาทุกเดือน จะไม่ได้รับสิทธิ์นี้ แต่เราไม่ได้ไม่โอเคในจุดนี้ แต่ที่เรารู้สึกเสียความรู้สึกเลย คือเราได้มีการคุยกับหมอที่จัดฟันให้ เพื่อแจ้งเหตุผลที่เราขาดการรักษา แล้วหมอบอกว่าเรา ขาดการมา คือเดือน มิ.ย. ส.ค. ซึ่ง 2 เดือนนี้ ที่เราขาดเพราะแอดมิน อาจจะเป็นการสื่อสารที่ไม่ตรงกัน แต่ตอนคุยต่อหน้าหมอ แอดมินเงียบไม่มีการพูดใดๆ -เดือนมิ.ย. 67 เรานัด 10:00น. แต่เราโดนเลื่อนนัด ไป 20:00น. พอเราใกล้จะถึงคลินิค แอดมินโทรแจ้งว่าหมอจะกลับบบ้าน (หมอไม่รอตามเวลานัด) แล้วแอดมินเลื่อนนัดเราไปเดือนใหม่ *ตอนนั้นเรากะเวลาให้ถึงคลินิคตอน 19:30น. เพราะเราไปธุระข้างนอก แอดมินโทรมาให้รีบเข้าไปคลินิค ตอน 19:00น. ซึ่งมันไม่ทันค่ะ แต่ถ้า 19:30น. เราไปทัน แต่หมอจะกลับบ้าน เลยไม่รอตามเวลานัด -เดือน ส.ค. แอดมินแจ้งตารางหมอผิดคน (หมอที่ทำให้เราคือหมอตอย แต่แอดมินแจ้งตารางหมอแคนน่อน) แล้วแอดมินเลื่อนเราให้มาเดือน ก.ย. มีการสื่อสารไม่ถูกต้อง ตอบสั้นห้วน และต่อว่าเราในแชท ว่าไม่แยกแยะ และเราจดไว้หมดว่าจ่ายอะไรไปกี่ครั้ง แต่แอดมินก็แจ้งผิด ว่าเราเหลือจ่ายอีก 15,000บาท ทั้งๆที่เรา เหลือจ่ายแค่ 13,200 บาท ไม่เช็คข้อมูลก่อน จนเราต้องไปขอเช็คเองที่คลินิค ปล.หมอตอยจัดฟันให้ดีค่ะ และคลีนิคก็ดีมากๆ ซึ่งตอนนี้เราขอย้ายเคสแล้วค่ะ ทั้งนี้เขียนรีวิวจากประสบการณ์จริงค่ะ ขอบคุณค่ะ
0x30e2997f056535bb_0xca373a778eed275f.author: BXI
0x30e2997f056535bb_0xca373a778eed275f.en: My honest review based on my experience: Throughout my orthodontic treatment since July 20, 2024: According to the promotion, I had to come every month to receive a free clear retainer. However, I didn't receive this benefit because I missed appointments in January and July (due to surgery). I couldn't open my mouth wide because of the pain from the surgery. I informed the clinic in advance about this. The clinic didn't mention that I wouldn't receive the benefit if I didn't come every month. I wasn't upset about this point, but... What really upset me was that I spoke with my orthodontist to explain my missed appointments. The doctor said I missed appointments in June and August. These two months were due to the administrator, possibly a miscommunication. But when I spoke to the doctor in person, the administrator remained silent and didn't say anything. - In June 2024, my appointment was at 10:00 AM, but it was rescheduled to 8:00 PM. Just as I was about to arrive at the clinic, the administrator called to inform me that the doctor was going home. (The doctor didn't wait for the appointment) and the admin rescheduled our appointment for the next month. *At that time, we planned to arrive at the clinic at 7:30 PM. Because we had errands to run outside. The admin called and told us to hurry to the clinic at 7:00 PM. Which was too late. But if we arrived at 7:30 PM, we would have made it. 0x30da3bfd3b64eddb_0x4b130d50158fa1df.text: We initially came here just to check the prices, as we had already compared several clinics in Chiang Mai, including those located in shopping malls. From the very first moment, the experience was completely different. Two ladies immediately came out to welcome me and my wife, greeted us warmly, and took the time to talk with us instead of trying to sell anything. The atmosphere was calm, friendly, and very comfortable — no crowds, no noise, no pressure, and no people pushing flyers into your hands like in shopping malls. The clinic itself is very modern, clean, and clearly well maintained, with a professional and sterile environment, but still warm and pleasant inside. Although the prices listed online were promotional, the staff kindly honored the holiday promotional prices for us without any hesitation. Thanks to this, we were able to get a treatment package for nearly half the price compared to similar clinics in shopping malls, where prices were literally twice as high. Everything was clearly explained and calculated in advance, so there were no surprises at all. We were taken in immediately, without waiting, and the laser hair removal treatment was completely painless. Every step of the procedure was explained carefully, and the staff made sure we felt comfortable throughout the entire process. Communication in English was very good — everything was easy to understand and there were no issues at all. During our visit, we also learned that the clinic offers Botox treatments not only for the jaw and forehead, but also for other areas of the body. They also provide facial fillers to reduce wrinkles and restore volume where needed, as well as CO₂ skin boosters and vitamin IV drips. We are definitely interested in trying more treatments here in the future. Since these procedures usually require follow-up sessions, we are certain we will be coming back. In terms of price, quality of service, professionalism, friendly staff, and central location, this is by far the best clinic we have found in Chiang Mai. We highly recommend this place to anyone traveling or living here.

But when I went to the finance department, they told me to go and get the injection first, then take it to the emergency room and then come back and pay. I waited for over 20 minutes. I'm so confused about the system. If it could be improved to be more efficient, it would be great. Update: I got my last injection. I just learned that if I paid, I could just present my receipt to get the medication. When I paid, the staff didn't clearly state which counter to go to get the medication, so I didn't have to wait to be called. I waited almost half an hour until I got up to ask. They finally told me I didn't have to wait, I could just come and get it. I'm sorry. Shouldn't things be more systematic? 0x311d7d0a810183ef_0xadc037882eac0a7e.en: A heartfelt review of my first-ever veneer treatment 🦷✨ I'm going to share my experience in a very real way because I'm genuinely impressed 🥹 Today, I went to get veneers done with Dr. Pao. Everything happened so fast! I contacted her in the morning and was there in the evening. It was super real! 😅 While Dr. Pao was taking a break to go to the restroom, I walked out of the room and the first thing I saw was… A picture of myself wearing a crown was pasted on the wall with the words “It’s VIP Day! JOIN OUR EXCLUSIVE VIP CLUB & SAVE K’ PASPHANORN PROM.” 🥹👑 I mean… this picture wasn't there before I came in! It's such a small thoughtful detail that really touched me. She's so considerate of her patients! Now, let me talk about my teeth. My previous problems were: 1️⃣ I had braces before but didn't wear my retainer, resulting in gaps between my teeth and short teeth. 2️⃣ I wanted whiter teeth so they would look good on camera during beauty pageants. 3️⃣ My teeth were tilted to the left, which Dr. Pao said… “My teeth were about to fall out!” I'm so lucky that Dr. Pao saved my life! 😭 Most importantly… it didn't hurt at all! Believe it or not, it really didn't hurt. Dr. Pao has such a gentle touch, the gentlest ever! I'm so touched. I could feel that Dr. Pao was so kind and dedicated to taking care of me. 🤍 Dr. Pao is incredibly skilled, and the result is the most impressive thing I've ever experienced with veneers for the first time in my life. Everyone at the clinic was so lovely. I have to say, the whole clinic was excited, and I was excited too! 😆 And they even asked to take pictures with me, so sweet! And I was so happy to! It was such a warm atmosphere from the moment I walked in. Thank you so much, Dr. Pao and everyone at the clinic. For making me more beautiful and confident. This review is from the heart, no script at all. It might be a bit long, but I really wanted to share it. 💕 For anyone who is hesitant about teeth or veneers, I want to say… if you come here, you will understand the meaning of… "They treat you like family," truly! 🦷✨💖 P.S. I'll make a video for you soon. 🫶 TWOP Dental Clinic - Orthodontics, Clear Aligners, Veneers, Dental Implants #DrPao'sDaughter #twopdentalclinic #veneers

0x305031311322fc3d_0x969f45f715726e87.text: We couldn’t recommend SAFE Fertility Clinic (Phuket) enough. My husband and I travelled from the UK to pursue IVF here, and the experience exceeded our expectations in every way. Originally, we planned to do IVF at home in the UK, but we decided that going through the process in Phuket — a place we’ve always loved — might make the journey feel more positive and less stressful. After finding Dr. Manop Pinyopummintr and communicating with him over WhatsApp and Zoom before traveling, we immediately felt comfortable and confident moving forward. From the very beginning, Dr. Manop and his entire team were outstanding. Communication was always clear and prompt, and they were incredibly patient and supportive with every question or concern we had. IVF can feel overwhelming, but the staff at SAFE made the whole process feel smooth, professional, and genuinely caring. The clinic itself is modern, well organized, and the level of care we received was exceptional. What stood out most was how warm and attentive everyone was. After only two months of treatment, I’m now heading back home pregnant, and we are beyond grateful. Choosing SAFE and Dr. Manop was one of the best decisions we could have made. Thank you to the entire team for giving us such an incredible experience and helping make our dream come true!

And most importantly, thank you very much to Dr. Manop for making my family complete. Dr. Manop is skilled, kind, friendly, and provides excellent advice. I highly recommend him. 0x3102960b88a71a1f_0x58e069f6b8ed430f.text: On January 21, 2025, I visited this clinic under my insurance policy. I must say right away that my visit was pleasant and the service was professional! First, they took a full jaw x-ray. On a large screen, they showed not only the source of the pain but also potential future problems elsewhere. They offered me two options: I chose tooth extraction, removal of the pus, and wound healing, with a subsequent decision on implantation. The second option was root canal treatment with a success rate of up to 60%, but that wasn't my option. The entire procedure was conducted with the help of a translator, with the doctor, a relatively young specialist, displaying information on a large screen and on the screen in front of me. The doctor answered many of my questions, prescribed treatment after the extraction, and provided me with all the necessary medications. They also sent me a link on WhatsApp with instructions on measures to take after the tooth extraction. From there, it's up to me to strictly take the prescribed medications. Thank you very much to the staff at Your Dentist Pattaya Dental Clinic for your timely and high-quality assistance!
0x3102960b88a71a1f_0x58e069f6b8ed430f.author: Ольга Решетникова

0x3102960b88a71a1f_0x58e069f6b8ed430f.text: As someone who's afraid of dentists even in my own country, I'll write this. The place is excellent! The staff is young but professional, and even under stress, they'll wait until you're ready to work. If you don't speak the language, as mentioned earlier, they have a translator available so you can communicate with them. They do their work very carefully and meticulously. They offer several treatment options. Some people say they had something done to them and then it fell off because they didn't follow the recommendations for further treatment. Or they simply refused the specific treatment they were given. Treatment options include those covered by insurance (with further recommendations) and those covered by insurance. The prices are much better compared to Russia. In the end, they even prescribed pills (painkillers and antibiotics) that they didn't have to buy; they were simply given to them after the treatment! Thank you!

0x311d6777a1017b51_0x45ab5340488a147c.text: The clinic is on the third floor, and the actual PCR testing area is located after exiting Exit 7 on the first floor and walking to the left (towards Exit 8). Near Exit 3 on the first floor is the antigen test. It's inexpensive at 550 baht, but it's only a qualitative antigen test, so it can't be used when entering Japan. First, tell the staff where you're traveling to (step ①), then hand over your passport and 1,200 baht. Next, fill out a medical questionnaire and hand it to the staff. The staff will create a form based on the questionnaire. If the documents you're given are correct, hand them over (step ③), open the door, enter, and have a swab inserted into both your nostrils. You can go home when you're done. You'll receive your test results later via email. If the email address on the questionnaire is incorrect, you won't receive the email, so be sure to write it correctly. Apparently, test results won't be sent that same day unless you register by 11:00. Please note that if you plan to take a late-night flight on the same day, if you register by 11:00, the test results will be sent to you around 16:00.
0x311d6777a1017b51_0x45ab5340488a147c.author: ダーロン

0x311d6777a1017b51_0x45ab5340488a147c.text: It's located between Gates 7 and 8 on the first floor. Gate 3 is for antigen tests, so it cannot be used when returning to your home country. At the reception, inform them that you're returning to Japan and submit your passport. Fill out the reception form with your physical condition, email address, etc., and hand over 1,200 baht. The information is confirmed on the paper with your email address and other details written on it. You enter a small room and a sample is taken from your nose. Both nostrils are taken. I took the test at around 9:00 AM, and the results arrived by email around 4:00 PM.

0x30e29f5477630fbb_0xb0dee926e4c5169c.en: I found out about this place through a recommendation. My second impression was how friendly and lovely the dentist and other assistants were during my visit. The dentist was very gentle and gave excellent advice. As someone who used to be terrified of dentists, I regret not meeting this doctor sooner. I've only ever encountered strict and heavy-handed dentists before. If you're looking for a good dental clinic, give this place a try; you won't be disappointed.

I didn't feel any pain at all during the procedure. 🤝 Service: The receptionists and doctor's assistants are all lovely. The service is excellent; they are always smiling, friendly, and constantly checking in, making me feel very comfortable. ✨ Clinic: The clinic is clean, the equipment looks modern, and the space is spacious and comfortable. You can feel the attention to detail. 👍 Overall: This has been one of the best dental experiences I've ever had. If you're afraid of dental work, I highly recommend trying this place. It's totally worth it!

0x30e2a133492c31f9_0xa41d2e4ce7fee008.text: ขอแชร์ประสบการจากการมารักษาฟันที่นี่นะคะคือดิฉันอยู่ประเทศออสเตรเลียค่ะมารับบริการรักษาฟันกับคุณหมอธนกรมาเป็นเวลาหลายปีมากแล้วตั้งแต่ขูดหินปูน รักษารากฟัน จัดฟันใสและตอนนี้ทำรากฟันเทียมคะรู้สึกประทับใจทุกครั้งที่มารักษาที่นี่ คุณหมอดูแลดีมากคะอธิบายขั้นตอนในการรักษาละเอียดบอกแม้กระทั่งการแปรงฟัน คุณหมอใจดี มือเบา เป็นกันเองทำให้เวลามารักษาที่นี่ไม่เกรงและกลัวที่สำคัญคุณหมอมีประสบการณ์ เครื่องมือก็ทันสมัย ถ้าใครที่กำลังหาคลินิกดีมีคุณภาพหมอเก่งเครื่องมือทันสม้ยราคาเป็นกันเองขอแนะนำที่นี่เลยคะ

0x30e29f1499dc98f5_0xc4def6d20d0e51f5.text: I'm responding here because I can't reply to the admin. First, I'd like to commend the admin for their polite response, but let me explain what you've already provided. 1. I've already informed the stylist that my hair isn't even, and he said he hadn't cut it yet to style it. I let him style it, but it still wasn't even, just the other side. While I was sitting at the salon, I didn't want to compare the two sides of my hair in front of the stylist because it would be rude and hurtful. And if I didn't compare the two sides, I wouldn't be sure if my hair was really even. I'd feel bad about it, and I'd feel bad for him. 2. Regarding the hair color, the admin informed me that I had bleached the ends, so there were some seams. I'd like to clarify that this isn't related. I bleached about a cubit off the ends, but the stylist cut it off completely. Before the haircut, my hair was longer than mid-back. The stylist cut it off to just above my chest, so there was definitely no bleached hair left. The stylist even said during the cut that the bleached hair had been completely removed. Actually, the bleaching isn't related at all, as it's on the lower back. The real problem is that my roots are light, but the ends are still dark, and the color barely adheres. And most importantly, I wanted a dull brown, which I had already prepared myself for. I thought it wouldn't be as dull as I wanted, but this one was a reddish brown, a completely different tone. When choosing the color, I consulted with the stylist for a long time. I asked if it would have a green or red tint, and the stylist said no, it was the same color as Pimtha's. I'm not sure if this meant Pimtha's hair color. I understand that Asians have a lot of orange pigment in their hair, but the stylist should have informed me beforehand that it would turn reddish-brown. More importantly, it's only reddish at the roots. I wouldn't have dyed it. My original goal was to get a perm, not to color it. However, when I got there, the stylist told me my hair was thin and wouldn't work with the thick curls I had intended. I understood and decided to dye it instead. But if the stylist had told me from the beginning that it could only be reddish-brown, I would have just gotten the cut. 3. Regarding the claim, I'd like to say that it's fine because I've already had it fixed at other salons and I didn't intend to claim it or anything. However, this review is based on my honest experience. ———————————————— The stylist cut my hair on two sides unevenly. I was prepared for this from the moment I sat in the salon because I didn't see the stylist compare the two sides. I had to comment after the blow-dry. The hairdresser said it hadn't been styled yet, so he came and cut the side that I said was longer. Cutting and cutting, the side that was cut was obviously shorter than the other side. I said I wanted it long layered, and I had a reference to show the hairdresser. He looked for a bit and then said okay. When I cut it, the length of each layer was almost the same. I dyed it, but the roots were still black, much lighter at the roots. I was very unimpressed. I was most irritated by the coloring because the haircut was only 300 but the coloring was 2490, so I paid almost 3000. In the end, I had to fix both the hairstyle and the color.
0x30e29f1499dc98f5_0xc4def6d20d0e51f5.author: Jidapa Viravaidya

0x3102c9328bb7b6f5_0xdac320780318b517.text: Pro: Modernly equipped clinic, beautiful design. There is a mini children's playground. Toilet for children. Friendly staff. Cons: *Chaotic atmosphere. My baby is 1 year and 3 months old. He had a temperature of about 38 degrees. He was very sensitive and emotional this day. During the tests, each nurse came up every 3 minutes, looked into the pants, and looked to see if the child had peed. It was as if they were rushing him. Which was very annoying for a child who was very sick. The doctor was also sarcastically surprised : How come you haven’t peed yet? We were in no hurry, but the team was in a hurry, since the laboratory for checking the debt analyzes was soon to close. It seems to me that the one-year-old child did not really want to pee in such a chaotic atmosphere, since he could not relax due to the fact that the nurses were bothering him every 3 minutes. *Non-Professionalism of doctors. That day, my child only had a fever; other symptoms had not yet appeared. The doctor suggested that our baby take the urine and blood test from a vein in order to make a diagnosis. I agreed, but later I regretted it. I have already described the issue of urine test above. But taking a blood test is definitely a psychologically traumatic action. Everything happened so quickly that I didn’t even have time to mentally prepare my child for the blood test from a vein. I don't think this should have been done at all. Watching your one-year-old baby cry, be afraid and horrified by the whole process. After receiving a laboratory blood report, the doctor revealed only a viral infection. However, she did not say what kind of viral infection it was. We were not given any medications except ibuprofen in case of high fever. Although we did not need this medicine, as we used paracetamol. As a result, we paid more than 1,600 TB, for the blood test, for the appointment and care ? of a doctor and nurses, for an unclear diagnosis and unnecessary medicine. After such service, where the direction is to get more money from clients and not give anything in return, I don’t want to go back and recommend such a clinic. On a professional note, our baby showed more symptoms the next day. We went to another simple clinic with a professional doctor and within 15 minutes received a clear diagnosis with medications. No blood and urine test have been required, just professionalism of this doctor. We only paid 300 TB for everything. Three days later our child recovered. And of course, I will come back here in case if my baby is sick. Bcz of the professionalism and care of the doctor.
0x3102c9328bb7b6f5_0xdac320780318b517.author: Hummingbird

It was easy to get through, and the staff gave us another contact number for direct COVID-related matters. The other line was a bit harder to get through, but we still managed to. The staff were very polite, provided excellent service, and were more knowledgeable than even the staff at private hospitals. They asked about our medical history and symptoms. They even let us add their LINE account for contact. We contacted them around 10:00 AM. Around 3 or almost 4:00 PM, we received a call saying... We could come pick up our medication. 🙏🥰👍 We were very impressed. The medication included Favipharmacist and was tailored to our symptoms. 0x30e29ee3ea330dad_0x100935c7dee63cab.text: I previously had under-eye filler injections. The doctor recommended 1 cc on each side. After the injection, my left eye was much more swollen than my right (the right side was normal). I asked the doctor about it afterward because I felt my cheekbones were uneven, but the doctor said swelling was normal and would subside the next day. However, I could barely open my eyes and they felt very tight. The next evening and morning, my left eye was even more swollen, making it almost impossible to fully open my eye. Comparing the two sides, the asymmetry was clearly visible. I immediately made an appointment to see Dr. Pipe (the doctor who performed the injection). During the appointment, the doctor said he would inject filler under my eyes to soften it (only on the swollen left side). He said it wasn't a dissolving injection (I double-checked and he confirmed it was saline solution*). After the injection, my left eye was sunken and the skin looked saggy. My face was noticeably uneven, making it impossible to use my face for a month. I wasted time, suffered mentally, and wasted money. At the time, the doctor only mentioned that it was a possible case, which I understood. However, there was no follow-up or even an apology from the clinic.
0x30e29ee3ea330dad_0x100935c7dee63cab.author: Wannid Riyachan

0x30e29f0c0765907b_0xe104a6604f191b90.text: ♾️/10 We've been receiving acne treatment and procedures here for almost 4 years now, and I can honestly say I'm incredibly impressed. Since I started treating acne, I've never found a clinic that made me feel this good and comfortable. The results are truly impressive. Throughout the treatment, my skin has visibly improved, with significantly less acne and overall better skin condition. From someone who used to struggle with acne and worried about my skin, I now feel much more confident because I can see the clear changes in my skin. Throughout my treatment here, I wasn't just treated for acne, but also for other skin conditions. Whenever I have a skin problem, Dermaglow is always the first clinic I think of because I have complete confidence in their care and the doctor's advice. Dr. Kate is incredibly beautiful 🫠💖, kind, and lovely. She provides detailed consultations every time, listens to my problems, explains things in an easy-to-understand way, and is a dermatologist, which makes me feel confident and comfortable every time I come for treatment. The skincare and medication she prescribes are also excellent. I use them as she recommends, including the acne spot treatment cream. The acne medication and scar-reducing creams have all given excellent results to my skin, especially the acne spot treatment – ​​it's the best! Just one application and the pimples are gone overnight; no need to worry about whether they'll be gone by morning, it's guaranteed. Some even dry up completely. It deserves some kind of award! This is another thing I'm very impressed with because I've seen the results myself. Another thing I'm very impressed with is how kind and lovely all the staff are 🫶🏻💖. And the standard of acne extraction is truly excellent. I don't have to worry or request the same staff member because no matter who I'm treated by, I feel confident that they all provide the same high standard of care. They are very gentle and thorough. Throughout my time here, I've never had a recurring breakout of inflamed acne after extraction. I also want to mention the clinic's atmosphere. It's incredibly clean, you can feel the cleanliness from the moment you walk in, and it smells amazing! It's a very relaxing and comfortable scent. The overall atmosphere is clean, pleasing to the eye, and makes you feel good from the moment you step into the clinic. For me, these little things show the care put into every aspect of the service. It makes you feel that they truly care about the customer experience from the moment you enter the clinic. Another thing I really liked is… Here, they never try to sell you courses or recommend additional procedures during treatment. There's no pressure to do anything extra, and throughout my visits, I was never hard-sold. All the staff have a wonderful service attitude, both in their care and their words to customers. For those with acne problems or who are self-conscious about their skin, you'll understand how much the words of those caring for you affect your feelings. Here, they never said anything that made me feel bad about my skin. On the contrary, they were encouraging and made me feel comfortable. 🥹🫶🏻💗 For me, Dermaglow isn't just an acne clinic; it's a clinic where I feel genuinely cared for for almost four years. Whether it's acne, skin problems, or various skin conditions, I trust them and always think of them first. If you're looking for a clinic that cares for your skin problems attentively, provides detailed consultations, has kind doctors, excellent service staff, doesn't hard-sell, and prioritizes customer feelings—and most importantly, one that shows noticeable changes in your skin—I highly recommend Dermaglow based on my own experience.

0x30e298e0d27bc31d_0x989ecce134f3d009.text: I have just been discharged after spending three days here, and I wanted to leave what I believe is a very honest and detailed review. Unfortunately, despite the hospital having large and impressive facilities, I feel there are simply not enough resources to provide the kind of environment that people in mental health crisis really need. I come from Europe, so the conditions were quite different from what I am used to. They are not necessarily unsafe or unhygienic, but they can be very stressful if you are not accustomed to them, and I don’t think that environment helps someone who is already going through a mental health crisis. Patients are not separated into smaller rooms, so you can find yourself in a large ward with around 50 other people. On my first day, as part of the hospital’s protocol, I was restrained to the bed. From what I understood, this is partly because there are not enough dedicated rooms for patients who arrive very agitated or distressed so everyone restrained on your first day, That can obviously be a very difficult experience. The food is not very good, although I would not say it is unsafe. The beds are basic, and sometimes there are not enough beds for everyone, although mattresses are available so at least you can sleep reasonably comfortably. The bathrooms would be considered very poor by European standards. They are cleaned every day, but with the number of people using them, this is not always enough. That being said, the staff genuinely surprised me in a positive way. They work extremely hard and do their best with the limited resources available to them. There are people who clearly care deeply about helping patients. In particular, there was one member of staff nicknamed “Mr. Beast/Bean” and another staff member with red/orange hair whose name I unfortunately don’t remember. There were also many doctors, nurses and other staff members who were genuinely kind and tried their best to help. Of course, not everyone becomes emotionally involved in their work, and I don’t think it is fair to expect every employee to feel the same way about such a difficult and mentally demanding job. But overall, I saw many people working very hard despite the limitations of the system. Personally, what saddened me most was seeing how much more could potentially be done if there were more mental health professionals, resources and facilities specifically designed for psychiatric care. I was staying in one of the most basic options. I understand that there may be higher-level or private options available, but I imagine that many people simply cannot afford them. My overall impression is that if you come from a Western or European healthcare background, the environment may feel extremely stressful and could potentially make an already difficult situation feel worse. For an average Thai patient, some of these conditions may feel less unfamiliar, but even then, I believe the hospital’s main strength is its ability to stabilize someone during a serious crisis rather than provide a calm, therapeutic environment. I sincerely hope that in the future there will be more resources and better facilities available for mental healthcare. The people working here deserve them just as much as the patients do. A big thank you to the staff and to the people I shared my stay with. As a foreigner, I was treated kindly and, in some situations, I felt I received particularly good treatment. I genuinely hope things go well for everyone I met during my stay.

0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.text: The counselling staff are among the best I've ever been in contact with. I've seen many psychologists and counsellors and the Cabins are by far the best. I found a lot of use from the art therapy with Yuliya. She has a way of getting information and emotions out with just a few scribbles on a page. I learnt about "box breathing" during meditation sessions with Nim. It came in handy for many situations, from solo meditation to controlling my anxiety in so many circumstances. Nim is a wealth of knowledge when it comes to engaging with life's trials and tribulations. The support staff are great. And a barrel of laughs too. The nurses are very caring. Don't forget to meet Prem and Mickey in the restaurant area. They're great for a chat and always have a smile on their face. I definitely recommend learning some basic Thai so you can chat with the lovely cleaning staff, gardener's and security. Be prepared to get fit with Aon and Nay in the gym too. Yoga in the morning with Nock and Siri is a great way to stretch after a good night's sleep. The Cabins new addition Prijanka who does meditation and mindfulness sessions, is out of this world. Prijanka helped me to see myself in a different light. I suffer from severe self esteem issues which go way back to childhood trauma. And these sessions have helped me immensely.
0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.author: Tim C

0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.text: I cannot not express how incredible this program is. Substance. One word to describe The Cabin. The staff, the program, the food, the way they individualize care . THE VALUE. I’ve never felt such a return on an investment in my life. They have world class counselors that are able to unlock the individual enigma that each addict presents. I’m brought to tears of gratitude just writing this bc of the love and energy that they chose to put into their clients. From the nurses, cooks, support staff, yoga/reiki, art teachers to counselors. They all are there bc they want to help those that are suffering. 14 of last 18 years I spent on a combination of Heroin/fentanyl or methadone. I felt no rehab could handle a situation as complex as mine. I left after 8.5 weeks with my happiness back, my emotional stability back, my life back... If you want to be pampered and have your every desire for instant gratification met this may not be the place for you. If you want to do the real work that leads to recovery, to be held accountable, while being provided every opportunity to heal then this is the place for you. Thank you all for your commitment and unwavering dedication to my recovery. I’ll never forget you.
0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.author: Bin Met

0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.text: I really don’t have the words to fully explain how much this place helped me. It’s just something you feel when you’re there. The program has real depth, nothing fake, nothing rushed. They actually take time to understand you and your situation. Every person I met here truly cared. The counselors, nurses, kitchen staff, support team, everyone. You can tell they are not just doing a job. They want to help people who are hurting. I came in thinking my case was too complicated and that no rehab could really help me. I was wrong. After a little over two months, I left feeling more stable, clearer in my mind, and honestly happier than I’ve been in years. I got my life back. This place doesn’t give you shortcuts or quick comfort. You are expected to do the work, but you are never alone while doing it. If you want real healing and not just to be “treated,” this is the place. I’m very thankful for everything they did for me. I won’t forget it.
0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.author: Jacques Luong

0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.text: This is THE place to go to when you are struggling with addiction and/or mental health issues. 0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.text: Being a clinician in addiction services, I throughly enjoy working with The Cabin Chiang Mai. 0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.author: Vedanta Attri

0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.text: WARNING! I would NOT recommend the Cabin to anyone! Complete BREACH of Service Standards, Duty of Care and Safety Policies. I attended rehabilitation at The Cabin in September 2025. The Cabin still is withholding $39,650. Dismissing the events trying to cover it up! 6 clients were dropped off to an AA park meeting. One of the clients took off and went missing for the entire meeting. Apparently ‘normal’ for him to do so. He returned in time to catch the lift back to the Cabin. He was completely off his face, unable to speak, passing out and couldn’t keep he’s eyes open. Given water, he rinsed his mouth out and spat the water out. Returning to the cabin the client went straight to the sink to rinse, he’s mouth out again. I asked staff to check on him as I was worried about him overdosing. Later, the client was caught naked swimming in the fishpond. Staff denied the client being under the influence of drugs LYING and saying the test was negative. That evening he was moved to a different room with a high balcony despite reports being made he stated he was now feeling suicidal. At this point I was really worried about him. I didn’t think placing someone there with suicidal ideation was a good idea, he could have jumped off the balcony. This client repeatedly stated that he was forced to be here and could not wait get back on substances. Sunday Morning, he was below my villa. I later returned and found he had entered my room and left a note on my desk and cigarette butts at my door. People were scared and locking their doors with belts. Later that day, walking back to show a support worker the Cigarette butts and the note. He was in my room! There were loud banging noises. He had put cigarette butts in my hat, threw them all over the floor, tore my bathroom apart, put my clothes on the floor, wooden boxes had been thrown around, cosmetics all over the room. Personal education notes ripped up and thrown around. It was confirmed to me and a fellow client that it was true that the client was on drugs. This had been confirmed by a Cabin Support Staff member to us! The rest of the staff lied and tried to cover it all up! When my family selected The Cabin Chiang Mai, they relied on the representations made in the brochure, on the website, and by staff, which promised: • Careful screening of clients for suitability to ensure a safe environment. • 24-hour supervision and medical support. • No access to drugs or alcohol. • Professionally managed and supervised offsite excursions. • Private, secure accommodation and a safe environment conducive to recovery. These standards were not met during my stay. Another client, who openly stated they were unwilling to engage in rehabilitation, gained access to substances while unsupervised offsite. This same client later acted aggressively towards myself, entering my private room, trashing it and destroying my personal belongings. Despite these serious breaches, the client was not discharged, supervised, or monitored as required under The Cabin’s stated policy. I was left without access to counselling support when I requested it and was provided no assurance of safety following the incident. The facility’s failure to implement security measures or maintain communication with my family caused significant emotional distress and placed my mental health and recovery at serious risk. These events represent: • Negligence in ensuring client safety and duty of care. • Breach of contract as the services provided did not align with those advertised and agreed upon. • Misleading conduct under Thailand’s Consumer Protection Act, which prohibits false or misleading representations and entitles consumers to refunds where services are substandard or misrepresented. Due to these failures, my family made the decision to remove me from The Cabin, as I no longer felt safe or supported. The experience caused me significant emotional distress, high stress levels for my immediate family and a financial loss for the family.
0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.author: Jack

0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.text: I am a registered nurse from Australia, and my family and I sent my brother to The Cabin due to it's long-standing reputation as a safe, ethical, and well-run rehabilitation facility. We believed we were sending him somewhere that prioritised client safety and accurately represented its practices. Unfortunately, this was not the case. It became apparent that The Cabin is now operating under new ownership, benefiting from its former reputation while no longer upholding the standards it once advertised. Prior to my brother’s admission, I had a consultation with Elijah, who explicitly stated that clients were never taken off-site unsupervised and that clients could not access other clients’ rooms. During my brother’s stay, he attended an AA meeting where clients were taken off-site without supervision. One client absconded, later returned for transport back to the facility, and then entered and trashed my brother’s room. Cigarette butts were placed inside my brother’s hat, cigarettes were thrown across the floor, his bathroom was torn apart, his clothes were scattered throughout the room, wooden boxes were overturned, and his personal recovery notes were ripped apart. This was an incredibly violating and distressing experience. My brother was extremely distressed and did not sleep that night, fearful of what may have happened due to staff’s inability to safely manage another client. Other clients were also visibly frightened, reportedly locking their doors with belts in an attempt to feel safe. Despite requesting counselling support following this incident, my brother was denied access to support. My brother was the first to inform me of what had occurred, followed by an email from his therapist stating that he had “credible reason to leave.” As his family, on the other side of the world, this was an awful and helpless feeling. The way staff interacted with our family throughout this event was emotionless, insensitive, and lacking compassion, which only compounded the distress. Given the seriousness of the incident and the misleading information provided to us regarding supervision and safety, we made the decision to remove my brother from the facility. I was blown away by the unprofessional manner in which The Cabin handled this situation. When I escalated the matter to the CEO after requesting my brother be discharged, he attempted to instil fear by stating, “You know he can access weed anywhere here.” This was an entirely inappropriate and unprofessional response. My brother was at the facility for 16 days of a 6-week program, which we had paid for in full. Despite the discharge being a direct result of The Cabin’s negligence and failure to provide the safety they advertised, no refund was offered for the remaining weeks or even for the compromised portion of his stay. I cannot emphasise enough that I would not recommend this rehab. It has changed significantly since changing ownership, and families should be extremely cautious. Please do not trust this facility with your vulnerable family members.

0x30503196f657859b_0x3a96812f8c5f9af3.text: Two months ago, I had two fillings done here. When I got home, the fillings felt very uncomfortable. At the end of the appointment, the dentist didn’t ask me if the fillings felt too high or check my bite, as is usually done. Had to make another appointment to fix this, and I also felt pressure between my teeth. But my complaints about this uncomfortable pressure were laughed at and the doctor did nothing, saying that everything was fine. Now it’s been two months, and I still can’t chew properly with those teeth - every time I try, the gums around the fillings get inflamed. I’m not a dentist, but this really doesn’t seem “fine”. I also feel that one of the fillings was done completely unnecessarily. Only after the appointment did I realize that three different dentists from other clinics had seen my x-rays and never mentioned anything about that second tooth. The cavity that needed treatment was on one tooth. So be prepared, they might try to sell you fillings you don’t even need.

0x311d66a3395b2149_0x145349b7b3e0da70.text: This is my third time using their services because I need continuous wound cleaning from a cat bite. Previously, I went to a well-known private hospital in Ramkhamhaeng, and on the first day, I was charged over 10,000 baht because I needed serum injections, a tetanus booster, and the first rabies shot. My insurance completely covered it. So I tried continuing treatment at Romklao Public Health Center to see how it would go. My intention was that if it wasn't good, I'd go back to using my insurance for outpatient care at a private hospital. In short, it's excellent! The nurses are very skilled^^ They clean the wound well and even drain the pus. The first one or two times I went to the private hospital, they cleaned the wound like I would at home, and it was still painful at night. I wanted to share that you can try using public health services near your home. Romklao Public Health Center 45 has excellent service, the staff are caring, polite, and very kind.

0x311d66a3395b2149_0x145349b7b3e0da70.text: Today, May 13, 2024, I woke up with a headache, slight fever, and a slight cough. I was scared, so I grabbed an ATK test kit and tested myself. The result: two lines! I am 69 years old and have a pre-existing condition of cerebral artery stenosis. Because I wanted to get COVID-19 medication, I went to this center at 6:30 AM. When I arrived, I said I was there to get tested for COVID-19. The volunteers told me to sit in the garden. I sat and waited until after 8:30 AM, but I was still not called, even though I was the only one waiting for COVID-19 testing. I had a headache, dizziness, and blurred vision, so I had to go ask for help. Because of the severe headache, I saw a screening nurse. She asked if I had a test result. I replied that I didn't, that I just wanted to get tested for COVID-19. She said that if I didn't have proof of a test, she wouldn't treat me. So I showed her the picture of my test I took that morning. The nurse said that it was definitely COVID-19 and I didn't need to see a doctor; I could just get medication. I was happy, thinking I would be able to go home soon. It was around 8:45 AM, but the nurse said, "You can go home or wait. You'll get the medication around 11 AM." They said I had to go through the system first. We were confused about what system we were in, we didn't even see a doctor or get examined. And why did we have to get medication at 11 am? Actually, I was the only one with COVID, they should have given me the medication and sent me home quickly so I wouldn't spread the infection to other people, especially the elderly in the area. In short, I'm very confused. If they had asked me from the beginning if I had a test kit with results, and if I didn't, they wouldn't have tested me, and I could have gone somewhere else. But instead, I waited until late, almost time to see the doctor, before they finally asked. How do they even work? Giving them one star is already too much. In summary, I received treatment at Bamrasnaradura Infectious Diseases Institute, Nonthaburi.

0x30e2bc4ea4ea50cd_0xc4a5fcd6549d1e06.text: I recently had the opportunity to use this facility for the first time after recovering from COVID-19. Following their instructions, the change was processed in less than half an hour, which was fantastic! I'd also like to commend the 1330 hotline; they were incredibly helpful. On the day of my treatment, I called ahead to confirm my eligibility. The staff were very helpful and provided excellent guidance. They even took photos for my ATK test. Upon arrival at the health center, I simply informed the staff at the front desk, and they provided excellent service. The patient screening area was clearly separated, and the service from the examination to dispensing medication was superb. I highly recommend anyone with COVID-19 to see a doctor immediately, even if it's not severe, to ensure a faster recovery and prevent the spread of the virus. There is parking available next to the building. In summary, I was very impressed with my first experience using my universal health coverage at Public Health Center 65. Thank you very much to all the staff!
