0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.text: I have suffered from back pain for around about 15 years, at times it has been bad but overall it was generally well managed with pain relief and physio. In September of 2018 this all changed when the back pain suddenly became unbearable and I was unable to walk unaided or even sit in a comfortable position. My sciatic nerve had been compromised due to a severely herniated disc and the pain was something I can’t describe. I had heard about Spine Connection through a friend that had recently travelled to Germany for surgery on her neck. I decided to make contact with them to see if there was something that they could do for me. I am so glad that I did, Jake Lemon was amazing. He asked me to provide him with x-rays and MRIs and came back to me within days advising that they were going to be able to help me. In fact, I was asked to be in Germany within 3 days as they were able to fit me in for an artificial disc replacement in my L5/S1. This was a great relief for me as I had been told by NZ Drs that I would have to have a fusion. Once I organised flights, Jake had taken care of everything else. My support person and I were collected by a taxi at the airport and taken to the hospital for some tests before being taken to our Accommodation. The fact that everything is taken care of was a great relief to both me and my support person. The whole process was seamless. Doctor Illerhaus met with me the day before my surgery to explain the process to me. He spoke excellent English and was able to explain things to me in a way that was both calming and reassuring. All the nurses were very caring and most of them spoke very good English. The hospital was clean and the staff were friendly. The only thing I struggled with a bit was the food but this was largely down to the fact that I was on a liquid diet, something I am not a big fan of. Post-surgery I remained in hospital for a week before being transferred to Medicos Rehab Centre. What an amazing facility! There is literally everything you need under one roof to get well on the road to recovery. This is attached to a hotel where we stayed. Once again all our meals were provided. Dr V and his team are amazing. He had me in fits of laughter during our appointments and immediately put me at ease. Recovery is not easy but having such an amazing treatment team around certainly helps. I formed some really great bonds with my team and could not speak highly enough of them all. Spine Connection have given me back my life. Without them I would still be waiting for treatment in NZ and it is unlikely that I would have the same mobility that I have now. I have even been told I can go back to riding my horse. I would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone who is suffering with pain in their back or neck. Every step is meticulously planned and goes off without a hitch. The team are professional, the hospital and rehab centre are amazing and the results are outstanding.
0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.author: Jacqui Cleaver

0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.text: Words can not describe how grateful I am to have meet Jake from Spine Connection. After years of suffering with neck pain that started to radiate down my arm and causing numbness, weakness and massive headaches everyday I knew I had to get this looked into. I spoke to my Father who recommended I look into Artificial Disc Replacement, however no-one here in Australia seemed to do it, and the Surgeon I had meet with here (not affiliated with SC) told me it was not possible and the only hope I had was to have a fusion done as it was my ONLY option. Sadly enough I was in desperate need to get rid of the pain and with boarder restrictions I thought fusion was my destiny, I'm lucky that due to a hospital glitch they refused my surgery here in Australia. I went back to Jake and sent through everything I needed for the Surgeons to look at my case, as I was not wanting to live through another winter with the pain, headaches and numbness for another winter. Within 5 days I had my answers from Jake and the Surgeons. I rang my parents who live in New Zealand at 10:45pm at night to tell them I had a date, my surgery was scheduled for in a months time. Jake answered all my questions I remember emailing him and within a few hours I had either a phone call or an email back. Once we where in Germany I kept in contact with Jake and he would email/message me to see how I was doing and ensuring I was doing well and if I had any issues I could contact him. The hospital staff were incredible and Susanne the liaison at the hospital was so lovely and made me feel very calm, and any issues or questions I could contact her when I needed. My surgeon Dr Illerhaus, he's an absolute crack up and a wonderful Surgeon, he answered any questions and concerns I had. After the surgery was completed I remember he came up to meet with my parents and I to see how I was feeling after the surgery, he explained to us that healing will take time (even though I was already excited that I could swing my head left to right in full motion which is something I have not done in MANY years) and that the surgery went according to plan C4-C5 C5-C6 Artificial Disc Replacement. Rehabilitation was next level at Medicos, you are treated so well by all the staff there.. My parents are excited that they have their daughter back after 22.5 years "the day you hit the bottom of the pool all the light went out of you, and here you are today 22.5 years on and your back with the light", my father told me this the day after my surgery, 2 months on I feel like a brand new woman, and I'm excited to see the next chapter of my life as healed woman. Jake, thank you again and your team you guys don't really understand how much of my life you have given me back.
0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.author: Catherine Ross

0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.text: I had three discs replaced in Germany in October 2018, two in the lumbar area and one in my neck. Jake did an outstanding job of facilitating the whole process. He responded to every question promptly; sometimes within minutes. When I had questions regarding the surgery, he ensured the German clinic answered them promptly and thoroughly. He also put in touch with former patients who had similar procedures in Germany, which really helped me make the decision to proceed with the surgery. He was in constant contact during my time in Germany, and when there was an issue with the airport transfer, he ensured we were fully compensated. I can’t speak highly enough of the service Spine Connection provides. Jake’s customer service is second to none. It is now five and half years since I had the disc replacements and I have nothing but issues with the lumbar discs since. Within twelve months of the original surgery an osteophyte formed. Jake did try to organise a trip back to Germany, but the borders closed. I recently learnt that the bone has grown over both disc replacements and they are effectively fused. I paid a lot of money to avoid a fusion and ended up with two anyway. Few people are candidates for ADR make sure you are suitable. I was told I was but I wasn't. The disc above the discs that were replaced has now herniated as a result of taking the load from the failed disc replacements. If you have been told you are not a candidate for a ADR by your local doctors, you probably aren't. Ensure you speak to the neurosurgeon and triple check that your joints are healthy enough to be suitable for an ADR.
0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.author: Bob Thomas

0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.text: As an American working overseas, I was inclined to simply return home and have surgery on my cervical spine because I was somewhat reluctant, and a little afraid, to have such a serious operation overseas. That said, however, after researching the Spine Connection and seeing the state of the art facilities and equipment, coupled with the cutting edge technological advances they are making, the decision to have the surgery in their Germany clinic became very easy for me. They provided an artificial disc replacement at C2-3, above my previous fusion and disc compression at C4-6, along with a disc decompression, fusion and artificial bone replacement at C6-7. Unlike my first surgery in the US, I was out and about the day after surgery, walking throughout the hospital and into town for lunch. The post-op guidance has been great and in six to eight weeks I will begin weight training again, albeit lightly as I work back to full strength. The staff were amazing, the facilities top notch, and perhaps the biggest selling point for me personally - the information provided through honest and ultra-responsive communications when attempting to make my final decision and to schedule the procedure. Through and through the Spinal Connection exceeded my expectations and I am so extremely happy I made the decision to select their clinic for my surgery. Dr. Illerhaus was my surgeon and was the absolute best!
0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.author: Keith Marsland

0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.text: After Jake organised a meeting in Sydney with myself and Dr Bierstedt, I walked out of that meeting knowing that he was the surgeon for me. All the milestones Jake said came true, even though to me at the time seemed too unbelievable. Milestones such as- that I will be able to walk on day 2 after the surgery, day 3-4 I will be able to walk up and down stairs and that after 2 weeks i will be able to get on a flight and fly back to Australia. All this seemed so surreal to me at the time, however it was all came to fruition. I also was impressed by how Jake and the team handled the whole Covid situation which certainly made the process a bit more complicated. I am thankful to Jake and all his support along my journey. He has always been very positive and never ever had any problem with me contacting him with my concerns however trivial they may have been.I am now 8 months post surgery and well on my way to living a fully active lifestyle which had been hindered for so long. I would highly recommend Jake to guide you back to your journey to better health.

0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.text: As one of the first New Zealand patients to travel off shore for a double M6 motion preserving surgical procedure, Jake was instrumental in gathering all the data and communicating between Surgeons and myself, also linking me up with past patients to talk to. I have already given a review of my excellent experience at the ONZ in Germany, and would recommend anyone contemplating a ‘fuse’ of the spine, to look seriously at the option of Motion Preserving surgery by surgeons who perform hundreds and not dozens a year.

0x30502f94a3aa4217_0x78e9080e29e7c51c.text: Don’t fall into the positive reviews here, 90% written by employees! I found this place on Google when my sister was visiting me in Phuket for the limited time. She was looking to get face rejuvenation and lip filler procedures. They accepted her on weekend. After a quick consultation they said that the doctor has time at the moment. My sister got Radiesse and Juvederm lip filler. Prices were pretty high ( 30000 Tbh for Radiesse and 16000 for Juvederm) and when I asked the sales lady convinced me that they have the best doctor here with 30 years experience, that’s why their prices are higher than others. And I convinced because we were looking for someone experienced. Usually when you take this kind of injections, doctor gives you the information about the solution/medication, explain you the expected results, complications, risks and having you to read and sign the written consent form. None of this happened in this place. Doctor and the staff knew that my sister will have a flight after 3 days back to her home country. As soon as my sister arrived home she called me crying that all the Radiesse is gathered in one side of her face, she can even feel the liquid is moving under her skin when she walks. For the record Radiesse is not a filler, it supposed to improve the collagen production. I immediately contacted to the clinic and they said it’s a swallow and if she do some massage it will go away. 1 week passed, my sister did massage every day and it didn’t go away. I messaged to the clinic again in the morning. They got back to me after 7 hours that doctor is not in the clinic now and she will get back after 2 days. It’s been about 3 weeks now that my sister got those injections, that liquid which is gathered on one line on her face ( right side) doesn’t go away. She went to see the cosmetologist in US, they are asking about the serial numbers of the Juvederm and the Radiesse, but Blue Icon “clinic” is not able to give me that information, and they never given anything. I went to the clinic, there were only the receptionist, and said she can’t do anything. Now I don’t know what to do and my only option is to make a claim with the tourist police. Note: I can see now the pictures on the reviews, they all are employees there. Please be careful. They won’t give you any guarantee.

0x30e29ed28ae6edc7_0xacba9abf16af5e48.text: Last January, I underwent an Ulthera Prime treatment with 800 shots for 85,000 baht. This was a significant investment, and my first time intentionally taking care of myself, so I had high expectations for the results. Before deciding, I researched and chose a reputable clinic due to concerns about counterfeit machines. I understood that Ulthera is one of the best skin tightening technologies, but because I lacked in-depth knowledge of my own skin condition, I expected the doctor or specialist to provide appropriate advice. However, I later learned that Ulthera may not be suitable for everyone, especially those with significant cheek fat, which is typical of my face shape. This wasn't clearly explained before the treatment. The clinic offered an additional fat-dissolving program, costing nearly the same as Ulthera, suggesting a better combination for optimal results. However, they didn't clearly explain why, given my cheek fat, prioritizing fat dissolution over Ulthera would yield more noticeable results. The combined cost was quite high for me. Therefore, I opted for the more expensive Ulthera treatment alone, believing it would be sufficient for skin tightening. However, after approximately three months, I saw almost no change. The results didn't meet my expectations, leaving me quite disappointed with this experience. Initially, I thought that if the treatment was effective, I would continue using their services every year because I believed I had found a trustworthy clinic. However, this will likely be my first and last time. Ultimately, as consumers, we expect good results and value for money. But on the other hand, we also expect expert advice, which is crucial and a matter of professional ethics for clinicians. I hope the clinic will take my review into consideration for improvement.

0x30e29924b07f0b3f_0xc67ac2c54192a716.text: หลังจากตัดสินใจทำวีเนียร์ฟันที่คลินิกแห่งนี้ สิ่งที่ได้รับไม่ใช่เพียงรอยยิ้มที่สวยงามขึ้น แต่ยังได้รับความประทับใจในทุกขั้นตอนของการดูแลรักษา ตั้งแต่วันแรกที่เข้ามาปรึกษา คุณหมอให้คำแนะนำอย่างละเอียด ตอบทุกข้อสงสัยด้วยความใส่ใจ และช่วยออกแบบรอยยิ้มให้เหมาะกับใบหน้าและบุคลิกของผมอย่างเป็นธรรมชาติ ทำให้รู้สึกมั่นใจและสบายใจตลอดกระบวนการรักษา ขอขอบคุณทีมทันตแพทย์ทุกท่านที่มีความเชี่ยวชาญ ละเอียด และพิถีพิถันในทุกขั้นตอน รวมถึงเจ้าหน้าที่ทุกคนที่คอยดูแล ต้อนรับ และให้บริการด้วยรอยยิ้มและความเป็นกันเองเสมอ บรรยากาศภายในคลินิกสะอาด ทันสมัย และเป็นมืออาชีพ ทำให้ทุกครั้งที่เข้ารับบริการรู้สึกผ่อนคลายและได้รับการดูแลเป็นอย่างดี ผลลัพธ์ที่ได้เกินความคาดหวังมาก ฟันดูสวย เรียงตัวเป็นธรรมชาติ สีฟันเหมาะสมกับใบหน้า และช่วยเพิ่มความมั่นใจในการพูด การยิ้ม และการใช้ชีวิตประจำวันอย่างเห็นได้ชัด ขอขอบคุณคุณหมอและทีมงานทุกท่านจากใจจริงสำหรับความตั้งใจและการดูแลที่ยอดเยี่ยม หากใครกำลังมองหาคลินิกทันตกรรมที่ใส่ใจในรายละเอียด มีมาตรฐานสูง และให้ผลลัพธ์ที่น่าประทับใจ ผมขอแนะนำที่นี่ด้วยความมั่นใจและยินดีบอกต่อครับ ขอให้คลินิกและทีมงานทุกท่านประสบความสำเร็จ มีผู้รับบริการเพิ่มขึ้น และสร้างรอยยิ้มที่สวยงามให้กับผู้คนอีกมากมายต่อไปครับ

0x30e29f004d7ef6a9_0x4a8473048f456b5b.text: At first, I was going to let it go, but after thinking about it, I decided to write about it. On April 18, 2025, I went to get a haircut at a shop in Central Rama 3. After getting a haircut, I was about to go home. While going down the escalator, I was stopped by a salesperson selling a clinic course. He asked me to help him test his skin, as I was the only one who got it that day. I told him that it would help, but I didn’t buy any courses at all. The salesperson just said yes, yes. After examining my skin, he immediately sold me a course!! He tried to persuade me, so I said okay, I’ll help you buy it because the price isn’t that high. As soon as I bought it, he took me upstairs to do it. I emphasized again that I didn’t want to buy anything else. The salesperson just said yes, yes. After the facial, he came back to sell me another course. I told him I didn’t want to buy anything and that I wouldn’t let him go. He even brought the assistant manager and the shop manager to sell me the price without any consideration. From 15,000 to 10,000 to 7,500. I was extremely annoyed, but I was also angry at myself for cutting off the annoyance by buying the 7,500 baht course. I’m not pretty, but I don’t like to get any treatments at clinics. I've encountered this situation many times, and I just have to pay the money and throw it away. I'm not writing this because I'm sorry for the money, but because I've lost my understanding of why salespeople don't keep their word. Regardless of their profession, they should keep their word. They shouldn't force sales. That's unprofessional.
0x30e29f004d7ef6a9_0x4a8473048f456b5b.author: Natpat Sakulraksa

0x30e29fa8536ac9e9_0xc8f9071312f6f9ad.text: บริการดีมากเลยค่ะ ทั้งคุณหมอ คุณผู้ช่วย คุณพนักงานต้อนรับ สถานที่ก็สะดวกดีมากเลยค่ะ เพราะลงรถไฟฟ้า BTS ก็คือถึงเลย แล้วก็ฟันที่จัดคือสบายปากมากๆ เมื่อเทียบกับจัดฟันเหล็กๆ ตอนเด็กๆ ฟันที่เกๆ ก็คือมีวิวัฒนาการที่ไวมาก เมื่อเทียบกับความเจ็บที่ไม่ค่อยเจ็บ แบบว่าช่วงหลังเปลี่ยนแผ่นจัดฟัน มันมีช่วงเจ็บที่สั้นมากๆค่ะ เต็มที่ 2-3 วัน จัดไปนานๆ คือชิน คือสบายมากๆ ยิ่งจัดไปได้เดือนที่ 4-5 เปลี่ยนแผ่นจัดฟันนี่ไม่รู้สึกอะไรแล้วสำหรับเรา ขอบคุณหมอธีรวุฒิ ที่ช่วยเหลือตอบคำถามร้อยแปดอย่างสำหรับคนที่ไม่ค่อยหาข้อมูลเยอะเท่าไหร่อย่างเรา และใส่ใจเคสมาโดยตลอด โดยเฉพาะช่วยส่งข้อมูลจนทำให้เรามั่นใจทางเลือกในการจัดฟันครั้งนี้ค่ะ

0x30e29fa8536ac9e9_0xc8f9071312f6f9ad.en: The service was excellent, from the doctor and the assistants to the reception staff. The location was also very convenient, as it's right by the BTS Skytrain. The braces are so comfortable now compared to the metal braces I used to have as a child. My crooked teeth improved very quickly, and the pain was minimal. The periods of pain after changing the aligners were very short, at most 2-3 days. I got used to it and it became very comfortable. By the 4th-5th month, changing the aligners was practically painless for me. Thank you, Dr. Teerawut, for answering countless questions, especially for someone like me who hasn't done much research, and for your continuous care and attention to my case. You even provided information that helped me feel confident about choosing this orthodontic treatment.

And both the doctor and the staff at the Siam branch gave very good advice, were patient, and listened to my needs in every matter. Now I just passed the first step. I'm still in the beginning stage, but I feel that I can live a normal life when I wear it. It's not too revealing and doesn't hurt as much as I thought. I just have to be disciplined to take it off and put it on on time. Even though I haven't seen much result yet because I just started, I feel that I "made the right choice". 😊 If anyone is thinking about it, try scanning your teeth for free first. It really doesn't hurt at all.

0x30e29373731a03e5_0x70a274e23902d1a7.text: ร้านอยู่ชั้นสองติดกับสุกี้ตี๋น้อย คุณหมอดีมากครับ มือเบา ให้คำแนะนำ และอธิบายรายละเอียดดีมาก ราคาไม่แรงครับ ถ้าวันไหนคนน้อยสามารถ Walk-in ได้เลย แต่เพื่อความชัวร์นัดไว้ดีกว่าครับ เพราะบางวันคุณหมออาจไม่เข้าคลินิก
0x30e29373731a03e5_0x70a274e23902d1a7.en: The clinic is on the second floor, next to Suki Teenoi. The doctor is excellent; gentle, provides great advice, and explains everything in detail. The prices are reasonable. If it's not busy, you can walk in, but it's better to make an appointment to be sure, as the doctor may not be at the clinic on some days.

0x30e29373731a03e5_0x70a274e23902d1a7.text: มาปรึกษาคุณหมอเพื่อจัดฟัน ไปปรึกษามาหลายที่แล้วมีแต่บอกว่าเคสยาก แต่มาที่นี่ คุณหมอรับเคส ให้คำแนะนำดีมากๆเลยค่ะ พนักงานหน้า เคาน์เตอร์ก็บริการดีค่ะ โดยรวมแฮปปี้ค่ะ เดินทางสะดวกคลินิกสะอาด ราคาโอเคอยู่ค่ะ
0x30e29373731a03e5_0x70a274e23902d1a7.en: I came to consult with the doctor about orthodontic treatment. I've consulted with several places before, but they all said my case was difficult. But here, the doctor accepted my case and gave excellent advice. The staff at the counter were also very helpful. Overall, I'm happy. It's easy to get to, the clinic is clean, and the price is reasonable.

0x30e29373731a03e5_0x70a274e23902d1a7.text: สาขาใหม่ย้ายจาก สาย5 ไปสาขา the fourth สาย 4 ที่ตั้งสะดวก อยู่ตรงวงเวียนพอดี พนง.บริการดีมาก หมอก็ให้คำปรึกษาดีมากค่ะ สะอาด และสว่างมากค่ะ ทำฟันเสร็จช็อปปิ้งต่อ สะดวกมาก 🥰🥰
0x30e29373731a03e5_0x70a274e23902d1a7.en: The new branch has moved from Soi 5 to The Fourth branch on Soi 4. The location is convenient, right by the roundabout. The staff provides excellent service, and the dentist gives great advice. It's very clean and bright. You can go shopping right after your dental appointment – ​​very convenient! 🥰🥰

0x30e29373731a03e5_0x70a274e23902d1a7.text: ผ่าฟันคุดใช้ประสังคม ทางคลินิคแนะนำเรื่องการใช้สิทธิ์ประกันสังคม ทำเรื่องง่ายมาก ไม่ต้องวุ่นวายเลยค้า คุณหมอเเละพี่ๆอธิบายละเอียดบริการดีสุดๆ ตอนฉีดยาชาคุณหมอมือเบาๆๆๆ
0x30e29373731a03e5_0x70a274e23902d1a7.en: I had my wisdom tooth extracted using social security benefits. The clinic explained how to use my social security benefits, making the process very easy and hassle-free. The doctor and staff explained everything in detail and provided excellent service. The doctor was very gentle when administering the local anesthetic.

0x30e29373731a03e5_0x70a274e23902d1a7.text: มาฟอกสีฟันครั้งแรก ฟันขาวขึ้นประมาณ 2 ระดับ ตอนนี้ยิ้มแล้วฟันไม่เหลือง รู้สึกดีมากค่ะ คุณหมอใจดี น่ารัก ให้คำแนะนำหลังฟอกสีฟันเสร็จด้วยค่ะ
0x30e29373731a03e5_0x70a274e23902d1a7.en: This was my first teeth whitening session, and my teeth are about two shades whiter. Now my smile isn't yellow anymore, and I feel great! The dentist was kind and lovely, and gave me advice after the whitening was complete.

0x30e29373731a03e5_0x70a274e23902d1a7.text: วันนี้มาฟอกฟัน ขูดหินปูน และอุดฟัน คุณหมอใจดี มือเบามากค่ะ คลินิคสะอาด ที่นี่รับประกันสังคมด้วยไม่ต้องสำรองจ่าย ดีมากเลยค่าาา
0x30e29373731a03e5_0x70a274e23902d1a7.en: Today I came for teeth whitening, scaling, and fillings. The dentist was very kind and gentle. The clinic is clean. They accept social security insurance here, so I didn't have to pay upfront. It's great!

0x30e29373731a03e5_0x70a274e23902d1a7.text: คุณหมอน่ารักมากค่ะพี่ๆผู้ช่วยพูดดีน่ารัก แต่อยากพูดถึงพี่ที่ต้อนรับหรือแอดมินค่ะ ตอบและบริการค่อนข้างไม่ค่อยโอเคค่ะ ตอบห้วย ชักสีหน้า บาฃทีก็ทำเหมือนมาอ้อนวอนให้ทำให้อะค่ะ แต่อย่างอื่นโอเคหมดเลยนะคะ
0x30e29373731a03e5_0x70a274e23902d1a7.en: The doctor is very nice, and the assistants are friendly and kind. However, I'd like to mention the receptionist or administrator. Their responses and service weren't very good. They answered rudely, made faces, and sometimes acted like we were begging them to do things. Everything else was okay though.

0x311d672152540305_0x68677dde4a620a33.text: This clinic has state-of-the-art laser equipment and excellent service. The doctor is lovely, friendly, and attentive to every detail. The place is spacious and easy to navigate, and it's been open for over 15 years. The clinic looks very clean. I recommend trying their services... high quality and reliable! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻 …
0x311d672152540305_0x68677dde4a620a33.author: MaPrang

0x311d672152540305_0x68677dde4a620a33.text: The doctor is lovely, and all the staff provide excellent and friendly service. After every treatment visit to the clinic, they always call to check on my condition and show genuine care. 🥰 …
0x311d672152540305_0x68677dde4a620a33.author: พรวดี แตงอําไพ

0x311d672152540305_0x68677dde4a620a33.text: The doctor is lovely, gentle, and gives excellent advice. The staff at the clinic are nice and friendly. The clinic is clean and conveniently located. I like it!
0x311d672152540305_0x68677dde4a620a33.author: Lalada Panupatharadit

0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.text: ปกติกลัวหมอฟันมาโดยตลอด แต่มาเจอคุณหมอโอ๊ตสิ่งที่กลัวทุกๆอย่างเปลี่ยนไปเลย ที่อื่นๆคุณหมอจะดุ มือหนัก และพอเรามีอาการอะไร หมอจะเฉยชา เหมือนเราเป็นตอไม้ แต่คุณหมอที่นี้มือเบา คอยสังเกตุเรา ปลอบเรา ไอ้เราก็แก่แล้วนะ แต่การใส่ใจแบบนี้มันทำให้เรารู้สึกดีกับการทำฟันมากๆ ใครที่เคยกลัวการทำฟัน ที่นี้จะทำให้คุณเปลี่ยนใจแน่นอนครับ อยากให้คุณหมอทุกคนบนโลกเป็นแบบคุณหมอโอ๊ตมากๆ อ๋อ จริงๆต้องชมว่าบุคลากรทุกๆท่านน่ารักและใส่ใจเราทุกคนนะครับไม่ใช่แค่คุณหมอโอ๊ต ขอบคุณมากๆนะครับที่ทำให้คนกลัวเรื่องทำฟันมาจนจะ 40 อยู่แล้ว รู้สึกว่าการทำฟันมันไม่ได้โหดร้ายอย่างที่เคยๆ และผลลัพธ์ก็ดูดีมากๆครับ
0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.en: I've always been afraid of dentists, but after meeting Dr. Oat, all my fears have disappeared. At other places, the dentists are harsh, heavy-handed, and indifferent when I have any symptoms, like I'm a dead wood. But the dentist here is gentle, attentive, and comforting. I'm older now, but this kind of care makes me feel so much better about dental work. Anyone who's ever been afraid of dentistry will definitely change their mind here. I wish all the dentists in the world were like Dr. Oat. Oh, and I should also commend all the staff; they're all so lovely and caring. Thank you so much for making someone who's almost 40 and afraid of dentistry feel like it's not as terrifying as I thought, and the results are amazing!

0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.text: ที่นี่จัดฟันโดย หมอทันตกรรมจัดฟันเฉพาะทาง จบปริญญาเอกสาขาทันตกรรมจัดฟันจากประเทศญี่ปุ่น และเป็นสมาชิกทั้งสมาคมทันตกรรมจัดฟันแห่งประเทศไทย และระดับนานาชาติ ทำให้การจัดฟันไว้วางใจได้เลย เรื่องราคาถือว่าถูกและเข้าถึงง่ายมาก ส่วนตัวที่ทำมา ติดเครื่องมือครั้งแรก 599 บาท ค่าขูดหินปูน 550 บาท ถ้ามีฟันผุซี่ละ 550 บาท จากนั้นจ่าย เดือนละ 1,000 บาท ระยะเวลา 30–36 เดือน โดยรวมคุ้มค่า เหมาะกับคนที่อยากจัดฟันกับหมอเฉพาะทางจริง ๆ ในราคาสบาย ๆ ไม่มีการยัดเยียดคอร์สหรือค่าใช้จ่ายแฝง แจ้งราคาชัดเจนตั้งแต่แรก ทำให้ตัดสินใจได้ง่ายและสบายใจ
0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.author: TANUKI
0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.en: Here, orthodontic treatment is provided by a specialist orthodontist with a Ph.D. in orthodontics from Japan, and a member of both the Thai and international orthodontic associations, ensuring trustworthiness of the treatment. The price is very affordable and accessible. For my case, the initial cost for braces was 599 baht, scaling was 550 baht, and each cavity was 550 baht. After that, I paid 1,000 baht per month for 30-36 months. Overall, it's great value for money, ideal for those who want orthodontic treatment from a true specialist at a comfortable price. There are no hidden fees or extra charges; the prices are clearly stated upfront, making the decision easy and reassuring.

0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.text: คุณหมอใจดี น่ารักมากกก อยากได้อะไรหรือมีปัญหากับฟันตรงไหนบอกคุณหมอได้ดลยพร้อมให้คำแนะนำ คลินิคก็จัดน่ารักมาก มินิมอล พี่ๆผู้ช่วยก็ใจดีด้วยค่ะ แถมราคาเป็นมิตรมากๆด้วยประทับใจมากๆๆ🥰 ช่วงเทศกาลปีใหม่มีขอฃแจกด้วยค่ะ
0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.author: ชนิกา เนียมฉาย
0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.en: The dentist is so kind and lovely! You can tell her anything you want or any problems you have with your teeth, and she'll gladly give you advice. The clinic is also very cute and minimalist, and the assistants are all very kind. Plus, the prices are very reasonable. I'm so impressed! 🥰 They even gave away gifts during the New Year's season!

0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.text: มาปรึกษาจัดฟันกับคุณหมอ คุณหมอและผู้ช่วยบริการดีมากให้คำปรึกษาแนะนำการรักษาดี คุณหมอมือค่อนข้างเบา ใครกำลังมองหาคลินิกที่ให้บริการดีราคาไม่แรงมาที่นี่ได้เลยค่ะ 🫶🫶
0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.author: H Ning
0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.en: I came for an orthodontic consultation with the dentist. The dentist and assistants provided excellent service and good advice on treatment. The dentist was very gentle. If you're looking for a clinic with good service at reasonable prices, come here! 🫶🫶

0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.text: คุณหมอโอ๊ตใจดี มือเบามากๆๆๆๆๆคะ พูดเพราะตลอดการทำเลย ให้คำแนะนำ และคำปรึกษาดีมากๆคะ ราคาก็ไม่แพง บริการดีมากๆคะ เราอ่านรีวิวมานานมาก ดีตามรีวิวจริงคะ แนะนำนะคะ
0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.author: Boonrudee Koedsin
0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.en: Dr. Oat is very kind and gentle. He speaks politely throughout the procedure, giving excellent advice and consultation. The price is also reasonable, and the service is outstanding. I've read many reviews, and he's as good as they say. I highly recommend him.

0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.text: มาปรึกษาจัดฟันคุณหมอศุภกรให้คำแนะนำดีมากๆเลยค่ะ มีโปรดีๆสำหรับจัดฟันแถมนักศึกษาได้ส่วนลดเพิ่มอีก ถูกใจมากค่ะ (แนะนำทุกคนมาจัดฟันกับหมอเฉพาะทางเลยค่ะ)
0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.en: I had a consultation with Dr. Supakorn about orthodontic treatment and he gave me excellent advice. They have great promotions for orthodontic treatment, and students get an additional discount. I'm very happy with my decision. (I highly recommend everyone get orthodontic treatment from this specialist!)

0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.text: คุณหมอใจดี พี่พยาบาลน่ารักมากๆ มาทำรีที่นี่ไม่ผิดหวังเลยค่ะ ตรงตาม Ref. ทุกอย่าง วัสดุดี สีก็สวย แถมราคาก็ดี ถูกใจมากค่า
0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.author: Wannakron Thanatananon
0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.en: The doctor was kind and the nurses were very lovely. I wasn't disappointed at all with my retainer appointment here. Everything matched the reference image perfectly. The materials are high quality, the colors are beautiful, and the price is great. I'm very satisfied!

0x30e2b900019dd8e3_0x5010a16f3059fe7b.text: タイで初めて歯医者さんに行きました。いろいろと不安でしたが、本当に優しく接してくれて、丁寧に対応してくださいました。 처음으로 태국에서 진료를 받았는데 워크인임에도 불구하고 잘 대해주시고 치료도 만족스럽게 받았습니다.

0x311d5f8f572967a5_0x627a3766ef04b1f5.text: คลินิกอยู่ริมถนน เดินทางสะดวก มีที่จอดรถหน้าร้าน บรรยากาศเป็นกันเอง คุณหมอเก่ง ดูแลดี ให้คำแนะนำดี ราคาไม่แพง ใช้สิทธิประกันสังคมได้ มีจัดฟันใสทั้งของ invisalign และ smartee
0x311d5f8f572967a5_0x627a3766ef04b1f5.author: Supalarp Pasurawanich
0x311d5f8f572967a5_0x627a3766ef04b1f5.en: The clinic is located on the main road, easily accessible, and has parking in front. The atmosphere is friendly, the doctor is skilled, attentive, and provides good advice. The prices are affordable, and social security insurance is accepted. They offer both Invisalign and Smartee clear aligners.

0x311d5f8f572967a5_0x627a3766ef04b1f5.text: Professional dental care by the experience team. Service mind with efficient and experienced dentists. Reasonable price. Highly recommended.
0x311d5f8f572967a5_0x627a3766ef04b1f5.author: Tao Rapeepat Lekkham

0x311d5f8f572967a5_0x627a3766ef04b1f5.text: คุณหมอใจดีมากกกก พี่ที่เคาน์เตอร์น่ารักมาก ๆ พูดเพราะ แถมแนะนำดีด้วยค่ะ ขูดตั้งแต่เด็กจนตอนนี้จะ 40 แล้ว ไว้มาขูดใหม่ค่ะ :)
0x311d5f8f572967a5_0x627a3766ef04b1f5.en: The doctor was so kind! The staff at the counter were lovely, spoke politely, and gave great advice. I've been getting dental work done here since I was a child, and now I'm almost 40. I'll definitely come back for more! :)

0x311d5f8f572967a5_0x627a3766ef04b1f5.text: คุณหมอใจดีค่ะ มือเบามากให้กำลังใจในการขูดหินปูนตลอดเลยค่ะ พี่ๆเป็นกันเอง ดูแลสุขภาพใจดีมาก ขอบคุณค่ะ🙏🏻 ประทับใจมากเลยค่ะ
0x311d5f8f572967a5_0x627a3766ef04b1f5.author: pattra wisetkasikon
0x311d5f8f572967a5_0x627a3766ef04b1f5.en: The dentist was very kind and gentle, and kept encouraging me throughout the teeth cleaning process. The staff were friendly and took great care of my health. Thank you so much! 🙏 I was very impressed.

0x311d5f8f572967a5_0x627a3766ef04b1f5.text: บริการดี ใส่ใจ คุณหมอมือดี วางใจ 20 ปีแล้วที่ใช้บริการ เคยไปทำฟันที่อื่นแล้วก็ไม่ถูกใจเท่า ขอบคุณนะคะ
0x311d5f8f572967a5_0x627a3766ef04b1f5.author: Nong Sirithorn
0x311d5f8f572967a5_0x627a3766ef04b1f5.en: Excellent service, attentive, skilled dentist. I've been a trusted dentist for 20 years. I've been to other dental clinics before but wasn't as satisfied. Thank you!

0x30e29d070d83742d_0x5102ebf03028369a.text: overall is above satisfaction at every aspects. คลินิตสะอาดมาก คุณหมอใจดี บุคลากรของคลินิกพูดเพราะมากด้วยค่ะ แถมใส่ใจทุกรายละเอียดของคนไข้จริง ๆ ค่ะ เราประทับใจมากเลย ที่สำคัญเพลงในคลินิกเพราะมากค่ะนอนฟังเพลินมากเลย จะกลับมาใช้บริการอีกนะคะ
0x30e29d070d83742d_0x5102ebf03028369a.en: Overall, I am more than satisfied in every aspect. The clinic is very clean, the doctor is kind, and the clinic staff are very polite and attentive to every detail of the patient's needs. We were very impressed. Importantly, the music in the clinic is very pleasant; it was very relaxing to listen to while lying down. I will definitely come back again.

0x30e29d070d83742d_0x5102ebf03028369a.text: วันนี้ไปขูดหินปูน คลินิคสะอาด พนักต้อนรับให้คำปรึกษาดี คุณหมอมือเบามาก พูดคุย บอกตลอด ตรงนี้เจ็บนิดนึง ถ้าไม่ไหวยกมือขวานะคะ ประทับใจมากครับ มาใช้บริการอีกแน่นอน
0x30e29d070d83742d_0x5102ebf03028369a.en: I went for a teeth cleaning today. The clinic was clean, the receptionist was helpful and provided good advice, and the dentist was very gentle. Eventually, I realized the source of the pain was the tooth I had treated at this clinic. I wrote to the doctor about the problem, and she invited me to come. I insisted that a repeat repair would be covered by warranty. I arrived at the clinic, the doctor examined me, took an X-ray, and...she said: you need to have the root canals cleaned, removing the nerves in your tooth, there's inflammation there, and it will cost 10,000 baht!!! I refused. They also wanted to charge me 300 baht for the X-ray!!! Now I seriously doubt the professionalism of this clinic! Why, when I first visited, didn't the doctor immediately take an X-ray or tell me that I NEEDED a nerve removal? Instead, she simply filled it under anesthesia (she knew my tooth was hurting) for 1,500 baht, and that led to further pain in my mouth!? So, I wasted 1,500 baht just to have a hole filled (in about 40 minutes) with no guarantee of pain relief! I hope the pain goes away and I don't have to return to my country early for dental treatment! This is an extremely strange approach to treatment. Perhaps this is customary in Thailand.

0x30fdab7c88e20957_0x326d56d238267433.en: I had an appointment to have my braces removed via LINE on Sunday, but the clinic notified me via WhatsApp, which I don't use, resulting in my appointment being canceled. This careless management has wasted a lot of my time. The appointment scheduling system needs improvement. P.S. I saw a reply saying they tried to contact me through every channel. Why didn't they contact me through the first channel used to schedule the appointment? My appointment was at 1:00 PM, but I arrived at the clinic between 1:01 PM and 1:05 PM. The staff said I had rescheduled several times, but I had only scheduled one appointment beforehand. At that time, I mentioned that if I couldn't come as scheduled, a new appointment would be arranged. This was the second rescheduling attempt. The staff claimed I was late, even though I arrived around 1:01 PM - 1:05 PM. Furthermore, the appointment scheduling system needs improvement. I contacted them via LINE, but they responded via WhatsApp instead. Their claim of trying multiple channels is untrue; the initial appointment was via LINE. They said there are multiple staff members and they don't know who scheduled the appointment. This highlights a serious issue with the back-end system for managing patient appointments. I was trying to convey that the appointment was cancelled because I had cancelled appointments with the clinic multiple times. The second time, I arrived on time, but the staff cancelled the appointment via WhatsApp, which wasn't enabled, so I wasn't aware of the cancellation. The point I want to make is about the appointment management system. There's a lack of internal communication among the staff, leading to errors. The original clinic, if there's no answer, would send a confirmation message through the initial contact method to confirm the appointment. This made me feel that the clinic's appointment management system is inefficient. The staff also tried to blame me, saying that I had rescheduled multiple times, which is why the clinic cancelled it. Even though the staff asked if I wanted to wait, they didn't specify how long, saying, "You didn't ask how long," and "We didn't say we wouldn't serve you." This was a very inappropriate response. They also claimed that I was late, which I countered, but only between 13:01 and 13:05. The staff insisted that was untrue, saying it was later than that. I was very displeased with this staff member's behavior. They said it was because I had rescheduled multiple times, even though I had only rescheduled once. Furthermore, before making the first appointment, I informed the staff member who had scheduled it that if I couldn't make it this time, I would reschedule. This happened more than once, totaling several times. However, there was only one time we actually rescheduled. The staff member I spoke with emphasized the rescheduling issue instead of addressing the back-end appointment management system that I was questioning.

0x30e29c0d015f3dad_0x6204451a2c016722.text: Excellent in all aspects. Regarding the MRI procedure, the problem is that during the procedure in the tunnel, patients can be frightened because they are unaware of the scary sounds. This is especially concerning given that patients are already anxious and afraid of serious illnesses. Having to repeatedly listen to the machine instruct them to breathe in and out and hold their breath is particularly distressing. Consider how frightening it would be for patients who don't understand and follow the instructions. Therefore, I offer the following suggestions: 1. Have staff explain to patients what will happen in the tunnel, including the noises and the instructions they need to follow. 2. Provide a document or guide for patients to read two to three minutes before entering the tunnel to reduce their fear and panic, so they can understand and follow instructions correctly. I respectfully submit these suggestions with good intentions.

0x305194866763e8cd_0x83cad44735f49997.text: As a French couple visiting Krabi for a holiday, we needed to see a doctor for a respiratory infection. The wait was very short, and the doctor's explanations were clear thanks to our willingness to use Google Translate. We were directed to the nurses, received our medication at the hospital very quickly, and settled the bill for our treatment (2420 baht / 66 euros for both of us). The staff were helpful, friendly, and attentive to our needs via Google Translate. They didn't hesitate to advise us to return to the hospital if any complications arose within two days. We highly recommend this hospital.

0x305194866763e8cd_0x83cad44735f49997.text: The rating is based on the good medical team, but it doesn't overshadow the negative experience with the nurses. My father was admitted as an inpatient, and the illness itself was already upsetting enough, but the service from some of the nurses was even worse—I'd even describe it as terrible. I understand it's a public hospital, but if I had a choice, I wouldn't want to come here at all. This incident (though it might just be my experience) is particularly problematic. Today, I went to call a nurse because my father complained of severe phlegm and difficulty breathing. I informed the nurse, but they didn't provide immediate assistance. When I returned to the patient's bed, he said he couldn't breathe anymore, so I had to go back again. The response I received was one of dissatisfaction and a tone of voice. If they don't want to work, why are they there? Patients and their families are already uncomfortable at the hospital, and then they have to deal with such hurtful words and actions from government staff. When I followed up repeatedly, they scolded the family for disturbing the patient and preventing him from resting. Seriously, what were they thinking? Who wants to disturb a patient? Everyone wants the patient to rest. But since he reported pain and difficulty breathing, what were we supposed to do? Shouldn't we believe the nurse or the patient himself? And what I want to focus on the most is that you spoke to the patient and took your emotions out on them by suctioning phlegm so forcefully. Is that acceptable? It's terrible. If I had a choice, I wouldn't want to come here again, and if possible, I would report this to everyone I know and would not recommend this place to anyone. It's awful.

0x30e2990813867e45_0xa76412effc5eb6f7.text: I had a snowboarding accident more than 10 years ago, which resulted in a T8/T9 spinal cord injury. In March 2026, I came to Verita Neuro in Bangkok for epidural stimulation surgery and spent 5 weeks at the clinic. From the very first online meeting, I felt supported, heard, and cared for. Making a decision like this is not easy, especially when it involves traveling to another country for treatment, but the team made the whole process feel much less overwhelming. Their communication was always professional, clear, and reassuring. What stood out to me the most was the people. Everyone at the clinic was incredibly kind, warm, and welcoming. It never felt like I was just another patient. The doctor, therapists, nurses, and clinic staff all treated me with genuine care and attention, and that made a huge difference during my stay. The 5 weeks I spent there were not only about the surgery and therapy, but also about feeling encouraged every day. The team created a positive and supportive environment that helped me stay motivated through the process. I’m very grateful for my experience at Verita Neuro. From the first call to the very end of my visit, I felt that I was in good hands. It was a professional, friendly, and truly heartwarming experience, and I will always appreciate the care I received there.
0x30e2990813867e45_0xa76412effc5eb6f7.author: Oleg Vorobiov

0x30e2990813867e45_0xa76412effc5eb6f7.text: I'm Marin and 3 and a half years ago I have cavernoma on my spinal cord that broke and leak on my spinal cord. It makes me more then 10 cm of presure on a spinal cord. After the surgury I can't move anything but my head. After 5 months I made my first step but without any fealings in my legs. After 2 years of that I was in Nerita Neuro for the first time Stem Cell treatmant. 10 hours after first treatmant of Stem Cell I put my leg on leg and finaly feal them touching....2 years after surgery. Now I'm finishing my 3 Stem Cell treatmant and I really belive it will get me back a lot more feal in my body. I have more power,stamina and endurance. This kind of therapy is the only thing that can help people to get back some normal life and to try their best. But without you work like crazy on your rehabilitation don't expect miracles. Team here in hospital is really nice and they know what they are doing. People with the spinal cord injury this is probably your last and only chance.
0x30e2990813867e45_0xa76412effc5eb6f7.author: Marin Ivezic

0x30e2990813867e45_0xa76412effc5eb6f7.text: My procedure (EES implants and Stem Cell Treatment) went well. Being SCI T6 paraplegic, Asia A I expected increased trunk control and being able to stand up for a certain time. My expectations were fully met and beyond I was able to walk with assistance. The surgery went very well and the consecutive hospital stay was pleasant. My quest to increased mobility just started and continuation of permanent exercise is needed to further improve. The staff of Verita Neuro is highly professional, forthcoming and super friendly. Their facilities were very good and I always felt well taken care of. I am looking forward to my re-mapping visit in Thailand in 6-8 months, depending on my further progress. Finally, I recommend this procedure and Verita Neuro to everybody who is willing to put in time and effort into their recovery as well to increase their mobility.
0x30e2990813867e45_0xa76412effc5eb6f7.author: Joachim Enenkel

0x30e2990813867e45_0xa76412effc5eb6f7.text: Big things often begin with small steps. This treatment may not be a complete solution, but it is an important and promising first step in the recovery process, and it gives us real optimism moving forward. It helps keep the legs and body in good condition and prepares the patient for future, more advanced treatments as medical options for spinal cord injuries continue to evolve. We are very grateful to the entire team for their excellent care, professionalism, and dedication to helping people in this condition.

0x30e299ab65adf521_0x22ba2f559714b848.text: My mother and uncle used their services and told me about their experience, so I thought I'd bring it to your attention. My mother called to inquire about a package deal for CO2 laser treatment to remove skin tags on my uncle's neck, as he had many. She got a price of 5,000 baht. The next day, the two elderly individuals went for the service. Upon arrival, the staff saw the large number of skin tags and requested a price of 6,000 baht. My mother and uncle understood and negotiated for additional mole removal (three or four spots). That was the agreed-upon price. After my uncle had the numbing cream applied and was about to begin the procedure, they learned that the staff wanted to increase the price to 8,000 baht. They claimed it was their mistake and that they couldn't do it at the original price because they would be reprimanded. My question is, two elderly individuals traveled for service only to have their price changed twice. I personally think this is unfair, as they felt that a large clinic like this couldn't resolve the issue properly. I hope you will consider this and improve your system in the future.

0x305039188cc2e987_0xbc153b448503f7a8.text: Update 15.04.25 Pictures 1 week after resolving the misplaced fillers in a different branch in Patong. the bump next to the lips are not gone but it is way better than before - see picture. The Botox between eyebrows and forehead I got instead in Patong was good. One eyebrow I can move and the other one not at all. But it might change. The lifting effect of the eye brows I don't see much but they told me honestly from the beginning so it's completely fine. I wanted to try it once. Very cute staff, not pushy or in a rush, very caring, got nice skin treatment, explained everything and listened to what you really want and they were the only ones recognizing that the previous fillers look very odd and wrong. I appreciated that a lot! Downside from this experience is that I lost quite some money, time and nerves as my treatment is not equal to what I paid as explained below. Mistakes can happen, that's okay. It could have been very easy and quick for the management and first doctor to recognize, acknowledge, change and fix the situation immediately but it became difficult and long with unnecessary comments. Update 07.04.25: After some back and forth I had to drive to Patong branch to resolve a previously misplaced filler, as I preferred a different doctor. But the management made clear that I will not get a treatment worth 100% what I paid ( 17.000 thb) but Botox worth less than that (lower would be 11k/10k). according to them they deduct my money because a customer saw my experience and canceled their appointment because of me. Not sure what to say to this. Original post: Most horrible result. I went to this beauty studio and asked specifically for thread lift and maybe fillers under the eyes or Botox so that my face will look more slim, fresh and uplifted. Later at my appointment the doctor said he won't do thread lifting and recommended like the deep wrinkles on the cheek, the smile lines. I was very hesitant because I really don't like this style of fillers where the face looks big round or fat at the cheeks and communicated it. He assured it won't be like that because of his technique. I paid 17.000 thb (450eur). Now I look like a fat sad hamster like already predicted. The face is more saggy downwards now, very bumpy, second wrinkle appeared, worse than before. Also the front desk staff can be a bit pushy sales wise. I got a call out of the blue on the weekend to make an appointment. In the clinic they made offer after offer until I had to ask them to stop suggesting more treatments. I went there twice after the treatment because I saw directly this will go in the wrong direction. The doctor said I need to wait over a month because it is only swollen and maybe he would need to put more filler there. I did not believe it because it was visible and putting more would look horribly bad and at the wrong place, so I felt unsafe to go back. Maybe they are good with skin that is full of fillers already or tight like a 20 year old. I prefer my old wrinkles back. Obvious that I had a bad treatment but the doctor can't see it. Embarrassing.

0x30e29ff7efd816fb_0x6fc8a5bd8be3be10.text: To be honest, I came because of the renowned dentists. Each of them is highly skilled in their own field and always in high demand. Upon arrival, I was impressed by the scent and the beautiful, fragrant atmosphere. Inside the room, it was even better. The equipment is modern, and the chair I usually lie on is hard, but this one was so comfortable; I could just lean my weight on it. Importantly, today I came for a tartar removal and a spa treatment for my teeth and gums. It was the first time I felt like every tooth and every angle was being treated. The dentists were incredibly skilled; it wasn't painful at all, and their touch was gentle. Finally, they finished with polishing powder. Normally, when you get polished, it feels like you're scratching your car or polishing your shoes, but this time, I realized they were actually polishing! The dentist explained that they use premium powder, which is very fine, but you don't feel the swirling motion of any polishing machine. In short, I loved it and highly recommend it.

0x30e29f059ee1cce9_0x9dd9b2fabeb93697.text: I begin this review with a great sadness and wish I didn't have to say the following. However this is my real experience. The person who began the work was lovely however she failed to communicate that she was leaving to go on holidays and that's when my nightmare began. A new dental technician? took over and didn't communicate what was going on when I thought I was having a root canal this person removed nine teeth without my knowledge (due to language barrier and anasthesia I was left toothless, majorly infected and without a voice to sort the issue out. The dentures made do not fit and I paid more money than the Australian equivalent and am left with no teeth to chew and dentures that rip my gums to pieces due to sharp steel wires that cut immediately if I try to use them. Although the owner stated she would fix the problem I am still yet to have the original toot canal and can only eat soup or mashed vegetables. The owner became visibly angry at me for no real reason and although I am a frequent visitor to Bangkok am left without a caring service to take responsibility. I will start the process again and pay for Australian dental care that I know is backed by guarantee. I wish I could give this service a good review because it began well and the people were nice at the start before I handed over the money.

0x30e299566aa11b19_0xdf4e1208c47a2f11.text: ขัดหินปูนมาหลายที่ ที่นี่ทำดีที่สุดที่เคยทำมาในชีวิตเลยค่ะ คุณหมอทำละเอียดมากกก ไม่ได้ใช้แค่เครื่องมือที่เป็นไฟฟ้า แต่ใช้เครื่องมือแบบไม่ไฟฟ้า ขูดอีกรอบทุกซี่ ใส่ใจมากๆค่ะ สะอาดทุกตรง เบามือ เลือดไม่ออก ไม่เสียวฟัน
0x30e299566aa11b19_0xdf4e1208c47a2f11.author: Supapitch Poothong
0x30e299566aa11b19_0xdf4e1208c47a2f11.en: I've had my teeth cleaned at many places, but this is the best I've ever had in my life. The dentist was incredibly meticulous. They didn't just use electric tools, but also non-electric tools, scraping every single tooth again. They were so attentive and thorough, cleaning every area perfectly. They were gentle, there was no bleeding, and no tooth sensitivity.

0x30e299566aa11b19_0xdf4e1208c47a2f11.text: คุณหมอมือเบามาก พี่พยาบาลพูดดี บริการก็ดีมากๆคะ ไปถอนฟันมาหลายรอบแล้ว บริการดีทุกรอบ แนะนำเลยคะ
0x30e299566aa11b19_0xdf4e1208c47a2f11.author: ชลดา หงษ์ชัย
0x30e299566aa11b19_0xdf4e1208c47a2f11.en: The dentist was very gentle, the nurses were kind, and the service was excellent. I've had teeth extracted several times and the service has been great every time. I highly recommend this clinic.

0x30e299566aa11b19_0xdf4e1208c47a2f11.text: วันนี้ไปซ่อมฟันหน้าที่แตก พนักงานหน้าเคาน์เตอร์แจ้งว่าบัตรประชาชนเสียไม่สามารถใช้สิทธิ์ประกันสังคมได้ บอกให้เราไปทำบัตรใหม่แล้วค่อยเอาบัตรใหม่มาใช้สิทธิวันนี้ให้สำรองจ่ายก่อน อยากทราบว่าไม่สามารถคีย์ข้อมูลแต่ต้องสิทธิ์จากบัตรเท่านั้นหรอกค่ะ แต่ทางเรายืนยันว่าพึ่งทำบัตรมาไม่มีทางที่จะเสียได้ แอบเสียความรู้สึกนิดนึงค่ะเราทำคลินิกนี้มาตั้งหลายรอบแล้ว
0x30e299566aa11b19_0xdf4e1208c47a2f11.author: Lalitgorn Intun
0x30e299566aa11b19_0xdf4e1208c47a2f11.en: Today I went to get my broken front tooth repaired. The counter staff informed me that my ID card was damaged and I couldn't use my social security benefits. They told me to get a new card and then use it today, but asked me to pay upfront. I'd like to know if it's really impossible to process payments without a valid ID card. I insisted that I just got the card and there's no way it's damaged. I'm a little disappointed, as I've been to this clinic many times before.

0x30fdab001688f973_0x5aedeb3c1755adc6.text: I visited this clinic because I had lower back pain from sitting with poor posture for a long time at work. The physiotherapist was excellent. He carefully assessed my condition and treated it step by step. He also used cupping therapy as part of the treatment. I had 3 sessions and start to feel better, less pain. The doctor was very patient and took the time to explain everything clearly while working on the problem. He answered all my questions and never made me feel rushed. I also appreciated that there was no pressure to buy any packages. Overall, it was a very positive experience. Highly recommended!
0x30fdab001688f973_0x5aedeb3c1755adc6.author: Sirimanas M

0x30fdab001688f973_0x5aedeb3c1755adc6.text: I highly recommend your clinic. I'm very impressed. I've had chronic pain in my right shoulder blade for three years. I go to massage parlors every month, and it gets better, but it doesn't go away completely. Then the pain comes back, and it keeps coming back. I've been to your clinic four times (once a week). My right shoulder blade pain is completely gone. It's truly amazing. It's been excruciating for three years, especially when I'm sleeping. I can't sleep soundly every night. Thank you so much, doctor. I'll help you with recommendations.
0x30fdab001688f973_0x5aedeb3c1755adc6.author: ศุภกิตต์ เมธารัตนกร

0x30fdab001688f973_0x5aedeb3c1755adc6.text: I was recommended to come to Kitikhun Thai Traditional Medicine Clinic by my lovely friend from the gym. I have had chronic lower back pain for about 6 years. My first consultation plus physiotherapy and cupping took a little over an hour. First of all, the shooting pain down my right leg amazingly disappeared. Unbelievable. The therapist demonstrated some stretches and exercises that I could do at home along with sleeping positions and type of pillow to use. I will be back for my weekly therapy sessions. I highly recommend this clinic.
0x30fdab001688f973_0x5aedeb3c1755adc6.author: Sue Poonapirat

0x30fdab001688f973_0x5aedeb3c1755adc6.text: I had a pinched nerve in my right arm. The doctor examined me and explained the cause. I have been treated about five times since then and feel resurrected. Physiotherapy, osteopathy, and cupping were all part of the treatment. I would recommend him to everyone...
0x30fdab001688f973_0x5aedeb3c1755adc6.author: Frank Terneven

0x30fdab001688f973_0x5aedeb3c1755adc6.text: Excellent experiences in this clinic. Well known about physics & treatment! 5 stars up!☝️
0x30fdab001688f973_0x5aedeb3c1755adc6.author: Rolex Ralle

0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.text: Last Thursday, I had the opportunity to use their services. I hadn't read any reviews beforehand, but I knew about them from a friend who had previously undergone radiation therapy there. I was an emergency case; I'd been let down by a private hospital, but I was already preparing for radioactive iodine treatment, so I needed to find a new place urgently. When I called, the staff were incredibly helpful and provided excellent information. They checked for available beds and even spoke with the doctor on my behalf, as they had actually stopped accepting new patients that day (but the doctor was happy to take my case, so I got the last appointment of the day). Everything fit perfectly with my original treatment plan, which was surprisingly good and made me feel very lucky. Finally, after the phone call, I went straight to the center to see the doctor. I have to admit, the registration process, waiting for a queue number, and waiting to be called took quite a while compared to private hospitals (though from what I've read from others, mine was relatively quick). However, I understand that even though it's a private hospital, it's not the typical expensive one. They probably mostly accept cases from social security or government hospitals. The cost of radioactive iodine treatment here was more than half the price of the private hospital I initially spoke with, as was the consultation fee with the doctor. This place is almost four times cheaper than the private hospital we went to, so it's no surprise the service is different. Overall, of course, only one staff member we encountered had a slightly harsh tone, but not to the point of being aggressive. They provided normal advice and assistance, and didn't make us feel bad at all. I'll add more reviews after I've had my radioactive iodine treatment here. I couldn't find many reviews about this place.
0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.author: Pat Pat

0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.text: Before coming to use the service, we read the reviews. At first, we were worried because there were only negative aspects... Let me share my real experience when bringing my mother for treatment. The first day will be a bit slow, doing many programs, seeing the doctor, the doctor asked for a history and examined in detail. After that, the nurse took her to simulate radiation therapy, totaling about 3 hours. After that, they will make an appointment for radiation therapy, but the first day has not been radiation yet. The nurse will take her to simulate radiation therapy again, inform the schedule and make an appointment because it has to be done for 5 consecutive days, rest for 2 days, there are no holidays here. Today is not long, about 3 hours, and an appointment for radiation therapy is made for the next day. From arriving, putting down the appointment card, weighing, measuring blood pressure, waiting to be called, radiation therapy takes about 1-1.5 hours, not more than this (arrive at the appointed time, wait about this much, not an exaggeration). And most importantly, the staff and nurses take very good care of all the patients. This is my mother's 8th radiation therapy, and each time it has been good every time... Confirm that the review is from real experience as of October 5, 2025.
0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.author: Oranee Luangpimol

0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.text: Initially, I must admit I was very worried because I had read many negative reviews on Google, which made me a little scared and unsure. However, since it was a referral from my original hospital, I decided to come for treatment. In reality, the experience was very different from what I expected. All the staff were attentive, polite, patient, and provided detailed advice, which gradually reduced my initial anxiety. The overall atmosphere wasn't as bad as the reviews suggested. Regarding the waiting time, I personally considered it normal given the large number of patients, but it wasn't excessively long or slow as I feared. Everything proceeded according to the queue order and was well-managed. This experience has made me want to add my voice in support of the hospital team and I would like to add stars to this excellent service. Thank you to all the staff who dedicated themselves to caring for patients. 🙏
0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.author: Lastlogin

0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.text: I went as a patient. The nurse was very kind and explained everything that new patients didn't understand. Her gentle tone made me feel more relaxed, especially since I was very scared because I went alone. The doctor was also very friendly and approachable, letting me ask any questions. Overall, it was great; I give it a perfect 100! (If possible, I wouldn't want to be a patient myself 😊😊)
0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.author: วันเพ็ญ สีดาโล้น

0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.text: Throughout April 2023, I had the opportunity (an opportunity I never wanted) to receive radiation therapy for stage 0 breast cancer at a small hospital, true to its name. On the first day, I went with a referral letter from my home hospital. It took a very long time (you could say I practically waited at the hospital). I got my turn, but didn't receive radiation therapy. Seven days later, I went again with another referral letter (requesting referral letters is very wasteful). I finally received radiation therapy on my second visit. There were so many patients, especially in the afternoons, many with patients in wheelchairs. The hospital always prioritizes patients who can walk normally over those who are not. There are few staff members, so be prepared for long waits. After the first treatment, subsequent treatments were much faster. The staff in radiation therapy room 1 were lovely and kind, mostly young people. I often bought snacks for them. I deducted one star because I think the hospital requested too many referral letters from the home hospital. Even after completing radiation therapy, you had to bring a referral letter to every follow-up appointment. This can be problematic for some patients who have to constantly run back and forth requesting documents.
0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.author: Sirinda Yothasiri

0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.text: The hospital itself is okay, but the service system is still lacking. On my first visit, for radiation therapy, the staff informed me that the radiation room needed equipment replacement and would be closed. I acknowledged this and didn't come for a day. Later, I went for my scheduled treatment, but the room wasn't ready. I was surprised; I had an appointment from 6:00 AM to 7:00 AM. The staff didn't call to inform the patients until the morning! I traveled from Nakhon Pathom to Ari, a journey of 1-2 hours, and they only called at 6:38 AM. This needs improvement, especially since not all patients live in the area. The hospital needs to plan ahead for future incidents.
0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.author: Tanapron Wingngam

0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.text: This was my first visit, and I never want to come back. When I called to confirm, they told me I had to arrive before 8:00 AM, or at the latest 9:00 AM, because the doctor would start seeing patients at 8:30 AM. I arrived at 8:00 AM, completed the paperwork, and then had to stand in a long line until it was my turn. Furthermore, the doctor in charge of the examination room arrived at 9:50 AM, but had already instructed patients to arrive at 8:00 AM, with the examination starting at 8:30 AM. This is already not on time. The area for patients or visitors is extremely small. I stood waiting from the moment I arrived at the hospital, and not a single staff member came to ask me what was wrong or offer me a chair. Private hospitals should urgently improve this aspect.
0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.author: ปอนด์หนวด OFFICIAL

0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.text: The front desk and registration staff were terrible. When I inquired about documents, they made a disgusted face and sneered at the patient. A female nurse with red hair also sneered at the patient; her behavior was unbecoming of a nurse. The patient even continued gossiping about her before she left. If they can't improve their communication and demeanor, they shouldn't be working at the front desk, regardless of whether the patient is insured or paying privately. They should have a polite attitude towards patients. Who wants to have to deal with this kind of mental distress while getting cancer?
0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.author: Ratsarin Tananaweeshed

0x311d5fc08a02e46d_0x89912852fba5bdbe.text: ไปฉีดหน้าที่เบาเบามา ตอนแรกก็ลืมสังเกตุหน้าตัวเองไปว่ามีอะไรเปลี่ยนแปลงบ้างรึป่าว จนมีคนมาทักว่าหน้าดูเรียวและดูเด็กขึ้น จนมามองและสังเกตุตัวเอง ดูดีขึ้นจริงๆครับ เห็นผลจริง คลีนิกให้ยาครบโดสเต็มที่ แล้วจะกลับไปฉีดอีกนะครับ จะชวนเพื่อนๆไปด้วย ราคาก็ถูกได้ยาเต็มโดส👍
0x311d5fc08a02e46d_0x89912852fba5bdbe.author: Yada Krongsiririt
0x311d5fc08a02e46d_0x89912852fba5bdbe.en: I went for a light facial injection. At first, I didn't notice any changes in my face until people commented that my face looked slimmer and younger. When I finally looked closely, I realized I did look better! The clinic gave me the full dose of medication. I'll definitely go back for more injections and bring my friends along. The price is affordable and you get the full dose! 👍

0x311d5fc08a02e46d_0x89912852fba5bdbe.text: I came here for rechecking my oral health. The dentist is so kind, his hands are very gentle and light touch. The clinic’s staff are very friendly and polite. The price is reasonable. I really recommend this place for you guys.
0x311d5fc08a02e46d_0x89912852fba5bdbe.author: FT PT

0x311d5fc08a02e46d_0x89912852fba5bdbe.text: คุณหมอมือเบาสมชื่อคลินิกเลยค่ะ ประทับใจทุกการบริการมากเลยค่ะ มีสียางให้เลือกแบบหนักใจเพราะเยอะมากก 10/10เลยค่ะ⭐️
0x311d5fc08a02e46d_0x89912852fba5bdbe.en: The doctor was very gentle, just like the clinic's name suggests. I was very impressed with every aspect of the service. There were so many colors of rubber bands to choose from – it was overwhelming! 10/10! ⭐️

0x311d5fc08a02e46d_0x89912852fba5bdbe.text: คุณหมอบริการดี จัดฟันที่นี้ตั้งแต่เปิดคลินิค ไม่มีเปลี่ยนใจไปที่อื่น พนง เคาเตอร์ก็น่ารัก เป็นกันเอง บริการดี
0x311d5fc08a02e46d_0x89912852fba5bdbe.author: pornthip desanthia
0x311d5fc08a02e46d_0x89912852fba5bdbe.en: The dentist provides excellent service. I've been getting my braces done here since the clinic opened and I haven't considered going anywhere else. The counter staff are also lovely, friendly, and provide great service.

0x311d5fc08a02e46d_0x89912852fba5bdbe.text: คุณหมอน่ารักมากค่ะ มือเบามาก พี่ๆที่คลิกนิกก็น่ารักมากค่ะพูดเพราะ คลินิกดีมากๆค่ะ ประทับใจสุดๆ
0x311d5fc08a02e46d_0x89912852fba5bdbe.en: The doctor was very kind and gentle. The staff at the clinic were also very nice and polite. It's a great clinic! I'm extremely impressed.

0x30503193ba542bd9_0x97e402187b817a24.text: I was impressed from the moment I called. The staff were helpful, provided detailed information, and weren't pushy about sales; they focused on attentive conversation and listening carefully to the client. On the day of my appointment, the doctor explained everything in great detail, even asking if I understood and clarifying if I didn't. They were very attentive and caring towards the patient. They explained the prices at every step, allowing me to consider and decide whether or not to proceed. Some prices were significantly cheaper than elsewhere. Just a consultation with an X-ray was a little over 500 baht, and it included a consultation certificate and X-ray photos. Even if I don't proceed with the treatment there, these photos can be used as references. I've been to other places that charged almost 2000 baht, and they didn't even include the X-rays. The atmosphere and location were very pleasant and comfortable. Most patients were by appointment. I give them a 4.8 rating!
0x30503193ba542bd9_0x97e402187b817a24.author: ธัญสินี พุทธทาสินี

0x30503193ba542bd9_0x97e402187b817a24.text: I was on holiday in Phuket when a crown on one of my molars got dislodged. Our hotel concierge recommended this studio, and it was an excellent suggestion. The studio is clean and peaceful, with cold drinking water available in the waiting room. The staff speak English and are friendly. I was seen by Dr. Hatsumol, who was incredibly gentle when fixing my tooth; I felt no pain at all. I really appreciated that she explained everything she was doing. She did an X-ray right there in the dental chair, which was so convenient, and I was done in 30 minutes. The price was very reasonable too, only 2300THB for everything. Highly recommended! (P.S. As with many places in Thailand, patients just remove their shoes before entering. If you are not comfortable in bare feet, then you may want to bring a pair of socks with you.)
0x30503193ba542bd9_0x97e402187b817a24.author: Bethany Bassett

0x30503193ba542bd9_0x97e402187b817a24.text: Hi, I've been treated at the Tangmo Dental Clinic for quite a few years, at all times the service was of a very professional standard. My latest (yearly visit) was May/June 2025, Dr Aui conducted my treatment. She is very professional, meticulous in her work and very thoughtful of the patients comfort throughout the consultation. Visiting the dentist is never high on most peoples list of things they enjoy, however the professionalism of all staff at Tangmo Clinic make process as comfortable as it can be.
0x30503193ba542bd9_0x97e402187b817a24.author: David Knowles

0x30503193ba542bd9_0x97e402187b817a24.text: This is a dentist's office, so you don't have to wait long because there are many doctors and many assistants. Regarding the prices, I've heard people say they're cheap, but I'm not sure if that's true. I only used their services for scaling, which cost 1,000 baht, and for removing two wisdom teeth, which cost 2,000 and 3,000 baht. It didn't feel cheap or expensive. What impressed me most was the queue management, even though there were a lot of people waiting in line and walking in.
0x30503193ba542bd9_0x97e402187b817a24.author: เจสช่าพาเที่ยว

0x30503193ba542bd9_0x97e402187b817a24.text: My first visit was very impressive... from the counter staff to the doctor and his assistant... the service was excellent, they spoke politely and smiled sweetly... the doctor was very kind, explaining everything before using any instruments in my mouth and clearly stating the price. She was very gentle; the anesthetic injection was painless. I felt very comfortable making subsequent appointments.
0x30503193ba542bd9_0x97e402187b817a24.author: Jaruwan Kumpai

0x30503193ba542bd9_0x97e402187b817a24.text: I had my first tooth extracted there. The staff were lovely. The dentist spoke kindly and had a very gentle touch. I'm very afraid of dental work... This was my first time having a wisdom tooth extracted, and it didn't hurt at all. I will definitely go back here again next time.
0x30503193ba542bd9_0x97e402187b817a24.author: Naiyana Rayaphak

0x30503193ba542bd9_0x97e402187b817a24.text: We really enjoy using Dr. Tangmo's clinic. Our whole family comes here for dental work. All the doctors are lovely, gentle, and give excellent advice. They make dental procedures less scary! Thank you to all the doctors for caring for our family's dental health. 🥰🙏🏻🩷🌸 …
0x30503193ba542bd9_0x97e402187b817a24.author: Orapat Mekurai

0x30503193ba542bd9_0x97e402187b817a24.text: I'm waiting in line for my braces wire replacement, and my teeth are practically decaying, but there are no openings at all. If anyone is thinking of getting braces, think carefully because scheduling a wire replacement is extremely difficult. The waiting list is very long. The staff doesn't offer any advice; they just keep saying "the schedule is full," "there are no openings," "it's full." I'm confused because some months I haven't even had a replacement scheduled yet, and the schedule is already full. I understand there are a lot of people, but there's no help in rescheduling or adjusting the appointment. They just keep saying "full," and "wait until next month." Sometimes, even when my teeth hurt or seem to have a problem, I have to wait until an opening becomes available. However, the doctor is good and provides excellent care.
0x30503193ba542bd9_0x97e402187b817a24.author: nut att

0x311d61aa01906b51_0x177a2adc669fd01e.text: คุณหมออธิบายดีมาก ใจเย็น แอบกลัวคุณหมอนิดๆแต่คุณหมอก้อค่อยๆอธิบายจนเข้าใจ พี่ผู้ช่วยก็พูดดีคะ ม่ดุเรย พี่เคาน์เตอร์ตัวเล็กน่ารักมากยิ้มแย้มตลอดตั้งแต่เข้ามา แถมอธิบายดีมากใจเย็นสุดๆคะ เราถามเยอะมากเพราะม่เข้าใจ แต่พี่เขาม่วีนเรยอธิบายจนเข้าใจขั้นตอนและราคา ราคาไม่แพงเรย จะทำอะไรก้อแจ้งราคาก่อนตลอดคะ เด่วจะชวนเพื่อนมาอีกคะ
0x311d61aa01906b51_0x177a2adc669fd01e.en: The doctor explained everything very well and was very patient. I was a little scared of the doctor, but she patiently explained everything until I understood. The assistant was also very nice and not at all harsh. The receptionist was small and very cute, smiling the whole time I came in. She explained everything very well and was incredibly patient. I asked a lot of questions because I didn't understand everything, but she happily explained the process and the price until I understood. The prices were very reasonable. They always informed me of the price before doing anything. I'll definitely bring my friends along.

0x311d61aa01906b51_0x177a2adc669fd01e.text: Dr. Boom gave excellent advice, was very friendly and patient. He explained every step before proceeding, and when I felt pain, he stopped to rest and added more local anesthetic. His assistant was also very patient, and the staff were friendly as well. I will definitely come back for more services.
0x311d61aa01906b51_0x177a2adc669fd01e.author: Phanpaphon Khorat

0x311d61aa01906b51_0x177a2adc669fd01e.text: The dental work is affordable, the dentist gives good advice, and only does what's necessary; extractions aren't required, just treatment based on the symptoms. I tried asking the nurse at the counter, and they said the doctor had left and would return in the afternoon. How can you treat an elderly person like this?
