0x30e29fc7fb6c8db7_0x6471808a8270004a.text: วันนี้ค้นหาร้านจากใน google เจอร้านนี้ก้อเลยเข้าไปอุดฟัน พอเข้าไปให้คุณหมอตรวจ เข้าใจว่าต้องเอกซเรย์ และเป็นฟันซี่กรามเลยต้องรอหมออีกท่านในวันถัดไปพอสอบถามคุนหมอก้อบอกว่าวันพรุ่งนี้จะเข้าแนะนำให้ขูดหินปูนก่อน เราก้อพยายามจะเข้าใจว่ายังไงก้อต้องขูดในอนาคตเห้นหมอพูดจาดี ทำเสร็จก้อถามคุนหมอผมต้องทนไปถึงพรุ่งนี้เลยใช่ไหม หมอบอกกินยาแก้ปวดได้ พอออกมาจ่ายเงินทำการนัดในวันพรุ่งนี้ สรุปเคาเตอร์บอกฟมอเข้าวันที่ 18 คืออาทิตต่อไป แล้วผมต้องทนไปอีก ทั้งๆที่วันนี้จะมาอุด หรือถอนไปเลยก้อได้ แต่กลับได้ ขูดฟินปูน 1800 เอกเรย์ฟันอีก 200 ผมงงมากครับ กับการบริการ ประตูอยุ่แค่นิดเดียวถ้าบอกต้องทนอีกอาทิตหน้าผมเปลี่ยนใจไปนานแล้วครับ แย่มากแบบนี้เสียความรู้สึกมากๆ จะไม่กลับไปใช้อีกแน่นอน
0x30e29fc7fb6c8db7_0x6471808a8270004a.en: Today I found this clinic on Google and went in for a filling. When I went in, the dentist examined me and I understood they needed an X-ray, and since it was a molar, I had to wait for another dentist to come back the next day. When I asked, the dentist said they would be back tomorrow and recommended getting a tartar removal first. I tried to understand that I would need it in the future anyway, and the dentist seemed nice. After the procedure, I asked if I had to endure the pain until tomorrow, and the dentist said I could take painkillers. After paying and making an appointment for tomorrow, the counter staff said the dentist wouldn't be back until the 18th, which is next week. So I have to endure this again? They could have just given me a filling or an extraction today, but instead I got a tartar removal for 1800 baht and an X-ray for 200 baht. I'm very confused by the service. The clinic is located just a short distance away; if they had told me I had to endure it for another week, I would have left a long time ago. This is a terrible experience; I'm very disappointed and will definitely not be returning.

0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.text: I stayed for 6 weeks at The Treehouse Retreat — and yes, it was truly life-changing for me. Coming from a phase where professional and personal responsibilities had completely defined my identity, I was battling anxiety, chronic depression and an overall low phase in life. This retreat gave me the calmness and space I desperately needed, while also helping me build a routine — with daily workouts and simple brain exercises. More than that, I learned to practice the basics: empathy, kindness, and love — which made me more mindful and humble each day. The weekly Thursday excursions felt like moments of freedom within the structure, thoughtfully designed within time slots. I highly recommend this place to anyone prepared to put in the work to become a better version of themselves. But let me clarify — this is not a place of instant magic. The team equips you with the right tools, but it is entirely up to you to practice, apply, and build positivity from them. The food, while simple and sometimes monotonous, is part of the process — and as the team rightly says, “trust the process.” I personally committed to a digital detox during my time here and brought along a few long-awaited books — which turned out to be the perfect companion for my downtime. One of my most significant realizations during this journey was: acceptance of your weaknesses can make life much easier. It’s essential to accelerate your strengths, but equally important to develop coping mechanisms for your weaknesses. Brain mapping was another eye-opener for me. I completed 20 sessions of neurofeedback in 6 weeks. However, the experts did mention that meaningful results usually show after 60 sessions — so I would suggest opting for these only if truly necessary and committed for 60 sessions. The staff here is incredibly friendly and supportive. I’m especially grateful for the sessions I had with Tony and John — both of whom guided me through invaluable reflections and personal revelations. Overall, my experience was transformative — but like everything in life, you’ll only get as much as you’re willing to put in.
0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.author: Suvidha Shetty

0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.text: When I first got here I thought I just needed like, a break from weed you know? Figured it was about cutting back or whatever, maybe learning some tricks to deal with stuff. But what actually went down was way deeper than I expected. I've been dealing with depression and anxiety pretty much my whole life. Weed became my go-to for numbing all that out, but it never actually fixed anything - just made things... quieter I guess. At The Treehouse they really pushed me to dig into the stuff underneath. All the old wounds and self-doubt and fear. God it was painful. There were definitely times I wanted to just bail, but I started realizing the real fight wasn't even with cannabis. It was with all these parts of myself I'd been running from for years. Writing my story down... man that nearly destroyed me. Had to look at all these moments I've been trying so hard to forget, left me feeling completely raw and exposed. But slowly - and I mean slowly - I began seeing these patterns. How the depression would just drag me down into this hole, how anxiety kept me totally paralyzed, and how weed was basically just this band-aid I slapped on everything. The Treehouse didn't like, magically cure me or anything. That's not how recovery works I guess. But it gave me tools and honesty and just... space to finally stop running from myself. I'm leaving here knowing the real work happens at home, and honestly? For the first time in forever I actually think I can handle it.
0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.author: Frank Wright

0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.text: It was a relief to find The Treehouse in Thailand. The location strikes a perfect balance – close enough to city conveniences and attractions for outings, yet wonderfully peaceful by the river with beautifully maintained grounds. The amenities, including the pool, gym, and yoga, are a definite plus, and the rooms are as comfortable as a good city hotel. However, the staff truly set The Treehouse apart. The nurses are incredibly understanding and patient. What struck me was that many of the support staff have personal experience with addiction, which allows them to connect with clients on a deeper level. I had the pleasure of meeting with the clinical manager, John, who was fantastic. He provided honest and clear updates on progress and consistently sent helpful email updates to my family. From my initial inquiry, Grace was exceptional, dedicating a significant amount of time over several calls to answer all my questions. Overall, I am very happy with the care and support provided by The Treehouse and wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone considering a stay for themselves or a loved one. It's reassuring to know such a dedicated facility exists here in Thailand.
0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.author: ณัฐวดี โปธิ

0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.text: Review for Treehouse Treatment Centre I recently had the pleasure of staying at the Treehouse rehab Centre, and I must say, it was an exceptional experience. From the moment I arrived, I was greeted with warmth and professionalism by the staff, who made me feel right at home. I’d like to give special thanks to Emmy the nurse and Wine who works in the restaurant. Though I cannot forget Dr Tony, John, Jamie, Conan, Gigi, Pia, Tyler, Bryan, Note, Gabriel, Yamin, Bhum, Mate, Nigh, in fact the whole Team (I hope I haven’t forgotten anyone!) The facilities are top-notch, with beautifully appointed treehouses that offer a unique blend of comfort and nature. Each treehouse is equipped with everything you could possibly need, and the attention to detail is evident in every corner. The serene setting provides the perfect backdrop for relaxation and healing. One of the highlights of my stay was the variety of treatments available. The therapists are highly skilled and attentive, ensuring that each session is tailored to your specific needs. The holistic wellness program, at the Treehouse Treatment Centre has it all. 5 stars!!!
0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.author: Tim Hill

0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.text: My daughter was at the treehouse a few months ago and I just want to share how much it meant to us. As her mom I had watched her struggle for years, which was so hard and nothing ever seemed to help. When she went to the treehouse it was the first time I felt like she was truly safe and being understood. The counselor’s there were patient and caring through all her ups and downs. They didn’t give up on her, even when she felt like giving up on herself. I could see little by little she was starting to find hope again, and that’s something I hadn’t seen in her for a llong time. What really made a difference for me was that I was updated about her treatment every week and I could ask questions or ask about anything I was worried about to the clinical manager. A few days before she left the treehouse we even had a family zoom meeting with all of the treehouse team and we were able to plan for when she came home. Looking back now, I’m so grateful for the support she got at the treehouse. It gave her the chance to heal and gave me comfort and hope knowing she was finally in good hands.
0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.author: Casey Quinn

0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.text: Spent 6 weeks at Treehouse and it was lifechanging. I arrived burnt-out, fearful and anxious and left super fit, healthy and empowered. The location is amazing, on the River Ping with stunning gardens, mountain views and an icy refreshing pool. The rooms are amazing traditional teak huts with incredibly comfy fluffy four poster beds. The trauma based treatment covers education, group and individual sessions and is applicable to a broad range of issues. I'm not going to say it was easy. There were some days I didn't want to run up the temple stairs, do crunches or face my demons and be brave and vulnerable but you get out what you put in. The first week can be a little scary as you get used to the place but if you commit to the program and trust the process you will find your happy place again. I went specifically for EMDR and felt healed of trauma memories that had plagued me for years. Happy to be contacted if you want more detail but highly recommend this place.
0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.author: Epicphannys - with a silent C

0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.text: Fantastic service. Our youngest son has just completed 2 months at the Tree House and we have nothing but good things to say. Rehab is not just on the client but rather a wider issue including the staff of the facility as well as the family unit. The range of support covering the underlying mental health issues is paramount and the neuro mapping and EMDR process is 100% worthwhile and handled by proper professionals. The journey or recovery is a long and difficult one but John and the staff at the treehouse assign the right levels of tough love and counselling to guide each client to achieve their best version of themselves. There is NO magic bullet but the treehouse certainly helps load the metaphorical gun to recovery.
0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.author: James Watson

0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.text: DON'T GO FOR THE FAKE REVIEWS!!! THIS PLACE IS UNETHICAL, A BUSINESS AND SHADY. THE OWNER IS TONY, A GUY WHO COULD BE SEEN SHOUTING AT HIS STAFF FOR NO REASON ALL THE TIME. He will be very sweet to you since day one. I came there with a few mild issues and was hoping that i would get some healing time. But well its just a well run business. They have one group therapy, one group yoga session, one group exercise and i guess one personal session. Thats it. They dont really have any expertise and except for the councellors no one even speaks English. John will gaslight you into believing everything is your fault to the extend I really thought I am the problem. They promise you fresh cooked meals but then they order it from somewhere, plate it and give it to you at a tripple price. This is basically a very expensive scam, like its a resort with all sorts of restrictions. If anyone needs further proof for whatever I've just said, am always happy to provide evidence. (I have lots of it)
0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.author: Anx Ghs

0x30e28348aa78026f_0x1a7b44f4684b932d.text: ไม่ค่อยโอกับผู้ช่วยหมอนิดหน่อยค่ะ เลือกสียางสองสีมีสีนึงสีอ่อน เเต่ผู้ช่วยหยิบสีเข้มมาให้เราสองสีเลย เราก็ไม่ได้เอะใจคิดว่าเขาคงหยิบถูกเลยบอกโอเคค่ะ เเต่พอทำเสร็จเท่านั้นเเหละ อื้อออ เลือกม่วงอ่อนเเต่หยิบม่วงเข้มมาให้ คือเราผิดเองเเหละที่ไม่ได้ดูดีๆ จะบอกหมอก็ไม่กล้าเพราะเกรงใจไม่อยากให้เขาทำให้ใหม่ อยากให้หมอช่วยดูผู้ช่วยให้หน่อยนะคะ บางทีคนเป็นลูกค้าก็ไม่ค่อยกล้าพูดอะไรมาก ฮืออ

0x30e29a0a0406aacb_0xb84a63f1f1573df5.en: I've been seeing this dentist since before my child was born, and I still go to them today. On New Year's and Children's Day, the dentist always has raffles, which is very kind. Sometimes, even if my child doesn't go to the dentist but I do, the dentist will give me a gift. I forgot to mention, I live in Bangkok, but the clinic is in Chiang Mai. My first impression upon arriving at the clinic was that it was spacious, clean, and the staff were polite and friendly. The doctor explained the treatment process and post-treatment care. After the treatment, I was amazed by how much lighter my ankle felt and how significantly the pain had subsided. I was very impressed with this clinic. My ankle is completely healed to this day, truly living up to their slogan that they can solve even the most difficult cases.

0x30da300c40f985e9_0xf99d939fb24478ae.text: I don't think many Japanese people give birth here, but my daughter did, so I'm recording it here. First, the hospital name is incorrect; officially it's the "Health Promotion Hospital." Since it specializes in obstetrics, gynecology, and pediatrics, "Mother and Child Hospital" is probably a more accurate name. It seems to be a mid-range hospital in Chiang Mai; I didn't see any foreign patients. There were two doctors on duty at night and five during the day. It appears to be a major maternity hospital in the region; the facilities are quite old but sufficient, and there are many staff members. The hospital has a policy against formula and disposable diapers; cloth diapers are provided. They strongly advocate breastfeeding, so it will be difficult for those who can't breastfeed. Of course, there are classes and other assistance available. A normal birth costs 21,000 THB according to the website. My personal impression is that, compared to births in Japan, this hospital is very mother-centered. Because of breastfeeding, mothers and babies stay together unless there are special circumstances. If you expect hands-on assistance from the nurses, you might be disappointed.
0x30da300c40f985e9_0xf99d939fb24478ae.author: Kazuaki Chiba

0x30da300c40f985e9_0xf99d939fb24478ae.text: It's really terrible. Every time I make an appointment, I waste a whole day. I make an appointment at 1 PM and the doctor doesn't show up until 2 PM. 0x305031e3716d56f7_0x753f6ae2365e34a0.text: We went to the doctor because of an itchy rash on our body that had been present for almost 3 weeks and was spreading to our face. Before this, we had seen a doctor at a hospital twice and received both oral and topical medication, but it didn't improve (we didn't see a specialist). So we decided to see a dermatologist at this clinic, which was recommended by a friend. The doctor listened attentively to our medical history, problems, and symptoms. From what I observed, and for those before me, the doctor spent at least 5 minutes examining and diagnosing the condition. The doctor also gave excellent advice (though sometimes they might have gotten distracted by other things, which was fine with me, but perhaps not so much for those waiting outside). The treatment and medication were very affordable and effective. If you're looking for a dermatologist, I highly recommend this clinic.

0x305031e3716d56f7_0x753f6ae2365e34a0.text: I had terrible acne that wouldn't go away no matter what I applied. Then someone recommended a doctor. 0x30da3f88bc8c6209_0xa04a1a288e25582.text: I have been to psychiatric units and rehabs over the world and my praise isn't easily earned. I can say with warm sincerity this sets the standard when it comes to rehabs. Especially as the price comparison with the UK and US I choose very wisely these days and was extremely hesitant to stray from Engalnd after a horrifying experience ce with a well know outfit in South Africa. The Hills was personally recommended and I phoned Peter directly. He gave me all the reassurance I needed with his honesty and candour, and I gor to talk to the psychiatrist about a potentially difficult prescription med taper. Luxury, food and shouldnt be the impetus to go to a rehab. Yet it helps. As for the money it's utterly ridiculous how such a beautiful place, sublime amenities, and all that can exist. More imlortantly the one on one therapy sessions were very good. I am complicated but was given great help and perspective by my therapist. What was new to me and something i have repeatedly shunned was the holistic aspect of recovery. Craig, a therapist, recommended a book “ the body keeps score” and thats where massage, tension release exercise, personal training, kickboxing, reiki sound healing, chats with monks and walks, excursions in nature as varied as white water rafting to waterfall hikes to thai cooking all have a part to play. Obviously they also have classes on the evidence based psychological techniques. I would have prefered these to be less lecture type though. I was happy to be in a group that was diverse but shared the common goal of wanting to get better, a given prerequisite one would think. And the community supportive and the surrounding, acres of apace, pools, open air Indeed it is not high security, so it also requires personal accountability and one wanting to get better. Although providing a safe, secure place to do so. If one wants to self sabotage and cause issues a more secure unit may be for yiu. And when I say safe, I also include the fact for such a facility it also has 24 hour trained nursing Staff, Physican and psychiatrist there daily and a hospital nearby. Which isn't always the standard. Overall, what i found stood out the most, was how they treated people with humanity and respect. Often not the case in rehabs
0x30da3f88bc8c6209_0xa04a1a288e25582.author: Rajan Puri

0x30da3f88bc8c6209_0xa04a1a288e25582.text: I had two alcohol rehab experiences in the past, which were obviously not successful. My experience at The Hills has been different and extremely positive. After the initial alcohol detoxification during which I was constantly monitored, the rehab treatment started, addressing the core issues, deep healing and dynamic personal transformation. The therapist assigned to me has been absolutely fantastic and really help me to clarify my problems, prioritise and coping mechanisms. During my stay, I engaged in yoga, swimming, sport in a very well equipped gym, sound healing and mindfulness. Before my departure, the therapist and I review all strategies and tools to prevent a relapse. Staff are very professional, kind and efficient. The facilities and food at The Hills are what you would expect in a 5 star hotel. I strongly recommend The Hills to anyone in need, just don’t forgot your swimming goggles like I did (lol).👍👍👍❤️❤️
0x30da3f88bc8c6209_0xa04a1a288e25582.author: Fatinia Adinah

0x30e29f2c05a690b5_0xec94f08941883013.text: Today, I went to use my remaining service voucher after not visiting for 1-2 years. I called to inquire and was told I could come in. I contacted them at 1:30 PM, but there was an available slot at 4:30 PM, so I would have to wait about 3 hours. I was happy to wait. However, a staff member called to inform me that an earlier appointment had been cancelled at 3:45 PM, so I was able to receive the service sooner. During the hair examination, they said my hair was healthier and suggested I continue purchasing the treatment and do it in conjunction with other services, but I declined because I wanted to try the treatment first. When it was time for the vitamin injection, the staff had prepared the vitamins and was about to enter the room when, after some discussion, they informed me that they had run out of shampoo. If I wanted to continue, I would have to buy a bottle for 1200 baht. I didn't mind the price, but I felt why wasn't this mentioned earlier? The clinic had over 2 hours to prepare. And the way they handled the situation was lacking; there was no notification to the customer or a subsequent apology, even though they assumed I was in a hurry. - After 10 minutes, the clinic called to apologize and said that if I came for service again next time, I could have my hair washed first and then receive the vitamin injection. - They called a second and third time, wanting me to return for service and promising better care. I was already planning to purchase more because I wanted to return for more services. Experiencing this made me understand things better and feel like I wasn't treated properly. Including solving problems that make you trust and return to using the service again. Today, I planned to use my remaining treatment sessions after not visiting for 1–2 years. I called the clinic first, and they confirmed that I could use the service. I contacted them at around 1:30 PM, but the available slot was at 4:30 PM, so I had to wait for about three hours, which I was willing to do. Later, a staff member called and informed me that an earlier appointment at 3:45 PM had been canceled, so I was able to use the service earlier. During the hair check, the staff told me that my hair condition had improved. They recommended that I buy another package and continue the treatment, but I decided not to purchase it yet because I wanted to try the service again first. When it was time for the vitamin treatment, the staff had already prepared the vitamins and was about to take me into the treatment room. Suddenly, after talking with another staff member, they came back and told me that the shampoo had just run out. If I wanted to continue the treatment, I would have to buy a bottle for THB 1,200. The price was not the issue for me. What disappointed me was why no one informed me from the beginning. The clinic had more than two hours to prepare before my appointment. Also, I was disappointed with how the situation was handled at that moment. There was no clear explanation to the customer, and no follow-up apology call afterward, possibly because they thought I was in a hurry. About 10 minutes later, the clinic called to apologize and said that next time I could wash my hair before coming in and then receive the vitamin treatment right away. They called a second and third time, asking me to come back and saying that they would take better care of me. At first, I was actually considering buying another package because I planned to come back for the service. However, after this experience, I understood the situation more clearly. I felt that I did not receive proper service, and the way the problem was handled made it hard for me to trust the clinic enough to return again.
0x30e29f2c05a690b5_0xec94f08941883013.author: Aunatip Insiriphong

0x30e29e944e40c79f_0x3c4ad299a1b908d7.text: ขอบคุณสามีที่หาข้อมูลเจอคุณหมออาคม ปวดฟันคุดมาผ่าไม่เคยผ่าฟันคุดมาก่อนเลยแล้วคุณหมอให้ความรู้แน่นมาก เจอคุณหมอที่จริงใจที่เต็มที่ให้บริการอย่างดีไม่กั๊กไม่รีบ คุณหมอมือเบามากกลัวตอนฉีดยาชามากแต่คุณฉีดไม่เจ็บเลยตอนผ่าเหมือนไม่ได้ผ่าเลยมือเบามากไม่เจ็บคุณหมอคอยบอกทุกขั้นตอนที่กำลังทำมันดีมากๆสำหรับคนที่ขี่กังวลแบบเรา ผ่ามาได้ 5 วันแผลเย็บสมานดีมากไม่บวมไม่เจ็บเท่าที่คิดไว้เลย ทักไลน์สอบถามเพิ่มเติมหลังบริการคุณหมอตอบเองตลอดมีอะไรไม่สบายใจถามได้เลยคุณหมอให้ความรู้ดีมากๆค่ะ อยากบอกต่อมากๆค่ะคุณหมอเก่งมากๆเลยค่ะ ไม่เร่งไม่ขายคอร์สไม่กดดันอะไรเลยค่ะ มีลูกเล็กไปด้วยก็สอบถามเกี่ยวกับฟันลูกไปด้วยคุณให้คำแนะนำที่ตรงจริงๆที่ไปหาที่ไหนก็ไม่เจอ ขอบคุณคุณหมออาคมมากๆเลยค่ะ
0x30e29e944e40c79f_0x3c4ad299a1b908d7.en: Thank you to my husband for finding Dr. Arkom. I had a wisdom tooth extraction, and I'd never had one before. Dr. Arkom provided incredibly thorough information. He's a truly sincere and dedicated doctor, offering excellent service without holding anything back or rushing. He has a very gentle touch; I was very afraid of the anesthetic injection, but it didn't hurt at all. The extraction itself felt like it wasn't even surgery – his technique was so gentle. He explained every step of the procedure, which was fantastic for someone as anxious as me. Five days after the surgery, the stitches have healed very well; there's not as much swelling or pain as I expected. I contacted him via LINE for follow-up inquiries, and he responded personally. I could ask him anything that concerned me, and he provided excellent information. I highly recommend him; he's incredibly skilled. He didn't rush me, didn't try to sell me any packages, and there was no pressure. I even brought my young child with me, and he gave me very helpful and accurate advice – something I couldn't find anywhere else. Thank you so much, Dr. Arkom!

0x30e29facb7e28c31_0xbcb78e5cd1454ce2.text: To anyone who is afraid of painful dentist experience and do not have anywhere familiar to visit, I strongly recommend this place for your oral health care. I have had impact wisdom for years and the requirement of surgical extraction does not really encourage me to visit unfamiliar dentist even though I know the consequence of ignoring it can be excruciatingly painful. Finally under a close friend's recommendation I decided to give this Dr a visit while visiting Bangkok for a short vacation. I arrived her place without appointment together with my girlfriend slightly close to noon and thankfully she has no appointment that day. She did a full scan of me and my girlfriend and seen that we have much to do, she urged us to go for quick lunch. After lunch she wasted no time and started working with my girlfriend's teeth as mine requires more time. She girlfriend's work took slightly over an hour and she experience obvious skill superiority compared to the dentist back in her own country. As for myself, she took the balance of the time which is around 2 hours to polish, fill up a more critical fillings and surgically removal of 2 molars and 1 wisdom. The only discomfort I felt throughout the procedure was during the polishing and I have felt nothing about those extraction process. After the extraction and under her recommendation, I took a pain killer pill and that was it until I visit another dentist back in home country 10 days later to remove the thread for the stitches.
0x30e29facb7e28c31_0xbcb78e5cd1454ce2.author: Sia Siaw Yang

0x30e29facb7e28c31_0xbcb78e5cd1454ce2.text: I have visited Dr. Aubonrutt (periodontist) on the 07/08/18 due to my receding gums, to get a professional opinion on the issue. After the check up, she explaining in detail all the possible reasons for my problem, i.e made me aware of the correct brushing technique, the need for a guard against grinding my teeth and various other personal factors. After that she cleaned my teeth spotless, which took quite some time. Also the check up revealed multiple smaller cavities that needed fillings, which I did on a follow up visit. Overall I feel confident about Dr. Aubonrutt's work practices and professional advice and I will continue to use her services.

0x30e298a3b7683f0b_0x8b9972bd0c50c4e1.en: I usually go to the dentist at the hospital, but the last two times I asked the hospital dentist about cavities, and told them I was experiencing tooth sensitivity. The doctor examined me and said there were none. Two weeks later, the sensitivity increased, so I visited a local dental clinic because it's closer to home. The doctor examined me thoroughly and took X-rays for clarity, discovering deep cavities. They recommended fillings for one tooth and root canal treatment and a crown for the other. The doctor explained the procedure in detail, completed it within three weeks, and the price was reasonable. The doctor was very gentle. From now on, I'll probably go to the clinic closer to home instead of the hospital. Thank you so much, doctor, for detecting and treating the cavities in time, preventing the need for root canal treatment on the other tooth.

0x30e284f0d987e0a7_0x3e96656739fa7b72.author: Nuttarada
0x30e284f0d987e0a7_0x3e96656739fa7b72.en: We've trusted and received treatment from this doctor for almost 21 years. Both my mother and I have been receiving treatment from him since my child was in kindergarten until my child started working. We've had various procedures done, including scaling, extractions, dental implants, and dentures (and we'll be getting braces in the future...which is considered a difficult case). The doctor provides treatment options tailored to our dental condition and any underlying medical conditions. He answers questions patiently and doesn't rush or pressure us. He only treats patients when they are ready. It's truly rare to find a doctor with such professional ethics. The price might be slightly higher than other clinics, but it's worth it for peace of mind. You can try it yourself. You need to call and book an appointment in advance. The doctor has extensive experience and explains all the risks. Most recently, I had a wisdom tooth extracted. I considered doing it near home, but I didn't want to risk it. Finally, I decided to come a bit further for peace of mind and trust. Every other clinic I asked said, "Extraction is the only option." But the doctor said, "We'll try extraction first...if that doesn't work, then we'll proceed with surgery." As someone working in the medical field, this helps reduce the risk of infection and costs for patients. Sharing my direct experience. "...Not a 'bangs' (a term used to describe someone who is not a professional), but I have bangs." "...The 02 number is having problems." "Parking is free at Sukhothai Thammathirat Open University (STOU). Go through the gate, get a parking ticket, turn left, park, and walk across the road; it's easier that way. The clinic is on the same side as the Bangchak gas station & opposite STOU. It's the 4th unit in a commercial building almost at the bridge over the canal. The easiest way is to exit the expressway at Muang Thong Thani; I don't recommend entering via Chaeng Wattana Road.

0x30da3a937d5985c7_0xffc8b3d4b0c1d6ad.text: The first time I came, I encountered a queue taker. As I thought about it, another patient arrived at the same time. He had gotten his turn but couldn't find his card. He turned to me and said, "Go ahead, son." I thanked him and went to sign in. The staff member in a very curt tone said, "Sign in!!" Since it was my first time, I asked, "Would you like to take your medical history?" He replied, "Go sit down!" Until it was my turn, I gave my medical history late, and the queue taker told me to jump the queue. At that moment, I didn't think I was jumping the queue. Maybe I was just being too stingy. Honestly, the queue taker could have just told me to leave my name in the queue for you earlier. We were very happy to help. We didn't want to cause any problems. We were just here for treatment. The first person told us to go first, son, so I went to sign in. If I was wrong to leave my name in the queue for that person earlier, you can switch. I was fine with that. No problem. I can wait. We can tell you. We're quite understanding. But you shouldn't have acted so disrespectfully towards us. // We understand working with a lot of people, but doing this not only makes you look bad, but also damages your organization's reputation. I sincerely thank that patient for telling me to sign in first. I sincerely apologize to the patient who didn't write down their name to leave their appointment (you were scheduled ahead of us for that day's treatment), which I'm very comfortable with. You deserved to be there first. 🙏🏻🥹) Thank you again for your kindness. May you be healthy. 🙏🏻🥹 The doctor treated me very well. He was friendly, easy to talk to, relieved my anxiety, and provided excellent assistance to my patients. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

0x30e29d9a25897307_0xe3f3e935ab79a74e.text: ไม่ต้องการกลั่นแกล้งหรือใช้อารมณ์กับธุรกิจของใครนะคะ แต่ ปสก ที่ได้รับจากที่นี่ สร้างความ ไม่พึงพอใจอย่างยิ่ง ทำให้เสียเวลามากๆ ไม่โอเคด้วยประการทั้งปวง รู้สึกเหมือนถูกหลอก อยากทราบยินดีเล่า ปสก ส่วนตัว เพื่อเป็น วิทยาทานค่ะ เวลาเป็นสิ่งมีค่า อย่าเล่นกับความรู้สึกของคนไข้ และไม่ควรสร้างเม็ดเงินด้วยการบูลี่ ปมของคนไข้ ถ้าสวยพอแล้วจะมาหาหมอเพื่อตกแต่งเพิ่มทำไมคะ เหตุเกิด ที่คลินิกฟันแห่งหนึ่ง ที่มีระบบฉีดเติมผิวตกแต่งฟัน ซึ่ง เราพอใจเลือกแบบนี้เพราะลูกกลัวเจ็บ และจะได้ฝึกใช้ฟัน ที่ตกแต่งก่อนจะไปสู่ เทคนิคอื่นๆที่ต้องระวังรักษาฟันมากขึ้น ซึ่งวันแรกที่มาพบ รอคิวนานมาก วันนี้ก็ยังเลยเวลาไปครึ่ง ชม นัดแล้วเหมือนไม่ได้นัด รักษาเวลานัดให้ตรงไม่ได้ ในครั้งก่อนนั้นได้พบหมอ ๆ ทำแบบจำลองให้ดู มีการตกลงราคา 4หมื่นกว่าบาท ก็ทำมัดจำและ หมอได้ยืนยันว่าทำได้ ดีกว่าแบบจำลองแน่นอน เพราะจะมีการขัดมันด้วย จึงนัดกันทำจริงเป็นวันนี้ แต่ก่อนจะไปทำ ทางคลินิคโทรมาบอกว่า จะได้ทำกับหมออีกท่านนึงที่เก่งมากๆระดับประเทศเลย ก็โอเค ยืนยันนัดไป วันนี้ เหตุการณ์ที่พบคือ เมื่อพบหมอคนใหม่ หมอตำหนิฟันลูกหลายครั้ง ว่าฟันน้องซื่ใหญ่มาก ถ้าทำแบบฉีด ฟันจะใหญ่ไปกว่าเดิมอีก กลัวจะรับไม่ได้เมื่อทำเสร็จแล้ว แม่จึงเอารูปจำลองโดยหมอท่านเก่าให้ดู ก็นี่ไงคะ เราพอใจแล้ว ถ้าเป็นตามนี้ หมอคนใหม่ก็เอาแต่ย้ำว่าลูกฟันซี่ใหญ่ ทำแบบฉีดแล้วกลัวรับไม่ได้ แม่จึงขอคุยกับหมอโดยตรง ว่า หมอกรุณา อย่าใช้คำพูดจี้ปมน้องแบบนั้น ขอแค่ ทำตามแบบจำลองที่หมอท่านก่อนทำ ให้ดู เราพอใจแล้ว หมอยังอิดออด ทำให้คิดดีไม่ได้เลย ว่าเจตนา คืออยากให้ทำเป็น วีเนียร์ ให้ได้ใช่หรือไม่ ก็เลยยืนยันว่า น้องไม่ยินดีกรอฟัน แยกเหงือก แน่นอน น้องกลัวเจ็บ ให้ทำแบบฉีดไปก่อน หมอบอกว่า งั้นให้หมอคนเดิมมาทำ เราบอกว่าโอเค แต่พนง ด้านหน้าบอกว่า วันนี้ไม่ได้ต้องนัดใหม่ แต่ไม่ใช่วันนี้ หมอท่านนั้นไม่ได้มาตลอด อ้าว แต่วันก่อนเรานัดกันดิบดี กับหมอ กับ พนง พร้อมกันเลย คนที่เหมือนเป็นผู้ดูแล มาบอกว่า คลินิกให้หมอท่านนั้น ออกไปแล้ว อ้าว ความจริงคืออะไรคะ หมอไม่มาประจำ แต่ที่ทำนัดไว้ล่ะ ตอนนี้บอกว่า หมอออกไปแล้ว คลินิกขอจบ โดยการคืนเงินมัดจำ ดิฉันจึงบอกว่า โอเค และ ดิฉันจะรีวิว ให้ ค่ะ ยังสงสัยว่า ทางคลินิกให้หมอคนเก่านั้น ออกไปแล้ว ทำไมล่ะ ท่านเป็นหมอที่ให้ข้อมูลดี ตรงไปตรงมาแต่ไม่ทำร้ายจิตใจคนไข้ เหมือนที่เราเจอวันนี้ หรือว่าเพียงแค่ดึงลูกค้าเข้ามาด้วยเทคนิคง่าย ราคาไม่แพง แล้วมาต่อยอดขยับไปหา เทคนิคอื่น ???? ตามเป้า ไม่เช่นนั้น จะเปลี่ยนหมอที่ทำไม่ได้มาให้ทำไมกัน ระหว่างที่มีการโต้ตอบกันมีลูกค้าหลายท่านในคลินิก ได้ยินการพยายามขาย บอกเลยว่า ไม่ยินดีแนะนำค่ะ สำหรับ ชื่อจริง คลินิกบอกตรงนี้ไม่สะดวกค่ะ แต่ยินดีเล่าละเอียดให้เพื่อนสนิทฟังได้นะคะ คือไม่ใช่คนไม่เคยทำฟัน ทำมาตั้งแต่สาวยันแก่ ทั้งปากนี้เหมือนอมตึกไว้ทั้งหลัง รู้ดีว่า ฟันสวยสำคัญแค่ไหน และขั้นตอนก็รู้ดีมากๆ ที่เขียนนี้ไม่ได้อยากทำร้ายทำลายใคร แต่ไม่อยากให้เพื่อนๆ พลัดหลงเข้าไปค่ะ อยากให้โลกรู้เหมือนกันว่า คลินิกดีๆ ทำกันจนเป็นเพื่อนรักกับหมอ ก็มี คลินิกแย่ๆ ก็เคยเจอ วันนี้ก็รู้สึกแย่ บอกเลยว่า ตึกใหญ่ หรูหรา รีวิวจัดตั้งก็รู้ว่ามากมายล้วน ไม่ใช่ เครื่องยืนยัน ว่าทุกอย่างดี วันนี้ คือเรื่องราวที่แม่พาลูกรอดออกมาจาก วงการมายา ที่ทำสื่อของถูกเหมือนกับดักล่อ พอไม่ยอมขยับตาม ก็ขอจบด้วยการคืนมัดจำ แต่ความจดจำ ลูกค้า ที่เสียเวลากับเกมนี้ 2 วัน เสียความรู้สึก เพราะกลับมาบ้านแล้ว ลูกยังคงถาม ว่าฟันหนูซี่ใหญ่น่าเกลียดจริงไหมแม่ สิ่งเหล่านี้จะซ่อม หรือชดเชยยังไง
0x30e29d9a25897307_0xe3f3e935ab79a74e.en: I don't mean to be spiteful or emotional about anyone's business, but my experience here was extremely dissatisfying, a huge waste of time, and completely unacceptable. I felt like I was deceived. I'm happy to share my personal experience as a cautionary tale. Time is precious. Don't play with patients' feelings, and you shouldn't make money by bullying patients' insecurities. If my child's teeth were already beautiful enough, why would they need further enhancements? This incident occurred at a dental clinic that offers tooth enamel filler injections for cosmetic purposes. We chose this option because our child is afraid of pain and wanted to practice with the enhanced teeth before moving on to other techniques that require more careful dental care. On our first visit, we waited a very long time. Today, we were still half an hour late. It felt like we didn't have an appointment; they couldn't keep to the scheduled time. During our previous visit, the doctor showed us a model, and we agreed on a price of over 40,000 baht. We paid a deposit, and the doctor assured us that the procedure would be even better than the model because it would include polishing. We scheduled the actual procedure for today. However, before the procedure, the clinic called to say that we would be seeing another doctor who is considered highly skilled, at a national level. We agreed and confirmed the appointment. Today, the new doctor criticized my child's teeth multiple times. My daughter's teeth are very large, and I'm worried that if we do the injection method, they'll become even bigger and she won't be able to accept it after the procedure. So I showed the new dentist a simulation from our previous dentist. I said, "This is it. We're happy with this result." The new dentist kept emphasizing that my daughter's teeth are large and I'm afraid she won't be able to accept the injection method. I then asked to speak directly with the dentist, saying, "Please, don't use words that reinforce my daughter's insecurities. Just do the procedure as the previous dentist showed us. We're satisfied with that." The dentist hesitated, making me wonder if their intention was to get veneers done. I insisted that my daughter definitely wouldn't want any tooth grinding or gum separation; she's afraid of the pain. I asked them to do the injection method first. The dentist said, "Then have the previous dentist do it." We said okay. But the front desk staff said that we needed to schedule an appointment, but not for today, as that dentist isn't regularly available. But we had a formal appointment with both the dentist and the staff the day before! The person who seemed to be in charge said that the dentist had left the clinic. So what's the truth? Is the dentist just not regularly available? But what about the appointment I had? Now they say the doctor has left. The clinic offered to end the matter by returning my deposit. I said okay, and I would write a review. I'm still wondering why the clinic fired that doctor. He was a doctor who provided good information, was straightforward, and didn't hurt the patient's feelings like what I experienced today. Or are they just attracting customers with easy, inexpensive techniques, and then moving on to other techniques to achieve their goals? Otherwise, why would they change doctors who can't do the job? During the exchange, several customers in the clinic overheard the sales pitch. I can say I'm not happy to recommend this clinic. I'm not comfortable disclosing the clinic's real name here. But I'm happy to share the details with close friends. I'm not someone who's never had dental work done before; I've been doing it since I was young. My mouth is practically covered in dental work! I know how important beautiful teeth are, and I'm very familiar with the procedures. I'm not trying to harm or upset anyone with this, but I don't want my friends to fall for it. I want the world to know that there are good clinics where people become close friends with the doctors. I've also encountered bad clinics, and today I feel terrible. Let me tell you, a big, luxurious building and numerous positive reviews don't guarantee that everything is good. Today's story is about a mother who helped her child escape from the world of illusion, where cheap media is used as a trap. When the customer didn't comply, they simply returned the deposit. But the memory, the customer's wasted time on this game for two days, the heartbreak – even after returning home, the child kept asking, "Mom, is my tooth really big and ugly?" How can these things be fixed or compensated for?

0x30e29d0015c1633f_0x9791be2d0dcd6544.en: I'm terrified of dentists. This was my first visit in over 10 years. My blood pressure was 188 the first time I saw one. The dentist had me wait and then measured it again, at 194. He quickly gave me medication and sent me home. Last Saturday, I had another appointment, and it took two blood pressure readings (188, 164) to get it within the acceptable range. Both the dentist's assistant and the person who accompanied me were anxiously hoping it would go down. During the actual procedure, I didn't even know when the dentist injected the medication. The full-mouth scaling was only slightly painful; the dentist had incredibly gentle hands. I've been afraid for so long! I've scheduled follow-up appointments now. I regret letting this go on for so long. I highly recommend this dentist; you won't be disappointed!

0x30e29f60c122f74d_0xe5bf56df4a5d3635.text: Review of filler injection with Dr. Ploy Atmosphere/Location: The clinic is clean and not too difficult to get to. It's located in a small alley within another alley, about a 10-minute walk from the BTS station. The clinic has two floors, with one room upstairs. Service: The staff are lovely, polite, and friendly. They offered sweet drinks and blankets/pillows when I seemed afraid of needles. They followed up after the injection and explained the medication in an easy-to-understand way. Doctor: I had my injection with Dr. Ploy because I was mainly concerned about the area around my eyes. The admin informed me that Dr. Ploy is an ophthalmologist, so I chose her. She has a gentle touch; there was the normal pain from a deep needle insertion. She gave excellent advice, distributing the filler evenly across my face from the 3cc package I purchased. She didn't try to sell me more, only recommending specific areas I wanted to address. She offered suggestions for future appointments and didn't pressure me. Initially, I didn't plan on getting filler, but she also added filler to my chin, making my face look softer. She was very patient and took breaks to allow me to prepare. I will definitely come back for more injections with her. Results: About two days later, I love how I look. I feel like I've had enough sleep, and my face looks slimmer. Shallow under-eye grooves, slightly flat cheeks, a little eye lift, a subtle chin enhancement – ​​very natural-looking. Price: We used the 14,999 baht promotion and got 3cc of Elasty, which works out to about 5,000 baht per cc. It was okay, I was satisfied. I paid the same price upon leaving the clinic; there were no additional purchases. Overall, it was good. This was my first time getting filler injections, and I think I'll come back for more services.

0x30e283696aabe5dd_0x640bc81310dd0da3.text: เป็นการจัดฟันที่มาไกลมากๆจริงๆ หนูจัดฟันแบบ เทคนิค Alexander รายละเอียดค่อนข้างเยอะและปราณีตมากๆค่ะ ได้รับคำชมจากเพื่อน คนใกล้ชิดและลูกค้าในโรงแรมเยอะมากๆค่ะ แต่ถ้าหนูได้เข้ามาตามนัดตามโปรแกรมคงสวยและเสร็จไปนานแล้ว😅ขนาดไม่ค่อยได้เข้ามาหาคุณหมอฟันยังเรียงสวยอยู่นะคะ แล้วเทคและการถอนฟันก็ไม่เหมือนที่อื่นเท่าที่สอบถามเพื่อนๆมาค่าใช้จ่ายของหนูค่อนข้างสูงกว่าเพื่อนถ้านับเป็นก้อน แต่ไม่ค่อยมีค่าใช้จ่ายยิบย่อยเหมือนของเพื่อนค่ะ จบตามที่คุยกับคุณหมอเลยค่ะ ตอนนี้เพื่อนถอดเครื่องมือแล้วแล้วฟันค่อนข้างห่างเลยค่ะ เพื่อนถอนบนล่าง4+4 หนูถอนบนล่าง5+5ค่ะ (คุณหมอแนะนำค่ะถ้าถอนเบอร์5จะสวยแล้วเข้ารูปสวยกว่า)ที่นี้คุณหมอใส่ใจรายละเอียดมากๆใช้เวลาค่อนข้างเยอะกับเราค่ะคุยตกลงกับคุณหมอได้ค่ะคุณหมอคุยง่ายใจดีพี่พยาบาลก็น่ารักค่ะ☺️🥰

0x30e283696aabe5dd_0x640bc81310dd0da3.en: This orthodontic treatment has come a really long way! I'm using the Alexander technique, which is quite detailed and meticulous. I've received many compliments from friends, family, and hotel guests. If I had followed my appointments regularly, my teeth would probably be perfectly aligned and finished much sooner!😅 Even though I haven't been to the dentist often, my teeth are still beautifully aligned. The technique and tooth extraction are also different from other places. From what I've gathered from my friends, my costs are higher than theirs if calculated as a lump sum, but I didn't have as many additional hidden costs as they did. Everything went exactly as we discussed with the dentist. My friend has already had her braces removed, and her teeth are quite spaced apart. She had 4+4 teeth extracted upper and lower, while I had 5+5 extracted upper and lower (the dentist recommended extracting only 5 teeth for a better and more aesthetically pleasing result). The dentist here is very attentive to detail and spends a considerable amount of time with us. We were able to communicate and come to an agreement with the dentist; he's easy to talk to and kind, and the nurses are lovely too.☺️🥰

0x30da3a62212f552f_0xfe6f5a2f5e2bb20e.text: I came to this clinic with my partner because I had a large, painful cyst on my face. I explained the situation to the doctor and asked what my options were, and what she recommended I should do. I also mentioned that I can’t take antibiotics due to ongoing stomach issues. As soon as I said that, she stood up immediately and basically showed me the door — no advice, no alternative options, no attempt to help, nothing. The next day I went to another skin clinic and they took it seriously straight away and told me to go to the hospital, which is where I’m writing this now. I’m honestly shocked by the level of care and professionalism I received here. It felt like the doctor had zero interest in helping unless she could prescribe antibiotics, and dismissing a patient like that is not acceptable. Avoid this clinic.

0x30da3a62212f552f_0xfe6f5a2f5e2bb20e.text: I used to have a severe itchy rash on my legs. Sometimes I'd scratch it in my sleep and wake up bleeding. The doctor here said treatment would take at least 6 months, so I endured the treatment there. During that time, the doctor kept giving me the same medication even though my condition didn't improve, and told me to buy expensive skin creams. After 6 months, the rash hadn't gone away, so I went to a hospital instead. The doctor at the hospital reviewed the medications I had been using and said they weren't effective; the condition wouldn't go away without medication. So, the doctor prescribed a new medication, just one drug, which improved immediately in just one week.

People don't know anything about this. Terrible service, a waste of time. They even told us to go to another clinic that stays open later! The point is, why stay open if there's no doctor? Just wasting electricity? Or are they only hiring doctors until 6 PM?! Awful. They wasted people's time, especially sick patients who had to go through all that trouble to get here and then encountered an irresponsible clinic that lied and deceived them by saying they closed at 7 PM when the doctor had actually disappeared at 6 PM. This kind of thing happens… Why stay open if you don't announce that you're closed on the website/Google Maps? I strongly advise against coming here. They can't even explain their opening and closing times and doctor management. If they can't even do things right, how can they provide medical care to patients!?!? The worst! Highly do not recommend this place… Run away as far as you can. This place doesn't deserve even a star!

0x310297174c6e7c85_0x66f2512ccb2fe951.text: Doctors should speak at the appropriate time. Patients come to the doctor to describe their symptoms, and the doctor should inform them, not question them in return. If I knew, why would I come to the doctor? I could just stay home and treat myself. And then you're talking about education regarding medical certificates? My existing medical license doesn't allow me to get one, but other doctors can. I've attended regular check-ups, but you know what? I'm here for a check-up, not to be lectured about my rights. If you don't want it, that's it. I took time off work to see a doctor, get medication, and rest. I didn't want to be lectured by a doctor. If I go back to my old job, I'll just get sick again, and how will I ever recover? Are you suggesting I quit? And you didn't even inform me of my symptoms before prescribing medication. Whether it's allergies or a cold, who would want to treat me like that? Go to another clinic that's better equipped to provide good service. I don't even want to give you one star. And this isn't the first time!

0x30da3103e0dd4ddf_0x1ae4560ed2843f0e.text: I’d got myself into a bit of a rut after severely breaking my leg 4 years ago , my pain was intense to say the least and I was finding myself taking a lot of painkillers to try and manage my daily pain , opiates are great for pain but unfortunately they are extremely addictive and appear to cause pretty bad lethargy and tend to make one quite uninspired , unfortunately I’d become extremely lazy and was just plotting through life , having been quite fit in the past I’d managed to gain a lot of weight and was not happy with my appearance and lack of interest in anything, I needed a kick start big time . After speaking to Darren and telling him I needed to be reinvigorated and get off these painkillers him and I devised a plan , Darren is a good guy and he will give you a straight up answer . I knew what the jig was as ive danced this dance before . You will arrive at Jintara and they will have your roadmap ready , if you need to be detoxed from a certain substance they’ll do it for you slowly and safely depending on your poison , you will attend classes for 2 hours each week day morning , now these classes will guide you through why you do what you do , they will give you the tools you need to heal yourself and indeed there are sprinkles of gold dust among them ,the rest of the time you are exercising on your own terms at your own pace , with a plethora of extras including massage , Reiki , meditation, swimming , pickleball , Muay Thai and possibly most importantly your 121 councillor appointment twice weekly, it’s all there for you , you just have to give the program a chance . The food is fantastic, 3 professionally served nutritious meals daily and my fav , fresh fruit with every meal and if you wanna buy some junk food, you can as there are 7/11 visits and Rimping Supermarket on Saturday after the excursion, which is always pretty great . The Staff are fantastic and actually do care , the nurses Max and Oh are serious professionals who will take care of all your needs , the support staff are fantastic always smiling and happy to help , Tong , Tang , Nook and rest are great people , you’re Client Liaison will be June , she will take care of pretty much anything you need , June is a fantastic person and seriously great at her job always happy and Smiling and there to lent a hand , Infact they all are absolutely great and if you wanna get fit Lek is your man , I can honestly say I really liked all the staff members . Denise and Hannan and Rebecca are the therapists and they are all highly respected and skilled at their jobs , Denise most definitely helped me a lot with finding myself again . It took be a while to get motivated but once I did I found myself back in the zone again , I’ve been swimming and going to gym constantly for the past month and I can feel myself getting stronger and back to where I need to be , yeah ive got a long way to go but I’ve started , I’ve had the kick start which is 100% why I came . If you have any fears or reservations about coming to Jintara Rehab , don’t , it’s only 10 people max at any one time so you’re not just another number , you matter , they will get you on the the main road again , of course you will need to put in the work as well , im over a week out and honestly feeling the best I have in a long time
0x30da3103e0dd4ddf_0x1ae4560ed2843f0e.author: Dave Foxmill

0x30da3103e0dd4ddf_0x1ae4560ed2843f0e.text: Jintara review I came to Jintara and left feeling like I could beat addiction forever and learned to love and respect myself like never before. I really wish you reading this comment the best of luck as I partly feel I know what it’s like where you are now. I was so anxious and terrified about making the wrong choice going to rehab after hearing countless horror stories. I can truly say with so much confidence that Jintara was the best choice I could have made. Initially speaking to Darren I was very paranoid about going to rehab for the first time and being treated like a number, falling back to relapse and simply not getting what I needed, the healing and direction to start a better life. Of all the places I called, Darren was the only one who spent an hour with me listening to what state I’d gotten myself in and connected with me on exactly why his team could ensure my success. I probably think most people are salesy and Darren was no different but I was so wrong and have nothing but admiration for what he’s trying to do for people like you and I. I hated myself, I was lost and had thoughts of giving up. I’d resigned myself to never getting out of the hole I was in and was so confused about why I didn’t operate like a ‘normal’ person in life. One day I turned around in Jintara and realised all the work I was putting in, listening/contributing in group, forcing myself out of my room to socialise, participating in anything and everything, that I had begun loving myself, gaining confidence and felt there was a path forward. Jintara focused on providing a calm environment that offered me the chance to become physically, mentally and spiritually fit. I lost 9 kg, became very convinced of mindfulness and its ability to help regulate emotions and learned everything about addiction, why I fell into it and how to beat it going forward. They really do put the therapy first, and somehow make it extremely cost effective with the yummy meals, PT, yoga, Muay Thai, reiki, meditation and an environment with others looking to support each other constantly being prioritised so you are as comfy as you can be to focus on yourself. As of writing this I’m 90 days sober and not a thought of ever going back to substances. I really feel if you’ve suffered trauma in your life that this place is the perfect path for your recovery and if I could I’d jump on a call and tell you exactly why! I can’t so instead I hope this review gives you some peace that though there’s relatively few of them, the reviews say a lot about this place and how focused Darren and his team are on your recovery. I miss them all dearly and some really felt like family and friends by the end but I was excited to go home knowing I had a new life waiting to burst into. I wish you all the best and please make a choice you know will get you to a better place, Jintara was that for me x
0x30da3103e0dd4ddf_0x1ae4560ed2843f0e.author: James Bamford

0x30da3103e0dd4ddf_0x1ae4560ed2843f0e.text: Just over one year ago, my son was at a low point in his life. He was drinking to excess, was not concentrating on his university studies and was generally unhappy. He said to me that when he walked down the street, he hoped that a car would knock him over and kill him. One of his hobbies is golf and I had booked a tee time at a course that he was very keen to play but when the time came, he was unable to get out of bed. He came to us that evening and said that he really needed help and was ready to go into rehab. We sent him to Jintara and he stayed for two months. During that time, he participated in all counselling sessions and other activities, including exercising, playing badminton and going to the driving range. He came out a totally changed person. He set goals for himself, which he was keen to achieve. He wanted to stay clean and joined Alcoholics Anonymous to get a support structure. We said that he could go to a week´s refresher course at Jintara if he stayed clean for a year and this was a big incentive. He wanted to improve his golf game and get a lower handicap than his father (me). And he wanted to be successful in his degree studies. He has achieved all of his first-year objectives. He has been clean for over a year and continues to enjoy a clean life. His golf game has improved by probably 10 strokes (he is now better than his father) and he is taking his schoolwork seriously and is getting good grades. He is also a much nicer and friendlier person and he is physically fitter. It has not been an easy year. His old friends did not fully appreciate what he was doing and most of those are no longer in his circle but he has made a lot of new friends. We went to Jintara with him when he returned for his refresher course and met Darren and the staff and we were very impressed with their approach. They are very caring and have a system which works for those clients who put in an effort. They certainly laid the groundwork for Billy to successfully learn how to live with and control his addiction.
0x30da3103e0dd4ddf_0x1ae4560ed2843f0e.author: Frank Buck

0x30da3103e0dd4ddf_0x1ae4560ed2843f0e.text: I HAVE MY SON BACK THANKS TO JINTARA.... A little over a year ago, our son came to his father and me and said that the time had come, that he couldn’t go on the way he was going and that he needed to be in rehab. At that point, alcohol was winning – my beautiful baby had become a 33 year old alcoholic and it was destroying his life. School, relationships – even with me – were suffering. He was depressed and his life was out of control, and there was nothing I could do about it. Thankfully he asked for help – and we found Jintara. Less than a week later, he was on a plane to Chiangmai. For the next two months, he met with counselors, started exercising, and learned that he could have fun and enjoy life without drinking. There was no shame involved. The wonderful people at Jintara taught him how to be himself again, without alcohol. The change in him was nothing short of profound. Each time he called us (and the calls & WhatsApp chats were frequent), I saw a change in him. It started small and just kept growing. He was actually enjoying getting rid of poisons in his life. Somehow Jintara made it seem easy to us. Of couse, we know it wasn’t – but it did seem that way. He came home a changed person. He was able to focus on his studies, stick to a schedule so that he could get his work done, go to the gym, attend AA meetings, and make new friends who are happy to support him. Our son hasn’t had a drink in more than a year, and he went back to Jintara for a one week refresher to help him stay on track to continue leading a clean and sober life. I can see how proud he is of himself, I know how proud I am of him, and especially how thankful I am to Jintara for giving my son back to me. No matter how old your child is, they are still your child – and if your child needs help to fight an addiction, I urge you to talk to Darren and the people at Jintara. You and your child won’t regret it.
0x30da3103e0dd4ddf_0x1ae4560ed2843f0e.author: Jane Buck

I was very impressed. It's recommended to make an appointment in advance for convenience, but waiting for an available slot is manageable.

0x30e298ea0acc6967_0x2ac4f94453589cf7.text: คุณหมอน่ารักมากคะพาญาติไปปรึกษาการจัดฟันคุณหมอหล่อน่ารักมากคะแนะนำทุกขั้นตอนในการจัดฟันเพื่อให้เราตัดสิ้นใจในการจัดฟันผู้ช่วยน่ารักคะให้คำแนะนำก่อนเจอคุณหมอน่ารักมากๆๆคะ
0x30e298ea0acc6967_0x2ac4f94453589cf7.author: Suwannapoo Khiewsri
0x30e298ea0acc6967_0x2ac4f94453589cf7.en: The doctor is very lovely. I brought my relative to consult about orthodontic treatment, and the doctor is very pretty and kind. She explained every step of the orthodontic treatment process to help us make a decision. The assistant is also lovely and gave advice before meeting the doctor. Everything was great!

0x30e298ea0acc6967_0x2ac4f94453589cf7.text: มาอุดฟันและขูดหินปูน คุณหมอน่ารักมากเลยค่ะให้คำปรึกษาดี สอนใช้ไหมขัดฟันและการแปรงฟันให้สะอาดถูกวิธีด้วยค่ะ 🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰
0x30e298ea0acc6967_0x2ac4f94453589cf7.author: Sikhram phormmala
0x30e298ea0acc6967_0x2ac4f94453589cf7.en: I came for a filling and teeth cleaning. The dentist was so lovely and gave great advice. She also taught me how to use dental floss and how to brush my teeth properly. 🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰

0x30e298ea0acc6967_0x2ac4f94453589cf7.text: คลินิกเกี่ยวกับฟัน ย่านคลองต้นไทร ใกล้สะพานลอย ทำฟัน จัดฟัน อุดฟัน ขูดหินปูน เคลือบฟลูออไรด์ รักษารากฟัน ชาวบ้านแถวนีต้องมาที่นี่บริการดีไม่แพง ตรวจและให้คำปรึกษาโดยแพทย์ปริญญา ผู้ประกันตนไม่ต้องสำรองจ่าย ต้องหาที่จอดรถเองครับ
0x30e298ea0acc6967_0x2ac4f94453589cf7.author: Sombat Honghem
0x30e298ea0acc6967_0x2ac4f94453589cf7.en: A dental clinic in the Khlong Ton Sai area, near the pedestrian overpass. They offer various dental services including fillings, braces, scaling, fluoride treatments, and root canal treatment. Locals in the area frequent this clinic for good service at affordable prices. Examinations and consultations are provided by licensed dentists. Insured patients do not need to pay upfront. Parking is available for self-collection.

0x30e298ea0acc6967_0x2ac4f94453589cf7.text: เวปไซต์​แจ้งเปิด9 โมง ไปถึงพนักงานแจ้งหมอมา10โมงมาเลทนิดๆ รับคนไข้ที่นัดไว้เข้าก่อน เท่ากับรอชม.กว่าๆ เดินไปถามบอกอีกนานไหมกว่าจะได้พบหมอ พนักงานแจ้งว่าต้องทำลูกค้าที่มีคิวนัดก่อน ลูกค้ามีธุระที่ไหนไหมคะ? พนักงานพูดจาดีไพเราะแต่คำถามนี้ควรถามและแจ้งตั้งแต่ตอนเข้ามาลงชื่อแล้วไหม จะได้พิจารณาและตัดสินใจว่าจะรอหรือไปร้านอื่นไม่ใช่ให้นั่งรอ หรือต้องไปถามเอง สรุปไม่ได้ทำ เสียเวลาฟรี
0x30e298ea0acc6967_0x2ac4f94453589cf7.author: JCahme B
0x30e298ea0acc6967_0x2ac4f94453589cf7.en: The website stated opening time was 9 am. Upon arrival, the staff informed me that the doctor would arrive at 10 am, slightly late. They prioritized patients with scheduled appointments, meaning I waited over an hour. When I asked how much longer it would be to see the doctor, the staff replied that they would prioritize those with appointments and asked if I had any other errands to run. The staff was polite and courteous, but this question should have been asked and stated when I signed in. That way, I could have considered whether to wait or go to another clinic, instead of being told to sit and wait or having to ask myself. In short, I didn't get treated; it was a waste of time.

0x30e298ea0acc6967_0x2ac4f94453589cf7.text: นัดขูดหินปูน 15:00 มารอก่อนเวลากับแฟน 2 คน กว่าแฟนจะได้เข้า 15:07 ช้า 7 นาที พอเข้าใจกันได้ พอแฟนผมทำเสร็จตอน 15:25 ต่อไปคิวผมให้นั่งรอจนถึง 16:01 พอถามว่าทำอะไรตอบมาว่า "กินข้าว" คิดได้ยังไงให้ลูกค้ามานั่งรอคุณกินข้าว 36 นาที คนอื่นเขาก็มีธุระปะปางต้องไปทำ ไม่เคารพเวลาของคนอื่น และไม่รู้กาลเทศะ แย่มาก
0x30e298ea0acc6967_0x2ac4f94453589cf7.author: Patcharawat Chotiratparkorn
0x30e298ea0acc6967_0x2ac4f94453589cf7.en: I had a teeth cleaning appointment at 3:00 PM. My girlfriend and I arrived early. She didn't get in until 3:07 PM, 7 minutes late, which we understood. My girlfriend finished at 3:25 PM, and I was made to wait until 4:01 PM. When I asked what they were doing, they replied, "Eating." How could they make customers wait 36 ​​minutes while they eat? Other people have errands to run too. It's disrespectful and shows a lack of courtesy. Terrible.

0x30e2992fbccce3bd_0x1a9c005263676a4f.text: I've never been to a doctor here; I only came for medical certificates for work. Before, there was an older woman at the counter whose manners were exactly as other reviews described. Even though I wasn't there for a doctor, her rudeness made me hesitant to come back. Latest update: The older woman is gone. I met another female staff member who provided excellent service. It was very empty; I was the only patient in the clinic around 6:30 PM.
0x30e2992fbccce3bd_0x1a9c005263676a4f.author: Yinne Review

0x30e2992fbccce3bd_0x1a9c005263676a4f.text: An old favorite, I've been coming here since I was a kid. The doctor's family is lovely and friendly❣️😁❣️ The best in my heart. If you have any questions, just ask, the doctor explains everything like you're studying medicine. …
0x30e2992fbccce3bd_0x1a9c005263676a4f.author: Daiki at บรรทัดทอง

0x30e2992fbccce3bd_0x1a9c005263676a4f.text: It's great! The doctor is kind and the prices aren't exorbitant. Even though the owner, an elderly lady, isn't very welcoming, it's okay. We went to the doctor to treat Jaa.
0x30e2992fbccce3bd_0x1a9c005263676a4f.author: ศัสยมน ทรัพย์โกศารักษ์

0x30e2992fbccce3bd_0x1a9c005263676a4f.text: The doctor is very kind and friendly. We've been treated here for over 10 years. We've been going here for all our illnesses, from my father's generation to my own.
0x30e2992fbccce3bd_0x1a9c005263676a4f.author: บุญแร่ ทอง

0x30e2992fbccce3bd_0x1a9c005263676a4f.text: Dr. Manas and his family possess the spirit of a true physician: compassionate, generous, fair-priced, and helpful to the surrounding community.
0x30e2992fbccce3bd_0x1a9c005263676a4f.author: kamolpun punpuing

0x30e2992fbccce3bd_0x1a9c005263676a4f.text: I've been receiving treatment here since I was a child, and now it's been over thirty years. It's very effective for treating coughs and colds.
0x30e2992fbccce3bd_0x1a9c005263676a4f.author: คุณพ่อตกปลา พาลูกเที่ยว

0x30e2992fbccce3bd_0x1a9c005263676a4f.text: The service at the counter was terrible. I told them I was genuinely sick and just told them to go see a doctor, saying "Then go see a doctor yourself." I was confused why they would talk like that when I was there for a check-up. Their attitude was awful. Initially, I admitted I came to buy a medical certificate, but they wouldn't sell one. I decided to see a doctor because I had a fever and hives, but they didn't ask about my symptoms at all and just told me to go see a doctor elsewhere. I initially didn't go to the hospital because I thought a clinic would be faster. I've encountered this kind of behavior at the counter many times. If they're unhappy about something, they just say it nicely, instead of chasing me away like a dog.
0x30e2992fbccce3bd_0x1a9c005263676a4f.author: Siriruk Thaweesuk

0x30e2992fbccce3bd_0x1a9c005263676a4f.text: The lady at the counter could be nicer. We've been coming here since we were kids because we used to live in the area. We stopped by today while driving because we weren't feeling well, but she's still consistently unpleasant. She's exactly the same as before; she's just as unfriendly as she used to be. No matter how good the treatment is, if she's not welcoming, we'll pass.
0x30e2992fbccce3bd_0x1a9c005263676a4f.author: Toey 21

0x305031252b56927b_0xd058656446afdef2.text: I've been to many clinics, but this is the first time I felt like there was no pressure to buy anything, and the doctor explained everything well. I got exactly what I wanted based on the references I presented. I really liked it.
0x305031252b56927b_0xd058656446afdef2.author: ไม่ถือสา แต่ว่ามันรู้สึก

0x305031252b56927b_0xd058656446afdef2.text: I really liked it. The masseuse was gentle, gave good advice, and wasn't pushy. It felt like going to a cafe or visiting a friend's house.
0x305031252b56927b_0xd058656446afdef2.author: Vorachet Loetkeattiyot

0x305031252b56927b_0xd058656446afdef2.text: The staff were very kind and approachable. The doctor was also very lovely. There were plenty of snacks to eat while waiting.
0x305031252b56927b_0xd058656446afdef2.author: palmy23 tan

0x305031252b56927b_0xd058656446afdef2.text: The clinic is clean, well-maintained, and safe. The doctor is lovely, and the staff are very friendly. I was very impressed.
0x305031252b56927b_0xd058656446afdef2.author: Supitchaya Aryamueang

0x305031252b56927b_0xd058656446afdef2.text: Great deal, genuine products, Dr. Jet's facial injections are amazing! No need to fly to Bangkok anymore.
0x305031252b56927b_0xd058656446afdef2.author: Ah-pae Chermuegu

0x305031252b56927b_0xd058656446afdef2.text: The doctor gave excellent advice. The staff were lovely, and the clinic was clean. I was very impressed.
0x305031252b56927b_0xd058656446afdef2.author: Rungsak Potchanee

0x305031252b56927b_0xd058656446afdef2.text: The staff are all lovely. I'll definitely come back again. The doctor has a very gentle touch.
0x305031252b56927b_0xd058656446afdef2.author: arlisa

0x305031252b56927b_0xd058656446afdef2.text: Dr. Ta is very lovely and has a very gentle touch. I highly recommend coming to see her.
0x305031252b56927b_0xd058656446afdef2.author: สิปปกร มันทรานนท์

0x311d5f453f0faa39_0x5ddf2e2ed2aef6a1.text: Great experience being looked after with attention to detail. Highly recommended with their service. Will be coming back when I'm back in Thailand 🇹🇭 🫡
หมอเว็บกับผู้ช่วยหมอเก่งมากพูดจาเพราะให้คำแนะนำดีพนักงานเอาใจใส่ดีตอบแซทไวใช้สิทธิ์30ได้ด้วยพนักงานทุกคนในร้านพูดจาเพราะน่ารักทุกคนเลยแนะนำร้านเลยคะ
0x311d5f453f0faa39_0x5ddf2e2ed2aef6a1.author: อิสสราวดี ศรีไพบูลย์
0x311d5f453f0faa39_0x5ddf2e2ed2aef6a1.en: The doctor and his assistant are excellent, speak politely, and give good advice. The staff are attentive, respond quickly to messages, and you can use your 30 baht discount. All the staff in the shop are polite and lovely. I highly recommend this shop!

0x311d5f453f0faa39_0x5ddf2e2ed2aef6a1.text: ต้องขอบคุณหมอพลอยฟันเด็กและทีมงาน เป็นอย่างสูงที่ล๊อคลูกสาววัย5ขวบได้ดีมากๆค่ะสำหรับถินฟันน้ำนม ทถกท่านพูดจาสุถาพและใจเย็นมากๆ4คน ล๊อคเพื่อถอนฟัน
0x311d5f453f0faa39_0x5ddf2e2ed2aef6a1.en: Many thanks to Dr. Ploy, the pediatric dentist, and her team for doing an excellent job holding my 5-year-old daughter in place for the extraction of her baby tooth. Everyone was very polite and patient. Four people were involved in holding the tooth in place for extraction.

0x311d5f453f0faa39_0x5ddf2e2ed2aef6a1.text: คุณหมอมือเบา ทำไว ใจดี มากค่ะ พี่พนักงานหน้าเคาเตอร์ก็บริการดี แนะนำดีมากค่ะ ใช้สิทธิบัตรทอง ไม่เสียค่าใช้จ่ายเลย ขั้นตอนไม่ซับซ้อนค่ะ
0x311d5f453f0faa39_0x5ddf2e2ed2aef6a1.author: Preem Ss
0x311d5f453f0faa39_0x5ddf2e2ed2aef6a1.en: The doctor was gentle, efficient, and very kind. The counter staff were also very helpful and provided excellent advice. I used my government health insurance, so there were no charges at all. The process was not complicated.

0x311d5f453f0faa39_0x5ddf2e2ed2aef6a1.text: คุณหมอและพี่ๆผู้ช่วย น่ารักและเป็นกันเองทุกคนเลยค่ะ คุณหมอใจดีม้ากกๆ มีแวะให้เราพักยกด้วยฮะ แงงง 💗🙏🏻
0x311d5f453f0faa39_0x5ddf2e2ed2aef6a1.author: Kotchakorn Punnapirom
0x311d5f453f0faa39_0x5ddf2e2ed2aef6a1.en: The doctor and all the assistants were so lovely and friendly. The doctor was incredibly kind and even let us take a break! 💗🙏🏻

0x311d5f453f0faa39_0x5ddf2e2ed2aef6a1.text: ปกติ เป็นลูกค้าที่นี่ เข้ามาทำฟันหลายครั้ง ทุกครั้งจะนัด11โมง ไม่เคยเลจ บางทีไปก็ต้องรอ แต่รอบนี้ไปสาย17นาทีเพราะมีอุบัตเหตุทำให้รถติด ไปถึงก็แจ้งชื่อที่เคาน์เตอร์จนท.พูดว่า ลูกค้านัด11โมง ต้องมาให้ตรงเวลานะคะ ด้วยน้ำเสียงและท่าทางที่สัมผัสได้ว่าต่อว่าเรา ซึ่งเราก็ไม่ได้พูดอะไร และเขาก็พูดอะไรต่อไม่รู้เพราะเสียงรถมอเตอร์ไซค์มา เลยถามกลับว่า พูดว่าอะไรนะคะ เขายิ้มแบบยิงฟันบอกว่าไปนั่งค่ะ ซึ่งเราไม่โอเค เราจะไปจัดฟันเลยไม่กล้า จริงๆคุณหมอที่นี่น่ารักนะ คงต้องหาที่ใหม่ คนเราเจตนาคืออะไรในใจรู้ดีที่สุด
0x311d5f453f0faa39_0x5ddf2e2ed2aef6a1.author: นุชรี ธุพําําพภภึพพภภจขระพันธ์
0x311d5f453f0faa39_0x5ddf2e2ed2aef6a1.en: I'm a regular customer here, having been to the dentist many times. My appointments are always at 11 am, and I've never been late, although sometimes I have to wait. But this time, I was 17 minutes late because of a traffic accident. When I arrived, I gave my name at the counter, and the staff member said, "You have an 11 am appointment, you must be on time," in a tone and demeanor that clearly indicated she was scolding me. I didn't say anything, and she said something else I couldn't understand because a motorcycle approached. I asked, "What did you say?" She just grinned and told me to sit down. I wasn't comfortable with that. I'm planning to get braces, so I didn't dare speak up. The dentist here is actually very nice. I guess I'll have to find a new place. People know their intentions best in their hearts.

0x26c39ffd89d2a3b7_0x80f754de3e571ea8.text: I initially decided to get this done because I felt self-conscious about the front of my hair. I was constantly worried when taking photos or tying my hair up. After the procedure, you have to wait a while for the results; it's not an immediate change. But once my hair started growing back and the style became clearer, I felt it was worth it. Now I don't have to worry about it like before. Dr. Mai gave excellent advice.
0x26c39ffd89d2a3b7_0x80f754de3e571ea8.author: Sirawita Duangjan

0x26c39ffd89d2a3b7_0x80f754de3e571ea8.text: Previously, I had thinning hair on my forehead and a receding hairline, so I decided to consult a hair transplant clinic. After reading many reviews, I ultimately chose this clinic because the doctor explained everything in detail, assessed my hairline, and it looked natural. The doctor was also very skilled and kind. All the staff were friendly and provided excellent service.
0x26c39ffd89d2a3b7_0x80f754de3e571ea8.author: ภาณุเดช สายทอง

0x26c39ffd89d2a3b7_0x80f754de3e571ea8.text: The doctor and team provided excellent care from the initial consultation, through the hair transplant planning, to the actual procedure. The results were outstanding; my hair has grown back fully, and I see a significant difference compared to before the procedure. Post-operative care and consultation were also excellent.
0x26c39ffd89d2a3b7_0x80f754de3e571ea8.author: Mark Markawan

0x26c39ffd89d2a3b7_0x80f754de3e571ea8.text: My hair grew back great! The clinic is good, clean, and the doctor gave excellent advice. All the staff were very attentive. I felt comfortable using their services. I highly recommend it!
0x26c39ffd89d2a3b7_0x80f754de3e571ea8.author: Wicthsupa J

0x26c39ffd89d2a3b7_0x80f754de3e571ea8.text: The doctor gave excellent and straightforward advice. I visited several places and consulted with them once before deciding to have the procedure done here.
0x26c39ffd89d2a3b7_0x80f754de3e571ea8.author: Ekarat Jerome

0x26c39ffd89d2a3b7_0x80f754de3e571ea8.text: I had my hair transplant one year ago. The service was excellent, and the doctor gave very good advice. I recommend coming back for another transplant.
0x26c39ffd89d2a3b7_0x80f754de3e571ea8.author: Heang Bangrak

0x26c39ffd89d2a3b7_0x80f754de3e571ea8.text: Very good consultation. The Doctor is very kind and gives the reliable consult. Also very good take care after surgery. Totally recommend
0x26c39ffd89d2a3b7_0x80f754de3e571ea8.author: Wittawin Worakitchanon

0x30e29e705658b941_0x9400486e984e5b48.text: I highly recommend this dental clinic. The clinic is very clean, modern, and meets high professional standards. The dental chairs and equipment are brand new, which made me feel confident and comfortable throughout the treatment. The dentist explains everything clearly before and after the procedure, with detailed explanations and photo documentation, which is very reassuring. The prices are reasonable and affordable compared to other clinics, offering great value for the quality of care. I especially appreciate that the clinic uses modern dental technology to ensure accurate and effective treatment. Overall, an excellent experience — definitely a clinic worth visiting for anyone looking for quality dental care.
0x30e29e705658b941_0x9400486e984e5b48.author: Jonathan Kim

0x30e29e705658b941_0x9400486e984e5b48.text: Dr. Pop rocks! Thank you so much for the excellent dental care. Your professional expertise, integrity and compassionate concern for my pupils when you donated the spinner are most appreciated.
0x30e29e705658b941_0x9400486e984e5b48.author: Stefan Satur

0x30e29e705658b941_0x9400486e984e5b48.text: ไปมาแล้วครับคุณหมอน่ารักมาก เจ้าของคลีนิค(พี่แนน) น่ารักใจดี ตอบคำถามเก่งครับ ปกติอยู่ไกลแต่ตอนนี้จะมาเป็นลูกค้าประจำที่นี่ล่ะแนะนำที่นี่เลยครับสะดวกรวดเร็วแอร์เย็นครับบริการดีเยี่ยม
0x30e29e705658b941_0x9400486e984e5b48.author: Amego Solah
0x30e29e705658b941_0x9400486e984e5b48.en: I've been there already. The doctor is very lovely. The clinic owner (Nan) is lovely, kind, and answers questions well. I usually live far away, but now I'll be a regular customer. I highly recommend this place; it's convenient, fast, the air conditioning is cool, and the service is excellent.

0x30e29e705658b941_0x9400486e984e5b48.text: Not a good place for foreigners. They tried to oversell, overcharged, bait and switched, and rushed through the procedure missing critical steps. They couldn't even get their stories aligned when I inquired about the extra charges. Felt like I was dealing with salesmen rather than medical professionals. One of their dentists left a big hole in my gum that was bleeding for days, from a very shakey injection. When replacing my fillings, he just removed the old fillings and immediately put on the new fillings. I suffered tooth sensitivity for weeks afterwards. So I saw another dentist at another clinic, who found that when these guys had replaced the fillings, they didn't clean out the decay, so (a) the new fillings didn't bond to the teeth properly and (b) it left a high risk of internal decay that could lead to a root canal. We thought that going to a small local clinic would be safer than going to a big place for tourists. But I was treated very much like an unwitting tourist here. Travellers beware.

0x30e298de1103c6c1_0x84f6d07b169b5a01.text: This is a small hospital, not very large or spacious, mostly a public hospital under the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration in the Khlong San district of Bangkok's Thonburi side. The entrance features a statue of King Taksin and the hospital's patron deity. The area around the patient examination rooms and payment counters for medication and fees is busy. There's a single-story building inside with a 7-Eleven convenience store and a COVID-19 screening unit (visitors must arrive before 8:00 AM). It's located near the Khlong San intersection and the Khlong San station of the Gold Line BTS Skytrain. The ICONSIAM shopping mall is also a short walk from the hospital. During my recent visit, I saw the hospital's new building, constructed almost four years ago, now open. This four-story building houses the clinics: Gynecology, Pregnancy Checkup, Dentistry, Surgery, and General Medicine departments.

0x30e298de1103c6c1_0x84f6d07b169b5a01.text: I recently started using the services after the new building was completed. I've completely forgotten about the old Taksin Hospital. Dispensing medication is also much faster than before, when I had to spend the whole day there, wasting more time dispensing medication than waiting for my examination. With the new, more spacious building, it feels less crowded than before. There are also more elevators, so you don't have to wait in line and get frustrated. But if there's leftover budget, I hope they'll renovate the old building as well. Excellent!
