0x311d6347e5679051_0x5d429be1f7ff54e6.en: Update 14/8/67 I would like to respond to the clinic's clarification. **Since there is no space to write a reply, I will provide further clarification in the original review instead.** **Thank you to the clinic for your attentiveness and for clarifying the facts, and thank you to the doctor who owns the clinic for offering to take care of me. However, I will not be returning for treatment because:** 1. I have already had the tooth in question extracted at another clinic. Once the wound heals, I will need to get a denture. 2. I would like to clarify that it is indeed the same tooth that was filled that day, but the filling did not reach the area with the decay. I asked the doctor who extracted the tooth. The doctor didn't mention the old clinic at all, probably due to medical ethics, but I felt uneasy and asked if this was the tooth that was recently filled. The doctor confirmed it was, but the filling didn't reach the decay, which is why it's sensitive when eating. (This is my personal opinion, based on my observation of the extracted tooth as someone with no knowledge of fillings. I felt that the previous doctor may have filled the top layer and not the inner area, the crevices I mentioned. The decay wasn't small either; the unfilled decay was clearly visible if you looked closely as I described.) (That day, I think they saw the hole in the gap between the teeth where the decay was.) **I would like to thank the clinic again for taking the time to write this clarification in my review. Thank you very much. I usually get my treatments done here using my social security benefits. The service is generally normal, with varying degrees of success. I sometimes switch to other clinics each year, but this year I went here for a filling. I paid for it myself, without using social security, and I was *not* impressed at all. I felt really bad this time. I went to get a filling for an inner molar that had a hole on the side where food particles kept getting stuck, requiring flossing to remove them. Otherwise, there were no other symptoms; no pain, no sensitivity, and I could eat and chew normally. However, I was worried that leaving it untreated would cause problems later, so I made an appointment. I explained the problem to the doctor and staff. The doctor filled the tooth. After the filling, I felt sensitivity, which wasn't usually present. The doctor was a bit irritable during the procedure, snapping at the assistant and speaking in a harsh tone to me. In total, I paid 1,000 baht for the filling. When I got home, the sensitivity became more frequent and intense. Even drinking cold water caused sensitivity. I thought it was probably normal after a filling. After a month, it still hadn't improved, so I went back to the same doctor. After a while of examination, the assistant found the sensitive spot, but the dentist couldn't find it. Once she found it, the dentist said she hadn't done that tooth. I politely pointed out that I had come for that specific tooth. The dentist insisted she hadn't done it, possibly because other teeth were more sensitive. She repeatedly denied it, asking if I wanted a filling for the sensitive tooth, which would incur a fee. I declined. When I got home, I checked which tooth she had filled that day, and the white/cream-colored filling material was clearly visible on the sensitive tooth. Honestly, normally, if a dentist isn't going to fill a tooth they don't intend to, they should explain it to the patient beforehand. Or if there's a problem after the filling, they should just acknowledge it and fix it. Dentists are human; mistakes happen. But this dentist just kept insisting she hadn't done it. Oh, and on my next visit, I paid 50 baht for sterilization. The sensitivity is worse than before; it's now throbbing with pain. I don't know if it's from the sensitivity testing equipment or something else, but it's making life difficult. Eating is hard, and my tooth is constantly sensitive. But I'm just a regular patient, so I don't have much to fight for or pursue against this dentist. I guess all I can do is seek advice and solutions from elsewhere. Consider it bad luck that's passed.

0x3050256546909393_0xf514ba707638407.text: Dr Sarawut is a great dentist who cares about what is best for you and not what make him the most money. Prior to a trip to Phuket I went to a dentist in Brisbane and was told I needed a root canal and that the tooth could not be saved so I would need to implant/crown. I decided to wait and see what it would cost in Thailand. I made the rounds of several dentists and chose Dr Sarawut even though he was not the cheapest. When he examined my tooth he confirmed that a root canal was necessary but that he would be able to save the tooth, "you do not get rid of your own teeth unless there is no alternative" he said. I was impressed. On my last visit I had a cavity on the side of a wisdom tooth that was right at the gum line so could not be filled. Dr Sarawut told that the tooth would need to come out but told me wait and do it back in Australia, he said "you are on holiday so you do not want to ruin that with getting a wisdom tooth extracted." Again, more concerned with what was best for me than making money. When I did get it removed back in Brisbane I understood what he meant and was thankful for his advise. I am going back next month to have my amalgam fillings replaced. By the time I included the cost of airfare and accommodation I will probably be paying close to the same as I would in Brisbane but Dr Sarawut is worth it. If you are visiting Phuket and want/need to get dental work done then do yourself a favour book an appointment with Dr Sarawut.
0x3050256546909393_0xf514ba707638407.author: Don Ostapov

0x3050256546909393_0xf514ba707638407.text: FYI - I am Kenans wife I had an excellent experience with Dr Sarawut and team. From the moment I walked in, the lovely reception was warm and welcoming and made us feel so comfortable I initially visited for a consultation about replacing missing teeth Dr. Sarawut took the time to thoroughly evaluate my situation and offer honest advice. I originally went in expecting to get dental bridges to address some missing teeth — something I was ready to move forward with. But after carefully examining my situation, Dr. Sarawut gave me honest, thoughtful advice: he recommended doing Invisalign first to correct my bite and alignment. It was clear that this recommendation was made in my best long-term interest, even though it meant losing immediate business for the clinic. He also did a few fillings during my visit, and the work was done incredibly smoothly and professionally—no discomfort, no stress, just efficient, kind and careful treatment. My husband also received treatment at the clinic earlier in the year and had a similarly positive experience. He had several crowns done, and the results were excellent. He was very satisfied with the quality of care and the outcome. It’s refreshing to meet a dentist who prioritizes patient care and integrity over profit. I’ll definitely be returning for future treatment and would highly recommend Dr. Sarawut to anyone looking for trustworthy, high-quality and ethical dental care.
0x3050256546909393_0xf514ba707638407.author: Kenan Eryilmaz

0x3050256546909393_0xf514ba707638407.text: I cannot recommend this dentist highly enough. During my recent trip to Thailand I had several treatments done, including a clean and polish using their incredible modern technology, four teeth with composite bonding, six fillings, and a custom night guard made and fitted. I am usually absolutely petrified of the dentist, but the cleaning technology Dr. Sarawut uses is unbelievably gentle — I genuinely didn’t feel a thing. It was completely different from any dental experience I’ve had before. The entire clinic is extremely professional and clearly state-of-the-art. Everything was spotless, organised and very reassuring. The dentist himself was outstanding — knowledgeable, precise and clearly passionate about his work. His whole team were fantastic as well. Everyone was incredibly friendly and welcoming, and they all spoke excellent English which made the whole process very easy and comfortable. Not only was the quality of care exceptional, but I also saved thousands of pounds compared to what the same treatment would have cost me at home. If you’re considering dental treatment in Thailand, I honestly cannot recommend Dr. Sarawut and his clinic enough. Absolutely five-star service from start to finish.

0x30502f0f90fb9c69_0xa546bca15a1dbc84.text: Good afternoon! I've been trying to treat myself for three days, without success. I have high blood pressure, my left arm is failing, I have cervical osteochondrosis, and so on. I went to the hospital. I walked in at 10:50 and there wasn't a single empty chair. There were a lot of people, BUT by 11:50 I was already in the doctor's office. The appointment took five minutes (it's like a conveyor belt). I had my blood pressure checked beforehand (they have public access to the machines), and I got a prescription for the medications and services (they dispense the medications on-site). This took another 15 minutes because I needed an injection. I had to wait for my shot in the emergency room, but the whole thing took an average of two hours. Bottom line: the lobby was almost empty. Arrive at the clinic after 12:00 if possible. Service was fast, everything was clear, the staff was friendly, and they prescribed medication based on my symptoms, making me want to live the next day. And it only cost 1,050 baht for a bunch of pills, ointment (not pictured), the appointment, and an intravenous injection. Thank you so much for your help!

0x30e29915e608d13d_0x53d22a6507eaf063.text: The doctor is very kind, polite, and friendly. The prices are excellent. I highly recommend this place! More information: Pisit Clinic, located in Soi Ban Dok Mai (near Worachak and Khlong Thom), is considered a legendary clinic, especially among older generations and people in inner Bangkok. Here's some history and interesting facts about the clinic: The Beginning and Reputation The Era: This clinic has been operating for many decades (probably more than 40-50 years), since a time when access to specialist dermatologists wasn't as widespread as it is today. Expertise: It's widely known for its "treatment of skin diseases," including acne, melasma, freckles, rashes, and various chronic skin conditions. Unique Feature: Pisit Clinic's defining characteristic is its own "medications," especially its acne treatment solution and moisturizing creams, which many people recommend as "effective" at affordable prices compared to modern beauty clinics. Atmosphere and Charm of the Clinic Classic: The clinic is located in an old shophouse in Soi Ban Dok Mai. The interior retains the simple atmosphere of an old-fashioned clinic, without luxurious decorations. But the focus is on friendly and personalized treatment. Waiting lines: In the past (and even today), it's known for its very long queues. Some people have to wait from early morning to get a chance to see a doctor. Even ordering medication by mail for customers from other provinces is very popular. Why has it survived? Even though there are many beauty clinics in shopping malls nowadays, Pisit Clinic still maintains a loyal customer base for several main reasons: Treatment results: Targeted treatments and uniquely formulated medications. Affordable prices: The cost of treatment and medication is not high, making it accessible to all groups. Word of mouth: From generation to generation, children are often brought to see the doctor here, following in their parents' footsteps. Additional note: Soi Ban Dok Mai itself has a long history. It's an old community famous for making fireworks and firecrackers in the past. Going to see a doctor here is like stepping back in time to experience the atmosphere of old Bangkok. I'll take pictures and share them later.

0x30e29fa08c614af3_0x422a2d2abb73770c.text: I had a very disappointing experience at this dental clinic yesterday. During my treatment, I was assisted by a new dental assistant who seemed to be inexperienced with using the suction properly. She repeatedly failed to suction the water and saliva effectively, which caused me to choke twice during the procedure. After the second incident, I had a panic attack and was no longer able to continue with the treatment. What disappointed me even more was her reaction afterward. She did not apologize or even say a single word to me. Instead, she just stared directly at me intensely. However, the clinic later contacted me to apologize and offered to redo the treatment, which I appreciate. But after this experience, I no longer feel comfortable returning to the clinic, so I declined the offer. I understand that mistakes can happen, especially with new staff. However, when a patient has choked twice during a procedure and is clearly distressed, I believe a sincere apology and basic communication are the bare minimum. Unfortunately, this experience completely changed my impression of the clinic. I will not be returning.

One staff member told us to wait for payment before receiving our vaccinations, but our turn had already been called. The finance department said they didn't have any payment information. 0x30e29d3e376bc147_0x74b1b5d0136a8068.text: Let me share my experience. As I got older, I started having problems with drooping eyebrows and eyelids. Botox wasn't enough anymore 😅 I was pulling my temples in the mirror every day. I figured I needed surgery. I carefully selected a specialist doctor and finally met Dr. Hope. During a consultation, she recommended Endotine eyebrow lift using an endoscope, a minimally invasive procedure with a small incision hidden in the hairline. The result was that it corrected my hooded double eyelids, upper eyelid sagging, drooping eyebrows, and frown lines. I can live my life normally now; I can wash my face, put on makeup, and style my hair. It's amazing! Dr. Hope uses Korean techniques, so I didn't have to travel far. Importantly, the surgery is performed at Vimut Hospital, which is safe. It's been 3 months since the surgery, and I'm incredibly happy. My eyes look bigger, my eyebrows are lifted, my temples are lifted. Honestly, I look brighter, less sad, and my eyelids don't droop or fold at the corners. Crow's feet are gone without Botox! Dr. Hope is meticulous throughout the procedure, lovely, and follows up constantly. I give her 1,000 points! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

0x30e29ea65869e699_0x8e52e996da4f5bd1.en: I went to have a molar extracted. The dentist explained every step of the procedure (so I could prepare myself) and took an X-ray beforehand to make sure it was the right tooth. Initially, I was worried that a molar extraction might cause side effects like gum bruising, but the dentist used gentle tools and proceeded slowly, not rushing, so it wasn't very painful. I didn't even realize it was over when the extraction was finished; I thought there were still many steps involved. The whole process took about half an hour. The cost of extracting each tooth varies; mine, for a molar, was a little over a thousand baht. Payment can be made via bank transfer, and the clinic provides a receipt.

0x30502f1004b40d8b_0x745fb6643f65d2e.text: I’m in Thailand and needed to get a Thai driver’s license. For that, I needed a medical certificate, so I went to the nearest place for me: Thiti Clinic. I’d read some negative reviews saying the staff were impolite or rude, but I reminded myself that I’m in Thailand and the official language isn’t English—so it would be unreasonable to expect literary, eloquent English from everyone. As a tourist and guest, it’s my job to make communication easier. Since I don’t speak Thai yet, I asked GPT to help me write a polite message explaining what I needed: that I’m a tourist, I need a driver’s license, and I require the medical papers—could they please help and what should I do? At reception, a staff member named Fatima (wearing a hijab) and her colleague Kimberly were very nice. For context, I’m a pretty intense customer—I have some temper issues and I’m not always the most pleasant person—but they stayed polite and helpful. When I said I don’t speak Thai (I know about four words), they even helped me learn a few. The procedure was very fast—no more than five minutes—smooth, and Fatima was smiling. I don’t want to point fingers, but sometimes our experience depends on how we treat people. Maybe we should first ask ourselves how we’re treating others; they might just respond accordingly. My experience here was really good and even a bit fun. Thank you! I received my medical certificate after a proper check.
0x30502f1004b40d8b_0x745fb6643f65d2e.author: Taras

0x30502f1004b40d8b_0x745fb6643f65d2e.text: Will visit tomorrow again after a really long time. They X-Rayed with some contrast fluid for 2 hours, just to tell me they dont know what i have. Doc Thiti let me pee in a cup, checked it under a Microscope and showing it to me. 0x30502f1004b40d8b_0x745fb6643f65d2e.text: From my experience this is a fast and efficient little practice. Was in seeing the doctor 10 mins after arriving. Diagnosed with ear infection and antibiotics prescribed. The total bill for doctor and medications was 380 Baht. Unfortunately antibiotics did not work and infection got worse so went back to see doctor again. This was not a result of poor care or bad meds, just a bad infection. He immediately referred me to hospital and wrote a medical note for doctors explaining what he had done. Doctor did not charge for the 2nd visit. If i was in the area again and need his service I would definitely go again. The practice is easy to find, Situated on the left, northbound road from Rawai to chalong. Its about 50 meters shy of the clock tower roundabout. The location on google maps is accurate.

0x30502f1004b40d8b_0x745fb6643f65d2e.text: I came to get my ears cleaned. The whole process took less than an hour, including the wait. It cost 780 baht for both ears. I'm not sure if you could pay by card, but you can definitely use a QR code. The doctor is a pleasant man and speaks English well enough to understand each other, so I gather he's a jack of all trades. Other comments said the woman at the reception desk was rude. I can't say she was rude to me, but this isn't a Bangkok hospital. When she was putting a blanket on my shoulders, she painfully caught my hair with a clothespin and left. But the doctor, at my request, adjusted everything and apologized. Perhaps she wasn't being mean, but just tired from the sheer volume of work. Basically, if you're not rude to her, she won't be rude to you either. For some basic cases, it's definitely an okay place in terms of price and quality. Also, the opening hours at the time of my visit are slightly different from those on Google Maps. They have a sign on the door that they're open until 12, and then from 5:00 PM, not 5:30 PM. So you can show up right at 5:00 PM and there won't be much of a line. UPDATE: I got an ear infection there and had to treat it for the next three weeks.

0x30da3b3400108177_0x58aa9059391c035b.text: On April 28th at 10:00 AM, I went for a Thai massage here for the first time. The counter staff were welcoming. The male massage therapist was polite and friendly, so I started a conversation with him to get to know him better and hopefully use his services again in the future. While he was massaging my left leg (the first step), a female staff member parted the curtain to look in, and then left. A moment later, the same female staff member parted the curtain again and told me to lower my voice. I immediately stopped talking to the male massage therapist and didn't speak to him again until the massage was over. I then got dressed and left. I would like to criticize this female staff member. You lacked maturity and the manners expected of a service provider. You should study and find a better way to guide clients, instead of directly requesting them to speak louder. This made me, as a client, feel disgusted and unwilling to use your services again. I want to emphasize that I spoke with the male massage therapist in a normal tone of voice; it wasn't a celebratory conversation, and it was a casual discussion. The first time, during a massage that lasted less than ten minutes, I, a retired civil servant and former military officer, know social etiquette and what is appropriate and inappropriate. Therefore, I requested that the head of this department train the staff on manners, kindness, and leniency in general, especially first-time customers like myself. Luckily, I'm not a hot-headed person. I might have retorted, "What's with all this fuss? I paid 250 baht for this service. Don't be so pretentious," or even gotten up and stormed out. That's not the behavior of a gentleman. I don't accept an apology, but I ask that this staff member improve their behavior. While it wasn't a serious offense, they should respect and be accommodating to customers. Even if they claim I disturbed others, I still swear I spoke in a normal tone of voice and the conversation wasn't long. Anyone who heard it, please don't be so pretentious. I also paid for this service. Same as you all. Suggestion: A large notice should be posted: No talking or shouting while getting a massage. Anyone who reads it will understand and strictly adhere to the rules. Thank you. Signed, Colonel Chatukorn Rattanagos, Patient at the Health Center, Chiang Mai University.
0x30da3b3400108177_0x58aa9059391c035b.author: เจตน์ รัตนสกุล

0x30da3b3400108177_0x58aa9059391c035b.text: I went to the hospital two days in a row for respiratory checkups. It was a different doctor each time, but their personalities and egos were the same. Perhaps it's because they're older; everything they said seemed abrupt and irritating. They seemed especially annoyed when they found out what was wrong with me (the patient). If they were annoyed, they should have at least examined me more thoroughly! They rushed the examination so much, I don't know where they were rushing to. We talked for less than three minutes each, like playing a question-and-answer game. I recommend anyone planning to go there or who is sick to do a lot of research beforehand, because if you don't know and can't answer the questions, you won't know what the results will be. I was quite confused, because if you need to know what you're sick with, why go to the doctor? I had a fever for several days, a high fever, but I was taking fever reducers. How could I have a fever during the examination? 🥹 They didn't ask any detailed questions, just rushed through the discussion, like they were judging me and concluding what was wrong instead of being sure. They told me I had a sore throat when I had been bedridden for three days with a high fever every night. In the end, I had to do my own research and tell them what was wrong, and then get a medical certificate. It's like their only job is to sit there and issue medical certificates. If anyone received good service, congratulations, because I won't be going back again. Exhausted from fever and medication, I still had to answer questions correctly and quickly. The queue was long, but the queue management was terrible. It felt like there weren't that many people on the day I went; they should have organized the system better and more consistently, not kept changing it. I felt sorry for the nurses walking around the building looking for people. The diagnosis was also wrong. I understand people make mistakes, but it was quite upsetting. The way they worked felt like they weren't putting in their full effort. The doctors didn't seem to see me as an ordinary patient, but more like medical students who needed to know medical knowledge. Luckily, I'm also a health science student, but I wouldn't do what the doctors did if I were a patient. Please improve this. I usually trust all doctors, but after this, I'm done. I can't trust anyone but myself. I don't know the internal system, but being a doctor or nurse is your job. You should have more empathy for students or see them as human beings. You shouldn't expect patients to know everything or do everything instantly. If you've been sick yourself, you'll understand.
0x30da3b3400108177_0x58aa9059391c035b.author: kira jay

0x30da3b3400108177_0x58aa9059391c035b.text: If you're reading this review, I recommend going somewhere else... Let me vent like a friend. I went to Suan Dok Hospital, but the nurse there told me to go to Phai Lom instead. So I came. I'd heard beforehand that the service there was bad, from both professors and students. Let me tell you, the nurses here are lovely. They're polite, patient, and helpful. The older male doctor I saw was the problem. At first, we were talking nicely, but later he became very angry and yelled loudly. I have problems with frequent bowel movements and severe abdominal pain before defecating. The doctor said, "Everyone poops, everyone has abdominal pain before pooping." He emphasized the word "poop" very strongly. I tried to be polite by saying "pooping," and I tried to explain how much pain I was experiencing, but he kept interrupting me before I could finish. I'm not a good speaker, so I wrote down what I wanted to say on my phone, but I barely spoke because he kept cutting me off. He told me to take care of myself, about my eating and sleeping habits. He asked what faculty I was studying in. I said business administration. He then said, "You can't even manage a business yet." I never expected that to come out of a doctor's mouth. We understand that they couldn't prescribe medication because diarrhea is common and usually resolves on its own without medical attention. However, we needed a medical certificate because it was causing us to be late for our exam. When we explained this, the doctor said they would only issue a certificate stating "frequent bowel movements." We were surprised that our explanation of severe abdominal pain before the bowel movements didn't matter at all – we were in so much pain we could barely walk! The doctor even shook their head in exasperation while entering information into the computer. But the actual certificate stated, "Reported abdominal pain causing late exam." It was clear they intended it to sound bad. We overheard the nurses exchanging glances when printing the certificate; they probably understood the doctor's reasoning. We were shocked that strangers could speak to each other like that. We gritted our teeth the whole time we got there. Our ears were ringing, and we were on the verge of tears. We were already afraid of talking to strangers, and today's fear intensified. We probably won't dare talk to a doctor again for a long time. 😂
0x30da3b3400108177_0x58aa9059391c035b.author: Chanah nn

0x30da3b3400108177_0x58aa9059391c035b.text: On the first floor, we saw lovely and kind doctors. They even asked if we needed a medical certificate. The nurses were also very kind, asking if we needed one. Since I was sick and had a dental appointment, the nurse suggested I do the dental work first and then come back down (I had my teeth cleaned and fluoride applied, which didn't take long). I arrived just in time for my turn. The second time I went, the nurses explained everything clearly. At point number 9, they were very kind, telling me to wait and asking if I needed a medical certificate. No one was rude or dismissive. I didn't have to wait long at all. I can't give separate ratings, so I'm giving it 5 stars! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 The Thai massage service was excellent, perfect for students like me who suffer from back, neck, shoulder, and back pain from studying MT (medical science) and a lot of bending and sitting. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 I'd like to commend the dentists; they were very polite. However, during the teeth cleaning, water splashed all over the cloth. And when they applied fluoride, they used the wet side to cover my eyes again. Please improve this. When wiping with water, please be mindful of the person's nostrils. They covered my nostrils so tightly that I couldn't breathe and couldn't raise my hand because the doctor said it would be too much. I tried to explain by crying and raising my hand, but they still wouldn't listen. Next time I have an appointment, I'll remind them beforehand. 🌟

0x30e29ed2bf2744a5_0x144cdd30dceafab9.text: Terrible. Run away. For anyone considering treatment for snoring: 1. After the sleep test, I only got to talk to the doctor for exactly one minute. The doctor was very rushed and told me to consult a nurse who didn't know much. I asked about the next steps but received no helpful information to make a decision. 2. I was semi-forced to undergo a CT scan and endoscopy, because they were unsure of the source of the snoring. After both procedures, I only got to talk to the doctor for another two minutes. The doctor rapped on the spot and then ran off, leaving the same inexperienced nurse to continue the conversation. 3. Expensive. Very expensive. CT scan + endoscopy cost over ten thousand baht. 4. The next steps/solutions offered were minimal. Only CPAP and dental braces were suggested. The only good thing was the standard-priced sleep test, which provided accurate results. Recommendation: You should go to Bumrungrad Hospital. It's much cheaper, and the doctors there say that a sleep test alone is sufficient. A quick examination of the throat and nose is enough to determine the condition. Very few cases require a CT scan; most cases are diagnosed with a simple light examination. Most importantly, Bumrungrad is much cheaper and provides much better advice. ------------------------------------------- My experience with this clinic was extremely bad. After enduring an overpriced CT scan, I was afforded a paltry one-minute consultation with the doctor who seemed to be in more of a rush than a crowded subway train during rush hour. This woefully inadequate consultation left me feeling unheard and disregarded. The 'solution' I was offered? A ludicrously expensive metal teeth bracket, the cost of which was double that of Thailand's most luxurious hospital. The price was an absolute gut punch, especially after such a brief and impersonal consultation. Healthcare should be about patient care, not running a factory-style operation. It's a bitter pill to swallow, but patients are more than just a credit card swipe. I strongly advise potential patients to reconsider before stepping foot in this clinic. Their practices need a serious overhaul.
0x30e29ed2bf2744a5_0x144cdd30dceafab9.author: Moo Songsaksakul

0x30e29f4f67bf1ef7_0x923a3f87699645d2.text: For 990 baht, you get what you pay for: not much. I think the staff and facilities are fine, but I want to help readers set expectations. The sign in the window promises a cleaning and x-rays. But when you sit in the chair, you learn that the x-ray is only if the doctor deems it necessary. In my case, I didn’t get an x-ray, even after inquiring. I can’t recommend this if you’re expecting a comprehensive cleaning. The cleaning experience was awkward and comically fast — fewer than 15 minutes. He jumped from tooth to tooth in no coherent order, like a child coloring outside the lines of a coloring book with a crayon with bite marks. I’ve probably been to two dozen different dentists in my life. This was probably among the least satisfying dental experiences I’ve had. Two stars because the low price accurately reflects the service you’d expect for something so cheap.
0x30e29f4f67bf1ef7_0x923a3f87699645d2.author: Emilio Reyes Le Blanc

0x3050396f418868e9_0x9b887f050d535c8d.text: I traveled from the United States to Phuket to train for a few weeks and decided to have my teeth cleaned while I was here. Choosing Laguna Dental Care was one of the best decisions I made during my trip. The cleaning was extremely thorough, and I also chose their whitening treatment. The results were incredible—my teeth are noticeably several shades whiter, and I could see the difference immediately. The entire experience was pleasant from start to finish. The receptionist was welcoming and professional, the dental assistant was attentive and caring, and the dentist was outstanding. I especially enjoyed speaking with the dentist, who studied in Iowa, which made me feel right at home. The clinic was modern, clean, and efficient, and the surrounding Laguna area is absolutely beautiful. Between the quality of care, the professionalism of the staff, and the beauty of the area, this visit played a significant role in helping me decide that Phuket is a place I would like to call home long-term. I highly recommend Laguna Dental Care to anyone visiting or living in Phuket. Thank you for an excellent experience and for giving me a smile I’m proud to show off.

0x3050396f418868e9_0x9b887f050d535c8d.text: I fractured a veneer while on holiday and was fortunate to find Laguna Dental Care. The staff was extremely helpful, and the dentist was professional, explaining the process clearly at every step. She ordered X-rays but only treated what was necessary, without trying to push additional procedures. The admin team was welcoming and efficient, and the dental assistant was just as professional and attentive. The entire experience was seamless and reassuring during what could have been a stressful situation. I highly recommend Laguna Dental Care not only for emergency treatment but also for routine cleanings, cosmetic work, or any dental needs. Having recently moved to Phuket, I feel very lucky to have such an excellent clinic nearby. Look no further—this is the place to go for quality dental care.

0x30e287291c67c955_0xf68b2c7d14b8a5c3.text: I once had Chikungunya. After recovering for two weeks, I had severe joint pain in every joint and couldn't sleep. The pain was even worse in the mornings; I couldn't get out of bed and needed my children and husband to help me get dressed because my arms and shoulders ached so much. I went to two hospitals, received injections and medication, but the pain returned after 1-2 days. I cried myself to sleep for two months. My husband, recommended by a friend, took me to see this doctor. I received acupuncture, injections, and medication. The next morning, the pain was almost gone; I could even shower and get dressed myself. My husband, who brought me here, couldn't believe it! I also had an allergic reaction to the doctor – a rash of small, itchy blisters that were painful, sometimes bleeding, and peeling, almost completely obscuring my fingerprints. Now, two years later, I'm finally recovered and have no more appointments. I am so grateful to the doctor; he is incredibly skilled and compassionate. My husband's back sprain healed completely after just one acupuncture session. A friend from abroad also recommended the doctor, and their frozen shoulder cleared up in one session without surgery. Unbelievable, right? If you're experiencing something similar, come and see this doctor; you'll see I'm not exaggerating.

We always donate extra whenever we visit. The treatment costs are incredibly cheap, truly affordable. I never thought I'd meet someone who genuinely does good for society like this. I'm truly impressed.

0x310295007a980203_0x8273d23cf9fc1fdc.text: I had a nose job at this clinic, so I wanted to share my experience in case it's helpful. At first, I saw a rather interesting promotion, and it said "free tip correction." But when I arrived, the staff informed me that if I wanted a shape like the reference, I'd have to pay an additional 5,000 baht. I was quite confused, as the promotion already stated that it was included. Before the procedure: I didn't have a chance to consult with the doctor in detail. The staff did most of the talking beforehand, and then I met the doctor for a short while. They didn't measure my face or explain much. When I looked at the photos, the doctor said, "You can do it, but the tip might not be perfect. If you want it perfect, you'll have to pay more." Then he got me on the bed. During the actual procedure, I felt like the doctor was in a rush. The anesthesia was administered, and in less than two minutes, the surgery began. I felt a little sore during the incision. Then, when I opened my eyes, the doctor had already left. He didn't explain the technique used or whether the tip correction was actually done. This made me feel a bit unsure. The queue and management: It was quite chaotic, crowded, and unorganized. I felt like I didn't get the consultation I should have received before the surgery. I'm still swollen, so I haven't yet determined the results. But overall, I was quite disappointed with my experience. I'm sharing this here in case anyone else is considering it might need some additional information.

0x311d65b449f5fa19_0x3917a2e4b7f4828d.en: I haven't been to the dentist much since COVID; I've been to clinics very rarely. I recently tried Dentall on my own. I'd brought my daughter before, and she said the dentist was very kind. Today, I came for a teeth cleaning and filling, but it turned out my tooth neck was worn down, which the dentist filled. They also found another cavity, so I'm coming back for that next time. Dr. Ploy was very thorough and honest in her examination and advice. She didn't push unnecessary treatments. The teeth cleaning and polishing were very thorough; my teeth feel incredibly clean afterwards. The clinic is also very clean. I'm very impressed. Some places look good, but the work is rushed and superficial, but here, the dentist is very attentive. I recommend trying their services. Call to make an appointment beforehand to avoid long waits. P.S. During the filling, the dentist put a mouthguard on my mouth, which prevented fatigue, and also applied Vaseline because my mouth was very dry.

For the teeth whitening, the dentist applied the whitening solution in three rounds, each taking about 20 minutes. After whitening, my teeth were noticeably whiter and felt incredibly clean. The dentist also checked my oral health and provided instructions on post-treatment care. A year after the whitening, I was so impressed I came back for fillings. The dentist was very gentle and thorough. I had a cavity filling for 800 baht and a tooth filling for 700 baht. Excellent value for money. Highly recommend!

0x3050310056e23503_0x758bae233a4339a8.text: Dr Kitisak and his team seamlessly continued my treatment as I moved to Phuket following a complex break and subsequent long term treatment. They immediately understood the extent of the damage, reviewed my treatment up to that point, and from the start each and every session has been tailored to my rehabilitation as well as my needs that day, including treating other unrelated injuries or issues that ever crop up. The physical massage is expertly reactive to both what I feel and what they can feel in the moment. They seem to have a wide range of equipment, including the ultrasound and electric therapy that I need; facilities and amenities are on par with those I experienced at the private hospital in the city where I moved from. I love the fact I can buy sessions in batches which further help save money on the already reasonable prices, as well as the fact that you don't have to make an appointment and can turn up to suit your schedule. And with long opening hours throughout the week, it is easy to get treatment to fit in with all your daily commitments. Location is easy to find with plenty of parking in the car park behind - you can get a pass from the physio to cover the parking. With excellent English, communication is also very easy. Highly recommended.

0x3050310056e23503_0x758bae233a4339a8.text: I've been a patient since their old location, and now they've moved to the new one across from Vachira Phuket Hospital. This place is amazing! I used electrical therapy to treat my inflamed muscle injury and received a diagnosis from Dr. Elephant (the nickname foreign patients use for him). After my initial treatment, they referred me for a follow-up ultrasound. I feel much better now; the pain is only about 20% gone. I plan to visit again tomorrow when I have time. The new location has convenient parking behind the clinic.

0x30e29f295233ef5d_0xfb6062ce4f50e68d.text: Definitely a top clinic managed by incredible staff who went above and beyond to ensure my recovery was smooth. Right from the initial consultation I felt the staff were very involved in ensuring all the queries are addressed and they help you to decide the best possible procedure for you. Once the surgery was scheduled, The clinic staff (Kana and Lan) understood any unexpected challenges that came along in my preparation for the surgeries and supported me through them. Prior to my surgery travel to Bangkok, they provided me a detailed itinerary of events and eased all my nerves on how the stay was going to be like especially after the surgery. Once discharged from hospital post surgery, they ensured that all my care needs were met, even the smallest of things to ease my recovery. I'm beyond grateful to have had Lan take care of my recovery at the condo, she lifted my mood, supported me emotionally when days were hard. I cannot imagine to have had this recovery without the support from the clinic staff through their care package. I absolutely recommend anyone getting their procedures done to avail their care package to ease your recovery. Its incredible to experience how they extend support for you. Finally, Doctor Thee delivered as expected and exceptional results and I'm extremely happy. He is definitely one of the best surgeons in the world and his results speak about his skill and technique.

0x30e29f295233ef5d_0xfb6062ce4f50e68d.text: Had a tummy tuck and another minor procedure on June 3rd, 2024 with Dr. Theerapong. Eight months later, and... While I'm still waiting on the scars to fade, I have my body back, and feel so much more confident now. It is hard to accurately convey just how profoundly talented Dr. Thee is as a surgeon. I live in Florida, one of the most popular places in the world for plastic surgery - and multiple local doctors have independently commented that the work Dr. Theerapong did is superior to anything I could have gotten done locally. Any discussion of Interplast is incomplete without mentioning the post-op care and attention provided by Lan. She's one of the kindest, sweetest, and most attentive people you'll ever meet. I still cherish those memories and am thankful to have met her. Something you should know - this is not Dr. Thee's fault and there does not appear to be anything to be done about this, apparently the nicer hospitals significantly infringe upon a surgeon's freedom - but my experience with hospital staff was a bit rougher than I had bargained for. Fortunately - Lan and Dr. Thee got me out of there as soon as possible!
0x30e29f295233ef5d_0xfb6062ce4f50e68d.author: Amelia Bennett

0x30e29f295233ef5d_0xfb6062ce4f50e68d.text: I had a procedure with Dr. Theerapong. I had a wonderful experience. He was very knowledgeable about surgical techniques and asked my preferences for the surgery. He ended up using a technique that matched my anatomical features, corrected my natural asymmetry, and healed naturally. During the surgery he had good surgical hygiene and focus, and was aware of signs of potential complications. The sutures healed symmetrically and evenly and I had no complications. Right after the procedure there was lots of swelling which is expected, about a month afterward it looks how I was picturing. I opted for local anesthesia and it was most painful right after the anesthesia wore off but staff was helpful in getting me pain medication and prophylactic antibiotics post-op. Support staff was attentive, friendly, and helpful in walking me through the whole process. They corrected a physical insecurity that had been bothering me for years. Happy with the clinic, I would go back.

0x30e29f295233ef5d_0xfb6062ce4f50e68d.text: Hello everyone! Today I'm sharing my experience with double eyelid surgery at Interplast Clinic with Dr. Teerapong. I got it at a very affordable price. It's been three months now, and I'm absolutely thrilled! It was my first surgery ever, and the doctor and everyone involved were incredibly friendly. Before the surgery, I had a consultation with the doctor, and they provided excellent advice and guidance. I thought about it a lot before deciding; I was afraid of the pain and potential post-operative problems. But after the surgery, I felt so relieved because I didn't feel any pain or discomfort at all. The doctor and everyone provided excellent post-operative care, including medication and regular follow-up checkups. I want to thank the clinic for their care and attention. Finally, if anyone is considering double eyelid surgery, I highly recommend Interplast Clinic. The doctor and everyone there are wonderful! 😊
0x30e29f295233ef5d_0xfb6062ce4f50e68d.author: Jitwadee Butlakhon

0x30e29f295233ef5d_0xfb6062ce4f50e68d.text: Hi everyone! Today marks one month since my double eyelid and rhinoplasty (augmentation + hump reduction) at INTERPLAS CLINIC. I wanted to share my experience in case it helps others who are considering or are thinking about getting a nose job but are hesitant or just researching options. I wanted to make this review an option for your decision-making process. I'm very happy with the results. The nose shape is beautiful; my friends and people around me say it suits me perfectly. My face has changed; I look prettier and more defined. I'm so happy and love it so much! It's exactly what I wanted. My face is settling in more since the surgery, but the tip of my nose isn't completely healed yet. The doctor said it will heal a little more. As for my eyes, there are still some slight marks and occasional itching, but overall everything is normal and there are no problems.
0x30e29f295233ef5d_0xfb6062ce4f50e68d.author: กรกวี เงินดิษฐ์

0x30e29f295233ef5d_0xfb6062ce4f50e68d.text: **AVOID THIS DOCTOR AT ALL COSTS** I had breast revision surgery with this doctor in February 2023. The implant I received was a Motiva Ergonomix 1 with a chip. A few months after my surgery, I noticed a hardening of the implant, which worsened over time. I contacted the clinic and returned to see the doctor in March 2024, but I realized he couldn’t remember where my implant was placed and had no knowledge of the warranty policy for the Motiva brand. I revisited him in July of this year to get more details about the revision surgery he performed. To my horror, I discovered he did not remove the old capsule during the revision surgery, despite this being a critical step for addressing capsular contracture. Instead, he replaced the old implant with a new one. Additionally, he was unsure about the implant placement. At first, he said it was under the muscle, then later stated it was above the muscle after I asked for clarification. He also claimed to have no information regarding the warranty for Motiva implants, stating he was "just a surgeon" and did not know the policies. I expressed that I no longer had confidence in his ability to perform another revision surgery and requested a refund to seek treatment elsewhere. At this point, he became aggressive, accused me of only wanting money, and refused to continue the conversation. He instructed me to speak with the staff and dismissed me from the clinic. After he left, I attempted to discuss the issue with the staff, but to no avail. I texted the clinic after the incident, but they refused to respond until my sister reached out. They insisted that there was no wrongdoing regarding the surgery. My intention in sharing this is to raise awareness. **DISCLAIMER: All the statements above are factual, and I have the entire voice recording as proof.**
0x30e29f295233ef5d_0xfb6062ce4f50e68d.author: Melvin king

0x30e297cec5cb41e9_0x71e98ba5684bcb59.text: มาเขียนใบประวัติเส็จ รอหมอมา11.30 เรามาเป็นคิวที่2 เรามาตั้งแต่10.20 แต่ต้องมานั้งรอหมอ พอรอถึงเวลาหมอมา คิวแรกเข้าไป แล้วคิวที่3,4,5เข้าก่อนเราเฉยเลย รอไปอีก2-3ชั่วโมงก็ยังไม่ได้เข้า แต่คนแรกยังไม่ออกมา แต่3,4,5ออกไปจนจะถึงบ้านอยู่ล่ะ เรายังไม่ได้เข้าเลย เสียเวลามาก ไม่รู้ว่าเรารีบหรือไม่รีบ ก็ให้เรารอเรียก ไอ้เราก็ไปต่อไปเถอะ เรียกชื่อคนอื่นแล้วคนอื่นอีก ไอ้เราก็งงว่า ไหนเราเป็นคิวที่2ไง แต่ทำไมเค้ายังไม่เรียกเข้าห้องอีก แค่เรามาอุดฟัน ทำไมมันนานขนาดนี้
0x30e297cec5cb41e9_0x71e98ba5684bcb59.en: I filled out the medical form and waited for the doctor to arrive at 11:30. I was the second in line. I arrived at 10:20, but had to sit and wait. When the doctor arrived, the first person in line went in, then the 3rd, 4th, and 5th people went in before me. I waited another 2-3 hours and still hadn't been called in. The first person hadn't even come out yet, but the 3rd, 4th, and 5th people had already left and were almost home. I still hadn't been called in. It was such a waste of time. I was confused because I was the second in line, but they still hadn't called me into the room. It's just a filling, why is it taking so long?

0x30e297cec5cb41e9_0x71e98ba5684bcb59.text: พึ่งเคยไปอุดฟันครั้งแรกที่แย่มาก เข้าไปก็พาลูกเหลือเราชนะอยู่8ร้อยก็เลยใช้เราชนะ พอลูกเราเข้าไปก็พูดด้วยน้ำเสียงที่ไม่ดีบอกลูกเรานอนลงๆพูดเหมือนเราเป็นนักโทษยังไงยังงั้น อุดเสร็จจ่ายตังกลับบ้านผ่านไป1อาทิตย์ ที่อุดมันร้าวก็เลยกลับไปใหม่แล้วกะจะอุดเพิ่ม แต่พอไปบอกมาอุดฟันเพิ่มบอกอันที่อุดอันที่แล้วมันร้าว หมอดูแล้วก็บอกว่ามันไม่ร้าวนะคะมันเป็นร่องฟัน แต่เราเปิดไฟจ่ายคืนเห็นชัดมากว่ามันร้าวแต่ไม่อยากมีปันหา แล้ววันนั้นก็อุดเพิ่ม2ซี่ ทั้งหมด3ซี่เราครั้งแรก พอจ่ายตั้งรอบนี้ซี่ละ6ร้อย แต่ครั้งก่อนหน้านี้ที่ใช้เราชนะ8ร้อย แต่ที่ป้ายติดอยู่ซี่ละ6ร้อยเพราะเราพึ่งเห็น ทุกคนคิดยังไงค่ะ อุดไปได้1-2เดือนที่อุดทั้งหมด3ซี่เหลือที่อุดอยู่ซี่เดียว แล้วไอซี่ที่ร้าวก็แตกเครื่องเหลือที่อุดอยู่ครึ่งนึง เป็นไปได้ไม่อยากให้สักดาวเดียวเลย
0x30e297cec5cb41e9_0x71e98ba5684bcb59.en: I had a terrible first experience getting fillings. I went in with my child and we had a discount of 800 baht from the "payout scheme" (using the scheme's credit card). When my child went in, the dentist spoke to us in a rude tone, telling my child to lie down, treating us like prisoners. After the filling was done, we paid and went home. A week later, the filling cracked, so we went back to get more fillings. The dentist examined it and said it wasn't cracked, just a groove, but I could clearly see the crack under the light, though I didn't want any trouble. That day, we got two more fillings, making a total of three. This time, we paid 600 baht per filling, whereas the previous time we paid 800 baht (the sign said 600 baht per filling, which I only noticed later). What do you all think? After 1-2 months, out of the three fillings, only one remains, and the cracked one has completely broken, leaving only half the filling. I wouldn't give a single star if I could.

0x311d67f18f624a21_0xccc01792fd4dcad.text: I'm very disappointed. I made a 500 baht deposit for an appointment at 12:00. I rushed to get dressed and arrived on time because I was afraid I wouldn't get my appointment. It turned out there was someone else in line, which is understandable. The clinic's promotion was quite attractive, and the price was much cheaper than other places. I sat and waited. While I was sitting there, a staff member came up to inform me that it would be a short wait. I thought that the injection would probably be done in a while. I waited from 12:00 to 12:40, so I decided not to do it because I had other things to do. Within 40 minutes, there was no further reaction. I thought that if they had enough service mind, they might have given me a rough time or told me to go have lunch and call to inform them. But in this case, there was no time estimate at all. There was no reaction at all. They just made me wait. So I asked if I could get my deposit back after waiting for more than 30 minutes. The clinic refused, saying that it was not a refund because the clinic was not at fault. I was confused as to whether it was normal for the clinic to let me wait longer than 30 minutes. I've been to clinics with a long queue, but the sales staff talked and asked me to go have lunch. Sometimes they serve snacks because they were afraid that the customer would feel bad. But in this case, they just let it go. Ultimately, I was able to get a refund, but the wait was 7-14 days. Anyone who came because of the enticing promotion price, be prepared for the time constraints. As for me, I'll pass. Furthermore, the staff member's words made it seem like long waits were normal, and they couldn't blame me for the wait. So, I'd like to share my disappointing experience, even before the injection, for anyone else who doesn't want to waste their time like me. 🙏🏻
0x311d67f18f624a21_0xccc01792fd4dcad.author: Papatsorn Chaichumpol

0x30e29d2c661286e7_0x68110a8faa15e4da.text: A year ago, I went for a re-treatment. The result was exactly as advertised, but I didn't pay the full amount I was promised. They told me I needed to have my tartar removed, and the doctor was being sarcastic. In the end, I spent a whopping 4,000 baht that day. The doctor spoke politely, but with a sarcastic and mocking tone. I'm very dissatisfied. I spent a lot of money at this clinic – fillings, scaling, and retainers – totaling over 3000 baht – but the service I received was not worth it at all. Even the retainer adjustment was terrible. One visit is enough. I won't be coming back. I'll choose another clinic that's more expensive but has better service. Goodbye.

0x30e2996d52061a81_0x53a4da543fc6426a.text: We were recommended this clinic by our hotel. My partner and I both had road rash from a motorbike accident, I wasn't too bad but he had quite severe wounds. The nurses are very professional and friendly! They speak quite a bit of English and they spend a lot of time on each wound to make sure they are clean and are gentle unlike a lot of clinics (who rip off bandages that are stuck to open wounds, tearing off healing skin). Some clinics are known to give medicines that aren't needed to get extra money from you but this clinic didn't. They had to scrub our wounds, which sounds awful and was at other clinics, but they made this experience so much easier and comfortable. This clinic isn't too expensive, but more than average. BUT you get what you pay for. I felt our wounds after a week were not healing but the first day after we went to this clinic our wounds were so much better and we could see they were healing and they felt much better. We came from Phuket (where the accident happened) which we went to a couple of different clinics and they were rough, expensive and didn't clean or dress the woulds correctly. We highly recommend this clinic! They accept travelers insurance also and are open 24 hours! We sometimes see one of the nurses around and she always says hello!
0x30e2996d52061a81_0x53a4da543fc6426a.author: Monique Martyn

0x30e2996d52061a81_0x53a4da543fc6426a.text: I was suffering with severe food poisoning and after 9 hours of not being able to keep water down I was becoming severely dehydrated. I was too sick to go anywhere. Short of calling an ambulance there wasn't much I could do and I was really scared for my life. These angels came to my hostel. Without their intervention I am convinced I would have passed out and died in my sleep. I believe they saved my life. They were more kind and compassionate than most medical professionals I've dealt with back in the states. First of all, in America they would never make a house call. I'd have had to go to the emergency room or call an ambulance for $2000 plus. Words cannot describe my gratitude for their care in my time of desperate need. What I was charged was very reasonable compared to back home and it was worth every baht. If you're suffering like I was do not hesitate to call these people. They saved me.
0x30e2996d52061a81_0x53a4da543fc6426a.author: Juliana Rowe

0x30e2996d52061a81_0x53a4da543fc6426a.text: I visited Cambodia and I arrived to Bangkok with fever lasted already for 3 days. Me and my girlfriend visited Dr.Khaosan Clinic at 22:30. Asking me what I need, how I need etc. Provided me soup, fresh fruit, medications, soap, shampoo etc when I had to spend a day at their place. (Which was better than my hotel room). I didn't ever feel at all if I was in a hospital. Many thanks dr. Toon, Way and everyone else helping me!

0x30e2996d52061a81_0x53a4da543fc6426a.text: The consultation fee was 700 baht, which is fine, but charging 1440 baht for an antibiotic, which I obviously didn't pay for since I bought it at the pharmacy on the corner for 120 baht, I think is highway robbery. When the doctor finished examining me, he wrote down my case and the medication I should take on a form. He didn't say goodbye, he just stood up and left me sitting there waiting. My partner went to reception to see what was happening, and the doctor was at the door, about to leave... all very strange, right? The receptionist showed me a paper indicating that I had to pay 6500 baht in total because I had to pay for the consultation plus the medication. After some calculations, I paid only for the consultation as required and waited 10 minutes for her to give me a receipt. The paper in the photo was the prescription. You have to be careful with what they charge; it's excessive. Check carefully and make sure they give you an itemized list. It's a huge business taking advantage of tourists, a real rip-off.
0x30e2996d52061a81_0x53a4da543fc6426a.author: Lj SV

0x30e2996d52061a81_0x53a4da543fc6426a.text: I used it because it was close to the cheap lodging and I didn't have much to move around, but I thought it would be better to just go to Bumrungrad. Since it's a clinic, I thought it wouldn't be too expensive, but they charge 7,000 baht for a similar flu test and treatment at Bumrungrad and 6,000 baht here. However, the difference in facilities and service is huge. I said I thought I had the flu, but they checked my blood pressure for nothing, and that was on the list. What's more, Bumrungrad gave me the real Tamiflu, but here they gave me a Thai-style medicine. I'm worried about the efficacy.

0x30e2996d52061a81_0x53a4da543fc6426a.text: Went for a malaria test and complete blood test. Got tested. Told me everything came negative for malaria. Told me I need a dengue fever test. Because I had no insurance staff had no interest in helping me find a hospital. Just Google it!! This place is a rip off and extremely unprofessional. Stay away. The staff at the hospital I finally ended up at were laughing at the blood report that they gave me. STAY AWAY!!

0x30e29c166db23063_0x9cfb5abbe4cc001d.text: I just finished my dental work here and as always I've never been disappointed ever since I was introduced to this place and Dr. Photjana over 10 years ago. My wife and I live in the US. We have been treated with so many different dentists there and we have never been happy with any of them, neither with their practice ethics nor their sales tactics to trick us into unnecessary add-on services with higher charges. To get a lousy and extremely expensive crown work in US could have paid for two to three best crowns performed by her here, with airfare included. She's so knowledgeable. She is so willing to take her time to diagnose and patiently work on all very hard cases which we couldn't get them fixed properly in the US. She was once taught in a school of dentistry at a well-known university in the states. Ever since, every time we visit Thailand which is every other year, we'll always make appointments ahead of time first thing first to see her to have our dental needs done before we even go enjoy the rest with our trips. I highly recommend her. And last but not least, I strongly dispute some of the other reviews claiming that the place is not clean. This definitely is not true. Period!

0x30da30780b28da6d_0x41d0f60fb7e80194.text: On November 5th, 2019 (today), I brought a relative from Phitsanulok to see a doctor. We traveled since 4 AM. Upon entering the hospital, I was very impressed with all the staff. - First, the security guard politely helped us find parking. Once we found a parking spot, two people quickly came to help direct us, and another person in civilian clothes (probably a member of the public) also helped. They were all very cheerful and provided excellent service. I even felt guilty for not buying them coffee because I was busy checking on my patient. 1. The first point, the man in the yellow uniform at the registration point, was very helpful and attentive. 2. The point where we filled out the medical history information, was also very helpful. He urged us to fill it out quickly because he was worried we wouldn't make it in time for the morning queue. He did his best, and we managed to get in on time for the afternoon queue (very impressed, worth the wait). 3. The new patient registration point was good. 4. The screening point, queue B, number 2, was very polite to everyone. 5. The man (or woman) at the social welfare office provided excellent service, was very helpful and polite. 6. The doctor at the social welfare office was very polite and gave excellent advice. 7. Dr. Wachana, who examined me in room 4, gave excellent advice. I forgot my medical certificate after the examination and went back to request it, but he was still very helpful and not annoyed at all. 8. The finance department provided good service and the staff were polite. 9. The pharmacy counter (front counter 8, male staff member) provided excellent service and advice. After receiving my medication, I forgot something and went back to have the medication description written down. He wrote it for me and gave helpful advice with a smile. 10. The referral room for patients returning to their place of residence provided excellent advice and service. Everything was completed with a smile on everyone's faces. The service was incredibly impressive. Everyone was chatting amongst themselves. It would be wonderful if all hospital staff were like this. Everyone was tired, but they had a great spirit and excellent ethics. Usually, you only see this in luxurious, expensive hospitals in Bangkok, but even those aren't always good in every department. The only places with excellent service in every department are 5-star hotels. But this hospital made me and my companion feel better than we would at a luxury hotel. There was more than just smiles and service; there was genuine sincerity and a feeling of genuine kindness from within. Thank you to everyone, and thank you to the director for selecting such good staff to serve the public. I will remember this day and continue to support everyone. Oh... and thank you to the relative of the patient I was with as well, while I was looking for the restroom. They were also very helpful, even walking me to the restroom. Driving there and back was tiring, but I was incredibly impressed. It's beyond words. Somkiat Chainbarameetham
0x30da30780b28da6d_0x41d0f60fb7e80194.author: somkiat chaiyabarrameetham

0x30da30780b28da6d_0x41d0f60fb7e80194.text: I was admitted to this hospital as emergency three years ago as I was Full of emotions due to very horrible experiences could not control myself and known myself at Thai Burmese border near Mae Hong Son while I was in Thailand. I was at this hospital for about ten days for the treatment, I could not remember all of my experiences while I stayed at this hospital. For those that might need help with mental health, I personally recommend to use upgrade services which is available around 1500 Baths to 2000 Baths per night that you will have your own shared room with much friendly staffs and better food. I am agree that the standard or normal service that you will have to stay and sleep with more than 20 patients in one large room and the staff are very strict so the standard or normal service of this hospital is a little bit touch for as foreigners to hand on but cheaper, I stayed 10 days including upgrade service costed me only 20,000 Baths. Therefore if you or your family member want the treatment from this hospital, I am strongly suggest that use the upgrade services which is only available upon the request. I am now partially or fully recovered and so thankful that this hospital was there and saved me, otherwise I can not for see my future. Thank you, get well soon.

Once the injection was real, I felt like, "Okay, this is what an Advanced Injector should be!" I realized that I'd only ever encountered basic injectors before; this doctor was much more precise than I'd ever experienced. I used to have a downturned lip and had a corrective injection elsewhere that left one side of my lip distorted. I was abroad at the time and couldn't get it corrected, so I was traumatized and stopped getting Botox for a year and a half. But this time, there were no problems. I can smile more easily, and my face feels lighter. I'm happy, but also a little nervous about the results. After more than a week, I feel like it's working. The price was slightly higher than what I've had before, but that's understandable because the doctor is truly skilled. If anyone reading this review is considering going there... Please thank the doctor on our behalf! 555 I have a small suggestion—I think the clinic should have a price list of procedures (e.g., on LINE) so people can prepare their budget in advance more easily.

At this clinic, the practitioner carefully performs pulse diagnosis and consultation during each visit, and adjusts the treatment plan accordingly based on my condition that day. I have found that my symptoms are consistently relieved after each session. The clinic environment is clean and well-maintained, and all the staff are friendly and welcoming, always greeting patients with a warm smile. The doctor is not only professional and attentive, but also exceptionally patient and gentle in providing care. In addition, the clinic owner is very open to feedback and often takes into consideration my perspective as a Chinese patient. Overall, I believe this clinic is well worth trying. At the same time, I would encourage giving the treatment some time, as the benefits of traditional Chinese medicine typically become more evident with consistent and ongoing care.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for safe, effective, and natural wellness solutions in Thailand. — Tom

0x30da3a857b7417af_0x4a156d18ef0d595d.text: Wow! Time medicine is so far ahead of the United States. He examined me for anything precancerous on my skin, and found a few places. After this very thorough examination, he froze off the trouble spots in a completely fast and painless procedure. 0x30da3a857b7417af_0x4a156d18ef0d595d.text: I attended the dermatology department for a skin/mole check and had a small biopsy done during the appointment. Getting an appointment was straight forward and the staff were prompt with their replies. The procedure itself was completed, but overall my experience was disappointing. The communication and aftercare process were not as clear as I expected. I was initially told to return in person for the biopsy results and stitch removal. After I contacted the hospital, they were able to email the pathology result to me instead. I appreciated that this was possible, but I wish this option had been explained upfront, as it saved me both time and additional cost. I also found the itemised bill difficult to understand. For a small biopsy, the bill appeared to include multiple glove charges — around 10 pairs/items of gloves in total, including surgical and latex gloves, about 287 baht total — as well as 150 ml of saline, listed at 142 baht, which I did not recall being used or receiving for wound care. There was also a nylon suture item charged at 409 baht. I contacted the hospital to ask for clarification and was told the query would be forwarded to the department head, but I did not receive any follow-up explanation. During the consultation, comments about sun damage and sunscreen made me feel quite self-conscious. I understand that sun exposure is medically important, hence why I do regular skin checks, but I would have appreciated a more neutral and supportive explanation. Overall, while the clinical procedure was completed, I felt the communication, billing clarity, and aftercare guidance could have been much better.
0x30da3a857b7417af_0x4a156d18ef0d595d.author: John, Kara and Mack Ross

0x30da3a857b7417af_0x4a156d18ef0d595d.text: Saw a skin specialist here after 4 weeks of itching in full body and having consulted a doctor in another hospital. Really disappointed that after having suffered for a month the doctor isn't thinking outside the box for what could be the root cause and just prescribed further ten days with antihistamines. It is a common sense that until the cause is found the symptoms would not go away. Further the medication was charged at double the price 466 THB for 10 pills which is available in pharmacy for 225 THB. My confidence in this hospital died completely when they asked me to come after two days to review the blood reports and pay the same doctor fee again. I think the following up with the doctor for reports should not be another consultation fee and it's unethical practice because I already paid for the doctor and blood tests during my first visit. What is more upsetting that not all the reports be available in two days then why book follow up in two days? With this type of business practice, I cancelled my appointment and found a local, old and experienced skin specialist. It was a humanly experience to meet that man who immediately thought could be the problem from my initial blood reports and gave prescription. He even suggested places to visit in the city and hiking points. I think a doctor should make patient feel at ease first. I am hoping this will work because just taking antihistamines from these big hospitals is not curing the problem at all. Further the medication should be cheaper in big hospitals and not make business. I feel the patient care and medicare are dead in big branded hospitals.
0x30da3a857b7417af_0x4a156d18ef0d595d.author: Jayant Solanki

0x30e29c1a1124ccd5_0x628bcee0c57650c8.en: This was my first time getting my teeth cleaned in 24 years. The service was excellent, starting from the counter. The dentist had a very gentle touch. During the procedure, they were very kind, giving advice and constantly asking if I was in pain, if I was okay with anything, and if I needed to let them know if it hurt, if I wanted them to stop, or if I needed a break. They even asked me to turn left or right, and I thanked them repeatedly. They were so polite and lovely. I was very impressed. The assistant was also very nice. The clinic was clean, and the service was great.

0x30503aa248747279_0xe0ff9b6f01619ceb.text: Super clean, the staff are very kind and very efficient. Everything is clearly labelled in Thai and English, often also in Chinese and Russian. I find the prices really cheap. If you don't have an appointment, you get a number on your form when you take your vitals (automatic blood pressure/ heart rate/etc test machine) and register. The nurses will call you by number and name. They will make sure to call in a way you understand if you aren't Thai, so don't worry about language barriers. The doctors and nurses speak perfectly understandable English. The doctor even filled out my care recommendation in English. In the winter, a kind man from Switzerland is at the information desk to help you find your way around. Do note that the nurses have a lunch break ending at about 13:00, with the doctors' break ending at about 13:30, so for non- emergency cases I recommend you come in the morning. There is a very cute garden smoking area with some animals and a stone table with a chess board on it. If you stand facing the blue atm (pictured) and look to the right you'll see it just next to the ramp. I hope I don't get injured again (I walked into a low concrete structure lol), but if I do I'll feel safe and happy coming here! Lastly, please consider putting whatever you can in the donation boxes in the two large halls on either side of the hospital this is a state hospital with not much funding and they are doing an amazing job!
0x30503aa248747279_0xe0ff9b6f01619ceb.author: Alice S

0x30503aa248747279_0xe0ff9b6f01619ceb.text: I would like to explain how patient care is prioritized at this government hospital, especially for foreign patients. All patients are first assessed by medical staff and classified as clinically stable or unstable, based on basic evaluations such as vital signs. • If your vital signs are stable, you will be directed to the Outpatient Department (OPD). • If your vital signs are unstable, you will be managed in the Emergency Department (ED). As this is a government hospital, medical resources and staff are limited. Therefore, priority is given to severe and life-threatening cases, such as patients who are unconscious, require intubation, have severe trauma, or conditions that may result in organ loss. For this reason, long waiting times—especially at night—are normal, particularly if your condition is stable, such as having cough, fever, or mild symptoms that have already been evaluated by medical staff. If you prefer faster service, you may choose to visit a private clinic or private hospital. However, please be aware that the cost will be significantly higher compared to government hospitals, which provide more affordable care. Thank you for your understanding. Please take good care of yourself—and always wear a helmet when riding a motorcycle.
0x30503aa248747279_0xe0ff9b6f01619ceb.author: Phatteera Chaiyaphongtarin

Three days later, during the dressing change at Ko phi phi, it was discovered that the infection had (very likely) become inflamed due to poor cleaning in the hospital and the lack of daily dressing changes, and it required surgical cleaning. 0x30503aa248747279_0xe0ff9b6f01619ceb.text: Arrived around 0900am and registered and given a number. There were SIX other visitors at casualty/A&E. When you are called eventually you are asked if you've taken your blood pressure and had you had your weight & height taken (of course not, no one told us this was required) This was done and we continued to wait for what seemed another hour. It is 1345 now. A short consultation & we were advised to sit outside another area for 'dressing'. We sat outside the dressing area, not knowing to ask or wait ? So I decided to ask and the hospital person said to wait. It is now 1430. at 1500, we had a small dressing cleaned and rebandaged. The hospital prescribed painkillers and antibiotics. That cost 1400 bahtt. We left after paying and picking up the prescription. It's now 1545. We arrived at 0900. So if you do come here, make sure you register and have your blood pressure and height and weight taken and be prepared for a very long wait. Ideally, bring water and something to snack on. There is clearly no one rushing around here so let's hope you don't have a medical emergency and needed to come here. Having said all the above, for this done privately at one of the tourist-aimed pharmacy/clinics, it would have cost approx 9000 bahtt (we paid 1400 bahtt)
