0x30503aa248747279_0xe0ff9b6f01619ceb.text: Absolutely joke. Want to give negative star only if I can and I almost alway only give only good review. We trying to get the ATK COVID test for going to bangkok. I called them at 9:30 to ask if you have this service available. They told me that they only accepted 15 people per day, do not accept appointments and will only do the test until 11 am. We arrive at 9:45. I told the blood pressure test and measure my weight. They then notify me that they won’t start the test until 10:30. So 1.5 hours wait outside in the heat. No shop to sell water. No vending machine. Be prepared and bring your own water. And at 11:05 we decided to ask them what going on. They said that the doctor will need to take care of all the walk-in patients first before start doing ATK. Why would you need doctor to do the ATK anyway? Anywhere else in the world nurse can do the ATK. After the test you have to come back at 1 pm to collect the result. I wonder if they know how to use email or Text. What a typical Thai government hospital. If you have money just go for the private one unless you want to waste the whole day. The toilet here is old fashion. No toilet seat and no toilet paper
0x30503aa248747279_0xe0ff9b6f01619ceb.author: Watanya Morrison

0x30503aa248747279_0xe0ff9b6f01619ceb.text: The service was absolutely terrible. Completely unprofessional and the staff were rude. I honestly wouldn't even give them a single star. I was sick, and I know my condition is contagious. They made me wait outside, which I understood. They told me to wait for my medical history but wouldn't let me provide anything. They acted like they were disgusted with me. If the doctor is going to be like this, who am I supposed to ask for help? When it was my turn to see them, they were still rude. They asked a few questions, and when they took my temperature, they even said something like, "We're going to use that on children!" I was confused. And didn't they have a separate thermometer? Where's the hygiene? I've never taken a temperature before, and when I did, I pulled it away too quickly. They said it hadn't even gone off yet, and I pulled it away too fast. They were in a bad mood. Why didn't they tell me that? It was like they didn't want to work. The public relies on you; please provide better service, medical personnel. *Note: The other doctors spoke nicely.* I also work in service. No matter how bad your mood is, you shouldn't take it out on others.
0x30503aa248747279_0xe0ff9b6f01619ceb.author: Thanks Biko

0x30503aa248747279_0xe0ff9b6f01619ceb.text: A complete failure on all fronts. I want to warn everyone who values ​​their health. 1. Dismissive attitude towards patients. Absolutely no one here cares about people. Even if you're really sick, be prepared to wait in line for 3-5 hours. There's no scheduling system, and appointment times mean nothing. 2. Doctors don't explain diagnoses. They treat you "blindly"—they might prescribe something or even perform surgery, but they don't give you any conclusions or really explain what exactly happened. You leave completely in the dark. 3. Terrible hospital organization. A patient can be kept in the hospital for just a couple of days and then discharged "to nowhere." In our case, we were sent home without a final examination or discharge instructions. They simply said, "Go." Result: wasted nerves and time. Treatment here is risky. I strongly recommend it.
0x30503aa248747279_0xe0ff9b6f01619ceb.author: Vasily Shevtsov

0x30e29f32da9842ff_0x89092795cad6fdc5.text: พนักงานหน้าเค้าเตอร์บริการดี พูดจาสุภาพ - คุณหมอทุกคนก็พูดเพราะ ยกมือไหว้สวัสดีเราทุกคนเลย - หมอก็ชวนคุยเก่ง พอเราไม่ตอบก็ว่าเราหยิ่งอี๊กกก ... - คลินิกสะอาด สะอ้านมาก - คลินิกอยู่ชั้น 12 สาทรธานี ตึก 2 นะ เดินมาแล้วกดลิฟต์ขึ้นได้เลย ไม่ต้องแลกบัตร (เสียเวลา เพราะยามไม่ตรวจอะไรเลย) - ห้องน้ำอยู่ในหลืบใกล้ ๆ คลินิก - ราคา ถือว่าถูกนะ ถ้าเทียบกับบริการที่ได้รับ - แนะนำเลยค้าบ คลินิกนี้ มีแพทย์ให้บริการเกี่ยวกับทันตกรรมทุกประเภท - แต่อย่าลืมนัดก่อนเข้าใช้บริการเด้อ
0x30e29f32da9842ff_0x89092795cad6fdc5.author: Paitoon Pairor
0x30e29f32da9842ff_0x89092795cad6fdc5.en: The front desk staff provided excellent service and were very polite. - All the doctors were also very polite, greeting us with a wai (traditional Thai greeting). - The doctors were very talkative, and when we didn't respond, they even called us arrogant! - The clinic was very clean. - The clinic is located on the 12th floor of Sathorn Thani Building 2. Just walk up and take the elevator; no need to exchange cards (it's a waste of time because the security guard doesn't check anything). - The restrooms are tucked away near the clinic. - The price is considered cheap compared to the service received. - I highly recommend this clinic! They have doctors providing all types of dental services. - But don't forget to make an appointment before your visit!

0x30e29f32da9842ff_0x89092795cad6fdc5.text: แนะนำเลยค่ะ ที่นี่ดีมาก ดีตั้งแต่พนักงานเคาเตอร์ ผู้ช่วย คุณหมอ พูดจา ยิ้มแย้ม เคลียร์ช่องปากละเอียดมากค่ะ ขูดหินปูนไม่เคยเจอที่ไหนละเอียดขนาดนี้ ขนาดเราใช้สิทธิ์ประกันสังคมยังทำละเอียดมากๆๆๆ ไม่ทำลวกๆเหมือนที่เคยๆเจอจากที่อื่น ฟอกสีฟันขาวขึ้นตั้งแต่ครั้งแรก มีเสียวฟันแบบจิ๊ดๆๆๆๆ ไม่เหมือนที่คิดไว้ว่า ที่เคยฟังจากคนอื่นว่าจะเสียวมากๆๆๆๆ แนะนำเลยค่ะ
0x30e29f32da9842ff_0x89092795cad6fdc5.author: Parichat Buangam
0x30e29f32da9842ff_0x89092795cad6fdc5.en: I highly recommend this place. Everything is great, from the counter staff and assistants to the dentist. They are all friendly and smiling, and they do a very thorough job of cleaning my mouth. I've never had such a detailed scaling procedure anywhere else. Even though I used my social security insurance, they still did a very meticulous job, unlike what I've experienced elsewhere where they do it haphazardly. My teeth whitening was noticeable from the first session. There was only a slight tingling sensation, unlike what I expected from hearing others would say. I highly recommend it!

0x30e29f32da9842ff_0x89092795cad6fdc5.text: ไปฟอกฟันขาวมา คุณหมออธิบายดี ใจดีมากค่ะ อธิบายทุกขั้นตอนเลย เราฟันA3 ขาวสุดได้A1 ขาวมา2เฉดค่ะ ถือว่าพอใจแล้วสำหรับเรา เสียวจี๊ดๆแค่ตอนฟอกรอบที่2ค่ะ หลังจากนั้นก็ไม่รู้สึกอะไรเลยอาจจะมีแว๊บๆเสียวเข้ามาบ้าง พนักงานต้อนรับพูดดีพูดเพราะแนะนำดีมากค่ะ เราได้โปร 1766 จ่ายเท่านั้นเลยไม่มีเพิ่ม ดีมากค่ะ ถ้าฟันกลับมาเหลืองปีหน้า มีโอกาสจะไปทำใหม่อีกค่ะ
0x30e29f32da9842ff_0x89092795cad6fdc5.author: paphatsaranakardhan 18
0x30e29f32da9842ff_0x89092795cad6fdc5.en: I went for teeth whitening. The dentist was very kind and explained every step of the process well. My teeth were A3 level (the whitest they could be), but I got A1, two shades whiter. I'm very satisfied with the results. I only felt a slight tingling sensation during the second whitening session. After that, I didn't feel anything, maybe just a fleeting sensitivity sometimes. The receptionist was very polite, helpful, and gave great advice. I got a promotional price of 1766 baht, which was all I paid, no extra charges. It was great! If my teeth turn yellow again next year, I'll definitely go back.

0x30e29f32da9842ff_0x89092795cad6fdc5.text: Went today, after 4 years of different dentist and root canals, split my tooth last week and needed an extraction...they were polite, helpful..very competent and as soon as I walked in put me at ease.. very very clean and modern.. Lady dentist explained everything as she went.. great service ..reasonable..and would go back...thank you!

0x30e29f32da9842ff_0x89092795cad6fdc5.text: จัดฟันใสที่นี่กับคุณหมอท็อป 12+12 sets คุณหมอและสตาฟทุกคนน่ารักมากค่ะ ให้คำแนะนำดีมาก จากนั้นก็มาทำฟัน อุดฟัน ขูดหินปูนกะที่นี่เรื่อยๆเลย หมอผู้หญิงอุดฟันดี เนี้ยบ อุดคอฟัน2ปีละยังไม่หลุด ทน มาก (จำชื่อไม่ได้ ขอโทษนะคะ) เคยวาร์ปไปอุดฟันที่อื่นงานแย่ จนต้องกลับมาทำที่นี่ใหม่ คุณหมอน่ารักพูดจาดีค่ะ

0x30e29f32da9842ff_0x89092795cad6fdc5.en: I went for teeth whitening, but my teeth didn't get any whiter. I feel like I wasted my money. However, I went to my appointment on time, didn't have to wait long, and got the treatment done right away. The counter staff were polite. I went for whitening on Saturday, January 4th, 2025. When comparing the before and after colors, they did it very quickly and then rushed to take my things away. I wasted my money and time.

0x311d5cfb60b21e27_0xf6ede00b10861bbb.text: ไปรักษาที่นี่มาหลายครั้งหลายเรื่องมากแล้วค่ะ ครั้งแรกที่ไปก็คือประทับใจมากเลย คุณหมอใส่ใจตั้งใจฟังปัญหาช่องปากของเรามากๆ มากแบบเพิ่งเคยเจอแบบนี้ครั้งแรกเลยค่ะ การพูดคุยของคุณหมอเป็นกันเอง ให้ความรู้สึกสบายใจไม่กลัวเลยค่ะ และทุกครั้งที่ไปรักษาเรื่องอื่นๆ ก็ประทับใจทุกครั้งค่ะ คุณหมอทุกท่านที่นี่รักษาดีมากค่ะ มือเบา สุภาพ และเป็นมิตรมากค่ะ ผู้ช่วยฯทุกคนก็สุภาพและเป็นมิตรเช่นกันค่ะ ภายในคลินิกสะอาดและกว้างดีค่ะ มีห้องตรวจ 3 ห้อง ห้อง x-ray 1 ห้อง อาจจะมีจุดบกพร่องไปบ้างนิดหน่อย แต่โดยส่วนตัวขอมองข้ามค่ะ ในเมื่อคุณหมอรักษาดี ทุกอย่างก็โอเคค่ะ
0x311d5cfb60b21e27_0xf6ede00b10861bbb.author: G NaDa
0x311d5cfb60b21e27_0xf6ede00b10861bbb.en: I've been here for many treatments and various issues. My first visit was incredibly impressive. The doctor was very attentive and listened carefully to my oral health concerns—something I'd never experienced before. The doctor was very friendly and approachable, making me feel comfortable and not afraid at all. And every subsequent visit has been equally impressive. All the doctors here are excellent; they are gentle, polite, and friendly. The assistants are also very polite and friendly. The clinic itself is clean and spacious, with three examination rooms and one X-ray room. There might be a few minor drawbacks, but personally, I'd overlook them. Since the doctors provide such good treatment, everything else is great.

0x311d5cfb60b21e27_0xf6ede00b10861bbb.text: วันนี้พาลูกไปถอนฟัน ไม่รู้ว่าไม่มีหมอเด็ก เจอหมอผู้ชายพูดจาไม่ดี ด่าลูกเรา เอามือปิดปากให้หยุดร้องไห้ ชี้หน้าด่าว่าเด็กโกหกที่บอกว่ามันจะเจ็บ แม่เลยบอกว่าน้องเป็นเด็กพัฒนาการช้า เด็กออทิสติก หมอบอกว่าไม่เกี่ยว ก็ด่าชี้หน้าต่อไป สงสารลูกมากน้องเป็นคนขี้กลัวมาก ตกใจเร็ว แต่น้องฝืนจนทำเสร็จ แล้วหมอหันมาบอกเราว่าทีหลังมาหาหมอเด็กนะ เหมือนไม่เต็มใจรักษา ถ้าหมอได้อ่านโปรดพิจารณาตัวเองด้วย ว่าทำให้เด็กคนหนึงกลัวการไปหาหมอฟันตลอดชีวิต แม่เสียใจมากที่พาน้องไปรักษาที่นี่ โปรดใช้คำพูดกับผู้ใช้บริการให้ดีกว่านี้ เพราะเราไปรักษาเสียเงินนะคะ คุณเป็นผู้ให้บริการต้องทำตัวให้ดีกว่านี้ ฝากไว้ให้คิด
0x311d5cfb60b21e27_0xf6ede00b10861bbb.author: Kittima Kamnak
0x311d5cfb60b21e27_0xf6ede00b10861bbb.en: Today I took my child to get a tooth extracted, not knowing there was no pediatric dentist. The male doctor was very rude, scolding my child, covering his mouth to stop him from crying, and pointing at him, accusing him of lying when he said it would hurt. I told him my child has developmental delays and is autistic, but he said that wasn't relevant and continued to scold and point at my child. I felt so sorry for my child; he's very timid and easily startled, but he endured until the procedure was finished. Afterward, the doctor told me to come to a pediatric dentist next time, as if he was unwilling to treat my child. If you, doctor, read this, please reflect on your behavior. You've made a child afraid of dentists for life. I am very upset that I took my child to this clinic. Please use more respectful language with your patients. We paid for this treatment; you are a healthcare provider, you should behave better. Please consider this.

0x30e29ee46117e255_0x2897361b212d5bde.text: Atom Clinic is located in the middle of Asoke Soi. 0x30e29ee46117e255_0x2897361b212d5bde.text: This was my first time at the Sukhumvit branch. I tried their introductory offer: a facial and body white deluxe treatment. The treatment was good and relaxing; they didn't try to push any special packages. I'm not sure if it's because it was a trial version and not a full course, but they didn't even give me a bottle of water (though regular customers seemed to have a menu to choose from). The staff and customers seemed very familiar with each other. There were a lot of young people there, getting acne extractions and Botox injections. As a newcomer, I felt like an uninvited stranger. During the IV drip, they wheeled the IV stand out right in the waiting area (where other customers were waiting) and inserted it in front of everyone. I'd seen reviews saying they do it in a room with a doctor carefully inserting the needle, so I was surprised to see them doing it outside. During the drip, which lasted about 15 minutes, the staff member who was attending to me would occasionally check on my vitamin levels. I'm not sure if they divide the staff to look after each customer, because the other staff members didn't pay any attention to me, not even a smile. It's like only the person taking care of us really knows us. Even if the products are good, if a first-time customer encounters this version, they won't be impressed enough to buy a repeat course. For us, we had high expectations for this clinic because we thought that if it was good, we would continue to buy because we saw good videos on TikTok. But after experiencing it firsthand, we changed our minds. There are so many clinics now, and if this happens on the first visit, if we had the choice, we would probably look for another clinic where we feel impressed from the first visit.
0x30e29ee46117e255_0x2897361b212d5bde.author: Mickey KK

0x30e29ee46117e255_0x2897361b212d5bde.text: I went to the Sukhumvit branch and let me tell you, it was terrible! I usually frequent clinics, but this branch was the worst service I've ever encountered. It was terrible from the moment I called the clinic. They asked me to add them on Line to ask what vitamins were in their ingredients. They then rudely called me. I've never seen a clinic do this before. They didn't even ask permission before calling. Even if the customer answered, that doesn't mean it's appropriate. Asking on Line would be better, but if they were going to call to explain, they should ask permission first. It's very unprofessional. When I asked about treatments and asked for recommendations, the staff member replied asking which course I was interested in. I was so confused. "You just told me to recommend, lol." I didn't know what was included. All I got was the course name and price. "Can you explain the details to customers?" I had to ask again, and then I took a picture of the flyer. It was extremely unprofessional. When I arrived, I felt like a ghost, like I wasn't even a customer. I waited for a moment, and then they invited me straight into the doctor's office. I had to fill out my medical history after the vitamin injection. The order of things was completely out of proportion. If a customer has an allergic reaction, it's going to be a disaster. The staff are talking loudly, the SOP is terrible, as if there aren't any customers. They only treat old customers who seem familiar. New customers are like ghosts. When I went to see the doctor, the doctor didn't even know it was my first time getting a skin injection. Didn't the counter staff tell me anything? Like, aren't you going to give me advice like in the advertisements about how much better my skin will be after getting the injection? What products are included? It's all terrible. I'm so disappointed. And the assistant doctor stood there directing me, saying things like that. It felt like sarcasm. From what I've seen, this branch gets criticized a lot, but you're talking in front of customers. I initially thought I'd buy a package if it was good, but that was the only time. I saw this on Google Reviews, and it's even clearer that many people have had the same experience. After the procedure, the staff didn't say anything at all. They just brought me paperwork to fill out my history, then just asked me to pay. The customer left without saying goodbye or thanking me. I'm telling you, anyone who comes here should think twice. Those images you see on social media will make you think twice.

0x30e29f5c17a8f201_0xa9f7f6118a6e7d04.text: Experience a life-changing first-time beauty treatment at Patama Clinic, Silom branch. For women, deciding to undergo a first-time skincare procedure is no easy feat. I, Sukanya, was one of those who hesitated and researched extensively, especially for my first Botox injection. That is, until I discovered Patama Clinic, Silom branch, which changed my perspective and provided an invaluable experience far exceeding my expectations. The moment I stepped into the clinic, all my nervousness and apprehension vanished. The service here emphasizes a warm, home-away-from-home atmosphere, making me feel relaxed and comfortable in my own private space. This is combined with impeccable standards of cleanliness and hygiene. I felt the care and attention from the receptionist to the overall ambiance. What made me choose this clinic was the clarity and transparency. The consultations were straightforward, explaining everything in a way that was easy to understand for someone without prior experience. All products used are verifiable and FDA-approved. Furthermore, the pricing was reasonable and affordable. It's premium quality within reach, befitting a Thai beauty brand with the potential to reach international standards. And the most important highlight of today is… Sukanya had the opportunity to meet Dr. Patthama directly, and the doctor performed the procedure herself. I truly felt the clinic's "Magic Hand Pro" philosophy. Professional beauty transformation is truly different. Dr. Patthama's touch was incredibly gentle, precise, and skillful. She understood my facial structure and naturally highlighted my best features. From being afraid and anxious, Sukanya can now confidently say that she entrusts her life and face to Patthama Clinic and Dr. Patthama forever. For anyone looking for a clinic that offers beauty, safety, and ultimate peace of mind, Sukanya wholeheartedly recommends this place.

0x30e29f77a7893109_0x958433bb564ae363.author: Sirikul P

0x30e29f77a7893109_0x958433bb564ae363.text: I bought a package of 12 underarm laser hair removal sessions and got 12 whitening sessions free. Each session takes about 1-2 minutes – I was surprised how fast it was! I think I'll need to do all 12 sessions to see real results 😂 It's worth the price. (P.S. This was my first session, so I haven't seen any results yet. I'll wait and see if I see any improvement after the next sessions.) The clinic is clean, and the staff is average. Some of them seem a bit stern and rushed. I like that they don't try to sell you packages; you book what you want and then go home. It's difficult to choose your next appointment date because their schedule is full. They give you a selection of available days. Parking is available at the Wannasorn building; the first hour is free, subsequent hours are 20 baht. ‼️‼️‼️‼️‼️‼️‼️‼️‼️‼️‼️‼️‼️‼️‼️ 👉Review after 1 year: ✅️Hair Removal 8/10 I went sporadically, not every month. Hair thinning started after about 3-4 sessions. There are a few left with thick roots, but they are much thinner. ✅️Whitening 6/10 I don't really feel like my skin has gotten much whiter. And there are still dark marks from chicken skin bumps. ✅️Service It depends on the staff. Some are very quick, finished in 4-5 breaths. Some are good, taking a while. Sometimes the waves are strong and a little painful. Sometimes I don't feel anything at all except the cool breeze (the waves are probably gentler). 💕And most importantly, I still stand by what I said, they don't push sales of courses. They only offer suggestions sometimes, but once you decline, that's it. They don't pester you at all. I really like that. ❌️A complaint: Once, I had an appointment for 4 PM, but I arrived early, around 3:40 PM, thinking I would be done by 4 PM. In the end, I was done at 5:30 PM 🥲. It turned out that I had to pay for parking myself, even though I arrived before my appointment time. This has actually happened several times. ❌️Queue management Once, I went for 5 treatments. 3 had already been done, and the staff told me to wait outside for the skin drip and mesotherapy (the mesotherapy is injected by the doctor in another room, not the laser room). Okay, I waited for half an hour, even though the nurse for the skin drip was free and the doctor was free. I got annoyed at the long wait when there were hundreds of people in line and the staff were available. I went to the front desk and asked how much longer I had to wait. Including the first three procedures and the waiting time, it had already been two hours. They then took me for a facial injection and had a nurse give me a skin IV drip. Seriously, the front desk staff can't just sit around chatting! There were almost 10 of them (I understand that not all 10 of them have to manage the queue, it's not their job), but could they at least glance over and say, "Hey, what are people waiting for? The queue is very short!" They were kneeling while selling the treatment packages, and then completely ignored me afterward. It was so frustrating. Stamping my parking ticket is pointless. Every time I come, I have to pay for parking because I'm always over an hour late. ✅️Recommendation: If you're waiting too long, get up and ask. Otherwise, you'll waste a lot of time. The staff aren't that attentive to whether you've completed all your treatments. 😑
0x30e29f77a7893109_0x958433bb564ae363.author: auenita deeraphankul

0x30e29f77a7893109_0x958433bb564ae363.text: The course is not expensive (if you get a promotion). There are few people. In the beginning, it was good. 0x30e29991f01b6971_0x8e23494e6fb4ef99.text: ไม่รู้ต้องขอบคุณที่ฟรี(บัตรทอง)มั้ย หรือเราซวยเองที่เจอวันที่หมอนอยมาจากไหน มือหนัก ปากเสีย ไม่มีกำลังใจอะไรใดๆทั้งสิ้น ไม่เหมือนกับรีวิวอื่นๆจนอยากให้ติดลบด้วยซ้ำ ดาวที่ให้คงต้องให้เพื่อขอบคุณที่อนุญาตให้ใช้สิทธิบัตรทอง เราดัดฟันมาจากที่อื่นและเพราะติดเครื่องมือถึงมีหินปูนเกาะมาก หมอฟันคลินิคอื่นคิด 900-1200 เราเลยมาใช้บริการตามสิทธิบัตรทองที่นี่ หมอบ่นว่า “ดัดฟันที่ไหนก็น่าจะขูดหินปูนที่นั่น คิดจะทำแล้วไม่น่าจะมาเสียดายเงินเท่านี้“ ก็ใช่ เราไม่ใช่คิดไม่ได้ ว่าควรทำทุกอย่างที่คลินิคเดียว ดัดฟันที่ไหนก็ขูดที่นั่น และไม่ใช่ไม่รู้ว่าการใส่เหล็กดัดทำให้ขูดยาก อาจไม่สะอาดหมด เราคือคนไข้ เราคือคนเจ็บ เราคือคนที่จะได้รับผลถ้าหมอทำได้ไม่เต็มที่ คุณนึกว่าคนเจ็บเขาไม่รู้ตัวเหรอ แต่คนไม่มีเงินก็คือไม่มีเงิน หรือหมอจะบอกว่า ถ้าไม่มีเงินก็ไม่ควรดัดฟันตั้งแต่แรก คุณควรรู้ดีกว่าใครว่าการดัดฟันก็สามารถที่จะมีค่าใช้จ่ายบานปลายขึ้นมาได้ มันไม่ใช่แค่การเสียดายเงินน้อย เพราะถ้าคนไข้มีเงินเค้าก็คงไม่มาใช้บริการบัตรทองกับเรื่องที่เขาต้องเจ็บตัวหรอก และระหว่างทำ เราเจ็บ เราร้องเพราะเจ็บ หมอบอกว่า “ไม่ต้องร้องก็ได้นะ” คือถามจริง คนเจ็บมาบอกไม่ต้องร้องก็ได้....คือ ละร้องได้มั้ยล่ะ เรารู้นะว่าถ้าคนไข้ร้อง มันก็ส่งผลว่าหมอจิตตกไม่กล้าทำ แต่การมาบอกว่า “ไม่ต้องร้องก็ได้นะ” นี่คือเอาอะไรคิด หรือประสบการณ์เป็นหมอเยอะแต่ว่าความเห็นอกเห็นใจมันแห้งไปหมดแล้ว หรือเพราะเป็นบัตรทอง เลยทำกันแบบนี้ คนจนต้องอดทนกับปากและอารมณ์ของบุคลากรทางการแพทย์เท่านั้นเหรอ แล้วจะเปิดคลินิคที่รับบัตรทองมาทำไมถ้าจะบริการด้วยปากแบบนี้ เราไม่ได้คาดหวังให้มาโอ๋เอาใจ แต่ถ้าพูดดีๆกับคนเจ็บไม่ได้ เงียบไว้ยังจะดีกว่า ตอนที่เราไปคนไข้ก็ไม่ได้เยอะ มีเราคนเดียวไม่มีคิวต่อ คุณเป็นหมอ ควรรู้นะว่าคนที่เจ็บคือคนไข้ จะมาพูดแย่ๆซ้ำทำไม ละโคตรแย่ที่มาพูดตอนทำ คนไข้ทำได้แค่กลั้นใจทั้งเจ็บและต้องมาฟังคำพูดแย่ๆ และร้องก็ไมไ่ด้เพราะหมอจิตตกไม่กล้าทำต่อ แต่ก็ขอบคุณนะที่พูดจาแย่ขนาดนี้มา เพราะมันทำให้ครึ่งหลังของการอดทนขูดหินปูนไม่เจ็บเลย เพราะโกรธและท้อกับคนที่เรียกตัวเองว่าหมอจนลืมเจ็บไปได้ ทุเรศชิบ
0x30e29991f01b6971_0x8e23494e6fb4ef99.author: T J
0x30e29991f01b6971_0x8e23494e6fb4ef99.en: I don't know if I should be thankful for the free service (using the government health insurance) or if I was just unlucky to encounter a dentist who was incredibly grumpy, heavy-handed, rude, and completely unenthusiastic. It was nothing like the other reviews; I'd even give it a negative rating. The stars I'm giving are probably just to thank them for allowing me to use my government health insurance. I had braces done elsewhere, and because of the braces, I had a lot of tartar buildup. Other clinics charge 900-1200 baht, so I came here using my government insurance. The dentist complained, "You should have gotten your braces done at the same place you got them. You shouldn't regret spending this much money if you're going to do it this way." Yes, that's true. I'm not clueless; I should have gotten everything done at one clinic. I should have gotten my braces done at the same place I got them. And I'm not unaware that braces make scaling difficult and might not be completely thorough. I'm the patient, I'm the one suffering, I'm the one who will suffer if the dentist doesn't do their best. Do you think patients don't realize what they're doing? But people without money just don't have money. Or is the dentist saying that if you don't have money, you shouldn't have gotten braces in the first place? You should know better than anyone that braces can have escalating costs. It's not just about regretting a small expense. Because if the patient had money, they wouldn't use their universal healthcare card for something that involves pain. And during the procedure, I was in pain and cried because of the pain. The doctor said, "You don't have to cry." Seriously, telling someone in pain not to cry... well, can't we cry? I know that if a patient cries, it makes the doctor feel discouraged and hesitant to continue, but saying, "You don't have to cry," what were they thinking? Do they have a lot of medical experience, but their empathy has completely vanished? Or is it because it's universal healthcare that they treat people like this? Do poor people have to endure the rudeness and bad attitude of medical personnel? Why open a clinic that accepts universal healthcare if you're going to provide service with such a rude attitude? We don't expect coddling, but if you can't speak nicely to someone in pain, it's better to stay silent. When I went, there weren't many patients; I was the only one, no queue. You're a doctor, you should know that the patient is the one in pain. Why say something so rude? And it's even worse to say it during the procedure. The patient can only hold their breath, enduring the pain while listening to such harsh words, and can't even cry because it would upset the doctor and prevent them from continuing. But thank you for speaking so rudely. Because it made the second half of the teeth scaling procedure painless. I was so angry and frustrated with the people who called themselves doctors that I forgot the pain. It was awful.

0x311d6fe104b8c3c7_0x6f1f99bafd352154.text: She's a beautiful woman, after all. No matter where I sit, I have to cross my legs. It wouldn't be a problem for a moment, but out of habit, I had to cross my legs as soon as I sat down. This time, it wasn't just for a moment. I was sitting cross-legged. While I was sitting at my desk, I suddenly felt pain in my left leg, and it was tingling in my knee. When I tried to stand up, it hurt so much that I had to straighten my leg out. It was like the universe knew. This led me to see the doctor at Sala Prapak Thai Traditional Medicine Clinic... Well... the name alone should make me feel relaxed and comfortable... When I arrived... I was relaxed. I didn't have to circle around ten times looking for parking, like you usually do at other clinics. And when I arrived at the clinic and saw the doctor, oh my... my leg must be so sore. She's like an angel... beautiful, with a sweet smile, gentle, and kind. They even offered me snacks. We talked and took my medical history in a gentle, warm manner. Ahhh... time to get into bed! The angelic doctor chose a Thai massage treatment... but I was confused. Thai massage involves using two pieces of wood to pound the body. But why doesn't it hurt? And the rhythmic sound of the pounding is beautiful. I was about to fall asleep, but the doctor kept asking about my symptoms and examining me constantly, asking where and how it hurt. He also used massage and stretching techniques, which helped me stay awake. In the blink of an eye, the treatment was over... Whoa... My knee pain from climbing the stairs was gone. Stretching my leg relieved the pain... I could walk like a baby... There it is... the angel doctor... One treatment and I'm so comfortable. Her clinic is called... Sala Phloen Phlu. Thank you, angel doctor, for helping my knees and legs function normally again... and remember to follow your advice: don't sit in the wrong position again, or it will come back... Yes, doctor... but if I'm not sick, can I just come and talk to you? Angel doctor...

0x30e29dfbaa808077_0x733cb07e6947e276.text: เป็นลูกค้าที่นี้มาประมาณ 10 ปี เริ่มจากเพื่อนแนะนำมา หลังจากนั้นก็ไว้วางใจมาใช้บริการที่นี้ตลอด ไม่ว่าจะ ถอนฟัน อุดฟัน หรือรักษารากฟัน ขูดหินปู ล่าสุดเดือนนี้ พ.ย.64 โควิด-19 ยังคงอยู่ มีมาตรการป้องกัน มีอ่างล้างมือก่อนเข้ามา มีเจลแอลกอฮอล์ตามจุดต่างๆ มีน้ำยาฆ่าเชื้อบ่วนปาก ที่นี้มีหมอประจำหลายคน เป็นหมอเฉพาะทาง ซึ้งหากมีปัญหาเรื่องฟันที่แตกต่างกันไป ก็จะมีการส่งให้คุณหมอที่มีความชำนาญ เป็นคนดูแลต่อ สภาพแวดล้อมทั่วไปดี คนไม่เยอะ ส่วนมากมาตามนัดจะสะดวก มีที่จอดรถใต้อาคาร จอดได้ประมาณ 4-5 คัน

0x30e29dfbaa808077_0x733cb07e6947e276.en: I've been a customer here for about 10 years. It started with a friend's recommendation. Since then, I've trusted them and used their services consistently, whether it's for tooth extractions, fillings, root canal treatment, or scaling. Most recently, this month (November 2021), despite the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, they have preventative measures in place. There's a handwashing station before entering, and hand sanitizer is available at various points. They also provide antiseptic mouthwash. They have several resident dentists, all specialists. This means that if you have different dental problems, they will refer you to a skilled dentist for further care. The overall environment is good, and it's not crowded. It's convenient to come according to your appointments. There's parking under the building for about 4-5 cars.

0x30da300ed597ac63_0xd4e939804144f7a8.text: I came to Chiang Mai memorial hospital on a Sunday after having had a red body rash, all over and feeling so very sick for 4 days. I was treated excellently from start to finish by all hospital personal, but especially by Dr Chainarin. He gave lots of test, importantly, an early blood test to confirm I had contacted Dengue Fever!( I had previously seen a doctor at another hospital who said it was an allergic reaction and gave me antihistamines and cream, which did not help!) After the dengue diagnosis which included a chest X-ray, it was suggested that I could stay overnight if that was helpful. I was very dehydrated and potassium deficient as well as super teary. I was processed quickly and given an intravenous drip full of redyradtion medicine and given a number of options to ease my extremely itchy skin. This morning, I feel almost normal after feeling dreadful for a few days. Dr chainarin was also kind and warm- his English is good and when we were at a word impasse. Google translate was perfect. I highly recommend Chiang Mai memorial hospital and particularly Dr Chianarin. They were also transparent with all the fees each time a new procedure was initiated. Thankyou for my health back- it means soooo much!

0x310295fd3d409c75_0xc6ca5c6bf34ef81.text: I rarely leave reviews for anything. Frankly I usually cannot be arsed. Unless I feel really compelled to do so. In this case, having seen some of the reviews here, which are mostly positive, but a few horribly and unnecessarily negative reviews I thought I would make an exception and offer my input. I am the clinics longest running patient, I was 50/51 when I first walked in when they opened up 9 or 10 years ago and I have been on a monthly program ever since. I am now 59. And I am doing great. Thats largely thanks to Dr Tim and his great team. I pay my money every month and I get ongoing monitoring and adjustments to treatment as and when needed. The first step was to fix the problems and then its ongoing maintenance from then on. I am not a body builder - that was not my reason or purpose in seeking help. I came to see Dr Tim because I have multiple chronic immune system disorders caused by heavy and prolonged chemical exposure at age +/- 20 which basically screwed up my hormones (among other things). Since age 27 I have been on TRT therapy plus Cortisol (for Addisons disease) and Thyroid hormones (hypo). I have had dedicated endocrinologists in the UK, in Hong Kong, Spain, and Bangkok (Bumrungrad hospital) - basically anywhere I have lived long term I have needed professional monitoring and support - literally if I don’t take my meds correctly I die. It’s that simple. Let alone being able to have an active sex life or have a great body. Staying alive and well is my first priority. I have had to educate myself along the way - even my previous endocrinologists and other doctors have acknowledged that I am a very rare case. No less than 6 autoimmune disorders. Ergo at this point I know more about the totality of my condition than any single doctor I have ever met. And yet I live a normal, VERY active life (wink wink, if you know what I mean). I look better, I feel better and life is good! Thanks to Dr Tim and his team. Because of my past experiences (my medical files in hospitals around the word are probably thousands of pages by now) I have learned to question everything - especially advice and treatments offered by various so called medical professionals (albeit seemingly highly qualified). I was told, at age 27, by my then consultant at Derriford hospital in the UK, that I would be in a wheelchair within 2 years because of my disorders, He gave me antidepressants and that was it. Of course I ignored his advice and never went back. I realised there and then that the mainstream medical profession wasn’t there to help me and I learned to question EVERYTHING. What I have especially appreciated with Dr Tim is that he actually LISTENS. And he really doesn’t mind when I question something (as I often do). That’s a key part in understanding any problem and then being open minded about the solution. It’s like teamwork. He works with you to find the best way forward. In my case the solution was fundamentally about changing to a healthy diet (avoid anything that is processed basically) and tweak and maintain the hormones to optimum levels. The diet part is easy, I didn’t need the clinics help for that. The hormone part is very very complex obviously and that’s where I really needed help. In my experience Dr Tim is always totally professional and methodical in his approach. At the same time he is not afraid to think ‘outside of the box’ - which is just what I needed. I see a few silly complaints on here about price - which seems like nonsense to me - the reality is they are neither expensive nor cheap - fairly priced I would say. To my mind the price is irrelevant anyway. What price can you put on your health and quality of life? My case is extremely complex to say the least. If Dr Tim and his team can handle me and fix my problems, which they have, then I think any relatively normal person should have no doubts whatsoever about the service here. Happy to confirm anythign if any one has doubts - ask the staff for my cell phone.
0x310295fd3d409c75_0xc6ca5c6bf34ef81.author: Martin B

0x310295fd3d409c75_0xc6ca5c6bf34ef81.text: First, a little background. I'm an American, but I have a condo in Thailand. Almost 20 years ago, I was diagnosed with a massive tumor in my optical chiasm, the area in the brain where the optical nerves criss-cross from one hemisphere to the other. It was causing me to lose my eyesight, and immediate surgery was required. The upshot is that my pituitary gland was destroyed when the tumor was removed, meaning I'd need to be on testosterone replacement therapy for the rest of my life. In the U.S., getting a prescription for testosterone can be difficult, even when you have a well-documented medical need for it, as I do. Then there's the insurance issue. I've often had to do battle with my insurance company over getting testosterone treatments, and any time I changed insurers, the problems started all over again. Moving from one state to another made matters even worse. The people at my (very expensive) insurance were useless. Anyway... I came to Thailand three years ago, and with my supply of testosterone dwindling I went into the Maximum Performance Center in Pattaya to see if they could help me. My life got so much better that day! Getting on a regular schedule of injections was easy, and the cost includes regular blood testing and monitoring of not only my testosterone levels, but other critical blood components, too. I was able to start immediately. I didn't have to wait six weeks for a consultation with a doctor, then wait another month for a referral to a specialist, and then spend another two months arguing with my insurance company over whether the treatments were even warranted (that routine seemed to be the norm for me in the U.S.). Fortunately, quality health care is much more accessible here in Thailand. I've been going to Maximum Performance for over two years now, except for brief periods when I was visiting other countries, or when I've had to travel back to the United States. My doctor at Maximum Performance is always available if I have questions (either in person or on the Line app), and the staff have always been friendly and very efficient. The monthly price of the treatments sounds high when quoted in Thai Baht, but when you convert it to U.S. dollars it's actually an incredible value. For me, it's less than half of my old co-pay. I happily pay "out of pocket" because the cost is so reasonable. I also don't have to book separate appointments with a diagnostic lab (like Quest - yuck!) and then wait to hear from my endocrinologist to go over the test results. Everything is handled in one location, and those test results are ready the very next day. In summary, Maximum Performance has been a game-changer for me. Something that was a major headache for almost 20 years has been reduced to the simple task of stopping in twice a week for a quick shot. Easy peasy! FIVE STARS from me.

I replied that they didn't ask for my name on the phone yesterday. The receptionist looked confused and repeatedly asked my name and if I had called the right branch, without any politeness or respect. I had to show them the call log to prove it was indeed this branch before they believed me. Then they said, "Oh, there's a bit of a wait, the doctor has many cases." Even though I had called to schedule an appointment, the long wait wasn't the problem. The issue was the receptionist's lack of attention to detail in confirming the appointment and their attitude as if I were the one at fault. I suggest they improve their customer service attitude. In short, I'm very disappointed and will be changing clinics.

0x30e2a31c155deca5_0x67a347af244db557.en: I wanted to write this review because I'm truly impressed. The dentist here is the kindest in the world, in my opinion. My biggest worry when taking children to the dentist is that they'll be scared, cry, or refuse to go through the procedure. But this clinic completely dispelled all my worries. The dentist is excellent at communicating with children, very patient, and interacts with them naturally. This made the children feel trusting. What I thought would be a scary dental procedure turned into a comfortable, non-crying, and non-resistent experience for the children. The equipment and tools were modern, clean, and made me feel confident that my children were being well cared for. Another lovely thing that impressed me personally is that the dentist refers to herself as "Doctor Need," but I always heard "Mommy." It felt so warm and comforting, like having a kind person caring for them and making the children feel safe naturally. Even I, as a mother, felt relieved. Thank you for making dental visits for my children a non-scary and wonderful experience. ❤️

0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.text: I recently underwent multiple procedures at PPSI with Dr. Piyapas Pichaichanarong, and I cannot recommend him or the entire team highly enough. From the moment I met Dr. Piyapas, I felt completely at ease. He was warm, honest, and incredibly thorough. He answered all my questions without sugar-coating anything, which I really appreciated — especially travelling alone for major surgery. What truly blew me away was the extra care he showed — knowing I'd had gastric sleeve surgery and needed extra protein for healing, he personally brought me a banana protein shake every day. That simple gesture meant so much and showed how genuinely he cares for his patients. I had quite an extensive list of procedures done: ✔️ Breast Reduction with Implants ✔️ Vaser Liposuction (Upper & Lower Abdomen, Love Handles, Lower Back) ✔️ Extended Tummy Tuck & Flankplasty (Belt Lipectomy) ✔️ Vaser Liposuction of the Circumferential Thighs (Inner, Outer, and Front Thighs) ✔️ Extended Thigh Lift They were big surgeries, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. Even my GP back home was seriously impressed with Dr. Piyapas' work — so much so that he asked for his contact details to refer future patients. Emotionally, the days after surgery were tough — I was extremely emotional and couldn't stop crying, even though I didn't fully understand why. But the nurses and hospital staff were absolutely incredible. Despite the language barrier, I felt cared for, supported, and safe. They showed me so much kindness and respect, and always empowered me to believe I was improving, even on the tough days. Every time I went for my check-ups, the staff were genuinely happy to see my progress and mobility improving. It made me feel seen and celebrated. I also have to give a huge thank you to Restored Beauty Getaways, who organised this for me. From the initial booking to the daily check-ins while I was recovering, they made the entire process so smooth and stress-free. Travelling alone for such a big surgery was daunting, but with their support, I never felt alone. I wouldn’t have had the confidence to do this without them. If you're considering surgery in Thailand, I honestly couldn’t recommend PPSI, Dr. Piyapas, and Restored Beauty Getaways more. Their care, professionalism, and kindness exceeded all expectations. 10/10 — I wouldn’t trust anyone else.
0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.author: Zoe

0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.text: I have just returned to Perth after having an Endoscopic Brow Lift with Dr Piyapas Pichaichanarong, who is an incredible surgeon. I cannot rate Phuket Plastic Surgery Institute (PPSI) high enough! The team of doctors, nurses and staff members are absolutely incredible, from first point of contact via email in Australia to my last follow up appointment in Phuket two weeks after surgery. Dr Piyapas was very informative, honest and kind, I was a bit nervous about the surgery, but Dr Piyapas, and his Anaesthetist both put me at ease, and they both did a fantastic job before and after surgery. My Anaesthetist was there to wake me up, and managed my pain level straight away back in my private room, along with the lovely nurses who cared for me and checked on me hourly. The level of service at this hospital it unbelievable, the breakfast, lunch and dinners were divine, the food and drinks did not stop coming. Straight after surgery I didn’t look great, my eyes were a bit puffy but I expected worse, and the very next day I looked and felt perfectly fine, to be honest less than a week later you couldn’t even tell. Dr Piyapas, has done an incredible job, I would highly recommend him and his colleagues at PPSI. Also, Phuket is the best place for recovery, not only did I return home looking great with my new brow lift, I had a lovely sun tan, and I also felt mentally calm and relaxed. Thank you to everyone at PPSI.
0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.author: Tara Thomson

0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.text: I'm not usually one to leave reviews, but choosing a place for a procedure is a big decision, so hopefully I can help someone undecided to choose this amazing hospital. 2 weeks ago I flew to Thailand from Australia for a rhinoplasty at PPSI. Absolutely incredible standards, on par with Sydney hospitals. Amazing service from nurses during my stay, my surgeon; Dr. Piyapas Pichaichanarong was very professional and kind. The recovery was very quick and painless, making the surgery feel a lot less invasive than it was. Absolutely every question I had was answered during my consultation, leaving me with no doubts or worries. Be aware when getting a nose job that the results take around 6 months to fully develop, so don't get discouraged if it is very swollen when the cast first comes off! My only minor criticism would be the initial difficulty communicating via email. Sometimes it would take a few days to get a reply and have my questions answered. If this was fixed, it would be a lot easier for foreigners looking for cosmetic surgery to be equipped with all the information they need. Kind, professional, attentive nurses and doctors and amazing results so far, for a quarter of the Australian price. I am surprised there are not more reviews for PPSI (part of Bangkok hospital), so if anyone has any questions, I can only answer from my personal experience. feel free to reach out! My instagram is saskiafinnan
0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.author: Saskia Finnan

0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.text: Came here the first time for consultation after doing some google research. But google research won’t be enough because thai people don’t really use google and not all the people that came here did the reviews. So I’m going to tell you what to do. Book an online appointment (consultation or surgery) or make a call to the PPSI (Phuket Plastic Surgery Institute). They’ll tell you what to do, when to come, and approximation of the fees. Go here as scheduled. Though the PPSI personnel are able to speak English fluently the other staff here don’t. Go straight to 4th floor (PPSI floor) and do what you need to do here. If you don’t know how to get here in the first place, take Local Bus Line 1 from Bus Terminal 1 (Pink bus with number 1 on it) 15 TB/person and asked for Big C as destination, PPSI just next to it. If you want to leave after surgery I suggest you book a rental car. If not you can take Local Bus Line 1 again to Bus Terminal 1.
0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.author: natio jiwa ksatria

0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.text: I made an appointment to see Dr Jib who came highly recommended by friends for a BA revision. On the day of the appointment, I waited for 1.5hrs before seeing Dr Jib. This seems to defeat the purpose of making an appointment and showing up early to register myself. During the consult, Dr Jib was kind and professional. And recommended Motiva. I left Dr Jib's room and waited another 1hour outside for a quotation. The reception staff provided me with 2 quotes for 2 models. This was not discussed at all with Dr Jib, thus I was taken back. The staff said one is softer than the other. But I wanted Dr Jib's recommendation since this is a BA revision. If he had mentioned 2 different models during the consult, I would have asked more questions then. This discussion with the reception staff went on for about 10 mins, and I was uncomfortable with this. It would have been better if they took me into a room to discuss the quote, rather than just hand me a piece of paper after paying for the consult. There was also no discussion about possible schedule for the surgery when I specifically asked Dr Jib about his schedule. I wanted to discuss about the different models with Dr Jib but he was already with another patient. So I asked if I can send Dr Jib and email or via other communication methods. They say he does not reply to emails or any other communication channels! But I can write in to their general enquiry email address. I did write in that very same day with about 6-7 questions but failed to get a response after 5 days. So I called in and was transferred to a Jason. He managed to send me a reply a few days later but only replied to one of my questions. I wrote back at once asking for more answers but they have gone silent for the last 10 days or so. I called 2 days ago to reach Jason since he is the gatekeeper, left my name and number, but so far no reply. I am floored that the surgeon does not reply to questions. The procedures may be routine to him but it is a big surgery to me. So questions are normal. And I am put off that he is so unreachable with gatekeepers protecting him like a god. At the end of the day, the prices are the same as in Singapore. I might as well go to Singapore for the procedure. The surgeon and his team there are also so much more responsive and caring.
0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.author: LY

0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.text: The surgeons might be amazing, but actually talking to them has proven impossible. If you end up talking to someone called "Jason" just ignore the email, start again and hope you get someone else. After three months with replies from Jason a month apart and no useful information in any of them, he'd suddenly said I was due for male-to-female GRS in a couple weeks and my online consult with Dr.Singto (not the doctor I requested) only a couple of days away. That consult got cancelled a couple hours beforehand because Jason gave me the incomplete and incorrect payment information and part of the bits I had to find and fix myself was incorrect. The information he'd gave me was for partly bit from two separate banks, neither in Phuket, with an address for the transaction that was just a suburb in Phuket with no street address (though not the suburb where the hospital is either). After sending through more money to cover that (6,000 baht total) with the correct information, which Jason refused to provide me and I still had to go scrounging for myself, the second attempt at a consult was cancelled a couple hours beforehand because, even though all the information was correct, their accounting department doesn't know how to read an international transfer receipt so the last minute consult Jason booked was impossible anyway, because you have to wait two weeks for the money to actually come though. If it comes through, and he hasn't given me the wrong information again. Despite asking several times, Jason still hasn't given me the correct (or even complete) payment information. This is apparently not an isolated incident with PPSI but is isolated to talking to "Jason" specifically. Pretty sure I'm just going to be left in limbo because there's no way to pay for my consult if the person I'm talking to won't tell me where to send the money. I would be sure this was a scam if the part where so bad at wasn't specifically the part where they're taking my money.
0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.author: Alice Keath

0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.text: I’m leaving this as a serious warning to anyone considering Phuket Plastic Surgery. A very close friend of mine went through surgery connected with this hospital, and I have watched the aftermath devastate her, her partner and their family. After the procedure, she became seriously unwell with shaking, muscle spasms, confusion, breathing issues and seizures. I was told by her family that when they repeatedly asked for help, they felt dismissed and unsupported while her condition continued to worsen. She was later formally diagnosed with serotonin syndrome and has been left dealing with ongoing seizures, PTSD, chronic pain, neurological symptoms, weakness, trauma and major disruption to her ability to live and work the way she once did. Over the past two years, I have had regular conversations with my best mate about the ongoing impact, the legal process, and the emotional and financial stress this has caused their family. What has stayed with me most is that a family very close to me has been devastated by this whole situation, and after everything they have been through, they have been left with nothing to show for it. I’m not writing this lightly. I’m writing it because people need to be warned. Please do serious research, ask hard questions, get everything in writing, and think very carefully before putting your health in their hands. Based on what I have seen, I would avoid Phuket Plastic Surgery if you can.
0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.author: Christopher Ioppolo

0x30da25b9f9467cdd_0x80169a68d2f33228.text: I got 2cc of chin filler at this clinic. The salesperson recommended two brands: the black box and the gold box. I asked about the difference, and they explained that the gold box was better, shaped better, and lasted longer. On the day of the injection, the doctor showed me the black box to scan. I was confused because I had purchased the gold box (2cc) for 15,000 baht. I asked the doctor why I hadn't bought the gold box, and she said she needed to check with the salesperson outside. Then, the salesperson who sold me the filler said I should get the black box because it shaped better. It was ridiculous; they said one thing during the sales pitch and another during the injection. I paid more for the gold box than the black box. Ultimately, I got the black box. (However, I really liked the doctor here; they were honest with customers, advised on the appropriate cc, and were very polite. But I disliked one of the salespeople who sold me the filler; they lacked sincerity. Before going to this clinic, I researched it thoroughly because it looked luxurious, modern, and trustworthy. 0x30e29cf6b9467a95_0x66586477d57b4b32.text: A Truly World-Class Healing Journey with Verita Life and Dr. Hossami My wife Daniella and I first came to Verita Life in 2017 after she was diagnosed with breast cancer. After researching several alternative cancer clinics, we spoke with Dr. Hossami over the phone. His calm reassurance, deep expertise, and compassionate approach gave us hope at a time when we were overwhelmed. Just five days later, we flew from the Middle East to begin our journey with Verita Life—and that decision changed everything. Thanks to Dr. Hossami’s personal attention and the clinic’s integrative approach, Daniella’s breast cancer was successfully treated during our first visit. From then on, we returned only for annual health checks. We’re also glad to share that her cancer markers have been steadily reducing —a testament to the effectiveness of the treatments and the ongoing care. In 2025, Daniella’s health declined again, and we returned to Verita Life. A PET scan revealed a fractured hip due to a recurrence of cancer. Once again, under Dr. Hossami’s guidance, Daniella regained her strength through a tailored program of treatments and therapies. After a few months, we were able to enjoy our summer vacation. What makes Verita Life truly exceptional is the complete experience: • Advanced Wellness Treatments: Hyperthermia, red light therapy, oxygen therapy, and many other integrative treatments are part of the standard offering. Each therapy is delivered with precision and care. • Seamless Arrival Experience: From the moment you land, Verita Life’s first-class meet-and-greet service at the airport ensures a smooth transition to your hotel. It’s one less thing to worry about during a stressful time. • Luxury Limousine Transfers: Daily transport from the hotel to the clinic and back is provided in comfort, allowing us to take in the vibrant sights of Thai life along the way. • Exceptional Nutrition Plans: The health food options are outstanding—nutritionally balanced, delicious, and tailored to support recovery and wellness. • State-of-the-Art Facilities: The brand-new clinic on the 32nd floor offers breathtaking views and a serene, healing environment. The facilities are exactly what you’d expect from a 5-star medical center—modern, spotless, and thoughtfully designed. • Unmatched Care and Attention: While you're here, you truly don’t have to think. Every detail is taken care of by the incredible team, whose loving care and attention lift the burden from your shoulders. • Comprehensive Departure Support: When it’s time to leave, Dr. Hossami and his team prepare all your medications and travel documents, and continue to follow up with calls to check in and answer any questions. It’s also worth noting that Dr. Hossami is constantly researching new methods for treating cancer. His commitment to staying updated with the latest protocols and innovations in wellness is truly astonishing. Knowing that he is always seeking better ways to help his patients puts our minds at ease and reinforces our faith in Verita Life. Words cannot fully express our gratitude. Daniella and I feel truly blessed for everything Dr. Hossami and his team have done—and continue to do—with such dedication, compassion, and excellence Oliver Harper
0x30e29cf6b9467a95_0x66586477d57b4b32.author: Oliver Harper

0x30e29cf6b9467a95_0x66586477d57b4b32.text: I would like to share my personal experience with my mother. I was literally in a state of confusion and extreme fear after she was diagnosed with stage 2 breast cancer. I started searching for clinics or places that offer complementary medicine treatments and came across Dr. Abdullah Hossami through an online interview with Alia Al-Moayed. I researched the clinic further, but since personal experiences were not widely available online, I was very anxious and hesitant. To be honest, I was also worried about some of the comments I read, which made me hesitant about visiting the clinic. However, my manager recommended the place after hearing about it from a Bahraini patient who had been treated there. I contacted her, and she provided me with all the details I needed. I kept praying and hesitated a lot, especially since my mother’s body couldn’t tolerate the first strong chemotherapy dose in our country, and her health deteriorated. I reached out to the marketing manager, Tareq, who was extremely responsive. He clearly explained all the required procedures and documents, guiding me through the online submission process. He also scheduled a free consultation with Dr. Abdullah. The doctor was very transparent and explained the treatment details thoroughly. That’s why I encourage anyone who is unsure about whether this treatment is suitable for them to book a consultation with the doctor. When we arrived at Virta Life Clinic, everything was smooth, quick, and comfortable—from airport reception to the treatment procedures during our four-month stay (as my mother underwent surgery in Bangkok). The way they treat cancer patients is incredibly kind and compassionate. We truly felt their care from every single member of the medical team. My mother felt both physically and emotionally reassured, unlike her experience with some doctors in our country. Now, we have returned home, and my mother is continuing her treatment with follow-ups from Dr. Abdullah. They remain attentive to our inquiries, responding to all our questions. Dr. Abdullah personally asked me to keep him updated on all my mother’s current symptoms and side effects after completing her treatment. To be completely honest in my review, my mother has improved, and the tumor has been removed. She is now undergoing additional treatments for three more months. However, we can only confirm whether her body is completely cancer-free after an MRI in three months. I made a promise to myself to help anyone who wants to ask about my experience because I remember how scared and lost I felt at the beginning. My mother is happy with her progress and always thanks me for choosing a comfortable place that offers gentle complementary cancer treatments and milder chemotherapy doses instead of the strong ones. I will write an update later 👍🏼

0x30e29cf6b9467a95_0x66586477d57b4b32.text: Dr. Hossami, Julie Palmer, a patient at Veritalife Thailand, died on April 4th, 2024, after returning home with promising actionable scan results provided by your clinic to her metastatic breast cancer. However, Australian oncologists found severe discrepancies, indicating her cancer had exponentially and significantly progressed. Additionally and despite assurances from you, that Julie was on the road to recovery. Julie's health deteriorated rapidly upon returning to Australia causing admission to the ICU THE VERY NEXT DAY OF HER RETURN to Australia, eventually leading to her death. We both attempted to reach out for clarification, from Veritalife and you in particular for direction and assurance, but we received no response at all and this was all promised to Julie leaving you and your facility. This tragic outcome occurred after 19 weeks of intensive treatment at your facility when we were told that 6 weeks would be adequate. And raises severe medical concerns and question to your actual treatment regime. It also raises alarm bells to serious concerns about the care Veritalife and you provided Julie and towards the accuracy of the scan results you assured Julie were encouraging as she left your facility. Julie was aged 63, came home at 41 kg and her lungs were filled with fluid on return home but leaving AUSTRALIA she was approximately 65kg. She returned home in severe respiratory distress with 4 Ltr of fluid in one lung and one ltr of fluid in the other lung but so devastatingly sick, and you declared her fit to fly home and without oxygen , really Dr Hossami? When Julie was given the news here by the oncologist in AUSTRALIA , It completely broke her heart and shattered us all especially as she and I were expecting correlation to your scan results. She was told straight out that her cancer had progressed seriously and she would not survive and that they recommend palliative care immediately from this point on? Julie and I trusted Veritalife and you, only to be let down so Severely and devastatingly it is hard for us to comprehend . Ultimately we buried Julie on April 26th, 2024. This unethical behaviour has devastated our family not just to losing my dear wife but has broken my daughter on losing her mother, physically and spiritually. We are suffering financially now as a result as a family and this abomination demands accountability from you and Veritalife." Anthony Donnellan

0x30e29cf6b9467a95_0x66586477d57b4b32.text: I was diagnosed with breast cancer in 2024. Before starting any treatment in my home country of Saudi Arabia, I researched the most effective and efficient methods to completely eradicate the tumor without any residual effects or side effects. I heard from a friend that her relative had been treated in Thailand in a record time of three months. I contacted her and learned all about her experience and how she returned home completely cancer-free, so I decided to try it myself. I traveled to Thailand, which proved to be a suitable option. I met Dr. Abdullah Husami, whose approach was very reassuring, and I immediately began treatment. It was a comprehensive treatment plan that focused on the type of food and vitamins the body needed, detoxifying the body, and using natural cancer-fighting agents, with the addition of a low-dose chemotherapy with minimal side effects if necessary to eliminate the disease. The approach was comfortable and the treatment was excellent. My treatment continued for three months, after which I returned home and continued treatment with a special diet and immune-boosting supplements, antioxidants to combat inflammation, and low-dose chemotherapy pills. I remained in contact with Dr. Husami, and we are still in close contact and monitoring my condition. …Thanks to Professor Tariq, the clinic supervisor…Thanks to Dr. Hossami for his excellent treatment…I ask God to grant complete healing to me and every patient.

0x30e29fc7a36f7349_0x5c09b1443fff6609.text: I came for filler injections, but the doctor wouldn't let me because other treatments would give me even better results! For genuine care, only Jairak Clinic! Now that I'm in my 30s, my face is aging, so I needed Jairak's help. Last time I had filler injections with Dr. Ning, the results were amazing, but because I was in a hurry and wanted it done right then and there, I had Dr. Phuwan take care of me. I initially planned to only get filler injections to lift my face, but Dr. Phuwan analyzed my situation in detail. I have sunken temples, hollow cheeks, sagging skin, and uneven facial bone structure, making my face look asymmetrical. He said too much filler would make my face look bigger. So, he recommended Sculptra to address these issues, focusing on plumping the skin and providing an overall solution for a more youthful appearance. It also addresses the sunken areas with a biostimulator that stimulates collagen production, tightening loose and sagging skin. Improved skin structure + improved external appearance = a younger look. They always go all out with numbing cream here; they apply a generous amount of numbing mask. If you're afraid of pain, don't worry! He waits until the anesthetic takes full effect before starting the procedure, and he also injects local anesthetic at specific points. Therefore, the Sculptra injection was completely painless. The doctor was kind, gave excellent advice, explained every detail, provided full knowledge, and had a very gentle touch. Before the injection, the doctor mixed the medication in front of you, and you could scan a QR code to check the product information. You don't have to worry about getting counterfeit, smuggled, or expired medication; it's definitely the real thing. Now, let's talk about the location. It's a new branch, still easy to get to, and the atmosphere is fantastic. It feels like a spa, very modern, with private waiting rooms for those who need to have meetings or quick work discussions while waiting. The treatment rooms are clean and not intimidating. The immediate immediate effect was an improved skin appearance, like someone who had just finished a face mask. After 3 days, my face felt firmer and less saggy. I think the results will be more noticeable within 1-3 months. If you want to take care of your skin, choose Jairak Clinic; you won't be disappointed!

0x30e29fc7a36f7349_0x5c09b1443fff6609.text: I received the service on December 4th, 2025 at 5:23 PM, with an appointment scheduled for 6:00 PM. I was interested in the Titanium Lifting program because I watched the promotional video and considered the doctor's credibility, so I decided to come. Upon arrival, the consultation process went well without any problems. I asked about the pain, and they said it wouldn't be painful, just a tight feeling, so I thought it would be similar to Ultraformor. In addition, the doctor recommended the 120KJ program. I double-checked if this was necessary for the first treatment, and the female doctor confirmed that it was. During the treatment, they said they would apply numbing cream for 30 minutes, but in reality, it wasn't that long. I told them I felt it starting to numb, so they began the treatment. As soon as the machine went down, after three or four strokes, I told the doctor, "It's starting to get hot." The doctor continued to move the machine across my skin. I told her it was getting hot, but she continued until I said, "It's hot. Should we do another area first?" They told me to endure it for a while before moving on to my neck. At that point, my face was extremely hot, hotter than any machine had ever made before. The doctor kept saying, "Very red, very red," but didn't do anything. During the treatment, the doctor spoke up... I was planning to do the Onda treatment, but I didn't get a chance. The doctor said this while working on my face. I couldn't help but think that the reason she didn't give me a break was because she was in a hurry. If she was in a hurry, why did she schedule me for 6 PM when I arrived before that time, even though the clinic wasn't closed yet? Why was she in such a rush? And my face was so hot. After she finished one side and moved to the other, I couldn't take it anymore, so I asked, "Will it burn, doctor? Do I need to apply a cool pack?" Because I'm in the medical field too, and too much heat could cause blisters. I was very worried. The doctor said, "The heat is just right for a normal facial treatment. Here, go get a cool pack," and told her assistant. She also said to me, "If the heat isn't enough, it can't create collagen under the skin." She was still trying to push more heat under my skin, which was excessive. I've never had a treatment this hot without a break before. My face was very red, and I was very worried. After she finished, she turned off the machine immediately. I didn't even check the energy settings. After the treatment, my face was very red. The doctor took a picture of my red face, so the assistant gave me a mask to apply (during the lifting machine treatment). (My face has never been this red before. It looked more like a pico-therapy treatment.) Once my face started to get less red, the doctor came over and said, "It's because your skin is sensitive. You have fair skin, so it reddens easily." I was confused because didn't the doctor assess the suitability of the machine for my skin during the procedure? Why didn't they stop and rest even though I said it was hot? Isn't safety the first priority? When I was about to leave, I complained about the service I received. The salesperson then told me that if I wanted to see the energy levels, I should have requested it before the procedure. I've been to many places, and they all let me see it myself without me ever asking. But here, my face was stinging, and you turned off the machine as soon as you finished. When I asked to see the records again, there was only the doctor's handwritten notes in the OPD, but I couldn't access my medical history. The salesperson then said that my face was red because my skin reddens easily and because of the numbing cream, not because of the machine. This is where I got really angry. How could they lie? The machine was hot. It was very hot during the procedure. I told them to rest, but they didn't. They kept telling me to endure it, saying, "Just a little longer, just a little longer," but it was very hot. Also, the doctor and the salesperson contradicted each other. The doctor said I shouldn't apply a compress during the procedure because the heat under the skin wasn't working. The salesperson said, "You can apply a compress during the procedure." It's like the information I received was completely inconsistent and unreliable. It's been 7 days now, and my face hasn't been lifted much, plus my skin is extremely sensitive, even though I'm using the same creams and everything else is the same. My skin quality hasn't improved at all. When I was leaving the clinic, there wasn't even an apology from the staff or the doctor. Only the sales staff said they would improve. And after a while, the manager finally sent a message apologizing. I paid 23,900 baht very quickly, but received terrible service. They only blamed the customer. The results haven't improved either. I'm very disappointed.
0x30e29fc7a36f7349_0x5c09b1443fff6609.author: กฤติกา กันไชยา

0x30e29fc7a36f7349_0x5c09b1443fff6609.text: I booked a treatment during the 11.11 live stream. I asked the admin many questions because I wasn't sure if the machine was right for me. Some machines were exclusive to the clinic and didn't have reviews elsewhere, so I wanted a lot of information to feel comfortable. The admin responded quickly at first, but after asking many questions, their responses became very slow. Initially, I wasn't going to book, but I decided to because I trusted the doctor and planned to have another consultation later. I asked if the program could be changed on the day of the treatment, and they said yes, so I agreed. However, before the course expired, I couldn't go and asked if I could extend it by 1-2 days. The admin replied that I had to pay the full course fee to extend it. I argued that I couldn't pay the full price when I wasn't sure if I could actually do the course. Why was the clinic forcing me to pay upfront when the doctor in the live stream said to consult with a doctor first? The admin insisted on full payment, so I decided to forfeit my deposit and not proceed with the treatment. I believe that paying an extra thousand baht, or whatever amount, with a valid reason, would be better than being forced to pay the full course price. Nowadays, patients do their research, and everyone is more afraid of clinics upselling them for unnecessary procedures. Because once we've paid in full, the salesperson, doctor, or front-line staff can say anything to us. We might be being pessimistic, but beauty clinics these days aren't always that honest with their customers. Ultimately, readers are advised to use their own judgment. This is merely the opinion of someone who was considering the service, based on marketing content seen on social media, but who was quite disappointed with the experience.
0x30e29fc7a36f7349_0x5c09b1443fff6609.author: Wanwisa Sawichako

Thank you so much to the nurses at Chalong Krung Clinic for their attentiveness. They told every patient, "You must eat eggs and take supplements. Eggs are the best protein." I am so grateful to the nurses at Chalong Krung Clinic. It's the best clinic I've ever been to. Thank you.

0x305031e80228b915_0x720d29d806ced6b.text: I want to help all the girls who were looking for information about abortion in Phuket and ended up at this clinic. At the time of this review, the clinic is open Thursdays from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM. You should arrive early and get in line if you don't want to wait all day or not see the doctor at all. We arrived around 10:30 AM and didn't see the doctor until 3:30 PM. It was really crowded (but there's a Central shopping center nearby, so you can wait there). So, you enter the clinic barefoot (put on socks if you're worried about that), approach the very nice girl in the lobby, and she gives you a ticket with a number. Then you wait while she processes everyone who arrived before you. Once you're in line, you'll be called and given a time when the doctor will be ready to see you. After that, you can go about your business. I recommend arriving half an hour before your scheduled appointment, as the doctor may see you earlier (this happened to me; they saw me about 15-20 minutes early). Next, you'll be called in by a doctor with whom you'll discuss your concerns. The doctor is very professional, performs the ultrasound very gently (she doesn't press hard on your abdomen, as is often the case) and listens fully to you. She offers solutions and clearly describes the entire procedure. If your English is poor, the doctor will speak to you through a translator. Then you'll receive instructions and medications to address your concerns. Or, if, for example, the ultrasound doesn't show a fetus, you won't receive them. I saw the doctor rushing between the reception and her office, trying to see as many women as possible during her workday. Yet, the quality of the consultation doesn't suffer. This inspires respect; it's rare to find such a doctor. The doctor will also provide her WhatsApp number so you can receive information about the abortion procedure and contact you if you have any problems. Personally, I was extremely pleased with my visit to this hospital. Everything was handled very clearly and correctly, from the registration process to the administration and dispensing of pills. Thank you.

0x30da3bb6af3a6277_0x180d3a1bd3cc90c3.text: I didn't want to give it even one star, but I have to. I had an appointment at the clinic for lip treatment at 11:00 AM. I arrived at the clinic at 11:08 AM and waited until 12:00 PM with no notification. So I asked the counter staff when the doctor would arrive (because I only took the morning off work, so I didn't mind if it was delayed until the afternoon). The staff said to wait a moment. Then it was 12:40 PM and the doctor still hadn't arrived, so I asked what time I would be able to have the procedure done. The staff said the doctor was busy with a case at the hospital; the patient had a ruptured appendix! (She spoke in a very sarcastic and condescending way. If you go to the clinic, you'll only encounter one person with that kind of attitude.) I told her, "It's none of my business to know." Initially, I was going to wait until the afternoon, but I felt like my time was worthless. So I gave up waiting. The clinic is taking advantage of other people's time. It wastes time, work, opportunities, and money. Everything that requires waiting has a cost. We're not just sitting around waiting for customers all day.

0x30da3bb6af3a6277_0x180d3a1bd3cc90c3.text: I'm glad I only bought the course once, because the experience I had with the staff at the counter was truly frustrating. From the moment I walked in, the staff were completely unperturbed. They sat at the counter as usual, but chose not to greet me or make eye contact. Normally, when I go to any clinic, I'd say "Hello, sir/ma'am," but this was completely silent. It made me feel like I was floating around. When they spoke to me, their tone was extremely curt and without any nuance. They seemed to be just saying things casually, like "Sign the documents," like they were talking to a wall. I could tell they weren't willing to serve me. In a clear comparison, when another customer walked in (probably someone I knew), they were a completely different person. They spoke so sweetly, "Hello," and it was like... Why did they treat me differently? If you're looking for a clinic that cares about hospitality and wants a good feeling from the moment you step in, think carefully. For me, it was a one-time visit and I was completely unimpressed with the reception staff. 😔

0x311d7d49ce36cf93_0x65e0b216803b7fc5.en: Today I had an emergency. My tooth broke in half 8 years ago, but it wasn't convenient to get a crown at the time 🤣🤣🤣. Today it fell out, leaving me with a gap. I had to quickly find a clinic near my house. I found this place, called, and the staff let me talk to the dentist first. When I went in, the dentist recommended a crown, as is standard practice, but I wasn't comfortable with that, so I asked if I could have a filling done like before. The dentist quoted 1500-2000 baht, which I agreed to. The dentist was very meticulous and dedicated, taking a long time. My tooth looks even better than the last one! The price was also cheap, and they even included a teeth cleaning using my social security insurance. Usually, other places charge extra, but not here! Hahaha! The dentist's name was Kao, if I remember correctly.

They used local anesthetic, and we didn't experience much pain afterward. (The price was reasonable at 900฿). 🌻 My father came for dentures. This was a difficult case because we had been to many places in Bangkok and Chiang Mai, but none could do it. They suggested extractions or bridges, but consistently said they couldn't. We even went to a non-Dental dentist who made dentures, but it didn't improve things. Then we found this doctor. They invited us to see the procedure, planned the treatment, calculated the budget, and managed it efficiently, ensuring we could afford the best possible treatment. Other places we inquired at were many times more expensive. The doctor was very attentive and explained everything in detail. (We also used our social security benefits for this). We were incredibly impressed. We're happy for my father to be able to chew and eat normally again. That would be greatly appreciated. P.S.
