0x30da2fedc7ad3acd_0x40b1f63e562cb34d.en: I heard from friends in Chiang Mai that this clinic makes high-quality dentures, so I came to get a retainer. The dentist made me a clear retainer twice, and this time they switched me to a type with a metal frame. It feels secure and strong when I wear it.

0x30da2fedc7ad3acd_0x40b1f63e562cb34d.text: ฟันกรามบนผุกว้างมาก ไปอุดที่อื่นหลุดหลายรอบ บางคลินิกบอกว่าอุดไม่ได้แล้วต้องทำครอบฟัน คนในบ้านฮ่อบอกให้ลองมาหาคุณหมอสุภัทร์ชัย คุณหมอบอกว่าน่าจะพออุดอยู่ อุดกลับไปใช้งานได้ดีครับ
0x30da2fedc7ad3acd_0x40b1f63e562cb34d.author: ต่วนเอ็มร่อน ลอจิ
0x30da2fedc7ad3acd_0x40b1f63e562cb34d.en: My upper molar had a very large cavity. I had it filled elsewhere several times, but it kept falling out. Some clinics said it couldn't be filled anymore and I needed a crown. Someone in my family recommended I see Dr. Suphatchai. He said it might be possible to fill it, and after the filling, it's working well.

0x30da2fedc7ad3acd_0x40b1f63e562cb34d.text: คุณหมอมือเบา ใจเย็น อธิบายรายละเอียดเข้าใจง่าย ทำฟันปลอมสวยมาก ดูไม่ออกว่าเป็นฟันปลอมเลย ที่จอดรถสะดวก จอดได้ทั้งในโครงการและในลานจอดรถตลาดอ้อมเมือง (อยู่หลังคลินิก)
0x30da2fedc7ad3acd_0x40b1f63e562cb34d.author: แวซานียะห์ บราเฮม
0x30da2fedc7ad3acd_0x40b1f63e562cb34d.en: The dentist was gentle, calm, and explained everything clearly. The dentures are beautiful; you can't even tell they're dentures. Parking is convenient, both within the clinic complex and in the Oom Muang Market parking lot (behind the clinic).

0x30da2fedc7ad3acd_0x40b1f63e562cb34d.text: ปวดฟันกรามมาหลายวัน ฟันผุกว้างมากค่ะ ไปหาหลายที่แนะนำให้ถอนฟันซี่นี้ ตัดสินใจโทรนัดคุณหมอ สุดท้ายคุณหมออุดฟันซี่นี้ให้จนสำเร็จ ชื่นชมคุณหมอที่มีความพยายามสูงมากค่ะ
0x30da2fedc7ad3acd_0x40b1f63e562cb34d.author: ตัสนีม สะแลแม
0x30da2fedc7ad3acd_0x40b1f63e562cb34d.en: I've had a toothache in my molar for several days. The cavity was very large. I went to several places, and they all recommended extracting it. I finally decided to call and make an appointment with a dentist. In the end, the dentist successfully filled the tooth. I really admire the dentist's dedication and effort.

0x30da2fedc7ad3acd_0x40b1f63e562cb34d.text: พาลุงมาทำฟันปลอมทั้งปาก แต่เดิมลุงแก้มตอบ คางยื่นมาก ทำฟันปลอมใส่แล้วดูเป็นหนุ่มขึ้นมากเลยค่ะ เคี้ยวอาหารได้อร่อย ลุงดูอ้วนขึ้น หน้าตาดูมีความสุขขึ้นมากค่ะ
0x30da2fedc7ad3acd_0x40b1f63e562cb34d.author: To Yu
0x30da2fedc7ad3acd_0x40b1f63e562cb34d.en: I brought my uncle to get full dentures. Before, he had sunken cheeks and a protruding chin. After getting the dentures, he looks so much younger! He can chew food more easily, looks a little fatter, and much happier.

0x30da2fedc7ad3acd_0x40b1f63e562cb34d.text: คุณหมอมือเบา ใจดี สุภาพ ร้านสะอาด โล่ง ที่จอดรถเพียบ บรรยากาศดี คุณหมอให้คำแนะนำที่เหมาะสมกับสถานการณ์ ใครเคยผิดหวังกับร้านทำฟันที่อื่น ลองมาดูที่นี่ครับ
0x30da2fedc7ad3acd_0x40b1f63e562cb34d.author: somjun someday
0x30da2fedc7ad3acd_0x40b1f63e562cb34d.en: The dentist is gentle, kind, and polite. The clinic is clean and spacious with plenty of parking. The atmosphere is pleasant. The dentist provides advice that is appropriate for the situation. If you've been disappointed with other dental clinics, try this one.

0x30e29feb20bd8f29_0x2d872d53c1c13855.text: I met Johan when I was going through a really tough time — struggling with severe depression and anxiety after breaking up with my girlfriend during Covid. He helped me in ways I honestly didn’t think were possible. Since meeting him, I’ve changed completely. My depression is gone, and my anxiety has become so small it barely affects me anymore. What I like most about Johan is that he never judges you for who you are or what you’ve done. He lets you make mistakes and learn from them. He also has this way of giving you a new perspective (one you might not have thought of) and then letting you figure out your own way forward. He’s got a great personality and sense of humour, and I genuinely enjoy every chat we have. I can’t thank him enough for how much he’s helped me. I’d recommend him to anyone without hesitation.
0x30e29feb20bd8f29_0x2d872d53c1c13855.author: Ali B

0x30e29feb20bd8f29_0x2d872d53c1c13855.text: Johan has helped me through many life transitions. I’ve stuck with him throughout the years because he really knows what he is doing. He’s professional, compassionate, and also has a wonderful sense of humor. He always seems to be able to meet me where I’m at and gently help me discover where I need to go. He’s always on your side… even if he has to gently challenge you, you still know it’s for your highest good. Johan knows what’s needed to help his patients experience positive changes. He’s the real deal - honest, authentic, knowledgeable.
0x30e29feb20bd8f29_0x2d872d53c1c13855.author: Jorden Dormer

0x30e298e4304193e1_0x3d452aad845aeec3.text: I was very impressed. Two weeks ago, on Saturday, September 12th, I had my nose surgery done. The doctor was very kind and lovely, and most importantly, very gentle. I was a little worried about the pain from the local anesthetic injection before the procedure, but the doctor had an excellent technique, making it much less painful than I expected. I barely felt any discomfort at all, which made the procedure very relaxing and went smoothly. Another person I want to thank very much is the assistant who took care of me by my bedside. She was very kind, helpful, and constantly checked on me, making me feel comfortable and less anxious. Thank you very much to the doctor and all the staff for the excellent care and attention to detail, from before to during the procedure. I was truly impressed. If I have the opportunity, I would definitely come back for their services again. My new nose shape is beautiful and I'm very happy with it.
0x30e298e4304193e1_0x3d452aad845aeec3.author: ฐิฐาณี ใจปิง

0x30e298e4304193e1_0x3d452aad845aeec3.text: I have been to see Dr Thiti since I was a young boy. Now I am in my mid 30s. Excellent dentist with gentle manners. Polite, careful & caring. Meticulous with his fine dental skills and always gives me enough analgesia before major procedures. He has great communication skills and always puts his patients at ease.
0x30e298e4304193e1_0x3d452aad845aeec3.author: Pleayo Tovaranonte

0x30e298e4304193e1_0x3d452aad845aeec3.text: The doctor had a very gentle touch, performed the procedure meticulously, and explained everything in detail.
0x30e298e4304193e1_0x3d452aad845aeec3.author: Chomanat im-erbsin

0x30e298e4304193e1_0x3d452aad845aeec3.text: I used to go because the senior dentist, who graduated from a university in the same state as me when I was a child, was kind, meticulous, and attentive. Even as I grew up, I still went to see her because I had seen her since I was a child. But now there's a female dentist, and her work is very shoddy. My fillings don't fit properly when I bite down. She works quickly but carelessly, to the point where I had to get it polished elsewhere. I'm very sad and miss the old senior dentist. I couldn't even get to see her again, so I don't plan on going back. I'm giving it two stars purely based on my childhood memories. Goodbye. I hope you never come back.
0x30e298e4304193e1_0x3d452aad845aeec3.author: Mae Lee

0x30e29fcf2deacf7f_0x5f73e40f41cf2ca.text: I used the nap room during my lunch break. I booked it for 1 hour for 100 baht, which was great value. A bed, pillow, bolster, and blanket were all provided. The air conditioning was cool, the room was quiet, and the lights were completely dark. I was able to take a nap and wake up feeling refreshed and ready to work. The staff were also very helpful. I was very impressed.
0x30e29fcf2deacf7f_0x5f73e40f41cf2ca.author: Sopita Assawa

0x30e29fcf2deacf7f_0x5f73e40f41cf2ca.text: I've used their services and before, my body didn't want to do anything because I was uncomfortable and easily aching from office syndrome. But now it's like I have a new body. The physiotherapist is truly knowledgeable, gives good advice, treats the problem directly, is healthy, and even accepts insurance claims. It's worth it. I highly recommend this place.
0x30e29fcf2deacf7f_0x5f73e40f41cf2ca.author: jame HaleluyA

0x30e29fcf2deacf7f_0x5f73e40f41cf2ca.text: My girlfriend complained of back pain from raising our child, so I brought her here for treatment. I'm very satisfied. The problem was solved right away. The physical therapists are experts, very knowledgeable, and friendly. The clinic is small but clean and has a full range of equipment. I highly recommend it. I'll definitely be back.
0x30e29fcf2deacf7f_0x5f73e40f41cf2ca.author: Atjayut Sangkasem

0x30e29fcf2deacf7f_0x5f73e40f41cf2ca.text: Excellent service. The physiotherapist inquired about my symptoms in detail and provided attentive treatment. The equipment is modern and the location is convenient. *The clinic requests that patients wear masks throughout treatment and refrain from taking photographs.
0x30e29fcf2deacf7f_0x5f73e40f41cf2ca.author: Supitchaya Khemthong

0x30e29fcf2deacf7f_0x5f73e40f41cf2ca.text: Excellent service. The staff are lovely, knowledgeable, and skilled. The equipment is diverse and modern. The place is clean, and parking and access are convenient. I'm 100/10 impressed.
0x30e29fcf2deacf7f_0x5f73e40f41cf2ca.author: Tunyakarn Anucharchart

0x30e29fcf2deacf7f_0x5f73e40f41cf2ca.text: The physiotherapist was excellent. They did their best and gave great advice. At first, I was in a lot of pain, but after the treatment, I felt much better. The pain decreased by 80%.
0x30e29fcf2deacf7f_0x5f73e40f41cf2ca.author: Natcha Chalodom

0x30e29fcf2deacf7f_0x5f73e40f41cf2ca.text: The clinic is very good. They explain each step of the physical therapy procedure in great detail.
0x30e29fcf2deacf7f_0x5f73e40f41cf2ca.author: Tanoytaanoy V

0x30e29fcf2deacf7f_0x5f73e40f41cf2ca.text: The doctor is very good. He explains things simply and I understood. The space is a bit cramped, and the air conditioning is too cold.
0x30e29fcf2deacf7f_0x5f73e40f41cf2ca.author: Ayumu Narumi

0x30e2990e98c4d501_0x9dee65b2f4f50ed1.text: Review for Acupuncture Doctor Both the doctors have a very nice and caring nature. They understand the health issues deeply and support with patience and kindness. Their needle treatment is effective, and they also provide strong and valuable health advice. They are truly genuine people, and it feels very good to see how acupuncture can naturally improve health under their guidance. The place is still developing — it can be made a bit cleaner and more comfortable — but the doctors themselves are very, very good. I sincerely wish them good luck and continued growth. Blessed to meet such good-hearted, knowledgeable, and understanding professionals. Regards, 🌸 Prince Rajesh Kumar 🌸
0x30e2990e98c4d501_0x9dee65b2f4f50ed1.author: RAJESH KUMAR LADDHA

0x30e2990e98c4d501_0x9dee65b2f4f50ed1.text: This is my second acupuncture and cupping session. I'm absolutely hooked! I felt so much better in my neck, shoulders, and back after the first session. It was so relaxing. I'll be doing it continuously (once a week) to quickly relieve muscle tension. I love it so much because I don't like massages at all. Getting acupuncture and cupping here has been amazing! 😍 I'll be doing it for a long time. The doctor is so lovely and so accurate! She pinpointed all the pressure points perfectly! 👍🏻 (The price is also very good!)
0x30e2990e98c4d501_0x9dee65b2f4f50ed1.author: Worrapitcha (MYN)

0x30e2990e98c4d501_0x9dee65b2f4f50ed1.text: Great acupuncture clinic! It's only a 5-minute walk from the boxing stadium, very convenient. The doctor is caring. I felt better right after the session.
0x30e2990e98c4d501_0x9dee65b2f4f50ed1.author: Chotiwan Hoon

0x30e2990e98c4d501_0x9dee65b2f4f50ed1.text: Finally found a clinic near my house. I've been looking for it for a long time. The place I pinned is the one I always go to. Definitely my regular shop.
0x30e2990e98c4d501_0x9dee65b2f4f50ed1.author: kewaraporn s.

0x30e2992d487847bf_0xe40c0efe7a747835.text: I had a herniated disc surgery 10 years ago. The doctor is the best I've ever seen. I've consulted every doctor I could find, including those offering conventional medicine at a government hospital, MRIs, and chiropractic treatments. But after seeing Dr. Liu, I saw results from the very first session. Because my condition was severe, I continued treatment until I was completely cured without needing surgery. And recently, when I experienced numbness or hearing loss, the doctor prescribed steroids, but my hearing didn't return to normal. After seeing Dr. Liu, just one treatment session, and within one day, I was completely healed. I have so much respect for the doctor.
0x30e2992d487847bf_0xe40c0efe7a747835.author: กฤตยา จิวจําเนียร

0x30e2992d487847bf_0xe40c0efe7a747835.text: The doctor is very skilled and kind, but doesn't speak Thai well. The treatment is effective and efficient. She explains little, so you have to keep asking questions. In short, I've been receiving treatment for 20 years for all sorts of minor ailments. The treatment is 99% effective.
0x30e2992d487847bf_0xe40c0efe7a747835.author: kobkul ruangravenukit

0x30e2992d487847bf_0xe40c0efe7a747835.text: I feel much better after my first visit, having limped for two weeks. The doctor is kind. I'll be back for another treatment soon, hopefully I'll be completely cured.
0x30e2992d487847bf_0xe40c0efe7a747835.author: Sawitta Batviset

0x30e2992d487847bf_0xe40c0efe7a747835.text: I tried treating constipation twice, and after many years... it's completely gone. I have easy bowel movements.
0x30e2992d487847bf_0xe40c0efe7a747835.author: Yuwaporn Kamussatian

0x30e2992d487847bf_0xe40c0efe7a747835.text: It seems like they're not really serious about treating me, they're just focused on the expensive treatment fees, and my condition isn't improving.
0x30e2992d487847bf_0xe40c0efe7a747835.author: iChettha Mari Aon

0x30da3a8fb0db80d3_0x4c4970539e69e4b8.text: Wow! I truly have never had such good orthodontic treatment. The staff are so lovely. The doctor is truly an expert and explains every step of the process. My permanent retainer broke sometime ago and I’m so regretful for not visiting sooner. It feels better now than when I first had it installed! Thank you so much. I’m so grateful 🙏🏻🙌🏻✨
0x30da3a8fb0db80d3_0x4c4970539e69e4b8.author: Shenai

0x30e2a75cc7cb3459_0xbe37bf431b196456.text: รีวิวคลินิกทำฟัน บ้านฟันฟ้า สาขาพระสมุทรเจดีย์ ประทับใจจริง! สะอาด ทันสมัย บริการดีเยี่ยม เมื่อไม่นานมานี้ ผมได้มีโอกาสเข้าไปใช้บริการที่คลินิกทำฟันบ้านฟันฟ้า และบอกตรงๆ ว่าประทับใจมากครับ เลยอยากมาแชร์ประสบการณ์ให้ฟัง เผื่อใครกำลังมองหาคลินิกทำฟันดีๆ อยู่ #บริการที่น่าประทับใจตั้งแต่ก้าวแรก: ตั้งแต่เดินเข้าไป พนักงานต้อนรับให้การต้อนรับดีมากครับ เป็นกันเองและให้ข้อมูลครบถ้วน คุณหมอบุ๋มเองก็เก่งและเป็นมืออาชีพสุดๆ อธิบายขั้นตอนการรักษาชัดเจน เข้าใจง่าย ทำให้ผมคลายความกังวลไปได้เยอะเลยครับ ระหว่างทำก็คอยถามไถ่ตลอดว่าเจ็บไหม สบายดีรึเปล่า รู้สึกได้เลยว่าใส่ใจคนไข้จริงๆ #ความสะอาดและอุปกรณ์ที่ทันสมัย: เรื่องความสะอาดนี่ต้องยกให้เลยครับ คลินิกสะอาดมาก ทุกอย่างจัดวางเป็นระเบียบเรียบรบร้อย ส่วนเรื่องเครื่องมือนี่ไม่ต้องห่วงเลยครับ เห็นได้ชัดว่าทางคลินิกใช้ อุปกรณ์ที่ทันสมัย และได้มาตรฐาน ทำให้มั่นใจเรื่องความปลอดภัยและสุขอนามัยได้เต็มที่ #บรรยากาศผ่อนคลาย ไม่น่ากลัว: ปกติผมไม่ค่อยชอบเข้าคลินิกทำฟันเท่าไหร่ เพราะรู้สึกกังวล แต่ที่นี่บรรยากาศสบายๆ ครับ การตกแต่งดูทันสมัย ไม่ได้น่ากลัวเหมือนโรงพยาบาล ทำให้รู้สึกผ่อนคลายมากขึ้นเยอะเลย โดยรวมแล้ว ผมประทับใจกับการบริการที่คลินิกบ้านฟันฟ้ามากๆ ครับ ทั้งคุณหมอที่เก่งและใจดี พนักงานที่ดูแลเอาใจใส่ รวมถึงเรื่องความสะอาดและเครื่องมือที่ทันสมัย ใครที่กำลังมองหาคลินิกทำฟันที่ตอบโจทย์ทั้งคุณภาพและการบริการ แนะนำที่นี่เลยครับ ไม่ผิดหวังแน่นอน!
0x30e2a75cc7cb3459_0xbe37bf431b196456.author: Kiddy T
0x30e2a75cc7cb3459_0xbe37bf431b196456.en: Review of Baan Fun Fah Dental Clinic, Phra Samut Chedi Branch Truly Impressed! Clean, Modern, Excellent Service Recently, I had the opportunity to use the services at Baan Fun Fah Dental Clinic, and honestly, I was very impressed. So I wanted to share my experience in case anyone is looking for a good dental clinic. #Impressive Service from the First Step: From the moment I walked in, the reception staff were very welcoming, friendly, and provided complete information. Dr. Bum herself is incredibly skilled and professional. She explained the treatment process clearly and easily, which greatly reduced my anxiety. During the treatment, she constantly asked if I was in pain or feeling well. It was clear she genuinely cared for her patients. #Cleanliness and Modern Equipment: Cleanliness is exceptional. The clinic is very clean, and everything is neatly organized. As for the equipment, there's no need to worry. It's clear the clinic uses modern and standard equipment, giving complete confidence in safety and hygiene. #Relaxing and Not Scary Atmosphere: Normally, I don't like going to dental clinics because I feel anxious. But here, the atmosphere is comfortable. The decor is modern and not scary like a hospital, which made me feel much more relaxed. Overall, I was very impressed with the service at Baan Fun Fah Dental Clinic. From the skilled and kind doctor to the attentive staff, everything was excellent. This includes cleanliness and modern equipment. If you're looking for a dental clinic that offers both quality and service, I highly recommend this one. You won't be disappointed!

0x30e2a75cc7cb3459_0xbe37bf431b196456.text: คุณหมอพูดเพราะมากค่ะ ขูดหินปูนไม่เจ็บเลย พนักงานต้อนรับสุภาพเรียบร้อย หมอนัด11.30 เราไปก่อน พอถึงเวลาหมอเรียกเข้าไป ใช้เวลาไม่นานขูดเสร็จก็มีคุณหมอมาแนะนำการแปลงฟันด้วย ดีมากๆเลยค่ะ
0x30e2a75cc7cb3459_0xbe37bf431b196456.author: MUNIN PHRAPHO
0x30e2a75cc7cb3459_0xbe37bf431b196456.en: The dentist was very kind. The teeth scaling was painless. The reception staff were polite and courteous. My appointment was at 11:30 AM, and I arrived early. When it was my turn, the dentist called me in. The scaling didn't take long, and afterwards, the dentist gave me instructions on how to brush my teeth. It was a great experience!

0x30e2a75cc7cb3459_0xbe37bf431b196456.text: I go to this clinic regularly. The doctor and assistants are kind and cheerful. The clinic is easy to find and convenient to get to.
0x30e2a75cc7cb3459_0xbe37bf431b196456.author: Amornmart Chantrasa

0x30e2a75cc7cb3459_0xbe37bf431b196456.text: คลินิกใหม่ สะอาด ที่นั่งรอเยอะ นั่งสบาย รอคิวไม่นาน พนักงานพูดจาดีรู้เรื่อง คุณหมอทำเบามือมากๆ มีหมอเด็กเฉพาะทางด้วย ที่จอดรถสะดวก
0x30e2a75cc7cb3459_0xbe37bf431b196456.author: Pai Petsungvarn
0x30e2a75cc7cb3459_0xbe37bf431b196456.en: The clinic is new, clean, and has plenty of comfortable waiting seating. Wait times are short. The staff are polite and knowledgeable. The doctor is very gentle. They also have a pediatric specialist. Parking is convenient.

0x30e29fdf7cede86d_0x273357fda523ff01.text: I am a patient in the neurology department. I underwent my first surgery in August 2024 for a ruptured cerebral artery and a second surgery in March 2025 to prevent another rupture. Before that, I received treatment at the physical therapy department for a frozen left shoulder. I would like to express my sincere gratitude to the three physical therapists who took such excellent care of me. With brain surgery, my biggest fear was the side effects, which can range from muscle weakness to paralysis. Besides the expert brain surgery team, I cannot help but write a heartfelt thank you to the three physical therapists who provided me with physical and emotional support, giving me the strength to do physical therapy every day until I became almost completely normal (even though during that time I wasn't confident I would ever fully recover). The physical therapists enabled me to have a healthy body and fulfill my dream: to study Thai classical dance. 🥰🥰 Memorizing dance movements, maintaining balance—head, arms, legs, torso—everything must move in coordination and with perfect rhythm. This comes from consistent and sometimes intense practice. Thanks to the skills of these three physiotherapists. I would like to take this opportunity to express my gratitude to the following three individuals: 1. Mr. Prasit Suwanmanirat. I would like to call him a Super Coach. He was incredibly patient with my mood swings and trained me rigorously and consistently. Most importantly, he changed my perspective on what it means to be a good physiotherapist. He taught me that it's not just about training the patient's body, but also training their heart to be patient, persistent, and to reach their goals without giving up. 2. Ms. Manasavee Uraiphan. She was the first physiotherapist who trained me for my frozen shoulder. She was sincere in her training, making it fun, and she constantly encouraged me even before my stroke. 3. Ms. Kanjana Chulaphan. She was a physiotherapist who, when I was fussy and sleepy from taking anti-seizure medication, comforted me in countless ways. I felt so grateful and motivated to do my arm physiotherapy, even though it was very painful. These three individuals are physiotherapists of the highest quality I've ever met. I am so incredibly happy that during my year and a half at Bangkok Hospital, I met all three of them. Christmas is almost here! I may not have any gifts to give to the three of you, so I would like to take this opportunity to say "Thank you very much" for helping me, a brain patient, to return to studying performing arts, as I have always dreamed. Thank you so much. And I would also like to thank Bangkok Hospital for screening out highly qualified physical therapists to work at Bangkok Hospital, so that patients like us have the opportunity to receive such excellent treatment for life.

0x30e29f4c058e6d95_0x8d3f1b1f7c61b18c.en: The dentist was very gentle. I had a filling done today. Previously, I went to another clinic, probably because the old filling didn't leave much tooth structure, so they weren't willing to fill it. Then today, my tooth cracked, so I quickly called to check their services and make an appointment. The dentist was very straightforward, explaining that if drilling wasn't enough to fill it, they would recommend root canal treatment or extraction. They also mentioned that another one or two teeth needed fillings next. The dentist was very patient in explaining everything to me, even answering my questions repeatedly. I have to come back in two weeks if the filled tooth is fine for the other fillings. Overall, I was impressed with their straightforward advice and will definitely return. Thank you.

0x30503075c28da7e7_0x29238182f7492e2e.text: 😗 Went to the doctor to get some medicine because I was really sick. At the counter, they asked me what my symptoms were. “I said I had a headache, fever, sore throat, runny nose, and a nosebleed. It wasn’t as bad as a nosebleed, but it was definitely there.” The person at the counter said, “Okay.” Then they went into the examination room. The doctor said, “My throat isn’t red, my nose isn’t runny, and I don’t have a fever.” Okay, there might not be a fever because I took the medicine this morning because I had a headache and a high fever. As for the runny nose, I told them I had just blown my nose before coming. I was confused, “What’s with this thick feeling in my throat?” The doctor said, “It might be phlegm.” Oh, then you just said there wasn’t anything. The doctor asked if I wanted any more medicine and what medicines I had at home. So I asked for “throat medicine.” Because the doctor didn’t even check if there was blood in my nose. So I didn’t want anything and just asked to go home because I was already dizzy. If you don’t want to give me medicine, it’s okay. I didn’t ask for it for free. I paid for it. The doctor said, “Can I drink warm water instead?” I was confused, so I didn’t ask for any medicine. The doctor just gave me a throat spray. We came because we trusted him, because my father had recommended him. We came because we really came for a checkup, because we were really sick, not to buy a medical certificate. When we got home, there was still blood in our nose. We really wanted to go to the hospital, but we didn't have time, so we came to a nearby clinic instead.
0x30503075c28da7e7_0x29238182f7492e2e.author: znaoqe

0x30fdabd196b2b6e3_0xe1ca88ecaadc9f3.text: จองคิว ทุ่มครึ่ง มาถึง 6:40 แต่ลัดคิวให้คนอื่นที่ดูเหมือนจะไม่ได้ลงคิวก่อน สรุปได้เริ่มทำ 7:45 - หมอไม่อธิบายการทำงานในแต่ละขั้นตอนเพื่อคลายกังวลคนไข้ เช่น ฟันซี่ไหนที่ต้องทำบ้าง อธิบายปัญหา ก่อนและหลังอุดฟัน - ยกมือขึ้นบอกว่าเจ็บ หมอก็ยังกรอฟันต่อ ดูรีบๆ รีบทำมาก ไม่ให้หยุดพักอ้าปากเลย - หลายครั้งผู้ช่วยเกี่ยวที่ดูดน้ำลายไว้กับเหงือกระหว่างที่หมอทำอยู่ ซึ่งมันเจ็บมาก ทำให้ลิ้นเราขยับไปใกล้เครื่องมือ ก็ได้แต่บอกให้ขยับออก แต่ไม่ได้ดูเลยว่าคนไข้ทำแบบนั้นเพราะอะไร - ยอด 2500 ชำระด้วยบัตรเครดิตมีค่าธรรมเนียม 3% - โดยรวมก็โอเค ถ้าไม่เคยทำที่ดีกว่ามาก่อน ก็คงไม่รู้สึกอะไร
0x30fdabd196b2b6e3_0xe1ca88ecaadc9f3.en: I booked an appointment for 7:30 PM, arrived at 6:40 PM, but they let someone who didn't seem to have a reservation skip ahead of me. I finally started treatment at 7:45 AM. - The dentist didn't explain each step of the procedure to alleviate my anxiety, such as which teeth needed treatment or explaining the problem before and after the filling. - Even when I raised my hand to indicate pain, the dentist continued drilling, seemingly in a hurry. They rushed the process and didn't allow me to open my mouth for a break. - Several times, the assistant held the suction device against my gums during the procedure, which was very painful and caused my tongue to move closer to the instrument. They just told me to move it, but didn't seem to notice why I was doing that. - The total was 2500 THB, paid by credit card with a 3% fee. - Overall, it was okay. This is a public health center that serves the public, not a marketplace. The person in question should receive some training before performing their duties. My parents were using the service here for the first time, and they even bowed to thank the woman despite her rude behavior. Another woman sitting next to her told my parents (and probably other patients) that there was a donation box outside... My parents then donated 100 baht, not 20 baht. Are you even a nurse? If so, why did you speak so rudely and lacking in training to the elderly? Whoever oversees this unit should train this woman to have better manners when speaking to the elderly and other patients. ***Photography is prohibited in this area.***

0x30e297a7603cd7df_0xcf66f64dd36cd036.text: Yesterday, I received a platelet-boosting injection for stage 4 breast cancer. 0x3102969a5132a507_0xf71a1fbf0176757d.text: Front incisor root pin broke (after previous repair at local hospital) and now an implant was the only viable course of action. After visiting several places, I settle on Dr. Nan (his nickname). Besides being license here, he attended a year of implant training at UCLA (California USA) and has good mastery of the English language. He was prepared to explain everything in writing and was most willing to answer questions without pressure or rushing you. During the many visits, he took great care to reduce discomfort and to verify his work. Because this was a very visible area of the mouth he made a temporary bridge from flow-able resin. No one could tell I was having work done. Please understand he certainly isn't the cheapest place around, but as with most things, you get what you pay for. What impressed me also was "no surprises" of up-charging for extras. Dr. Nan has training from several of the major implant makers. In my case we decided on a mid range implant made by Anyridge. This was after much web investigation and consultation. I won't know for sure until years down the road if I made the correct decisions of doctor and device; but I am pretty sure I did.

0x30e29fead08def43_0x2fa835476be33f41.text: I was so impressed! It was the most fun Ulthera treatment I've ever had. The doctor explained the equipment, how to identify authentic products, how to check skin layers, and the number of lines – it was like a pre-medical course! It helped me understand how the machine works and what I was getting into my body, how deep it penetrated, and how I could see my skin condition. It was so fun I wanted to get up and take notes! Throughout the procedure, there were 3-4 nurses massaging and using a massage machine to distract me from the pain. Actually, it wasn't painful at all and added to the comfort. Another thing that impressed me was the pillowcase! They changed the sheet for each person, so it was incredibly clean. Sometimes they don't invest in things like that. Imagine, so many heads sharing the same pillow! During the procedure, the doctor had the nurses adjust the neck angle left and right, tilting it up and down using techniques that didn't strain the client's neck at all. And the doctor sang a happy birthday song throughout the procedure! I can honestly say it was a very fun and memorable procedure. Importantly, the price was reasonable. Having flown to Korea for treatments for the past 3 years, I didn't have any plans to fly this year, so I looked for a trustworthy clinic with a good price, and I wasn't disappointed. I came with a promotion from James: 400+400. The doctor was very meticulous and the procedure took over an hour. It was totally worth the price because the doctor's time is money, but they were so thorough and careful. They didn't rush or try to accommodate too many clients. I highly recommend it. There's parking available. The clinic is near Chidlom BTS station, close to a suit shop. If you go up to the second floor, you'll see the suit shop first, with a beautiful view of Louis Vuitton as a backdrop. The clinic entrance is a little hard to find, but once you get inside, it's amazing! I was impressed with everything.🤙🏻

0x30da3a9bb656ad91_0x58c3bca20960da10.text: Hello. I received treatment from this doctor when I returned to Thailand last month, and I was very impressed. Personally, I feel that since receiving treatment at clinics in Thailand, Tara Clinic is my number one choice. The doctor is very attentive to patients, doesn't rush, and tries to explain the treatment methods, post-treatment instructions, and even dressing guidelines. Personally, I had many problems: a very strong odor in my vagina, itching, abnormal and discolored discharge, lower abdominal pain, a breast tumor, and other issues. While abroad, I went to other doctors, but the vaginal problems didn't improve. I was very worried and anxious. But after returning to Thailand and receiving treatment, all my problems disappeared. In summary, I had many conditions including a vaginal yeast infection, vaginal bacteria, uterine inflammation, and a bladder infection. I had internal examinations and an abdominal ultrasound. The doctor found a chocolate cyst, which was the cause of my lower abdominal pain. But after treatment with the doctor, my symptoms have improved significantly. My discharge is back to normal, the color hasn't changed, and there's no itching. The lower abdominal pain hasn't completely disappeared because of the chocolate cyst, but the odor in my vagina has disappeared, and other problems have lessened. The medical costs might be a bit expensive considering my extensive conditions, but while it was costly, I'm cured. And the doctor didn't charge me extra for my follow-up appointments. We had two check-ups because we had several symptoms, but in the end, the doctor only charged us for the first treatment because the follow-up was for monitoring our condition. We paid a total of 7200 baht for the symptoms we mentioned, including a free cervical cancer screening. Now we are very happy, much more confident, and no longer bothered by anything like before. Thank you so much, doctor! ❤️🙏

0x30da3a9bb656ad91_0x58c3bca20960da10.text: Today I went to see the doctor about my symptoms. I wasn't sure if they were warts, so I just asked him to check my symptoms. I was just curious. He did a pelvic exam, which I could understand. He also examined my vaginal discharge, which I could understand. He also performed a cervical cancer test, even though I hadn't told him I wanted one. I just wanted to consult and see what was wrong with my symptoms. I didn't ask the doctor how much it would cost, but I did ask the staff member up front. He told me to wait for the doctor to write a receipt. I also had to wait about an hour for the urine test results, and then he told me the results. I had warts and should get treatment, and I was satisfied. So I asked how much it would cost today. The doctor told me 2,100 baht, which shocked me. He explained the various expenses, so I told him I didn't want a cervical cancer test, just to check on my symptoms and find out what was wrong. He then said, "Okay, I'll cancel the cervical cancer test." I replied, "Okay," and ended up paying 1,500 baht. Why is it so expensive just for the test? I'm confused. I usually go to clinics whenever I have problems, and it's not that expensive. Another thing I'm concerned about is the pelvic exam and vaginal discharge test. The doctor didn't mention any symptoms related to vaginal discharge, but I do have vaginal discharge. And they didn't give me any medicine. Instead of checking for vaginal discharge and giving me medicine, they didn't give me anything. I feel really bad about this clinic.

0x30e2a26e7c2e65c1_0xbcf8eb7f88b2ad91.text: It doesn't live up to the "international" name because of one rotten apple (the service in some departments). I took my father for a scheduled check-up and wanted to use his insurance and vehicle registration. I didn't know where to inform them. While my father was signing in front of the emergency room in Building 2, I asked a plump woman in a sweet, polite voice, "If we want to use insurance and the vehicle registration, where do we need to inform them?" (Because I didn't know, I asked out of ignorance). She replied, "What kind of insurance?" (I started gritting my teeth, thinking she probably didn't hear or understand what I asked). So I asked again (still in my usual polite tone), "The insurance that we'll use for the check-up appointment." And she answered, "This is it!" and pointed to the documents my father was signing. That was a terrible answer. I became annoyed and went back to wait for the check-up, which took a very long time, over an hour. When they called my father (the examination itself probably lasted less than a minute; he had a car accident and broke his collarbone), that wasn't too bad. After the examination, no one told my father where to go. I told him they probably wanted him to wait until they called him and then follow instructions. But he sat and waited for a very long time, seeing other people finish their examinations and leave. So I decided to go ask the same woman again, still using the same polite tone as before, "Excuse me, where do I need to go next?" She immediately retorted, "Ask the nurse!!" (That was awful!) So I went to ask a nurse who was nearby, explaining where I needed to go next. I said that since I'd finished my checkup, no one had told me what to do next. The nurse quickly checked and told me I could go to the pharmacy building. I must say, the nurses and staff in other departments were very polite and helpful. But as for this woman, I'm boycotting her; I'll make sure to be firm with her next time I see her. And while she was working, she was chatting loudly over a patient's head while they were filling out forms. I'd like to suggest that the hospital should call her in for etiquette training and screen their staff more carefully.
0x30e2a26e7c2e65c1_0xbcf8eb7f88b2ad91.author: หนึ่งฤทัย จ้อยสูงเนิน

0x30e2a26e7c2e65c1_0xbcf8eb7f88b2ad91.text: The service was absolutely terrible. My partner had a stroke and was receiving treatment under the government health insurance scheme. We had a referral letter from a clinic, but the nurses were completely unhelpful. The clinic had written on the referral letter that we needed to go to the emergency room, but the result was that upon arrival at the hospital, the patient was made to wait for hours. When we inquired, they sent a stretcher to move him to Building 3, where he waited for half an hour. When we asked again, they showed a complete lack of preparedness. Then, they sent another stretcher to move him to Building 2, where he had already been waiting. The patient has a stroke due to a blocked blood vessel in his brain, and the movement was extremely rough. If he had a ruptured brain hemorrhage, he could have been disabled. The service was the worst ever. This was our first time using their service, and it was awful. They should stop calling it "international" – it doesn't suit the service. The staff were rude and seemed forced to provide service. On the day of the blood test, we waited for an extremely long time. People who arrived later were seen first; they weren't examined in order. The blood test results were ready, but they didn't give the doctor the results to call for further examination. People who had just arrived were examined first. It was very confusing. Overall, the service was terrible. If senior management sees this, please order improvements. The work system is flawed, and some staff members provide poor service.
0x30e2a26e7c2e65c1_0xbcf8eb7f88b2ad91.author: ยิ้มยิ้ม สดใส

I messaged the clinic to inquire about the material, and the response from the staff was quite shocking. If you're considering getting a retainer here, I personally think it might still be a bit risky.
0x3050313343271bb9_0x56eeaf56209defc.author: Keaw Orapp

0x3050313343271bb9_0x56eeaf56209defc.text: I'd like to share my personal experience to provide information for those considering clear aligner treatment at this clinic. Initially, I inquired about the price and was quoted around 19,xxx baht. However, on the actual visit, there were additional charges bringing the total to approximately 25,000 baht, significantly different from my initial understanding. During the consultation, I didn't even see a doctor; I only spoke with staff and nurses. The mouth scanning (performed by the counter staff) and X-rays felt insufficient for a thorough case assessment on the first day. The clinic stated that treatment could be completed within approximately 4 months, and the teeth would be perfectly aligned. Therefore, I decided to pay on that day. *There was no doctor's assessment on that day. I only met the doctor for the first time about 3 weeks later, on the appointment to receive the aligners.* On the day the aligners were fitted, there were several issues with the attachments coming loose, handled by the assistant, requiring the doctor to intervene. Furthermore, the number of aligners provided only covered 3 months, which was confusing given the initial timeframe. The quality of the aligners received was consistently poor. They lacked precision and were cut to a sharp point, causing sores on my tongue and gums. After completing the treatment, the results were not as expected. My teeth were not properly aligned. Compared to the nearly 30,000 baht cost, I was very disappointed with my overall experience. The communication, care, and appointment system are all quite slow, with very long waiting times each time. This review is based solely on our personal experience. We recommend researching, comparing multiple clinics, and asking for complete details before making a decision.

0x311d5e3c5cf26cdd_0x1b3658f3e32e42f5.text: การบริการของเจ้าหน้าที่แย่มาก ควรมีการอบรมเรื่องพฤติกรรมและการให้บริการใหม่ทั้งหมด เนื่องจากขาดมารยาทและความเป็นมืออาชีพมากๆ ได้จองคิวกับสาขานี้ไว้ แต่เกิดธุระกระทันหันจึงต้องการขอเลื่อนเวลา โดยทางเพจใช้ระบบตอบกลับอัตโนมัติ (บอท) แจ้งว่าสามารถเข้าไปใช้บริการเวลาใดก็ได้ หลังจากนั้นดิฉันไม่ได้เปิดอ่านข้อความเพิ่มเติม ทำให้ไม่เห็นข้อความที่เจ้าหน้าที่แจ้งกลับมาว่าคิวเต็ม แทนที่เจ้าหน้าที่จะมีหัวคิดหน่อยว่าลูกค้าอาจไม่ได้อ่านข้อความ หรือโทรมาแจ้งเพื่อยืนยันก่อนถึงเวลานัดหมาย ซึ่งเป็นมาตรฐานที่สถานบริการอื่น ๆ ปฏิบัติกัน กลับปล่อยให้ลูกค้าเสียเวลาเดินทางไปถึง แล้วจึงแจ้งว่าไม่สามารถให้บริการได้ ต้องนัดใหม่เนื่องจากคิวเต็ม ทั้งที่ขณะนั้นไม่เห็นมีลูกค้าคนอื่นเข้ามาใช้บริการเลย ส่วนที่โทรคอนเฟิร์มกับลูกค้าท่านอื่นก็ไม่มีคนรับสายคอนเฟิร์ม เท่ากับว่าทางสาขาค่อนข้างที่จะว่าง อีกทางได้มีการสอบถามเราว่าทำไมเมื่อใกล้ถึงเวลาแล้วไม่โทรมาแจ้งว่าไม่สามารถเลื่อนนัดได้ แต่สิ่งที่ได้รับคือ ลักษณะคำพูดและท่าทีเหมือนเป็นการโทษว่าลูกค้าเป็นฝ่ายผิด เพราะก็ยังแจ้งว่าก็ตอบกลับแชทไปแล้ว (แค่ตอบแชท) และก็ยังยืนยันคำตอบเดิมและมีการโต้เถียงกับลูกค้า ซึ่งเป็นสิ่งที่ไม่เหมาะสมอย่างยิ่งสำหรับงานบริการมาก หากเปรียบเทียบกับคลินิกอื่น ๆ ที่เคยใช้บริการมา ไม่เคยพบการบริการในลักษณะนี้เลย ที่นี่ดูเหมือนไม่ให้ความสำคัญกับลูกค้า ขอแนะนำคนอื่นที่กำลังดูบริการของที่นี่อยู่ ให้ไปใช้บริการคลินิกอื่นจะได้รับประสบการณ์ที่ดีกว่า เพราะถ้าสถานที่นี้ไม่ใส่ใจลูกค้า ลูกค้าก็ไม่จำเป็นต้องเสียทั้งเวลาและเงินกับการบริการที่ไม่ได้มาตรฐานเช่นนี้ค่ะ ยังมีที่ที่อื่นที่ถูกและให้บริการดีกว่าอีกมาก

0x311d5e3c5cf26cdd_0x1b3658f3e32e42f5.en: The service from the staff was terrible. They need complete retraining on behavior and customer service, as they lacked manners and professionalism. I had booked an appointment at this branch, but due to an unforeseen event, I needed to reschedule. The page used an automated system (bot) to inform me that I could come at any time. After that, I didn't read further messages and therefore didn't see the message from the staff saying the schedule was full. Instead of considering that the customer might not have read the message or called to confirm before the appointment, which is standard practice at other clinics, the staff let me waste my time traveling there only to inform me that they couldn't serve me and I needed to reschedule because the schedule was full. This was despite the fact that there were no other customers present at the time. Other customers who called to confirm their appointments also didn't answer, indicating the branch was quite empty. Furthermore, when asked why I didn't call to inform them that the appointment couldn't be rescheduled close to the scheduled time, the response was blaming me. I had already replied via chat (just a chat reply), and the staff continued to argue with me, which is highly inappropriate for a customer service position. Compared to other clinics I've used, I've never encountered such service. This place seems to not prioritize customer service. I would recommend that anyone considering this service go to another clinic for a better experience. If this place doesn't care about its customers, customers shouldn't waste their time and money on such substandard service. There are many other places that are cheaper and offer better service.

0x311d6147755da50d_0x39d0b01c645499d0.text: Tourist here from America. The dialysis process went smoothly. I emailed the facility and got a prompt response. I'm on a TTS schedule (3, 4-hour treatments/week). I was usually finished by 6pm and the cost pretty reasonable. I had to pay out of pocket because my insurance from the states will not work there. Each treatment cost approximately $45 USD which is far better than HCM in Vietnam and the philippines. If you can't speak thai there is at least one nurse available for you. The atmosphere is welcoming and cozy and you're not too far from plenty to do in Bangkok. There are plenty of nearby hotels and popular attractions. It also reminds me of a spa. There are other cosmetic and medical services offered in the same medical facility on different floors as well. Payment is accepted after each treatment and since Bangkok never sleeps you'll never miss out on anything. The only major difference I noticed between this facility and the facility I used in the states is that the use of saline (salt) it's used more conservatively in Thailand so bring mustard or salt tablets if you're the type who cramps. Also, bring your medications as well some meds are not carried here so check first.
0x311d6147755da50d_0x39d0b01c645499d0.author: Nathaniel Whitt

0x311d6147755da50d_0x39d0b01c645499d0.text: This is absolutely terrible. I can confirm again that the staff and doctors are awful. They wrote down the patient's temperature without actually measuring it. I had a rapid heartbeat and shortness of breath, but the doctor was indifferent, didn't examine me, and ignored my symptoms. They just prescribed paracetamol and allergy medication. Two weeks passed, and I went back for a second visit with the same symptoms. It was Friday morning, and they said there was no doctor available and I should come back on Monday. The staff verbally told me to go to the emergency room at the hospital, but the hospital refused. When I asked for a referral letter, they couldn't provide one because there was no doctor available and they didn't have any medical records from the previous visit where the doctor didn't examine me at all. When I called the National Health Security Office (NHSO) at 1330, another doctor came down within three minutes (why did they hide earlier? I don't understand). When I explained the rapid heartbeat and shortness of breath, the doctor said it was because I wanted a referral letter that my heart was beating fast. Are they crazy? It's been two weeks, and they said they wouldn't know because the doctor didn't use any equipment to examine me. This doctor said, ***"You have to understand, if this were a private hospital, the doctor would examine you completely. But because of the NHSO health insurance, it's preventing me from doing so."*** If you talk like that, you shouldn't be a doctor. If I hadn't called and complained to the National Health Security Office (NHSO), they wouldn't have bothered to come see me. It was a complete waste of time and money on transportation. I'm telling everyone, run away! Don't come here. You only have a gold card (universal health coverage), they won't treat you.
0x311d6147755da50d_0x39d0b01c645499d0.author: Turbo T.

0x311d6147755da50d_0x39d0b01c645499d0.text: This is the worst 30-baht health clinic I've ever been to. It's incredibly complicated and inconsiderate of patients' travel difficulties. I'm an elderly person who can't walk well, and I personally don't want elderly people to walk too much because they might fall. They should only walk when absolutely necessary, like when going to the hospital. They said that if you're not bedridden, you have to come to the clinic; if you can go to the hospital, you should be able to come to the clinic too. The staff are constantly rude to patients, and I've seen it happen many times. The wait times are ridiculously long. If they're not willing to treat patients and the service is terrible, the rules and regulations are more numerous than in high school. How many times does one person have to go to the hospital just to get a referral slip? Waiting for half a day is insane! Has the clinic ever discussed or clarified this with the hospital? The referral slip issue is a huge problem. The service used to be much better; the staff were good, and the rules weren't unfair to patients. I spend so much money on transportation to the hospital every day. And getting medication takes forever.

If we were to do crown, how long was the process because we are travelers so if we were to do it, will it be on time before our flight, what’s the differences between veneer and crown. After asking those questions, we decided that we should also go ask other clinics within that mall and see which one has the better deals and services. As we started walking out, the old lady to the left said in Thai, “ they asked this many questions and still ended up not doing it”. Lady, if I’m gonna spend $3,500 + $18,000 THB you better guessed that I’m making sure I’m using my money correctly and wisely. It’s not wrong to ask questions when you spend this amount. I don’t know what kind of world they live in, running a dental clinic and expect customers to come in and get their teeth done without questions. Keep in mind, sometimes travels can actually speak/understand Thai but they are much more comfortable in a language they speak more often and rather used that to communicate. Yes, my sister and I fully understand what you guys were saying. If you gonna work with customers make sure to learn about manners, like we were taught in school, If you have nothing nice to say, don’t say it at all.

0x3054f552a2fd34a5_0xa010c17200714917.text: We waited for many months to write this review after discontinuing Kru Fon’s services. We wanted to see how our son performed in school and at home, so we could compare. We want other parents and children to avoid what our son went through. Our school referred our 4-year-old boy to Kru Fon who advertises as an occupational therapist. Our son needed extra help with his fine motor skills and concentration. We took him to Kru Fon's office south of Samui. Within ten minutes of seeing him, she said, "I'm not qualified to diagnose him, but your son has ADHD." My husband immediately said, "No way, he's not even close." Kru Fon ignored his comment. My heart sank in disbelief as he is nothing like a typical ADHD child, and the school in the previous year didn't report any issues. My husband couldn't believe Kru Fon, an unqualified person, could casually throw out such a severe diagnosis. However, we were open people and decided to see if she could help our son. We called Kru Fon visits ‘Brain School' to our son. We know how incredible he is, and we don't want to think or treat him like he has a disability. Kru Fon would have 50 minutes with a child and 5-10 minutes to give the parents the report. She reported the exercises she used are for a three-year-old and that our son should be able to do them. Then she would report that maybe if he can't do this, he might have an LD (learning disability). She seemed to want always to try and 'pigeonhole' our son into a behavioral spectrum. Kru Fon showed me the toy activities my son struggled to do, and I would take the same toys home and practice with him. At home, he could easily do them, so the next session, I told her that he could do it. She would say “kids with this condition sometimes appeared to be able to do the exercises but it’s more of a guess” The more we got to know her, and how she approached our son, the more we understood she was working within a limited education structure. It seemed she believed that almost every child was on the ADHD Spectrum. One day, Kru Fon inappropriately told me about another kid in my son's class. She said the boy's father wouldn't let his son be alone with her. He felt the boy cried too much during her sessions. The father said, please let him do the activities he enjoyed first. Kru Fon told the father that if he did the activities he liked, then he would get nowhere. Kru Fon even went as far as telling us that this fathers boy needed a physical therapist for his legs, and she knew someone who could help him, but she wouldn't help because she disliked the boy's father. I was shocked. We decided to walk away from Kru Fon, leaving eight unused sessions. It was the day I heard our son crying hysterically for 10 minutes. I decided that was enough and went into the room. He had never cried hysterically like this. His older brother had a few tantrums when he was younger, so hearing this I knew something was terribly wrong. What I saw when I went into the room shocked me. Our son was in the corner; Kru Fon had trapped him with her legs and was forcing him to do the activities. He didn't want to continue, and she was repeatedly demanding him to respond. I reminded Kru Fon he’s four years old, he’s left handed and they develop differently. It was a horrible experience, and I cried in the car on the way home. After reviewing all the twelve sessions, I don't know how our son and I endured this for so long. I have many sleepless nights, blaming myself for putting our son through this ordeal. If anything came from those twelve sessions with Kru Fon, it was how NOT to treat your child. We play games and read as we continue to work with our son. He is now a happy five-year-old at the top of his class. He can do math, read books correctly, and write far above his age. We genuinely believe that had we continued the session with Kru Fon, our son would not have progressed like he has. In fact, we believe he could have been a very different, damaged child if he’d continued using Kru Fon‘a services.

0x30e290446038e513_0x5dd7cba239f415ad.text: I wanted to send my support to the nurses in the delivery room on the 5th floor of the outpatient building. And thank the doctor who delivered my baby. My baby was in a breech presentation (the doctor was so kind; I had a follow-up appointment for my C-section wound, and the doctor greeted me, remembered me, asked about the baby, inquired about the baby's condition, and even gave me advice on wound care). I was so impressed and grateful. I had booked a private room, but the baby was born with rapid breathing and needed oxygen. The baby needed close contact with doctors and nurses, so I chose to stay with him in the shared delivery room. However, I got to see how attentive all the nurses were to me and my baby. While waiting for the baby's blood test results, I requested to be moved to a private room because the baby could initially be taken off the oxygen machine. Also, the baby's father and relatives wanted to visit and see the baby. So, I gained experience with both shared and private rooms at Bang Yai Hospital. The private rooms are just rooms, nothing special. Checking on the baby was very superficial; for example, weighing the baby – in the shared delivery room, they weighed him without clothes (how attentive they were!), but in the private room, they only weighed him without the swaddling cloth. The weight difference was significant. The doctor assessed the baby and said he could go home without any concerns, just waiting for the blood test results in the afternoon. When I asked at the counter about the private room, the nurse said I could stay another night to wait for the results. But I felt it was wasteful because it was just like sleeping without any check-ups or care, and I wanted to go home because the doctor assessed me in the morning and said there was nothing wrong, so I could leave that day. However, when I told the nurse at the counter, she sounded displeased and had a displeased expression. I would like to see improvements in the private rooms. Everything else was great from my prenatal care to childbirth. Thank you from the bottom of my heart. 🙏🏻
0x30e290446038e513_0x5dd7cba239f415ad.author: bongbawl

0x30e290446038e513_0x5dd7cba239f415ad.text: This was my first time at this hospital for a medical check-up for a job application. I was very impressed with several things: 1. There's a lot of parking space because there's an empty area next to the hospital where you can park. There are also quite a few food stalls (but no shade). 2. The medical check-up wasn't as crowded as I expected. I arrived at the hospital around 7:30 AM. After opening my medical record (which was very easy; just inserting my ID card to verify my identity and handing it to the staff), I waited in front of the specialist clinic on the 4th floor. I put the pink slip I received in the basket and waited. The nurse arrived around 8:30 AM. I was then called in to have my blood pressure taken, my medical history taken, and then sent for various lab tests specified by the company. Mine included a blood test, a urine test, and an X-ray. At the lab, upon arrival, I scanned the barcode on the pink slip and received a queue number (but I recommend informing the staff again beforehand that you also need a urine test). The queue for blood tests didn't take long at all. It might be because it wasn't a medical check-up. I only waited a short time before getting my turn for blood and urine tests. After that, I went to the 3rd floor for an x-ray. Then I came back to the 4th floor to wait for the results. The whole process flowed quite smoothly. There was no waiting around except for the lab results. Once the lab results were out, they called me in to see the doctor to hear the results, receive the medical certificate, and pay. All of this only cost 550 baht. I finished paying at 10:40 AM, so it only took about 3 hours in total. That's very fast for me considering it's a government hospital, because I was mentally prepared to wait 5 hours, haha. 3. All the staff were very nice. No one was rude or aggressive, even though I didn't know anything about what to do or where to go. I was especially impressed with the nurse in the special clinic.
0x30e290446038e513_0x5dd7cba239f415ad.author: pat poppy

0x30e290446038e513_0x5dd7cba239f415ad.text: 📢 Booking a dental appointment online is very convenient, hassle-free, and fast. It saves a lot of money. The doctor and assistants are lovely. At the scheduled time, you go up to the 4th floor, weigh yourself, have your blood pressure checked, and confirm your appointment. I usually arrive about 15 minutes early, or about an hour early, to have my blood pressure checked again because I have high blood pressure and need it measured multiple times. Almost everything was perfect. ❌ Except for some male doctors who, seeing that a case was difficult, refused to treat it. They went on to treat teeth that weren't specified, even though my medical history clearly indicated which teeth needed treatment (1, 2, 3, 4). This caused the patient to have to reschedule. ✅ I wondered if this doctor might not be as skilled as I thought, and I can confidently say this because I've encountered this twice with this male doctor. This is based on my personal experience receiving treatment at this hospital. I hope that others who go for treatment will receive the most lovely doctors and assistants. 🙏🙏🙏
0x30e290446038e513_0x5dd7cba239f415ad.author: Ake Noppadol

0x30e290446038e513_0x5dd7cba239f415ad.text: The problems at this hospital lie in its OPD system management and communication. The OPD system, which starts at the registration counter, creates a bottleneck. Even scheduled patients have to present their appointment cards at the registration counter, leading to overcrowding until their turn is called. Personally, I experienced paperwork issues stemming from the hospital's back-end, resulting in me being moved to the back of the queue despite submitting my card earlier. The patient management system is disorganized; I constantly had to ask what to do next and if the process was complete. Fortunately, the front-line staff were somewhat helpful and able to resolve some problems. Waiting times for appointments were inconsistent. The hospital stated my appointment was at 9:00 AM, but I waited for three hours, until noon, before being sent for lunch and told to return in the afternoon to wait again before being seen. If the queues were separated into 9:00 AM, 10:00 AM, and 11:00 AM, they should calculate the average time required per patient and provide a more accurate estimate so patients have time to manage their schedules and avoid congestion at the OPD. Payment and medication dispensing were not a problem.
0x30e290446038e513_0x5dd7cba239f415ad.author: Iil Lilil

0x30e290446038e513_0x5dd7cba239f415ad.text: The chronic disease clinic on the 3rd floor, room 5, doctor: The doctor was uncommunicative, didn't prescribe all the necessary medication, and when we reported that our mother was coughing a lot, the doctor said, "She's not coughing right now. She doesn't look like she's sick." Does she mean we have to wait until the symptoms appear before coming to see her? She coughs a lot in the evenings, but not in the mornings. The doctor's attitude was terrible. Is this all the doctors the hospital has? Are they so used to treating patients like this that they think they're clueless? If it's just a matter of prescribing the same medication, the nurses could do it. Or hire a doctor who is caring and genuinely wants to treat patients. A doctor who makes patients feel lucky to have met them. They didn't even inform us if they forgot to give or stopped medication. When we tried to go back to ask, they were gone. We asked the reception staff, but they couldn't do anything. The queuing system is completely disorganized. The hospital has been around for a long time, but there's been no improvement at all. It's heartbreaking for patients who have to be treated here.
0x30e290446038e513_0x5dd7cba239f415ad.author: Pattarathorn J

0x305031f0a9d87749_0xc2615a17bd181b04.text: The doctor is excellent! The treatment was great. I had a serum allergy for months, and even hospital visits didn't help. 0x30e2a3bc4f5c29f5_0xebebc2752973aa13.en: The service is terrible. Avoid this clinic if you can. I had an appointment for teeth cleaning and fillings. When I went in, the dentist told me to choose only one, and scheduled the fillings for another day, saying I was 10 minutes late and they couldn't finish it on time. I've been here three times and had to wait every time. The dentist is never punctual. If they don't want to provide good service, I won't use their services again. If they think I'm late, they should have offered to let me wait for the next patient, instead of making me waste time scheduling appointments. With this kind of service, they'll lose a lot of customers, believe me. There are plenty of other clinics out there.

0x30e29fe63cd2f3a1_0x7253a9f43b644738.en: All the dentists are lovely and very kind. Even after getting braces, I still come back for checkups and wisdom tooth extraction. The staff are all wonderful too.

0x30e29fe63cd2f3a1_0x7253a9f43b644738.text: จัดฟันที่นี้ดีมากหมอใจดีมากเลย ฟันเสร็จเร็วมากไม่เลี้ยงไข้ จัดฟันกับหมอที่จบด้านจัดฟันได้โดยตรงด้วย แนะนำ

0x30e29fe63cd2f3a1_0x7253a9f43b644738.text: จัดฟันที่นี้อยู่ ฟันเข้าเร็วมาก คุณหมอแนะนำดีมาก ไม่เลี้ยงไข้เลย ใครสนใจจัดฟันอยู่ แนะนำที่เลยค่ะ

Anyone considering using these benefits should think carefully before proceeding.

0x30e29f001dc7f9d3_0xe8104e8957cebc2c.text: I accompanied my wife here before, and it broke my heart to see her suffer. But the doctors and nurses at Danruo took great care of her, and Xue Bo's treatment plan minimized the pain of injections. The sperm retrieval process was also very private and went smoothly. Now my wife is pregnant, and I'm truly grateful to everyone here! Our first child is already in elementary school, and we wanted a second child, but it's not easy at our age. Danruo helped us realize our dream. The technology here is indeed much more advanced than when I had my first child, especially the screening technology, which gave us a lot of peace of mind. Because of oligospermia, I was very self-conscious. Xue Bo's team's intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) freezing technology really saved me. They are truly professional; they didn't make me undergo that horrible puncture surgery, they found it directly in the semen! Xue Bo called this technology "pulling," thank you so much! Finally graduated! Going home with the baby! Thank you Danruo, Bangkok is truly my lucky place! Highly recommended, I'll definitely visit them again next time I'm in Bangkok!

0x30e29f001dc7f9d3_0xe8104e8957cebc2c.text: When I learned about this hospital, I had already experienced two missed miscarriages and undergone numerous procedures including countless immune tests, hysterosalpingography, and hysteroscopy. Btw, Professor Xue used to be a renowned IVF expert at a top-tier Grade A tertiary hospital in China .I resolutely traveled from China to Thailand for IVF treatment and never expected the environment here to be so excellent. The medical staff are extremely gentle and also attach great importance to privacy. As my IVF treatment, Professor Xue and the medical team helped me find the most suitable personalized plan—with a low dosage and high comfort level. Although egg retrieval hasn’t started yet, I’m already looking forward to a positive outcome. This process has made me feel reassured and comfortable. Highly recommended!! Btw the fee structure here is very reasonable and transparent. 十分感谢丹若的技术过硬和经验丰富，我在泰国享受假期的同时能够快乐的期待宝宝来！！

0x30e29fb38973cb57_0x8a6002b87d4a2dde.text: ช่วงเวลาที่รักษารู้สึกไม่ประทับใจ 1. ไม่มีแผนการรักษา ไม่มีชี้แจง แจ้งให้ชัดว่าจะทำอะไร จะรู้แค่ว่า ปรับเครื่องมืออย่างเดียว ด้วยก่อนเข้า พบคุณหมอแจ้งว่ามีฟันคุดที่ต้องถอน คุณหมอแจ้งว่าสามารถทยอยเอาออกได้ระหว่างการจัดฟัน ตอนนี้ผ่านมา 4 เดือน มีแต่แจ้งการปรับอุปกรณ์ วันนี้จึงเข้าถามว่า แผนการรักษามีไหม แล้วฟันคุดจะนัดเอาออกเมื่อไหร่ วันนี้มีคำตอบค่ะ แต่เพิ่งดูชาทการรักษา แล้วบอกว่าเอาออกได้เลย ถ้าปล่อยไว้นานบางเคสเจอหนอง / ถ้าปล่อยไว้นานจะถอนยากถ้าจัดฟันนานขึ้น คำถามคือ #แล้วทำไมไม่นัดไม่แจ้ง ไม่บอก ไม่ตรวจดูช่องบอกลูกค้าค่ะ? ทำแค่เปลี่ยนเครื่องมือแล้วบอกเสร็จ สิ่งที่อยากบอกคือ 1. เรามีตารางงาน ตารางเวลาของตัวเอง ไม่ใช่จะทำงานแค่ช่วงเวลาใดเวลาหนึ่ง เอาสะดวกของคลินิก เวลานัดได้จัดเวลาได้ 2. ควรชี้แจงแผนการรักษาให้ชัดเจน ไม่ใช่ต้องให้ลูกค้ามานั่งถามเอง ให้ลูกค้าได้สบายใจในการรักษานะคะ สถานการณ์ที่ 2 วันนี้มีคิวคุณหมอถอนฟัน จึงคิดว่าไหนๆ โมโหแล้ว ถอนๆ ไป เข้าการรักษาเจอคำถามว่า จะถอนซี่ไหน? คำถามคือ แล้วครั้งแรกที่สแกนฟันไว้ แผนสแกนหายไปไหน คือมาถามคนไข้ว่าจะถอนฟันซี่ไหนหรอคะ (พยายามเข้าใจแล้วค่ะว่า อาจจะชวนคุย ทำให้ผ่อนคลาย) แต่ต้องเข้าใจว่า #จัดฟันครั้งแรก ไม่ได้เป็นหมอฟัน ไม่รู้นะคะว่าวิธี ขั้นตอนจะเป็นอย่างไรบ้าง คือใช้บริการเสียเงินเต็มจำนวนทุกครั้ง แต่ถ้าได้รับบริการแบบนี้ ไม่พอใจมากๆ ค่ะ เราเลือกที่ไว้ใจ และใช้บริการคุณแล้ว ช่วยเพิ่มความมั่นใจ ไว้ใจในการรักษาให้หน่อยนะคะ วันนี้ต้องขอโทษพี่พนักงานที่ต้องรับเรื่องนี้เอง เพราะส่วนตัวไม่รู้ว่าใครที่จะรับเรื่องนี้ไว้ เข้าใจพี่ๆ พนักงานว่าไม่ได้มีอำนาจตัดสินใจคะ พี่เขาออกหน้าขอโทษแทนแล้ว รับไว้ค่ะ แต่รู้สึกไม่พอใจค่ะ อยากได้คำอธิบายจากคนมีอำนาจตัดสินใจ ขออนุญาตรีวิวตามข้อเท็จจริงนะคะ
0x30e29fb38973cb57_0x8a6002b87d4a2dde.en: The treatment experience was very disappointing. 1. There was no treatment plan or explanation of what would be done. All I knew was that the braces would be adjusted. Before the appointment, I was informed that I had a wisdom tooth that needed to be extracted. The doctor said it could be removed gradually during orthodontic treatment. Now, 4 months have passed, and I've only been informed about brace adjustments. Today, I came in to ask about the treatment plan and when the wisdom tooth would be removed. Today, I received an answer, but they only reviewed the treatment chart and said it could be removed immediately. They said that if left for too long, some cases might develop pus, and it would be difficult to remove if the orthodontic treatment takes longer. My question is: #Why wasn't there an appointment, an announcement, a notification, or a check of the tooth beforehand? They just changed the braces and said it was finished. What I want to say is: 1. I have my own work schedule and timetable. I don't work only during certain hours. I prioritize the clinic's convenience and can schedule appointments. 2. The treatment plan should be clearly explained, not made to the client have to ask. Clients should feel comfortable with the treatment. Situation 2: Today, I had an appointment with the doctor to have a tooth extracted, so I thought, since I'm already angry, I might as well get it done. During the treatment, I was asked, "Which tooth will be extracted?" My question is: Where did the initial dental scan and treatment plan go? I was asked which tooth I wanted extracted (I tried to understand that it might have been a way to strike up a conversation and help me relax), but you have to understand that this is my #firsttimeorthodontictreatment. I'm not a dentist, I don't know the procedures or steps involved. I pay the full amount for your services every time, but I'm extremely dissatisfied with this kind of service. We trusted you and used your services. Please increase our confidence and trust in the treatment you provide. I apologize to the staff member who had to handle this matter today, as I didn't know who was supposed to handle it. I understand that the staff member didn't have the authority to make the decision. They apologized on my behalf, but I'm still unhappy. I want an explanation from someone with the authority to decide. This review is based on the facts.

0x310297e79fbe2b0b_0x157b17ad6e8e581b.text: On October 9th, 2019, my boyfriend went to get a medical certificate. The officer asked what type of driver's license he was applying for. 0x30e29fd1f0b7d2ad_0x3d6adc63668717f0.text: Initially, after reading the reviews for this clinic (there was only one review), I wasn't keen on going here. So I went to the clinic across the street, but the doctor and staff there weren't very good. I had an 11 am appointment, arrived 30 minutes early, and only saw the doctor at 11:30 am. I was even skipped in line! They did an X-ray of my root canal and then explained a lot about the costs. I asked for the X-ray film to take back to Max Dental the next day. It turned out that Dr. Phadet, a specialist in root canal treatment, facial structure, jaw, and nerve disorders related to the tooth roots (Maxilofacial Surgery), is an excellent doctor. My condition: Last year, my lower molar cracked and needed a filling. However, the filling was too large, allowing infection to damage the root. Now, the root behind it is damaged and dry. Currently, two of my front roots are inflamed and infected with pus, caused by the poorly done filling – instead of treating the root canal first, they filled it, leading to the infection. Max Dental's treatment: X-ray analysis of the root canal. Looking at the X-ray, the front tooth root appeared black. The doctor said there was a 50:50 chance of extraction, but after examining the actual tooth, the chances became 70:30 – a possibility of successful treatment without extraction (I was so happy because this is my first time having root canal treatment and I didn't want to lose my molar). Comment: After reviewing the X-ray, the doctor explained how it happened. After examining the actual tooth and analyzing the damage, he explained the treatment options very clearly. He even mentioned that if there was a worst-case scenario involving extraction, I shouldn't worry because they had done their best. Furthermore, the cost of the root canal treatment today can be claimed for a prosthetic or crown later, which I think is very fair. I'm glad I met a truly skilled doctor, not just a commercialist. As Confucius said, "Doctors who talk a lot are for business; those who don't talk much are for genuine and thorough treatment." This clinic has been open for 10 years, which speaks to their skill, and we shouldn't trust Google Maps reviews too much. If you have problems with tooth roots or molars, I can confirm this clinic is excellent.

0x30e29fd1f0b7d2ad_0x3d6adc63668717f0.text: If you’re a foreigner, please by all cost avoid this place. I came in for a tooth cleaning and filling, I spoke to the receptionist and she told me the price, I’ve been told in Thailand to always confirm the price before any sales or procedures. It was the day of my appointment, I went into the doctor’s treatment room. His name is DR Padete, tall and slim man. I could tell from his demeanor that he doesn’t like Farangs, but I proceeded as I was in pain as I needed a tooth cleaning and filling. We sat down and he showed me my X-ray, he proceeded to telling me that I needed a root canal in which I didn’t need. I told him, it’s not the first time I’ve ever been to the dentists, he continued to say I needed 4 visits in which I replied … the issue I have does not require 4 visits… I told him, I’m from the UK, when we go to the dentists, they will explain to you that we will clean your teeth then provide you with a filling that will last 6 months, you don’t need to come back. I believe this doctor tells patients this in order to extort them. So I explained to him, what I need doesn’t need 4 visits… so after many debates, he proceeded with the treatment. During the treatment, he gave me Anaesthesia, while waiting for it to kick him, I told him it hasn’t kicked in yet, I could still feel my teeth. He ignored me and said we needed to do the treatment now. Being on the table, I submitted to him saying he had to start now. As he started I could still feel pain when he drilled into my teeth, I told him to stop please. What then came out of his mouth really surprised me as him being a doctor he said “if you want me to stop the treatment, you can leave” whilst in the middle of him drilling my tooth, and I could feel pain, I then told him… sir I’m not a Dog, or even a Dog is treated better than this, is it because I’m black?! His two assistance then proceed to laugh at me being in pain. He proceeded with the treatment while he administered another anaesthesia into my gum. Finally the treatment was done. I could feel how rough he was with my teeth and how badly he’s treated me. As I processed what just happened, I continued to get myself ready to go… he never said anything to me after as to what I needed to do next, no information as to please don’t eat, until a certain time. So I exited the surgery room and went to the reception in which the reception lady tried to extort me and say the procedure was 3000 when initially I opted for the 800-1000 treatment. I paid for the treatment after going back and forth as he saw that I was complaining to the English fella and his Thai girlfriend sitting waiting for their treatment. They saw and understood my concerns after explain everything to them despite still being under the influence of anaesthesia… the hole is still in my tooth as he didn’t fill it in. I came for that specific purpose but he didn’t do complete his task. Please avoid this place at all cost if you’re a foreigner, especially if you’re BLACK. Thank you for reading.

0x3102b70061b1b847_0xf03017387d4a85a7.text: It's just so expensive. And am I the only one who feels like it's some kind of spiritual sales scam? They said some pretty harsh things to me at my first consultation, and all the treatments are extremely expensive. On top of that, I don't even get 70% of the cost reimbursed from my Japanese company's social insurance. Because it's way too expensive compared to 70% of the going rate in Japan, my out-of-pocket expenses are so high that it's really tough. The only thing I sense is an aura that says, "They have interpreters and Japanese staff on-site, selling peace of mind. If you don't like it, you can just get treatment elsewhere." It's a scary atmosphere. I don't really feel like I'm safe now that I've started treatment at the hospital. I'm trembling at the thought of how much they'll charge me next time. And it's not just the cold and strong air in the examination room that's making me tremble. I'm in trouble. If I don't get treated, it's going to be a big problem. But a month's salary would be gone in an instant. So I'll have to wait until I get treatment in Japan. When I showed it to a Thai friend of mine, she said, "If it were me, I wouldn't get treatment. I'd just put up with it." If it's just a tooth extraction, I'll go to a local dentist. There are a lot of mothers with children, and even though it's expensive, they keep quiet and pay, using their children's treatment as a hostage, so perhaps the prices end up getting even more expensive? Sorry for being so harsh.
0x3102b70061b1b847_0xf03017387d4a85a7.author: MITZ

0x3102b70061b1b847_0xf03017387d4a85a7.text: As others have mentioned, it's simply expensive! And unlike in Japan, they explain the approximate cost of treatment... They start by telling you the minimum amount (cheap), but on the day it actually costs more than that. Also, every time they message me saying that their previous appointment was canceled, so if I'd like to come earlier... I'm worried about how they manage it. The cost of root canal treatment for my back teeth is higher than the cost of implants I got at another local dentist! If that was the case, I would have chosen implants!
