0x31029520929ffef7_0x6e0842d6b795ec24.author: kanitta tuanjantuk

0x3102957fd4481039_0xe655412247e908f9.text: If you're looking for health insurance that's easy to claim and doesn't require upfront payment, I recommend Pacific Cross Health Insurance. You can call their Pattaya branch for inquiries. Their staff are friendly and provide excellent advice.
0x3102957fd4481039_0xe655412247e908f9.author: Ammy Lovely

0x3102957fd4481039_0xe655412247e908f9.text: I called to inquire about health insurance, and the staff at the branch provided very clear information and explanations. The branch is also conveniently located on Sukhumvit Road just before North Pattaya, and easily visible.
0x3102957fd4481039_0xe655412247e908f9.author: TheBeeryers

0x3102957fd4481039_0xe655412247e908f9.text: I'd like to share my review of Pacific Cross insurance; maybe it will help someone avoid making the same mistake I did. They market themselves as a company where you can just show up at the hospital and get treatment cashless. In other words, they'll pay for everything upfront (the hospital staff will send you the documents, etc.), like with Tinkoff Insurance, for example. But in reality, they simply won't respond until late in the evening, after you've already paid for everything. Coincidentally, I was waiting for the ultrasound department to open, so I had no choice but to sit and wait. After five hours at the hospital, I still hadn't received a response. It wasn't until 5 PM that evening that I received a reply. The text message informing me that the documents had been received and they were reviewing my case arrived at 10:23 AM. I find this type of scam unacceptable.
0x3102957fd4481039_0xe655412247e908f9.author: Darya S

0x30e29ed18065364f_0xf9a209e977231e40.text: ตอนแรกดูจากรีวิวแล้วตัดสินใจไม่ถูกเลยว่าจะไปต่อหรือไม่ สุดท้ายก็ตัดสินใจมาหาทันตแพทย์ที่นี่ ลงทะเบียนครั้งแรกผ่านไปด้วยดี เจ้าหน้าที่บริการดี พูดจาดี โดยส่วนใหญ่คือดี ราคาก็ดี พื้นที่ใหญ่พอสมควร คงมีหลายแผนก มีศูนย์อาหารด้วยราคาไม่แพงแต่ไม่ค่อยอร่อยมตามราคาก็รับได้ค่ะ
0x30e29ed18065364f_0xf9a209e977231e40.en: Initially, after reading the reviews, I was undecided whether to continue or not. Finally, I decided to come to this dental clinic. My first registration went well. The staff were friendly and polite. Overall, the service was good. The prices were also good. The clinic is quite large, likely with many departments. There's also a food court with inexpensive food, although the taste wasn't great, but acceptable considering the price.

0x30e29ed18065364f_0xf9a209e977231e40.text: ภรรยาปวดเหงือกอักเสบกระทันหัน ตัดสินใจหาทันตแพทย์แบบกระทันหัน ตอนวันเสาร์ ประทับใจในสถานที่ และบริการมาก
0x30e29ed18065364f_0xf9a209e977231e40.en: My wife suddenly experienced gum inflammation, so we decided to see a dentist on short notice, on a Saturday. We were very impressed with the facility and the service.

0x30e29ed18065364f_0xf9a209e977231e40.text: คุณหมอและพยาบาลดีค่ะ ตลอดจนเจ้าหน้าที่เคาน์เตอร์ทุกคนดีค่ะ เว้นแต่คุณหมอกับผู้ช่วยพยาบาลชอบคุยเรื่องส่วนตัวกันระหว่างรักษาค่ะ ไม่ทราบว่าช่วยคลายเครียดหรือเปล่า หรือเพื่อสร้างสัมพันธ์ระหว่างกัน แต่คนไข้ไม่อยากฟังน่ะค่ะ ที่จอดรถน้อย อาจต้องไปจอดที่สยาม เรื่องอื่นดีหมดค่ะ
0x30e29ed18065364f_0xf9a209e977231e40.en: The doctors and nurses are good, as are all the counter staff. Except for the doctor and the nursing assistant who liked to talk about personal things during treatment. I don't know if it helps relieve stress or to build rapport, but patients don't want to listen. Parking is limited; you might have to park at Siam. Everything else was great.

0x30e29ed18065364f_0xf9a209e977231e40.text: มาใช้บริการคลินิกพิเศษ รีโนเวทแล้วสบายตาขึ้นเยอะ ราคาดี พนงโอเค คุณหมอน่ารัก แต่ห้องน้ำปย่มากเลย เพศนึงเข้าได้แยกชั้น ลุงป้าแก่ๆต้องมาคอยรอลิฟต์
0x30e29ed18065364f_0xf9a209e977231e40.en: I visited the newly renovated VIP clinic; it's much more visually appealing now. The prices are good, the staff is okay, and the doctor is lovely. However, the restrooms are terrible. They have separate floors for each gender, and elderly people have to wait for the elevator.

0x30e29ed18065364f_0xf9a209e977231e40.text: ปกติรักษารากฟันที่นี่รู้สึกคุ้มค่าที่จะจ่ายตัง(ไม่ได้ใช้สิทธิใด) จึงทำนัดครอบฟันที่นี้ด้วย(กับหมอเกศินี) แต่วันนี้มาด้วยการอุดฟันรู้สึกไม่ประทับใจ(หมออีกคน) เหมือนมาทำฟรี หมอฟันทำแรงมากหลายครั้ง(ดันสำลี) ไม่มีการพูดแนะนำ หรือขอความร่วมมือว่าหมอต้องการอะไร อาจจะไม่ไปอีกแล้ว (12/07/68) แก้ไขเพิ่มเติมวันที่ (13/07/68) ทั้งรักษารากฟัน และอุดฟันทำที่คลินิกพิเศษทันตจุฬา หมอเฉพาะทาง ล่าสุดวัสดุอุดฟันน่าจะหลุดมีกลิ่น ตอนนี้กำลังรอทางคลินิกตอบกลับว่าสามารถทำอย่างไรได้บ้าง
0x30e29ed18065364f_0xf9a209e977231e40.en: I usually get root canal treatments here and feel it's worth the money (I'm not using any insurance). I also had an appointment for a crown here (with Dr. Kesinee). But today, I came for a filling and was very unimpressed (with a different dentist). It felt like I was getting it done for free. The dentist was very rough and pushed the cotton swab many times. There was no explanation or request for cooperation about what the dentist needed. I probably won't go back again. (12/07/68) Updated (13/07/68): Both the root canal treatment and the filling were done at the Chulalongkorn Dental Specialty Clinic with a specialist. Recently, the filling seems to have come loose and is smelling. I'm currently waiting for a response from the clinic about what can be done.

0x30e29ed18065364f_0xf9a209e977231e40.text: เวลาเข้ามาทำฟันไม่ว่าจะมาตรงเวลาหรือมาสายก็ต้องใช้เวลารอคิว1ชมหรือมากกว่าในทุกๆครั้ง ไม่แน่ใจว่ามีการลงคิวเยอะเกินกว่าความสามารถในการให้บริการหรือไม่ บางครั้งมีคิวก่อนหน้ามาสายแต่ก็ให้บริการคิวก่อนหน้าก่อนอยู่ดี การบริหารจัดการเวลาย่ำแย่ แม้ราคาก็ไม่ได้ถูกกว่าหรือต่างจากคลินิกเอกชนทั่วไปมาก ส่วนการรักษาคุณหมอดูไม่ได้ใส่ใจเท่าที่ควรแม้เป็นคลินิกของจุฬาเอง คนไข้มีสิทธิในการแก้ไขแผนการรักษาจัดฟันและราคาค่ารักษาเป็นหลักแสน แต่คุณหมอดูไม่เต็มใจในการช่วยให้คำปรึกษาหรือแก้ไขแผนจัดฟันให้ ค่าเสียเวลาที่มานั่งรอคิวในทุกๆครั้งไม่คุ้มกับราคาที่ถูกกว่าคลินิกเอกชนอื่นแค่ไม่กี่บาท ผิดหวังมาก ถ้าไม่พร้อมให้บริการในจำนวนเยอะๆก็แนะนำว่าอย่ารับคิวค่ะ คนไข้มารอเป็นหลายชมในทุกๆวัน
0x30e29ed18065364f_0xf9a209e977231e40.en: Every time I come for dental treatment, whether I arrive on time or late, I have to wait in line for an hour or more. I'm not sure if the number of patients on the waiting list exceeds their capacity. Sometimes, people ahead of me who arrive late are served first. Time management is terrible. The prices aren't significantly cheaper or different from other private clinics. The doctor doesn't seem to be attentive enough, even though it's a Chulalongkorn University clinic. Patients have the right to modify their orthodontic treatment plan, and the treatment costs hundreds of thousands of baht, but the doctor seems unwilling to provide consultation or adjust the treatment plan. The time wasted waiting in line every time is not worth the slightly lower price compared to other private clinics. I'm very disappointed. If you can't handle a large number of patients, you shouldn't accept appointments at all. Patients wait for hours every day.

0x30e29ed18065364f_0xf9a209e977231e40.text: ญาติปวดฟันแถวฟันครุฑ เจ้าหน้าที่ก็นัดให้มาหาหมอฟันตรวจฟันรวมๆก่อนและ x-ray แล้วก็ส่งไปหาหมอที่จะผ่าฟันครุฑ พอเสร็จนึกว่าจบดี มาตัดไหมออกหมอก็ไม่พูดไร จนตัดเสร็จผ่านไปสองอาทิตย์ ปรากฏปวดฟัน ไปตรวจเจอว่าฟันที่อยู่ติดกับฟันครุฑที่ผ่าออกไปนั้นแตก รากเป็นโพรงแล้ว ญาติเลยไปหาหมอที่คลินิคข้างนอก อาทิตย์ถัดมาก็บอกว่ารากฟันเสียแล้วต้องถอน อยากรู้จริงๆว่าเป็นก่อนหคือหลังผ่าฟันครุฑ ถ้าเป็นก่อนทำไมหมอไม่เห็นไม่พูด ถ้าเป็นหลังก็เพราะผ่าฟันครุฑแล้วไปกระทบ แล้วก็เฉยๆ ไม่บอกไม่กล่าว แย่จริงๆ
0x30e29ed18065364f_0xf9a209e977231e40.en: My relative had a toothache near their wisdom tooth. The staff scheduled a general check-up and X-ray, then referred them to a dentist for wisdom tooth extraction. They thought everything was fine, but when the stitches were removed, the dentist didn't say anything. Two weeks later, the tooth arose with pain. A subsequent examination revealed the adjacent tooth was cracked with a cavity at the root. My relative went to an outside clinic, and the following week was informed that the root was damaged and needed extraction. I'm really curious whether this was before or after the wisdom tooth extraction. If it was before, why didn't the dentist mention it? If it was after, the extraction must have affected the root, and then they just remained silent. This is truly unacceptable.

0x30e29ed18065364f_0xf9a209e977231e40.text: เมื่อวันที่ 24 สิงหาคม 2024 เวลา 09.32น-10.20น คนไข้มีความประสงค์เลื่อนนัดหมายภายในปี 2024 แต่เจ้าหน้าที่เลื่อนนัดบน LINE แจ้งว่ามีตารางนัดเร็วสุดเดือนมีนาคม 2025 คนไข้จึงโทรไปเลื่อนนัดหมายแทน และได้นัดเดือนพฤศจิกายน 2024 เจ้าหน้าที่เลื่อนนัดบน LINE ทำงาานไม่มีประสิทธิภาพ ควรปรับปรุง
0x30e29ed18065364f_0xf9a209e977231e40.en: On August 24, 2024, between 9:32 AM and 10:20 AM, the patient wished to reschedule an appointment to within 2024. However, the appointment rescheduling staff via LINE informed them that the earliest available appointment was in March 2025. The patient then called to reschedule instead and secured an appointment for November 2024. The appointment rescheduling staff via LINE were inefficient and should be improved.

0x30e29fd1eccfe2e7_0xe4f25d7bb3a997be.text: The staff are cheerful and give good advice. The doctor is friendly and the price is friendly. I recommend it.
0x30e29fd1eccfe2e7_0xe4f25d7bb3a997be.author: Arnon

0x30e29fd1eccfe2e7_0xe4f25d7bb3a997be.text: I got lip fillers here. The doctor was very gentle and sculpted the lips beautifully. Highly recommend! :‘)

0x30e29fd1eccfe2e7_0xe4f25d7bb3a997be.text: The store at Central World has closed. I tried calling to schedule an appointment for the treatments I purchased, but no one answered. I also tried the Thonglor and Nonthaburi branches, but no one answered either. I called the Central World call center and found out the store was closed. Where can I use the remaining treatments I purchased? Does anyone know? Please tell me.

0x3102b701ecada8b3_0x29a6de0d3be0fa0d.text: My girlfriend went to get a filling/dental treatment. The dentist said it could be filled, so she agreed. The dentist then cut into her gums. After a while, they said it needed to be extracted and took her for a new X-ray. Shouldn't the X-ray have been done from the start, and the patient informed about the procedure, including the possibility of extraction, so they could make an informed decision? Instead, they cut into her gums first. Once the dentist said it needed to be extracted, she had no choice but to accept it. My girlfriend saw the dentist from around 5 PM until almost 8 PM. She came out with pain, swelling, and a torn mouth. She had to keep her mouth open for 3 hours. General dentists usually don't recommend extraction if the root is still strong and the tooth isn't decayed. This is incredibly strange but true. I'm giving it 1 star. I really didn't want to give any stars if this is how a clinic operates.

When we talked about the previous course before purchasing, I asked for the same one, but they wouldn't sell it to me. They just kept pushing me to get a more invasive, more expensive, less effective course. The doctor also changed. The last time I met them, they were gossiping about customers. I'm very disappointed. 0x30e29f78a5a8f0bd_0xd507e7ee827528da.text: This clinic's waiting list is so long, you'll be waiting forever! I waited about an hour and still didn't get treated, so I decided to give up. I was so tired! Last time I waited an hour and didn't get treated. This time I waited 2-3 hours and still didn't get treated! I arrived around noon. The staff said it was busy and suggested I go eat. I walked around until I was exhausted and came back at 4 pm. I was still thinking about waiting, but after thinking about it, I didn't want to wait anymore. I was too tired. The staff called to check on me, but I was too lazy to go back. Why do people have to wait this long? I've never bought a treatment package at a clinic where I had to wait this long before. If you see this post, I recommend you don't buy a treatment package. The promotions are good, but if the wait is this long, I'd rather buy from another clinic where I can schedule an appointment. I've waited no more than 5-15 minutes before getting treated. The management system here is terrible. The staff don't care about customer service; they're only interested in selling treatment packages. Probably because their income comes from selling packages, not from service. It's so different from other places. Just walking in, you're served water. Every staff member who passes by says "please wait a moment" and smiles. But I didn't wait long at all because I had an appointment. The difference is huge. I regret spending my money so much! I'm going to cry for a bit... TOT

0x30e29f1811b9821f_0xd67e6f09f61bed95.text: Extremely disappointed with the reception service at this clinic. I called to reschedule my appointment because I wasn’t available on the original date. Since it was only a routine check-up that would take around 15–20 minutes, I asked if I could move it to an earlier date. The first receptionist told me that wasn’t possible and said the next available appointment would be almost two months later. I accepted it, although I found it surprising. Later, I called again and spoke to a different receptionist, who immediately told me that an earlier appointment was available. Naturally, I asked why I had been told the opposite before. Her response, in a rude tone, was simply, “It was a different receptionist.” What does that even mean? Are patients supposed to receive different answers depending on who picks up the phone? It suggests either inconsistent training or poor communication between staff, neither of which is acceptable. To make matters worse, shortly after I hung up, the original receptionist called me back sounding upset and claimed she had never been informed that I wanted to move my appointment to an earlier date. That explanation makes no sense—the entire purpose of my call was to ask whether I could reschedule to an earlier date. What frustrated me most was that, instead of acknowledging the misunderstanding or admitting that she may have made a mistake, she chose to make what sounded like an unreasonable excuse to avoid taking responsibility. A simple apology or explanation would have been far more professional than trying to shift the blame. The lack of consistency, poor internal communication, and unprofessional attitude made what should have been a simple appointment change unnecessarily frustrating. I hope the clinic improves the training, communication, and professionalism of its reception staff so future patients don’t have to go through the same experience.
0x30e29f1811b9821f_0xd67e6f09f61bed95.author: Nathan P

0x30e29f1811b9821f_0xd67e6f09f61bed95.text: คุณหมอต้องเลือกถูกคนถึงจะรักษาดี มีเคสไปเพราะเสียวฟันมากมั่นใจว่าผุแต่หมอบอกว่าฟันดีไม่ผุเลยหมอไม่ทำอะไรนอกจากขูดหินปูน ไม่บอกให้x-ray ด้วย ปรากฎว่าเช็คฟันอีกครั้งตรงรอบ x-ray ผลออกมามีฟันผุร่องฟัน เกิน 5จุด บางจุดจะถึงเส้นประสาทแล้วเลยต้องส่งหมอเฉพาะทาง และยังโทษว่าเราปล่อยไว้นานเกินทั้งที่เราเคยบอกแล้ว ยังดีผลสุดท้ายหมอเฉพาะทางอีกท่านวินิฉัยว่าไม่ต้องรักษารากฟัน พนักงานด้านหน้าแย่มาก เหมือนเราไปรับบริการฟรี ทั้งที่ที่นี่ราคาค่อนข้างสูงกว่าทั่วไป การจองนัดคิวยาวมากอันนี้รอได้เพราะเลือกเอง แต่ที่เคยเจออย่างดีสุดคือจองมาครึ่งปีแล้วแคลเซิลก่อน 1 วัน อย่างแย่คือแคนเซิล1ชั่วโมงก่อนเวลาจริง ถ้าครั้งสองครั้งยังพอคิดว่าเหตุสุดวิสัย นี่เจอมา 4 ครั้งแล้วที่แจ้งกระชั้นแบบนี้ และพอจะนัดแก้คือไม่ต่ำกว่า1เดือน ถึงจะบอกว่าฟันที่ทำไปครั้งที่แล้วมีปัญหาในการใช้งานมากก็ไม่เห็นความเดือดร้อนของคนไข้ รีวิวนี้ไม่ได้จะให้ทางคลีนิคแก้อะไรเพราะคงไม่แก้ แต่อยากให้ข้อมูลผู้ที่กำลังตัดสินใจ หมอต้องเลือกคนให้ถูกถึงจะดี บริการเหมือนรพ.รัฐ ราคาสูงกว่าทั่วไป
0x30e29f1811b9821f_0xd67e6f09f61bed95.author: Rachelle Wong
0x30e29f1811b9821f_0xd67e6f09f61bed95.en: Choosing the right dentist is crucial for effective treatment. I went to this clinic because of severe tooth sensitivity and certain decay, but the dentist said my tooth was fine and only did a scaling. They didn't even recommend an X-ray. Upon further examination, the X-ray revealed more than five cavities, some nearing the nerve, requiring referral to a specialist. The dentist even blamed me for delaying treatment, despite my prior warnings. Fortunately, the specialist diagnosed root canal treatment as unnecessary. The front desk staff were terrible, treating me like I was receiving free service despite the clinic's relatively high prices. The waiting list is extremely long. While I can tolerate this as I chose the clinic, the worst I've experienced is a cancellation half a year in advance, or an hour before the scheduled time. While this has happened four times before, with such short notice, it's unacceptable. Appointments for corrective treatment often take at least a month to process. Even after explaining the previous issues, the dentist shows no empathy for the patient's inconvenience. This review isn't meant to pressure the clinic into making changes, as they likely won't, but rather to provide information for those considering a clinic. Choosing the right dentist is essential for successful treatment. The services are similar to a government hospital. The prices are higher than average.

0x30e29f1811b9821f_0xd67e6f09f61bed95.text: หน้าเคาน์เตอร์พูดจาไม่น่ารักเลยค่ะ ทำงานบริการ แต่หน้าตาเหมือนโดนบังคับมานั่งเฝ้า เวลาที่ต้องโทรนัดก็เลื่อนบ่อยมาก บางครั้งถึงขั้นยกเลิกภายในไม่กี่วันก่อนที่ต้องไป ทำให้เสียเวลาเตรียมตัว ระบบคิวก็ล่าช้าตลอด ไม่เคยตรงเวลาเลยค่ะ ไปก็เผื่อเวลาไว้แล้วนะคะ แต่กลับต้องเสียเวลานั่งรออยู่ดี แถมตอนคิดเงินก็ช้าสุดๆ เคยรอเป็นชั่วโมง เรียกว่าเหมาะกับคนมีเวลาว่างเหลือเฟือเท่านั้นจริงๆ ค่ะ ชอบทำสีหน้าตึงใส่ลูกค้าเวลาเข้ามาสอบถามโดยเฉพาะกับราคาที่ต้องจ่ายไปซึ่งก็ไม่ใช่น้อย ๆแถมบางครั้งการพูดยังทำให้ต้องหันไปมองเพื่อนร่วมงานเหมือนมีอาการเหยียด แบบนี้เรียกว่าการบริการที่เหมาะสมหรอคะ ทั้งที่ลูกค้าก็ถามกันด้วยมารยาทดีๆ การตอบกลับด้วยน้ำเสียงและท่าทีที่ดีก็ไม่ใช่เรื่องยากเลยค่ะ จากรีวิวที่อ่านมา เข้าใจแล้วว่าไม่ใช่ปัญหาของเราคนเดียว แต่ถ้าจะปรับปรุงอะไรก่อน ขอให้เริ่มจากพนักงานก่อนนะคะ ทำงานไม่ต้องจิกตาลูกค้าตลอดนะคะ แบบนี้ทำให้บรรยากาศแย่และลูกค้ากลัวหมดค่ะ อ่านรีวิวแล้วเอาไปปรับปรุงบ้างนะคะ จากคะแนน 2.6 ดาว ถ้ามีการปรับปรุง จะดีขึ้นแน่นอนค่ะ
0x30e29f1811b9821f_0xd67e6f09f61bed95.author: Ba Be
0x30e29f1811b9821f_0xd67e6f09f61bed95.en: The staff at the counter were very unpleasant. They work in customer service, but their expressions were like they were forced to sit there. Appointments were frequently rescheduled, sometimes even canceled just days before the scheduled date, wasting valuable preparation time. The queuing system was constantly delayed and never on time. Even with ample time allocated, we still wasted time waiting. The checkout process was incredibly slow; I once waited for an hour. It's truly only suitable for people with plenty of free time. They often give customers stern looks, especially regarding pricing, which isn't cheap. Sometimes their tone is so condescending that they make you glare at their colleagues. Is this what you call appropriate customer service? Customers are asking politely, and a polite response with a pleasant tone and demeanor isn't difficult. From the reviews I've read, I understand this isn't just my problem, but if you're going to improve anything, please start with the staff. There's no need to constantly glare at customers; it creates a negative atmosphere and intimidates customers. Please read the reviews and make improvements. From a 2.6-star rating, improvements would definitely make things better.

0x30e29f1811b9821f_0xd67e6f09f61bed95.text: วันนี้โทรหาคลินิค เพื่อจะสอบถามเวลาที่นัดให้ชัวร์ A : สอบถามวันและเวลาคุณหมอจัดฟัน ว่ามีนัดเมื่อไหร่เวลาไหน B : ไม่มีค่ะ A : งง ไปสักพัก และถามเพิ่มว่าไม่มีที่นัดไว้เลยหรอคะ แล้วมีคิวคุณหมอว่างวันไหนอีกคะ (ถามเพื่อไว้ เพราะไม่ชอบถามบ่อย) B : แจ้งวันที่และเวลาที่คุณหมอสะดวก A : โอเคค่ะ เดี๋ยวติดต่อกลับ A : หาข้อมูลละ ว่ามีนัดวัน ... จริงๆ เลยติดต่อกลับไปอีกครั้งเพื่อ Confirm ว่าสรุปแล้วมีหรือไม่มีจริงๆนัดที่จะถึง เลยแจ้งกับพนักงานไป คุยไปคุยมา B : อ๋อ มีนัดอีกทีเดือน พ.ค. ค่ะ A : งงหนักกว่าเดิม สรุปอะไรกันคะ เราเลยย้ำกับพนักงานอีกรอบว่าของวันที่....นี้นะคะ B : อ๋อ ขอโทษค่ะ เป็นวันนี้เวลานี้ค่ะ A : ค่ะ ขอบคุณค่ะ (วางสาย) ผ่านไป 3 นาที มีสายเข้า B : ขอโทษนะคะ พอดีคุณหมอนัดวันที่ .... แทนค่ะ พอดีคุณหมอไม่เข้าวัน... A : เริ่มไม่โอเคละ เลยถามว่าสรุปยังไงแน่ วันไหนกันแน่เอาให้ชัวร์ B : ขอโทษค่ะ พอดีคอมมันรวน !! A : ถึงกับห่ะ !! ออกมา เป็น งง มาก โทษคอม ยกเว้นจะโทษตัวเองจ๊ะ
0x30e29f1811b9821f_0xd67e6f09f61bed95.author: Manow Secretary_SPW
0x30e29f1811b9821f_0xd67e6f09f61bed95.en: Today, I called the clinic to confirm my appointment time. A: I asked about the orthodontist's available dates and times. B: We don't have any appointments. A: I was confused for a moment and asked if there were really no appointments scheduled, and if the doctor had any other available dates. (I asked this just in case, because I don't like asking too often.) B: I informed them of the dates and times the doctor was available. A: Okay, I'll call you back. A: I looked up the information and confirmed that there really was an appointment on... so I called again to confirm whether there was an appointment or not. I told the staff about it. After some back and forth, B: Oh, the next appointment is in May. A: I was even more confused. What's going on? I emphasized to the staff again that I wanted an appointment on... B: Oh, I'm sorry. It's today at this time. A: Okay, thank you. (I hung up.) Three minutes later, I received a call. B: I'm sorry, but the doctor has an appointment scheduled for... instead. The doctor isn't available on... A: I was starting to get annoyed, so I asked what the real situation was. What day is it exactly? Be sure. B: Sorry, my computer is acting up!! A: Completely bewildered!! Blaming the computer, unless you are blaming yourself, huh?

0x30e2bf826a65ab19_0xcaec36cfcd6653a4.text: I would like to complain about the traffic light control on Phutthasakhon Road, before the entrance to Wat Nong Pha Ong. I would like the lights to be set to an automatic on/off timer, instead of having police officers manually pressing the buttons. Manually pressing the buttons actually causes more traffic congestion. I have used this route from Highway 4 for at least 10 years and have observed that the traffic flow on the straight stretch is very limited. Initially, it wasn't too bad, but it has gotten worse every day. Only 10-20 cars are allowed through at a time, leaving a long traffic jam of 50-100 cars almost reaching the U-turn. Please consider finding a solution. This road is a straight 4-lane road and traffic flow is actually very easy if the traffic flow is managed appropriately. #From a citizen with constructive criticism. Thank you 🙏

0x30e2bf826a65ab19_0xcaec36cfcd6653a4.text: I have the utmost respect for traffic police officers, but I am uncomfortable with the performance of some patrol officers. Even though the government provides them with salaries and benefits, I have observed instances of unfair arrests of innocent foreigners and the demand for bribes. Furthermore, when patrol officers make arrests and escort individuals to a checkpoint (under a tree), an elderly Thai-Myanmar interpreter is present. However, the interpreter's communication is often unclear, and their impolite behavior causes inconvenience and dissatisfaction for those being investigated. Such actions could negatively impact the country's image and public trust in the legal system. Therefore, I respectfully request that superiors investigate and take appropriate action. Thank you very much.

0x30e285007fb62737_0xd38c4a6ea4423ac.text: I booked a promotion through Facebook and paid the full price. The admin explained that the price I paid included everything. Upon arrival at the clinic, the receptionist was welcoming, but explained that the price on Facebook was just a promotional price to attract customers. Customers who bought through Facebook weren't considered in-store customers; they needed to purchase a course in-store to become members. The Facebook promotion was also made to look like a great deal for sales purposes (I wondered why they would say that). The staff aggressively tried to sell courses (extremely aggressive). I told them I just wanted to try a course today and would buy one if it was good. There were two of us, and we agreed to add a treatment and paid beforehand. Once inside the treatment room, they continued to push more courses, explaining endlessly and wasting a lot of my time. The staff waiting to serve treatments were also delayed. Normally, payment should be made at the counter before the service; this is very rare. Usually, payment is made after the treatment is finished. (It felt like they were afraid I wouldn't pay or would change my mind.) The clinic's products and services are good, but they need more training for their staff in sales. It made me feel like I wouldn't want to return. I have one more treatment scheduled, but I'll probably only go back once. :(

0x30e29ef562923039_0x47d1fdba6ab4cd1c.text: I am a patient at Dr. Saim's Clinic. I started treatment because of an allergic rash that I had never had before. I had previously gone to a traditional Chinese medicine practitioner who said my kidneys weren't functioning properly. I spent several months and tens of thousands of baht on Chinese medicine, and my condition only slightly improved. Then I learned about Gua Sha and Dr. Saim's Clinic from Pantip (a Thai online forum) and old videos of Dr. Saim appearing on TV. I decided to try Gua Sha with Dr. Saim, initially just wanting to cure the rash. The results have been amazing; my internal systems have become stronger, my overall health has improved, and I still see the doctor occasionally. The treatment is the same for all patients: Gua Sha scraping at the problem areas and taking Thai medicine recommended by the doctor (you can refuse the medicine if you wish). The scraping isn't done haphazardly; the doctor scrapes the problem areas according to traditional Thai medicine principles (the level of pain depends on the individual's problem). The doctor's medicine is limited, mainly: - Laxatives: These are detoxifying agents that remove waste from the body. Their potency varies (varying from person to person). My case was very severe. Initially, I fainted, vomited, and had diarrhea all night, barely sleeping. My stool was black and very foul-smelling. After taking them continuously, the color changed to yellow. And it's odorless. - The doctor recommended taking the liquid and tablet medicines together, as a tonic and a treatment. The taste is terrible and difficult to swallow, but that's understandable because it's the natural taste of the medicine itself, without added flavors or scents. The doctor's medicine is safe because I previously bought a steroid test kit from the Ministry of Public Health and it didn't detect any steroids. Therefore, before you decide to seek treatment at Saiim Traditional Thai Medicine Clinic, you must ask yourself: 1. Are you sick and want to improve your health? 2. Based on what you've read above, do you think you can follow the doctor's treatment plan? If the answer is "yes," call to schedule an appointment with the doctor. It's painful, but it's worth it in the long run.

Insomnia Headaches, pain in the neck and shoulders, back pain, arm pain, leg pain In short, the pain spreads all the way to my feet Stomach aches, indigestion, acid reflux The first few bites of food get stuck in my throat, making it difficult to swallow Constipation, bloating, from childhood to the present Today I did Gua Sha and received medication. 0xacb7bf244b5f3911_0x6f78e398b5ca6c94.text: I've been bringing my two children here for dental care for almost a year now (spending over 20,000 RMB, because their teeth were completely decayed. I initially wanted to give them more control, but now I regret it; the cost of trial and error is too high. You really have to find a balance). I live in Sansai, which is quite far from here. I came here last year with a doctor, but ended up meeting another doctor, who is also the owner—Dr. Praew. I've also had my teeth cleaned, filled, and wisdom teeth extracted here. Everyone is very friendly, and I don't have any fear of going to the dentist. Last Saturday, I suddenly had a lot of pain in my back teeth. Since appointments are required here, I desperately went to a clinic in Sansai. They diagnosed me with root canal treatment, but there was a waiting list. I felt they weren't very professional, so I left. I called Happy Bear on a whim (because the pain was so bad I wanted immediate help). The receptionist said the appointment was for the next day. Feeling the pain was unbearable, I asked her to ask Dr. Praew what could help alleviate the pain. She said she'd check and get back to me. A little while later, I received a call from Dr. Praew, who told me to come in that afternoon so they could handle it before they closed. I was so touched. When I arrived, the doctor said the X-ray taken at the clinic that morning was too blurry and needed to be redone. Everyone was working overtime for me; it was truly heartwarming. After the X-ray, the doctor examined it and said my pulp was fine and I didn't need root canal treatment, but the periodontal pockets needed cleaning because it had been six months since the last cleaning, and the current pain might be caused by that. What would have cost over 10,000 baht was resolved for only 460 baht. It's Thursday today, and after a few days, my toothache has subsided, with only a slight swelling. Here, I felt the care of friends and the respect shown to patients. I said I didn't want anesthesia, and the doctor supported me. I said I didn't want painkillers, and the doctor prescribed a few just in case. I would recommend this dental clinic to friends living in Hangdong, but not to those living in Sansai—it's really too far. However, I come regularly, so the distance is acceptable.
0xacb7bf244b5f3911_0x6f78e398b5ca6c94.author: lin yang

0xacb7bf244b5f3911_0x6f78e398b5ca6c94.text: Chinese residents living in Hangdong, please don't come here again! We came here a few times last year, mainly because it's close to home, but we never expected this place to be such a rip-off. 1. Poor skill level. One of my teeth was hurting and needed a root canal and crown. After three root canal treatments, the crown still wouldn't fit. To put on that green waterproof membrane, they pulled hard on my other two front teeth, loosening even the healthy ones. I refused the prepaid crown fee and went to Lan Hospital for a second opinion. They took X-rays there and said the root canal wasn't thorough enough, so I had to redo it. I was devastated! 2. Overtreatment. This is truly outrageous. Last year, when I took my child for fluoride treatment, I met a Chinese family who didn't speak much English and asked for my opinion. I was shocked to learn that Happybear Clinic had put a four-year-old child under general anesthesia and performed root canal treatments on eight teeth at once! Good heavens! I've never heard of doing root canals on baby teeth! "And you want general anesthesia? With your level of expertise, are you just after money?!" I quickly told the family that if they were going back to China soon, they should go to a top-tier hospital, or the pediatric dentistry department at Lanzhou Hospital was also quite good. It's a major hospital; they wouldn't pay me to be a shill. 3. Arbitrary pricing, catering to different customers. Basically, they specifically target Chinese people. Seeing that their English isn't good, or that they're accompanying mothers with children, they fill in random items at checkout. They just want to rip off whoever they can. If they're caught, they offer some excuse, and if they can't fool them, they remove those items—they don't lose anything. The other day, my friend took her child for fluoride treatment. The agreed price was 350, but the bill came to 600. What happened? They said 350 was for four teeth, and 600 was for the whole mouth. Are you kidding me? It's not like fissure sealing; fluoride treatment isn't done one tooth at a time! My friend couldn't understand the explanation and had to slam the money on the table. The Happybear owner actually complained about the attitude and called the police! He told the police that a Chinese mother had slapped money in his face! The store has security cameras! Just check the footage, and you'll see. Then the owner stopped insisting and still charged 350 baht. Who cares about a few hundred baht? There are principles and right and wrong in this matter, okay? It's blatant ripping people off, yet they act arrogantly and threaten to call the police. If there's no security footage, or if the police are just targeting Chinese people, isn't there any justice?! Later, when we talked about it at a gathering, we all realized we'd had unpleasant experiences at Happybear, yet so many Chinese people still fall for these scams because it's close to home and convenient. Today, I can only share my and my friend's experiences here, hoping no more fellow countrymen will be cheated. Be vigilant!
0xacb7bf244b5f3911_0x6f78e398b5ca6c94.author: 刘喆

0xacb7bf244b5f3911_0x6f78e398b5ca6c94.text: I took my child to this clinic and had a very disappointing experience. 0x30e298cfe85cb605_0xda077eb2df800077.text: Skip the pricey clinic, head to BNH Hospital. We came in with temperatures and a cough, generally feeling unwell from our previous travels. Malaria, Dengue and Chikungunya tests were run which were all negative. Dr. Sumait was nice, personable and was easy to talk to but also easily distracted. We paid $601.55 for the doctor's consultation, the tests, antibiotic injections, antibiotic pills, probiotic pills, an inhaler, and cough medicine. Two days later my husband's condition worsened, a rash broke out all over and he had severe bodyache. Our Guest House recommended BNH Hospital that ran similar tests and found that he had Chikungunya. The clinic should consider using a different testing facility. I'm giving three stars for the kindest clinic staff we've ever met and the easy going nature of Dr. Sumait.

0x311d67b15ec6deff_0x3ff03542b72e6a86.text: I took my cat for a grooming appointment at 10 am. I arrived before 10 am, and the staff informed me that if a new case came in, they would have to prioritize that case and have the cat waiting. I understood this, so I left my cat with them and went home. It was past 11 am, and I hadn't received a call informing me that my cat still hadn't been groomed. My cat had been kept in a carrier for over an hour, and there was no larger cage to switch her to. The clinic was empty; there was no doctor or staff present, only one person grooming the cats. The clinic owner/doctor only came to the clinic when staff called to report a problem with an animal. The grooming staff member, who claimed to be a nurse, was giving IV fluids to another cat without the doctor present. Anyone considering bringing their cat for grooming or treatment should think carefully. There's no resident doctor, only one staff member, and it's uncertain if they'll be able to help in time if something goes wrong.

0x30e2a11a12dd8cc7_0x65c7fb536561b6ce.text: มาทำฟันที่นี้ สิทธิบัตรทอง ทำฟรีจริงคะ หมอๆไม่เก็บเงินเพิ่ม หมอใจดี ตรวจฟันและทำให้ฟรีจริง แค่เอาบัตรประชาชนตัวจริงมา พนักงานที่คลินิกพูดจาดีมาก ตอนแรกคิดว่าทำฟรี แล้วจะเหมือน รพ ทั่วไป แต่ที่นี้บริการดีมากคะ ประทับใจ มาทำที่นี้ใช้สิทธิครบ 3 ครั้ง ส่วนที่เหลือ หมอแนะนำให้ไปทำ รพ ต่อ คือ อยู่ที่เราสมัครใจจะทำต่อที่นี้ แต่ต้องรอปีงบใหม่ หรือ จะไปทำ รพ ลูกชายก็จัดฟันที่นี้ หมอปุ๋ย ใจดี พูดจาดีมากคะ ดูแลจัดฟันลูกชายจากฟันเหยิน จนฟันสวย ครบ 2 ปีกว่า ถอดเหล็กมาแล้วฟันก็ยังสวย ใช้บริการที่นี่มา 10 ปีแล้ว มาทำทั้งครอบครัว และหมอใจดี ราคายุติธรรม ไม่แพง และหมอดูแลดีมาก พอคลินิกรับทำฟันฟรีบัตรทอง ก็ฟรีจริงคะ ประทับใจ จะมาใข้บริการต่อคะ
0x30e2a11a12dd8cc7_0x65c7fb536561b6ce.author: Mona Cute
0x30e2a11a12dd8cc7_0x65c7fb536561b6ce.en: I came here for dental treatment under the government's universal healthcare scheme. It's truly free! The dentists don't charge extra. They're kind and offer free check-ups and treatment. You just need to bring your original ID card. The clinic staff are very polite. At first, I thought that because it's free, it would be like a regular hospital, but the service here is excellent. I'm very impressed. I've used my benefits three times here. For the remaining treatments, the dentist recommended going to a hospital, meaning it's up to me whether I want to continue here (but have to wait for the next fiscal year) or go to a hospital. My son also had orthodontic treatment here. Dr. Pui is very kind and speaks very well. She took care of my son's orthodontic treatment, transforming his crooked teeth into beautiful teeth. After more than two years, even after removing the braces, his teeth are still beautiful. We've been using their services for 10 years, with our whole family coming here. The dentists are kind, the prices are fair and not expensive, and the dentists provide excellent care. Since the clinic accepts the government's universal healthcare scheme for free dental treatment, it's truly free. I'm very impressed and will continue to use their services.

0x30e29eb0a13b825d_0x86863a4777da841e.text: Very unprofessional. I made an appointment. When I showed up at the allotted time, there was a backlog of four people with what looked like at least an hour wait. Everybody can fall behind schedule. I think everyone can sympathize with that. But give people the courtesy of a call so they don’t waste their time. When you don’t, it gives people the message “my time is more valuable than yours.” The following is a response to your reply (I see no option to reply otherwise). First, thanks for taking the time to reply. The fact that I was 10 minutes late in this instance simply meant I would have waited even longer given the doctor was behind schedule, hence why I didn't mention it. More to the point, my "excessive assumption" was in fact not an assumption at all. When the doctor told me a 15 minute wait and I saw the four people waiting in the room, I explicitly asked the doctor if all of these people were waiting because if so it didn't seem like it would be 15 minutes. She explicitly said yes all of these people were waiting. When I said that would clearly be more than 15 minutes she just said "I'm sorry I'm behind schedule." Assuming 15 minutes per person to estimate an hour wait time was a reasonable assumption based on what I saw and what the doctor told me, not an exaggeration. Now I take you at your word and assume good intentions that she simply didn't understand me, but it's important to note based on what I saw and what the doctor told me there was no reason to assume this would be a relatively short, 15 minute wait. Again, falling behind schedule is something we can all sympathize with. But a call to a patient, or even just a text, if you're going to be excessively late would be courteous (there was a receptionist there). If I'm going to be late or if the doctor is late give or take 10 minutes it's not a big deal. But close to half an hour is a different story. If I were going to be half an hour late I would certainly have called. I'm sure your patients would appreciate this as well if you fall behind schedule again. It was one mistake. It happens. Best of luck going forward.
0x30e29eb0a13b825d_0x86863a4777da841e.author: Adrian Baker

0x30e298eb35b044df_0xd771281715a8b5fb.text: I came to this clinic because of the sign that said "Nail Disease," but after being evaluated by a female doctor, I received inappropriate advice and treatment. The diagnosis and recommended treatment were wrong, and the medical certificate contained incorrect medication information, stating "mupirocine ointment internal medicine," which I later found to be an external cream, not an internal one. This is a serious error. I had an ingrown toenail with pus-filled blisters and a slight fungal infection. The doctor didn't even touch or examine the affected area; she just looked at it and prescribed oral and topical medication. I asked if surgery was necessary, and she said no. Upon returning home, I felt that if I left it untreated, the inflammation would worsen. I sought other clinics and eventually received proper treatment, including surgical removal of the damaged nail. I am very relieved with the outcome. I would like a refund and want to state that if you cannot treat nail diseases, you shouldn't put "Nail Disease" on the entrance, and that improving the clinic's cleanliness and maintaining a patient history database or storage system would be more appropriate.
0x30e298eb35b044df_0xd771281715a8b5fb.author: Patharawan R

0x311d7be8ffa446f5_0xd7b7af29c3e6b319.text: The service is absolutely terrible. I went ahead to my hospital appointment to get a referral letter, but they told me to come back on the scheduled date. When I arrived, they said they don't accept new patients. Why didn't they tell me that from the first day? I asked for the bill to be issued beforehand, but they refused, even though I had brain surgery and a specialist appointment. If I had to pay, I wouldn't have switched my insurance in the first place. If you don't want to work, just close the clinic. You waste people's time and irritate them. Nobody has time to wait all day for processing. Patients just want to be examined and rest. When I asked questions, they gave no answers and just passed the buck. [Expletive]
0x311d7be8ffa446f5_0xd7b7af29c3e6b319.author: อภิสรา กตแก้ว

0x311d7be8ffa446f5_0xd7b7af29c3e6b319.text: We've been here since 1 PM. We informed them that our child has a fever of 38 degrees Celsius, and we're wiping them down and giving them medicine every 4 hours, but the fever hasn't gone down. We're medical professionals too, and we understand that. But what we don't understand is that a one-year-old child who has had a fever for a day that won't go down isn't being prioritized for examination, and it's almost 4 PM now, and they still haven't been seen. We're very disappointed. They should pay more attention to patients and prioritize them based on symptoms. For example, someone picking up medication on behalf of another person can wait. It's just one person in line; they probably won't run out of medication.
0x311d7be8ffa446f5_0xd7b7af29c3e6b319.author: Kamonchanok Kongkaew

0x311d7be8ffa446f5_0xd7b7af29c3e6b319.text: I went to inquire about my rights, but the staff didn't give me any information on what to do. They told me to transfer back because they had called the NHSO (National Health Security Office) and were told to come back here. The staff there said the NHSO should call them directly and confirmed they wouldn't provide treatment. They had a bad attitude even though I was asking politely; they wouldn't listen. They even said, "If you want to call the NHSO, call them yourself, or transfer back to your original clinic." When I called the NHSO, they said yes and to come back and try again. The staff there still wouldn't listen and told the NHSO to call the clinic themselves.

0x311d7be8ffa446f5_0xd7b7af29c3e6b319.text: Personally, I think it was terrible. Even just to get a referral letter, I waited 2-3 hours. Also, as a nurse, you should be talking to patients with a cheerful expression and be ready to work. 0x3050313575824649_0x31a1c05d9478d3e7.text: I ended up at this establishment not because of its specialty, but because it was nearby and the clinic was open 24/7. After calling ahead, I was told I needed to come in since I'd been drinking alcohol. They'd give me a miracle IV and everything would be fine, like Doctor Aibolit. Upon arriving, I was met by the receptionist, whom I helped raise the blinds at the entrance. After listening to my complaints about my persistent vomiting, she immediately recommended an IV for 18,500 baht. I said I couldn't afford that and would go to the hospital. The receptionist called someone named Taras Sergeyevich, and the price dropped to 5,000 baht. I was so exhausted I had to agree. A man arrived, introduced himself as a doctor at the clinic, and quickly processed my transfer to Sberbank at a rate of 2.9. They sat me down in a chair just like in the ad, and their ad is beautiful, just like Guf in a cap. They started the drip, and I went to the bathroom a couple of times with the IV to puke, then asked for a bucket. The person who accepted my transfer brought me a large office bucket with a bag and garbage inside, into which I proceeded to puke. The man, who introduced himself as a doctor, said, "Yeeesss, serious poisoning," and left the hospital. I continued lying on the chair, just like in the ad, except I couldn't smile, only gagging. The girl replied, "Well, we'll treat you for what you paid." Knowing it wouldn't do any good, I asked to disconnect the system and let me go to the hospital, since I had received confirmation from the insurance company. The girl stubbornly continued to hold me back, insisting that I'd feel better any minute, that I'd already paid, and that I should receive the full amount. Well, what can I do? I couldn't force myself to escape. I lay on the chair and vomited into the office bucket until the saline solution ran out. Just for fun, I lifted the bucket; it was about three liters. Wasn't it hard to carry? I'm familiar with drug addiction and detoxing patients. Regarding the service you provided me, you "doctors" wasted my precious time, blurring the picture for a proper diagnosis and further treatment. Of course, I received treatment in the hospital; it was seafood poisoning, but that's another story. I'd recommend anyone suffering from this to regular, small Thai clinics. They'll give you IVs for 1,000-1,500 baht and add vitamins as a bonus. They won't offer Phenazepam, of course, but they have plenty of Diazepam and Haloperidol. Stay safe, and all the best!
0x3050313575824649_0x31a1c05d9478d3e7.author: Roman “Mr. Roman” Kapitsky

0x311d7dc11a5200bb_0x38f73ab5873fe8b0.text: ขออนุญาตแบ่งปันประสบการณ์ส่วนตัวที่เกิดขึ้นระหว่างเข้ารับบริการทำฟันที่คลินิกค่ะ ไม่ได้มีเจตนาทำให้คลินิกเสียหาย เพียงต้องการเล่าความรู้สึกของตัวเองเพื่อเป็นข้อมูลสำหรับผู้ที่จะมารับบริการค่ะ” ดิฉันเป็นคนไข้จัดฟันของคลินิกนี้มานานแล้ว และเคยแนะนำเพื่อนให้มาทำด้วยค่ะ ประสบการณ์ด้านการจัดฟันช่วงแรกถือว่าโอเค แต่ระหว่างทางมีบางจุดที่ทำให้รู้สึกไม่มั่นใจ จึงอยากเล่าในฐานะประสบการณ์เฉพาะบุคคลนะคะ 1. เรื่องการอุดปิดช่องฟันหน้าห่าง ในครั้งล่าสุดที่ทำการอุดปิดช่องฟัน สีฟันที่ได้จากการอุดไม่ค่อยเข้ากับสีฟันจริงของดิฉันค่ะ เมื่อนำไปให้คลินิกอื่นดู เขาแจ้งว่าเฉดสีดูไม่ค่อยตรง ซึ่งอาจเป็นความไม่เหมาะสมเฉพาะเคสของดิฉันเองค่ะ เมื่อขอให้คุณหมอท่านเดิมถอดออก รู้สึกได้ว่าคุณหมอไม่ค่อยพอใจ และหลังถอดออก ดิฉันรู้สึกว่าโครงสร้างฟันดูต่างจากก่อนทำ เลยเกิดความกังวลค่ะ เมื่อแสดงรูปฟันก่อนทำให้คุณหมอดู คุณหมอได้กล่าวว่าก่อนหน้านี้ฟันดิฉัน “แย่กว่านี้” ซึ่งทำให้รู้สึกไม่ค่อยสบายใจค่ะ ทั้งหมดนี้เป็นเพียงความรู้สึกส่วนตัว ไม่ได้หมายความว่าบริการของคลินิกไม่ดีนะคะ แต่อาจไม่เหมาะกับเคสของดิฉันค่ะ 2. เรื่องการนัดหมายจัดฟันและข้อมูลด้านค่าใช้จ่าย ช่วงแรกดิฉันรักษากับคุณหมออีกท่านหนึ่ง ซึ่งนัดวันเสาร์–อาทิตย์ ทำให้สะดวกค่ะ ต่อมามีการเปลี่ยนวันนัดเป็นวันพฤหัส ซึ่งตรงกับเวลาที่ดิฉันเรียน จึงไม่สามารถไปได้ ทำให้ต้องเปลี่ยนหมอผู้รักษา ในส่วนนี้อาจเป็นความไม่ลงตัวระหว่างผู้ให้บริการกับผู้รับบริการมากกว่า ไม่ได้โทษใครค่ะ ในด้านข้อมูลค่าใช้จ่าย ดิฉันเคยเข้าใจว่ายังจ่ายไม่ครบโปรแกรม แต่หลังจากเช็กแล้วพบว่าจ่ายครบและจ่ายเกินไปประมาณ 3,000 บาท ซึ่งพนักงานหน้าเคาน์เตอร์ไม่ได้แจ้งให้ทราบตั้งแต่แรกค่ะ สุดท้ายทางคลินิกแจ้งว่าไม่สามารถคืนส่วนเกินได้ เนื่องจากดิฉันมีการขาดนัดบ้าง (สาเหตุเพราะมีการเปลี่ยนเวลานัด) ซึ่งในส่วนนี้อาจเป็นความเข้าใจไม่ตรงกันค่ะ สรุป สิ่งที่เล่ามานี้เป็น ประสบการณ์ของดิฉันคนเดียว นะคะ และไม่ได้ต้องการเรียกร้องค่าเสียหายใดๆ แต่อยากให้คลินิกรับฟังเพื่อปรับปรุงเรื่องการสื่อสาร การแจ้งข้อมูล และการให้คำอธิบายกับคนไข้ค่ะ หวังว่าจะเป็นประโยชน์กับคนที่กำลังหาข้อมูลค่ะ 🙏🏻
0x311d7dc11a5200bb_0x38f73ab5873fe8b0.author: Casper n.
0x311d7dc11a5200bb_0x38f73ab5873fe8b0.en: I'd like to share my personal experience during my dental treatment at this clinic. I don't intend to damage the clinic's reputation; I just want to share my feelings as information for potential patients. I've been an orthodontic patient at this clinic for a long time and have even recommended friends to come here. My initial orthodontic treatment went well, but along the way, there were some points that made me feel insecure, so I'd like to share my personal experience. 1. Regarding filling gaps between my front teeth: During my last filling, the color didn't match my natural tooth color. When I showed it to another clinic, they said the shade didn't quite match, which might be an unsuitability specific to my case. When I asked the original dentist to remove it, I felt they weren't happy, and after removal, I felt my tooth structure looked different from before, which caused me concern. When I showed the dentist before pictures of my teeth, they said my teeth were "worse" than this, which made me feel uneasy. All of this is just my personal feeling; it doesn't mean the clinic's service is bad, but it might just not have been suitable for my case. 2. Regarding orthodontic appointments and costs: Initially, I was treated by a different dentist who had appointments on Saturdays and Sundays, which was convenient." Later, the appointment was rescheduled to Thursday, which clashed with my classes, making it impossible for me to attend. This resulted in a change of doctor. This might be more of a misunderstanding between the service provider and the patient; I'm not blaming anyone. Regarding the charges, I initially thought I hadn't completed the program, but after checking, I found I had paid in full and even overpaid by approximately 3,000 baht, which the counter staff didn't inform me of initially. Finally, the clinic stated that they could not refund the excess amount because I had missed some appointments (due to the appointment scheduling change), which may have been a misunderstanding. In summary, this is my personal experience only, and I am not seeking any compensation. I simply want the clinic to listen to my feedback to improve their communication, information dissemination, and explanations to patients. I hope this is helpful for those seeking information. 🙏🏻

0x310293b9b63ddf69_0xf47772a6ae4c4474.text: คุณหมอมือเบา รอคิวไม่นานคะ เป็นคนที่กลัวการทำฟันมาก แต่รู้สึกประทับใจ ทำให้ลืมความกลัวไปได้เลย แนะนำเลยคะ

0x30da3135c844d997_0x1484df0cfb7da27a.text: Could you please make it easier for customers who have appointments at 4:00 or 4:30? I mean, can I be 10 minutes late? I'd like to see them for even 20 minutes longer. The last time, I was in such a hurry that we almost bumped into each other on the road. Not only did the child miss the appointment, but I also had to clear the traffic. I feel so sorry for my child who didn't get to see the doctor today. He really wanted to see the doctor because he's gotten much better after receiving treatment here. So I told him that next time is fine, my child. Let's just say that we've arrived at the clinic and it's okay if we don't go in. I'll just take him to the cafe to buy some drinks instead. Thank you so much to the clinic. I think I'll consider finding a more convenient place from now on.

0x311d7c3d02f94313_0xff20e4462e4e990d.text: ถอนฟันที่โยกนิดๆ 1 ซีก บอกซีกละ 300-1,000 บ. แล้วแต่ความยากง่าย (ถอนฟันล่างที่ไม่ใช่ฟันกราม) ใช้เวลา 5 นาที รวมฉีดยาชา ไม่รวมเวลาเอ็กเรย์ คุณหมอทำไวมากๆ คิดเงิน ค่าถอน 600 บ. ค่าเอ็กซ์เรย์ 150 บ. ถ้าถอนง่ายๆ ยัง 600 บ. แล้ว 300 ถอนอาราย??.. รวมๆ แล้วมาตรฐานใช้ได้คะ รวดเร็วดี

0x30e295caf602b759_0x94653e6aeb75f2f9.text: คิดอยู่นานว่าจะเขียนรีวิวดีไหมแต่รู้สึกผิดหวังกับร้านทำฟันร้านนี้มาก 2 ปีที่แล้วอุด 2 ซี่ แต่พอมำเสร็จรู้สึกว่าเขาเก็บงานไม่เรียบร้อย เหมือนเขาทำฟันดูบิ่น เป็นรอยแต่คิดว่าเดี๋ยวนี้เขาคงทำแบบนี้เพราะไม่ได้ทำฟันนานมาก ปีนี้กลับไปใหม่ อุดอีก 3 ซี่ก่อนไปเรากินข้าวได้ตามปรกติไม่มีปัญหา ไม่เป็นไร แต่หลักจากทำกินข้าวแล้วรู้สึกเจ็บ ผ่านไป 2 อาทิตย์แล้วปรากฏว่าข้างที่ทำมันเจ็บจากที่ไม่เคยมีปัญหา เหมือนกับว่าเขาอุดแต่ใส่ตัวที่อุดไม่มากพอ ทำให้ เจ็บเวลากิน อุดซี่ ละ 900 ขูดหินปูน อีก 900 รวม 3600 คงไม่ไปอีกแล้ว ร้านนี้ที่ไปเพราะใกล้บ้าน เสียความรู้สึก จริง จริง คิดไปเลยเถิดว่า ซี่ที่เจ็บเขาอาจไม่ได้อุดแต่ทำให้ผุ เพื่อที่เราจะได้กลับไปใหม่
0x30e295caf602b759_0x94653e6aeb75f2f9.author: Duangjai Chaichanpan
0x30e295caf602b759_0x94653e6aeb75f2f9.en: I hesitated for a long time whether to write a review, but I'm extremely disappointed with this dental clinic. Two years ago, I had two fillings done, but afterwards, the work felt sloppy. It looked chipped and scratched, but I thought that's probably how they do it now since I hadn't had dental work done in a long time. This year, I went back for three more fillings. Before the procedure, I could eat normally without any problems. But after, eating became painful. Two weeks later, the treated side is now sore, even though it never had a problem before. It's like they didn't put enough filling material in, causing pain when eating. Each filling cost 900 baht, plus another 900 baht for scaling, totaling 3600 baht. I won't be going back there again. I went because it's close to home. I'm truly disappointed. I'm even speculating that they might not have filled the painful tooth properly, but deliberately allowed it to decay so I'd have to come back again.

0x30e284d093fdfd73_0x7c07a9441e0cdcad.text: คลินิกสะอาด แต่สถานที่ค่อนข้างเล็ก เนื่องจากร้านอยู่ใกล้ที่พักจึงสนใจจัดฟันที่นี่ ตอนแรกได้รับข้อมูลจากเจ้าหน้าที่ว่าหากจองโปรตอนนี้จะได้รับรีเทนเนอร์ฟรี แต่เมื่อเข้าพบคุณหมอกลับได้รับข้อมูลว่ารีเทนเนอร์ต้องทำเอง และมีค่าใช้จ่ายเพิ่มเติม จึงรู้สึกสับสนกับข้อมูลที่ได้รับจากแต่ละฝ่าย ตั้งแต่เริ่มจัดฟัน จนปัจจุบันมีโอกาสพบคุณหมอเพียงไม่กี่ครั้ง ส่วนใหญ่เป็นเจ้าหน้าที่ท่านอื่นที่ดูแล ซึ่งไม่แน่ใจว่าเป็นผู้ช่วยทันตแพทย์หรือไม่ จึงตัดสินใจไปปรึกษาคลินิกอื่น และได้รับข้อมูลว่าฟันมีการหมุนไปหลายซี่ ซึ่งทำให้รู้สึกกังวลมาก เมื่อสอบถามถึงแผนการจัดฟัน ก็ได้รับคำตอบเพียงว่า “จัดครบ 2 ปีสามารถถอดเครื่องมือได้” หรือ “หากอยากจัดต่อก็สามารถทำต่อได้” โดยไม่มีรายละเอียดเพิ่มเติม จึงรู้สึกไม่มั่นใจในการรักษา จากประสบการณ์ส่วนตัว อยากให้คลินิกพิจารณาปรับปรุงเรื่องการสื่อสารและการดูแลคนไข้ให้ใกล้ชิดมากขึ้น

0x30e284d093fdfd73_0x7c07a9441e0cdcad.en: The clinic is clean, but the space is quite small. I was interested in getting braces here because it's close to my accommodation. Initially, I was told by staff that booking a promotional package would include a free retainer. However, after meeting the doctor, I was informed that the retainer had to be made by myself and would incur additional costs, leaving me confused by the information I received from different parties. Since starting my orthodontic treatment, I've only had to see the doctor a few times. Most of the time, I've been cared for by other staff members, and I'm not sure if they were dental assistants. Therefore, I decided to consult other clinics and was informed that several of my teeth had shifted, which has caused me significant concern. When I inquired about the treatment plan, I was only given the answers, "The braces can be removed after 2 years," or "If you wish to continue treatment, you can," without any further details. This made me feel uncertain about the treatment options. Based on my personal experience, I would like the clinic to consider improving its communication and providing closer patient care.

0x310297b95e837e77_0x48768324b8a3fca.text: We went to a clinic to have a wound cleaned for 300฿. This was the first clinic where the service from the staff was so bad. Not even a greeting was given. The staff at the counter sat playing on their phones from the moment we entered until we left. They did work, but they did it quickly and then rushed back to playing on their phones. If I had no choice but to go there again, I'd regret paying 10฿ for it. From the initial inquiry to the wound dressing, I greeted them when I entered the clinic, but there was no response or sign of welcome from anyone working there. Don't even think about a smile. The woman at the counter barely looked up from her phone to see the patients. Seeing that, I sat down to wait. (There were a total of 4 nurses and staff in the clinic, each seated at their assigned spot.) After a while, the woman at the reception desk spoke loudly and abruptly, without any politeness or intonation. “What’s wrong?” *I got up and walked over to answer her.* She then asked about my weight, etc., and after finishing, said, “Go sit and wait to be called.” I sat for a while and then was called to pay. I didn't have to wait long before they called me in to have my wound treated. The treatment was quick, without any regard for the patient. They rushed through the process, just to get it over with. They put on a very large gauze pad, almost reaching my genitals, making it difficult to use the restroom. Even a light urination soiled the gauze. I had to buy replacement supplies myself, even though the wound was on the upper thigh, far from my genitals. When I left, I went to the counter to ask for my receipt, but the woman at the checkout counter was still playing on her phone. I saw her place something on the counter, and I assumed it was the receipt. No one said or told me that it was my receipt; I had to open it myself to see which one had my name on it. Even after I picked up the documents and receipt from the counter, she continued playing on her phone without even looking up. A clinic with such a good location should have many patients wanting to use its services, but it's a shame that with staff who are constantly on their phones and lack a passion for service, there won't be any positive reviews from patients.
0x310297b95e837e77_0x48768324b8a3fca.author: wilailuk pimso

It was such a headache; such hard selling! I feel sorry for the presenter (the person who advertised the treatment). 0x30e2955c835bebbf_0xfde9753b9f4209fa.text: Terrible service. Around 11:45 AM today, I went in for a birth control injection. They didn't even take my blood pressure. #They didn't even wipe with alcohol! Is that acceptable? When I asked the counter staff, they said they did. "You have sharp eyes, like you were there! Look at the cotton swabs in the trash (there were some, but they belonged to other people, not me!). Because for me, they just pulled my pants down and injected the medicine." Then they argued, "How much alcohol do you want me to use?" They even retorted, "Professional ethics are important! Others might have, but you don't!" I'm not so numb that I wouldn't feel anything; I knew they wiped with alcohol, and I was fully conscious. There's a time limit for pulling down pants, wiping with alcohol, and injecting the medicine... but they just pulled my pants down and injected! Besides their unprofessional attitude, they lacked manners. They were grumpy, rude, and had a sharp tongue. If they're so sure, bring camera evidence to prove they did what they said about wiping with alcohol. I was a customer, not asking for a free injection. I paid for it. I have the money. I suggest they find a new nurse who provides good service so the clinic doesn't tarnish its reputation. #Something to think about #Arguing together that the touch was so gentle the patient didn't feel anything, right? 555 That gentle? Amazing! Bravo! Good job. From my experience, every time I go there, it's the same situation. Last time, I'm done with it.
0x30e2955c835bebbf_0xfde9753b9f4209fa.author: อภัสรา ปานสุวรรณ

0x30e2955c835bebbf_0xfde9753b9f4209fa.text: The service was absolutely terrible! Seriously, I've been to so many places and never encountered service like this. This is the worst. I went to the counter and explained that I was sick, had a runny nose, but my COVID test came back negative, only showing a faint flu. The staff seemed confused, not knowing what flu was. How can they work in the medical field? Then, when I went to see the doctor, they asked what was wrong. I explained my symptoms and showed them my test results, revealing a faint flu. The doctor asked, "Then why did you come?" What?! I was sick, so I came to see a doctor! You don't need to focus on the flu test; you can diagnose based on the symptoms I described. I told them I had a lot of runny nose but no cough, yet they gave me cough medicine. Seriously, did they even listen to me? That's one thing, but then they criticized my attire. What does that have to do with anything? They said I should be dressed more modestly. Wearing a tank top and long pants has nothing to do with going to the doctor! This is the most frustrating doctor's experience I've ever had. The service was terrible from the first person to the last. Thank you. There won't be a second time, and my boyfriend's family, who have been going there since they were kids, won't be going anymore. My boyfriend also complained about the service, but I never imagined it would be this bad. It's awful and needs improvement. The feeling of being awful from the first second to the last.
0x30e2955c835bebbf_0xfde9753b9f4209fa.author: nattaya boonkaow

0x30e2955c835bebbf_0xfde9753b9f4209fa.text: Just like everyone else's reviews say, it's really bad. The service was terrible. During the medical history taking, they were busy chatting, laughing, and playing on their phones. They asked questions while talking to their friends. They just sat there chatting for a while before finally calling me to sit down to take my blood pressure and ask about my symptoms. The doctor spoke so softly that I had to lean over to hear them. I had to say "excuse me, doctor," twice to make sure they spoke more softly. I only understood that they were giving me an injection. When I went to get the injection, I asked the person giving it to me, "Excuse me, what is this injection for?" The person sighed and called another person, saying, "She asked what kind of injection it is." I thought to myself, "Doesn't the person giving the injection know what they're giving me? How are they going to pick the right one if they don't know the name of the drug?" I was really uneasy at that point. I heard the doctor say, "Well, I already told you." Sigh. This will definitely be my first time here. I've seen the one-star reviews for a long time and thought they'd improved, but they haven't. The medication was also expensive and not worth the price; it felt like I was getting free treatment.
0x30e2955c835bebbf_0xfde9753b9f4209fa.author: Wanna Wanna

0x30e2957bd611ad49_0x10a8c0bfa246faf4.text: พนักงานแก่ๆหน้าเคาเตอร์พูดจาแย่มาก ในเพจลงว่าเปิด9.00 แต่พอไปจริงบอก9.00เป็นเวลาพนักงานมา 10โมงคือเวลาประตูเปิด แล้วพอไปถามก้อพูดไม่ดี กรุณาเปลี่ยนเวลาเปิดในเพจ คนที่จะไปใช้บริการเข้าอยากรู้เวลาเปิด ไม่ได้อยากรุ้เวลาพนักงานมา แล้วให้ลูกค้านั่งรอข้างๆคลินิกร้อนๆได้ยังไง ถ้าไม่มีจิตใจบริการ อย่าทำเลยงานบริการ ควรแก้ไขปรับปรุงอย่างมาก
0x30e2957bd611ad49_0x10a8c0bfa246faf4.author: สุชาดา กาญจนะวรรณ
0x30e2957bd611ad49_0x10a8c0bfa246faf4.en: The older staff member at the counter had a very rude attitude. The page says they open at 9:00 AM, but when I arrived, they said 9:00 AM was when the staff arrived, and 10:00 AM was when the doors actually opened. When I asked about this, they were also very rude. Please change the opening time on the page. Customers want to know the opening time, not when the staff arrives. How can you make customers sit and wait outside the clinic in the heat if you don't have a service-oriented mindset? You shouldn't be in a service job. Significant improvements are needed.

0x30e2957bd611ad49_0x10a8c0bfa246faf4.text: ไม่มีโทรมาแจ้งขอเลื่อน ไปถึงคลินิกพนักงานขอเลื่อนให้เหตุผลว่าเรทจากคนก่อนหน้า มีน้องนักเรียนมารอแล้ว นัด16.30 ไปถึง16.15ด้วยซ้ำ เหตุผลฟังไม่ขึ้นเลยสักนิด คำขอโทษไม่มี เสียเวลาเสียความรู้สึกสุดๆ
0x30e2957bd611ad49_0x10a8c0bfa246faf4.author: Plp
0x30e2957bd611ad49_0x10a8c0bfa246faf4.en: There was no phone call to inform me about the rescheduling. When I arrived at the clinic, the staff asked to reschedule, giving the reason that there was a delay from the previous client and that a student was already waiting. My appointment was at 4:30 PM, but I arrived at 4:15 PM. The reason given was completely unbelievable. There was no apology. It was a complete waste of time and very frustrating.

0x30e29f2c3ac8d56d_0x2d7faa2bdddb4bd2.text: Thank you, Dr. Wathan and Dr. Pim. I had a serious problem with my teeth. I went to another leading hospital in the country and they recommended new dental implants, which cost hundreds of thousands of baht. I also had receding gums. Dr. Wathan solved the problem by using braces, which eliminated the need for dental implants. The gaps between my teeth were reduced, which reduced the chance of food getting stuck. My teeth are perfectly straight, and it took less than a year to straighten them. My bite has improved, and so much more. The doctors gave me excellent advice. I'm so lucky to have met Dr. Wathan and Dr. Pim. They treat every patient to the best of their ability. I'm very impressed.
0x30e29f2c3ac8d56d_0x2d7faa2bdddb4bd2.author: Suphapong Rattanarangsan

0x30e29f2c3ac8d56d_0x2d7faa2bdddb4bd2.text: The doctor was very kind and patient, understanding of the child's fears. My son had a previous experience where he was afraid of getting fillings elsewhere. We explained the problem to the doctor, and she took care of him and explained everything until my son was completely okay. This will definitely be our family's regular clinic.
0x30e29f2c3ac8d56d_0x2d7faa2bdddb4bd2.author: Tanussorn Suphawat

0x30e29f2c3ac8d56d_0x2d7faa2bdddb4bd2.text: My children have been seeing Dr. Pim since their very first dental visit. We were very impressed; she helped reduce their fear of dental procedures. They never cried and said Dr. Pim has a gentle touch. They loved it! This first impression has made them want to become dentists themselves. Thank you!
0x30e29f2c3ac8d56d_0x2d7faa2bdddb4bd2.author: Nickki Chun

0x30e29f2c3ac8d56d_0x2d7faa2bdddb4bd2.text: Anyone who has had braces should be disciplined in wearing their retainers. My teeth shifted, so I needed braces a second time. This dental clinic is excellent. The doctor is attentive and provides ethical advice; it's not just about business. ❤️❤️❤️

0x30e29f2c3ac8d56d_0x2d7faa2bdddb4bd2.text: The pricing was unclear, and there was no apology or expression of responsibility from any of the staff.

0x30e28ffc26e16343_0x9654b292e2ee3673.en: The service was excellent. The doctor was kind and friendly, and did a fantastic job with my difficult dental case. My face has changed and I look so much more beautiful now!

0x30da3ba4287102ad_0x8080e40d4bfa4598.text: I traveled from the United States to Thailand for eyelid surgery and had an excellent experience. The doctor was extremely precise, professional, and had wonderful bedside manners. He took the time to explain everything clearly and made me feel comfortable throughout the process. The entire staff was incredibly caring and attentive. As an international patient, I felt well taken care of from start to finish. They were always available to answer questions and followed up after surgery to check on my recovery. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone considering eyelid surgery, especially those traveling from abroad. The level of care and professionalism exceeded my expectations.
0x30da3ba4287102ad_0x8080e40d4bfa4598.author: Cat Whitwell

0x311d61a26425cc2f_0x1852b69132a6d5f8.text: เป็นลูกค้ามานานแล้วสาขากรุงเทพกรีฑา คุณหมอหมด เก่งทุกท่านเลยค่ะ แต่จะไม่มีอีกเเล้ว เพราะ พนง.ที่อยู่เค้าเตอร์ ผู้หญิง ผมสั้น หลายครั้งแล้ว ดึงหน้าใส่ ตลอด บริการ/พูดจา แย่

But I won't be going there anymore because the female counter staff with short hair has been consistently rude and unfriendly. Her service and attitude are terrible.

0x311d61a26425cc2f_0x1852b69132a6d5f8.text: ปกติหา รพ. ขูดหินปูนราคาแพฃกว่าหน่อย แต่ไม่มีเวลา ลองทำคลรนิคเป็นครั้งแรก พอเลย หลแน มาก ขูดอย่างไว ไม่เท่าไร เลือดออกดต็มไปหมด ทำรพ.ไม่เคยเจ็บแบบนี้เลย

0x3102969f70f76481_0xf491fb4d18e9843f.text: Excellent clinic for dentures. Fast service. 4 days from the date of application. Beautiful and comfortable teeth.

0x3102969f70f76481_0xf491fb4d18e9843f.text: Wonderfully nice and skilled staff with good prices and short waiting times, can definitely be recommended 🤗 …
0x3102969f70f76481_0xf491fb4d18e9843f.author: Mr Klo

0x3102969f70f76481_0xf491fb4d18e9843f.text: Very unpleasant experience! I came here to have my teeth cleaned and tartar removed. The week before, I was told the price would be 900-1200 baht. When I arrived, the price had changed to 1500 baht. The dentist entered without a smile, and with a directly unfriendly demeanor. I took my place in the dental chair and immediately felt that something was not right. The dentist did not support her hand on my jaw, resulting in imprecise handling of the tool used to remove tartar. She hit my gums several times, causing a lot of bleeding and hitting spots that resulted in a lot of pain. I got up after 10 minutes, paid, and left as I did not feel I was in safe hands. Not recommended!
0x3102969f70f76481_0xf491fb4d18e9843f.author: Raymond Furre

0x30da3b81f95739c1_0xd4d29bea02a61430.text: ผ่าฟันคุดค่ะ สะดวก รวดเร็ว จนท.บริการดี คุณหมออธิบายหัตถการละเอียด มือเบา ไม่เจ็บเลย ราคาค่อนข้างสูง แต่ก็สมเหตุสมผล จับต้องได้ถ้าต้องการความสะดวก รวดเร็ว

0x30da3b81f95739c1_0xd4d29bea02a61430.author: Mekumi 33
0x30da3b81f95739c1_0xd4d29bea02a61430.en: I recommend that if you need uncomplicated dental work, other clinics might be more convenient. The waiting list is quite long. If you arrive at 6 pm, the female dentist will likely rush the procedure because she wants to get home quickly. This clinic might be more suitable for patients with pre-existing conditions already treated at a hospital, as their medical records are already linked. However, I think other clinics manage their appointments better. Arriving on or even before your scheduled time means you won't have to wait half an hour, which often leads to rescheduled appointments and affects subsequent patients. I recommend allocating extra time for your dental work, especially if you know what's required for your next appointment. This will prevent other patients from having to wait excessively longer than their scheduled time. Researching the systems of related dental clinics might help you find a more suitable approach, as walk-ins are not permitted here; appointments must be made in advance.
