0x311d655ccc033ab9_0x8f0aa72aaea0d916.text: We don't know this place, we've never been there. Why does the DoctorProm app show that we've used their services twice? Our benefits aren't registered there. We're confused.
0x311d655ccc033ab9_0x8f0aa72aaea0d916.author: Noree Noree

0x311d655ccc033ab9_0x8f0aa72aaea0d916.text: The service is terrible. Patients waited for an hour with no staff or employees present, yet the clinic was open and quiet as if no one was there. No one answered the phone.
0x311d655ccc033ab9_0x8f0aa72aaea0d916.author: ธเนศ เกตมณี

0x311d655ccc033ab9_0x8f0aa72aaea0d916.text: The service is good and fast. It was my first time there and I was very impressed.
0x311d655ccc033ab9_0x8f0aa72aaea0d916.author: Abu. Ratanaruengtrakul

0x30e29fc1dc6213d5_0x9c1293a1277077dc.text: มาขูดหินปูนกับเคลือบฟลูออไรด์คุณหมอมือเบาเเจ้งรายละเอียดฟันที่ผุให้ดีมากครับ คลินิกสะอาดพนักงานสุภาพมากครับ
0x30e29fc1dc6213d5_0x9c1293a1277077dc.author: Santhasak Naksuk
0x30e29fc1dc6213d5_0x9c1293a1277077dc.en: I came for a teeth cleaning and fluoride treatment. The dentist was very gentle and explained the details of my cavities very well. The clinic is clean and the staff are very polite.

0x30e29fc1dc6213d5_0x9c1293a1277077dc.text: มาใช้บริการที่สาขาแบริ่งค่ะ คุณหมอใจดีมากค่ะ พี่พนักงานก็น่ารัก คลีนิกสะอาดมาก น่าเข้าใช้บริการมาก 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
0x30e29fc1dc6213d5_0x9c1293a1277077dc.author: Panadda Butsuwan (Panadda)
0x30e29fc1dc6213d5_0x9c1293a1277077dc.en: I used the services at the Bearing branch. The doctor was very kind, the staff were lovely, and the clinic was very clean. A very pleasant place to visit! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

0x30e29fc1dc6213d5_0x9c1293a1277077dc.text: เราก็ไม่ใช่ลูกค้าใหม่ที่นี่หรอก และเคยมาใช้บริการตั้งแต่ยังอยู่ตรงสาขาอุดมสุข แล้วค่อยเปลี่ยนมาตรงอ่อนนุช แต่รู้สึกว่าการบริการตกต่ำลงมาก โดยเฉพาะเรื่องการทำนัดตรวจ เราโทรไปนัดวันเวลาก่อนล่วงหน้า 3 วัน พอถึงวันที่นัดซึ่งเป็นวันอาทิตย์ตอน 4 โมงเย็น กลับไม่มีข้อมูลลงบันทึกไว้ หมอก็กลับไปแล้ว แจ้งว่ารับคิวสุดท้ายตอนบ่ายสามกว่าๆตัวพนักงานเองก็ดูไม่ได้อยาก service หรือพยายามแก้สถานการณ์อะไรมากมาย แค่เช็คว่าเป็นเบอร์ที่ได้มีการติดต่อกันมาก่อนหน้าจริง ไม่ใช่นัดผิดสาขา แล้วก็ได้แค่ถามกลับมาว่าสะดวกเป็นวันอื่นไหม ถ้าทำได้แค่นี้เราก็เปลี่ยนไปหาที่อื่นดีกว่า คลินิกหมอฟันร้านอื่นๆมันก็ไม่ได้หายากในกรุงเทพ โคตรเสียเวลาเดินทาง และเสียความรู้สึก ถ้าไม่อยากรักษาลูกค้าไว้ ก็เชิญทำแบบเดิมกันต่อไปเถอะ
0x30e29fc1dc6213d5_0x9c1293a1277077dc.author: Thititorn Paojinda
0x30e29fc1dc6213d5_0x9c1293a1277077dc.en: We're not new customers here, and we've been using their services since they were at the Udom Suk branch before they moved to On Nut. However, we feel the service has deteriorated significantly, especially regarding appointments. We called to schedule an appointment three days in advance. On the day of our appointment, a Sunday at 4 PM, there was no record of our call. The dentist had already left, and they said the last appointment was at around 3 PM. The staff themselves didn't seem interested in providing good service or trying to resolve the situation. They just checked that the number was legitimate and that we hadn't made an appointment at the wrong branch, and then simply asked if we were available on another day. If that's all they can do, we'd rather go elsewhere. There are plenty of other dental clinics in Bangkok. It was a complete waste of time traveling and very disappointing. If you don't want to retain customers, then please continue doing the same thing.

0x30502f056fc0dcc1_0x1b93c2df824e39b6.text: This place is great, very reasonably priced and very quick, I got a partial plate with 5 teeth, cast Monday picked up Friday for around $200 Australian
0x30502f056fc0dcc1_0x1b93c2df824e39b6.author: Kim Hansen

0x30502f056fc0dcc1_0x1b93c2df824e39b6.text: Awesome service! Broke front tooth in accident and they fixed it right away in about 40 minutes. Great price and fantastic service!
0x30502f056fc0dcc1_0x1b93c2df824e39b6.author: Bent Posejpal

0x30502f056fc0dcc1_0x1b93c2df824e39b6.text: A holiday in Phuket and then a toothache! The 32 Dental Clinic in Chalong was very accommodating and kind. I would like to take this opportunity to thank them very much.
0x30502f056fc0dcc1_0x1b93c2df824e39b6.author: Gerhart Ameringer

0x30502f056fc0dcc1_0x1b93c2df824e39b6.text: Initiated a long term full mouth overhaul to include caps and dentures . Mid way thru the treatment was told the roots were too weak to be able to bite with the caps and they would only last 5 - 6 years . Once moved on to a fixed price , all agreed , all in , to the end plan , three treatments in got told the price would be increased by 25 % as they had forgotten part of the treatment . The thing they had supposedly forgotten being an item I had repeatedly mentioned and specifically highlighted in our conversations as it referred to the completion of a procedure that left the two teeth concerned weakened and unable to be used for biting . We will be forgetting to go back and finalizing the treatments elsewhere
0x30502f056fc0dcc1_0x1b93c2df824e39b6.author: andy s

0x30e29e9c0a8ee6cb_0x644d423f2ae48e3b.text: ***** 10/8/69 at 07:00, almost a year later, I returned to use the service again. This time, from the moment I was called, to the new staff member taking my medical history (not the same person as last year), who was more thorough and attentive, not just asking vague questions, and with a cheerful, smiling demeanor, to the staff member who issued the referral slip and returned my ID card, everyone provided excellent service and was dedicated to their duties. I noticed that the staff members mentioned last year were just as dedicated. Therefore, I would like to change my rating from one star last year to five stars, because I don't want to discourage other dedicated staff members from a negative review (and I don't want one bad apple to spoil the whole barrel). * 23/1/69 at 13:30, the head nurse called to inquire about further details. I explained what I had experienced, but despite my attempts to explain the service I received, she seemed to understand, yet not quite. She seemed sympathetic, but not quite. Furthermore, she implied that I must be rich to not care about the department specified on the referral slip, which is irrelevant. If the doctor doesn't specify the disease to be treated, I cannot use my insurance. I understand that, but my post was only about the "service," and I want that to be understood as well. I also want to clarify that the person taking the patient's history was not a nurse. I didn't know this from the start. Seeing them ask detailed questions about the illness, I assumed it was a nurse. Ultimately, calling to inquire didn't improve the situation; it just made me more frustrated... * The person taking the history was extremely rude. It was only the first person in line; what was the rush? Didn't they read the documents, or were they illiterate? When I pointed this out, they ignored me and said, "The doctor will check it later." Why ask in the first place? Their facial expression and tone were as if I had to beg them. Someone in this role should at least be humane, not a robot asking questions. They should have empathy for the patients. (15/12/68, 08:00) Other staff members provided normal service and were cheerful.
0x30e29e9c0a8ee6cb_0x644d423f2ae48e3b.author: Kullz

0x30e29e9c0a8ee6cb_0x644d423f2ae48e3b.text: I used my 30-baht healthcare benefit for a burning, red rash. I called the center and someone answered. The person on the other end advised me to arrive before 11 am. I arrived at 10 am, and everything was done by noon. The wait wasn't long and the process wasn't complicated, probably because there weren't many people. The service room inside the building was air-conditioned and comfortably cool. The nurses and doctors were kind, provided good service, and answered questions clearly. I'm glad that the public service center has improved. Thank you to all the staff for your service.
0x30e29e9c0a8ee6cb_0x644d423f2ae48e3b.author: Lookkaew mini

0x30e29e9c0a8ee6cb_0x644d423f2ae48e3b.text: The staff were a bit loud, but overall the service was good. All patients with universal healthcare coverage can use their benefits for free; there's no need to pay anything, and you don't even need to have benefits here to use it.
0x30e29e9c0a8ee6cb_0x644d423f2ae48e3b.author: Anond Kulthanmanusorn

0x30e29e9c0a8ee6cb_0x644d423f2ae48e3b.text: I really don't want to give 3 stars because the department I usually use provides excellent and prompt service. But today was my first time at this dental clinic. I arrived to get a queue number at 1 PM. I came with an older woman to wait for a queue number. It turned out she had reserved a spot for her sister, but her sister hadn't arrived yet. Instead of being number 3, we ended up being number 4. I asked the staff if they had a reservation system, and they replied no. Then I said, "Then you should be number 3 because your sister hasn't arrived yet, since we arrived first." In short, the older woman and I just pretended nothing happened, even though we explained this to her. The staff didn't offer any assistance or clarification. We wasted the whole day waiting in line, especially since it was a holiday. Why don't they follow the rules and maintain order? If they reserve a spot for 3 or more people, and those people don't arrive, won't those who arrived earlier lose their chance? This kind of unfair treatment is unacceptable. I hope the relevant staff here, if they see this, will consider and improve their service. It's 2023 already; things should have improved by now. I feel really bad. * If you're coming for dental treatment here, arrive at 1 PM and wait in line at 3:30 PM. Then wait for the doctor for another 30 minutes. After that, they start calling numbers at 4 PM. The last appointment is probably at 6:30 PM. * Dr. Puttiporn Chansuchai gave excellent consultation, provided great advice, and managed the time quickly. She did a very good and professional job. In summary, the wait was very long, but I was patient because the service fee was really cheap compared to other clinics. Overall, I spent 6 hours here today.
0x30e29e9c0a8ee6cb_0x644d423f2ae48e3b.author: Areeya Maijungko

0x30e29e9c0a8ee6cb_0x644d423f2ae48e3b.text: I came to get a referral letter at 8:30 AM and didn't get it until 10:45 AM. What kind of work are they doing? There are so many staff members, they're practically bumping into each other. There aren't even that many people waiting for service. When I did this at a private clinic, it took less than an hour. In short, the doctor was just late. Amazing, the Thai bureaucratic system... I came to get a referral letter again. This time I arrived at 8:10 AM, got a queue number, and it took until 10:40 AM to be called for the medical history check. That was only 20 seconds! They told me to sit and wait for the referral letter. I waited until 11:20 AM to receive it. I don't understand how they work. Just one referral letter took 3 hours. From what I saw, there were so many people working, some were just sitting around playing on their phones, chatting in groups. What a waste of taxpayer money...
0x30e29e9c0a8ee6cb_0x644d423f2ae48e3b.author: Sanphat Kijprueang

0x30e29e9c0a8ee6cb_0x644d423f2ae48e3b.text: Before coming for service, I called to ask if they were still offering flu blood tests. Rajavithi Hospital had informed me that I should get a blood test here first to maintain my eligibility. But upon arrival and stating that I was there for a blood test, the nurse responded, "Don't tell the doctor what to do; let the doctor decide." Then they made me wait for 2-3 hours, and finally, a nurse came out and said that testing hours were over. - My question is, what did I gain from coming here? - My sibling has been sick for 6 days. Did the nurse think, "Being sick for another day won't hurt"? - If you don't want to work, just stay home, Ms. Nurse!
0x30e29e9c0a8ee6cb_0x644d423f2ae48e3b.author: Bell _ Mainpoint

0x30e29e9c0a8ee6cb_0x644d423f2ae48e3b.text: I took my child for vaccinations, and everything else was good. However, when I entered the vaccination room, the staff member administering the vaccine (who wasn't a doctor today) was extremely rude and disrespectful. I understand being told how to hold a baby, but she spoke poorly to me, looked at me with contempt, and even continued to belittle and insult me ​​before I left the room. It's unbelievable how disrespectful she acted; if she were truly a good person, she wouldn't have behaved so poorly towards others. (Service used on 20/9/65)
0x30e29e9c0a8ee6cb_0x644d423f2ae48e3b.author: Thawinee Meelom

0x30e29e9c0a8ee6cb_0x644d423f2ae48e3b.text: The service from the doctor was terrible. Not only was he rude, but he didn't ask a single question about my condition during the examination. He just wrote down the medication and told me to leave. I forgot to ask for a medical certificate, and when I went to request one, he said I should eat first. I feel sorry for the nurses; they're all so helpful but have to work with someone like this. I hope the nurses find a nice doctor who makes their lives easier. (The doctor was an older male.)
0x30e29e9c0a8ee6cb_0x644d423f2ae48e3b.author: 王弘文Copter

0x310295c58e59d501_0x5573b3d84c7bb040.text: The female doctor gave excellent advice. She clearly explained the costs of medication and treatment, and provided detailed information to the patient. The nurse was also polite and provided good service. The price was reasonable, not as expensive as I thought. 🙏🏻🙏🏻 …
0x310295c58e59d501_0x5573b3d84c7bb040.author: July July

0x310295c58e59d501_0x5573b3d84c7bb040.text: I went to see a doctor about my blood pressure. I saw a small, female doctor who gave me excellent advice. She answered all my questions and didn't rush me into prescribing medication and sending me out of the room.
0x310295c58e59d501_0x5573b3d84c7bb040.author: Pornchai Rojsattarat

0x310295c58e59d501_0x5573b3d84c7bb040.text: The doctor was very kind, provided excellent care, and was very friendly. I had been searching for a dental clinic for a long time before finding this one, and the care was outstanding. I'm extremely impressed! ♥️♥️
0x310295c58e59d501_0x5573b3d84c7bb040.author: Jaruwan

0x310295c58e59d501_0x5573b3d84c7bb040.text: The service was excellent. The staff were helpful, the doctor was lovely, and they provided great treatment recommendations and advice. The price was reasonable.
0x310295c58e59d501_0x5573b3d84c7bb040.author: สมศักดิ์ จิตหลัง

0x310295c58e59d501_0x5573b3d84c7bb040.text: Good service. I come here regularly for treatment. The staff are polite. The doctor is cute and speaks nicely. The doctor gives very good advice.
0x310295c58e59d501_0x5573b3d84c7bb040.author: Yuwadee Butta

0x310295c58e59d501_0x5573b3d84c7bb040.text: The service was excellent. The person on the phone was very polite, and the service was great when I arrived.
0x310295c58e59d501_0x5573b3d84c7bb040.author: momo xinli

0x310295c58e59d501_0x5573b3d84c7bb040.text: I drove 7 kilometers to see a doctor hoping for treatment. I arrived at 6:16 PM, but the nurse said the doctor's shift ended at 6:30 PM and told me to come back tomorrow. What kind of medical ethics is this? Can't they treat a patient who's already there? I'm so disappointed. 👎👎👎
0x310295c58e59d501_0x5573b3d84c7bb040.author: Samairat Palapanyawongsa

0x310295c58e59d501_0x5573b3d84c7bb040.text: The wound dressing was terrible, done haphazardly, and the way they covered it looked awful. One visit was enough for me. ❌
0x310295c58e59d501_0x5573b3d84c7bb040.author: Watcharaporn Utthapong

0x30da300edf5301f9_0x1f590a79a95bf1ba.text: VK Dental Clinic 2 doesn’t like westerners. They did a good job cleaning my teeth but said i had no cavities, they wanted me gone. I went to dentist in bangkok and had a dead molar removed with repeat visits scheduled for cavities that i was shown visibly on a xray. I think they are just lazy but not honest
0x30da300edf5301f9_0x1f590a79a95bf1ba.author: David

0x30da300edf5301f9_0x1f590a79a95bf1ba.text: This was the first time I'd encountered such a rude merchant in Thailand. I was completely speechless! They had a sour face and were impatient the whole time. In the end, I didn't even want to go to the dentist anymore. It made me feel really bad, so I just left!
0x30da300edf5301f9_0x1f590a79a95bf1ba.author: ivy WU

0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.text: ดีจังมีคลินิกที่ดีและสะอาดใกล้บ้าน ที่นี่ทำฟันดีมากคะ คลินิกสะอาด พนักงานพูดจาน่ารัก คุณหมอก็แนะนำพูดจาดีมากๆคะ(แจส กรีน วัดลาดปลาดุก)
0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.author: Paymiga Chimphali
0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.en: It's great to have a good and clean clinic near my house. The dental work here is excellent. The clinic is clean, the staff are lovely, and the doctor is very helpful and gives great advice. (Jas Green, Wat Lad Pladuk)

0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.text: คุณหมอทำฟันมาครั้งแรกน่ารักมากทำมือนิ่มๆ พูดจาก็เพราะ ผู้ช่วยก็น่ารักค่ะราคาก็ไม่แพงทำดีจริงๆ ประทับใจ👍
0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.author: พรพรรณ อยู่จําเนียร
0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.en: The dentist who came to my dentist for the first time was so lovely, with gentle hands and a very kind voice. The assistant was also lovely. The price was not expensive, and the work was really good. I'm very impressed 👍

0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.text: หมอมือเบากว่าที่อื่นเยอะครับ พูดจาดีด้วยแต่ต้องโทรมาจองล่วงหน้าสัก1วันครับ ผมมาตอนเดือนกรกฎาคมปี69
0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.en: The doctor was much gentler than elsewhere. He was also very polite, but you need to call and book at least one day in advance. I came in July 1969.

0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.text: คลินิคสะอาดมากค่ะ เจ้าหน้าที่ให้คำปรึกษาดีมากค่ะ คุณหมอใจดี แนะนำมาดัดฟันที่นี่นะคะ
0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.author: เหมียว เหมียว
0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.en: The clinic is very clean. The staff provides excellent consultations. The doctor is kind. I recommend getting braces here.

0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.text: คิวง่าย แต่ราคาแรง และขูดหินปูนเจ็บที่สุดในชีวิต ปกติขูดปีละครั้ง เป็นคนหินปูนเยอะ และขูดเจ็บประจำเพราะต้องขูดใต้เหงือก แค่ที่นี่ทำได้เจ็บปวดที่สุดจริง ๆ แต่ก็คงสะอาดแหละ
0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.author: Pharnuphong W.
0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.en: The queue was easy, but the price was steep, and the tartar removal was the most painful I've ever experienced. I usually get it done once a year because I have a lot of tartar and it's always painful because they have to scrape under the gums. But this place was the most painful I've ever had. At least it's clean enough.

0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.text: ไปอุดฟันมาจากที่กินอาหารได้ หลังทำเสียวฟันซี่ที่ทำ ไปแก้มา2ครั้งเหมือนเดิม หมอบอกเป็นเพราะฟันเราก่อนทำผุอยู่แล้ว เข็ดว่าจะไปครอบฟันไปที่อื่นดีกว่า
0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.author: ชนิดาภา อุ่นเอม
0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.en: I went to get a filling done, and now I can eat. After the procedure, I experience sensitivity in that tooth. I've had it fixed twice, but it's still the same. The dentist said it's because my tooth was already decayed before the procedure. I'm hesitant and plan to get a crown elsewhere.

0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.text: บริการไม่ประทับใจเลยครับ หมอกับพยาบาลคุยกันแต่เรื่องส่วนตัว เรื่องหนังละคร ไม่ใส่ใจคนไข้ คุยกันในขณะเรานอนอ้าปากทำฟัน
0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.author: โชคชัย เจนติยานุรักษ์
0x30e29155cab69d6f_0x3e4e7569429d6da6.en: The service was very disappointing. The doctor and nurses were only talking about personal things, movies, and TV shows, completely ignoring the patient. They were chatting while I was lying there with my mouth open for dental work.

0x30e2837d5524206d_0x1b3858848e70c9b5.text: คุณหมอบริการดีมาก ให้คำแนะนำอย่างละเอียด ใส่ใจและอธิบายทุกขั้นตอน ที่สำคัญ ใช้สิทธิประกันสังคมได้ และ บริการรวดเร็ว ไม่ยุ่งยากเลย 📍 คลินิกอยู่ในซอยแจ้งปากเกร็ด 19 เลยตลาดมานิดเดียว อยู่ฝั่งขวามือ ตรงข้ามเซ็นทรัลแจ้งวัฒนะ แนะนำเลยครับ สำหรับใครที่มองหาคลินิกที่ให้บริการดี ใช้สิทธิประกันสังคมได้แบบไม่วุ่นวาย 🙌
0x30e2837d5524206d_0x1b3858848e70c9b5.author: Patipan Chombutsri
0x30e2837d5524206d_0x1b3858848e70c9b5.en: The doctor provided excellent service, giving detailed advice, being attentive, and explaining every step. Importantly, I could use my social security benefits, and the service was fast and hassle-free. 📍 The clinic is located in Soi Chaengpak Kret 19, just past the market on the right-hand side, opposite Central Chaengwattana. I highly recommend it for anyone looking for a clinic with great service and hassle-free social security benefits. 🙌

0x30e2837d5524206d_0x1b3858848e70c9b5.text: เคยถอนฟันคุดที่นี่ หมอน่ารักมาก มือเบา ทำเร็วด้วย ราคาถูกกก ตาแตก คือชอบมาก ปลื้มมม🩷
0x30e2837d5524206d_0x1b3858848e70c9b5.author: Kanlayani
0x30e2837d5524206d_0x1b3858848e70c9b5.en: I had my wisdom tooth extracted here. The dentist was so nice, gentle, and fast. The price was incredibly cheap! I loved it, I'm so pleased! 🩷

0x30e2837d5524206d_0x1b3858848e70c9b5.text: หมอทำงานไม่ละเอียด ฉุ่ย ไม่มีความเป็นมืออาชีพ ลูกแหกปากร้องลั่นร้าน สภาพร้านไม่ดี
0x30e2837d5524206d_0x1b3858848e70c9b5.author: T T
0x30e2837d5524206d_0x1b3858848e70c9b5.en: The doctor was careless, sloppy, and unprofessional. My child was screaming loudly in the clinic. The clinic was in poor condition.

0x30e298e42252e8e5_0x99b54802a20d9c24.text: หมอนัดมาให้มาวันนี้ ก็รีบกลับจากที่ทำงาน เพื่อมานตามนัด แต่หมอไม่มา ก็ควรจะโทรแจ้ง นัดเอง ไม่มา ไม่โทรแจ้ง โทรบอกอะไรทั้งสิ้น เสียเวลา เสียค่าใช้จ่ายเดินทาง เสียความรู้สึกมาก
0x30e298e42252e8e5_0x99b54802a20d9c24.author: Sirirat Worasin

0x30e298e42252e8e5_0x99b54802a20d9c24.text: พาแมวไปหาหมออาการหนัก แต่หมอตรวจแค่กดๆแล้วฉีดยาให้ยากลับไปกิน ยังไม่ถึงวันแมวตาย
0x30e298e42252e8e5_0x99b54802a20d9c24.author: Teerisara Kamsripong

0x30da2d350e99abd5_0x8f4a233589f88648.text: It's an affordable clinic, the doctor is kind, and I've never been disappointed every time I go.
0x30da2d350e99abd5_0x8f4a233589f88648.author: Sak Khamlue

0x30da2d350e99abd5_0x8f4a233589f88648.text: The doctor was pleasant and polite, and the staff at the counter was also polite. However, I'd like to criticize the staff in the dispensing room. Today, my girlfriend had a stomach ache and went to the clinic. The doctor spoke very well, but the staff in the dispensing room asked my girlfriend if she came to get a medical certificate. They said she lied about her stomach ache and spoke rudely to her. After receiving the medicine, they didn't tell me anything about the dosage. I understand that there are instructions to read, but it would be good if they could have reiterated it.
0x30da2d350e99abd5_0x8f4a233589f88648.author: kantharat sangson

0x30da2d350e99abd5_0x8f4a233589f88648.text: The service staff were very rude (at the pharmacy). Please improve this; I wasn't using the service for free.
0x30da2d350e99abd5_0x8f4a233589f88648.author: ปาณิศา ดอกติ๊บ

0x30e29870fb050a25_0xea31a38ab87fcc67.text: หมอเก่งดี ทำงานละเอียด จากที่ต้องถอน หมออุดให้ บอกว่าน่าจะอยู่ได้ชั่วคราว นี่จะครบ2ปีแล้ว ยังสภาพดีอยู่เลย ไม่ต้องถอน
0x30e29870fb050a25_0xea31a38ab87fcc67.author: Takkawit Tweelapaporn
0x30e29870fb050a25_0xea31a38ab87fcc67.en: The dentist is skilled and meticulous. The tooth needed to be extracted, but the dentist filled it and said it would likely last temporarily. It's almost been two years now, and it's still in good condition. No extraction needed.

0x30e29870fb050a25_0xea31a38ab87fcc67.text: 2ปีก่อน หมอผู้ชายใช้เครื่องมือไม่ระวังเลย พลาดบาดมุมปากของเรา เขาไม่ขอโทษด้วยนะให้แค่น้ำแข็งมาประคบ ล่าสุด หมอผู้หญิงก็ไม่ละเอียดรอบคอบเช่นกัน ไม่รู้ว่าเมื่อยหรืออะไร เอาเครื่องมือวางกดที่มุมปากเรานานมากจนมือปากเราบวมเลย สรุปได้ว่า หมอที่นี่ไม่มีความละเอียดรอบคอบเลย ไปทีไรได้แผลกลับมาทุกที
0x30e29870fb050a25_0xea31a38ab87fcc67.author: Kittisak :3
0x30e29870fb050a25_0xea31a38ab87fcc67.en: Two years ago, a male doctor was careless with his instruments and accidentally cut the corner of my mouth. He didn't apologize, only gave me ice to apply. Most recently, a female doctor was also careless. I don't know if she was tired or what, but she pressed the instrument on the corner of my mouth for so long that my mouth and hand swelled up. In short, the doctors here are not careful at all. Every time I go, I leave with a cut.

0x30e29870fb050a25_0xea31a38ab87fcc67.text: เพิ่งไปถอนฟันมาหมอผู้หญิงฉีดยาชาเข็มเดียวร้องแทบตาย ยังจะบังคับถอนอีกพอเลยเดินออกมาเลย😭😭😭😭
0x30e29870fb050a25_0xea31a38ab87fcc67.en: I just had a tooth extracted. The female dentist gave me one injection of local anesthetic and I was in agony. She still tried to force me to pull it out, so I just walked out. 😭😭😭😭

0x30da21326e3494a9_0xe47eb16dc18096a4.text: Very good doctor, trained in London. He correctly diagnosed a tendonitis. Very affordable including prescription.
0x30da21326e3494a9_0xe47eb16dc18096a4.author: Patrick Magnus

0x30da21326e3494a9_0xe47eb16dc18096a4.text: This is an old clinic in Doi Saket district, run by Dr. Kasem. Previously located at the Doi Saket intersection in an old wooden house, it has now moved to a new, modern building that is more comfortable.
0x30da21326e3494a9_0xe47eb16dc18096a4.author: surapong c.

0x30da21326e3494a9_0xe47eb16dc18096a4.text: It is recommended to install parking signs for both cars and motorcycles. Not everyone knows where to park. If there are signs for car parking inside the alley and motorcycle parking next to the clinic building, those who have never been here before will not be confused.
0x30da21326e3494a9_0xe47eb16dc18096a4.author: Arpaporn Thatinjan

0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.text: อยู่ชั้นใต้ดิน อาคาร B ค่ะ เพิ่งเคยมาใช้บริการครั้งแรก(มาถอนฟัน) เข้ามาอ่านรีวิวคือต้องมาจองแต่เช้าเพราะรับแค่วันละ 8 คิว ก็เลยทำตามรีวิวค่ะ พอมาถึง โอเค 8 คิวจริงๆค่ะ เพราะที่เหลือจะเป็นการให้บริการคนไข้เก่าที่มีนัดอยู่แล้วซึ่งเยอะมากๆ เราเข้าคิวจองตอน 06.25 น. ได้ลำดับที่ 6 ยืนรอถึง 07.00 น. จนท.จะมาเปิดประตูและให้วัดความดันพร้อมกับยื่นบัตรหน้าเคาท์เตอร์ จากนั้นจนท.จะแจ้งเวลาคร่าวๆ ของเราจนท.แจ้งว่าประมาณ 10.15 น. ซึ่งเราไปไหนก็ได้แล้วค่อยกลับมา แต่ห้ามเกินเวลาที่เขาเรียกชื่อ(ไม่เกิน 15 นาทีจากที่เรียกชื่อ) ไม่งั้นคิวเราจะโดนแซงถือเป็นเรื่องปกติ เราได้คุณหมอมือเบามากๆ คุณหมออธิบายดี จนท.(บางคน) อาจมีเสียงดังบ้างแต่ไม่มีอะไรค่ะ เหมือนถามย้ำๆกับคนไข้บางคนเท่านั้น รวมๆแล้วสำหรับการมาใช้บริการครั้งแรก ดีงามค่ะ ปล. มีจุดให้ยืนรอคิวเป็นรูปเท้าเหมือนในรูปค่ะ
0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.author: KannikaR Naka
0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.en: It's located in the basement of Building B. This was my first time using their services (for a tooth extraction). I read reviews saying you have to book early because they only accept 8 patients per day, so I followed the reviews. When I arrived, it was true there were only 8 patients, as the remaining slots were for existing patients with many appointments. I queued at 6:25 AM and was number 6. I waited until 7:00 AM. A staff member opened the door, had my blood pressure checked, and I presented my card at the counter. Then, they gave me an estimated appointment time; mine was around 10:15 AM. I could go anywhere and come back later, but I had to stay within 15 minutes of my name being called, otherwise my turn would be skipped – this is common. The dentist was very gentle and explained everything well. Some staff members were a bit loud, but nothing serious; they just seemed to repeat questions to some patients. Overall, for my first visit, it was a great experience. P.S. There are designated waiting areas shaped like feet, as shown in the picture.

0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.text: มาฉีดวัคซีนไข้หวัดใหญ่ประจำปี ราคาเข็มละ 550 บาท ฉีดเสร็จแวะช้อปผัก ผลไม้ ที่มาออกบูธอยู่ข้างๆ คลีนิคคะ ได้มาเต็มรถเลย เป็นสวนปลอดสารเคมีจากราชบุรี ราคาไม่แพง 3 ถุง 50 บาท มีร้านกาแฟ และก๋วยเตี๋ยวเจียงลุกชิ้นปลาด้วยคะ แนะนำจอดรถขั้น 4A จะตรงกับทางเข้าตึก แล้วเดินตรงยาวทางเชื่อมไปเลยคะ มีบริการทัตกรรมด้วย
0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.author: Niya Ka
0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.en: I came for my annual flu shot. It costs 550 baht per dose. After the shot, I stopped by to shop for fruits and vegetables at the booths next to the clinic. I filled my car up with stuff! They're organic produce from Ratchaburi, and the prices are very reasonable – 3 bags for 50 baht. There's also a coffee shop and a noodle shop selling fish ball noodles. I recommend parking on floor 4A, which is right by the building entrance, and then walking straight along the connecting walkway. They also offer dental services.

0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.text: โรงพยาบาลอยู่ชั้น 1 ของอาคารรัฐประศาสนภักดี หรือตึก B ค่ะ นั่งวินมอไซค์จากหน้าศาลปกครองมา 15 บาท เราไปขอใบรับรองแพทย์ราคาย่อมเยามากๆ แค่ 200 บาท ที่สำคัญสอบถามข้อมูลผ่านทาง LINE แอดมินตอบคำถามเร็วมากๆ เจ้าหน้าที่ทำงานเร็วค่ะ โดยรวมประทับใจในการให้บริการมากๆ
0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.author: Molly
0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.en: The hospital is located on the 1st floor of the Ratthaprasanphakdi Building, or Building B. It's a 15 baht motorcycle taxi ride from in front of the Administrative Court. We went there to get a medical certificate, and the price was very reasonable, only 200 baht. Importantly, inquiries via LINE were answered very quickly by the admin. The staff were also very efficient. Overall, we were very impressed with the service.

0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.text: ศูนย์แพทย์และทันกรรม ของโรงพยาบาลบ้านแพ้ว ตั้งใจอยู่อาคารบี มีการให้บริการตรวจรักษาโรคทั่วไป และบริการด้านทันตกรรม ซึ่งรองรับทั้งบุคคลทั่วไป และข้าราชการ เจ้าหน้าที่ของหน่วยงานของรัฐทุกคน
0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.author: I'am Joseph
0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.en: The Medical and Dental Center of Ban Phaeo Hospital is located in Building B and provides general medical check-ups and dental services, serving both the general public and all government officials and staff.

0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.text: ราคาก็เท่ากับคลินิกข้างนอก รอตั้งแต่8.00-12.00 บอกคิวว่าทำตอน11.00 หมอผญบอกจะนัดให้ พอออกมาจ่ายตังไม่นัดให้แล้ว เพื่อ?? ให้มาวอคอินใหม่วันหลัง กุก็ต้องรอใหม่แบบนี้อีก กูไปทำคลินิกข้างนอกดีกว่า
0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.author: Chattarika Chinpakdee
0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.en: The price is the same as outside clinics. I waited from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. They said my appointment was at 11:00 AM. The female doctor said she would schedule it for me. But when I went to pay, they hadn't scheduled it anymore. Why?? They told me to walk in another day, so I had to wait again. I'd rather go to an outside clinic.

0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.text: โทรถามบอกให้มาก่อน 7โมงมารับบัตรคิว เราถามว่าได้ตรวจแน่นะ จะได้ไป พอมาถึง รับคิว 8คน คือ ทำไมไม่บอก มาไกลเสียเวลา อย่ามาเลย แค่รับโทรศัพท์ก็สื่อสารไม่รู้เรื่องแล้ว
0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.author: lda niy
0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.en: We called and were told to arrive before 7 am to get a queue number. We asked if we would definitely get checked so we could go. When we arrived, they were giving out queue numbers to 8 people. Why didn't they tell us? We came from far away and wasted our time. Don't bother coming. They can't even communicate properly on the phone.

0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.text: มีบริการแซงคิว จากอภิสิทธิ์ชน บ่อยมาก ไม้ต้องกดคิว เดินมาพร้อมคนติดตาม เข้าตรวจเฉย... กดธรรมดานั่วรอคิว.... ผู้บริหารดูแลบ้าวค่ะ
0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.author: ni niramol
0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.en: There is a queue jumping service from the privileged people very often. You don't have to press the queue button. They walk with an attendant and just go in for inspection... Press the button normally and sit and wait in line.... The management takes care of you.

0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.text: ทันตกรรมตอนนี้รับแค่ 8 คิว สบายๆ ยุบสาขาเถอะครับ จองล่วงหน้าก็หามีไม่ สบายเกิ๊นนนน เห็นแก่พยาบาลน่ารักนะคับ❤️❤️
0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.author: Jiraphat Rakhang
0x30e2832f8af3ef99_0x81b3b1fe41431603.en: The dental clinic is currently only accepting 8 patients. It's too relaxed. They should just close the branch. It's impossible to book in advance. It's too easy! (For the sake of the cute nurses, please.) ❤️❤️

0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.text: คุณหมอพูดเพราะมากครับ บริการดีด้วย ทำไม่เจ็บเลย อธิบายชัดเจน มือเบามากกกกกก พี่ๆพนักงานหน้าเค้าเตอร์ ก็น่ารักมากๆ บริการดีมากครับโดยเฉพาะพี่ที่จัดฟันยิ้มบ่อยๆ น่ารักสุดๆ ♥️ **อยากให้ปรับปรุงตักเตือนพนักงานหน้าเค้าเตอร์หรือแอดมินคนนึงครับ ไม่แน่ใจว่าพึ่งมาแทนรึป่าว แต่รู้สึกว่าพูดห้วนมากๆ ไม่มีหางเสียงเลย 🙇🏻‍♀️ ไม่จัดฟัน ผมปล่อย
0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.author: Nn Vv
0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.en: The doctor was very kind and the service was excellent. The procedure was painless, the explanations were clear, and the doctor was very gentle. The counter staff were also very lovely and provided great service, especially the woman who was getting braces and smiled a lot – she was the sweetest! ♥️ **I would like to suggest that you reprimand one of the counter staff members or the admin. I'm not sure if they just started working there, but they spoke very abruptly and without any politeness. 🙇🏻‍♀️ I'm not getting braces, so I'm leaving it as is.**

0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.text: ขูดหินปูนกับคุณหมอไชยไม่เจ็บเลย คุณหมอมือเบามากพูดจาน่ารัก พี่ผู้ช่วยก็น่ารักคุยเล่นกับคุณหมอทำให้เราไม่เครียดค่ะ เดี๋ยวจะพาลูกหลานไปใช้บริการอีกแน่นอนค่ะ
0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.author: SuperPloy 1991
0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.en: Getting my teeth cleaned by Dr. Chai was painless. He has a very gentle touch and is very kind. The assistant was also lovely and chatted with the doctor, which made the experience very stress-free. I will definitely bring my family and friends back for treatment again.

0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.text: พาแฟนมาฟอกสีฟันแบบZoom ขาวใน45นาที หมอใจดีไม่ดุ ผู้ช่วยน่ารัก ที่นี่เป็นกันเองมาก ใครฟันเหลือง กินชากาแฟ แนะนำให้มาทำค่ะ ราคาไม่แรง เห็นผลตั้งแต่แรกเลย❤️
0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.author: Natkritta Paenkaew
0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.en: I brought my boyfriend to get Zoom teeth whitening done in 45 minutes. The dentist was kind and not harsh, and the assistants were lovely. The atmosphere here is very friendly. If you have yellow teeth from drinking tea or coffee, I recommend coming here. The price isn't too high, and you'll see results from the first few times! ❤️

0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.text: ดัดฟันที่นี่คือฟันเข้าไวมากๆคุณหมอไม่เลี้ยงไข้ ใจดีพูดจาน่ารัก ล่าสุดได้ถอดเหล็กแล้ว และได้ทำ รีเทนเนอร์ทีนี่ด้วยคือประทับใจ รีเทนเนอร์สวยมากกก💖🫶🏻

0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.en: The orthodontic treatment here is incredibly fast; the doctor doesn't prolong the treatment unnecessarily, is kind, and has a lovely way of speaking. I recently had my braces removed and also got my retainer made here, which I'm very impressed with. The retainer is so beautiful! 💖🫶🏻

0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.text: เคยมาทำฟันที่นี้ 2-3รอบ วันนี้มาทำรีเทรนเนอร์ พี่หน้าเคาเตอร์น่ารักเป็นกันเองมากค่ะ คุณหมอใจดีน่ารักมาก คลินิคสะอาด เดินทางสะดวก โดยรวมดีมากค่ะ
0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.author: May koan
0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.en: I've been here for dental work 2-3 times before. Today I came for a retainer. The staff at the counter were very nice and friendly. The dentist was kind and lovely. The clinic is clean and easy to get to. Overall, it's very good.

0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.text: คลินิกสะอาดตกแต่งน่ารัก คุณหมอมือเบามากส่วนพี่ๆพยาบาลก็น่ารักโดยเฉพาะพี่ที่อยู่หน้าเคาน์เตอร์น่ารักเป็นกันเอง ที่สำคัญราคาไม่แพงค่ะ
0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.en: The clinic is clean and cutely decorated. The doctor is very gentle, and the nurses are lovely, especially the one at the counter who is friendly and welcoming. Most importantly, the price is affordable.

0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.text: หมอพูดจาแย่มากค่ะที่ไปหาชั้นแรกค่ะหมอผู้ชาย ถ้าหมอควบคุมอารมตัวเองไม่ได้กับเด็ก ก็ต้องบอกตั้งแต่ที่ไปติดต่อทำฟันนะคะว่าไม่รับเด็กทำฟันกับเด็กไม่ได้ค่ะ ถามอะไร ก็หงุดหงิด พูดมาได้ไงค่ะ ถ้ากลัวก็ไม่ต้องต้องถอน แค่ถามว่าถ้าถอนเยอะน้องจะเป็นอันตรายไหมค่ะเพราะไม่เคยพาน้องมาทำฟันเลยค่ะแทนที่จะบอกกับเราดีๆค่ะแล้วก็พูดอีกว่าถ้าไม่ไหวแนะนำให้ไปโรงพยาบาล ถ้าคุณหมอ ไม่อยากทำให้เด็กก็ควรบอกตั้งแต่ทีแรกค่ะ เสียตังไม่เท่าไหร่ เสียความรู้สึกมากค่ะ😢
0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.en: The doctor I went to on the first floor, a male doctor, was terrible. If a doctor can't control their emotions with children, they should have said from the start that they don't treat children. He was irritable with every question and said something like, "If you're scared, you don't have to have the tooth extracted." I was just asking if a lot of extractions would be dangerous for my child, as I'd never brought my child to the dentist before. Instead of answering nicely, he said, "If you're not comfortable, I recommend going to the hospital." If the doctor didn't want to treat the child, he should have said so from the beginning. It's not about the money, but the feeling of being treated badly. 😢

0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.text: รวดเร็วแต่...เตือน ส่วนตัวมองว่าไม่เหมาะกับเคสของผู้ใหญ่ไม่ผ่าน เพราะมีรายละเอียดที่ต้องระวังเยอะ ครับ
0x30e2bf824c2368f5_0x50f76c626f38bf98.en: Quick, but... a word of warning. Personally, I don't think it's suitable for adult cases that might not pass because there are many details to be careful about.

0x30e29fff2b8f70fd_0x5f881d8a023cafda.text: The clinic only accepts patients with appointments, so it's not crowded, the interior is very bright and clean, and the facilities are well-equipped, so you can come for treatment with peace of mind. There is also a dedicated parking space just a 1-2 minute walk away, so coming by car is no problem. However, as staff only speak Thai, it is not recommended for those who do not speak the language.
0x30e29fff2b8f70fd_0x5f881d8a023cafda.author: Shinichi Hoshi

0x30e29fff2b8f70fd_0x5f881d8a023cafda.text: คุณหมอพูดเพราะมากค่ะ ไปครั้งแรกก็ประทับใจเลย ถึงจะอ้าปากให้หมออุดฟัน ก็แอบยิ้มเวลาหมอชมว่าเก่ง พนักงานก็พูดเพราะยิ้มแย้ม บริการดีมากค่ะ

0x30e29fff2b8f70fd_0x5f881d8a023cafda.en: The dentist was very kind. I was impressed from my first visit. Even though I had my mouth open for the filling, I couldn't help but smile when the dentist complimented me on how skilled I was. The staff were also polite, smiling, and provided excellent service.

0x30e29fff2b8f70fd_0x5f881d8a023cafda.text: 1790 baht for 25 minute clean, would not return again. I have and better dental clean else in Thailand.
0x30e29fff2b8f70fd_0x5f881d8a023cafda.author: Stefan Lucas

0x30e29fff2b8f70fd_0x5f881d8a023cafda.text: ปกติไม่รีวิวอะไรเลย แม้จะแย่แค่ไหน แต่ครั้งนี้แย่มากจริงค่ะ ไปขูดหินปูนร้านนี้ ครั้งแรกและครั้งเดียวเลย เห็นว่าใกล้ๆเลยนัดแล้วไปเลยไม่ได้ดูรีวิว 1 ไปถึงตรงเวลา แต่ต้องนั่งรอไป35 นาที ถ้าไม่มีคิวว่างไม่ต้องรับนัดน่าจะดีกว่า จะได้ไม่เสียเวลา 2 ครั้งนี้ใช้สิทธิประกันสังคม 900 บาท โดยเจ้าหน้าที่ไม่มีแจ้งราคาว่าที่นี่ขูดหินปูน1,500+290 บาท ที่อื่นที่ดีๆกว่านี้ราคาไม่overขนาดนี้ ปกติ800-1000 ในคุณภาพเดียวกัน 3. ที่นี่มีค่าบริการ290 บาท ไม่รู้บริการอะไร สรุปขูดหินปูนราคา 1790 บาทถ้วน ใช้สิทธิประกันสังคมแล้วยังจ่ายเพิ่มไปอีก 890 บาท 4 คุณหมอมือหนักมาก ขูดหินปูนที่ฟันแต่รู้สึกได้ว่าเครื่องมือมันไปขูดที่เหงือก และไม่ใช่เผลอโดน มันโดนหลายทีและมีเลือดออกทั้งตอนบ้วนน้ำและเสร็จแล้วเช็ดมาก้อมีเลือดซึม ไม่ว่าหมอจะรีบหรืออะไรก้อแล้วแต่ ไม่ok สุดท้าย ไม่ต้องปรับปรุงก้อได้นะคะ เพราะคงไม่ไปอีกแล้ว
0x30e29fff2b8f70fd_0x5f881d8a023cafda.author: Nuri Int
0x30e29fff2b8f70fd_0x5f881d8a023cafda.en: I usually don't review anything, no matter how bad it is, but this time was truly awful. I went to this clinic for teeth cleaning, my first and only time there. I saw it was nearby, so I made an appointment without checking the reviews. 1. I arrived on time, but had to wait for 35 minutes. If there are no available slots, it's better not to accept appointments to avoid wasting time. 2. This time I used my social security benefit of 900 baht. The staff didn't inform me that teeth cleaning cost 1,500 + 290 baht. Other better clinics don't overcharge like this. Normally, 800-1000 baht for the same quality work. 3. There's a 290 baht service fee, I don't know what it's for. In total, the teeth cleaning cost 1790 baht. Even with my social security benefit, I still had to pay an additional 890 baht. 4. The dentist was very heavy-handed. While cleaning my teeth, I could feel the instrument scraping against my gums, and it wasn't accidental. It happened multiple times, and there was bleeding both when rinsing and after wiping it clean. Whether the dentist was rushing or whatever, it was not okay. Finally, you don't need to improve anything, because I won't be going back again.

0x310295aeaa1cb735_0x63f530482be47050.text: The doctor spoke nicely, but the staff were impolite and seemed to belittle the patients. I think I'll only go there once.
0x310295aeaa1cb735_0x63f530482be47050.author: นนท์ สับระเบิด

0x3054f11adb97d81b_0x72cb43ddda033c6e.text: “As a traveler, I was so relieved to find this clinic. They speak English fluently, the service is fast, and the doctor is very professional. I felt safe and well taken care of. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Samui!”
0x3054f11adb97d81b_0x72cb43ddda033c6e.author: Kanyakron Payakum

0x3054f11adb97d81b_0x72cb43ddda033c6e.text: Tried to take our sick kids there at 11am and it still wasn't open at 11:10am. Called their phone number. No answer. No sign on the door. It's a disgrace for a medical clinic to be unreliable like this
0x3054f11adb97d81b_0x72cb43ddda033c6e.author: Kieran Francis

0x305197a839be31ab_0xb5cd0a4e8b85f5e2.text: My experience getting filler injections for my penis with Dr. Beer was painless. This is my third time getting it done. The first time I drove to Phuket because Dr. Beer was only in Krabi for one day. Dr. Beer is very friendly and gives great advice. He solves the problem directly, solving all my sexual problems for sure. There are always interesting promotions. I've spent hundreds of thousands of baht and still haven't gotten to touch it, but I guarantee that if I come back often, it will be as big as my arm! 🥰🥰 P.S. I recommend the Flore Max 1400 brand. It's painful but worth it. And another thing, the Step 2 filler is really good. The doctor gave me a sachet to try, and I saw great results, using it 5-6 times a day, and it was fully erect every time.
0x305197a839be31ab_0xb5cd0a4e8b85f5e2.author: Police Gamer

0x305197a839be31ab_0xb5cd0a4e8b85f5e2.text: I was very impressed. I traveled from Songkhla for my first filler injection. The doctor gave excellent advice, they provided lunch, and on my way back, clinic staff even gave me a ride to the bus station.
0x305197a839be31ab_0xb5cd0a4e8b85f5e2.author: Waranyoo Thepla

0x305197a839be31ab_0xb5cd0a4e8b85f5e2.text: I was very impressed. The doctor explained everything in detail, spoke kindly and was friendly. The place was convenient, clean, and the nurses provided excellent service.

0x305197a839be31ab_0xb5cd0a4e8b85f5e2.text: I was very satisfied with the service. The doctor gave excellent advice and recommendations. The doctor and nurses were very friendly.
0x305197a839be31ab_0xb5cd0a4e8b85f5e2.author: Yossak LeeDee

0x30da3064b34c765d_0xa2d664268c16d3fe.text: I was very impressed. I felt so relaxed after the treatment. The staff were very attentive and friendly. The service was excellent, the rooms were clean, and the staff were polite, cheerful, and always smiling. I will recommend this place to my friends and family.
0x30da3064b34c765d_0xa2d664268c16d3fe.author: Nungruthai Autsasan

0x30da3064b34c765d_0xa2d664268c16d3fe.text: I was impressed with my experience here. The staff were attentive and provided good advice. The shop is spacious, comfortable, clean, and a pleasant place to use.

0x30da3064b34c765d_0xa2d664268c16d3fe.text: The service was excellent. All the staff were lovely. The BT (Bio-Treatment) team did a great job, and the doctor was also very nice. I was very impressed.

0x30da3064b34c765d_0xa2d664268c16d3fe.text: The staff were so lovely and polite. The facial massage was excellent. I was extremely impressed!

0x30da3064b34c765d_0xa2d664268c16d3fe.text: The clinic is clean, the staff are polite, and they provide excellent advice and service.

I went from looking like a panda to a normal person 😂 I highly recommend it. The price is reasonable, and the doctor and staff are lovely 😍 It's conveniently located not far from the Ganesha landmark in Huai Khwang! …

0x30e29f2b92c571d3_0xd2abad9266531533.text: I'm very impressed with the nasolabial fold filler. It has boosted my confidence every day and I feel it was a worthwhile investment in myself. For anyone who is hesitant, I want to say that the doctor is experienced and uses high-quality fillers, so you can be confident that you'll be happy 💙 …

0x30e29f2b92c571d3_0xd2abad9266531533.text: I had Botox and fat dissolving injections for over a month now, and I haven't seen any results. The clinic didn't provide any follow-up. They didn't even let me see the medication during the injection; it was already mixed in the vial. I basically wasted money and suffered pain for nothing.
0x30e29f2b92c571d3_0xd2abad9266531533.author: Nattaya Jaisuedee

0x30da2534d5c55f4f_0xbe8cf54ed204bb52.text: The clinic is beautiful and clean, the equipment is new, the prices are affordable, and the service is excellent.
0x30da2534d5c55f4f_0xbe8cf54ed204bb52.author: puttarat cho

0x30da34041ae5815f_0xbd7efd102e9f9bcf.text: I can't say whether I was impressed or disappointed. Many times when I've been there, the wait times are long due to the large number of patients, which I understand. However, some staff members, quite a few, speak impolitely. Their answers are unclear, they point in the wrong direction, and when I ask again, they get irritated. But on my most recent visit, I was very impressed with the nurse at desk 2 (the one in the green uniform) who took my medical history. She spoke clearly and explained things clearly. Even during lunchtime, when many others were on break, this nurse still came to desk 4 to process my referral form. I had waited a long time, but she tried her best to get it done, speaking in a respectful tone and explaining everything to me. I understood and felt much better after the long wait; I wasn't angry at all about the wait. I've encountered this nurse two or three times before, and each time she's been consistently kind. 🙏🙏 I sincerely commend her.
0x30da34041ae5815f_0xbd7efd102e9f9bcf.author: teeraporn kongkaew

0x30da34041ae5815f_0xbd7efd102e9f9bcf.text: When we first went in, we thought the nurses spoke loudly and were a little startled. But after going several times and opening our minds, we realized they just tend to speak loudly. We encountered many of them, but we saw that they also have their good points of speaking. We used the antenatal care and delivery rooms, and we completely overlooked the loudness. They provided excellent care and were very attentive to patients. Even though we were only using our government health insurance, we thought it was great. Thank you to all the nurses and doctors. We and your family are very grateful. 🙏🙏
0x30da34041ae5815f_0xbd7efd102e9f9bcf.author: Tiop Hiup

0x30da34041ae5815f_0xbd7efd102e9f9bcf.text: The service was terrible, and the staff were quite unpleasant. The emergency room was incredibly slow. There are signs indicating the patient types and colors, and the waiting times are stated, but when I took my mother, she was classified as green, meaning she expected a 2-hour wait (if I remember correctly). However, we waited for 3 hours. We initially went around noon, unsure if it was dengue fever, as my mother had a high fever and was in pain. We went to room number 10, where they said the doctor wasn't there (only in the mornings). So, we took my mother to an outside clinic, costing 400 baht. When we presented the clinic's result – confirming dengue fever – we returned to room number 10, only to be made to wait outside the emergency room for another 3 hours. Then, they told us to go to room number 13 for a blood test. I don't understand why we needed another blood test when we already had a certificate from the clinic. And they said the doctor wasn't there (only in the mornings), but it was almost 6 PM when we went for the blood test, and the doctor was still there. It was very confusing. Why make us waste time going to the clinic and then coming back again? And the staff were very rude. The emergency room staff... I noticed that the elderly man was alone and had no relatives, so he seemed unaware of the situation. Instead of speaking in a polite tone, they spoke rudely to him, yelling. I felt sorry for him. I hope the hospital owner reads this and can improve the service, especially the speed of service.
0x30da34041ae5815f_0xbd7efd102e9f9bcf.author: ANCHALEE SELEE

0x30da34041ae5815f_0xbd7efd102e9f9bcf.text: Very bad. The nurses are foul-mouthed and work very slowly. There was a car accident and a broken bone. It took 3 hours for the wound to be treated. I waited in front of the wound dressing room, but no one paid attention for the entire 3 hours. When I went for an X-ray, the bones kept hitting me from one angle to another. They even used my bed to hit the door to get into the X-ray room. When the cast was put on, the doctor didn't know how to put it on. He wrapped my finger so tightly that it was squeezed by the cast. My finger was crooked and hurt so much. I had to come to another hospital to have the cast removed. It's really bad. The hospital that removed the cast said that they definitely don't know how to put it on, so they put it on like this. Another thing that's suspicious about the hospital where I had the cast changed is that they didn't explain how to care for the cast and didn't explain anything to me. I wasn't the only one who experienced this. That's all I'll say. When I got in the rescue vehicle, the rescuers told me to go somewhere else because this place was slow. But I really couldn't take it anymore, so I chose this one. In the end, I waited for more than 3 hours, and it was the most torturous 3 hours for me at a hospital that shouldn't be a hospital.
0x30da34041ae5815f_0xbd7efd102e9f9bcf.author: Sirasit Ball

0x30da34041ae5815f_0xbd7efd102e9f9bcf.text: This is the worst hospital experience in my life, the nurse is very bad even though I went to the emergency room. The nurse just chitchating and ignored the patient, when the aircons is too cold (they asked me is it cold, I said yes and then they say of course the air con is cold and just let it go). Then when they need the Pee sample, one of the male nurse using a wheelchair and take me to the bathroom and open the door, then he pressuring me to speed up. So I can’t give them a lot of the pee sample, and after that I felt like I need to pee, so I asked the nurse to go to the toilet. All of the nurse scolded and yelled at me that I already gave them the sample, why need to go to toilet again, so i told them the guy was pressured me so i cant, the they started making fun of me because of that. And also me in my coma, with pneumonia one of the nurse told my mother that, if i die should they do heart pumping or let me die. And last thing is the injection they all the nurse just chitchatting and saying they hate their jobs and they just being rude, because it is government hospital so all the process they did to me is very painful that I almost cried. Worst experience, not exaggerated and not recommended for patients who expecting good medical service here.
0x30da34041ae5815f_0xbd7efd102e9f9bcf.author: Pongrapee Supateerawiwat

0x30da34041ae5815f_0xbd7efd102e9f9bcf.text: Today, I took my child to the emergency room because he was crying so hard he was vomiting up a lot of milk, and he seemed to have mucus in his throat and was crying nonstop. When I arrived at the emergency room, I told the nurse at the front desk that it was normal and to go to room 10 if I was uncomfortable. After I finished, an elderly nurse came in to take a medical history and ask about his condition, but her words were so rude that it's unacceptable to live this long. She then went into the emergency room while my child was still crying nonstop and vomiting again. Then a nurse shouted, "My child has had this problem too. I'm 5 now and I'm fine," and she looked displeased at the child's crying. When I left the room, the nurse at the front desk said the doctor needed to come, but she didn't know when he would come, or if she wasn't comfortable, she could go to another hospital. **** I want to ask, if you were the child of one of those nurses, would you bring your own child here for treatment? Are the hospital personnel untrained? How did they graduate? If they knew what to do or knew what was wrong with your child, they wouldn't have come to the doctor. If they had come, they wouldn't have encountered such foul-mouthed people.
0x30da34041ae5815f_0xbd7efd102e9f9bcf.author: Sukanya S

0x30da34041ae5815f_0xbd7efd102e9f9bcf.text: On September 23, 2025, two of my friends were in a car accident and waited outside the emergency room. One friend was seriously injured, while the other had minor injuries. The less injured friend was treated first and even treated rudely, while the seriously injured friend had to wait a long time. Even just a "slight" movement resulted in the doctor scolding them – I'm baffled how someone with such behavior could be a doctor. Furthermore, because the doctor was treating the seriously injured friend's wounds painfully, they cried, and just a slight cry resulted in the doctors in the room ganging up and scolding them, calling them "ugly." I'm so confused. Was they poorly raised or is it just their personality? And this wasn't the first time the doctors behaved like this. While waiting for my injured friend, I saw a doctor kick a patient out because they wouldn't lie down. That patient politely asked if they could sit, but the doctor just kicked them out and refused to treat them. It was a terrible experience. If I had other hospital options, I would never go to this one.
0x30da34041ae5815f_0xbd7efd102e9f9bcf.author: Sita

0x30da34041ae5815f_0xbd7efd102e9f9bcf.text: Hi View, I honestly didn't want to give any stars, but I have to give one because of the comments. #EmergencyRoom Hang Dong Hospital Terrible. 0x311d65a8fbfde89b_0x4f18bb31f7824958.text: ปกติผมเป็นลูกค้าประจำของที่นี่ เลยรู้สึกผิดหวังกับเหตุการณ์ครั้งนี้มาก ผมโทรนัดล่วงหน้าไว้ 1 วัน และก็มาตามเวลาที่นัด แต่พอมาถึงหน้าคลินิก พนักงานกลับแจ้งว่าคุณหมอลงเวรไปแล้ว ทั้งที่ไม่มีใครโทรมาแจ้งหรือแจ้งล่วงหน้าเลยสักนิด ทางหน้าคลินิกบอกว่าคนที่อยู่เคาท์เตอร์เมื่อวานกับวันนี้เป็นคนละคนกัน เลยไม่มีการโทรแจ้ง ?? เสียทั้งเวลา เสียความรู้สึก หวังว่าคลินิกจะปรับปรุงเรื่องการนัดหมายและการแจ้งลูกค้าให้ดีกว่านี้ เพราะเหตุการณ์แบบนี้ไม่ควรเกิดขึ้นกับลูกค้าท่านอื่น
0x311d65a8fbfde89b_0x4f18bb31f7824958.en: I'm usually a regular customer here, so I'm very disappointed with this experience. 0x311d65a8fbfde89b_0x4f18bb31f7824958.text: ทำฟันปลอมที่นี่(สาขาเลียบคลองสอง) ไปให้หมอปรับให้เพราะใส่แล้วไม่พอดีเคี้ยวไม่ได้หมอบอกทำให้เป็นครั้งสุดท้าย..ครั้งสุดท้ายคือไปครั้งแรกแต่หมอบอกไม่ปรับให้อีกแล้ว..คือต้องทนใส่แบบมีปัญหาไป..ปัดความรับผิดชอบแบบนี้ก็ได้หรอคะคุณหมอ...หน้าเคาท์เตอร์หน้าตาเหวี่ยงตลอด ควรปรับปรุงมากๆๆๆ แย่สุดๆ

My son had a piece of metal stuck in his mouth, almost tearing off some flesh, but the counter staff had absolutely no customer service professionalism. They refused to cut the metal and told us to go home and come back on Monday. I was so confused. My son was in so much pain, he couldn't swallow, and the pain extended to his throat, but they insisted they couldn't do it right away. I had to call and beg them repeatedly until they finally agreed to schedule a visit. I'm extremely disappointed with this branch. Basically, we came to the doctor for treatment, but we got an answer like they were just telling us to go home and come back later.

0x30e2a29fc44374b5_0x753b60ef6fcc3773.text: I went for treatment before because IHM Thonburi said they changed their treatment system and I had to use my existing insurance coverage. My insurance is here, so this was my first time using their service. I saw a female doctor with glasses and short hair. I went for treatment for eye pain. The doctor shone a flashlight for less than a second and said, "I'll give you some eye drops." I told her my right eye hurt constantly and watered all the time. The doctor said, "Okay, let me check again," and shone the flashlight again, saying, "It looks like there's a slight inflammation. I'll give you some antibiotic eye drops." I asked if I could also get artificial tears to use when my eyes were dry. The doctor said, "I already gave you antibiotics." I then asked if I could buy them outside, and the doctor said, "If you have the budget," then you can. 😳 - I said I felt like I had phlegm all the time and asked if I could get some medication. The doctor said, "5 baht per pill, how many do you want?" I said 100 baht. The doctor said, "Okay, 20 baht, I'll get it for you." And I also said my hand hurt and felt numb all the time when I drove, held a pen, or used a cutting board. The doctor asked what I did for work. I said I sell ice cream and drive back and forth every day. The doctor said, "Medication won't cure it. The only way to get better is to quit your job." 😳 My God, what a doctor's answer! I understand that what the doctor said is true, but there were other ways to say it that would make the patient feel better. I wanted to post this today to encourage the doctor to improve their communication with patients. Even though we used the 30-baht healthcare scheme, we have the right to it because we pay taxes, and we should be able to use that right. This is probably why people prefer private hospitals, clinics, or self-medicating. Because the Thai healthcare system is terrible. And those who are struggling, the poor, if they get sick and need treatment, and receive it like this, they just have to endure it. P.S. I gave 3 stars because the clinic was clean and the service was quick. But the quickness might be because the examination was just a quick glance, and I'm sure I wasn't the only one who experienced this, because according to other reviews, others have had similar experiences.
0x30e2a29fc44374b5_0x753b60ef6fcc3773.author: Hay Day

0x30e2a29fc44374b5_0x753b60ef6fcc3773.text: I paid 150 baht for a medical certificate and it took an entire hour and a half. In my 57 years of life, I've never encountered such a slow service. I've always gotten medical certificates in less than 20 minutes. I was 23rd in line, but people 24-27 cut in front of me, got their medicine, and went home. Meanwhile, I waited another hour. When the doctor called me, they used a stethoscope twice in the back and once in the front, and the examination took less than a minute. Then I waited another 30 minutes. There were three people at the counter: one playing on an iPad, two scribbling on paper, and one in a nurse's uniform constantly dispensing medication and signing documents. The other two were just sitting around playing. Instead of coordinating, they were all working. My process was very easy; I just signed twice, received my envelope, and went home. But all the work was done by the nurse dispensing medication alone. It was a terrible experience. I've never experienced an hour and a half of waiting like this. I didn't check reviews about the long wait times; I thought I'd seen clinics this backward in Bangkok before. It was the worst experience ever – paying for an hour and a half, while people who didn't pay cut in line and finished first. Does a system this backward still exist in the world? I can already predict the future of those two people sitting around; they'll never see any progress. The doctor's clinic is terrible. The person running it is short-haired and wears glasses. Only one person is actually working; the rest are just sitting around. At 10 am, they order food from 7-Eleven and wait to eat. Eating is fast, but the work is incredibly slow. Anyone passing by the clinic can guess there's nowhere to go that will improve. Many reviews complain about the slow service, but they don't seem to care about fixing it. How have they managed to stay in business? May they only encounter misfortune in life.
0x30e2a29fc44374b5_0x753b60ef6fcc3773.author: Phisit Thavornvatanapong

0x30e2a29fc44374b5_0x753b60ef6fcc3773.text: Since the doctor changed from a male doctor to a female doctor with short hair and glasses, the treatment here has become significantly slower. And it's not even a slowness in the sense of a thorough examination; it's just slow in a way that we don't understand what's causing the delay. Even with few patients, it takes an extremely long time to be called into the examination room. Once inside, the doctor only asks a few questions, and then you have to wait again. However, other staff members work relatively quickly. Regarding the new referral system, you can only request referral slips on Mondays and Tuesdays, and only 3-7 days before your appointment. I don't know if other clinics operate this way, but please improve it. People in other professions also need to earn a living. When I arrived at the clinic after 3:30 PM, the staff and doctor told me to come back the next day, even though the sign says it closes at 6 PM. They told me to leave because they needed time to clear paperwork. Some people have to take time off work to come here to get referral slips; some are elderly and can barely walk. Coming here each time isn't easy and involves expenses. Please consider and improve this.
0x30e2a29fc44374b5_0x753b60ef6fcc3773.author: Benjamas Wanphosob

0x30e2a29fc44374b5_0x753b60ef6fcc3773.text: The service is terrible. I used to bring my girlfriend here for treatment, but I won't be bringing her anymore. I'd rather spend my money at a clinic that provides better treatment. The treatment is shoddy, getting a referral letter is difficult, and the service is poor. How is the doctor with short hair and glasses even a doctor? Since this doctor took over, this clinic has been a complete disaster. Don't even think about coming here. The doctor is more rude and aggressive than the nurses. They use polite language like "ka" and "kha," but their tone, words, and actions make you not think they're doctors at all. Before, waiting times for examinations and paperwork were reasonable, but now it's incredibly slow. Who is in charge of this clinic? They need to inspect this clinic immediately. We're here to use our benefits as we should. Don't claim you're tired. If you're so tired, maybe reorganize the work system. If you're not ready to provide good service, don't be in this profession. And during my visits, I didn't behave disrespectfully towards the doctor or nurses, yet I had to experience this. I'm very disappointed.
0x30e2a29fc44374b5_0x753b60ef6fcc3773.author: Her LoTHric

0x30e2a29fc44374b5_0x753b60ef6fcc3773.text: I've never been here before. When I arrived, I read the instructions and tried to follow them, but I had to double-check with the nurse. The staff here are incredibly rude and have unpleasant expressions. I understand they might be tired, but if they chose this job, they should speak more politely. Patients are already suffering enough from their illnesses and symptoms; to have to deal with such behavior is unacceptable. If everyone had financial choices or the option to choose a hospital, they wouldn't come here because the service is truly terrible. I've seen many negative reviews, but I never expected this. The same goes for the doctors. I saw reviews mentioning pills costing [amount] baht each, and I didn't expect to encounter that. Please improve your attitude and smile a little; we're all fellow Thais.
0x30e2a29fc44374b5_0x753b60ef6fcc3773.author: พรีเมี่ยม วีไอพี

0x30503754c736de77_0x71060360cc5a2803.text: We were looking for our daughter's first preschool (1.6 years old) while wintering in Thailand. 0x30da2512576cf195_0xcf818e259847ce37.en: Today I went to get a brace removed because it was poking my cheek. Honestly, I walk past this place every day and trusted them to cut off the excess brace. The brace was poking me, so I went to get it removed. I couldn't go to my usual place because it's far away, so I went to a clinic in a mall. I thought it would be better, but the result was they dislodged my bracket. Two doctors worked on it. The first doctor, probably a female student nurse, took quite a while. She had me open my mouth, turn to the left, and used pliers to pry it open. When she finished, she asked if there was any more, and I said yes because the sharp brace was still poking me. Then the male doctor came in and said the bracket had come loose. He asked if I had done it myself or when it came loose, and the female doctor replied, "It didn't come loose before the procedure." So that means it came loose while they were working on it. I paid for it; it wasn't free. There was no apology, and they didn't even ask if I had dislodged it myself. Wouldn't I have noticed if it came loose?

0x30e2a2ee88448b1f_0x1a11f26eed8e7f1f.author: Naphob Kattiyasuwong
0x30e2a2ee88448b1f_0x1a11f26eed8e7f1f.en: To the person using the name "secret secretzone": Please provide the full name of the patient you claim to have, and a medical certificate stating that the illness resulted from the dental service. If the claims are true, the clinic will gladly take responsibility. Regarding the claim of "throwing something into the patient's throat," what does that mean? Patients are not under general anesthesia during dental procedures. If there were any foreign objects, the patient would be immediately conscious. It's impossible for someone to intentionally throw something into another person's throat. Concerning the sterilization of instruments, the clinic uses a standard autoclave that meets all requirements of the Medical Council (as shown in the actual photos used in the clinic) and is registered annually according to Ministry of Public Health standards. You can inspect this at the clinic anytime. Finally, to the person using the name "secret secretzone," if you and the patient you claim to have existed, and the illness described did occur and can be proven to have been caused by the dental service, with an official certificate from the treating physician, the clinic will gladly take responsibility. Please contact us. However, if the claims cannot be proven, the clinic considers them baseless and unsubstantiated accusations, especially since the accuser is too afraid to reveal their face and real name. The clinic reserves the right to pursue legal action to the fullest extent. For your information. Rak Fun Dental Clinic

I'm relieved that I can visit the dentist whenever I have a problem (Saturdays only). Finding a clinic I like for dental implants isn't easy, but I finally found one... 0x30e29fe11e8801c3_0x7f0d8716183ad25e.text: I had my dental implants done with Dr. Panumas about 2-3 years ago. Most recently, I went in today to have a replacement implant adjusted because it was slightly spaced out, allowing food to easily get trapped. Dr. Panumas replaced the implant free of charge, without any additional fees. The clinic is clean and located in the M Tower office building. The rooms are spacious and comfortable. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone reading this review. It's a one-time payment with excellent after-sales service. Plus, it's run by a single doctor who is a highly qualified medical professor, and they use the latest X-ray equipment. There are no hidden extra charges. If you're interested, you can try calling Dr. Panumas directly. She's very kind and gives great advice.

0x30e29fe11e8801c3_0x7f0d8716183ad25e.text: The clinic's atmosphere was excellent. The doctor was very professional, and the assistants were all lovely and well-prepared. 0x30e29d2b6aaa1923_0x160f5ce6f5ed0462.text: คุณหมอมือเบา พูดจาเพราะมากๆ พยาบาลบริการดีคะ ไปถอดฟันมา หมอถามตลอดเจ็บมั้ย ปวดรึเปล่า ฟันหลุดไปยังไม่รู้สึกอะไรเลย เจ็บเเค่ตอนฉีดยาชานิดเดียวว

0x30e29d2b6aaa1923_0x160f5ce6f5ed0462.text: วันนี้ไปถอนฟันช่วงเวลาบ่ายโมงกว่าฯค่ะ พอถึงเวลาถอนคุณหมอก็ฉีดยาชาให้ แล้วถึงเวลาถอนเหมือนคุณหมอจะใช้เวลานานพอสมควรก็ถอนไม่ออกแล้วคุณก็ได้เอาเครื่องมือมาเจาะเหมือนให้มันมีที่จับฟัน จะได้ดึงฟันง่ายขึ้น นี้เป็นครั้งแรกกับการถอนฟันที่น่ากลัวมากเลยค่ะ เข็มที่เป็นตัวเจาะหลุดออกมากระเด็นลงที่ลิ้นแล้วกำลังจะล่นลงคอดิฉันรีบยกมื้อขึ้นขออนุญาตบ้วนปาก เพราะตอนเเลกคิดว่าคุณหมอถอนฟันออกแล้วฟันกะเด็นออกมา แต่ที่ไหนได้เข็มค่ะฉันตกใจมาก ตอนที่บ้วนปากออกมาเจอเข็มเพราะถ้าเกิดมันหลุดลงไปแล้วจะเป็นยังไงมันจะไม่ติดที่คอฉันเหรอฉันตกใจบอกหมอว่าคุณหมอทำไมมีเข็มค่ะมันจะติดคอฉันแล้วนะคุณหมอบอกว่าไม่ติดหรอกค่ะกำลังจะดูออกค่ะฉันงงมากเลยค่ะไม่ขอโทษแล้วยังจะไม่ยอมให้ฉันลุกบ้วนปากฉันต้องจำใจยอมให้หมอถอนฟันต่อโดยที่ใจยังกลัวแหละระแวงไปหมด รีบจ่ายตังค์รีบออกมาเพราะกลัวมากเลยค่ะหมอพุหญิงนะค่ะอยากให้คุณหมอรอบคอบตระหนักนึกถึงคนไข้ให้มากกว่านี้นะค่ะ
0x30e29d2b6aaa1923_0x160f5ce6f5ed0462.author: สรัญญา ครึ้มค้างพลู
0x30e29d2b6aaa1923_0x160f5ce6f5ed0462.en: I had a tooth extracted around 1 PM today. The dentist gave me a local anesthetic, and then it took quite a while. She couldn't pull the tooth out, so she used a tool to drill a hole, creating a grip on the tooth to make it easier to extract. This was my first time having a tooth extracted, and it was terrifying! The needle used for drilling came loose, landed on my tongue, and was about to go down my throat. I quickly raised my hand to rinse my mouth because I initially thought the tooth had just come loose. But it was the needle! I was so shocked. When I rinsed my mouth, I saw the needle and wondered what would happen if it had gotten stuck in my throat. I told the dentist, "Doctor, why is there a needle? It's going to get stuck in my throat!" The dentist said, "It won't get stuck, I was just about to see." I was so confused. She didn't apologize and wouldn't let me rinse my mouth. I had to reluctantly let her continue, still terrified and apprehensive. I quickly paid and left because I was so scared. This was a female dentist. I wish dentists would be more careful and considerate of their patients.
