0x311d7e1c399849fd_0xe4a07949a2afce10.text: As patient, I really appreciate the good service and care at this clinic. The staff are kind, respectful, and supportive, and the treatment process is handled professionally. For me, this is something you can find only in Thailand. I’m grateful for the care and support I received here. Highly recommended.
0x311d7e1c399849fd_0xe4a07949a2afce10.author: arun verma

0x311d7e1c399849fd_0xe4a07949a2afce10.text: Namu Win was the one dispensing the medication. I'm confused as to how he's allowed to dispense medication to patients. He also spoke very rudely.
0x311d7e1c399849fd_0xe4a07949a2afce10.author: Punch Phawita

0x30e28ffa9ff7142f_0x3f119f00dfe85453.text: The staff were friendly and helpful, but I personally liked that they were pushy about selling courses. It annoyed me and made me not want to use their services again.
0x30e28ffa9ff7142f_0x3f119f00dfe85453.author: qeanyawn

0x30e28ffa9ff7142f_0x3f119f00dfe85453.text: The manners were extremely poor; their demeanor and emotional intelligence were completely lacking at this clinic.
0x30e28ffa9ff7142f_0x3f119f00dfe85453.author: Bayachun Punchen

0x30e2a3ca4f625661_0x5901237565db9ff3.text: วันนี้มาขูดหินปูนคุณหมอและพี่ผู้ช่วยบริการดีมาก คลินิครับประกันสังคม หมอทำดี no overprice ค่ะ
0x30e2a3ca4f625661_0x5901237565db9ff3.author: eve Arisa
0x30e2a3ca4f625661_0x5901237565db9ff3.en: Today I came for a teeth cleaning and the dentist and assistant provided excellent service. The clinic accepts social security insurance. The doctor did a good job and the price wasn't overpriced.

0x30e2a3ca4f625661_0x5901237565db9ff3.text: คุณหมอพูดจาดีให้คำปรึกษาเรื่องฟันดี แต่ราคาแพงเกินไปมาก แค่ดูฟันหน้าซี่เดียวและให้คำปรึกษาไม่เกิน10นาทีคิดราคา 230 บาท ถ้าคิดสัก100 จะไม่ว่าเลยถือว่าค่าน้ำยาบ้วนปากค่าทำความสะอาดเครื่องมือ
0x30e2a3ca4f625661_0x5901237565db9ff3.author: Mink659
0x30e2a3ca4f625661_0x5901237565db9ff3.en: The dentist was polite and gave good advice about my teeth, but the price was excessively high. Just examining one front tooth and giving a consultation for less than 10 minutes cost 230 baht. I wouldn't mind if it were 100 baht, considering the cost of mouthwash and cleaning the instruments.

0x30e28250baf0e3e3_0x34ad1a5fb3d4ef76.text: เคยอุดฟันตอนร้านยังอยู่ที่เก่า ร้านใหม่เพิ่งเข้ามาขูดหินปูน ร้านใหม่ สะอาด คุณหมอให้คำแนะนำดี สะดวกกว่าที่เก่า เพราะมีที่จอดรถ ให้บริการ
0x30e28250baf0e3e3_0x34ad1a5fb3d4ef76.author: Nopparat Inmorn
0x30e28250baf0e3e3_0x34ad1a5fb3d4ef76.en: I had fillings done when the clinic was at its old location. The new clinic recently opened for teeth cleaning. The new clinic is clean, the dentist gave good advice, and it's more convenient than the old one because it has parking.

0x30e28250baf0e3e3_0x34ad1a5fb3d4ef76.text: คุณหมอชำนาญการและเก่งมากเลยค่ะ เป็นห่วงและดูแลคนไข้ดีมากด้วยค่ะ ขอบคุณคุณหมอมากค่า
0x30e28250baf0e3e3_0x34ad1a5fb3d4ef76.author: Kiranaphak Bunnag
0x30e28250baf0e3e3_0x34ad1a5fb3d4ef76.en: The doctor is very skilled and experienced. They are also very caring and attentive to patients. Thank you very much, doctor!

0x30e28250baf0e3e3_0x34ad1a5fb3d4ef76.text: มาอยู่แถวนี้ได้3-4 ปี ใช้บริการขูดหินปูน ที่นี้ตลอดทั้งแต่ร้านเก่า ถือว่าโอเคมากๆ
0x30e28250baf0e3e3_0x34ad1a5fb3d4ef76.author: Thammanoon Duangporn
0x30e28250baf0e3e3_0x34ad1a5fb3d4ef76.en: I've lived in this area for 3-4 years and have been getting my teeth cleaned here ever since the old shop. It's been great.

0x30e28250baf0e3e3_0x34ad1a5fb3d4ef76.text: เป็นร้านทำฟันที่แปลกมาก ผมไปขูดหินปูน แต่ไม่มีการให้บ้วนน้ำยาฆ่าเชื้อก่อนเริ่มขูดหินปูน การขูดหินปูนเป็นไปด้วยความรีบเร่ง งงมาก
0x30e28250baf0e3e3_0x34ad1a5fb3d4ef76.author: saravut intharit
0x30e28250baf0e3e3_0x34ad1a5fb3d4ef76.en: This is a very strange dental clinic. I went for a teeth cleaning (tartar removal), but they didn't give me an antiseptic rinse before starting. The tartar removal was done in a hurry. Very confusing.

0x30e28250baf0e3e3_0x34ad1a5fb3d4ef76.text: จะเปลื่ยนยางทีนัดคิวยากมาก ถ้าเลื่อนต้องรอคิวหมอเป็นเดือนๆ ไม่รู้ลูกค้าเยอะหรือหมอไม่ค่อยอยู่ ใครจะจัดฟันที่นี่คิดดีๆ
0x30e28250baf0e3e3_0x34ad1a5fb3d4ef76.author: Eemmi
0x30e28250baf0e3e3_0x34ad1a5fb3d4ef76.en: Getting an appointment to change your braces' rubber bands is extremely difficult. If you reschedule, you have to wait months for the doctor. I don't know if there are a lot of patients or if the doctor is rarely available. Anyone considering getting braces here should think carefully.

0x30e2a2bf2ba39447_0xad23b6da338313f8.text: Dentist was great. But, the service were bad. I was trying to appointment for my braces and she is saying thing without manner. Poor service
0x30e2a2bf2ba39447_0xad23b6da338313f8.author: Fyssle

0x30e2a2bf2ba39447_0xad23b6da338313f8.text: บริการไม่ดีแย่ตั้งแต่หน้าเคาเตอร์ยันหมอพูดจาไม่ดีใส่ครับ ผมว่าเป็นสถานบริการควรจะบริการดีๆนะครับ พยาบาลบริการแย่สุดๆ ขนาดคนไข้เป็นคนต่างชาติอ่านภาษาไทยไม่ได้ให้พยาบาลช่วย พยาบาลที่ดูแลไม่ช่วยแถมพูดจาแย่ๆ ส่วนหมอก็พอตรวจก็ถามทําไมไม่ไปทําฟันปลอมที่เก่าทําไมมาทําที่นี่ หมอก็ตรวจลวกๆเหมือนไม่อยากทํางานอะครับ แย่ตั้งแต่เคาเตอร์ยันหมอ ผมว่าคนไข้ก็จ่ายตังมาทํานะครับไม่ใช่เดินมาขอทําฟรีๆนะครับ ทําไมแย่ขนาดนี้? ถ้าทําให้ดีๆไม่ได้ก็อย่ามาบริการดีกว่าครับ โดนดูถูกตั้งแต่เคาเตอร์ พูดตามความจริงไม่ใส่ไข่นะครับ
0x30e2a2bf2ba39447_0xad23b6da338313f8.author: Lontaldo hahaha
0x30e2a2bf2ba39447_0xad23b6da338313f8.en: The service was terrible, starting from the counter to the doctor who spoke rudely. I think a healthcare facility should provide better service. The nurses were the worst. Even when a foreign patient who couldn't read Thai asked for help, the nurse who was attending to them refused and spoke rudely. As for the doctor, during the examination, she asked why I didn't get my dentures done elsewhere, why I came here. The doctor examined me carelessly, as if she didn't want to work. It was terrible from the counter to the doctor. I think patients pay for this service; they're not asking for it for free. Why is it so bad? If you can't provide good service, you shouldn't be providing it. I felt insulted from the counter onwards. This is the absolute truth, no exaggeration.

0x305031f9d1a41a45_0xcfba3e1910e4b768.text: I've been receiving treatment at Dr. Hongrat's clinic for a long time. The doctor is lovely, and provides excellent treatment, consultations, and advice. The clinic staff are also very polite and provide great service. If you're looking for a skilled obstetrician's clinic in Phuket, I highly recommend Dr. Hongrat's. You won't be disappointed!
0x305031f9d1a41a45_0xcfba3e1910e4b768.author: Suchada Aupparee

0x305031f9d1a41a45_0xcfba3e1910e4b768.text: The doctor provided excellent service; they treated me like family. The service at the reception counter was also outstanding.
0x305031f9d1a41a45_0xcfba3e1910e4b768.author: Paravee P.

0x3050319420583931_0x132f2ff05d581e68.text: 10/10 for the appointment, ultrasound, and examination, we paid 1,000 baht, and the service was a million times better than all the other Thai hospitals we've been to. My wife was very happy to have found this doctor; she's very considerate and pleasant. I highly recommend her.
0x3050319420583931_0x132f2ff05d581e68.author: Динмухаммед Кабдуллаев

0x3050319420583931_0x132f2ff05d581e68.text: This is my second prenatal visit. My first pregnancy was a C-section, and the scar is very smooth and not raised at all. The ultrasound examination was very thorough, and the care was excellent. I highly recommend them.
0x3050319420583931_0x132f2ff05d581e68.author: Bim rapeephan

0x3050319420583931_0x132f2ff05d581e68.text: Everything was good, okay, but the front desk staff brought Northeastern Thai sausages to eat in the air-conditioned room, and it smelled terrible. It felt like a fresh market. 🤮 …
0x3050319420583931_0x132f2ff05d581e68.author: Gavyn Don

0x3050319420583931_0x132f2ff05d581e68.text: This is the worst clinic I've ever been to. The doctor did a very superficial examination with just a quick glance, and there were no medications available for visual inspection. Isn't 400฿ an excessive fee?
0x3050319420583931_0x132f2ff05d581e68.author: Sureehcay Changkid

0x3050319420583931_0x132f2ff05d581e68.text: It's terrible. They're only interested in the money and don't provide any special care. Even when a loss occurred, they didn't come to be there, even though we were receiving prenatal care from them.
0x3050319420583931_0x132f2ff05d581e68.author: Rtn Y

0x30da252fb151d58d_0xfbe723f049bc0e6.text: This place is good. They don't force you to pay and give you a free after-check. Very good. I recommend The Face Clinic.
0x30da252fb151d58d_0xfbe723f049bc0e6.author: เพ็ญศรี ก้อนปัญญา

0x30da252fb151d58d_0xfbe723f049bc0e6.text: The wait was very long. The queuing system was terrible. The clinic had cobwebs on the ceiling and wasn't very clean.
0x30da252fb151d58d_0xfbe723f049bc0e6.author: ปราณปรียา บัวสงค์

0x30da252fb151d58d_0xfbe723f049bc0e6.text: No long-term results. The effects returned to normal less than a month after the injection. The room smelled strongly of food and was unclean. The staff were preoccupied with their phones and sat on the customer lounge while customers were present.
0x30da252fb151d58d_0xfbe723f049bc0e6.author: Phacharawat Bossini Yawichai

0x30e2854cd3b16f6d_0x370427e18b1c0ea5.text: แนะนำทำที่นี่เลยค่ะ ดีมาก ประทับใจตั้งแต่พนักงานต้อนรับ พูดจาน่ารัก เป็นกันเองมาก ❤️ คุณหมอประเมินและแนะนำการดูแลฟันดีมาก ทำฟันรวดเร็วและมีความเชี่ยวชาญค่ะ ส่วนผู้ช่วยดูดน้ำลายเก่งมาก 💯/10 !! 🥹 ระหว่างทำฟันไม่สำลัก ไม่กลืนน้ำลายเลย มีความชำนาญและตั้งใจดูดกว่าหลายๆที่ที่เราเคยไปทำอีกค่ะ ชื่นชมมมม 🙏🏻🩷
0x30e2854cd3b16f6d_0x370427e18b1c0ea5.en: I highly recommend this clinic! It's excellent. I was impressed from the moment I arrived; the receptionist was very friendly and polite. ❤️ The dentist provided a great assessment and advice on dental care. The procedure was quick and the dentist was highly skilled. And the assistant was incredibly efficient at suctioning saliva 💯/10!! 🥹 I didn't choke or swallow saliva during the procedure. They were more skilled and meticulous than many other places I've been to. Kudos to them! 🙏🏻🩷

0x30e2854cd3b16f6d_0x370427e18b1c0ea5.text: บริการเป็นกันเอง คุณหมอใจดีมีการแนะนำที่ตรงจุด บัตรทอง/บัตร30บาท สามารถใช้สิทธิ์ทำฟันที่นี่ได้ แนะนำครับ
0x30e2854cd3b16f6d_0x370427e18b1c0ea5.en: The service is friendly, the doctor is kind and gives helpful advice. You can use your universal healthcare card/30-baht card for dental treatment here. Highly recommended.

0x30e2854cd3b16f6d_0x370427e18b1c0ea5.text: ร้านนี้คิดยิบย่อยจนเต็มไปหมด ค่าปลอดเชื้อ ค่า นู่นนี่นั่น คิดอิรุงตุงนังไปหมด เหมือนขอทาน เมื่อเทียบกับร้านอื่นไม่ใช่แบบนี้
0x30e2854cd3b16f6d_0x370427e18b1c0ea5.en: This shop charges for everything in such a complicated way. Disinfection fees, this and that – they charge for everything haphazardly, like beggars. Compared to other shops, it's not like this at all.

0x30e29e55aa2480ef_0x2b07c0a2084d2630.text: I came here for a cavity treatment. I had another appointment after the treatment, so I was short on time and asked for a rush appointment, but I'm grateful for the excellent service. I was also impressed by the way you pointed out the locations of teeth that are at risk of cavities and explained how to prevent them.
0x30e29e55aa2480ef_0x2b07c0a2084d2630.author: Yusuke Taba

0x30e29e55aa2480ef_0x2b07c0a2084d2630.text: My dentures broke, so I had them remade by a denture specialist. They fit surprisingly well and feel much more comfortable than before. I plan to ask them for denture treatment again in the future. Their kind and polite Japanese made the treatment very reassuring. Thank you for preparing my insurance claim form.
0x30e29e55aa2480ef_0x2b07c0a2084d2630.author: Yamadera Kazuhiko

0x30e29e55aa2480ef_0x2b07c0a2084d2630.text: The doctors and staff at Fukumori were all very kind, so I was able to receive treatment with peace of mind. They also handled my insurance claim free of charge, which was very helpful!
0x30e29e55aa2480ef_0x2b07c0a2084d2630.author: Linlin Tan

0x30e29e55aa2480ef_0x2b07c0a2084d2630.text: They provided all the support for insurance applications free of charge, which was extremely helpful! I'm grateful for the kind support provided by the Japanese staff. …
0x30e29e55aa2480ef_0x2b07c0a2084d2630.author: 一慶奈良

0x30e29e55aa2480ef_0x2b07c0a2084d2630.text: Experienced dentists and staffs. Cozy atmosphere for kids. Highly recommend for everyone!!
0x30e29e55aa2480ef_0x2b07c0a2084d2630.author: ZestiriaPiTE (パイト)

0x30e29e55aa2480ef_0x2b07c0a2084d2630.text: This was a truly awful teeth cleaning experience. Because the receptionist was Japanese and it was a dental clinic with a Japanese name, I felt more confident and booked the appointment. The Japanese staff told me the service would cost 1200-1500 Thai Baht. When I arrived at the clinic, a Thai female dentist examined my teeth and then told me they were very dirty (of course, dirty teeth need cleaning), requiring special tools and charging 2000 Thai Baht. I agreed while already in the cleaning chair. After the cleaning, I didn't feel like they used any special tools; it was the same process as my teeth cleaning in Hong Kong. That evening, when I brushed my teeth, I found some stains that hadn't been removed. I was absolutely furious! I had to write this down because I was ripped off and didn't even get my teeth cleaned properly.
0x30e29e55aa2480ef_0x2b07c0a2084d2630.author: Jack Chan

0x30e29e55aa2480ef_0x2b07c0a2084d2630.text: They charged me 2500B even though nothing was fixed. The first time, they did something to keep the crown in place, but it fell out in two days. The second time, they quoted me 70,000B just for the estimate, but charged me 1000B without doing any treatment.
0x30e29e55aa2480ef_0x2b07c0a2084d2630.author: はさみや8338

0x30e29e55aa2480ef_0x2b07c0a2084d2630.text: I was charged 3,000 baht just for tartar removal. When I was billed, it was changed to periodontal disease treatment, which increased the fee. I never mentioned periodontal disease during or after the treatment... …
0x30e29e55aa2480ef_0x2b07c0a2084d2630.author: 石田ジュンイチ

0x3102b9386d9b6a4b_0xf5831771f273c64a.text: รีวิวถอนฟันคุดคลินิกคุณหมอ ไปถอนเมื่อวาน จะมีอาการปวดและเจ็บประมาณ 3 ชั่วโมงแรก พอกินยาแล้วดีขึ้น วันนี้ใช้ชีวิตได้ปกติแล้วนะคะ ไม่เจ็บเลยกินข้าวได้ปกติ ตอนแรกกลัวมากก่อนจะไปถอน ไปถอนออกแล้ว 2 ซี่ เหลืออีก 2 ซี่ ไม่กลัวแล้วค่ะ เดี๋ยวเดือนหน้าจะไปเอาออกให้หมด ตอนถอนก็เจ็บพอทนได้ คุณหมอมีประสบการณ์ใช้เวลาถอนไม่นาน แถมราคาถูกซี่ละ 700 บาทเหมือนฟันปกติ ปลื้มค่ะ เดี๋ยวจะแนะนำเพื่อนๆต่อให้นะคะว่าคลินิกนี้ทำดี ส่วนตัวแนะนำให้เพื่อนไปจัดฟันกับคุณหมอ 1 คนแล้วค่ะ ตอนนี้เพื่อนทำได้เดือนที่ 3 จากฟันที่้เบี้ยวเข้าข้างในตอนนี้ฟันนางออกมาแล้วนางปลื้มค่ะ เป็นกำลังใจให้คุณหมอนะคะ✌️❤️
0x3102b9386d9b6a4b_0xf5831771f273c64a.en: Review of wisdom tooth extraction at the doctor's clinic: I had my wisdom teeth extracted yesterday. There was pain and soreness for about 3 hours first, but it improved after taking medication. Today I'm able to live normally and eat without any pain. I was very scared before the extraction. I've already had two removed, and there are two more to go. I'm not scared anymore! I'll have the rest removed next month. The extraction was bearable, the doctor is experienced, and it didn't take long. Plus, it was cheap at 700 baht per tooth, the same price as a normal tooth. I'm very pleased! I'll recommend this clinic to my friends. I've already recommended one friend to get braces from this doctor. She's now in her third month, and her teeth, which were crooked inwards, are now straight, and she's very happy. Keep up the good work, doctor! ✌️❤️

0x3102b9386d9b6a4b_0xf5831771f273c64a.text: รีวิวแบบไม่อวย โดยส่วนตัว ขอหมอถอน4ซี่ (แต่ขอ2-3ครั้งหมอถึงจะให้555 เพราะกลัวกินข้าวไม่ได้ พอได้ถอนก็กินไม่ได้จริงๆ แต่ไม่ถึงขั้นแบบระบม ก็ยังอ้างปากกินโจ๊กได้ ไม่ได้ปวดแผล แต่น่าจะจากการดึงฟันมากกว่า หมอใช้เวลาถอนไวมากๆ ราคา ไม่สร้างบ้านได้ 🤣🤣
0x3102b9386d9b6a4b_0xf5831771f273c64a.en: An unbiased review. Personally, I asked the dentist to extract 4 teeth (but it took 2-3 requests before he finally agreed, lol, because I was afraid I wouldn't be able to eat. And after the extractions, I really couldn't eat, but it wasn't to the point of being severely sore. I could still open my mouth and eat porridge. The wound wasn't painful, but it was probably from the tooth extraction itself. The dentist extracted them very quickly. The price? You could build a house with that money! 🤣🤣

0x3102b9386d9b6a4b_0xf5831771f273c64a.text: ขอแชร์ประสบการณ์ส่วนตัวค่ะ เผื่อจะช่วยให้คนอื่นตัดสินใจก่อนเข้ารับบริการ เรามีอาการปวดและอักเสบมากหลังจัดฟันจนต้องถามคลินิกว่าควรไปโรงพยาบาลไหม เพราะมีเลือดออกตลอด แต่สิ่งที่ได้รับคือคำตอบแบบสั้น ๆ ไม่ใส่ใจ และให้ถอนอย่างเดียวโดยไม่ได้ตรวจหรืออธิบายสาเหตุเพิ่มเติม ในแชตยังมีการตอบว่า ‘ไม่ถูกกว่านี้หรอก 😁’ ซึ่งค่อนข้างทำให้รู้สึกไม่เหมาะสมกับสถานการณ์ที่คนไข้กำลังกังวลและเจ็บมาก พอถามเหตุผลหรือทางเลือกอื่น ก็ได้แต่คำว่า “ต้องถอนออกจ้ะ ไม่งั้นก็เป็นแบบนี้ตลอด” โดยไม่มีคำแนะนำเพิ่มเติม ไม่มีการประเมินจากภาพ ไม่มีความพยายามอธิบายว่าทำไม หรือมีวิธีรักษาอื่นก่อนถอนหรือไม่ การสื่อสารลักษณะนี้ทำให้รู้สึกว่า ไม่ได้รับความใส่ใจ ไม่ได้รับข้อมูลครบถ้วน และไม่สบายใจอย่างมาก อยากให้คนที่กำลังหาคลินิกพิจารณาให้ดี และหวังว่าทางคลินิกจะพัฒนาการตอบคำถามคนไข้ รวมถึงการให้ข้อมูลที่เหมาะสมและเคารพความกังวลของคนไข้มากกว่านี้ค่ะ
0x3102b9386d9b6a4b_0xf5831771f273c64a.en: I'd like to share my personal experience to help others make an informed decision before seeking treatment. I experienced severe pain and inflammation after getting braces, to the point where I had to ask the clinic if I should go to the hospital because of constant bleeding. However, I received a short, indifferent response, and they simply recommended extraction without any further examination or explanation of the cause. In the chat, they even responded, "It wouldn't be any cheaper than this 😁," which felt inappropriate given my anxiety and pain. When I asked for reasons or alternative options, I only received: "It has to be extracted, otherwise it will continue like this." There was no further advice, no assessment based on images, no attempt to explain why, or whether there were other treatment options before extraction. This type of communication made me feel neglected, uninformed, and extremely uncomfortable. I want those looking for a clinic to consider this carefully, and I hope the clinic will improve its approach to answering patient questions, providing more appropriate information, and respecting patients' concerns.

0x311d6071fb565375_0xd4fd8e30e369f920.en: Are there any negative stars? Anyone thinking of getting braces at Trust Clinic Samut Prakan, RAVE!!!! Actually, I didn't get my braces done here, but the doctor who handles my cases moved here. Before, at the old clinic, there were never problems with waiting for hours like this. At most, it was half an hour or so. I had an appointment with the orthodontist at 6 PM. I arrived before 6 PM to be one of the first in line. The staff said the first slot was at 6 PM. So I walked around and waited until 6:15 PM. They didn't call, so I went to the clinic to ask. The staff said the doctor was still working on the 5 PM appointments. So I went for another walk, walking around the mall once. At 7 PM, the staff called, saying it was almost my turn. At 7:10 PM, they called my name and said I was the next in line. After that, I just sat and waited. They called 5-6 other people, but it was never my turn. At 7:33 PM, I decided to go home. Their queue management is terrible, and it just keeps getting worse. 0x311d6071fb565375_0xd4fd8e30e369f920.en: Terrible!!! I once waited in line for a full 3 hours. The management is awful. They schedule so many patients every day, wasting so much time. Plus, the doctor is dragging out the treatment; it's been over 4 years and the braces still aren't finished. I had to ask the doctor myself if my teeth were in place before they'd tell me that I could actually take the braces off and wear a retainer. (So, if I hadn't asked, they would have just kept scamming me for money??) It's awful. Usually, the doctor just comes to adjust the braces and doesn't mention any problems or changes to my teeth at all. They don't tell me anything; I have to ask myself. P.S. 1: Once the treatment is done and I get up from the chair, the doctor is gone! I've been going there for over 4 years and I don't even remember what the doctor looks like anymore. Terrible. If I could give 0 stars, I would. 👎🏻👎🏻 P.S. 2: The braces come off so easily! Once, after getting them adjusted, I sat down to eat a slice of bread and the braces came off in less than an hour. Just from eating bread! 🤔 P.S. 3: I'm not sure what material the retainer is made of, but it's incredibly difficult to clean. I clean it morning and evening, and the stains still won't come off, even though my friend's retainer from another clinic cleans the white stains off easily.

0x311d6071fb565375_0xd4fd8e30e369f920.en: Anyone thinking of going here because of the cheap promotion, don't bother. There's nothing good about it. The dentist schedules appointments way too frequently, twice a month. The equipment comes loose easily, and they schedule tons of procedures, charging for everything. If you're unavailable or have other commitments, they'll make a fuss. They only care about collecting money from the patient. They never explain what they're doing during the procedure. After 7 months, there's been almost no change, just more expenses beyond the promotional package. They keep wanting me to get a tooth lift, fillings, and scaling. I don't understand why they keep adding fillings when I already had them done at another clinic before. They did it so quickly, like they just touched the tooth with a tool, practically nothing. Then they scheduled scaling even though I just had it done 4 months ago. The scaling was done very quickly because there wasn't much tartar left since I just had it done; they just wanted to charge me more. I advise anyone considering going here to stop. Go to another clinic. My personal experience is that I feel terrible.

0x30e299b4a391921f_0x2baeee78abef3473.text: Trying to understand if a doctor is truly skilled and can cure all diseases... but is it really true that they can cure every disease? How many diseases has the doctor specialized in? -The doctor speaks very softly, causing confusion and suspicion in the patient. When asked questions, the doctor accuses the patient of interrupting or arguing. (Is there something wrong with the doctor?) -The doctor doesn't prescribe medication. Is this genuine goodwill, or is something abnormal? -If the clinic doesn't have the medication, the doctor tells the patient to buy it themselves. Very confusing. -If the doctor can't treat the patient or doesn't have the medication, why not refer them to a hospital? -The doctor only seems to refer patients when surgery is required. -The doctor acts like a pharmacist. Wouldn't it be better for the patient to go to a pharmacy? What's the point of coming to see a doctor? -The patient is allergic to medication, even after being informed, the doctor still prescribes the same medication. -The ointment for bruises, etc., that the patient previously received from the hospital/pharmacy (even with the same universal healthcare coverage), is not dispensed, claiming it's off-list. -The patient presented an appointment slip to request a referral (even though the illness is different), but the doctor refused, making excuses to avoid it. Even worse, the doctor said the hospital issued the appointment slip to prolong the illness. (This is all I can think of) - There are problems with the NHSO regarding per-patient fees and reimbursement, yet they criticize patients for wasting budget. - Requesting a referral letter takes a very long time, regardless of the number of patients. The worst part is they can't even issue a referral letter. - Regarding hygiene, if I could rate it, I'd give it a 4 out of 10. Is all this what the NHSO's concern for Thai people is?
0x30e299b4a391921f_0x2baeee78abef3473.author: Green S.

0x30e299b4a391921f_0x2baeee78abef3473.text: I had a stroke and collapsed in the bathroom. I went to a doctor here, and they referred me to the central hospital. Initially, things seemed fine, but later they stopped referring me to the central hospital, saying I had all my medication. I told them I had an appointment for a blood test for anemia, but they refused, saying it wasn't a big deal if one patient recovered. I wanted to know my results, but they wouldn't take my blood sample, saying it was only needed once a year. I went to the central hospital, and Dr. Sukij wanted me to get a blood transfusion because I was fatigued and anemic, according to my blood test results. But the clinic doctor said it wasn't necessary. They wouldn't listen to my explanations. It's like they're not giving their all; they seem like they're not 100% committed, like they're bottling up their frustrations. It would be better to revoke their license and stop them from practicing medicine. They lack ethics. Also, the bathroom is unclean; every time I go, there's no cleaning staff, and they don't even dare buy toilet paper for patients. A medical certificate costs 200 baht, which isn't cheap for a job application. Toilet paper is 20 baht, and there's no bathroom service. There's accumulated wound cleaning waste, and dust on the shelves in the cardiac examination room. It's clearly unhygienic. Finally, the clinic owner is the worst. They spoke rudely to a patient who was wearing perfume, saying in front of them that it made them dizzy and nauseated. You work in customer service and are highly educated, but your attitude is condescending towards others, including your patients. We've switched to a new clinic and will not recommend it to anyone. We will no longer use the Pracha 4 Yaek Lan Luang clinic. The owner is bad, the doctor is bad, but the service staff are good.
0x30e299b4a391921f_0x2baeee78abef3473.author: Palinee Pa

0x30e299b4a391921f_0x2baeee78abef3473.text: Many years ago, I went there for the first time and saw an elderly doctor. He said it was gonorrhea and it cleared up in less than a month. But the second time, treatment lasted for months! Each visit cost 700-800 baht, and I went almost 10 times before it finally cleared up. I later found out that Doxycycline, costing 50-60 baht a pack, clears up in less than a month! It felt like I had to keep getting medication. The last time, my genitals swelled up with blisters. After a month of treatment, it didn't get better; in fact, it got worse. It was excruciating. When I asked what it was, they always just said gonorrhea. I couldn't take it anymore and decided to go to Siriraj Hospital. That's when I learned it was herpes! Wow! The doctors at Siriraj were excellent; they gave me medication, and I recovered in two weeks. When I tried to get my medical records from here to show the doctors at Siriraj, a female staff member became loud and refused to give me my information. That was enough to know I was done with this place. If you have a sexually transmitted disease, go to a large hospital or a Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) public health center near your home. That's the real deal; there are no tricks involved.
0x30e299b4a391921f_0x2baeee78abef3473.author: Traveler at Southern

0x30e299b4a391921f_0x2baeee78abef3473.text: Doctors should take care of their mental health too. Speaking softly and asking the same questions repeatedly is unacceptable. I was speaking and my mask slipped down slightly, then he yelled at me, "Why are you taking your mask off? Wearing your mask not above your nose counts as taking it off!" He repeated this three times. I apologized, but he still wouldn't stop. He said, "If I didn't ask you, you shouldn't speak." And what I wanted to say, I couldn't because I wasn't asked. In short, who's sick and using their government health insurance for treatment? That's my tax money. If it's so tiring and difficult, don't be a doctor.
0x30e299b4a391921f_0x2baeee78abef3473.author: Jenjira Tiyanon

0x30e29dbe04687d49_0xaabd9ea991600a1c.text: ปกติไม่เคยเขียนรีวิวเลยนะ ไม่ว่าจะดีหรือแย่ แต่ครั้งนี้มันไม่ไหวจริงๆ อยากเตือนทุกคนค่ะ ว่าไม่แนะนำให้ไปใช้บริการค่ะ เราอยู่ต่างประเทศ จะกลับไทยสองถึงสามปีครั้ง ตัดสินใจไปทำรีเทนเนอร์เมื่อเดือนสิงหาคม ตอนนี้กลับมาต่างประเทศแล้ว ปรากฏว่ารีเทนเนอร์บิ่น พยายามติดต่อไปให้โอนเงินคืนมาหรือไม่ก็ให้เครดิตไว้สำหรับรอบหน้า (ซึ่งไม่รู้ด้วยว่าคลินิกจะยังเปิดอยู่มั้ย เพราะตอนเราไปทำ ไม่เคยเห็นมีคนไข้มารอซักคน) ไม่รับผิดชอบใดๆทั้งสิ้นค่ะ บอกต้องเอากลับไปซ่อม คือเราต้องซื้อตั๋วเครื่องบินอีกเจ็ดหมื่นเพื่อไปซ่อมรีเทนเนอร์ชิ้นละ 2,000 เหรอ ถ้ามันนานเราเข้าใจว่า แต่นี่เราพึ่งทำมาเดือนเดียว มันก็ยังไม่ควรจะชำรุดใช่มั้ย หาว่าเราทำตกด้วย แต่ถึงจะทำตก รีเทนเนอร์มันก็ไม่มีทางแตกหักง่ายๆ นอกจากรถจะทับ! (เราเป็นลูกค้ากับทางคลินิกมานาน และรู้จักพี่ผู้ช่วย เค้ายังไม่รับผิดชอบเลยค่ะ) ตอนเราตัดสินใจทำ เรายอมจ่ายแพงคู่ละ 4,000 บาท (เพราะเคยทำรีเทนเนอร์เมื่อสามปีที่แล้ว ทนทานและดีมาก) ทั้งๆที่ถ้าทำที่อื่นๆจะตกคู่ละ 2,000 นิดๆ ใครยังไม่เคยเป็นคนไข้ หาคลินิกอื่นค่ะ ใครเป็นคนไข้เก่า ก็ย้ายค่ะ คลินิกดีๆมีความรับผิดชอบมีเยอะค่ะ
0x30e29dbe04687d49_0xaabd9ea991600a1c.author: JIJA COOKING
0x30e29dbe04687d49_0xaabd9ea991600a1c.en: I usually never write reviews, whether good or bad, but this time it's just too much. I want to warn everyone: I do not recommend using their services. I live abroad and only return to Thailand every two to three years. I decided to get retainers made in August. Now that I'm back abroad, my retainer is chipped. I tried to contact them to get a refund or credit for my next visit (which I don't even know if the clinic is still open, because when I went, I never saw any patients waiting). They refused to take any responsibility whatsoever. They said I had to send it back for repair. Do I have to buy another 70,000 baht plane ticket just to get a retainer repaired for 2,000 baht each? I understand if it takes a long time, but I only got it a month ago. It shouldn't be damaged yet, right? They even claimed I dropped it. But even if I dropped it, a retainer wouldn't break that easily unless a car ran over it! (I've been a customer of the clinic for a long time and know the assistant, but they still wouldn't take responsibility.) When I decided to get them made, I paid 4,000 baht per pair (because I had retainers made three years ago that were very durable and good). Other places would cost around 2,000 baht per pair. If you haven't been a patient with them yet, find another clinic. If you're a returning patient, you can switch to another clinic. There are many good, responsible clinics out there.

0x30e29fc0b64f55d5_0x92e8a346f1e0633f.text: (Please read to the end for guidance for those considering this service. I've explained every step so it will be helpful for everyone.) ❤️ From someone who just had the vacuum extraction service yesterday, I can say it wasn't as scary or painful as I thought. It was like menstrual cramps, just a tight, heavy feeling. The procedure (the suction part) probably took less than 5 minutes. Before the procedure, the doctor's words helped to alleviate my stress and anxiety, which was great. The doctor explained everything to me throughout the process. Thank you! (P.S. The assistant who administered the anesthesia also chatted with me, asking where I was from, which was very relaxing.) I thought it would be more painful, but it was much less than I expected. 🙏🏻 As for the procedure itself, it's quite long because there are many steps involved (I recommend eating beforehand). I went on a Saturday, and my case took 4 hours to complete because there were 3 patients ahead of me. My appointment was at 2:40 PM, but I arrived at 2:00 PM. (It's okay to arrive early so you can get a queue number, have your blood pressure checked, and be allowed to drink water beforehand to relieve yourself and hold your urine once for the ultrasound.) After the ultrasound, the assistant will draw blood to check blood concentration. Then, drink 2 liters of water until your urine is clear. Once it's clear, urinate and take a picture to show the counter staff (this step takes quite a long time; you'll drink 2 liters until your stomach is bloated). After taking the picture of your clear urine, wait to be called for a sarong to change into. Drink one bottle of electrolyte solution (available for purchase at the clinic). After drinking the electrolyte solution, you'll receive a set of medication, about 5 pills. The medication is quite strong, so it's recommended to eat beforehand (this whole process takes 3 hours). Around 5:00 PM, the counter staff started calling people to go up to the 3rd floor. However, there weren't just people getting the procedure done; there were also those picking up medication and likely those getting ultrasounds. We went up to the 3rd floor around 5:40 PM (it's recommended to bring a bag to put your underwear, sanitary pads, and tissues in). We were called into the room around 6:00 PM. The doctor will have you urinate again before getting on the table. After that, they'll administer anesthesia and perform the procedure. After it's finished, you'll change back into the underwear you came in. That's it. (The assistant will take pictures of the ultrasound before and after the procedure with your phone.) I sat and waited while the assistant explained the various effects and post-procedure self-care guidelines. I scanned the remaining payment upstairs and then went down to go home… P.S. All the staff, including the doctor, were very kind and polite. No one was rude or aggressive. I was very impressed. Just following the procedures makes it easy. I was very scared during the 4 hours I spent in the clinic before the procedure; my heart was racing. But after it was over, everything felt so relieved. Thank you so much. (If you're driving, I recommend parking at Center One mall and walking across the pedestrian bridge. It's not far.) That's all I wanted to share about my experience. I hope it's helpful for everyone. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
0x30e29fc0b64f55d5_0x92e8a346f1e0633f.author: Jai Dee

0x30e29fc0b64f55d5_0x92e8a346f1e0633f.text: I give it 5 stars! The nurses all worked incredibly hard. Cases finished at 1 or 2 AM – they were amazing! The doctor explained everything well and followed the procedures. If the patient wasn't feeling well, they wouldn't force them, demonstrating professionalism and a gentle touch. 📍Recommendations from my actual experience📍 - I recommend arriving on time for your appointment to avoid long waits. - Park at Center One mall and remember to get your parking ticket stamped; it's 30% cheaper than not stamping it. - I recommend bringing someone with you in case they need to buy water or food. But if you must go alone, I recommend preparing everything you need: water, snacks, sanitary pads, charging cable, power bank. - Wearing a dress is easiest; you don't need to change, just put on a sarong for the quickest process. - I recommend eating a little before taking the medication (after the ultrasound) otherwise you might vomit because the antibiotics can irritate the stomach. - Smelling salts, balm, and a warm jacket are must-haves. - The wait is quite long, depending on the previous cases. If a case can't be performed, the nurses will ask you to wait. So, it might not be as quick as you'd like, so be patient and don't complain. - Drink plenty of water throughout the procedure. Dehydration can prevent the procedure from being performed. - If you have a panic attack and experience symptoms before the procedure, the doctor will monitor your symptoms and may recommend whether or not to proceed. - It depends on the patient's decision, but medication may be recommended instead (medication is 95% effective, vacuum suction is 100% effective). - Total cost is 4,500 baht (300 baht deposit, 4,200 baht payable after the procedure). - The procedure isn't scary. There will be a strange tingling sensation in the lower abdomen, some slight discomfort, and a dull ache, but it's not excruciatingly painful. Those who have had surgery before will be able to mentally prepare themselves. - There's no blood splatter, it's not scary. The room is bright, clean, and odorless. The atmosphere is like a typical clinic, not gruesome. - The nurses are very helpful from start to finish, providing excellent advice and care. 📍Finally, for everyone who goes through with this procedure, please don't blame yourselves. Just going through the procedure already makes you feel unwell, there's no need to blame yourself and add to your negative feelings. Live your life to the fullest and be cautious. Take vitamins and supplements, keep your body healthy, do good deeds to find peace of mind but don't let it become a sin. Do everything you want to do, and encourage yourself a lot. ✌🏻 Hopefully, this review will help many people.
0x30e29fc0b64f55d5_0x92e8a346f1e0633f.author: Kayu

0x30e29fc0b64f55d5_0x92e8a346f1e0633f.text: This might be helpful for those deciding whether to get medication 💊 - I got two faint lines on the pregnancy test (tested twice). - I added the clinic's LINE account, consulted, and booked an appointment to pick up medication in the morning, finishing almost at noon 🕝 - The clinic is very cold, so bring a jacket 🥶 - Upon arrival, register, fill out your medical history, and have your blood pressure checked. - Drink enough water to feel the urge to urinate, then hold it in (do not urinate). There's a reason why you need to drink a lot of water and hold your urine during the ultrasound. Try searching for the reason on the internet. - The staff called me up to wait on the 3rd floor. - I went in for the ultrasound with the doctor. - The doctor was kind and explained things well. If you're unsure, you can search the doctor's name online. They are a real gynecologist 👨🏻‍⚕️ - The ultrasound didn't show anything clear, it was very small. The doctor let me decide whether to wait another month for another ultrasound or to get the medication now. ⚠️ You'll sit and talk with the staff here to test your ability, knowledge, and understanding to see if you've read and understood the information. ⚠️ The staff at this point are quite strict, even a bit stern. It's like a Thai language teacher ready to hit you with a stick at any moment if you answer wrong, too slowly, or don't answer the question directly or to the point. You shouldn't beat around the bush; answer directly, concisely, and to the point. Don't stress. Be patient, we'll get through this. ⚠️Pay for medication, add the LINE account for the support team while using medication. ⚠️We recommend watching the doctor's videos, videos about potential side effects, and information about the medication thoroughly until you understand it. -Going home 🏡 I have one child already and raise him/her 24/7. I understand the exhaustion. My child just started school, and I was about to go back to work, but this baby came at a time when I wasn't ready, so I decided to terminate the pregnancy. I have to accept what happened, but I shouldn't blame myself. Is it sin? Does it really exist? It would be a huge sin if the child had to be born and I couldn't raise them. Being able to raise them well means not just raising them day by day. Regarding the post-medication review, I don't know yet because I haven't taken it, but it will probably be painful, but I can handle it. P.S. Everyone shouldn't blame themselves. Everyone makes mistakes, and I won't make the same mistake again because it's a good lesson. Hang in there! ❣️
0x30e29fc0b64f55d5_0x92e8a346f1e0633f.author: Meyou

0x30e29fc0b64f55d5_0x92e8a346f1e0633f.text: I had an appointment for 7:10 PM and arrived about 20 minutes early. The procedure finished around 11 PM. I recommend eating and drinking beforehand if you want it to be over quickly. Also, bring two large bottles of water because the doctor will ask you to drink 2 liters and urinate until your urine is clear, then take a picture to show the doctor. If you're having vacuum aspiration, prepare electrolyte solution or a sugar drink. Water and tissues are available for purchase if you didn't bring any. Once your urine is clear, inform the doctor. However, my procedure took longer because I was nervous, causing them to check my blood pressure and pulse multiple times because they were too high. The nurse had me drink more water and then check again. I had them check about 5 times before my blood pressure and pulse went down. Then they took an ultrasound to review the images before the procedure. After that, they gave me medication and I waited another 15 minutes. Then I informed the doctor. Once the time was up, I waited to be called for the procedure. The actual procedure takes about 15 minutes. During the procedure, I felt abdominal pain similar to menstrual cramps, but maybe a little tingling. After the procedure and the equipment was removed, I was able to stand up immediately, but I had a little pain in my lower left abdomen. I could walk normally, there was no burning sensation, and there was very little bleeding. After the procedure, they'll explain the post-procedure instructions, and then you can go home. The nurses were very nice and not as scary as I thought. They kept encouraging me. I was impressed that throughout the procedure, no doctor or nurse was rude. Everyone smiled and spoke in a very friendly manner. There are very few seats, so I recommend that if you bring a relative or partner, you should wait outside. When I came, half the room was occupied by men, and I had to walk around to find a chair.
0x30e29fc0b64f55d5_0x92e8a346f1e0633f.author: Morfreen Morphine

0x30e29fc0b64f55d5_0x92e8a346f1e0633f.text: My boyfriend and I experienced an unexpected event. After discussing it, we decided to terminate the pregnancy. We searched online for information and found this doctor's clinic. We sent our information late Friday night. The doctor contacted us Saturday morning to book an appointment via the green app. We booked and luckily got a Saturday appointment. Before coming, I read reviews and found that most were positive. The low-star reviews mostly concerned waiting times and negative experiences with the nurses. In reality, everyone was very caring, although some were a little strict, as is typical of nurses. Overall, everything went very well. Thank you to the doctor and nurses for your care. Our appointment was at 7:50 PM, but we arrived a little early in case of registration. The entire process was completed around 1:30 AM, taking a total of 5.5 hours. The clinic provided water, tissues, and electrolyte solution. The process went something like this: First part: 1. Registration 2. Basic health check 3. Waiting for ultrasound. Finished around 9:30 PM (a little over an hour from registration). Second part: [After ultrasound] [During this time, you can eat. If you're alone, bring snacks or food, or you can walk out to eat nearby. There are 7-Eleven stores, coffee shops, and shopping malls nearby. / Bring headphones or a tablet to download content to watch while you wait. / The air conditioning in some areas is very cold because it can get hot when there are many people. If there are few people, it might be very cold. / If you're coming from far away, there are many accommodations nearby.] 4. Go down and have some water while you wait. 5. Wait in line for medication. 6. Drink electrolyte solution. 7. Undergo the procedure. I offer my encouragement to everyone who has to make this decision, and I thank the doctor for giving me this opportunity.
0x30e29fc0b64f55d5_0x92e8a346f1e0633f.author: C P

0x30e2bc8c82dff8f1_0x61f783068be7e6b1.text: ไปถอนฟันมาคุณหมอพูดจาดี พูดเพราะมาก ซักถามละเอียดมาก ยืนยันถูกต้องถึงถอนให้ ถอนไม่เจ็บเลย จากประสบการณ์ที่ไปมาหลายที่ เช็คสภาพรายละเอียด ใช้สิทธิประกันสังคมแต่ได้ยาแพงยาดีมาให้ ไม่มีอาการบวมช้ำระบมหลังถอน เหมือนปกติ ดีมากทุกอย่าง และเหมาะสำหรับผู้ใช้ประกันสังคมเพราะหมอพูดดีไม่ดูถูกเหมือนที่อื่นที่ต้องการแต่เงินสด 👍
0x30e2bc8c82dff8f1_0x61f783068be7e6b1.author: ใจนิ่ง ต่อไป
0x30e2bc8c82dff8f1_0x61f783068be7e6b1.en: I went to get a tooth extracted and the doctor was very kind and polite. He asked detailed questions and confirmed everything was correct before proceeding. The extraction was painless. Compared to other places I've been to, this doctor checked the condition and details thoroughly. I used my social security insurance but received high-quality, expensive medication. There was no swelling, bruising, or soreness after the extraction; everything felt normal. It was excellent in every way, and highly recommended for social security beneficiaries because the doctor is respectful and not condescending like some places that only care about cash. 👍

0x30e2bc8c82dff8f1_0x61f783068be7e6b1.text: คุณหมอพูดจาดี คลินิกสะอาดล่าสุดไปถอนฟันโทรไปก่อนสอบถามเรื่องข้อมูลใช้สิทธิประกันสังคม ไปทำวันอาทิตย์สามารถใช้สิทธิได้แต่ควรโทรนัดไว้ก่อนดีกว่า
0x30e2bc8c82dff8f1_0x61f783068be7e6b1.author: Cherry Itsarawalee
0x30e2bc8c82dff8f1_0x61f783068be7e6b1.en: The doctor is kind and the clinic is clean. I recently had a tooth extracted and called ahead to inquire about using my social security insurance. I went on a Sunday and was able to use my insurance, but it's better to call and make an appointment beforehand.

0x311d646143c78b99_0xf485900a426716f7.text: 6/06/63ไปรับบริการขูดหินปูนค่ะ900บาท,เคลือบฟลูออไรด์500บาท,อุดฟัน3ด้าน1700บาท คุณหมอบริการดีมากค่ะ ส่วนทางด้านเคาน์เตอร์บริการควรใส่ใจและปรับปรุงค่ะ ควรมีไหวพริบให้มากกว่านี้ค่ะ

The dentist provided excellent service. However, the service at the counter needs improvement; they should be more attentive and quick-witted.

0x311d646143c78b99_0xf485900a426716f7.text: มีพี่ที่ทำงาน ลูกสาวของเค้าดัดร้านนี้ค่ะ เค้าแนะนำมา วันอาทิตย์ที่ 1 มิ.ย. นี้จะเข้าไปที่ร้าน อยากทราบว่าต้องเตรียมอะไรไปบ้าง เสียค่าอะไรบ้างค่ะ

0x311d646143c78b99_0xf485900a426716f7.en: A colleague at work has a daughter who got her hair permed at this salon. She recommended it. I'm going to the salon this Sunday, June 1st. I'd like to know what I need to prepare and what the fees are.

0x311d646143c78b99_0xf485900a426716f7.en: The queue-taking assistant named Aum provided terrible service. She spoke rudely, gave judgmental looks, and acted disdainfully. If you don't enjoy customer service, don't do it.

0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.text: I originally had gaps between my teeth, but didn't want braces. I consulted a dentist, who recommended clear aligners. The price was 49,000 baht, payable in 10 installments. I decided to go with it because I don't have much time, I wouldn't need frequent visits, and the braces wouldn't be visible. The entire treatment took about 4 months, and now my teeth are close together. I'm about to get my retainers made. The prices here are reasonable, and the quality is good. The dentist is skilled, explains things well and clearly, and informs you about the costs beforehand. The filling and scaling process was gentle and painless. Parking is convenient.
0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.author: athichai yun

0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.text: จัดฟันกับหมอโอ๋ เจอหมอมาจากยูทูปเลยตามมาที่คลินก หมอใจดีและเเนะนำดีมาก อธิบายเข้าใจง่าย ถามได้ตลอด ฟันซ้อนเลยจัดแบบไม่ถอนฟัน แต่โดนผ่าฟันคุด ๔ ซี่ ผ่ากับหมอวันศุกร์ทำเร็วมาก เดือนหน้าหมอโอ๋บอกว่าจะพิมปากทำรีเทนเนอร์แล้ว ให้เลือกเอารีเบบบไหน ผู้ช่วยบางคนก็น่ารัก บางคนก็ไม่ค่อยยิ้ม การคอนเฟิมนัดจะเเจ้งทางไลนฺ บางทีมีอ่านช้าบ้าง คิวรอทำฟัน ก็ได้มีทั้งไม่ตรงเวลา และรอบ้าง อาจเพราะเราไปวันอังคารคิวเลยไม่ค่อยเยอะ แต่หากเป็นช่วงเลิกงานก็มีต้องรอบ้าง ตอนเคลียรฺ ช่องปาก อุดฟันกับขูดหินปูน แล้วติดเครื่องมือในวันนั้นเลย หมอโอ๋อุดฟันและขูดให้มือเบามาก ใช้สิทธเบิก ประกันสังคม900 บาท โดนรวมถือว่า โอเคนะสำหรับเรา ราคาไม่แพง บริการพอใช้ได้ หมอน่ารัก
0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.author: Naw Tin tin nwe
0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.en: I got my braces done with Dr. O. I found her on YouTube and came to her clinic. She's very kind and gives great advice. Everything is easy to understand, and you can ask questions anytime. I had crowded teeth, so I opted for braces without extractions, but I did need to have four wisdom teeth removed. Dr. O had them extracted on a Friday, and it was very quick. Next month, Dr. O said she'll take impressions for my retainers and I can choose which type to get. Some of the assistants are lovely, while others don't smile much. Appointment confirmations are sent via LINE, but sometimes they're slow to respond. The waiting list for dental work can be inconsistent, with some delays. This might be because I went on a Tuesday, so the queue wasn't too long. However, there can be longer waits during peak hours after work. During the oral cleaning, fillings, and scaling, Dr. O had her braces put on the same day. She was very gentle with her fillings and scaling. I used my social security insurance, which covered 900 baht. Overall, I think it's okay for me. The price is reasonable, the service is decent, and the doctor is lovely.

0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.text: Hello! I've had fillings done at this clinic several times now. ❤️🙂 I usually schedule appointments through their Facebook page; it's very easy with an admin always responding. You can also call to schedule an appointment, but I prefer this method. 🔅🔅 Upon arrival, the staff were very friendly and provided excellent service. What I especially liked was the free consultation! 😁😁 Ultimately, I still needed fillings because the cavity was deep. 😅 The dentist gave excellent advice. 🥰 I was able to use my social security benefits, so I didn't have to pay upfront. Overall, based on my experience, I highly recommend this clinic! 👍
0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.author: อังสุมารินทร์ สุพรรณรัตน์

0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.text: เพื่อนเเนะนำมาให้ทำฟันปลอมที่นี้ เพื่อนไปทำมาเเล้ว บอกว่าไม่แพงและหมอแนะนำดี เลยลองไปทำดูบ้าง ชอบมากคะ คุณหมอแนะนำดีมาก ทำฟันปลอมบน6ซี่ และฟันล่าง3ซี่ ไปทำประมาณ 3ครั้ง ราคาก็ไม่แพง แบ่งจ่ายได้3ครั้ง หลังใส่ฟันปลอมไป ก็มีเจ็บเวลาเคี้ยว เลยโทรไปที่รา้นนัดคุณหมอ คุณหมอแก้ให่ไม่เสียค่าใช้จ่าย ไปแก้อีก2ครั้งก็หาย ตอนนี้ใช้ได้ดี ตอนแรก เคี้ยวไม่ถนัดเลย ค่อยเคี้ยวตามที่หมอบอกตอนนี้ดีขึ้น ขอบคุณคุณหมอมากไปเลยคะ
0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.author: จันทรามาศ สุพรรณรัตน์
0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.en: A friend recommended this clinic for my dentures. She said it wasn't expensive and the dentist gave great advice, so I decided to try it. I'm very happy with my experience. The dentist gave excellent advice. I had six upper dentures and three lower dentures made. I went about three times, and the price was affordable, payable in three installments. After getting the dentures, I experienced some pain when chewing, so I called the clinic to schedule an appointment. The dentist adjusted them free of charge. I went for two more adjustments, and the pain subsided. Now they work perfectly. Initially, chewing was difficult, but following the dentist's instructions made it much better. Thank you so much, dentist!

0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.text: ข้อไล่เรียงทีละข้อนะคะ เริ่มที่ 1.หมอจัดฟัน 1.1 พูดจาแย่มาก อารมณ์ขึ้นๆลงๆเหมือนไปทะเลาะกับข้างบ้านละมาลงกับคนไข้ ไม่มีการควบคุมอารมณ์เหมือนกับที่ความคิดเห็นอื่นๆบอก(มันเป็นความจริงเจอมากับตัว)หมอควรปรับปรุงอารมณ์ด่วนนะคะ คนไข้มาจ่ายเงินให้คุณไม่ใช่มาขอทำฟรี อย่าคิดว่าเก่งอย่างเดียวแล้วไม่ต้องมีจรรยาบรรณและมารยาทนะคะ ฝากไว้ให้คิดแล้วปรับปรุงด้วย 1.2.ไม่มีการอธิบายขั้นตอนว่าจะทำไรล่วงหน้าต่อไปเลย จะถามก็ไม่กล้าดูไม่สบอารมณ์สุดๆ -ถ้าเป็นหมอจะมีประมาณนี้ที่คนส่วนใหญ่เจอ+ตัวเองเจอ 2.ผู้ช่วย - นี่ก็พูดจาเหมือนไม่ผ่านการอบรมservice mind ทั้งสีหน้า อารมณ์ การตอบคำถามคือแย่ ไม่รู้คลีนิคไปรับสมัครจากหลุมไหนมาเหมือนไปรับสก๊อยมาทำงาน แย่ที่สุด.บอกแค่นี้ //แต่บางคนก็มีพูดจาดีอยู่บ้าง ก็คงน่าจะอยู่ที่กระบวนนิสัยสะมากกว่า 3.ความสะอาดของคลีนิก - (เริ่มที่สภาพตอนรอคิว) เต็ม10ให้0.5 สภาพเน่ามากไม่มีความสวยงามใดใด การจัดเก้าอี้ ที่นั่ง เหมือนมาต่อคิวรอรับสิทธิ์สวัสดิการฟรี - (ส่วนของตอนเข้าไปห้องตรวจ) ข้างนอกว่าเละแล้ว ข้างในยิ่งกว่า ถ้าเข้ามาทำครั้งแรกก็คืออึ้ง ถ้าคนเคยไปคลีนิกที่ดีๆมาก่อนก็จะรู้สึกได้แค่นี้พอ (ที่รีวิวมาทั้งหมดอยากให้ปรับปรุงค่ะ เพราะในเฟสก็ไม่เปิดให้รีวิวเลยต้องมารีวิวในนี้แทน เพราะที่มารีวิวได้ก็เพราะเป็นคนไข้ที่เสียเงินจ่าย แต่สิ่งที่ได้กลับมาเหมือนขอทำฟรี)จบการรีวิว.
0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.author: Barbie Joo
0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.en: Let's go through each point: Starting with 1. The Orthodontist: 1.1. Their communication skills were terrible. Their mood was erratic, like they'd had a fight with a neighbor and taken it out on the patient. They had no emotional control, as other reviews mentioned (this is true, I experienced it myself). The doctor needs to improve their temper immediately. Patients are paying for treatment, not asking for free services. Don't think that just being skilled means you don't need ethics and manners. Please consider this and improve. 1.2. There was no explanation of the procedure beforehand. I didn't dare ask; they seemed extremely irritated. - This is what most people and I experienced with the doctor. 2. The Assistant: - Their communication skills were terrible, like they hadn't received any service mind training. Their facial expressions, mood, and answers were awful. I don't know where the clinic found them; they seemed like unruly individuals. The worst. That's all I'll say. //However, some assistants were polite, so it's probably more about their personality. 3. Clinic Cleanliness: - (Starting with the waiting area) On a scale of 10, I'd give it a 0.5. It was filthy and completely unattractive. The seating arrangement was like queuing for a free welfare benefit. - (Regarding the area inside the examination room) The outside was a mess, but the inside was even worse. If this was your first time here, you'd be shocked. If you've been to much better clinics before, this is all you'll feel. (All the points in this review are for the benefit of improvement. Since Facebook doesn't allow reviews, I had to write them here instead. I'm a patient who paid for the service, but what I received felt like it was free.) End of review.

0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.text: การจัดฟันใช้ได้ค่ะ 2 ปีครึ่งเสร็จแต่ว่า - ในระหว่างที่จัดฟันไม่สามารถสอบถามอะไรกับคุณหมอได้สักเท่าไหร่ค่ะ คุณหมออารมณ์ขึ้นเร็วมาก ด้วยความที่คุณหมอเป็นเจ้าของคลินิกเอง บางครั้งดูควบคุมอารมณ์ไม่ได้ ไม่น่าเชื่อว่าจะได้เห็นกับตา ว่าเป็นกับคนไข้หลายท่านค่ะ - ในส่วนของการตอบแชทของทางคลินิค ที่มีทั้งคุณหมอเจ้าของคลินิค และพนักงานเป็นผู้ตอบ ในส่วนของการสอบถามรายละเอียดนั้น มีครั้งนึงที่ได้รับการตอบกลับมา ที่ไม่มีมารยาทอย่างมากค่ะ - การทำรีเทนเนอร์ เกิดความผิดพลาดหลายครั้งระหว่างดำเนินการ ด้วยระบบงานหลายๆอย่างทำให้ต้องพิมพ์ปากใหม่หลายครั้ง ซึ่งจริงๆแล้วควรจะดูออกตั้งแต่การพิมพ์ปากว่า แบบพิมพ์สมบูรณ์ดีหรือไม่ ทางลูกค้ารับไม่ไหว ทั้งในความล่าช้าของกระบวนการและมารยาท จึงขอ cancel รีเทนเนอร์ ชิ้นที่ทางคลินิคทำพลาด ไม่สามารถส่งให้ลูกค้าได้ตามวันนัด แล้วไปทำรีเทนเนอร์ที่อื่นแทนค่ะ พบว่ารีเทนเนอร์ที่อื่นที่ได้มา มีคุณภาพที่ดีกว่า มารยาทที่ดีกว่า การบริการที่ดีกว่า service mind ที่ดีกว่าที่นี่มากค่ะ - คลินิกบางที่เดี๋ยวนี้มีแลปเป็นของตัวเองได้รีเทนเนอร์ที่ดีกว่า ไวกว่า มาตรฐานสูงกว่า ในราคาที่ต่ำกว่า ความสะอาดและความทันสมัยมากกว่า การบริการดีกว่า service mind สูงกว่า แนะนำว่าใครที่จะจัดฟันและหารีเทนเนอร์ให้ไปที่อื่นดีกว่านะคะ สบายใจกว่าเยอะเลย
0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.author: komai artshop
0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.en: The orthodontic treatment was effective, taking 2.5 years to complete, but... - During the treatment, I couldn't ask the doctor many questions. The doctor's temper flared up very quickly, likely because they own the clinic. Sometimes they seemed unable to control their emotions. It's unbelievable that I witnessed this with multiple patients. - Regarding the clinic's chat responses, both the owner (the doctor) and staff responded. On one occasion, the response was extremely impolite. - There were several errors during the retainer production process. Due to various workflows, multiple re-taking impressions were required. This should have been evident from the start, as the clinic's impressions were deemed incomplete. Unable to tolerate the delays and the impolite behavior, I canceled the retainer order due to the clinic's mistakes and opted to have my retainer made elsewhere. I found that the retainers from the other clinic were of much higher quality, had better service, and a much better service mindset than here. - Some clinics now have their own labs, resulting in better retainers, faster service, higher standards, and lower prices. They are also cleaner and more modern. The service is much better, and they have a much better service-minded attitude. I recommend anyone considering braces and needing a retainer to go elsewhere; you'll have much more peace of mind.

0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.text: I feel terrible. I've been wearing braces for over two years and nothing has changed. They keep pulling my teeth left and right, they're never aligned even once. I have gaps between my teeth. Some months they even pull my lower teeth over my upper teeth. The dentist even asked me, "Why are your lower teeth overlapping your upper teeth?" Wait, shouldn't I be the one asking that? The dentist in the extraction room is nice, but the orthodontist is in a bad mood for no reason. They rarely say anything, they have a grumpy face, and they hit my mouth with their instruments very often. At first, they did a great job and my teeth were beautifully aligned, but lately I can't even bite through a noodle. If you're looking for a clinic, I'm telling you, don't come here. Don't be fooled into coming here. The clinic doesn't look clean at all, especially the X-ray room, it's full of all sorts of stuff.
0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.author: Donal Dark

0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.text: สักดาวเดียวก็ไม่อยากจะให้ ไปเจอหน้าเคาน์เตอร์ด่านแรกแย่ที่สุดพนักงานทำงานเหมือนโกรธผัวตลอดเวลา เข้าไปจัดฟันรอคิวไม่นานแต่หมอก็ดุหน้าเหวี่ยงไม่กล้าถามอะไรด้วย ผู้ช่วยคุณหมอก็ไม่มีความรู้ พูดมาก แต่ตอบคำถามของคนไข้ได้ไม่ดี จัดฟันคุณหมอมือหนักทำแรงเหมือนจะทำฟันคนไข้หลุดตลอดเวลา และมักจะมีเศษลวดที่เกินหรือยางที่ติดไม่เรียบร้อยและเกี่ยวปากมีแผลเป็นประจำ ตอนไปจัดครั้งแรกหมอว่าเราว่าหน้าตาแย่ ไม่มีจรรยาบรรณและมารยาท ไม่มีคำปรึกษาก่อนจัดฟัน ควรปิดคลินิกไปซะ หยุดหลอกคนอื่นด้วยโปรโมชั่นแย่ๆ ไปขูดหินปูน 1,000 บาทแต่เหมือนเอาคุณหมอปี 1 เพิ่งเข้ามหาลัยมาขูด คลินิกนี้มีอะไรดีบ้างปรับปรุงใหม่ไม่ก็ปิดคลินิกไปซะ อย่าเปิดคลินิกแย่ๆที่ไม่มีจรรยาบรรณแบบนี้ออกมาเลย ใครอยากมาแนะนำให้อ่านรีวิวใน google map ทุกคนพูดเป็นเสียงเดียวกันว่าที่นี่แย่ลองอ่านของคนอื่นก่อนนะครับ
0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.author: Ch Ch
0x311d62e10ea59f8b_0xcbcbd36fec8a5d7.en: I wouldn't even give it one star. The first impression at the counter was the worst; the staff acted like they were constantly angry at their husbands. I waited a short time for braces, but the dentist was grumpy and didn't dare ask any questions. The dentist's assistant was inexperienced, talked a lot, but couldn't answer patient questions well. The dentist was heavy-handed with the braces, making it seem like they were going to knock my teeth out. There were always excess wires or poorly attached rubber bands that scratched my mouth, causing sores. On my first visit, the dentist even told me I looked ugly. They lacked ethics and manners, and offered no consultation before starting treatment. They should close the clinic and stop misleading people with their terrible promotions. I paid 1,000 baht for teeth cleaning, but it was like they hired a freshman doctor. What's good about this clinic? They should either improve it or close it down. Don't open a clinic with such bad ethics. Anyone considering coming here should read the reviews on Google Maps; everyone says the same thing – it's terrible. Read other people's reviews first.

0x30e298c5a940627f_0x8c6d62247d805794.text: รักษาราฟันที่นี่ ทำรอบแรกเจ็บค่ะ เพราะเขี่ยเส้นประสาทออก ทำรอบที่ 2-4 ตอนทำเรานอนหลับได้เลยค่ะ ยิ่งกว่าประทับใจค่ะ หมอน่ารักค่ะ แจ้งไปเลยว่าจะทำอะไรบ้าง อยากทำอะไรบ้าง หรือถ้าหมอแนะนำให้ทำ แต่ตัวเราไม่อยากทำ หมอก้ยินดีจะอธิบายข้อดีข้อเสียของการทำและไม่ทำให้ฟังค่ะ
0x30e298c5a940627f_0x8c6d62247d805794.author: Raticha Onranichratanapon (Pat AIA)
0x30e298c5a940627f_0x8c6d62247d805794.en: I had my tooth extracted here. The first session was painful because they removed a nerve. During the 2nd to 4th sessions, I was able to fall asleep. I was more than impressed! The dentist was lovely. I told them exactly what I wanted done and what I needed. If the dentist recommended something that I didn't want, they were happy to explain the pros and cons and whether or not to proceed with it.

0x30e298c5a940627f_0x8c6d62247d805794.text: Quick, easy and cost effective! I highly recommended visiting should you need any dental work.
0x30e298c5a940627f_0x8c6d62247d805794.author: jonesmatt 100

0x30e298c5a940627f_0x8c6d62247d805794.text: คลินิคไม่ค่อยโอ ชอบดูถูกคน นึกว่าคนเข้าไปไม่มีเงินซะหมดเพราะแต่งตัวบ้านๆไป ผู้ช่วยใช้วาจาไม่โอเค แต่เวชทะเบียนน่ารักแต่ไม่กลับไปใช้บริการดีกว่า
0x30e298c5a940627f_0x8c6d62247d805794.author: catcat catcat
0x30e298c5a940627f_0x8c6d62247d805794.en: The clinic isn't great. They're condescending and act like everyone who comes in is broke because they're dressed casually. The assistant's language was inappropriate. However, the medical records department was nice, but I won't be going back.

0x30e298c5a940627f_0x8c6d62247d805794.text: Service ไม่ดีครับ ไม่คุ้มราคา ผ่าฟันครุท 4000 ไม่ได้น้ำแข็ง ผ่าก็เจ็บ พนักงานก็หยิบของไม่ค่อยถูก
0x30e298c5a940627f_0x8c6d62247d805794.author: Boss
0x30e298c5a940627f_0x8c6d62247d805794.en: The service was poor and not worth the price. The wisdom tooth extraction cost 4000 baht and didn't include ice. The extraction was painful, and the staff weren't very efficient with supplies.

0x30da3a9923422b29_0xc6c5b4b44a412073.text: On October 15, 2014, a young, innocent girl had her first cosmetic surgery. Back then, there wasn't much information available. We chose a clinic close to home in case the doctor could provide support if needed. We had arm liposuction done here for 30,000 baht, which was expensive at the time. I remember it vividly because it was terrible. The procedure was done without an anesthesiologist, without any general anesthesia; they only gave me local anesthesia. It was incredibly painful, but I endured it because I wanted my arms to be more toned. I later found out that other clinics provide much better aftercare, but here...ugh. There were no follow-up appointments for wound cleaning, no follow-up appointments whatsoever. It turned out that the incisions weren't stitched at all. You heard right, not stitched. To this day, I still have indented scars from the liposuction at this clinic. A terrible experience.
0x30da3a9923422b29_0xc6c5b4b44a412073.author: Iam Babie

0x30da3a9923422b29_0xc6c5b4b44a412073.text: Terrible. The doctor must have changed his name a hundred times. He didn't care about the surgery at all, talking on the phone the whole time. He rushed through the procedure haphazardly and crookedly just to get it over with. Awful. The result is terrible; I'm left with nothing but scars and no improvement. It was a complete waste of money and I'm disfigured for nothing.
0x30da3a9923422b29_0xc6c5b4b44a412073.author: องอาจ ฉีกหน้ากากคนเลว

0x30da3a9923422b29_0xc6c5b4b44a412073.text: I had double eyelid surgery. My eyelids were very large. My eyelids were drooping as usual. My eyes were not shaped at all. The place was stuffy. The doctor did the surgery in a rush because he had to travel to many provinces.
0x30da3a9923422b29_0xc6c5b4b44a412073.author: Pipatch NL

0x30e29f002fa26f73_0x290fcef152dc5c66.text: As a new patient, registration was hassle-free. I didn't have to wait long to be examined. I chose to be treated by a student, who conducted a thorough examination. A professor also joined in to assist. They assessed my wisdom tooth …

0x30e29f002fa26f73_0x290fcef152dc5c66.text: I went to the specialized clinic and the service was very good, but I needed a tooth extracted and had to wait almost 20 days for the doctor. Then I had terrible tooth pain, couldn't eat, and my bite hurt when my teeth clenched. I asked …
0x30e29f002fa26f73_0x290fcef152dc5c66.author: KayAiAim

0x311d62e175dcc24f_0x97d2c903559861fd.text: ทั้งคุณหมอ, ผู้ช่วย, พนักงานที่เคาท์เตอร์ พูดจาดี น้ำเสียงดี มีการให้คำแนะนำต่าง ๆ หมอมือเบา ไม่ดุ
0x311d62e175dcc24f_0x97d2c903559861fd.author: Napatsanan Rattanavar
0x311d62e175dcc24f_0x97d2c903559861fd.en: The doctor, assistant, and counter staff were all polite, had pleasant voices, and provided helpful advice. The doctor was gentle and not harsh.

0x311d62e175dcc24f_0x97d2c903559861fd.text: คุณหมอมือเบา แนะนำและบริการดูแลฟันอื่นๆ นอกเหนือจากที่ต้องการทำให้ด้วย ขอบคุณมากครับ
0x311d62e175dcc24f_0x97d2c903559861fd.author: Peerapat Vatcharakamol
0x311d62e175dcc24f_0x97d2c903559861fd.en: The dentist was very gentle and also offered additional dental care beyond what I requested. Thank you so much!

0x311d62e175dcc24f_0x97d2c903559861fd.text: คุณหมอพูดจาดี น้ำเสียงในการอธิบายดีมากค่ะ แต่พนักงานหน้าเคาน์เตอร์รบกวนปรับปรุงสีหน้า ท่าทางคำพูดและน้ำเสียงในการให้บริการด่วนค่ะ ทำงานบริการควรจะยิ้มแย้มมากกว่านี้ค่ะ แล้วน้ำเสียงไม่ใช่ทำเหมือนไม่พอใจเวลาลูกค้าถาม อาจจะเหนื่อยหรือเจอเรื่องอะไรมาก็ควรจะเก็บไว้ในใจนะคะ ปล.เจอมา 2 รอบแล้วค่ะ
0x311d62e175dcc24f_0x97d2c903559861fd.author: อยากรีวิว
0x311d62e175dcc24f_0x97d2c903559861fd.en: The doctor spoke very well and explained things in a great tone. However, the counter staff needs to urgently improve their facial expressions, demeanor, speech, and tone of voice in providing service. Those working in customer service should be more cheerful and smiling. Also, their tone of voice shouldn't sound like they're annoyed when customers ask questions. They might be tired or have had a bad day, but they should keep it to themselves. (P.S. This has happened twice already.)

0x30fdaa5939b619c3_0x9da71c3d9d2f8646.text: Under min ferie, var jeg så uheldig at flække/brække 25% af min ene tand. Fik hotellet til at kontakte klinikken, som fik lavet at jeg kunne komme til med det samme. Efter 1.5 time og et røgent billede, pris 1300 bath. Grundet den store skade, knækkede tanden igen ca 5 timer, kontaktede dem og fik den lavet igen, dog med en bedre forstærkning. De ville have lavet en krone, men på af min tid tilbage af ferien ville det ikke kunne nåes, derfor kunne lavet som en nødløsning, anden behandling var gratis. De har virkelig været meget søde og professionelle og gode til engelsk, fik også lavet en dokumentation over skaden på engelsk til mit forsikringsselskab uden beregning Tusind tak til personalet 👍
เมื่อวานเข้าทำฟันที่สาขา market village คุณหมอผู้หญิงตัวเล็กๆใส่แว่น น่ารักมากก มือเบา อธิบายดีทั้งก่อนทำและหลังทำ วันหลังจะใช้บริการอีกนะคะ👍🏻👍🏻
0x30fdaa5939b619c3_0x9da71c3d9d2f8646.author: Nam Wong
0x30fdaa5939b619c3_0x9da71c3d9d2f8646.en: Yesterday I had dental work done at the Market Village branch. The dentist was a small, pretty woman with glasses. She was very gentle and explained everything well before and after the procedure. I will definitely use her services again in the future. 👍🏻👍🏻

0x30fdaa5939b619c3_0x9da71c3d9d2f8646.text: วันนี้ฉันได้ไปผ่าตัดฟันคุดที่คลินิกพี่หมอและพนักงานดูแลดีมาก ให้คำแนะนำหลังการผ่าเป็นอย่างดีใครที่กำลังมองกาคลินิกทำฟันแนะนำให้มาที่นี่ค่ะ
0x30fdaa5939b619c3_0x9da71c3d9d2f8646.author: Wanwisa Meekaew
0x30fdaa5939b619c3_0x9da71c3d9d2f8646.en: Today I had my wisdom tooth extracted at this clinic. The doctor and staff were very attentive and provided excellent post-operative advice. If you're looking for a dental clinic, I highly recommend this one.

0x30fdaa5939b619c3_0x9da71c3d9d2f8646.text: Unprofessional. The dental hygiene appointment lasted 12 minutes for 1000 TBH. One minute was spent greeting me, and five minutes were spent on teeth whitening, which I, as a tourist, hadn't even ordered. The appliance was okay. Perhaps they're better at fitting braces for Thai people.
0x30fdaa5939b619c3_0x9da71c3d9d2f8646.author: Sindro Schmid

0x30fdaa5939b619c3_0x9da71c3d9d2f8646.text: เข้าไปถอนฟัน แต่หมอแนะนำ แต่หมอแนะนำให้รักษารักฟันสิงห์ข้างละ 4000 บาทครั้งที่สองคุณหมอเก็บเงินผ่อน 8000 บาทเพราะว่าไม่มีเวลามารักษาต่อสุดท้ายกลับบ้านมานอนปวดฟัน สรุป เสียเงินรักษ 12000 แต่ยังปวดฟันอยู่ ยังไม่ได้ครอบฟันอีก12000 บาทนะ และอุปกรณ์ กระแทกฟันบ่อยมาก
0x30fdaa5939b619c3_0x9da71c3d9d2f8646.author: Boossie katie Phosery
0x30fdaa5939b619c3_0x9da71c3d9d2f8646.en: I went in for a tooth extraction, but the dentist recommended treatment for the ligament, costing 4000 baht per side. The second time, the dentist charged 8000 baht because I didn't have time for further treatment. In the end, I went home with tooth pain. In total, I spent 12000 baht on treatment, but I'm still in pain. I haven't even gotten a crown yet, another 12000 baht. And the dental equipment was hitting my tooth very frequently.

0x30fdaa5939b619c3_0x9da71c3d9d2f8646.text: วันนี้เข้ารับบริการที่สาขามาร์เก็ตวิลเลจ ทำฟันไม่สะอาดเลยค่ะ พาครอบครัวไปขูดหินปูน เช็คอัพ หมอทำแบบรีบๆ รีบมาก ไม่รู้จะรีบไปไหน เวลาทำ น้ำไหลเปียกไปหมด กระเด็นไปทั่ว ไม่โปรเลย และสุดท้ายต้องจองคลีนิคอื่นทำอีก ต้องเสียเงิน2รอบ เพราะไม่สะอาดเลย ไม่กลับไปอีกแน่นอน อยากให้ปรับปรุงด้วยนะคะ เสียเงินไปทำแต่ไม่คุ้มเงินจริงๆค่ะ แพงไม่ว่า แต่ขอทำดีสะอาด เท่าไหร่ก็ยอมจ่าย เสียความรู้สึกมาก แต่น้องพนักงานต้อนรับโอเคมาก
0x30fdaa5939b619c3_0x9da71c3d9d2f8646.author: Nattakan Taimaingam
0x30fdaa5939b619c3_0x9da71c3d9d2f8646.en: Today I received dental services at the Market Village branch, and the dental work was very unclean. I brought my family for teeth cleaning and a check-up. The dentist was very rushed, I don't know why they were in such a hurry. During the procedure, water was splashing everywhere, making everything wet. It was very unprofessional. In the end, we had to book another clinic for further treatment, paying twice because it was so unclean. I will definitely not go back there again. I hope you will improve your service. 0x3054f1052fe64571_0x9cd3cdfb4ff4ed16.text: Review for Dental Solution at Bangkok Hospital, Koh Samui I can only praise the all-round service at Dental Solution in Bangkok Hospital, Koh Samui. First of all, I was able to get an appointment at very short notice. My issue was an inflamed tooth root, with swollen and extremely painful gums. I was given an appointment on the same day, and everything was explained to me transparently. X-rays were taken, and the further treatment options were discussed in detail. I was presented with three choices, and after making a decision, the procedure was carried out promptly. Just one and a half hours later, I was pain-free and on my way back to the hotel. By the evening, I was already able to resume all my activities, and I have been pain-free ever since. A huge compliment to the entire team, especially Dr. Wanwimon Potjanatkomon, who treated me with great care and professionalism, and Joy, the assistant, who was incredibly competent and efficient. Joy had already communicated with me in the morning via WhatsApp, providing excellent support and ensuring a smooth process. Her English skills were outstanding, making everything even easier. The whole team was absolutely excellent – highly recommended for anyone in need of professional and efficient dental care!

0x311d6f70347b5fcf_0xad29616bcc88d59.text: Just getting a referral letter is so difficult. In the morning, I went to a clinic on the right side of the road, but they told me to go to the clinic on the other side, which would be faster. So I went. When I got there, the doctor said my child was too young and they didn't have enough equipment to treat her, telling me to go back to the clinic on the right side. They don't seem to consider the inconvenience it causes the patient, making me move back and forth. It's not like it's close by. If I were paying for treatment myself, I would have gotten it done a long time ago. Then, when I got to the hospital and had an appointment, I asked for a referral letter, and they said my child had to be examined by a doctor first. It's ridiculous! They want me to carry a baby back and forth? If they don't have the capacity to treat a child, they could just write a referral letter.
0x311d6f70347b5fcf_0xad29616bcc88d59.author: วรนุช สะมัน

0x311d6f70347b5fcf_0xad29616bcc88d59.text: I went today and found out that using my universal healthcare card meant I wouldn't have to pay. The people outside were talking amongst themselves, and they understood what was happening. But the doctor had absolutely no professionalism. They were gossiping about me to the people waiting outside. Then an elderly woman asked the doctor if they had just asked for a referral letter. The doctor was speaking about me in such an unprofessional way; everyone in the room could hear. I was still sitting there. I only asked for a referral letter. Wasn't it the doctor who didn't read what the nurse had written? Instead, they blamed me. The nurse had written it well, but the doctor didn't read it, right? And then they accused me of making things up.

0x311d6f70347b5fcf_0xad29616bcc88d59.text: Just like many negative reviews say, it's true. It was probably good at first (I guess), but later it became bad, as many people (including me) experienced. Why not wait until the clinic's closing time to go elsewhere? Isn't that cheating on time? Some patients have to wait for half a day, but the doctor just leaves before closing time. I've experienced this twice now. I'm fed up with this terrible system, honestly. 👎👎👎

I went to do the operation on my wisdom tooth (it was totally lay on my gum horizontal line) and it was perfectly nice. I had pain for the first few hours after they took my tooth out but today I can eat everything like normal and I don't feel any painful anymore. If anyone would like to give it a go, this place you should consider to try.
0x311d63d97fcc877f_0xc2aef1c30075d1ad.author: Kanta Stythe
0x311d63d97fcc877f_0xc2aef1c30075d1ad.en: The dentist was very calm and patient. I had my wisdom tooth extracted yesterday. It was a wisdom tooth that was horizontally positioned against the bone, and the dentist said it might be a little difficult. But she showed me how easy it was to remove it. It didn't take long, and she was very careful. Today, I'm not in much pain anymore, just a little swelling because the dentist was so gentle. I'm very impressed. Before I transferred to another clinic, my mouth and face were swollen and I was in pain for a week. I brought my mother here for dental work, and she loved it too. I also brought my husband for teeth whitening, and he liked it as well. The dentist here is super professional and super calm. I had the operation on my wisdom tooth (it was totally lying on my gum horizontally) and it was perfect. I had pain for the first few hours after they took my tooth out, but today I can eat everything like normal and I don't feel any pain anymore. If anyone would like to give it a try, this place is worth considering.
