0x30e29ed5bd4ac469_0x45581b444c43d9f2.text: If you are an international student and cannot speak Thai well, you can read this for more instructions. Hi, I am an international student from Vietnam, and I fell seriously ill in January 2025 when PM 2.5 affected the whole of Bangkok. Despite visiting several pharmacies and spending a lot of money, I did not recover after a week. I was then advised to visit this health center by my ajarn. Initially, I was very scared because of the negative reviews, but I decided to ignore them and give it a try. In reality, I found the reviews to be overly negative. The staff here are very friendly. You can take Chula bus number 4 to reach the center. Go to the second floor, where you will find a receptionist who speaks English and can assist you. Bring your student ID card, as it is required on your visit and free of charge for the medicine. You will need to fill in some basic information, such as your name and faculty. The staff will then ask about your symptoms, and you can provide a general overview before discussing the details with the doctor. The doctor speaks fluent English. The medicines are all free. Make sure to mention all your symptoms. If you have a severe cough, do not hesitate to ask for candy or syrup to relieve it. In conclusion, this place is very kind and the staff will try their best to communicate with you. Be patient and do not rush
0x30e29ed5bd4ac469_0x45581b444c43d9f2.author: Nguyễn Huỳnh

0x30e29ed5bd4ac469_0x45581b444c43d9f2.text: I visited the health center twice last week because I had a cough and a fever. I was examined and given free medication because I have a Chula student ID. Even though I am an international student, I didn't face any difficulties because the staff and doctors all spoke English very well. A few days later, I had an allergy with an antibiotic, so I returned and was given a new medication. Overall, I am very satisfied with my experience here. Thank you to the staff and doctors for taking care of me.
0x30e29ed5bd4ac469_0x45581b444c43d9f2.author: Khánh Huyền Phạm

0x30e29ed5bd4ac469_0x45581b444c43d9f2.text: The staff member who took my blood pressure and took my medical history was very unpleasant to speak to. She spoke abruptly and rushedly, even though there was no one else around. When she asked my weight, I wasn't sure where it was, and she just told me to go weigh myself. I was confused because it was my first time and I didn't know where the scale was. After I looked at her confusedly, she finally nodded to show me where it was. My question is, why couldn't she just say clearly, "You can weigh yourself at the back"? It wouldn't be that tiring, would it? Please consider providing training for your staff. From what I've read, there are quite a few problems with the service.
0x30e29ed5bd4ac469_0x45581b444c43d9f2.author: K

0x30e29ed5bd4ac469_0x45581b444c43d9f2.text: January 12, 2026, approximately 11:19 AM 1. The staff at the reception counter told us to present our ID card and wait to be called (they were shouting from the moment we entered). 2. The nurse who took our blood pressure called us to have our blood pressure measured. 3. After that, we were given a white slip to submit at the waiting area to see the doctor. 4. After seeing the doctor, we handed the prescription to the nurse at the final waiting area. We still hadn't received our ID card back, so we went back to ask the staff at the counter, "Excuse me, I haven't received my ID card back." She then yelled back, "I already gave it back!" "Have you checked your bag?" "Empty your bag and look!" "It's not here. Go ask the nurse at the blood pressure measurement area." We went to ask at the blood pressure measurement area if our ID card had been misplaced. The nurse there said, "No, it's not here. Check if it's misplaced. If it's not here, it's not here anymore." Throughout the time we were searching for our ID card, both the nurse at the blood pressure measurement area and the staff at the counter were very rude and kept blaming each other. They blamed us, saying we didn't find it properly after returning it, and every sentence they said was shouted and inappropriate 💀 even though we asked politely. We started to get annoyed and admit that at this point, we raised our voices back (if you happen to read this, I apologize 🙏 but you should have spoken more politely). We then asked to see the CCTV footage to see if they had returned it or not. We heard a voice saying, "So annoying! I'm tired!" We don't know who said that, but if you're tired, you should find a way to manage your feelings instead of taking it out on others. If working here is that tiring, you should consider whether you're fit to work here. We are very certain that we haven't received it back because throughout the process of checking, we were constantly thinking about where we would get it back. In the end, we didn't get it back, so we went back to ask them. Now, all we can do is wait because they said that to see the CCTV footage, we have to go through security, file a police report, or something with several parties, and we don't know if they will actually do it. They asked for our name and phone number in case they contact us back. And we need our ID card to make photocopies and submit documents for the university today, which we don't have right now. It's a waste of time, travel expenses to get a new ID card, and a loss of opportunity for us. ‼️Finally, this review is just one of many that the Chulalongkorn University Health Center will likely ignore and not take into consideration for improvement. Reading past reviews, I still see incidents of staff speaking rudely.😩😩 (If I could give negative stars, I would have already.) Thank you to the young man at the counter and the other nurses who helped me find what I needed and did not display any inappropriate behavior, as well as the doctor who provided excellent service. Thank you.
0x30e29ed5bd4ac469_0x45581b444c43d9f2.author: Supanun Morakanun

0x30e29ed5bd4ac469_0x45581b444c43d9f2.text: read if you are an international student. if you have never received treatment from here before, beware that you need to do an ATK test and show the results if you have a fever, sore throat, and runny nose. this is not mentioned on any CU website, and the staff at the first counter slaps you with this new information in the face. it is very inconvenient since you will need to go down to the 1st fl, buy an ATK test from the mini mart, and do it yourself on a table somewhere nearby, then wait for the results. why can't the health center give it for free, and why is this information not on any CU website? then, you will need to record your own weight, height, and blood pressure at another station. the next part is really infuriating. you will need to see a staff at another station who will record all the previous information (weight, height, b.p.) for you in your medical sheet, and she will ask if you have any medical allergies. this staff was incredibly mean to me, and shouted at me for not knowing that i had to take my temperature. i expected some kind of classic thermometer that one would stick in the ear or mouth, but the health center uses one of those hand/heat detection scanners, similar to the ones you need to wave in front of before entering 7-11 during 2020. it is so embarrassing to have to deal with this staff and i hated every moment of it. there is no reason to raise your voice at patients who are here to get treatment. believe me, when she is not dealing with anyone, the staff just sits at the desk with 3 phones watching youtube videos, or watches everyone else that enters into the center closely like a hawk. it felt very unprofessional. the next part was the actual meeting with the doctor. i spoke in english the whole time when explaining my symptoms and medical history because my thai is not great and i would rather have them understand me fully. somehow, it felt like the doctor was also slightly arrogant when she saw my blue ID card, but i didn't speak thai. she said, "i'm thai, so i am proud to be thai." sorry? i don't see how this has anything to do with my medical condition and health? i left the room feeling very shocked that a doctor would say something like that, and made me explain why i would rather prefer to speak english than thai. the only good thing about this place is that if you show your CU student card, the doctor's assessment and medication are free. however, if you can, DON'T come here for medical treatment. go to somewhere else instead where you will be treated with more respect and courtesy by the staff.
0x30e29ed5bd4ac469_0x45581b444c43d9f2.author: peaches

0x30e29ed5bd4ac469_0x45581b444c43d9f2.text: Today I went to the Chulalongkorn University area and stopped by the health center to see a doctor, but the worst part was, it seemed like the person examining me wasn't a doctor at all 🥲🥲 My thumb was swollen at the joint, but they didn't even touch it or check the symptoms. They just asked what happened and prescribed antibiotics. I asked if I didn't need to apply ointment, and they said the medication wouldn't reach the affected area, I had to take it orally... I was confused, there was no wound at all. So I chose not to take the medication because I felt like something wasn't right ;-;. It was really strange. When I went to see them during my student days, they were real doctors. But today, they looked like some kind of staff member, wearing a yellow and blue polo shirt, and they kept asking me where I worked and if I lived nearby 😱 The staff outside were very nice. They were kind, answered questions politely, and even wrote a note on the form because they recognized me as an alumna, so they could help the staff find my information more easily. But the staff at the counter scolded me for writing "alumnus," saying why would I do that, since I'm still an outsider... I was confused, why scold me? 😑 The nurse who took my blood pressure spoke without any politeness. And they weren't accommodating at all. They just said, "Take your blood pressure, take your temperature, go to room 6, knock, and if it's free, go in." Then their face was stern. We've seen a lot of people go there because the price isn't expensive, but if they operate like this, it's like disrespecting the patients. Even if it's inexpensive, you should perform your duties properly according to your professional ethics. I feel terrible hearing that the saying "Chulalongkorn University's prestige is about serving the public" is true. Does that even exist...?
0x30e29ed5bd4ac469_0x45581b444c43d9f2.author: Jennie K

0x30e29ed5bd4ac469_0x45581b444c43d9f2.text: I went for my flu shot. There were hardly any people when I arrived, but I waited for hours with no one calling my number and no notification whatsoever. Eventually, more people started arriving, and it became unbearable. I had to get up and ask a staff member. Turns out, there was no doctor available; the doctor was on their way. I was extremely disappointed. Why make me wait so long? Shouldn't they have told me beforehand? After an hour, the doctor finally arrived and just stood there chatting with the staff. Patients were completely meaningless to them. It's my fault for choosing this clinic because of the cheap price, but the service was terrible. I felt like I wasted my time, my mental health, and my overall well-being. Finally, I saw the doctor for less than 30 seconds. It was just to see them briefly; they didn't ask a single question, only needed my signature. Then I had to wait at the cashier and for the injection. The worst part was, the staff member who was going to give me the injection just stood there gossiping with other staff members at the counter. I'm done with this clinic. I will never use their services again.
0x30e29ed5bd4ac469_0x45581b444c43d9f2.author: Belle Hathaithip

0x30e29ed5bd4ac469_0x45581b444c43d9f2.text: This is a bit long, please read to the end because I want you to know about the terrible service I received. I usually go to private clinics, I've never experienced a free visit like this before. I decided to try my student benefits, but it was a huge mistake. The doctor was incredibly rude. He barely asked about my symptoms and told me to prescribe medication myself, just because he saw I was a veterinary student. He asked what time I went to bed – which I usually do because I have daily rounds and cases, but he acted like he was blaming me for staying up late. He then asked if I went to bed at 9 PM if I didn't have rounds or to study. I said 4 or 5 PM, and he asked why I included 11 PM, even though he threatened to curse me and say he wouldn't get a first-class honors degree if I wasn't telling the truth. I was just confused about why he would act like that. It's bizarre. How could he be a doctor? He has no medical ethics at all. Why would I go to a doctor if I have to diagnose and prescribe medication for myself? P.S. The doctor was a man in his 50s. I went around 5:30 PM.
0x30e29ed5bd4ac469_0x45581b444c43d9f2.author: Chanisara Tanthongthae

0x3102f300499c4655_0x4fbb9c1cbfb9b6cc.text: The doctor gave great advice and was incredibly gentle. The staff were lovely and provided excellent service. The clinic was clean and met high standards. I highly recommend this place! 😍 …
0x3102f300499c4655_0x4fbb9c1cbfb9b6cc.author: Icez Iyavee

0x3102f300499c4655_0x4fbb9c1cbfb9b6cc.text: The doctor has a very gentle hand. The staff provided excellent service. I was impressed from the first time I used the service. I will definitely come back. ❤️
0x3102f300499c4655_0x4fbb9c1cbfb9b6cc.author: Nutta Bandadee

0x3102f300499c4655_0x4fbb9c1cbfb9b6cc.text: I was impressed from the front of the store to the staff. The staff were very helpful and friendly. The store looked clean and had convenient parking. 10/10
0x3102f300499c4655_0x4fbb9c1cbfb9b6cc.author: Wanida Wongchai

0x3102f300499c4655_0x4fbb9c1cbfb9b6cc.text: I was impressed from the very first day I received service. Both the doctor and the staff took very good care of me. 🥰 …
0x3102f300499c4655_0x4fbb9c1cbfb9b6cc.author: ศิริลักษณ์ เพิ่มลาภ

0x3102f300499c4655_0x4fbb9c1cbfb9b6cc.text: Service date: 19th Initially, I booked the 999 baht tie pin. But at the clinic, I changed my mind and opted for the Mounjaro pen tie pin. Because I've had it done elsewhere before. The staff informed me that the 999 baht tie pin wasn't the same as the pen. Upon arrival, I encountered a staff member trying to sell me a course of treatments. However, it wasn't convenient for me, so I opted for the pen tie pin as before. But because I also requested a tummy massage, the staff member added that. The total bill came to 3000 baht. The staff collected payment before the procedure. I thought I would have everything done at the same time. But after I paid, the staff informed me that the doctor wasn't in, and I should get the tummy massage first 😡😡😡 and then come back on Saturday for the tie pin tie pin 😡😡 I was very unhappy because it was my due date for the tie pin tie, but I had already paid, so I thought, "Whatever, I'll come back on Saturday." 😡😡😡 On Saturday, there was no discussion at all. I just went in, had the tie pin inserted, without any explanation of the medication or anything. They just injected it. Other clinics I've been to before... They showed me the brand of the injected substance. And how many mg were used. But after the injection, there was absolutely nothing. It didn't control my appetite, nothing at all. I'm so confused about what they injected. I'm very disappointed and unimpressed. It had no effect whatsoever. Customer service and honesty with customers are very important. 3000 baht isn't a small amount. I spent a whole month getting my hair done. But I wanted to do it because it was close to my workplace. I didn't want to travel far. If they were honest with their customers, they should have informed me beforehand that the doctor wasn't available. They collected the money beforehand, even though nothing had been done. This is a warning to anyone considering getting treatment at this clinic. I'm not biased; I'm speaking from a pure heart. Experiencing this makes me so sad. Other places I went to before were cheaper. But I chose to go there because it was close to my workplace.
0x3102f300499c4655_0x4fbb9c1cbfb9b6cc.author: ชนัฏกานต์ หลักปัญญา

0x30502f06741cd13d_0x4fedb773c7cf2f54.text: The clinic is in Chalong, about 500 meters past the police station. A doctor's certificate costs 400 baht and takes 10 minutes. I recommend it. P.S. I received my medical degree from Mahidol University, handed over to King Rama IX. Here you can get a medical certificate, including a blood test for syphilis, for 400 baht. It wasn't easy to find :) And the doctor's degree came from King Rama IX (Mahidol University).
0x30502f06741cd13d_0x4fedb773c7cf2f54.author: Dmitry Bogatyrev

0x30502f06741cd13d_0x4fedb773c7cf2f54.text: My mother had a cervical cancer screening five months ago. The biopsy and wound examination were performed about a week ago. The results were nothing to worry about. However, after five months, she developed symptoms, so she had to be admitted to Bangkok Hospital. The biopsy was sent for examination. The results revealed stage 3 cervical cancer, which is very serious. If the doctor had examined her more thoroughly, she would have been able to treat her promptly. 👎🏽👎🏽
0x30502f06741cd13d_0x4fedb773c7cf2f54.author: วนาลีย์ นะถา

0x30502f06741cd13d_0x4fedb773c7cf2f54.text: The ultrasound appointment was terrible. They didn't give us any ultrasound paper. My husband wanted to see the baby's development, but the doctor made him wait outside. It was really awful. We didn't get any detailed information about the baby at all.
0x30502f06741cd13d_0x4fedb773c7cf2f54.author: Kamolwan Naoprai

0x311d61e0ba7d9dd5_0xfab5dd76d91f40b5.text: The price is quite high considering the clinic's condition and the diagnostic equipment. The person who actually examined me didn't match the name and didn't look like me at all; they were very unprofessional. The medication didn't work; it took several weeks. The diagnosis was wrong, and I only went to the hospital once to find out.
0x311d61e0ba7d9dd5_0xfab5dd76d91f40b5.author: P Petar

0x311d61e0ba7d9dd5_0xfab5dd76d91f40b5.text: The doctors here don't really examine people. People only go to the doctor with symptoms. But when you go to a clinic, describe your symptoms, and the doctor says everything is normal. I sprained my ankle, and the doctor didn't even examine me; he just said I walked normally. Who goes to the doctor like that?
0x311d61e0ba7d9dd5_0xfab5dd76d91f40b5.author: NPD Winmono

0x311d61e0ba7d9dd5_0xfab5dd76d91f40b5.text: The treatment was inaccurate, the diagnosis was wrong, and the medication was prescribed incorrectly. I only found out the diagnosis was wrong when I went to the hospital. What a waste of money. The clinic was old, dirty, and completely unsanitary. They just did a quick check-up and I paid.
0x311d61e0ba7d9dd5_0xfab5dd76d91f40b5.author: Li Ting

0x3054f1ae2f20fb5d_0xbb61e87e589f3792.text: I booked via there Facebook page from New Zealand to have 7 white crowns crowns,(2 x bridges). Everything from start to finish was excellent, from the professional receptionists and the attentive dentist. Very friendly too. I felt no pain during or post. The cost for all the work including the temporary teeth were around $3500 NZ, the price was competitive compared to the fancy looking frontage dentists you will see in Koh Samui. Thank you to the team not only did you do a great job you have given me confidence not having to wear a denture anymore.
0x3054f1ae2f20fb5d_0xbb61e87e589f3792.author: Neil Kember

0x3054f1ae2f20fb5d_0xbb61e87e589f3792.text: Excellent - Teeth whitening. Could not be more happy. They squeezed me in a short notice last minute appointment. Receptionists, dentist and all staff were very professional. Would recommend.
0x3054f1ae2f20fb5d_0xbb61e87e589f3792.author: Lisa Tebbutt

0x3054f1ae2f20fb5d_0xbb61e87e589f3792.text: I had a complicated sixth tooth pulled out. I had an implant installed. I am very pleased.
0x3054f1ae2f20fb5d_0xbb61e87e589f3792.author: Urgen Prochnoff

0x3054f1ae2f20fb5d_0xbb61e87e589f3792.text: No integrity whatsoever. After agreeing to a set price and speaking directly to the dentist I was advised that my general clean and polish that I have annually back home suddenly went up 400 baht upon arriving on time whilst sitting in the dentists chair. Very poor and misleading particularly when I asked to speak to the dentist directly prior to arriving. I will not recommend friends who will be arriving on the island who need considerable amount of work. This is the first time I have had to walk out from a business based on principles and thought I would share my experience.
0x3054f1ae2f20fb5d_0xbb61e87e589f3792.author: Tony Srpcanski

0x3054f1ae2f20fb5d_0xbb61e87e589f3792.text: Terrible clinic. They say they're open, but in reality, there's just one bored receptionist who can't really explain anything. I understand there are no doctors on site. I was constantly calling someone. My problem was that a veneer on my front tooth fell off. I wanted to replace it. Eventually, the receptionist showed me the price list and, for some reason, started referring me to Bangkok Samui Hospital. Basically, it's some kind of underground lab! I don't recommend visiting.
0x3054f1ae2f20fb5d_0xbb61e87e589f3792.author: Светлана Федотова

0x3054f1ae2f20fb5d_0xbb61e87e589f3792.text: The implant was placed on me completely crookedly, for which I paid a high price. Now everything needs to be redone and I have to wait another year for my new front tooth. I would not recommend this place to anyone. A.U
0x3054f1ae2f20fb5d_0xbb61e87e589f3792.author: Aivar Kala

0x311d6191f42453fb_0xab11934d671635b9.text: ไม่โอเค ไปที่อื่นเถอะ พนักงานต้อนรับพักก่อน ไปอุดหินปูน พนักงานไม่แจ้งว่าใช้สิทธิ์ยังไม่ได้ พอเริ่มขึ้นเตียง เดินมาแจ้งว่าใช้สิทธิ์ประกันสังคมยังไม่ได้ ให้เราจ่ายไปก่อน เราบอกไม่ทำแล้ววได้มั้ย หมอบอกว่าได้ค่อยรอมาครั้งหน้า เดินออกมาขอเก็บค่าอุปกรณ์100 คือ งง ว่า ถ้าใช้สิทธิ์ไม่ได้ ทำไมไม่แจ้งงตั้งเเต่เเรก เวลาตั้งแต่เอาบัตรประชาชนไป จนรอขึ้นเตียงประมาณ10 นาที แล้วไม่มีคิวคนอื่นเลยนะ มีแค่เรา แต่ไม่แจ้ง คือถ้ามันใช้สิทธิ์ไม่ได้ เค้าเอาบัตรประชาชนเราไปตั้งแต่เเรก ค้นหา ถ้ามันใช้ไม่ได้มันก็ขึ้นตั้งแต่่แรกกแล้วมั้ย ไม่ใช่พอหมอเริ่มให้เราอ้าปาก แล้ว เดินมาแจ้ง เหมือนตั้งใจโดนหลอก รู้สึกเหมือนมัดมือชก ถ้าเป็นคนที่ไม่กล้าปฏิเสธ ก็คงต้องยอมทำต่ออะ พอถามทำไมพี่ไม่แจ้งก่อนครับ เค้าบอกอ้าว พี่ก็นึกว่าน้องรู้ เอาเถอะ เสียเงิน ฟรี ไม่เริศ
0x311d6191f42453fb_0xab11934d671635b9.en: Not okay. Go somewhere else. The receptionist was unhelpful. I went to get my teeth cleaned, but the staff didn't inform me that I couldn't use my social security benefits. Once I was on the treatment bed, they came and said I couldn't use my social security benefits and asked me to pay upfront. I asked if I could just not do it, and the doctor said yes, and I could come back next time. Then they came out and asked for 100 baht for equipment. I was confused. If I couldn't use my benefits, why didn't they tell me from the beginning? From the moment they took my ID card until I waited on the bed (about 10 minutes), and there were no other patients, just me, they didn't inform me. If it wasn't valid, they would have taken my ID card and searched for information. If it wasn't valid, it would have shown up from the start. It felt like I was intentionally tricked and forced into it. If I were someone who couldn't refuse, I would have had to go along with it. When I asked why they didn't inform me beforehand, they said, "Oh, we thought you knew." Whatever. Wasted money. Not good.

0x311d6191f42453fb_0xab11934d671635b9.text: ป้าพนักงานต้อนรับปากหมามากครับ (ใส่แว่น ผมบ๊อบสั้น ๆ) แค่เข้าไปถามเรื่องจัดฟันและการวางแผน บอกอุ่นเครื่องรอแล้ว ถ้าไม่ทำวันนี้จ่าย 100 บาท ถามราคาว่ามันน่าจะประมาณเท่าไหร่บ้าง ตอบว่าบอกไม่ได้ แล้วจะเตรียมเงินในกระเป๋ามาตอนวันเคลียร์ช่องปากได้ยังไงล่ะ ใช้ถ้อยคำตะเพิดแม่ผมให้ไปนั่งไกล ๆ เพราะเรื่องไวรัสต้องห่างกัน แถมมาสั่งสอนลูกค้าว่าอย่าตะคอก ทั้งที่มันสุดแล้วเรื่องอารมณ์ พูดจาห้วนและห้าวมาก เคยเจอหมอที่นี่แล้ว หมอดีมากครับ แต่มนุษย์ป้าพนักงานต้อนรับทำให้ผมต้องยอมไม่เจอหมอคลีนิคนี้ก็ได้ ไปทำที่อื่นดีกว่า
0x311d6191f42453fb_0xab11934d671635b9.en: The receptionist (a woman with glasses and a short bob haircut) was incredibly rude. I just went in to ask about orthodontic treatment and planning, and she said, "We're already preparing you. If you don't do it today, you'll have to pay 100 baht." When I asked about the approximate price, she said she couldn't give me an estimate. How am I supposed to prepare the money for the appointment? She rudely told my mother to sit far away because of the virus, and even lectured me about yelling, even though she was already at her wit's end. Her tone was extremely abrupt and harsh. I've met a doctor here before, and they're excellent. But this rude receptionist made me decide I'd rather not see the doctor at this clinic and go somewhere else.

0x30e29c39f0206371_0x991850bef70a5258.text: ประทับใจคลินิกทำฟันนี้มากค่ะ ตอนแรกตั้งใจแค่วอล์กอินเข้าไปขูดหินปูนอย่างเดียว ไม่ได้นัดล่วงหน้าไว้ แต่ก็ได้คิวเลยค่ะ พอเข้าห้องตรวจ คุณหมอตรวจละเอียด นอกจากขูดหินปูนแล้วยังเจอฟันผุ คุณหมอให้คำแนะนำดี ก็เลยตัดสินใจอุดฟันหลังจากขูดหินปูน ใช้เวลาไม่นาน เสร็จรวดเร็วทันใจ แถมคุณหมอมือเบาสุดๆ คลินิกก็สะอาด ที่สำคัญคือราคาน่ารัก รอบหน้ากลับมาทำที่นี่อีกแน่นอนค่ะ I had a great experience at this dental clinic. I initially walked in without an appointment just to get a teeth cleaning, and they were able to fit me in right away. During the checkup, the dentist was extremely thorough. Along with the cleaning, they spotted a cavity and gave me helpful recommendations, so I decided to get it filled right then and there. The whole process was fast and efficient, and the dentist had such a gentle touch with zero discomfort. The clinic itself is super clean and welcoming. On top of all that, the prices are very reasonable and affordable for the quality of service. I’ll definitely be coming back next time.
0x30e29c39f0206371_0x991850bef70a5258.en: I was very impressed with this dental clinic. Initially, I only intended to walk in for a teeth cleaning, without an appointment, but I got a slot right away. During the examination, the dentist was very thorough. Besides the teeth cleaning, they found a cavity and gave me helpful advice. So I decided to get a filling after the cleaning. It didn't take long; it was quick and efficient. The dentist was incredibly gentle, the clinic was clean, and most importantly, the price was very reasonable. I will definitely be back here next time. I had a great experience at this dental clinic. I initially walked in without an appointment just to get a teeth cleaning, and they were able to fit me in right away. During the checkup, the dentist was extremely thorough. Along with the cleaning, they spotted a cavity and gave me helpful recommendations, so I decided to get it filled right then and there. The whole process was fast and efficient, and the dentist had such a gentle touch with zero discomfort. The clinic itself is super clean and welcoming. On top of all that, the prices are very reasonable and affordable for the quality of service. I’ll definitely be coming back next time.

0x30e29c39f0206371_0x991850bef70a5258.text: โดนมาเหมือนกันไปใส่ฟันแล้วงานมันไม่เรียบร้อยพอรู้ว่าต้องแก้งานเท่านั้นแหละหมอพูดจาและใช้กิริยากวนตีนขึ้นมาเลยทำนองว่าเราเรื่องมาก ปกติไปทำบ่อยไม่เคยเจอปัญหาแต่รอบนี้ได้เห็นฤทธิ์เพราะมีแก้งานผมถึงกับสตั้นเลยโมโหมากจนพูดไม่ออกเถียงก็ไม่ทันไปรอบสองยังไม่วายโดนพูดกวนอีก แต่ตั้งใจว่าถ้างานไม่โอเคก็จะยอมเสียเงินไปทำที่อื่นก็พยายามควบคุมอารมณ์ไม่อยากทะเลาะด้วย ทำให้จบๆแล้วจะไม่กลับไปอีก เจ็บใจจริงๆ
0x30e29c39f0206371_0x991850bef70a5258.author: viking VK
0x30e29c39f0206371_0x991850bef70a5258.en: I had a similar experience. I went to get dentures fitted, and the work wasn't done properly. As soon as I found out it needed fixing, the dentist became rude and disrespectful, implying I was being difficult. I usually go there often and never have problems, but this time I saw their true colors. I was stunned and so angry I couldn't speak or argue. Even on the second visit, they continued to be disrespectful. I decided that if the work wasn't satisfactory, I would just pay and go somewhere else. I tried to control my emotions and avoid arguing, just to get it over with and never go back again. It was truly infuriating.

0x30e29c39f0206371_0x991850bef70a5258.text: Extremely rude and disrespectful doctor. Very unpleasant experience and ended up walking out. The nurses were very polite and kind however.
0x30e29c39f0206371_0x991850bef70a5258.author: Zay

0x30da28fa5fe38243_0xf07453587bb9bd3b.text: I received friendly care. I was sick with a fever and a sore throat. I will come and use the service.
0x30da28fa5fe38243_0xf07453587bb9bd3b.author: Thanyakanpas Ngernkaew

0x30da28fa5fe38243_0xf07453587bb9bd3b.text: I took my girlfriend with COVID-19 to get tested and get a medical certificate. When I arrived, a staff member greeted me with a pleasant smile. She was a slightly chubby woman wearing a blue dress. She had me wait for about 15 minutes, then finally called me to take her blood pressure and other measurements. She was having my girlfriend take her temperature, and she was telling me to wait. Then she disappeared. After a while, a woman in a black shirt with slightly wavy hair walked in with an unwilling expression. I wasn't sure if she was a doctor. If she was, she probably should have bought a license to practice instead of relying on her knowledge. Her words, tone, and facial expression were something like, "If you can't test me, I can't give you a certificate." My girlfriend asked if she could get tested, and she said, "There's no place to test, I can't test, I can't give you a certificate." Even though I was already prepared for the harsh language of doctors and nurses in the community, I didn't expect her tone and facial expression to be this bad. She didn't even look like she was disgusted. Oh, and the worst part was that I had already stated my purpose from the beginning. If they couldn't do it, I should have told them from the beginning. Now, she's making me wait, taking measurements, and taking my medical history, wasting my time for hours, and then she can't tell me. It's so awful. And the last thing she said was, "Go get tested at San Kamphaeng Hospital." But it's a bit expensive. Sorry, but you can afford it. (Morning of January 24, 2024)
0x30da28fa5fe38243_0xf07453587bb9bd3b.author: Katesiri Siriwutthiphat

0x30da3cb4ae8b02f3_0xb947b38add7d7bde.text: The doctor is very skilled. The service is good, fast, and the doctor provides excellent knowledge of treatment and care. 0x30fdabacd9b652f7_0x9a006fcebad83240.en: The root canal treatment was terrible. If left untreated, it would rot, requiring a new dentist to remove the old one and do it again, resulting in double the expense and a very long time.

0x30fdabacd9b652f7_0x9a006fcebad83240.text: มาทำฟันปลอมให้คุณแม่ทำแย่มาก ใส่ไม่ได้เลย เสียเงินเยอะมาก แก้แล้วก็ยังใส่ไม่ได้ สุดท้ายไปทำร้านอื่นค่ะ

0x30fdabacd9b652f7_0x9a006fcebad83240.en: I had dentures made for my mother, but the service was terrible. They didn't fit at all. I wasted a lot of money. Even after adjustments, they still didn't fit. In the end, I went to another clinic.

0x311d67ccb30a6f9b_0x38c36746567c769a.text: คุณหมอน่ารักทุกคนเลยค่ะ พูดดีมากๆ แนะนำคนไข้ดีชวนคุยถามเราอยู่ตลอดไม่ให้เรากังวล ชอบมากๆค่ะ แนะนำบ้านฟอฟันเลยค่า❤️😊

0x311d67ccb30a6f9b_0x38c36746567c769a.en: All the doctors are so lovely! They speak so well, give great advice to patients, and constantly chat with us to keep us from worrying. I really like them! I highly recommend Baan Fofun! ❤️😊

0x311d67ccb30a6f9b_0x38c36746567c769a.text: พนักงานรับโทรศัพท์ พูดจาหมาไม่แดรกมากๆ อย่างกับสก๊อยมาทำงาน แดกดัน ไม่มีหางเสียง ทำเหมือนไปขอบริการ ไม่โอเคอย่างมาก 31/12/68 เวลา 2:30

0x311d67ccb30a6f9b_0x38c36746567c769a.en: The person answering the phone was incredibly rude and spoke like a low-class, sarcastic, and disrespectful person. It was as if I was begging for service. Absolutely unacceptable. 31/12/68, 2:30 AM.

0x30e280e3ffffffc1_0xebb06b5c76524244.text: ถอนเสร็จไวมาก ไม่เจ็บเลย คุณหมอ มือเบามาก และ น่ารักด้วย 😍 คุณหมอพูดจาดี และ น่ารักทุกคนเลย ในคลินิก 👍 วันหลังจะไปใช้บริการอีก ครับ เหลือขูดหินปูน 😊 โดยรวมให้ —> 5 ดาว ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 🎉 ประกันสังคม ก็ใช้ได้ครับ ไม่ต้องสำรองจ่าย 👍

0x30e280e3ffffffc1_0xebb06b5c76524244.en: The extraction was very quick and painless. The doctor had a very gentle touch and was lovely too 😍 All the doctors at the clinic were kind and friendly 👍 I'll definitely come back for more services in the future. I just need a teeth cleaning 😊 Overall, I give it 5 stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 🎉 Social security insurance is also accepted; no upfront payment required 👍

0x30e280e3ffffffc1_0xebb06b5c76524244.text: จริงๆก็เป็นลูกค้ามายาวนานกว่าจะเลือกใช้บริการต่อเนื่อง ดูแลดีรับผิดชอบลูกค้ามีปัญหาช่วยแก้ไข ช่วยแนะนำแนวทางการรักษาที่เหมาะสมให้

0x30e280e3ffffffc1_0xebb06b5c76524244.en: Actually, I've been a long-time customer, which is why I choose to continue using their services. They provide excellent care, are responsible, help resolve problems, and recommend appropriate treatment options.

0x30e280e3ffffffc1_0xebb06b5c76524244.text: พนักงานบริการเเย่ โทรไปถามอะไรก็ไม่ได้คำตอบ พูดไม่รู้เรื่อง ให้ข้อมูลผิด ถ้าเห็นรีวิว กรุณาโทรเเจ้งข้อมูลที่ถูกด้วยค่ะ บอกว่าเดี๋ยวโทรกลับก็ไม่โทรมาสักที

0x30e280e3ffffffc1_0xebb06b5c76524244.en: The customer service is terrible. I called to ask something and got no answers. They were incomprehensible and gave incorrect information. If you see this review, please call and provide the correct information. They said they would call back but never did.

0x30e29fb218acb439_0xe5dd0d66e2c2790e.text: Booked a Rf session here. The service was splendid! A lot better than I expected! I will definitely book again.

0x30e29fb218acb439_0xe5dd0d66e2c2790e.text: I went for a laser treatment and initially purchased a course, but the staff were incredibly pushy and pressured me to buy more. After I bought it and used it only once, the clinic suddenly announced a temporary closure for renovations on …

0x30e2996e98a6c7d9_0x424cd203142f0144.text: The first review must be a lie 😂 Yes, the man doesn't talk much, but he examined my wound, gave me exactly what I wanted, and at the right price. Many pharmacies charge foreigners more, but he has prices printed on the medications. And in my country, it would cost me three times as much. I recommend this pharmacy. …
0x30e2996e98a6c7d9_0x424cd203142f0144.author: Kevin Pa

0x30e2996e98a6c7d9_0x424cd203142f0144.text: Best and cheapest around. Just ask your AI what you need before going in rather than bother the pharmacist
0x30e2996e98a6c7d9_0x424cd203142f0144.author: ryan

0x30e2996e98a6c7d9_0x424cd203142f0144.text: I can put my mind at ease! After reading the reviews, I marched off to the pharmacy a bit nervously, as it was the only one open on Sunday in the Samsen district. But the pharmacist was friendly enough to have exactly what I needed for my upset stomach right there. And the pharmacy is well-stocked, because he even had a medication that's not easy to find.
0x30e2996e98a6c7d9_0x424cd203142f0144.author: Doritatravels

0x30e2996e98a6c7d9_0x424cd203142f0144.text: Pharmacist is a condescending jerk. Went in with symptoms of food poisoning. He said it wasn’t food poisoning but then changed his mind when he heard about the vomiting. Wanted to give me electrolyte powder and two medicines. When I asked what the medicines were he wouldn’t let me look telling me I wouldn’t know, then out everything back under the counter.
0x30e2996e98a6c7d9_0x424cd203142f0144.author: Timothy Crepeau

0x30e2996e98a6c7d9_0x424cd203142f0144.text: Avoid at all costs! The man there got annoyed because I wanted to check the name of the product he was giving me (understandable, given that his English isn't perfect and neither is mine). He said, "Check what? I'm the pharmacist!" and gestured wildly to make me leave. Rude and disrespectful.
0x30e2996e98a6c7d9_0x424cd203142f0144.author: Mélanie Pilon

0x30e2996e98a6c7d9_0x424cd203142f0144.text: Very impolite pharmacist. Didn’t care about my symptoms. Didn’t offer advice. Only wanted money. Not recommended. Find a Boots or a Watson instead.

0x30e2996e98a6c7d9_0x424cd203142f0144.text: Super rude wouldn’t let me look at the box to read it. Even though I tried to explain allergies
0x30e2996e98a6c7d9_0x424cd203142f0144.author: Holly Coleman

0x3102b9c0bbe3ffab_0x7a1dbff20cfcd1d2.text: แค่เปิดประตูก็ประทับใจแล้วเจ้าหน้าที่ให้การต้อนรับยิ้มแย้มสดใสทักทายดีมาก ได้พบคุณหมอยิ่งอุ่นใจแล้วรู้สึกดี มากคุณหมอให้คำแนะนำดีมากๆ คลายความกลัวได้เยอะเลยค่ะ ใครที่ฝันร้ายจากการทำฟัน แนะนำมาที่นี่เลยค่ะ คุณจะฝันดีตลอดไป
0x3102b9c0bbe3ffab_0x7a1dbff20cfcd1d2.author: Tang gamer
0x3102b9c0bbe3ffab_0x7a1dbff20cfcd1d2.en: The moment I opened the door, I was impressed. The staff were welcoming, smiling brightly, and greeted me very well. Meeting the doctor made me feel even more reassured and good. The doctor gave excellent advice, which greatly relieved my fears. If you ever have nightmares about dental procedures, I highly recommend coming here. You'll have sweet dreams afterward!

0x3102b9c0bbe3ffab_0x7a1dbff20cfcd1d2.text: เจ้าหน้าที่บริการดี หมอใจดีมือเบา ไม่เคยโดนดุ ย้ายมาจัดฟันที่นี่ก็ฟันเรียงสวยเร็วมาก ให้คำแนะนำ และอัพเดตตลอดว่าถึงขั้นตอนไหนแล้ว
0x3102b9c0bbe3ffab_0x7a1dbff20cfcd1d2.en: The staff are excellent, the dentist is kind and gentle, I've never been scolded. My teeth straightened beautifully very quickly after switching to this clinic. They provide advice and update me on the progress of my treatment throughout the process.

0x3102b9c0bbe3ffab_0x7a1dbff20cfcd1d2.text: เจ้าหน้าที่บริการดี เป็นกันเอง คนหมอมือเบามาก แนะนำดี แผนการรักษาชัดเจนคะ ใครสนใจจัดฟันแนะนำที่นี้เลยครับ#โปร3999
0x3102b9c0bbe3ffab_0x7a1dbff20cfcd1d2.en: The staff were friendly and provided excellent service. The dentist was very gentle and gave good advice. The treatment plan was clear. I highly recommend this place to anyone interested in getting braces! #Promo3999

0x3102b9c0bbe3ffab_0x7a1dbff20cfcd1d2.text: จะเข้าไปทำฟันนั่งรอตั้งแต่หกโมงครึ่งจนหนึ่งทุ่มต้องลุกไปถามพนักงานต้อนรับบอกไม่รับเคส work in แทนที่จะบอกสักหน่อยปล่อยไห้นั่งรอเพื่อ ??? นั่งมองหน้าแล้วไม่ถามสักคำ
0x3102b9c0bbe3ffab_0x7a1dbff20cfcd1d2.author: วิศิษฐ์ ตั้งตรงเป้า
0x3102b9c0bbe3ffab_0x7a1dbff20cfcd1d2.en: I went to the dentist and waited from 6:30 PM until 7:00 PM. I had to get up and ask the receptionist, who said they don't accept walk-in cases. Instead of telling me that, they just let me sit and wait. Why? They just sat there staring at me without asking a single question.

0x3102b9c0bbe3ffab_0x7a1dbff20cfcd1d2.text: นัดไม่เคยตรงนัด รอ30-40นาทีพอทน แต่นี่รอ2ชม.กว่าทุกรอบ ใครจะเริ่มจัดฟันก็อย่าลืมเน้นย้ำเรื่องเวลานะคะ ไม่งั้นจะเสียเวลาชีวิตมากกก
0x3102b9c0bbe3ffab_0x7a1dbff20cfcd1d2.author: Kare Lau
0x3102b9c0bbe3ffab_0x7a1dbff20cfcd1d2.en: Appointments are never on time. Waiting 30-40 minutes is tolerable, but here I've waited over 2 hours every single time. Anyone considering braces should remember to emphasize the importance of punctuality; otherwise, you'll waste a lot of your time!

0x3050378dd5c92ab7_0x42af5c243c2f7237.text: This was the first clinic I went to, and I was incredibly disappointed with the doctor. I took my child there because he had severe ear pain and couldn't sleep all night. But the doctor told me to go to the hospital because my child had a slight fever. He said, "If he has a fever, go somewhere else. Go to the hospital!" He acted disgusted too. I brought my child to see a doctor for ear pain, not for a fever!! And he didn't even examine him thoroughly. The examination took less than a minute. He said he was done, rushed me to get the medicine, and left. He just gave me a bottle of medicine and that was it! Unbelievable!
0x3050378dd5c92ab7_0x42af5c243c2f7237.author: Azmee Butlay

0x3050378dd5c92ab7_0x42af5c243c2f7237.text: DFIU, why are you still scheduling my mother for a check-up? Why not refer her to another hospital? Aren't you afraid my mother will bleed? That's enough of this terrible first experience.
0x3050378dd5c92ab7_0x42af5c243c2f7237.author: Ayub Yong

0x30e298cc57352b1f_0x2d41178acc54eda6.text: พาลูก ๆ ไปทำฟรีตลอดเลย ไปมา 4 ปีแล้วค่ะ ดีใจมากค่ะที่มีโครงการดี ๆ แบบนี้ อยากให้มีไปตลอดเลย ทุกครั้งที่ไปเจอทุกคนพูดจาดี ทั้งผู้ช่วยหน้าและในเค้าเตอร์บริการดีตลอด ทำฟรีคนเยอะ แต่ลูก ๆ รอได้ค่ะ ส่วนตัวมาจัดฟันเสียเงินเอง ได้เจอหมอทุกคนเลย ทั้งหมอจัดฟันผู้หญิงพูดจาน่ารักมาก แต่เคลียร์ช่องปากกับหมอพ่อและหมอลูก หมอพ่อไม่ค่อยพูดแต่เห็นรอยยิ้มบ้าง หมอลูกพูดจาอบอุ่นมาก จากที่กลัวหมอฟันก็หายกลัวไปเปราะนึง รอบหน้าวันพรุ่งนี้เคลียร์ช่องปากครั้งสุดท้ายกับหมอพ่อ ใจจริงอยากเจอหมอลูกมากกว่า
0x30e298cc57352b1f_0x2d41178acc54eda6.author: Wi Orangey
0x30e298cc57352b1f_0x2d41178acc54eda6.en: I've been taking my kids for free dental checkups for four years now. I'm so happy there's such a great program and I hope it continues forever. Every time I go, everyone is so kind, from the assistants at the counter to the service. It's free, so it's busy, but my kids are happy to wait. I paid for my own orthodontic treatment and got to see all the dentists. The female orthodontist is especially lovely. I had my final cleaning with the father and son dentists. The father doesn't talk much, but I see his smile sometimes. The son is so warm and friendly. My fear of dentists has lessened a bit since then. Tomorrow is my final cleaning with the father dentist, but I really wish I could see the son more.

0x30e298cc57352b1f_0x2d41178acc54eda6.text: They do service connected with schools so always crowded of people for their kids
0x30e298cc57352b1f_0x2d41178acc54eda6.author: Patrice in thailand

0x30e298cc57352b1f_0x2d41178acc54eda6.text: ทำฟันได้แย่มากกกกกกกกก ค่าอุดฟันกับแฟน 2 คน เสียไป 6500 บาท เข้าใจว่าอุดหลายซี่ แต่พอถึงบ้านวัสดุอุดเรากับแฟนหลุดหมดเลย ตอนทำก็เจ็บ ไม่แนะนำให้ไปใช้บริการ เราเบิก ปกสค. 900 อุดซี่เดียว+จ่ายเอง 300 แถมหลุดอีก เสียดายตังค์มากๆ งานหยาบ คิดเอาละกันว่าโกรธขนาดไหนปกติไม่เคยรีวิวใครในนี้เลย
0x30e298cc57352b1f_0x2d41178acc54eda6.author: Borwornsingh
0x30e298cc57352b1f_0x2d41178acc54eda6.en: The dental work was terrible! My boyfriend and I paid 6500 baht for fillings (two teeth). I understand we needed fillings, but when we got home, all the fillings had fallen out. It was painful during the procedure. I do not recommend this service. We claimed 900 baht from social security for one filling and paid 300 baht ourselves, and even that came loose! Such a waste of money. The workmanship is shoddy. You can imagine how angry I am; I usually never review anyone here.

0x30e298cc57352b1f_0x2d41178acc54eda6.text: หมอใช้อารมณ์ตัวเองเป็นหลักค่ะ คือเรามาปรึกษาเรื่องฟันและเล่าที่เก่าให้ฟัง เค้าเป็นเพื่อนกับที่เก่ากลับมาว่าเราและไล่เราออกมา ทั้งๆที่เราไม่ได้พูดจาไม่ดีเลย เสียความรู้สึกมากค่ะ
0x30e298cc57352b1f_0x2d41178acc54eda6.author: Kigkapoo Lala
0x30e298cc57352b1f_0x2d41178acc54eda6.en: The doctor was acting mostly based on her own emotions. I came for a dental consultation and told her about my previous clinic. She was friends with my old clinic staff, and she ended up criticizing me and telling me to leave, even though I didn't say anything disrespectful. I felt very hurt.

0x30e281a46d45cd43_0x798fa63359bb3c01.text: คุณหมอใจดีพูดจาดีมากชอบมือเบา แต่พนักงานหน้าเคาน์เตอร์คำพูดคำจาไม่ค่อยน่าฟังเท่าไหร่
0x30e281a46d45cd43_0x798fa63359bb3c01.author: สมร มีสมยุทธ์
0x30e281a46d45cd43_0x798fa63359bb3c01.en: The doctor was very kind and spoke nicely; I liked his gentle touch. However, the counter staff's tone and demeanor weren't very pleasant.

0x30e281a46d45cd43_0x798fa63359bb3c01.text: คุณหมอใจดีมากกก ทำฟันดี แต่พนักงานหน้าบอกบุญไม่รับ ใครมาก่อนมาหลังไม่สำคัญ ได้ยินพนักงานซุบซิบกันว่าเคสนี้ง่ายกว่าเลยให้เคสนี้ทำก่อนดีกว่า ทั้งๆที่เขามาทีหลัง ก็นั่งรอต่อไป ยิ่งเป็นบัตรทองไม่ต้องพูดถึง ใครใจเย็นและปล่อยผ่านเรื่องพนักงานได้ ก็แนะนำค่ะ เพราะหมอดี
0x30e281a46d45cd43_0x798fa63359bb3c01.author: Plengaksorn Janthasom
0x30e281a46d45cd43_0x798fa63359bb3c01.en: The dentist is incredibly kind and does a great job, but the staff are unwelcoming. It doesn't matter who arrived first; I overheard them whispering that this case was easier and they should go first, even though the client arrived later. I just sat there waiting. It's even worse if you have a government-sponsored health insurance card. If you're patient and can tolerate the staff's attitude, I recommend it, because the dentist is excellent.

0x30e281a46d45cd43_0x798fa63359bb3c01.text: ใกล้บ้านเคยมาสมัยเปิดใหม่ๆรอคิวนานตลอดถึงจะจองมาแล้ว ลองมาอีกครั้งโทรจองก่อนเหมือนเดิมพอเลยไปที่อื่นดีกว่าเสียเวลามาก

0x30e281a46d45cd43_0x798fa63359bb3c01.en: It's near my house, and I used to come here when it first opened. There was always a long wait, even if I had a reservation. I tried again, and called ahead to reserve as usual, but this time I decided to go somewhere else. It was a complete waste of time.

0x311d630061a6ae01_0x6fccc88f1abbc45a.text: I'd give this clinic 0 stars. The consultation wait was incredibly long, even though I'd already scheduled an appointment. I've already changed clinics. This clinic was extremely pushy; I was very uncomfortable with their behavior. They …

Before this, I had injected it at other places, which was much cheaper. But the word "inject" here is 4 doses, normally 1-2 doses, so I agreed to pay. In conclusion, it was 4cc, the same as the normal Made at other clinics, which is half the price. Plus, they didn't count the acne injection and made me pay a fixed price, which was more expensive than the actual injection on my face. I felt really bad. When I told the doctor and assistant that the actual injection was not as much as the fixed amount, they counted the needle marks that were injected and said that they were acne injection marks.

When I arrived at the clinic, the staff said the doctor was busy with a case that would take a very long time, possibly 2-3 hours, so I didn't wait. It was a complete waste of time. They should manage the appointment schedule better, especially if they know it's a difficult case, or if they know they won't be able to accommodate the next patient in line, they could call and inform the customer in advance so they don't waste time waiting.

0x311d63cddd0984af_0xcc1e523326e040c6.text: ผ่าฟันคุดได้ห่วยมากกกก ไปผ่าที่อื่นดีกว่า หมอไม่โปร แถมทำผิดพลาดเยอะ โกรธมากอ่ะ โคตรชุ่ย!
0x311d63cddd0984af_0xcc1e523326e040c6.author: Yelly Uu
0x311d63cddd0984af_0xcc1e523326e040c6.en: The wisdom tooth extraction was terrible! Go somewhere else. The doctor was unprofessional and made many mistakes. I'm so angry! So careless!

0x3050315eb3b02ee5_0x4d0e7c4e4ae51fd.text: The doctor examined me very thoroughly, explained everything well, and it was very easy to understand.
0x3050315eb3b02ee5_0x4d0e7c4e4ae51fd.author: Eve Patteera

0x3050315eb3b02ee5_0x4d0e7c4e4ae51fd.text: The doctor was lovely, explained things well, and paid great attention to detail. 😊 …
0x3050315eb3b02ee5_0x4d0e7c4e4ae51fd.author: เบญจมาศ ณ ตะกั่วทุ่ง

0x3050315eb3b02ee5_0x4d0e7c4e4ae51fd.text: The service provided excellent advice, excellent craftsmanship and meticulousness.
0x3050315eb3b02ee5_0x4d0e7c4e4ae51fd.author: บาว brown

0x3050315eb3b02ee5_0x4d0e7c4e4ae51fd.text: Who would have thought? This clinic only has one doctor. The doctor is knowledgeable and experienced, but their work is focused on their own convenience, constantly rescheduling patients' appointments without regard for date or time. The concept here is "the doctor won't extract" teeth; you'll have to ask the doctor for the reason. The dental assistants are all lovely, but the counter service is terrible. They constantly have to call to reschedule appointments, and they never issue receipts. I've been receiving treatment here for a year and still haven't received a receipt. I'm personally very frustrated. I've also received numerous complaints about the appointment delays. I switched clinics and started treatment anew; the doctor didn't reschedule, and everything was resolved very quickly. I was able to focus on my life and no longer have to deal with the constant delays at this clinic.
0x3050315eb3b02ee5_0x4d0e7c4e4ae51fd.author: Yaowalak Uisakul

0x3050315eb3b02ee5_0x4d0e7c4e4ae51fd.text: I had an appointment for a tooth extraction. I inquired at the counter and was told the X-ray was free. When I arrived, the dentist checked my mouth and said extraction wasn't possible; I needed to take medication to reduce inflammation first. They gave me Ponstan and another anti-inflammatory medication, costing 800 baht. Oh my god!
0x3050315eb3b02ee5_0x4d0e7c4e4ae51fd.author: K Knsr

0x3050315eb3b02ee5_0x4d0e7c4e4ae51fd.text: I think the person at the counter and the doctor need to communicate. The prices quoted don't match. They provide poor customer service and lack clarity, then they make displeased faces. Anyone planning to go there should ask for clear details beforehand. I waited over half a day to get treated.
0x3050315eb3b02ee5_0x4d0e7c4e4ae51fd.author: PP Baby

0x3050315eb3b02ee5_0x4d0e7c4e4ae51fd.text: Moving the case is very expensive. The counter doesn't even tell you what the fees are. There are still food scraps in the mouthwash basin in the examination room. It doesn't look clean at all.
0x3050315eb3b02ee5_0x4d0e7c4e4ae51fd.author: พรนภา เพชรเพ็ง

0x30e29ed205e2e133_0xb1769b37d184f6b1.text: I went for Flexed Restore Laser treatment at the Central World branch. The staff member named June was very lovely. Thank you so much!
0x30e29ed205e2e133_0xb1769b37d184f6b1.author: wawa te

0x30e29ed205e2e133_0xb1769b37d184f6b1.text: Give rate for only treatment staff but not for reception staffs, no calls for reminder schedule or pay attention to client members. I used the service of hair removal but the machine broken. Reception staff said they will call back when it’s back to work but no calls until I called back to them and make appointment again by myself. Second worse was reception staffs and salesman talk about other clients behind their back. And speak louder on phone call to disturb other client who waiting for queue inside clinic. Hope this message can find SLC management team to improve this branch as suppose to make it more better.
0x30e29ed205e2e133_0xb1769b37d184f6b1.author: Pitchy W

0x30e29ed205e2e133_0xb1769b37d184f6b1.text: When I got there, I lay on the bed. The staff adjusted the bed so hard that my head almost fell off. They massaged meso and the meso stick fell into my eye. I won't go again.
0x30e29ed205e2e133_0xb1769b37d184f6b1.author: ploypailin pimmy

0x30e29ed205e2e133_0xb1769b37d184f6b1.text: The staff are very bad. They don't care about customers and leave them waiting for a very long time.
0x30e29ed205e2e133_0xb1769b37d184f6b1.author: yokk w.

0x30e2a72b42f82403_0xa907fee2fb6ecbac.text: What phone number should I use to contact the clinic? The number 02-425-9143 is not working.
0x30e2a72b42f82403_0xa907fee2fb6ecbac.author: เกศรา ล้ําประเสริฐ

0x30e2a72b42f82403_0xa907fee2fb6ecbac.text: I have a sore butt from riding in the car. They said I have to wait for the doctor to arrive at 1:30 PM.
0x30e2a72b42f82403_0xa907fee2fb6ecbac.author: อนาวิล จีนากูล

0x30e2a72b42f82403_0xa907fee2fb6ecbac.text: I want to buy a medical certificate to get a driver's license. Do I need to be there too?
0x30e2a72b42f82403_0xa907fee2fb6ecbac.author: คมสัน คําแก้ว

0x30e284702fdfbaed_0x33e39f92d3c96e62.text: มาเอาเศษอาหารออกจากร่องฟัน คุณหมอและน้องพยาบาลดูแลดี ทำเร็ว รอคิวไม่นาน แนะนำค่ะ
0x30e284702fdfbaed_0x33e39f92d3c96e62.author: R BeeR
0x30e284702fdfbaed_0x33e39f92d3c96e62.en: I came to have food particles removed from between my teeth. The dentist and nurse were very attentive and the procedure was quick. I didn't have to wait long. I recommend this clinic.

0x30e284702fdfbaed_0x33e39f92d3c96e62.text: ไปทำการอุดฟันหน้ามา เสร็จเร็วเสร็จไวแต่ไม่ถูกใจแก้อยู่ประมาณ3รอบ พอกลับมาเพิ่งสังเกตว่าฟันที่อุดติดกันกับอีกเล่ม555555เยี่ยม
0x30e284702fdfbaed_0x33e39f92d3c96e62.author: Nalinee Khongphetsak
0x30e284702fdfbaed_0x33e39f92d3c96e62.en: I went to get a front tooth filled. It was quick, but I wasn't satisfied, so they fixed it about three times. When I got home, I noticed the filling was right next to another tooth! LOL, great!

0x30e298d8ea84c159_0xae34204410a2efb0.text: 3 ครั้งที่ไปหาที่นี่ คุณหมอ ทั้ง ชาย และ หญิง ให้การรักษาที่ตรงจุด และมีคุณภาพจริงๆค่ะ ถึงคลีนิคอาจจะไม่ใช่แนวสมัยใหม่ เหมือนหลายๆที่ในปัจจุบัน แต่แก้ปัญหาให้ได้ผลจริงๆค่ะ (ไปรับบริการ ขูดหินปูน, อุดฟัน และ ช่วยให้หาสาเหตุ ว่าทำไมฟันถึงปวดจากการอุดมาจากที่อื่น)..ขอบคุณมากๆนะคะ
0x30e298d8ea84c159_0xae34204410a2efb0.author: Jutamast Wiramitchai
0x30e298d8ea84c159_0xae34204410a2efb0.en: I've visited this clinic 3 times, and both the male and female doctors provided accurate and high-quality treatment. Although the clinic may not be as modern as many others nowadays, they effectively solved my problems. (I received services including teeth cleaning, fillings, and they helped me find the cause of my tooth pain from a filling I had done elsewhere)...Thank you very much!

0x30e298d8ea84c159_0xae34204410a2efb0.text: คุณพ่อจะไปทำฟัน นัดคิวเวลา 11.00 พอไปถึงกับมีคิวเเทรกเข้ามาเเล้ว คุณพ่อเลยยกเลิกไม่ทำ เเล้วมาทำอีกคลินิกนึงเขาเเจ้งว่าเหมือนทางคลินิกเก่าตัดสิทธิ์ไปแล้วจึงไม่สามารถตัดสิทธิ์ได้ จึงโทรกลับมาให้ทางคลินิกยกเลิกให้เเต่ ทางเจ้าหน้าที่เเจ้งว่ายกเลิกไปเเล้ว แต่เจ้าหน้าที่คลินิกสาขาใหม่ตรวจสอบไม่ได้ยกเลิก เหมือนจะตัดสิทธิ์ทั้งๆที่พ่อหนูไม่ได้ทำการรักษา ไม่โอเคเลยค่ะ ถ้าไม่มาทำการรักษากับอีกคลินิกนึงก็คงไม่รู้เลยว่า เขาตัดสิทธิ์พ่อเราไปฟรีๆ ถ้าคนไม่รู้ก็โดนเอาเปรียบเเบบนี้ได้หรอคะ แย่มากค่ะ
0x30e298d8ea84c159_0xae34204410a2efb0.author: La Senza Rose
0x30e298d8ea84c159_0xae34204410a2efb0.en: My father had a dental appointment at 11:00 AM. When he arrived, there was already a new appointment, so he canceled. He then went to another clinic, but they said the old clinic had revoked his treatment rights and therefore they couldn't cancel it. He called the old clinic to have the cancellation done, but the staff there said it had already been cancelled. However, the staff at the new clinic couldn't verify the cancellation. It seems they're essentially revoking his rights even though he didn't receive any treatment. This is unacceptable. If we hadn't gone to the other clinic, we wouldn't have known they revoked his rights for no reason. How can people be taken advantage of like this if they're unaware? This is terrible.

0x30e298d8ea84c159_0xae34204410a2efb0.text: อุดฟันแล้ว มีปัญหาปวดฟันเวลาโดนน้ำเย็นน้ำร้อน ให้เช็คอีกรอบก็ไล่ให้ไปหาจุฬา สุดยอดมาก
0x30e298d8ea84c159_0xae34204410a2efb0.author: จิตสิงห์ ศิริขจรกิจ
0x30e298d8ea84c159_0xae34204410a2efb0.en: After getting a filling, I experienced tooth pain when exposed to hot or cold water. When I asked for a second checkup, they told me to go to Chulalongkorn University Hospital. Amazing!

0x3102c40ccf3cad73_0x15542005e16e9628.text: Both the doctor and the assistant were very lovely. They were friendly, always smiling, and had a great personality. They gave excellent advice and recommendations.
0x3102c40ccf3cad73_0x15542005e16e9628.author: พชรมน ทองขาว

0x3102c40ccf3cad73_0x15542005e16e9628.text: The medical technology clinic in Bowin is about 300 meters past Lotus Bowin, on the same side of the road.
0x3102c40ccf3cad73_0x15542005e16e9628.author: พุทธ ไทย

0x3102c40ccf3cad73_0x15542005e16e9628.text: The service is awful, don't bother coming here. The counter staff were rude to customers, it's unacceptable, absolutely terrible. If possible, don't come here.
0x3102c40ccf3cad73_0x15542005e16e9628.author: sssananda

0x3102c40ccf3cad73_0x15542005e16e9628.text: The service was terrible, and the staff were rude, acting like the check-up was free. 😡 …
0x3102c40ccf3cad73_0x15542005e16e9628.author: Sudarat Oonphim

0x30e2872d316115b1_0xc7cb94d99f24ac44.text: I got my vaccine today. It was quick, I didn't have to wait long. The nurse who gave me the injection had a gentle touch, it didn't hurt much. Everything went well.
0x30e2872d316115b1_0xc7cb94d99f24ac44.author: ingkykkm

0x30e2872d316115b1_0xc7cb94d99f24ac44.text: Convenient, close to home, excellent doctor who takes good care of patients and conducts thorough examinations (Dr. Chaiyos). The price isn't too expensive. Those with health insurance can request a medical certificate to submit for insurance claims. I've never had any problems claiming insurance money. (For those who complain about high prices and poor service, I recommend trying the hospital located at the Poonsap Market intersection. It might give you a new perspective.)
0x30e2872d316115b1_0xc7cb94d99f24ac44.author: N. Lin

0x30e2872d316115b1_0xc7cb94d99f24ac44.text: Yesterday, I took my sibling to the doctor, but the diagnosis was wrong. The system recorded it as dengue fever, while the medical certificate stated it was an early respiratory infection. The bill last night was 1690 baht. We had another appointment today, and a different doctor said the previous doctor's record was inaccurate. Today, we were charged another 1620 baht. There's been no accountability whatsoever. Is the medication they prescribed even appropriate? Can I file a complaint with the Medical Council about this?
0x30e2872d316115b1_0xc7cb94d99f24ac44.author: Arunrat Wongprom

0x30e2872d316115b1_0xc7cb94d99f24ac44.text: I wasted 1,600 baht and the doctor didn't even examine me properly. They didn't listen to my heart, kidneys, or lungs. They just gave me Tylenol. They made me sit by the door (without moving the chair) while the doctor was inside. They just kept asking questions without really paying attention to me. I went all the way here to see a doctor, and if this is what I get, I could just buy medicine from a pharmacy myself.
0x30e2872d316115b1_0xc7cb94d99f24ac44.author: Kanes Pitchayanirun

0x30e2872d316115b1_0xc7cb94d99f24ac44.text: I brought my child for rabies vaccinations. Three shots were given elsewhere, the fourth shot is here. It's okay if it's not reimbursable; I'll claim it myself with the receipt. But if I want a medical certificate, I have to pay an extra 200 baht. What's that all about? I apologize for the patient card; it was left outside the clinic for my child's first visit. Please throw it in the trash.
0x30e2872d316115b1_0xc7cb94d99f24ac44.author: วลี คำฉ่ำ

0x30e2872d316115b1_0xc7cb94d99f24ac44.text: This is the worst service I've ever experienced at this clinic. The staff were grumpy and unpleasant, even though we paid. My sister was in so much pain, doubled over in pain and vomiting heavily, and we paid almost a thousand baht without knowing the cause. They gave her an injection and sent her home, but her condition hasn't improved at all.
0x30e2872d316115b1_0xc7cb94d99f24ac44.author: ศุภณัฐ พูลพันธ์

0x30e2872d316115b1_0xc7cb94d99f24ac44.text: I went to a clinic near my house and got an antibiotic injection. They charged 900 baht for the injection! That's insane!!! I was shocked and paid without realizing it. I even brought my own medication, and the injection cost more than the medication itself. Anyone thinking of going there for treatment, please inquire about the price first!
0x30e2872d316115b1_0xc7cb94d99f24ac44.author: nongyao phansap

0x30e2872d316115b1_0xc7cb94d99f24ac44.text: The treatment was expensive, so I asked if I could decline the medication. The finance staff looked displeased and curtly replied, "Even without the medication, it's still 1400 baht." If I knew getting a fish bone stuck in my throat treated this expensively, I would have gone to a government hospital instead.
0x30e2872d316115b1_0xc7cb94d99f24ac44.author: Narumon Jaidee

0x30e29fab6ae269d5_0xa3493de173b016c8.text: The clinic provides excellent care and friendly service. The doctor is available on Sundays.
0x30e29fab6ae269d5_0xa3493de173b016c8.author: SD Surakit

0x30e29fab6ae269d5_0xa3493de173b016c8.text: Is this the clinic that was in the news, the one with the viral video where a man in a white shirt, claiming to be the owner, hit a doctor with an umbrella when the doctor came to collect his overtime pay? It was a very big news story. Is this the place?
0x30e29fab6ae269d5_0xa3493de173b016c8.author: Lee Pharm

0x30e29fab6ae269d5_0xa3493de173b016c8.text: The clinic is terrible. They abuse doctors, don't pay staff salaries, and don't pay doctors' salaries.
0x30e29fab6ae269d5_0xa3493de173b016c8.author: P J

0x30e2a75eea24967f_0x9d825e472b186771.text: พนักงานเคาน์เตอร์ทำหน้าบูดเหมือนไม่อยากทำงาน เข้าใจแล้วว่าทำไมวันนั้นไม่มีคนเลย ระหว่างทำก็ไม่ระวัง คีบโดนเนื้อปากจนเจ็บ แถมกลายเป็นร้อนในอีก
0x30e2a75eea24967f_0x9d825e472b186771.author: ผัก โขม
0x30e2a75eea24967f_0x9d825e472b186771.en: The counter staff had a grumpy face, like they didn't want to work. Now I understand why there were no customers that day. While preparing the food, they weren't careful and accidentally poked my lip, causing pain and resulting in a canker sore.

0x30e2a75eea24967f_0x9d825e472b186771.text: หมอเลี้ยงไข้จริงๆ 4-5ปีแระ ไม่เสร็จซักที ถามเมื่อไหร่ก็บอกอีกนิดเดียวๆ ซึ่งก็เหลือรูนิดเดียวไม่ดึงให่มันเข้าอ่ะ
0x30e2a75eea24967f_0x9d825e472b186771.author: Kea fordbangpoo
0x30e2a75eea24967f_0x9d825e472b186771.en: The doctor has been dragging this out for 4-5 years now, and it's still not finished. Whenever I ask, he just says "just a little bit more," but there's only a tiny hole left that he won't pull to get it in.

0x30e2a75eea24967f_0x9d825e472b186771.text: หมอเลี้ยงไข้สุดๆ จัดฟันมา4-5 ฟันไม่ดีขึ้นเลย พูดจาไม่ดีตั้งแต่เคาร์เตอร์ยันหมอ อ่างบ้วนปากสกปรกมาก
0x30e2a75eea24967f_0x9d825e472b186771.author: ก๊วยจั๊บ ญวณ
0x30e2a75eea24967f_0x9d825e472b186771.en: The doctor is dragging out the treatment for too long. I've had braces on 4-5 teeth and haven't seen any improvement. Everyone from the counter staff to the doctor is rude. The mouthwash basin is also extremely dirty.

0x3051948b2126ae6f_0x14ace40d663140f7.text: I once received treatment from this doctor at Krabi Hospital. After talking to the doctor, my mental state was worse than before. The doctor was very rude and had a very sharp tongue. The doctor seemed to have mental health issues; they didn't seem suitable for a psychiatrist. Personally, I recommend the doctor get more rest so they can provide higher quality treatment. Treating patients emotionally is unprofessional and lacks standards.
0x3051948b2126ae6f_0x14ace40d663140f7.author: Norain Noflowers

0x3051948b2126ae6f_0x14ace40d663140f7.text: Very bad, starting from the female staff in front of the doctor's office, she looked bad to the patients until the patients had to talk to each other. In the end, I decided not to get treatment. I had to pay a fine of 20 baht for the card. The more I read the reviews, the happier I am that I don't have to waste more money on this place.
0x3051948b2126ae6f_0x14ace40d663140f7.author: Thungngoen Ploy

0x3051948b2126ae6f_0x14ace40d663140f7.text: After reading the reviews, I understand why people gave it 1 star. The counter staff were very rude. I initially thought they would have read the reviews and improved on the staff's poor customer service. But I experienced the same thing as many other comments. I really hope they improve their staff. 😔 …
0x3051948b2126ae6f_0x14ace40d663140f7.author: Parichat Chumphuchana

0x310295ee0a62f9a3_0xe92788a7da39aa84.text: The doctor here is very skilled and the prices are very affordable. I've been to many places that didn't work, but I've been cured here many times. I highly recommend it. But it has to be this doctor who is available from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM and from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM. These are approximate times.
0x310295ee0a62f9a3_0xe92788a7da39aa84.author: D P

0x310295ee0a62f9a3_0xe92788a7da39aa84.text: The nurses were so gentle, I thought I hadn't gotten the injection yet. The doctor spoke very politely. The clinic was clean and the procedure was fast, so I didn't have to wait long.
0x310295ee0a62f9a3_0xe92788a7da39aa84.author: SAKUNRAT PRAJUNRIT

0x310295ee0a62f9a3_0xe92788a7da39aa84.text: I've been coming to this clinic for almost 20 years. Both the nurses and the doctors are lovely. The doctor is skilled. My whole family comes here, and we always get treated here.
0x310295ee0a62f9a3_0xe92788a7da39aa84.author: Pooh Pooh

0x310295ee0a62f9a3_0xe92788a7da39aa84.text: Good service, lovely staff, reasonable prices. Closes at 8:30 PM. Convenient parking.
0x310295ee0a62f9a3_0xe92788a7da39aa84.author: ก้อย

0x310295ee0a62f9a3_0xe92788a7da39aa84.text: The treatment was terrible. The doctor only asked questions without doing any examinations. The treatment was expensive, and the medication didn't improve things. They even gave me an injection, which almost made me sick. I would never recommend this place.
0x310295ee0a62f9a3_0xe92788a7da39aa84.author: Salermoon moon

0x30e29da74cb4417d_0xa138c73b775dc393.text: I wanted to go negative, but there was no option. I came to request a referral on Tuesday, March 6, 2025, at 9:00 a.m. They said the appointment was full and I couldn't get another appointment today. They told me to reschedule my appointment with the hospital. They also posted a sign announcing new referral regulations, which I only learned about when I visited the clinic. Announcement Referral Times Tuesday, 8:30 AM - 12:00 PM (Accepting 35 cases) Thursday, 8:30 AM - 12:00 PM (Accepting 35 cases) Effective February 11, 2025 onwards Announced on February 7, 2025 Referral Regulations 1. Referrals will be issued only on Tuesdays and Thursdays. 2. Patients must come in person. 3. Request a referral three days before the appointment. 4. Original ID card/birth certificate. 5. Medical history, with one copy. 6. Hospital appointment slip, with one copy. 8:30 AM - 12:00 PM A conversation with the grandmothers, aunts, and uncles who were affected by the situation, who told me about the situation. -If you want to be sure of a spot, you have to wait in front of the clinic at 2:00 or 3:00 AM. - Requesting medical records from the hospital takes a considerable amount of time, typically two weeks or more, to be used in the referral. - One woman recounted having to reschedule her appointment with the hospital two or three times before a referral was issued. - Another recounted that her father, who has Alzheimer's, requested medical records. Of course, the hospital takes time to compile them. Everyone understands this, but wouldn't the clinic's request for patients to request them from the hospital each time increase the burden on the hospital and the patient? Patients are already sick. Don't make them suffer more. Patients will die because of regulations that trample on your patients. I hope the NHSO will address this issue. Thank you.
0x30e29da74cb4417d_0xa138c73b775dc393.author: Salmon Salmon

0x30e29da74cb4417d_0xa138c73b775dc393.text: This is the worst clinic I've ever seen in my life. They severely restrict referrals, most recently limiting them to only 35 patients per day, and only accepting patients on Tuesdays and Thursdays a week. Patients must go in person. Bedridden patients need to provide photos proving their condition. My father went to request a referral letter at 4 AM, only to find out the queue was full and he couldn't get a slot. I learned from other patients that some had been queuing since 9 PM the day before the clinic opened. Referrals are extremely difficult; they constantly refuse referrals, citing that the clinic has specialist doctors. In reality, this is beyond the capabilities of primary care, and the patients are vulnerable and seriously ill, requiring referral to hospitals with the necessary equipment and specialist care. Patients' lives aren't a business; the clinic isn't just about making money. A referral letter means the condition is beyond the clinic's authority and there's a genuine need. I feel sorry for the patients; they were already ill and now they have to suffer through long waits and emotional distress. The clinic's ethics are terrible, the staff are rude, and it's incredibly difficult to contact them. I called until my hand was numb and no one answered. If you have other options, please avoid this clinic. Another thing is that they don't care about any suggestions or criticisms here. People complain to the NHSO every day, but nothing seems to progress. It's a pity for the sick people!
0x30e29da74cb4417d_0xa138c73b775dc393.author: Oiyippee 2

0x30e29da74cb4417d_0xa138c73b775dc393.text: I came to see a doctor because I had a cough after recovering from COVID-19. Basically, I wanted to get tested, but the staff handled the situation terribly. I had tested negative for COVID-19 five days prior, but I was made to wait outside the clinic in the rain. I was exposed to the rain while my cough hadn't gone away and I have allergies. I understand there were elderly people in the clinic, but I'm recovered and free of the virus. If my test result was positive, I wouldn't complain; I would have waited outside willingly because I'm responsible enough! They even gave me medication without letting me see a doctor or getting any tests. I had to specifically ask to see a doctor and get my lungs checked because this was my second time seeing a doctor, and I was very worried. Finally, I got tested after I asked (the doctor was calm and spoke nicely). Honestly, it was a terrible experience. If I just wanted medication, I wouldn't have come to the clinic; I could have bought it myself. My purpose was to get tested. This is my first time transferring my insurance to this clinic, and this is the first time I've experienced something like this. I'm very disappointed. 09/05/67
0x30e29da74cb4417d_0xa138c73b775dc393.author: S P

0x30e29da74cb4417d_0xa138c73b775dc393.text: Today, my grandmother went to get a referral letter because the doctor had a follow-up appointment for her knee surgery. However, the same staff member refused to give it to her and told her to receive treatment at a clinic instead, giving the reason that the clinic hadn't received payment from various hospitals, or that the hospitals were paying late. I want to know if this problem is justifying the patient's actions. If it were a normal illness, we would gladly go to a clinic for treatment. But in this case, we already have the appointment slip from the hospital. My grandmother has both cancer and diabetes, so the doctor wants a follow-up appointment to prepare for surgery early next year. Honestly, I don't know if this problem lies with the clinic or the staff member at the counter. The staff member was also rude. It was just one person, and if they don't have a service-oriented attitude, they shouldn't be working there. Patients are already mentally distressed from their illnesses, and then they have to deal with this kind of service. They should have some professional ethics.
0x30e29da74cb4417d_0xa138c73b775dc393.author: Aoraea

0x30e29da74cb4417d_0xa138c73b775dc393.text: Now, they don't listen to customer feedback. Complaints are impossible. They change the rules whenever they want, without any notice of the start or enforcement period. The owner protects their employees, and while they're nice to them, that's not good for the patients. Don't expect the owner to listen; they won't. Their main revenue comes from the government, the National Health Security Office (NHSO) (which comes from taxes). Complaints are made daily, but they've been going on for years without anything being done because the government wants to increase primary care units and reduce the burden on hospitals, so they have to turn a blind eye. Both the affiliated hospitals and the clinics know this, giving them an unfair advantage. If your affiliated hospital opens up other units for referrals, move to another clinic. This place isn't good.

0x30e29e93514b0909_0x16f4b546deae9b8f.text: On March 8, 2018, I went for treatment for eye pain. I arrived around 11:30 AM. The registration desk said the doctor was on lunch break and I should wait to see a doctor after noon. I registered first and came back later. The doctor in examination room 2 examined me. I had pain in my left eye, and I didn't know what was in it, but the doctor examined my right eye. At first, I thought the doctor had examined the wrong eye, so I told him I had pain in my left eye, but he didn't examine my right eye. I didn't say anything more. The doctor only asked about my symptoms... and took my medical history... and wrote something down. Then he gave me medication. I received a bottle of eye drops, painkillers, and allergy medication, and was sent to the eye washing room next to examination room 2. After washing my eye, I asked the doctor in the eye washing room to check my eye to see if there was anything in it. The doctor said that the doctor who examined my eye had already done so. I explained that I had pain in my left eye, but the doctor in examination room 2 looked at my right eye. The eye washing doctor just glanced at it and said there was nothing. The treatment was finished. I was thinking, if there was something in my eye, how would the doctor know if I had pain in my left eye but examined my right?

0x30e2a32fa5e22f7d_0xe97fae944ea43fe9.text: A nice place and a good clinic are definitely needed for the community, but if the staff or personnel at the clinic are not good, it's not okay. I'd like to see improvement in how you communicate and answer questions. Sometimes people asking questions don't know your workflow. Don't answer as if you know everything; otherwise, you'd be the clinic owner! I understand you're stressed and tired from work, but in a service job, at least think a little. People who come for service don't want to hear negative things you say. If you're tired of this job, quit and do something else. Coordination is also important; please communicate and consult with each other so that work doesn't turn out so badly. P.S. Yes, some people may be receiving free services, but they shouldn't have to experience this kind of thing.

0x30e2a32fa5e22f7d_0xe97fae944ea43fe9.text: I had COVID-19 and paid almost 700 baht for a medical certificate, but the medication I received wasn't appropriate for my condition. I don't understand why they gave me amoxicillin; it's an antibacterial drug, and COVID-19 is a virus. Amoxicillin cannot treat COVID-19. The other medications were all basic drugs: Paracetamol, CPM, Bromhexine, and ORS. Importantly, I didn't even get to see a doctor. I waited outside for about 30 minutes before being called to pick up my medication. The staff at the counter weren't very polite either. In summary, in my opinion, the service and the medication I received weren't worth the cost of treatment.

0x311d655926d6490d_0x18e79262dc0ac8aa.en: The female dentist who works on weekends speaks nicely but is very careless with patients. I had a small amount of tartar buildup because she only charged 900 baht. During the scaling, the tip of her P5 instrument touched my lower lip, causing a wound, but she chose to lie, saying it was from a mirror. I don't want free medicine, but I want the truth. Furthermore, she didn't use a sickle to record details during the procedure. The scaling wasn't clean; there's still plaque on my front teeth. She's incredibly careless. I wouldn't be upset if she didn't apologize for her carelessness.

0x311d655926d6490d_0x18e79262dc0ac8aa.text: ถ้ามีติดลบก็จะให้ติดลบค่ะ ไปติดต่องานกับหมอแต่โดนป้าที่หน้าเคาเตอร์ด่า เสียใจที่ไม่ได้อัดเสียงมาเผื่อเอาไปแจ้งความหมิ่นประมาทได้

The hair color was nothing like the reference picture. I was very disappointed and had to buy hair dye remover to get rid of the terrible color. 0x30e2955c5bfc7765_0xc72fa55a0da1bb37.text: It was terrible. The thing is, I was walking (very quickly, practically running) when someone handed me some kind of form. At first, I refused, saying I was in a hurry. Then the employee asked if I could please sign something for them, just for a minute. I felt sorry for them, thinking, "Okay, it's just a signature, probably to keep track of who's filled out the survey or something. It won't take much time, just my name and surname." But it wasn't over. They made me sit there for almost 10 minutes, criticizing my appearance and trying to sell me a mole/freckle removal package. They said it was normally 2,000 baht per session, but today it was 1,000 baht (for two sessions). If it didn't work, they'd give me a free second session. They showed me reviews and pictures of the laser machine, saying it was very small and wouldn't leave any scars. When I made a face like I was refusing (shaking my head slightly), the employee said that if I paid today, they'd give me a free hand spa and other things. I refused, and I'm a student, so I always consult my family about expenses before doing anything. The employee even told me to tell my family... "Could you spare me 1,000 baht from your allowance?" When I heard that, I have to admit, I was completely stunned. In the end, I said, "Excuse me," and the employee even said after me, "We'll be right back." I was so upset. I just asked for one minute, but they dragged me out for almost 10 minutes.
0x30e2955c5bfc7765_0xc72fa55a0da1bb37.author: Chalita Khuntiangtham

0x30e2955c5bfc7765_0xc72fa55a0da1bb37.text: Let me share my experience. I was walking by and suddenly they handed me a voucher without warning. I shook my head and refused, but they insisted until I accepted. Then they told me to sign up and enter my phone number in just one minute—which was completely untrue. They asked me countless questions and even insulted me, saying I had a lot of acne and should focus on acne treatment first. They also said my face was uneven. It was a really upsetting experience. I initially signed up because I felt sorry for them, but instead, I was criticized and blamed. There are countless ways to interact with customers or answer questions, but they chose to use such language. Who would want to do business with them?
0x30e2955c5bfc7765_0xc72fa55a0da1bb37.author: ชาติชาย ขันประมาณ

0x30e2955c5bfc7765_0xc72fa55a0da1bb37.text: The salespeople here are really pushy. They keep refusing, and some of them just won't stop. I ended up spending 3,000 baht, and they wouldn't let me pay in installments. I finally gave in. You could say I was stupid. 🥲 And even after they finished and I walked out, they still tried to sell me more, saying things like, "Can you please buy something? Help me with my work!" I was so annoyed. They only cared about their own work and didn't care about the customer at all. Especially since I'm a student, they just kept trying to suck me out of my money. It was terrible. I'm completely fed up with this place. I highly do not recommend it.
0x30e2955c5bfc7765_0xc72fa55a0da1bb37.author: Nicole Van der Schoot

0x30e2955c5bfc7765_0xc72fa55a0da1bb37.text: It was awful. They pulled me in just as I was walking past, trying to get me to fill out a form and give them a rating. Even after I left, they kept saying things like, "Are you sure you don't want it? The price is really cheap!" I just walked away with my head held high.
