0x305195cccb07b84d_0x9daf52f0fb5505cb.text: On February 7th, 2025, I went for a PRP treatment for hair loss. The wait was extremely long. I arrived at 4 PM and didn't finish until after 6 PM. The doctor was rude and abrupt. The blood draw was very painful and left a wound that took three days to heal. When it was time for the injection in my head, she just poked me repeatedly without asking if it hurt. Afterward, she didn't say anything or give any instructions. The assistant just patted my head and said, "That's it," and then walked me out. I just left, thinking, "One time here is enough. Don't expect a next time.
0x305195cccb07b84d_0x9daf52f0fb5505cb.author: วุฒินันท์ บุญนาค

0x305195cccb07b84d_0x9daf52f0fb5505cb.text: I booked a "buy one get one free" skin injection promotion, but when I arrived, the staff said there wasn't enough medication and only one injection was needed. I was confused, why advertise a "buy one get one free" promotion if there wasn't enough medication? The staff seemed indifferent and just wanted to get it over with. The doctor wasn't very polite either; it seemed like they were busy and in a hurry. I recommend improving the service. I only went once and won't be going back, and I won't recommend it to others. That's it.

0x311d65c6438eba33_0x80c3bc95355251cc.text: We've switched to a new doctor, and the clinic feels much brighter now. The new doctor inquired about my symptoms and gave excellent advice. The counter staff were also very helpful and polite.
0x311d65c6438eba33_0x80c3bc95355251cc.author: วาสนา โต๊ะหมัน

0x311d65c6438eba33_0x80c3bc95355251cc.text: Today after work, I took my son to get his wound cleaned and I was furious. The nurse was incredibly rude. The doctor, meanwhile, walked into the room without even looking at the wound, just said "Hmm" and left. He didn't even glance at the wound on my son's forehead. The total cost was 400 baht. The wound cleaning cost 150 baht. They only applied Betadine, didn't even use alcohol, and used a non-waterproof gauze bandage. The doctor's fee was 250 baht. He just walked in and said "Hmm," and that was it. 250 baht. In contrast, yesterday at another clinic, the doctor and nurses were exceptionally polite. The doctor cleaned the wound himself and charged only 85 baht (including alcohol disinfectant, ointment, and a good quality waterproof bandage). The amount of money isn't huge, but I was shaking with anger at their actions.
0x311d65c6438eba33_0x80c3bc95355251cc.author: ธรรมธิเบศร ตรีโภคา

0x311d65c6438eba33_0x80c3bc95355251cc.text: I called to inquire before using the service that my younger brother had an ingrown toenail and wanted the doctor to check if it would be removed or if he needed to take medicine. The person who answered the phone said the doctor was in. When I got there, they said the doctor wasn't in because he had an urgent case, but they didn't call to inform me of anything. The next day, I called to inform them that the doctor was in, but when I got there, they said they didn't have the treatment equipment and had to send me to the hospital. What's going on? When you came to promote the service to people, you should have told them everything the clinic had ready. It's a waste of time. If I had known, I wouldn't have moved from the beginning. It would have been over.
0x311d65c6438eba33_0x80c3bc95355251cc.author: npxjay_

0x311d65c6438eba33_0x80c3bc95355251cc.text: Does this clinic hire employees to play on their phones? I went in today and the employees spoke rudely, didn't look welcoming, and seemed like they didn't want to work. Then they told me to go buy medicine at the pharmacy. Why open a clinic like this? I asked to speak to the doctor, but they said I couldn't because he wasn't there. Last time the doctor wasn't there, they were able to contact me and ask. But this time, there was no effort at all. Very bad.
0x311d65c6438eba33_0x80c3bc95355251cc.author: hana nohkasem

0x311d65c6438eba33_0x80c3bc95355251cc.text: Of all the clinics I've been to, I've never felt as bad as this one. I was sick and had to sit outside in the sun waiting. The staff seemed so hostile, but I could tolerate them. They gave me flu tests and COVID tests, but when they came back negative, they still left me waiting. They were so hostile. I felt really bad. I truly feel for them. They don't have to be so indifferent and hostile. I can't take it anymore.
0x311d65c6438eba33_0x80c3bc95355251cc.author: ปนัดดา นุชแดง

0x311d65c6438eba33_0x80c3bc95355251cc.text: The staff is incompetent. How could they forget to return the patient's ID card? It wasted so much time. They didn't even apologize or show any remorse.
